verses.name: Genesis 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1"/><div sID="gen8" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tagna'an Dunya itu</title> <div sID="gen9" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1"/> Ma tagna'anna to'ongan, Tuhan ya bay amapanjari dunya maka langit.

verses.name: Genesis 1:2
verses.text: Na, ma waktu kapamapanjari, in dunya halam gi' aniya' pangluwahanna maka halam gi' aniya' ai-aina. Aheya kal'ddoman ma sakalibutna maka alimun e' bohe' tegob-tegoban. Ina'an isab Rū<note>Rū Tuhan: ‘Nyawa Tuhan’ bang ma kasehe'an.</note> Tuhan magpehē'-pi'itu min diyata' bohe' inān.  <div eID="gen9" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2"/><div sID="gen10" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2"/> Na angallam Tuhan, yukna, “Subay aniya' sawa.” Magtūy paniya' sawa.

verses.name: Genesis 1:4
verses.text: Pag'nda' Tuhan ma sawa inān, kasulutan iya. Puwas e' pinasaddī e'na sawa maka l'ddom.

verses.name: Genesis 1:5
verses.text: Ya pangōnna ma sawa ‘llaw’, ati ya pangōnna ma l'ddom ‘sangom’. Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw na, ya na tagna'an llaw.  <div eID="gen10" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3"/><div sID="gen11" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3"/> Puwas e' angallam Tuhan pabīng, yukna, “Subay aniya' pagtonga'an ma llot bohe' min deyo' maka bohe' min diyata'.” Magtūy paniya'.

verses.name: Genesis 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3"/><div sID="gen11" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3"/> Puwas e' angallam Tuhan pabīng, yukna, “Subay aniya' pagtonga'an ma llot bohe' min deyo' maka bohe' min diyata'.” Magtūy paniya'.

verses.name: Genesis 1:8
verses.text: Na, ya pangōn Tuhan ma pagtonga'an e' ‘langit’. Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw, llaw karuwana na.  <div eID="gen11" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4"/><div sID="gen12" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4"/> Angallam na isab Tuhan, yukna, “Ya bohe' ma deyo'an langit subay pinagtimuk ma dakayu' pat'nna'an supaya aniya' tana' atoho'.” Magtūy paniya'.

verses.name: Genesis 1:10
verses.text: ‘Tana'’ ya pangōn Tuhan ma gintana'an, ati ‘tahik’ ya pangōnna ma bohe' pinagtimuk e'. Pag'nda' Tuhan ma hinangna inān, kasulutan iya.  <div eID="gen12" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5"/><div sID="gen13" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5"/> Manjari itu, angallam na Tuhan, yukna, “Subay patomo' ai-ai ma tana' itu, kaginisan tinanom magbibinhi'<note>Magbibinhi' atawa magbibigi.</note> maka kaginisan kayu magbubuwa', ya taga-binhi' isab.” Magtūy aniya' paltomo'-tomo'an indaginis ma gintana'an,

verses.name: Genesis 1:12
verses.text: saga tinanom magbibinhi' maka saga kakayuhan magbubuwa' ma ginis-ginisanna. Pag'nda' Tuhan, kasulutan iya.

verses.name: Genesis 1:13
verses.text: Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw, llaw kat'lluna na.  <div eID="gen13" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6"/><div sID="gen14" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6"/> Angallam isab Tuhan, yukna, “Subay aniya' saga sawa ma diyata' langit pamasaddī llaw min sangom, manjari aniya' pamandogahan llaw maka tahun maka musim<note>Musim: tonga' tahun.</note>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:15
verses.text: Saga sawa he' subay asinag ma diyata' langit supaya amasawa dunya.” Magtūy paniya' sawa.

verses.name: Genesis 1:16
verses.text: Aniya' tahinang e' Tuhan duwa sawa a'aslag, ya na mata llaw maka bulan. Mata llaw ya akosog amuwan sawa ma waktu llaw, bo' bulan ya amuwan sawa ma waktu sangom. Tapaniya'na isab saga bitu'un.

verses.name: Genesis 1:17
verses.text: Manjari saga sawa itu pinat'nna' e' Tuhan ma diyata' langit supaya pamasawa dunya

verses.name: Genesis 1:18
verses.text: ma waktu llaw maka ma waktu sangom, bo' aniya' pagbidda'an sawa maka l'ddom. Na, pag'nda' Tuhan ma bay hinangna itu, kasulutan iya.

verses.name: Genesis 1:19
verses.text: Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw, llaw ka'mpatna na.  <div eID="gen14" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7"/><div sID="gen15" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7"/> Angallam isab Tuhan, yukna, “Ya tahik maka bohe' subay ap'nno' e' ginisan sattuwa anahut-a'aslag. Subay isab aheka ginisan manuk-manuk magleyangan ma tonga'an ayan.”

verses.name: Genesis 1:21
verses.text: Manjari itu pinapanjari e' Tuhan saga sattuwa aheya ya maglahat ma tahik, maka ai-ai maglangihan atawa maglelehan ma tahik maka ma bohe'. Pinapanjari isab e'na kamemon ginisan manuk-manuk magleyangan. Na, pag'nda' Tuhan, kasulutan iya.

verses.name: Genesis 1:22
verses.text: Manjari itu binarakatan e' Tuhan bay pinapanjari e'na inān kamemon. Yukna ma ai-ai ma tahik, “Bang pa'in kam paheka supaya ap'nno' e'bi tahik ilu.” Yukna isab ma saga manuk-manuk, “Bang pa'in kam paheka.”

verses.name: Genesis 1:23
verses.text: Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw, llaw kalimana na.  <div eID="gen15" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8"/><div sID="gen16" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8"/> Angallam Tuhan, yukna, “Subay aniya' ba'anan kaginisan ma deya, saga hayop ni'ipat maka saga sattuwa talun, maka ai-ai isab maglelehan ma tana'.” Magtūy paniya' na.

verses.name: Genesis 1:25
verses.text: Hatina tahinang e' Tuhan saga kasattuwahan talun maka kahayopan maka ba'anan ai-ai ya maglelehan ma tana'. Pag'nda' Tuhan ma bay tahinangna, kasulutan iya.  <div eID="gen16" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9"/><div sID="gen17" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9"/> Manjari angallam isab Tuhan, yukna, “Papanjarita manusiya' pinasali' ni kita. Sigām ya pinapagbaya' ma ai-ai kamemon ma kaluha'an dunya itu, ma saga daing, ma saga ai-ai magleyangan, ma saga hayop maka sattuwa, maka ma sasuku isab maglelehan ma tana'.” <lg sID="gen18"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:27
verses.text: Manjari pinapanjari manusiya' e' Tuhan ma buwat kajarihanna.<l eID="gen19" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20"/>Pinas'ppu sigām ni iya,<l eID="gen20" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen21"/>nihinang sigām l'lla maka d'nda.<l eID="gen21" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen18"/>  <div eID="gen17" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10"/><div sID="gen22" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10"/> Binarakatan sigām e' Tuhan. Yukna ma sigām, “Anganak kam paheka bo' pasaplag panubu'bi ma kaluha'an dunya ilu. Jari ka'am ya subay magbaya' ma dunya. Pagbaya'inbi saga daing maka saga manuk-manuk, sampay ai-ai kamemon ya taga-napas ma kareya-reyahan.”  <div eID="gen22" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11"/><div sID="gen23" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11"/> Angallam lagi' Tuhan, yukna, “Na, buwananta kam takakanbi saga tinanom magbibinhi' maka saga kayu magbubuwa', ya taga-binhi' isab.

verses.name: Genesis 1:30
verses.text: Pamuwanku isab kaparangan maka dahun kayu takakan e' saga sattuwa talun maka saga manuk-manuk sampay sasuku maglelehan ma tana'.” Magtūy tahinang buwat bay panoho'an Tuhan e'.

verses.name: Genesis 1:31
verses.text: Manjari pag'nda' Tuhan ma kamemon bay pinapanjari e'na, kasulutan to'ongan iya. Puwas pa'in sangom bo' llaw, llaw ka'nnomna na.  <div eID="gen23" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.1"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:1
verses.text: Buwattē' bay pamapanjari dunya maka langit maka kamemon ai-aina.  <div eID="gen24" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12"/><div sID="gen25" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12"/> Ta'abut llaw kapitu'na, aubus na Tuhan ma kamemon hinangna ati pahali na iya.

verses.name: Genesis 2:3
verses.text: Binarakatan e' Tuhan llaw kapitu' he', minulliya e'na, sabab ya he' llaw bay kahalina min hinangna amapanjari ma kamemon ai-ai.  <div eID="gen25" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv13"/><div sID="gen26" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Mbo' Adam maka si Sitti Hawa</title> <div sID="gen27" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv13"/> Na, buwattē' ya pamapanjari langit maka dunya. <div eID="gen27" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen28" type="paragraph"/> Tagna' bay kapamapanjari <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan<note><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan: atawa ‘Tuhan Yawe.’ Yawe itu dī ōn Tuhan, sagō' mbal agon kasandalan kawasana angkan mbal tak'bbat e' bangsa Yahudi. <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya pamaganti' sigām bang amassa Kitab.</note> ma langit maka dunya,

verses.name: Genesis 2:5
verses.text: halam gi' aniya' tinanom patomo', halam gi' aniya' pasaha', sabab halam gi' aniya' ulan bay pinabeya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan ni dunya. Halam gi' aniya' manusiya' isab angisbat ma tana' pagtanoman,

verses.name: Genesis 2:6
verses.text: sagō' abase' tana' e' bohe' ya patubud min deyo'.  <div eID="gen28" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv14"/><div sID="gen29" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv14"/> Manjari itu aniya' tana' niā' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan, kinompol e'na nihinang baran a'a. Ninapasan e'na napas kallum ni ūng a'a inān ati tahinang iya manusiya' taga-napas na.  <div eID="gen29" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv15"/><div sID="gen30" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv15"/> Na aniya' kabbun bay pinatomo' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan ma lahat Eden, tampal ni sobangan. Manjari in manusiya' bay hinangna inān tapat'nna' e'na maina'an ma kabbun.

verses.name: Genesis 2:9
verses.text: Aniya' isab pinatomo' e' Tuhan ma kabbun inān kamemon ginisan kayu ya ahāp ni'nda' maka ahāp kinakan buwa'na. Ina'an isab ma t'ngnga' kabbun dampo'on kayu ya makabuwan kallum, maka ina'an isab dampo'on kayu makabuwan pangita'u pasal kahāpan maka kala'atan.  <div eID="gen30" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv16"/><div sID="gen31" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv16"/> Aniya' sapa' anasahan min lahat Eden amohe'an kakayuhan ma kabbun. Paluwas pa'in min Eden, in sapa' inān magsanga mpat.

verses.name: Genesis 2:11
verses.text: Dakayu' sangana inān, ya na sapa' Peson, anasahan pehē' tudju ni kaluha'an lahat Habila. Aniya' dī bulawan ma lahat ina'an-i

verses.name: Genesis 2:12
verses.text: maka aniya' du isab maina'an saga palmata maka bulitik kayu pahamut.

verses.name: Genesis 2:13
verses.text: Ya sanga karuwana, ya na sapa' Gehon, anasahan pehē' ni kaluha'an lahat Kūs.

verses.name: Genesis 2:14
verses.text: Sanga kat'lluna, ya na sapa' Tigris, anasahan pehē' tudju ni lahat Assiriya min bihingna tampal ni sobangan. Maka sanga ka'mpatna inān, ya na sapa' Alpurati.  <div eID="gen31" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv17"/><div sID="gen32" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv17"/> Sakali in manusiya' binowa e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan bo' pinat'nna' ma lahat Eden. Sinō' iya maghuma maka angisbat kabbunna.

verses.name: Genesis 2:16
verses.text: Magpanoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan ma iya, yukna, “Makajari ka amangan buwa' kayu ai-ai kabaya'annu mailu.

verses.name: Genesis 2:17
verses.text: Ya sadja mbal takakannu buwa' kayu ya makabuwan pangita'u pasal kahāpan maka kala'atan. Ebot-ebot to'ongan, da'a ka amangan. Ya llaw kapamangannu, ya na llaw kamataynu.”  <div eID="gen32" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv18"/><div sID="gen33" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv18"/> Manjari ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan, yukna, “Mbal ahāp bang l'lla itu karangan-danganan. Hinanganku iya limbang makatōp ma iya bo' aniya' sehe'na makatabang.”

verses.name: Genesis 2:19
verses.text: Jari binowa e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan kamemon saga hayop maka sattuwa maka kamemon saga manuk-manuk ya bay hinangna min tana'. Binowa e'na pehē' ni l'lla inān supaya kinata'uwan bang ai pangōnna ma ba'anan sattuwa, hayop maka manuk-manuk e'. Manjari ai-ai pangōnna ma sasuku taga-napas inān, ya na he' ōnna.

verses.name: Genesis 2:20
verses.text: Sakali kaōnan e' l'lla inān kamemon saga sattuwa maka hayop maka saga manuk-manuk, malaingkan halam aniya' minsan dakayu' makatōp ma iya.  <div eID="gen33" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv19"/><div sID="gen34" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv19"/> Angkan pinatuli a'a itu e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan. Ahaluk pa'in tulina, niā' e' Tuhan dakayu' gusukna, ati tinaplok pabīng maka isi ya bay pangā'an gusuk.

verses.name: Genesis 2:22
verses.text: Jari aniya' d'nda nihinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan min gusuk l'lla, ati binowa e'na pehē' ni l'lla.  <div eID="gen34" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv20"/><div sID="gen35" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv20"/> Angabtang magtūy l'lla, yukna, <lg sID="gen36"/> <l level="1" sID="gen37"/>“Ndū', itiya' na sali'ku.<l eID="gen37" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen38"/>Bokog<note>Bokog atawa to'olang.</note> sin bokogku,<l eID="gen38" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen39"/>isi sin isiku.<l eID="gen39" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen40"/>Ōnanku iya ‘d'nda’<l eID="gen40" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen41"/>sabab bay iya ningā' min l'lla.”<note>D'nda: ‘ISHA’ ma bahasa Hibrani. L'lla ‘ISH’.</note><l eID="gen41" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen36"/>  <div eID="gen35" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv21"/><div sID="gen42" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv21"/> Ya ilu sababanna angkan l'lla pabutas min okoman ina'-mma'na bo' parakayu' ni h'ndana. Manjari tahinang sigām dabaran.  <div eID="gen42" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv22"/><div sID="gen43" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv22"/> Na, in l'lla maka d'nda itu anantang sali'-sali', sagō' halam sigām aiya'.  <div eID="gen43" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.2"/> <div eID="gen26" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><div sID="gen44" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tagna' Manusiya' Magdusa ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen45" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/> Na, ma kamemon sattuwa bay pinapanjari e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan, sowa ya ataha' akkalna. Manjari atilaw sowa inān ma d'nda, yukna, “B'nnal bahā'? Bay kam nilāng e' Tuhan, sinō' da'a amangan buwa' kayu ai-ai ma kabbun ilu?”  <div eID="gen45" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv24"/><div sID="gen46" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv24"/> Ya sambung d'nda, “Makajari kami amangan min saga buwa' kayu ma kabbun itu,

verses.name: Genesis 3:3
verses.text: sagō' aniya' pangalāngan kami e' Tuhan. Sinō' kami da'a amangan buwa' kayu ya ma t'ngnga' kabbun itu. Minsan hal ni'ntanan buwa' inān, na amatay kami.”  <div eID="gen46" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv25"/><div sID="gen47" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv25"/> Yuk sowa, “Ā! Mbal du kam amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 3:5
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pamissala Tuhan, sabab kata'uwanna asal bang kam ganta' makakakan, makata'u kam kahāpan maka kala'atan, hatina tahinang kam sali' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen47" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><div sID="gen48" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/> Sakali itu, pag'nda' d'nda ni buwa' kayu-i, kalingkatan iya. Buwa'na inān ahāp kinakan, ahāp isab pangā'an pangita'u. Jari ang'ttu' iya buwa' min kayu inān bo' kinakan e'na. Binuwanan isab e'na h'llana, ati kinakan e'na.

verses.name: Genesis 3:7
verses.text: Aubus pa'in sigām amangan, magtūy aniya' panayu sigām in sigām anantang sali'-sali'. Manjari angā' sigām dahun kayu igira<note>Igira: ginis po'on kayu taga-buwa' ahāp kinakan.</note> tinuhug-tuhug e' sigām nihinang panambun.  <div eID="gen48" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><div sID="gen49" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/> Na, akohap-kohap pa'in lahat, takale e' sigām bahonos <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan pal'ngngan min deyom kakabbunan e'. Magtūy sigām patapuk karuwangan ma deyom kakayu-kayuhan supaya mbal ta'nda' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 3:9
verses.text: Sagō' angalingan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan ma l'lla, yukna, “Maingga na ka?”  <div eID="gen49" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv28"/><div sID="gen50" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv28"/> Ya sambung l'lla, “Takaleku bahonosnu mailu ma kabbun ati tināw aku ma sabab anantang aku. Angkan aku patapuk.”  <div eID="gen50" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv29"/><div sID="gen51" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv29"/> Atilaw Tuhan, yukna, “Sai bay amata'u ka'a ya ka'a ilu anantang? Bay ka makakakan bahā' min buwa' kayu, ya bay pangalānganku ma ka'a?”  <div eID="gen51" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv30"/><div sID="gen52" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv30"/> Yuk sambung l'lla, “O'o, ya d'nda bay pamalimbangnu aku, iya ya bay amuwanan aku, angkan aku bay makakakan.”  <div eID="gen52" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv31"/><div sID="gen53" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv31"/> Tinilaw d'nda isab e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan, yukna, “Angay ka makahinang buwattilu?” <div eID="gen53" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen54" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung d'nda, “O'o, ya sowa e'. Pinarupang aku e'na, ya angkan aku makakakan.”  <div eID="gen54" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv32"/><div sID="gen55" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv32"/> Manjari amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan ma sowa he', yukna, <div eID="gen55" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen56" type="paragraph"/> “Pagka tahinangnu ina'an-i, ka'a ya taluwa' mulka' <lg sID="gen57"/> <l level="2" sID="gen58"/>labi lagi' min kamemon sattuwa maka hayop.<l eID="gen58" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen59"/>Sat'ggolnu allum<l eID="gen59" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen60"/>palele du ka maka b'ttongnu,<l eID="gen60" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen61"/>bagunbun isab ya pagkakannu.<l eID="gen61" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen62"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:15
verses.text: Pagbantata ka maka d'nda itu.<l eID="gen62" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen63"/>Panubu'nu maka panubu'na<l eID="gen63" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen64"/>magbanta du saumul-umul.<l eID="gen64" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen65"/>Kōknu ya gini'ikan e' panubu'na,<l eID="gen65" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen66"/>maka buli' tape'na ya tanghabnu.”<l eID="gen66" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen67"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:16
verses.text: Amissala isab Tuhan ma d'nda, yukna,<l eID="gen67" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen68"/>“Na, buwattitu pangangganta'ku ma ka'a,<l eID="gen68" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen69"/>ganapanku to'ongan kasusahannu bang ka ab'ttong,<l eID="gen69" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen70"/>kap'ddi'an to'ongan ka bang ka anganak.<l eID="gen70" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen71"/>Daipara minsan buwattē',<l eID="gen71" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen72"/>h'llanu ya kabilahiannu na pa'in,<l eID="gen72" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen73"/>maka iya ya makapagbaya' ma ka'a.”<l eID="gen73" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen57"/>  <div eID="gen56" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv33"/><div sID="gen74" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv33"/> Ya pamissala Tuhan ma l'lla, “Ka'a isab, ma sabab kapameya'nu ma lling h'ndanu, ati kakannu buwa' kayu ya bay pangalānganku ka'a, <lg sID="gen75"/> <l level="1" sID="gen76"/>Na, sapdahanku tana' ma sababannu.<l eID="gen76" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen77"/>Subay ka kahunitan to'ongan amiha kalluman min tana'<l eID="gen77" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen78"/>sat'ggolnu allum.<l eID="gen78" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen79"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:18
verses.text: Patomo' kasagmotan indaginis ma tana'nu,<l eID="gen79" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen80"/>kasagmotan aheka itingna.<l eID="gen80" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen81"/>Jari maghulas-sangsā' du ka<l eID="gen81" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen82"/>supaya aniya' takakannu<l eID="gen82" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen83"/>sampay ni llaw pamole'nu ni deyom tana'.<l eID="gen83" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen84"/>Tana' asal bay pamapanjarihan ka'a,<l eID="gen84" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen85"/>maka tana' ya pamole'annu.”<l eID="gen85" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen75"/>  <div eID="gen74" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:19
verses.text: Patomo' kasagmotan indaginis ma tana'nu,<l eID="gen79" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen80"/>kasagmotan aheka itingna.<l eID="gen80" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen81"/>Jari maghulas-sangsā' du ka<l eID="gen81" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen82"/>supaya aniya' takakannu<l eID="gen82" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen83"/>sampay ni llaw pamole'nu ni deyom tana'.<l eID="gen83" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen84"/>Tana' asal bay pamapanjarihan ka'a,<l eID="gen84" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen85"/>maka tana' ya pamole'annu.”<l eID="gen85" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen75"/>  <div eID="gen74" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv34"/><div sID="gen86" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv34"/> Manjari ya pangōn si Adam<note>Ya ōn Adam itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘manusiya'’. Pa'anggil isab ma dakayu' kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘tana'’.</note> ma h'ndana ‘Hawa’<note>Ya ōn Hawa itu, hatina ma bahasa Hibrani ‘llum’ sabab ina' iya ma bangsa manusiya' kamemon.</note>.  <div eID="gen86" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv35"/><div sID="gen87" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv35"/> Na, aniya' kuwit hayop nihinang s'mmek e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan panambun baran si Adam maka h'ndana.  <div eID="gen87" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv36"/><div sID="gen88" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv36"/> Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan, yukna, “In manusiya' itu sali' kita na, pagka makata'u na ahāp-ala'at. Mbal iya makajari ama'abut tanganna ang'ttu' buwa' kayu ya makabuwan kallum. Mbal iya subay pinarūl allum salama-lama.”

verses.name: Genesis 3:23
verses.text: Angkan na disi Adam pinaluwas e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Tuhan min kabbun Eden. Sinō' iya maghuma ma tana' bay pangahinangan iya.

verses.name: Genesis 3:24
verses.text: Tapaluwas pa'in, aniya' mala'ikat taga-pikpik pinat'nna' e' Tuhan ma bihing kabbun Eden inān tampal ni sobangan. Aniya' isab pinat'nna' maina'an dakayu' kalis magsuleyab keyatna. Maglabad sadja, supaya halam aniya' palabayan tudju ni po'on kayu ya makabuwan kallum salama-lama.  <div eID="gen88" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.3"/> <div eID="gen44" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv37"/><div sID="gen89" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Kabil maka si Habil</title> <div sID="gen90" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv37"/> Na, maghulid na si Adam maka h'ndana si Hawa, jari ab'ttong iya ati anganak l'lla, ōnna si Kabil.<note>Ya ōn Kabil itu pa'anggil ma dakayu' lapal Hibrani, hatina ‘kaniya'an.’ ‘Cain’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> Ya lling si Hawa, “Min tabang-tulung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe kabuwanan aku anak l'lla.”

verses.name: Genesis 4:2
verses.text: Puwas e' ab'ttong si Hawa pabīng ati anganak isab l'lla, ōnna si Habil.<note>Habil: ‘Abel’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> Na, asangpot pa'in sigām, si Habil tahinang a'a magi'ipat bili-bili, bo' si Kabil ya tahinang a'a maghuhuma.

verses.name: Genesis 4:3
verses.text: Na, ta'abut pa'in ajatu tanoman si Kabil, aniya' saga buwa' binowa e'na panukbalna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<note><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>: atawa Yawe, ya dī ōn Tuhan.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:4
verses.text: Ya tinukbal e' si Habil dakayu' bili-bili ya bay dahū nianakan ma ba'anan bili-bilina. Sinumbali' e'na bo' yampa tukbalanna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> isina ya ahāp to'ongan. Na, kasulutan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma hinang si Habil buwattē' ati tinaima' tutukbalanna.

verses.name: Genesis 4:5
verses.text: Malaingkan si Kabil maka saga buwa' ya tutukbalanna halam tinaima' e' Tuhan. Jari akagit magtūy atay si Kabil, ala'at isab s'mmuna.

verses.name: Genesis 4:6
verses.text: Manjari ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Kabil, yukna, “Otō', angay akagit ataynu? Angay angkan ala'at s'mmunu?

verses.name: Genesis 4:7
verses.text: Bang taluwa' hinangnu tantu du aku kasulutan ma ka'a. Damikiyanna bang mbal taluwa', na, ilu mailu dusa angagad anasat ma ka'a. Ya kabaya'anna subay ang'ntanan ka'a, sagō' subay atuhannu.”  <div eID="gen90" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv38"/><div sID="gen91" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv38"/> Manjari itu ah'lling si Kabil ma siyalina si Habil, yukna, “Otō', sūng kita pehē' ni huma.” Ma huma pa'in, binono' si Habil e' si Kabil pinapatay.  <div eID="gen91" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv39"/><div sID="gen92" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv39"/> Atilaw <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Kabil, yukna, “Maingga siyalinu?” <div eID="gen92" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen93" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Kabil, “Sitta'a. Angay? Hinangku bahā' anganjagahan danakanku?”  <div eID="gen93" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv40"/><div sID="gen94" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv40"/> Manjari ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Angay angkan tahinangnu ilu-i! Sumbang ko' ilu! O'ō, ilu laha' siyalinu sapantun a'a mikibalos ma aku min deyom tana'.

verses.name: Genesis 4:11
verses.text: Na, taluwa' sapda du ka. Mbal na ka makabāk kalluman min tana' ilu sabab kasobsoban na e' laha' siyalinu.

verses.name: Genesis 4:12
verses.text: Minsan buwattingga pagtuyu'nu maghinang ma tana', mbal ajatu tinanomnu. Maglunsulan sadja ka pi'ingga-pi'ingga ma dunya itu, sagō' mbal ka makabāk lahat pat'ttogannu.”  <div eID="gen94" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv41"/><div sID="gen95" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv41"/> Ah'lling si Kabil ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Arōy! Abuhat makalandu' ya paniksa'nu ma aku!

verses.name: Genesis 4:14
verses.text: Itiya' aku pala'annu min tana' bay paghuma'anku, maka palawaknu aku min matahannu. Halam du aniya' lahat pat'ttoganku ma dunya itu, tahinang aku a'a magsampig-manampig sadja. Bang aku ganta' talanggal e' sai-sai, binono' du aku pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen95" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv42"/><div sID="gen96" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv42"/> Sagō' ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, “Mbal du. Bang aniya' amono' ka'a subay iya binalosan min pitu'.” Magtūy aniya' gindan pinat'nna' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Kabil supaya iya takilā e' sai-sai makalanggal ma iya. Hatina mbal iya makajari binono'.

verses.name: Genesis 4:16
verses.text: Manjari itu ala'an na si Kabil min alopan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pehē' ni lahat Nōd<note>Ya kabtangan Nōd itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘magsampig-manampig.’</note> ma dambila' Eden tampal ni sobangan, ati mahē' iya pat'nna'.  <div eID="gen96" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen89" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv43"/><div sID="gen97" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panubu' si Kabil</title> <div sID="gen98" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv43"/> Na, magdakayu' si Kabil maka h'ndana ati angiram iya. Maka'anak iya l'lla ōnna si Idris. Manjari si Kabil ya bay makahinang kauman, niōnan e'na Idris buwat ōn anakna he'.

verses.name: Genesis 4:18
verses.text: Si Idris itu taga-anak l'lla, ōnna si Irad ya mma' si Mihuja'il. Si Mihuja'il taga-anak isab l'lla, ōnna si Mitusail ya mma' si Lamek.

verses.name: Genesis 4:19
verses.text: Si Lamek itu duwa h'ndana, si Ada maka si Silla.

verses.name: Genesis 4:20
verses.text: Manjari anganak si Ada l'lla, ōnna si Jabal. Si Jabal itu panagna'an saga manusiya' magi'ipat hayop maka magluma' tolda ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Genesis 4:21
verses.text: Aniya' isab siyali si Jabal ōnna si Jubal. Si Jubal ya panagna'an manusiya' apanday magsuling maka maggitara.<note>Suling: ‘flute’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis. Gitara: Gitara sigām ma masa ina'an-i niōnan ‘harp’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:22
verses.text: Na, si Silla isab anganak l'lla, ōnna si Tubal-Kabil. Apanday iya magsasal tumbaga maka basi' nihinang kapanyapan kaginisan. Aniya' isab siyali si Tubal-Kabil d'nda, ōnna si Na'ama.  <div eID="gen98" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv44"/><div sID="gen99" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv44"/> Manjari amissala si Lamek ma saga h'ndana, yukna, <lg sID="gen100"/> <l level="1" sID="gen101"/>“O Ada, O Silla, ka'am h'ndaku, kalehunbi kabtanganku.<l eID="gen101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen102"/>Bay aku makapatay subul<l eID="gen102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen103"/>ma sabab kapangalagutna ma aku.<l eID="gen103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen104"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:24
verses.text: Na, bang bineya' bissala Tuhan ma si Kabil<l eID="gen104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen105"/>in iya subay binalosan min pitu',<l eID="gen105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen106"/>ya lagi'na bang aniya' amono' aku,<l eID="gen106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen107"/>a'a inān subay binalosan min pitumpū' maka pitu'.”<l eID="gen107" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen100"/>  <div eID="gen99" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen97" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv45"/><div sID="gen108" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Sēt maka anakna si Enos</title> <div sID="gen109" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv45"/> Jari maghulid isab si Adam maka h'ndana, ati kabuwanan na isab sigā anak l'lla. Yuk si Hawa, “Itiya' aku pinasuku'an anak l'lla e' Tuhan, pangangganti' ma si Habil ya bay binono' e' si Kabil.” Sakali niōnan e'na Sēt.<note>Ya ōn Sēt itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘pinasuku'an.’</note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:26
verses.text: Na, si Sēt taga-anak l'lla ōnna si Enos. Masa si Enos e', ya na masa panagna'an manusiya' anabbut ōn Yawe<note>Si Yawe, ya dī ōn Tuhan.</note> pagtuhanan sigām.  <div eID="gen109" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.4"/> <div eID="gen108" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv46"/><div sID="gen110" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Mbo' Adam</title> <div sID="gen111" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv46"/> Ya na itu salsila panugsugan si Adam. Ma waktu pamapanjari Tuhan ma manusiya' bay sigām pina'anggil ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 5:2
verses.text: Pinapanjari sigām e'na d'nda maka l'lla. Binarakatan sigām e'na ati manusiya' ya pangōnna ma sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 5:3
verses.text: Na, pagabut dahatus maka t'llumpū' tahun umul si Adam, aniya' anakna l'lla an'ppu iya, ōnna si Sēt.

verses.name: Genesis 5:4
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Sēt, aniya' gi' walu' hatus tahun umul si Adam, maka aniya' gi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:5
verses.text: Manjari pagabut siyam hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun umul si Adam, awapat<note>Awapat: hatina ‘amatay’, kabtangan tinōp ma a'a bangsahan.</note> na iya.  <div eID="gen111" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv47"/><div sID="gen112" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv47"/> Na si Sēt isab, dahatus pa'in maka limantahun umulna, aniya' anakna l'lla, ōnna si Enos.

verses.name: Genesis 5:7
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Enos e', aniya' gi' walu' hatus maka pituntahun umul si Sēt, maka aniya' gi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:8
verses.text: Jari pagabut siyam hatus maka sangpū' maka duwantahun umul si Sēt, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen112" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv48"/><div sID="gen113" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv48"/> Na, si Enos isab, pagabut siyampū' tahun umulna, taga-anak iya l'lla, ōnna si Kenan.

verses.name: Genesis 5:10
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Kenan, aniya' gi' walu' hatus maka sangpū' maka limantahun umul si Enos, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:11
verses.text: Na, pagabut siyam hatus maka limantahun umul si Enos, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen113" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv49"/><div sID="gen114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv49"/> Si Kenan isab, pagabut umulna pitumpū' tahun, aniya' anakna l'lla, ōnna si Mahalalel.

verses.name: Genesis 5:13
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Mahalalel, aniya' gi' walu' hatus maka mpatpū' tahun umul si Kenan, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:14
verses.text: Jari pagabut siyam hatus maka sangpū' tahun umul si Kenan, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen114" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv50"/><div sID="gen115" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv50"/> Si Mahalalel isab, pagabut nnompū' maka limantahun umulna, taga-anak iya l'lla, ōnna si Jared.

verses.name: Genesis 5:16
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Jared e', aniya' gi' walu' hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun umul si Mahalalel, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:17
verses.text: Jarina, pagabut walu' hatus maka siyampū' maka limantahun umul si Mahalalel, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen115" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv51"/><div sID="gen116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv51"/> Na, si Jared isab, pagabut dahatus maka nnompū' maka duwantahun umulna, aniya' anakna l'lla, ōnna si Idris.

verses.name: Genesis 5:19
verses.text: Manjari aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Idris, aniya' gi' walu' hatus tahun umul si Jared, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:20
verses.text: Manjari pagabut siyam hatus maka nnompū' maka duwantahun umul si Jared, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen116" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv52"/><div sID="gen117" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv52"/> Si Idris isab, pagabut umulna nnompū' maka limantahun, taga-anak iya l'lla, ōnna si Mitusala.

verses.name: Genesis 5:22
verses.text: Puwas e', ma deyom t'llu hatus tahun, magda'atay si Idris maka Tuhan. Aniya' gi' isab saga anakna d'nda-l'lla. Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in t'llu hatus maka nnompū' maka limantahun umulna, palanyap sadja iya pagka niā' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:23
verses.text: Puwas e', ma deyom t'llu hatus tahun, magda'atay si Idris maka Tuhan. Aniya' gi' isab saga anakna d'nda-l'lla. Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in t'llu hatus maka nnompū' maka limantahun umulna, palanyap sadja iya pagka niā' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:24
verses.text: Puwas e', ma deyom t'llu hatus tahun, magda'atay si Idris maka Tuhan. Aniya' gi' isab saga anakna d'nda-l'lla. Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in t'llu hatus maka nnompū' maka limantahun umulna, palanyap sadja iya pagka niā' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv53"/><div sID="gen118" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv53"/> Na si Mitusala isab, pagabut umulna dahatus maka walumpū' maka pituntahun, taga-anak iya l'lla, ōnna si Lamek.

verses.name: Genesis 5:26
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Lamek, aniya' gi' pitu' hatus maka walumpū' maka duwantahun umul si Mitusala, maka taga-anak lagi' iya d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:27
verses.text: Jari ta'abut pa'in siyam hatus maka nnompū' maka siyam tahun umul si Mitusala, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen118" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv54"/><div sID="gen119" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv54"/> Si Lamek isab, pagabut umulna dahatus maka walumpū' maka duwantahun, taga-anak iya l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:29
verses.text: Ya pangōnna ma iya Nū ati aniya' pagkallam si Lamek ma pasalna. “Onde' itu,” yukna, “amowa kahāpan du luwas min tana' ya bay sinapdahan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<note><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>: hatina ‘Yawe’, ya dī ōn Tuhan.</note> jari kabuwanan kitam pahalian min hulas-sangsā'tam.”

verses.name: Genesis 5:30
verses.text: Aubus pa'in min bay panganak ma si Nū, aniya' gi' lima hatus maka siyampū' maka limantahun umul si Lamek, maka aniya' gi' anakna d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 5:31
verses.text: Manjari pagabut pitu' hatus maka pitumpū' maka pituntahun umul si Lamek, amatay na iya.  <div eID="gen119" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 5:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv55"/><div sID="gen120" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv55"/> Na, in si Nū itu, aniya' na lima hatus tahun umulna bo' yampa iya taga-anak. Manjari t'llu anakna l'lla, ya na si Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet.  <div eID="gen120" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.5"/> <div eID="gen110" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv56"/><div sID="gen121" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nilatapan Katibu'ukan Dunya</title> <div sID="gen122" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv56"/> Manjari itu, salta' angaheka na bangsa manusiya' ma deyom dunya, aniya' isab anak sigām budjang.

verses.name: Genesis 6:2
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in saga budjang itu e' kal'llahan ya ngga'i ka a'a dunya, na, kalingkatan sigām. Jari sasuku budjang kinabaya'an e' saga l'lla inān, ningā' h'nda e' sigām.<note>Kal'llahan ya ngga'i ka a'a dunya: bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘saga anak Tuhan’. Mbal kita makatantu bang ai hatina, sagō' makajari bang sinalin ni ‘l'lla ngga'i ka a'a dunya.’ Makajari isab ‘saga panubu' si Sēt, ya ahāp kasuddahanna.’ Maka kabudjangan itu, ya na panubu' si Kabil anak si Adam ala'at kasuddahanna.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:3
verses.text: Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yukna, “Mbal na pataptap Rū-ku ma saga manusiya' itu, subay sigām buwananku ganta'an. Mbal na pinalabi umul sigām min dahatus maka duwampū' tahun.”  <div eID="gen122" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv57"/><div sID="gen123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv57"/> Na, ma waktu he'-i sampay ma tahun damuli gi' minnē', aniya' maitu ma dunya saga a'a kosogan maka alanjang, ya niōnan bangsa Nipilim. Aesog sigām maka abantug ma kalahat-lahatan. Panubu' asal sigām min saga l'lla ngga'i ka a'a dunya ya bay makah'nda budjang a'a dunya.  <div eID="gen123" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv58"/><div sID="gen124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv58"/> Na, in binangsa manusiya' ma dunya itu ta'nda' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ap'nno' e' dusa maka ala'at lullun hona'-hona' sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 6:6
verses.text: Pag'nda'na, magkarukka'an iya ati magsusun na ma pasal pamapanjarina manusiya' maitu ma dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 6:7
verses.text: Angkan angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Pahalamku na binangsa manusiya' ya bay papanjariku. Pahalamku sigām sampay ba'anan sattuwa maka hayop, pahalamku isab ai-ai maglelehan maka manuk-manuk magleyangan. Sababna magsusun to'ongan aku ma bay papanjariku.”

verses.name: Genesis 6:8
verses.text: Daipara pag'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Nū, kasulutan iya.  <div eID="gen124" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen121" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv59"/><div sID="gen125" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Nabi Nū</title> <div sID="gen126" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv59"/> Ya itu salsila panugsugan si Nū. T'llu du anakna l'lla, ya si Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet. Luwal si Nū halam dusahan ma waktu he'-i, magda'atay isab iya maka Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv59"/><div sID="gen125" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Nabi Nū</title> <div sID="gen126" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv59"/> Ya itu salsila panugsugan si Nū. T'llu du anakna l'lla, ya si Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet. Luwal si Nū halam dusahan ma waktu he'-i, magda'atay isab iya maka Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 6:11
verses.text: Malaingkan saga pagkahina manusiya' kumarukan kala'atan sigām ma matahan Tuhan. Ap'nno' deyom dunya e' kajahulaka'an sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 6:12
verses.text: Angkan ta'nda' e' Tuhan in dunya itu alumu' na ma sabab kasabulan ya nihinang e' saga manusiya' kamemon.  <div eID="gen126" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv60"/><div sID="gen127" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv60"/> Manjari magkallam Tuhan ma si Nū, yukna, “Pahalamku na saga manusiya' kamemon ma sabab kajahulaka'an sigām maingga-maingga ma dunya. Pagmulka'anku na sigām kamemon, maka lubuku isab sampay baran dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 6:14
verses.text: Na, angahinang na ka adjung<note>Adjung: ginis pameya'an ma tahik bay awal.</note> ma ka'am,” yukna ma si Nū. “Subay kayu apagon ya pangahinangnu. Hinangin saga bilik ma deyom, bo' kitlanun lullun deyom-luwasanna.

verses.name: Genesis 6:15
verses.text: Ya sukuranna subay buwattitu: taha'na pitumpū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga', maka langkawna subay pitund'ppa maka tonga'.

verses.name: Genesis 6:16
verses.text: Hinangin olangan duwa h'kka langana ma llot diyata' dinding maka bihing atop. Hinangin t'llu angkap, angkap deyo', angkap t'ngnga' maka angkap diyata'. Hinangin isab dakayu' lawang ma bihingna.

verses.name: Genesis 6:17
verses.text: Hatiun pahāp,” yuk Tuhan. “Itiya' na aku song amaniya' latap ma kaluha'an dunya itu pamahalamku kamemon indaginis, sasuku taga-napas. Manjari kamemon ai-ai ma dunya itu amatay du.

verses.name: Genesis 6:18
verses.text: Malaingkan pat'nna'anta ka paljanji'an, in ka'am magtai'anak sampay ayuwannu d'nda pariyata' du ni adjung ya hinangnu ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 6:19
verses.text: Subay duwa'nu isab min ba'anan ai-ai taga-napas bo' pinakallum sambeya' maka ka'am. Patimuk du ni ka'am kamemon ginisan manuk-manuk, kamemon ginisan sattuwa maka hayop, sampay ginisan ai-ai maglelehan ma tana'. Magbeya' du sigām duwa-ruwa maglimbang.

verses.name: Genesis 6:20
verses.text: Subay duwa'nu isab min ba'anan ai-ai taga-napas bo' pinakallum sambeya' maka ka'am. Patimuk du ni ka'am kamemon ginisan manuk-manuk, kamemon ginisan sattuwa maka hayop, sampay ginisan ai-ai maglelehan ma tana'. Magbeya' du sigām duwa-ruwa maglimbang.

verses.name: Genesis 6:21
verses.text: Bowahun isab takakan indaginis. Tau'un pagkakanbi maka pagkakan saga sattuwa maka hayop maka kamanuk-manukan.”

verses.name: Genesis 6:22
verses.text: Manjari bineya' e' si Nū kamemon bay panoho'an Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen127" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.6"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:1
verses.text: Na, aubus pa'in nihinang adjung e', magsuwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Nū, yukna, “Pariyata' na kam magtai'anak, sabab hal ka'a ya ta'nda'ku halam dusahan ma kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 7:2
verses.text: Pasambeya'un ma ka'am kamemon ginisan hayop halal, pitu' l'lla pitu' d'nda ma ginis-ginisanna. Bang sattuwa ya mbal tahalal, duwa-ruwa sadja ya niruwa', dakayu' l'lla dakayu' d'nda maglimbang.

verses.name: Genesis 7:3
verses.text: Damikiyanna du isab ginisan manuk-manuk, pitu' l'lla pitu' d'nda ma ginis-ginisanna. Hinangun buwattilu supaya aniya' anatas allum min ginisan binangsa ai-ai kamemon bo' angaheka du pa'in pabalik ma kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 7:4
verses.text: Pitung'llaw minnitu patumbukku ulan alandos ma deyom mpatpū' ng'llaw, mpatpū' bahangi. Jari pahalamku na kamemon taga-napas ya bay papanjariku.”

verses.name: Genesis 7:5
verses.text: Na, bineya' e' si Nū kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen128" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv61"/><div sID="gen129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv61"/> Ta'abut pa'in kapangalatap dunya, aniya' na nnom hatus tahun umul si Nū.

verses.name: Genesis 7:7
verses.text: In iya maka anak-h'ndana sampay ayuwanna d'nda bay pariyata' ni adjung bo' mbal ta'abut e' latap.

verses.name: Genesis 7:8
verses.text: Manjari patimuk ni si Nū kamemon ginisan hayop maka sattuwa, halal maka ngga'i ka halal, sampay saga manuk-manuk maka kamemon maglelehan ma kuwit tana', duwa-ruwa maglimbang. Pariyata' na kamemon ni deyom adjung e' buwat bay panoho'an Tuhan ma si Nū.

verses.name: Genesis 7:9
verses.text: Manjari patimuk ni si Nū kamemon ginisan hayop maka sattuwa, halal maka ngga'i ka halal, sampay saga manuk-manuk maka kamemon maglelehan ma kuwit tana', duwa-ruwa maglimbang. Pariyata' na kamemon ni deyom adjung e' buwat bay panoho'an Tuhan ma si Nū.

verses.name: Genesis 7:10
verses.text: Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in pitung'llaw minnē', yampa patumbuk ulan.  <div eID="gen129" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv62"/><div sID="gen130" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv62"/> Pagabut pa'in nnom hatus tahun si Nū, bulan karuwana, sangpū' maka pitu' kasobangan ma tahun ina'an, abustak kamemon tuburan bohe' ya asal ma deyom tana'. Taukab isab taplok langit bo' patumbuk ulan alandos.

verses.name: Genesis 7:12
verses.text: Halam aniya' hondonganna ma deyom mpatpū' bahangi.

verses.name: Genesis 7:13
verses.text: Ma llaw katagna' ulan inān, ina'an asal disi Nū ma deyom adjung, iya maka h'ndana sampay saga anakna t'llungan si Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet sampay h'nda sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 7:14
verses.text: Tabeya' isab ma sigām kamemon ginisan sattuwa maka hayop aheya-ariki', sattuwa talun maka hayop ni'ipat, sampay saga maglelehan ma tana'. Tabeya' isab kamemon ginisan manuk-manuk maka ai-ai magleyangan.

verses.name: Genesis 7:15
verses.text: Manjari aniya' patipun ni si Nū l'lla maka d'nda maglimbang min binangsa kaginisan kamemon sasuku taga-napas, pinariyata' ni adjung.

verses.name: Genesis 7:16
verses.text: Ya na ina'an panoho'an Tuhan asal ma si Nū inān. Na, mahē' pa'in sigām kamemon ma deyom adjung, magtūy sigām tinambolan lawang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.  <div eID="gen130" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv63"/><div sID="gen131" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv63"/> Ma deyom mpatpū' bahangi pasōng na pa'in latap e', pasōng palalom bohe', sampay pagūng na adjung e'.

verses.name: Genesis 7:18
verses.text: Pasōng palalom bohe' sampay talaran na adjung.

verses.name: Genesis 7:19
verses.text: Palalom na pa'in bo' palalom bohe', sampay aletop na kamemon saga kabūd-būran.

verses.name: Genesis 7:20
verses.text: Palalom na pa'in bohe' sampay pa'abut saga mpat d'ppa lalomna min diyata' saga pussuk būd.

verses.name: Genesis 7:21
verses.text: Manjari maglembohan to'ongan sasuku bay taga-napas ma dunya, ba'anan kamanuk-manukan, kasattuwahan talun, kahayop-hayopan maka ai-ai maglelehan ma tana'. Magpatayan kamemon sampay binangsa manusiya'.

verses.name: Genesis 7:22
verses.text: Kamemon ai-ai bay taga-napas ma gintana'an wa'i magpatayan lullun.

verses.name: Genesis 7:23
verses.text: Alaglag sasuku taga-napas kamemon, saga manusiya', kasattuwahan, kamanuk-manukan maka saga ai-ai maglelehan ma kuwit tana'. Ya du takapin allum si Nū maka saga kamemon bay ameya' ma iya ma deyom adjung.

verses.name: Genesis 7:24
verses.text: Na, in latap inān halam bay pakō' ma deyom dahatus maka limampū' bahangi.  <div eID="gen131" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.7"/> <div eID="gen125" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv64"/><div sID="gen132" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pakō' na Latap</title> <div sID="gen133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv64"/> Malaingkan nientom e' Tuhan disi Nū sampay saga sattuwa maka hayop ya ma deyom adjung, ati aniya' baliyu akosog pinatiyup e' Tuhan, manjari pakulang bohe' he'.

verses.name: Genesis 8:2
verses.text: Tinambol pabīng e' Tuhan saga bohe' bay min deyom tana' maka bohe' min langit bo' pahondong na angulan.

verses.name: Genesis 8:3
verses.text: In bohe' latap-i pakō'-kō' na pa'in ma deyom dahatus maka limampū' bahangi.

verses.name: Genesis 8:4
verses.text: Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in bulan kapitu'na ma tahun e'-i, sangpū' maka pitu' kasobangan, yamboho' sumanglad<note>Sumanglad: ‘sum'llad’ bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> adjung e' pehē' ni dakayu' būd ma jadjahan Ararat.<note>Ya kabūran Ararat itu, mahē' ma lahat Turkey buwattina'an.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:5
verses.text: Pakō'-kō' na pa'in bohe' sampay ni panagna'an bulan ma bulan sangpū' he', jari ta'nda'an di-na na saga pussuk kabūd-būran.  <div eID="gen133" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv65"/><div sID="gen134" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv65"/> Na, palabay pa'in mpatpū' bahangi min bay katuwa' pussuk būd e', niukab e' si Nū tandawan bay tahinangna ma adjung

verses.name: Genesis 8:7
verses.text: bo' paleyangna dakayu' owak ni luwasan. Jari paleyang na pa'in owak e' pi'ingga-pi'ingga sampay aniya' katoho'an pat'ppakanna.

verses.name: Genesis 8:8
verses.text: Mbal at'ggol pinaleyang na isab e' si Nū dakayu' assang bo' kata'uwanna bang pakō' na bohe' min kareyahan.

verses.name: Genesis 8:9
verses.text: Sagō' masi aletop e' bohe', maka assang e' mbal makabāk pat'ppakanna. Manjari paleyang pabīng ni adjung. Na niabut e' si Nū assang e' labay min tandawan bo' pinasōd pabīng ni deyom adjung e'.

verses.name: Genesis 8:10
verses.text: Angagad lagi' si Nū pitumbahangi bo' yampa paleyangna assang e' pabīng.

verses.name: Genesis 8:11
verses.text: Pagkohap pa'in, na, ilu na assang pabalik ni iya, ananga' dahun kayu jaitun baha'u bay k'ttu'na. Minnē' kinata'uwan agtūy e' si Nū ya bohe' latap pakō' na.

verses.name: Genesis 8:12
verses.text: Angagad gi' iya pitumbahangi bo' yampa paleyangna assang e' pabīng. Jari ma l'ngngan itu halam na makabīng ni adjung.  <div eID="gen134" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv66"/><div sID="gen135" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv66"/> Ta'abut pa'in nnom hatus maka dantahun umul si Nū, bo' sahali bulan ma bulan dakayu' ma tahun e'-i, pakō' na latap. Manjari nila'anan e' si Nū sapaw adjung e'. Ang'nda' iya paluwas ati ta'nda'na atoho'-toho' na kuwit tana'.

verses.name: Genesis 8:14
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in ni t'llu kamatayan bulan ma bulan karuwana, atoho' na to'ongan.  <div eID="gen135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv67"/><div sID="gen136" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv67"/> Manjari magkallam Tuhan ma si Nū, yukna,

verses.name: Genesis 8:16
verses.text: “Pareyo' na kam magtai'anak maka saga ayuwannu.

verses.name: Genesis 8:17
verses.text: Pareyo'un isab ma ka'am saga kamanuk-manukan kamemon maka kahayop-hayopan, maka ai-ai maglelehan ma tana', supaya anganak paheka ma kaluha'an dunya itu.”

verses.name: Genesis 8:18
verses.text: Manjari magdeyo'an na si Nū maka anak-h'ndana sampay ayuwanna.

verses.name: Genesis 8:19
verses.text: Pareyo' du isab saga kahayop-hayopan maka saga kamanuk-manukan sampay ai-ai maglelehan ma tana'. Pareyo' sigām daginis maka daginis.  <div eID="gen136" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv68"/><div sID="gen137" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv68"/> Manjari amangkat batu si Nū nihinang pagkukulbanan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Pagubus, angā' iya hayop maka manuk-manuk halal daginis maka daginis. Sinumbali' e'na bo' yampa tinunu' ma pagkukulbanan.

verses.name: Genesis 8:21
verses.text: Kasulutan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma hamut kukulbanan inān, manjari yukna ma deyom atayna, “Mbal na pagmulka'anku pabalik dunya itu ma sababan manusiya', minsan ala'at asal hona'-hona' sigām sangay min kanahut sampay ni kaheya sigām. Mbal na paka'atku pabīng kamemon ya sasuku taga-napas buwat bay hinangku itu. <lg sID="gen138"/> <l level="1" sID="gen139"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:22
verses.text: Sat'ggol anatas dunya itu,<l eID="gen139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen140"/>sat'ggol isab mags'lle'-s'lle' musim maka waktu,<l eID="gen140" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen141"/>musim pagtanom maka musim pagani,<l eID="gen141" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen142"/>waktu haggut maka waktu pasu',<l eID="gen142" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen143"/>pang'llaw maka pangulan,<l eID="gen143" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen144"/>llaw maka sangom.”<l eID="gen144" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen138"/>  <div eID="gen137" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.8"/> <div eID="gen132" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv69"/><div sID="gen145" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paljanji'an Tuhan maka si Nū</title> <div sID="gen146" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv69"/> Manjari si Nū maka saga anakna l'lla binarakatan na e' Tuhan. Magkallam iya ma sigām, yukna, “Anganak kam paheka supaya ap'nno' e'bi kaluha'an dunya ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 9:2
verses.text: Ka'am ilu kinatāwan du e' kamemon sattuwa maka hayop, manuk-manuk maka ai-ai maglelehan ma tana', sampay saga daing. Buwananta kam kapatut magdūl-baya' ma sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 9:3
verses.text: Manjari takakanbi na ai-ai taga-napas ilu. Ma waktu dahū inān, tinanom ya bay pamuwanku ma ka'am, sagō' buwattitu pamuwanku na kamemon.  <div eID="gen146" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv70"/><div sID="gen147" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv70"/> “Saguwā' aniya' pangalānganku ma ka'am subay mbal kakanbi, ya na sumbali'an halam tapaluwas laha'na, sabab laha' ya pameya'an nyawa.

verses.name: Genesis 9:5
verses.text: Damikiyanna laha'bi manusiya', pameya'an nyawa isab angkan subay tinungbasan to'ongan. Sai-sai a'a amahuddud laha' pagkahina manusiya' sampay amatay, tungbasanku du. Minsan sattuwa, bang aniya' amapatay ma manusiya', subay du papatayku. <lg sID="gen148"/> <l level="1" sID="gen149"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:6
verses.text: Sabab aku ya bay amapanjari manusiya' pina'anggil ni aku,<l eID="gen149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen150"/>angkan na bang aniya' a'a amahuddud laha' pagkahina,<l eID="gen150" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen151"/>binalosan du a'a inān, pinahuddud isab laha'na e' pagkahina manusiya'.<l eID="gen151" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen148"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:7
verses.text: Na, ka'am ilu subay anganak paheka supaya asaplag kaluha'an dunya e' saga panubu'bi magsuring-magsaingsing.”  <div eID="gen147" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv71"/><div sID="gen152" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv71"/> Manjari itu magkallam isab Tuhan ma si Nū maka saga anakna l'lla, yukna,

verses.name: Genesis 9:9
verses.text: “Itiya' aku amat'nna' paljanji'anku ma ka'am sampay ma saga panubu'bi magpangkat-mamangkat.

verses.name: Genesis 9:10
verses.text: Ya du ai-ai taga-napas kamemon ya bay tabeya' ma ka'am ma adjung e', talapay du isab pinat'nna'an paljanji'an, ai na ka manuk-manuk, ai na ka hayop, ai na ka sattuwa.

verses.name: Genesis 9:11
verses.text: Ya na itu pagkallamku pasal paljanji'anku ma ka'am: tinagna'an minnitu in dunya itu mbal na taluwa' latap pabalik, maka ai-ai taga-napas kamemon mbal du alaglag e' latap.

verses.name: Genesis 9:12
verses.text: Aniya' isab tanda' palsaksi'an pat'nna'ku ma ka'am magtubu'-manubu' sampay ma sasuku taga-napas kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 9:13
verses.text: Pat'nna'ku biradaliku<note>Biradali: ‘salindugu'’ atawa ‘bāngaw’ bang ma kasehe'an.</note> ma kagabunan, bo' aniya' paltanda'an pamaentom saga manusiya' ma pasal paljanji'anku ma kamemon ya ma dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 9:14
verses.text: Bang pa'andomku lahat bo' aniya' biradali patuwa' min deyom andom,

verses.name: Genesis 9:15
verses.text: entomku du paljanji'anku ma ka'am saga manusiya' sampay ma kamemon taga-napas mailu ma dunya. Janji'anta kam, halam na aniya' latap makalaglag pabīng.”

verses.name: Genesis 9:16
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan isab, “Bang patuwa' biradali ma kagabunan sumiyan-sumiyan, nda'ku maka entomku paljanji'anku ma ai-ai taga-napas ma babaw dunya, paljanji'an anatas ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen152" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv72"/><div sID="gen153" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv72"/> Buwattē' pagkallam Tuhan ma si Nū, yukna, “Ya na ina'an tanda' sin paljanji'an ya tahinangku ma sasuku taga-napas mailu ma dunya.”  <div eID="gen153" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen145" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv73"/><div sID="gen154" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Nabi Nū maka saga Anakna</title> <div sID="gen155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv73"/> Na, saga anak si Nū ya bay sehe'na ma adjung e', ya na disi Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet. (Si Hām ya mma' si Kana'an.)

verses.name: Genesis 9:19
verses.text: In anak si Nū kat'llungan itu, ya na pang'mbo'an ma kamemon manusiya' ya pasaplag ma kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 9:20
verses.text: Na si Nū itu a'a maghuhuma asal, jari anagna' iya magtanom anggul.<note>Anggul: ‘grape’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis. Buwa'na ahāp kinakan, bohe'na ahāp ni'inum. Nihinang binu-anggul isab.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:21
verses.text: Manjari itu, aniya' inuman makalango nihinang e' si Nū min bohe' anggul e'. Paginumna, nilango iya ati ahurusan di-na saga s'mmekna. Ati pabahak iya anantang ma deyom tolda ya pagluma'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 9:22
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in iya pabahak, makasōd pehē' anakna si Hām, ya mma' si Kana'an. Manjari tapandang e'na harapan mma'na. Pagpandangna itu, magtūy iya paluwas anuli-nulihan saga danakanna

verses.name: Genesis 9:23
verses.text: si Sēm maka si Japet. Sigā duwangan itu bay angā' s'mmek magtūy. Pinasablay ma baha sigā bo' yampa pasōd dahū bukut anambunan mma' sigā. Halam sigā palingi' bo' mbal ta'nda' kaiya'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 9:24
verses.text: Na, pagsayu si Nū min bay kalangona, bo' kata'uwanna bay hinang anakna kasiyalihan ma iya,

verses.name: Genesis 9:25
verses.text: magtūy pabukaganna. Yukna, <lg sID="gen156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen157"/>“Si Kana'an itu t'kkahan sukna'.<l eID="gen157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen158"/>Tahinang iya ata ma deyo'an saga danakanna.”<l eID="gen158" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen156"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:26
verses.text: Ah'lling isab si Nū, <lg sID="gen159"/> <l level="1" sID="gen160"/>“Pudjiku <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya pagtuhanan si Sēm!<l eID="gen160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen161"/>Bang pa'in pa'ata ni iya si Kana'an sampay panubu'na.<l eID="gen161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen162"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:27
verses.text: Si Japet isab, bang pa'in angaluha paglahatan saga panubu'na.<l eID="gen162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen163"/>Bang pa'in sigām palamud sangkahāpan ma saga panubu' si Sēm.<l eID="gen163" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen164"/>Bang pa'in isab pa'ata ni sigām si Kana'an maka panubu'na.”<l eID="gen164" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen159"/>  <div eID="gen155" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv74"/><div sID="gen165" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv74"/> Na, damuli pa'in min latap e' aniya' gi' t'llu hatus maka limampū' tahun kallum si Nū.

verses.name: Genesis 9:29
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in siyam hatus maka limampū' tahun umulna, awapat na iya.  <div eID="gen165" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.9"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:1
verses.text: Ya na itu salsila panugsugan si Sēm, si Hām maka si Japet, ya anak si Nū. Aniya' na anak sigām puwas bay min latap.  <div eID="gen166" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen154" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv75"/><div sID="gen167" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Japet</title> <div sID="gen168" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv75"/> Na, ya na itu saga anak si Japet l'lla, maka ōn bangsa isab ya patubu' min sigām: si Gomer, si Magog, si Maday, si Jaban, si Tubal, si Mesek maka si Tiras.

verses.name: Genesis 10:3
verses.text: Tubu'an si Gomer ya na saga a'a Askenas, a'a Ripat maka a'a Togarma.

verses.name: Genesis 10:4
verses.text: Tubu'an si Jaban ya na saga a'a Elisa, Tarsis, Kīt, maka Rodan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:5
verses.text: Manjari tubu'an si Jaban tahinang saga bangsa ya maglahat ma bihing tahik maka ma kapū'-pū'an. Kaniya-kaniya sigām magsaddī-saddī lahat maka bahasa sigām.  <div eID="gen168" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen167" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv76"/><div sID="gen169" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Hām</title> <div sID="gen170" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv76"/> Na, ya na itu saga anak si Hām l'lla, maka ōn bangsa isab ya patubu' min sigām: si Kūs, si Misil, si Pūt maka si Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 10:7
verses.text: Tubu'an si Kūs, ya na saga a'a Seba, Habila, Sabta, Ra'ama maka Sabteka. Tubu'an si Ra'ama isab ya na saga a'a Seba maka Dedan.

verses.name: Genesis 10:8
verses.text: Aniya' isab anak si Kūs dakayu', ōnna si Nimrud. In si Nimrud itu dahū min a'a kamemon akosog angagaw lahat maitu ma dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 10:9
verses.text: Abantug isab iya ma sabab kosogna magpana' sattuwa. Angkan na pinagbahasa h'lling itu, “Bang pa'in ka pasali' ni si Nimrud ya akosog magpapana' ma sabab tabang min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”

verses.name: Genesis 10:10
verses.text: Na, ya tagna'an da'ira<note>Da'ira: ‘lungsud’ bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> pinagbaya'an e' si Nimrud itu, ya na Babilon, Erek, Akkad maka Kalne, ya bay mahē' ma lahat Babilon.

verses.name: Genesis 10:11
verses.text: Pinaluha isab pagnakura'na sampay ni lahat Assiriya ati mahē' iya amahinang da'ira Niniba maka Rehobot-Ēl maka Kala.

verses.name: Genesis 10:12
verses.text: Bay pahinangna isab da'ira Resen ma tonga'an Niniba maka Kala, ya da'ira aheya ōnna.  <div eID="gen170" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv77"/><div sID="gen171" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv77"/> Manjari panubu' si Misil isab, ya na saga a'a Lūd, Anam, Lehab, Naptu,

verses.name: Genesis 10:14
verses.text: Patrus, Kaslu maka Kiriti. A'a Kiriti<note>A'a Kiriti: atawa a'a Kaslu.</note> itu ya na paluwasan bangsa Pilistin.  <div eID="gen171" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv78"/><div sID="gen172" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv78"/> Si Kana'an taga-anak l'lla, si Sidun ya siyaka, bo' pasunu' si Hīt.

verses.name: Genesis 10:16
verses.text: Si Kana'an isab ya pang'mbo'an saga a'a Jibus, Amor, Gilgas,

verses.name: Genesis 10:17
verses.text: Hīb, Arka, Sīn,

verses.name: Genesis 10:18
verses.text: Arbad, Semar maka Hamat. Pasaplag asal saga bangsa paltubu'an si Kana'an itu,

verses.name: Genesis 10:19
verses.text: min lahat Sidun sampay ta'abut lahat Gerar ya ma kasekotan lahat Gasa. Pasampay isab sigām tudju ni lahat Sodom, Gomora, Adma maka Seboyim, ya ma kasekotan lahat Lasa.

verses.name: Genesis 10:20
verses.text: Na, ya du ilu saga panubu' si Hām ya tahinang palbangsa-bangsahan. Kaniya-kaniya sigām magsaddī-saddī lahat maka bahasa.  <div eID="gen172" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen169" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv79"/><div sID="gen173" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Sēm</title> <div sID="gen174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv79"/> Na, si Sēm isab, siyaka si Japet, ya na pang'mbo'an si Eber sampay panubu'na kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 10:22
verses.text: Saga anak si Sēm l'lla ya na si Elam, si Assur, si Alpaksad, si Lūd maka si Aram.

verses.name: Genesis 10:23
verses.text: Saga panubu' si Aram ya na saga a'a Ūs, Hūl, Geter maka Mesek.

verses.name: Genesis 10:24
verses.text: Manjari si Alpaksad ya mma' si Sela, bo' si Sela ya mma' si Eber.

verses.name: Genesis 10:25
verses.text: Si Eber itu duwa anakna l'lla. Ya pangōn ma anakna dangan inān si Peleg<note>Ya ōn Peleg itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘abahagi'’.</note> sabab binangsa manusiya' bay abahagi' ma deyom masana. Si Joktan ya danakan si Peleg.

verses.name: Genesis 10:26
verses.text: Manjari ya panubu' si Joktan ya na saga a'a Almodad, Selep, Hasamabet, Jera,

verses.name: Genesis 10:27
verses.text: Hadoram, Usal, Dikla,

verses.name: Genesis 10:28
verses.text: Obal, Abimail, Seba,

verses.name: Genesis 10:29
verses.text: Opir, Habila, maka Jobab. Panubu' si Joktan asal sigām kamemon itu.

verses.name: Genesis 10:30
verses.text: Ya paglahatan sigām ma lahat Mesa sampay ta'abut lahat Separ, ya lahat kabūd-būran tampal ni sobangan.  <div eID="gen174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv80"/><div sID="gen175" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv80"/> Ya na ina'an saga panubu' si Sēm. Kaniya-kaniya sigām magsaddī-saddī lahat maka bahasa.  <div eID="gen175" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv81"/><div sID="gen176" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv81"/> Na, panubu' si Nū saga a'a kamemon ya tasabbut inān, kaniya-kaniya sigām magsaddī-saddī panugsugan. Lāgi, damuli pa'in min latap, pasaplag ma dunya saga kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon, luwas min panganak si Nū.  <div eID="gen176" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.10"/> <div eID="gen173" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv82"/><div sID="gen177" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Luma' Landu' Alanga ma Lahat Babilon</title> <div sID="gen178" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv82"/> Na, ma masa awal e' dakayu' du bahasa pah'lling saga manusiya' kamemon ma sakalingkal dunya.

verses.name: Genesis 11:2
verses.text: Maglatun-latun na pa'in sigām ma lahat sobangan sampay ta'abut e' sigām karatagan aluha ma lahat Babilon.

verses.name: Genesis 11:3
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, magisun-isun sigām, yuk-i, “Sūng kitam angahinang tisa'<note>Tisa': sali' haloblāk, sagō' tana' ya pangahinang iya.</note> paheka, tinapa ma api bo' patuwas.” Ngga'i ka batu ya ginuna e' sigām pangahinang luma' sagō' tisa' pinagpikit maka kitlan.

verses.name: Genesis 11:4
verses.text: Yuk sigām isab, “Gom na kitam maghinang da'ira taga-luma' pamantawan. Pamantawan itu subay alangkaw to'ongan sa'agon-agon maka'abut langit. Manjari abantug kitam, maka mbal tapulak-palik ni mpat pidju alam.”  <div eID="gen178" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv83"/><div sID="gen179" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv83"/> Manjari pareyo' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pina'an ang'nda' da'ira maka luma' pamantawan ya nihinang e' saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Genesis 11:6
verses.text: “Na,” yukna, “Dabangsa asal manusiya' itu kamemon, maka bahasa sigām dakayu' du isab, ya angkan sigām makarapat angahinang da'ira buwattitu. Tagna'anna sadja ko' itu, gana-gana angahinang du sigām ai-ai kamaksuran sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 11:7
verses.text: Gom gi' kita patulun pehē' amapaglamud-lamugay bahasa sigām pakaniya-kaniya supaya sigām mbal maghati-hiyatihi dansehe'an.”

verses.name: Genesis 11:8
verses.text: Manjari kinanat-kanat e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga manusiya' kamemon ni mpat pidju alam ati pahali sigām maghinang da'ira he'.

verses.name: Genesis 11:9
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan lahat inān niōnan Babel<note>Babel: atawa Babilon. Ya ōn Babel itu pa'anggil ni dakayu' kabtangan bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘lamud-lamugay.’</note> sabab ya ina'an lahat paglamud-lamugayan bahasa saga manusiya', lahat isab pagkanat-kanatan sigām e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni kalahat-lahatan ma mpat pidju alam.  <div eID="gen179" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen177" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv84"/><div sID="gen180" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Sēm</title> <div sID="gen181" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv84"/> Na, balikta salsila panugsugan si Sēm. Duwantahun palabay min bay latap ma dunya, bo' dahatus tahun na umul si Sēm, aniya' anakna l'lla ōnna si Alpaksad.

verses.name: Genesis 11:11
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min bay kapaganak ma si Alpaksad aniya' gi' lima hatus tahun umul si Sēm, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:12
verses.text: Na si Alpaksad isab, pagabut t'llumpū' maka limantahun umulna, aniya' anakna l'lla ōnna si Sela.

verses.name: Genesis 11:13
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min kapaganak ma si Sela, aniya' gi' mpat hatus maka t'lluntahun umul si Alpaksad, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:14
verses.text: Na si Sela isab, pagabut t'llumpū' tahun umulna, aniya' anakna l'lla ōnna si Eber.

verses.name: Genesis 11:15
verses.text: Puwas e', aniya' gi' mpat hatus maka t'lluntahun umul si Sela, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:16
verses.text: Na si Eber isab, pagabut t'llumpū' maka mpat tahun umulna, taga-anak iya l'lla ōnna si Peleg.

verses.name: Genesis 11:17
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min bay kapaganak ma si Peleg, aniya' gi' mpat hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun umul si Eber maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:18
verses.text: Na si Peleg isab, pagabut t'llumpū' tahun umulna, taga-anak iya l'lla ōnna si Riyu.

verses.name: Genesis 11:19
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min bay kapaganak ma si Riyu, aniya' gi' duwa hatus maka siyam tahun umul si Peleg, maka aniya' lagi' anakna d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:20
verses.text: Na si Riyu isab, ta'abut pa'in umulna t'llumpū' maka duwantahun, taga-anak iya l'lla ōnna si Serog.

verses.name: Genesis 11:21
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min bay kapaganak ma si Serog, aniya' gi' duwa hatus maka pituntahun umul si Riyu. Taga-anak lagi' iya d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:22
verses.text: Na, ta'abut pa'in t'llumpū' tahun umul si Serog, aniya' anakna l'lla ōnna si Nahor.

verses.name: Genesis 11:23
verses.text: Palabay pa'in min bay kapaganak ma si Nahor, aniya' gi' duwa hatus tahun umul si Serog. Taga-anak lagi' iya d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:24
verses.text: Na si Nahor isab, ta'abut pa'in umulna duwampū' maka siyam tahun, aniya' anakna l'lla ōnna si Tera.

verses.name: Genesis 11:25
verses.text: Manjari min bay kapaganak ma si Tera, aniya' gi' dahatus maka sangpū' maka siyam tahun umul si Nahor. Taga-anak gi' iya d'nda-l'lla bo' yampa iya amatay.

verses.name: Genesis 11:26
verses.text: Na si Tera itu, pitumpū' tahun umulna bo' yampa iya taga-anak. Si Ibram ya anakna siyaka, bo' pasunu' si Nahor, bo' si Haran ya kasiyalihan.  <div eID="gen181" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen180" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv85"/><div sID="gen182" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanubu'an si Tera</title> <div sID="gen183" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv85"/> Na, ya na itu salsila pasal si Tera maka saga panubu'na. Si Tera itu mma' disi Ibram, si Nahor maka si Haran. Si Haran itu aniya' anakna ōnna si Lōt.

verses.name: Genesis 11:28
verses.text: Saguwā' ma allum lagi' mma'na si Tera, amatay na si Haran ma lahat Uru, ya lahat paglahatan bangsa Kaldiya, lahat bay kapanganakan iya asal.

verses.name: Genesis 11:29
verses.text: Na si Ibram maka si Nahor taga-h'nda karuwangan. Si Saray ya h'nda si Ibram, sagō' halam aniya' anak sigā sabab si Saray mbal to'ongan maka'anak. Si Milka anak si Haran ya h'nda si Nahor. Aniya' danakan si Milka niōnan si Iska.  <div eID="gen183" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:30
verses.text: Na si Ibram maka si Nahor taga-h'nda karuwangan. Si Saray ya h'nda si Ibram, sagō' halam aniya' anak sigā sabab si Saray mbal to'ongan maka'anak. Si Milka anak si Haran ya h'nda si Nahor. Aniya' danakan si Milka niōnan si Iska.  <div eID="gen183" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv86"/><div sID="gen184" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv86"/> Manjari magla'anan na disi Tera min Uru ya bay paglahatan bangsa Kaldiya. Tabeya' ma iya anakna si Ibram maka mpuna si Lōt anak si Haran. Tabeya' isab ayuwanna si Saray h'nda si Ibram. Ya tinudju e' sigām lahat Kana'an sagō' at'kka pa'in sigām ni da'ira Haran, mahē' sigām maglahat.  <div eID="gen184" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv87"/><div sID="gen185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv87"/> Na, kat'ddasan sigām ma Haran sampay amatay na si Tera, duwa hatus maka limantahun umulna.  <div eID="gen185" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.11"/> <div eID="gen182" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:1
