verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv88"/><div sID="gen186" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an Tuhan ma si Ibram</title> <div sID="gen187" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv88"/> Na aniya' palman <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Ibram, yukna, “Ala'an ka min lahatnu luggiya' ilu. Ala'an ka min saga lūng-kampungnu maka min okoman mma'nu bo' ka pehē' ni lahat dakayu' ya pa'nda'anku ni ka'a ma sinosōng. <lg sID="gen188"/> <l level="1" sID="gen189"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:2
verses.text: Hinangta ka po'onan bangsa aheya maka abantug.<l eID="gen189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen190"/>Buwananta ka kahāpan maka pabantugku ōnnu.<l eID="gen190" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen191"/>Saga pagkahinu manusiya' isab kabuwanan kahāpan ma sababnu.<l eID="gen191" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen192"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:3
verses.text: Sasuku anabbut ōnnu ni kahāpan buwananku isab kahāpan.<l eID="gen192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen193"/>Sasuku anabbut ōnnu ni kala'atan pagmulka'anku du.<l eID="gen193" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen194"/>Manjari saga kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon maitu ma dunya pinasuku'an kahāpan ma sababnu.”<l eID="gen194" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen188"/>  <div eID="gen187" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv89"/><div sID="gen195" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv89"/> Sakali ta'abut pa'in pitumpū' maka limantahun umul si Ibram, ala'an iya min lahatna Haran tudju ni lahat Kana'an, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya. Ameya' isab si Lōt.

verses.name: Genesis 12:5
verses.text: Manjari ya binowa e' si Ibram h'ndana si Saray, kamanakanna si Lōt, sampay saga ata bay b'llina ma lahat Haran. Binowa isab pangalta'na kamemon bay tausahana mahē'.  <div eID="gen195" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv90"/><div sID="gen196" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv90"/> Na pagt'kka sigām ni lahat Kana'an, nilanjalan na pa'in l'ngngan sigām sampay ta'abut kayu pagduwa'ahan ma More, ma tongod lahat Sekem. (Kabangsa-bangsahan Kana'an ya tag-lahat ma masa inān.)

verses.name: Genesis 12:7
verses.text: Manjari magpa'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Ibram bo' magkallam ma iya, yukna, “Ma sinosōng pamuwanku lahat Kana'an itu ma saga panubu'nu.” Magtūy si Ibram angahinang tambak batu panukbalanna kulban tudju ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, ya bay magpa'nda' ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 12:8
verses.text: Puwas e' palanjal iya tudju ni kabūran ma jadjahan Betel tampal ni sobangan. Mahē' iya pahanti' ma tonga'an kauman Betel maka kauman Ayi. Aniya' isab panukbalan kulban tahinangna maina'an pagsumbahanna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:9
verses.text: Puwas e' pauntas na si Ibram tudju ni lahat Negeb.  <div eID="gen196" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen186" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv91"/><div sID="gen197" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ibram maka si Saray ma Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen198" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv91"/> Na aniya' gotom maina'an ma lahat Kana'an, asigpit to'ongan, angkan palūd disi Ibram ni lahat Misil bo' pahanti' mahē'.

verses.name: Genesis 12:11
verses.text: Manjari itu, song pa'in sigām at'kka ni lahat Misil, ah'lling si Ibram ma h'ndana si Saray, yukna, “Saray, ka'a ilu ahāp d'nda.

verses.name: Genesis 12:12
verses.text: Bang ka ganta' ta'nda' e' saga a'a Misil, kinata'uwan e' sigām in ka'a h'ndaku. Jari pinapatay aku e' sigām bo' ka'a ya pinakallum.

verses.name: Genesis 12:13
verses.text: Gom na yuknu ma sigām magdanakan kita, supaya aku kinahāpan e' sigām ma sababnu. Manjari aku itu mbal ni'inay.”

verses.name: Genesis 12:14
verses.text: Na, pagt'kka sigām ni lahat Misil, bo' pag'nda' saga a'a maina'an ma si Saray, b'nnal alingkat.

verses.name: Genesis 12:15
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in iya e' saga a'a pangandolan Pira'un,<note>Ya kabtangan Pira'un itu, bahasa Misil pangangg'llal ma sasuku pinatingkō' magsultan ma kaluha'an lahat Misil ma masa he'-i. Ngga'i ka ōn pangōn sultan dangan.</note> magtūy sigām angahaka pehē' ni Pira'un-i pasal kalingkatna. Sakali binowa si Saray pehē' ni deyom astana'.

verses.name: Genesis 12:16
verses.text: Bo' si Ibram ya kinahāpan e' Pira'un ma sabab si Saray. Binuwanan iya ba'anan bili-bili, kambing, sapi', kura' maka unta', sampay isab saga ata d'nda-l'lla.  <div eID="gen198" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv92"/><div sID="gen199" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv92"/> Sagō' in Pira'un pinat'kkahan saki aheya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sabab pangā'na ma si Saray. Talapay isab saga a'a kamemon ma deyomanna.

verses.name: Genesis 12:18
verses.text: Angkanna pinalinganan si Ibram e' Pira'un bo' tilawna bang ai sababna. “Angay aku putingannu?” yuk Pira'un. “Angay aku halam pata'unu in iya h'ndanu?

verses.name: Genesis 12:19
verses.text: Yuknu ma aku in si Saray ilu danakannu, angkan iya arak ta'ā'ku h'nda. O'o, h'ndanu itu, ā! Ngā'un iya pabalik bo' kam ala'an minnitu!”

verses.name: Genesis 12:20
verses.text: Manjari magpanoho'an Pira'un ma saga tendogna ma pasal disi Ibram. Sinō' iya pinala'an ma sigām min lahat Misil, iya baranna maka h'ndana sampay ai-aina kamemon.  <div eID="gen199" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.12"/> <div eID="gen197" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv93"/><div sID="gen200" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagokat si Ibram maka si Lōt</title> <div sID="gen201" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv93"/> Manjari ala'an na disi Ibram min lahat Misil bo' pabīng ni Negeb mahē' ma lahat Kana'an. Ameya' isab h'ndana maka pangalta'na kamemon sampay isab kamanakanna si Lōt.

verses.name: Genesis 13:2
verses.text: Magkarayahan na to'ongan si Ibram. Aheka to'ongan ba'anan kahayop-hayopanna maka aheka isab pamulawanna indaginis.

verses.name: Genesis 13:3
verses.text: Manjari palintas sigām min Negeb bo' maglatun-latun tudju ni kauman Betel, ni bay pahanti'an sigām tagna' ma tonga'an Betel maka da'ira Ayi.

verses.name: Genesis 13:4
verses.text: Asal aniya' bay maina'an pagtukbalan kulban bay tahinang e' si Ibram ma waktu palabay. Maina'an isab iya anabbut ma ōn Yawe.  <div eID="gen201" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv94"/><div sID="gen202" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv94"/> Na si Lōt isab, ya sehe' si Ibram maglatun-latun, aniya' anak-h'ndana maka saga sosoho'anna. Aheka isab kahayopanna, saga kambing, bili-bili maka sapi'.

verses.name: Genesis 13:6
verses.text: Jari aheka sidda kahayopan sigām karuwangan, angkan mbal s'ddong ma kaparangan lahat inān bang masi na pa'in sigām dambeya'an.

verses.name: Genesis 13:7
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan magsasaw saga magi'ipat hayop si Ibram maka saga a'a magipat hayop si Lōt. Masi isab aniya' saga a'a bangsa Kana'an maka bangsa Peres maglahat maina'an ma masa disi Ibram inān.  <div eID="gen202" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv95"/><div sID="gen203" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv95"/> Sakali si Ibram bay amowa si Lōt maggara', yukna, “Otō', dalaha' du kita angkan aku mbal bilahi bang aniya' pagsasawan, ai na ka ma kita, atawa ma saga tendogta.

verses.name: Genesis 13:9
verses.text: Gom kita magokat sabab aluha lahat itu. Ka'a ya amene' maingga-maingga kabaya'annu paglahatan. Bang kabaya'annu tana' tampal ni gibang, ma aku na tampal ni kowan. Bang kabaya'annu tana' tampal ni kowan, ma aku na tampal ni gibang.”

verses.name: Genesis 13:10
verses.text: Na amantaw si Lōt ni kapantayan ma bihing sapa' Jordan tobtob ni lahat Sowar. Pag'nda'na ma kapantayan inān, na, aheka bohe'na, buwat lahat Eden ya bay pinaniya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma awal jaman. Dahāp isab maka lahat Misil. (Ma waktu ītu halam gi' bay minulka'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> da'ira Sodom maka Gomora.)

verses.name: Genesis 13:11
verses.text: Manjari ya tapene' e' si Lōt palsuku'anna tana' kapantayan kamemon ya ma bihing sapa' Jordan. Pagubus, papinda na iya pehē' tudju ni sobangan. Na buwattē' ya kapag'bba si Ibram maka si Lōt.

verses.name: Genesis 13:12
verses.text: Si Ibram ya pat'nna' maina'an ma kabūran lahat Kana'an, bo' si Lōt ya pat'nna' ma kapantayan asekot ni da'ira Sodom. Mahē' na iya amat'ngge tolda pagluma'an sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 13:13
verses.text: Na, saga a'a Sodom itu asal jahulaka' maka lumandu'an dusa sigām ni si Yawe.  <div eID="gen203" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen200" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv96"/><div sID="gen204" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaglain disi Ibram ni Kauman Hebron</title> <div sID="gen205" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv96"/> Makala'an pa'in si Lōt, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Ibram, yukna, “Ang'nda' ka ni katilibutnu ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 13:15
verses.text: Ya kaluha'an lahat ta'nda'nu ilu, pamuwanku du ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu salama-lama.

verses.name: Genesis 13:16
verses.text: Buwananta ka tubu' paheka, mbal taitung, sapantun heka gusung ma gintana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 13:17
verses.text: Na, pehē' na ka, latagun kaluha'an lahat ilu, sabab pamuwanku du ma ka'a ma sinosōng.”  <div eID="gen205" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv97"/><div sID="gen206" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv97"/> Jari papinda si Ibram pehē' ni Hebron, ati mahē' iya maglahat ma tongod saga kakayuhan Mamre, ya pagduwa'ahan a'a kasehe'an. Aniya' isab pagtunu'an kulban nihinang e' si Ibram maina'an panumbahanna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen206" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.13"/> <div eID="gen204" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><div sID="gen207" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Lōt Nilappas e' si Ibram</title> <div sID="gen208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/> Na, ma masa he', aniya' mpat sultan magbono' maka lima pagkahi sigām sultan. Ya itu ōn mpat sultan maka lahat bay pagnakura'an sigām: si Amdapel sultan min lahat Babilon, si Areyok sultan min da'ira Ellasal, si Kedollomer sultan min Elam, maka si Tidal sultan min Goyem. Aniya' isab lima sultan saddī ya kuntara sigām: si Bera sultan min da'ira Sodom, si Bilsa sultan min da'ira Gomora, si Sinab sultan min Adma maka si Semeber sultan min Seboyim. Kalimana sultan min kauman Bela (hatina Sowar).

verses.name: Genesis 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><div sID="gen207" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Lōt Nilappas e' si Ibram</title> <div sID="gen208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/> Na, ma masa he', aniya' mpat sultan magbono' maka lima pagkahi sigām sultan. Ya itu ōn mpat sultan maka lahat bay pagnakura'an sigām: si Amdapel sultan min lahat Babilon, si Areyok sultan min da'ira Ellasal, si Kedollomer sultan min Elam, maka si Tidal sultan min Goyem. Aniya' isab lima sultan saddī ya kuntara sigām: si Bera sultan min da'ira Sodom, si Bilsa sultan min da'ira Gomora, si Sinab sultan min Adma maka si Semeber sultan min Seboyim. Kalimana sultan min kauman Bela (hatina Sowar).

verses.name: Genesis 14:3
verses.text: Na, lima sultan itu bay amatimuk kasundaluhan sigām ma Kapantayan-Siddim, ya niōnan isab Tahik Ma'asin.

verses.name: Genesis 14:4
verses.text: Sangpū' maka duwantahun ya t'ggol sigām ma pang'ntanan sultan Kedollomer, sagō' ta'abut pa'in sangpū' ka t'lluntahun, anawakkal sigām angatu ma iya.  <div eID="gen208" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv99"/><div sID="gen209" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv99"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in sangpū' maka mpat tahun, at'kka pina'an si Kedollomel maka saga sultan ya gapi'na. Jari tara'ug e' sigām bangsa Repa ma lahat Asterot Karnaim, tara'ug bangsa Sūs ma lahat Hām, maka bangsa Ēm ma Kapantayan Kiriyataim.

verses.name: Genesis 14:6
verses.text: Tara'ug isab bangsa Hōr ma kabūd-būran lahat Se'er ati taturul sigām sampay ta'abut jadjahan Elparan ya ma bihing lahat paslangan.

verses.name: Genesis 14:7
verses.text: Puwas e', pabīng isab saga sundalu disi Kedollomel inān pehē' ni lahat Kades, ya bay pinagōnan En-Mispat ma waktu tagna'. Tara'ug isab e' sigām bangsa Amalek, ati ta'agaw kaluha'an lahat sigām. Ya du bangsa Amor ya maglahat ma da'ira Hasason-Tamar, ka'agawan isab.  <div eID="gen209" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv100"/><div sID="gen210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv100"/> Na, balikta sultan lima hekana, hatina sultan min da'ira Sodom, min Gomora, min Adma, min Seboyim maka min Bela. Bay sigām magtimuk ma Kapantayan-Siddim magbono'

verses.name: Genesis 14:9
verses.text: maka si Kedollomel sultan Elam maka saga sultan ya gapi'na. Ya na si Tidal sultan Goyem, si Amdapel sultan ma lahat Babilon, maka si Areyok sultan Ellasal. Hatina lima sultan min dambila', mpat isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Genesis 14:10
verses.text: Aheka asal lowang ma Kapantayan-Siddim e', ap'nno' e' kitlan. Na, maglahian pa'in sultan Sodom maka sultan Gomora min pagbono'an, aniya' saga tendog sigām bay ahūg ni deyom lowang e', maka aniya' isab bay makalahi pehē' ni kabūd-būran.

verses.name: Genesis 14:11
verses.text: Manjari itu, anganda'ug pa'in saga sultan mpat hekana he', ta'agaw e' sigām kamemon pangalta' maka balanja' bay ma deyom da'ira Sodom maka da'ira Gomora. Pagubus, magla'anan sigām minnē'.

verses.name: Genesis 14:12
verses.text: Tabowa isab e' sigām si Lōt kamanakan si Ibram, iya baranna sampay alta'na kamemon, pagka da'ira Sodom ya paglahatanna.  <div eID="gen210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv101"/><div sID="gen211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv101"/> Sakali itu aniya' a'a makal'ppa min pang'ntanan disi Kedollomel amowa lapal ni si Ibram, ya bangsa Hibrani<note>Hibrani: ōn bangsa maka ōn bahasa. Si Ibram bangsa Hibrani asal, sagō' in panubu'na luwas min si Yakub maumu kaōnan bangsa Isra'il atawa bangsa Yahudi. Parahāl Hibrani ya bahasa sigām kamemon.</note>. Ina'an iya maglahat ma tongod kakayuhan pagduwa'ahan, ya ma si Mamre a'a bangsa Amor. Aniya' isab danakan si Mamre, si Eskol maka si Aner. Pagapi' asal sigām magdanakan itu ma si Ibram.

verses.name: Genesis 14:14
verses.text: Na, pagta'u si Ibram wa'i tasaggaw kamanakanna si Lōt, magtūy iya amatipun saga tendogna ya bay asal ma deyomanna, a'a ata'u magbono'. T'llu hatus maka sangpū' maka walu' puhu' ya heka sigām. Atimuk pa'in, magtūy sigām paturul ni mpat sultan inān sampay ta'abut lahat Dān.

verses.name: Genesis 14:15
verses.text: Sangom pa'in, pinagbahagi' e' si Ibram saga tendogna bo' parugpak ni kuntara sigām. Aga'os disi Ibram inān ati anurul saga kuntara sigām sampay ni kauman Hoba, ya ma dambila' da'ira Damaskus tampal ni uttala'.

verses.name: Genesis 14:16
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in kauman Hoba, magtūy ta'ā' pabalik saga pangalta' kamemon bay tataban e' mpat sultan e'. Ta'ā' isab pabīng e' si Ibram kamanakanna si Lōt maka alta'na, sampay saga kar'ndahan maka a'a kasehe'an ya bay tasaggaw inān.

verses.name: Genesis 14:17
verses.text: Sakali tara'ug e' si Ibram sultan Kedollomel maka saga sultan gapi'na. Ma labayan pa'in iya tudju amole', bo' ta'abut L'bbak Sabe, ya pinagōnan isab L'bbak sin Kasultanan, sinampang iya e' sultan min da'ira Sodom.  <div eID="gen211" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen207" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv102"/><div sID="gen212" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ibram Niamu'-amu'an Kahāpan e' si Malkisadik</title> <div sID="gen213" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv102"/> Sinampang isab iya e' si Malkisadik, sultan ma lahat Salem maka imam maghinang ni Tuhan Mahatinggi. Aniya' tinapay maka binu-anggul binowa e'na pangalabotna ma si Ibram,

verses.name: Genesis 14:19
verses.text: bo' yampa angamu'-amu'an iya kahāpan, yukna, <lg sID="gen214"/> <l level="1" sID="gen215"/>“Bang pa'in si Ibram kabuwanan kahāpan<l eID="gen215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen216"/>e' Tuhan Mahatinggi,<l eID="gen216" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen217"/>ya magpapanjari dunya maka langit!<l eID="gen217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen218"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:20
verses.text: Pudjiku Tuhan Mahatinggi,<l eID="gen218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen219"/>ya bay anukbal saga bantanu<l eID="gen219" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen220"/>ni deyom pang'ntanannu!”<l eID="gen220" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen214"/> <div eID="gen213" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen221" type="paragraph"/> Manjari saga alta' bay ta'agaw pabīng e' si Ibram, binahagi' e'na pasangpū', ati dabahagi' he' pangahulmatna ma si Malkisadik.  <div eID="gen221" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv103"/><div sID="gen222" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv103"/> Ah'lling isab sultan min da'ira Sodom ma si Ibram, yukna, “Ma ka'a na kamemon pangalta'ku ilu. Sagō' amu'ku pole'in sadja ni aku saga tendogku ya bay tabowanu pal'ppa ilu.”  <div eID="gen222" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv104"/><div sID="gen223" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv104"/> Ya sambung si Ibram, “Saksi'ku si Yawe, ya Tuhan Mahatinggi bay magpapanjari dunya maka langit. Bay aku makasapa ma iya,

verses.name: Genesis 14:23
verses.text: mbal aku anaima' ai-ai palsuku'annu, minsan la'a dalamba salbannu atawa engkot taumpa'nu bo' mbal ka makapah'lling ka'a ya bay makaparaya ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 14:24
verses.text: Mbal aku anambut ai-ai min ka'a, luwal ya bay panganggastu saga a'aku. Sagō' aniya' a'a bay makarapit ma aku amono', ya na disi Aner, si Eskol maka si Mamre. Patut sigām pinahampitan.”  <div eID="gen223" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.14"/> <div eID="gen212" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv105"/><div sID="gen224" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paljanji'an Tuhan ma si Ibram</title> <div sID="gen225" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv105"/> Pagubus ina'an-i, takale e' si Ibram suwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe magkallam ma iya hinabuna atuli, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen226"/> <l level="1" sID="gen227"/>“O Ibram, da'a ka tināw.<l eID="gen227" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen228"/>Aku ya anampanan ka'a, sali' hantang taming.<l eID="gen228" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen229"/>Ahāp to'ongan panungbasku ma ka'a.”<l eID="gen229" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen226"/>  <div eID="gen225" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv106"/><div sID="gen230" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv106"/> Anambung si Ibram, yukna, “O Yawe, ka'a Panghū'ku, ai pūsna bang aku tungbasannu bo' halam aniya' anakku? Ya pinusaka'an alta'ku ya na si Ele'eser, a'a Damaskus.

verses.name: Genesis 15:3
verses.text: Halam aku bay buwanannu anak, angkan dakayu' ipatanku itu ya pinasuku'an pusaka'.”  <div eID="gen230" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv107"/><div sID="gen231" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv107"/> Na, takalena suwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabīng, yukna, “Ngga'i ka ipatannu ya pamusaka'annu, sagō' anaknu lissi.”

verses.name: Genesis 15:5
verses.text: Sakali binowa iya e' Tuhan paluwas min luma'na bo' ah'lling ma iya, yuk-i, “Pahangad ka ni diyata' langit, sulayin ni'itung saga bitu'un ilu. Saheka-heka taitungnu ilu, ya isab heka panubu'nu.”  <div eID="gen231" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv108"/><div sID="gen232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv108"/> Na, am'nnal to'ongan si Ibram ma pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> e'. Jari minnē', min pam'nnalna, kasulutan Tuhan ma iya ati ni'itung iya a'a abontol.  <div eID="gen232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv109"/><div sID="gen233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv109"/> Magkallam isab Tuhan ma si Ibram, yukna, “Aku si Yawe, ya Tuhan bay amowa ka'a pi'itu min Uru lahat bangsa Kaldiya bo' supaya pamasuku'ku lahat itu ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv110"/><div sID="gen234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv110"/> Atilaw gi' si Ibram ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “O Yawe, ka'a Tuhanku, buwattingga e'ku makatantu in lahat itu ma aku du?”  <div eID="gen234" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv111"/><div sID="gen235" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv111"/> Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Angā' ka dakayu' sapi' d'nda, dakayu' kambing d'nda maka dakayu' bili-bili l'lla, t'llu-t'llun tahun pangumulanna. Angā' ka isab dakayu' manuk-manuk malapati maka dakayu' anak assang ati bowahun pi'itu ni aku.”  <div eID="gen235" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv112"/><div sID="gen236" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv112"/> Jari binowa saga hayop itu ni Tuhan e' si Ibram. Binila' duwa bo' yampa pinapagalop bila'anna. Sagō' halam binila' saga manuk-manuk, hal pinat'nna' sadja.

verses.name: Genesis 15:11
verses.text: Sakali aniya' saga belle' pat'ppak ma sumbali'an inān arak amangan, daipara tin'ggal e' si Ibram.  <div eID="gen236" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv113"/><div sID="gen237" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv113"/> Pags'ddop mata llaw tatuli si Ibram, ahaluk to'ongan tulina. Kal'ddoman iya sidda maka sinōd tāw aheya.

verses.name: Genesis 15:13
verses.text: Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, yukna, “Ma tahun sinōng in panubu'nu tahinang a'a liyu ma lahat ngga'i ka lahat sigām. Tahinang sigām banyaga' ma lahat e' ati pinissoko' sigām to'ongan ma deyom mpat hatus tahun.

verses.name: Genesis 15:14
verses.text: Saguwā',” yuk Tuhan, “pat'kkaku mulka' ma bangsa ya amanyaga' sigām. Ta'abut pa'in waktu katulak sigām min lahat inān, makabowa du isab sigām alta' lumandu'an hekana.

verses.name: Genesis 15:15
verses.text: Sagō' in pasalnu, Ibram, pataha'ku du umulnu ati amatay du ka ma deyom kasannangan, maka takubul ka pahāp.

verses.name: Genesis 15:16
verses.text: In pasal panubu'nu isab, subay palabay mpat masa<note>Masa: atawa ‘pangkatan’.</note> bo' yampa sigām pabīng ni lahat Kana'an itu sabab in paldusahan bangsa Amor subay pinajukup dahū.”  <div eID="gen237" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv114"/><div sID="gen238" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv114"/> Manjari, pas'ddop pa'in llaw bo' angal'ddom na lahat, aniya' sali' hantang lapohan maka suwariyan palabay ma tonga'an saga sumbali'an bay pinagdambila' inān. Maghumbu asal lapohan maka arokot suwariyan.

verses.name: Genesis 15:18
verses.text: Magtūy ma waktu ina'an, aniya' paljanji'an pamat'nna' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Ibram, yuk-i, “Pamuwanku du katibu'ukan lahat itu ma saga panubu'nu, tobtob min sapa' lahat Misil sampay ni sapa' Alpurati ya sapa' aheya.

verses.name: Genesis 15:19
verses.text: Tabeya' isab tana' saga bangsa Kēn, Kenes, Kadmon,

verses.name: Genesis 15:20
verses.text: Hīt, Pirissi, Repa,

verses.name: Genesis 15:21
verses.text: Amor, Kana'an, Gilgas maka Jibus.”  <div eID="gen238" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.15"/> <div eID="gen224" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv115"/><div sID="gen239" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Hajara maka si Isma'il</title> <div sID="gen240" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv115"/> Na, si Saray h'nda si Ibram halam anakan. Sagō' aniya' ipatanna d'nda Misil, ōnna si Hajara.

verses.name: Genesis 16:2
verses.text: Manjari itu, ta'abut pa'in sangpū' tahun kapaglahat si Ibram ma Kana'an, ah'lling ma iya si Saray, yukna, “Kahandak min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya angkan aku mbal maka'anak. Bang bahā' hulidnu ipatanku itu. Kalu aniya' anakku labay min iya.” <div eID="gen240" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen241" type="paragraph"/> Kasulutan isab si Ibram ma h'lling si Saray. Jari binowa e' si Saray ipatanna si Hajara pamah'ndana ma h'llana.

verses.name: Genesis 16:3
verses.text: Manjari itu, ta'abut pa'in sangpū' tahun kapaglahat si Ibram ma Kana'an, ah'lling ma iya si Saray, yukna, “Kahandak min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya angkan aku mbal maka'anak. Bang bahā' hulidnu ipatanku itu. Kalu aniya' anakku labay min iya.” <div eID="gen240" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen241" type="paragraph"/> Kasulutan isab si Ibram ma h'lling si Saray. Jari binowa e' si Saray ipatanna si Hajara pamah'ndana ma h'llana.

verses.name: Genesis 16:4
verses.text: Manjari maghulid si Ibram maka si Hajara ati angiram na iya. Makananam pa'in si Hajara in iya angiram na, magtūy pareyo'-deyo'na si Saray.  <div eID="gen241" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv116"/><div sID="gen242" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv116"/> Anumbung magtūy si Saray ma si Ibram, yukna, “Dusanu ya angkan aku pinareyo'-deyo' e' si Hajara itu. Ya b'nnalna, aku ya bay amuwan iya ma ka'a. Sagō' pagta'una ab'ttong na iya, mbal na iya magaddat ma aku. Na, baya'-baya' si Yawe angahukum ma kita duwangan.”  <div eID="gen242" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv117"/><div sID="gen243" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv117"/> Anambung si Ibram, yukna, “Ipatannu ko' ilu, baya'-baya'nu na minsan ai hinangnu ma iya.” Manjari alahi si Hajara pagka kinabigsi'an e' si Saray.  <div eID="gen243" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv118"/><div sID="gen244" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv118"/> Sakali itu, hinabu si Hajara ma lahat paslangan, tabāk iya e' mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma atag dakayu' tuburan bohe', ina'an ma labayan tudju ni lahat Sūr.

verses.name: Genesis 16:8
verses.text: Ya lling mala'ikat ma iya, “O Hajara, ka'a ipatan si Saray, bay ka minningga? Maka pi'ingga isab ka?” <div eID="gen244" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen245" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Hajara, “Itiya' aku alahi min si Saray ya bay pagipatanku.”  <div eID="gen245" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv119"/><div sID="gen246" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv119"/> Yuk mala'ikat-i, “Subay ka amole' pehē' ni nakura'nu magpa'ata ma iya pabīng.”

verses.name: Genesis 16:10
verses.text: Ah'lling isab mala'ikat ma si Hajara, yukna, “Buwananta ka tubu' paheka, mbal taitung hekana.

verses.name: Genesis 16:11
verses.text: Ilu ka ab'ttong, jari anganak du ka l'lla. Si Isma'il<note>Ya ōn Isma'il itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘takale e' Tuhan.’</note> ya pangōnnu iya sabab takale e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> kasusahannu.

verses.name: Genesis 16:12
verses.text: Malaingkan anaknu ilu tahinang sali' kura' talun mbal tasoho'. Pinagsagga' e'na saga pagkahina manusiya', maka anagga' isab saga a'a kamemon ma iya. Jari mbal iya makapagdakayu' lahat maka saga kakampunganna.”  <div eID="gen246" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv120"/><div sID="gen247" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv120"/> Yuk si Hajara ma deyom atayna, “Arī! Masi bahā' aku allum minsan ta'nda'ku Tuhan?” Manjari ya pangōnna ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay ah'lling ma iya, “Tuhan ya Maka'nda' ma aku.”

verses.name: Genesis 16:14
verses.text: Angkan na tuburan bohe' inān pinagōnan Be'er-Lahai-Ruwi, hatina ‘Bohe' Tuhan ya Maka'nda' ma aku.’ Bohe' itu, ina'an ma tonga'an lahat Kades maka kauman Bered.  <div eID="gen247" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv121"/><div sID="gen248" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv121"/> Na anganak na si Hajara, angkan aniya' anak si Ibram l'lla. Si Isma'il ya pangōn si Ibram ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 16:16
verses.text: Walumpū' maka nnom tahun ya umul si Ibram ma waktu panganak si Hajara ma si Isma'il-i.  <div eID="gen248" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.16"/> <div eID="gen239" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv122"/><div sID="gen249" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagislam ya Tanda' sin Paljanji'an Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen250" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv122"/> Manjari pagabut siyampū' maka siyam tahun umul si Ibram, magpa'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya. “Aku ya Tuhan Sangat Kawasa,” yukna. “Beya'un panoho'anku, maka pabontolun isab hinangnu kamemon,

verses.name: Genesis 17:2
verses.text: ati tumanku paljanji'anku ma ka'a. Pahekaku to'ongan isab paltubu'annu.”

verses.name: Genesis 17:3
verses.text: Na, pasujud magtūy si Ibram. Ya palman Tuhan ma iya,

verses.name: Genesis 17:4
verses.text: “Buwattitu ya paljanji'anku ma ka'a, hinangta ka pagmatto'ahan ma kabangsa-bangsahan.

verses.name: Genesis 17:5
verses.text: Maka pindahanku isab ōnnu. Puwas itu ngga'i ka na si Ibram ya pangōn ka'a, sagō' si Ibrahim<note>Ya ōn Ibram itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘Mma' ya pinaheya.’ Maka ōn Ibrahim isab, hatina ‘Mma' ma kabangsa-bangsahan.’</note> na, sabab hinangta ka pagmatto'ahan saga bangsa kaginisan.

verses.name: Genesis 17:6
verses.text: Aho', pahekaku to'ongan saga panubu'nu ati tahinang sigām kabangsa-bangsahan. Ma sinosōng isab aniya' saga sultan patubu' min ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 17:7
verses.text: Pahogotku to'ongan paljanji'anku itu ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu magpangkat-mamangkat. Janji' itu mbal magbaluba ni kasaumulan. Aku ya Tuhannu, maka pagtuhanan saga panubu'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 17:8
verses.text: In katibu'ukan lahat Kana'an itu, ya paghanti'annu ma buwattina'an, pamuwanku du ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu saumul-umul. Aku ya pagtuhanan sigām.”  <div eID="gen250" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv123"/><div sID="gen251" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv123"/> Magkallam isab Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Na ka'a isab, subay bogbogannu paljanji'anta itu, damikiyanna isab saga panubu'nu magpangkat-mamangkat salama-lama.

verses.name: Genesis 17:10
verses.text: Buwattitu ya pamogbogbi ma janji' pagsulutanta itu, kamemon kal'llahan ma deyomanbi subay ni'islam.

verses.name: Genesis 17:11
verses.text: Ya du ilu tanda' ma paljanji'an ya pagsulutanta itu, in ka'am kal'llahan subay ni'islam.

verses.name: Genesis 17:12
verses.text: Puwas min waktu itu sampay ma waktu sinōng, in l'lla kamemon ya nianakan ma deyomanbi tahun ni tahun, ai na ka anakbi, ai na ka isab anak ata, subay ni'islam bang ta'abut walung'llaw ma luwasan.Ya du isab saga ata bay b'llinu min a'a liyu subay ni'islam isab. Aho',” yuk Tuhan, “kamemon kal'llahanbi ilu subay ni'islam, manjari aniya' pangilāhan ma baranbi in janji' pagsulutanta itu kakkal saumul-umul.

verses.name: Genesis 17:13
verses.text: Puwas min waktu itu sampay ma waktu sinōng, in l'lla kamemon ya nianakan ma deyomanbi tahun ni tahun, ai na ka anakbi, ai na ka isab anak ata, subay ni'islam bang ta'abut walung'llaw ma luwasan.Ya du isab saga ata bay b'llinu min a'a liyu subay ni'islam isab. Aho',” yuk Tuhan, “kamemon kal'llahanbi ilu subay ni'islam, manjari aniya' pangilāhan ma baranbi in janji' pagsulutanta itu kakkal saumul-umul.

verses.name: Genesis 17:14
verses.text: Saguwā' sai-sai l'lla halam taislam, mbal iya taitung suku'ku sabab halam bogboganna paljanji'anku itu.”  <div eID="gen251" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv124"/><div sID="gen252" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv124"/> Magkallam lagi' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Na, ya pasal h'ndanu si Saray, ngga'i na ka si Saray ya pangōnnu iya puwas itu, sagō' si Sara<note>Ya ōn Sara itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘dayang-dayang.’</note> na.

verses.name: Genesis 17:16
verses.text: Buwananku iya kahāpan bo' aniya' anaknu l'lla min iya. Aho', tantu iya buwananku kahāpan manjari tahinang iya ina' ma kabangsa-bangsahan. Aniya' isab saga sultan luwas min panubu'na.”  <div eID="gen252" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv125"/><div sID="gen253" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv125"/> Na, pasujud magtūy si Ibrahim maka e'na anittowa. Yukna ma baranna, “Arī! Makabuwan tubu' gi' bahā' bang a'a dahatus tahun umulna? Maka'anak bahā' si Sara minsan siyampū' tahun umulna!”

verses.name: Genesis 17:18
verses.text: Yukna isab ma Tuhan, “O Tuhan, bang pa'in mura-murahan pagka'inagonannu anakku si Isma'il!”  <div eID="gen253" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv126"/><div sID="gen254" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv126"/> Anambung Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, “Aho', makajari. Sagō' aniya' du anaknu l'lla min h'ndanu si Sara. Si Isa'ak ya pangōnnu iya<note>Ya ōn Isa'ak itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘anittowa.’</note>. Pahogotku paljanji'anku ma iya sampay ma paltubu'anna salama-lama.

verses.name: Genesis 17:20
verses.text: Na, ya pasal si Isma'il, takaleku isab bay pangamu'nu-i. Buwananku iya kahāpan, pahekaku panganakna bo' aheka to'ongan saga panubu'na. Manjari aniya' sangpū' a'a min panubu'na makapagdatu' ma sinosōng. Saga panubu'na isab nihinang e'ku bangsa ga'osan.

verses.name: Genesis 17:21
verses.text: Saguwā' anaknu si Isa'ak ya pahogotanku janji'ku. Nianakan du iya e' si Sara ma tahun balik sali' bulan itu.”

verses.name: Genesis 17:22
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e' Tuhan amalman ma si Ibrahim, magtūy iya ala'an.  <div eID="gen254" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv127"/><div sID="gen255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv127"/> Na ma llaw ina'an-i, bineya' e' si Ibrahim panoho'an Tuhan ma iya. Taislam e'na anakna si Isma'il sampay kal'llahan kamemon ma deyomanna. Ya du isab saga ata bay nianakan ma deyomanna sampay saga ata bay tab'llina.

verses.name: Genesis 17:24
verses.text: Ya umul si Ibrahim ma waktu pagislam ma iya maka si Isma'il, siyampū' maka siyam tahun.

verses.name: Genesis 17:25
verses.text: Ya umul si Isma'il sangpū' maka t'lluntahun.

verses.name: Genesis 17:26
verses.text: Jari magdongan si Ibrahim maka anakna si Isma'il ni'islam ma dang'llaw du.

verses.name: Genesis 17:27
verses.text: Tabeya' isab ni'islam ma llaw ina'an-i saga atana kamemon, a'a bay nianakan ma deyomanna sampay ata bay tab'llina.  <div eID="gen255" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.17"/> <div eID="gen249" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv128"/><div sID="gen256" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paljanji'an Tuhan ma si Ibrahim maka si Sara</title> <div sID="gen257" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv128"/> Manjari aniya' llaw magpa'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Ibrahim ma tongod kakayuhan pagduwa'ahan, ina'an ma tana' si Mamre. Alanga na llaw, maka ina'an si Ibrahim aningkō'-ningkō' ma bowa' lawang luma'na tolda.

verses.name: Genesis 18:2
verses.text: Na, ta'nda' e'na t'llungan a'a an'ngge-n'ngge ma dahuanna. Pag'nda'na itu, magtūy iya magdai'-dai' anampang sigām, maka e'na pasujud.  <div eID="gen257" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv129"/><div sID="gen258" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv129"/> Yukna ma sigām, “Saga tuwan, pahapit gi' kam ni luma' kami minsan mbal na apatut.

verses.name: Genesis 18:4
verses.text: Pabowahanta kam bohe' pangose' tape'bi bo' kam pahali-hali ma sindungan kayu itu.

verses.name: Genesis 18:5
verses.text: Bowahanta pa'in kam saga pagkakan isab minsan mbal na apatut. Subay na ahāp palasahanbi pabīng bo' yampa kam palanjal ni pal'ngngananbi.” <div eID="gen258" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen259" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām ma si Ibrahim, “Aho', magsukul.”  <div eID="gen259" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv130"/><div sID="gen260" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv130"/> Na, magdai'-dai' si Ibrahim pasōd ni deyom luma' tolda angalinganan si Sara. “Dāng,” yukna, “angā' ka tirigu ahāp, t'llu t'ppongna, bo' ka angahinang tinapay. Dai'-dai'un pa'in.”

verses.name: Genesis 18:7
verses.text: Pagubus, magdai'-dai' si Ibrahim pehē' ni buluyan hayopna amene' dakayu' anak sapi' ahāp isina. Sinoho' sinumbali' ma sosoho'anna bo' niadjal saru'un-du'un.

verses.name: Genesis 18:8
verses.text: Jari asakap pa'in kamemon, binowa e' si Ibrahim gatas maka sapi' pangalabotna ma saga a'a-i. Hinabu sigām amangan, si Ibrahim magbaran amuhatan sigām ma lindung kayu.  <div eID="gen260" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv131"/><div sID="gen261" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv131"/> Na, tinilaw e' sigām si Ibrahim, “Ma'ai h'ndanu si Sara?” <div eID="gen261" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen262" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Ibrahim, “Ina'an ma deyom.”  <div eID="gen262" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv132"/><div sID="gen263" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv132"/> Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, “Ma tahun sinōng ilu, buwat bulan itu, pabalik du aku pi'itu. H'ndanu si Sara anganak du, l'lla ya anakna.” <div eID="gen263" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen264" type="paragraph"/> Na maina'an asal si Sara pakale-kale ma bukut lawang.

verses.name: Genesis 18:11
verses.text: Ato'a iya, mbal na pinaglaha'. Maka si Ibrahim isab, ato'a na asal.

verses.name: Genesis 18:12
verses.text: Angkanna, pagkale si Sara ma bissala inān, tatittowa iya ati yukna ma deyom atayna, “Ē, buwattingga lagi' pagkōg kami maglakibini pagka ato'a na kami sali'-sali'?”  <div eID="gen264" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv133"/><div sID="gen265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv133"/> Sakali angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Ibrahim, yukna “Angay si Sara tatittowa? Angay buwattē' llingna, ya yukna, ‘Buwattingga e'ku anganak pagka aku ato'a na?’

verses.name: Genesis 18:14
verses.text: Aniya' bahā' ahunit ma si Yawe? Pahati ka, pagabut bulan bay pangahakaku ma ka'a pabalik du aku pi'itu, bo' h'ndanu si Sara anganak l'lla.”  <div eID="gen265" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv134"/><div sID="gen266" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv134"/> Na, tināw si Sara angkan iya maglimbung, yukna, “Halam aku bay atittowa.” <div eID="gen266" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen267" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' anambung Tuhan, yukna, “Allā! Bay ka anittowa.”  <div eID="gen267" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen256" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv135"/><div sID="gen268" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Lahat Sodom</title> <div sID="gen269" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv135"/> Sakali itu palanjal na a'a t'llungan e'. Tinūran e' si Ibrahim sampay taromol e' sigām lahat Sodom.

verses.name: Genesis 18:17
verses.text: Manjari ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Mbal limbunganku min si Ibrahim ya song hinangku ma lahat Sodom.

verses.name: Genesis 18:18
verses.text: Sababna in iya po'onan bangsa aheya maka abantug. Buwananku isab kahāpan saga bangsa manusiya' kamemon labay min iya.

verses.name: Genesis 18:19
verses.text: Tapene'ku iya supaya iya amandu'an saga anak-mpuna ameya' ma kabaya'anku. Subay sigām angahinang ni kahāpan maka ni kabontolan, manjari tumanku to'ongan paljanji'anku ma iya.”

verses.name: Genesis 18:20
verses.text: Manjari amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Aniya' takaleku sumbungan pasal saga a'a ma da'ira Sodom maka Gomora, lumandu'an kono' la'at dusa sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 18:21
verses.text: Subay aku pehē' ang'nda' bang b'nnal saga sumbungan e'. Jari kata'uwanku bang b'nnal ka atawa mbal.”  <div eID="gen269" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv136"/><div sID="gen270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv136"/> Sakali palanjal na duwangan min sigām-i pehē' ni lahat Sodom, sagō' pa'bba gi' Tuhan maina'an ma si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 18:23
verses.text: Na pasekot si Ibrahim pehē' ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, palamudnu bahā' a'a halam aniya' dusana pinagmulka'an sali'-sali' maka a'a taga-dusa?

verses.name: Genesis 18:24
verses.text: Bang saupama,” yukna, “aniya' limampū' a'a abontol ma lahat e', pagmulka'annu bahā' kamemon? Mbal bahā' ka ma'ase' ma lahat inān ma sabab limampū' a'a abontol maina'an?

verses.name: Genesis 18:25
verses.text: Bang pa'in du mbal pagsali'nu a'a halam aniya' dusana maka a'a taga-dusa, bang pa'in sigām mbal pagmulka'annu. Ka'a ya maghuhukum ma saga manusiya' kamemon ma deyom dunya, maka hukumannu subay abontol sadja.”  <div eID="gen270" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv137"/><div sID="gen271" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv137"/> Manjari ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Ibrahim, “Aho', bang aniya' tabākku ma lahat Sodom ilu limampū' a'a halam aniya' dusana, mbal du pagmulka'anku lahat ilu ma sababan sigām.”  <div eID="gen271" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv138"/><div sID="gen272" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv138"/> Manjari angallam si Ibrahim pabīng, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, manusiya' du aku, halam aniya' kawasaku, sagō' anawakkal aku angamu' ma ka'a pabīng.

verses.name: Genesis 18:28
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' mpatpū' maka lima a'a abontol ma lahat inān, pagmulka'annu lagi' bahā' ma saukat kulang lima min heka a'a bay amu'ku-i?” <div eID="gen272" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen273" type="paragraph"/> Anambung isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Bang aniya' tabākku mpatpū' maka lima a'a abontol, mbal pagmulka'anku lahat ilu.”  <div eID="gen273" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv139"/><div sID="gen274" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv139"/> Na, ah'lling si Ibrahim pabalik, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, bang saupama aniya' mpatpū' du?” <div eID="gen274" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen275" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Aho', ma sabab mpatpū' a'a abontol, mbal pagmulka'anku lahat ilu.”  <div eID="gen275" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv140"/><div sID="gen276" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv140"/> Angamu' lagi' si Ibrahim, “Ndū' Panghū'ku, da'a akagit ataynu, dūlin aku angamu' pabīng. Bang saupama aniya' du t'llumpū' a'a tabāknu abontol, pagmulka'annu bahā'?” <div eID="gen276" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen277" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung Tuhan, “Bang aniya' tabākku t'llumpū' a'a abontol, na, mbal pagmulka'anku lahat ilu.”  <div eID="gen277" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv141"/><div sID="gen278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv141"/> Manjari angamu' na pa'in si Ibrahim, “Ampunun lagi' aku, O Panghū'ku, anawakkal gi' aku angamu' ma ka'a pabīng. Bang saupama aniya' tabāknu duwampū' du a'a halam magdusa, pagmulka'annu lagi' bahā'?” <div eID="gen278" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen279" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung Tuhan, “Ma sabab duwampū' a'a abontol ilu, mbal du pagmulka'anku lahat ilu.”  <div eID="gen279" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv142"/><div sID="gen280" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv142"/> Manjari ya katapusan niamu' e' si Ibrahim, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, ndū', da'a akagit ataynu, ya sadja itu amu'ku ma ka'a. Bang saupama aniya' sangpū' sadja tabāknu mailu halam magdusa?” <div eID="gen280" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen281" type="paragraph"/> Na, ya sambung Tuhan, “Ma sabab sangpū' a'a, sagarin na, mbal na pagmulka'anku lahat ilu.”

verses.name: Genesis 18:33
verses.text: Manjari aubus pa'in kapagbissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka si Ibrahim, ala'an na iya minnē'. Amole' isab si Ibrahim.  <div eID="gen281" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.18"/> <div eID="gen268" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv143"/><div sID="gen282" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Taluwa' Mulka' Lahat Sodom maka Gomora</title> <div sID="gen283" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv143"/> Na, song na sangom, at'kka na duwa mala'ikat e' ni da'ira Sodom, hinabu si Lōt aningkō'-ningkō' ma atag lawang da'ira. Pag'nda' si Lōt ma duwangan itu, pasampang iya ma sigām maka e'na pasujud.

verses.name: Genesis 19:2
verses.text: Yuk si Lōt, “Saga tuwan, pahapit lagi' kam pi'itu ni luma'ku minsan mbal na apatut. Ngā'anta kam bohe' pangose' tape'bi. Labotta kam, ati maitu na kam atuli. Subay na subu bo' yampa kam palanjal.” <div eID="gen283" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen284" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Sagarin na, maitu sadja kami atuli ma halaman itu.”

verses.name: Genesis 19:3
verses.text: Sagō' pinogos sigām e' si Lōt subay pinasōd ni luma'na, manjari ameya' na sigām. Magpanoho'an si Lōt ma saga sosoho'anna, sinō' magadjal sampay angahinang tinapay halam pinasuligan pangalabot ma sigām. Atahak pa'in, amangan na sigām.  <div eID="gen284" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv144"/><div sID="gen285" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv144"/> Na, halam lagi' sigām atuli, alibut na luma' si Lōt e' saga kal'llahan kamemon onde'-matto'a min sakalibutan da'ira Sodom inān.

verses.name: Genesis 19:5
verses.text: Angalingan sigām ma si Lōt, yuk sigām, “Oy, Lōt! Ma'ai na saga a'a bay bowanu ni luma'nu insini'-i? Paluwasun sigām pi'itu ni kami. Bilahi kami angusiba'an sigām duwangan.”  <div eID="gen285" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv145"/><div sID="gen286" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv145"/> Pagkale si Lōt, magtūy iya paluwas min luma'na. Tinambol e'na lawang

verses.name: Genesis 19:7
verses.text: ati yukna ma kal'llahan inān, “Saga tuwan, angamu' aku junjung ma ka'am. Da'a kam maghinang jahulaka' ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 19:8
verses.text: Pakale lagi' kam. O'o, itiya' duwangan anakku budjang. Soho'ku sigām paluwas pi'ilu ati baya'-baya'bi na. Da'a sadja saga a'a itu sabab itiya' sigām ma deyomanku, subay sigām halli'anku.”  <div eID="gen286" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv146"/><div sID="gen287" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv146"/> Saguwā' ya sambung saga kal'llahan Sodom e' ma si Lōt, yuk-i, “Pasebog ka minnilu! Sai sa ka'a ilu amituwa ma kami? Ka'a ilu ngga'i ka a'a minnitu. Na, bang ka mbal pasebog minnilu, hinang kami ma ka'a akalap lagi' min duwangan a'a ilu.” Magtūy nijudjalan si Lōt e' sigām ni bihing lawang, song to'ongan nilarak e' sigām tambolna inān.

verses.name: Genesis 19:10
verses.text: Daipara ya duwangan ma deyom-i makaukab lawang supaya tahella' si Lōt pareyom. Ma deyom pa'in, tinambol magtūy e' sigām lawang.

verses.name: Genesis 19:11
verses.text: Manjari saga l'lla kamemon ma luwasan luma', ai na ka onde'-onde', ai na ka matto'a, bay kasilawan e' a'a duwangan-i bo' mbal makabāk lawang.  <div eID="gen287" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv147"/><div sID="gen288" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv147"/> Manjari atilaw duwangan mala'ikat e' ma si Lōt, yuk sigām, “Aniya' lagi' kampungnu maitu ma lahat Sodom, anaknu d'nda-l'lla ka, atawa ayuwannu? Bang aniya', subay sigām bowanu alahi min da'ira itu

verses.name: Genesis 19:13
verses.text: sabab lubu kami lahat itu. Takale asal e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe sumbungan pasal kala'atan saga a'a Sodom, makalandu' na to'ongan. Angkan kami sinoho' pi'itu e'na amaka'at katibu'ukan lahat itu.”  <div eID="gen288" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv148"/><div sID="gen289" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv148"/> Magtūy pehē' si Lōt ni duwangan l'lla ya tunang anakna budjang ati yukna, “O, pal'kkas kam, ala'an kam minnitu sabab lahat itu song nilubu e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.” Saguwā' mbal sigām am'nnal ma si Lōt. Pangannal sigām in iya hal maglata.  <div eID="gen289" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv149"/><div sID="gen290" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv149"/> Pagdai' llaw pinogos si Lōt e' saga mala'ikat-i, yuk sigām, “Pal'kkas ka magmomos. Bowahun anak-h'ndanu ala'an min lahat itu bo' supaya kam mbal talapay pinagmulka'an e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen290" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv150"/><div sID="gen291" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv150"/> Saguwā' magduwa-ruwa lagi' si Lōt angkan iya arak taluwa' mulka', daipara ma'ase' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya. Niambit iya e' mala'ikat, iya baranna sampay h'ndana maka duwangan anakna budjang. Jari binowa sigām paluwas min da'ira he'.

verses.name: Genesis 19:17
verses.text: Ma luwasan pa'in, ah'lling mala'ikat dangan, yukna, “Anginosog kam paragan bo' kam mbal magmula. Da'a kam pahogga' ma kapantayan ilu. Da'a kam minsan palingi'. Alahi sadja kam pehē' ni kabūd-būran supaya kam mbal talapay amatay.”  <div eID="gen291" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv151"/><div sID="gen292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv151"/> Sagō' aniya' pah'lling si Lōt ma iya. “Oy da'a saga tuwanku,” yukna.

verses.name: Genesis 19:19
verses.text: “Aheya pagsukulanku ma ka'am, tatabangbi ginhawa baranku. Sagō', ndū', alawak makalandu' kabūran e'. Marai' mbal tasampayku ati ta'abut mulka' aku.

verses.name: Genesis 19:20
verses.text: Nda'un ba kauman inān, anahut asal maka asekot pi'itu. Bang bahā' tugutannu aku alahi pina'an, sabab ta'nda'nu kanahutna. Manjari asalamat du aku.”  <div eID="gen292" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv152"/><div sID="gen293" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv152"/> Na, ya sambung mala'ikat ma si Lōt, “Aho', makajari kam pina'an. Mbal du paka'atku kauman ina'an-i.

verses.name: Genesis 19:22
verses.text: Saguwā' paragan kam pahāp. Subay kam at'kka pehē' bo' yampa lanjalanku hinangku.” Manjari ya kauman kapē'an disi Lōt inān, kaōnan Sowar<note>Sowar: ōn lahat pa'anggil ma dakayu' kabtangan ma bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘nahut.’</note> ma sabab bissala si Lōt, ya yukna anahut-nahut kono'.  <div eID="gen293" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv153"/><div sID="gen294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv153"/> Na, pagt'kka disi Lōt ni Sowar yamboho' pasobang mata llaw.

verses.name: Genesis 19:24
verses.text: Lahat Sodom maka lahat Gomora he' pinatumbukan ulan api e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Genesis 19:25
verses.text: Manjari kamulka'an e'na duwa lahat e'. Talapay isab saga kaluma'an ma kaluha'an kapantayan inān sampay manusiya'na kamemon sampay isab paltomo'-tomo'anna kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 19:26
verses.text: Sagō' bay palingi' h'nda si Lōt ni buli'anna ati tahinang iya magtūy batu asin.  <div eID="gen294" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv154"/><div sID="gen295" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv154"/> Na, pagsalung dakayu' bo' subu-subu lagi', magdai'-dai' si Ibrahim pabīng pehē' ni bay pat'nggehanna ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:28
verses.text: Niromolan e'na karatagan lahat Sodom maka Gomora. Humbu sadja ya ta'nda'na maina'an, sali' humbu tapahan aheya makalandu'.

verses.name: Genesis 19:29
verses.text: Daipara kinannal si Ibrahim e' Tuhan hinabuna amat'kka mulka' ma saga da'ira bay paglahatan si Lōt. Hatina si Ibrahim ya sababna angkan si Lōt pinapuwas e' Tuhan min mulka'.  <div eID="gen295" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen282" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv155"/><div sID="gen296" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal si Lōt maka saga Anakna Budjang</title> <div sID="gen297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv155"/> Na, si Lōt maka duwa anakna budjang inān tināw maglahat ma lahat Sowar. Manjari ala'an sigām pehē' ni kabūd-būran ati mahē' na sigām pat'nna' ma deyom dakayu' songab batu.

verses.name: Genesis 19:31
verses.text: Dakayu' llaw magsuli-suli anak si Lōt karuwangan. Yuk siyaka ma siyali, “Nneng, ato'a na si Mma' maka halam na aniya' l'lla ma lahat itu tahinangta h'lla buwat kabiyaksahan manusiya'.

verses.name: Genesis 19:32
verses.text: Gom lagi' palangota si Mma', jari maghulid kita maka iya bo' supaya aniya' tubu'ta.”

verses.name: Genesis 19:33
verses.text: Na pagsangom pa'in, pinalango si Lōt e' anakna-i ati pabihing ni iya anakna siyaka. Halam tasayu e' si Lōt sabab nilango iya.  <div eID="gen297" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv156"/><div sID="gen298" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv156"/> Pag'llaw, amissala siyaka ma siyali, yukna, “Aku ya bay ma bihing si Mma' dibuhi'. Na, sangom ilu, palangota iya pabīng ati ka'a na ya pabihing atuli. Manjari,” yukna, “sali'-sali' kita makabāk tubu' min mma'ta.”

verses.name: Genesis 19:35
verses.text: Sakali itu pagsangom pa'in, pinalango si Lōt e' duwangan anakna bo' pabihing ni iya anakna siyali. Halam du isab aniya' ai-ai tasayu e' si Lōt sabab nilango iya.

verses.name: Genesis 19:36
verses.text: Manjari ab'ttong e' si Lōt duwangan anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 19:37
verses.text: Siyaka anganak l'lla ati ōnanna Mowab.<note>Ya ōn Mowab itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘min mma'ku.’</note> Si Mowab itu ya na po'onan saga bangsa Mowab buwattina'an.

verses.name: Genesis 19:38
verses.text: Ya du anak si Lōt siyali, anganak isab l'lla ati niōnan e'na Bin-ammi.<note>Ya ōn Bin-ammi itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘anak min kampungku.’</note> Manjari si Bin-ammi itu, ya na po'onan saga bangsa Ammon buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen298" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.19"/> <div eID="gen296" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv157"/><div sID="gen299" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal si Ibrahim maka si Abimelek</title> <div sID="gen300" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv157"/> Na, maglain disi Ibrahim min lahat Mamre tudju ni Negeb ma lahat Kana'an bo' pahanti' ma tonga'an Kades maka Sūr. Puwas e', palanjal sigām ni da'ira Gerar, ati ma Gerar pa'in,

verses.name: Genesis 20:2
verses.text: angahaka si Ibrahim pasal h'ndana si Sara, in iya danakanna kono'. Manjari pagta'u itu e' si Abimelek, ya sultan ma lahat Gerar, pinabowa e'na si Sara bo' hinangna h'nda.

verses.name: Genesis 20:3
verses.text: Pagsangom pa'in, pinauppihan si Abimelek e' Tuhan. Yuk Tuhan ma iya ma deyom uppina, “Amatay ko' ka'a ilu sabab d'nda bay ta'ā'nu ilu taga-h'lla asal.”  <div eID="gen300" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv158"/><div sID="gen301" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv158"/> Na, halam gi' makabihing si Abimelek ni si Sara, angkan iya anambung ma Tuhan, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, papataynu aku bahā', sampay saga a'aku, ma halam aniya' dusaku?

verses.name: Genesis 20:5
verses.text: Bay aku nihaka'an e' si Ibrahim ya d'nda itu danakanna kono'. Ya du d'nda-i, bay angahaka isab in sigām magdanakan kono'. Tu'ud aku a'awam, halam kata'uwanku in iya taga-h'lla, maka halam aku makahinang ala'at.”  <div eID="gen301" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv159"/><div sID="gen302" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv159"/> Manjari ya sambung Tuhan ma si Abimelek ma deyom uppina, “Aho', kata'uwanku a'awam ka. Angkan ka bay sagga'ku bo' mbal makasekot ni iya, maka mbal isab makahinang dusa ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 20:7
verses.text: Na, papole'un na d'nda ilu pehē' ni h'llana. Nabi asal iya ati angamu'-ngamu' iya ni aku ma pasalnu supaya ka mbal amatay. Sagō' bang saupama mbal papole'nu, tantu du ka amatay sampay saga a'a ma deyomannu kamemon.”  <div eID="gen302" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv160"/><div sID="gen303" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv160"/> Pagsubu-subu pa'in, pinatimuk e' si Abimelek kamemon saga tendogna supaya pata'una sigām pasal bay tumaluwa' ma iya inān. Magtūy aheya tāw sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 20:9
verses.text: Si Ibrahim isab sinō' patampal ni si Abimelek bo' tilawna, yukna, “Ala'at pahāp hinangnu ma kami! Ai dusaku ma ka'a ya angkan kami maka bebeya'anku katōngannu dusa landu' aheya itu? Mbal manjari!

verses.name: Genesis 20:10
verses.text: Ai po'onanna ya angkan ka makahinang buwattilu?”  <div eID="gen303" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv161"/><div sID="gen304" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv161"/> Na, ya sambung si Ibrahim, “Tuwan sultan, pangannalku halam aniya' ma lahat itu tināw ma Tuhan. Angkanna ya ma deyom atayku binono' du aku bo' ta'ā' h'ndaku.

verses.name: Genesis 20:12
verses.text: B'nnal isab, magdanakan kami, da'mma', duwa ina'. Jari tahinangku iya h'nda.

verses.name: Genesis 20:13
verses.text: Na, ma masa bay panoho' Tuhan ma aku subay palawak min deyoman mma'ku, bay sa yukku ma h'ndaku, ‘Bang ka sab'nnal-b'nnal ma'ase' ma aku, pi'ingga-pi'ingga lahat kat'kkahanta angahaka ka in kita magdanakan.’ ”  <div eID="gen304" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv162"/><div sID="gen305" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv162"/> Na, pagkale lling itu e' si Abimelek, pinapole' e'na si Sara ni si Ibrahim. Aniya' isab saga bili-bili, saga sapi' maka saga ata d'nda-l'lla pamuwan e' si Abimelek ma si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 20:15
verses.text: Amissala lagi' iya ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Nda'un luha lahatku itu. Amene' ka maingga-maingga kabaya'annu pat'nna'an.”

verses.name: Genesis 20:16
verses.text: Yukna isab ma si Sara, “Itiya' buwananku danakannu dangibu pilak dī pilak pangandiyat kasā'anku, paltanda'an in ka'a halam bay makahinang dusa minsan ai.”  <div eID="gen305" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv163"/><div sID="gen306" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv163"/> Na, saga kar'ndahan kamemon ma okoman si Abimelek bay pinatigangan kandang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sabab kapangā'na ma si Sara h'nda si Ibrahim. Jari angamu'-ngamu' si Ibrahim ni Tuhan ma pasalan disi Abimelek, ati nirūlan pangamu'-ngamu'na. Hatina kauli'an si Abimelek maka h'ndana sampay saga ipatanna d'nda ati maka'anak sigām pabīng.  <div eID="gen306" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.20"/> <div eID="gen299" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv163"/><div sID="gen306" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv163"/> Na, saga kar'ndahan kamemon ma okoman si Abimelek bay pinatigangan kandang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sabab kapangā'na ma si Sara h'nda si Ibrahim. Jari angamu'-ngamu' si Ibrahim ni Tuhan ma pasalan disi Abimelek, ati nirūlan pangamu'-ngamu'na. Hatina kauli'an si Abimelek maka h'ndana sampay saga ipatanna d'nda ati maka'anak sigām pabīng.  <div eID="gen306" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.20"/> <div eID="gen299" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv164"/><div sID="gen307" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanganak ma si Isa'ak</title> <div sID="gen308" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv164"/> Na, tinuman e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bay panganjanji'na ma si Sara, kabuwanan iya kahāpan.

verses.name: Genesis 21:2
verses.text: Hatina ab'ttong iya ati anganak iya l'lla. Jari taga-anak na si Ibrahim ma kato'ana. Ya waktu kapanganak si Sara ya na waktu asal bay pangallam Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 21:3
verses.text: Manjari si Isa'ak ya pangōn si Ibrahim ma anakna min si Sara.

verses.name: Genesis 21:4
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in walumbahangi si Isa'ak ma luwasan, magtūy iya ni'islam e' si Ibrahim buwat bay panoho'an Tuhan ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 21:5
verses.text: Dahatus tahun na umul si Ibrahim ma waktu kapanganak ma si Isa'ak e'.  <div eID="gen308" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv165"/><div sID="gen309" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv165"/> Sakali ang'bbat si Sara, yukna, “Itiya' aku kabuwanan kakōgan maka pagtittowahan e' Tuhan. Sasuku isab makakale ma pasal itu-i magbeya' du magtittowa maka aku.”

verses.name: Genesis 21:7
verses.text: Yukna lagi', “Ma waktu dahū halam aniya' a'a makatawakkal ah'lling ma si Ibrahim in aku itu makaparuru' gi'. Sagō' itiya' aku kabuwanan anak minsan ato'a na h'llaku.”  <div eID="gen309" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen307" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv166"/><div sID="gen310" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalahi si Hajara maka si Isma'il</title> <div sID="gen311" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv166"/> Na, aheya-heya pa'in si Isa'ak, nilutas iya min ina'na. Manjari aheya jajamuhan pinasakap e' si Ibrahim ma llaw kalutas onde' inān.

verses.name: Genesis 21:9
verses.text: Pagubus, ta'nda' e' si Sara anakna si Isa'ak pinagtittowahan e' onde'-onde' ya anak si Ibrahim min si Hajara ya bangsa Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 21:10
verses.text: Sakali ah'lling si Sara ni si Ibrahim, yukna, “Tuwanku, pala'anun banyaga' itu maka anakna si Isma'il. Mbal iya subay binahagi'an alta' ya pamusaka'nu ma anakta si Isa'ak.”  <div eID="gen311" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv167"/><div sID="gen312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv167"/> Na, pagkale si Ibrahim ma lling h'ndana-i, landu' iya asusa sabab anakna du isab si Isma'il.

verses.name: Genesis 21:12
verses.text: Saguwā' magsuwala Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Da'a ka asusa pasal onde' ilu maka ina'na ya atanu. Beya'un sadja pah'lling si Sara ma ka'a, sabab si Isa'ak ya po'onan paltubu'annu.

verses.name: Genesis 21:13
verses.text: Ya pasal anak si Hajara, pahekaku panubu'na sampay sigām tahinang bangsa, sabab anaknu du iya.”  <div eID="gen312" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv168"/><div sID="gen313" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv168"/> Sakali pagsalung, subu-subu pa'in, aniya' sinakap e' si Ibrahim kinakan maka kuwit kambing isihan bohe'. Pinatanggung e'na ma baha si Hajara bo' yampa pinatulak e'na, iya maka anakna si Isma'il. Jari pal'ngngan-l'ngngan sigām ma paslangan lahat Be'erseba bo' halam sali' aniya' patudjuhan sigām tantu.

verses.name: Genesis 21:15
verses.text: Na, aubus pa'in bohe' bay lutu' sigām, ka'bbahan e' si Hajara anakna ma lindung kayu areyo'-deyo'.

verses.name: Genesis 21:16
verses.text: Paokat iya saga limampū' d'ppa lawakna aningkō'. Ya ma pikilanna, “Arōy, mbal aku makasandal ang'nda' bang amatay anakku.” Jari magdohon iya pagtingkō'na ma tongod ina'an.  <div eID="gen313" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv169"/><div sID="gen314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv169"/> Daipara takale tangis onde'-onde' inān e' Tuhan. Magtūy aniya' suwala mala'ikat min deyom sulga' ah'lling ni si Hajara, yuk-i, “O Hajara, angay ka asusa? Da'a ka tināw sabab takale e' Tuhan pagtangis anaknu hinabuna palege ma dambila' ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 21:18
verses.text: Bangunun iya bo' ambitun pahāp, sabab ma sinosōng hinangku paltubu'anna bangsa ga'osan.”  <div eID="gen314" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv170"/><div sID="gen315" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv170"/> Sakali itu aniya' bohe' pama'nda' Tuhan ma si Hajara. Magtūy iya pehē' anauk bo' pin'nno'an kuwit kambing ya bay bowana, ati pamainum e'na ma anakna inān.  <div eID="gen315" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv171"/><div sID="gen316" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv171"/> Manjari si Isma'il itu halam bay pinasagaran e' Tuhan hinabuna pasulig. Ina'an iya maglahat ma Paslangan Paran. Apanday asal si Isma'il magpana' hayop talun.

verses.name: Genesis 21:21
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in sigām ma lahat Paran, aniya' d'nda niā' min lahat Misil e' si Hajara pamah'ndana ma si Isma'il.  <div eID="gen316" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen310" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv172"/><div sID="gen317" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paljanji'an si Ibrahim maka si Abimelek</title> <div sID="gen318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv172"/> Na ma masa ina'an-i, pinehē' si Ibrahim e' sultan Abimelek maka si Pikul, nakura' kasundaluhanna. Yuk si Abimelek ma si Ibrahim, “Tuwan, kata'uwanku in ka'a tinabang sadja e' Tuhan ma ai-ai hinangnu.

verses.name: Genesis 21:23
verses.text: Manjari aniya' maksudku ni ka'a. Anapa ka maitu ma matahan Tuhan in ka'a mbal angakkal ma aku sampay ma anak-mpuku tubu'-manubu'. Bay aku amogbogan ka'a, manjari ka'a isab subay amogbogan aku sampay saga a'a kamemon ma deyom lahat ya pahanti'annu itu.”  <div eID="gen318" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv173"/><div sID="gen319" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv173"/> Anambung si Ibrahim, yukna, “Aho' tuwan, anapa aku.”  <div eID="gen319" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv174"/><div sID="gen320" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv174"/> Sakali itu aniya' palkala' pagdugalan si Ibrahim ma si Abimelek. Aniya' kono' bohe' kali si Ibrahim bay niagaw e' saga tendog si Abimelek.

verses.name: Genesis 21:26
verses.text: Ya sambung si Abimelek, “Tuwan, mbal kata'uwanku bang sai magkahinangan ya yuknu ilu. Halam aku asal bay pata'unu, yamboho' takaleku ma buwattina'an.”

verses.name: Genesis 21:27
verses.text: Manjari aniya' saga bili-bili maka sapi' binowa e' si Ibrahim pamuwanna ma si Abimelek bo' aniya' kapagsulutan sigām ahogot.

verses.name: Genesis 21:28
verses.text: Aniya' isab pitu' anak bili-bili, d'nda lullun, pinasaddī pa'ataganna min ba'anan bili-bilina kasehe'.

verses.name: Genesis 21:29
verses.text: Magtūy iya tinilaw e' si Abimelek, yukna, “Pamagaynu anak bili-bili pitu' hekana ya pasaddīnu ilu?”  <div eID="gen320" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv175"/><div sID="gen321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv175"/> Ya sambung isab si Ibrahim, “Tuwan sultan, taima'un kono' pitu' anak bili-bili itu paltanda'an in aku bay amakali bohe' he'.”

verses.name: Genesis 21:31
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan lahat inān kaōnan Be'erseba<note>Ya ōn Be'erseba itu, hatina ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘k'ppong pagsapahan’ atawa ‘k'ppong kapitu'an.’</note>, sabab bay pagsapahan si Ibrahim maka si Abimelek.  <div eID="gen321" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv176"/><div sID="gen322" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv176"/> Aubus pa'in sigām maghinang paljanji'an maina'an ma lahat Be'erseba, amole' na disi Abimelek maka si Pikul ni lahat sigām bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: Genesis 21:33
verses.text: Na aniya' po'on kayu tamaris tinanom e' si Ibrahim ma lahat Be'erseba-i ati maina'an iya anabbut ma ōn Yawe, ya Tuhan kakkal salama-lama.

verses.name: Genesis 21:34
verses.text: Manjari at'ggol kapaglahat disi Ibrahim ma lahat bangsa Pilistin e'.  <div eID="gen322" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.21"/> <div eID="gen317" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv177"/><div sID="gen323" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinulayan e' Tuhan si Ibrahim Pasal Anakna si Isa'ak</title> <div sID="gen324" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv177"/> Na, at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, sinulayan si Ibrahim e' Tuhan. Nilinganan iya, “O Ibrahim!” <div eID="gen324" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen325" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy anaul si Ibrahim, yukna, “Itiya' aku.”  <div eID="gen325" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv178"/><div sID="gen326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv178"/> Ya lling Tuhan ma iya, “Bowahun anaknu tunggal ilu, si Isa'ak ya kalasahannu to'ongan, pehē' ni lahat Muriya. Tō'anta ka būd ya pamowahannu iya. Jari pagt'kkabi pehē', sumbali'un iya bo' tunu'un pagkulbannu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen326" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv179"/><div sID="gen327" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv179"/> Dai' llaw pa'in, abati' na si Ibrahim an'tta' kayu panunu' sumbali'an. Niruwa' magtūy ni kura'na maka binowa isab anakna si Isa'ak maka duwa sosoho'anna. Jari palintas sigām tudju pehē' ni atag bay panoho'an Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen327" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv180"/><div sID="gen328" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv180"/> Ta'abut pa'in kat'llu llawna, ta'nda' e' si Ibrahim būd ya patudjuhan sigām min kalawakan lagi'.

verses.name: Genesis 22:5
verses.text: Yuk si Ibrahim ma duwangan sosoho'anna, “Angagad kam maitu maka kura' ilu. Aku maka onde' itu palanjal gi' ni atag e' maghinang ni Tuhan. Pabīng du kami pi'itu bang aubus na.”  <div eID="gen328" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv181"/><div sID="gen329" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv181"/> Manjari nihawas e' si Ibrahim kayu panunu' kukulbanan, ati pinatanggung e'na ma baha si Isa'ak. Si Ibrahim ya amowa lahut maka baga pangapi ati magbeya' sigā patukad.

verses.name: Genesis 22:7
verses.text: Pasalta', ah'lling si Isa'ak ni mma'na, yukna, “Mma'!” <div eID="gen329" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen330" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Ibrahim, “Ai, Otō'?” <div eID="gen330" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen331" type="paragraph"/> Ya lling si Isa'ak, “Mma', ilu ma ka'a baga pangandokot api, maka itiya' ma aku saga kayu. Sagō' maingga bahā' anak bili-bili ya sinumbali' maka tinunu' pagkulbanta?”  <div eID="gen331" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv182"/><div sID="gen332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv182"/> Anambung magtūy si Ibrahim, yukna, “Otō', Tuhan du ya amaniya' bili-bili pagkulbanta.” Manjari palanjal na sigā karuwangan.  <div eID="gen332" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv183"/><div sID="gen333" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv183"/> Na, makat'kka pa'in sigā ni būd bay panō' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim e', magtūy iya anambak batu pagtunu'an kulban. Aubus pa'in, pinat'nna' kayu ma diyata'na ati niengkotan anakna si Isa'ak bo' yampa palegena ma diyata' kayu.

verses.name: Genesis 22:10
verses.text: Puwas e' niā' bari' e' si Ibrahim panumbali' anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 22:11
verses.text: Malaingkan aniya' mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angalingan min deyom sulga', yukna “Ibrahim! O Ibrahim!” <div eID="gen333" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen334" type="paragraph"/> Anaul magtūy si Ibrahim, “Itiya' aku.”  <div eID="gen334" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv184"/><div sID="gen335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv184"/> Ah'lling mala'ikat-i, “Da'a sumbali'un anaknu! Da'a iya inayun! Kata'uwanku na in ka'a magmahaltabat sab'nnal-b'nnal ma Tuhan. Sabab minsan anaknu tunggal halam ka'llogannu, gom pa'in tukbalannu ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv185"/><div sID="gen336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv185"/> Na palingi' si Ibrahim ati aniya' ta'nda'na dakayu' bili-bili l'lla sumagnat tandukna ma kayu. Magtūy ningā' e'na bo' yampa sinumbali'. Jari tinunu' pagkulban ni Tuhan, pangangganti' baran anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 22:14
verses.text: Ya pangōn si Ibrahim ma lugal inān ‘Yawe-Yiri,’ hatina, ‘Pinaniya'an kitam e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.’ Sampay isab ni kabuwattituhan ya pangōn a'a ma lahat inān, yuk sigām, “Ma būd si Yawe kitam pinaniya'an e'na.”  <div eID="gen336" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv186"/><div sID="gen337" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv186"/> Nilinganan si Ibrahim pabīng min deyom sulga'. Mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya angalingan, kaminduwana na.

verses.name: Genesis 22:16
verses.text: Yukna, “Ibrahim, aku itu si Yawe<note>Si Yawe: dī ōn Tuhan ya pamabukisna ma nabi Musa.</note> ya angallam itu ma ka'a, maka ōnku luggiya' ya pamahogotan janji'ku. Bay ka ameya' ma panoho'anku ati halam ka'llogannu anaknu tunggal, gom pa'in tukbalannu ni aku.

verses.name: Genesis 22:17
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan aku amat'nna'an ka'a lidjiki' aheya, lidjiki' tuman. Pahekaku du panubu'nu, sali' heka bitu'un ma diyata' langit atawa heka solagan gusung ma bihing tahik. Anganda'ug sadja saga panubu'nu ati ta'agaw e' sigām lahat bay suku' kabantahan sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 22:18
