verses.text: Manjari bangsa kamemon ma deyom dunya angamu' kahāpan du min aku pinasali' ni kahāpan ya pamuwanku ma panubu'nu. Angkan buwattē', sabab bay ka ameya' ma panoho'anku.”  <div eID="gen337" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv187"/><div sID="gen338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv187"/> Puwas e' pabalik na disi Ibrahim ni saga sosoho'anna. Jari magbeya' sigām amole' pehē' ni lahat Be'erseba ati mahē' sigām pat'nna'.  <div eID="gen338" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen323" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv188"/><div sID="gen339" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panubu' si Nahor</title> <div sID="gen340" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv188"/> Na at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, kahaka'an si Ibrahim pasal danakanna si Nahor. Aniya' anakna min h'ndana si Milka, walu' hekana.

verses.name: Genesis 22:21
verses.text: Ya siyaka to'ongan si Ūs, ya pasunu' si Būs, bo' si Kimuwil mma' si Aram.

verses.name: Genesis 22:22
verses.text: Puwas si Kimuwil si Kesed, bo' si Haso, bo' si Pildas, bo' si Jidlap, bo' kasiyalihan to'ongan si Bituwil

verses.name: Genesis 22:23
verses.text: ya mma' si Ripka. Ya na ina'an saga anak l'lla si Milka h'nda si Nahor danakan si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 22:24
verses.text: Aniya' isab kalu'a si Milka, ōnna si Rema. Taga-anak isab iya mpat. Ya siyaka si Teba, pasunu' si Gaham, bo' si Tahas, bo' si Ma'aka ya kasiyalihan.  <div eID="gen340" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.22"/> <div eID="gen339" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv189"/><div sID="gen341" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Sara</title> <div sID="gen342" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv189"/> Na si Sara, ta'abut pa'in dahatus maka duwampū' maka pituntahun umulna,

verses.name: Genesis 23:2
verses.text: amatay na iya ma lahat Kana'an, ma kauman Hebron, ya kaōnan Kiriyat-Aba ma waktu bay palabay. Manjari pareyom si Ibrahim anangisan h'ndana.

verses.name: Genesis 23:3
verses.text: Aubus pa'in, pabuhat iya min bihing mayat h'ndana bo' paluwas amowa saga bangsa Hīt maggara'. Yukna ma sigām,

verses.name: Genesis 23:4
verses.text: “Saga tuwan, aku itu a'a liyu maglihan sadja ma deyomanbi. Ya amu'ku ma ka'am, amab'lli kono' kam tana' bo' aniya' pangubulanku h'ndaku.”  <div eID="gen342" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv190"/><div sID="gen343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv190"/> Anambung saga a'a bangsa Hīt ma si Ibrahim, yuk-i,

verses.name: Genesis 23:6
verses.text: “Tuwan, kalehun kono'. Bang ma kami ka'a ilu a'a alanga, patut pinagaddatan. Kubulun h'ndanu ma deyom tampat kami ya katapusan ahāp. Amene' ka kono' maingga-maingga kabaya'annu pangubulan. Halam aniya' min kami makapagin'mbal ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen343" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv191"/><div sID="gen344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv191"/> Na, pakuru' magtūy si Ibrahim ma dahuan saga a'a Hīt, ya bangsa tag-lahat, bo' yukna ma sigām,

verses.name: Genesis 23:8
verses.text: “Bang aku parūlbi angubul h'ndaku maitu, magpati'llot kam ma aku maka si Epron anak si Sohar.

verses.name: Genesis 23:9
verses.text: Suli-sulihinbi iya pasal songab batu ya ma tōng tana'na, ya ma jadjahan lahat Makpela inān. Bang iya bilahi amab'lli, na, b'lliku du minsan pila pangahalga'na ma aku, jari hinangku pagkubulan. Maitu du aku magbayad ma dahuanbi kamemon.”  <div eID="gen344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv192"/><div sID="gen345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv192"/> Na maina'an asal si Epron samatingkō' maka kasehe'anna bangsa Hīt ya patimuk ma atag lawang pagsōd-luwasan da'ira inān. Magtūy sambunganna si Ibrahim ma pagkalehan sigām kamemon, yukna,

verses.name: Genesis 23:11
verses.text: “Tuwan, kalehun kono' pah'llingku itu. In tana' ilu sampay songab batuna pamuwanku du ma ka'a. Saksi'ku saga lūng-kampungku itu. Na, taima'un kono' pangubulannu h'ndanu.”  <div eID="gen345" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv193"/><div sID="gen346" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv193"/> Na, pakuru' si Ibrahim pabīng ma dahuan sigām bangsa Hīt.

verses.name: Genesis 23:13
verses.text: Ah'lling iya ma si Epron ma pagkalehan sigām kamemon, yukna, “Tuwan, kalehun aku. B'lliku tana' ilu kamemon. Bayaranta ka pila-pila halga'na. Taima'un kono' bayad itu supaya aku makakubul mayat h'ndaku mahē'.”  <div eID="gen346" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv194"/><div sID="gen347" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv194"/> Anambung magtūy si Epron, yukna,

verses.name: Genesis 23:15
verses.text: “Tuwan, ya halga' tana' ilu mpat hatus pilak sadja. Saguwā' pamagayta ilu-i? Kubulun na h'ndanu pehē'.”  <div eID="gen347" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv195"/><div sID="gen348" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv195"/> Na kasulutan si Ibrahim ma bay pangahalga' si Epron ma pagkalehan saga a'a inān kamemon. Tinimbang e' si Ibrahim mpat hatus pilak tibu'uk ma buwat pagtimbang saga palilitu ma waktu ina'an-i, ati bayaranna na.

verses.name: Genesis 23:17
verses.text: Manjari palsuku'an si Ibrahim na tana' si Epron, ya ma jadjahan Makpela ma bihing lahat Mamre. Palsuku'anna na tana' maka songab batu, sampay kakayu-kayuhan kamemon isab ya ma deyomna.

verses.name: Genesis 23:18
verses.text: Manjari kasaksi'an e' a'a bangsa Hīt kamemon ya magtimuk maina'an ma pagsosōran da'ira, in si Ibrahim na tag-dapu tana' inān.  <div eID="gen348" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv196"/><div sID="gen349" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv196"/> Aubus pa'in, kinubul e' si Ibrahim h'ndana si Sara ma deyom songab batu inān ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 23:20
verses.text: Na, ya na he'. Ya tana' maka songab batu bay ma a'a bangsa Hīt palsuku'an na ma si Ibrahim, pagkubulanna.  <div eID="gen349" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.23"/> <div eID="gen341" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv197"/><div sID="gen350" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa'ak maka si Ripka</title> <div sID="gen351" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv197"/> Na, ato'a na to'ongan si Ibrahim. Aheka asal kahāpan bay pamuwan iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma ai-ai hinangna.

verses.name: Genesis 24:2
verses.text: Manjari aniya' dakayu' llaw ah'lling si Ibrahim ma dakayu' sosoho'anna, ya tag-ntanan pangalta'na kamemon. Yukna, “Dai' ka. Pat'nna'un tangannu ma llotan pa'aku<note>Pat'nna'un tangannu ma llotan pa'aku: addat bangsa Hibrani ma masa awal, paltanda'an in sapana mbal to'ongan amaluba.</note>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:3
verses.text: Anapa ka ma ōn Yawe, ya Tuhan tag-sulga' maka dunya, da'a pah'nda'in anakku si Isa'ak ni d'nda min bangsa Kana'an, ya tag-lahat pat'nna'anku itu.

verses.name: Genesis 24:4
verses.text: Pehē' ka gom pa'in ni saga kakampunganku mahē' ma lahatku porol, ati piha'in si Isa'ak d'nda minnē' pamah'nda ma iya.”  <div eID="gen351" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv198"/><div sID="gen352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv198"/> Manjari tinilaw si Ibrahim e' sosoho'anna-i, yukna, “Tuwan, bang saupama mbal bilahi d'nda ameya' ma aku pi'itu ni lahat itu, ai subay hinangku? Bowaku anaknu pehē' bahā', ni bay lahatnu tagna'?”  <div eID="gen352" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv199"/><div sID="gen353" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv199"/> Ya sambung si Ibrahim, “Oy da'a! Amay-amay, da'a bowahun anakku pehē'.

verses.name: Genesis 24:7
verses.text: Si Yawe ya Tuhan tag-sulga' bay amapi'itu aku min lahatku porol maka min kakampunganku. Aniya' isab janji' pagkallamna ma aku. Lahat itu kono' pamuwanna du ma saga panubu'ku. Tantu du Tuhan itu amabeya' mala'ikatna parahū min ka'a anakap ai-ai supaya ka makapiha d'nda minnē' pamah'nda ma anakku si Isa'ak.

verses.name: Genesis 24:8
verses.text: Malaingkan,” yuk si Ibrahim, “bang d'nda ilu mbal bilahi ameya' ma ka'a pi'itu, puwas na ka min palkala' ya pagsapahanta itu. Ya sadja pangamay-ngamayku ma ka'a, da'a bowahun anakku pehē'.”

verses.name: Genesis 24:9
verses.text: Magtūy anapa sosoho'an si Ibrahim pasal ina'an-i, maka pinat'nna' tanganna ma deyo' pa'a nakura'na.  <div eID="gen353" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv200"/><div sID="gen354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv200"/> Pagubus, sinakap e'na unta' si Ibrahim sangpū' hekana, niruwa'an ginisan alta' bo' aniya' kasampangan. Jari pauntas iya tudju pehē' ni kauman si Nahor ma lahat Mesopotami.

verses.name: Genesis 24:11
verses.text: Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, at'kka na sosoho'an si Ibrahim pehē' ni kaluma'an si Nahor, ati pinatingkō' e'na saga unta' ma atag bohe' ya ma luwasan kaluma'an. Abay kohap na lahat, waktu pagā' bohe' e' saga kar'ndahan.

verses.name: Genesis 24:12
verses.text: Manjari angamu'-ngamu' iya ma Tuhan, yukna, “O Yawe, ya pagtuhanan nakura'ku si Ibrahim, tabangin aku llaw itu bo' ta'ā'ku maksudku. Pa'nda'in isab lasanu maka ase'nu ma nakura'ku he'.

verses.name: Genesis 24:13
verses.text: Itiya' aku an'ngge ma tongod pagbohe'an, maka ilu na isab saga kabudjangan pi'itu min kaluma'an supaya angā' bohe'.

verses.name: Genesis 24:14
verses.text: Na, bang sigām ganta' palūd pi'itu, ya pah'llingku ma dakayu' min sigām, ‘Arung, painumun lagi' aku bohe' min kibutnu ilu.’ Na, bang iya ina'an d'nda ya asal tapene'nu pamah'nda ma sosoho'annu si Isa'ak, na, mura-murahan bang pa'in buwattitu panambungna: ‘Aho' tuwan, anginum ka, maka ngā'anta lagi' ka bohe' pamainum saga unta'nu.’ Na, bang hati' buwattē', magtūy kata'uwanku in kasi-lasanu ma nakura'ku aheya to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen354" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv201"/><div sID="gen355" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv201"/> Manjari itu, halam gi' aubus pangamu'-ngamu'na, aniya' budjang palūd pina'an magtanggung kibut, ōnna si Ripka. Na, mma' si Ripka itu si Bituwil, anak si Nahor maka si Milka. Si Nahor itu magdanakan maka si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 24:16
verses.text: Ahāp d'nda si Ripka, alingkat to'ongan, maka halam bay makalabay l'lla. Palūd iya ni bohe' angisihan kibutna bo' yampa patukad pabalik.

verses.name: Genesis 24:17
verses.text: Pal'kkas magtūy sosoho'an si Ibrahim anampang iya, yukna, “Arung, painumun lagi' aku bohe' min kibutnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen355" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv202"/><div sID="gen356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv202"/> Ya sambungna, “Aho', Tuwan, anginum na ka.” Magtūy pinareyo' kibutna supaya makainum a'a-i.  <div eID="gen356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv203"/><div sID="gen357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv203"/> Aubus pa'in e'na anginum, yuk budjang ma iya, “Angagad gi' ka, tuwan, ngā'anku lagi' bohe' pamainum saga unta'nu sampay sigām asso.”

verses.name: Genesis 24:20
verses.text: Magtūy tinuwangan isi kibutna pehē' ni pagi'inuman saga hayop, ati magkuwat-kuwat iya angā' bohe' sampay tapainumna kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 24:21
verses.text: Halam ah'lling sosoho'an-i. Hal ang'nda'-ng'nda' maka e'na maghona'-hona' bang kalu ta'ā'na maksudna sabab tabang min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen357" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv204"/><div sID="gen358" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv204"/> Aubus pa'in anginum saga unta' inān, aniya' kasampangan nihawas e' sosoho'an-i min duwa'anna: dakayu' singsing ahalga' maka duwa gallang aheya, bulawan lullun, ati pamuwanna ma budjang-i.

verses.name: Genesis 24:23
verses.text: Puwas e' atilaw iya ma budjang, yukna, “Arung, sai mma'nu? Makajari kami atuli ma luma'bi sangom ilu? S'ddong bahā'?”  <div eID="gen358" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv205"/><div sID="gen359" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv205"/> Yuk sambung budjang, “Mma'ku si Bituwil, mbo'ku si Nahor maka si Milka.

verses.name: Genesis 24:25
verses.text: Aheka parang-parang kami pamakan saga unta'nu, aniya' isab kapantayan paghali-halian. Maka luma' kami aheya du isab.”  <div eID="gen359" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv206"/><div sID="gen360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv206"/> Magtūy pakuru' sosoho'an inān amudji <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:27
verses.text: Yukna, “Pudjiku si Yawe ya pagtuhanan nakura'ku si Ibrahim, pagka itiya' pa'nda'anna lasana maka ase'na ma iya. B'nnal-b'nnal katō'an aku e'na lān tudju ni kakampungan nakura'ku.”  <div eID="gen360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv207"/><div sID="gen361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv207"/> Sakali itu magdai'-dai' budjang-i parahū amole' ni pagluma'an ina'na. Kasuli-sulihan sigām kamemon pasal bay kahālanna inān.

verses.name: Genesis 24:29
verses.text: Na aniya' danakan si Ripka l'lla ōnna si Leban. Pagkale si Leban itu ma suli-suli si Ripka, maka pag'nda'na isab singsing ma ūngna maka gallang ma l'ngngonna karuwambila', magtūy iya magdai'-dai' pehē' ni bohe'. Ta'nda'na a'a bay panuli-nuli e' danakanna an'ngge maina'an ma bihing saga unta'na.

verses.name: Genesis 24:30
verses.text: Na aniya' danakan si Ripka l'lla ōnna si Leban. Pagkale si Leban itu ma suli-suli si Ripka, maka pag'nda'na isab singsing ma ūngna maka gallang ma l'ngngonna karuwambila', magtūy iya magdai'-dai' pehē' ni bohe'. Ta'nda'na a'a bay panuli-nuli e' danakanna an'ngge maina'an ma bihing saga unta'na.

verses.name: Genesis 24:31
verses.text: Yuk si Leban ma iya, “O tuwan, ka'a binarakatan e' Tuhan. Angay ka paddas maitu? Sūng kita pehē' ni luma'. Sakap na ma ka'a maka aniya' isab palegehan kaunta'annu.”  <div eID="gen361" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv208"/><div sID="gen362" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv208"/> Manjari pehē' a'a-i ni luma', ati nihawasan saga duwa'an min bukut saga unta'na e' si Leban. Pinakan isab unta' he' maka pinat'nna'an parang-parang pabahakan. Aniya' isab bohe' binowahan sosoho'an si Ibrahim maka saga sehe'na pangose' tape' sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 24:33
verses.text: Pagbuhat pa'in lalabotan ma sosoho'an si Ibrahim-i, ah'lling iya, yukna, “Mbal lagi' aku amangan, tuwan. Subay paluwasku gawiku dahū.” <div eID="gen362" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen363" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Leban, “Na aho', paluwasun kono'.”  <div eID="gen363" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv209"/><div sID="gen364" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv209"/> Jari ah'lling na, yukna, “In aku itu sosoho'an si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 24:35
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan tapamuwan si Yawe ma iya, manjari dayahan na. Ya pamuwan Tuhan ma iya ba'anan hayop kaginisan, angkan jukup iya ma bili-bili, kambing, sapi', unta' maka kura'. Aheka isab bulawan kaginisan, aheka isab atana d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 24:36
verses.text: Na h'ndana si Sara bay anganak l'lla ma kato'ana, ati pamusaka' na e' si Ibrahim ma anakna itu karayana kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 24:37
verses.text: Manjari aku itu bay binowa magsapa e' nakura'ku he'. Yukna ma aku, ‘Da'a pah'nda'in anakku si Isa'ak d'nda minnitu min lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 24:38
verses.text: Subay ka pehē' ni kakampunganku, ni dī kausbahanku bo' supaya ka amiha d'nda maina'an pamah'nda ma anakku.’  <div eID="gen364" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv210"/><div sID="gen365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv210"/> “Magtūy tilawku nakura'ku, yukku, ‘Bang saupama aniya' d'nda tapihaku sagō' mbal bilahi ameya' ma aku pi'itu ni lahat itu, painay?’

verses.name: Genesis 24:40
verses.text: Ya sambungna ma aku, ‘Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pagbeya'anku, tantu iya anoho' mala'ikatna anehe'an ka'a supaya ta'ā'nu maksudnu. Tantu aniya' d'nda min kakampunganku tabowanu pamah'nda ma anakku.

verses.name: Genesis 24:41
verses.text: Malaingkan,’ yuk nakura'ku-i, ‘bang ka saupama pehē' ni saga kausbahanku bo' ka mbal tinaima', apuwas na ka min palkala' ya pagsapahanta itu.’ ”  <div eID="gen365" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv211"/><div sID="gen366" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv211"/> Anuli-nuli gi' sosoho'an si Ibrahim, yukna, “Na, makat'kka pa'in aku ni bohe' insini', angamu'-ngamu' aku. Yukku, ‘O Yawe, ya pagtuhanan nakura'ku si Ibrahim, tabangin aku supaya ta'ā'ku maksudku.

verses.name: Genesis 24:43
verses.text: Itiya' aku ma bihing bohe'. Jari bang aniya' budjang pi'itu angā' bohe', angamu' du aku pinainum bohe' min kibutna.

verses.name: Genesis 24:44
verses.text: Na Tuhan, bang ya na d'nda ya asal tapene'nu pamah'nda ma anak nakura'ku, na, bang pa'in buwattitu panambung budjang-i ma aku, “Aho' tuwan, anginum ka. Ngā'anta ka bohe' isab pamainum saga unta'nu.” ’  <div eID="gen366" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv212"/><div sID="gen367" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv212"/> “Sakali itu,” yuk a'a-i ma disi Leban, “halam gi' aubus e'ku angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ma deyom atayku, ina'an si Ripka patuwa' magtanggung kibut. Palūd iya magtūy angā' bohe'. Aubus pa'in, yukku ma iya, ‘Arung, makajari aku painumnu bohe'?’  <div eID="gen367" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv213"/><div sID="gen368" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv213"/> “Pinareyo' kibut magtūy min bahana. Yukna ma aku, ‘Aho' tuwan, anginum na ka. Painumku isab saga unta'nu.’ Jari anginum na aku, maka pinainum isab unta'ku.  <div eID="gen368" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv214"/><div sID="gen369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv214"/> “Bay iya tilawku isab, ‘Sai mma'nu?’ Ya sambungna ma aku, ‘Aku itu anak si Bituwil, mbo'ku si Nahor maka si Milka. Manjari tuwan,” yuk a'a, “bay sangonanku singsing ilu ni ūngna maka pasulugku isab gallang ma l'ngngonna karuwambila'.

verses.name: Genesis 24:48
verses.text: Pagubus, pakuru' aku magtūy amudji si Yawe ya pagtuhanan nakura'ku si Ibrahim. Aheya pagsukulanku ma iya sabab katuli'an aku e'na pi'itu ni saga lahasiya' si Ibrahim. Tapihaku na anak sigām budjang pamah'nda ma anak nakura'ku, bang hati aniya' dapat.

verses.name: Genesis 24:49
verses.text: Na, bang aniya' lasabi ma nakura'ku pagka kam maglahasiya' du, haka'inbi aku sab'nnal-b'nnal bang taima'bi maksudku itu atawa mbal. Bang hati' mbal, na maghona'-hona' lagi' aku bang ai subay hinangku.”  <div eID="gen369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv215"/><div sID="gen370" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv215"/> Anambung si Leban maka si Bituwil, yuk sigām, “Ya palkala' ilu min kabaya'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> du, jari halam aniya' kapatut kami angaho' atawa magin'mbal.

verses.name: Genesis 24:51
verses.text: Itiya' si Ripka, bowahun iya pasambeya' ma ka'a tudju ni pamole'anbi. Pah'nda'un iya ma anak nakura'nu. Tu'ud kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ko' ilu.”  <div eID="gen370" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv216"/><div sID="gen371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv216"/> Na, pagkale sosoho'an si Ibrahim ma sambung disi Leban-i, magtūy iya pasujud magsarang-sukul ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:53
verses.text: Puwas e', pinaluwas e'na saga s'mmek maka pamulawan dī bulawan bo' yampa pamuwanna ma si Ripka. Aniya' isab kasampangan ahalga' pamuwanna ma disi Leban sampay ma ina' si Ripka.

verses.name: Genesis 24:54
verses.text: Na aubus pa'in ina'an-i, magkakanan maka maginum sosoho'an si Ibrahim maka saga sehe'na bo' yampa sigām atuli. <div eID="gen371" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen372" type="paragraph"/> Pag'llaw dakayu' bo' magbati'an na sigām, ama'id sosoho'an e' min disi Leban. Yukna, “Amuhun lagi' aku amole' ni nakura'ku.”  <div eID="gen372" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv217"/><div sID="gen373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv217"/> Saguwā' mbal bilahi danakan si Ripka maka ina'na, yuk sigām, “Tuwan, bang bahā' minaitu gi' si Arung saga sangpū' bahangi. Pagpuwas, ameya' du iya ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv218"/><div sID="gen374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv218"/> Malaingkan yuk sosoho'an, “Ndū' ampunun aku, sagō' ahāp kami da'a taggahinbi. Ta'ā'ku na in maksudku ma sabab tabang min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, manjari papole'unbi na aku bo' pabīng ni nakura'ku he'.”  <div eID="gen374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv219"/><div sID="gen375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv219"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Lingananta gi' si Ripka. Tilawta iya bang ai kabaya'anna.”

verses.name: Genesis 24:58
verses.text: Sakali nilinganan si Ripka bo' tinilaw. Yuk-i, “Na buwattingga? Bilahi ka ameya' ma a'a itu?” <div eID="gen375" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen376" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Ripka, “Aho', ameya' aku.”  <div eID="gen376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv220"/><div sID="gen377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv220"/> Manjari pinatulak kakasi sigām si Ripka ameya' ma a'a inān sampay saga sehe'na. Pinabeya' isab ma iya matto'a d'nda ya bay angipat iya min kariki'-diki'na gi'.

verses.name: Genesis 24:60
verses.text: Niamu'-amu'an isab iya duwa'a min Tuhan e' disi Leban. Yuk pangamu' sigām, <lg sID="gen378"/> <l level="1" sID="gen379"/>“Arung, mura-murahan bang pa'in laksa'an heka panubu'nu!<l eID="gen379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen380"/>Bang pa'in ta'agaw e' panubu'nu lahat kabantahan sigām.”<l eID="gen380" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen378"/>  <div eID="gen377" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv221"/><div sID="gen381" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv221"/> Puwas e' magsakap na si Ripka maka saga sehe'na d'nda ati pakura' sigām ni saga unta' bo' ameya' ma tendog si Ibrahim e'. Jari pauntas sigām kamemon ni pal'ngnganan sigām.  <div eID="gen381" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv222"/><div sID="gen382" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv222"/> Na in si Isa'ak, wa'i na pat'nna' ma lahat Negeb (lahat tampal ni satan min lahat Kana'an). Yamboho' iya makapole' min bohe' niōnan Be'er-Lahai-Ruwi.

verses.name: Genesis 24:63
verses.text: Manjari itu, abay kohap pa'in lahat, hinabuna maglunsul-lunsul ma kaparangan, aniya' ta'nda'na saga unta' magt'kkahan.

verses.name: Genesis 24:64
verses.text: Ahā, ta'nda' isab si Isa'ak e' si Ripka. Pag'nda'na, magtūy iya pareyo' min unta'

verses.name: Genesis 24:65
verses.text: bo' tilawna sosoho'an si Ibrahim. Yukna, “Sai bahā' l'lla ma kaparangan inān, ya pal'ngngan tudju pi'itu ni kita?” <div eID="gen382" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen383" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sosoho'an si Ibrahim, “Si Isa'ak ko' inān, ya nakura'ku.” Magtūy niā' e' si Ripka turungna panambunna ma baihu'na.  <div eID="gen383" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv223"/><div sID="gen384" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv223"/> Makasampay pa'in sigām ni si Isa'ak, nihaka'an iya e' sosoho'an e' pasal kamemon bay kalabayanna.

verses.name: Genesis 24:67
verses.text: Pagubus, binowa si Ripka e' si Isa'ak tudju ni deyom kamalig bay pagluma'an ina'na si Sara. Gana-gana tahinangna h'nda. Alasa to'ongan si Isa'ak ma si Ripka, manjari kauli'an karukka'anna min kamatay ina'na.  <div eID="gen384" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.24"/> <div eID="gen350" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv224"/><div sID="gen385" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panubu' si Ibrahim</title> <div sID="gen386" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv224"/> Manjari si Ibrahim makapagh'nda na pabīng, ōn h'ndana si Kitura.

verses.name: Genesis 25:2
verses.text: Nnom anakna l'lla min si Kitura. Ya siyaka si Simran, pasunu' si Joksan, bo' si Medan, bo' si Midiyan, kalimana si Isbak bo' si Suwa ya kasiyalihan.

verses.name: Genesis 25:3
verses.text: Si Joksan itu ya na mma' si Seba maka si Dedan. Manjari saga panubu' si Dedan, ya na bangsa Assur, bangsa Litus maka bangsa Leyom.

verses.name: Genesis 25:4
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga anak si Midiyan l'lla. Ōn sigām si Epa, si Eper, si Hanok, si Abida maka si Elda. Na, iya na ina'an panubu' si Ibrahim min h'ndana si Kitura.  <div eID="gen386" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv225"/><div sID="gen387" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv225"/> Si Isa'ak ya pamusaka'an e' si Ibrahim suku'na kamemon. Daipara sasangna allum lagi', aniya' alta' pamuwanna ma saga anakna min saga h'ndana saddī min si Sara. Sinoho' sigām maglahat ma lahat dakayu' tampal ni sobangan bo' supaya sigām alawak min anakna si Isa'ak.  <div eID="gen387" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv225"/><div sID="gen387" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv225"/> Si Isa'ak ya pamusaka'an e' si Ibrahim suku'na kamemon. Daipara sasangna allum lagi', aniya' alta' pamuwanna ma saga anakna min saga h'ndana saddī min si Sara. Sinoho' sigām maglahat ma lahat dakayu' tampal ni sobangan bo' supaya sigām alawak min anakna si Isa'ak.  <div eID="gen387" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv226"/><div sID="gen388" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv226"/> Na ataha' to'ongan umul si Ibrahim, dahatus maka pitumpū' maka limantahun. Manjari amatay na iya ma deyom kasannangan ati pinapagtimuk iya maka ka'mbo'-mbo'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv226"/><div sID="gen388" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv226"/> Na ataha' to'ongan umul si Ibrahim, dahatus maka pitumpū' maka limantahun. Manjari amatay na iya ma deyom kasannangan ati pinapagtimuk iya maka ka'mbo'-mbo'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 25:9
verses.text: Kinubul iya e' anakna si Isa'ak maka si Isma'il ma deyom songab batu ma tana' si Makpela tampal ni sobangan min tana' si Mamre. Songab batu itu asal ma tana' bay bin'lli e' si Ibrahim min si Epron anak si Sohar bangsa Hīt. Jari kinubul si Ibrahim ma bihing h'ndana si Sara.

verses.name: Genesis 25:10
verses.text: Kinubul iya e' anakna si Isa'ak maka si Isma'il ma deyom songab batu ma tana' si Makpela tampal ni sobangan min tana' si Mamre. Songab batu itu asal ma tana' bay bin'lli e' si Ibrahim min si Epron anak si Sohar bangsa Hīt. Jari kinubul si Ibrahim ma bihing h'ndana si Sara.

verses.name: Genesis 25:11
verses.text: Na, pagka amatay na si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak ya pas'lle' binuwanan kahāpan na pa'in e' Tuhan. Maglahat si Isa'ak ma tongod bohe' Be'er-Lahai-Ruwi.  <div eID="gen388" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen385" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv227"/><div sID="gen389" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panubu' si Isma'il</title> <div sID="gen390" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv227"/> Ya na itu saga panubu' si Isma'il, anak si Ibrahim min si Hajara a'a bangsa Misil, ya bay ipatan si Sara.

verses.name: Genesis 25:13
verses.text: Ya itu ōn saga anak si Isma'il magsunu'-sunu': si Nebayot ya kasiyakahan, pasunu' si Kedar, bo' si Abbe'el, bo' si Mibsam.

verses.name: Genesis 25:14
verses.text: Ya pasunu' ma si Mibsam si Misma, bo' si Duma, bo' si Massa,

verses.name: Genesis 25:15
verses.text: bo' si Hadad, bo' si Tema, bo' si Jetor, bo' isab si Napis, kasiyalihan si Kedema.

verses.name: Genesis 25:16
verses.text: Na saga anak si Isma'il itu tahinang po'onan sangpū' maka duwa tumpuk. Maka ōn sigām tahinang ōn lahat isab, ya pat'nna'an ba'anan katumpukan itu.

verses.name: Genesis 25:17
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in umul si Isma'il dahatus maka t'llumpū' maka pituntahun, amatay na iya ati pinapagtimuk maka ka'mbo'-mbo'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 25:18
verses.text: Manjari saga panubu' si Isma'il itu ina'an maglahat ma tonga'an lahat Habila maka Sūr, ma bihing lahat Misil tampal ni sobangan. Magsaddī asal pat'nna'an sigām min saga panubu' si Ibrahim kasehe'an.  <div eID="gen390" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen389" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv228"/><div sID="gen391" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yakub maka si Esaw</title> <div sID="gen392" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv228"/> Ya na itu salsila pasal si Isa'ak, anak si Ibrahim. <div eID="gen392" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen393" type="paragraph"/> Si Ibrahim ya mma' si Isa'ak.

verses.name: Genesis 25:20
verses.text: Mpatpū' tahun ya umul si Isa'ak waktu pah'ndana ma si Ripka danakan si Leban, anak si Bituwil. (Si Bituwil itu a'a Aram min lahat Mesopotami.)

verses.name: Genesis 25:21
verses.text: Sakali itu, pagka halam maka'anak si Ripka minsan at'ggol na pagpūn sigām, angamu'-ngamu' si Isa'ak ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bang pa'in pinapangiram h'ndana. Manjari pinarūl pangamu'na e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ati ab'ttong si Ripka.

verses.name: Genesis 25:22
verses.text: Ya kinab'ttongan e' si Ripka k'mbal, sagō' ma halam lagi' paluwas tananamna sigām magkosog-kosogan ma deyom b'ttongna. Yuk si Ripka, “Angay bahā' buwattitu pagb'ttongku?” Jari angaru iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.  <div eID="gen393" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv229"/><div sID="gen394" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv229"/> Ati yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, <lg sID="gen395"/> <l level="1" sID="gen396"/>“Ya ma deyom b'ttongnu ilu, duwa onde'-onde',<l eID="gen396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen397"/>manjari tahinang sigām duwa bangsa mbal to'ongan magsulut.<l eID="gen397" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen398"/>Sababna dakayu' ilu akosog min dakayu',<l eID="gen398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen399"/>maka anaknu siyaka ilu pinagbaya'an du e' siyali.”<l eID="gen399" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen395"/>  <div eID="gen394" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv230"/><div sID="gen400" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv230"/> Manjari ta'abut na bulanan si Ripka, k'mbal l'lla anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 25:25
verses.text: Ya dahū paluwas, akeyat-keyat kuwitna maka bahibuan baranna kamemon sali' kahantang kakana' akasap. Angkan iya niōnan Esaw.<note>Ya ōn Esaw itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘bahibuan.’</note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:26
verses.text: Ya paluwas damuli wa'i amalut pahogot ma buli' tape' si Esaw. Angkanna iya niōnan si Yakub.<note>Ōn Yakub itu pa'anggil ma dakayu' kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘amalut ma buli' tape'.’ Ya hantang hatulanna isab, ‘pangangakkal.’</note> Nnompū' tahun asal umul si Isa'ak ma waktu kapanganak ma anakna k'mbal itu.  <div eID="gen400" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen391" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv231"/><div sID="gen401" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinab'llihan e' si Esaw Kapatutanna Anak Siyaka</title> <div sID="gen402" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv231"/> Manjari asangpot pa'in umul duwangan k'mbal itu, si Esaw ya a'a magpapana', apanday to'ongan angā' hayop talun. Ya katagihanna subay ma luwasan sadja. Saddī kajarihan si Yakub. Ahantap iya, ya katagihanna subay pataptap ma kauman.

verses.name: Genesis 25:28
verses.text: Na, aheya lasa si Isa'ak ma si Esaw sabab asōb iya amangan susumbali'an ya tapana' e' si Esaw. Sagō' si Yakub ya kalasahan si Ripka.  <div eID="gen402" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv232"/><div sID="gen403" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv232"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw, hinabu pa'in si Yakub itu maghinang sayul batung keyat niloho'an, makapole' si Esaw min pagpana'an. Lingantu to'ongan iya,

verses.name: Genesis 25:30
verses.text: angkan yukna ma si Yakub, “Buwanin aku min loho' keyat ya b'llanu ilu. Sidda aku pinunung!” Ya he' sababanna angkan iya niranglay si Edom, hatina ‘keyat.’  <div eID="gen403" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv233"/><div sID="gen404" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv233"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Aho', sagō' buwanin aku kapatutannu dahū, ya pamusaka' anak siyaka.”  <div eID="gen404" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv234"/><div sID="gen405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv234"/> Ya sambung isab si Esaw, “Na, pehē'un na, ma ka'a na kapatutan e'. Pamagayku bang aku arai' na patay otas?”  <div eID="gen405" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv235"/><div sID="gen406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv235"/> Yuk si Yakub ma iya, “Subay ka anapa dahū, in kapatutan pamusaka' ma ka'a pamuwannu na ma aku sab'nnal-b'nnal.” Magtūy sinapahan e' si Esaw, jari pamuwanna pusaka'na ma siyalina.  <div eID="gen406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv236"/><div sID="gen407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv236"/> Pagsapa si Esaw, binuwanan iya tinapay maka loho' keyat e' k'mbalna. Na, amangan na iya sampay anginum bo' na paluwas. Halam to'ongan pinahalga' e'na kapatutanna ya pamusaka' ma anak siyaka.  <div eID="gen407" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.25"/> <div eID="gen401" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv237"/><div sID="gen408" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal si Isa'ak maka si Abimelek</title> <div sID="gen409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv237"/> Sakali itu aniya' gotom ma lahat Kana'an e', saddī min gotom bay kalabayan disi Ibrahim ma waktu dahū. Jari maglain disi Isa'ak pehē' ni Gerar, ya lahat pagsultanan si Abimelek sultan bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: Genesis 26:2
verses.text: Bay na magpa'nda' asal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Isa'ak maka e'na ah'lling, yuk-i, “Isa'ak, da'a ka pehē' ni lahat Misil. Ya paglahatannu subay lahat song panō'ku ma ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 26:3
verses.text: Sagō' pahanti' ka buwattina'an ma jadjahan ya pat'nna'annu ilu. Taptap du aku mailu ma ka'a amuwanan ka'a kahāpan. Saga lahat kamemon ma jadjahan itu-i pamasuku'ku ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu. Tumanku isab bay paljanji'anku ma mma'nu si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 26:4
verses.text: Buwananta ka paltubu'an aheka, buwat saga bitu'un ma diyata' langit ya heka sigām. Pamuwanku du isab katibu'ukan lahat ilu ma sigām. Manjari kabangsahan kamemon ma deyom dunya angamu' kahāpan du min aku bang pa'in pinasali' ni kahāpan ya pamuwanku ma saga panubu'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 26:5
verses.text: Aho', buwananta ka kahāpan ma sabab kapameya' si Ibrahim ma panoho'anku. Bay kabogbogan e'na sara' maka panoho'an bay pamat'nna'ku ma iya.”

verses.name: Genesis 26:6
verses.text: Manjari mahē' na si Isa'ak pahanti' ma lahat Gerar.  <div eID="gen409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv238"/><div sID="gen410" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv238"/> Na, tinilaw pa'in iya e' saga l'lla minna'an pasal si Ripka, ya sambungna ma sigām, “Danakanku ko' ilu.” Halam bay bontolna in si Ripka h'ndana du, sabab tināw iya. Pangannalna in iya binono' e' saga a'a inān bo' ta'ā' si Ripka e' sigām pagka ahāp d'nda sidda.  <div eID="gen410" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv239"/><div sID="gen411" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv239"/> Sakali itu, at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in kamahē' disi Isa'ak ma lahat Gerar, aniya' dakayu' llaw amantaw sultan Abimelek min tandawanna. Ta'nda' e'na si Isa'ak anapu-napu si Ripka.

verses.name: Genesis 26:9
verses.text: Magtūy pinalinganan si Isa'ak e' si Abimelek, sinō' patampal ma iya. Yukna, “Halam aniya' pagduwa-ruwana, h'ndanu ko' ilu. Angay kami putingannu in iya kono' danakannu?” <div eID="gen411" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen412" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Isa'ak, “Tuwan sultan, tu'ud aku tināw binono' bang aku angahaka sab'nnal-b'nnal in iya h'ndaku.”  <div eID="gen412" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv240"/><div sID="gen413" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv240"/> Yuk si Abimelek, “Angay kami tala'atnu buwattilu? Bang saupama aniya' a'aku bay makabihing atuli ma iya, na, ka'a ya sababna bang kami kat'kkahan dusa.”

verses.name: Genesis 26:11
verses.text: Angkanna sinanggupan e' si Abimelek saga tendogna kamemon, yukna, “Sai-sai angala'at a'a itu atawa h'ndana, pat'nna'anku iya hukuman ni kamatay.”  <div eID="gen413" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv241"/><div sID="gen414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv241"/> Manjari itu, ma Gerar pa'in si Isa'ak maglahat, maghuma iya ati ahāp to'ongan buwa' tinanomna ma tahun inān. Maghatusan buwa'na dampo'on maka dampo'on ma sabab lidjiki' min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:13
verses.text: Pak'nnop na pa'in alta' si Isa'ak sampay aheya to'ongan karayana.

verses.name: Genesis 26:14
verses.text: Na, pagka aheka to'ongan bili-bilina, kambingna maka sapi'na, maka aheka isab saga sosoho'anna, nijingki iya e' bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: Genesis 26:15
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan nirasokan tana' saga pagbohe'an kamemon bay kinali e' saga sosoho'an mma'na si Ibrahim ma masana allum lagi'.  <div eID="gen414" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv242"/><div sID="gen415" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv242"/> Angkanna si Abimelek bay amowa si Isa'ak maggara', yukna, “Tuwan, subay kam papinda ni lahat saddī, sabab aga'os na kam min kami.”  <div eID="gen415" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv243"/><div sID="gen416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv243"/> Sakali pauntas disi Isa'ak pehē' ni L'bbak Gerar ati mahē' na sigām pat'nna'.

verses.name: Genesis 26:18
verses.text: Aniya' saga pagbohe'an asal ma tongod ina'an-i bay kinali ma masa lagi' mma'na si Ibrahim, sagō' amatay pa'in si Ibrahim bay nirasokan tana' e' saga a'a Pilistin. Manjari ya bohe' inān bay pinakali pabīng e' si Isa'ak, pinat'nna'an isab ōn bay pangōn e' mma'na-i.  <div eID="gen416" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv244"/><div sID="gen417" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv244"/> Puwas e' aniya' pagbohe'an baha'u bay kinali e' saga sosoho'an si Isa'ak ma l'bbak inān ati makabāk sigām bohe' ahāp.

verses.name: Genesis 26:20
verses.text: Sagō' magsagga' saga a'a Gerar maka saga a'a magi'ipat hayop si Isa'ak. Yuk a'a Gerar e', “Kami dapu bohe' ilu.” Ya he' sababna angkan bohe' inān niōnan ‘Esek’ e' si Isa'ak, hatina ‘Pagsagga'an.’

verses.name: Genesis 26:21
verses.text: Na angali gi' saga sosoho'an si Isa'ak pagbohe'an saddī, jari ya du ina'an tahinang pagsasawan e' saga a'a Gerar, angkan niōnan e' si Isa'ak ‘Sitna’, hatina ‘Pagbantahan.’

verses.name: Genesis 26:22
verses.text: Palawak gi' disi Isa'ak minnē' bo' yampa angali bohe' saddī. Na halam na aniya' pagsagga'an ma pagbohe'an itu angkan niōnan Rehobot, hatina ‘Kaluhaya'an.’ Yuk si Isa'ak, “Itiya' kitam pinaluhaya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pat'nna' to'ongan ma lahat itu. Tantu kitam makabāk kahāpan maitu.”  <div eID="gen417" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv245"/><div sID="gen418" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv245"/> Na, patukad sigām minnē' tudju ni lahat Be'erseba.

verses.name: Genesis 26:24
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām pehē' bo' sangom na, magpa'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Isa'ak magsuwala, yuk-i, “Aku ya Tuhan pagtuhanan mma'nu si Ibrahim. Da'a ka tināw sabab taptap du aku mailu ma ka'a. Buwananta ka kahāpan, pahekaku panubu'nu ma sabab sosoho'anku si Ibrahim.”  <div eID="gen418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv246"/><div sID="gen419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv246"/> Aniya' pagtunu'an kulban nihinang e' si Isa'ak maina'an, bo' ana'at iya ma ōn si Yawe.<note>Si Yawe, atawa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.’</note> Jari maina'an iya pat'nna', maina'an isab saga sosoho'anna bay angali pagbohe'an.  <div eID="gen419" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen408" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv247"/><div sID="gen420" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsulutan si Isa'ak maka si Abimelek</title> <div sID="gen421" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv247"/> Na aniya' dakayu' llaw pinehē' si Isa'ak e' si Abimelek, ya sultan ma lahat Gerar. Ya sehe' si Abimelek si Ahussat, ya bagayna pangandolan, maka si Pikul, ya nakura' saga kasundaluhanna.

verses.name: Genesis 26:27
verses.text: Atilaw si Isa'ak ma sigām, yukna, “Tuwan sultan, ai gawinu pi'itu? Bay aku pala'anbi min lahatbi inān maka aheya kab'nsibi ma aku. Na, ai maksudbi ma aku?”  <div eID="gen421" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv248"/><div sID="gen422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv248"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Aho' tuwan, saguwā' kata'uwan kami in ka'a tinabang sadja e' si Yawe, angkan yuk kami subay aniya' pagsulutantam. Manjari ya maksud kami itu mikisapa ma ka'a,

verses.name: Genesis 26:29
verses.text: supaya ka mbal angala'at kami. Bistahun, sat'ggol kam bay ma lahat kami kahāpan sadja ya tahinang kami ma ka'am. Maka ta'abut waktu isab kala'anbi, pinatulak kam ma deyom kasannangan. Tantu ka kabuwanan kahāpan na pa'in e' si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen422" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv249"/><div sID="gen423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv249"/> Pagkale si Isa'ak, magpajamu iya pangahulmatna ma disi Abimelek ati magsalu sigām amangan maka anginum.

verses.name: Genesis 26:31
verses.text: Pagsubu pa'in magjanji' sigām min karuwambila', magsapa in sigām mbal na magbono' dansehe'an. Pagubus, pinaba'id disi Abimelek e' si Isa'ak ati amole' sigām magatay pote'.  <div eID="gen423" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv250"/><div sID="gen424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv250"/> Na, ma llaw ina'an-i, pina'an ni si Isa'ak saga sosoho'anna angahaka'an iya pasal pagbohe'an yamboho' kinali e' sigām. “Makabāk kami bohe'!” yuk sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 26:33
verses.text: Ya pangōn si Isa'ak ma bohe' inān ‘Siba'’. Ya he' sababna angkan kauman inān kaōnan Be'erseba sampay ni kabuwattituhan.<note>Ya kabtangan Siba' itu duwa hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani. Kaissana ‘sapa’, karuwana ‘pitu'.’ Manjari ya ōn Be'erseba itu, hatina ‘bohe' pagsapahan’ atawa ‘bohe' kapitu'.’</note>  <div eID="gen424" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv251"/><div sID="gen425" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv251"/> Na, in pasal si Esaw, ta'abut pa'in mpatpū' tahun umulna, makapagh'nda iya duwa d'nda bangsa Hīt, ya na si Judit anak si Be'ere maka si Basemat anak si Elon.

verses.name: Genesis 26:35
verses.text: Aheya isab kasukkalan si Isa'ak maka si Ripka, ya matto'a si Esaw, ma sabab duwangan d'nda itu.  <div eID="gen425" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.26"/> <div eID="gen420" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv252"/><div sID="gen426" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangakkal si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen427" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv252"/> Na palabay pa'in daka pilantahun, ato'a na si Isa'ak, mbal na maka'nda'. Jari aniya' llaw pangalinganna ma si Esaw, ya anakna siyaka. Yukna ma iya, “Otō'.” <div eID="gen427" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen428" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Esaw, “Oy, Mma'.”  <div eID="gen428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv253"/><div sID="gen429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv253"/> Yuk si Isa'ak, “Otō', ta'nda'nu aku itu ato'a na. Sōng-sōng na ta'abut ganta'anku, angkan aniya' amu'ku ma ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 27:3
verses.text: Bowahun pana'nu pehē' ni kareya-reyahan amiha'an kita hayop susumbali'an.

verses.name: Genesis 27:4
verses.text: Adjalin aku pagkakan ahāp nanamna ya kasōbanku. Bowahun pi'itu bo' kakanku ati amu'-amu'anta ka ni Tuhan bang pa'in ka pinasuku'an lidjiki'. Pang'bbaku ma ka'a sasangku masi allum.”  <div eID="gen429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv254"/><div sID="gen430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv254"/> Na, hinabu pa'in si Isa'ak magsuli-suli maka si Esaw, ina'an si Ripka pakale-kale. Jari makalanjal pa'in si Esaw kaleya amana',

verses.name: Genesis 27:6
verses.text: magtūy ah'lling si Ripka ni si Yakub, yukna, “Otō', yamboho' takaleku mma'nu ah'lling ma siyakanu, yukna,

verses.name: Genesis 27:7
verses.text: ‘Piha'in kita susumbali'an ma deya. Adjalun pahāp bo' aniya' palaukku ahāp nanamna. Aubus pa'in aku amangan, amu'-amu'anta ka kahāpan ni Tuhan bang pa'in ka pinasuku'an lidjiki' ya kapatutan pamasuku' ma anak siyaka. Ya du ina'an pang'bbaku ma ka'a sasangku masi allum. Si Yawe ya saksi'ku.’

verses.name: Genesis 27:8
verses.text: Na, Otō',” yuk si Ripka, “kalehun aku. Beya'un panoho'anku itu.

verses.name: Genesis 27:9
verses.text: Pehē' na ka ni buluyan hayopta. Pene'un duwa anak kambing ahāp l'mmokna ati bowahun pi'itu ni aku. Aku ya angadjalan mma'nu lauk alanab ya kasōbanna to'ongan.

verses.name: Genesis 27:10
verses.text: Atahak pa'in lauk e', ka'a ya amowa pehē' ni mma'nu ati ka'a ya amakan iya. Manjari ka'a ya niamu'-amu'an kahāpan min Tuhan e' mma'nu sasangna masi allum lagi'.”  <div eID="gen430" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv255"/><div sID="gen431" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv255"/> Yuk si Yakub ni ina'na, “Oy, Ina', bahibuan asal si Esaw. Aku ngga'i ka, alanu' kuwitku.

verses.name: Genesis 27:12
verses.text: Painay bahā' bang aku sinanaw e' si Mma', bo' kata'uwanna magtūy in aku amarupang ma iya. Bang buwattē' ngga'i ka kahāpan ya ta'ā'ku, saguwā' sukna'.”  <div eID="gen431" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv256"/><div sID="gen432" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv256"/> Na ya sambung ina'na ma iya, “Mbal, Otō'. In sukna' inān subay papelleng ni aku, ngga'i ka ni ka'a. Pehē' na ka, ngā'in kita kambing.”  <div eID="gen432" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv257"/><div sID="gen433" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv257"/> Sakali pehē' na si Yakub angā' duwa anak kambing. Binowa e'na pehē' ni ina'na bo' adjalanna lauk ya kasōban si Isa'ak kinakan.

verses.name: Genesis 27:15
verses.text: Pagubus, pinaluwas e' si Ripka badju' si Esaw ahāp to'ongan, ya bay ma deyom tau'an. Jari pasulugna na ma anakna siyali, ya si Yakub.

verses.name: Genesis 27:16
verses.text: Niā' isab e' si Ripka kuwit kambing bay ta'adjal inān ati pangalapis e'na ma bukut tangan si Yakub sampay ma buli' k'llongna supaya iya bahibuan sali'.

verses.name: Genesis 27:17
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e'-i, ni'nde'an e' si Ripka ni si Yakub lauk ahāp nanamna, maka tinapay baha'u bay hinangna.  <div eID="gen433" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv258"/><div sID="gen434" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv258"/> Sakali pehē' na si Yakub ni mma'na, yukna, “O Mma'!” <div eID="gen434" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen435" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa'ak, “Aho', Otō'. Sai sa ka'a ilu?”  <div eID="gen435" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv259"/><div sID="gen436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv259"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Si Esaw, anaknu siyaka. Tahinangku na bay panoho'annu ma aku. Itiya' na lauk bay adjalanku ka'a. Papunduk ka amangan bo' aku yampa amu'-amu'annu kahāpan ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen436" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv260"/><div sID="gen437" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv260"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa'ak ma si Yakub, yukna, “Al'kkas pahāp kapihanu susumbali'an ilu. Angay bahā'?” <div eID="gen437" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen438" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Tu'ud aku tinabang e' si Yawe, ya pagtuhanannu.”  <div eID="gen438" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv261"/><div sID="gen439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv261"/> Yuk si Isa'ak isab, “Otō', pasekot ka kono'. Sanawta ka bang ka b'nnal-b'nnal anakku si Esaw.”  <div eID="gen439" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv262"/><div sID="gen440" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv262"/> Manjari pasekot na si Yakub ni mma'na bo' tasanaw e'na. Yuk si Isa'ak, “Lagamnu sali' lagam si Yakub, malaingkan tangannu itu sali' tangan si Esaw.”

verses.name: Genesis 27:23
verses.text: Na, halam takilāna in a'a inān si Yakub, sabab tasanawna tanganna bahibuan, dasali' maka tangan si Esaw. Na, arai' pa'in si Isa'ak angamu'-ngamu' kahāpan tudju ni Tuhan,

verses.name: Genesis 27:24
verses.text: tinilaw e'na si Yakub pabīng, yukna, “B'nnal bahā'? Ka'a ilu anakku si Esaw?” <div eID="gen440" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen441" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', Mma',” yuk si Yakub. “Halam saddī.”  <div eID="gen441" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv263"/><div sID="gen442" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv263"/> Sakali ah'lling si Isa'ak, yukna, “Ndiya na lauk bay adjalannu aku-i. Amangan na aku bo' yampa ka amu'-amu'anku kahāpan tudju ni Tuhan.” <div eID="gen442" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen443" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy iya binowahan lauk maka binu-anggul e' si Yakub.

verses.name: Genesis 27:26
verses.text: Aubus pa'in, nilinganan iya. Yuk mma'na ma iya, “Otō', pi'itu ka kono', siyumun aku.”  <div eID="gen443" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv264"/><div sID="gen444" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv264"/> Manjari pasekot na si Yakub ni mma'na aniyum iya. Sakali itu, tahamut pa'in s'mmekna e' si Isa'ak, hamut si Esaw to'ongan, magtūy iya niamu'-amu'an kahāpan ni Tuhan. Ya pagkallam si Isa'ak ma iya, <lg sID="gen445"/> <l level="1" sID="gen446"/>“Ya hamut anakku itu sali' hamut tana' paghuma'an<l eID="gen446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen447"/>kabuwanan kahāpan e' si Yawe.<l eID="gen447" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen448"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:28
verses.text: Bang pa'in binusugan tana'nu e' Tuhan<l eID="gen448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen449"/>maka alu' min diyata' langit.<l eID="gen449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen450"/>Bang pa'in isab pinajatu e'na tanomannu,<l eID="gen450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen451"/>supaya aheka buwa'na pagkakannu maka paginumnu!<l eID="gen451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen452"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:29
verses.text: Bang pa'in kapagbaya'annu saga kabangsa-bangsahan,<l eID="gen452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen453"/>bang pa'in sigām pasujud ma ka'a.<l eID="gen453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen454"/>Bang pa'in ka magnakura' ma kakampungannu kamemon,<l eID="gen454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen455"/>bang pa'in isab pasujud ma ka'a kapanubu'an ina'nu.<l eID="gen455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen456"/>Bang pa'in kataluwa'an mulka'<l eID="gen456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen457"/>sasuku anabbut ōnnu ni kala'atan.<l eID="gen457" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen458"/>Bang pa'in binuwanan kahāpan<l eID="gen458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen459"/>sasuku anabbut ōnnu ni kahāpan.”<l eID="gen459" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen445"/>  <div eID="gen444" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv265"/><div sID="gen460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv265"/> Manjari itu, aubus pa'in pangamu'-ngamu' si Isa'ak, bo' yamboho' paluwas si Yakub, ina'an na si Esaw at'kka min deya.

verses.name: Genesis 27:31
verses.text: Magtūy du iya angadjal lauk ahāp nanamna bo' yampa bowana pehē' ni mma'na. Yukna, “O Mma', itiya' na lauk bay adjalanku ka'a. Papunduk ka amangan bo' yampa aku amu'-amu'annu kahāpan ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv266"/><div sID="gen461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv266"/> Tinilaw iya magtūy e' si Isa'ak, “Arī, sai sa ka'a ilu?” <div eID="gen461" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen462" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Esaw, “Aku itu si Esaw, anaknu siyaka.”  <div eID="gen462" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv267"/><div sID="gen463" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv267"/> Agsai takuddat si Isa'ak, amidpid to'ongan baranna. Yukna, “Sai sa a'a bay amowahan aku palauk insini'. Susumbali'an kono' bay tapana' e'na! Yamboho' takakanku ma waktu kat'kkanu itu. Baha'u du iya bay amu'-amu'anku kahāpan ni Tuhan. Pangannalku ka'a, sagō' kahāpan ilu mbal kapindahan sabab makalagtik na d'lla'ku.”  <div eID="gen463" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv268"/><div sID="gen464" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv268"/> Na, pagkale si Esaw ma lling mma'na he' magtūy iya anangis pakosog kabowa kagit atayna. Yukna, “Arōy, aku isab Mma', amu'-amu'in aku kahāpan isab!”  <div eID="gen464" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv269"/><div sID="gen465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv269"/> Ya sambung si Isa'ak, yukna, “Arōy, Otō'. Bay aku tarupang e' siyalinu. Ta'ā'na na kahāpan ya arak pamasuku'ku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen465" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv270"/><div sID="gen466" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv270"/> “Ā,” yuk si Esaw, “tinōp iya niōnan Yakub<note>Ya ōn Yakub itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘amalut ma buli' tape'’. Ya hantang hatulanna isab, ‘pangangakkal.’</note>, sabab min duwa na aku ka'akkalan e'na. Ta'agaw e'na pusaka' ya kapatutanku pagka aku anak siyaka. Maka ma buwattina'an isab, ta'ā'na kahāpan min Tuhan ya subay pamasuku' aku. Mma', halam bahā' aniya' lidjiki' bay kapinannu aku?”  <div eID="gen466" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv271"/><div sID="gen467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv271"/> Anambung si Isa'ak, yukna, “Bay na amu'-amu'anku si Yakub kahāpan bang pa'in iya tahinang nakura'nu. Maka kampungna kamemon subay tahinang sosoho'anna. Ta'amu'-amu'ku isab bang pa'in iya binalanja'an kinakan ahāp e' Tuhan maka binu-anggul paginumna. Hatina, Otō', si Yakub ya pinasuku'an kamemon, ati halam aniya' tahinangku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen467" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv272"/><div sID="gen468" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv272"/> Sakali angamu' na pa'in si Esaw, yukna, “Mma', min t'dda sadja ka bahā' angamu'-ngamu' kahāpan ni Tuhan? Mbal bahā' kaisaban? Ndū' Mma', amu'-amu'in aku kahāpan isab.” Jari aheya tangisna.  <div eID="gen468" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv273"/><div sID="gen469" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv273"/> Manjari magkallam si Isa'ak ma si Esaw, yukna, <lg sID="gen470"/> <l level="1" sID="gen471"/>“Paglahatannu alawak du min huma<l eID="gen471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen472"/>ya taptap pinajatu e' Tuhan.<l eID="gen472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen473"/>Mbal ka pinasuku'an tana'<l eID="gen473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen474"/>ya binusugan maka alu' min diyata' langit,<l eID="gen474" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen475"/>tana' akansang buwa'na.<l eID="gen475" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen476"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:40
verses.text: Magbono' du ka bo' aniya' tatabannu pagkallumannu,<l eID="gen476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen477"/>sagō' siyalinu ya pagnakura'annu na pa'in.<l eID="gen477" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen478"/>Malaingkan bang ka mbal makasandal pinagbaya'an e'na,<l eID="gen478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen479"/>angatu du ka ati makal'ppa min komkomanna.”<l eID="gen479" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen470"/>  <div eID="gen469" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen426" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv274"/><div sID="gen480" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalahi si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv274"/> Sakali ab'nsi sidda si Esaw ma si Yakub ma sabab kahāpan ya pamasuku' ma iya e' mma' sigām. Ya minohot e' si Esaw ma deyom atayna, “Mbal at'ggol amatay du si Mma' ati papatayku si Yakub itu.”  <div eID="gen481" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv275"/><div sID="gen482" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv275"/> Daipara kahaka'an si Ripka pasal kamohotan si Esaw. Makata'u pa'in iya, magtūy lingananna si Yakub, yukna, “Otō', pakale ka. Agara' si Esaw amalosan ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 27:43
verses.text: Na, buwattitu panganggara'ku ma ka'a, Otō'. Ala'an ka magdai'-dai' pehē' ni kauman Haran, ni danakanku si Leban e'.

verses.name: Genesis 27:44
verses.text: Subay ka pahanti' ma deyomanna sampay alungay na kab'nsi siyakanu ma ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 27:45
verses.text: Jari bang ahāp-hāp na atayna ni ka'a, bo' alungay min pangentomna bay hinangnu ma iya, na, tambukuhanta pa'in ka bo' ka makapole' pi'itu. Tu'ud aku mbal bilahi kalungayan duwa anak ma dang'llaw.”  <div eID="gen482" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv276"/><div sID="gen483" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv276"/> Sakali aniya' pah'lling si Ripka ma si Isa'ak, yukna, “Ab'nsi aku ma saga d'nda bangsa Hīt buwat h'nda si Esaw itu. Bang si Yakub ganta' magh'nda isab ma bangsa Hīt, na, ahāp lagi' aku amatay.”  <div eID="gen483" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.27"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:1
verses.text: Manjari halam gi' makauntas si Yakub, pinalinganan iya e' si Isa'ak. Maina'an pa'in, sinagina iya maka niamay-amayan. Yuk mma'na ma iya, “Otō', da'a ka magh'nda d'nda Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 28:2
verses.text: Pehē' ka gom pa'in ni lahat Mesopotami, ni tumpuk si Bituwil ya mbo'nu min ina'. Pene'un d'nda ngā'nu h'nda min ka'anakan bapa'nu si Leban.

verses.name: Genesis 28:3
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka binuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, bang pa'in pinaheka panubu'nu bo' ka tahinang pag'mbo'an ma kabangsa-bangsahan.

verses.name: Genesis 28:4
verses.text: Bang pa'in pinasampay ni ka'am dapanubu'an ya kahāpan bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma mma'ku si Ibrahim. Hatina ka'am iya tahinang tag-dapu lahat pahanti'antam itu, ya lahat bay pamuwan asal e' Tuhan ma mma'ku.”

verses.name: Genesis 28:5
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e' si Isa'ak ah'lling ma si Yakub, pinatulak na iya bo' pauntas tudju ni lahat Mesopotami, ni kauman si'itna si Leban. Ya si Leban itu anak si Bituwil a'a Aram.  <div eID="gen484" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv277"/><div sID="gen485" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv277"/> Manjari tata'u e' si Esaw pasal si Isa'ak bay angamu'-ngamu'an si Yakub kahāpan. Bay patulakna isab pehē' ni lahat Mesopotami amiha d'nda ngā'na h'nda. Niamay-amayan iya sinō' da'a magh'nda d'nda bangsa Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 28:7
verses.text: Ya takale isab e' si Esaw in si Yakub kono' bay ameya' ma panoho'an matto'ana, hatina wa'i na pal'ngngan tudju ni lahat Mesopotami.

verses.name: Genesis 28:8
verses.text: Na minnē' kinata'uwan na e' si Esaw in mma'na si Isa'ak mbal to'ongan kasulutan ma saga d'nda bangsa Kana'an,

verses.name: Genesis 28:9
verses.text: angkan iya pehē' ni si'itna si Isma'il anak si Ibrahim. Maina'an pa'in, makah'nda iya ni si Mahalat anak si Isma'il, danakan isab si Nebayot. Manjari t'llu na h'nda si Esaw.  <div eID="gen485" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen480" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv278"/><div sID="gen486" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panguppi si Yakub ma Lahat Betel</title> <div sID="gen487" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv278"/> Na, pauntas na si Yakub min lahat Be'erseba bo' pal'ngngan tudju ni kauman Haran.

verses.name: Genesis 28:11
verses.text: Manjari makasampay pa'in iya ni dakayu' pa'atagan, pahanti' iya maina'an sabab pas'ddop na llaw. Angā' iya dakayu' batu paū'anna bo' yampa pabahak atuli.

verses.name: Genesis 28:12
verses.text: Jari anguppi iya. Ya ta'nda'na ma deyom uppina haronan bay pinat'ngge min tana' tudju ni diyata' langit. Aniya' isab ta'nda'na saga mala'ikat magdeyo'-diyata'.

verses.name: Genesis 28:13
verses.text: Ina'an isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> an'ngge min diyata'na maka e'na magsuwala. Yukna, “Aku itu si Yawe ya pagtuhanan mbo'nu si Ibrahim maka mma'nu si Isa'ak. Ya tana' pabahakannu ilu pamuwanku ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 28:14
verses.text: Pahekaku du tubu'nu, ya heka sigām sali' solagan gusung ma gintana'an. Paheka du sigām ma kaluha'an lahat itu, min sobangan sampay ni s'ddopan. Maka kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon maitu ma dunya buwananku kahāpan du ma sababannu maka ma sababan saga panubu'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 28:15
verses.text: Na, taptap du aku mailu ma ka'a, jagahanta ka pi'ingga-pi'ingga pal'ngnganannu, sampay ni waktu pamowata ka'a pabīng ni lahat itu. Mbal ka bbahanku, maka tumananku to'ongan ya paljanji'anku itu ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen487" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv279"/><div sID="gen488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv279"/> Jari abati' na si Yakub maka e'na amikilan. “Sab'nnal-b'nnal, itiya' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma lahat itu, sagō' halam bay kata'uwanku.”

verses.name: Genesis 28:17
verses.text: Sinōd iya tāw angkan yukna, “Ag'mma sumangatku ma tongod itu-i! Pagluma'an Tuhan ko' itu. Itiya' isab maitu lawang pagsosōran sulga'.”  <div eID="gen488" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv280"/><div sID="gen489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv280"/> Pagsubu-subu pa'in, binuhat e' si Yakub batu bay paū'anna sangom-i bo' pinat'ngge e'na sali' hāg. Tapat'ngge pa'in, binase' maka ns'llan bo' nihinang e'na tampat pangentoman.

verses.name: Genesis 28:19
verses.text: Manjari Betel<note>Ya ōn Betel itu, bang ma bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘luma' Tuhan.’</note> ya pangōn si Yakub ma lahat inān. (Lūs ya ōn kauman ma atag ina'an ma masa awal lagi'.)  <div eID="gen489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv281"/><div sID="gen490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv281"/> Sakali magnajal si Yakub ni Tuhan, yukna, “Bang ka'a-i sab'nnal-b'nnal pataptap anganjagahan aku ma l'ngngananku itu, bang ka amuwanan aku pagkakan maka tamongon,

verses.name: Genesis 28:21
verses.text: maka bang aku papole'nu isab ni luma' mma'ku ma deyom kasalamatan, na, si Yawe ya Tuhanku, halam aniya' saddī.

verses.name: Genesis 28:22
verses.text: Ya batu tapat'nggeku itu ibarat luma' pagsusumbahan ni ka'a. Tukbalanku isab ma ka'a bahagi' sangpū' min ai-ai kamemon ya pamasuku'nu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen490" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.28"/> <div eID="gen486" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv282"/><div sID="gen491" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kat'kka si Yakub ni Si'itna si Leban</title> <div sID="gen492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv282"/> Pal'ngngan na pa'in si Yakub sampay ta'abutna lahat sobangan.

verses.name: Genesis 29:2
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, bo' ma tongod kaparangan, aniya' ta'nda'na bohe' kali tinambolan asal maka batu aheya. Aniya' isab bili-bili t'llu ba'ananna pahali-hali ma tongod ina'an angagad pinainum.

verses.name: Genesis 29:3
verses.text: Sagō' ya kabiyaksahan saga a'a magi'ipat bili-bili maina'an, subay atipun ba'anan bili-bili kamemon bo' yampa sigām angaligiran batu sampay amainum. Jari aubus pa'in pinainum ba'anan bili-bili kamemon, magtūy tinūran batu-i ni baina.  <div eID="gen492" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv283"/><div sID="gen493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv283"/> Manjari itu atilaw si Yakub ma saga a'a magi'ipat inān, yukna, “Saga tuwan, minningga sa ka'am ilu?” <div eID="gen493" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen494" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung saga a'a inān, “Kami itu min Haran, tuwan.”  <div eID="gen494" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv284"/><div sID="gen495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv284"/> Yuk si Yakub isab, “Magkata'u kam bahā' maka si Leban, mpu si Nahor?” <div eID="gen495" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen496" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Aho' tuwan, kata'uwan kami.”  <div eID="gen496" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv285"/><div sID="gen497" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv285"/> Atilaw gi' si Yakub, yukna, “Ahāp isab ginhawa baranna?” <div eID="gen497" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen498" type="paragraph"/> “Aho' tuwan”, yuk a'a-i, “Ahāp du. O'o, ilu'un na anakna si Rakiya maka ba'anan bili-bilina.”  <div eID="gen498" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv286"/><div sID="gen499" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv286"/> Yuk si Yakub, “Nda'unbi ba, masi alanga llaw. Mbal gi' waktu pamapole' hayop ni deyom sasak. Bang bahā' painumbi buwattina'an bo' yampa bowabi ni kaparang-parangan pinakan pabīng.”  <div eID="gen499" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv287"/><div sID="gen500" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv287"/> Ya sambung saga a'a he', “Mbal makajari, tuwan. Subay atimuk pi'itu kaba'anan bili-bili kamemon bo' yampa ligiran kami tambol batu itu. Makajari pinainum bang maitu na kamemon.”  <div eID="gen500" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv288"/><div sID="gen501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv288"/> Na, hinabu pa'in si Yakub magsuli-suli itu maka saga a'a magi'ipat inān, at'kka na si Rakiya maka ba'anan bili-bili mma'na. Tu'ud hinangna angipat bili-bili.

verses.name: Genesis 29:10
verses.text: Jari pag'nda' si Yakub ma kakina si Rakiya maka bili-bili si'itna si Leban, magtūy niligiran e'na batu min bowa' bohe' bo' painumna saga bili-bili ya suku' si'itna.

verses.name: Genesis 29:11
verses.text: Aubus pa'in, siniyum e'na si Rakiya maka e'na anangis ma sabab kakōganna.

verses.name: Genesis 29:12
verses.text: Yuk si Yakub ma iya, “Aku itu si Yakub, kamanakan mma'nu. Ina'ku si Ripka, ya danakan mma'nu.” Na, pagkale si Rakiya, magtūy iya paragan amole' angahaka'an mma'na.  <div eID="gen501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv289"/><div sID="gen502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv289"/> Manjari itu, makata'u pa'in si Leban pasal kat'kka kamanakanna si Yakub, magtūy iya magdai'-dai' pehē' anampang. Ginapus e'na si Yakub, siniyum isab ati binowa pehē' ni luma'. Pagka ma deyom luma' na, sinuli-sulihan si Leban e' si Yakub pasal kamemon bay kalabayanna.

verses.name: Genesis 29:14
verses.text: “Ā,” yuk si Leban ma iya, “lahasiya'ta ka sab'nnal-b'nnal, magdalaha' magdaisi.” Manjari dambulan ya kahanti' si Yakub ma deyoman disi Leban.  <div eID="gen502" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen491" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv290"/><div sID="gen503" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagh'nda si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv290"/> Palabay pa'in dambulan-i, ah'lling si Leban ma si Yakub, yukna, “Otō', minsan kita magdalaha', bang ka ganta' maghinang ma aku mbal apatut bang halam aniya' tongodna. Subay ka gadjihanku. Haka'in aku bang pila kabaya'annu?”  <div eID="gen504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv291"/><div sID="gen505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv291"/> Na, aniya' duwa anak si Leban budjang. Ya ōn siyaka si Leya maka si Rakiya ya ōn siyali.

verses.name: Genesis 29:17
verses.text: Bulahaw asal mata si Leya, sagō' si Rakiya ya alingkat, ahāp pamarananna.

verses.name: Genesis 29:18
verses.text: Jari kinabilahian si Rakiya itu e' si Yakub ati yukna ma si Leban, “Bapa' bang ka'a-i asulut, maghinang aku maitu ma ka'a pituntahun, minsan aku mbal gadjihannu. Ya sadja amu'ku ma ka'a bang pa'in pamah'ndanu ma aku anaknu si Rakiya.”  <div eID="gen505" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv292"/><div sID="gen506" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv292"/> Ya sambung si Leban, yukna, “Ā, gom lagi' ka'a ya pamah'llaku ma iya, da'a a'a saddī. Maitu na ka ma deyomanku.”

verses.name: Genesis 29:20
verses.text: Manjari pituntahun ya paghinang si Yakub ma si Leban supaya tah'ndana si Rakiya, sagō' halam tabistana t'ggolna ma sabab kaheya lasana ma si Rakiya.  <div eID="gen506" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv293"/><div sID="gen507" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv293"/> Na, palabay pa'in pituntahun e', yuk si Yakub ma si Leban, “Bapa', ta'abut na waktu, kawinun kami maka si Rakiya bo' kami makapagdakayu' na.”

verses.name: Genesis 29:22
verses.text: Angaho' si Leban ati magsakap iya jajamuhan. Pinata'u e'na saga a'a kamemon ma lahatna, sinō' paluruk ni pagkawinan.

verses.name: Genesis 29:23
verses.text: Saguwā' pagsangom e', ngga'i ka si Rakiya ya ni'nde'an e' si Leban ni si Yakub sagō' si Leya. (Aniya' isab ipatan si Leban ōnna si Silpa bay pamuwanna ma si Leya nihinang ipatan.) Jari si Yakub maka si Leya magbihing na atuli.  <div eID="gen507" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:24
verses.text: Saguwā' pagsangom e', ngga'i ka si Rakiya ya ni'nde'an e' si Leban ni si Yakub sagō' si Leya. (Aniya' isab ipatan si Leban ōnna si Silpa bay pamuwanna ma si Leya nihinang ipatan.) Jari si Yakub maka si Leya magbihing na atuli.  <div eID="gen507" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv294"/><div sID="gen508" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv294"/> Na, pagk'llat pa'in llaw dakayu', yamboho' tasayu e' si Yakub in si Leya bay sehe'na sangom inān! Pehē' iya magtūy ni si Leban. “Bapa',” yukna, “angay buwattilu hinangnu ma aku? Jukup na pituntahun ya paghinangku ma ka'a bo' supaya si Rakiya ta'ā'ku h'nda. Angay aku angkan akkalannu?”  <div eID="gen508" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv295"/><div sID="gen509" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv295"/> Ya sambung si Leban, “Otō', ya addat kami maitu, mbal makajari bang siyali pinah'lla'an dahū min siyaka.

verses.name: Genesis 29:27
verses.text: Tangguhanta dapitu' lagi'. Subay na aubus paglami-lami ma si Leya itu bo' yampa ka pakawin kami maka si Rakiya. Saguwā' aniya' tongodna. Ya paghinangnu maitu ma aku subay sinugpatan pituntahun lagi'.”  <div eID="gen509" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv296"/><div sID="gen510" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv296"/> Na, kasulutan si Yakub. Aubus pa'in dapitu' iya paglami-lami sigām ma si Leya, pinakawin si Yakub e' si Leban ma anakna si Rakiya.

verses.name: Genesis 29:29
verses.text: Damikiyanna du isab, aniya' ipatan d'nda pamuwan si Leban ma si Rakiya, ōnna si Bilha.

verses.name: Genesis 29:30
verses.text: Sakali itu magdakayu' na si Yakub maka si Rakiya. Aheya sidda lasana ma si Rakiya, labi-labi min lasana ma si Leya. Jari pituntahun gi' ya paghinang si Yakub ma deyoman si Leban.  <div eID="gen510" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen503" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:31
