verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv297"/><div sID="gen511" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Anak si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv297"/> Na, ta'nda' pa'in e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ariki' asal lasa si Yakub ma si Leya, aniya' kahāpan pamuwanna ma iya. Jari si Leya ya makapangiram du, sagō' si Rakiya mbal maka'anak.

verses.name: Genesis 29:32
verses.text: Jari ab'ttong na si Leya ati anganak iya l'lla. Yukna, “Ta'nda' kasusahanku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Tantu aku kinalasahan na e' h'llaku.” Manjari Rubin<note>Ya ōn Rubin itu pa'anggil ma dakayu' kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘ta'nda' kasusahanku.’</note> ya pangōnna ma anakna he'.  <div eID="gen512" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv298"/><div sID="gen513" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv298"/> Manjari ab'ttong iya pabīng ati l'lla du isab anakna. Yukna, “Ya anak itu pamuwan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma aku sabab takalena pasal aku mbal kinalasahan.” Angkan Simiyun<note>Ya ōn Simiyun itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘takale.’</note> ya pangōnna ma onde'.

verses.name: Genesis 29:34
verses.text: Na, ab'ttong iya pabīng ati l'lla isab anakna. Yukna, “Na, tantu h'llaku pat'ttog na ma aku sabab t'llu na anak l'lla ya pamuwanku ma iya.” Manjari Libi ya pangōnna ma onde' itu.<note>Ya ōn Libi itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘at'ttog.’</note>  <div eID="gen513" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv299"/><div sID="gen514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv299"/> Anā, ab'ttong si Leya pabīng, ka'mpatna na, l'lla du isab. Yukna, “Pudjiku na <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> buwattina'an.” Angkan ōnanna anakna si Yahud.<note>Ya ōn Yahud (atawa Yuda) itu pa'anggil ma dakayu' kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘pudji’ atawa ‘pabantug.’</note> Na minnē' pahondong si Leya maganak.  <div eID="gen514" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.29"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:1
verses.text: Na si Rakiya itu, pagka tasayuna in iya mbal to'ongan makabuwanan si Yakub anak, angimbū na ma siyakana si Leya. Ah'lling iya ma si Yakub, yukna, “Buwanin aku anak. Bang aku mbal maka'anak, gom gi' aku amatay.”  <div eID="gen515" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv300"/><div sID="gen516" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv300"/> Apasu' magtūy atay si Yakub ma si Rakiya, yukna, “Pangannalnu aku itu Tuhan bahā', makapagbaya' amuwanan ka'a anak maka mbal?”  <div eID="gen516" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv301"/><div sID="gen517" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv301"/> Ya lling si Rakiya ma iya, “O'o, ipatanku si Bilha itu. Pahulid ka ma iya supaya iya anganak ganti' min aku, ati taga-tubu' aku min iya.”

verses.name: Genesis 30:4
verses.text: Jari sinōngan e'na ipatanna si Bilha ma si Yakub pamah'ndana. Magbihing sigām atuli,

verses.name: Genesis 30:5
verses.text: ati ab'ttong si Bilha maka anganak l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 30:6
verses.text: Ya lling si Rakiya, “Kabogbogan aku e' Tuhan in aku patut taga-anak. Takalena bay pangamu'-ngamu'ku ma iya, ati kabuwanan aku anak l'lla.” Manjari Dān<note>Ya ōn Dān itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘binogbogan ma hukuman.’</note> ya pangōnna ma iya.  <div eID="gen517" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv302"/><div sID="gen518" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv302"/> Ab'ttong na isab si Bilha pabīng ati aniya' gi' anak si Yakub l'lla min iya, karuwana na.

verses.name: Genesis 30:8
verses.text: Ya pah'lling si Rakiya, “Aheya paggaggud kami maka siyakaku, sagō' ma aku da'ugan.” Manjari Naptali ya pangōnna ma onde'.<note>Ya ōn Naptali itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘pagda'ug-da'ugan.’</note>  <div eID="gen518" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv303"/><div sID="gen519" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv303"/> Na si Leya isab, pagka tasayuna in iya mbal na anganak, manjari pamuwanna isab ipatanna si Silpa ma si Yakub pamah'ndana.

verses.name: Genesis 30:10
verses.text: Ab'ttong isab si Silpa ati anganak l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 30:11
verses.text: “Ahāp sukudku!” yuk si Leya. Jari Gād<note>Ya ōn Gād itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘ahāp sukud.’</note> ya pangōnna ma anakna he'.

verses.name: Genesis 30:12
verses.text: Damuli pa'in minnē', anganak pabīng si Silpa itu, jari duwa na anak si Yakub min iya.

verses.name: Genesis 30:13
verses.text: Ya pah'lling si Leya, “Aheya kakōganku! Pinagsuli-sulihan du aku e' saga kar'ndahan in aku itu d'nda akōd.” Angkan na Aser<note>Ya ōn Aser itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘kinōgan.’</note> ya pangōn si Silpa ma anakna.  <div eID="gen519" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv304"/><div sID="gen520" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv304"/> Na ma musim pagani lagi', ina'an si Rubin anak si Leya maglunsul ma huma. Aniya' tabākna buwa' kayu<note>Ya ōn buwa' kayu itu ‘mandrake’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> tapagtambal pamapangiram, jari binowa e'na pehē' ni ina'na si Leya. Ah'lling magtūy si Rakiya ni si Leya, yukna, “Kaka', buwanin aku min buwa' kayu ya tabāk e' anaknu ilu.”  <div eID="gen520" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv305"/><div sID="gen521" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv305"/> Ya sambung si Leya, “Ē, mamarahi pahāp ka'a ilu! Bay ta'agawnu h'llaku ati agawnu lagi' buwa' kayu anakku?” <div eID="gen521" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen522" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Rakiya, “Bang aku buwanannu, tugutanku si Yakub pabihing ma ka'a sangom ilu.”  <div eID="gen522" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv306"/><div sID="gen523" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv306"/> Manjari itu, pagt'kka si Yakub min huma abay kohap na, sinampang iya e' si Leya. Yukna ma si Yakub, “Subay ka pabihing ma aku atuli sangom ilu. Makapagisun kami maka si Rakiya insini'. Bay iya buwananku saga buwa' kayu ya tapuwa' e' anakku si Rubin, manjari pinatuli ka ma aku.” Manjari pabihing si Yakub ma si Leya ma sangom inān.  <div eID="gen523" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv307"/><div sID="gen524" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv307"/> Na nirūlan si Leya e' Tuhan. Ab'ttong iya ati anganak l'lla. Manjari lima na anak si Yakub l'lla min h'ndana si Leya.

verses.name: Genesis 30:18
verses.text: Yuk si Leya, “Katungbasan aku e' Tuhan ni kahāpan ma sabab kapamuwanku ipatanku ma h'llaku.” Angkanna Issakar<note>Ya ōn Issakar itu bang ma bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘tungbas ni kahāpan.’</note> ya pangōnna ma anakna itu.  <div eID="gen524" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv308"/><div sID="gen525" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv308"/> Angiram isab si Leya pabīng, paganakna l'lla. Manjari nnom na anak si Yakub l'lla bay min si Leya.

verses.name: Genesis 30:20
verses.text: “Na,” yuk si Leya, “ahalga' to'ongan ya pamuwan Tuhan ma aku. Tantu aku pinaheya na e' h'llaku ma sabab nnom na anakna l'lla min aku.” Manjari Sibulun<note>Ya ōn Sibulun itu pa'angil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘pagpaheya.’</note> ya pangōn si Leya ma anakna itu.  <div eID="gen525" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv309"/><div sID="gen526" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv309"/> Na, mbal pa'in at'ggol, ab'ttong si Leya pabīng ati anganak iya d'nda. Dina ya pangōnna ma iya.  <div eID="gen526" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv310"/><div sID="gen527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv310"/> Na, in si Rakiya isab, taentom du e' Tuhan. Takale bay pangamu'-ngamu' si Rakiya ma iya, ati nirūlan iya bo' makapangiram na.

verses.name: Genesis 30:23
verses.text: Manjari ab'ttong si Rakiya ati anganak iya l'lla. Ah'lling iya, yukna, “Kala'anan na kaiya'anku e' Tuhan sabab itiya' aku kabuwanan anak.

verses.name: Genesis 30:24
verses.text: Mura-murahan bang pa'in aniya' gi' anakku l'lla pinasunu' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni onde' dakayu' itu.” Manjari Yusup<note>Ya ōn Yusup itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘bang pa'in aniya' k'nnopna.’</note> ya pangōn si Rakiya ma anakna-i.  <div eID="gen527" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen511" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv311"/><div sID="gen528" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magkarayahan si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen529" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv311"/> Manjari itu, bay pa'in nianakan si Yusup, binowa e' si Yakub mato'ana si Leban magisun. Yuk si Yakub, “Bapa', paba'irun aku sabab bilahi na aku amole' ni lahatku.

verses.name: Genesis 30:26
verses.text: Pabeya'un ma aku saga anak-h'ndaku, ya tausahaku maitu ma deyomannu. Kata'uwannu du ya katuyu'ku maghinang ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen529" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv312"/><div sID="gen530" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv312"/> Sagō' ya sambung si Leban ma si Yakub, “Otō', da'a gi'. Aniya' pamowahanta ka'a magsuli-suli. Ta'nda'ku ma putika'an ka'a iya sababna ya angkan aku nilidjiki'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:28
verses.text: Ah'lling sadja ka. Gadjihanta ka pila-pila kabaya'annu.”  <div eID="gen530" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv313"/><div sID="gen531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv313"/> Anambung si Yakub, yukna “Kata'uwannu du bang buwattingga e'ku maghinang maitu ma ka'a. Angahāp sadja kahayopannu ma deyom kapagipatku.

verses.name: Genesis 30:30
verses.text: Ma halam gi' aku maitu, kulang asal pangalta'nu. Malaingkan aheka na ma buwattina'an. Minsan maingga-maingga paghinanganku ma deyomannu, nilidjiki'an sadja ka e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Bang ma aku ta'abut na waktu pamas'lle' ma aku, bo' supaya aniya' palsuku'an ma kami sampay anak-h'ndaku.”  <div eID="gen531" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv314"/><div sID="gen532" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv314"/> Atilaw si Leban ma iya, yukna, “Na, subay pila panganggadji ma ka'a?” <div eID="gen532" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen533" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Ngga'i ka gadji ya kabaya'anku. Bang pagsulutanta, subay aku parūlnu angipat ba'anan hayopnu buwat bay dahū. Saguwā' aniya' amu'ku ma ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 30:32
verses.text: Tugutin aku angaliling ba'anan hayopnu ma llaw itu to'ongan. Ingga aniya' bili-bili ettom atawa kambing kabang-kabang, ma aku na palsuku'anku. Ya du ilu pangangganti'nu gadjiku.

verses.name: Genesis 30:33
verses.text: Manjari ma sinosōng, bang ka ganta' bilahi angitung bang pila panambanu ma aku, kata'uwannu magtūy bang aku kapangandolan atawa mbal. Bang saupama aniya' ta'nda'nu ma aku kambing ngga'i ka kabang atawa bili-bili ngga'i ka ettom, takilānu du bay tangkawku min ka'a.”  <div eID="gen533" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv315"/><div sID="gen534" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv315"/> Ya sambung si Leban, “Aho', sulut. Buwattē' na.”

verses.name: Genesis 30:35
verses.text: Malaingkan karahūan si Yakub e' si Leban ma llaw ina'an-i. Pinasaddī e'na pat'nna'an saga kambingna l'lla jali'-jali' maka kambing d'nda kabang-kabang maka bili-bili ettom-ettom isab. Pinaipat kamemon ma saga anakna e' si Leban,

verses.name: Genesis 30:36
verses.text: ati palawak sigām min si Yakub saga t'llung'llaw nil'ngngan. Si Yakub ya ta'bba maina'an angipat kaheka'an hayop si Leban ya halam binowa.  <div eID="gen534" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv316"/><div sID="gen535" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv316"/> Na pagka buwattē' akkal si Leban, aniya' saga sanga kayu nilabas e' si Yakub min kayu t'llungginis.<note>In t'llungginis kayu itu, bang ma bahasa Ingglis ‘poplar’, ‘almond’ maka ‘plane’.</note> Kinupas-kupasan kuwitna supaya magjali'-jali' ettom maka pote'.

verses.name: Genesis 30:38
verses.text: Kakupasan pa'in, pinat'nna' e'na ma deyom pagbohe'an saga hayop bo' ta'nda' e' sigām pasalta' anginum pehē'. Bang ta'abut timpu pagd'nda saga hayop,

verses.name: Genesis 30:39
verses.text: magd'nda du ma dahuan saga sanga kayu jali'-jali' he'. Manjari tapangā'an lihi e' kambing d'nda maka bili-bili d'nda ati jali'-jali' maka kabang-kabang maka b'ttikan ya nianakan e' sigām.  <div eID="gen535" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv317"/><div sID="gen536" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv317"/> Na, ya anak hayop e' pinasaddī na pa'in e' si Yakub. Saguwā' ya hayop asangpot pinaharap e'na tudju ni saga hayop jali'-jali' maka ettom-ettom ya suku' si Leban. Minnē' pinapagsaddī ba'anan hayop si Yakub maka ba'anan hayop si Leban.  <div eID="gen536" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv318"/><div sID="gen537" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv318"/> Tiyap-tiyap aniya' hayop d'nda ahāp baranna ya magd'nda, pinat'nna' e' si Yakub saga sanga kayu nijali'-jali' ma deyom paginuman bo' supaya magd'nda ma kasekotan saga sanga-i.

verses.name: Genesis 30:42
verses.text: Saguwā' bang hayop kulang ahāp ya magd'nda, mbal pinat'nna'an kayu-kayu. Ya kat'kkahanna, in hayop kulang hāpna pinasuku' ma si Leban. Malaingkan ya pinasuku' ma si Yakub anak hayop ahāp sadja baranna.

verses.name: Genesis 30:43
verses.text: Ya kat'kkahanna, paheka na pa'in bo' paheka karaya si Yakub. Gana-gana aheka na ba'anan bili-bili maka kambingna. Aheka isab saga unta'na maka kura'na. Ya du saga sosoho'anna d'nda-l'lla, aheka du isab.  <div eID="gen537" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.30"/> <div eID="gen528" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv319"/><div sID="gen538" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ala'an si Yakub min Deyoman si Leban</title> <div sID="gen539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv319"/> Na, kahaka'an si Yakub in iya pinah'llingan ala'at e' saga ipalna anak si Leban. Yuk sigām, “Saga kahayop-hayopan mma'ta wa'i ta'ā' e' si Yakub. Ya angkan iya dayahan ma sabab pangalta' bay suku' si Mma'.”

verses.name: Genesis 31:2
verses.text: Ta'nda' isab e' si Yakub apinda na addat si Leban ma iya, ngga'i ka na buwat bay tagna'.  <div eID="gen539" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv320"/><div sID="gen540" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv320"/> Magkallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Yakub, yukna, “Pabīng ka pehē' ni lahat kamatto'ahannu, ni kakampungannu. Pataptap du aku ma ka'a ma l'ngnganannu.”  <div eID="gen540" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv321"/><div sID="gen541" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv321"/> Anambuku magtūy si Yakub ma disi Rakiya maka si Leya. Sinō' sigām kaleya ni iya, ni tongod pagipatanna hayop.

verses.name: Genesis 31:5
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in sigām pehē', yukna ma sigām, “Saga dayang, tasayuku apinda na pamaihu'an mma'bi ma aku, ngga'i ka buwat bay dahū. Daipara tatabang aku e' Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'ku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:6
verses.text: Makata'u kam bay pagsangsā'ku maghinang ma deyoman mma'bi.

verses.name: Genesis 31:7
verses.text: Sagō' minsan na, parupangna sadja aku pagka pinagpinda-pinda e'na gadjiku. Ngga'i ka hal min t'dda, min sangpū'. Daipara halam aku bay tainay e'na sabab mbal bilahi Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 31:8
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' h'lling si Leban ma aku, yukna, ‘saga hayopan b'ttikan ya panganggadjiku ma ka'a,’ na, b'ttikan lullun ya nianakan e' saga hayop inān. Ya du bang pindahanna llingna bo' yukna, ‘hayop jali'-jali'an ya panganggadjiku ma ka'a,’ na, jali'-jali' na pa'in ya nianakan e' saga hayop kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 31:9
verses.text: Hatina Tuhan ya bay angala'anan karaya mma'bi bo' pamuwanna ma aku.”  <div eID="gen541" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv322"/><div sID="gen542" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv322"/> Anuli-nuli gi' si Yakub, yukna, “Aniya' bay tauppiku ma waktu pagd'nda saga kambing. Kabang-kabang maka jali'-jali'an lullun saga kambing l'lla ya ta'nda'ku magd'nda ma deyom uppiku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:11
verses.text: Jari aniya' pah'lling mala'ikat Tuhan ma aku, yukna, ‘O Yakub!’ <div eID="gen542" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen543" type="paragraph"/> “Ya sambungku, ‘Oy, itiya' aku.’

verses.name: Genesis 31:12
verses.text: Agsai angabtang mala'ikat-i, yukna, ‘Ang'nda' ka pehē'. Saga kambing l'lla ya magd'nda ilu, kabang lullun maka jali'-jali'an. Min kabaya'anku ko' ilu, sabab kata'uwanku bay pamarupang si Leban ma ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 31:13
verses.text: Aku ya Tuhan bay magpa'nda' ma ka'a ma lahat Betel. Ya na lahat bay pamat'nggehannu batu pangentomannu ma aku, lahat isab bay pagnajalannu. Na,’ yukna, ‘magsakap na ka buwattina'an bo' ka amole' pehē' ni lahatnu porol.’ ”  <div eID="gen543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv323"/><div sID="gen544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv323"/> Na anambung disi Rakiya maka si Leya. Yuk sigām ma si Yakub, “Tuwan, halam aniya' pusaka' taholat kami min si Mma'.

verses.name: Genesis 31:15
verses.text: Tahinang kami sali' a'a liyu, ngga'i na ka anakna lissi. Bang pinagbahasa, in kami itu sali' dagangan pinab'llihan e'na, sagō' aubus e'na b'llihanna.

verses.name: Genesis 31:16
verses.text: Ya kataluwa'anna, in pangalta' bay kala'anan e' Tuhan min si Mma' palsuku'an na ma kami maka ma saga ka'anakantam. Angkan na, tuwan, beya'un sadja ai-ai panoho'an Tuhan ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv324"/><div sID="gen545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv324"/> Manjari itu magsakap na si Yakub amole' pehē' ni mma'na ma lahat Kana'an. Pinakura' e'na anak-h'ndana ma saga unta', maka pinal'ngngan saga ba'anan hayopna kamemon dahū min iya. Binowa isab ai-aina kamemon ya bay tausahana t'ggolna bay ma lahat Mesopotami<note>Mesopotami, atawa Paddan-Aram.</note>.  <div eID="gen545" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv324"/><div sID="gen545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv324"/> Manjari itu magsakap na si Yakub amole' pehē' ni mma'na ma lahat Kana'an. Pinakura' e'na anak-h'ndana ma saga unta', maka pinal'ngngan saga ba'anan hayopna kamemon dahū min iya. Binowa isab ai-aina kamemon ya bay tausahana t'ggolna bay ma lahat Mesopotami<note>Mesopotami, atawa Paddan-Aram.</note>.  <div eID="gen545" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv325"/><div sID="gen546" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv325"/> Na, alikut pa'in si Leban magguntingan bulbul saga bili-bilina, tinangkaw saga ta'u-ta'u pagtutuhananna e' anakna si Ripka.

verses.name: Genesis 31:20
verses.text: Jari si Leban bangsa Aram bay kalimbungan e' si Yakub, pagka halam pinata'u pasal mohot si Yakub ala'an na amole' ni lahatna.

verses.name: Genesis 31:21
verses.text: Jari magdai'-dai' si Yakub ala'an maka e'na amowa ai-ai palsuku'anna kamemon. Pauntas iya ni dambila' sapa' Alpurati bo' patudju pehē' ni kabūd-būran ma lahat Giliyad.  <div eID="gen546" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen538" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv326"/><div sID="gen547" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anurul si Leban ma si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv326"/> Manjari makalabay pa'in t'llumbahangi, kahaka'an si Leban pasal kala'an disi Yakub.

verses.name: Genesis 31:23
verses.text: Tinurul iya magtūy e' si Leban maka saga kampungna, pitumbahangi ya t'ggol kapanurulna. Yamboho' ta'abutna disi Yakub ma kabūd-būran lahat Giliyad.

verses.name: Genesis 31:24
verses.text: Jari ma sangom e' aniya' pah'lling Tuhan ma si Leban ma deyom uppina. Yuk Tuhan ma iya, “Amay-amay, da'a sanggupin si Yakub, ai na ka ahāp, ai na ka ala'at.”  <div eID="gen548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv327"/><div sID="gen549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv327"/> Na, ina'an disi Yakub pahanti' ma kabūd-būran lahat Giliyad pagabut si Leban ma iya. Pahanti' isab si Leban maka saga kampungna ma tongod ina'an-i.

verses.name: Genesis 31:26
verses.text: Manjari itu ah'lling si Leban ma si Yakub, yukna, “Otō', angay aku akkalannu? Angay buwattilu pamowanu ma saga anakku? Bā'nu d'nda tasaggaw!

verses.name: Genesis 31:27
verses.text: Angay ka ala'an patapuk, halam minsan ama'id min aku? Bang ka bay ama'id, bay du pa'in kam tapatulakku ma deyom paglami-lamihan maka saga kalangan. Bay ka isab kabiyulahan maka katambulan.

verses.name: Genesis 31:28
verses.text: Angay aku halam minsan pasiyumnu ma saga anak-mpuku bo' kami mag'bba sangkahāpan? Dupang-dupang ka maghinang buwattilu!

verses.name: Genesis 31:29
verses.text: Aniya' kapatutku angala'at ma ka'a, daipara talāng aku dibuhi' e' Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'nu, da'a sinō' ananggupan ka'a.

verses.name: Genesis 31:30
verses.text: Kata'uwanku du bang ai sababna ya angkan ka ala'an. Tu'ud ka angentom lahatnu maka kakampungannu. Sagō' iya paginu-inuhanku, angay tangkawnu saga ta'u-ta'uku?”  <div eID="gen549" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv328"/><div sID="gen550" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv328"/> Anambung si Yakub ma si Leban, yukna, “Bapa', angkan aku halam ama'id min ka'a sabab tināw aku. Pangannalku in saga anaknu d'nda itu niagaw min aku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:32
verses.text: Sagō' in pasal saga ta'u-ta'unu, Bapa', sitta'aku. Bang hati tabāknu ma deyom duwa'an kami, minsan ma sai-sai, subay iya pinapatay. Itiya' kakampunganta anaksi'. Na, piha'un to'ongan. Bang aniya' tapihanu maitu ai-ai palsuku'annu, ngā'un na.” Tu'ud awam si Yakub, halam tasayuna in si Rakiya bay anangkaw saga ta'u-ta'u ya pagtuhanan mma'na.  <div eID="gen550" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv329"/><div sID="gen551" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv329"/> Manjari tolda si Yakub ya pamiha'an si Leban dahū. Pasunu', tolda si Leya, bo' ni deyom tolda duwangan ipatan d'nda. Sagō' halam tabāk maina'an saga ta'u-ta'u. Pagpuwas, pasōd na isab iya ni deyom tolda si Rakiya.

verses.name: Genesis 31:34
verses.text: Na in ta'u-ta'u itu bay tinapukan asal e' si Rakiya ma pakol unta'na bo' tiningkō'an e'na. Makasōd pa'in si Leban, agsai binulangkayat e'na duwa'an kamemon ya ma deyom tolda inān, sagō' halam aniya' tapihana.  <div eID="gen551" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv330"/><div sID="gen552" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv330"/> Ah'lling si Rakiya ma mma'na, yukna “Mma', da'a pa'in ala'at ataynu ma aku. Ampunun aku, sabab itiya' aku binulan, ya po'on aku mbal makat'ngge ma kamaitunu.” Na, minsan buwattingga e' si Leban amiha ta'u-ta'una inān, halam to'ongan tabāk maina'an.  <div eID="gen552" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv331"/><div sID="gen553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv331"/> Manjari akalintaw si Yakub, angkan yukna ma mato'ana, “Ai dusaku? Sara' ai bay talanggalku ya angkan aku turulnu pi'itu?

verses.name: Genesis 31:37
verses.text: Tajagjagnu duwa'anku kamemon. Aniya' bahā' suku'nu tabāknu mailu? Bang hati aniya', paluwasun kono' pi'itu ma pang'nda'an saga lahasiya'ta itu ati sigām ya maghukum ma kita duwangan bang sai magsab'nnal, ka'a ka atawa aku.  <div eID="gen553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv332"/><div sID="gen554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv332"/> “Duwampū' tahun,” yuk si Yakub, “bay t'ggolku ma deyomannu. Halam aniya' bili-bilinu atawa kambingnu kapulakan. Maka halam aku bay makakakan minsan dakayu' kambingnu l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 31:39
verses.text: Tiyap-tiyap bang aniya' hayop tatanggal e' sattuwa talun, halam bay bowaku ni ka'a. Sagō' akuhanku sinambi'an minsan ngga'i ka suku'ku. Maka bang aniya' hayopnu tinangkaw sumiyan-sumiyan, llaw ka atawa sangom, patanggungnu na pa'in ma aku, soho'nu ginanti'an ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:40
verses.text: Buwattē' na pa'in bay kahālanku. Kapasu'an aku sidda ma ka'llawan, kahaggutan ma waktu sangom. Ai na ka llaw, ai na ka sangom, halam ahāp e'ku atuli.

verses.name: Genesis 31:41
verses.text: Buwattē' sadja kahālanku ma deyomannu duwampū' tahun t'ggolna. Sangpū' maka mpat tahun isab ya t'ggolku maghinang ma ka'a supaya ta'ā'ku h'nda duwangan anaknu itu. Nnom tahun isab ya kapaghinangku ma ka'a supaya aniya' saga hayop ma aku. Aheya asal untungnu min aku, sagō' minsan na, min pila bay pagpinda-pindanu panganggadjinu ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:42
verses.text: Daipara nientom aku e' Tuhan, ya pagtuhanan mbo'ku si Ibrahim, ya pagmatāwan mma'ku si Isa'ak. Bang aku halam bay bogboganna, arak aku bay patulaknu ma halam aniya' ai-ai tabowaku. Saguwā' ta'nda' e' Tuhan katiksa'anku sampay lu'ug-liksa'ku ma deyomannu. Ya he' sababna angkan ka'a nilāng e'na dibuhi'.”  <div eID="gen554" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv333"/><div sID="gen555" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv333"/> Ya sambung si Leban ma si Yakub, “Aku ya tag-dapu ma ai-ai kamemon ilu. H'ndanu ilu, anakku du. Anaknu ilu, mpuku du. Kaba'anan hayop ilu, aku ya tag-dapuna. Saguwā' minsan na, halam na aniya' dapatku angokoman saga anakku maka ka'anakan sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 31:44
verses.text: Manjari Otō', in kita itu subay magjanji' buwattina'an. Subay kita amangkat batu isab pangentoman supaya mbal takalipatta.”  <div eID="gen555" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv334"/><div sID="gen556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv334"/> Magtūy aniya' batu dansolag pinuwa' e' si Yakub niosol maina'an.

verses.name: Genesis 31:46
verses.text: Yuk isab si Yakub ma saga a'ana, “Angahangkut kam batu pinatumpuk pi'itu.” Pagubus, mahē' na sigām amangan ma bihing tumpukan batu he'.

verses.name: Genesis 31:47
verses.text: Na ya pangōn si Leban ma tumpukan batu he' bang ma bahasa sigām, ‘Jegar Sahaduta.’ Ya pangōn si Yakub, ma bahasana isab, ‘Gale'ed.’<note>Ya ōn Jegar Sahaduta itu, bahasa Aram, hatina ‘tumpukan pangentoman.’ Ya ōn Gale'ed, sali' du isab hatina sagō' ma bahasa Hibrani.’</note>  <div eID="gen556" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv335"/><div sID="gen557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv335"/> Ya pamissala si Leban ma si Yakub, “Ya tumpukan batu itu paltanda'an in kita duwangan bay makapagjanji' ma llaw itu.” Angkanna tumpukan e' kaōnan Gale'ed.

verses.name: Genesis 31:49
verses.text: Niōnan Mispa<note>Ya ōn Mispa itu, bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘tongod pagpeyanan.’</note> isab ma sabab kabtangan si Leban, ya yukna, “Bang pa'in kita pineyanan e' si Yawe sat'ggolta magsaddī lahat.”

verses.name: Genesis 31:50
verses.text: Aniya' gi' lling si Leban, yukna, “Bang ka saupama aminjala' saga anakku itu atawa magh'nda ma d'nda saddī, entomun to'ongan, ilu du Tuhan ang'nda' ma kita minsan halam aniya' makata'u.  <div eID="gen557" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv336"/><div sID="gen558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv336"/> “Nda'un isab,” yuk si Leban, “tumpukan batu itu maka batu bay osolanta.

verses.name: Genesis 31:52
verses.text: Paltanda'an ko' itu ma kita duwangan ma pasal paljanji'anta dakayu'. In aku itu mbal paliyu min tumpukan batu itu angala'at ma ka'a. Damikiyanna isab, in ka'a ilu mbal paliyu min batu itu angala'at ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 31:53
verses.text: Na, mura-murahan bang pa'in kita nihukum e' Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mbo'nu si Ibrahim maka pagtuhanan mbo'ku si Nahor.” <div eID="gen558" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen559" type="paragraph"/> Manjari anapa na si Yakub ma ōn Tuhan ya pagmatāwan e' mma'na si Isa'ak. Ya pagsapana in iya amogbog ma paljanji'an sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 31:54
verses.text: Sakali itu, aniya' hayop sinumbali' e' si Yakub maina'an pagkulbananna ni Tuhan. Nilinganan isab saga kakampunganna sinō' magjamu. Jari maina'an sigām magtulihan ma bihing būd inān.  <div eID="gen559" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv337"/><div sID="gen560" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv337"/> Pagdai' llaw pa'in siniyum e' si Leban saga mpuna maka saga anakna. Niamu'-amu'an isab sigām kahāpan bo' yampa iya amole' ni lahatna.  <div eID="gen560" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.31"/> <div eID="gen547" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv338"/><div sID="gen561" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magsakap si Yakub Magbāk maka si Esaw</title> <div sID="gen562" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv338"/> Ya du si Yakub bay pauntas ni patudjuhanna. Sakali itu, ma labayan pa'in, aniya' saga mala'ikat min Tuhan anampang iya.

verses.name: Genesis 32:2
verses.text: Ya lling si Yakub pag'nda'na ma sigām, “Kilāku, pat'nna'an kasundaluhan Tuhan ko' itu.” Ati Mahanaim<note>Ya ōn Mahanaim, hatina ‘duwa tumpukan.’</note> ya pangōnna ma lahat inān.  <div eID="gen562" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv339"/><div sID="gen563" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv339"/> Manjari aniya' panoho'an si Yakub ma saga a'ana, yukna, “Parahū kam min aku ni danakanku si Esaw, ina'an ma jadjahan Se'er, ma lahat Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 32:4
verses.text: Ya llingbi ma iya subay buwatittu, ‘Tuwan, aniya' itu lapal min atanu si Yakub. Yuk lapal itu, “At'ggol aku bay maglahat ma deyoman si'itta si Leban. Halam aku bay magla'an-la'an minnē'.

verses.name: Genesis 32:5
verses.text: Aheka na hayop palsuku'anku, buwat saga sapi', kura', bili-bili, maka kambing. Aheka na isab saga sosoho'anku d'nda-l'lla. Manjari, tuwan, ya angkan pabowaku lapal itu ni ka'a, bang pa'in aku taima'nu magatay pote'.” ’ ”  <div eID="gen563" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv340"/><div sID="gen564" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv340"/> Sakali itu, makabīng pa'in saga a'a bay pamabowahan lapal si Yakub, aniya' pangahaka sigām ma iya, yuk-i, “Tuwan, bay kami patampal pehē' ni danakannu si Esaw, maka ilu'un na iya pasampang ma ka'a. Aniya' ma iya saga tendogna mpat hatus hekana.”

verses.name: Genesis 32:7
verses.text: Na, sinōd tāw magtūy si Yakub, aheya to'ongan kasusahanna, angkan binahagi' duwa saga a'a ya bebeya'anna. Ya du ba'anan hayopna sampay saga unta'na, binahagi' duwa isab.

verses.name: Genesis 32:8
verses.text: Ya ma deyom pikilan si Yakub, bang si Esaw ganta' pina'an amono' sigām, makal'ppa sigām dabahagi'.  <div eID="gen564" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv341"/><div sID="gen565" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv341"/> Jari angamu'-ngamu' si Yakub ni Tuhan, yukna, “O Tuhanku, ka'a ya pagtuhanan mbo'ku si Ibrahim maka mma'ku si Isa'ak, angamu' aku tabang ma ka'a. O Yawe, ka'a ya bay anoho' aku subay amole' ni lahatku maka ni kakampunganku. Bay aku janji'annu isab in aku buwanannu kahāpan ma ai-ai hinangku.

verses.name: Genesis 32:10
verses.text: Atanu aku, a'a mbal tinōp subay nihāp e'nu. Sagō' minsan na, aheya ase' maka lasanu ma aku. Waktu lagi' kauntasku ni dambila' sapa' Jordan, halam aniya' tabowaku, luwal la'a dakayu' tungkud ma tanganku. Saguwā' ma buwattina'an itiya' na aku magduwa tumpukan ma labayan tudju amole'.

verses.name: Genesis 32:11
verses.text: O Tuhan, tabangin aku sabab aheya kagawahanku ma siyakaku si Esaw. Pi'itu iya arai' amono' aku sampay saga anak-h'ndaku.

verses.name: Genesis 32:12
verses.text: Entomun lagi' bay paljanji'annu ma aku, in aku buwanannu kahāpan, maka buwanannu aku tubu' mbal taitung hekana, sapantun heka solagan gusung ma bihing tahik.” Ya na he' pangamu'-ngamu' si Yakub ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen565" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv342"/><div sID="gen566" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv342"/> Manjari pahanti' iya maina'an dambahangi. Pagsubu, amene' iya hayop aheka pamasampangna ma si Esaw.

verses.name: Genesis 32:14
verses.text: Ya tapene'na duwa hatus kambing d'nda maka duwampū' kambing l'lla, duwa hatus bili-bili d'nda maka duwampū' bili-bili l'lla,

verses.name: Genesis 32:15
verses.text: t'llumpū' unta' d'nda taga-anak masi anganduru', mpatpū' sapi' d'nda maka sangpū' sapi' mandangan, duwampū' kura' d'nda maka sangpū' kura' l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 32:16
verses.text: Jari pinagbahagi' magba'an-ba'an saga hayop itu e' si Yakub ati patunggu'anna ma saga a'ana. Ya panoho'anna ma sigām, “Pauntas kam dahū min aku. Paglawak-lawakunbi isab saga hayop ilu damba'an maka damba'an.”  <div eID="gen566" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv343"/><div sID="gen567" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv343"/> Aniya' isab pamandu'na ma sosoho'anna dakayu' ya parahū min kamemon, yukna, “Bang ka saupama talanggal e' siyakaku, bo' yukna ma ka'a, ‘Pi'ingga ka, maka sai nakura'nu, maka sai isab tag-dapu saga hayop ilu?’

verses.name: Genesis 32:18
verses.text: Ya panambungnu ma iya subay buwattitu. Yuknu, ‘Tuwan, atanu si Yakub ya tag-dapu itu kamemon. Sinō' binowa pi'itu ni ka'a kasampangan. Ilu'un na iya paturul min buli'an.’ ”  <div eID="gen567" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv344"/><div sID="gen568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv344"/> Ya du panoho'an si Yakub ma saga a'ana magsunu'-sunu' ya tag-tunggu'an saga hayop kasehe'. Yukna, “Bang kam ganta' talanggal e' siyakaku si Esaw, ya pangahakabi ma iya subay buwattitu,

verses.name: Genesis 32:20
verses.text: ‘Aho' tuwan, ilu'un du atanu si Yakub paturul min buli'an.’ ” Ya ma deyom pikilan si Yakub, bang aniya' kasampangan pinabeya'an si Esaw dahū gi' min kapaglanggal sigām, kalu ahāp atayna tudju ni si Yakub ati magkahāp sigām pabīng.

verses.name: Genesis 32:21
verses.text: Manjari pinarahū e' si Yakub kasampanganna inān kamemon. Sagō' si Yakub baranna angagad gi' ma pahanti'an sigām dambahangi.  <div eID="gen568" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen561" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv345"/><div sID="gen569" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magkosogan si Yakub maka Tuhan ma Lahat Peniyēl</title> <div sID="gen570" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv345"/> Na, ma sangom inān, papunduk si Yakub min patulihanna. Niā' h'ndana karuwangan maka ipatan sigām, sampay anakna l'lla kasangpū' maka dda. Ni'nde'an sigām e'na pehē' ni dambila' sapa' Jabbok.

verses.name: Genesis 32:23
verses.text: Ma dambila' pa'in saga anak-h'ndana, pinauntas isab e' si Yakub kaniya'na kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 32:24
verses.text: Sagō' in iya baranna pat'nna' dangan-danganna ma tongod ina'an. Sakali aniya' magpasalupa ma si Yakub amowa iya magkosogan sampay asekot ni karai'-llawan.

verses.name: Genesis 32:25
verses.text: Na, pagnanam e' a'a inān in si Yakub mbal tara'ugna, magtūy tibu'na ma pangkulna ati magsā' lo'atanna.

verses.name: Genesis 32:26
verses.text: Ya yuk a'a-i ma iya, “Bbahin aku, marai' na llaw.” <div eID="gen570" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen571" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Yakub, yukna, “Ē, mbal ka bbahanku. Subay ka amuwanan aku barakat dahū.”  <div eID="gen571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv346"/><div sID="gen572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv346"/> Manjari tinilaw si Yakub bang sai ōnna. “Si Yakub,” yukna.  <div eID="gen572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv347"/><div sID="gen573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv347"/> Angabtang a'a inān, yukna, “Ngga'i ka na Yakub ya pangōn ka'a puwas minnitu, sagō' si Isra'il<note>Ya ōn Isra'il itu, hatina ‘magkosogan maka Tuhan.’</note> na, ma sabab kapagkosognu maka Tuhan maka ma pagkahinu manusiya'. Bay tara'ugnu sali'-sali'.”  <div eID="gen573" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv348"/><div sID="gen574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv348"/> Ah'lling gi' si Yakub, “Tuwan, pahati'un aku kono' bang sai ōnnu.” <div eID="gen574" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen575" type="paragraph"/> Anambung a'a-i, yukna, “Oy, angay tilawnu ōnku?” Manjari barakatanna si Yakub.  <div eID="gen575" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv349"/><div sID="gen576" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv349"/> Ya pah'lling si Yakub, “Arī, magharap aku maka Tuhan, bo' pa'in itiya' aku masi allum.” Angkanna lahat inān niōnan Peniyēl<note>Ya ōn Peniyēl itu, hatina ‘magharap maka Tuhan.’</note> e' si Yakub.  <div eID="gen576" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv350"/><div sID="gen577" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv350"/> Yamboho' paluwas mata llaw ma waktu kalanjal si Yakub min lahat Peniyēl e'. Magpengka'-pengka' isab iya ma sabab dambila' lo'atan pangkulna magsā'.

verses.name: Genesis 32:32
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan bangsa Isra'il mbal to'ongan amangan ugat sumbali'an ya ma lo'atan pangkul. Ya ina'an addat sigām sampay ni kabuwattituhan, tu'ud nientom mbo' sigām si Yakub bay waktu kapanibu' pangkulna.  <div eID="gen577" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.32"/> <div eID="gen569" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv351"/><div sID="gen578" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagsampang si Yakub maka si Esaw</title> <div sID="gen579" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv351"/> Manjari itu, maka'nda' pa'in si Yakub ni dahuanna, ilu na si Esaw maka saga tendogna mpat hatus puhu'. Magtūy pinapagtumpuk e' si Yakub saga onde'-onde' maka kaina'an sigām magkaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: Genesis 33:2
verses.text: Ya pinarahū e'na si Bilha maka si Silpa sampay saga anak sigām. Pasunu' disi Leya maka saga anakna, ati karamulihan si Rakiya maka anakna si Yusup.

verses.name: Genesis 33:3
verses.text: Si Yakub baranna ya parahū min kamemon. Na, asekot-sekot pa'in iya ni si Esaw, magtūy iya pasujud min pitu' pagaddatna ma siyakana.  <div eID="gen579" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv352"/><div sID="gen580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv352"/> Malaingkan si Esaw paragan anampang si Yakub. Anganggapus iya maka aniyum, ati magtangis sigām karuwangan.

verses.name: Genesis 33:5
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Esaw ma saga kar'ndahan maka saga onde'-onde', atilaw iya ma si Yakub, yukna, “Sai kasehe'annu ilu?” <div eID="gen580" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen581" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Kaka' tuwan, ya na itu ka'anakan bay pangalidjiki' Tuhan ma aku, ya atanu itu.”  <div eID="gen581" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv353"/><div sID="gen582" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv353"/> Manjari pasōng isab saga ipatan si Yakub maka ka'anakan sigām, ati pasujud ma dahuan si Esaw.

verses.name: Genesis 33:7
verses.text: Pasunu' isab si Leya maka saga anakna, karamulihan si Rakiya maka anakna si Yusup, pasujud sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen582" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv354"/><div sID="gen583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv354"/> Atilaw gi' si Esaw, yukna, “Pamagay ba'anan tumpukan hayop bay talanggalku ma lān ina'an? Ai kagunahanna?” <div eID="gen583" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen584" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Ya kagunahanna, Kaka' tuwan, pamuwanku ma ka'a pamahāp ataynu tudju ni aku.”  <div eID="gen584" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv355"/><div sID="gen585" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv355"/> Yuk si Esaw, “Otō', da'a na. Aheka du ma aku. Mailuhun na ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv356"/><div sID="gen586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv356"/> Yuk si Yakub, “Ndū', Kaka' tuwan, bang sab'nnal-b'nnal ahāp na ataynu ma aku, taima'un kasampanganku itu ma ka'a. Ya pagharapku maka ka'a llaw itu, sali' hantang pagharapku maka Tuhan, sabab ahāp sidda pamaihu'annu ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 33:11
verses.text: Taima'un, Kaka' tuwan, ya kasampanganku itu ma ka'a, sabab aheya kahāpan ya bay pamuwan Tuhan ma aku. Halam aniya' kulang ma aku.” Jari tinaima' na e' si Esaw pagka tapogos e' si Yakub.  <div eID="gen586" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv357"/><div sID="gen587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv357"/> “Na,” yuk si Esaw, “Sūng na kitam. Sehe'anta kam.”  <div eID="gen587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv358"/><div sID="gen588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv358"/> Sagō' mbal si Yakub. Yukna, “Kaka' tuwan, kata'uwannu du. Alamma saga onde'-onde' itu. Maka pagsusahanku isab saga bili-bili maka saga sapi' taga-anak duru'an lagi'. Bang puspusanta pal'ngngan minsan dang'llaw sadja, marai' magpatayan du kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 33:14
verses.text: Ndū', Kaka',” yuk si Yakub ma si Esaw, “parahū gi' ka min kami. Kami maka saga anakku sampay saga ba'anan hayop itu subay paturul min damuliannu. Painut-inut sadja kami pal'ngngan sampay ka ta'abutku mahē' ma lahat Se'er.”  <div eID="gen588" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv359"/><div sID="gen589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv359"/> “Na aho', Otō',” yuk si Esaw. “Bbahanku isab saga a'aku pagapi' ma ka'am.” <div eID="gen589" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen590" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Yakub, “Minsan mbal na, Kaka' tuwan. Ya sadja aheya ma aku bang pa'in ahāp na ataynu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen590" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv360"/><div sID="gen591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv360"/> Manjari ma llaw ina'an-i magpamole' na disi Esaw ni lahatna Se'er.

verses.name: Genesis 33:17
verses.text: Sagō' si Yakub iya pehē' gom pa'in ni lahat Sokkot. Ma Sokkot pa'in, angahinang iya luma' pat'nna'anna maka saga anak-h'ndana. Angahinang isab iya saga kamalig pasindungan ba'anan kahayopanna. Ya he' sababna angkan lahat inān niōnan Sokkot.<note>Ya ōn Sokkot itu, hatina ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘pasindungan.’</note>  <div eID="gen591" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv361"/><div sID="gen592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv361"/> Ya hatulanna, makapole' pa'in si Yakub min lahat Mesopotami, at'kka na ni lahat Kana'an ma halam aniya' baya-baya. Tat'kkana da'ira Sekem ati maina'an iya magpat'ngge tolda pagluma'an sigām, ina'an ma anggopan da'ira.

verses.name: Genesis 33:19
verses.text: Manjari ya tana' pat'nna'an sigām inān bay bin'lli e'na min saga panubu' si Hamor mma' si Sekem, dahatus pilak tibu'uk ya pam'llina.

verses.name: Genesis 33:20
verses.text: Aniya' isab pagtunu'an kulban nihinang e' si Yakub ma tana' ina'an. El-Elohe-Isra'il<note>Ya ōn El-Elohe-Isra'il itu, hatina ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘Tuhan ya pagtuhanan si Isra'il.’</note> ya pangōnna ma pagkukulbanan inān.  <div eID="gen592" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.33"/> <div eID="gen578" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv362"/><div sID="gen593" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Niusiba'an si Dina</title> <div sID="gen594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv362"/> Na, aniya' anak si Yakub maka si Leya budjang, ōnna si Dina. Dakayu' llaw pal'ngngan si Dina itu anibaw saga bagayna d'nda, a'a Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 34:2
verses.text: Jari ta'nda' iya e' si Sekem anak si Hamor, ya pagbebeya'an ma lahat inān. (A'a bangsa Hīb disi Hamor itu.) Pag'nda' si Sekem ma si Dina, magtūy saggawna bo' yampa usiba'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 34:3
verses.text: Sagō' ka'amuhan iya ma si Dina he' maka sinōd lasa. Jari bissalahanna pahāp-hāp, kalu tabowa alasa isab ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 34:4
verses.text: Yuk si Sekem ma mma'na si Hamor, “Mma', pah'nda'un ma aku d'nda itu.”  <div eID="gen594" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv363"/><div sID="gen595" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv363"/> Sakali itu, makata'u pa'in si Yakub pasal pangusiba' itu ma anakna si Dina, halam aniya' tapah'llingna pasal palkala' itu. Subay na bay makapole' saga anakna min kaparangan, min hinang sigām anunggu' kahayopan.  <div eID="gen595" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv364"/><div sID="gen596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv364"/> Manjari si Hamor, ya mma' si Sekem-i, pehē' ni si Yakub amowa iya maggara'.

verses.name: Genesis 34:7
verses.text: Maina'an isab saga anak si Yakub l'lla baha'u bay at'kka min deya. Kahaka'an pa'in sigām pasal palkala' itu, magtūy sigām astolan makalandu' ma sabab pangusiba' si Sekem ma danakan sigām si Dina. Mbal to'ongan manjari, talapay saga a'a Isra'il kamemon nihinangan kaiya'an.  <div eID="gen596" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv365"/><div sID="gen597" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv365"/> Ah'lling si Hamor ma si Yakub maka saga anakna-i, yukna, “Ndū' tuwan, in anakku si Sekem itu aheya to'ongan baya'na ma anaknu si Dina. Taima'un iya, pah'nda'un ma anaknu.

verses.name: Genesis 34:9
verses.text: Ahāp kitam magpikit-pikiti d'nda maka l'lla.

verses.name: Genesis 34:10
verses.text: Bang hati buwattē', makapaglahat du kam maitu maingga-maingga kabaya'anbi pat'nna'an. Aluhaya du kam angusaha maitu, makajari isab am'lli tana'.”  <div eID="gen597" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv366"/><div sID="gen598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv366"/> Ah'lling isab si Sekem ma mma' si Dina sampay ma saga danakanna, yukna, “Ndū', saga Tuwan, bang pa'in aku makasulut ataybi. Ai-ai amu'bi ma aku pamuwanku du ma ka'am.

verses.name: Genesis 34:12
verses.text: Haka'inbi aku bang pila ungsudna maka sokatna ati akuhanku du, bang aku pakawinbi ma si Dina.”  <div eID="gen598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv367"/><div sID="gen599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv367"/> Sagō' angakkal saga anak si Yakub ma si Sekem maka mma'na si Hamor, ma sabab pangusiba'na ma danakan sigām si Dina.

verses.name: Genesis 34:14
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Ē, mbal makajari. In danakan kami itu mbal tapah'lla ma l'lla halam bay taislam. Kaiya'an ko' ilu ma kami.

verses.name: Genesis 34:15
verses.text: Magsulut du kitam bang pa'in ni'islam kal'llahanbi kamemon, buwat pagislam ma kami.

verses.name: Genesis 34:16
verses.text: Jari magpikit-pikiti du kitam. Magdalahat kitam magdabangsa.

verses.name: Genesis 34:17
verses.text: Malaingkan bang kam mbal ameya' ma gara' kami itu, pagka mbal bilahi magislam, na, ngā' kami na danakan kami d'nda itu bo' ala'an minnitu.”  <div eID="gen599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv368"/><div sID="gen600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv368"/> Manjari kasulutan si Hamor maka anakna si Sekem ma gara' bay nihūgan sigām e' saga anak si Yakub e'.

verses.name: Genesis 34:19
verses.text: Mbal pa'in at'ggol, bineya' e' si Sekem gara' sigām ma sabab baya'na ma si Dina anak si Yakub. Si Sekem ya pinagaddatan asal labi min kakampunganna kasehe'an.

verses.name: Genesis 34:20
verses.text: Manjari pehē' na iya maka mma'na si Hamor ni tongod pasōran da'ira bo' amowa magisun saga l'lla ya magtipun maina'an.

verses.name: Genesis 34:21
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Saga tuwan, in bangsa Isra'il itu patibagayun asal. Ahāp bang sigām tugutanta maglahat maitu maka magusaha isab ma deyom kaluhaya'an, sabab aluha asal lahattam. Ahāp isab bang tugutantam saga anak sigām subul-budjang magkawin-kiyawani maka anaktam.

verses.name: Genesis 34:22
verses.text: Saguwā' mbal gi' sigām makajari magdalahat-magdabangsa maka kitam. In kitam kal'llahan subay magislam dahū buwat kapagislam ma sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 34:23
verses.text: Manjari bang beya'ta addat sigām e', in hayop sigām kamemon maka pangalta' sigām kamemon ma kitam du ma waktu sinōng. Jari patut bahā' bang kitam magsulut supaya sigām maglahat maitu ma kitam?”  <div eID="gen600" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv369"/><div sID="gen601" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv369"/> Manjari kasulutan saga l'lla ma da'ira inān kamemon. Bineya' e' sigām gara' si Hamor maka anakna si Sekem ati magislam sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen601" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv370"/><div sID="gen602" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv370"/> Na, palabay pa'in t'llumbahangi min bay pagislam e', bo' halam gi' kauli'an, pina'an na duwangan anak si Yakub l'lla, si Simiyun maka si Libi ya langgung si Dina. Pasōd sigām magtakos kalis ni deyom da'ira inān ma halam aniya' pangalab-ngalab saga a'a maina'an. Jari nilagut pinapatay saga l'lla inān kamemon e' sigām karuwangan.

verses.name: Genesis 34:26
verses.text: Talapay isab si Hamor maka anakna si Sekem pinapatay. Si Dina iya niā' e' sigām min deyom luma' si Sekem.

verses.name: Genesis 34:27
verses.text: Magpatayan pa'in saga a'a itu, paturul isab saga anak si Yakub kasehe'an anaban kamemon ai-ai bay ma deyom da'ira. Ya he' pamalos sigām ma kaiya'an danakan sigām budjang.

verses.name: Genesis 34:28
verses.text: Tinaban e' sigām pangalta' kamemon ma deyom-luwasan da'ira inān, buwat saga kambing, bili-bili, sapi' maka kura', hatina ai-ai taga-guna.

verses.name: Genesis 34:29
verses.text: Tinaban pangalta' kamemon bay ma deyom luma', sinaggaw isab saga d'nda maka kaonde'an kamemon.  <div eID="gen602" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv371"/><div sID="gen603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv371"/> Na, kinata'uwan pa'in e' si Yakub hinang si Simiyun maka si Libi itu, magtūy pah'llinganna sigām. Yukna, “Arōy! Aheya kasusahan ya pamuwanbi itu ma aku. Binantahan du aku e' saga bangsa Kana'an maka bangsa Pirissi sampay bangsa a'a kamemon ma lahat itu. Ariki' du kitam. Bang sigām ganta' magdakayu' pi'itu angandugpak, tantu kitam alaglag kamemon magtai'anak.”  <div eID="gen603" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv372"/><div sID="gen604" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv372"/> Ya sambung si Simiyun maka si Libi, “Pasagaranta bahā' bang danakan kami si Dina tahinang sali' d'nda pinagtatambahan?”  <div eID="gen604" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.34"/> <div eID="gen593" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv373"/><div sID="gen605" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pabīng Si Yakub ni Lahat Betel</title> <div sID="gen606" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv373"/> bdNa aniya' panoho'an Tuhan ma si Yakub, yukna, “Patukad ka ni Betel bo' ka maglahat mahē'. Hinangun pagtunu'an isab mahē' pagkulbanannu ma aku, ya Tuhan bay magpa'nda' ma ka'a waktu lagi' kalahinu min siyakanu si Esaw.”  <div eID="gen606" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv374"/><div sID="gen607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv374"/> Ah'lling si Yakub ma saga anak-h'ndana sampay ma saga a'a bebeya'anna kamemon, yukna, “Timaninbi saga ta'u-ta'u kamemon ya pagtutuhananbi ilu. Sussihunbi baranbi pahāp bo' yampa kam magsalinan badju' al'ssin.

verses.name: Genesis 35:3
verses.text: Pagubus, patukad kitam ni Betel ati angahinang aku pagkulbanan maina'an pangarapan ni Tuhan ya bay anabangan aku ma waktu kasukkalanku. Ginapi' na pa'in aku e'na pi'ingga-pi'ingga bay pal'ngngananku.”

verses.name: Genesis 35:4
verses.text: Manjari bineya' lling si Yakub e' saga a'ana inān ati sinōngan ni iya saga ta'u-ta'u sigām kamemon sampay saga aretes<note>Aretes itu marai' bay nihinang e' sigām hadjimat, atawa bay tinaban e' sigām min da'ira Sekem.</note> bay ma tainga sigām. Jari kinubul kamemonna e' si Yakub ma tongod po'on kayu pagduwa'ahan ya ma Sekem.

verses.name: Genesis 35:5
verses.text: Pagubus, pasalta' pa'in disi Yakub atulak minnē', pinat'kkahan tāw aheya saga a'a ma kakauman Sekem angkan sigām mbal makatawakkal anurul disi Yakub amalos.  <div eID="gen607" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv375"/><div sID="gen608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv375"/> Manjari itu magt'kkahan na si Yakub sampay saga a'ana kamemon ni Lūs, ya pinagōnan Betel ma tahun damuli itu. Ma lahat Kana'an ko' inān.

verses.name: Genesis 35:7
verses.text: Aniya' pagtunu'an kulban nihinang e' si Yakub mahē'. El-Betel<note>Ya ōn El-Betel itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘Tuhan Lahat Betel.’</note> ya pangōnna ma lahat inān, sabab ya na lahat bay pagpa'nda'an Tuhan ma iya waktu bay kalahina min siyakana.  <div eID="gen608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv376"/><div sID="gen609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv376"/> Amatay na si Debora, ya d'nda bay angayurahan si Ripka min kariki'-diki'na gi'. Takubul iya ma tongod dakayu' po'on kayu ya ma lūran lahat Betel. Allon Bakut (hatina Kayu Pagkarukka'an) ya pangōn a'a ma kayu inān.  <div eID="gen609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv377"/><div sID="gen610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv377"/> Na, ma waktu kapamole' si Yakub min lahat Mesopotami, bay magpa'nda' Tuhan ni iya pabalik maka amuwanan iya kahāpan.

verses.name: Genesis 35:10
verses.text: Ya pangallam Tuhan ma iya, “Ōnnu si Yakub<note>Ya ōn Yakub itu pa'anggil ma dakayu' kabtangan, hatina ‘amalut ma buli' tape'.’ Ya hantang-hatulanna, ‘pangangakkal.’</note> sagō' puwas itu ngga'i ka na si Yakub ya pangōn ka'a, sagō' si Isra'il<note>Ya ōn Isra'il itu, hatina, ‘magkosogan maka Tuhan.’</note> na.” Hatina Tuhan to'ongan ya bay angōnan iya si Isra'il.  <div eID="gen610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv378"/><div sID="gen611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv378"/> Manjari angallam na isab Tuhan ma iya, “Aku itu Tuhan Sangat Kawasa. Anganak ka paheka, manjari ma waktu sinōng aniya' kabangsa-bangsahan patubu' min ka'a. Lāgi aniya' saga sultan isab luwa' min panubu'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 35:12
verses.text: Ya lahat bay pamuwanku ma mbo'nu si Ibrahim maka mma'nu si Isa'ak pamuwanku isab ma ka'a sampay ma saga panubu'nu.”

verses.name: Genesis 35:13
verses.text: Pagubus, ala'an na Tuhan min lugal bay pagsuli-sulihanna maka si Yakub.  <div eID="gen611" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv379"/><div sID="gen612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv379"/> Na maina'an, ma tongod bay pangallaman Tuhan ma iya, aniya' batu niosolan e'na. Taosol pa'in, binusug e' si Yakub binu-anggul maka ns'llan jaitun<note>Ns'llan pin'gga' min buwa' kayu jaitun.</note> ma diyata'na panukbal ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 35:15
verses.text: Manjari Betel<note>Ya ōn Betel itu bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘luma' Tuhan.’</note> ya pangōn si Yakub ma lahat ina'an-i.  <div eID="gen612" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen605" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv380"/><div sID="gen613" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Rakiya</title> <div sID="gen614" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv380"/> Pagpuwas, palanjal na si Yakub maka saga anak-h'ndana min Betel inān. Na alawak-lawak lagi' sigām min kauman Eprata, ta'abut na bulanan si Rakiya anganak. Kahunitan iya to'ongan.

verses.name: Genesis 35:17
verses.text: Jari itu, pagka makalandu' hunitna, yuk panday ma iya, “Ndū', Rakiya, da'a ka tināw, l'lla ko' itu.”

verses.name: Genesis 35:18
verses.text: Song pa'in ab'kkat napasna, si Benoni (hatina ‘anak kasusahanku’) ya ōn pang'bba si Rakiya ma anakna. Manjari amutawan na iya. Saguwā' Benjamin<note>Benjamin, hatina ‘anak taga-kawasa’ atawa ‘anak ahāp sukudna.’</note> ya pangōn si Yakub ma onde'-onde' he'.  <div eID="gen614" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv381"/><div sID="gen615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv381"/> Pagka amatay na si Rakiya, kinubul iya ma bihing lān tudju ni kauman Eprata, ya pinagōnan Betlehem ma tahun damuli itu.

verses.name: Genesis 35:20
verses.text: Jari aniya' batu lakit niosolan e' si Yakub, batu panganggindanan kubul si Rakiya. Ina'an du isab sampay ni buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen615" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv382"/><div sID="gen616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv382"/> Pagpuwas, palanjal na disi Yakub (ya pinagōnan isab si Isra'il) ati magpat'ngge tolda pagluma'an sigām ma liyuhan Migdal-Eder.<note>Migdal-Eder itu bahasa Hibrani, hatina ‘luma' pamantawan hayop.’</note>

verses.name: Genesis 35:22
verses.text: Sakali itu, waktu lagi' disi Isra'il pat'nna' ma liyuhan Migdal-Eder inān, makapagbihing anakna si Rubin maka h'nda-h'ndana si Bilha. Kahaka'an si Yakub pasal ina'an-i angkan akagit atayna. Na, si Yakub itu, sangpū' maka duwa anakna l'lla.  <div eID="gen616" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv383"/><div sID="gen617" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv383"/> Ya itu saga anakna min si Leya: <lg sID="gen618"/> <l level="2" sID="gen619"/>si Rubin ya pagsiyakahan,<l eID="gen619" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen620"/>bo' si Simiyun, si Libi, si Yahud, maka si Issakar,<l eID="gen620" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen621"/>si Sibulun ya kasiyalihan.<l eID="gen621" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen618"/>  <div eID="gen617" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv384"/><div sID="gen622" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv384"/> Saga anak si Yakub min si Rakiya: <lg sID="gen623"/> <l level="2" sID="gen624"/>si Yusup ya siyaka, bo' si Benjamin.<l eID="gen624" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen623"/>  <div eID="gen622" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv385"/><div sID="gen625" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv385"/> Anakna isab min si Bilha ya ipatan si Rakiya: <lg sID="gen626"/> <l level="2" sID="gen627"/>si Dān maka si Naptali.<l eID="gen627" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen626"/>  <div eID="gen625" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv386"/><div sID="gen628" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv386"/> Anakna isab min si Silpa ya ipatan si Leya: <lg sID="gen629"/> <l level="2" sID="gen630"/>si Gād maka si Aser.<l eID="gen630" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen629"/> <div eID="gen628" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen631" type="paragraph"/> In sangpū' maka duwa anak si Yakub l'lla itu bay nianakan ma lahat Mesopotami.  <div eID="gen631" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen613" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv387"/><div sID="gen632" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kawapat si Isa'ak</title> <div sID="gen633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv387"/> Manjari at'kka na si Yakub ni mma'na si Isa'ak ma lahat Mamre (hatina lahat Hebron), ya na lahat bay paglahatan si Isa'ak maka si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Genesis 35:28
verses.text: Na, ta'abut pa'in dahatus maka walumpū' tahun umul si Isa'ak,

verses.name: Genesis 35:29
verses.text: awapat na iya ma deyom kasannangan, ati pinapagtimuk iya maka ka'mbo'-mbo'anna. Takubul iya e' anakna karuwangan si Esaw maka si Yakub.  <div eID="gen633" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.35"/> <div eID="gen632" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv388"/><div sID="gen634" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panubu' si Esaw</title> <div sID="gen635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv388"/> Ya na itu salsila panugsugan saga panubu' si Esaw, ya pinagōnan isab si Edom.

verses.name: Genesis 36:2
verses.text: Min lahat Kana'an h'ndana kat'llungan. H'ndana dakayu' si Ada anak si Elon, a'a bangsa Hīt. Karuwana si Oholebama anak si Ana anak si Sebeyon, a'a bangsa Hīb.

verses.name: Genesis 36:3
verses.text: Kat'lluna si Basemat anak si Isma'il, ya magdanakan maka si Nebayot.

verses.name: Genesis 36:4
verses.text: Si Elepas ya anak si Esaw min si Ada, si Ruwil iya anakna min si Basemat.

verses.name: Genesis 36:5
verses.text: Saga anakna min si Oholebama, ya na si Jiyus, si Jalam maka si Kora. In itu kamemon bay nianakan ma si Esaw ma lahat Kana'an.  <div eID="gen635" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv389"/><div sID="gen636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv389"/> Manjari aniya' waktu pabutas na si Esaw min siyalina si Yakub, maglain ni lahat saddī. Tabeya' ma iya saga anak-h'ndana sampay saga tendogna kamemon. Tabowa isab kahayopanna sampay pangalta'na kamemon bay tausahana ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 36:7
verses.text: Ya angkan si Esaw pabutas min si Yakub, sabab aheka makalandu' ba'anan hayop ya suku' sigā karuwangan, mbal s'ddong ma tana' bay paglahatan sigā he'. Mbal na sigā makapagdakayu' lahat.

verses.name: Genesis 36:8
verses.text: Manjari si Esaw, hatina si Edom, pehē' na ni kabūd-būran lahat Se'er bo' maglahat mahē'.  <div eID="gen636" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv390"/><div sID="gen637" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv390"/> Ya na itu isab salsila panugsugan panubu' si Esaw, ya pang'mbo'an bangsa Edom, a'a kabūd-būran Se'er.

verses.name: Genesis 36:10
verses.text: Saga anak si Esaw l'lla: <lg sID="gen638"/> <l level="1" sID="gen639"/>Si Elepas ya anakna min h'ndana si Ada, si Ruwil ya anakna min h'ndana si Basemat.<l eID="gen639" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen638"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:11
verses.text: Saga anak si Elepas l'lla: <lg sID="gen640"/> <l level="1" sID="gen641"/>si Teman, si Omar, si Sepo, si Gatam maka si Kenas.<l eID="gen641" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen640"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:12
verses.text: Aniya' h'nda-h'nda isab si Elepas, ōnna si Timna, <lg sID="gen642"/> <l level="1" sID="gen643"/>ya bay anganakan l'lla, ōnna si Amalek. Ya du ina'an saga mpu si Esaw min h'ndana si Ada.<l eID="gen643" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen642"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:13
verses.text: Saga anak si Ruwil l'lla: <lg sID="gen644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen645"/>si Sera, si Samma maka si Missa. Ya du ina'an saga mpu si Esaw min h'ndana si Basemat.<l eID="gen645" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen644"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:14
verses.text: Aniya' gi' anak si Esaw l'lla min h'ndana si Oholebama anak si Ana, mpu isab si Sebeyon: <lg sID="gen646"/> <l level="1" sID="gen647"/>si Je'us, si Jalam maka si Kora.<l eID="gen647" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen646"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:15
verses.text: Itiya' na saga datu' bay patubu' min si Elepas anak si Esaw siyaka: <lg sID="gen648"/> <l level="1" sID="gen649"/>si Teman, si Omar, si Sepo, si Kenas,<l eID="gen649" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen648"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:16
verses.text: si Kora, si Gatam maka si Amalek. Si Ada h'nda si Esaw ya mbo' saga a'a magdaratu' itu ya bay panubu' si Esaw.

verses.name: Genesis 36:17
verses.text: Saga datu' isab bay patubu' min si Ruwil ya anak si Esaw dakayu': <lg sID="gen650"/> <l level="1" sID="gen651"/>si Nahat, si Sera, si Samma maka si Missa. Si Basemat h'nda si Esaw ya mbo' sigām.<l eID="gen651" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen650"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:18
verses.text: Saga anak si Esaw isab min h'ndana si Oholebama anak si Ana: <lg sID="gen652"/> <l level="1" sID="gen653"/>si Je'us, si Jalam maka si Kora, a'a magdaratu' kamemon.<l eID="gen653" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen652"/>  <div eID="gen637" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv391"/><div sID="gen654" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv391"/> Manjari ya du ina'an saga bangsa maka ba'anan datu' sigām ya bay patubu' min si Esaw (ya pinagōnan isab si Edom).  <div eID="gen654" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv392"/><div sID="gen655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv392"/> Na, in pasal saga bangsa porol ma lahat Edom, si Se'er bangsa Hōr ya pang'mbo'an sigām. Saga anak si Se'er ya tahinang datu', ya na si Lotan, si Sobal, si Sebeyon, si Ana, si Disun, si Eser maka si Disan.

verses.name: Genesis 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv392"/><div sID="gen655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv392"/> Na, in pasal saga bangsa porol ma lahat Edom, si Se'er bangsa Hōr ya pang'mbo'an sigām. Saga anak si Se'er ya tahinang datu', ya na si Lotan, si Sobal, si Sebeyon, si Ana, si Disun, si Eser maka si Disan.

verses.name: Genesis 36:22
verses.text: Saga anak si Lotan: <lg sID="gen656"/> <l level="1" sID="gen657"/>si Hore maka si Homan. Si Timna ya danakan si Lotan d'nda.<l eID="gen657" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen656"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:23
verses.text: Saga anak si Sobal: <lg sID="gen658"/> <l level="1" sID="gen659"/>si Alban, si Manahat, si Ebal, si Sepo maka si Onam.<l eID="gen659" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen658"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:24
verses.text: Saga anak si Sebeyon isab: <lg sID="gen660"/> <l level="1" sID="gen661"/>si Aya maka si Ana. Si Ana itu bay makabāk bohe' amukal-mukal ma lahat paslangan, hinabuna magipat saga kura' mma'na.<l eID="gen661" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen660"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:25
verses.text: Saga anak si Ana: <lg sID="gen662"/> <l level="1" sID="gen663"/>si Disun ya anakna l'lla, si Oholebama ya anakna d'nda.<l eID="gen663" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen662"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:26
verses.text: Saga anak si Disun: <lg sID="gen664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen665"/>si Hemdan, si Esban, si Itran maka si Keran.<l eID="gen665" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen664"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:27
verses.text: Saga anak si Eser anak si Se'er: <lg sID="gen666"/> <l level="1" sID="gen667"/>si Bilhan, si Sa'aban maka si Akan.<l eID="gen667" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen666"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:28
verses.text: Saga anak si Disan: <lg sID="gen668"/> <l level="1" sID="gen669"/>si Ūs maka si Aran.<l eID="gen669" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen668"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:29
verses.text: Itiya' na isab ōn saga a'a pagdatu'an kabangsa-bangsahan Hōr ya bay maglahat ma lahat Se'er: <lg sID="gen670"/> <l sID="gen671"/>si Lotan, si Sobal, si Sebeyon, si Ana, si Disun, si Eser maka<l eID="gen671"/> <l sID="gen672"/>si Disan.<l eID="gen672"/> <lg eID="gen670"/>  <div eID="gen655" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen634" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:30
verses.text: Itiya' na isab ōn saga a'a pagdatu'an kabangsa-bangsahan Hōr ya bay maglahat ma lahat Se'er: <lg sID="gen670"/> <l sID="gen671"/>si Lotan, si Sobal, si Sebeyon, si Ana, si Disun, si Eser maka<l eID="gen671"/> <l sID="gen672"/>si Disan.<l eID="gen672"/> <lg eID="gen670"/>  <div eID="gen655" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen634" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv393"/><div sID="gen673" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Sultan ma Lahat Edom</title> <div sID="gen674" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv393"/> Na, ya na itu saga a'a magsusultan ma lahat Edom masa halam gi' aniya' sultan ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Genesis 36:32
verses.text: Si Bela anak si Beyor tahinang sultan ma bangsa Edom. Dinhaba ya ōn da'ira pagsultananna.  <div eID="gen674" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv394"/><div sID="gen675" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv394"/> Amatay pa'in si Bela, si Johab anak si Sera' ya pas'lle' aningkō' magsultan. A'a iya min lahat Bosla.  <div eID="gen675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv395"/><div sID="gen676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv395"/> Amatay pa'in si Johab, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Husam a'a min jadjahan bangsa Teman.  <div eID="gen676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv396"/><div sID="gen677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv396"/> Amatay pa'in si Husam, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Hadad anak si Bedad. Abit iya ōn da'ira pagsultananna. Si Hadad itu bay makara'ug ma bangsa Midiyan ma deyom lahat Mowab.  <div eID="gen677" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv397"/><div sID="gen678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv397"/> Amatay pa'in si Hadad, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Samla min lahat Masleka.  <div eID="gen678" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv398"/><div sID="gen679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv398"/> Pagmatay si Samla, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Sa'ul, a'a min lahat Rehobot ma bihing sapa' aheya.  <div eID="gen679" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv399"/><div sID="gen680" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv399"/> Na, amatay pa'in si Sa'ul, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Ba'al-Hanan anak si Akbor.  <div eID="gen680" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv400"/><div sID="gen681" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv400"/> Amatay pa'in si Ba'al-Hanan anak si Akbor, ya pas'lle' magsultan si Hadad. Pau ya ōn da'ira pagsultananna. Si Mehetabel anak si Matered, mpu si Mesahab, ya h'nda si Ba'al-Hanan itu.  <div eID="gen681" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv401"/><div sID="gen682" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv401"/> Itiya' na isab ōn saga datu' bay patubu' min si Esaw, kaniya-kaniya sigām magsaddī-saddī lahat maka bangsa: si Timna, si Alba, si Jetet,

verses.name: Genesis 36:41
verses.text: si Oholebama, si Ela, si Pinun,

verses.name: Genesis 36:42
verses.text: si Kenas, si Teman, si Mibsar,

verses.name: Genesis 36:43
verses.text: si Magde'el maka katapusan si Iram. Saga panubu' si Esaw itu kamemon bay datu' ma lahat Edom kaniya-kaniya ma paglahatan sigām. <div eID="gen682" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen683" type="paragraph"/> Na, ya na ina'an salsila pasal paltubu'anan si Esaw, ya po'onan bangsa Edom.  <div eID="gen683" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.36"/> <div eID="gen673" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv402"/><div sID="gen684" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup maka Panguppina</title> <div sID="gen685" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv402"/> Ya na itu salsila pasal si Yakub maka anak-mpuna. Maglahat asal iya ma Kana'an, ya lahat bay paghanti'an mma'na si Isa'ak. <div eID="gen685" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen686" type="paragraph"/> Manjari itu, ya anakna si Yusup wa'i angipat saga hayop sigām, beya' isab saga danakanna l'lla min saddī ina', min si Bilha maka si Silpa. Sangpū' maka pituntahun umul si Yusup ma waktu ina'an-i. Jari sinumbung e' si Yusup saga danakanna itu ni mma' sigām. Aniya' kono' hinang sigām mbal taluwa'.  <div eID="gen686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv402"/><div sID="gen684" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup maka Panguppina</title> <div sID="gen685" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv402"/> Ya na itu salsila pasal si Yakub maka anak-mpuna. Maglahat asal iya ma Kana'an, ya lahat bay paghanti'an mma'na si Isa'ak. <div eID="gen685" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen686" type="paragraph"/> Manjari itu, ya anakna si Yusup wa'i angipat saga hayop sigām, beya' isab saga danakanna l'lla min saddī ina', min si Bilha maka si Silpa. Sangpū' maka pituntahun umul si Yusup ma waktu ina'an-i. Jari sinumbung e' si Yusup saga danakanna itu ni mma' sigām. Aniya' kono' hinang sigām mbal taluwa'.  <div eID="gen686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv403"/><div sID="gen687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv403"/> Na, aheya lasa si Yakub ma si Yusup. Salasa-lasa iya ma anakna kasehe', alasa gi' ma si Yusup sabab anak ma kato'ana. Jari pinatahi'an e'na si Yusup juba alingkat.

verses.name: Genesis 37:4
verses.text: Kinata'uwan pa'in e' saga dauranakan kaheya lasa si Yakub ma si Yusup, labi-labi min lasana ma sigām kasehe'an, magtūy sigām ab'nsi ma iya. Mbal na sigām amissala sangkahāpan ma iya.  <div eID="gen687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:5
