verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv404"/><div sID="gen688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv404"/> Manjari itu, aniya' waktu anguppi si Yusup. Kahaka'an pa'in dauranakanna pasal uppina, gom pa'in ab'nsi sigām ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 37:6
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Ā, kalehunbi bay tauppiku.

verses.name: Genesis 37:7
verses.text: In kitam kamemon bay ma huma magp'kkos pai, manjari ya p'kkosan pai bay ma aku magtūy an'ngge pabontol. Ya du saga p'kkosan pai bay ma ka'am, an'ngge isab bo' patilibut ni p'kkosanku ati pasujud.”  <div eID="gen688" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv405"/><div sID="gen689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv405"/> Sinambungan si Yusup e' danakanna, yuk sigām, “Ē! Ka'a ilu magsultan bahā' ma kami? Pagbaya'annu kami?” Pasōng gom pa'in kab'nsi sigām ma iya ma sabab uppina maka suli-sulina he'.  <div eID="gen689" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv406"/><div sID="gen690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv406"/> Pinauppihan na isab si Yusup pabalik ati suli-sulihanna isab saga danakanna. Yukna ma sigām, “Kalehunbi pasal uppiku dakayu' itu. Tauppiku llaw maka bulan sampay saga bitu'un sangpū' maka ssa hekana pasujud ni aku.”  <div eID="gen690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv407"/><div sID="gen691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv407"/> Anuli-nuli isab si Yusup ma mma'na pasal uppina itu. Magtūy iya pinah'llingan e' mma'na, yuk-i, “Oy! Uppi ai ilu? Pikilnu bahā' in aku maka ina'nu sampay saga danakannu subay pasujud ni ka'a?”

verses.name: Genesis 37:11
verses.text: Manjari akagit atay saga danakan si Yusup ma iya. Sagō' kinannal e' mma'na palkala' inān.  <div eID="gen691" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen684" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv408"/><div sID="gen692" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinab'llihan si Yusup bo' Binowa ni Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen693" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv408"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw, pagka maina'an saga danakan si Yusup ma lahat Sekem angipat ba'anan kahayopan ya suku' mma' sigām,

verses.name: Genesis 37:13
verses.text: aniya' panoho'an si Isra'il (hatina si Yakub) ma si Yusup. Yukna, “Otō', kata'uwannu asal, ina'an saga danakannu ma Sekem angipat hayop. Bilahi aku anoho' ka'a pehē'.” <div eID="gen693" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen694" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Aho', Mma', pehē' aku.”  <div eID="gen694" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv409"/><div sID="gen695" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv409"/> Yuk mma'na isab, “Na, pehē' na ka. Tibawun danakannu inān bang ahāp du kahālan sigām maka saga hayopta bo' ka amole' isab pi'itu angahaka'an aku.” Jari pinatulak iya min kapantayan Hebron tudju ni lahat Sekem. <div eID="gen695" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen696" type="paragraph"/> Pagt'kkana ni Sekem,

verses.name: Genesis 37:15
verses.text: hinabuna amiha saga danakanna ma kaparang-parangan, aniya' a'a makalanggal ma iya. Yukna, “Otō', ai pihanu ilu?”  <div eID="gen696" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv410"/><div sID="gen697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv410"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Ya pihaku, tuwan, saga danakanku. Maitu kono' sigām angipat kahayopan kami. Kata'uwannu bahā' tuwan bang maingga sigām?”  <div eID="gen697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv411"/><div sID="gen698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv411"/> Yuk a'a inān, “Ā, halam na sigām maitu. Takaleku sigām magsuli-suli, ni lahat Dotan kono'.” <div eID="gen698" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen699" type="paragraph"/> Manjari paturul si Yusup ni saga danakanna sampay ta'abutna sigām ma tongod Dotan.

verses.name: Genesis 37:18
verses.text: Na, alawak-lawak gi' si Yusup, ta'nda' iya he' saga danakanna. Magtūy iya pinagisunan pinapatay e' sigām.  <div eID="gen699" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv412"/><div sID="gen700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv412"/> Yuk sigām dansehe'an, “O'o, nda'unbi. Ilu na si Pangunguppi.

verses.name: Genesis 37:20
verses.text: Sūng, bono'ta iya ati timananta baranna ni deyom lowang bay pagtau'an bohe' itu. Ya pangahakata ma pasalna in iya bay pinapatay maka kinakan e' sattuwa talun. Nda'ta minnē' bang ai kapūsan uppina.”  <div eID="gen700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv413"/><div sID="gen701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv413"/> Na, pagkale pagisun itu e' siyaka sigām si Rubin, magtūy iya amikil bang buwattingga e'na anabang si Yusup bo' mbal kinala'atan e' saga danakanna. Yukna ma sigām, “Ndū', da'a iya papatayhunbi.

verses.name: Genesis 37:22
verses.text: Hūgta sadja iya ni lowang itu. Halam aniya' a'a maglahat maitu. Saguwā' da'a iya inay-inayunbi.” Angkan buwattē' lling si Rubin sabab magmaksud iya angā' si Yusup pabalik bo' pinapole' ni mma'na.  <div eID="gen701" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv414"/><div sID="gen702" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv414"/> Ahā, pagt'kka si Yusup pehē' ni saga danakanna, magtūy iya sinaggaw e' sigām bo' niurusan jubana alingkat e'.

verses.name: Genesis 37:24
verses.text: Puwas e', binowa iya nihūg ni deyom lowang halam bohe'na sabab atigang na.  <div eID="gen702" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv415"/><div sID="gen703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv415"/> Sakali itu, hinabu saga danakan si Yusup aningkō' amangan, na, aniya' ta'nda' e' sigām saga a'a bangsa Isma'il. Ina'an sigām magturul-turul min lahat Giliyad tudju ni lahat Misil. Aniya' isab dagangan paruwa' ma saga unta' sigām, saga ginisan bulitik pahamut maka ginisan pamapā.  <div eID="gen703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv416"/><div sID="gen704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv416"/> Ah'lling magtūy dakayu' danakan sigām ōnna si Yahud, “Ai untungna bang bono'ta siyalita itu bo' limbunganta kamatayna?

verses.name: Genesis 37:27
verses.text: Gom lagi' iya pab'llihanta ni saga a'a Isma'il itu. Da'a sadja iya mulata sabab danakanta du iya, dalaha' maka kitam.” Manjari kasulutan saga danakan si Yahud ma llingna he'.  <div eID="gen704" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv417"/><div sID="gen705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv417"/> Manjari itu, makasekot pa'in saga a'a magdaragang e',<note>A'a magdaragang: bangsa Isma'il min lahat Midiyan.</note> nihella' si Yusup paluwas min deyom lowang bo' yampa pinab'llihan ma saga bangsa Isma'il e'. Ya b'llihanna duwampū' pilak tibu'uk.<note>Ya duwampū' pilak tibu'uk itu, ya na halga' ata l'lla bang pinab'llihan ma masa ina'an. Ya timbang pilak e' labi-labi 200 gram.</note> Pagb'lli pa'in, tabowa iya pehē' ni lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv418"/><div sID="gen706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv418"/> Na, pabalik si Rubin ni lowang bay pangahūgan si Yusup arak angā' iya. Pagdomolna halam maina'an si Yusup, agsai gineret e'na badju'na tanda' sin pagdukkana.

verses.name: Genesis 37:30
verses.text: Pabīng iya magdai'-dai' ni tongod saga danakanna bo' yukna, “Arōy! Halam maina'an si Yusup! Daka painay hinangku!”  <div eID="gen706" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv419"/><div sID="gen707" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv419"/> Jari, anumbali' sigām kambing ati niledje juba si Yusup maka laha'na.

verses.name: Genesis 37:32
verses.text: Binowa juba inān amole' bo' pina'nda'an ni mma' sigām. Ya yuk sigām, “Ndū' Mma', nda'un ba bay tabāk kami. Juba si Yusup bahā'?”  <div eID="gen707" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv420"/><div sID="gen708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv420"/> Takilā magtūy e' si Yakub. “Aho',” yukna. “Ma si Yusup ko' ilu! Kilāku aniya' sattuwa talun bay angā' iya anagpe' baranna. Arōy! Anakku si Yusup!”  <div eID="gen708" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv421"/><div sID="gen709" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv421"/> Magtūy gineret e' si Yakub badju' ma baranna bo' yampa magbinadju' karut,<note>Karut: Ya addat saga bangsa Hibrani bang magkarukka'an subay magsin'mmek akasap buwat saga karut.</note> tanda' ma pagkarukka'anna. Jari at'ggol to'ongan pagdukka si Yakub ma anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 37:35
verses.text: Pina'an ni iya saga anakna d'nda-l'lla bahasa amauli' karukka'anna, saguwā' mbal iya, subay pasangdan magdukka. Angabtang iya, yukna, “Mbal ala'an pagdukkaku ma anakku sampay aku amole' ni ahirat.” Manjari kasangdanan si Yakub magdukka ma anakna si Yusup.  <div eID="gen709" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv422"/><div sID="gen710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv422"/> Pasalta', si Yusup bay binowa ni lahat Misil e' saga magdaragang.<note>Hatina a'a min lahat Midiyan.</note> Ma Misil pa'in, pinab'llihan iya ni dakayu' kapitan pangandolan Pira'un,<note>Ya kabtangan Pira'un itu bahasa Misil pangangg'llal ma sasuku pinatingkō' magsultan ma kaluha'an lahat Misil ma masa he'-i. Ngga'i ka ōn pangōn ma sultan dangan sadja.</note> ōnna si Putipar. Pagnakura'an iya ma saga jaga ma deyom astana' Pira'un.  <div eID="gen710" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.37"/> <div eID="gen692" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv423"/><div sID="gen711" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yahud maka si Tamar</title> <div sID="gen712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv423"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an pabutas na si Yahud min saga danakanna bo' pehē' ni da'ira Adullam pat'nna' ma luma' si Hira.

verses.name: Genesis 38:2
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in si Yahud, makapagkilā iya maka budjang, anak si Suwa bangsa Kana'an. Jari tahinangna h'nda.

verses.name: Genesis 38:3
verses.text: Anganak iya l'lla ati si Ēr ya pangōn si Yahud ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 38:4
verses.text: Angiram h'ndana pabīng bo' anganak isab l'lla. Onan ya pangōnna ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 38:5
verses.text: Ma lahat Keseb pa'in, anganak gi' iya pabīng, l'lla isab. Sela ya pangōnna ma iya.  <div eID="gen712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv424"/><div sID="gen713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv424"/> Na palabay pa'in daka pilantahun, si Yahud bay amah'nda'an anakna siyaka, ya si Ēr, ma si Tamar.

verses.name: Genesis 38:7
verses.text: Sagō' lumandu'an ala'at kajarihan si Ēr ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, angkan iya magtūy minomos.  <div eID="gen713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv425"/><div sID="gen714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv425"/> Manjari ah'lling si Yahud ma si Onan ya anakna pasunu'. “Otō',” yukna, “ipalnu si Tamar abalu na. Subay ka magpūn maka iya supaya aniya' tubu' siyakanu. Ya na addat bang aniya' amatay ma halam aniya' anakna.”

verses.name: Genesis 38:9
verses.text: Sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' si Onan bang si Tamar ganta' ab'ttong e'na bo' anganak, in anak inān mbal taitung anakna. Taitung anak siyakana. Angkanna si Onan itu, sakahaba' iya magbihing maka si Tamar, mbal tino'ongan e'na supaya halam aniya' tubu' ma siyakana ya bay amatay he'.

verses.name: Genesis 38:10
verses.text: Ala'at isab hinang si Onan inān ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angkan amatay isab iya.  <div eID="gen714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv426"/><div sID="gen715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv426"/> Na, aniya' lling si Yahud ma ayuwanna si Tamar, yukna, “Amole' na ka ni okoman mma'nu. Da'a ka magh'lla saddī, lagarin gi' anakku si Sela. Subay na iya asangpot bo' kam magpūn.” Angkan buwattē' lling si Yahud sabab ahalli' iya ma si Sela. Kalu iya amatay buwat duwangan siyakana he'. Jari amole' na si Tamar ni matto'ana.  <div eID="gen715" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv427"/><div sID="gen716" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv427"/> At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, amatay isab anak si Suwa ya h'nda si Yahud. Ataptap pa'in pangatayan si Yahud itu min bay kamatay h'ndana, magbeya' iya maka bagayna si Hira a'a Adullam. Amaklay sigām karuwangan pehē' ni lahat Timna, ni lugal pagguntingan bulbul saga bili-bili si Yahud.  <div eID="gen716" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv428"/><div sID="gen717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv428"/> Manjari aniya' makahaka ma si Tamar in mato'ana song at'kka ni Timna angangguntingan saga bili-bilina.

verses.name: Genesis 38:14
verses.text: Na pagta'u si Tamar, magtūy iya analinan s'mmekna balu. Tinambunan isab baihu'na maka sulban bo' mbal takilā, ati aningkō' iya ma tongod pagsosōran ni deyom kauman Inaim, ya ma bihing kalsara tudju ni Timna. Kinata'uwan asal e' si Tamar in si Sela asangpot na, sagō' halam gi' tapamah'lla ma iya.  <div eID="gen717" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv429"/><div sID="gen718" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv429"/> Na, ta'nda' e' si Yahud si Tamar e' sagō' halam takilāna. Pangannalna d'nda pinagtatambahan sabab magtambun baihu'na.

verses.name: Genesis 38:16
verses.text: Manjari itu, pagka halam kinata'uwan e' si Yahud in d'nda inān ayuwanna, pina'an si Yahud ni tongodna ma bihing lān. Yukna ma iya, “Bilahi ka ameya' ma aku?” <div eID="gen718" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen719" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Tamar, “Ai panambanu aku?”  <div eID="gen719" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv430"/><div sID="gen720" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv430"/> Ya sambung si Yahud, “Pabeya'anta ka dakayu' anak kambing min ba'anan kambingku.” <div eID="gen720" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen721" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Tamar, “makajari. Sagō' subay aniya' sanda' pang'bbanu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen721" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv431"/><div sID="gen722" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv431"/> Atilaw si Yahud, “Ai pang'bbaku?” <div eID="gen722" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen723" type="paragraph"/> Yuk d'nda, “Ā, engkot k'llongnu ilu maka tungkudnu.” Na sinōngan magtūy e' si Yahud ati magbihing na sigā maka angiram iya.

verses.name: Genesis 38:19
verses.text: Puwas e' amole' na si Tamar bo' yampa nila'anan sulban bay panambun baihu'na ati magsin'mmek iya balu pabīng.  <div eID="gen723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv432"/><div sID="gen724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv432"/> Na, si Yahud itu bay amabeya' kambing ma bagayna si Hira. Sinō' e'na angā' ai-ai bay pang'bbana ma d'nda he', sagō' halam tabāk e'na.

verses.name: Genesis 38:21
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga a'a Inaim bay tinilaw e' si Hira bang maingga d'nda pinagtatambahan ya bay ma bihing lān. <div eID="gen724" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen725" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung saga l'lla he', “Tuwan, bay min katagna' lagi' halam aniya' d'nda pinagtambahan maitu.”  <div eID="gen725" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv433"/><div sID="gen726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv433"/> Pabalik si Hira pehē' ni si Yahud angahaka'an iya. Yukna, “Tuwan, halam tabākku. Yuk isab saga l'lla maina'an halam kono' aniya' d'nda pinagtambahan maina'an min katagna'.”  <div eID="gen726" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv434"/><div sID="gen727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv434"/> “Na,” yuk si Yahud, “ya niyatku subay anambahan iya dakayu' anak kambing, sagō' halam ya tabāknu. Ma iya na ai-ai bay pang'bbaku. Pasagarin na bo' kita mbal pagtunggīngan e' a'a.”  <div eID="gen727" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv435"/><div sID="gen728" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv435"/> Sakali itu, palabay pa'in saga t'llumbulan, aniya' a'a makahaka ma si Yahud, yukna, “Ayuwannu si Tamar ala'at kajarihanna magusaha'an baranna, maka ab'ttong na iya.” <div eID="gen728" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen729" type="paragraph"/> Magpanoho'an si Yahud, yukna, “Bowahunbi iya paluwas min kauman itu. Tunu'unbi bo' amatay.”  <div eID="gen729" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv436"/><div sID="gen730" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv436"/> Hinabu si Tamar binowa paluwas bahasa tinunu', bay iya amabeya' lapal ni mato'ana. Yuk lapalna, “Ab'ttong aku e' a'a ya tag-dapu engkot k'llong maka tungkud itu. Nda'un pahāp, kalu takilānu.”  <div eID="gen730" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv437"/><div sID="gen731" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv437"/> Takilā magtūy e' si Yahud. Yukna, “Abontol iya labi-labi min aku. Tinaikutan e'ku addattam pagka halam bay pamah'llaku ma iya anakku si Sela.” Jari puwas minnē' halam iya bay makasekot pabalik ni ayuwanna si Tamar e'.  <div eID="gen731" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv438"/><div sID="gen732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv438"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in bulan panganak si Tamar, k'mbal l'lla ya nianakan e'na.

verses.name: Genesis 38:28
verses.text: Ang'ddon pa'in iya, amaluwas tanganna k'mbal dakayu'. Magtūy niengkotan e' panday maka salban keyat. “Ya itu,” yukna, “k'mbal siyaka.”

verses.name: Genesis 38:29
verses.text: Sagō' sinuhutan tanganna. Jari ya k'mbal pasunu' paluwas dahū. Yuk panday isab, “Mamarahi pahāp ka'a ilu pa'agaw paluwas dahū!” Jari si Peres<note>Ya ōn Peres itu, hatina ‘angagaw paluwas.’</note> ya pangōn onde'-onde' dahū paluwas e'.

verses.name: Genesis 38:30
verses.text: Puwas e', paluwas na k'mbal ya taga-salban keyat ma tanganna, l'lla du isab, ati niōnan iya si Sera.<note>Ya ōn Sera' itu, hatina ‘b'ttik keyat.’</note>  <div eID="gen732" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.38"/> <div eID="gen711" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv439"/><div sID="gen733" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup maka H'nda si Putipar</title> <div sID="gen734" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv439"/> Na, in si Yusup bay na tabowa ni lahat Misil e' saga a'a bangsa Isma'il. Pinab'llihan iya e' sigām ni si Putipar, ya pagnakura'an saga jaga ma deyom astana' Pira'un.  <div eID="gen734" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv440"/><div sID="gen735" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv440"/> Manjari itu, ahāp sadja kat'kkahan ai-ai nihinang e' si Yusup hinabuna pat'nna' ma luma' nakura'na si Putipar a'a Misil. Tu'ud iya tinabang na pa'in e' si Yawe.

verses.name: Genesis 39:3
verses.text: Ta'nda' isab e' si Putipar in si Yusup tinabang asal e' si Yawe, maka ahāp kasōngan hinangna kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 39:4
verses.text: Manjari kasulutan si Putipar ma si Yusup ati tahinang iya pangandolanna. Binuwanan iya kapatut magnakura' ma a'ana kamemon sampay ma pangalta'na kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 39:5
verses.text: Na, tinagna'an min waktu ina'an-i, si Putipar a'a Misil bay nilidjiki'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sabab si Yusup. Paheka na pa'in palsuku'anna, ai na ka ma deyom luma', ai na ka ma humana maka ma kabbunna.

verses.name: Genesis 39:6
verses.text: Angandol to'ongan si Putipar ma si Yusup, angkan pangandolna ma iya pangalta'na kamemon. Halam aniya' pagsusahan si Putipar, luwal pagkakanna. <div eID="gen735" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen736" type="paragraph"/> Na, si Yusup itu dakayu' l'lla ahāp luwana maka pamarananna.

verses.name: Genesis 39:7
verses.text: Sakali itu, mbal isab at'ggol, kinabilahian iya e' h'nda si Putipar. Yukna ma si Yusup, “Pi'itu ka ni deyom bilik, maghulid kita.”  <div eID="gen736" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv441"/><div sID="gen737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv441"/> Sagō' mbal si Yusup. Ya llingna ma d'nda he', “Oy, aku itu pangandolan e' nakura'ku, ya na h'llanu. Mbal pamagayna ai-ai pangalta'na ma deyom luma' itu pagka pangandolna ma aku.

verses.name: Genesis 39:9
verses.text: Bang binista, in kapatutku daheya du maka kapatutna ma deyom luma' itu. Pagdūl-baya'anku kamemon, luwal du ka'a sabab h'ndana ka. Angkan aku mbal makahinang la'at ya yuknu ilu, sabab dusa ko' ilu ni Tuhan!”

verses.name: Genesis 39:10
verses.text: Na minsan buwattē' lling si Yusup, masi-masi du iya nilogos e' h'nda si Putipar, saguwā' mbal to'ongan iya ameya' maghulid maka iya. Mbal minsan pasekot ni tongodna.  <div eID="gen737" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv442"/><div sID="gen738" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv442"/> Sakali aniya' dakayu' llaw, makasōd pa'in si Yusup ni deyom luma' maghinang ai-ai kabiyaksahanna, halam aniya' sosoho'an saddī ma deyom luma'.

verses.name: Genesis 39:12
verses.text: Pagsōdna, magtūy iya tahella' ma tōng badju'na e' h'nda si Putipar. Yukna ma iya, “Dai' na ka. Maghulid kita.” Daipara makakawas si Yusup min balutanna maka e'na alahi paluwas. Ka'bbahan badju'na ma tangan d'nda.  <div eID="gen738" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv443"/><div sID="gen739" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv443"/> Na, pag'nda' h'nda si Putipar ma si Yusup paragan paluwas, maka badju' bay ka'bbahan e'na,

verses.name: Genesis 39:14
verses.text: magtūy lingananna saga sosoho'anna. “Nda'unbi,” yukna, “a'a Hibrani bay pinapi'itu e' h'llaku angahina' kitam. Bay iya anōd bilikku, arak aku niusiba'an e'na, manda' aku angolang saru'un-du'un.

verses.name: Genesis 39:15
verses.text: Na, pagolangku itu,” yukna, “alahi iya paluwas magdai'-dai'. O'o, badju'na bay bbahanna ma bilikku.”  <div eID="gen739" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv444"/><div sID="gen740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv444"/> Manjari d'nda inān bay ang'nna' badju' si Yusup ma bihingna sampay at'kka h'llana.

verses.name: Genesis 39:17
verses.text: Na, at'kka pa'in si Putipar magtūy iya sinuli-sulihan e' h'ndana. Yukna, “O, ya atanu Hibrani bay bowanu pi'itu, bay makasōd ni deyom bilikku insini' amuwanan aku kaiya'an.

verses.name: Genesis 39:18
verses.text: Daipara angolang aku saru'un-du'un. Pagolangku, magtūy iya alahi magdai'-dai' paluwas. Sagō' ta'bba badju'na ma bihingku.”  <div eID="gen740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv445"/><div sID="gen741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv445"/> Na, pagkale pa'in si Putipar ma sumbungan h'ndana pasal bay tahinang kono' e' atana he', magtūy akagit sidda atayna,

verses.name: Genesis 39:20
verses.text: ati soho'na si Yusup sinaggaw bo' pinakalabusu ma deyom luma' pagkumbisan saga pilisu bay makalanggal sara' Pira'un. <div eID="gen741" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen742" type="paragraph"/> Kasangdanan si Yusup ma deyom kalabusu,

verses.name: Genesis 39:21
verses.text: malaingkan halam bay pinasagaran e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Taptap iya pinat'kkahan lasa maka ase', ya angkan iya makasulut atay nakura' kalabusu inān.

verses.name: Genesis 39:22
verses.text: Si Yusup kabuwanan e'na kapatut magbaya' ma saga pilisu kasehe'an, maka pangandolna isab ma iya kahinangan ai-ai maina'an ma kalabusu.

verses.name: Genesis 39:23
verses.text: Manjari itu, pagka si Yusup ya a'a pangandolan ma deyom kalabusu, halam aniya' pagsusahan nakura' inān sabab aheya tabang <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Yusup. Ai-ai hinangna ahāp sadja kasōnganna.  <div eID="gen742" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.39"/> <div eID="gen733" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv446"/><div sID="gen743" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup Angama'anahan<note>Angama'ana: atawa ‘amahati’ bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> Uppi</title> <div sID="gen744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv446"/> Na at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, aniya' duwa sosoho'an Pira'un makarusa ma iya. Dakayu' itu bay pagnakura'an saga a'a magbubuhat inumanna, maka dakayu' ya pagnakura'an saga a'a maghinang tinapayna. Angastol Pira'un ma sigām karuwangan itu,

verses.name: Genesis 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv446"/><div sID="gen743" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup Angama'anahan<note>Angama'ana: atawa ‘amahati’ bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> Uppi</title> <div sID="gen744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv446"/> Na at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, aniya' duwa sosoho'an Pira'un makarusa ma iya. Dakayu' itu bay pagnakura'an saga a'a magbubuhat inumanna, maka dakayu' ya pagnakura'an saga a'a maghinang tinapayna. Angastol Pira'un ma sigām karuwangan itu,

verses.name: Genesis 40:3
verses.text: ati pinakalabusu sigām ma deyom luma' kapitan saga jaga, hatina luma' pangumbisan si Yusup.

verses.name: Genesis 40:4
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in sigām, aniya' hinang pamat'nna' kapitan jaga ma si Yusup. Sinō' iya anabangan a'a duwangan-i ma ai-ai kagunahan sigām. <div eID="gen744" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen745" type="paragraph"/> Na, at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in sigām ma deyom kalabusu, ma dasangom du,

verses.name: Genesis 40:5
verses.text: aniya' tauppi e' duwangan pilisu itu, ya bay pagnakura'an ma deyom astana' Pira'un. Magsaddī uppi sigām dangan maka dangan, maka saddī isab ma'anana.  <div eID="gen745" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv447"/><div sID="gen746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv447"/> Pagsubu, pasekot si Yusup ni duwangan sosoho'an Pira'un ya sehe'na ma deyom kalabusu itu. Ta'nda'na magtūy aniya' pagsusahan sigām angkan tilawna. “Asusa pahāp pamaihu'anbi ilu. Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv447"/><div sID="gen746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv447"/> Pagsubu, pasekot si Yusup ni duwangan sosoho'an Pira'un ya sehe'na ma deyom kalabusu itu. Ta'nda'na magtūy aniya' pagsusahan sigām angkan tilawna. “Asusa pahāp pamaihu'anbi ilu. Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv448"/><div sID="gen747" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv448"/> Ya sambung sigām karuwangan, “Aniya' uppi kami dibuhi', sagō' halam aniya' maitu ata'u angama'anahan iya.” <div eID="gen747" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen748" type="paragraph"/> “Ā,” yuk si Yusup, “dakayu'-kayu' du Tuhan makabuwan pangita'u magma'ana. Haka'in aku kono' ya bay tauppibi ilu.”  <div eID="gen748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv449"/><div sID="gen749" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv449"/> Manjari ah'lling a'a dangan ya pagnakura'an saga a'a magbubuhat inuman Pira'un, yukna, “Ya ta'nda'ku ma deyom uppiku dampo'on bahan anggul

verses.name: Genesis 40:10
verses.text: t'llu sangana. Paguplutna, magtūy anumping. Pagsumping itu, magtūy patahak buwa'na.

verses.name: Genesis 40:11
verses.text: Na, ina'an asal sawan pagi'inuman Pira'un ma tanganku, jari k'ttu'ku buwa' anggul e' bo' yampa p'gga'ku ni deyom sawan. Puwas e', bay sōnganku bohe'na pehē' ni Pira'un. Na, halam na.”  <div eID="gen749" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv450"/><div sID="gen750" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv450"/> Yuk si Yusup, “Ya na itu ma'ana uppinu ilu. Ya t'llu sanga ilu, hatina t'llung'llaw.

verses.name: Genesis 40:13
verses.text: T'llung'llaw gi' minnitu in ka'a pinaluwas du e' Pira'un min deyom kalabusu. Pinabīng du ka ni bay hinangnu dahū magbubuhat inumanna.

verses.name: Genesis 40:14
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' pangamu'ku ma ka'a,” yuk si Yusup. “Bang ka ma deyom kasannangan na, ndū', entomun pa'in aku sangkahāpan. Sabbutun kahālanku ma munda'an Pira'un supaya aku makaluwas min deyom kalabusu itu.

verses.name: Genesis 40:15
verses.text: Sabab ya b'nnalna, in aku itu bay tasaggaw min lahatku porol, ya lahat bangsa kami Hibrani. Damikiyanna isab maitu ma lahat Misil, takalabusu aku ma halam aniya' sababna.”  <div eID="gen750" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv451"/><div sID="gen751" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv451"/> Na, takale pa'in kahāp ma'ana itu e' nakura' dakayu' ya maghihinang tinapay Pira'un, magtūy iya amaluwas uppina ma si Yusup. Yukna, “Ya du aku taga-uppi dibuhi'. Ma deyom uppiku in aku baranku bay angandurung t'llu ligu magbangkat-bangkat.

verses.name: Genesis 40:17
verses.text: Aniya' ginisan tinapay maka bāng-bāng ma ligu diyata', arak pangalabot Pira'un, sagō' pinagtittuk e' saga manuk-manuk. Na, ya du ilu uppiku.”  <div eID="gen751" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv452"/><div sID="gen752" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv452"/> Manjari ah'lling si Yusup ma nakura' maghihinang tinapay, “Ya ma'ana uppinu ilu,” yukna “buwattitu. Ya t'llu ligu sapantun t'llung'llaw.

verses.name: Genesis 40:19
verses.text: Jari t'llung'llaw minnitu in ka'a-i pinaluwas du e' Pira'un min deyom kalabusu bo' yampa paponggolanna kōknu. Pagpuwas, pinasagnat bangkaynu ma diyata' hāg bo' pinagtittuk isina e' saga manuk-manuk.”  <div eID="gen752" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv453"/><div sID="gen753" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv453"/> Na, t'llung'llaw pa'in damuli minnē', ta'abut na llaw pagmahaltabat kapaganak ma Pira'un. Pinagjamuhan e'na kamemon saga tendogna ya pagnakura'an, maka soho'na pinaluwas min kalabusu ya nakura' magbubuhat inumanna inān sampay nakura' maghihinang tinapayna. Pinatampal sigā ni matahan ba'anan nakura' inān.

verses.name: Genesis 40:21
verses.text: Ya nakura' magbubuhat inuman pinabalik e' Pira'un ni bay hinangna.

verses.name: Genesis 40:22
verses.text: Saguwā' in nakura' maghihinang tinapay inān sinō' pinasagnat bangkayna ni hāg. Jari taluwa' bay pagma'ana si Yusup ma pasal panguppi duwangan itu.  <div eID="gen753" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv454"/><div sID="gen754" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv454"/> Malaingkan halam taentom e' nakura' magbubuhat inuman ya bay tambuku si Yusup ma iya. Takalipatna na.  <div eID="gen754" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.40"/> <div eID="gen743" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv455"/><div sID="gen755" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup Angama'anahan Uppi Pira'un</title> <div sID="gen756" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv455"/> Na, aniya' saga duwantahun palabay, anguppi isab Pira'un. Ma deyom uppina, ina'an iya an'ngge-n'ngge ma bihing sapa' Nīl.

verses.name: Genesis 41:2
verses.text: Jari aniya' pitu' sapi' al'mmok maka alanu' patukad min deyom sapa' e' bo' amangan ma kaparangan.

verses.name: Genesis 41:3
verses.text: Pagpuwas, aniya' pitu' sapi' saddī patukad min sapa', angagkag lullun maka ahigtal. Jari pasekot saga sapi' damuli itu ni sapi' al'mmok ya ma bihing sapa' e'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:4
verses.text: Ahā, saga sapi' al'mmok kinakan magtūy e' saga sapi' angagkag. Na, makabati' na Pira'un min uppina.  <div eID="gen756" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv456"/><div sID="gen757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv456"/> Pagtulina pabīng, anguppi na isab iya. Ya tauppina pitumbatang pai ahāp isina maka asambu, patomo' asal min dampo'on.

verses.name: Genesis 41:6
verses.text: Mbal at'ggol, aniya' isab pitumbatang pai saddī patomo' min po'onna. Ak'ppes isi paina maka alūs e' baliyu apasu'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:7
verses.text: Manjari tin'llon magtūy e' pai ak'ppes in pai asambu inān. Na, pagbati' pa'in Pira'un e', tasayuna in iya bay anguppi.  <div eID="gen757" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv457"/><div sID="gen758" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv457"/> Pagsubu, aheya kasusahanna angkan palingananna saga a'a ilmu'an maka kamemon a'a bal-akkal ma kaluha'an lahat Misil. Maina'an pa'in sigām ma Pira'un, nihaka'an sigām e'na pasal uppina, malaingkan halam aniya' min sigām makapahati iya bang ai ma'anana.  <div eID="gen758" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv458"/><div sID="gen759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv458"/> Manjari aniya' lling nakura' magbubuhat inuman ma Pira'un. Yukna, “Tuwan Pira'un, yamboho' taentomku ma llaw itu, aniya' kasā'an bay tahinangku.

verses.name: Genesis 41:10
verses.text: Ma waktu kakagit ataynu ma aku maka ma nakura' maghihinang tinapay, bay kami pakalabusunu ma luma' kapitan saga jaga.

verses.name: Genesis 41:11
verses.text: Manjari dakayu' sangom makauppi kami karuwangan, bo' saddī ma'anana.

verses.name: Genesis 41:12
verses.text: Na, aniya' a'a Hibrani bay sehe' kami ma deyom kalabusu, subul lagi', sosoho'an kapitan jaga. Bay iya haka'an kami pasal bay tauppi kami. Pagkalena, magtūy mina'anahan e'na pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Genesis 41:13
verses.text: Ya kaluwasanna, tatuman ai-ai kamemon bay pagma'anana ma kami. Aku itu bay pinabīng ni bay hinangku. Ya a'a maghihinang tinapaynu bay soho'nu pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen759" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv459"/><div sID="gen760" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv459"/> Angkan na pinalinganan magtūy si Yusup e' Pira'un ati pinaluwas iya magdai'-dai' min deyom kalabusu. Aubus pa'in e'na amagongan p'ngngotna sampay analinan badju'na, paharap iya pehē' ni Pira'un.  <div eID="gen760" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv460"/><div sID="gen761" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv460"/> Yuk Pira'un ma si Yusup, “Makauppi aku sagō' halam aniya' minsan dakayu' makapahati aku ma pasalna. Na kahaka'an aku pasal ka'a. Bang aniya' uppi a'a takalenu, ata'u ka kono' angama'anahan iya.”  <div eID="gen761" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv461"/><div sID="gen762" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv461"/> Ya sambung si Yusup ma Pira'un, “Tuwan sultan, ngga'i ka min pangita'uku. Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' ya makabuwanan ka'a ma'ana ahāp.”  <div eID="gen762" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv462"/><div sID="gen763" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv462"/> Ya lling Pira'un ma si Yusup, “Ma deyom uppiku, ina'an aku an'ngge-n'ngge ma bihing sapa' Nīl.

verses.name: Genesis 41:18
verses.text: Manjari aniya' ta'nda'ku pitu' sapi' al'mmok maka alanu' patukad min deyom sapa' amangan ma kaparangan.

verses.name: Genesis 41:19
verses.text: Puwas e', aniya' patukad pitu' sapi' saddī, angagkag maka ahigtal. Yamboho' aku maka'nda' sapi' buwattē' la'atna minsan ma'ingga-ma'ingga ma lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 41:20
verses.text: Sakali itu, in sapi' al'mmok inān kinakan magtūy e' saga sapi' angagkag.

verses.name: Genesis 41:21
verses.text: Malaingkan halam apinda baran saga sapi' bay amangan. Bā'nu halam bay makakakan ai-ai sabab masi angagkag. Na halam na, makabati' magtūy aku.  <div eID="gen763" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv463"/><div sID="gen764" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv463"/> “Pagtuliku pabīng, anguppi na isab aku. Ya ta'nda'ku ma deyom uppiku damuli itu, pitumbatang pai patomo' min dampo'on. Ahāp isi paina, asambu lullun.

verses.name: Genesis 41:23
verses.text: Puwas e', aniya' patomo' pitumbatang pai saddī, min dampo'on du isab. Ak'ppes isi paina maka alūs e' baliyu apasu'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:24
verses.text: Oy na, ya pai asambu inān tat'llon magtūy e' pai ak'ppes. Na, iya na he' tauppiku. Manjari haka'anku saga a'a ilmu'an pasal bay tauppiku he', sagō' halam aniya' minsan dakayu' min sigām makapahatian aku bang ai ma'anana.”  <div eID="gen764" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv464"/><div sID="gen765" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv464"/> Yuk si Yusup ma Pira'un, “Tuwan Pira'un, ya duwa uppinu ilu dama'ana du. Tu'ud ka pinata'u e' Tuhan bang ai hinangna ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Genesis 41:26
verses.text: Ya pitu' sapi' al'mmok ilu, maka pitumbatang pai asambu, sapantun pituntahun ahāp to'ongan anihanna.<note>Ani, anihan: kabtangan pasal kinakan ya ningā' min tinanom, buwat saga buwas, gandum, tirigu, dawa maka buwa' kayu ya ni'llawan supaya tatau' ma tahunan.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:27
verses.text: Buwattē' isab pitu' sapi' angagkag ya patukad ma karamulihan, maka pitumbatang pai ya alūs e' baliyu, sapantun pituntahun gotom.  <div eID="gen765" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv465"/><div sID="gen766" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv465"/> “Buwat bay pangahakaku ma ka'a, Tuwan Pira'un, in ka'a pinata'u na e' Tuhan bang ai nihinang e'na ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Genesis 41:29
verses.text: Hatina, ma deyom pituntahun ya song pat'kka itu, ajatu to'ongan saga tinanom ma katilibut lahat Misil, magdayas-dayas ma kinakan.

verses.name: Genesis 41:30
verses.text: Pasunu' isab pina'an pituntahun gotom, jari in lahat Misil itu magkasigpitan, ati takalipat e' saga a'a kamemon bay timpu pagdayas-dayas e'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:31
verses.text: Alungay timpu kahāpan min pangentom manusiya' ma sabab kabisa paggotom ya makasunu'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:32
verses.text: Tuwan, ya angkan ka pinauppihan min duwa e' Tuhan, sabab ahogot niyatna. In pakaradja'an bay tauppinu ilu marai' na pinat'kka e'na.  <div eID="gen766" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv466"/><div sID="gen767" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv466"/> “Da'a busung, Tuwan Pira'un, bang bahā' aku angahūgan ka'a gara'? Subay ka amiha dakayu' a'a bal-akkal, a'a alalom pangita'una, pinapagnakura' e'nu ma katilingkal lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 41:34
verses.text: Subay ka amat'nna' saga mandul isab maka subay aniya' kapatut sigām angā' bahagi' lima min ai-ai pinagani ma deyom pituntahun ya aheka anihanna.

verses.name: Genesis 41:35
verses.text: Subay aniya' isab kapatut sigām deyo' min Pira'un amatipun kamemon anihan inān sat'ggol ahāp tahunanna, maka subay tinau' pahogot ma deyom saga da'ira.

verses.name: Genesis 41:36
verses.text: Ya kinakan tatipun itu subay tinagama pagbalanja' manusiya' ma timpu gotom ya song pat'kka ni lahat Misil. Manjari mbal sigām patay otas.”  <div eID="gen767" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen755" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv467"/><div sID="gen768" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasulutan Pira'un ma Gara' si Yusup</title> <div sID="gen769" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv467"/> Na, kasulutan Pira'un maka kamemon saga tendogna ma bay panganggara' si Yusup e'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:38
verses.text: Angkan yuk Pira'un ma sigām, “Mbal na kitam makapiha a'a saddī makasali' ni si Yusup itu. In iya dakayu' a'a katulunan pikilan alalom e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen769" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv468"/><div sID="gen770" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv468"/> Angabtang Pira'un ma si Yusup, yukna, “Pagka ka'a ya bay kabuwanan pangita'u maka pikilan alalom e' Tuhan, mattan halam aniya' angatu ma ka'a ma akkal maka pamikil.”  <div eID="gen770" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen768" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv469"/><div sID="gen771" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup Gin'llal Gubnul ma Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen772" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv469"/> Ah'lling gi' Pira'un ma si Yusup, yukna, “Itiya' aku angangg'llal ka'a pagmakōkan ma pagsultananku itu. Ai-ai panoho'annu subay bineya' sadja e' saga a'aku kamemon. Luwal kawasaku ya aheya min kawasanu, sabab Pira'un aku.

verses.name: Genesis 41:41
verses.text: Buwattina'an g'llalta na ka gubnul ma sakalingkal lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Genesis 41:42
verses.text: Manjari niurusan e' Pira'un singsingna taga-gindan pagsultanna, ati pasulugna ma tangan si Yusup. Pinasulugan iya juba ahalga' kakana'na isab, maka engkot k'llong bulawan.

verses.name: Genesis 41:43
verses.text: Puwas e' binuwanan iya dakayu' kalesa, ya pamasuku' a'a bangsahan ya pasunu' ma Pira'un. Aniya' isab jaga sinō' parahū min kalesana amasimay saga a'a bo' aluhaya palabayanna. Manjari si Yusup ya pinapaggubnul ma kaluha'an lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen772" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv470"/><div sID="gen773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv470"/> Ah'lling Pira'un ma si Yusup, yukna, “B'nnal, aku ya sultan maitu ma Misil, sagō' halam aniya' a'a ma katilibut lahat Misil itu makatawakkal maghinang ai-ai bang ngga'i ka min panoho'annu.”

verses.name: Genesis 41:45
verses.text: Jari aniya' ōn saddī pamuwan Pira'un ma si Yusup ma bahasa Misil. Niōnan iya Sapenat-Paneya. Pinah'nda'an isab iya e' Pira'un ma si Asenat anak si Potepera, dakayu' imam ma da'ira Ūn.<note>Da'ira Ūn: pinagōnan isab da'ira Heliyopolis.</note> T'llumpū' tahun ya umul si Yusup ma waktu katagna'na maghinang ma deyoman Pira'un ya magsultan ma lahat Misil. Makaluwas pa'in iya min deyom astana', nilibut e'na kaluha'an lahat.  <div eID="gen773" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:46
verses.text: Jari aniya' ōn saddī pamuwan Pira'un ma si Yusup ma bahasa Misil. Niōnan iya Sapenat-Paneya. Pinah'nda'an isab iya e' Pira'un ma si Asenat anak si Potepera, dakayu' imam ma da'ira Ūn.<note>Da'ira Ūn: pinagōnan isab da'ira Heliyopolis.</note> T'llumpū' tahun ya umul si Yusup ma waktu katagna'na maghinang ma deyoman Pira'un ya magsultan ma lahat Misil. Makaluwas pa'in iya min deyom astana', nilibut e'na kaluha'an lahat.  <div eID="gen773" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv471"/><div sID="gen774" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv471"/> Manjari itu ma deyom pituntahun ahāp, aheka to'ongan buwa' tinanom ya niani ma lahat e'.

verses.name: Genesis 41:48
verses.text: Pinatau' e' si Yusup ma saga da'ira pakaniya-pakaniya ya ingga-ingga bay ta'ani min kahuma'an ya ma katilibut saga da'ira inān. Buwattē' na pa'in hinang si Yusup ma deyom pituntahun ya ahāp pagani.

verses.name: Genesis 41:49
verses.text: Tinipun bo' tinipun sampay palasay min pagtau'an. Angkan pinahondong e' si Yusup saga sosoho'anna inān angitung t'pponganna. Tu'ud aheka makalandu', buwat ibarat gusung ma bihing tahik mbal taitung.  <div eID="gen774" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv472"/><div sID="gen775" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv472"/> Na, ma halam lagi' ta'abut waktu gotom, aniya' duwa anak si Yusup l'lla min h'ndana si Asenat ya anak si Potepera imam ma da'ira Ūn.

verses.name: Genesis 41:51
verses.text: Si Manasse<note>Ya ōn Manasse itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani hatina ‘takalipat.’</note> ya pangōn si Yusup ma anakna siyaka inān. Ya pangabtang si Yusup, “Min Tuhan ya angkan aku kalungayan pangentom ma kakampunganku kamemon, sampay kabinasahan kamemon bay kalabayanku.”

verses.name: Genesis 41:52
verses.text: Manjari si Epra'im<note>Ya ōn Epra'im itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘binuwanan anak min duwa.’</note> ya pangōnna ma anakna pasunu'. Angabtang isab si Yusup, yukna, “Kabuwanan aku tubu' ma lahat ya bay makabuwanan aku kabinsana'an.”  <div eID="gen775" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv473"/><div sID="gen776" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv473"/> Na, ta'abut na tobtoban pituntahun ya aheka anihanna ma lahat Misil,

verses.name: Genesis 41:54
verses.text: ati anagna' pituntahun gotom buwat bay pangahaka si Yusup. Taluwa' gotom kalahat-lahatan inān kamemon, malaingkan aniya' kinakan ma sakalingkal lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 41:55
verses.text: Kakulangan pa'in balanja' saga a'a Misil e', angamu' sigām ni Pira'un. Angkan na aniya' panoho'anna ma saga a'a inān kamemon, sinō' sigām pehē' ni si Yusup bo' ameya' ma ai-ai pamat'nna'na ma sigām.  <div eID="gen776" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv474"/><div sID="gen777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv474"/> Pasōng na pa'in gotom sampay pa'abut ni kaluha'an lahat Misil. Jari magpanoho'an si Yusup, sinō' niukab saga bodega panau'an kinakan bo' yampa pinab'llihan ma saga a'a Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 41:57
verses.text: Damikiyanna saga a'a ma kamemon kalahat-lahatan, kasigpitan sidda ma sabab gotom. Angkan na sigām pehē' ni lahat Misil am'lli balanja' min si Yusup.  <div eID="gen777" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.41"/> <div eID="gen771" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv475"/><div sID="gen778" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapehē' saga Danakan si Yusup ni Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen779" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv475"/> Na, makata'u pa'in si Yakub mma' si Yusup aniya' balanja' tab'lli ma lahat Misil, ah'lling iya ma saga anakna l'lla. Yukna, “Angay kam hal aningkō'?

verses.name: Genesis 42:2
verses.text: Takaleku aniya' balanja' tab'lli mahē' ma Misil. Pehē' kam, b'llihinbi bo' kitam mbal patay otas.”  <div eID="gen779" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv476"/><div sID="gen780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv476"/> Manjari pehē' na saga siyaka si Yusup sangpū' puhu' am'lli balanja' ni Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 42:4
verses.text: Ya halam pinabeya' e' si Yakub anakna kasiyalihan si Benjamin, ya langgung si Yusup. Nihalli'an iya e' mma'na bo' mbal t'kkahan la'at ma l'ngnganan.

verses.name: Genesis 42:5
verses.text: Manjari pa'abay na saga anak si Yakub ma a'a kasehe'an pehē' ni lahat Misil am'lli balanja', sabab kaluha'an lahat Kana'an inān talapay gotom isab.  <div eID="gen780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv477"/><div sID="gen781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv477"/> Na, pagka si Yusup ya gubnul ma lahat Misil, taga-kapatut iya magpab'lli balanja' ma sai na. Sakali itu, at'kka pa'in saga danakan si Yusup pina'an, magtūy sigām pasujud ma dahuanna.

verses.name: Genesis 42:7
verses.text: Magtūy sigām takilā e' si Yusup, sagō' magbau'-bau' sadja iya in sigām mbal kata'uwanna. Akasla isab llingna ma sigām, yukna, “Oy, minningga kam?” <div eID="gen781" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen782" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Min lahat Kana'an, tuwan. Bay kami pi'itu am'lli balanja'.”  <div eID="gen782" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv478"/><div sID="gen783" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv478"/> Minsan takilā e' si Yusup saga danakanna, in iya halam takilā e' sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 42:9
verses.text: Jari taentom e' si Yusup bay tauppina ma masa palabay pasal saga danakanna inān, angkan yukna, “Ā, mata-mata ko' ka'am ilu bay pi'itu ang'nda'-ng'nda' lahat kami bang tongod ai ya aluhay sinōd.”  <div eID="gen783" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv479"/><div sID="gen784" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv479"/> Ya sambung saga danakanna, “Arōy tuwan, kami itu ngga'i ka mata-mata. Halam aniya' maksud kami ala'at. Sosoho'annu du isab kami bay pi'itu am'lli balanja'. Magdanakan kami, a'a asaltun lullun.”  <div eID="gen784" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv479"/><div sID="gen784" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv479"/> Ya sambung saga danakanna, “Arōy tuwan, kami itu ngga'i ka mata-mata. Halam aniya' maksud kami ala'at. Sosoho'annu du isab kami bay pi'itu am'lli balanja'. Magdanakan kami, a'a asaltun lullun.”  <div eID="gen784" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv480"/><div sID="gen785" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv480"/> “Ē!” yuk si Yusup. “Mbal aku am'nnal. Ya gawibi pi'itu ang'nda'-ng'nda' bang tongod ai ya aluhay sinōd ma lahat kami.”  <div eID="gen785" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv481"/><div sID="gen786" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv481"/> Ya sambung sigām ma si Yusup, “Tuwan Gubnul, in kami sosoho'annu itu bay sangpū' maka duwa magdanakan. Mma' kami ina'an ma lahat Kana'an, maka ina'an ma iya danakan kami kasiyalihan. Aniya' isab danakan kami amatay na.”  <div eID="gen786" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv482"/><div sID="gen787" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv482"/> “Ā,” yuk si Yusup, “B'nnal ya yukku insini', in ka'am ilu mata-mata. Ala'at maksudbi.

verses.name: Genesis 42:15
verses.text: Sulayanta kam bang b'nnal llingbi. Ya danakanbi kasiyalihan e' subay pinapi'itu. Bang hati' mbal, na sapahanta kam min ōn Pira'un, in ka'am mbal to'ongan makala'an minnitu.

verses.name: Genesis 42:16
verses.text: Dangan min ka'am subay pehē' angā' siyalibi he'. Kasehe'anbi subay tinahan maitu ma deyom kalabusu sampay tata'u bang b'nnal llingbi atawa mbal. Bang mbal, mattan du in ka'am mata-mata. Ōn Pira'un ya pagsapahanku.”

verses.name: Genesis 42:17
verses.text: Manjari pinakalabusu na sigām e' si Yusup t'llung'llaw t'ggolna.  <div eID="gen787" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv483"/><div sID="gen788" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv483"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in llaw kat'lluna, ah'lling na si Yusup ni saga danakanna, yukna, “Aku itu magmatāw ma Tuhan. Mbal kam papatayku bang pa'in kam ameya' ma pamat'nna'ku itu.

verses.name: Genesis 42:19
verses.text: Bang kam b'nnal asaltun, ahāp maksudbi, subay aniya' mattanna. Dakayu' a'a min ka'am ta'bba maitu ma deyom kalabusu, bo' kasehe'anbi ilu tinugutan amole' amowa balanja' ma saga anak-h'ndabi ya agon-agon patay otas.

verses.name: Genesis 42:20
verses.text: Pagubus, bowahunbi siyalibi pi'itu ni aku. Bang buwattē' hinangbi kamattanan aku in llingbi ma aku b'nnal to'ongan. Jari mbal na kam papatayku.” Na, kasulutan sigām magdanakan ma lling si Yusup.  <div eID="gen788" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv484"/><div sID="gen789" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv484"/> Magsuli-suli sigām pakaniya-pakaniya, yuk-i, “Na, tantu kitam katongoran ma bay tahinangtam ma siyalitam e'. Bay ta'nda'tam kasigpitanna waktu kapangamu'na ase' ma kitam. Sagō' halam asiptam. Ya he' sababanna angkan kitam t'kkahan sigpit buwattina'an.”  <div eID="gen789" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv485"/><div sID="gen790" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv485"/> Ah'lling isab si Rubin, yukna, “Bay na sa yukku ma ka'am da'a binasahunbi onde' e', sagō' halam aku bay beya'bi. Na, itiya' kitam binalosan pasal kamatayna.”

verses.name: Genesis 42:23
verses.text: Tahati asal e' si Yusup ai-ai pamissala sigām, saguwā' halam kinata'uwan e' sigām sabab kahaba' sigām anuli-nuli ma si Yusup aniya' magsasalin bahasa sigām ni bahasa Misil.  <div eID="gen790" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv486"/><div sID="gen791" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv486"/> Pagkale si Yusup ma pamissala sigām, tatangis iya ati pataikut min sigām. Pahondong pa'in tangisna bo' makasuwala pabīng, pabaihu' iya ni dauranakanna. Pinene' e'na si Simiyun, bo' soho'na niengkotan ma matahan sigām.  <div eID="gen791" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv487"/><div sID="gen792" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv487"/> Na, arai' pa'in amole' saga danakan si Yusup kasehe'an, magpanoho'an si Yusup ma saga tendogna, sinō' pin'nno'an balanja' saga karut sigām pakaniya-pakaniya. Sinō' isab ni'isi ni karut sigām sīn bay pamayad sigām dangan maka dangan. Pinalutu'an lagi' sigām bo' aniya' takakan-kakan sigām ma labayan.

verses.name: Genesis 42:26
verses.text: Kaniya-kaniya sigām anganduwa' ni kura' sigām saga balanja' bay tab'lli sigām. Pagduwa' itu, palanjal na sigām amole'.  <div eID="gen792" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv488"/><div sID="gen793" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv488"/> Sangom pa'in, pahondong sigām ma pahanti'an. Sakali itu, aniya' dangan min sigām angukab karutna bahasa angā' gandum pamakan kura'na. Pagukabna, na, aniya' sīn ma bowa' karut e'.

verses.name: Genesis 42:28
verses.text: Agsai lingananna saga danakanna, yukna, “Oy, itiya' sīnku bay pinabīng ni karutku.” <div eID="gen793" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen794" type="paragraph"/> Na taluwa' sigām sukkal aheya, jari magpamidpid sigām ati magtilaw-tilawan dansehe'an, yuk-i, “Ai sa ya pamat'kka kitam itu e' Tuhan?”  <div eID="gen794" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv489"/><div sID="gen795" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv489"/> Manjari itu, at'kka pa'in sigām ni lahat Kana'an maka ni si Yakub ya mma' sigām, sinuli-sulihan iya pasal kamemon bay kalabayan sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 42:30
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Mma', binissalahan kami e' Gubnul ya pagnakura'an lahat Misil, akasla sidda. Tinuna'an kami e'na angamata-mata kono' ma lahatna.

verses.name: Genesis 42:31
verses.text: Ya sambung kami, ‘Tuwan, ngga'i ka kami saga mata-mata. A'a abontol kami, ahāp sadja maksud kami.

verses.name: Genesis 42:32
verses.text: Sangpū' maka duwa kami magdanakan, da'mma' kamemon. Dakayu' danakan kami wa'i na amatay. Maka danakan kami kasiyalihan ina'an tabba ma mma' kami ma lahat Kana'an.’ Ya he' bay pah'lling kami ma Gubnul e'.  <div eID="gen795" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv490"/><div sID="gen796" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv490"/> “Ya sambungna ma kami, ‘Nda'ku na bang kam b'nnal a'a abontol. Tahanku maitu a'a dangan min deyomanbi. Jari in ka'am kasehe'an makajari amole' bo' amowa balanja' ma anak-h'ndabi ya mbal makasandal otas.

verses.name: Genesis 42:34
verses.text: Malaingkan,’ yuk gubnul-i, ‘ya siyalibi subay bowabi pi'itu ni aku. Minnē' kamattanan aku in ka'am ngga'i ka mata-mata bay pi'itu amiha lugal aluhay sinōd. Jari nde'anku ni ka'am danakanbi bay tahanku ati aluhaya na kam magusaha ma lahat itu.’ Na, buwattē' lling gubnul inān ma kami.”  <div eID="gen796" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv491"/><div sID="gen797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv491"/> Sakali itu, hinabu sigām angukab karut sigām pakaniya-pakaniya bo' anumpahan isina, allā! Ya putusan sīn bay pamayad sigām balanja', ina'an ma deyom karut. Pag'nda' sigām magtūy sigām sinōd tāw. Ya du si Yakub ya mma' sigām, sinōd tāw isab.

verses.name: Genesis 42:36
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Arōy, kalungayan aku anak ma sababanbi. Halam na si Yusup, halam na si Simiyun, ati kabaya'anbi subay amowa si Benjamin? Aku ya marasahi magkarukka'an.”  <div eID="gen797" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv492"/><div sID="gen798" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv492"/> Manjari yuk si Rubin ma mma'na, “Mma', pangandolun si Benjamin ma aku. Bang saupama mbal tabowaku pabalik ni ka'a, makajari papataynu anakku l'lla karuwangan ilu.”  <div eID="gen798" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv493"/><div sID="gen799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv493"/> Saguwā' mbal tapogos si Yakub. Yukna, “Mbal makabeya' ma ka'am anakku kabungsuhan itu. Wa'i na amatay langgungna, hal iya takapin allum. Bang aniya' makamula ma iya ma l'ngnganan, paheya gom pa'in karukka'anku ati tabowa aku amole' ni ahirat, sabab ato'a na aku.”  <div eID="gen799" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.42"/> <div eID="gen778" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv494"/><div sID="gen800" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ni Misil saga Danakan si Yusup, Kaminduwana</title> <div sID="gen801" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv494"/> Na, karuhunan gotom ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 43:2
verses.text: Ya balanja' bay tab'lli e' saga anak si Yakub ma lahat Misil aubus na kamemon. Manjari ah'lling si Yakub ma saga anakna, yukna, “Pabalik kam pehē' ni Misil am'lli balanja' minsan mbal aheka.”  <div eID="gen801" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv495"/><div sID="gen802" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv495"/> Sagō' yuk si Yahud ma iya, “Mma', bay kami sinanggupan e' gubnul ma lahat-i, yukna bang kami mbal amowa siyali kami pehē', mbal kami makajari paharap ni iya.

verses.name: Genesis 43:4
verses.text: Bang hati pabeya'nu siyali kami itu, na, pehē' du kami am'lli balanja'.

verses.name: Genesis 43:5
verses.text: Sagō' bang iya mbal pabeya'nu, in kami itu mbal pehē' pagka mbal tinugutan paharap ni gubnul.”  <div eID="gen802" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv496"/><div sID="gen803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv496"/> Ya sambung si Isra'il (hatina si Yakub), “Angay kam bay makahaka'an a'a inān aniya' gi' danakanbi saddī? Kasusahan sadja ya pamat'kkabi ma aku.”  <div eID="gen803" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv497"/><div sID="gen804" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv497"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Tu'ud mbal pahali a'a inān anilosa kami ma pasal kaukampungan kami. Tinilaw kami e'na pasal mma' kami bang masi allum, maka bang aniya' danakan kami saddī? Manjari, Mma', mbal kami makapagin'mbal ma panilawna. Maka halam isab bay makani-pikilan kami in siyali kami sinō' binowa pina'an ni iya.”  <div eID="gen804" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv498"/><div sID="gen805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv498"/> Manjari si Yahud ya ah'lling, yukna, “Mma', pangandolun onde' ilu ma aku bo' kami pehē' magtūy am'lli balanja' supaya halam aniya' min kitam patay otas.

verses.name: Genesis 43:9
verses.text: Paglilla'ku baranku angakuhan iya min ai-ai makamula. Bang aniya' tum'kka ni iya, aku ya binīngan. Bang iya s'lle'-bale puhu' mbal tabowaku amole' pi'itu ni ka'a ma halam baya-baya, aku ya kasusunan sat'ggolku allum.

verses.name: Genesis 43:10
verses.text: Mma', bang kami halam bay taggahannu, bay du kami magpehē'-pi'itu min duwa na.”  <div eID="gen805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv499"/><div sID="gen806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv499"/> Yuk si Isra'il ya mma' sigām, “Na, bang buwattē', subay kam amowa kasampangan pangahulmatbi ma gubnul e'. Isihunbi ni karutbi ai-ai ya katapusan ahāp min lahatta itu, saga bulitik ahamut maka gula' buwani minsan sadja dangkuri', maka ginisan pamapā isab, maka saga kinakan ahāp nanamna buwat bigi-pistasyo<note>Pistasyo maka almon: Ginis kayu landu' ahāp bigi-buwa'na.</note> maka bigi-almon.

verses.name: Genesis 43:12
verses.text: Bowahunbi isab sīn nilipat duwa min bay pam'llibi tagna' he', kalna' in sīn bay tabākbi ma bowa' karut subay pinabalik ni sigām. Arai' aniya' bay makasā'.

verses.name: Genesis 43:13
verses.text: Na, bowahunbi na siyalibi bo' kam magdai'-dai' pehē' ni gubnul.

verses.name: Genesis 43:14
verses.text: Bang pa'in iya pinat'kkahan atay ahāp e' Tuhan Sangat Kawasa supaya aniya' ase'na amabīng ni ka'am si Benjamin maka danakanbi dakayu'. Malaingkan bang aku saupama kalungayan anak, na, magsabal aku.”  <div eID="gen806" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv500"/><div sID="gen807" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv500"/> Sakali itu, palanjal na saga ka'anakan si Yakub maka e' sigām amowa kasampangan maka sīn nilipat duwa min bay dahū e'. Tabowa isab si Benjamin. Pagt'kka sigām ni Misil, pehē' sigām paharap ni si Yusup.

verses.name: Genesis 43:16
verses.text: Manjari, pag'nda' si Yusup ma si Benjamin, magtūy soho'na sosoho'an ya ang'ntan kapatut ma luma'na. Yukna, “Bowahun saga a'a itu pehē' ni luma'ku. Pasumbali'un hayop maka pa'adjalin pagkakan. Magsalu kami amangan ugtu llaw ilu.”  <div eID="gen807" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv501"/><div sID="gen808" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv501"/> Bineya' e' sosoho'an inān bay panoho'an si Yusup ma iya, ati binowa saga dauranakanna pehē' ni luma'.

verses.name: Genesis 43:18
verses.text: Sakali itu, sabu pa'in sigām binowa ni luma', t'kkahan sigām tāw. Ma hona'-hona' sigām, “Ya angkan kitam binowa pi'itu ma sabab sīn ya bay pinabīng ni deyom karuttam tagna' kitam bay am'lli balanja'. Marai' bahā' pataggaha' kitam nirugpak, ati sinaggaw kitam nihinang ata. Niagaw isab saga kura'tam.”  <div eID="gen808" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv502"/><div sID="gen809" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv502"/> Angkan na, pagabut sigām ni bowa' lawang, pasekot sigām ni a'a ang'ntan kapatut ma luma' si Yusup amowa iya magbissala. Yuk sigām,

verses.name: Genesis 43:20
verses.text: “Tuwan, da'a busung, aniya' pah'lling kami ma ka'a. Bay kami makapi'itu mint'dda am'lli balanja'.

verses.name: Genesis 43:21
verses.text: Sagō' makahanti' pa'in kami ma l'ngnganan tudju amole', taukab kami saga karut pakaniya-pakaniya. Pagukab itu, ta'nda' kami ma bowa' karut sīn bay pamayad kami balanja', jukup to'ongan. Daka sai bay amat'nna' sīn inān ni deyom karut kami. Angkan na itiya' kami amowa sīn e' pinapole' ni ka'am. Maka aniya' itu sīn saddī pam'lli kami balanja' ma l'ngngan itu.”  <div eID="gen809" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:22
verses.text: Sagō' makahanti' pa'in kami ma l'ngnganan tudju amole', taukab kami saga karut pakaniya-pakaniya. Pagukab itu, ta'nda' kami ma bowa' karut sīn bay pamayad kami balanja', jukup to'ongan. Daka sai bay amat'nna' sīn inān ni deyom karut kami. Angkan na itiya' kami amowa sīn e' pinapole' ni ka'am. Maka aniya' itu sīn saddī pam'lli kami balanja' ma l'ngngan itu.”  <div eID="gen809" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv503"/><div sID="gen810" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv503"/> Ya sambung a'a ang'ntan kapatut e', “Da'a kam asusa. Da'a kam tināw. Tuhanbi, ya pagtuhanan mma'bi, bay makaisi sīn inān ni deyom karutbi. Bay du tasambutku bayadbi.” Puwas e' pinaluwas e'na si Simiyun ni'nde'an ni sigām.  <div eID="gen810" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv504"/><div sID="gen811" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv504"/> Na, binowa na saga danakan si Yusup ni deyom luma'na e' sosoho'anna he'. Binuwanan sigām bohe' pangose' tape' sigām maka binuwanan isab pagkakan saga kura' sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 43:25
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in sigām binowa sigām amangan ma luma' si Yusup, sinakap ba'anan kasampangan pangahulmat sigām ma iya pagt'kkana ni luma' ugtu llaw.  <div eID="gen811" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv505"/><div sID="gen812" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv505"/> Manjari pagt'kka si Yusup ni luma', pasujud sigām ma dahuanna maka e' sigām amuwanan iya saga kasampangan bay binowa e' sigām ni deyom luma'.

verses.name: Genesis 43:27
verses.text: Tinilaw sigām e' si Yusup pasal kahālan sigām. Yukna, “Painay na mma'bi ya bay pangahakabi ma aku ato'a na? Masi iya allum?”  <div eID="gen812" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv506"/><div sID="gen813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv506"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Aho' tuwan, ahāp masi mma' kami maka alasig.” Pasujud na isab sigām ni si Yusup pagaddat sigām ma iya.  <div eID="gen813" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv507"/><div sID="gen814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv507"/> Na, pag'nda' si Yusup ma langgungna si Benjamin, yukna, “Ā, ya na ka itu siyalibi, ya bay panuli-nulibi ma aku? Bang pa'in ka binuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan, Otō'.”

verses.name: Genesis 43:30
verses.text: Agon-agon ahansul pangatayan si Yusup pag'nda'na ma langgungna. Angkan iya parai'-dai' paluwas sabab mbal tasandal bohe' matana am'ttak. Jari pasōd iya ni deyom bilikna anangis maina'an.  <div eID="gen814" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv508"/><div sID="gen815" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv508"/> Pagpuwas, akula'up iya bo' pabalik ni saga danakanna. Sinandalan e'na bohe' matana maka e'na anoho' saga a'ana amat'nna' kinakan sigām.  <div eID="gen815" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv509"/><div sID="gen816" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv509"/> Pinat'nna'an si Yusup dangan-danganna. Saga danakanna pinat'nna'an ma pamanganan saddī, sigām-sigām sadja. Saddī isab ma saga bangsa Misil ya magkakan maina'an. Mbal sigām makapagsalu maka bangsa Hibrani, sabab asammal bang ma sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 43:33
verses.text: Jari pinatingkō' saga danakan si Yusup ma anggopanna, maka pinagsunu'-sunu' isab tingkō'an sigām min siyaka ni siyali. Pag'nda' sigām ma pagpatingkō' ma sigām buwattē', magtūy sigām mag'nda' mata tabowa e' kainu-inuhan sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 43:34
verses.text: Manjari aniya' palauk pangalabot ma sigām bay min lamisahan si Yusup, sagō' ya pangalabot si Benjamin nilipat lima min bay pangalabot saga danakanna. Na magjamu sigām maka si Yusup, maginum sampay maglami-lami.  <div eID="gen816" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.43"/> <div eID="gen800" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv510"/><div sID="gen817" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sawan Alungay</title> <div sID="gen818" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv510"/> Manjari aniya' panoho'an si Yusup ma a'a ang'ntan kapatut ma deyomanna, yukna, “P'nno'in balanja' karut sigām ilu kamemon, pila-pila ya takaya binowa e' sigām. Pole'in isab sīn bay pamayad sigām pakaniya-pakaniya, pat'nna'un ma diyata' balanja' ya ma deyom karut sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 44:2
verses.text: Ngā'un isab ya sawanku dī pilak bo' pat'nna'un pehē' ni deyom karut kasiyalihan e', pabeya'un ma sīn bay pamayadna.” Na bineya' e' a'a inān bay panoho'an si Yusup ma iya.  <div eID="gen818" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv511"/><div sID="gen819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv511"/> Pagsubu-subu lagi', pinapole' na saga dauranakan e' maka saga kura' ya pagduruwa'an sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 44:4
verses.text: Sakali itu, ma halam lagi' sigām makalawak min da'ira bay kamahē'an sigām-i, ah'lling si Yusup ma a'a tag-kapatut ma deyomanna. “Pal'kkas ka,” yukna. “Turulun saga a'a inān. Pagabutnu, tilosahun sigām. Yuknu, ‘Ē, ka'am ilu! Kabuwanan kam kahāpan ati kala'atan ya panungbasbi!

verses.name: Genesis 44:5
verses.text: Angay tatangkawbi sawan pilak ya suku' nakura'ku? Sawan panginumanna ko' ilu, sawan isab pagputika'anna. Langgal sara' to'ongan ya tahinangbi ilu!’ ”  <div eID="gen819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv512"/><div sID="gen820" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv512"/> Na, maka'abut pa'in sosoho'an si Yusup-i ni sigām magdanakan, magtūy isabanna kabtangan bay pah'lling si Yusup ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 44:7
verses.text: Ya panambung saga magdanakan ma iya, “Tuwan, angay kami pah'llingannu buwattilu? Makabusung ko' ilu bang kami makahinang buwat yuknu ilu.

verses.name: Genesis 44:8
verses.text: Entomun sīn ya bay tabāk kami ma bowa' karut kami. Bay tabowa kami min lahat Kana'an bo' tinūran ni ka'a. Jari pangannalnu bahā' in kami makatangkaw pilak atawa bulawan min deyom luma' nakura'nu?

verses.name: Genesis 44:9
verses.text: Tuwan, bang sawan ilu ganta' tabāk ma sai-sai min kami, a'a inān subay papataynu, maka kami kasehe'an subay magpa'ata ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen820" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv513"/><div sID="gen821" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv513"/> Ya sambung a'a si Yusup-i, “Sulut na,” yukna, “sagō' ya sadja hinangku ata, bang ma sai kabākan sawan ilu. Malaingkan ka'am kasehe'an puwas min palkala'.”  <div eID="gen821" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv514"/><div sID="gen822" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv514"/> Magtūy sigām magdai'-dai' amareyo' duwa'an sigām bo' yampa angukab karut pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Genesis 44:12
verses.text: Manjari pinaglungkad to'ongan saga karut sigām magdanakan e' sosoho'an si Yusup. Tinagna'an min siyaka tudju ni siyali. Allā, tabākna in sawan pilak ma deyom karut si Benjamin.

verses.name: Genesis 44:13
verses.text: Pagbāk itu, magtūy gineret e' saga dauranakan si Yusup saga badju' sigām ma sabab kaheya susa sigām. Taparuwa' pa'in ai-ai sigām ma saga kura', pehē' na sigām pabalik ni da'ira.  <div eID="gen822" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv515"/><div sID="gen823" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv515"/> Pagt'kka si Yahud maka saga danakanna ni luma' si Yusup, ina'an iya masi. Magtūy sigām pak'ppang ni tana' ma dahuanna.

verses.name: Genesis 44:15
verses.text: Yuk si Yusup ma sigām, “Angay kam makahinang buwattē'? A'awam kam bahā'? Bang a'a buwat aku ata'u ang'nda' putika'an, halam aniya' kalimbungan min aku.”  <div eID="gen823" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv516"/><div sID="gen824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv516"/> Ya sambung si Yahud, “Daka ai pangabtang kami ma ka'a, tuwan. Halam aniya' panganda'awahan kami in kami itu asaltun. Tapabukis na dusa kami e' Tuhan. Atanu na kami itu kamemon, ngga'i ka sadja ya a'a dangan bay kabākan sawannu.”  <div eID="gen824" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv517"/><div sID="gen825" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv517"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Ā, mbal. Mbal aho'anku ya yuknu ilu. Ya sadja hinangku ata ya a'a bay kabākan sawanku. Ka'am kasehe'an ilu makajari na amole' pehē' ni mma'bi ma deyom kasalamatan.”  <div eID="gen825" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv518"/><div sID="gen826" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv518"/> Sakali si Yahud pasekot ni si Yusup maka e'na ah'lling, yukna, “Tuwan, da'a aku busung, aniya' pamowahanta ka magsuli-suli. Da'a isab ap'ddi' ataynu ma aku, sabab bang ma aku in ka'a sali' Pira'un.

verses.name: Genesis 44:19
verses.text: Tuwan,” yuk si Yahud, “bay kami tatilawnu bang aniya' lagi' mma' kami atawa danakan kami saddī.

verses.name: Genesis 44:20
verses.text: Ya sambung kami ma ka'a, aniya' mma' kami sagō' ato'a na. Maka aniya' gi' siyali kami l'lla bay nianakan ma kato'a si Mma'. Duwangan sigām maglanggung sagō' amatay na langgung siyaka. Manjari hal iya la'a takapin min sigām da-ina', angkan iya kinalasahan to'ongan e' si Mma'.”  <div eID="gen826" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv519"/><div sID="gen827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv519"/> Ah'lling gi' si Yahud, yukna, “Manjari, tuwan, bay soho'nu kami amowa siyali kami pi'itu ni ka'a supaya iya ta'nda'nu.

verses.name: Genesis 44:22
verses.text: Ya sambung kami ma ka'a, ‘Onde' he' mbal makabutas min mma'na, sabab bang iya abutas, arakala' amatay si Mma'.’

verses.name: Genesis 44:23
verses.text: Sagō' ya llingnu in kami mbal makapagharap maka ka'a pabalik, luwal bang tabeya' pi'itu siyali kami.

verses.name: Genesis 44:24
verses.text: Na manjari tuwan, pagbīng kami pehē' ni si Mma', magtūy iya kahaka'an pasal bay pangabtangnu ma kami.  <div eID="gen827" type="paragraph"/>
