verses.name: Genesis 44:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv520"/><div sID="gen828" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv520"/> “Na, mbal at'ggol, sinoho' na isab kami e' si Mma' pi'itu pabalik am'lli balanja' mbal aheka.

verses.name: Genesis 44:26
verses.text: Ya sambung kami ma iya, ‘Mma', bang mbal pabeya'nu si Benjamin mbal kami makapehē', sabab mbal tinugutan paharap ni gubnul e' bang halam tabeya' danakan kami kasiyalihan.’  <div eID="gen828" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv521"/><div sID="gen829" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv521"/> “Ya sambung si Mma' ma kami, ‘Kata'uwanbi asal, duwa du anakku l'lla min h'ndaku si Rakiya.

verses.name: Genesis 44:28
verses.text: Dakayu' e' halam na. Marai' iya bay tasagpe' e' sattuwa talun, sabab halam iya ta'nda'ku pabīng sangay min llaw bay kala'anna.’

verses.name: Genesis 44:29
verses.text: Yukna isab ma kami, ‘Bang pabutasbi si Benjamin min aku bo' aniya' kamulahan pataluwa' ma iya, na, pat'kkahanbi aku karukka'an mbal kasandalan e' a'a to'a. Ati tabowa aku amatay e' karukka'an.’ ”  <div eID="gen829" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv522"/><div sID="gen830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv522"/> Ah'lling gi' si Yahud ma si Yusup. “Bang pinagbahasa, tuwan, onde' itu ya kapangā'an lasig si Mma'. Bang aku ganta' amole' bo' ta'nda' e' si Mma' in onde' halam tabeya' ma aku, piligdu, amatay du iya magkarukka'an.

verses.name: Genesis 44:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv522"/><div sID="gen830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv522"/> Ah'lling gi' si Yahud ma si Yusup. “Bang pinagbahasa, tuwan, onde' itu ya kapangā'an lasig si Mma'. Bang aku ganta' amole' bo' ta'nda' e' si Mma' in onde' halam tabeya' ma aku, piligdu, amatay du iya magkarukka'an.

verses.name: Genesis 44:32
verses.text: Paligay aku itu, tuwan,” yukna, “bay angakuhan kallum onde' itu. Yukku ma si Mma', ‘Bang iya mbal tabowaku pabīng pi'itu ni ka'a, aku iya kasusunan sat'ggolku allum.’  <div eID="gen830" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv523"/><div sID="gen831" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv523"/> “Ndū' tuwan,” yuk si Yahud, “bang pa'in tugutannu aku magpa'ata ma ka'a ganti' siyaliku. Paronganun iya ma saga danakanna kasehe'an amole' pehē' ni si Mma'.

verses.name: Genesis 44:34
verses.text: Daka painay e'ku amole' pehē' ni mma'ku bang halam ma aku onde' itu. Mbal aku makasandal ang'nda' ma pagkarukka'an si Mma'.”  <div eID="gen831" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.44"/> <div eID="gen817" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv524"/><div sID="gen832" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpakilā si Yusup ma Saga Danakanna</title> <div sID="gen833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv524"/> Manjari mbal na kasandalan e' si Yusup kahansul atayna angkan soho'na paluwas minna'an saga a'a Misil bay ma deyom luma'na. Na, halam pa'in aniya' a'a saddī maina'an, magpakilā na iya ma saga danakanna.

verses.name: Genesis 45:2
verses.text: Akosog pagtangis si Yusup, takale isab e' saga a'a Misil. Jari pinasampay habalna pehē' ni astana' Pira'un.  <div eID="gen833" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv525"/><div sID="gen834" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv525"/> Yuk si Yusup ma saga danakanna, “Aku na ko' itu si Yusup. Masi allum si Mma'?” Na, pagkale llingna itu e' saga danakanna, magtūy sigām sinōd tāw, kapam'ngngangan.  <div eID="gen834" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv526"/><div sID="gen835" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv526"/> Na amissala si Yusup ma sigām, yukna, “Pasekot kam pi'itu.” Jari pasekot na sigām. Yuk si Yusup isab, “Aku na ko' itu si Yusup, ya danakanbi bay pab'llihanbi bo' binowa ni Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 45:5
verses.text: Na, da'a kam asukkal. Da'a isab pagsusuninbi baranbi pasal pamab'llibi ma aku. Ya angkan aku makapi'itu, sabab Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku, ngga'i ka ka'am. Tu'ud aku pinarahū e'na min ka'am supaya kalappasan bangsa manusiya' min gotom.

verses.name: Genesis 45:6
verses.text: Ma buwattina'an yampa duwantahun paggotom ma lahat, jarina aniya' gi' limantahun halam aniya' tinanom, halam aniya' buwa' niani.

verses.name: Genesis 45:7
verses.text: Bay aku pinapi'itu e' Tuhan dahū min ka'am supaya kam kalappasan ma sabab kawasana makainu-inu, bo' aniya' du pa'in panubu'bi maitu ma dunya.  <div eID="gen835" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv527"/><div sID="gen836" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv527"/> “Hatina,” yuk si Yusup, “ngga'i ka ka'am ya bay amapi'itu aku, sagō' Tuhan. Min kahandakna ya angkan aku sali' sapantun pag'mma'an Pira'un angahūgan iya gara'. Tahinang aku pagmakōkan ma deyomanna, maka gin'llal aku nakura' ang'ntanan sakalingkal lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 45:9
verses.text: Na, pal'kkas na kam amole' ni si Mma'. Pasampayunbi ni iya lapalku itu. ‘Min kahandak Tuhan ya angkan aku (yuk si Yusup) tahinang pagnakura'an ma sakalingkal lahat Misil. Palūd ka pi'itu saru'un-du'un, da'a ka ananggu.

verses.name: Genesis 45:10
verses.text: Maitu na ka pat'nna' ma lahat Gosen supaya asekot ni aku. Bowahun pi'itu saga anak-mpunu kamemon, sampay saga kahayopannu, bili-bili ka, kambing ka, sapi' ka. Bowahun isab pangalta'nu kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 45:11
verses.text: Bang ka maina'an na ma Gosen aku ya angupiksa' ka'a. Aniya' gi' limantahun t'ggol gotom itu. Mbal aku bilahi bang ka'am magtai'anak atawa ba'anan hayopnu patay otas.’ ” Ya du ina'an lapal si Yusup ma mma'na si Yakub.  <div eID="gen836" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv528"/><div sID="gen837" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv528"/> Ah'lling gi' si Yusup ma saga danakanna, yukna, “Benjamin, ta'nda'nu na aku itu langgungnu. Maka ka'am ilu kamemon ta'nda'bi na, aku na ko' itu.

verses.name: Genesis 45:13
verses.text: Suli-sulihinbi si Mma' pasal kawasaku maitu ma lahat Misil. Suli-sulihinbi pasal kamemon ya ta'nda'bi maitu. Jari pasa'ut kam amowa iya pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen837" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv529"/><div sID="gen838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv529"/> Magtūy ginapus e' si Yusup siyalina si Benjamin. Ginapus isab si Yusup e' si Benjamin, jari tatangis sigām karuwangan.

verses.name: Genesis 45:15
verses.text: Siniyum e'na danakanna kamemon dakayu' maka dakayu', maka e'na anangisan sigām. Pagubus, magsambung-siyambungi sigām magbissala.  <div eID="gen838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv530"/><div sID="gen839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv530"/> Na, makasampay pa'in ni astana' Pira'un habal pasal kat'kka saga danakan si Yusup, akōd to'ongan Pira'un maka saga tendogna pagnakura'an.

verses.name: Genesis 45:17
verses.text: Yuk Pira'un ma si Yusup, “Soho'un saga dauranakannu angamomos saga kura' sigām bo' pabalik ni lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 45:18
verses.text: Sō'un sigām angā' mma'bi sampay anak-h'nda sigām kamemon bo' binowa e' sigām pi'itu waktu kapabalik sigām. Buwananku sigām tana' landu' ahāp maitu ma Misil, supaya sigām maglabi-labi ma kalluman.”  <div eID="gen839" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv531"/><div sID="gen840" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv531"/> Amissala gi' Pira'un, yukna, “Soho'un sigām amowa saga karitun minnitu pameya'an saga anak-h'nda sigām pi'itu, ya lagi'na mma'bi.

verses.name: Genesis 45:20
verses.text: Da'a na kinabimbangan palsuku'an sigām ta'bba ma lahat, sabab ma sigām na ai-ai ya ahāp to'ongan maitu ma Misil.”  <div eID="gen840" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv532"/><div sID="gen841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv532"/> Manjari bineya' panoho'an Pira'un inān e' saga anak si Yakub. Binuwanan sigām saga karitun e' si Yusup ma buwat bay pah'lling Pira'un ma iya. Binuwanan sigām balanja' isab palutu' sigām ma l'ngnganan.

verses.name: Genesis 45:22
verses.text: Aniya' isab dapangampu'an s'mmek ahalga' pamuwan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya. Malaingkan ya pamuwan si Yusup ma si Benjamin, lima pangampu'an s'mmek pagsalinanna maka t'llu hatus pilak.

verses.name: Genesis 45:23
verses.text: Mma'na ya pinabowahan e' si Yusup sangpū' kura' l'lla ap'nno' e' ai-ai ahāp hinangan Misil, maka sangpū' kura' d'nda ap'nno' e' balanja' maka saga tinapay maka ginisan takakan-kakan pamalutu' iya ma l'ngngananna tudju ni Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 45:24
verses.text: Manjari itu, pinalanjal na saga danakanna e' si Yusup. Yukna ma sigām, “Ebot-ebot, da'a kam magkalukassa ma pal'ngngananbi.”  <div eID="gen841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv533"/><div sID="gen842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv533"/> Na, ala'an na sigām min Misil bo' pabalik pehē' ni lahat Kana'an. Pagt'kka sigām, magtūy sigām angahaka ma mma' sigām, yuk-i,

verses.name: Genesis 45:26
verses.text: “Mma', masi allum si Yusup! Pagnakura'an iya buwattina'an ma sakalingkal lahat Misil.” Magtūy tak'bbal atay si Yakub, sali' alungay pangannalna, mbal agon makapam'nnal ma bay pangahaka ma iya e' saga anakna.

verses.name: Genesis 45:27
verses.text: Malaingkan pagkalena kamemon bay panambuku si Yusup ma sigām, maka pag'nda'na isab saga karitun bay pinabeya'an iya e' si Yusup pameya'anna tudju ni Misil, magtūy pabalik pangannalna.  <div eID="gen842" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv534"/><div sID="gen843" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv534"/> Yuk si Yakub, “Kamattanan na aku. Allum du anakku si Yusup. Halam aniya' angutku saddī, bang pa'in aku makapehē' ang'nda' iya dahū sat'ggolku masi allum.”  <div eID="gen843" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.45"/> <div eID="gen832" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv535"/><div sID="gen844" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yakub Maglain ni Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen845" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv535"/> Na, palintas na disi Isra'il (hatina si Yakub) min lahat Kana'an maka e' sigām amowa ai-ai sigām kamemon. Tat'kka pa'in e' sigām lahat Be'erseba, anumbali' iya hayop pagkulbanna tudju ni Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'na si Isa'ak.

verses.name: Genesis 46:2
verses.text: Jari itu, sangom pa'in, takale e' si Isra'il itu suwala Tuhan angalinganan iya. “Yakub, O Yakub,” yukna. <div eID="gen845" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen846" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Oy, itiya' aku.”  <div eID="gen846" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv536"/><div sID="gen847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv536"/> Ya lling suwala-i, “Aku itu Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'nu. Da'a ka tināw palain ni lahat Misil, sabab mahē' aku angahinang saga panubu'nu bangsa akosog.

verses.name: Genesis 46:4
verses.text: Pataptap du aku ma ka'a, maka bowaku isab panubu'nu pabalik pi'itu ni lahat itu ma sinosōng. Bang ta'abut na waktunu awapat, ina'an du si Yusup ma bihingnu.”  <div eID="gen847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv537"/><div sID="gen848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv537"/> Manjari palanjal na disi Yakub min Be'erseba tudju ni lahat Misil. Si Yakub ya pinariyata' e' saga anakna ni karitun bay min Pira'un pameya'an sigām. Ya du pinariyata' isab saga anak-h'nda sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 46:6
verses.text: Bay binowa e' sigām ba'anan kahayopan sigām maka palsuku'an bay tausaha sigām maina'an ma lahat Kana'an bo' na palūd ni lahat Misil. Binowa e' si Yakub saga tubu'na kamemon.

verses.name: Genesis 46:7
verses.text: Tabeya' ma iya kamemon saga anak-mpuna l'lla maka d'nda.  <div eID="gen848" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen844" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv538"/><div sID="gen849" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panubu' si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen850" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv538"/> Ya na itu salsila ma kapanubu'an si Isra'il (hatina si Yakub) bay tabeya' ma iya waktu kapaglainna ni Misil: <lg sID="gen851"/> <l level="1" sID="gen852"/>Si Rubin ya kasiyakahan.<l eID="gen852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen853"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:9
verses.text: Anak si Rubin l'lla, ya na disi Hanok, si Pallu, si Hesdon maka si Karmi.<l eID="gen853" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen854"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:10
verses.text: Pasunu' si Simiyun maka saga anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen855"/>ya na disi Jamuwal, si Jamin, si Hūd, si Yakin, si Sohar maka si Sa'ul. Si Sa'ul itu anakna min d'nda bangsa Kana'an.<l eID="gen855" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen856"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:11
verses.text: Pasunu' isab si Libi maka saga anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen857"/>ya disi Gerson, si Kohat maka si Merari.<l eID="gen857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen858"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:12
verses.text: Pasunu' si Yahud maka saga anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen859"/>ya disi Sela, si Peres maka si Sera.<l eID="gen859" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen860"/>Aniya' isab duwa anak si Yahud l'lla bay amatay ma lahat Kana'an lagi', ya na si Ēr maka si Onan.<l eID="gen860" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen861"/>Aniya' isab saga anak si Peres l'lla,<l eID="gen861" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen862"/>ya na si Hesdon maka si Hamul.<l eID="gen862" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen863"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:13
verses.text: Pasunu' isab si Issakar maka saga anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen863" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen864"/>disi Tola, si Puwa, si Jasub, maka si Semlon.<l eID="gen864" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen865"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:14
verses.text: Kasiyalihan si Sibulun. Ya itu ōn anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen866"/>disi Sered, si Elon maka si Jahale'el.<l eID="gen866" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen851"/>  <div eID="gen850" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv539"/><div sID="gen867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv539"/> Jari ya na ina'an saga anak si Yakub min h'ndana po'on si Leya, ya bay nianakan mahē' ma lahat Mesopotami. Aniya' isab anakna d'nda si Dina. Jari t'llumpū' maka t'llu ya heka panubu' si Yakub min h'ndana po'on si Leya. <lg sID="gen868"/> <l level="1" sID="gen869"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:16
verses.text: Ya anak si Yakub siyaka min h'nda-h'ndana si Silpa,<l eID="gen869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen870"/>ya na si Gād. Ya itu ōn anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen871"/>disi Sepon, si Haggi, si Suni, si Esbon, si Iri, si Arod maka si Arili.<l eID="gen871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen872"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:17
verses.text: Pasunu' si Aser maka anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen873"/>ya disi Imna, si Isba, si Isbi, si Biriya,<l eID="gen873" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen874"/>maka dakayu' d'nda isab si Sera.<l eID="gen874" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen875"/>Aniya' isab anak si Biriya l'lla duwa hekana, si Heber maka si Malki'il.<l eID="gen875" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen868"/>  <div eID="gen867" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv540"/><div sID="gen876" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv540"/> Jari sangpū' maka nnom ya heka panubu' si Yakub min si Silpa, ya d'nda ipatan bay pamuwan e' si Leban ma si Leya waktu kapagpūnna maka si Yakub. <lg sID="gen877"/> <l level="1" sID="gen878"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:19
verses.text: Saga anak si Yakub l'lla isab min h'ndana si Rakiya,<l eID="gen878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen879"/>ya na si Yusup maka si Benjamin.<l eID="gen879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen880"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:20
verses.text: Si Manasse isab maka si Epra'im, ya anak si Yusup l'lla bay nianakan ma lahat Misil e' si Asenat anak si Potipero imam ma da'ira Ūn.<l eID="gen880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen881"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:21
verses.text: Na, si Benjamin du isab maka saga anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen882"/>ya na disi Bela, si Beker, si Asbel, si Gera, si Na'aman, si Ihi, si Rōs, si Muppim, si Huppim maka si Harid.<l eID="gen882" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen877"/>  <div eID="gen876" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv541"/><div sID="gen883" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv541"/> Ya du ina'an saga tubu' si Yakub min h'ndana si Rakiya, sangpū' maka mpat puhu'.  <div eID="gen883" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv542"/><div sID="gen884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv542"/> Ya anak si Yakub siyaka min h'nda-h'ndana si Bilha, <lg sID="gen885"/> <l level="1" sID="gen886"/>ya na si Dān. Ya anak si Dān l'lla si Husim.<l eID="gen886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen887"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:24
verses.text: Pasunu' si Naptali, maka anakna l'lla,<l eID="gen887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen888"/>disi Jasil, si Guni, si Jeser maka si Sillim.<l eID="gen888" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen885"/>  <div eID="gen884" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv543"/><div sID="gen889" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv543"/> Ya du ina'an saga tubu' si Yakub pitu' puhu' hekana min si Bilha, ya d'nda ipatan bay pamuwan ma si Rakiya e' mma'na si Leban.  <div eID="gen889" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv544"/><div sID="gen890" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv544"/> Manjari nnompū' maka nnom ya heka panubu' si Yakub lissi bay tabeya' ma iya pehē' ni Misil, halam talapay ni'itung saga ayuwanna d'nda.

verses.name: Genesis 46:27
verses.text: Pak'nnop isab duwangan anak si Yusup ya bay nianakan ma Misil. Manjari pitumpū' ya heka sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen890" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv545"/><div sID="gen891" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv545"/> Manjari si Yahud ya sinō' e' si Yakub parahū min sigām ni tongod si Yusup, bo' aniya' magmalim ma lahat Gosen. Pagt'kka pa'in sigām pehē',

verses.name: Genesis 46:29
verses.text: bo' kinata'uwan e' si Yusup, magtūy pinasakap e'na kalesana. Jari parai'-dai' iya ni Gosen amāk mma'na. Magbāk pa'in, magtūy ginapus si Yusup ma mma'na maka e'na anangis pat'ggol.  <div eID="gen891" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv546"/><div sID="gen892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv546"/> Ya lling si Isra'il ma si Yusup, “Ndū' anakku, allum du hati ka! Lilla' na aku amatay pagka ka'a-i ta'nda'ku na.”  <div eID="gen892" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv547"/><div sID="gen893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv547"/> Puwas e', ah'lling si Yusup ma saga danakanna sampay ma lahasiya'na kamemon ya ma deyoman mma'na. Yukna, “Patut aku subay paharap ni Pira'un amata'uwan iya in dauranakanku sampay lahasiya'ku kamemon magt'kkahan na min lahat Kana'an. Itiya' na kam ma aku. Pata'uku isab iya pasal pagusahabi magipat bili-bili maka sapi', ya angkan tabowabi pi'itu ba'anan kahayopan maka pangalta' bay suku'bi ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 46:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv547"/><div sID="gen893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv547"/> Puwas e', ah'lling si Yusup ma saga danakanna sampay ma lahasiya'na kamemon ya ma deyoman mma'na. Yukna, “Patut aku subay paharap ni Pira'un amata'uwan iya in dauranakanku sampay lahasiya'ku kamemon magt'kkahan na min lahat Kana'an. Itiya' na kam ma aku. Pata'uku isab iya pasal pagusahabi magipat bili-bili maka sapi', ya angkan tabowabi pi'itu ba'anan kahayopan maka pangalta' bay suku'bi ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Genesis 46:33
verses.text: Jarina, bang kam sinō' patampal ni Pira'un bo' kam tinilaw bang ai pagusahabi,

verses.name: Genesis 46:34
verses.text: sambungunbi iya buwattitu, yukbi, ‘Ya kami sosoho'annu itu, a'a magi'ipat hayop asal min jaman kaonde'-onde' kami. Ang'ntan kami bay pagusaha ka'mbo'-mbo'an kami.’ Na, bang buwattē' panambungbi, tinugutun du kam pat'nna' ma lahat Gosen. Sababna ya addat bangsa Misil mbal magdalahat maka a'a magi'ipat hayop, asammal kono' ma pang'nda' sigām.”  <div eID="gen893" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.46"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:1
verses.text: Na, pehē' si Yusup ni Pira'un. Yukna ma iya, “Tuwan sultan, ilu na mma'ku maka saga danakanku at'kka min Kana'an. Tabowa e' sigām ba'anan saga kahayopan maka pangalta' sigām kamemon. Ina'an sigām ma jadjahan Gosen buwattina'an.”

verses.name: Genesis 47:2
verses.text: Manjari aniya' lima danakanna pinene' e' si Yusup pinakilā ma Pira'un.  <div eID="gen894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv548"/><div sID="gen895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv548"/> Tinilaw sigām e' Pira'un, “Ai usahabi?” <div eID="gen895" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen896" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Tuwan Pira'un, in kami sosoho'annu itu a'a magi'ipat bili-bili, buwat bay ka'mbo'-mbo'an kami.

verses.name: Genesis 47:4
verses.text: Bay kami pi'itu arak maglahat maitu sabab asigpit na gotom ma lahat Kana'an. Halam aniya' minsan sagmot pagkakan saga hayop kami. Angkan ko' kami parahing ni ka'a, Tuwan, bang pa'in kami tugutannu pat'nna' ma Gosen.”  <div eID="gen896" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv549"/><div sID="gen897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv549"/> Angabtang Pira'un ma si Yusup, yukna, “Na, pagka ilu na mma'-danakannu ma ka'a,

verses.name: Genesis 47:6
verses.text: makajari na sigām maglahat maingga-maingga kabaya'an sigām ma kaluha'an lahat Misil. Piha'in sigām tana' umbul-satu paglahatan sigām ma Gosen. Maka bang aniya' a'a kata'uwannu min sigām taga-kapandayan, pat'nna'un iya magmandul ma saga a'a ya magi'ipat ba'anan hayopku.”  <div eID="gen897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv550"/><div sID="gen898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv550"/> Pagpuwas ina'an, binowa e' si Yusup mma'na si Yakub pinakilā pehē' ni Pira'un. Ati angamu'an si Yakub pahala' ma Pira'un pangahulmatna ma iya.

verses.name: Genesis 47:8
verses.text: Jari aniya' patilaw Pira'un ma iya, yukna, “Pilantahun na umulnu, tuwan?”  <div eID="gen898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv551"/><div sID="gen899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv551"/> Ya sambung si Yakub, “Tuwan sultan, dahatus na maka t'llumpū' tahun ya paglunsul-lunsulku maitu ma dunya. Aheka isab kasukkalan bay kalabayanku. Sagō' mbal sakit at'ggol, ngga'i ka buwat bay paglunsul-lunsul kamatto'ahanku.”

verses.name: Genesis 47:10
verses.text: Na niamu'-amu'an Pira'un kahāpan isab e' si Yakub bo' yampa ama'id paluwas minnē'.  <div eID="gen899" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv552"/><div sID="gen900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv552"/> Manjari pinatuntul pahāp e' si Yusup paglahat mma'na maka saga danakanna maina'an ma lahat Misil. Bineya' e'na panoho'an Pira'un angkan disi Yakub kabuwanan tana' ahāp to'ongan ma jadjahan da'ira Ramisis.

verses.name: Genesis 47:12
verses.text: Jari amalanja' na pa'in si Yusup ma mma'na maka ma saga danakanna sampay ma lūng-kampungna kamemon. Talapay isab saga kamanahutan.  <div eID="gen900" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen849" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv553"/><div sID="gen901" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yusup maka Gotom Asigpit</title> <div sID="gen902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv553"/> Pasōng na pa'in kasigpit gotom sampay halam na to'ongan aniya' kinakan minsan maingga-maingga. Jari saga a'a kamemon ma kalahat-lahatan Misil maka Kana'an magkalammahan na e' punung.

verses.name: Genesis 47:14
verses.text: Magb'lli na pa'in sigām balanja' pehē' ni si Yusup. Tinipun e'na kamemon sīn pam'lli sigām bo' yampa bowana ni deyom astana' Pira'un.

verses.name: Genesis 47:15
verses.text: Na, apuppus pa'in saga sīn kamemon ma kalahatan Misil maka lahat Kana'an, pina'an ni si Yusup saga a'a Misil parahing. Yuk sigām, “Arōy, tuwan, buwanin kami pagkakan! Halam aniya' sīn kami pam'lli. Da'a pa'in kami pasagarin amatay e' punung itu!”  <div eID="gen902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv554"/><div sID="gen903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv554"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Bang hati' halam aniya' sīnbi, na, bowahun pi'itu saga hayopbi panambi' kinakan.”

verses.name: Genesis 47:17
verses.text: Manjari binowa saga hayop sigām, saga kura', bili-bili, kambing maka sapi'. Binowa e' sigām pehē' ni si Yusup panambi' pagkakan. Jari aniya' kinakan pamalanja' sigām e' si Yusup ma deyom dantahun inān, panambi' saga hayop sigām.  <div eID="gen903" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv555"/><div sID="gen904" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv555"/> Aubus pa'in dantahun e', pabalik na isab sigām pehē' ni si Yusup. Ya lling sigām, “Tuwan, mbal kalimbungan kami min ka'a, halam na aniya' sīn kami maka ilu ma ka'a isab saga hayop kami kamemon. Halam aniya' takapin pamuwan kami ma ka'a, luwal baran kami maka tana' kami.

verses.name: Genesis 47:19
verses.text: Ndū' tuwan, da'a kami pasagarin pinunung. Kaugun isab tana' kami bang halam aniya' makapajatu iya. B'llihun baran kami sampay tana' kami panambi' kinakan. Minsan kami pina'ata ma Pira'un, minsan tana' kami pinasuku' ma iya, bang pa'in kami mbal amatay gotom. Buwanin kami isab binhi' tinanom bo' mbal kaugun tana' kami.”  <div eID="gen904" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv556"/><div sID="gen905" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv556"/> Na, pagka buwattē' kabisa gotom, tab'lli e' si Yusup tana' kamemon bay suku' saga a'a Misil pakaniya-pakaniya. Manjari Pira'un na tag-tana' kamemon,

verses.name: Genesis 47:21
verses.text: ati saga a'a kamemon ma lahat Misil tahinang atana ma sabab hinang si Yusup.

verses.name: Genesis 47:22
verses.text: Ya sadja halam tab'lli e' si Yusup tana' saga kaimaman. Aniya' balanja' sigām min Pira'un sakahaba' llaw, angkan halam bay tapab'lli saga tana' sigām.  <div eID="gen905" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv557"/><div sID="gen906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv557"/> Manjari aniya' pamissala si Yusup ma saga a'a inān kamemon, yukna, “Na buwattina'an, pagka tab'lliku ka'am sampay tana'bi bo' kam suku' Pira'un na, na, itiya' na saga binhi' pananombi ma deyom tana'.

verses.name: Genesis 47:24
verses.text: Malaingkan, bang kam magani buwa' tinanombi, ya buwa'na subay binahagi' palima. Dabahagi' ilu subay pinasuku' ma Pira'un, ya mpat bahagi' takapin subay ma ka'am bo' aniya' pananombi pabīng maka aniya' takakanbi magtai'anak.”  <div eID="gen906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv558"/><div sID="gen907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv558"/> Ya sambung sigām “Tuwan, kalappasan kami min kamatay sabab ka'a. Bang pa'in ahāp sadja ataynu tudju ni kami, kami itu magpa'ata na ma Pira'un.”  <div eID="gen907" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv559"/><div sID="gen908" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv559"/> Manjari aniya' sara' pinat'nna' e' si Yusup ma lahat Misil, subay pinasuku' ma Pira'un bahagi' lima min ai-ai pinagani ma deyom lahat. Bineya' sara' inān sampay ni kabuwattina'anan. Luwal tana' saga kaimaman halam bay pinasuku' ma Pira'un.  <div eID="gen908" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen901" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv560"/><div sID="gen909" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yakub Ang'bba Bissalana Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen910" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv560"/> Manjari maglahat na bangsa Isra'il ma Gosen, ma deyom lahat Misil. Pasōng heka puhu' sigām, pasōng isab heka pangalta' sigām.  <div eID="gen910" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv561"/><div sID="gen911" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv561"/> Sangpū' maka pituntahun ya paglahat si Yakub mahē' ma Misil sampay dahatus maka mpatpū' maka pituntahun umulna.

verses.name: Genesis 47:29
verses.text: Manjari itu, song pa'in ta'abut waktuna, nilinganan e'na anakna si Yusup. Yukna, “Bang ka'a-i alasa du ma aku, pat'nna'un lagi' tangannu ma llotan pa'aku bo' yampa ka magsapa in janji'nu ma aku mbal binalubahan. Janji'in aku in aku mbal kubulnu maitu ma lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 47:30
verses.text: Bilahi aku kinubul ma pangubulan saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anku. Angkan na bang aku amatay, bowahun bangkayku paluwas min Misil itu ati kubulunbi aku ma bay pagkubulan sigām.” <div eID="gen911" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen912" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Aho' Mma', beya'ku llingnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen912" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv562"/><div sID="gen913" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv562"/> “Magsapa ka,” yuk si Yakub e'. Agsai pinagsapahan e' si Yusup. Manjari mahē' na si Yakub patukku' ma pabahakanna angamu' duwa'a ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen913" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.47"/> <div eID="gen909" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv563"/><div sID="gen914" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Epra'im maka si Manasse</title> <div sID="gen915" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv563"/> Palabay pa'in waktu, kahaka'an si Yusup pasal mma'na alamma na, angkan iya patibaw pehē'. Binowa isab e'na karuwangan anakna si Manasse maka si Epra'im.

verses.name: Genesis 48:2
verses.text: Pagta'u si Yakub ilu na at'kka si Yusup, magtūy iya pakulasog papunduk.

verses.name: Genesis 48:3
verses.text: Ah'lling iya ma si Yusup, yukna, “Waktu kamahē'ku lagi' ma Lūs ya ma lahat Kana'an, bay magpa'nda' ma aku Tuhan Sangat Kawasa. Aniya' kahāpan pamuwanna ma aku,

verses.name: Genesis 48:4
verses.text: yukna, ‘Pahekaku panubu'nu sampay sigām tahinang kabangsa-bangsahan. Pamuwanku isab lahat Kana'an ilu palsuku'an saga panubu'nu sampay ni kasaumulan.’ ”  <div eID="gen915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv564"/><div sID="gen916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv564"/> Magsibahat na pa'in si Yakub ma si Yusup, yukna, “Yusup, in pasal anaknu, ya bay nianakan ma lahat Misil dahū gi' min kapi'ituku, in sigām karuwangan subay pamasuku' ma aku. Aho', si Epra'im maka si Manasse subay ni'itung anakku luggiya' buwat si Rubin maka si Simiyun.

verses.name: Genesis 48:6
verses.text: Malaingkan bang aniya' gi' anaknu liyu min sigām duwangan itu, suku'nu na. Maka tana' pamusaka' sigām subay niā' min bahagi' tana' ya pamasuku' ma si Epra'im maka si Manasse.

verses.name: Genesis 48:7
verses.text: Ina'nu si Rakiya ya sababanna angkan sigām ni'itung anakku. Landu' aheya dukkaku ma kamatayna. Ma l'ngnganan pa'in kami pabīng ni Kana'an min lahat Mesopotami, alawak-lawak gi' min kauman Eprata, amatay na iya. Jari takubulku iya mahē' ma bihing lān tudju ni Eprata.” Eprata itu, ya na Betlehem ma buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen916" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv565"/><div sID="gen917" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv565"/> Manjari pag'nda' si Yakub ma saga anak si Yusup, atilaw iya, “Sai saga onde' itu?”  <div eID="gen917" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv566"/><div sID="gen918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv566"/> Ya sambung si Yusup, “Mma', ya na ko' itu anakku l'lla bay pamuwan Tuhan ma aku maitu ma Misil.” <div eID="gen918" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen919" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Yakub, “Pasōngun sigām pi'itu supaya sigām kapangamu'anku kahāpan min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv567"/><div sID="gen920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv567"/> Na si Yakub itu, mbal agon maka'nda' sabab ato'a na iya to'ongan. Angkan pinasekot e' si Yusup saga anakna. Magtūy sigām ginapus e' si Yakub sampay siniyum.

verses.name: Genesis 48:11
verses.text: Yuk si Yakub ma si Yusup, “Halam aku bay makaholat ang'nda' ka'a pabīng, daipara kahandak min Tuhan itiya' ka ta'nda'ku sampay isab anaknu.”  <div eID="gen920" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv568"/><div sID="gen921" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv568"/> Pagpuwas, pinala'an e' si Yusup anakna min gibahan mma'na bo' yampa iya pasujud ma dahuanna.

verses.name: Genesis 48:13
verses.text: Manjari binalutan e' si Yusup anakna duwangan bo' pinasekot ni si Yakub. Si Epra'im ya pinasekot ni tangan si Yakub gibang, si Manasse ni tanganna kowan.

verses.name: Genesis 48:14
verses.text: Saguwā' pinagsaliyu e' si Yakub tangan mma'na bo' pinat'nna' tanganna kowan ma kōk si Epra'im minsan iya siyali. Maka tanganna gibang pinat'nna' ma kōk si Manasse, ya siyaka.  <div eID="gen921" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv569"/><div sID="gen922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv569"/> Pagbuwattē', niamu'an duwa'a disi Yusup e' si Yakub, yukna, <lg sID="gen923"/> <l level="1" sID="gen924"/>“Bang pa'in saga onde' itu binuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan<l eID="gen924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen925"/>ya pameya'an mbo'ku si Ibrahim maka mma'ku si Isa'ak.<l eID="gen925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen926"/>Bang pa'in sigām pinat'kkahan lidjiki' e' Tuhan,<l eID="gen926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen927"/>ya bay angupiksa' aku min kanahutku sampay ni kabuwattituku,<l eID="gen927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen928"/>Bang pa'in nianughala'an duwangan onde' itu e' Mala'ikat<l eID="gen928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen929"/>ya bay amapuwas aku min kamulahan kamemon.<l eID="gen929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen930"/>Bang pa'in sigām pas'lle' amowa ōnku<l eID="gen930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen931"/>maka ōn mma'ku si Isa'ak sampay ōn mbo'ku si Ibrahim.<l eID="gen931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen932"/>Bang pa'in paheka to'ongan isab<l eID="gen932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen933"/>saga panubu' sigām maitu ma babaw dunya itu.”<l eID="gen933" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen923"/>  <div eID="gen922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv569"/><div sID="gen922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv569"/> Pagbuwattē', niamu'an duwa'a disi Yusup e' si Yakub, yukna, <lg sID="gen923"/> <l level="1" sID="gen924"/>“Bang pa'in saga onde' itu binuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan<l eID="gen924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen925"/>ya pameya'an mbo'ku si Ibrahim maka mma'ku si Isa'ak.<l eID="gen925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen926"/>Bang pa'in sigām pinat'kkahan lidjiki' e' Tuhan,<l eID="gen926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen927"/>ya bay angupiksa' aku min kanahutku sampay ni kabuwattituku,<l eID="gen927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen928"/>Bang pa'in nianughala'an duwangan onde' itu e' Mala'ikat<l eID="gen928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen929"/>ya bay amapuwas aku min kamulahan kamemon.<l eID="gen929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen930"/>Bang pa'in sigām pas'lle' amowa ōnku<l eID="gen930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen931"/>maka ōn mma'ku si Isa'ak sampay ōn mbo'ku si Ibrahim.<l eID="gen931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen932"/>Bang pa'in paheka to'ongan isab<l eID="gen932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen933"/>saga panubu' sigām maitu ma babaw dunya itu.”<l eID="gen933" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen923"/>  <div eID="gen922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv570"/><div sID="gen934" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv570"/> Na, pag'nda' si Yusup ma mma'na amat'nna' tanganna kowan ma kōk si Epra'im, halam iya kasulutan. Binalutan e'na tangan mma'na kowan, arak pinat'nna' ma kōk si Manasse.

verses.name: Genesis 48:18
verses.text: Yukna ma mma'na, “Mma', asā' ko' ilu! Ya itu siyaka, ya subay pinat'nna'an tangannu kowan.”  <div eID="gen934" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv571"/><div sID="gen935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv571"/> Sagō' mbal bilahi si Yakub, yukna, “Aho' Otō', kata'uwanku du. Si Manasse ilu b'nnal paheka panubu'na tahinang bangsa ga'osan. Malaingkan siyalina ya labi akosog min iya. Saga panubu' si Epra'im itu subay paheka to'ongan sampay sigām tahinang aheka bangsa gaga'osan.”

verses.name: Genesis 48:20
verses.text: Manjari niamu'-amu'an sigām kahāpan ma llaw ina'an-i. Yuk si Yakub, <lg sID="gen936"/> <l level="1" sID="gen937"/>“Ma tahun sinōng, bang aniya' a'a Isra'il angamu'an kahāpan ma sai-sai, ōnbi ya panabbutanna.<l eID="gen937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen938"/>Buwattitu ya pangamu' sigām, ‘Bang pa'in kam binuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan<l eID="gen938" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen939"/>buwat bay ma si Epra'im maka si Manasse.’ ”<l eID="gen939" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen936"/> <div eID="gen935" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen940" type="paragraph"/> Buwattē' pah'lling si Yakub, pagka paheyana si Epra'im labi min si Manasse.  <div eID="gen940" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv572"/><div sID="gen941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv572"/> Puwas e', ah'lling isab si Yakub ma anakna si Yusup, yukna, “Nda'un, asekot na waktuku. Saguwā' mbal kam pinasagaran e' Tuhan. Pagapi' du iya ma ka'am bo' kam tabowana pabīng ni lahat ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi.

verses.name: Genesis 48:22
verses.text: Ma deyom saga anakku, ka'a ya pusaka'anku tana' lahat Sekem, ya tana' ahāp ma kabūd-būran bay ngā'ku min bangsa Amor. Ya bay pangā'ku iya pakokosku kalis maka pana'.”  <div eID="gen941" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.48"/> <div eID="gen914" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv573"/><div sID="gen942" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Kabtangan Pang'bba e' si Yakub</title> <div sID="gen943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv573"/> Manjari nilinganan e' si Yakub saga anakna kamemon. “Pasekot kam,” yukna, “patipun kam ni aku. Haka'anta kam dangan maka dangan bang ai ya kasōnganbi ma tahun damuli. <lg sID="gen944"/> <l level="1" sID="gen945"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:2
verses.text: Patipun kam saga anak si Yakub,<l eID="gen945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen946"/>pakale kam ma pangabtang ya pang'bbahan ka'am e' mma'bi si Isra'il.<l eID="gen946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen947"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:3
verses.text: Ka'a Rubin, anakku kasiyakahan,<l eID="gen947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen948"/>anak min kosogku, paltanda'an pagkal'llaku.<l eID="gen948" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen949"/>Min kamemon saga anakku,<l eID="gen949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen950"/>ka'a ya pagmakōkan akosog maka abantug.<l eID="gen950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen951"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:4
verses.text: Saguwā' ya salla'nu, bay pakaiya'nu mma'nu<l eID="gen951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen952"/>pagka hulidnu h'ndana dakayu'.<l eID="gen952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen953"/>Napsunu ilu sali' dunuk mbal katiyara'an,<l eID="gen953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen954"/>angkan ka mbal na makalanga min dauranakannu.<l eID="gen954" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen955"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:5
verses.text: Ka'am Simiyun maka Libi, dalimbang du kam.<l eID="gen955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen956"/>Mbal aku bilahi palamud ma pagisunanbi,<l eID="gen956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen957"/>mbal pasōd ni deyom palhimpunanbi.<l eID="gen957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen958"/>Asapat kam angahublut pakokosbi<l eID="gen958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen959"/>ma saukat apasu' pangatayanbi.<l eID="gen959" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen960"/>Bang kam niastolan, magtūy kam amono' a'a,<l eID="gen960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen961"/>tapengkolbi saga sapi' mandangan ma halam sababna.<l eID="gen961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen962"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:6
verses.text: Ka'am Simiyun maka Libi, dalimbang du kam.<l eID="gen955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen956"/>Mbal aku bilahi palamud ma pagisunanbi,<l eID="gen956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen957"/>mbal pasōd ni deyom palhimpunanbi.<l eID="gen957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen958"/>Asapat kam angahublut pakokosbi<l eID="gen958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen959"/>ma saukat apasu' pangatayanbi.<l eID="gen959" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen960"/>Bang kam niastolan, magtūy kam amono' a'a,<l eID="gen960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen961"/>tapengkolbi saga sapi' mandangan ma halam sababna.<l eID="gen961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen962"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:7
verses.text: Bang pa'in kam pinat'kkahan mulka'<l eID="gen962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen963"/>ma sabab pangastolbi mbal tasangsang.<l eID="gen963" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen964"/>Pinapulak-palik saga panubu'bi<l eID="gen964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen965"/>ma katilibutan lahat Isra'il.<l eID="gen965" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen966"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:8
verses.text: Na, ka'a Yahud,<note>Yahud (atawa Yuda), ōn pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘pudji’ atawa ‘bantug’.</note> pinudji du ka e' saga dauranakannu.<l eID="gen966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen967"/>Pasujud sigām pagmahaltabat ma ka'a.<l eID="gen967" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen968"/>Tara'ugnu du palbantahannu.<l eID="gen968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen969"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:9
verses.text: Ka'a ilu ibarat halimaw asangpot kosogna.<l eID="gen969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen970"/>Bang aubus e'na an'kkob hayop maka amangan<l eID="gen970" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen971"/>magtūy pah'nnat atuli ma tongod ina'an.<l eID="gen971" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen972"/>Halam aniya' makatawakkal pasekot anasat iya.<l eID="gen972" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen973"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:10
verses.text: Saga panubu'nu, Yahud, sinusultan salama-lama.<l eID="gen973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen974"/>Mbal alungay kapatutnu kapagsultan<l eID="gen974" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen975"/>sampay at'kka a'a dangan ya apatut pinaghulmatan.<l eID="gen975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen976"/>Kapagbaya'anna saga kabangsa-bangsahan.<l eID="gen976" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen977"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:11
verses.text: Kaengkotan kura'na ni batang anggul,<l eID="gen977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen978"/>ya ahāp suliganna min kamemon.<l eID="gen978" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen979"/>Ajatu to'ongan ba'anan buwa' anggulna,<l eID="gen979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen980"/>landu' aheka bohe'na bang tap'gga',<l eID="gen980" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen981"/>manjari pangandakdakan s'mmekna.<l eID="gen981" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen982"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:12
verses.text: Matana arokot keyatna min bohe' anggul,<l eID="gen982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen983"/>emponna apote' sidda min gatas.<l eID="gen983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen984"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:13
verses.text: Na, anakku si Sibulun, bihing tahik ya paglahatanna,<l eID="gen984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen985"/>manjari paglalayohan kappal.<l eID="gen985" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen986"/>Aluha isab tana'na, maka'abut sampay ni lahat Sidun.<l eID="gen986" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen987"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:14
verses.text: Na, si Issakar, sali' sapantun kura' akosog baranna,<l eID="gen987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen988"/>pabahak sadja ma t'ngnga' duwa'anna.<l eID="gen988" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen989"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:15
verses.text: Pagsayuna ahāp pabahakanna,<l eID="gen989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen990"/>magtūy iya amuspus kosogna angahangkut.<l eID="gen990" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen991"/>Pagsayuna ahāp paglahatanna,<l eID="gen991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen992"/>magtūy iya lilla' pina'ata maghulas-magsangsā'.<l eID="gen992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen993"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:16
verses.text: Anakku si Dān, amat'nna' hukuman abontol<l eID="gen993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen994"/>ma saga a'ana, pagka dapanubu' sigām ma bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen995"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:17
verses.text: Ibarat iya sowa abisa pat'nna' ma bihing lān.<l eID="gen995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen996"/>Bang aniya' palabay minna'an a'a magkura',<l eID="gen996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen997"/>tinanghab e'na kura' inān ma buli' tape'na<l eID="gen997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen998"/>supaya pahantak ni buli'an a'a angura' he'.<l eID="gen998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen999"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:18
verses.text: O Yawe, lagaranku waktu pangalappasnu ma aku.<l eID="gen999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1000"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:19
verses.text: Na, anakku si Gād isab,<l eID="gen1000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1001"/>nilangpasan ko' ka'a ilu e' saga mundu,<l eID="gen1001" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1002"/>sagō' taturulnu sigām sampay ka'atuhannu.<l eID="gen1002" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1003"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:20
verses.text: Si Aser isab, alanab kinakan ya niā' min tana'nu,<l eID="gen1003" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1004"/>kinakan ahāp nanamna patut pagkakan sultan.<l eID="gen1004" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1005"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:21
verses.text: Si Naptali isab,<l eID="gen1005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1006"/>sali' sapantun usa d'nda bay pinal'ppa min sasak.<l eID="gen1006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1007"/>Alingkat isab saga anakna.<l eID="gen1007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1008"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:22
verses.text: Na, anakku si Yusup,<l eID="gen1008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1009"/>sali' hantang po'on kayu ajatu to'ongan buwa'na,<l eID="gen1009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1010"/>ya patomo' asal ma bihing bohe'.<l eID="gen1010" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1011"/>Palabung saga sanga sampay parambila' sasak.<l eID="gen1011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1012"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:23
verses.text: Nirugpak iya e' saga a'a magtakos pana',<l eID="gen1012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1013"/>nijingki iya e' sigām.<l eID="gen1013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1014"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:24
verses.text: Malaingkan atotog l'ngngonna, ahogot e'na ang'ntan pana'<l eID="gen1014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1015"/>ma sabab tabang min Tuhan Sangat Kawasa,<l eID="gen1015" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1016"/>ya Tuhan pagtuhanan si Yakub.<l eID="gen1016" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1017"/>Niupiksa' iya e' Tuhan, ya Batu-Lakit pasindungan bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen1017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1018"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:25
verses.text: Tinabang du si Yusup e' Tuhanku ya pagtuhanan mma'nu,<l eID="gen1018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1019"/>binarakatan ka e' Tuhan Sangat Kawasa.<l eID="gen1019" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1020"/>Kabuwanan ka kahāpan,<l eID="gen1020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1021"/>ulan min diyata' langit, bohe' min deyom tana',<l eID="gen1021" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1022"/>kahāpan panganak maka kahāpan pamaruru'.<l eID="gen1022" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1023"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:26
verses.text: In lidjiki' pangamu'-ngamu'anku ka'a itu<l eID="gen1023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1024"/>labi ahāp min lidjiki' kabūd-būran, lidjiki' bay min awal.<l eID="gen1024" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1025"/>Mura-murahan, bang pa'in saga lidjiki' itu kamemon makani-si Yusup,<l eID="gen1025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1026"/>ya tapene' e' Tuhan pinaliyu min dauranakanna.<l eID="gen1026" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1027"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:27
verses.text: Anakku isab si Benjamin,<l eID="gen1027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1028"/>a'a aesog iya, sali' sapantun ero' talun.<l eID="gen1028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1029"/>Subu-subu amangan ai-ai bay papatayna.<l eID="gen1029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1030"/>Abay kohap amahagi' ai-ai bay tatabanna ma pagbono'an.”<l eID="gen1030" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen944"/>  <div eID="gen943" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv574"/><div sID="gen1031" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv574"/> Na, ya du ina'an saga bangsa Isra'il kasangpū' maka duwa. Ya ina'an kabtangan bay pang'bba e' si Yakub ma anakna kasangpū' maka duwa, ya makatōpan sigām dangan maka dangan.  <div eID="gen1031" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen942" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv575"/><div sID="gen1032" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kawapat si Yakub maka pagkubul ma iya</title> <div sID="gen1033" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv575"/> Manjari aniya' panoho'an pang'bba e' si Yakub ma saga anakna he', “Itiya' aku arai' na patipun ni ka'mbo'-mbo'anku. Bang aku ta'abut na, kubulunbi aku ma deyom songab batu bay pangubulan ka'mbo'-mbo'anku. Ina'an ma lahat Kana'an, ma tana' Makpela ya ma anggopan Mamre. Songab batu inān sampay tana'na bay tab'lli e' mbo'ku si Ibrahim min si Epron bangsa Hīt.

verses.name: Genesis 49:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv575"/><div sID="gen1032" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kawapat si Yakub maka pagkubul ma iya</title> <div sID="gen1033" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv575"/> Manjari aniya' panoho'an pang'bba e' si Yakub ma saga anakna he', “Itiya' aku arai' na patipun ni ka'mbo'-mbo'anku. Bang aku ta'abut na, kubulunbi aku ma deyom songab batu bay pangubulan ka'mbo'-mbo'anku. Ina'an ma lahat Kana'an, ma tana' Makpela ya ma anggopan Mamre. Songab batu inān sampay tana'na bay tab'lli e' mbo'ku si Ibrahim min si Epron bangsa Hīt.

verses.name: Genesis 49:31
verses.text: Ina'an maina'an pagkubulan si Ibrahim maka h'ndana si Sara, mma'ku si Isa'ak maka ina'ku si Ripka. Ina'an isab pagkubulanku h'ndaku si Leya.

verses.name: Genesis 49:32
verses.text: Ya tana' maka songab ilu bay tab'lli min saga bangsa Hīt.”  <div eID="gen1033" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv576"/><div sID="gen1034" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv576"/> Aubus pa'in e' si Yakub ang'bba panoho'anna inān ma saga anakna, magtūy iya pabahak bo' yampa ab'kkat napasna. Hatina magtipun na iya maka kamatto'ahanna.  <div eID="gen1034" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gen.49"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:1
verses.text: Awapat pa'in si Yakub, magtūy iya ginapus pahogot e' anakna si Yusup. Tinangisan iya, siniyum isab baihu'na.

verses.name: Genesis 50:2
verses.text: Pagpuwas, magpanoho'an si Yusup ma saga panday ya tendogna, sinō' kinapul bangkay mma'na.

verses.name: Genesis 50:3
verses.text: Manjari aniya' mpatpū' llaw ya t'ggol sigām magkapul. Addat Misil ko' inān. Pitumpū' llaw isab ya paghinang saga a'a Misil pagdukka sigām ma iya.  <div eID="gen1035" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv577"/><div sID="gen1036" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv577"/> Atammat pa'in paghinang e', ah'lling si Yusup ma saga tendog Pira'un, yukna, “Bang makajari, pasampayunbi lapalku itu pehē' ni Pira'un, yukbi,

verses.name: Genesis 50:5
verses.text: ‘Tuwan sultan, marai' pa'in waktu mma'ku, bay aku pinasapa e'na. Bangkayna kono' subay kinubul ma lahat Kana'an, ma pagkubulan bay tagamahanna ma baranna. Jari makasapa aku, ya angkan subay beya'ku na. Angamu' aku ma ka'a, Tuwan, bang pa'in aku tugutannu pehē' ni Kana'an angubul mma'ku.’ Pabalik du aku pi'itu bang aubus na.”  <div eID="gen1036" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv578"/><div sID="gen1037" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv578"/> Ya sambung Pira'un ma si Yusup, “Makajari,” yukna. “Pehē' na ka angubul mma'nu. Beya'un bay pagsapahannu maka iya.”  <div eID="gen1037" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv579"/><div sID="gen1038" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv579"/> Manjari palanjal na si Yusup angubul mma'na. Pabunyug isab ma iya kamemon saga tendog ya pagnakura'an ma okoman Pira'un, ma deyom astana' ka atawa ma kaluha'an lahat Misil.

verses.name: Genesis 50:8
verses.text: Ya du pabunyug ma si Yusup saga dauranakanna maka saga a'a kamemon ya ma deyomanna. Tabeya' isab saga a'a bay ma deyoman mma' sigām. Ya sadja halam tabeya' kamanahutan maka ba'anan hayop sigām. Tabba maina'an ma Gosen.

verses.name: Genesis 50:9
verses.text: Aniya' pagapi' ma sigām saga a'a magkakaritun sampay saga a'a magkukura'. Jari landu' aheka sigām bay maglurukan angubul mma' si Yusup.  <div eID="gen1038" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv580"/><div sID="gen1039" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv580"/> Ta'abut pa'in sigām paggi'ikan pai ma Atad, ma bihing sapa' Jordan, magkarukka'an sigām ma mma' si Yusup. Akosog sidda pagdukka sigām. Jari pitumbahangi ya t'ggol paghinang si Yusup ma mma'na ma atag ina'an.

verses.name: Genesis 50:11
verses.text: Na pag'nda' paghinang itu e' saga bangsa Kana'an ya maglahat maina'an, yuk sigām, “Kaheya du pa'in karukka'an saga bangsa Misil e'.” Angkan kaōnan lahat inān Abel Misraim.<note>Ya ōn Abel Misraim itu pa'anggil ma kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘saga a'a Misil magkarukka'an.’</note>  <div eID="gen1039" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv581"/><div sID="gen1040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv581"/> Na, bineya' e' saga anak si Yakub buwat bay panoho'anna ma sigām.

verses.name: Genesis 50:13
verses.text: Binowa bangkayna ni lahat Kana'an bo' kinubul e' sigām ma deyom songab batu ma tana' Makpela ya ma anggopan Mamre. Tana' inān bay tab'lli asal e' si Ibrahim min si Epron bangsa Hīt bo' pagkubulan.

verses.name: Genesis 50:14
verses.text: Na, takubul pa'in, pabalik na disi Yusup ni lahat Misil, iya maka saga danakanna sampay sigām kamemon bay amunyugan mma'na he'.  <div eID="gen1040" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1032" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv582"/><div sID="gen1041" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinasannang e' si Yusup Pangatayan saga Danakanna</title> <div sID="gen1042" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv582"/> Na, pagka amatay na mma' sigām, magisun-isun saga danakan si Yusup. Yuk sigām, “Kalu aniya' akon-akon tatau' e' si Yusup ma deyom atayna pasal kala'atan kamemon bay tahinangtam ma iya. Painay bang kitam binalosan e'na?”

verses.name: Genesis 50:16
verses.text: Manjari anambuku sigām pehē' ni si Yusup, yuk-i, “Tuwan, ma halam lagi' amatay Mma'tam, aniya' bay panoho'anna.

verses.name: Genesis 50:17
verses.text: Sinō' ka tinambukuhan buwattitu: ‘Ampunun dauranakannu ma pasal dusa maka kala'atan bay tahinang sigām ma ka'a.’ Ya du ilu panambuku si Mma' ma ka'a. Manjari, Tuwan, itiya' kami parahing ma ka'a bang pa'in kami ampunnu, pagka in kami itu ata Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'tam.” Na, pagkale lapal itu e' si Yusup, magtūy iya tatangis.  <div eID="gen1042" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv583"/><div sID="gen1043" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv583"/> Puwas e', patampal saga danakanna ni si Yusup bo' yampa sigām pak'ppang ni tana' ma munda'anna. Ya lling sigām ma iya, “Tuwan, itiya' kami magpatiata ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen1043" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv584"/><div sID="gen1044" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv584"/> Sagō' ya sambung si Yusup ma sigām, “Da'a kam tināw ma aku. Ngga'i ka aku ya magbaya', luwal Tuhan.

verses.name: Genesis 50:20
verses.text: B'nnal, ala'at asal bay maksudbi, sagō' kahāpan ya pangangganti' e' Tuhan, ya angkan tahinang hinangku itu angalappasan manusiya' aheka min kamatay.

verses.name: Genesis 50:21
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am, da'a kam agawa. Akuhanku balanja'bi sampay saga ka'anakanbi.” Sakali asannang na pangatayan sigām ma sabab kahanunut bissala si Yusup e'.  <div eID="gen1044" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1041" type="section"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv585"/><div sID="gen1045" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kawapat si Yusup</title> <div sID="gen1046" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv585"/> Manjari maina'an na pa'in si Yusup pat'nna' ma lahat Misil maka saga a'a kamemon bay ma okoman mma'na. Allum iya sampay dahatus maka sangpū' tahun umulna.

verses.name: Genesis 50:23
verses.text: Ta'abutna saga anak-mpu si Epra'im, maka tagibana isab mpu si Manasse min anakna si Makil.  <div eID="gen1046" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv586"/><div sID="gen1047" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv586"/> Na, angabtang na si Yusup ma saga danakanna, yukna, “Aku itu arai' na ta'abut, sagō' ka'am ilu tinabang du e' Tuhan. Ma waktu sinōng binowa kam e'na paluwas min lahat itu tudju ni lahat bay panganjanji'na ma kamatto'ahantam disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.”

verses.name: Genesis 50:25
verses.text: Jari pinasapa e' si Yusup saga pagkahina panubu' si Isra'il (ya kaōnan isab si Yakub). “Sapahinbi aku,” yukna, “in to'olangku bowabi du bang ta'abut waktu panabang Tuhan ma ka'am paluwas min lahat itu.”  <div eID="gen1047" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv587"/><div sID="gen1048" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv587"/> Manjari awapat na si Yusup maina'an ma Misil, dahatus maka sangpū' tahun umulna. Kinapul bangkayna bo' yampa ni'isi ni deyom lalungan.  <div eID="gen1048" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1045" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Gen.50"/> <div eID="gen1" osisID="Gen" type="book"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv588"/><div sID="gen1056" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabinasahan Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen1057" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv588"/> Na, ya na itu saga anak nabi Isra'il l'lla ya bay ameya' ma iya papinda ni lahat Misil maka anak-h'nda sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 1:2
verses.text: Ōn sigām si Rubin, si Simiyun, si Libi maka si Yuda,

verses.name: Exodus 1:3
verses.text: si Issakar, si Sibulun maka si Benjamin,

verses.name: Exodus 1:4
verses.text: si Dān, si Naptali, si Gād maka si Aser.

verses.name: Exodus 1:5
verses.text: Pitumpū' ya heka saga panubu' si Isra'il kamemon ma waktu ina'an-i, sagō' anakna si Yusup halam bay taitung sabab wa'i asal ma Misil.  <div eID="gen1057" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv589"/><div sID="gen1058" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv589"/> Manjari palabay pa'in patahunan, amatay na disi Yusup magdauranakan sampay anak-mpu sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 1:7
verses.text: Malaingkan saga tubu' sigām anganak paheka sampay asaplag na ma lahat Misil. Makalandu' na heka sigām.  <div eID="gen1058" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv590"/><div sID="gen1059" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv590"/> Manjari itu, ma masa damuli gi', aniya' sultan saddī aningkō' magsultan ma lahat Misil, sultan a'awam ma pasal bay kahālan si Yusup.

verses.name: Exodus 1:9
verses.text: Yuk sultan itu ma saga a'ana, “Nda'unbi na saga a'a Isra'il ilu, makalandu' to'ongan heka sigām, mbal na ka'atuhantam.

verses.name: Exodus 1:10
verses.text: Jari in kitam itu subay maggara' pahāp. Bang pasagaranta sigām paheka, bo' aniya' bantatam ganta' parugpak pi'itu, piligdu. Pagapi' arai' bangsa Isra'il itu ma saga bantatam. Magdakayu' sigām amono' kitam ati makaluwas sigām min lahat Misil itu.”  <div eID="gen1059" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv591"/><div sID="gen1060" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv591"/> Ya he' sababna angkan aniya' saga a'a Misil bay gin'llal amanyaga' ma saga a'a Isra'il. Abuhat makalandu' ya hinang pamahinang e' saga bag'llal itu ma saga a'a Isra'il angkan sigām mbal na aholat nilappasan. Aniya' duwa da'ira nihinang e' sigām pagtau'an ba'anan anihan tinanom ya suku' Pira'un.<note>Pira'un: bahasa Misil pangangg'llal ma sasuku pinatingkō' magsultan ma kaluha'an lahat Misil ma masa he'-i. Ngga'i ka ōn pangōn sultan dangan.</note> Pitum maka Ramisis ya pagōn saga da'ira he'.

verses.name: Exodus 1:12
verses.text: Sagō' minsan buwattingga e' saga a'a Misil amanyaga' ma bangsa Isra'il, luhūy pasōng heka sigām sampay pasaplag na ma kaluha'an lahat. Angkan sigām kinagawahan e' saga bangsa Misil,

verses.name: Exodus 1:13
verses.text: manjari gom pa'in pinabuhatan saga hinang ya pamahinang e' saga a'a Misil ma bangsa Isra'il e'.

verses.name: Exodus 1:14
verses.text: Pinahunitan sidda kahālan sigām, mbal agon kasandalan. Sinō' sigām angahinang saga luma' tisa'<note>Tisa', sali' haloblāk, sagō' tana' ya pangahinang iya.</note> maka sinō' maghinang abuhat ma kahuma-huma'an. Jari ab'ngngis saga a'a Misil, mbal to'ongan ma'ase'.  <div eID="gen1060" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv592"/><div sID="gen1061" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv592"/> Manjari itu ma dakayu' llaw pa'in, aniya' panoho'an sultan Misil ma si Sipra maka si Puwa, duwangan panday ya magpa'anak ma saga d'nda Hibrani<note>‘Hibrani’, ōn dakayu' pangōn bangsa Isra'il.</note>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:16
verses.text: Ya panoho'an sultan ma sigām, “Ka'am ilu,” yukna, “bang kam ama'anak ma saga kar'ndahan Hibrani bo' ta'nda'bi l'lla ya anakna, papatayhunbi saru'un-du'un. Bang d'nda, pasagarinbi allum.”

verses.name: Exodus 1:17
verses.text: Sagō' saga panday inān magmatāw asal ma Tuhan angkan halam bineya' e' sigām bay panoho'an sultan e'. Halam pinapatay saga onde'-onde' l'lla bay nianakan.

verses.name: Exodus 1:18
verses.text: Na, pagka buwattē', pinalinganan pabalik saga panday itu e' sultan bo' tinilaw e'na. “Angay,” yukna, “halam beya'bi panoho'anku? Angay pakallumbi saga onde'-onde' l'lla bay nianakan?”  <div eID="gen1061" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv593"/><div sID="gen1062" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv593"/> Anambung sigām ma Pira'un, yuk-i, “Tuwan sultan, ya b'nnalna, in d'nda Hibrani kaluhayan sidda bang maganak, ngga'i ka buwat saga d'nda Misil. Pagt'kka panday ni luma', ina'an na asal ma luwasan onde'-onde'.”  <div eID="gen1062" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv594"/><div sID="gen1063" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv594"/> Manjari nihāp duwangan panday inān e' Tuhan ma sabab pagaddat sigām ma iya, ati kabuwanan sigām tubu'. Maka ba'anan bangsa Isra'il isab gom pa'in paheka.

verses.name: Exodus 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv594"/><div sID="gen1063" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv594"/> Manjari nihāp duwangan panday inān e' Tuhan ma sabab pagaddat sigām ma iya, ati kabuwanan sigām tubu'. Maka ba'anan bangsa Isra'il isab gom pa'in paheka.

verses.name: Exodus 1:22
verses.text: Ya katobtobanna aniya' panoho'an Pira'un ma saga a'ana kamemon. Yukna, “Bang aniya' onde'-onde' l'lla baha'u nianakan ma bangsa Hibrani, timaninbi ni sapa' Nīl supaya amatay kamemon. Sagō' bang onde'-onde' d'nda, da'a inayunbi.” <lb/>  <div eID="gen1063" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.1"/> <div eID="gen1056" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv595"/><div sID="gen1064" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaganak ma si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1065" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv595"/> Na, aniya' dakayu' l'lla bangsa Isra'il panubu' si Libi makah'nda ni pagkahina tubu' si Libi.

verses.name: Exodus 2:2
verses.text: Manjari, ab'ttong d'nda itu sampay anganak l'lla. Ta'nda'na pa'in ya kahāp luwa onde'-onde' bay nianakan e'na, na, tinapukan e'na ma deyom t'llumbulan bo' mbal tabāk e' a'a Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 2:3
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in mbal na katapukan, in d'nda itu bay angā' ambung nihinang min batang parang. Bay pininta maka kitlan bo' mbal ang'mman, ati pinalege onde' ma deyomna bo' yampa pinagūng ma deyom kaparangan alangkaw ya patomo' ma bihing sapa' Nīl.

verses.name: Exodus 2:4
verses.text: Ina'an asal siyakana d'nda an'ngge min kalawak-lawakan anganjagahan onde'-onde' inān bang ai tum'kka ni iya.  <div eID="gen1065" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv596"/><div sID="gen1066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv596"/> Sakali itu makapina'an dayang-dayang anak Pira'un amandi ma sapa'. Ina'an isab saga ipang-ipangna<note>Ipang-ipang, hatina d'nda ya sosoho'an dayang-dayang.</note> anusul-nusul min bihing sapa'. Manjari ta'nda' e' dayang-dayang ambung e' pagūng ma bihing sapa', ma kaparangan. Pag'nda'na, magtūy sinoho' e'na dakayu' ipang-ipangna palūd pina'an angā'.

verses.name: Exodus 2:6
verses.text: Ta'ā' pa'in ambung e', niukab magtūy e' dayang-dayang ati ta'nda' e'na onde'-onde' l'lla ma deyomna anangis. Jari sinōd iya ase' ma iya. “Ndū',” yukna, “anak Hibrani ko' itu.”  <div eID="gen1066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv597"/><div sID="gen1067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv597"/> Manjari pina'an d'nda-d'nda ya siyaka onde' bo' atilaw ma dayang-dayang ya anak sultan e'. “Dayang-dayang,” yukna, “bilahi ka bahā' bang aku amiha'an ka'a d'nda Hibrani amaruru' onde'-onde' ilu?”  <div eID="gen1067" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv598"/><div sID="gen1068" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv598"/> Ya sambung dayang-dayang, “Aho', arung. Pehē' ka amiha.” Magtūy iya pehē' angā' ina'na.

verses.name: Exodus 2:9
verses.text: Pagt'kka ina' onde', yuk dayang-dayang ma iya, “Ā, onde'-onde' itu. Bowahun iya amole' ni luma'bi bo' paruru'in aku. Tambahanta pa'in ka angipat iya.” Manjari onde'-onde' inān binowa amole' e' ina'na pinaruru' maka ni'ipat pahāp.  <div eID="gen1068" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv599"/><div sID="gen1069" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv599"/> Na, aheya-heya pa'in onde'-onde' itu, ni'nde'an na e' ina'na pehē' ni dayang-dayang ati tahinang sali' anakna luggiya'. Ya ma pikilan dayang-dayang e', “Ōnanku iya Musa,<note>Musa: pa'anggil ni dakayu' kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘ningā' atawa nihella' paluwas.’</note> sabab bay iya paluwasku min deyom bohe'.”  <div eID="gen1069" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1064" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv600"/><div sID="gen1070" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Musa Alahi ni Lahat Midiyan</title> <div sID="gen1071" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv600"/> Asangpot pa'in kasubul si Musa,<note>Ya umul si Musa ma waktu kalahina kulang-labi mpatpū' tahun.</note> pehē' na iya ni atag paghinangan saga pagkahina bangsa Hibrani. Ta'nda'na sigām ma deyom kabinasahan pagka pinahinang abuhat e' bangsa Misil. Aniya' isab dakayu' a'a Misil ta'nda' e' si Musa angandaplosan dakayu' pagkahina bangsa Hibrani.

verses.name: Exodus 2:12
verses.text: Na, maglingi'-lingi' si Musa. Pag'nda'na halam aniya' a'a saddī maina'an, magtūy binono' e'na a'a Misil e' bo' yampa l'bbonganna bangkayna ma deyom gusung.  <div eID="gen1071" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv601"/><div sID="gen1072" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv601"/> Pagsalung pa'in, makabalik si Musa ni bay papehē'anna. Sakali aniya' ta'nda'na maina'an duwangan a'a Hibrani magbono'. Yuk si Musa ma a'a dangan ya taga-dusa, “Angay la'ugannu pagkahinu Hibrani?”  <div eID="gen1072" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv602"/><div sID="gen1073" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv602"/> Ya sambung a'a inān ma si Musa, “Ē, sai bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut magbaya' maka angahukum ma kami! Papataynu isab aku buwat bay pamapataynu a'a Misil e'?” <div eID="gen1073" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1074" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy tināw si Musa. Yukna ma deyom atayna, “Tantu tasayu bay hinangku ma a'a Misil e'.”  <div eID="gen1074" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv603"/><div sID="gen1075" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv603"/> Na kahaka'an pa'in Pira'un pasal palkala' itu, anganiyat iya subay pinapatay si Musa. Daipara makalahi si Musa tudju ni lahat Midiyan bo' pat'nna' mahē'. Ma dakayu' llaw, wa'i iya aningkō' ma bihing pagbohe'an.

verses.name: Exodus 2:16
verses.text: Jari aniya' at'kka pina'an pitu' budjang anak si Jetro ya imam ma lahat Midiyan. Ya gawi sigām angā' bohe' bo' tinumpahan ni paginuman saga kahayopan ya suku' mma' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 2:17
verses.text: Sagō' saga budjang inān bay nilāng e' saga a'a kasehe', ya magi'ipat ba'anan bili-bili sigām. Jari itu, pagka mbal pinasauk saga kabudjangan e', an'ngge si Musa angandapitan sigām. Anauk iya bohe' isab pamainumna ma saga bili-bili sigām.  <div eID="gen1075" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv604"/><div sID="gen1076" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv604"/> Manjari itu, pagpole' saga kabudjangan itu ni si Jetro ya mma' sigām, tinilaw sigām. Yukna, “Al'kkas pahāp kam at'kka llaw itu! Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen1076" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv605"/><div sID="gen1077" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv605"/> Ya sambung saga anakna, “Sabab kami bay tinabangan e' dakayu' a'a Misil pagka kami nila'at e' saga a'a magi'ipat bili-bili. Lāgi, sinaukan kami bohe' e'na maka bay pinainum e'na saga kambing maka bili-bilitam.”  <div eID="gen1077" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv606"/><div sID="gen1078" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv606"/> Ya lling matto'a he', “Maingga na iya? Angay iya pasagaranbi mahē'? Ngā'unbi iya pehē' bo' magsalu maka kitam.”  <div eID="gen1078" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv607"/><div sID="gen1079" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv607"/> Na, kasulutan si Musa maglahat maina'an, ati pinapagā' iya e' si Jetro maka anakna si Sippura.

verses.name: Exodus 2:22
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in, anganak l'lla si Sippura. Gersom<note>Ya ōn Gersom itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘a'a liyu.’</note> ya pangōn si Musa ma iya, sabab yukna, “Aku itu a'a liyu ma ngga'i ka lahatku.”  <div eID="gen1079" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv608"/><div sID="gen1080" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv608"/> Palabay pa'in daka pilantahun, amatay na sultan Misil e'. Malaingkan bangsa Isra'il masi du magaruhuy ma sabab pamanyaga' bangsa Misil ma sigām. Angandahing na pa'in sigām ni Tuhan bang pa'in sigām tinabangan.

verses.name: Exodus 2:24
verses.text: Jari takale e' Tuhan pangandahing sigām. Nientom e'na bay paljanji'anna ma disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub, ya pag'mbo'an sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 2:25
verses.text: Ta'nda' isab e' Tuhan kabinasahan sigām ati kina'ase'an sigām e'na. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1080" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.2"/> <div eID="gen1070" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv609"/><div sID="gen1081" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpa'nda' Tuhan ma si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1082" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv609"/> Na aniya' waktu kapangipat si Musa ma saga kambing maka bili-bili mato'ana si Jetro, ya imam ma lahat Midiyan. Binowa e'na ba'anan hayop e' pauntas ni dambila' lahat paslangan. Jari pasampay iya ni Būd Horeb,<note>Būd Horeb: ya būd pagpa'nda'an Tuhan ma nabi Musa. Būd Turusina ōnna dakayu'.</note> ya pinagōnan isab Būd Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 3:2
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, magpa'nda' ni si Musa mala'ikat si Yawe<note>Yawe: dī ōn Tuhan. Nda'un lagi' ma ayat 3:14.</note> min t'ngnga' po'on kayu areyo', magpasalupa api asuleyab. Pag'nda' si Musa ma po'on kayu inān halam atunu' minsan arokot,

verses.name: Exodus 3:3
verses.text: amikil-mikil gi' iya, yukna, “Oy! Pabidda' pahāp po'on kayu itu, asuleyab sagō' halam atunu'. Angay bahā'? Sekotku gi' bo' lilingku.”  <div eID="gen1082" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv610"/><div sID="gen1083" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv610"/> Na, pag'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa pasekot pehē' angaliling, magtūy nilinganan e'na min deyom po'on kayu he'. Yukna, “Musa, O Musa!” <div eID="gen1083" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1084" type="paragraph"/> Anambag si Musa yukna, “Oy, itiya' aku.”  <div eID="gen1084" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv611"/><div sID="gen1085" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv611"/> Yuk Tuhan, “Da'a ka pasekot pi'itu. La'anin taumpa'nu, sabab mahasussi tana' ya pan'nggehannu ilu.”

verses.name: Exodus 3:6
