verses.text: Ah'lling gi' iya yukna, “Aku itu Tuhan ya pagtuhanan ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.” Takale pa'in e' si Musa, magtūy tampananna baihu'na sabab tināw iya patampal ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1085" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv612"/><div sID="gen1086" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv612"/> Angallam lagi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> yukna, “Ta'nda'ku kabinasahan ya kalabayan saga a'a suku'ku maina'an ma Misil. Takaleku isab pangandahing sigām ma sabab saga a'a ya amanyaga' sigām. Aho', asusa isab aku ma pasal kabinasahan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 3:8
verses.text: Angkan na aku makatulun pi'itu amuwasan sigām min komkoman saga bangsa Misil. Bowaku sigām paluwas min deyom lahat Misil tudju ni lahat ahāp maka aluha, ap'nno' isab e' kalluman landu' ahāp. Lahat itu kapaglahatan asal e' bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Amor, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus.”

verses.name: Exodus 3:9
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' Tuhan yukna, “Itiya' pasampay ni aku pangandahing bangsa Isra'il. Ta'nda'ku isab paminasa saga bangsa Misil ma sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 3:10
verses.text: Angkan ka soho'ku pehē' ni Pira'un bo' supaya ka amowa saga a'aku bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahat Misil. Na, pehē' na ka.”  <div eID="gen1086" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv613"/><div sID="gen1087" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv613"/> Sagō' aniya' pah'lling si Musa ma Tuhan, yukna, “Ya Tuhanku, sai sa aku itu, ya angkan aku soho'nu paharap ni Pira'un amowa bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahat Misil?”  <div eID="gen1087" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv614"/><div sID="gen1088" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv614"/> Anambung Tuhan yukna, “Tantu du aku anehe'an ka'a. Buwananta ka paltanda'an supaya ka makata'u in aku bay anoho' ka'a. Jari bang tabowanu na saga a'aku paluwas min lahat Misil, anumba du kam ni aku ma būd itu.”  <div eID="gen1088" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv615"/><div sID="gen1089" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv615"/> Yuk si Musa ni Tuhan, “Bang aku saupama pehē' ni saga a'a Isra'il bo' haka'anku sigām, ‘In Tuhan pagtutuhanan saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi bay anoho' aku pi'ilu ni ka'am.’ Na bang aku ganta' tinilaw e' sigām bang sai ōn Tuhan ya bay anoho' aku, ai bahā' panambungku ma sigām?”  <div eID="gen1089" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv616"/><div sID="gen1090" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv616"/> Anambag Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Aku itu si Yawe,<note>Yawe: ‘Yahweh’ ma bahasa Hibrani, dī ōn Tuhan bay pamabukisna ma si Musa, ya yuk-i, “EHYEH asher EHYEH”. Hatina ma Sinama: “In Aku-asal-aku.”</note> ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan. Ya pah'llingnu ma saga a'a Isra'il subay buwattitu, ‘Tuhan-asal-Tuhan bay anoho' aku pi'itu ni ka'am.’ ”  <div eID="gen1090" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv617"/><div sID="gen1091" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv617"/> Aniya' gi' pah'lling Tuhan ma si Musa. Sinō' iya angahaka'an saga a'a Isra'il in si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub, bay anoho' iya ni sigām. Yuk Tuhan isab, “Si Yawe ya ōnku salama-lama, ōn panabbutan aku e' saga a'a Isra'il magpangkat-mamangkat.

verses.name: Exodus 3:16
verses.text: Pehē' na ka,” yuk Tuhan ni si Musa, “patimukun saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il bo' ka amissala ma sigām. Yuknu, ‘Bay magpanyata' ni aku si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan ka'mbo'-mbo'antam si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub. Aheya pagka'inagonna ma ka'am, maka ta'nda'na isab paminjala' saga bangsa Misil ma ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 3:17
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan iya anganjanji' ma ka'am, in ka'am lappasan min deyom katiksa'an ya kalabayanbi ilu ma lahat Misil. Binowa kam e'na ni lahat ahāp, lahat ap'nno' e' kalluman landu' ahāp. Ya na paglahatan saga bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Amor, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus.’ ”  <div eID="gen1091" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv618"/><div sID="gen1092" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv618"/> Yuk Tuhan isab ma si Musa, “Bin'nnal bissalanu e' saga pagmatto'ahan a'a Isra'il. Subay ka magbeya' maka sigām paharap pehē' ni sultan Misil. Ya yukbi ma iya, ‘Tuwan sultan, si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan kami bangsa Hibrani, bay magpakilā di-na ni kami. Manjari itiya' kami ama'id min ka'a pehē' ni lahat paslangan t'llung'llaw t'ggolna. Magkulban kami ni si Yawe ya pagtuhanan kami.’

verses.name: Exodus 3:19
verses.text: Sagō',” yuk Tuhan ma si Musa, “kata'uwanku asal, in sultan bangsa Misil inān mbal amatugut, luwal bang tananamna kasangat kawasaku.

verses.name: Exodus 3:20
verses.text: Angkan subay pa'nda'ku kawasaku amat'kka saga bala' makatāw-tāw ma bangsa Misil. Pagubus, tinugutan du kam pal'ngngan paluwas min lahat.  <div eID="gen1092" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv619"/><div sID="gen1093" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv619"/> “Palunukku du isab pangatayan saga a'a Misil ni ka'am bangsa Isra'il,” yuk Tuhan. “Jari aniya' pangalta' tabowabi bang kam paluwas na min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 3:22
verses.text: Saga d'nda Isra'il kamemon subay angamu' alta' min saga kar'ndahan Misil, ai na ka d'nda ma kauman, ai na ka d'nda paokom ma luma' sigām. Jari ya pamulawan maka s'mmek pamuwan sigām subay pinasulug ma ka'anakanbi d'nda-l'lla. Minnē' tabowabi pangalta' bangsa Misil bang kam magla'anan min lahat e'.”  <div eID="gen1093" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.3"/> <div eID="gen1081" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv620"/><div sID="gen1094" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Musa Kawakilan e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1095" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv620"/> Anambung si Musa ma Tuhan yukna, “Painay bang mbal magkahagad saga a'a Isra'il maka mbal isab angasip ma pangahakaku? Bang saupama yuk sigām ma aku, ‘Ē, mbal kami magkahagad in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bay magpanyata' ni ka'a!’ ”  <div eID="gen1095" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv621"/><div sID="gen1096" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv621"/> Na, atilaw <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa yukna, “Ai ma tangannu ilu?” <div eID="gen1096" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1097" type="paragraph"/> “Tungkud,” yuk sambung si Musa.  <div eID="gen1097" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv622"/><div sID="gen1098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv622"/> Ah'lling gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> yuk-i, “Hantakin ni tana'.” Paghantakna pa'in, tahinang sowa ya bay tungkud e'. Magtūy alahi si Musa.  <div eID="gen1098" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv623"/><div sID="gen1099" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv623"/> Magpanoho'an gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, “Abutun sowa ilu maka tangannu. Ntanin ma togelna.” Jari niabut sowa e' si Musa bo' ni'ntanan. Magtūy tahinang tungkud pabalik.

verses.name: Exodus 4:5
verses.text: Ah'lling lagi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Hinangun buwattilu ma saga a'a Isra'il supaya sigām makapam'nnal in ka'a bay pinagpanyata'an e' si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.”  <div eID="gen1099" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv624"/><div sID="gen1100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv624"/> Pagubus, yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Pasōrun dambila' tangannu ni deyom badju'nu.” Magtūy pinasōd e'na. Pagpaluwasna pa'in, na, kinamuti' tanganna, makalandu' apote'.

verses.name: Exodus 4:7
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan isab, “Pasōrun pabīng.” Magtūy pinasōd pabīng ni deyom badju'na. Pagpaluwasna pa'in, kauli'an tanganna, al'ssin na buwat bay ka'ina tagna'.  <div eID="gen1100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv625"/><div sID="gen1101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv625"/> “Sagō',” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “bang sigām saupama mbal am'nnal ma bissalanu, maka mbal isab kamattanan ma tungkud bay tahinang sowa, kalu sigām tabowa am'nnal bang ka makahinang paltanda'an karuwana itu.

verses.name: Exodus 4:9
verses.text: Malaingkan, bang sigām mbal am'nnal ma paltanda'an duwa hekana ya bay tahinangnu, maka mbal isab am'nnal ma bissalanu, na, anauk ka bohe' min sapa' Nīl bo' bu'usin ni tana'. Pagbu'usnu, bohe' ilu tahinang laha'.”  <div eID="gen1101" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv626"/><div sID="gen1102" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv626"/> Sagō' ya lling si Musa ma si Yawe, “Ya Panghū'ku, aku itu,” yukna, “min kariki'-diki'ku sampay ni waktu kapamissalanu itu ma aku, halam aniya' kapandayanku amissala ma mairan. Alallay e'ku ah'lling, tamamang aku.”  <div eID="gen1102" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv627"/><div sID="gen1103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv627"/> Magsuwala lagi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Sai ya angahinang bowa' manusiya'? Sai isab amaumaw maka sai amabisu? Sai amuwan pang'nda' maka sai amabuta? Luwal aku, si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 4:12
verses.text: Angkan ka soho'ku pehē'. Tabanganta ka amissala, maka pandu'anta ka bang ai subay pah'llingnu.”  <div eID="gen1103" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv628"/><div sID="gen1104" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv628"/> Sagō' angamu' lagi' si Musa, yukna, “Ndū', Panghū'ku, bang makajari amiha na ka a'a saddī soho'nu.”  <div eID="gen1104" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv629"/><div sID="gen1105" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv629"/> Pagka buwattē' sambung si Musa, akagit atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya. Yukna, “Bang bahā' danakannu si Harun ya tubu' si Libi? Kata'uwanku in iya apanday magbissala. Ilu na iya ma labayan tudju pi'itu anampang ka'a. Akōd du iya pag'nda'na ma ka'a.

verses.name: Exodus 4:15
verses.text: Bowahun iya magsuli-suli. Pata'uhun iya bang ai subay pamissalana, sabab iya ya ganti'nu amissala ma kaheka'an saga a'a Isra'il. Hatina in iya sali' sapantun bowa'nu amissala, maka ka'a ya sapantun pagtuhananna. Tabanganta kam karuwangan magbissala maka pandu'anta kam bang ai subay hinangbi.

verses.name: Exodus 4:16
verses.text: Bowahun iya magsuli-suli. Pata'uhun iya bang ai subay pamissalana, sabab iya ya ganti'nu amissala ma kaheka'an saga a'a Isra'il. Hatina in iya sali' sapantun bowa'nu amissala, maka ka'a ya sapantun pagtuhananna. Tabanganta kam karuwangan magbissala maka pandu'anta kam bang ai subay hinangbi.

verses.name: Exodus 4:17
verses.text: Bowahun tungkudnu ilu pangahinangnu saga paltanda'an makainu-inu ma saga a'a.” Ya na ina'an pamalman Tuhan ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1105" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv630"/><div sID="gen1106" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv630"/> Puwas e', amole' na si Musa pehē' ni mato'ana si Jetro bo' ama'id min iya. “O Bapa',” yukna, “dūlin lagi' aku pabīng ni lahat Misil ang'nda' saga kampungku bang sigām allum lagi'.” <div eID="gen1106" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1107" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy iya pinaba'id e' si Jetro, yukna, “Aho', pehē' na ka. Bang pa'in ka mura-murahan asalamat.”  <div eID="gen1107" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1094" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv631"/><div sID="gen1108" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Musa Pabalik ni Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen1109" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv631"/> Manjari itu, hinabu lagi' si Musa ma lahat Midiyan, aniya' bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya, yukna, “Pabalik ka pehē' ni Misil, sabab wa'i na magpatayan saga a'a kamemon ya bay arak amapatay ka'a.”

verses.name: Exodus 4:20
verses.text: Angkan pinasakat e' si Musa h'ndana maka duwangan anakna ni kura' bo' yampa sigām pauntas tudju ni lahat Misil. Binowa isab e'na tungkud ya bay min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1109" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv632"/><div sID="gen1110" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv632"/> Magsuwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa pabīng yukna, “Pagt'kkanu ni Misil, subay ka angahinang ma matahan Pira'un saga hinang makainu-inu kamemon ya bay pamahinangku ma ka'a. Hinangun min kawasa bay pamuwanku ka'a. Sagō' patuwasku kōk Pira'un bo' mbal tugutanna saga a'a Isra'il paluwas min Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 4:22
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', subay pasampaynu lapal itu ni Pira'un. Yuknu ma iya, ‘Palman itu bay min si Yawe. In bangsa Isra'il sapantun anakna l'lla kasiyakahan.

verses.name: Exodus 4:23
verses.text: Bay ka soho'na anugutan sigām paluwas min lahatnu supaya sigām makapagpudji ma iya. Sagō' mbal ka bilahi, angkan papatayna anaknu l'lla kasiyakahan.’ ” Ya du ina'an lapal ya sinō' pinasampay ni Pira'un.  <div eID="gen1110" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv633"/><div sID="gen1111" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv633"/> Na, ma paghanti'an pa'in disi Musa hinabu sigām pal'ngngan tudju ni Misil, niharap iya e' si <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Arak bin'kkat nyawana,

verses.name: Exodus 4:25
verses.text: daipara h'ndana si Sippura bay angā' batu atalom bo' yampa angislam anakna l'lla. Pagubus, ya kuwit bay niutas e' pina'abut e' si Sippura ni tape' h'llana. Ya llingna ma si Musa, “B'nnal to'ongan, in ka'a h'llaku kapehē'an laha' du pa'in.”

verses.name: Exodus 4:26
verses.text: (Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Sippura ma sabab pagislam e'.) Manjari si Musa halam tainay e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen1111" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv634"/><div sID="gen1112" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv634"/> Sakali aniya' panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Harun, yukna, “Pehē' ka ni lahat paslangan anampang danakannu si Musa mahē'.” Jari tasampang si Musa e' si Harun ma atag Būd Tuhan. Tasiyumna isab.

verses.name: Exodus 4:28
verses.text: Puwas e', nihaka'an si Harun e' si Musa pasal kamemon bay panoho'an ma iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> subay pinasampay ni Pira'un. Nihaka'an isab pasal saga paltanda'an makainu-inu ya pamahinang Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen1112" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv635"/><div sID="gen1113" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv635"/> Pagt'kka si Musa maka si Harun ni lahat Misil, pinatimuk e' sigā saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 4:30
verses.text: Pinata'u sigām e' si Harun pasal kamemon bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa. Tahinang isab e'na saga paltanda'an ma matahan sigām,

verses.name: Exodus 4:31
verses.text: manjari am'nnal na sigām. Makata'u pa'in sigām ma pasal aniya' pagka'inagon <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigām, maka ma pasal pang'nda'na ma kabisa katiksa'an sigām, magtūy sigām pasujud anumba.  <div eID="gen1113" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.4"/> <div eID="gen1108" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv636"/><div sID="gen1114" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaharap disi Musa ma Pira'un</title> <div sID="gen1115" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv636"/> Puwas e', paharap na si Musa maka si Harun pehē' ni Pira'un. Yuk sigā ma iya, “Tuwan sultan, ya na itu palman min si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan kami a'a Isra'il. Ya yuk Tuhan itu ma ka'a, ‘Tugutin saga a'aku paluwas ni lahat paslangan inān supaya sigām maghinang ma aku.’ ”  <div eID="gen1115" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv637"/><div sID="gen1116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv637"/> Agsai anambung Pira'un, yukna, “Sai sa si Yawe? Angay iya subay beya'ku? Angay subay tugutanku saga a'a Isra'il paluwas min lahat itu? Mbal kata'uwanku si Yawe. Mbal isab tugutanku saga a'a Isra'il paluwas minnitu.”  <div eID="gen1116" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv638"/><div sID="gen1117" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv638"/> Yuk disi Musa maka si Harun, “Ya Tuhan kami bangsa Hibrani bay magpakilā di-na ma kami. Bang pa'in kami patugutannu pal'ngngan t'llung'llaw sadja ni lahat paslangan inān supaya kami makapagkulban ni si Yawe, ya Tuhan kami. Bang kami saupama mbal tugutannu, na, aniya' saki makapatay atawa bono' pinat'kka e' Tuhan ni kami.”  <div eID="gen1117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv639"/><div sID="gen1118" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv639"/> Saguwā' ya panambung sultan Misil ma si Musa maka si Harun. “Angay bowabi saga pagkahibi Isra'il pahali maghinang tisa'? Pabīng kam ni hinangbi!”

verses.name: Exodus 5:5
verses.text: Aniya' gi' pah'lling Pira'un yukna, “Bistahun saga bangsa Hibrani ilu, aheka na makalandu', ati bowabi sigām ang'bba min hinang ya pamahinang sigām.”  <div eID="gen1118" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv640"/><div sID="gen1119" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv640"/> Manjari itu, ma llaw ina'an-i, aniya' panoho'an Pira'un ma saga a'a Misil magbabanyaga' maka saga a'a Isra'il ya pinat'nna' magkapatas.

verses.name: Exodus 5:7
verses.text: Yuk panoho'an e', “In bangsa Isra'il angalisu' na maghinang, ya angkan sigām angamu' na pa'in subay paluwas min Misil itu bo' magkulban ni Tuhan sigām. Jari soho'ta kam da'a subay amuwanan sigām batang bay paganihan<note>Ya pisak nihinang tisa' subay aniya' lamudna kaparangan atawa batang bay paganihan supaya apagon.</note> pangalamud sigām ma pisak ya nihinang tisa'. Puwas minnitu in sigām subay amiha'an di-sigām. Sagō' ya tisa' pamahinangbi ma sigām subay mbal kinulangan hekana minsan dansolag.

verses.name: Exodus 5:8
verses.text: Yuk panoho'an e', “In bangsa Isra'il angalisu' na maghinang, ya angkan sigām angamu' na pa'in subay paluwas min Misil itu bo' magkulban ni Tuhan sigām. Jari soho'ta kam da'a subay amuwanan sigām batang bay paganihan<note>Ya pisak nihinang tisa' subay aniya' lamudna kaparangan atawa batang bay paganihan supaya apagon.</note> pangalamud sigām ma pisak ya nihinang tisa'. Puwas minnitu in sigām subay amiha'an di-sigām. Sagō' ya tisa' pamahinangbi ma sigām subay mbal kinulangan hekana minsan dansolag.

verses.name: Exodus 5:9
verses.text: Maka itu gi', ya pamahinangbi ma sigām subay gom pa'in pinabuhat min bay dahū supaya halam aniya' halian sigām, jari halam aniya' waktu sigām akale ma saga bissala kaputingan.”  <div eID="gen1119" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv641"/><div sID="gen1120" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv641"/> Manjari paluwas minnē' saga tag-soho'an ata maka saga kapatas Isra'il bo' magpasampay lapal sultan e' ni saga Isra'il kamemon. Yuk lling sigām, “Mbal na kam pinaniya'an batang bay paganihan pamapagon tisa'.

verses.name: Exodus 5:11
verses.text: Subay kam amiha'an di-bi na, maingga-maingga kapamiha'anbi. Malaingkan ya heka tisa' hinangbi subay mbal pakulang min bay tahinangbi tagna'.”  <div eID="gen1120" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv642"/><div sID="gen1121" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv642"/> Na pagka buwattē', alatag sakalibut lahat Misil e' saga a'a Isra'il pamiha'an sigām batang pangalamud sigām tisa'.

verses.name: Exodus 5:13
verses.text: Nilogos na pa'in sigām e' saga a'a Misil tag-soho'an ata. Yuk-i, “Talusunbi hinang ya pamahinang ka'am kahaba' llaw minsan kam mbal na binuwanan batang.”

verses.name: Exodus 5:14
verses.text: Jari niraplosan na saga kapatas Isra'il e' saga tag-soho'an ata, maka tinilaw isab. Yuk sigām e', “Ya tisa' tahinangbi di'ilaw maka llaw itu akulang hekana min bay hinangbi tagna'. Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen1121" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv643"/><div sID="gen1122" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv643"/> Pagubus, pehē' magtūy saga kapatas Isra'il mikitabang ma Pira'un ma pasal palkala' itu. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan sultan, angay buwattitu hinangnu ma kami saga sosoho'annu?

verses.name: Exodus 5:16
verses.text: Halam kami kabuwanan batang paganihan, sagō' masi-masi na pa'in kami sinoho' angahinang tisa'. Pinagdaplosan na pa'in kami parahāl ngga'i ka kami ya taga-sā'. Sagō' saga tendognu iya.”  <div eID="gen1122" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv644"/><div sID="gen1123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv644"/> Ya sambag sultan ma sigām, “Ē, lisu'an pahāp ka'am ilu! Ahuskaw kam maghinang, angkan du kam mbal pahali ama'id min aku subay tinugutan paluwas min Misil bo' magkulban ni si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 5:18
verses.text: Pabalik kam pehē' ni kahinanganbi! Mbal kam binuwanan batang paganihan, sagō' ya heka tisa' tahinangbi subay mbal pakulang min bay dahū.”

verses.name: Exodus 5:19
verses.text: Takale pa'in panoho'an Pira'un itu e' saga kapatas Isra'il, magtūy tasayu in kasusahan sigām aheya to'ongan. Sinō' sigām angahinang tisa' llaw-llaw ma halam aniya' kulangna min bay tagna'.  <div eID="gen1123" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv645"/><div sID="gen1124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv645"/> Na hinabu saga kapatas itu magla'anan min astana', tasampang e' sigām si Musa maka si Harun sabab bay maina'an asal angalagaran sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 5:21
verses.text: Ah'lling saga kapatas e' ma si Musa maka si Harun, “Bang pa'in kam ni'nda' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bo' kam tinungbasan e'na. Kinab'nsihan na kami e' Pira'un maka saga wakilna sabab min ka'am. Maka ka'am ya bay amuwanan sigām sababan amapatay kami.”  <div eID="gen1124" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv646"/><div sID="gen1125" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv646"/> Magtūy pabīng si Musa paharap ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yukna, “O Panghū'ku, angay tat'kkanu kasusahan ma bangsa kami itu? Ai maksudnu ya angkan aku soho'nu pi'itu?

verses.name: Exodus 5:23
verses.text: Sampay min waktu kapehē'ku ni Pira'un amasampay lapalnu, mbal iya pahali aminjala' saga bangsa Isra'il itu. Halam isab aniya' panabangnu ma saga a'a suku'nu minsan dangkuri'.” <lb/>  <div eID="gen1125" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.5"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:1
verses.text: Magtūy anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa yukna, “Sōng na ta'nda'nu bang ai hinangku ma Pira'un. Min kosog kawasaku, ya angkan iya anugutan saga a'a Isra'il paluwas. Aho', min kosog kawasaku ya angkan sigām tin'ggal e'na pala'an min lahatna.”  <div eID="gen1126" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv647"/><div sID="gen1127" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv647"/> Amalman gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Aku si Yawe, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 6:3
verses.text: Bay aku magpakilā di-ku ma disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub, in aku Tuhan Sangat-Kawasa. Sagō' ōnku Yawe halam bay pata'uku ma sigām ma waktu ina'an-i.

verses.name: Exodus 6:4
verses.text: Bay pat'nna'ku isab paljanji'anku ma sigām t'llungan. Yukku in sigām subay pinasuku'an lahat Kana'an, ya lahat bay paglihanan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 6:5
verses.text: Na,” yuk Tuhan, “takaleku na pagaruhuy saga a'a Isra'il ya tahinang ata ilu e' bangsa Misil. Entomku isab paljanji'an bay pat'nna'anku sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 6:6
verses.text: Angkan ka soho'ku amasampay lapalku itu ma sigām. Buwattitu ya pah'llingnu ma sigām deyo' min aku, ‘Aku itu si Yawe ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan, jari paluwasku ka'am min kasigpitan ya pamasigpit ka'am e' bangsa Misil. Aku ya angalappas ka'am min deyom pamanyaga'an. Aku ya angal'kkat ka'am min pang'ntanan saga a'a Misil pagka patuwa'ku na kosog kawasaku maka mulka'ku landu' abisa.

verses.name: Exodus 6:7
verses.text: Ka'am ya tahinangku bangsa suku'ku, maka aku ya Tuhanbi. Jari makata'u du kam sab'nnal-b'nnal in aku si Yawe ya Tuhanbi, bang kam kalappasanku na min komkoman saga bangsa Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 6:8
verses.text: Bowata du kam,” yukna, “pehē' ni lahat bay panganjanji'ku tuman ma saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub. Buwananta kam lahat inān palsuku'anbi. Aku itu si Yawe.’ ”  <div eID="gen1127" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv648"/><div sID="gen1128" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv648"/> Ya du ilu lapal Tuhan bay panganasihat si Musa ma saga bangsa Isra'il, sagō' halam iya kinale e' sigām. Tu'ud asukkal pangatayan sigām pagka halam aniya' pangasa-ngasa sigām pinaluwas min pamanyaga'an ab'ngngis makalandu'.  <div eID="gen1128" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv649"/><div sID="gen1129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv649"/> Sakali itu angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pabalik ni si Musa, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 6:11
verses.text: “Pehē' ka, haka'in sultan Misil in iya subay anugutan saga bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahatna.”  <div eID="gen1129" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv650"/><div sID="gen1130" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv650"/> Sagō' anambung si Musa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Akale bahā' Pira'un ma aku? Minsan saga pagkahiku bangsa Isra'il mbal akale pagka halam aniya' ta'uku amissala.”  <div eID="gen1130" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv651"/><div sID="gen1131" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv651"/> Malaingkan angalogos gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa maka si Harun. Kinallaman sigā subay amasampay lapalna ni saga a'a Isra'il sampay ni sultan Misil, hatina in sigā duwangan sinō' amowa bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen1131" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1114" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv652"/><div sID="gen1132" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panugsugan si Musa maka si Harun</title> <div sID="gen1133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv652"/> Ya na itu saga a'a pagnakura'an bangsa Isra'il, tinagna'an min tumpuk si Rubin sampay ni tumpuk si Libi. <div eID="gen1133" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1134" type="paragraph"/> Dahū si Rubin, ya anak aymulla Yakub siyaka. Mpat anakna l'lla, si Hanok, si Pallu, si Hesdon maka si Karmi. Buwattē' isab ōn saga tumpuk ya panubu' min si Rubin.  <div eID="gen1134" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv653"/><div sID="gen1135" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv653"/> Pasunu' si Simiyun ya anak si Yakub karuwana. Saga anak si Simiyun l'lla si Jamuwal, si Jamin, si Ohad, si Jakin, maka si Sohar. Katapusan si Sa'ul anak d'nda bangsa Kana'an. Buwattē' isab ōn saga tumpuk ya panubu' min si Simiyun.  <div eID="gen1135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv654"/><div sID="gen1136" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv654"/> Pasunu' isab si Libi. Saga anakna l'lla si Gerson, si Kohat maka si Merari. Awapat pa'in si Libi, umulna dahatus maka t'llumpū' maka pituntahun.  <div eID="gen1136" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv655"/><div sID="gen1137" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv655"/> Si Gerson, duwa anakna l'lla, ōnna si Libni maka si Simi. Buwattē' isab ōn tumpuk ya panubu' min iya.  <div eID="gen1137" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv656"/><div sID="gen1138" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv656"/> Si Kohat, aniya' mpat anakna l'lla. Ōn sigām si Imran, si Isahar, si Hebron maka si Usil. Na, awapat pa'in si Kohat, umulna dahatus maka t'llumpū' maka t'lluntahun.  <div eID="gen1138" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv657"/><div sID="gen1139" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv657"/> Si Merari, duwa anakna l'lla, ōn sigām si Mali maka si Musi. Ya du ina'an saga tumpuk panubu' si Libi, bang sinalsila isab.  <div eID="gen1139" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv658"/><div sID="gen1140" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv658"/> Si Imran (mpu si Libi) bay makah'nda ni danakan mma'na, ōnna si Jokebet. Duwa anak si Imran min si Jokebet itu, ya na si Harun maka si Musa. Awapat pa'in si Imran, umulna dahatus maka t'llumpū' maka pituntahun.  <div eID="gen1140" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv659"/><div sID="gen1141" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv659"/> Si Isahar, t'llu anakna l'lla, ōn sigām disi Kora, si Nepeg maka si Sikri.  <div eID="gen1141" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv660"/><div sID="gen1142" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv660"/> Si Usil isab, t'llu anakna l'lla, ōn sigām si Misail, si Elsapan, maka si Sitri.  <div eID="gen1142" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv661"/><div sID="gen1143" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv661"/> Manjari si Harun bay makah'nda ni si Eleseba, anak si Aminadab maka danakan isab si Nason. Taga-anak sigām mpat l'lla, ya na si Nadab, si Abihu, si Eleyasar maka si Itamar.  <div eID="gen1143" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv662"/><div sID="gen1144" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv662"/> Si Kora (anak si Isahar) taga-anak l'lla, ya na si Assir, si Elkana maka si Abiyasap. Ya ina'an isab ōn saga tumpuk panubu' si Kora.  <div eID="gen1144" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv663"/><div sID="gen1145" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv663"/> Si Eleyasar anak si Harun bay makah'nda ni dakayu' anak si Putil. Si Pinihas ya anakna. <div eID="gen1145" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1146" type="paragraph"/> Na, iya na ina'an ōn saga a'a ya pag'mbo'an ba'anan saga tumpuk kapanubu'an si Libi.  <div eID="gen1146" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv664"/><div sID="gen1147" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv664"/> Na, in si Harun maka si Musa ya sinalsilahan itu, ya na a'a bay kawakilan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe sinō' amowa saga a'a Isra'il magtumpuk-manumpuk paluwas min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 6:27
verses.text: Sigām duwangan itu bay amasampay lapal Tuhan ni Pira'un, hatina sultan Misil, pasal bangsa Isra'il subay tugutanna paluwas min Misil.  <div eID="gen1147" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1132" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv665"/><div sID="gen1148" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Harun ya Bibissalahun Paganti' min si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1149" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv665"/> Manjari itu, ma waktu kapah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa mahē' lagi' ma Misil,

verses.name: Exodus 6:29
verses.text: buwattitu pah'llingna, “Aku si Yawe, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan. Pasampayun ni sultan Misil kamemon pangahakaku itu ma ka'a.”

verses.name: Exodus 6:30
verses.text: Sagō' ya sambung si Musa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Akale bahā' Pira'un ma aku? Sali' aku tamamang bang amissala?”  <div eID="gen1149" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.6"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:1
verses.text: Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Musa, hinangta ka buwat ibarat tuhan ma pang'nda' Pira'un. Maka siyakanu si Harun isab ibarat nabi ya soho'nu amaluwas lapalnu.

verses.name: Exodus 7:2
verses.text: Pata'uhun si Harun ai-ai kamemon ya pangallamku ma ka'a, ati iya ya amasampay panoho'anku ni Pira'un, in saga a'a Isra'il subay tugutanna paluwas min lahatna.

verses.name: Exodus 7:3
verses.text: Sagō' patuwasku kōk Pira'un. Jari minsan pat'kkaku saga bala' makatāw-tāw pila-pila hekana ma lahat Misil,

verses.name: Exodus 7:4
verses.text: mbal iya akale ma ka'am. Buwattē' pa'in, pananamanku iya kosog kawasaku. Pat'kkaku mulka' ma lahat Misil bo' bowaku paluwas minnē' saga a'aku bangsa Isra'il magtumpuk-manumpuk.

verses.name: Exodus 7:5
verses.text: Pagnanam saga a'a Misil ma kawasaku, magtūy kinata'uwan e' sigām in aku si Yawe ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan bang pat'kka na mulka'ku ni lahat sigām, maka bang paluwasku na saga a'a Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1150" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv666"/><div sID="gen1151" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv666"/> Na, tahinang e' si Musa maka si Harun kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigā.

verses.name: Exodus 7:7
verses.text: Manjari ma waktu kapaharap sigā ma Pira'un walumpū' tahun na umul si Musa, maka si Harun walumpū' maka t'lluntahun umulna.  <div eID="gen1151" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv667"/><div sID="gen1152" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv667"/> Sakali itu, ah'lling gi' Tuhan ma sigā karuwangan, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 7:9
verses.text: “Bang kam saupama tinukas e' Pira'un subay maghinang saga hinang makainu-inu, soho'un si Harun angahantak tungkudna ma dahuan sultan-i bo' tahinang sowa.”  <div eID="gen1152" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv668"/><div sID="gen1153" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv668"/> Jari pehē' na si Musa maka si Harun paharap ni Pira'un ati tahinang e' sigā bay panoho'an si Yawe ma sigā. Kahantakan e' si Harun tungkudna ma dahuan Pira'un maka saga wakilna ati tahinang sowa magtūy.

verses.name: Exodus 7:11
verses.text: Pag'nda' Pira'un, pinalinganan e'na saga a'ana ilmu'an maka saga a'a ata'u maghinang-hinang. Jari tahinang e' sigām buwat bay tahinang si Harun e', pagka ginuna ilmu' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 7:12
verses.text: Paghantak sigām saga tungkud sigām magkaniya-kaniya, manjari tahinang sowa, sagō' tin'llon ba'anan tungkud sigām e' tungkud si Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 7:13
verses.text: Malaingkan minsan buwattē', masi na pa'in magmatuwas kōk Pira'un. Mbal to'ongan pakale ma disi Musa, buwat bay pangahaka asal e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen1153" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1148" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv669"/><div sID="gen1154" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Dakayu': Bohe' Tahinang Laha'</title> <div sID="gen1155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv669"/> Sakali itu, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa pabīng, yukna, “Atuwas na kōk Pira'un. Mbal to'ongan tugutanna saga bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahatna.

verses.name: Exodus 7:15
verses.text: Angkan ka subay paharap ni iya salung subu, hinabuna palūd ni sapa' Nīl. Lagarin iya maina'an. Bowahun isab tungkud bay tahinang sowa ilu.

verses.name: Exodus 7:16
verses.text: Makasampang pa'in ka ni Pira'un, subay buwatittu pangahakanu ma iya, yuknu, ‘Si Yawe, ya Tuhan bangsa Hibrani, bay anoho' aku amasampay llingna ma ka'a. Sinō' ka anugutan saga a'a suku'na paluwas min Misil itu bo' maghinang ni iya ma lahat paslangan. Saguwā' halam tabeya'nu panoho'anna itu sampay ni kabuwattituhan.’

verses.name: Exodus 7:17
verses.text: Manjari ya na itu pamalman si Yawe ma ka'a, yukna, ‘Kamattanan ka in aku Tuhan-asal-Tuhan ma sabab paltanda'an ya hinangku itu. T'bba'anku bohe' sapa' Nīl maka tungkud ya balutanku itu. Jari tahinang laha' bohe'na.

verses.name: Exodus 7:18
verses.text: Amatay ba'anan karaingan ma deyom sapa'. Bauwan isab, mbal tainum bohe'na.’ ”  <div eID="gen1155" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv670"/><div sID="gen1156" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv670"/> Yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> isab ma si Musa, “Soho'un si Harun amabantang tungkudna tampal ni kabohe'-bohe'an Misil kamemon, ai na ka kasapa'-sapa'an, ai na ka saga bohe' kali. Manjari in bohe' kamemon ma kaluha'an lahat Misil tahinang laha', sampay bohe' ma deyom ba'anan pangisihan.”  <div eID="gen1156" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv671"/><div sID="gen1157" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv671"/> Na, tahinang e' si Musa maka si Harun bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigā. Tapabantang e' si Harun tungkudna ma matahan Pira'un maka saga wakilna ati t'bba'na bohe' sapa' Nīl. Manjari laha' na kabohe'-bohe'an kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 7:21
verses.text: Magkamatay lullun saga daing bay ma deyom sapa' e' ati abau sidda, angkan mbal tainum bohe'na e' bangsa Misil. Jari laha' sadja minsan maingga-maingga ma sakalingkal lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen1157" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv672"/><div sID="gen1158" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv672"/> Sagō' bineya'an hinang disi Harun e' saga a'a Misil ilmu'an pagka ginuna pangilmu' sigām. Magmatuwas na pa'in kōk Pira'un buwat bay pah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma pasalna. Mbal to'ongan iya pakale ma si Musa maka si Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 7:23
verses.text: Halam tapagmagayna kahālan ina'an-i, gom pa'in iya pataikut min sigā bo' pasōd ni deyom astana'.

verses.name: Exodus 7:24
verses.text: Saguwā' saga a'a Misil kamemon bay magkali saga lowang ma bihing sapa' Nīl inān pangā'an sigām bohe' ni'inum, sabab bohe' sapa' inān mbal to'ongan tainum.  <div eID="gen1158" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1154" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv673"/><div sID="gen1159" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Karuwana: Ba'anan Ambak</title> <div sID="gen1160" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv673"/> Na palabay gi' pitung'llaw min bay pagmulka' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sapa' Nīl.  <div eID="gen1160" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.7"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:1
verses.text: Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa pabalik, yukna, “Pehē' ka ni Pira'un amasampay lapalku itu ma iya. Yuknu, ‘Ya na itu pamalman si Yawe ma ka'a, tugutin saga a'aku paluwas ni lahat paslangan supaya sigām makapagsumba ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 8:2
verses.text: Bang ka mbal, pagmulka'anku du lahatnu kamemon, aliput e' ambak.

verses.name: Exodus 8:3
verses.text: Angulatap saga ambak aheka to'ongan ma sapa' Nīl. Patukad minnē' bo' pasōd ni deyom astana'nu maka ni deyom bilik patulihannu, bo' pariyata' isab ni pabahakannu. Pasōd isab ni kaluma'an saga a'a pangandolannu maka kaluma'an saga a'anu kamemon. Saga pam'llahanbi maka pagaddunanbi tinapay, sinōd du e' ambak.

verses.name: Exodus 8:4
verses.text: Ka'a barannu maka baran saga a'a pangandolannu sampay saga a'anu kamemon kapaglaksu-laksuhan e' saga ambak.’ ”  <div eID="gen1161" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv674"/><div sID="gen1162" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv674"/> Angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Soho'un si Harun amabantang tungkudna paharap ni saga kasapa'-sapa'an maka ni kamemon saga pagbohe'an bo' supaya patukad ba'anan ambak angaliput kaluha'an lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Exodus 8:6
verses.text: Na pinabantang e' si Harun tungkudna paharap ni kabohe'-bohe'an kamemon ati paluwas ba'anan saga ambak angaliput kaluha'an lahat inān.

verses.name: Exodus 8:7
verses.text: Sagō' bineya'an hinang si Harun itu e' saga a'a Misil ata'u maghinang-hinang pagka ginuna pangilmu' sigām. Tabowa isab saga ambak paluwas min deyom sapa' tudju ni gintana'an.  <div eID="gen1162" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv675"/><div sID="gen1163" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv675"/> Sakali pinalinganan si Musa maka si Harun e' Pira'un. Pagt'kka pa'in, yukna ma sigā, “Amu'-amu'inbi aku ni si Yawe bang pa'in la'ananna ba'anan ambak itu. Jari tugutanku saga a'abi paluwas supaya kam makapagkulban tudju ni Tuhanbi si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen1163" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv676"/><div sID="gen1164" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv676"/> Ya sambung si Musa, “Tuwan sultan, ka'a ya pinagbaya' bang sumiyan waktu ya pangamu'ku duwa'a ma kahālanbi, hatina ma ka'a barannu, ma saga a'a pangandolannu, sampay ma saga a'anu kamemon. Bang buwattē' halam na aniya' ambak takapin ma deyom kaluma'anbi, luwal maina'an ma deyom sapa' Nīl.”  <div eID="gen1164" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv677"/><div sID="gen1165" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv677"/> Yuk Pira'un, “Salung.” <div eID="gen1165" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1166" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Musa, “Abeya' pagkallamnu, bo' kata'uwannu halam aniya' tuhan makasali' ni si Yawe ya Tuhan kami.

verses.name: Exodus 8:11
verses.text: Pagsalung ala'an saru'un-du'un saga ka'ambakan min ka'a maka min saga luma'bi, min saga a'a pangandolan maka min saga a'a suku'nu kamemon. Halam aniya' takapin luwal ma deyom sapa' Nīl ilu.”  <div eID="gen1166" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv678"/><div sID="gen1167" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv678"/> Makala'an pa'in si Musa maka si Harun min astana' Pira'un, magtūy angamu' junjung si Musa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang pa'in la'ananna saga ambak bay pamat'kkana ma Pira'un.

verses.name: Exodus 8:13
verses.text: Jari nirūlan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pangamu'-ngamu' si Musa itu. Amatay na saga ambak kamemon, ai na ka ma deyom kaluma'an, ai na ka ma halaman, ai na ka ma saga kahuma'an.

verses.name: Exodus 8:14
verses.text: Pinagtumpuk-tumpuk patay ambak inān e' saga a'a Misil, jari angahangsu katilibut lahat Misil e' bau patay ambak.

verses.name: Exodus 8:15
verses.text: Sakali, pag'nda' Pira'un in kahālan sigām pagām-gām na, agsai magmatuwas kōkna pabīng. Mbal na pakale ma disi Musa, buwat bay pangallam asal e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen1167" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1159" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv679"/><div sID="gen1168" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Kat'lluna: Ba'anan Hanglop</title> <div sID="gen1169" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv679"/> Pagubus ina'an, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pabīng ma si Musa, yukna, “Soho'un si Harun angahantak tōng tungkudna ni bagunbun, ati bagunbun inān tahinang hanglop ma sakalingkal lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Exodus 8:17
verses.text: Magtūy nihantakan e' si Harun tōng tungkudna ni bagunbun e', ati in bagunbun kamemon ma katilibut Misil tahinang hanglop na. Manjari kapilahan e' hanglop saga manusiya' kamemon maka kahayopan kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 8:18
verses.text: Pasulay isab saga a'a Misil ilmu'an magpaniya' hanglop luwas min ilmu' sigām, sagō' mbal makakole'. Manjari hanglop angulatapan na pa'in ni manusiya' maka ni hayop.  <div eID="gen1169" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv680"/><div sID="gen1170" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv680"/> Ah'lling saga a'a ilmu'an inān ma Pira'un, yuk sigām, “Halam pagduwa-ruwana, min kawasa Tuhan ko' itu.” Sagō' Pira'un iya masi magmatuwas kōkna. Mbal to'ongan pakale ma disi Musa, buwat bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma pasalna.  <div eID="gen1170" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1168" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv681"/><div sID="gen1171" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Ka'mpatna: Ba'anan Langaw</title> <div sID="gen1172" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv681"/> Puwas e', angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa pabīng, yukna, “Salung subu, dai' llaw lagi', papunduk ka angaharap Pira'un hinabuna palūd ni sapa' Nīl. Ya pah'llingnu ma iya subay buwattitu, yuknu, ‘Ya na itu pamalman si Yawe ma ka'a. Sinō' ka anugutan saga a'aku paluwas min lahatnu supaya makapagsumba ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 8:21
verses.text: Bang sigām saupama mbal paluwasnu, pat'kkaku ni ka'am saga ba'anan langaw patapu' ma ka'a, ma saga a'a pangandolannu sampay ma saga a'anu bangsa Misil kamemon. Ap'nno' e' langaw saga kaluma'anbi, aliput isab kuwit tana'.

verses.name: Exodus 8:22
verses.text: Malaingkan mbal lapayku jadjahan Gosen, ya lahat paglahatan saga a'a suku'ku. Halam du aniya' langaw angulapat maina'an, supaya kata'uwannu in aku si Yawe, itiya' ma deyom lahat itu.

verses.name: Exodus 8:23
verses.text: Papagbidda'ku saga a'aku maka saga a'anu. Subay na salung bo' tahinang paltanda'an makainu-inu itu.’ ”

verses.name: Exodus 8:24
verses.text: Manjari, aniya' ba'anan langaw aheka makalandu' pinarugpak e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni astana' sultan maka ni kaluma'an saga a'a kawakilanna. Sa'agon-agon magka'at sakalibutan lahat Misil ma sabab langaw.  <div eID="gen1172" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv682"/><div sID="gen1173" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv682"/> Magtūy pinalinganan si Musa maka si Harun e' Pira'un pabalik. Pagt'kka pa'in, yukna ma sigā, “Pehē'un na, tukbalinbi pagkulban ni Tuhanbi, bang pa'in ma lahat itu-i.”  <div eID="gen1173" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv683"/><div sID="gen1174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv683"/> “Ā,” yuk si Musa, “mbal makajari. Ya hayop pagkulban kami ni si Yawe ya Tuhan kami, mbal apatut pinagkulban bang ma addatbi bangsa Misil. Jari bang kami maghinang kulban bo' asammal ma pang'nda' sigām, tantu kami binantung e' sigām pinapatay.

verses.name: Exodus 8:27
verses.text: Subay kami pal'ngngan ni lahat paslangan t'llung'llaw t'ggolna, bo' magsumbali' saga hayop pagkulban ni si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan kami. Sabab ya na ilu panoho'anna ma kami.”  <div eID="gen1174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv684"/><div sID="gen1175" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv684"/> Yuk Pira'un, “Tugutanta du kam pehē' ni lahat paslangan bo' kam magtukbal hayop pagkulban ni si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. Sagō' da'a kam palawak minnitu. Amu'-amu'inbi isab aku duwa'a.”  <div eID="gen1175" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv685"/><div sID="gen1176" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv685"/> Anambung si Musa, yukna, “Pagluwasku min matahannu, amu'ku duwa'a magtūy ni si Yawe, bang pa'in magla'anan saga langaw ilu salung, min ka'a maka min saga a'a kawakilannu maka min saga a'anu kamemon. Sagō' da'a pa'in kami akkalin pabīng, da'a kami sagga'un pehē' maghinang kulban ni si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen1176" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv686"/><div sID="gen1177" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv686"/> Pagluwas pa'in si Musa min Pira'un, magtūy iya angamu' duwa'a ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,

verses.name: Exodus 8:31
verses.text: ati nirūlan iya ma pangamu'na. Magla'anan na ba'anan langaw inān kamemon min sultan, min saga a'a kawakilanna maka min saga a'ana kamemon. Halam aniya' langaw takapin minsan dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 8:32
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan buwattē', masi magmatuwas kōk Pira'un ati halam katugutanna saga a'a Isra'il palanjal maghinang ni Tuhan. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1177" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.8"/> <div eID="gen1171" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv687"/><div sID="gen1178" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Kalimana: Kahayopan Taluwa' Musiba</title> <div sID="gen1179" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv687"/> Na, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa pabalik. Sinoho' iya paharap ni Pira'un amasampay lapal deyo' bay min iya. Yuk lapalna he', “Ya na itu pamalman ka'a e' si Yawe, ya Tuhan bangsa Hibrani. Tugutin saga a'aku paluwas min lahatnu supaya sigām makapagsumba ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 9:2
verses.text: Bang ka pasangdan na pa'in magin'mbal ati mbal tugutannu sigām,

verses.name: Exodus 9:3
verses.text: na, pinagmulka'an lahatnu e' si Yawe min kosog kawasana. Aniya' musiba<note>Musiba itu, hatina saki makalaglag.</note> landu' abisa pamat'kkana ma saga kahayopanbi kamemon, hatina ma kura'bi, unta'bi, sapi'bi, kambingbi maka bili-bilibi.

verses.name: Exodus 9:4
verses.text: Sagō' pinapagbidda' e' si Yawe saga hayop bangsa Isra'il maka saga hayopbi bangsa Misil. Halam aniya' hayop palsuku'an bangsa Isra'il amatay minsan dakayu'.”  <div eID="gen1179" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv688"/><div sID="gen1180" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv688"/> Jari aniya' waktu pangangganta' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. “Subay na salung bo' pat'kkaku bala' inān,” yukna.

verses.name: Exodus 9:6
verses.text: Pagsalung pa'in, tahinang e' si Yawe buwat bay pangallamna. Alaglag saga hayop bangsa Misil, sagō' halam aniya' amatay minsan dakayu' ma kahayop-hayopan bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 9:7
verses.text: Sakali aniya' a'a sinoho' e' Pira'un atilaw bang ai kahālanna ma saga kauman bangsa Isra'il. B'nnal, halam aniya' hayop sigām amatay minsan dakayu'. Sagō' minsan buwattē', iya ya na pa'in magmatuwas kōk Pira'un. Mbal to'ongan anugutan saga a'a Isra'il paluwas.  <div eID="gen1180" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1178" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv689"/><div sID="gen1181" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Ka'nnomna: Musiba Bautut</title> <div sID="gen1182" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv689"/> Puwas e', angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabīng ma si Musa maka si Harun, yukna, “Angakup kam abu min pagtunu'an bo' pinasabulakan pariyata' ma si Musa ma munda'an Pira'un.

verses.name: Exodus 9:9
verses.text: Manjari in abu ilu tahinang sali' bagunbun pasaplag ma kaluha'an lahat Misil. Maka sasuku kapakpakan bagunbun ilu, maingga-maingga pa'ataganna, manusiya' ka atawa hayop, taluwa' bautut paluwasan nana'.”  <div eID="gen1182" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv690"/><div sID="gen1183" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv690"/> Manjari itu, aniya' abu ta'akup e' sigā duwangan. Makaharap pa'in sigā pehē' ni Pira'un, sinabulakan e' si Musa tudju pariyata'. Magtūy aniya' bautut paluwasan nana' makataluwa' ni saga manusiya' maka ni kahayop-hayopan.

verses.name: Exodus 9:11
verses.text: Saga a'a Misil ya ata'u maghinang-hinang mbal makapagharap maka si Musa sabab ya du sigām aliput e' bautut, buwat saga a'a Misil kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 9:12
verses.text: Saguwā' kōk Pira'un pinatuwas gom pa'in e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Mbal iya pakale ma si Musa maka si Harun, jari katumanan bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma pasalna.  <div eID="gen1183" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1181" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv691"/><div sID="gen1184" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Kapitu'na: Ulan Tigtigan Aes</title> <div sID="gen1185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv691"/> Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabalik ma si Musa, yukna, “Salung subu, dai' llaw lagi', papunduk ka angaharap Pira'un. Ya llingnu ma iya subay buwattitu, yuknu, ‘Ya na itu pamalman ma ka'a e' si Yawe, ya Tuhan bangsa Hibrani. Yukna, tugutin saga a'aku paluwas min lahat itu supaya sigām makapagsumba ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 9:14
verses.text: Bang sigām saupama mbal tugutannu, na tantu du aku amatumbuk mulka' lumandu'an bisana ma ka'a, ma saga a'a pangandolannu sampay ma saga a'anu bangsa Misil kamemon, bo' supaya kata'uwannu in aku Tuhan dakayu'-kayu', halam aniya' sibu'ku ma babaw dunya.

verses.name: Exodus 9:15
verses.text: Bang aku bay bilahi, bay du aku amat'kka musiba makalaglag ma ka'a maka ma saga a'anu kamemon, manjari halam aniya' takapin allum.

verses.name: Exodus 9:16
verses.text: Daipara halam bay kalanjalanku bala' ina'an. Ya angkan ka sabalanku magsultan sabab aheya maksudku ma ka'a. Ya kabaya'anku subay pama'nda'ku ma ka'a kosog kawasaku supaya patanyag ōnku ni manusiya' kamemon ma sakalibutan dunya.

verses.name: Exodus 9:17
verses.text: Malaingkan ka'a ilu mbal pahali anagga' saga a'aku, mbal isab anugutan sigām paluwas min lahatnu.

verses.name: Exodus 9:18
verses.text: Angkanna, pagsalung subu, ma waktu buwattē' du, paulananku tigtigan aes ma lahatnu. Sangay min katagna' bangsa Misil, halam bay aniya' ulan buwattē', yamboho'.

verses.name: Exodus 9:19
verses.text: Soho'un saga tendognu pasa'ut amasindung ba'anan hayopbi maka palsuku'anbi kamemon bay pat'nna' ma luwasan. Sabab ai-ai ta'bba ma luwasan, manusiya' ka atawa hayop, bang kaulanan e' tigtigan aes ilu, amatay sadja.’ ”  <div eID="gen1185" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv692"/><div sID="gen1186" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv692"/> Manjari saga sosoho'an Pira'un, sasuku tināw ma palman Tuhan, magdai'-dai' amasindung saga ata maka saga hayop sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 9:21
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku sigām anaikutan panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pinasagaran e' sigām ai-ai sigām ma luwasan, halam pinasindung.  <div eID="gen1186" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv693"/><div sID="gen1187" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv693"/> Pagubus, yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Pah'nnatun tangannu tudju ni langit bo' angulan tigtigan aes ni sakalingkal Misil, ni saga manusiya' maka ni saga hayop, sampay ni tinanom kamemon ya patomo' ma kahuma-huma'an mailu ma lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Exodus 9:23
verses.text: Pagangkat e' si Musa tungkudna paharap ni langit, magtūy aniya' l'ggon maka tigtigan aes pinatumbuk e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Aniya' l'tte' isab pahūg ni kuwit tana'. Min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ko' inān,

verses.name: Exodus 9:24
verses.text: ulan alandos to'ongan kalamuran aes, maka lāt isab min dambila' maka min dambila'. Yamboho' aniya' hunus buwattē' kosogna sangay min katagna' bangsa Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 9:25
verses.text: Taluwa' tigtigan aes saga manusiya' kamemon maka hayop kamemon ya halam tapasindung ma kaluha'an lahat Misil. Ah'bba' saga tinanom kamemon ma kahuma-huma'an, maka halam aniya' dahun kayu takapin, magka'at kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 9:26
verses.text: Luwal jadjahan Gosen halam bay katumbukan tigtigan aes. Ya na ko' ina'an paglahatan bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1187" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv694"/><div sID="gen1188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv694"/> Magtūy pinalinganan si Musa maka si Harun e' Pira'un. Pagt'kka itu, yukna ma sigā, “Tasayuku na, taga-dusa aku. Si Yawe ya tag-da'ugan. Kami maka saga a'aku ya makasā'.

verses.name: Exodus 9:28
verses.text: Amu'inbi kami duwa'a kono' ni si Yawe bang pa'in pahali l'ggon itu maka tigtigan aes, sabab sarang na. Janji'anta kam, tugutanta du kam paluwas minnitu. Mbal na kam taggahanku maitu.”  <div eID="gen1188" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv695"/><div sID="gen1189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv695"/> Anambag si Musa, yukna, “Aho', pagluwasku sadja min da'ira itu, sanggaku tanganku pangamu'ku ni si Yawe. Pahali du l'ggon maka pahalam du isab tigtigan aes itu bo' supaya kata'uwannu si Yawe sadja ya tag-dapu dunya.

verses.name: Exodus 9:30
verses.text: Sagō',” yuk si Musa, “kata'uwanku ka'am maka saga a'a kawakilannu, mbal na pa'in kam tināw ma si Yawe, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1189" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv696"/><div sID="gen1190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv696"/> Ya tinanom magka'at e' ulan, ya na saga tinanom ajatu maka tinanom yampa angugbus.

verses.name: Exodus 9:32
verses.text: Sagō' in ginis tinanom paghinangan tirigu halam bay magka'at sabab halam gi' angugbus, subay ma bulan sinosōng.  <div eID="gen1190" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv697"/><div sID="gen1191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv697"/> Pagpuwas, ang'bba si Musa min Pira'un inān bo' paluwas min deyom da'ira. Ma luwasan pa'in iya, sinangga tanganna maka e'na angamu' duwa'a ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Agsai pahali na l'tte' maka tigtigan aes, halam na isab angulan.

verses.name: Exodus 9:34
verses.text: Na, pag'nda' Pira'un ma l'tte' maka tigtigan aes maka ulan pahali na, magdusa iya pabalik. Magtuwas-tuwas iya di-na, beya' isab saga a'a kawakilanna.

verses.name: Exodus 9:35
verses.text: Jari tatuman bay pah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni si Musa ma pasal Pira'un. Halam tinugutan e'na bangsa Isra'il paluwas min lahat Misil. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1191" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.9"/> <div eID="gen1184" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv698"/><div sID="gen1192" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Kawalu'na: Ba'anan Ampan Dulu</title> <div sID="gen1193" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv698"/> Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Pehē' ka angaharap Pira'un. Tapatuwasku kōkna maka kōk saga a'a kawakilanna supaya hinangku saga paltanda'an makainu-inu ma pang'nda' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 10:2
verses.text: Manjari aniya' panuli-nulinu ma saga anak-mpunu ma waktu sinōng pasal katiksa'an ya tapat'nna'ku itu ma saga a'a Misil, maka pasal paltanda'an makainu-inu ya tahinangku ma deyoman sigām. Minnē' kata'uwanbi in aku si Yawe ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1193" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv699"/><div sID="gen1194" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv699"/> Sakali pehē' disi Musa maka si Harun ni Pira'un. Yuk sigā duwangan ma iya, “Aniya' itu pamalman ma ka'a e' si Yawe ya pagtuhanan bangsa kami Hibrani. Yukna, ‘Sumiyan lagi' ka pahali magtanggu-tanggu bo' yampa magmalilla' ma aku? Tugutin saga a'aku ala'an min Misil itu supaya sigām makapagsumba ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 10:4
verses.text: Bang ka pasangdan na pa'in magin'mbal ma kala'an sigām, pabowaku saga ampan dulu ni lahatnu salung.

verses.name: Exodus 10:5
verses.text: Aliput kaluha'an gintana'an ilu e' ampan dulu pagka aheka makalandu'. Pinagkakan e' sigām tinanom kamemon maka kakayu-kayuhan kamemon ya takapin allum ma kahuma-huma'anbi, ai-ai halam bay magka'at e' ulan tigtigan aes e'.

verses.name: Exodus 10:6
verses.text: Sinōd du isab e' ba'anan ampan dulu astana'nu maka kaluma'an saga wakilnu sampay luma' saga a'ana bangsa Misil kamemon. Minsan bay waktu kamatto'ahanbi, halam aniya' katiksa'an buwattitu bisana bay kalabayan sigām sangay min katagna' sigām maglahat ma tana' Misil itu.’ ” Na, aubus pa'in pah'lling si Musa buwattē', pataikut na iya bo' ala'an min matahan Pira'un.  <div eID="gen1194" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv700"/><div sID="gen1195" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv700"/> Sakali itu, makala'an pa'in si Musa, ah'lling ma Pira'un saga wakilna, yuk-i, “Sampay sumiyan bahā' ya panasat a'a itu ma kitam? Tugutin bangsa inān ala'an supaya sigām makapagsumba ni si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām. Halam gi' bahā' kata'uwannu in lahat Misil itu magka'at na?”  <div eID="gen1195" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv701"/><div sID="gen1196" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv701"/> Angkan na si Musa maka si Harun tabowa magharap maka Pira'un pabīng. Yukna ma sigā, “Aho', makajari. Pehē' na kam magsumba ni Tuhanbi si Yawe. Sagō' sai na pa'in ameya' ma ka'am?”  <div eID="gen1196" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv702"/><div sID="gen1197" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv702"/> Yuk sambung si Musa, “Magbeya' kami kamemon, onde'-onde' matto'a. Bowa kami isab saga ka'anakan kami d'nda-l'lla. Damikiyanna saga kahayopan-hayopan kami, sabab aniya' paghinang pamudji kami si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen1197" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv703"/><div sID="gen1198" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv703"/> Agsai ah'lling Pira'un, “Mattan ko' ilu,” yukna, “aniya' maksudbi mbal ahāp. Haka'anta kam, subay aheya tabang si Yawe ma ka'am bo' yampa aku tabowa anugutan ka'am paluwas minnitu, beya' isab kar'ndahanbi maka kaonde'-onde'an!

verses.name: Exodus 10:11
verses.text: Ē! Mbal kam tugutanku. Subay l'lla sadja ya nirūlan paluwas anumba si Yawe, sabab ya du ina'an pangamu'bi na pa'in.” Magtūy pinala'an na si Musa maka si Harun min matahan Pira'un.  <div eID="gen1198" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv704"/><div sID="gen1199" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv704"/> Sakali aniya' gi' pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Pabantangun tangannu tudju ni lahat Misil supaya angulatup pi'ilu ba'anan ampan dulu bo' amangan saga tinanom kamemon, ingga-ingga ya halam magka'at e' tigtigan aes.”  <div eID="gen1199" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv705"/><div sID="gen1200" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv705"/> Na, tapabantang pa'in e' si Musa tungkudna tudju ni katana'-tana'an Misil, magtūy aniya' baliyu akosog pinatumbuk e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> luwas min sobangan, min llaw ina'an sampay ni kasubuhan. Ta'abut pa'in subu, ina'an na saga ampan dulu bay tabowa e' baliyu he'.

verses.name: Exodus 10:14
verses.text: Manjari sakalingkal lahat Misil maka kahuma-huma'anna kamemon wa'i kat'ppakan ampan dulu landu' aheka. Sangay min awal sampay ni ahil, halam bay buwattē' hekana.

verses.name: Exodus 10:15
verses.text: Aettom kuwit tana' pagka aliput e' ampan dulu. Aubus pinagkakan tinanom kamemon ya takapin min bay hunus tigtigan aes. Beya' na saga buwa' kayu. Halam aniya' dahun takapin ma saga po'on kayu kamemon maka tinanom kamemon ma sakalibutan Misil.  <div eID="gen1200" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv706"/><div sID="gen1201" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv706"/> Pagka buwattē', magdai'-dai' Pira'un amalinganan si Musa maka si Harun. Maina'an pa'in, yukna ma sigā, “Taga-rusa aku ma si Yawe ya pagtuhananbi. Taga-rusa isab ma ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 10:17
verses.text: Na ampununbi dusaku min t'dda sadja la'a. Maka amu'-amu'inbi aku duwa'a ni Tuhanbi si Yawe, bang pa'in ala'an min aku bala' makamula itu.”  <div eID="gen1201" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv707"/><div sID="gen1202" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv707"/> Pagubus itu, ang'bba disi Musa min Pira'un bo' angamu' tabang ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 10:19
verses.text: Na, pinapinda e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> baliyu min sobangan inān, manjari baliyu min s'ddopan na landu' akosog makabowa ba'anan saga ampan inān pehē' ni dilaut Tahik Keyat. Halam aniya' ampan dulu takapin ma lahat Misil, minsan dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 10:20
verses.text: Sagō' ya kōk Pira'un masi pinatuwas e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, angkan halam tugutanna saga a'a Isra'il paluwas min lahatna.  <div eID="gen1202" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1192" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv708"/><div sID="gen1203" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Kasiyamna: Kalendoman</title> <div sID="gen1204" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv708"/> Sakali itu, aniya' pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Pa'angkatun tangannu tudju ni langit bo' angalendom bitu-bituhan ma sakalibut lahat Misil ilu.”

verses.name: Exodus 10:22
verses.text: Na, wa'i pina'angkat e' si Musa tanganna. Magtūy angalendom ma lahat Misil ma deyom t'llung'llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 10:23
verses.text: Mbal na makapag'nda' saga a'a Misil dansehe'an, mbal minsan makala'an min kaluma'an sigām t'llung'llaw t'ggolna. Sagō' asawa ma jadjahan paglahatan saga a'a Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1204" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv709"/><div sID="gen1205" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv709"/> Magtūy pinalinganan si Musa e' Pira'un. Maina'an pa'in, yuk Pira'un ma iya, “Pehē' na kam anumba ni si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. Makajari isab ameya' sampay anak-h'ndabi, saguwā' subay ta'bba maitu ba'anan bili-bilibi maka kambingbi maka sapi'bi.”  <div eID="gen1205" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv710"/><div sID="gen1206" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv710"/> Anambung si Musa ma Pira'un, yukna, “Subay kami dūlannu amowa saga hayop kami bo' aniya' sinumbali' maka tinunu' panukbal ni Tuhan kami si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 10:26
verses.text: Subay ameya' ma kami saga kahayop-hayopan kami kamemon. Subay halam aniya' ni'bbahan minsan dakayu', sabab kagunahan kami hayop kasehe'an itu pangahulmat kami ni Tuhan Yawe. Maka mbal gi' kinata'uwan bang hayop ingga ya pinene' pagkulban. Subay na kami at'kka pehē' ni pagsumbahan bo' yampa kinata'uwan.”  <div eID="gen1206" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv711"/><div sID="gen1207" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv711"/> Sagō' pinatuwas e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe kōk Pira'un inān, angkan iya mbal to'ongan anugutan saga Isra'il paluwas min lahatna.

verses.name: Exodus 10:28
verses.text: Yuk Pira'un ma si Musa, “Ala'an kam min matahanku. Amay-amay, da'a ka pabaihu' ma aku pabīng. Ya llaw paka'nda'nu ma aku, ya na llaw kamataynu.”  <div eID="gen1207" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv712"/><div sID="gen1208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv712"/> “Aho',” yuk si Musa, “ka'a ya beya'ku. Mbal aku pabaihu' ma ka'a pabalik.”  <div eID="gen1208" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.10"/> <div eID="gen1203" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv713"/><div sID="gen1209" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bala' Katapusan: Kamatay Pagsiyakahan</title> <div sID="gen1210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv713"/> Na, aniya' asal bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, ya yukna, “Dakayu' la'a mulka' takapin pamat'kkaku ma Pira'un sampay ma saga a'ana bangsa Misil, bo' yampa kam tinugutan paluwas minnitu. Tin'ggal kam e'na supaya kam pinala'an pagsakali.

verses.name: Exodus 11:2
verses.text: Haka'in saga a'a Isra'il d'nda-l'lla,” yukna, “in sigām subay angamu' pamulawan ni saga bangsa Misil ya magsekot luma' maka sigām.”

verses.name: Exodus 11:3
verses.text: Min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya angkan ahāp pangatayan saga bangsa Misil tudju ni bangsa Isra'il. Kapagmahaltabatan isab si Musa baranna e' saga wakil sultan maka saga a'a Misil kamemon.  <div eID="gen1210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv714"/><div sID="gen1211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv714"/> Manjari itu, aniya' pamalman Tuhan pamalatun e' si Musa ma Pira'un, yukna, “Ya na itu palman Tuhan Yawe, ‘Sangom ilu, tonga' bahangi, palabay du aku min deyom lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 11:5
verses.text: Ma paglabayku, amatay kamemon saga l'lla pagsiyakahan ma bangsa Misil, tinagna'an min anak Pira'un ya pinusaka'an magsultan, sampay ni anak ata ya maggiling gandum. Damikiyanna isab amatay saga hayop ya dahū bay nianakan.

verses.name: Exodus 11:6
verses.text: Jari landu' akosog ya paglemong saga a'a kamatayan ma katilibut Misil. Min awal sampay ni ahil, halam aniya' pagtangis buwattē' kosogna.

verses.name: Exodus 11:7
verses.text: Malaingkan in bangsa Isra'il maka ba'anan hayop sigām mbal ainay, mbal minsan tinanghulan e' ero'.’ Minnē',” yuk si Musa ma Pira'un, “makata'u kam aniya' pagbidda'an pinat'nna' e' si Yawe ma bangsa Misil maka bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 11:8
verses.text: Pareyo' du isab ni aku saga wakilnu ilu kamemon angamu'an aku junjung bang pa'in aku ala'an sampay saga bebeya'anku kamemon. Bang ta'abut na ina'an-i, ala'an du aku.” Akagit makalandu' atay si Musa, mbal agon kasandalan. Magtūy iya ala'an min matahan Pira'un.  <div eID="gen1211" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv715"/><div sID="gen1212" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv715"/> Na, aniya' bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, ya yukna, “Pira'un ilu, mbal to'ongan akale ma ka'am bo' supaya paheka lagi' saga hinangku makainu-inu ya paniya'ku ma lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Exodus 11:10
verses.text: Ya katobtobanna, minsan tahinang e' si Musa maka si Harun saga kahinangan makainu-inu itu kamemon ma matahan Pira'un, in kōkna masi na pa'in pinatuwas e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ya he' sababna angkan mbal tugutanna saga a'a Isra'il paluwas min lahatna. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1212" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.11"/> <div eID="gen1209" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv716"/><div sID="gen1213" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paglakad ma Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen1214" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv716"/> Manjari itu, maina'an lagi' si Musa maka si Harun ma lahat Misil, aniya' pamalman <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigā.

verses.name: Exodus 12:2
verses.text: Yukna, “In bulan itu subay itungbi bulan panagna'an tahun.

verses.name: Exodus 12:3
verses.text: Pata'uhunbi saga ummat bangsa Isra'il kamemon. Bang ta'abut sangpū' kasobangan ma bulan tagna'an itu, saga l'lla magmakōk ma luma' pakaniya-pakaniya subay angā' anak bili-bili atawa kambing pagkulban sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 12:4
verses.text: Bang isab aniya' a'a magtai'anak mbal makaubus amangan dakayu' bili-bili, subay sigām magbahagi' maka pagkahi sigām magsekot luma'. Sagō' bistahunbi pahāp puhu'bi bo' supaya atopod e'bi amangan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:5
verses.text: Ya hayop pene'bi subay hayop l'lla dantahun umulna, halam isab aniya' salla'na, ai na ka bili-bili, ai na ka kambing.

verses.name: Exodus 12:6
verses.text: Jagahinbi saga hayop ya tapene'bi sampay ta'abut sangpū' maka mpat kasobangan ma bulan ilu. Pagabay kohap ma llaw ina'an, ya ka'am ummat bangsa Isra'il kamemon subay magsama-sama anumbali' saga hayopbi.

verses.name: Exodus 12:7
verses.text: Puwas e', subay kam angā' laha' sumbali'an ilu bo' pahirinbi ni diyata' bowa' lawang maka ni bihingna karuwambila' ma luma' ya pagkakananbi hayop-i.

verses.name: Exodus 12:8
verses.text: Na, sangom pa'in, ya hayop ilu subay tinapa bo' pinagkakan maka sayul apa'it maka tinapay halam bay pinasuligan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:9
verses.text: In isi hayop ilu mbal manjari ni'inta' atawa nilaga', subay tinapa ma katibu'ukanna, beya' na isab kōkna, tape'na sampay pagdayaw baranna.

verses.name: Exodus 12:10
verses.text: Bang aniya' takapin, da'a tau'unbi sampay ni kasubuhan, subay tinunu'.

verses.name: Exodus 12:11
verses.text: Ya pagkakanbi subay asapat hinabubi magsakap atulak. Subay kam magbinadju', magsinontoron, magtinaumpa', magtinungkud. Hinang Paglakad ko' ilu, hinang pamaheyabi ma aku <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.  <div eID="gen1214" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv717"/><div sID="gen1215" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv717"/> “Ma sangom ilu du,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “palabay aku min deyom lahat Misil amapatay saga l'lla pagsiyakahan kamemon, ai na ka manusiya', ai na ka hayop. Pagmulka'anku saga pagtutuhanan bangsa Misil kamemon, sabab si Yawe aku, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:13
verses.text: In laha' pamahidbi ma bihing bowa' lawang tahinang paltanda'an ma saga luma' ya pat'nna'anbi. Jari pag'nda'ku laha' ilu, lakaranta sadja kam, ati halam aniya' kamulahan pat'kka ni ka'am ma waktu kapangamulka'ku lahat Misil.”  <div eID="gen1215" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv718"/><div sID="gen1216" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv718"/> Angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Llaw itu subay pagjamuhunbi sakahaba' tahun magpangkat-mamangkat pamaentoman bay kahāpku ma ka'am. Hatulan itu subay taptap bogboginbi.

verses.name: Exodus 12:15
verses.text: Ma deyom pitung'llaw,” yukna, “ya tinapay pagkakanbi subay halam aniya' pasuligna. Ma llaw tagna'an ma dapitu' inān, sinō' kam angala'anan pasulig kamemon min deyom kaluma'anbi. Sabab sai-sai makakakan ai-ai taga-pasulig ma deyom dapitu' he', mbal na taitung bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 12:16
