verses.text: Subay kam magtipun magsambahayang ma llaw tagna'an dapitu' he', damikiyanna du isab ma llaw kapitu'na. Mbal kam makajari maghinang ai-ai ma deyom duwang'llaw pagsambahayang e', luwal hinangbi magadjal pagkakan.  <div eID="gen1216" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv719"/><div sID="gen1217" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv719"/> “Hinangunbi Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna, pangentomanbi llaw bay kapamowaku ka'am magtumpuk-manumpuk paluwas min lahat Misil. Paghinangunbi llaw ina'an-i sakahaba' tahun sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:18
verses.text: Kahaba' bulan panagna'an tahun, subay kam magkakan tinapay halam taga-pasulig, tinagna'an min waktu abay kohap ma sangpū' maka lima kasobangan sampay ni abay kohap isab ma duwampū' maka duwa kasobangan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:19
verses.text: Subay halam aniya' pasulig tabāk ma deyom kaluma'anbi ma deyom pitu' llaw ilu. Sai-sai amangan ai-ai kalamuran pasulig, ai na ka a'a liyu, ai na ka a'a porol bangsa Isra'il, mbal taitung jama'a bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 12:20
verses.text: Ma'ai-ma'ai paglahatanbi wajib kam da'a amangan kinakan bay kalamuran pasulig. Ya sadja takakanbi ma deyom dapitu' subay pagkakan halam aniya' pasuligna.”  <div eID="gen1217" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv720"/><div sID="gen1218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv720"/> Puwas e', nilinganan e' si Musa saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il kamemon. Atipun pa'in, magpanoho'an iya ma sigām, yukna, “Ka'am kamemon kaniya-kaniya subay pasa'ut amene' anak bili-bili atawa anak kambing sinumbali' bo' supaya kam magtai'anak maghinang Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: Exodus 12:22
verses.text: Angā' kam isab dakayu' sanga-sanga jambangan hissup bo' t'nno'inbi ni laha' bay pasalud ma pinggan. Abase' pa'in, pahirinbi laha' ilu ni bowa' lawang luma'bi, ni diyata'na maka ni bihingna karuwambila'. Na, ma waktu ina'an subay halam aniya' min ka'am minsan dangan paluwas min luma' sampay ni kasubuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:23
verses.text: Sabab ma sangom ina'an du, palabay si Yawe min lahat Misil angamulka'an saga a'a Misil. Sagō' ka'am ilu lakaranna du pagka ta'nda'na laha' ma bihing bowa' lawangbi. Mbal pasagaranna mala'ikat pangmumulka' pasōd ni deyom luma'bi amapatay ka'am.”  <div eID="gen1218" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv721"/><div sID="gen1219" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv721"/> Yuk si Musa isab, “Saga panoho'an itu wajib subay bogboganbi magpangkat-mamangkat salama-lama.

verses.name: Exodus 12:25
verses.text: Bogboginbi isab hinang pagkulban itu bang kam makat'kka na ni lahat ya bay panganjanji' ma ka'am e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 12:26
verses.text: Lāgi bang kam saupama tinilaw e' saga ka'anakanbi bang ai sababna ya angkan kam maghinang buwattē',

verses.name: Exodus 12:27
verses.text: pandu'inbi sigām. Yukbi, ‘Hinang ko' itu pamudji ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, hinang pangentoman bay Paglakadna ma kitam. In ka'anakan siyaka bangsa Misil bay pagmulka'anna, saguwā' kaluma'antam bangsa Isra'il bay kalakaran e'na. Ya he' sababna angkan kitam maghinang buwattitu.’ ” Pagkale saga ummat Isra'il kamemon ma lling si Musa itu, magtūy sigām pasujud amudji Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:28
verses.text: Pagubus, patūy saga a'a Isra'il angahinang buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa maka si Harun e'.  <div eID="gen1219" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv722"/><div sID="gen1220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv722"/> Manjari itu, ta'abut pa'in tonga' bahangi, pinapatay e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe saga l'lla kamemon ya anak siyaka ma bangsa Misil. Tinagna'an min anak Pira'un ya pinusaka'an pagsultanna sampay ni anak pilisu ma deyom kalabusu, sampay isab hayop ya dahū bay nianakan, wa'i pinapatay kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 12:30
verses.text: Makabati' magtūy Pira'un maka saga a'a kawakilanna ma hinabu sangom inān, sampay saga a'a Misil kamemon makabati' du isab. Aheya paglemong ma sakalibut lahat Misil sabab halam aniya' luma' sigām ma halam kamatayan.  <div eID="gen1220" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1213" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv723"/><div sID="gen1221" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magla'anan Bangsa Isra'il min Misil</title> <div sID="gen1222" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv723"/> Na, ma sangom ina'an du, magpanoho'an Pira'un ma si Musa maka si Harun subay paharap ni iya. Makaharap pa'in, yukna ma sigā, “Ē! Ala'an kam min saga bangsaku, ka'am baranbi sampay bangsabi Isra'il! Ala'an kam pehē' amudji si Yawe buwat bay pangamu'bi!

verses.name: Exodus 12:32
verses.text: Bowahunbi saga kahayop-hayopanbi buwat yukbi, bang pa'in kam magla'anan na. Maka amu'-amu'inbi aku duwa'a.”  <div eID="gen1222" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv724"/><div sID="gen1223" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv724"/> Ya du saga a'a Misil kamemon, akosog e' sigām angamu' ni saga a'a Isra'il subay ala'an magdai'-dai'. “Sababna,” yuk sigām, “bang kam mbal ala'an, tantu kami magpatayan kamemon!”

verses.name: Exodus 12:34
verses.text: Sakali itu, pagka mbal makat'ggol, binowa e' saga a'a Isra'il addunan tinapay sigām ma halam gi' pinalamuran pasulig. Jari pinutus sampay pangisihanna maka s'mmek bo' yampa tinanggung e' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 12:35
verses.text: Bineya' isab e' bangsa Isra'il bay panoho'an si Musa ma sigām, hatina magpangamu' sigām saga pamulawan maka s'mmek min saga a'a Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 12:36
verses.text: Ya kat'kkahanna, saga a'a Isra'il bay kabuwanan ai-ai pangamu' sigām ma bangsa Misil, pagka alunuk pangatayan saga a'a Misil tudju ni sigām, sabab min kawasa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Jarina landu' aheka pangalta' suku' Misil bay ta'ā' e' saga a'a Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1223" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv725"/><div sID="gen1224" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv725"/> Na, magl'ngnganan bangsa Isra'il min da'ira Ramisis tudju ni kauman Sokkot. Ya heka puhu' sigām saga nnom hatus ngibu bang hal l'lla ni'itung, saddī kar'ndahan maka kaonde'-onde'an.

verses.name: Exodus 12:38
verses.text: Aheka du isab a'a bangsa saddī pasambeya' ma sigām, maka aheka isab katumpukan bili-bili, kambing maka sapi' tabowa sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 12:39
verses.text: Makahanti' pa'in, ya addunan bay binowa e' sigām min Misil tahinang tinapay na, tinapay halam aniya' pasuligna. Addunan inān halam bay kalamuran pasulig sabab nilogos sigām e' bangsa Misil subay ala'an magdai'-dai'. Halam sigām pinarūl minsan angamomos kinakan palutu' sigām.  <div eID="gen1224" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv726"/><div sID="gen1225" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv726"/> Na, mpat hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun ya t'ggol bay kapaglahat sigām bangsa Isra'il ma lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 12:41
verses.text: Ajukup pa'in mpat hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun e', ma llaw ina'an du, ya na waktu kaluwas saga a'a suku' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> magtumpuk-manumpuk min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 12:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv727"/><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya bay anganjagahan sigām ma sangom e' bo' supaya paluwasna sigām min lahat Misil. Ya he' sababna angkan saga a'a Isra'il subay magjaga bang ta'abut sangom ina'an-i sakahaba' tahun sampay ni kasaumulan, pamaheya sigām ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. <div eID="gen1225" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1221" type="section"/> <div sID="gen1226" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kal'ngnganan Pasal Hinang Paglakad</title> <div sID="gen1227" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv727"/> Aniya' gi' isab kabtangan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa maka si Harun, yukna, “Buwattitu kal'ngngananna bang kam maghinang Hinang Paglakad. Bang a'a saddī bangsana, mbal makajari palamud amangan.

verses.name: Exodus 12:44
verses.text: Makajari du bang a'a bay b'llibi magata, bang pa'in bay taislambi.

verses.name: Exodus 12:45
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a liyu ya pahanti' ma ka'am atawa a'a ginadjihan maghinang ma deyomanbi, mbal makajari.  <div eID="gen1227" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv728"/><div sID="gen1228" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv728"/> “Bang kam amangan sumbali'an pagkulban, subay ma deyom luma' bay pangadjalan iya, mbal makajari binowa paluwas. Da'a isab pōngunbi to'olangna minsan dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 12:47
verses.text: Wajib isab saga jama'a Isra'il kamemon maghinang pagjamu itu,

verses.name: Exodus 12:48
verses.text: sagō' sasuku halam taislam, mbal makajari palamud magjamu. Ya balikna, bang aniya' a'a bangsa saddī bilahi maghinang Hinang Paglakad pamaheyana ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, bo' a'a inān at'ggol na asal maglahat mailu ma ka'am, makajari du bang pa'in iya taislam sampay saga l'lla kamemon ma deyomanna. A'a inān taitung sali' porol a'a Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 12:49
verses.text: Manjari sali' du panoho'an ya pinat'nna'an ka'am kamemon, porol bangsa Isra'il ka atawa bangsa saddī ya maglahat asal maina'an ma ka'am.” Ya he' kabtangan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1228" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv729"/><div sID="gen1229" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv729"/> Na, bineya' e' saga bangsa Isra'il kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa maka si Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 12:51
verses.text: Jari ma llaw ina'an du, in bangsa Isra'il magtumpuk-manumpuk tabowa na e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe paluwas min lahat Misil. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1229" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.12"/> <div eID="gen1226" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv730"/><div sID="gen1230" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamasuku' Kasiyakahan ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1231" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv730"/> Magkallam isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 13:2
verses.text: “Pamasuku'unbi ma aku saga anak kasiyakahan l'lla kamemon, sabab aku ya tag-suku' ma kamemon ya dahū paluwas ma ka'am bangsa Isra'il, ai na ka manusiya', ai na ka hayop.”  <div eID="gen1231" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv731"/><div sID="gen1232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv731"/> Manjari ah'lling si Musa ma saga a'a Isra'il, yukna, “Entomunbi llaw kala'anbi itu min lahat Misil, lahat bay pamanyaga'an ka'am. Entomunbi pahāp sabab ya na itu llaw bay kapamaluwas ka'am e' si Yawe sabab min kosog kawasana. Da'a isab kam amangan ai-ai taga-pasulig ma llaw ītu.

verses.name: Exodus 13:4
verses.text: Ilu kam magla'anan buwattina'an min lahat Misil, ma Bulan Abib ya bulan panagna'an tahun.

verses.name: Exodus 13:5
verses.text: Binowa na kam e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni lahat bay panganjanji'na ma ka'mbo-mbo'antam, ya lahat paglahatan asal e' saga bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Amor, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus. Ahāp sidda lahat inān, ap'nno' e' kalluman landu' ahāp. Manjari, bang kam tapasōd na e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni deyom lahat e', subay kam angisbat paghinang itu pamudjibi Tuhan kahaba'-kahaba' tahun bang ta'abut bulan Abib itu.

verses.name: Exodus 13:6
verses.text: Manjari ma deyom pitung'llaw paghinang itu, mbal kam makajari amangan ai-ai taga-pasulig. Ta'abut pa'in llaw kapitu'na, subay kam magpajamu pamaheyabi ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 13:7
verses.text: Ma deyom pitung'llaw ilu mbal kam makajari amangan ai-ai taga-pasulig. Subay halam aniya' pasulig tabāk ma lahatbi ilu minsan maingga-maingga.

verses.name: Exodus 13:8
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in waktu paghinang itu, suli-sulihinbi saga anakbi bang ai sababna. Ya yukbi ma sigām, ‘Angkan aku angisbat paghinang itu sabab nientom bay tabang <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma aku waktu kala'anku min lahat Misil.’ ”

verses.name: Exodus 13:9
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Musa, yukna, “In kahinangan itu sali' sapantun tanda' binaggot ma tanganbi maka ma tuktukbi, pamaentom ka'am in sara' panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> subay taptap pah'llingbi. Sabab hatina in ka'am ilu bay binowa e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> paluwas min lahat Misil sabab min kosog kawasana.

verses.name: Exodus 13:10
verses.text: Subay sabuhunbi paghinang itu sakahaba' tahun bang ta'abut waktuna.”  <div eID="gen1232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv732"/><div sID="gen1233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv732"/> Amissala lagi' si Musa, yukna, “Pinasampay du kam e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ni lahat bangsa Kana'an, lahat bay panganjanji'na pinamuwan ma ka'am sampay ma saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi.

verses.name: Exodus 13:12
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in kam ni lahat e', subay pasuku'unbi ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga anakbi l'lla kasiyakahan kamemon. Damikiyanna saga anak hayop ya dahū l'lla nianakan, subay pinasuku'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> isab.

verses.name: Exodus 13:13
verses.text: Sagō' bang saga anak kura' ya dahū nianakan mbal taluwa' kinulban. Gom pa'in nil'kkat, hatina subay aniya' anak bili-bili atawa kambing sinumbali' ganti'na. Bang anak kura' mbal l'kkatbi, na subay pinōngan buli'-k'llongna. Saga anakbi l'lla kasiyakahan isab, subay nil'kkat maka susumbali'an pagkulbanbi ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv733"/><div sID="gen1234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv733"/> “Ma sinosōng isab, bang kam ganta' tinilaw e' anakbi pasal paghinang kasiyakahan ilu bang ai sababna, ya sambungbi subay buwatittu. ‘Ma sabab kapamowa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma kami paluwas min lahat Misil, ya lahat amanyaga', maka min kosog kawasana isab.

verses.name: Exodus 13:15
verses.text: Bay atuwas sidda kōk Pira'un ma waktu inān ati mbal to'ongan anugutan kami ala'an minnē', pinapatay e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga anak l'lla kasiyakahan kamemon ma kaluha'an lahat Misil, manusiya' ka atawa hayop. Ya he' sababna angkan subay pamasuku'ku ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga anak l'lla ai-ai ya dahū paluwas, maka anakku l'lla kasiyakahan subay l'kkatku maka anak bili-bili atawa kambing.’

verses.name: Exodus 13:16
verses.text: Ya hinang itu sali' sapantun tanda' binaggot ma tangantam atawa ma tuktuktam pamaentom kitam pasal bay kapamowa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma kitam paluwas min lahat Misil, min kosog kawasana isab.” Minnē' aubus kabtangan si Musa.  <div eID="gen1234" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1230" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv734"/><div sID="gen1235" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bangsa Isra'il Palintas ni Dambila' S'llang</title> <div sID="gen1236" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv734"/> Manjari, tapaluwas pa'in saga bangsa Isra'il e' Pira'un, halam sigām binowa e' Tuhan palabay min lān tudju ni lahat Pilistin, minsan asekot-sekot. Tu'ud halli'anna bangsa Isra'il bang sigām agon-agon nirugpak e' saga a'a amowa sigām magbono', marai' al'kkas apinda pikilan sigām ati bilahi sigām pabalik pehē' ni Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 13:18
verses.text: Angkan na sigām binowa e' Tuhan labay min lahat paslangan tampal ni Tahik Keyat.<note>Tahik Pagtomo'an Kaparangan, bang ma bahasa Hibrani.</note> Magtinakos asal sigām bo' asakap magbono'.  <div eID="gen1236" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv735"/><div sID="gen1237" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv735"/> Pagla'an sigām min Misil, binowa e' disi Musa saga to'olang bangkay si Yusup, sabab ma waktu allum lagi' si Yusup, bay pasapana saga anakna. Yukna ma sigām, “Tantu kam tinabang e' Tuhan ma sinosōng bo' kam makaluwas min lahat Misil itu. Amay-amayanta kam, bang ta'abut waktu kaluwasbi, bowahunbi isab bangkayku.”  <div eID="gen1237" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv736"/><div sID="gen1238" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv736"/> Na, ala'an pa'in bangsa Isra'il itu min lahat Sokkot, pahanti' sigām ma Etam, dakayu' lahat ma kasekotan paslangan.

verses.name: Exodus 13:21
verses.text: Manjari ina'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe anganjagahan sigām ma pal'ngnganan. Sakahaba' llaw ina'an iya ma dahuan sigām amandogahan sigām min deyom gabun-Tuhan. Sakahaba' sangom ina'an iya ma deyom api-Tuhan amuwanan sigām kasawahan. Minnē' sigām makal'ngngan llaw-sangom.

verses.name: Exodus 13:22
verses.text: Mbal ala'an gabun-Tuhan inān min munda'an sigām ma waktu llaw, mbal isab ala'an api-Tuhan ma waktu sangom.  <div eID="gen1238" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.13"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:1
verses.text: Angallam na isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 14:2
verses.text: “Soho'un saga a'a Isra'il palibut bo' pahanti' ma atag kauman Pī-Hahirut, mahē' ma tonga'an Migdul maka Tahik Keyat, ma anggopan isab kauman Ba'al-Sepon.

verses.name: Exodus 14:3
verses.text: Sabab bang ta'nda' e' Pira'un bangsa Isra'il magsōng-suhut, pinikil e'na marai' in ka'am alungay pagka kam maglibut-libut sadja ma lahat paslangan.”

verses.name: Exodus 14:4
verses.text: Angallam gi' Tuhan, yukna, “Patuwasku isab kōk Pira'un bo' soho'na saga sundaluna angapas<note>Angapas: ‘anurul’ bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> ka'am. Sagō' da'ugku iya sampay kasundaluhanna. Jari in panganda'ugku inān amuwanan aku kabantugan, lāgi magkahagad saga bangsa Misil in aku si Yawe, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.” Ati bineya' e' saga bangsa Isra'il bay panoho'an Tuhan e'.  <div eID="gen1239" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv737"/><div sID="gen1240" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv737"/> Sakali itu, kahaka'an pa'in Pira'un pasal bangsa Isra'il wa'i alahi, apinda pikilanna. Ya du saga wakilna, ati magsusun sigām. “Arōy,” yuk sigām, “mbal manjari! Wa'i pasagarantam saga a'a Isra'il ala'an min lahat itu ati alungay min kitam saga banyaga' ya bay maghinang ma kitam!”

verses.name: Exodus 14:6
verses.text: Angkan pinasakap e' Pira'un kalesana pagbobono',<note>Kalesa Misil itu ginis pameya'an pagbono', aniya' saga duwa atawa t'llu sundalu ma diyata'na. Duwa silikanna, maka aniya' kura' angangguyud.</note> maka sinō' isab saga kasundaluhanna magsakap.

verses.name: Exodus 14:7
verses.text: Binowa e' Pira'un ba'anan kalesana kamemon sampay saga sundalu ya pagmakōkan kalesa inān pakaniya-pakaniya. Beya' isab saga kalesana ya katapusan ahāp, nnom hatus hekana.

verses.name: Exodus 14:8
verses.text: Manjari itu, atuwas na pa'in kōk Pira'un ya sultan lahat Misil sabab min kabaya'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, angkan apasna bangsa Isra'il, ya anawakkal paluwas min lahatna ma mata mairan.

verses.name: Exodus 14:9
verses.text: Ya magpangapas inān ba'anan kasundaluhan Pira'un, saga sundalu magpangura', ba'anan saga kalesa pagbobono' sampay kakompol-kompolan sundalu magtape'. Ta'abut e' sigām bangsa Isra'il ina'an pahanti' ma bihing Tahik Keyat, ma kasekotan kauman Pi-Hahirut maka Ba'al Sepon.  <div eID="gen1240" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv738"/><div sID="gen1241" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv738"/> Manjari itu, asekot pa'in pina'an Pira'un maka saga kasundaluhanna, ta'nda' sigām e' saga a'a Isra'il. Pag'nda' itu, magtūy sigām sinōd tāw ati parahing ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe angamu' tabang.

verses.name: Exodus 14:11
verses.text: Amūng-mūng sigām ma si Musa, yuk-i, “Mbal manjari hinangnu itu, atiya' kami bowanu paluwas min lahat Misil! Halam bahā' aniya' pangubulan ma lahat Misil, ya angkan kami bowanu pi'itu magpatayan ma lahat paslangan?

verses.name: Exodus 14:12
verses.text: Bay ka pah'llingan kami ma lahat Misil gi', ya yuk kami ma ka'a, ‘Pasagarin kami maghinang gi' ma bangsa Misil.’ Padpad kami amatay ma lahat paslangan itu, gom lagi' kami magpa'ata ma sigām.”  <div eID="gen1241" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv739"/><div sID="gen1242" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv739"/> Anambung si Musa, yukna, “Da'a kam agawa. Pahogotun pangatayanbi ati ta'nda'bi bang buwattingga e' Tuhanta Yawe angalappas ma ka'am. Puwas min llaw itu, mbal na ta'nda'bi pabīng saga a'a Misil ilu.

verses.name: Exodus 14:14
verses.text: Patotog kam, sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya ganti'bi amono' sigām.”  <div eID="gen1242" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv740"/><div sID="gen1243" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv740"/> Angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Angay ka angamu' tabang na pa'in ni aku? Soho'un palanjal saga a'a Isra'il ilu.

verses.name: Exodus 14:16
verses.text: Pabantangun isab tungkudnu paharap ni tahik bo' abahagi' duwa. Manjari paniya' katoho'an ma t'ngnga' tahik palabayanbi bangsa Isra'il tudju parambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 14:17
verses.text: Patuwasku du kōk saga a'a Misil bo' supaya sigām tabowa angapas ka'am sampay ni t'ngnga' tahik. Jari pasōng gi' kabantuganku sabab panganda'ugku min Pira'un maka saga kasundaluhanna, ai na ka sigām ameya' min kalesa pagbono', ai na ka sigām magpangura'.

verses.name: Exodus 14:18
verses.text: Paheya gom pa'in kabantuganku ati magparassaya saga bangsa Misil kamemon in aku si Yawe, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan, pagka tara'ugku Pira'un maka kasundaluhanna kamemon.”  <div eID="gen1243" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv741"/><div sID="gen1244" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv741"/> Puwas e' in mala'ikat Tuhan ya bay parahū asal ma munda'an bangsa Isra'il, pasuhut na ni buli'an. Damikiyanna isab gabun-Tuhan ya bay ma dahuan, pasuhut isab ni buli'an.

verses.name: Exodus 14:20
verses.text: Jari magpati'llot na gabun inān ma saga bangsa Isra'il maka ba'anan kompolan sundalu Misil. Taluwa' kalendoman saga sundalu Misil, sagō' saga a'a Isra'il ma deyom kasawahan na pa'in minsan sangom. Jari halam bay makapagsekot saga a'a Misil maka saga a'a Isra'il waktu sangom inān sampay ni kasubuhan.  <div eID="gen1244" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv742"/><div sID="gen1245" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv742"/> Sakali itu pinabantang e' si Musa tungkudna paharap ni tahik. Pagpabantangna pa'in, magtūy aniya' baliyu akosog pinat'kka e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min sobangan animpus ni kasubuhan. Minnē' aniya' katoho'an ma t'ngnga' tahik. Jari abahagi' duwa tahik

verses.name: Exodus 14:22
verses.text: bo' aniya' t'bbahan palabayan saga bangsa Isra'il parambila'. Maka tahik inān tahinang sali' dinding min bihing sigām karuwambila'.  <div eID="gen1245" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv743"/><div sID="gen1246" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv743"/> Magtūy pa'apas saga sundalu Misil ma sigām, beya' isab saga kalesa Pira'un kamemon maka saga a'ana magpangura', paurul ma sigām sampay ni tahik.

verses.name: Exodus 14:24
verses.text: Na, song pa'in pak'llat llaw, paromol <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min deyom gabun maka api. Ta'nda'na ba'anan kompolan saga sundalu Misil, ati aheya hiluhala' pamat'kkana ma sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 14:25
verses.text: Pinaloblob e'na saga silikan kalesa sigām ya angkan sigām kahunitan magsōng-suhut. Yuk saga sundalu Misil, “Tinabangan saga bangsa Isra'il itu e' si Yawe, angkan halam aniya' dapattam. Sūng kitam alahi!”  <div eID="gen1246" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv744"/><div sID="gen1247" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv744"/> Angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Pabantangun tangannu bo' palalom tahik pabalik, ati bo' alimun ba'anan saga sundalu Misil, beya' isab saga kalesa sigām maka saga kompolan sundalu magpangura'.”

verses.name: Exodus 14:27
verses.text: Magtūy pinabantang e' si Musa tanganna paharap ni tahik. Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, pabīng na tahik ni bay baina. Alahi ba'anan a'a Misil inān kalu makapuwas, sagō' nilokoban sigām e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka tahik.

verses.name: Exodus 14:28
verses.text: Jari makabīng pa'in tahik ni bay baina, alembo kasundaluhan Pira'un kamemon, ya bay angapas saga bangsa Isra'il sampay ni tahik. Talapay saga kalesa sigām maka ba'anan sundalu magpangura'. Halam aniya' takapin allum minsan dakayu'.  <div eID="gen1247" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv745"/><div sID="gen1248" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv745"/> Sagō' saga bangsa Isra'il, pal'ngngan ma katoho'an sampay pa'abut ni dambila'. Aniya' tahik sali' hantang dinding min bihing sigām karuwambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 14:30
verses.text: Jari ma llaw ina'an, lappasan saga a'a Isra'il e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min pang'ntanan saga bangsa Misil. Ta'nda' e' sigām ba'anan saga bangkay a'a Misil ma bihing tahik.

verses.name: Exodus 14:31
verses.text: Na, pag'nda' saga a'a Isra'il itu ma kosog kawasa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya bay panganda'ugna ma saga bangsa Misil e', magtūy sigām magmatāw ma iya. Jari angandol sigām ma iya sampay ma sosoho'anna si Musa.  <div eID="gen1248" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.14"/> <div eID="gen1235" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv746"/><div sID="gen1249" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1250" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv746"/> Na, magpangalang disi Musa maka saga bangsa Isra'il pamudji sigām ni si <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ya na itu kalangan sigām: <lg sID="gen1251"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1252"/>Magkalangan aku ni Yawe<l eID="gen1252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1253"/>sabab abantug da'uganna.<l eID="gen1253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1254"/>Kalarukan e'na saga kura' ni tahik,<l eID="gen1254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1255"/>talapay isab saga a'a magpangura'.<l eID="gen1255" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1256"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:2
verses.text: Si Yawe ya amuwanan aku kosog,<l eID="gen1256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1257"/>in iya pagkalanganku<l eID="gen1257" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1258"/>pagka aku kalappasanna.<l eID="gen1258" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1259"/>In iya Tuhanku, pudjiku iya,<l eID="gen1259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1260"/>Tuhan isab kamatto'ahanku, paheyaku ōnna.<l eID="gen1260" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1261"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:3
verses.text: Aesog asal si Yawe ma pagbono'an,<l eID="gen1261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1262"/>si Yawe ya ōnna.<l eID="gen1262" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1263"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:4
verses.text: Saga kalesa suku' Pira'un<l eID="gen1263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1264"/>sampay ba'anan kasundaluhanna<l eID="gen1264" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1265"/>kalarukan e' Tuhan ni tahik.<l eID="gen1265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1266"/>Saga jiniral Pira'un ya katapusan aesog,<l eID="gen1266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1267"/>wa'i alembo ma Tahik Keyat.<l eID="gen1267" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1268"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:5
verses.text: He' na sigām ma t'ngnga' s'llang<l eID="gen1268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1269"/>sali' hantang batu pat'nde ni kalaloman.<l eID="gen1269" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1270"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:6
verses.text: O Yawe, ka'a ya Sangat-Kawasa,<l eID="gen1270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1271"/>kosognu mbal tapula'-pula'.<l eID="gen1271" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1272"/>Tapodjak saga palbantahannu<l eID="gen1272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1273"/>sabab min kosog kawasanu.<l eID="gen1273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1274"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:7
verses.text: Pinahantak sasuku angatu ma ka'a<l eID="gen1274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1275"/>pagka sigām taluwa' kosog kawasanu.<l eID="gen1275" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1276"/>Atunu' sigām sali' sapantun sagmot<l eID="gen1276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1277"/>pagka taluwa' mulka'nu.<l eID="gen1277" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1278"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:8
verses.text: Pabūd tahik sabab min kosog napasnu,<l eID="gen1278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1279"/>An'ngge goyak sali' hantang dinding,<l eID="gen1279" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1280"/>Akompol isab t'ngnga' s'llang.<l eID="gen1280" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1281"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:9
verses.text: Yuk pangabbu saga palbantahannu,<l eID="gen1281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1282"/>“Apasku saga a'a Isra'il sampay saggawku,<l eID="gen1282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1283"/>Suku'ku pangalta' ya tatabanku min sigām.<l eID="gen1283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1284"/>Karūlan aku amene' ai-ai kanapsuhanku.<l eID="gen1284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1285"/>Hublutku kalisku,” yuk banta inān,<l eID="gen1285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1286"/>“bo' papatayku sigām kamemon.”<l eID="gen1286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1287"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:10
verses.text: Sagō' ka'a, Tuhan, pagtiyupnu mint'dda<l eID="gen1287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1288"/>alimun magtūy palbantahannu e' tahik.<l eID="gen1288" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1289"/>Pat'nde sigām ma timbang<l eID="gen1289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1290"/>sali' sapantun tingga'.<l eID="gen1290" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1291"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:11
verses.text: O Yawe, halam aniya' makasali' ni ka'a<l eID="gen1291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1292"/>ma deyom katuhan-tuhanan ya pagta'atan manusiya'.<l eID="gen1292" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1293"/>Halam to'ongan aniya' sali'nu.<l eID="gen1293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1294"/>Ka'a iya sangat mahasussi, sangat asahaya,<l eID="gen1294" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1295"/>sangat akawasa,<l eID="gen1295" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1296"/>sangat makahinang saga hinang makatāw-tāw<l eID="gen1296" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1297"/>ya kainu-inuhan a'a.<l eID="gen1297" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1298"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:12
verses.text: Pinabantang sadja tangannu kowan,<l eID="gen1298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1299"/>magtūy aliyaw saga banta kami e' gumi.<l eID="gen1299" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1300"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:13
verses.text: Ya Tuhan, mbal amaluba kasi-lasanu<l eID="gen1300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1301"/>ma saga a'a kalappasannu,<l eID="gen1301" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1302"/>angkan sigām malimnu.<l eID="gen1302" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1303"/>Bowanu sigām ni lahatnu mulliya<l eID="gen1303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1304"/>sabab min kosog kawasanu.<l eID="gen1304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1305"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:14
verses.text: Makakale saga bangsa liyu pasal pakaradja'an itu,<l eID="gen1305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1306"/>kinobla'an sigām sampay amidpid.<l eID="gen1306" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1307"/>Saga a'a Pilistin sinōd tāw mbal kasandalan,<l eID="gen1307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1308"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:15
verses.text: Saga datu' bangsa Edom agawa makalandu',<l eID="gen1308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1309"/>pagbebeya'an bangsa Mowab niumagad.<l eID="gen1309" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1310"/>Saga bangsa Kana'an alanyap sadja,<l eID="gen1310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1311"/>angorog-ngorog sigām sabab min tāw.<l eID="gen1311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1312"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:16
verses.text: Sinōd tāw kamemon saga kabangsa-bangsahan<l eID="gen1312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1313"/>ma sabab kosog kawasanu.<l eID="gen1313" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1314"/>An'ngge sadja sigām sampay makalabay na saga a'anu,<l eID="gen1314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1315"/>ya tal'kkatnu min pagbanyaga'an.<l eID="gen1315" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1316"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:17
verses.text: O Tuhan, tantu kami pasampaynu ni lahatnu<l eID="gen1316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1317"/>bo' pat'nna' ma būd ya palsuku'annu lissi,<l eID="gen1317" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1318"/>ni pat'nna'an ya tapene'nu,<l eID="gen1318" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1319"/>ni pagluma'an sussi ya tahinangnu.<l eID="gen1319" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1320"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:18
verses.text: O Yawe, ka'a Tuhan-asal-Tuhan,<l eID="gen1320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1321"/>makapagbaya' du ka salama-lama.”<l eID="gen1321" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1251"/>  <div eID="gen1250" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv747"/><div sID="gen1322" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv747"/> Na, ya na ina'an kalangan disi Musa. Manjari itu, ma waktu kapehē' ni t'ngnga' tahik saga sundalu Pira'un magpangura', maka saga kalesana pagbobono' sampay ba'anan kura'na, alimun sigām kamemon e' tahik ya pinabīng ni baina e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Sagō' in bangsa Isra'il magl'ngnganan ma kat'bbahan sampay makat'kka ni dambila'.  <div eID="gen1322" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv748"/><div sID="gen1323" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv748"/> Sakali magkalangan si Mariyam, dakayu' nabi ya danakan si Harun d'nda. Angā' iya tambul-tambulna maka e'na angigal. Bineya'an isab iya e' saga kar'ndahan magpamowa tambul-tambul di-sigām maka magpangigal isab.

verses.name: Exodus 15:21
verses.text: Magkalangan si Mariyam ma ba'anan sehe'na inān, yukna, <lg sID="gen1324"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1325"/>“Pagkalanginbi si Yawe pamudjibi ma iya,<l eID="gen1325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1326"/>sabab abantug da'uganna.<l eID="gen1326" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1327"/>Kalarukan e'na saga kura' ni tahik,<l eID="gen1327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1328"/>tabeya' isab saga a'a magpangura'.”<l eID="gen1328" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1324"/>  <div eID="gen1323" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1249" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv749"/><div sID="gen1329" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bohe' Apa'it ma Lahat Mara</title> <div sID="gen1330" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv749"/> Na, binowa e' si Musa saga bangsa Isra'il ala'an min Tahik Keyat inān tudju ni lahat paslangan ya pinagōnan Sūr. T'llung'llaw ya t'ggol sigām magl'ngngan-l'ngngan ma lahat paslangan e' ma halam aniya' bohe' tabāk sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 15:23
verses.text: Sakali, maka'abut pa'in sigām ni Mara, mbal tainum bohe' maina'an sabab landu' apa'it. Angkan na lahat inān pinagōnan ‘Mara’, sabab hatina ‘apa'it.’

verses.name: Exodus 15:24
verses.text: Manjari pinagdugalan si Musa e' saga a'a Isra'il. Yuk sigām, “Arōy! Daka ai na inumtam itu!”  <div eID="gen1330" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv750"/><div sID="gen1331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv750"/> Parahing si Musa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe angamu' tabang ati pina'nda'an iya dambatang kayu-kayu. Niā' kayu itu e' si Musa bo' larukanna ni deyom bohe' apa'it e'. Paglaruk itu, magtūy at'bbag bohe' inān, ahāp ni'inum. <div eID="gen1331" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1332" type="paragraph"/> Manjari itu, mahē' pa'in bangsa Isra'il ma lahat Mara he', aniya' sara' pamat'nna' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> panulayanna ma sigām bang ameya' atawa mbal.

verses.name: Exodus 15:26
verses.text: Yukna, “Bang kam pakale to'ongan ma aku, ya Tuhanbi si Yawe, maka bang kam angahinang kabontolan ya makasulut atayku, maka bang kam amogbog isab ma panoho'anku maka pamituwaku kamemon, na, mbal kam pat'kkahanku saga saki ya bay pat'kkaku ma saga bangsa Misil e'. Aku si Yawe ya magpauli' saga sakibi.”  <div eID="gen1332" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv751"/><div sID="gen1333" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv751"/> Pagubus, palanjal na sigām sampay ta'abut pagbohe'an niōnan Ilim. Sangpū' maka duwa ya heka tuburan bohe' maina'an, maka pitumpū' po'onan hulma.<note>Hulma itu, ginis buwa' kayu maumu pinagkakan ma jadjahan ina'an-i. ‘Date’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> Jari pahanti' sigām maina'an ma bihing bohe'. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1333" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.15"/> <div eID="gen1329" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv752"/><div sID="gen1334" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkakan min Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv752"/> Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw ya kahanti' bangsa Isra'il ma Ilim, magbeya' sigām kamemon palanjal minnē'. Jari itu, ma bulan karuwana min bay kaluwas sigām min lahat Misil, sangpū' maka lima kasobangan, makasampay na sigām ni lahat Sīn, ya ma olangan Ilim maka Būd Turusina.<note>Būd Turusina: Būd Sinay isab pagōnna dakayu'.</note> Paslangan asal lahat Sīn itu, ahunit pamiha'an kalluman.

verses.name: Exodus 16:2
verses.text: Sakali itu, mahē' pa'in sigām ma lahat Sīn, magkarugalan kamemon saga a'a Isra'il pasal kulang pagkakan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 16:3
verses.text: Ya pah'lling sigām ma si Musa maka si Harun, “Ahāp kami amatay min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma lahat Misil lagi'. Ahāp bay pamangan kami mahē'. Aniya' saga sumbali'an niloho'an maka palauk indaginis, pila-pila ya kabaya'an kami. Sagō' nda'unbi kahālan kami buwattina'an, itiya' kami tabowabi ni paslangan itu bo' patay otas kamemon.”  <div eID="gen1335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv753"/><div sID="gen1336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv753"/> Sakali itu, pagka buwattē' pagmusmud saga a'a Isra'il, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Paniya'anta kam pagkakan sali' sapantun ulan deyo' min langit. Soho'un saga a'a ilu paluwas min kaluma'an sigām amuwa' pagkakan kahaba' llaw. Ya tatimuk e' sigām subay sarang-sarang pagkakan sigām ma dang'llaw sadja. Minnē' kasulayanku sigām bang ameya' ma panoho'anku atawa mbal.

verses.name: Exodus 16:5
verses.text: Ya ta'adjal e' sigām ma llaw ka'nnomna subay nilipat duwa bo' sarang pagkakan duwang'llaw.” Ya du ina'an pangallam Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1336" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv754"/><div sID="gen1337" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv754"/> Manjari amissala si Musa maka si Harun ma kamemon bangsa Isra'il. “Abay kohap ilu,” yuk sigā, “kamattanan kam in Tuhanbi si Yawe bay amowa ka'am paluwas min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 16:7
verses.text: Pagsalung subu isab maka'nda' kam sahaya si Yawe, sabab takale e'na pagdugalbi ma iya. Ngga'i ka kami ya pagdugalanbi, sabab ngga'i kami ya tag-soho'an.”

verses.name: Exodus 16:8
verses.text: Yuk si Musa isab, “<divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya amuwanan ka'am sumbali'an pagkakanbi kohap, maka tinapay pagkakanbi kahaba' subu, pila-pila ya maka'ssohan ka'am. Sabab hatina takale e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pagdugalbi. Maka ngga'i ka kami ya pagdugalanbi sagō' Tuhan. Ngga'i ka kami ya tag-kapatut.”  <div eID="gen1337" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv755"/><div sID="gen1338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv755"/> Puwas e' ah'lling si Musa ma si Harun, yukna, “Soho'un saga a'a ilu kamemon paharap ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> sabab takale e'na pagdugal sigām.”

verses.name: Exodus 16:10
verses.text: Sakali itu, sabu pa'in si Harun amissala ma saga a'a inān, na, pa'alop sigām tudju ni paslangan. Magtūy saru'un-du'un ta'nda' e' sigām sahaya si Yawe asinag min deyom gabun.  <div eID="gen1338" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv756"/><div sID="gen1339" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv756"/> Yukna ma si Musa,

verses.name: Exodus 16:12
verses.text: “Takaleku pagdugal saga a'a Isra'il. Buwattitu ya pangahakanu ma sigām, ‘Abay kohap itu amangan kam isi sumbali'an, maka salung subu amangan kam pagkakan sampay kam asso na. Minnē' kata'uwanbi in aku si Yawe ya Tuhanbi.’ ”  <div eID="gen1339" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv757"/><div sID="gen1340" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv757"/> Na, abay kohap pa'in, ap'nno' magtūy kauman sigām e' saga manuk-manuk ūl-ūl<note>Manuk-manuk ūl-ūl itu ‘quail’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> landu' aheka. Jari aniya' susumbali'an takakan sigām. Pagsubu isab, abase' e' alu' sakalibut kaluma'an.

verses.name: Exodus 16:14
verses.text: Atoho' pa'in, aniya' sali' luwa aes anipis-nipis to'ongan pat'nna' ma kuwit tana'.

verses.name: Exodus 16:15
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga a'a Isra'il, halam kinata'uwan e' sigām bang ai, angkan sigām magtilaw-tilaw dansehe'an, yuk-i, “Ai ilu?” <div eID="gen1340" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1341" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Musa, “Pagkakan ko' ilu ya pamuwan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 16:16
verses.text: Sinō' kam e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> animuk pagkakan ilu pila-pila ya kagunahanbi ma dang'llaw. Ganta'unbi duwa gantang ma a'a dangan maka dangan sasuku paokom ma luma'bi.”  <div eID="gen1341" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv758"/><div sID="gen1342" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv758"/> Na, bineya' e' saga a'a Isra'il ya bay panoho'an Tuhan e'. Aniya' sigām bay animuk aheka, aniya' isab bay animuk ariki'.

verses.name: Exodus 16:18
verses.text: Sagō' pagt'ppong pa'in, saga a'a bay animuk aheka mbal maglabi, maka saga a'a isab bay animuk ariki' mbal magkulang. Atopod sigām sali'-sali'.

verses.name: Exodus 16:19
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Musa ma sigām, yukna, “Subay kam da'a angapin pagkakanbi salung.”

verses.name: Exodus 16:20
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' sigām kasehe'an mbal ameya' ma pah'lling si Musa-i, ati aniya' kinapin e' sigām. Pagsalung pa'in, na, niulat na maka bau halu'. Jari akagit atay si Musa ma sigām.  <div eID="gen1342" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv759"/><div sID="gen1343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv759"/> Manjari itu, kahaba'-kahaba' subu, animuk pagkakan saga a'a kamemon, pila-pila ya kagunahan sigām. Ya halam tatimuk atunaw lullun e' llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 16:22
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw ka'nnomna, nilipat duwa ya tinimuk e' sigām, hatina mpat gantang ma a'a dangan maka dangan. Sakali itu, makata'u pa'in ba'anan a'a pagbebeya'an pasal pagtimuk aheka ilu, magtūy sigām anumbung pehē' ni si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 16:23
verses.text: Ya sambung si Musa ma sigām, yukna, “Makajari du, sabab aniya' panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pasal llaw kapitu'na, buwattitu. ‘Salung ya llaw paghali-hali, llaw mulliya pagtata'atbi ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.’ Manjari adjalunbi ya bay tatimukbi insini'. Bang kabaya'anbi angahinang dī tinapay, na hinangunbi. Bang kabaya'anbi kinakan sadja, b'llahunbi na. Ai-ai takapin subay tinau' pagkakanbi salung.”  <div eID="gen1343" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv760"/><div sID="gen1344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv760"/> Jari tinau' e' sigām kapinna pagkakan sigām ma llaw kapitu'na, buwat bay pamituwa si Musa. Halam niulat, halam isab bauwan.

verses.name: Exodus 16:25
verses.text: Pagka llaw kapitu'na na, ah'lling si Musa ma sigām, yukna, “Kakanunbi na pagkakan ya tatau'bi ilu, sabab ya na itu llaw kapitu'na, llaw paghali-hali, llaw mulliya pagta'at ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Mbal kam makapuwa' tinapay ma tana' ma llaw itu.

verses.name: Exodus 16:26
verses.text: Nnom llaw ya pagtimukbi, sagō' bang ta'abut llaw kapitu'na, ya llaw mulliya pagta'at ni Tuhan, halam aniya' tatimukbi.”  <div eID="gen1344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv761"/><div sID="gen1345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv761"/> Na, ya du isab, minsan buwattē' pamituwa si Musa, aniya' saga a'a paluwas min kaluma'an arak animuk kinakan ma llaw kapitu', sagō' halam to'ongan aniya' tabāk.

verses.name: Exodus 16:28
verses.text: Angkan amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Ka'am saga bangsa Isra'il, sumiyan kam pahali anagga' saga sara' panoho'anku?

verses.name: Exodus 16:29
verses.text: Entomunbi, aku si Yawe ya amat'nna'an ka'am llaw mulliya itu pagta'atbi ma aku. Ya he' sababna angkan kam buwananku pagkakan nilipat duwa ma llaw ka'nnomna bo' makasarangan ka'am duwang'llaw. Subay kam patotog ma luma'bi ma llaw kapitu'na, da'a kam magluwas-luwas.”

verses.name: Exodus 16:30
verses.text: Manjari pahali-hali saga a'a Isra'il inān ma llaw kapitu'na.  <div eID="gen1345" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv762"/><div sID="gen1346" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv762"/> Ya pangōn saga bangsa Isra'il ma tinapay inān manna.<note>Manna: hatina ma bahasa Hibrani, ‘ai ilu?’</note> Luwana sali' binhi' anahut-nahut walna' pote'. Ahāp nanamna, sali' bāng-bāng lamuran gula' buwani.  <div eID="gen1346" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv763"/><div sID="gen1347" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv763"/> Yuk si Musa ma sigām, “Ya panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> isab, subay tau'ta duwa gantang manna bo' supaya ta'nda' luwana e' panubu'tam magpangkat-mamangkat. Jari kinata'uwan e' sigām ma sinosōng pasal tinapay ya bay pamuwan Tuhan pagkakantam ma lahat paslangan, masa lagi' kapamowana kitam ala'an min lahat Misil.”

verses.name: Exodus 16:33
verses.text: Yuk si Musa isab ma si Harun, “Angā' ka garapun bo' isihun duwa gantang manna. Pat'nna'un ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bo' tinau' maina'an pamaentom saga panubu'tam pangkat-mamangkat.”  <div eID="gen1347" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv764"/><div sID="gen1348" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv764"/> Bineya' magtūy e' si Harun panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> itu. Pinat'nna' e'na garapun isihan manna ma dahuan Ba'ul Paljanji'an bo' tinau' pahāp.

verses.name: Exodus 16:35
verses.text: Manjari itu, in bangsa Isra'il inān magkakanan manna na pa'in ma deyom mpatpū' tahun, sampay ni waktu kat'kka sigām ni lahat taga-a'a. Subay bay ta'abut bihing lahat Kana'an bo' yampa sigām pahali amangan.

verses.name: Exodus 16:36
verses.text: (Epa ya t'ppongan sigām ma masa awal e', lima gantang ma da-epa.) <lb/>  <div eID="gen1348" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.16"/> <div eID="gen1334" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv765"/><div sID="gen1349" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bohe' Paluwas min Batu Lakit</title> <div sID="gen1350" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv765"/> Na, pauntas na saga bangsa Isra'il kamemon min lahat Sīn bo' angalatun lahat, pi'ingga-pi'ingga ya panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sigām. Ta'abut pa'in lahat Repidim, pahanti' sigām maina'an sagō' halam aniya' bohe'na ni'inum.

verses.name: Exodus 17:2
verses.text: Jari anoway saga a'a Isra'il ma si Musa. Yuk sigām, “Buwanin kami bohe'.” <div eID="gen1350" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1351" type="paragraph"/> Anambung magtūy si Musa yukna, “Angay aku panowayanbi? Angay sulayanbi si Yawe?”  <div eID="gen1351" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv766"/><div sID="gen1352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv766"/> Sagō' atoho' to'ongan k'llong sigām, ya angkan sigām angandugal ma si Musa, yuk-i, “Angay kami bay bowanu ala'an min Misil bo' supaya patay bohe' kami kamemon maka saga ka'anakan kami sampay isab ba'anan hayop kami?”  <div eID="gen1352" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv767"/><div sID="gen1353" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv767"/> Na, pagka buwattē' pah'lling sigām, parahing si Musa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angamu' tabang, yukna, “Ya Tuhanku, inayku saga a'a itu? Agon-agon aku pinagbantung e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen1353" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv768"/><div sID="gen1354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv768"/> Anambag <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Pal'ngngan ka parahū min saga a'a ilu. Pabeya'un isab ma ka'a saga kamatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il kasehe'. Bowahun tungkud ya bay pangalubaknu ma sapa' Nīl. Pehē' na ka,” yuk Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 17:6
verses.text: “An'ngge du aku ma matahannu mahē' ma bihing batu lakit ya ma tampalan būd Horeb. Pagt'kkanu pehē', lubakun batu inān maka tungkudnu, ati aniya' bohe' patubud minna'an pamainum saga a'a.” Bineya' e' si Musa panoho'an Tuhan itu ma matahan saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 17:7
verses.text: Ya pangōn si Musa ma atag bohe' inān Massa<note>17:7 Ya hati Massa itu ‘pagjawab’, ya hati Mereba ‘panulayan.’</note> maka Mereba, ma sabab kapamūng-mūng saga bangsa Isra'il maka halam bay amarassaya ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, pagka yuk sigām, “Itiya' bahā' si Yawe ma kitam? Atawa halam?”  <div eID="gen1354" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1349" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv769"/><div sID="gen1355" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bangsa Amalek Tara'ug e' Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen1356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv769"/> Na, ma Repidim pa'in bangsa Isra'il, nirugpak sigām e' saga bangsa Amalek.

verses.name: Exodus 17:9
verses.text: Manjari anoho' si Musa ma si Yussa', ya nakura' sundalu. Yuk si Musa, “Pene'in kitam saga l'lla ati bowahun sigām magbono' maka bangsa Amalek inān. Pagsalung, an'ngge aku ma diyata' būd ilu maka e'ku ang'ntan tungkud ya bay pamuwan aku e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv770"/><div sID="gen1357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv770"/> Bineya' e' si Yussa' panoho'an si Musa he'. Binowa e'na saga a'ana angatu ma bangsa Amalek. Sagō' si Musa maka si Harun, maka sehe' sigām si Hūr, bay patukad ni diyata' būd e'.

verses.name: Exodus 17:11
verses.text: Sat'ggol pina'angkat e' si Musa tanganna karuwambila' anganda'ug saga bangsa Isra'il. Sagō' bang pinareyo', bangsa Amalek ya anganda'ug.

verses.name: Exodus 17:12
verses.text: Manjari itu, ta'abut pa'in angalongkoy tangan si Musa, aniya' batu binowahan iya e' si Harun maka si Hūr pamatingkō'an iya. An'ngge sigām duwangan min bihing si Musa karuwambila' ama'angkat tanganna, manjari atotog sampay pas'ddop mata llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 17:13
verses.text: Na, minnē' tara'ug ba'anan sundalu bangsa Amalek e' disi Yussa'.  <div eID="gen1357" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv771"/><div sID="gen1358" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv771"/> Pagubus, amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Sulatun pakaradja'an itu bo' mbal takalipat. Pakalehun isab si Yussa', sabab lapnasku bangsa Amalek itu sampay sigām alungay tūy min pangentom manusiya'.”

verses.name: Exodus 17:15
verses.text: Manjari amangkat batu si Musa nihinang pagkulbanan ni Tuhan. Yawe-Nissi ya pangōn si Musa ma pagkulbanan-i, hatina ‘si Yawe ya Panjiku.’

verses.name: Exodus 17:16
verses.text: Yuk si Musa, “Pat'nggehunbi panji si Yawe. Binantahan e'na saga bangsa Amalek magpangkat-mamangkat.”  <div eID="gen1358" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.17"/> <div eID="gen1355" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv772"/><div sID="gen1359" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katibaw si Jetro ni Ayuwanna si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv772"/> Na si Jetro, ya imam ma lahat Midiyan, mato'a isab si Musa, bay makakale pasal kaheya tabang si Yawe ma disi Musa sampay ma saga bangsana Isra'il. Bay kono' sigām tapaluwas e'na min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 18:2
verses.text: Si Jetro itu bay angokoman si Sippura h'nda si Musa maka duwangan anakna, waktu bay kapamapole' iya e' h'llana. Si Gersom<note>Ya ōn Gersom itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘a'a liyu.’</note> ya ōn anakna dakayu' inān. “Sabab,” yuk si Musa, “aku itu a'a liyu ma ngga'i ka lahatku.”

verses.name: Exodus 18:3
verses.text: Si Jetro itu bay angokoman si Sippura h'nda si Musa maka duwangan anakna, waktu bay kapamapole' iya e' h'llana. Si Gersom<note>Ya ōn Gersom itu, hatina bang ma bahasa Hibrani ‘a'a liyu.’</note> ya ōn anakna dakayu' inān. “Sabab,” yuk si Musa, “aku itu a'a liyu ma ngga'i ka lahatku.”

verses.name: Exodus 18:4
verses.text: Si Ele'eser<note>Ya ōn Ele'eser itu, hatina ‘Tuhan ya magtatabang.’</note> ya ōn anakna pasunu'. “Sabab,” yuk si Musa, “tinabangan aku e' Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mma'ku. Kalappasan aku e'na min pang'ntanan Pira'un waktu iya bilahi amono' ma aku.”  <div eID="gen1360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv773"/><div sID="gen1361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv773"/> Manjari, takale pa'in e' si Jetro pasal kahālan si Musa itu, patibaw iya pehē' ni pahanti'an disi Musa, ya ma atag būd Tuhan ma lahat paslangan. Ina'an isab ameya' ma iya h'nda si Musa maka duwangan anakna.

verses.name: Exodus 18:6
verses.text: Aniya' isab tambuku bay pinabeya' e' si Jetro ni si Musa, yukna, “Pi'ilu aku patibaw ni ka'a, beya' isab h'ndanu maka duwangan anaknu.”

verses.name: Exodus 18:7
verses.text: Na, song pa'in at'kka disi Jetro, pehē' si Musa anampang. Pag'nda'na ma mato'ana, magtūy iya paruku'. Aubus, siniyum e'na mato'ana. Magaddat-iyaddati sigā bo' yampa pasōd ni deyom luma' si Musa tolda.

verses.name: Exodus 18:8
verses.text: Sinuli-sulihan si Jetro e' si Musa pasal kamemon bay nihinang e' si Yawe ma Pira'un maka ma a'a Misil kamemon, sabab min lasana ma bangsa Isra'il. Sinuli-suli isab pasal kasigpitan ya kalabayan sigām ma l'ngnganan sigām, maka buwattingga kalappas <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sigām.  <div eID="gen1361" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv774"/><div sID="gen1362" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv774"/> Makakale pa'in si Jetro pasal kahāpan kamemon ya tahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma saga bangsa Isra'il, kinōgan iya. Yukna, “Pudjita si Yawe, ya bay angalappasan ka'am min komkoman Pira'un maka saga bangsana. Sanglitanta iya, ya bay amaluwas ka'am min pagbanyaga'an.

verses.name: Exodus 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv774"/><div sID="gen1362" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv774"/> Makakale pa'in si Jetro pasal kahāpan kamemon ya tahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma saga bangsa Isra'il, kinōgan iya. Yukna, “Pudjita si Yawe, ya bay angalappasan ka'am min komkoman Pira'un maka saga bangsana. Sanglitanta iya, ya bay amaluwas ka'am min pagbanyaga'an.

verses.name: Exodus 18:11
verses.text: Kata'uwanku na, akawasa gi' si Yawe min katuhan-tuhanan kamemon ya pagta'atan manusiya', sabab tapareyo' e'na saga a'a Misil ya bay amissoko' ka'am bangsa Isra'il.”

verses.name: Exodus 18:12
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' dakayu' hayop binowa e' si Jetro mato'a si Musa panukbal ni Tuhan, tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna. Maka aniya' gi' susumbali'an saddī tinukbal isab. Jari magtipun si Harun maka kamemon saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il bo' magjamu maka si Jetro ma matahan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1362" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv775"/><div sID="gen1363" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv775"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', ina'an si Musa analassay palkala' ya binowa ni iya e' saga a'a kamemon. Magabut-abut sigām magtimuk ma sakalibutna min subu-subu sampay ni kasangoman.

verses.name: Exodus 18:14
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Jetro ma hinang si Musa itu abuhat makalandu', yukna ma iya, “Angay ka angkan maghinang buwattilu ma ba'anan a'a ilu! Angay subay ka'a dangan-dangannu ya analassay ba'anan palkala' sigām, maka sigām ya magt'nggehan ma sakalibutnu sampay ni kasangoman?”  <div eID="gen1363" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv776"/><div sID="gen1364" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv776"/> Ya sambung si Musa ma mato'ana, “Bapa', angkan buwattitu, sabab aku ya pangaruhan sigām pasal kahandak Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 18:16
verses.text: Bang aniya' palkala' pagsagga'an sigām sumiyan-sumiyan, aku ya amituwahan sigām pasal sara' maka panoho'an Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1364" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv777"/><div sID="gen1365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv777"/> Yuk si Jetro ma iya, “Ā, mbal taluwa' hinangnu ilu.

verses.name: Exodus 18:18
verses.text: Ahusa' makalandu'. Binale' ka sampay saga a'a ya angalagaran ka'a. Mbal takole'nu bang halam aniya' anabangan ka'a.

verses.name: Exodus 18:19
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Jetro isab, “kalehun pahāp, aniya' gara' pangahūganku ka'a, mura-murahan isab bang pa'in pataptap Tuhan ma ka'a. Ka'a ya subay paharap ni Tuhan ganti' saga a'a Isra'il bang aniya' palkala' sigām. Ati pasampayun ba'anan palkala' itu ni Tuhan bo' kinata'uwan bang ai kahandakna.

verses.name: Exodus 18:20
verses.text: Pata'uhun sigām pasal kasara'an maka panoho'an Tuhan. Pandu'in sigām pasal addat-tabi'at ya patut bineya' e' sigām maka hinang ya wajib nihinang.

verses.name: Exodus 18:21
verses.text: Subay ka isab amene' saga a'a min bangsa Isra'il. Ya pene'nu subay a'a taga-pangita'u, a'a magmatāw ma Tuhan, a'a kapangandolan ya mbal katambahan maka sīn. Buwanin sigām kapatut magmakōk ma pagkahi sigām dakompolan, sangpū' ka ma dakompolan, limampū' ka, dahatus ka, atawa dangibu.

verses.name: Exodus 18:22
verses.text: Pat'nna'un sigām analassay palkala' ma saga a'a Isra'il sakahaba' llaw. Sagō' bang palkala' landu' ahunit, ya mbal takole' niusay e' sigām, subay pinasampay ni ka'a. Bang palkala' aluhay-luhay, sigām ya analassay. Minnē' palampung hinangnu pagka aniya' sehe'nu magtabang.

verses.name: Exodus 18:23
verses.text: Na, bang beya'nu gara'ku itu, maka bang panoho'an Tuhan du isab, mbal ka sakit ahusa'. Magpole'an isab ba'anan saga a'a itu ma halam na aniya' makasasaw deyom atay sigām.”  <div eID="gen1365" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv778"/><div sID="gen1366" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv778"/> Manjari bineya' e' si Musa gara' kamemon bay pangahūg mato'ana inān ma iya.

verses.name: Exodus 18:25
verses.text: Tapene' e'na saga l'lla taga-pangita'u min saga bangsa Isra'il. Pinat'nna' sigām magmakōk ma kompolan pagkahi sigām, aniya' magmakōk ma sangpū', aniya' ma limampū', aniya' ma dahatus, aniya' isab ma dangibu.

verses.name: Exodus 18:26
verses.text: Binuwanan sigām kapatut analassay palkala' kahaba' llaw. Bang palkala' aluhay-luhay, sigām ya analassay. Sagō' bang palkala' ahunit, pinasampay ni si Musa.  <div eID="gen1366" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv779"/><div sID="gen1367" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv779"/> Na, pinaba'id si Jetro e' ayuwanna si Musa bo' pinatulak amole' ni lahatna. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1367" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.18"/> <div eID="gen1359" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv780"/><div sID="gen1368" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Būd Turusina</title> <div sID="gen1369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv780"/> Na, makauntas pa'in saga bangsa Isra'il min Repidim, at'kka na sigām ni dakayu' lahat, ōnna Paslangan Turusina. Angahinang sigām paghanti'an maina'an ma deyo'an Būd Turusina. Sahali bulan ya kat'kka sigām pina'an, ma bulan kat'lluna min bay kala'an sigām min Misil.  <div eID="gen1369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv780"/><div sID="gen1368" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Būd Turusina</title> <div sID="gen1369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv780"/> Na, makauntas pa'in saga bangsa Isra'il min Repidim, at'kka na sigām ni dakayu' lahat, ōnna Paslangan Turusina. Angahinang sigām paghanti'an maina'an ma deyo'an Būd Turusina. Sahali bulan ya kat'kka sigām pina'an, ma bulan kat'lluna min bay kala'an sigām min Misil.  <div eID="gen1369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv781"/><div sID="gen1370" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv781"/> Manjari itu patukad si Musa minnē' bo' paharap ni Tuhan, ati nilinganan iya e' si Yawe min būd, yuk-i, “Ya na itu pamissalanu ma saga a'a Isra'il, hatina saga panubu' si Yakub.

verses.name: Exodus 19:4
verses.text: ‘Bay na ta'nda'bi bang ai bay tahinangku ma saga bangsa Misil maka bang buwattingga e'ku bay amowa kam pi'itu ni aku. Ya pamowaku ma ka'am sali' sapantun belle' amowa ba'anan anakna ma pikpikna.

verses.name: Exodus 19:5
verses.text: Na buwattina'an, aniya' pangalapalku ma ka'am. Bang kam ameya' to'ongan ma panoho'anku maka amogbog ma paljanji'anku maka ka'am, na, ka'am ya pene'ku min deyom kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon ma babaw dunya. Manjari ka'am ya palsuku'anku landu' ahalga' ma atayku. Suku'ku asal katilibut dunya itu,

verses.name: Exodus 19:6
verses.text: sagō' ka'am ya itungku bangsaku sussi maka tubu'an kaimaman maghinang ma aku.’ Na,” yuk Tuhan, “ya du ilu lapal-kabtangan ya pamissalanu ma saga a'a Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1370" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv782"/><div sID="gen1371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv782"/> Manjari palūd si Musa minnē' ati soho'na patimuk saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il. Makatimuk pa'in, pinasampay e'na ni sigām saga lapal-kabtangan kamemon ya sinō' e' Tuhan pangahakana ma sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 19:8
verses.text: Na, dauyunan saga a'a Isra'il inān kamemon ati anambung sigām magsama-sama. “Beya' kami ai-ai panoho'an si Yawe ma kitam.” Jari pinasampay e' si Musa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya panambung sigām.  <div eID="gen1371" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv783"/><div sID="gen1372" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv783"/> Angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Pi'ilu aku ni ka'a min gabun magdo'om-do'om bo' supaya takale suwalaku e' saga a'a ilu hinabuku magsuli-suli maka ka'a. Ati tabowa sigām am'nnal to'ongan ma ka'a sampay ni kasaumulan.” <div eID="gen1372" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1373" type="paragraph"/> Angahaka isab si Musa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pasal bay pah'lling saga a'a he',

verses.name: Exodus 19:10
verses.text: ati amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, yukna, “Pehē' na ka ni saga a'a ilu. Pasuku'un sigām ma aku llaw itu maka salung. Soho'un sigām angandakdakan saga badju' sigām,

verses.name: Exodus 19:11
verses.text: bo' supaya sigām asakap pagabut simuddai. Sabab simuddai ya llaw katulunku ni būd Turusina ma pang'nda' sigām kamemon. Si Yawe aku, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.”

verses.name: Exodus 19:12
verses.text: Angallam gi' Tuhan-i. “Pat'nna'un gindan,” yukna, “bo' aniya' pangahāran saga a'a, maka soho'un sigām kamaya'-maya'. Subay halam aniya' min sigām paliyu minna'an bo' patukad ni būd atawa pa'abut ni deyo'anna. Bang ganta' aniya' a'a pa'abut atawa pagi'ik ni būd itu, subay iya pinapatay.

verses.name: Exodus 19:13
verses.text: Ya pamapatay ma iya subay batu atawa pana', mbal iya makajari ni'ntanan maka tangan. Ai na ka manusiya', ai na ka hayop, bang pa'abut ni būd, mbal manjari pinasagaran allum. Malaingkan, bang takale lling tanduk kambing tiniyup, yampa sigām makajari patukad ni atag būd e'.”  <div eID="gen1373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv784"/><div sID="gen1374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv784"/> Puwas e', makalūd pa'in si Musa min būd, pinasuku' e'na ni Tuhan saga a'a Isra'il kamemon ati nirakdakan saga s'mmek sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 19:15
verses.text: Amissala gi' si Musa, yukna, “Subay kam angamomos kamemon bo' kam sakap ma llaw simuddai. Da'a isab kam maghulid l'lla maka d'nda sampay apuwas min llaw ina'an.”  <div eID="gen1374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv785"/><div sID="gen1375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv785"/> Na, pagsimuddai subu pa'in, aniya' l'ggon maka lāt, maka aniya' gabun magdo'om-do'om ma diyata' būd e'. Aniya' isab tanduk-kambing tiniyup, landu' akosog llingna. Jari magpamidpid min tāw saga a'a kamemon ya ma pustu inān.

verses.name: Exodus 19:17
verses.text: Na, minaliman saga a'a inān e' si Musa, binowa paluwas min atag paghanti'an sigām e' bo' paharap ni Tuhan. Jari ina'an sigām magt'nggehan ma deyo'an būd.

verses.name: Exodus 19:18
verses.text: Aputus Būd Turusina e' humbu sabab bay patulun pina'an si Yawe ma deyom keyat api. Pat'bbud humbu inān buwat humbu min lapohan landu' aheya. Ajogjog isab katibu'ukan būd, akosog jogjogna.

verses.name: Exodus 19:19
verses.text: Ya pagtiyup tanduk-kambing inān pasōng na pa'in kosogna, bo' pasōng. Amissala si Musa ati sinambungan iya e' l'ggon, ya na suwala Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1375" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv786"/><div sID="gen1376" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv786"/> Ina'an asal si Yawe bay patulun ni puttuk Būd Turusina bo' lingananna si Musa sinō' patukad pehē' ni iya. Jari patukad magtūy si Musa

verses.name: Exodus 19:21
verses.text: bo' aniya' pah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya. Yukna, “Palūd na ka pehē'. Banda'in saga a'a inān subay da'a paliyu min gindan ya pangahāran sigām, minsan buwattingga baya' sigām ang'nda' ma aku. Tantu aheka sigām amatay bang ganta' paliyu.

verses.name: Exodus 19:22
verses.text: Minsan saga imam, ya biyasa pasekot ma aku, subay anussi di-sigām. Bang sigām mbal ameya', pat'kkahanku sigām mulka'.”  <div eID="gen1376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv787"/><div sID="gen1377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv787"/> Yuk si Musa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Mbal makatukad saga a'a Isra'il ni Būd Turusina itu sabab ka'a ya bay anoho' kami amat'nna' jangka'an ma sakalibutna. Būd itu subay nihalli'an bo' minulliya ma ka'a sadja.”  <div eID="gen1377" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv788"/><div sID="gen1378" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv788"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Palūd gi' ka amowa si Harun pi'itu. Sagō' da'a pasagarin saga kaimaman maka ba'anan saga a'a paliyu min jangka'an bo' pi'itu ang'nda' ma aku. Bang sigām makaliyu, pat'kkahanku sigām mulka'.”

verses.name: Exodus 19:25
verses.text: Sakali palūd na si Musa ni deyo'an būd bo' pangahakana ma saga a'a ya lapal Tuhan e'. <lb/>  <div eID="gen1378" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.19"/> <div eID="gen1368" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv789"/><div sID="gen1379" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sangpū' Sara' Panoho'an Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1380" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv789"/> Manjari buwattitu saga lapal-kabtangan ya pamalman Tuhan,

verses.name: Exodus 20:2
verses.text: “Aku si Yawe ya Tuhanbi, ya bay amowa ka'am pala'an min lahat Misil, lahat bay pamanyaga'an ka'am.  <div eID="gen1380" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv790"/><div sID="gen1381" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv790"/> “Wajib kam da'a magtuhan saddī min aku.  <div eID="gen1381" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv791"/><div sID="gen1382" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv791"/> “Wajib kam da'a angahinang tuhan-tuhan angaluwa ai-ai ma diyata' langit, atawa ma gintana'an, atawa ma tahik.

verses.name: Exodus 20:5
verses.text: Wajib kam da'a pasujud atawa anumba ma ba'anan tuhan-tuhan inān, sabab si Yawe aku, ya Tuhanbi. Ab'nsi aku niagawan kapagtuhanku e' sai-sai. Pat'kkahanku katiksa'an sasuku anaikutan aku, papole'ku dusana ni saga anak-mpuna magpangkat-mamangkat sampay ni mpuna kengkeng.

verses.name: Exodus 20:6
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku magmalasa ma aku maka ameya' isab ma panoho'anku, pat'kkaku lasaku tuman ma saga anak-mpuna sampay ni saga panubu'na magibu-ibuhan pangkat.  <div eID="gen1382" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv792"/><div sID="gen1383" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv792"/> “Wajib kam da'a anabbut ōn si Yawe ya pagtuhananbi ma halam aniya' pūsna tantu, sabab itungku taga-dusa sasuku anabbut ōnku ma halam kapūsanna.  <div eID="gen1383" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv793"/><div sID="gen1384" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv793"/> “Bogboginbi Llaw Paghali, pagka Llaw Mulliya tudju ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 20:9
verses.text: Makajari kam maghinang atawa magusaha ma deyom nnom llaw,

verses.name: Exodus 20:10
verses.text: sagō' ya llaw kapitu'na wajib pinagmulliya pamudjibi ma aku ya Tuhanbi si Yawe. Subay halam aniya' ma ka'am maghinang ai-ai ma llaw ina'an-i. Ai na ka ka'am baranbi, ai na ka ka'anakanbi, ai na ka ipatanbi d'nda-l'lla, ai na ka hayopbi, subay to'ongan pahali maghinang. Minsan a'a bangsa liyu ya pahanti' ma luma'bi, subay mbal isab maghinang.

verses.name: Exodus 20:11
verses.text: Kalna' aku si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. Nnom llaw ya bay pamapanjariku langit maka dunya maka tahik, sampay kamemon isina. Sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw kapitu'na, pahali na aku maghinang. Angkan minulliya e'ku llaw inān, nihinang llaw pamaheyabi ma aku.  <div eID="gen1384" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv794"/><div sID="gen1385" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv794"/> “Pagaddatinbi ina'-mma'bi bo' supaya ataha' pangumulanbi ma lahat ya pamuwan ka'am e' si Yawe ya Tuhanbi.  <div eID="gen1385" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv795"/><div sID="gen1386" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv795"/> “Wajib kam da'a amono' ma pagkahibi manusiya'.  <div eID="gen1386" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv796"/><div sID="gen1387" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv796"/> “Wajib kam da'a magjina.  <div eID="gen1387" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv797"/><div sID="gen1388" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv797"/> “Wajib kam da'a anangkaw.  <div eID="gen1388" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv798"/><div sID="gen1389" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv798"/> “Wajib kam da'a anaksi' puting pasal pagkahibi manusiya'.  <div eID="gen1389" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv799"/><div sID="gen1390" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv799"/> “Wajib kam da'a anganapsuhan luma' pagkahibi. Da'a kanapsuhinbi ai-ai suku' pagkahibi, ai na ka h'ndana, ai na ka ipatanna d'nda-l'lla, ai na ka sapi'na atawa kura'na.”  <div eID="gen1390" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv800"/><div sID="gen1391" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv800"/> Na, magpamidpid min tāw ba'anan a'a Isra'il, pagka takale e' sigām l'ggon maka tanduk-kambing pinagtiyup pakosog. Ta'nda' isab e' sigām lāt maka būd angahumbu. Angagad sadja sigām min kalawakan.

verses.name: Exodus 20:19
verses.text: Yuk sigām ma si Musa, “Bang pa'in ka'a sadja ya amissala ma kami, ati pakale du kami. Sagō' da'a papagsuwalahun Tuhan ni kami, sabab makapatay ko' inān.”  <div eID="gen1391" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv801"/><div sID="gen1392" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv801"/> Yuk si Musa ma sigām, “Da'a kam tināw. Sinulayan sadja kam e' Tuhan bang buwattingga pameya'bi ma iya. Kabaya'anna ma ka'am subay magmatāw ma iya supaya kam mbal makapagdusa.”  <div eID="gen1392" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv802"/><div sID="gen1393" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv802"/> Jari angagad-ngagad gi' saga a'a kamemon inān min kalawakan. Luwal si Musa ya pasekot ni atag karo'om-do'oman ya patulunan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1393" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1379" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv803"/><div sID="gen1394" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hatulan pasal Pangarapan ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1395" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv803"/> Sakali amalman gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Palatunun palmanku itu ni saga bangsa Isra'il. Ya yuknu, ‘Kasaksi'anbi na in aku bay ah'lling ni ka'am min diyata' langit.

verses.name: Exodus 20:23
verses.text: Da'a pagtuhaninbi saga ta'u-ta'u ya hinangbi min pilak atawa min bulawan. Subay halam aniya' pagtuhananbi saddī min aku.  <div eID="gen1395" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv804"/><div sID="gen1396" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv804"/> “ ‘Ya pangarapanbi ma aku subay tana' pinagtambak. Maina'an ya pangulbananbi saga bili-bilibi maka kambing maka sapi' ya sumbali'bi bo' tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna. Maka maina'an isab ya pagduwa'ahanbi salamat. Maingga-maingga lugal ya pene'ku panabbutanbi ōnku, pi'ilu du aku amuwanan ka'am kahāpan.

verses.name: Exodus 20:25
verses.text: Bang kam saupama anambak batu pangarapanbi ma aku, subay batu halam bay pinagsapsapan, sabab batu bay kasapsapan asammal ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 20:26
