verses.text: Lāgi, da'a kam angahinang haronan pariyata'anbi ni tambak batu ilu, sabab ta'nda' harapanbi hinabubi pariyata'.’ ”  <div eID="gen1396" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.20"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:1
verses.text: Na, angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa yukna, “Itiya' na ba'anan sara' panoho'anku ya subay palatunnu ni saga a'a Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1397" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1394" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv805"/><div sID="gen1398" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Pangipat Ata</title> <div sID="gen1399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv805"/> Yuk Tuhan, “Bang kam am'lli pagkahibi bangsa Hibrani nihinang ata, ya t'ggolna maghinang ma ka'am subay mbal palabi min nnom tahun. Ta'abut pa'in tahun kapitu'na subay iya paluhaya'unbi ma halam aniya' bayadna.

verses.name: Exodus 21:3
verses.text: Bang ata halam taga-h'nda ma waktu kasōdna ni pangipatannu, patut iya dangan-danganna pinaluhaya. Damikiyanna bang ata bay makabowa h'nda, subay amowa h'ndana isab ma waktu kaluwasna.

verses.name: Exodus 21:4
verses.text: Bang aniya' isab ata bay pinah'nda'an e' a'a pa'atahanna, ati aniya' anakna d'nda-l'lla minnē', in anak-h'ndana inān subay taitung suku' a'a pa'atahanna he'. Hal iya dangan-danganna pinaluwas.

verses.name: Exodus 21:5
verses.text: Malaingkan, bang ata inān magsubali in iya alasa ma a'a pa'atahanna sampay ma saga anak-h'ndana, ati mbal bilahi pinaluhaya min pagatahanna, na buwatittu hatulanna:

verses.name: Exodus 21:6
verses.text: in a'a inān subay binowa e' nakura'na ni lugal paghukuman.<note>Ni lugal paghukuman: atawa ni luma' pagta'atan ni Tuhan.</note> Maina'an pa'in, subay iya pinabihing e' nakura'na ni tambol lawang atawa ni hāgna ati bo' nilowangan taingana. Pagka buwattē', tattap na iya maghinang ma a'a pa'atahanna inān sat'ggolna allum.  <div eID="gen1399" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv806"/><div sID="gen1400" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv806"/> “Na, bang aniya' a'a amab'llian anakna budjang nihinang ata, in d'nda inān mbal tapaluhaya buwat ata l'lla.

verses.name: Exodus 21:8
verses.text: Bang iya mbal makasulut nakura'na ya bay arak angā' iya h'nda, in matto'a d'nda he' subay binuwanan lawang angal'kkat iya min pagatahan. Halam aniya' kapatut ma a'a paipatanna amab'llian iya ni a'a bangsa saddī, sabab kabalubahan bay janji'na ma iya.

verses.name: Exodus 21:9
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' a'a am'lli dakayu' budjang pamah'ndana ma anakna, ya addatna tudju ni iya subay dasali' maka addatna ni anakna lissi.

verses.name: Exodus 21:10
verses.text: Bang a'a isab magh'nda'an atana d'nda, bo' aniya' gi' d'nda saddī pagkalu'ana, in h'ndana po'on inān mbal manjari siniya-siya. Subay iya binuwanan ai-ai kapatutna, hatina pagkakan, pan'mmek, paghulid maka h'llana.

verses.name: Exodus 21:11
verses.text: Bang l'lla inān mbal ganta' amuwanan iya ai-ai kapatutna, na, subay iya paluhayana ma halam aniya' bayadna.  <div eID="gen1400" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1398" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv807"/><div sID="gen1401" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Pagbono'</title> <div sID="gen1402" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv807"/> “Sasuku angala'ugan pagkahina bo' amatay, a'a inān wajib subay pinapatay.

verses.name: Exodus 21:13
verses.text: Sagō' bang halam taniyat e' a'a makabono' inān, tu'ud ganta'anna min Tuhan, subay iya alahi ni lahat patapukan ya song pene'anku ka'am (Tuhan ya ah'lling).

verses.name: Exodus 21:14
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a anganiyat amapatay a'a dangan bo' tapapatayna, a'a inān subay pinapatay minsan iya amalut ma tampat pagkulbanan ma aku. La'aninbi iya minnē', papatayhunbi.  <div eID="gen1402" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv808"/><div sID="gen1403" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv808"/> “Sai-sai angala'ugan mma'na atawa ina'na subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1403" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv809"/><div sID="gen1404" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv809"/> “Sai-sai ta'abut bay anaggaw pagkahina manusiya' subay pinapatay. Minsan wa'i pinab'llian a'a bay tasaggawna he', atawa minsan isab masi ma deyomanna, subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1404" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv810"/><div sID="gen1405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv810"/> “Sai-sai anukna'an mma'na atawa ina'na subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1405" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv811"/><div sID="gen1406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv811"/> “Bang aniya' duwangan a'a maglugat bo' dangan ya angala'ugan sehe'na, buwat saga anuntuk atawa am'ppok iya maka batu, a'a inān mbal kasā'an luwal bang amatay sehe'na he'. Bang iya hal tabowa palege ma pabahakanna, bo' makabungkal du sampay makal'ngngan na ma luwasan luma' minsan magtungkud-tungkud, na, ya a'a bay angala'ug inān subay pina'atas amayaran ai-ai pagtambal iya sampay kauli'an to'ongan. Subay pina'atas isab angangganti' usahana sat'ggolna mbal makausaha.  <div eID="gen1406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv811"/><div sID="gen1406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv811"/> “Bang aniya' duwangan a'a maglugat bo' dangan ya angala'ugan sehe'na, buwat saga anuntuk atawa am'ppok iya maka batu, a'a inān mbal kasā'an luwal bang amatay sehe'na he'. Bang iya hal tabowa palege ma pabahakanna, bo' makabungkal du sampay makal'ngngan na ma luwasan luma' minsan magtungkud-tungkud, na, ya a'a bay angala'ug inān subay pina'atas amayaran ai-ai pagtambal iya sampay kauli'an to'ongan. Subay pina'atas isab angangganti' usahana sat'ggolna mbal makausaha.  <div eID="gen1406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv812"/><div sID="gen1407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv812"/> “Bang aniya' a'a angalubakan atana d'nda atawa l'lla, bo' amatay magtūy, subay iya sinā'an.

verses.name: Exodus 21:21
verses.text: Sagō' bang ata inān mbal amatay sagō' palege sadja saga duwa ni t'llung'llaw bo' yampa makabungkal, in a'a bay makalubak mbal kasā'an sabab atana asal, suku'na.  <div eID="gen1407" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv813"/><div sID="gen1408" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv813"/> “Bang aniya' saga a'a magsuntuk, bo' aniya' d'nda ab'ttong talapay ati tabowa anganak ma mbal gi' bulananna, sagō' mbal ainay baranna, buwattitu hatulanna: ya a'a bay anganjudjal d'nda he' subay pinaluwasan pangandiyat, pila-pila ya kabaya'an h'llana, bang pa'in da'a palabi min diyat ya pangahād e' saga kahuwisan.

verses.name: Exodus 21:23
verses.text: Malaingkan bang d'nda ilu pali'an aheya, ya pangandiyat subay pinapagtongod maka pali'na. Bang pali' makamatay, kamatay ya pangandiyat.

verses.name: Exodus 21:24
verses.text: Bang mata ya magka'at subay mata isab pangandiyat. Bang empon subay empon, bang tangan subay tangan, bang tape' subay isab tape'.

verses.name: Exodus 21:25
verses.text: Bang tunu', subay tunu', bang bakat subay bakat, bang alom subay alom.  <div eID="gen1408" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv814"/><div sID="gen1409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv814"/> “Bang aniya' a'a angala'ugan atana, l'lla ka atawa d'nda, bo' magka'at matana atawa emponna, in atana inān subay pinaluhaya paluwas min pagatahanna. Ya he' pangandiyat ma matana atawa emponna.  <div eID="gen1409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv814"/><div sID="gen1409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv814"/> “Bang aniya' a'a angala'ugan atana, l'lla ka atawa d'nda, bo' magka'at matana atawa emponna, in atana inān subay pinaluhaya paluwas min pagatahanna. Ya he' pangandiyat ma matana atawa emponna.  <div eID="gen1409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv815"/><div sID="gen1410" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv815"/> “Bang aniya' a'a amatay tinanduk e' sapi' mandangan, ya sapi' inān subay binantung sampay amatay. Isina mbal manjari kinakan, sagō' tag-dapu mbal taluwa' sinā'an.

verses.name: Exodus 21:29
verses.text: Malaingkan bang sapi' he' panananduk asal, bo' halam bay sinasak atawa niengkotan e' tag-dapu minsan bay kasanggupan, na, saddī hatulanna. Bang sapi' panananduk ya makapatay a'a, subay binantung. Maka tag-dapuna subay pinapatay isab.

verses.name: Exodus 21:30
verses.text: Malaingkan bang bilahi saga usba-waris a'a ya patay tanduk e', in tag-dapu sapi' makajari amuwan kasā'an ganti' baranna supaya mbal pinapatay, pila-pila ya niamu' e' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 21:31
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab bang onde'-onde' l'lla atawa d'nda ya amatay tinanduk e' sapi'.

verses.name: Exodus 21:32
verses.text: Bang aniya' isab ata a'a amatay e' sapi', ata l'lla ka atawa ata d'nda, ya tag-dapu sapi' he' subay amayad t'llumpū' pilak tibu'uk.<note>Ya t'llumpū' pilak tibu'uk itu, ya na halga' ata bang pinab'llihan. Ya timbangan t'llumpū' pilak e' saga 300 gram.</note>  <div eID="gen1410" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv816"/><div sID="gen1411" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv816"/> “Bang a'a angala'anan tambol min lowang pagbohe'an, atawa a'a bay angahinang lowang aheya bo' halam bay tambunanna, buwatittu hatulanna: bang aniya' hayop, sapi' ka atawa kura', ahūg pareyom,

verses.name: Exodus 21:34
verses.text: a'a inān subay amayaran a'a tag-dapu hayop e'. Jari suku' na ma iya in patay hayop e'.  <div eID="gen1411" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv817"/><div sID="gen1412" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv817"/> “Bang aniya' sapi' l'lla ya suku' a'a dangan ananduk sapi' l'lla dakayu' bo' amatay, na buwattitu hatulanna: ya sapi' allum subay pinab'llihan ati b'llihanna subay binahagi' duwa ma duwangan tag-dapu he'. Ya du isi sapi' amatay he', subay binahagi' duwa.

verses.name: Exodus 21:36
verses.text: Arapun, bang kinata'uwan in sapi' he' panananduk asal, bo' halam bay sinasak atawa niengkotan e' tag-dapuna, a'a inān subay angangganti'an sapi' amatay. Jari suku' na ma iya patay hayop e'.”  <div eID="gen1412" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.21"/> <div eID="gen1401" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv818"/><div sID="gen1413" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Tangkawan Alta'</title> <div sID="gen1414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv818"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan yukna, “Bang aniya' a'a makatangkaw sapi' atawa bili-bili bo' sinumbali' e'na atawa pinab'llihan, na, buwattitu hatulanna: a'a inān subay pinat'nna'an kasā'an. Bang dakayu' du sapi' bay tatangkawna, subay sapi' lima hekana ya pangangganti'na ni a'a bay panangkawan. Bang dakayu' du bili-bili, subay mpat bili-bili isab ya pangangganti'na.  <div eID="gen1414" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv819"/><div sID="gen1415" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv819"/> “Bang aniya' pananangkaw ta'abut parumpās ni deyom luma' a'a waktu sangom bo' binono' pinapatay, mbal karusahan a'a bay makabono' iya.

verses.name: Exodus 22:3
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' pananangkaw ta'abut ma waktu llaw bo' yampa binono' pinapatay, a'a makabono' inān subay katōngan dusa sabab pagtu'uranna amapatay. Ai-ai tinangkaw subay ginanti'an e' a'a bay makatangkaw, sagō' bang halam ai-aina pangangganti', in iya baranna subay pinab'llihan nihinang ata, ati b'llihanna ya pangangganti' ma a'a katangkawan.  <div eID="gen1415" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv820"/><div sID="gen1416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv820"/> “Bang aniya' dakayu' hayop tinangkaw, bo' tabāk ma komkoman panangkaw ma halam bay ni'inay, ya panangkaw inān subay amayad nilipat duwa. Hatina bang dakayu' sapi' atawa kura' atawa bili-bili ya tinangkaw, subay duwa hekana ya pamayad.  <div eID="gen1416" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv821"/><div sID="gen1417" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv821"/> “Bang a'a magpakan saga hayopna ma tana' atawa ma kabbun bo' halam jagahanna pahāp ati wa'i pehē' saga hayop amangan pananom ma huma a'a saddī, na buwattitu hatulanna. Ya pangangganti' tinanom magka'at e' subay pananom landu' ahāp min huma tag-dapu hayop e'.  <div eID="gen1417" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv822"/><div sID="gen1418" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv822"/> “Bang aniya' angandokot api ma tana'na, bo' pasuleyab keyatna ni s'ggit sampay talapay tatunu' saga tinanom maka anihan ya suku' a'a dakayu', na, buwattitu hatulanna: ya a'a makarokot tunu' inān subay angangganti' ai-ai bay magka'at.  <div eID="gen1418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv823"/><div sID="gen1419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv823"/> “Bang aniya' a'a amatau' sīn atawa alta' ma sehe'na, ati tatangkaw min luma' pagtatau'an inān, na, buwattitu hatulanna. Bang tasaggaw a'a bay makatangkaw, ya kasā'an ma iya subay halga' alta' inān nilipat duwa.

verses.name: Exodus 22:8
verses.text: Sagō' bang mbal tabāk a'a bay makatangkaw, ya a'a pagtau'an alta' inān subay binowa ni lugal paghuwisan<note>Atawa ni luma' pagta'atan Tuhan.</note> bo' pinariksa' pahāp bang iya ya bay angā' alta' he'.

verses.name: Exodus 22:9
verses.text: Tiyap-tiyap aniya' palkala' pasal pagdapu alta', ai na ka sapi', ai na ka kura', ai na ka bili-bili, minsan isab badju' atawa ai-ai bay tapuwa', na, buwattitu hatulanna. Duwangan a'a magdapuhan alta' inān subay binowa ni paghuwisan<note>Atawa ni luma' pagta'atan Tuhan.</note> bo' sinalassay palkala' sigām. Manjari ya a'a taluwa' hukuman saga huwis e' subay pinat'nna'an kasā'an. Ya pamayadna ma a'a dangan subay halga' alta' inān nilipat duwa.  <div eID="gen1419" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv824"/><div sID="gen1420" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv824"/> “Bang aniya' a'a amatau' hayopna ma sehe'na, buwat saga sapi'na, kura'na atawa bili-bilina, bo' amatay atawa kapali'an ma pagtau'an, atawa sinaggaw e' a'a saddī, na, buwattitu hatulanna.

verses.name: Exodus 22:11
verses.text: Ya a'a bay pangandolan subay pinasapa ma matahan si Yawe, in iya halam bay makainay hayop inān. Maka tag-dapu hayop inān subay ameya' sadja ma panapa sehe'na he'. Puwas isab iya min kasā'an pagka buwattē' sapana.

verses.name: Exodus 22:12
verses.text: Sagō' bang hayop inān tatangkaw hinabuna ma deyoman a'a kapangandolan e', na, a'a inān subay angangganti' sabab iya ya bahala'.

verses.name: Exodus 22:13
verses.text: Bang saupama hayop inān bay magka'at e' sattuwa, ya kapin patayna subay binowa pina'nda'an ni huwis. Jari mbal iya sinō' angangganti'.  <div eID="gen1420" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv825"/><div sID="gen1421" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv825"/> “Bang a'a angindam hayop bo' amatay atawa kapali'an ma halam maina'an tag-dapuna, hayop inān subay ginanti'an e' a'a bay angindam.

verses.name: Exodus 22:15
verses.text: Sagō' bang maina'an asal tag-dapu hayop e', mbal pinaganti' a'a bay makaindam. Ya balikna, bang hayop inān bay sinukayan, subay mbal pinaganti' a'a bay anukay he'. Panukayna ya taitung bayadna.”  <div eID="gen1421" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1413" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv826"/><div sID="gen1422" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hatulan Sara' Pasal Pagkahi Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen1423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv826"/> “Bang a'a amidjakan budjang magbihing maka iya, bo' budjang inān halam gi' taga-tunang, ya l'lla inān subay pinabayad ungsud. Manjari h'ndana na.

verses.name: Exodus 22:17
verses.text: Sagō' bang mbal angaho' matto'a d'nda itu maka mbal tabowa magsulut, na, mbal nilanjalan pagkawin. Ya l'lla inān subay amayad kasā'an, pila-pila ya kataluwa'an pangungsud budjang.  <div eID="gen1423" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv827"/><div sID="gen1424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv827"/> “D'nda maghihinang pantak atawa palkata'an subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1424" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv828"/><div sID="gen1425" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv828"/> “Sasuku magd'nda maka hayop subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1425" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv829"/><div sID="gen1426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv829"/> “Sasuku magkulban atawa magtukbal ai-aina tudju ni pagtuhanan saddī min aku si Yawe, a'a inān subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen1426" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv830"/><div sID="gen1427" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv830"/> “Bang aniya' a'a bangsa liyu pat'nna' ma lahatbi, da'a jahulaka'unbi sabab bangsa liyu isab kam waktu bay kapaglahatbi ma lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen1427" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv831"/><div sID="gen1428" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv831"/> “Da'a kam angakkal ma balu d'nda atawa aniya-niya ma anak ilu'.

verses.name: Exodus 22:23
verses.text: Bang sigām ganta' tala'atbi bo' angamu'-ngamu' ni aku, tantu sigām tabangku.

verses.name: Exodus 22:24
verses.text: Apasu' atayku sampay amat'kkahan ka'am mulka'. Pasagaranta kam binono' e' saga bantabi, manjari tabalu h'ndabi, tailu' anakbi.  <div eID="gen1428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv832"/><div sID="gen1429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv832"/> “Bang kam magpautang sīn ma a'a miskin ya pagkahibi bangsa Isra'il, da'a anakinbi sīn he'. Da'a kam anengoran saga a'a ya magusaha'an sīn.

verses.name: Exodus 22:26
verses.text: Bang a'a isab angutang sīn ni ka'am bo' ananda' jubana, juba ilu subay tinūran ni iya kahaba' kohap, song pa'in pas'ddop llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 22:27
verses.text: Sababna halam aniya' pak'mmosna saddī. Bang mbal tūrannu ati angamu' iya tabang ma aku, tantu iya kaleku sabab ma'ase' asal aku.  <div eID="gen1429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv833"/><div sID="gen1430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv833"/> “Da'a to'ongan kam ah'lling pangkal pasal Tuhan. Da'a kam anukna'an pagbebeya'anbi bangsa Isra'il isab.  <div eID="gen1430" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv834"/><div sID="gen1431" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv834"/> “Panukbalinbi aku min tinanom ya ta'anibi, maka min bohe' anggul ya tap'gga'bi. Da'a kam atakal. <div eID="gen1431" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1432" type="paragraph"/> “Pamasuku'unbi ma aku anakbi l'lla siyaka.

verses.name: Exodus 22:30
verses.text: Ya du isab saga anak l'lla ya dahū pinaganakan ma ba'anan hayopbi. Ai na ka anak sapi', ai na ka anak bili-bili, ai na ka anak kambing, subay pamasuku'bi isab ma aku. Dapitu' ya pamaruru'bi ma ina'na, sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw kawalu'na, subay pagkulbaninbi aku.  <div eID="gen1432" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv835"/><div sID="gen1433" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv835"/> “Ka'am ya bangsa palsuku'anku, angkan kam mbal makajari amangan isi hayop bay takeket e' sattuwa talun. Gom pa'in timaninbi pagkakan saga ero'.”  <div eID="gen1433" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.22"/> <div eID="gen1422" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv836"/><div sID="gen1434" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Kaul-Pi'il Abontol</title> <div sID="gen1435" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv836"/> “Da'a kam amasaplag suli-suli ma halam aniya' kab'nnalanna. Da'a kam anaksi' puting ma munda'an sara' pangandapitbi ma a'a ala'at jaguni'na.

verses.name: Exodus 23:2
verses.text: Da'a kam ameya' maghinang kala'atan ma saukat ya he' kahinangan kaheka'an. Da'a kam pauyun anaksi' puting ma kaheka'an a'a ma munda'an sara'.

verses.name: Exodus 23:3
verses.text: Da'a bogboginbi a'a miskin bang tinandanan ni sara' ma saukat miskin iya, luwal bang abontol panganda'awana.  <div eID="gen1435" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv837"/><div sID="gen1436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv837"/> “Bang kam makalanggal sapi' atawa kura' bay makapuwas min engkotna, subay tūranbi magtūy ni tag-dapuna, minsan iya bantabi.

verses.name: Exodus 23:5
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab bang aniya' ta'nda'bi kura' mbal makat'ngge pagka kabuhatan e' duwa'anna, da'a pasagarinbi. Tabanginbi tag-dapuna minsan ya a'a kab'nsihannu asal.  <div eID="gen1436" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv838"/><div sID="gen1437" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv838"/> “Da'a pabengkokunbi hukuman ma a'a miskin bang aniya' palkala'na ma sara'. Pabontolunbi sadja.

verses.name: Exodus 23:7
verses.text: Bang aniya' pagtuna' ngga'i ka b'nnal, da'a kam palamud. Da'a kam amat'nna' hukuman kamatay ma a'a halam aniya' sā'na atawa dusana. Sabab mbal papuwasku a'a min dusana bang iya amat'nna' hukuman abengkok.

verses.name: Exodus 23:8
verses.text: Ka'am saga a'a amal'ngngan sara', da'a kam anambut tatambahan min a'a pinahukum ma ka'am. Sabab minsan sara' abontol, bang pagkatambahan mbal ahāp e'na angusay palkala'. Nirusta' e'na a'a abontol minsan b'nnal saksi'na.  <div eID="gen1437" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv839"/><div sID="gen1438" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv839"/> “Bang aniya' a'a bangsa liyu pat'nna' ma lahatbi, da'a jahulaka'unbi, sabab bangsa liyu isab kam, waktu bay kapaglahatbi ma lahat Misil.”  <div eID="gen1438" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1434" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv840"/><div sID="gen1439" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Tahun Kapitu'na</title> <div sID="gen1440" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv840"/> “Nnom tahun subay pagtanombi kahuma-huma'anbi maka paganibi isab saga buwa'na.

verses.name: Exodus 23:11
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in tahun kapitu'na, in tana' inān subay pinasagaran na ma deyom dantahun e'. Da'a araruhunbi, da'a isab tanominbi. Jari ai-ai atomo'an di-na subay pamuwanbi ma saga pagkahibi miskin. Maka ai-ai halam takakan e' sigām, pagkakan saga sattuwa talun na. Buwattē' du isab ya saga po'onanbi anggul maka saga kakayuhanbi jaitun, subay pinasagaran pagkakan saga a'a miskin.  <div eID="gen1440" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv841"/><div sID="gen1441" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv841"/> “Maghinang kam ma deyom nnom llaw, sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw kapitu'na subay kam pahondong maghinang. Minnē' aniya' llaw pamahali saga sapi'bi maka saga kura'bi, sampay isab saga atabi maka a'a bangsa liyu ya paokom ma ka'am. Jari pahāp palasahan sigām pabīng.  <div eID="gen1441" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv842"/><div sID="gen1442" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv842"/> “Beya'unbi pahāp kamemon ya panoho'anku itu ma ka'am. Amay-amay, da'a ta'atunbi saga pagtuhanan saddī min aku. Minsan ōn sigām subay mbal sabbutbi.”  <div eID="gen1442" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1439" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv843"/><div sID="gen1443" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Paghinang Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen1444" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv843"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan, yukna, “Subay t'llu paghinang ya isbatbi na pa'in pamaheyabi ma aku ma deyom dantahun.  <div eID="gen1444" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv844"/><div sID="gen1445" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv844"/> “Kaissana, Paghinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna. Hinangunbi paghinang itu ma bulan Abib, sabab ya na he' bulan bay kala'anbi min lahat Misil. Ma deyom pitung'llaw ya kapaghinangbi ma hinang itu<note>Tinagna'an min sangpū' maka mpat kasobangan sampay ni duwampū' maka dda, ma bulan Abib.</note> subay tinapay halam taga-pasulig ya pagkakanbi, buwat bay panoho'anku ma ka'am. <div eID="gen1445" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1446" type="paragraph"/> “Ebot-ebot, bang kam angarap ni aku sumiyan-sumiyan, subay kam amowa tutukbalan.  <div eID="gen1446" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv845"/><div sID="gen1447" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv845"/> “Karuwana, Paghinang Anihan Dahū<note>Aniya' ōn saddī pangōn duwa paghinang itu. Paghinang Anihan Damuli itu kaōnan du isab Hinang Kapitu'an, sabab aniya' na limampū' llaw palabay min bay Hinang Paglakad (<reference osisRef="Exod.12.17">Paglappas 12:17</reference>). Hinang Anihan Damuli kaōnan isab Paghinang Panggung, sabab nientom e' sigām waktu kapagluma' sigām ma kapanggungan ma lahat paslangan.</note>, ya pinaghinang ma waktu paganibi saga buwa' tinanom ya dahū ajatu. <div eID="gen1447" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1448" type="paragraph"/> “Kat'lluna, Paghinang Anihan Damuli, ya pinaghinang song pa'in waktu paghaggut, waktu pagtimukbi kamemon saga buwa' tinanom.

verses.name: Exodus 23:17
verses.text: Manjari t'llu waktu ma deyom dantahun ya pangarap kamemon saga kal'llahanbi ma matahan si Yawe ya panghū'bi.”  <div eID="gen1448" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv846"/><div sID="gen1449" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv846"/> Yuk Tuhan isab, “Bang kam magkulban susumbali'an, da'a pabeya'unbi pagkakan ai-ai taga-pasulig. Da'a tau'unbi lanab min kukulbanan kakanbi salung.  <div eID="gen1449" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv847"/><div sID="gen1450" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv847"/> “Bang kam anagna' magani tinanom atawa magpusu' buwa' kayu, pene'unbi ya ahāp to'ongan bo' bowahunbi ni Luma' Pangarapan ni si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. <div eID="gen1450" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1451" type="paragraph"/> “Bang kam anumbali' anak kambing bo' b'llabi, da'a lamurinbi gatas ina'na.”  <div eID="gen1451" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1443" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv848"/><div sID="gen1452" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mala'ikat Pinamalim ma Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen1453" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv848"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan, yukna, “Na! Itiya' soho'ku dakayu' mala'ikat anganjagahan ka'am ma l'ngngananbi, ati pinasampay kam e'na ni lahat ya tagamahanku ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 23:21
verses.text: Kalehunbi bissalana, beya'unbi isab panoho'anna. Da'a iya sagga'unbi sabab tantu kam mbal niampun e'na pagka ina'an ma iya kawasaku.

verses.name: Exodus 23:22
verses.text: Bang iya kalebi pahāp, maka bang beya'bi kamemon panoho'anku ma ka'am, bantahanku sasuku amantahan ka'am, atuhanku isab sasuku angatu ma ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 23:23
verses.text: Parahū min ka'am mala'ikatku bo' kam tabowana tudju ni lahat ya paglahatan saga bangsa Amor, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus. Pahalamku saga bangsa inān kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 23:24
verses.text: Da'a kam pasujud atawa magsumba ma pagtuhanan saga bangsa inān, da'a kam palamud ma kahinangan sigām. Paka'atunbi to'ongan saga ta'u-ta'u<note>Ta'u-ta'u: atawa balhala' bang ma Sama kasehe'an.</note> ya pagtuhanan sigām, podjakunbi isab saga batu paosol ya minulliya e' sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 23:25
verses.text: Ta'atunbi aku, ya Tuhanbi Yawe. Jari buwananku kahāpan ma pagkakanbi maka ma paginumbi. Mbal kam kat'kkahan saki.

verses.name: Exodus 23:26
verses.text: Halam isab aniya' d'nda kapakpakan ma sakalibut lahatbi, anganak sigām kamemon. Pataha'ku isab umulbi kamemon.  <div eID="gen1453" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv849"/><div sID="gen1454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv849"/> “Parahū aku min ka'am amakitāw saga kabangsa-bangsahan ya talanggalbi ma lahat inān. Palengogku pikilan sigām supaya sigām mbal maka'atu ma ka'am, gom pa'in sigām pataikut bo' maglahian.

verses.name: Exodus 23:28
verses.text: Bowaku saga bangsa Hīb, saga bangsa Kana'an maka saga bangsa Hīt magla'anan min dahuanbi, buwat sapantun a'a pinagkeket e' tabungay.

verses.name: Exodus 23:29
verses.text: Sagō' mbal pala'anku saga a'a inān kamemon ma deyom dantahun sabab ariki' gi' puhu'bi. Bang sigām ganta' tinighan pinala'an, tantu kam mbal makagaga. Ap'nno' kahuma-huma'anbi e' s'ggit-man'ggit, maka paheka na pa'in ba'anan saga sattuwa talun angala'at ka'am.

verses.name: Exodus 23:30
verses.text: Pala'anku saga bangsa inān painut-inut sampay kam paheka na, bo' kam makapagbaya' ma lahat e'.  <div eID="gen1454" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv850"/><div sID="gen1455" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv850"/> “Manjari,” yuk Tuhan, “paluhaku lahat ya pamasuku'ku ma ka'am. Tinagna'an min Tahik Keyat sampay ni Tahik Pilistin,<note>Tahik Mediterranean ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> min lahat paslangan isab tudju ni sapa' Alpurati. Nde'anku isab ni pagbaya'anbi saga kabangsa-bangsahan ya pat'nna' mahē'. Jari bang ta'abut na waktuna, ka'am ya an'ggal paluwas min lahat e'.

verses.name: Exodus 23:32
verses.text: Da'a kam amiha pagsulutan maka saga bangsa inān atawa pagtuhanan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 23:33
verses.text: Da'a pasagarinbi saga bangsa inān magdalahat maka ka'am bo' kam mbal tabowa-bowa e' sigām angahinang dusa ni aku. Tantu kam tajallat palamud anumba saga pagtutuhanan sigām.” <lb/>  <div eID="gen1455" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.23"/> <div eID="gen1452" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv851"/><div sID="gen1456" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paljanji'an Tuhan Pinahogot</title> <div sID="gen1457" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv851"/> Sakali itu, angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Patukad ka ni aku. Pabeya'un isab si Harun maka duwangan anakna si Nadab maka si Abihu, sampay saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il pitumpū' hekana. Kaheka'anbi ilu subay anumba ni aku min katāhan.

verses.name: Exodus 24:2
verses.text: Ka'a Musa, subay dangan-dangannu sadja makasekot pi'itu ni aku. Mbal makasekot saga sehe'nu ilu. Ya du saga a'a Isra'il inān, mbal isab makabeya' ma ka'a patukad ni diyata' būd itu.”  <div eID="gen1457" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv852"/><div sID="gen1458" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv852"/> Na, palūd pina'an si Musa angahaka ni kaheka'an a'a inān pasal saga sara' maka panoho'an kamemon bay pamalman e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Pagkale sigām, magtūy sigām magdauyun anambung, yuk-i, “Beya' kami ya pamalman e' si Yawe ilu.”

verses.name: Exodus 24:4
verses.text: Manjari tasulat e' si Musa saga sara' panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> inān kamemon. <div eID="gen1458" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1459" type="paragraph"/> Pagdai' llaw pa'in, abati' na si Musa bo' paluwas anambak batu ma bihing būd, nihinang pagtukbalan kulban. Angosol isab iya saga batu sangpū' maka duwa hekana pamandogahan sangpū' maka duwa bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 24:5
verses.text: Pagubus, magpanoho'an si Musa ma saga onde' baha'u bangsa Isra'il. Sinō' sigām pina'an anukbal kulban ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, saga susumbali'an tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna. Aniya' isab saga anak sapi' l'lla tinukbal e' sigām pagduwa'a salamat.

verses.name: Exodus 24:6
verses.text: Sinalud e' si Musa laha' bay sinumbali' he'. Santonga' ni'isi e'na ni saga pinggan aheya, santonga' isab pinigsikan ni lugal pagkulbanan e'.<note>Laha' susumbali'an itu aheya kagunahanna ma agama Isra'il. Binu'usan e' nabi Musa ma tampat pagkulbanan pamahogot paljanji'an Tuhan maka saga bangsa Isra'il.</note>

verses.name: Exodus 24:7
verses.text: Puwas e' niā' e' si Musa Sulat Paljanji'an bo' binassa patanog ma saga ummat inān. Ya panambung sigām, “Beya' kami ai-ai bay pamalman e' si Yawe, bogbogan kami panoho'anna.”  <div eID="gen1459" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv853"/><div sID="gen1460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv853"/> Na, pagka buwattē' panambung sigām, niā' e' si Musa saga pinggan bay panaluranna laha' hayop ati pigsikanna ni saga ummat e'. Yuk si Musa, “Laha' itu pamahogot paljanji'an si Yawe, ya pinat'nna'an ka'am labay min saga panoho'anna itu kamemon.”  <div eID="gen1460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv854"/><div sID="gen1461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv854"/> Pagubus, patukad na disi Musa, si Harun, si Nadab maka si Abihu ni diyata' būd, tabeya' isab saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il pitumpū' hekana.

verses.name: Exodus 24:10
verses.text: Ma būd pa'in, ta'nda' e' sigām Tuhan ya pagtuhanan mbo' sigām si Isra'il. Jari aniya' sali' lantay luwa palmata bilu ta'nda' e' sigām ma deyo'an tape'na, dat'llak maka langit.

verses.name: Exodus 24:11
verses.text: Sagō' halam ni'inay e' Tuhan saga pagmakōkan bangsa Isra'il e'. Ta'nda' iya e' mata sigām hinabu sigām magduwa'a salamat.  <div eID="gen1461" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv855"/><div sID="gen1462" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv855"/> Manjari itu ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabalik ma si Musa, yukna, “Patukad ka pi'itu ni aku ni diyata' būd itu. Maitu lagi' ka bo' ka buwananku duwa batu amasagi'. Itiya' tasulatku saga panoho'an ya pamandu'ku ma saga ummat ilu.”  <div eID="gen1462" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv856"/><div sID="gen1463" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv856"/> Magtūy magsakap si Musa maka tendogna si Yussa' bo' patukad ni būd Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 24:14
verses.text: Yuk si Musa ma saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il, “Lagarinbi lagi' kami maitu sampay kami makabīng pi'itu. Ilu mailu ma ka'am si Harun maka si Hūr. Sigām ya analassay bang aniya' palkala'bi.”  <div eID="gen1463" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv857"/><div sID="gen1464" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv857"/> Na, makatukad pa'in si Musa, katambunan Būd Turusina e' gabun.

verses.name: Exodus 24:16
verses.text: Patulun isab sahaya si Yawe ni pussuk būd e'. Jari animpus gabun inān nnom llaw t'ggolna. Ta'abut pa'in pitung'llaw, angalingan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa min deyom gabun.

verses.name: Exodus 24:17
verses.text: Malaingkan in sahaya si Yawe sali' tunu' aheya makalandu' bang ma pang'nda' saga bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 24:18
verses.text: Manjari itu, patukad na si Musa bo' pasōd ni deyom gabun, ati mpatpū' bahangi ya kat'nna'na ma diyata' būd e'.  <div eID="gen1464" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.24"/> <div eID="gen1456" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv858"/><div sID="gen1465" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Luma' Tolda ya Pangarapan ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1466" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv858"/> Jari mahē' pa'in ma diyata' būd, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 25:2
verses.text: “Soho'un saga bangsa Isra'il amowahan aku huhulmatan. Sambutun ai-ai pamuwan e' sigām bang pa'in hilas min deyom pangatayan sigām dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:3
verses.text: Buwattitu saga huhulmatan ya patut sambutnu min saga a'a inān: bulawan, pilak maka tumbaga,

verses.name: Exodus 25:4
verses.text: salban walna' bilu, taluk maka keyat, kakana' pote' ahāp hinanganna, maka bulbul kambing pangahinang kakana'.

verses.name: Exodus 25:5
verses.text: Kuwit bili-bili l'lla isab bay nianjibihan keyat, maka kuwit duyung, kayu akasya,

verses.name: Exodus 25:6
verses.text: ns'llan jaitun ma palita'an, saga pamapā ya pamahamut ns'llan pangangg'llal imam, maka ginisan pamapā kamanyan,

verses.name: Exodus 25:7
verses.text: ginisan palmata isab pamalingkat epod maka puyu'-daggaha ya pan'mmek imam alanga.”  <div eID="gen1466" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv859"/><div sID="gen1467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv859"/> Yuk Tuhan isab, “Soho'un saga bangsa Isra'il angahinangan aku Luma' Sussi supaya aku makamailu ma sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 25:9
verses.text: Ya pangahinangbi luma' itu maka kamemon kapanyapanna subay pasali' ni suntu'an ya song pa'nda'anku ni ka'a.”  <div eID="gen1467" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1465" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv860"/><div sID="gen1468" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ba'ul Paljanji'an</title> <div sID="gen1469" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv860"/> Yuk Tuhan isab, “Soho'un sigām angahinang ba'ul min kayu akasya, lima h'kka<note>Taha' l'ngngon ya pagsukud bangsa Isra'il ma masa awal e', min tōng tudlu' tudju ni buli' siku. ‘Cubit’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis. Dataha' asal dakayu' cubit maka duwa h'kkata.</note> taha'na, t'llu h'kka lambuna, t'llu h'kka isab langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 25:11
verses.text: Ba'ul itu subay pinutus deyom-luwasanna maka bulawan porol. Kakīranna isab subay pinalingkat maka gipis bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:12
verses.text: Hinangunbi mpat gallang bulawan bo' patli'unbi pehē' ni tape' ba'ul inān, duwa gallang min bihing ba'ul dambila', duwa isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 25:13
verses.text: Hinangunbi saga tanggungan min kayu akasya, bo' putusinbi bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:14
verses.text: Tahinang pa'in, pasulugunbi ni gallang ya ma bihing ba'ul bo' aniya' pananggungan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:15
verses.text: Ya tanggungan itu mbal manjari nila'anan min panuluganna.

verses.name: Exodus 25:16
verses.text: Na pagubus, pat'nna'unbi ma deyom Ba'ul Paljanji'an ya paltanda'an song pamuwanku ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen1469" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv861"/><div sID="gen1470" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv861"/> “Hinangunbi turung sinasal min bulawan porol, lima h'kka taha'na, t'llu h'kka lambuna. Turung Pagtaubatan ko' inān.

verses.name: Exodus 25:18
verses.text: Sasalunbi isab duwa mala'ikat pikpikan<note>Mala'ikat pikpikan itu sali' kahantang luwa biradali. ‘Kerub’ ōnna ma bahasa Hibrani. Ya hinang sigām magpudji na pa'in maka magjaga ma haddarat Tuhan.</note> min tōng turung karuwa, langkus bulawanna maka bulawan turung.

verses.name: Exodus 25:19
verses.text: Sasalunbi isab duwa mala'ikat pikpikan<note>Mala'ikat pikpikan itu sali' kahantang luwa biradali. ‘Kerub’ ōnna ma bahasa Hibrani. Ya hinang sigām magpudji na pa'in maka magjaga ma haddarat Tuhan.</note> min tōng turung karuwa, langkus bulawanna maka bulawan turung.

verses.name: Exodus 25:20
verses.text: Saga mala'ikat pikpikan itu subay pinapagharap maka subay angandomolan turung. In pikpik sigām subay pab'llat pariyata' bo' makalandungan turung ba'ul.

verses.name: Exodus 25:21
verses.text: Pagubus pa'in, nna'un ma deyom Ba'ul Paljanji'an ilu ya sulat paltanda'an song pamuwanku ma ka'a, ati turungin.

verses.name: Exodus 25:22
verses.text: Manjari pasabu aku ma ka'a, Musa, ma llotan duwa mala'ikat pikpikan ya ma turung Ba'ul Paljanji'an e'. Pi'ilu du aku amasampay ni ka'a saga sara' kamemon ya panoho'anku ma saga bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1470" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1468" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv862"/><div sID="gen1471" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lamisahan Pamat'nna'an Tinapay</title> <div sID="gen1472" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv862"/> Magkallam gi' Tuhan ma disi Musa yukna, “Hinangunbi lamisahan min kayu akasya, mpat h'kka taha'na, duwa h'kka lambuna, t'llu h'kka isab langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 25:24
verses.text: Putusunbi maka bulawan porol, bo' palingkatunbi kīdna ka'mpat maka gipis bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:25
verses.text: Hinangunbi paga-paga da'mpāt-tangan lambuna ma sakalibut lamisahan e', bo' palingkatunbi isab maka bulawan gipis.

verses.name: Exodus 25:26
verses.text: Hinangunbi mpat gallang bulawan bo' patli'unbi pehē' ni mpat dugu lamisahan e', ma diyata'an saga tape'na.

verses.name: Exodus 25:27
verses.text: Pasekotun saga gallang e' ni paga-paga bo' aniya' pamasulugan tanggungan bang nihangkut pi'ingga-pi'ingga.

verses.name: Exodus 25:28
verses.text: Saga tanggungan ilu subay nihinang min kayu akasya pinutusan bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:29
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab saga kapanyapan ma Luma' Pangarapan, hinangunbi min bulawan porol, buwat saga lai', saga pinggan maka saga pangisihan binu-anggul ya binu'usan pangahulmat ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:30
verses.text: Jari lamisahan ilu ya pamat'nna'anbi Tinapay Hadarat<note>Tinapay Hadarat, hatina Tinapay Sussi pamasuku' ma Tuhan Yawe.</note> bo' aniya' ma matahanku sakahaba' waktu.”  <div eID="gen1472" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1471" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv863"/><div sID="gen1473" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palita'an ma Deyom Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1474" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv863"/> Magkallam gi' Tuhan, yukna, “Anasal kam baran palita'an min bulawan porol, dalos hinanganna min buli'na sampay ni batangna, beya' isab saga pinggan-pinggan ya pinagukilan sali' luwa sumping.<note>Saga sumping itu pasengod ni sumping kayu ‘almon’, kayu ahāp kinakan bigi buwa'na.</note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:32
verses.text: In batangna subay magsanga<note>Sanga, atawa senga.</note> nnom, t'llu min dambila' batang, t'llu isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 25:33
verses.text: Maka sangana inān subay nihinangan pinggan-pinggan sali' luwa sumping almon, t'llu hekana ma saga sanga ka'nnom pakaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: Exodus 25:34
verses.text: Ya du batang palita'an, subay nihinangan pinggan-pinggan mpat hekana sali' luwa sumping almon.

verses.name: Exodus 25:35
verses.text: Jari aniya' dakayu' pinggan-pinggan min deyo' saga sanga panagna'an, dakayu' min deyo' saga sanga t'ngnga'an, dakayu' isab min deyo' sanga ma diyata'. Nnom sangana kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 25:36
verses.text: Subay dalos hinangan palita'an itu kamemon, baranna maka saga sumping-sumpingna maka saga sangana. Bulawan ponod ya pangahinang iya.  <div eID="gen1474" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv864"/><div sID="gen1475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv864"/> “Manjari, angahinang kam saga palita'an maka sumbuhan pitu' hekana. Pagubus, pat'nna'unbi ma baran palita'an bo' supaya patudju sawana ni dahuan.

verses.name: Exodus 25:38
verses.text: Hinangunbi isab saga kapanyapan palita'an, buwat saga sisipit pamahāp sumbuhan maka saga talam-talamna.

verses.name: Exodus 25:39
verses.text: Ya buhat bulawan pangahinangbi palita'an itu sampay kamemon saga panyapna subay t'llumpū' maka mpat kilu.

verses.name: Exodus 25:40
verses.text: Ebot-ebot,” yuk Tuhan ma si Musa, “beya'un suntu'an bay pa'nda'anku ma ka'a ma diyata' būd itu.”  <div eID="gen1475" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.25"/> <div eID="gen1473" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv865"/><div sID="gen1476" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Luma' Pangarapan ni Tuhan<note>Ma masa awal in Luma' Pangarapan bangsa Isra'il ni Tuhan sali' luma' tolda. Tapaglangkat saga pagdayawna supaya takole' nihangkut e' sigām bang papinda ni pahanti'an saddī. Bang luma' inān pinat'ngge na, pitund'ppa maka tonga' ya taha'na. Bang tabatuk pagdayawna maka atopna, duwand'ppa maka tonga' luhana, duwand'ppa maka tonga' isab langana. Kōkanna tampal ni s'ddopan, pagsosōranna min sobangan. Atopna sali' atop tolda nihinang min kuwit hayop, maka kultina ya panambol lawangna. Manjari buwattitu hinanganna bang tinugila' kamemon.</note></title> <div sID="gen1477" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv865"/> Na, amalman Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Buwattitu ya pangahinangbi Luma' Pangarapan ni aku. Angahinang kam sangpū' sugpat kultina landu' ahāp kakana'na pinaglamuran salban bilu, salban taluk maka salban keyat bo' ahāp luwana. Pabuldahinbi isab luwa mala'ikat pikpikan ma a'a apanday magbubulda.

verses.name: Exodus 26:2
verses.text: Saga sugpat kultina itu subay dasali' sukuranna kamemon, pitund'ppa taha'na maka dand'ppa lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 26:3
verses.text: Jari lima sugpatna subay tinahi' pinagbihing-bihing bo' tahinang dakayu' kultina atibu'uk, damikiyanna lima sugpat takapin.<note>Kataha'anna ya pinagbihing, manjari in bay lima hekana tahinang dakayu' kultina aheya, sangpū' d'ppa taha'na, pitund'ppa lambuna.</note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:4
verses.text: Patahi'un tainga-tainga kakana' bilu ma bihing kultina aheya inān karuwa, hatina lima-limampū' heka tainga-tainga maganggop-anggop. Pahinangun isab limampū' kakansing bulawan pamarakayu' duwa kultina inān supaya arakayu' deyom Luma' Pangarapan ilu.  <div eID="gen1477" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:5
verses.text: Patahi'un tainga-tainga kakana' bilu ma bihing kultina aheya inān karuwa, hatina lima-limampū' heka tainga-tainga maganggop-anggop. Pahinangun isab limampū' kakansing bulawan pamarakayu' duwa kultina inān supaya arakayu' deyom Luma' Pangarapan ilu.  <div eID="gen1477" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:6
verses.text: Patahi'un tainga-tainga kakana' bilu ma bihing kultina aheya inān karuwa, hatina lima-limampū' heka tainga-tainga maganggop-anggop. Pahinangun isab limampū' kakansing bulawan pamarakayu' duwa kultina inān supaya arakayu' deyom Luma' Pangarapan ilu.  <div eID="gen1477" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv866"/><div sID="gen1478" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv866"/> “Pagubus, pahinangun saga kultina min bulbul kambing, sangpū' maka dda heka sugpatna pangalapis kultina deyom.

verses.name: Exodus 26:8
verses.text: Saga sugpat itu subay dasali' sukuranna kamemon, taha'na pitund'ppa maka tonga', lambuna dand'ppa.

verses.name: Exodus 26:9
verses.text: In sugpat bulbul kambing itu subay tinahi' pinagbihing-bihing isab, lima heka sugpat ma kultina dakayu', nnom heka sugpat ma kultina dakayu'. Ya kultina nnom sugpatna subay pinasangon ma dahuan luma' tampal ni pagsosōran, maka sugpatna katapusan subay nilupi' duwa.

verses.name: Exodus 26:10
verses.text: Patahi'un tainga-tainga kakana' ma tōng kultina karuwa, lima-limampū' hekana.

verses.name: Exodus 26:11
verses.text: Pahinangun isab limampū' kakansing tumbaga pamarakayu' kultina bulbul kambing itu karuwa.

verses.name: Exodus 26:12
verses.text: Na, pagka maglabi asal tōng kultina ya talupi' duwa, subay patontonan di-na ma kōkan luma'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:13
verses.text: Ya du tōng kultina ma bihing luma' karuwambila', maglabi isab tonga' sin tonga' d'ppa. Jari in labina itu subay pa'abut ni tana' bo' katambunan kultina ya ma deyom.

verses.name: Exodus 26:14
verses.text: Pahinangun duwa ginis turung isab panurung kaluha'an tolda. Kuwit bili-bili l'lla nianjibihan keyat ya pangahinang turung itu dakayu', maka kuwit duyung ya pangahinang turung katapusan.<note>Ya atop maka dinding Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan itu maglapis mpat. Kultina kakana' ya lapisna deyom, bo' kultina bulbul kambing, bo' kuwit kambing l'lla, bo' kuwit duyung ya katapusanna.</note>”  <div eID="gen1478" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1476" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv867"/><div sID="gen1479" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dinding ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1480" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv867"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma disi Musa yukna, “Angahinang kam saga papagan dinding min kayu akasya pamarindingan Luma' Pangarapan.

verses.name: Exodus 26:16
verses.text: Duwand'ppa maka tonga' langkawna, t'llu h'kka lambuna ma dakayu' sugpat.

verses.name: Exodus 26:17
verses.text: Saga papagan ilu kamemon subay nihinangan lagsak duwa hekana patuwa' min deyo'anna.

verses.name: Exodus 26:18
verses.text: Pahinangun duwampū' heka papagan dinding ma dambila' luma' maka ma dambila'. Pasasalun isab mpatpū' durukan hāg min pilak aponod, hatina duwa durukan ma papagan dakayu' maka dakayu' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:19
verses.text: Pahinangun duwampū' heka papagan dinding ma dambila' luma' maka ma dambila'. Pasasalun isab mpatpū' durukan hāg min pilak aponod, hatina duwa durukan ma papagan dakayu' maka dakayu' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:20
verses.text: Pahinangun duwampū' heka papagan dinding ma dambila' luma' maka ma dambila'. Pasasalun isab mpatpū' durukan hāg min pilak aponod, hatina duwa durukan ma papagan dakayu' maka dakayu' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:21
verses.text: Pahinangun duwampū' heka papagan dinding ma dambila' luma' maka ma dambila'. Pasasalun isab mpatpū' durukan hāg min pilak aponod, hatina duwa durukan ma papagan dakayu' maka dakayu' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:22
verses.text: Hinangunbi isab nnom papagan pangandinding ma tōng luma' tampal ni s'ddopan,

verses.name: Exodus 26:23
verses.text: maka duwa papagan isab ma duguna karuwa.

verses.name: Exodus 26:24
verses.text: Papagtapilun saga papagan ma dugu itu min deyo' sampay pariyata'. Diyata'na subay pinasulug ni dakayu' gallang bo' mbal magpuklas.

verses.name: Exodus 26:25
verses.text: Manjari walu' heka papagan pangandinding ma kōkan luma', sangpū' isab maka nnom durukanna nihinang min dī pilak. Hatina duwa durukan ma saga papagan ilu dakayu' maka dakayu'.  <div eID="gen1480" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv868"/><div sID="gen1481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv868"/> “Angahinang kam saga batang-batang kayu akasya pamahogot dinding, lima-lima hekana ma bihing luma' karuwambila', lima isab ma kōkan tampal ni s'ddopan.

verses.name: Exodus 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv868"/><div sID="gen1481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv868"/> “Angahinang kam saga batang-batang kayu akasya pamahogot dinding, lima-lima hekana ma bihing luma' karuwambila', lima isab ma kōkan tampal ni s'ddopan.

verses.name: Exodus 26:28
verses.text: Ya batang-batang ma t'ngnga' dinding subay pa'abut min tōng luma' dakayu' ni dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 26:29
verses.text: Putusinbi bulawan saga papagan dinding sampay saga batang-batangna. Angahinang kam saga gallang bulawan isab pamasulugan saga batang-batang e'.”  <div eID="gen1481" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv869"/><div sID="gen1482" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv869"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma disi Musa, “Ya pangahinangbi Luma' Pangarapan ma aku subay pasali' to'ongan ni suntu'an ya bay pa'nda'anku ka'a ma diyata' būd itu.”  <div eID="gen1482" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1479" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv870"/><div sID="gen1483" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kultina Pangalikus Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1484" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv870"/> Yuk Tuhan, “Hinangunbi dakayu' kultina pangalikus deyom Luma' he', tampal ni kōkan. Kultina itu subay nihinang min kakana' landu' ahāp, pinaglamuran salban bilu, salban taluk maka salban keyat. Pabuldahin isab luwa mala'ikat pikpikan ma a'a apanday magbubulda.

verses.name: Exodus 26:32
verses.text: Hinangunbi hāg mpat hekana min kayu akasya ati pat'nggehun ma mpat durukan dī pilak. Putusunbi hāg ilu maka bulawan, pē'inbi isab saga sasabit bulawan panagnatan kultina.

verses.name: Exodus 26:33
verses.text: Pagubus, pasagnatun kultina ilu min deyo' saga kakansing bay pamarakayu' duwa kultina pangatop. Jari in Luma' Pangarapan tabilik duwa na. Tampat Sussi ya pangōn bilik tampal ni pagsosōran, Tampat Mahasussi ya pangōn bilik ma liyu kultina tampal ni kōkan. Maina'an ya pamat'nna'anbi Ba'ul Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an, tinurungan asal maka turungna.

verses.name: Exodus 26:34
verses.text: Pagubus, pasagnatun kultina ilu min deyo' saga kakansing bay pamarakayu' duwa kultina pangatop. Jari in Luma' Pangarapan tabilik duwa na. Tampat Sussi ya pangōn bilik tampal ni pagsosōran, Tampat Mahasussi ya pangōn bilik ma liyu kultina tampal ni kōkan. Maina'an ya pamat'nna'anbi Ba'ul Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an, tinurungan asal maka turungna.

verses.name: Exodus 26:35
verses.text: Ya lamisahan bulawan subay pinat'nna' ma luwasan kultina, ma bihing luma' tampal ni kowan. Ya palita'an pitu' sangana subay pinat'nna' tampal ni gibang, maganggop maka lamisahan.  <div eID="gen1484" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv871"/><div sID="gen1485" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv871"/> “Angahinang kam kultina panambol lawang pagsosōran ni Luma'. Hinangunbi min kakana' ahāp isina, binulda isab maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.

verses.name: Exodus 26:37
verses.text: Hinangunbi lima hāg min kayu akasya pinutusan bulawan. Sasalunbi isab lima durukan tumbaga pamat'nna'an saga hāg e'. Pagubus, hinangunbi saga sasabit bulawan panagnatan kultina.”  <div eID="gen1485" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.26"/> <div eID="gen1483" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv872"/><div sID="gen1486" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lamisahan Pagtunu'an Tutukbalan</title> <div sID="gen1487" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv872"/> Magpanoho'an lagi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Angahinang kam lapohan pagtunu'an kulban min kayu akasya. Magpasagi' lambuna maka taha'na sangpū' h'kka sali'-sali', nnom h'kka langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 27:2
verses.text: Hinangunbi pussuk-pussuk kayu ma mpat duguna, sali' luwa tanduk. Kayuna subay dalos maka kayu ya pangahinangan baran lapohan. Jari putusunbi kamemonna maka dī tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 27:3
verses.text: Hinangunbi isab ba'anan kapanyapanna min tumbaga, buwat saga undam panaluran abu, saga kakagis, saga garul pangisihan laha' susumbali'an, saga tutugsuk aheya, sampay saga pangisihan baga.

verses.name: Exodus 27:4
verses.text: In lapohan ilu subay nihinangan pangayakan min tumbaga, maka gallang tumbaga isab ma duguna ka'mpat.

verses.name: Exodus 27:5
verses.text: Pagubus, pasangonun pangayakan itu ni deyom baran lapohan min deyo' paga-paga akiput, saga ma tonga'an kīdna.

verses.name: Exodus 27:6
verses.text: Hinangun tanggungan isab min kayu akasya pinutus maka tumbaga

verses.name: Exodus 27:7
verses.text: bo' pinasulug pehē' ni gallang ma kīd lapohan karuwambila' bang subay nihangkut.

verses.name: Exodus 27:8
verses.text: Beya'unbi suntu'an lapohan bay pa'nda'anku ma ka'a maina'an lagi' ma diyata' būd. Hinangunbi min papan, luwana sali' tu'ung halam turungna.”  <div eID="gen1487" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1486" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv873"/><div sID="gen1488" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv873"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Subay aniya' halaman ma sakalibut Luma' Pangarapan, taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Kultina landu' ahāp kakana'na ya panasak halaman itu, maka hāg nnompū' hekana panagnatan kultina. Duwa-duwampū' heka hāg min bihingna tampal ni uttala' maka ni satan, sangpū'-sangpū' isab min bihingna tampal ni sobangan maka ni s'ddopan. Saga hāg itu kamemon subay nileboran maka pilak, maka subay nihinangan durukan min dī tumbaga. Pinē'an sasabit pilak isab panagnatan kultina.  <div eID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv873"/><div sID="gen1488" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv873"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Subay aniya' halaman ma sakalibut Luma' Pangarapan, taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Kultina landu' ahāp kakana'na ya panasak halaman itu, maka hāg nnompū' hekana panagnatan kultina. Duwa-duwampū' heka hāg min bihingna tampal ni uttala' maka ni satan, sangpū'-sangpū' isab min bihingna tampal ni sobangan maka ni s'ddopan. Saga hāg itu kamemon subay nileboran maka pilak, maka subay nihinangan durukan min dī tumbaga. Pinē'an sasabit pilak isab panagnatan kultina.  <div eID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv873"/><div sID="gen1488" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv873"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Subay aniya' halaman ma sakalibut Luma' Pangarapan, taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. verses.name: Exodus 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv873"/><div sID="gen1488" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv873"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Subay aniya' halaman ma sakalibut Luma' Pangarapan, taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. verses.name: Exodus 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv873"/><div sID="gen1488" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv873"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Subay aniya' halaman ma sakalibut Luma' Pangarapan, taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Kultina landu' ahāp kakana'na ya panasak halaman itu, maka hāg nnompū' hekana panagnatan kultina. Duwa-duwampū' heka hāg min bihingna tampal ni uttala' maka ni satan, sangpū'-sangpū' isab min bihingna tampal ni sobangan maka ni s'ddopan. Saga hāg itu kamemon subay nileboran maka pilak, maka subay nihinangan durukan min dī tumbaga. Pinē'an sasabit pilak isab panagnatan kultina.  <div eID="gen1489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv874"/><div sID="gen1490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv874"/> “Ma sasak tampal ni sobangan, pahinangun duwa kultina lima-limand'ppa taha'na panasak halaman min karuwambila' lalabayan ya pagsōd-luwasan a'a. Subay t'llu hāg jukup maka durukanna min bihing lalabayan tampal ni kowan, t'llu isab tampal ni gibang. Hatina kulang-kulang mpat d'ppa ya taha' sasak min karuwambila'.  <div eID="gen1490" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv874"/><div sID="gen1490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv874"/> “Ma sasak tampal ni sobangan, pahinangun duwa kultina lima-limand'ppa taha'na panasak halaman min karuwambila' lalabayan ya pagsōd-luwasan a'a. Subay t'llu hāg jukup maka durukanna min bihing lalabayan tampal ni kowan, t'llu isab tampal ni gibang. Hatina kulang-kulang mpat d'ppa ya taha' sasak min karuwambila'.  <div eID="gen1490" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv875"/><div sID="gen1491" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv875"/> “Hinangunbi kultina panambol pagsosōran halaman, limand'ppa taha'na. Ya pangahinangbi subay kakana' ahāp binuldahan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Subay aniya' hāg panagnatan kultina inān, mpat hekana jukup maka durukanna.

verses.name: Exodus 27:17
verses.text: Kamemon saga hāg ma sasak inān subay nilebod maka lebod-lebod dī pilak, subay aniya' sasabitna isab nihinang min dī pilak. Tumbaga ya pangahinang saga durukan hāg e'.

verses.name: Exodus 27:18
verses.text: Duwampū' maka mpat d'ppa ya taha' halaman itu, sangpū' maka duwand'ppa luhana. Dand'ppa maka duwa h'kka ya langkaw kultinana, ahāp isab kakana'na. Aniya' isab durukan tumbaga ma ba'anan saga hāgna.

verses.name: Exodus 27:19
verses.text: Jari kapanyapan ai-ai ya ginuna ma Luma' Pangarapan itu nihinang min tumbaga. Ya du saga bale pangengkotan Luma' Pangarapan maka sasakna, tumbaga isab.”  <div eID="gen1491" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1488" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv876"/><div sID="gen1492" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ns'llan Pang'ns'llan Palita'an ma Luma' Sussi</title> <div sID="gen1493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv876"/> Ah'lling gi' Tuhan ma si Musa yukna, “Soho'un saga bangsa Isra'il amowahan ka'a ns'llan jaitun<note>Ns'llan buwa' jaitun: ns'llan aheya gunana ma kalahat-lahatan inān. Pin'gga' min buwa' kayu jaitun, jari ahāp paglamud kinakan, paglandang-landang, pagtambal maka pamakeyat palita'an. ‘Olive oil’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> halam aniya' sapalna bo' aniya' pang'ns'llan saga palita'an bo' mbal magkap'dda keyatna.

verses.name: Exodus 27:21
verses.text: Wajib si Harun maka saga anakna angayuput saga palita'an ya pat'nna' ma deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan<note>Tolda Pagsasabuhan itu, hatina luma' tolda pagsasabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya'. Pinagōnan isab Luma' Pangarapan atawa Luma' Sussi.</note> min luwasan kultina ya pangalikus ba'ul isihan Sulat Paljanji'an. Palita'an ilu subay akeyat na pa'in ma haddarat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe min waktu abay kohap sampay ni kasubuhan. Subay bineya' panoho'an itu e' saga bangsa Isra'il kamemon magpangkat-mamangkat.”  <div eID="gen1493" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.27"/> <div eID="gen1492" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv877"/><div sID="gen1494" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pan'mmek Imam Alanga</title> <div sID="gen1495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv877"/> Amalman gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Palinganin danakannu si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla, ya si Nadab, si Abihu, si Eleyasar maka si Itamar. Pasaddīhun sigām min pagkahi sigām bangsa Isra'il bo' tahinang imam maghinang ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 28:2
verses.text: Pahinangin si Harun saga badju' alingkat ya tōp pan'mmek imam alanga, supaya iya patut pinagmahaltabatan.

verses.name: Exodus 28:3
verses.text: Bowahun magsuli-suli ba'anan saga a'a ata'u magtahi' ya bay buwananku kapandayan. Sō'un sigām angahinang saga badju' pan'mmek si Harun, jari pabidda' iya min kaheka'an a'a ati tag'llal imam maghinang ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 28:4
verses.text: Buwattitu saga s'mmek ya pamahinangnu ma saga a'a magtatahi': kaissana puyu' pat'nna' ma daggaha, karuwana lampik s'mmek ya niōnan epod, kat'lluna juba, ka'mpatna badju' buldahan, kalimana sulban, katapusanna kambot. Ya du ilu saga pan'mmek ahalga' ya nihinangan danakannu si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla supaya sigām tag'llal imam maghinang ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 28:5
verses.text: Subay lubid-lubid bulawan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat ya ginuna e' sigām, maka subay kakana' ahāp t'nnunanna.”  <div eID="gen1495" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1494" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv878"/><div sID="gen1496" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangahinang Epod</title> <div sID="gen1497" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv878"/> “Hinangun epod<note>Epod itu sali' lampik juba.</note> min kakana' ahāp isina maka min lubid-lubid bulawan. Salban bilu, taluk maka keyat isab ya pangangguna e' sigām ya apanday magbulda.

verses.name: Exodus 28:7
verses.text: Epod itu subay tinahi'an duwa sablayan ma bahana karuwambila' bo' ahāp t'nna'na ma baran imam.

verses.name: Exodus 28:8
verses.text: Subay aniya' sambung ahāp hinanganna isab, nihinang min kakana' ahāp maka min lubid-lubid bulawan, bo' binulda maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Sambung itu subay dalos asal maka baran epod.  <div eID="gen1497" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv879"/><div sID="gen1498" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv879"/> “Pagubus, angā' ka saga palmata onek<note>Onek itu dakayu' ginis palmata jali'-jali' ettom maka pote'.</note> duwa hekana pangukilan ōn saga anak si Isra'il<note>Si Isra'il: hatina si Yakub, ya pang'mbo'an saga bangsa Isra'il kasangpū' maka duwa.</note> kasangpū' maka duwa.

verses.name: Exodus 28:10
verses.text: Subay pinagsunu'-sunu' pangumulan sigām, nnom ōn sigām ma palmata dakayu', nnom isab ma dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 28:11
verses.text: Paukilun pahāp ma a'a apanday maghinang palmata maka singsing. Sasalunbi isab duwa kait<note>Kait: ‘alperel’ bang ma kasehe'an.</note> bulawan pamat'nna'an duwa palmata ilu.

verses.name: Exodus 28:12
verses.text: Manjari in duwa kait e' subay pinasangon ma diyata' sablayan epod bo' aniya' pangentoman saga anak si Isra'il. Pagka buwattē', in ōn saga bangsa Isra'il tatanggung e' si Harun ma hadaratku,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “ati taentomku sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 28:13
verses.text: Pasasalun duwa kait bulawan maka duwa kili-kili bulawan, tinabid-tabid sali' luwa lubid. Jari in kili-kili itu subay pinaengkot ni kait e'.”  <div eID="gen1498" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1496" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:14
verses.text: Pasasalun duwa kait bulawan maka duwa kili-kili bulawan, tinabid-tabid sali' luwa lubid. Jari in kili-kili itu subay pinaengkot ni kait e'.”  <div eID="gen1498" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1496" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv880"/><div sID="gen1499" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangahinang Puyu'-Daggaha</title> <div sID="gen1500" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv880"/> “Na,” yuk Tuhan, “pahinangun puyu'-daggaha pang'nda'an kahandak Tuhan. Pahinangun ma a'a taga-kapandayan. Soho'un pinasali' ni bay hinangan epod e', hatina kakana' ahāp isina pinaglamuran lubid-lubid bulawan, binuldahan isab maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.

verses.name: Exodus 28:16
verses.text: Kakana' puyu' itu subay nilupi' duwa bo' amasagi' dah'kka taha'na, dah'kka isab lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 28:17
verses.text: Pat'nna'un saga palmata kaginisan<note>Taga-ōn kamemon saga palmata itu ma bahasa Hibrani, sagō' mbal na kinata'uwan patantu bang ai hatina. Ya itu sababna angkan tasulat ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis (ta'ā' min NIV) maka walna'na ma bahasa Sinama.</note> sangpū' maka duwa hekana ma dahuan puyu'. Saga palmata itu subay pinagtād-tād mpat, t'llu-t'llu hekana ma dantād. Ya ma tād diyata' subay rubi (palmata alutu' keyatna), topas (palmata kuning), maka berel (palmata jali'-jali').

verses.name: Exodus 28:18
verses.text: Ya ma tād pasunu' subay turkwis (palmata bilu magb'ttik-b'ttik), sappir (palmata alutu' biluna), maka emeral (palmata alutu' gaddungna).

verses.name: Exodus 28:19
verses.text: Ma tād pasunu' gi' subay jasint (palmata bilu magb'ttik-b'ttik), agat (palmata magjali'-jali' kausun maka pote'), maka amitis (palmata taluk).

verses.name: Exodus 28:20
verses.text: Ma tād deyo' katapusan subay krisolit (palmata biyaning), onek (palmata kausun jali'-jali'), maka jasper (palmata intan gaddung). Bulawan ya pamakaitan saga palmata itu kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 28:21
verses.text: Manjari in sangpū' maka duwa palmata itu subay niukilan saga ōn anak si Isra'il l'lla, sali' hantang ukilan singsing. Ōn a'a dakayu' ma palmata dakayu' pakaniya-kaniya.”  <div eID="gen1500" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv881"/><div sID="gen1501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv881"/> Ah'lling gi' Tuhan ma si Musa yukna, “Hinangun duwa kili-kili min bulawan tinabid-tabid bo' aniya' pangengkot puyu',

verses.name: Exodus 28:23
verses.text: maka hinangun isab mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, engkotin tōng kili-kili bulawan inān ni duwa singsing puyu'. Engkotin tōngna dakayu' isab ni duwa kait ya pamatukan palmata bo' pasangon ni sablayan epod, min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 28:24
verses.text: maka hinangun isab mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, engkotin tōng kili-kili bulawan inān ni duwa singsing puyu'. Engkotin tōngna dakayu' isab ni duwa kait ya pamatukan palmata bo' pasangon ni sablayan epod, min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 28:25
verses.text: maka hinangun isab mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, engkotin tōng kili-kili bulawan inān ni duwa singsing puyu'. Engkotin tōngna dakayu' isab ni duwa kait ya pamatukan palmata bo' pasangon ni sablayan epod, min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 28:26
verses.text: maka hinangun isab mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, engkotin tōng kili-kili bulawan inān ni duwa singsing puyu'. Engkotin tōngna dakayu' isab ni duwa kait ya pamatukan palmata bo' pasangon ni sablayan epod, min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 28:27
verses.text: Hinangun lagi' singsing bulawan saddī, duwa hekana isab, ati tahi'un ni tōng sablayan epod, ma atag sambungna.

verses.name: Exodus 28:28
verses.text: In singsing puyu' damuli itu subay niengkotan ni singsing epod maka lubid bilu bo' supaya mbal angalambe puyu' min baran imam.  <div eID="gen1501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv882"/><div sID="gen1502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv882"/> “Manjari itu,” yuk Tuhan, “sakahaba' waktu kapasōd si Harun ni Tampat Sussi ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan aku, ina'an ma atag jantungna puyu' ya pang'nda'an kahandakku. Ina'an isab maina'an saga ōn anak si Isra'il tabowa e'na pamaentoman aku, si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 28:30
verses.text: Pat'nna'un isab in Urim maka Tummim<note>Mbal kinata'uwan bang ai luwa urim maka tummim itu, batu-batu ka atawa saddī.</note> ma deyom puyu' inān supaya tabowa ma atag jantung si Harun bang iya pasōd ni hadaratku sumiyan-sumiyan waktu. Jari aniya' ma iya pang'nda'an bo' tata'una bang ai kahandakku,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “pasal saga bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1502" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1499" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv883"/><div sID="gen1503" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanyapan Kasehe' ya Pan'mmek Imam</title> <div sID="gen1504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv883"/> Amalman gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Buwattitu ya pangahinangbi juba pangalapis epod. Hinangunbi min kakana' bilu halam aniya' lamudna,

verses.name: Exodus 28:32
verses.text: maka hinangin lowang ma t'ngnga'na bo' aniya' pasulugan kōk a'a. Lowang itu subay sinulsi pahāp bo' mbal al'kkas agese' bang sinulug.

verses.name: Exodus 28:33
verses.text: Pa'ari-arihun kumpi' juba maka buwa'-buwa' dalima'<note>Dalima' itu ōn kayu taga-buwa' ahāp luwana maka ssana. ‘Pomegranate’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> nihinang min salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Subay aniya' bagting-bagting bulawan isab pinag'llot-'llot maka buwa'-buwa' he'.

verses.name: Exodus 28:34
verses.text: Pa'ari-arihun kumpi' juba maka buwa'-buwa' dalima'<note>Dalima' itu ōn kayu taga-buwa' ahāp luwana maka ssana. ‘Pomegranate’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> nihinang min salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Subay aniya' bagting-bagting bulawan isab pinag'llot-'llot maka buwa'-buwa' he'.

verses.name: Exodus 28:35
verses.text: Wajib si Harun subay magsin'mmek juba itu hinabuna maghinang ni aku, jari takale lling bagting-bagting inān ma waktu kasōdna ni hadaratku ma Tampat Mahasussi. Takale isab ma waktu kaluwasna, ati mbal ya pinapatay. Aku si Yawe ya Tuhanbi.”  <div eID="gen1504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv884"/><div sID="gen1505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv884"/> Ah'lling gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Amasasal ka dakayu' tapak-tapak dī bulawan niukilan maka kabtangan itu, ‘Sussi-manussi Pamasuku' si Yawe.’ Ukilanna subay sali' ukilan singsing.

verses.name: Exodus 28:37
verses.text: Pasangonun lubid bilu ma tapak-tapak ilu pamaengkot iya ni dahuan imam.

verses.name: Exodus 28:38
verses.text: Tapak-tapak inān subay pabatuk ma tuktuk si Harun, jari bang asā' e' saga a'a Isra'il anukbal ai-ai, tatanggung e' si Harun kasā'an sigām. In tapak-tapak inān subay paddas ma tuktukna sakahaba' waktu bo' tataima' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe saga tutukbalan ummat Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1505" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv885"/><div sID="gen1506" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv885"/> “Pat'nnunun kakana' ahāp isina nihinang badju' pamadju' si Harun, maka sulban isab maka sabitan. Sabitanna itu subay binuldahan e' a'a magbubulda.

verses.name: Exodus 28:40
verses.text: Ya du saga anak si Harun l'lla, subay nihinangan badju' maka sabitan maka porong, hatina pan'mmek alingkat supaya sigām patut pinagmahaltabatan.

verses.name: Exodus 28:41
verses.text: Pasulugun saga pan'mmek itu ma danakannu si Harun (yuk Tuhan ma si Musa) maka ma saga anakna. Pagubus, busugin kōk sigām maka ns'llan jaitun bo' tag'llal imam. Pasuku'un sigām ma aku sadja supaya sigām makapaghinang ni aku.  <div eID="gen1506" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv886"/><div sID="gen1507" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv886"/> “Pahinangin sigām sauwal-sauwal isab panambun harapan sigām min hawakan sampay ni pa'a.

verses.name: Exodus 28:43
