verses.text: Wajib sigām subay magsulug sauwal-sauwal ilu sakahaba' waktu kapasōd sigām ni deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan,<note>Hatina Luma' Pagsasabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya', ya niōnan isab Luma' Pangarapan.</note> atawa bang sigām pasekot pehē' ni lapohan pagtukbalan ma Tampat Sussi bo' magimam ni aku maina'an. Bang sigām ganta' pasōd ma halam asauwal, dusa makapatay ko' inān. Panoho'an itu subay binogbogan e' si Harun maka saga panubu'na salama-lama tahun.”  <div eID="gen1507" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.28"/> <div eID="gen1503" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv887"/><div sID="gen1508" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapangangg'llal ma Imam</title> <div sID="gen1509" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv887"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan ma si Musa, “Buwattitu hatulanna bang pasaddīnu disi Harun magimam tudju ni aku. Pene'un dakayu' anak sapi' l'lla maka duwa bili-bili l'lla halam aniya' salla'na.

verses.name: Exodus 29:2
verses.text: Ngā'unbi isab tirigu pinu halam aniya' pasuligna bo' hinangunbi tinapay maka mamun anahut kalamuran ns'llan, maka bāng-bāng anipis-nipis pinahiran ns'llan.

verses.name: Exodus 29:3
verses.text: Nna'un ai-ai itu ni deyom dakayu' ambung bo' yampa tukbalin ni aku, pinapagbeya' maka sapi' maka duwa bili-bili he'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:4
verses.text: Pagubus, bowahun si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla pehē' ni atag pagsosōran Tolda Pagsasabuhan ati pandihun sigām maka bohe'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:5
verses.text: Aubus pa'in bay pinandi, pas'mmekin si Harun saga s'mmek imam. Dahū badju', bo' juba, bo' epod isab maka puyu'-daggaha. Pakambotin isab hawakanna maka sambung ya ahāp hinanganna he'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:6
verses.text: Pasulbanin kōkna bo' pat'nna'un tapak-tapak ni dahuwan sulban e'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:7
verses.text: Puwas e', angā' ka ns'llan jaitun ya ginuna pangangg'llal, bo' busugin pehē' ni kōk si Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 29:8
verses.text: Bowahun isab saga anak si Harun l'lla bo' pinasulugan saga badju' imam.

verses.name: Exodus 29:9
verses.text: Paporongin kōk sigām maka pakambotin isab hawakan sigām. Buwattē' ya pangangg'llalnu disi Harun magimam, iya sampay saga anakna l'lla. Manjari tubu'an sigām magpangkat-mamangkat ya pinat'nna' magimam sampay ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen1509" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv888"/><div sID="gen1510" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv888"/> Ah'lling lagi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Na, ya sapi' l'lla bay pene'nu subay pinasekot ni pagsosōran Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Bowahun si Harun maka saga anakna amat'nna' tangan sigām ma kōk sapi' he',

verses.name: Exodus 29:11
verses.text: bo' yampa sumbali'un ma matahanku ma atag lawang Tolda Pagsasabuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 29:12
verses.text: Angā' ka laha' min bay tasaludnu bo' pahirun pehē' ni saga dugu lapohan tumbaga.<note>Ya na lamisahan pagtunu'an kulban.</note> Tōng tangannu ya pamahid. Bu'usin isab saga laha' takapin nireyo' lapohan e'.  <div eID="gen1510" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv889"/><div sID="gen1511" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv889"/> “Pagubus, ngā'un lanab sapi' ilu kamemon, ya lanab amikit ma tina'ina, maka buli'-atayna, maka kidnina<note>Kidni: ya ma deyom baran manusiya' maka hayop ma tongod tangkal (saddī atay, saddī p'ddu). ‘Kidney’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis, ‘batu’ bang ma Sama kasehe'.</note> karuwa jukup maka lanabna. Tunu'un pehē' ni diyata' lapohan tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 29:14
verses.text: Sagō' ya isi sapi' maka kuwitna maka tina'ina subay tinunu' ma luwasan pustu. Pagtaubatan ko' inān pangangganti' paldusahan saga imam.”  <div eID="gen1511" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv890"/><div sID="gen1512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv890"/> Angallam lagi' Tuhan, yukna, “Angā' ka dakayu' bili-bili l'lla min bay pene'nu ati bowahun si Harun maka saga anakna amat'nna' tangan sigām ma kōk bili-bili he'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:16
verses.text: Sumbali'un magtūy, maka salurun laha'na bo' pigsikun pehē' ni mpat bihing lapohan tumbaga inān.

verses.name: Exodus 29:17
verses.text: Pagubus, pagk'llot-k'llotun baran bili-bili he'. Kose'in tina'ina maka saga tape'na bo' bangkatun ni kōkna maka isina.

verses.name: Exodus 29:18
verses.text: Manjari in baran bili-bili ilu subay tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna ma diyata' lapohan tumbaga. Pagkulban tinunu' ko' inān panukbalbi ni aku. Kasulutan isab aku ma hamutna,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen1512" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv891"/><div sID="gen1513" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv891"/> “Angā' ka isab bili-bili dakayu', ati bowahun si Harun maka saga anakna amat'nna' tangan sigām ma kōkna.

verses.name: Exodus 29:20
verses.text: Sumbali'un bo' salurun laha'na. Angakup ka dangkuri' laha' bo' peherun pehē' ni tōng tainga si Harun maka saga anakna, tampal ni kowan. Peherun isab ni dambila' bokol tangan sigām kowan maka ni bokol tape' sigām, kowan du isab. Pagubus, pigsikun laha' ni mpat bihing lapohan tumbaga he'.

verses.name: Exodus 29:21
verses.text: Angā' ka isab laha' min bay pamigsikannu ni lamisahan, beya' isab saga ns'llan jaitun. Jari pigsikun ni disi Harun maka saga anakna, lapayun isab saga s'mmek sigām. Minnē' sigām tasussi ma baran maka ma s'mmek, hatina suku' na sigām ma aku.  <div eID="gen1513" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv892"/><div sID="gen1514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv892"/> “Angā' ka lanab min bili-bili karuwana sabab bili-bili pangangg'llal imam ko' ilu. Angā' ka lanab togelna, maka lanab ya amikit ma tina'ina, maka buli'-atayna sampay saga kidnina<note>Kidni: ya ma deyom baran manusiya' maka hayop ma tongod tangkal (saddī atay, saddī p'ddu). ‘Kidney’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis, ‘batu’ bang ma Sama kasehe'.</note> karuwa jukup maka lanabna. Pabeya'un isab pa'ana kowan.

verses.name: Exodus 29:23
verses.text: Amene' ka tinapay min ambung ya pat'nna' ma matahanku. Subay dakayu' tinapay atibu'uk, dakayu' mamun-mamun kalamuran ns'llan, maka dakayu' bāng-bāng anipis, halam aniya' pasuligna kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 29:24
verses.text: Nde'in saga tinapay ilu maka saga k'llotan bili-bili ni pang'ntanan si Harun maka saga anakna. Pa'angkatun kamemonna ma sigām pangahulmat ma aku, ya Tuhanbi si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 29:25
verses.text: Pagubus, sambutun pabalik min tangan sigām bo' tunu'un pehē' ni diyata' lapohan pagtunu'an, beya' maka susumbali'an ya tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna ati kasulutan aku ma hamutna. Pagkulban tinunu' ko' inān panukbalbi ma aku, si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 29:26
verses.text: Pagā'nu daggaha bili-bili bay sinumbali' pangangg'llal ma si Harun, angkatun ma matahanku dahū pangahulmatnu ma aku, jari ma ka'a na.  <div eID="gen1514" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv893"/><div sID="gen1515" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv893"/> “Pasuku'unbi ma aku dahū saga bahagi' bili-bili ya palsuku'an disi Harun maka saga anakna, hatina daggaha maka pa'a ya bay niangkat pangahulmat ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 29:28
verses.text: Buwattē' l'ngngananna salama-lama tahun bang aniya' susumbali'an tinukbal pagduwa'a salamat ni si Yawe e' saga a'a Isra'il. Daggaha maka pa'a subay pamasuku' e' saga bangsa Isra'il pagkakan si Harun maka anak-panubu'na.  <div eID="gen1515" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv894"/><div sID="gen1516" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv894"/> “Na, saga s'mmek pagimam si Harun inān subay pamusaka' saga panubu'na, pan'mmek sigām ma waktu pamat'nna' sigām magimam, waktu isab pamusug kōk sigām maka ns'llan jaitun.

verses.name: Exodus 29:30
verses.text: Jari sasuku pinat'nna' magimam pas'lle' min si Harun bo' pasōd ni deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan maghinang ni aku ma Tampat Sussi, wajib subay magbinadju' s'mmek si Harun pitung'llaw t'ggolna.  <div eID="gen1516" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv895"/><div sID="gen1517" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv895"/> “Manjari angā' na ka isi min bili-bili ya bay sinumbali' pangangg'llal ma disi Harun. Loho'in ma halaman Luma' Sussi

verses.name: Exodus 29:32
verses.text: ati pamakanun ma si Harun maka saga anakna ma atag pagsosōran Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Kapin tinapay bay ma deyom ambung ya palauk.

verses.name: Exodus 29:33
verses.text: Luwal sigām ya taga-kapatut amangan saga pagkakan ilu, sabab bay panukbal ni aku pagtaubatan dusa sigām ma waktu kapangangg'llal sigām magimam. Suku' Tuhan ko' inān angkan halam sai-na makajari amangan saddī min disi Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 29:34
verses.text: Bang isab aniya' isi bili-bili atawa tinapay angapin sampay ni kasubuhan, subay tinunu'. Mbal manjari kinakan sabab bay pinama-Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1517" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv896"/><div sID="gen1518" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv896"/> “Na,” yuk Tuhan ma si Musa, “beya'un hatulan kamemon ya panoho'anku itu pasal pangangg'llal ma si Harun maka saga anakna. Paghinang ilu subay pitung'llaw t'ggolna.

verses.name: Exodus 29:36
verses.text: Anumbali' ka sapi' l'lla kahaba' llaw ma deyom dapitu'. Pagkulban panaubatan dusa ko' inān, maka pamala'an tamak dusa isab min lapohan pagtunu'an. Busugin isab maka ns'llan pamasussi bo' pinama-aku sadja.

verses.name: Exodus 29:37
verses.text: Subay pitung'llaw ya t'ggolbi maghinang saga hinang itu magbalik-balik, hinang pamala'an tamak dusa maka hinang pamasussi. Manjari asussi sidda lapohan itu, maka asussi isab ai-ai makasagid pehē'.”  <div eID="gen1518" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1508" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv897"/><div sID="gen1519" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Susumbali'an ya Tinukbal Kahaba' Llaw</title> <div sID="gen1520" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv897"/> Amalman lagi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Ya panukbalbi ni aku ma lamisahan pagtunu'an subay duwa anak bili-bili dantahun umulna. Dakayu' ilu subay tukbalbi ma aku ma waktu subu, dakayu' isab ma abay kohap. Buwattē' hinangbi sakahaba' llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 29:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv897"/><div sID="gen1519" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Susumbali'an ya Tinukbal Kahaba' Llaw</title> <div sID="gen1520" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv897"/> Amalman lagi' Tuhan ma si Musa, yukna, “Ya panukbalbi ni aku ma lamisahan pagtunu'an subay duwa anak bili-bili dantahun umulna. Dakayu' ilu subay tukbalbi ma aku ma waktu subu, dakayu' isab ma abay kohap. Buwattē' hinangbi sakahaba' llaw.

verses.name: Exodus 29:40
verses.text: Pabeya'unbi ma bili-bili subu dagantang tirigu pinu kalamuran dalitru ns'llan jaitun. Tumpahinbi isab dalitru binu-anggul pangahulmatbi ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 29:41
verses.text: Damikiyanna bili-bili dakayu' ya tinukbal abay-kohap, subay pinabeya'an tirigu maka binu-anggul. Pagkulban tinunu' ko' inān ya panukbalbi ma aku, si Yawe, jari kasulutan aku ma hamutna.  <div eID="gen1520" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv898"/><div sID="gen1521" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv898"/> “In pagkulban tinunu' itu subay tinukbal ma matahanku kahaba' llaw, ma dahuan Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Subay tinukiran e'bi magpangkat-mamangkat. Mailu aku pasabu ma ka'a, Musa, maka e'ku amissala ma ka'a.

verses.name: Exodus 29:43
verses.text: Mailu du isab aku magsabu maka saga bangsa Isra'il kamemon. Jari asussi makalandu' atag pagsabuhan inān pagka taluwa' sahayaku.  <div eID="gen1521" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv899"/><div sID="gen1522" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv899"/> “Pasussiku Tolda Pagsasabuhan ilu sampay lapohan ya pagtunu'an kulban e'. Pasussiku du isab si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla, supaya sigām tahinang imam maghinang ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 29:45
verses.text: Jari pat'nna' aku ma deyoman saga bangsa Isra'il ati aku ya pagtuhanan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 29:46
verses.text: Minnē' sigām makata'u to'ongan in aku si Yawe ya pagtuhanan sigām, ya bay amowa sigām paluwas min lahat Misil bo' supaya aku pat'nna' ma deyoman sigām. Si Yawe aku, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1522" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.29"/> <div eID="gen1519" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv900"/><div sID="gen1523" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagtugtugan Kamanyan</title> <div sID="gen1524" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv900"/> Magpanoho'an gi' Tuhan ma si Musa yukna, “Angahinang kam lamisahan min kayu akasya, pagtugtugan kamanyan.

verses.name: Exodus 30:2
verses.text: Subay amasagi' duwa h'kka taha'na maka lambuna, mpat h'kka isab langkawna. Hinangin pussuk-pussuk sali' luwa tanduk ma duguna ka'mpat, dalos asal kayuna maka kayu ya pangahinangan baran lamisahan.

verses.name: Exodus 30:3
verses.text: Putusun diyata'na maka bulawan porol, beya' isab kīdna maka pussuk-pussukna ka'mpat. Pehē'in gipis bulawan isab ma kakīranna pamahāp luwana.

verses.name: Exodus 30:4
verses.text: Hinangun duwa gallang bulawan pinasangon pehē' ni kīd lamisahan min deyo'an gipis e', dakayu' min dambila', dakayu' isab min dambila' bo' aniya' pamasulugan tanggungan.

verses.name: Exodus 30:5
verses.text: Saga tanggungan itu subay nihinang min kayu akasya pinutus isab maka bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 30:6
verses.text: Pat'nna'un lamisahan itu min luwasan kultina ya pangalikus Ba'ul Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an, bo' min luwasan Turung Pagtaubatan isab. Maina'an aku pasabu ma ka'a.  <div eID="gen1524" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv901"/><div sID="gen1525" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv901"/> “Na, ya hinang si Harun ma waktu pamahilala'na saga palita'an kahaba' subu, subay anugtug kamanyan ahamut ma lamisahan inān.

verses.name: Exodus 30:8
verses.text: Ya du kahaba' abay-kohap, ma waktu panū'na palita'an, subay anugtug kamanyan isab supaya aniya' pat'bbud ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> waktu ni waktu salama-lama tahun.

verses.name: Exodus 30:9
verses.text: Da'a kam anukbal kamanyan saddī min kamanyan halal ma lamisahan panugtugan ilu. Mbal manjari bang panukbalan saga susumbali'an tinunu', atawa tirigu, atawa binu-anggul.

verses.name: Exodus 30:10
verses.text: Lamisahan ilu subay paghinangan taubat e' si Harun mint'dda dantahun bo' ta'ampun ba'anan karusahan bangsa Isra'il. In pussuk-pussukna ka'mpat subay pinahiran laha' min hayop ya sinumbali' pagtaubatan dusa min t'dda dantahun. Bogboginbi paghinang itu kahaba' tahun magpangkat-mamangkat sabab lamisahan landu' asussi ko' ilu, lamisahan suku' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”  <div eID="gen1525" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1523" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv902"/><div sID="gen1526" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panungbas Kallum Saga Kal'llahan</title> <div sID="gen1527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv902"/> Na ah'lling gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 30:12
verses.text: “Bang ka angitung saga kal'llahan bangsa Isra'il, subay aniya' bayad pakaniya-pakaniya min sigām kamemon panungbas kallum sigām. Jari halam aniya' bala' tum'kka ni sigām ma waktu kapangitung e'.

verses.name: Exodus 30:13
verses.text: Pabayarun tonga' sekel<note>Tonga' sekel itu, dī pilak saga sangpū' maka lima sussuk.</note> dī pilak ma sigām pakaniya-kaniya bang sigām ni'itung na, panukbal sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. (Timbangan sara' agama ya pagtimbangan e'.)

verses.name: Exodus 30:14
verses.text: Taluwa' ni'itung saga kal'llahan kamemon ya angabut duwampū' tahun umulna sampay pariyata'. Wajib sigām subay ang'nde'an tutukbalan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:15
verses.text: Ya tungbas kallum tinukbal ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> e' a'a dayahan subay mbal palabi min tonga' sekel. Ya tinukbal e' a'a miskin isab subay mbal pakulang min tonga' sekel.

verses.name: Exodus 30:16
verses.text: Timukun sīn panungbas kallum itu bo' panganggastuhun ai-ai tahinang ma Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Manjari aniya' pangentoman ma matahan si Yawe, paltanda'an in ka'am bay makatungbas kallumbi.”  <div eID="gen1527" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1526" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv903"/><div sID="gen1528" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Garul Pagailan</title> <div sID="gen1529" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv903"/> Pagubus ina'an, ah'lling gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 30:18
verses.text: “Angahinang kam dakayu' garul tumbaga pagailan saga imam. Hinanginbi isab patinggilan pamat'nna'an iya, tumbaga isab. Ya pamat'nna'anbi garul itu subay ma llotan Tolda Pagsasabuhan maka lamisahan pagkukulbanan. Isihinbi bohe' isab.

verses.name: Exodus 30:19
verses.text: Si Harun maka saga anakna subay magailan tape'-tangan sigām

verses.name: Exodus 30:20
verses.text: ma waktu kapasōd sigām ni deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya'. Jari mbal sigām taluwa' pinapatay. Buwattē' du isab bang sigām pasekot ni lamisahan pagkukulbanan bo' anunu' susumbali'an ni aku,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:21
verses.text: “Tangan maka tape' sigām subay niailan bo' supaya sigām mbal amatay. Panoho'an itu subay binogbogan e' si Harun maka saga panubu'na magpangkat-mamangkat.”  <div eID="gen1529" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1528" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv904"/><div sID="gen1530" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ns'llan Pamehed Ai-ai Pinasuku' ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv904"/> Ah'lling isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 30:23
verses.text: “Angahinang kam ns'llan sussi min ns'llan jaitun mpat litru. Lamurinbi isab mpat ginis pamapā pamahamut iya. Issa, bulitik mūr<note>Mūr itu, ginis kayu ahamut.</note> masi bohe'an, saga nnom kilu buhatna bang ma timbangan sara' agama. Karuwana, kuwit kayu sinamun<note>Sinamun itu, ginis pamapā, ‘cinnamon’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ahamut saga t'llu kilu buhatna. Kat'lluna, batang parang ahamut t'llu kilu isab buhatna. Ka'mpatna, kuwit kayu kassiya nnom kilu buhatna, ahamut isab.

verses.name: Exodus 30:24
verses.text: “Angahinang kam ns'llan sussi min ns'llan jaitun mpat litru. Lamurinbi isab mpat ginis pamapā pamahamut iya. Issa, bulitik mūr<note>Mūr itu, ginis kayu ahamut.</note> masi bohe'an, saga nnom kilu buhatna bang ma timbangan sara' agama. Karuwana, kuwit kayu sinamun<note>Sinamun itu, ginis pamapā, ‘cinnamon’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ahamut saga t'llu kilu buhatna. Kat'lluna, batang parang ahamut t'llu kilu isab buhatna. Ka'mpatna, kuwit kayu kassiya nnom kilu buhatna, ahamut isab.

verses.name: Exodus 30:25
verses.text: Papaglamurunbi saga kapanyapan itu kamemon nihinang ns'llan ahamut landu' asussi, bo' aniya' pamehed ai-ai pamasuku' ma Tuhan. Beya'unbi kapandayan saga a'a ata'u angahinang pahamut.

verses.name: Exodus 30:26
verses.text: Gunahun ns'llan sussi itu panussi Tolda Pagsabuhan sampay kamemon saga pagdayawna. Lapayun Ba'ul ya Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an,

verses.name: Exodus 30:27
verses.text: maka lamisahan pamat'nna'an tinapay sampay kapanyapanna, maka palita'an bulawan beya' isab panyapna, maka lamisahan panugtugan kamanyan.

verses.name: Exodus 30:28
verses.text: Ya du lapohan pagtunu'an kulban sampay kapanyapanna kamemon, maka garul pagailan isab sampay pat'nna'anna.

verses.name: Exodus 30:29
verses.text: In itu kamemon subay pinehē'an ns'llan sussi supaya asussi to'ongan, manjari suku'ku na. Bang aniya' isab makasagid ni ai-ai bay tasussi itu, subay suku'ku na.”  <div eID="gen1531" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv905"/><div sID="gen1532" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv905"/> Yuk Tuhan lagi', “Busugin ns'llan kōk disi Harun maka saga anakna, paltanda'an in sigām ma aku sadja, jari imam na sigām patut maghinang ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 30:31
verses.text: Pahati'un saga bangsa Isra'il in ns'llan sussi itu subay aheya kagunahanna ma ka'am sampay ma panubu'bi magpangkat-mamangkat.

verses.name: Exodus 30:32
verses.text: Da'a pamahirunbi ma baran sai-na saddī min imam, da'a isab sengorinbi hinanganna. Suku' Tuhan ko' ilu, angkan subay halli'anbi.

verses.name: Exodus 30:33
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a saddī angahinang ns'llan pahamut buwattitu hinanganna, atawa pamahidna ma a'a saddī min imam, in a'a inān mbal na taitung bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1532" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1530" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv906"/><div sID="gen1533" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamanyan ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1534" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv906"/> Angallam lagi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa yukna, “Buwattitu ya pangahinangbi kamanyan. Angā' kam duwa ginis bulitik ahāp isina maka hamutna, maka kuwit kūs-kūs maka kamanyan pote'. Buhatna kaniya-kaniya subay dasali' kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 30:35
verses.text: Ta'ā'bi pa'in ai-ai itu, beya'unbi kapandayan saga a'a ata'u angahinang pahamut. Paglamurunbi bo' tahinang kamanyan ahāp to'ongan hamutna. Pagubus, asininbi supaya al'ssin maka asussi.

verses.name: Exodus 30:36
verses.text: Pipisun kasehe'anna nihinang kamanyan anahut bo' pat'nna'un ma dahuan Ba'ul Paljanji'an ya ma deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Mailu du aku magsabu maka ka'a. Kamanyan itu subay taitungbi sussi min sussi sabab suku'ku asal.

verses.name: Exodus 30:37
verses.text: Wajib kam da'a angahinang kamanyan buwattitu pamahamut baranbi. Niyatunbi kamanyan sussi ma aku sadja.

verses.name: Exodus 30:38
verses.text: Sasuku angahinang kamanyan buwattitu lamudna bo' pamahamutna baranna, mbal na taitung bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen1534" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.30"/> <div eID="gen1533" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv907"/><div sID="gen1535" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Tapene' Angahinang Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1536" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv907"/> Na, angallam lagi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 31:2
verses.text: “Pata'u ka. Ya tapene'ku angahinang Luma' Pangarapan ma aku ya na si Besalel anak si Uri, mpu si Hūr, min panubu' si Yahud.

verses.name: Exodus 31:3
verses.text: Katulunanku iya kapandayan, akkal maka pangita'u bo' ahāp e'na angahinang ai-ai ya hinangan tangan.

verses.name: Exodus 31:4
verses.text: Ata'u iya angangguhit suntu'an ma ai-ai tahinang min bulawan, pilak atawa tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 31:5
verses.text: Ata'u iya anganggaugari' ginisan palmata bo' yampa pat'nna'na ma kait bulawan. Ya du bang kayu ya pangahinanganna, ata'u isab iya. Hatina ata'u iya angahinang indaginis.

verses.name: Exodus 31:6
verses.text: Tapene'ku isab si Oholeyab anak si Ahisamak, min bangsa Dān, bo' aniya' sehe' si Besalel anabangan iya ma hinangna. Aho', buwananku kapandayan kamemon saga a'a maghihinang supaya sigām makahinang ai-ai bay panoho'anku ma ka'a, ya tasulat ma lista itu:

verses.name: Exodus 31:7
verses.text: Tolda Pagsasabuhan, Ba'ul Pagtatau'an Sulat Paljanji'an maka Turungna ya pagtaubatan dusa, maka kapanyapan ai-ai ya pamapanyap Tolda.

verses.name: Exodus 31:8
verses.text: Lamisahan pamat'nna'an tinapay maka panyapna, Palita'an Bulawan maka panyapna, Lamisahan pagtugtugan kamanyan.

verses.name: Exodus 31:9
verses.text: Lapohan pagtunu'an kulban, beya' isab kapanyapanna. Garul pangailan sampay patinggilanna.

verses.name: Exodus 31:10
verses.text: Saga s'mmek mulliya ya tin'nnun pan'mmek disi Harun maka saga anakna ma waktu kapagimam sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 31:11
verses.text: Katapusan ya Ns'llan sussi pangangg'llal ma saga a'a maghinang ni Tuhan, maka kamanyan ahamut ya kagunahan ma Luma' Sussi. In itu kamemon subay nihinang e' saga a'a ya katulunan akkal maka kapandayan. Subay bineya' bay panoho'anku ma ka'a, Musa.”  <div eID="gen1536" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1535" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv908"/><div sID="gen1537" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Pasal Llaw Paghali</title> <div sID="gen1538" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv908"/> Na, angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa yukna,

verses.name: Exodus 31:13
verses.text: “Pasampayun palmanku itu ni saga bangsa Isra'il, ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam amogbog ma llaw ya ōnanku Llaw Mulliya. Jari in pangammalbi ma llaw mulliya tahinang pandoga pamaentom ka'am magtubu'-manubu' in aku maka ka'am bay makapagjanji'. Jari makata'u kam in aku si Yawe, ya makahinang ka'am bangsa sussi, bangsa suku'ku.’ Buwattē' ya pamasampaynu ma sigām.”  <div eID="gen1538" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv909"/><div sID="gen1539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv909"/> Angallam gi' Tuhan yukna, “Bogboginbi Llaw Paghali, sabab Llaw Mulliya ma ka'am. Sasuku mbal angammal ma Llaw Mulliya subay pinapatay. Sasuku isab makahinang ai-ai ma llaw ina'an, subay itungbi sali' a'a liyu, ngga'i ka bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 31:15
verses.text: Nnom llaw ya pamihabi kalluman ma deyom dapitu', sagō' bang ta'abut llaw kapitu'na, ya na llaw paghali, Llaw Mulliya pamaheyabi ma aku. Sasuku maghinang ai-ai ma llaw ina'an, subay pinapatay.

verses.name: Exodus 31:16
verses.text: In ka'am bangsa Isra'il magtubu'-manubu' subay amogbog ma Llaw Mulliya itu bo' mbal takalipat paljanji'antam ya anatas salama-lama.

verses.name: Exodus 31:17
verses.text: In Llaw Mulliya itu sali' pandoga pamaentom ka'am ni kasaumulan in aku maka ka'am bay makapagjanji'. Sababna nnom llaw ya bay kapamapanjariku dunya maka langit. Sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw kapitu'na, pahali na aku min hinangku.”  <div eID="gen1539" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv910"/><div sID="gen1540" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv910"/> Na, aubus pa'in pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa ma diyata' Būd Turusina, magtūy pamuwanna ma iya duwa batu amasagi' ya bay pangukilanna Sara' paljanji'anna maka bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1540" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.31"/> <div eID="gen1537" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv911"/><div sID="gen1541" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sapi' Bulawan</title> <div sID="gen1542" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv911"/> Manjari itu, pagka tasayu e' saga a'a Isra'il in si Musa at'ggol halam bay makalūd min būd, patimuk sigām pehē' ni si Harun. Yuk sigām ma iya, “Tuwan, hinangin kitam tuhan bo' aniya' magmunda' ma kitam ma pal'ngnganan. Daka maingga si Musa inān, ya bay amowa kitam paluwas min Misil.”  <div eID="gen1542" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv912"/><div sID="gen1543" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv912"/> Anambung si Harun ma sigām, yukna, “Ā, sō'un nila'anan saga bulawan ya pangaretes saga h'ndabi maka anakbi l'lla-d'nda. Bowahunbi pi'itu ni aku.”  <div eID="gen1543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv913"/><div sID="gen1544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv913"/> Magtūy kala'anan e' sigām kamemon saga aretes sigām bo' binowa pehē' ni si Harun.

verses.name: Exodus 32:4
verses.text: Tasambut pa'in ba'anan bulawan e', tinunaw e' si Harun bo' yampa hinangna ta'u-ta'u<note>Ta'u-ta'u atawa balhala', hatina tuhan-tuhan pagsusumbahan.</note> sali' luwa sapi' mandangan abata' lagi'. Aubus pa'in, ah'lling saga a'a Isra'il, yuk sigām, “Owa', ka'am saga a'a Isra'il! Nda'unbi tuhantam, ya bay amowa kitam paluwas min lahat Misil!”  <div eID="gen1544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv914"/><div sID="gen1545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv914"/> Na, tasayu pa'in lling itu e' si Harun, magtūy iya angahinang pagtunu'an kulban ma munda'an sapi' bulawan e'. Yukna ma saga a'a, “Maghinang kitam salung, hinang pamaheya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:6
verses.text: Pagsalung pa'in, waktu subu to'ongan, magbati'an saga a'a kamemon anunu' susumbali'an panukbal sigām ni Tuhan. Aniya' isab lalabotan tinukbal e' sigām pagduwa'ahan salamat. Aubus pa'in, magjamu na sigām sampay magkalumu'an d'nda maka l'lla.  <div eID="gen1545" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv915"/><div sID="gen1546" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv915"/> Na, magsuwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Pasa'ut ka palūd,” yukna, “sabab saga a'anu, ya bay bowanu paluwas min Misil, wa'i na maghinang kasabulan.

verses.name: Exodus 32:8
verses.text: Al'kkas pahāp sigām ang'bba min kal'ngnganan ya bay panoho'anku ma sigām. Aniya' ta'u-ta'u tahinang e' sigām buwat luwa sapi' mandangan, jari pagsujuran e' sigām maka pagtukbalan saga susumbali'an. Ya pah'lling sigām, ‘O'o, pagtuhanantam bangsa Isra'il, ya bay amowa kitam paluwas min Misil.’ ”  <div eID="gen1546" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv916"/><div sID="gen1547" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv916"/> Magsuwala gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa yukna, “Ta'nda'ku saga a'a inān, atuwas to'ongan kōk sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 32:10
verses.text: Da'a aku saparun sabab apasu' sidda atayku, maka magniyat aku amahalam sigām. Jari ka'a maka panubu'nu ya hinangku bangsa aheya.”  <div eID="gen1547" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv917"/><div sID="gen1548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv917"/> Sagō' angamu' junjung si Musa ni si Yawe ya pagtuhananna, yukna, “O Yawe, da'a mulahun saga a'a suku'nu itu, ya bay bowanu paluwas min lahat Misil sabab min kosog kawasanu.

verses.name: Exodus 32:12
verses.text: Dūlannu bahā' saga bangsa Misil amūng-mūngan ka'a ala'at kono' maksudnu, ya angkan bowanu bangsa Isra'il paluwas min Misil bo' papataynu sigām ma kabūran. Luhūy halam aniya' a'a Isra'il takapin ma babaw dunya itu? Ndū', Tuhanku, bang pa'in pindahannu kapasu' ataynu. Da'a lanjalin niyatnu angamula saga a'a suku'nu itu.

verses.name: Exodus 32:13
verses.text: Entomun saga sosoho'annu disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub. Entomun bay janji'nu ma sigām, ya bay pagsapahannu ma barannu, ya bay yuknu, ‘Pahekaku saga panubu'bi sampay sigām sali' heka bitu'un ma langit. Pamusaka'ku kaluha'an lahat Kana'an ma sigām salama-lama, buwat bay panganjanji'ku ma ka'am.’ ”

verses.name: Exodus 32:14
verses.text: Na, pagka buwattē' panganjunjung si Musa, halam nilanjalan e' si Yawe niyatna amahalam saga a'a Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv918"/><div sID="gen1549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv918"/> Manjari palūd na si Musa min būd maka e'na amowa duwa batu amasagi' ya panulatan sara'-panoho'an bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il. Batu inān bay pangukilan sara' ma dahuanna maka ma bukutna.

verses.name: Exodus 32:16
verses.text: Tuhan to'ongan ya bay angahinang duwa batu itu, maka Tuhan ya bay angukil saga sara'.  <div eID="gen1549" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv919"/><div sID="gen1550" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv919"/> Na, makakale pa'in si Yussa' ma hidjulan saga a'a Isra'il, yukna ma si Musa, “Sali' hidjul pagbono' ya takaleku itu!”  <div eID="gen1550" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv920"/><div sID="gen1551" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv920"/> Ya sambung si Musa, <lg sID="gen1552"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1553"/>“Ngga'i ka hidjul panganda'ug ya takaleta,<l eID="gen1553" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1554"/>ngga'i ka isab hidjul min a'a tara'ug,<l eID="gen1554" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1555"/>sagō' hidjul min saga a'a magkalangan.”<l eID="gen1555" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1552"/>  <div eID="gen1551" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv921"/><div sID="gen1556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv921"/> Makasekot pa'in si Musa ni pustu he', bo' ta'nda'na sapi' bulawan maka saga a'a magpangigal ma munda'an sapi', magtūy arugal sidda atayna. Hantakanna duwa batu amasagi' ya bay tabowana bo' alopot ma atag ina'an, ma deyo'an būd.

verses.name: Exodus 32:20
verses.text: Niā' isab e' si Musa sapi' bay tahinang e' saga a'a Isra'il. Aubus bay tinunu', pinagpipis-pipis e'na bo' binudburan ma kuwit bohe'. Katapusanna, pamainum e'na ma saga a'a Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1556" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv922"/><div sID="gen1557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv922"/> Yuk si Musa ma si Harun, “Ai bay tahinang ma ka'a e' saga a'a ilu ya angkan bowanu sigām maghinang dusa buwattilu heyana?”  <div eID="gen1557" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv923"/><div sID="gen1558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv923"/> Ya sambung si Harun, yukna, “Da'a pa'in akagit ataynu, tuwan. Kata'uwannu saga a'a itu, aluhay sigām tabowa maghinang kala'atan.

verses.name: Exodus 32:23
verses.text: Bay sigām amissala ma aku, yuk-i, ‘Hinangin kitam tuhan magmunda' ma kitam ma pal'ngnganan. Daka maingga si Musa inān, ya bay amowa kitam paluwas min Misil.’

verses.name: Exodus 32:24
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma sigām, ‘Sai-sai kam taga-pamulawan, la'aninbi.’ Magtūy ni'nde'an ni aku saga pamulawan sigām ati pehē'ku ni deyom api. Pagtunaw pa'in, paluwas sapi' mandangan inān!”  <div eID="gen1558" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv924"/><div sID="gen1559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv924"/> Na, ta'nda' e' si Musa saga a'a Isra'il wa'i magkangogan, mbal takole' nihawiran e' si Harun, angkan sigām tahinang pagtittowahan ma saga banta sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 32:26
verses.text: Jari itu, an'ngge na si Musa ma pagsosōran pustu maka e'na amissala, yukna, “Sasuku kam bilahi ameya' ma si Yawe, pi'itu kam ni aku.” Magtūy pehē' ni iya kamemon saga kal'llahan panubu' si Libi.

verses.name: Exodus 32:27
verses.text: Yuk si Musa ma sigām, “Ya pamah'lling ka'am e' si Yawe Tuhan bangsa Isra'il, in ka'am subay magtinakos pakaniya-pakaniya. Latagunbi kauman itu min dampōng ni dampōng amapatay pagkahibi bangsa Isra'il ai na ka kampungbi, ai na ka bagaybi.”

verses.name: Exodus 32:28
verses.text: Na bineya' e' saga panubu' si Libi panoho'an si Musa he' ati magpatayan saga t'llungibu a'a ma llaw ina'an.

verses.name: Exodus 32:29
verses.text: Pagubus, yuk si Musa, “Llaw itu, in ka'am saga panubu' si Libi tapasaddī na bo' ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe sadja, kalna' kam bay magmalilla' amono' saga anakbi maka langgungbi. Angkan kam kabuwanan kahāpan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”  <div eID="gen1559" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv925"/><div sID="gen1560" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv925"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', ah'lling si Musa ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Aheya to'ongan dusa bay tahinangbi. Saguwā', minsan buwattē', patukad aku ni būd pabalik angarap ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Kalu-kalu mura-murahan nirūlan aku angamu'an ka'am ka'ampunan ma pasal dusabi.”  <div eID="gen1560" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv926"/><div sID="gen1561" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv926"/> Manjari patukad si Musa pabalik ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Yukna ma iya, “Arōy Tuhanku, aheya sidda dusa bay tahinang e' saga a'a itu. Bay sigām makahinang tuhan-tuhan min bulawan panumbahan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 32:32
verses.text: Ndū', bang pa'in dūlannu panganjunjungku, ampunun dusa sigām. Malaingkan bang sigām mbal ampunnu, na, papasin ōnku min kitab ya panulatannu ōn saga a'a suku'nu.”  <div eID="gen1561" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv927"/><div sID="gen1562" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv927"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Luwal saga a'a bay makarusa ni aku ya papasanku min kitabku.

verses.name: Exodus 32:34
verses.text: Na pehē' na ka. Bowahun saga a'a ilu tudju ni lahat ya bay pangahakaku ma ka'a. Ilu isab mala'ikatku parahū min ka'a ma labayan. Sagō' bang ta'abut waktuna, tiksa'ku sasuku bay makarusa ilu.”  <div eID="gen1562" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv928"/><div sID="gen1563" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv928"/> Jari aniya' saki landu' abangat pinat'kka e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma bangsa Isra'il ma sabab bay kahinangan sigām ma sapi' bulawan ya bay tahinang e' si Harun.  <div eID="gen1563" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.32"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:1
verses.text: Na magsuwala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Patulak kam minnitu, ka'am maka saga a'a bay bowanu paluwas min lahat Misil. Pauntas kam ni lahat bay panganjanji'ku ma si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub. Aniya' bay panapaku ma sigām, ya yukku, ‘Pamuwanku lahat inān ma saga panubu'bi.’

verses.name: Exodus 33:2
verses.text: Pabeya'ku dakayu' mala'ikat parahū min ka'am. Dūyku isab saga kabangsahan maglalahat mahē', ya na saga bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Amor, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus.

verses.name: Exodus 33:3
verses.text: Pauntas kam ni lahat e', ya lahat ap'nno' e' kalluman landu' ahāp. Sagō' in aku itu mbal pasehe' ma ka'am sabab kalna' atuwas saga kōkbi. Bang kam saupama sehe'anku, marai' kam paka'atku to'ongan ma labayan.”  <div eID="gen1564" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv929"/><div sID="gen1565" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv929"/> Na, kahaka'an pa'in saga a'a Isra'il pasal pamissala makasusa itu, magtūy sigām anagna' magsusun maka halam aniya' min sigām magpamulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 33:5
verses.text: Sabab aniya' bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Haka'in saga a'a Isra'il in sigām bangsa landu' atuwas. Bang aku pasehe' ma sigām minsan la'a dansasa'at, marai' sigām mulaku saru'un-du'un. Sō'un sigām angala'anan ba'anan pamulawan ya pamakay sigām. Kira-kiraku lagi' bang ai hinangku ma sigām.”

verses.name: Exodus 33:6
verses.text: Manjari itu, makalanjal pa'in saga bangsa Isra'il min atag Būd Horeb (Būd Turusina), halam na sigām magpamakay saga pamulawan.  <div eID="gen1565" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1541" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv930"/><div sID="gen1566" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tolda Pagsabuhan Tuhan maka Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen1567" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv930"/> Na ya kabiyaksahan si Musa maingga-maingga pahanti'an sigām bangsa Isra'il, amat'ngge iya dakayu' luma' tolda alawak-lawak min pustu. ‘Tolda pagsabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya'’ ya pangōn si Musa ma tolda inān. Jari bang aniya' bilahi angaru ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, subay iya paluwas min kauman pehē' ni Tolda Pagsabuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 33:8
verses.text: Na sakahaba' si Musa paluwas pehē' ni luma' pagsabuhan, magt'nggehan saga a'a kamemon ma bowa' lawang tolda sigām. Ang'nda' sigām ma si Musa sampay iya pasōd na ni deyom.

verses.name: Exodus 33:9
verses.text: Makasōd pa'in iya, pareyo' pina'an gabun-Tuhan<note>Gabun-Tuhan maka api-Tuhan: sali' luwa buhawi' patudjak pariyata'.</note> ni dahuan lawang luma' he' bo' paddas maina'an sat'ggol si Yawe maka si Musa magsuli-suli.

verses.name: Exodus 33:10
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga a'a ma gabun-Tuhan pat'nna' ma atag pagsosōran luma' tolda, pabungkal sigām bo' yampa pasujud anumba ni Tuhan, kaniya-kaniya sigām ma bowa' lawang sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 33:11
verses.text: Tiyap-tiyap maina'an si Musa ma deyom tolda, magharap <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka iya magbissala buwat a'a magsuli-suli maka bagayna. Aubus pa'in, ya kabiyaksahan si Musa subay pabalik ni deyom kauman, sagō' tendogna si Yussa', ya anak si Nūn, halam bay paluwas min tolda pagsabuhan e'.  <div eID="gen1567" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1566" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv931"/><div sID="gen1568" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Musa maka Kasahaya'an si Yawe</title> <div sID="gen1569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv931"/> Ah'lling gi' si Musa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yukna, “Tasoho'nu aku amowa saga a'a itu patukad ni lahat e', saguwā' halam aku haka'annu bang sai pasehe'nu ma aku. Yuknu in aku taitungnu bagaynu lissi, maka kasulutan ka ma aku.

verses.name: Exodus 33:13
verses.text: Jari bang ka ka'amuhan du ma aku, ndū', pandu'in aku ma pasal kamaksurannu supaya aku makata'u ma ka'a sampay makasulut na pa'in ma ka'a. Entomun isab bangsa itu sabab suku'nu asal.”  <div eID="gen1569" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv932"/><div sID="gen1570" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv932"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, “Sehe'anta du ka, maka buwananta ka kasannangan atay.”  <div eID="gen1570" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv933"/><div sID="gen1571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv933"/> Yuk si Musa, “Ya Tuhanku, bang kami mbal sehe'annu to'ongan, ahāp lagi' kami mbal palanjalnu min jadjahan itu-i.

verses.name: Exodus 33:16
verses.text: Sabab bang kami siya-siyanu mbal kinata'uwan e' sai-na in ka'a kasulutan ma aku maka ma bangsa suku'nu. Bang kami mbal sehe'annu, halam aniya' pagbidda'an kami maka palbangsahan kasehe' ma sakalibut dunya itu.”  <div eID="gen1571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv934"/><div sID="gen1572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv934"/> Sakali anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa, yukna, “Dūlanku ya pangamu'nu ilu sabab kasulutan aku ma ka'a, maka kata'uwanku ōnnu.”  <div eID="gen1572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv935"/><div sID="gen1573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv935"/> Na, aniya' gi' pangamu' si Musa ma Tuhan, yukna, “Bang pa'in aku pa'nda'annu sahayanu.”  <div eID="gen1573" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv936"/><div sID="gen1574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv936"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Aho', palamanku kahāpanku kamemon ma matahannu. Maka sabbutku isab ōnku ma pakalehannu, in aku si Yawe Tuhan-asal-Tuhan. Aku ya tag-baya'an bang sai ya pinat'kkahan lasaku maka bang sai kina'ase'an.

verses.name: Exodus 33:20
verses.text: Malaingkan,” yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “mbal ka makajari ang'nda' ma baihu'ku. Sabab amatay sadja saga manusiya' bang maka'nda' ma aku.  <div eID="gen1574" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv937"/><div sID="gen1575" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv937"/> “Na,” yukna, “aniya' batu lakit pan'nggehannu ilu, asekot-sekot ni aku.

verses.name: Exodus 33:22
verses.text: Manjari bang palabay sahayaku ma matahannu, pasindungta ka ma deyom songab batu itu. Tampananta ka maka tanganku hinabuku palabay min ka'a.

verses.name: Exodus 33:23
verses.text: Makalabay pa'in, la'ananku tanganku supaya ka maka'nda' bukutku. Sagō' in baihu'ku mbal makajari ni'nda'.”  <div eID="gen1575" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.33"/> <div eID="gen1568" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv938"/><div sID="gen1576" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Papan Batu Lakit Karuwana</title> <div sID="gen1577" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv938"/> Manjari angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa yukna, “Sapsapin batu amasagi' duwa hekana, daluwa maka bay dahū. Sulatku mailu saga panoho'an bay ma batu tagna', ya bay lopotnu.

verses.name: Exodus 34:2
verses.text: Pasakap ka salung subu bo' ka patukad ni Būd Turusina itu. Pagtukadnu ni pussuk būd, an'ngge ka ma matahanku.

verses.name: Exodus 34:3
verses.text: Subay halam aniya' parongan ma ka'a. Minsan maingga-maingga ma sakalingkal būd itu, subay halam aniya' manusiya' ta'nda', luwal ka'a. Minsan hayop, bili-bili ka atawa sapi', subay halam aniya' magkakan ma deyo'an būd ilu.”  <div eID="gen1577" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv939"/><div sID="gen1578" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv939"/> Sakali sinapsapan e' si Musa duwa batu amasagi', daluwa maka bay tagna'. Pagdai'llaw pa'in, patukad iya ni Būd Turusina' maka e'na amowa duwa batu he'. Hatina bineya' e'na bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:5
verses.text: Sakali patulun si Yawe min deyom gabun bo' an'ngge ma atag si Musa. Tapata'u isab e' Tuhan ōnna si Yawe ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan.

verses.name: Exodus 34:6
verses.text: Magsuwala iya hinabuna palabay min alopan si Musa. Yukna, “Aku si Yawe ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan. Patitabangun asal aku maka patiase'un. Alallay aku angastol, al'kkas aku amaluwas lasaku, lasa mbal magkapinda.

verses.name: Exodus 34:7
verses.text: Taptap lasaku ma saga manusiya' sampay ni kaibuhan pangkat. Ampunku kasā'an maka karusahan sigām. Ampunku minsan sigām anagga' sara'. Saguwā' bang a'a makarusa, mbal to'ongan pasagaranku. Papole'ku karusahanna ni anak-mpuna, sampay ni mpuna tu'ut, sampay ta'abut mpat pangkat.”  <div eID="gen1578" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv940"/><div sID="gen1579" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv940"/> Na pagkale si Musa ma bissala Tuhan itu, magtūy iya pasujud anumba.

verses.name: Exodus 34:9
verses.text: Yukna, “O Panghū'ku, bang ka kasulutan sab'nnal-b'nnal ma aku, ndū' Tuhan, bang pa'in ka pagapi' ma kami. Minsan atuwas kōk saga bangsaku itu, ampunun pa'in kala'atan maka karusahan kami. Taima'un kami ati hinangun kami saga a'a suku'nu.”  <div eID="gen1579" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv941"/><div sID="gen1580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv941"/> Angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Nda'un, paniya'ku paljanji'anku ma ka'a pabīng. Angahinang aku saga hinang makainu-inu ma pang'nda'an saga a'a bangsanu Isra'il kamemon. Halam to'ongan aniya' bay makahinang buwattē', minsan ma ai lahat, minsan ma ai bangsa. Song ta'nda' hinangku makatāw-tāw e' saga a'a ya pat'nna' ma sakalibutnu, ati tasayu e' sigām bang buwattingga panabangku ma ka'a.

verses.name: Exodus 34:11
verses.text: Beya'un saga sara' panoho'an ya pat'nna'anku ka'am llaw itu. Dūyku min dahuannu saga bangsa Amor, bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus.

verses.name: Exodus 34:12
verses.text: Amay-amay, da'a kam magkahāp maka saga bangsa ya asal maglahat ma lahat ya song papehē'anbi ilu. Tantu kam pinalabayan kasasatan e' sigām, sapantun jallat ma tape'bi.

verses.name: Exodus 34:13
verses.text: Paka'atunbi saga tampat ya pagkulbanan sigām. Lopotunbi saga batu paosol ya pagsusumbahan sigām. Puwarunbi isab saga hāg pangilāhan si Asera, ya tuhan sigām d'nda.

verses.name: Exodus 34:14
verses.text: Wajib kam da'a magta'at ma pagtuhanan saddī min aku, sabab si Yawe aku, ya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan. Mbal to'ongan aku bilahi aniya' pagtuhananbi saddī min aku.  <div eID="gen1580" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv942"/><div sID="gen1581" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv942"/> “Amay-amay, da'a kam amiha magkahāp maka saga bangsa ya asal maglahat ma lahat song papehē'anbi ilu. Sabab kalna', bang kam ganta' magkahāp maka sigām, tantu kam pinogos e' sigām ang'bba min aku bo' magta'at ni saga pagtuhanan sigām. Tabowa kam magsalu isab maka sigām ati kakanbi ba'anan susumbali'an bay pangungsud ni pagtuhanan sigām e'.

verses.name: Exodus 34:16
verses.text: Lāgi bang aniya' saga anak sigām budjang tapene'bi pamah'nda ma ka'anakanbi l'lla, tantu sigām kapitnahan e' saga d'nda he' subay palamud ana'at ni saga pagtuhanan sigām.”  <div eID="gen1581" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv943"/><div sID="gen1582" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv943"/> Amalman Tuhan, yukna, “Wajib kam da'a magsasal tumbaga nihinang ta'u-ta'u pagtuhanan.”  <div eID="gen1582" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv944"/><div sID="gen1583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv944"/> “Wajib kam maghinang Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna sakahaba' tahun bang ta'abut bulananna. Subay pitumbahangi ya t'ggolbi magkakan tinapay halam bay pinasuligan, buwat bay panoho'anku ma ka'am. Hinangunbi ma bulan Abib, ya na bulan bay kapaluwasbi min lahat Misil.  <div eID="gen1583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv945"/><div sID="gen1584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv945"/> “Pamasuku'unbi ma aku kamemon saga anakbi kasiyakahan l'lla, beya' isab saga hayop l'lla ya dahū nianakan, ai na ka bili-bili maka kambing, ai na ka sapi'.

verses.name: Exodus 34:20
verses.text: Sagō' mbal taluwa' kinulban bang kura'. Bang aniya' kura' anganak kamint'ddana, in anak kura' inān subay nil'kkat, hatina subay aniya' dakayu' anak bili-bili atawa kambing sinumbali' ganti'na. Bang saupama mbal nil'kkat, na subay pinōng buli'-k'llongna sabab kura' iya. Saga anakbi l'lla kasiyakahan isab, subay nil'kkat maka susumbali'an pagkulbanbi ni Tuhan. Amay-amay isab, bang kam angarap ni aku sumiyan-sumiyan, subay kam amowa tutukbalan.  <div eID="gen1584" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv946"/><div sID="gen1585" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv946"/> “Makajari kam maghinang atawa magusaha ma deyom nnom llaw, sagō' subay kam pahali maghinang ma llaw kapitu'na. Minsan ma waktu pagararu atawa waktu pagani, subay kam pahali ma llaw kapitu'.  <div eID="gen1585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv947"/><div sID="gen1586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv947"/> “Hinangunbi Paghinang Kapitu'an<note>Aheka ōn pangōn bangsa Isra'il ma dakayu' paghinang itu: Hinang Kapitu'an maka Hinang Anihan Dahū, maka kaōnan isab Paghinang Limampū' sabab limampū' llaw t'ggolna min bay Hinang Paglakad.</note> ma waktu paganibi saga buwa' tirigu. Hinangunbi Paghinang Anihan Damuli ma song pa'in waktu paghaggut.<note>Hinang Anihan Damuli itu kaōnan isab Hinang Panggung, sabab taentom e' saga bangsa Isra'il waktu bay kapagluma' sigām ma deyom kapanggungan ma lahat paslangan lagi'.</note>  <div eID="gen1586" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv948"/><div sID="gen1587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv948"/> “Manjari t'llu waktu ma deyom dantahun ya pagtipun kamemon saga kal'llahanbi ma matahan si Yawe, ya pagpanghū'an bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Exodus 34:24
verses.text: Da'a kabimbanginbi saga tana'bi bang kam alikut magtipun ni aku ya Tuhanbi. Halam sai-sai anganapsuhan tana'bi sabab paluwasku min dahuanbi saga bangsa Amor, bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Pirissi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jibus. Paluhaku isab lahat ya pat'nna'anbi.  <div eID="gen1587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv949"/><div sID="gen1588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv949"/> “Na bang kam anumbali' hayop pagkulbanbi ni aku, da'a papagbeya'un laha'na maka tinapay halam pinasuligan. Bang kam maghinang Hinang Paglakad, da'a kapininbi isi susumbali'an sampay ni kasalungan.  <div eID="gen1588" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv950"/><div sID="gen1589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv950"/> “Bang kam anagna' magani tinanom atawa magpusu' buwa' kayu, pene'unbi ya ahāp to'ongan bo' bowahunbi ni Luma' pangarapanbi ni si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. <div eID="gen1589" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1590" type="paragraph"/> “Bang aniya' anak kambing b'llabi, da'a paglamurunbi maka gatas ina'na.”  <div eID="gen1590" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv951"/><div sID="gen1591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv951"/> Pagubus, ah'lling <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa, yukna, “Sulatun saga kabtangan itu sabab kataddangan ko' itu ma paljanji'antam.”

verses.name: Exodus 34:28
verses.text: Jari mpatpū' bahangi ya panimpus si Musa maina'an ma atag <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, maka halam aniya' bay takakanna atawa tainumna t'ggolna bay maina'an. Tasulat e'na ma duwa papagan batu saga kabtangan paljanji'an, hatina Sara' Panoho'an sangpū' hekana.  <div eID="gen1591" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1576" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv952"/><div sID="gen1592" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sahaya ma Pamaihu'an si Musa</title> <div sID="gen1593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv952"/> Na, palūd si Musa min Būd Turusina' amowa duwa papan batu ya panulatan paljanji'an Tuhan maka bangsa Isra'il. Paglūd na pa'in, halam tasayu e' si Musa in baihu'na anahaya asal ma sabab kapagsuli-sulina maka <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:30
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Harun maka kamemon saga a'a Isra'il ma sahaya baihu' si Musa, na tināw sigām pasekot ni iya.

verses.name: Exodus 34:31
verses.text: Malaingkan nilinganan e' si Musa disi Harun maka kamemon saga pagbebeya'an bangsa Isra'il. Sinō' sigām pabalik ni atagna bo' sigām bissalahanna.

verses.name: Exodus 34:32
verses.text: Pagubus, patipun ni si Musa saga a'a Isra'il kamemon ati pinasampay e'na ma sigām saga sara' kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya ma diyata' Būd Turusina'.  <div eID="gen1593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv953"/><div sID="gen1594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv953"/> Aubus pa'in pamissala si Musa ma sigām, tinambunan e'na baihu'na bo' mbal ta'nda' sahayana.

verses.name: Exodus 34:34
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' waktuna pasōd ni haddarat si Yawe magsuli-suli maka iya, nila'anan e'na tambunna he' sampay iya makaluwas pabīng. Pagluwas pa'in, pinalatun e'na ma saga bangsa Isra'il ai-ai bay panoho'an Tuhan ma iya.

verses.name: Exodus 34:35
verses.text: Ta'nda' magtūy e' sigām baihu'na anahaya, angkan tinambunan baihu'na pabīng, sampay ni waktu kapagsuli-sulina maka <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pabalik.  <div eID="gen1594" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.34"/> <div eID="gen1592" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv954"/><div sID="gen1595" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hatulan Pasal Llaw Mulliya</title> <div sID="gen1596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv954"/> Manjari itu, pinalinganan e' si Musa kamemon saga bangsa Isra'il, sinō' patipun ma iya. Yukna ma sigām, “Ka'am saga bangsa Isra'il, ya itu saga hatulan panoho'an ka'am e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:2
verses.text: Nnom llaw ya pamihabi ka'lluman, sagō' bang ta'abut llaw kapitu'na, ya na llaw mulliya, llaw paghali pamaheyabi ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Sasuku maghinang ai-ai ma llaw itu subay pinapatay.

verses.name: Exodus 35:3
verses.text: Da'a kam minsan magparokot api ma deyom luma'bi ma Llaw Kapitu'.”  <div eID="gen1596" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1595" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv955"/><div sID="gen1597" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ai-ai Pangahinang Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv955"/> Ah'lling si Musa ma saga jama'a bangsa Isra'il kamemon, yukna, “Buwattitu panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma ka'am,

verses.name: Exodus 35:5
verses.text: sinō' kam amowa huhulmatan ni iya luwas min kaniya'bi. Bang isab tapangahilasbi, bowahunbi ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ba'anan saga ai-ai ya tinutat itu: bulawan, pilak maka tumbaga,

verses.name: Exodus 35:6
verses.text: salban walna' bilu, taluk maka keyat, kakana' pote' ahāp hinanganna, bulbul kambing pangahinang kakana',

verses.name: Exodus 35:7
verses.text: kuwit bili-bili l'lla nianjibihan keyat, maka kuwit duyung isab. Bowahunbi kayu akasya,

verses.name: Exodus 35:8
verses.text: ns'llan buwa' jaitun ma palita'an, saga pamapā pamahamut ns'llan ya pangangg'llal imam, maka ginisan pamapā pamahamut kamanyan.

verses.name: Exodus 35:9
verses.text: Bowahunbi isab ginisan palmata pamalingkat epod (lampik-juba) maka puyu'-daggaha ya pinakay e' imam alanga.”  <div eID="gen1598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv956"/><div sID="gen1599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv956"/> Yuk si Musa isab, “Sasuku kam taga-kapandayan maghinang, pi'itu kam. Hinangunbi kamemon ya pamahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma kitam.

verses.name: Exodus 35:11
verses.text: Hinangunbi Luma' Pangarapanbi ma iya, apanyap maka toldana sampay turungna katapusan, ba'anan saga kakansingna, papagan dindingna, batang-batangna, hāgna maka durukanna isab.

verses.name: Exodus 35:12
verses.text: Hinangunbi Ba'ul Paljanji'an, beya' isab tanggunganna, maka turungna ya Pagtaubatan, maka kultina pangalikus.

verses.name: Exodus 35:13
verses.text: Hinangunbi lamisahan pamat'nna'an Tinapay Hadarat, jukup maka tanggunganna, maka saga kapanyapanna,

verses.name: Exodus 35:14
verses.text: palita'an pitu' sumbuhanna ya pamasawa deyom Luma', beya' isab kapanyapanna maka ns'llan pamakeyat iya.

verses.name: Exodus 35:15
verses.text: Hinangunbi lamisahan pagtugtugan kamanyan maka tanggunganna, ns'llan sussi pangangg'llal imam, kamanyan ahamut, maka kultina panambol lawang ya pagsosōran ni Luma' Pangarapan.

verses.name: Exodus 35:16
verses.text: Hinangunbi isab lapohan pagtunu'an susumbali'an maka pangayakanna tumbaga, beya' isab tanggunganna maka saga kapanyapanna kamemon, garul pagailan nihinang min tumbaga sampay patinggilan ya pamat'nna'an iya.

verses.name: Exodus 35:17
verses.text: Hinangunbi saga kultina panasak halaman Luma', jukup maka saga hāg pangahāg sasak maka ba'anan durukan, beya' isab kultina ya panambol pagsosōran ni halaman e'.

verses.name: Exodus 35:18
verses.text: Hinangunbi bale pangengkotan tolda ya panurung Luma' Pangarapan sampay kakultinahan ya panasak halaman, maka ba'anan lubidna.

verses.name: Exodus 35:19
verses.text: Pagubus, t'nnununbi s'mmek pan'mmek saga imam ma waktu kapaghinang sigām ma Luma' Sussi, hatina saga s'mmek sussi ya pamakay si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla hinabu sigām magimam ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan.”  <div eID="gen1599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv957"/><div sID="gen1600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv957"/> Pagubus pamissala si Musa inān, magla'anan na min matahanna saga a'a Isra'il kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 35:21
verses.text: Pabīng isab pina'an saga a'a kamemon ya taga-baya' anukbal kaniya' sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, lilla' isab min deyom atay sigām. Binowa e' sigām ba'anan ai-ai pangahinang Tolda Pagsasabuhan,<note>Tolda Pagsasabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya', hatina Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan. Tu'ud duwa ōnna.</note> maka ai-ai pangahinang s'mmek ya pan'mmek imam.

verses.name: Exodus 35:22
verses.text: Jari pina'an saga l'lla maka d'nda kamemon sasuku taga-baya' amuwan, binowa e' sigām kaginisan saga pamulawan, buwat saga kait, aretes, singsing, gallang maka palmata, bo' niangkat e' sigām pangahulmat ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:23
verses.text: Saga a'a isab taga-salban walna' bilu, taluk maka keyat, atawa kakana' ahāp hinanganna, atawa bulbul kambing, atawa kuwit kambing l'lla bay nianjibihan keyat, atawa kuwit duyung, bay amowa saga palsuku'an sigām pina'an.

verses.name: Exodus 35:24
verses.text: Saga a'a isab taga-pilak atawa tumbaga aponod, bay amowa alta' sigām e' panukbal sigām ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ya du amowa saga a'a taga-kayu akasya ya kinagunahan ma luma' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1600" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv958"/><div sID="gen1601" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv958"/> Kamemon saga kar'ndahan taga-pangita'u isab bay aminsal<note>Aminsal: hatina angahinang lubid.</note> salban, ati binowa e' sigām kakana' ahāp ya bay nihinang e' sigām min salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.

verses.name: Exodus 35:26
verses.text: Sasuku sigām taga-pangita'u, ya bilahi isab palamud, bay aminsal salban min bulbul kambing.

verses.name: Exodus 35:27
verses.text: Saga a'a pagbebeya'an isab bay amowa palmata onek maka palmata indaginis ya pinat'nna' ma epod maka ma puyu'-daggaha ya pan'mmek imam alanga.

verses.name: Exodus 35:28
verses.text: Binowa isab e' sigām ns'llan jaitun ya kagunahan pamakeyat palita'an ma deyom Luma', maka pangangg'llal imam. Binowa isab pamapā pangalamud ma ns'llan e', maka pamahamut kamanyan.

verses.name: Exodus 35:29
verses.text: Jari sai-sai taga-baya' ma kaluha'an bangsa Isra'il, l'lla ka atawa d'nda, bay amowa huhulmatan panukbal sigām ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, hilas min deyom pangatayan. Tapamuwan e' sigām ai-ai ya kinagunahan ma saga hinang bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1601" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1597" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv959"/><div sID="gen1602" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Besalel maka si Oholeyab</title> <div sID="gen1603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv959"/> Na amissala si Musa ma saga bangsa Isra'il, yukna, “Pata'u kam. Tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> si Besalel anak si Uri ya anak si Hūr, min bangsa Yuda.

verses.name: Exodus 35:31
verses.text: Aniya' pangita'u maka akkal maka kapandayan bay pamatulun e' Tuhan ma iya supaya iya makahinang ai-ai ahāp maka alingkat.

verses.name: Exodus 35:32
verses.text: Ata'u iya angangguhit suntu'an ma ai-ai tahinang min bulawan atawa min pilak atawa min tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 35:33
verses.text: Ata'u iya anganggaugari' ginisan palmata bo' yampa pasangonna ma kait bulawan. Ata'u isab angukil kayu, maka ata'u angahinang kapanyapan indaginis bo' ahāp ninda'.

verses.name: Exodus 35:34
verses.text: Aniya' akkal pamuwan e' Tuhan ma iya maka ma si Oholeyab anak si Ahisamak min bangsa Dān, supaya sigām makapandu' ma saga a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Exodus 35:35
verses.text: Jari katulunan sigām kapandayan angkan ata'u maghinang kaginisan ai-ai, ata'u isab magguhit suntu'an. Ata'u isab sigām magbuldahan kakana' pote' maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat, ata'u isab angahinang kakana' landu' ahāp isina. Apanday kamemon saga a'a itu maghinang ai-ai ya kahinangan tangan, alalom isab pikilan sigām magguhit suntu'an kaginisan.”  <div eID="gen1603" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.35"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:1
verses.text: “Manjari niamay-amayan si Besalel maka si Oholeyab sampay saga a'a kamemon ya kabuwanan akkal maka kapandayan e' si <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe supaya sigām makahinang Luma' Sussi maka ba'anan kapanyapanna. Sinō' sigām ameya' to'ongan ma bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigām.”  <div eID="gen1604" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv960"/><div sID="gen1605" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv960"/> Pagubus, pinalinganan na e' si Musa si Besalel maka si Oholeyab maka saga a'a kamemon ya kabuwanan kapandayan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, beya' isab sasuku taga-kōg maka baya'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:3
verses.text: Tasambut he' sigām min si Musa ba'anan saga huhulmatan bay tatukbal e' saga a'a Isra'il pamapagdayaw maka pamapanyap ma Luma' Pangarapan e'. Aniya' na pa'in saga huhulmatan pinagbowa e' saga a'a Isra'il inān kahaba' subu,

verses.name: Exodus 36:4
verses.text: angkan saga a'a ata'u maghinang bay ang'bba min hinang sigām

verses.name: Exodus 36:5
verses.text: bo' pehē' ah'lling ni si Musa. Ya yuk sigām, “Tuwan, maglabi to'ongan ya pinagbowa na pa'in e' saga a'a itu. Sarang na makahinangan kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”  <div eID="gen1605" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv961"/><div sID="gen1606" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv961"/> Jari aniya' panoho'an si Musa bay pinasaplag ma kaluha'an kauman, yukna, “Ka'am kamemon d'nda maka l'lla, sinō' pahali amowa saga huhulmatan paghinangta Luma' Sussi.” Minnē' sigām tabowa pahali ang'nde'an ba'anan bubuwanan sigām labi-manglabi.

verses.name: Exodus 36:7
verses.text: Sabab sarang na, maka'abut pangahinang Luma' Pangarapan sampay kamemon kapanyapanna.  <div eID="gen1606" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1602" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv962"/><div sID="gen1607" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangahinang Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv962"/> Manjari tahinang Luma' Pangarapan he' saga maghihinang, sasuku sigām alalom pikilanna. Tahinang e' sigām sangpū' sugpat kultina min kakana' ahāp isina pinaglamuran salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Aniya' isab sali' luwa mala'ikat pikpikan binulda pina'an he' saga a'a apanday magbubulda.

verses.name: Exodus 36:9
verses.text: In ba'anan sugpat kultina itu dasali' sukuranna kamemon, pitund'ppa taha'na maka dand'ppa lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 36:10
verses.text: Lima sugpat kultina bay tinahi' e' sigām pinagbihing-bihing, damikiyanna isab lima hekana takapin, manjari duwa kultina ataha' na.

verses.name: Exodus 36:11
verses.text: Na aniya' tainga-tainga nihinang min kakana' bilu tinahi' pehē' ni tōng kultina ataha' inān karuwa, hatina lima-limampū' heka tainga-tainga tahinang maganggop-anggop.

verses.name: Exodus 36:12
verses.text: Na aniya' tainga-tainga nihinang min kakana' bilu tinahi' pehē' ni tōng kultina ataha' inān karuwa, hatina lima-limampū' heka tainga-tainga tahinang maganggop-anggop.

verses.name: Exodus 36:13
verses.text: Aniya' isab kakansing bulawan limampū' hekana tahinang pamarakayu' duwa kultina inān bo' supaya arakayu' deyom Luma' Pangarapan.  <div eID="gen1608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv963"/><div sID="gen1609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv963"/> Pagubus, aniya' kultina bay nihinang e' saga a'a inān min bulbul kambing, sangpū' maka dda sugpatna pangalapis kultina deyom.

verses.name: Exodus 36:15
verses.text: Daheya du saga sangpū' maka dda sugpat kultina damuli itu, taha'na pitund'ppa maka tonga', lambuna dand'ppa.

verses.name: Exodus 36:16
verses.text: Lima sugpatna bay tinahi' pinagbihing-bihing bo' tahinang dakayu' kultina ataha', damikiyanna isab nnom heka sugpatna takapin.

verses.name: Exodus 36:17
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' tainga-tainga kakana' nihinang e' sigām ma tōng kultina karuwa, lima-limampū' hekana,

verses.name: Exodus 36:18
verses.text: limampū' isab kakansing tumbaga pamaralos kultina bulbul kambing e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:19
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' duwa ginis turung tahinang e' saga a'a inān panurung kamemonna. Dakayu' turung inān bay tahinang min kuwit bili-bili l'lla nianjibihan keyat, dakayu' isab tahinang min kuwit duyung, ya na turung katapusan.  <div eID="gen1609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv964"/><div sID="gen1610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv964"/> Aniya' isab saga papagan tahinang e' sigām min kayu akasya pamarindingan Luma' Pangarapan e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:21
verses.text: Duwand'ppa maka tonga' ya langkawna, t'llu h'kka lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 36:22
verses.text: Tahinang isab lagsak duwa hekana patuwa' min deyo'anna. Buwattē' ya pangahinang saga papagan dinding kamemon,

verses.name: Exodus 36:23
verses.text: duwampū' hekana min bihing luma' tampal ni satan, duwampū' isab min bihingna tampal ni uttala'. Aniya' isab saga durukan dī pilak tasasal e' saga a'a maghihinang, mpatpū' hekana, hatina duwa durukan ma dakayu' papagan bo' aniya' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:24
verses.text: duwampū' hekana min bihing luma' tampal ni satan, duwampū' isab min bihingna tampal ni uttala'. Aniya' isab saga durukan dī pilak tasasal e' saga a'a maghihinang, mpatpū' hekana, hatina duwa durukan ma dakayu' papagan bo' aniya' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:25
verses.text: duwampū' hekana min bihing luma' tampal ni satan, duwampū' isab min bihingna tampal ni uttala'. Aniya' isab saga durukan dī pilak tasasal e' saga a'a maghihinang, mpatpū' hekana, hatina duwa durukan ma dakayu' papagan bo' aniya' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:26
verses.text: duwampū' hekana min bihing luma' tampal ni satan, duwampū' isab min bihingna tampal ni uttala'. Aniya' isab saga durukan dī pilak tasasal e' saga a'a maghihinang, mpatpū' hekana, hatina duwa durukan ma dakayu' papagan bo' aniya' pamatukan lagsak e'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:27
verses.text: Tahinang isab saga papagan nnom hekana pamarindingan kōkan luma' (tampal ni s'ddopan),

verses.name: Exodus 36:28
verses.text: maka duwa hekana isab ma duguna karuwa.

verses.name: Exodus 36:29
verses.text: In duwa heka papagan itu bay pinapagtapil min deyo' sampay pariyata', maka diyata' bay pinasulug ni dakayu' gallang bo' mbal magpuklas.

verses.name: Exodus 36:30
verses.text: Manjari walu' heka papagan ya tahinang pamarindingan kōkan luma', sangpū' maka nnom isab durukan tahinang min dī pilak.  <div eID="gen1610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv965"/><div sID="gen1611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv965"/> Aniya' isab saga batang-batang pamahogot dinding bay tahinang e' saga a'a maghihinang e', lima-lima hekana ma bihing luma' dakayu' maka dakayu', lima hekana isab ma kōkan (tampal ni s'ddopan).

verses.name: Exodus 36:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv965"/><div sID="gen1611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv965"/> Aniya' isab saga batang-batang pamahogot dinding bay tahinang e' saga a'a maghihinang e', lima-lima hekana ma bihing luma' dakayu' maka dakayu', lima hekana isab ma kōkan (tampal ni s'ddopan).

verses.name: Exodus 36:33
verses.text: Ya batang-batang ma t'ngnga' dinding bay pina'abut e' sigām min tōng dakayu' tudju ni tōng dakayu'.

verses.name: Exodus 36:34
verses.text: Bay pinutusan bulawan saga papagan dinding itu, beya' isab batang-batangna. Maka aniya' isab saga gallang bulawan tahinang e' sigām pamasulugan ba'anan batang-batang e'.  <div eID="gen1611" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv966"/><div sID="gen1612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv966"/> Pagubus, aniya' kultina tahinang pangalikus deyom Luma' Pangarapan, tampal ni kōkan. Tahinang e' sigām min kakana' landu' ahāp isina, pinaglamuran isab salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Aniya' isab sali' luwa mala'ikat pikpikan binulda pina'an he' a'a apanday magbubulda.  <div eID="gen1612" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv967"/><div sID="gen1613" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv967"/> Aniya' saga hāg akasya mpat hekana bay tahinang e' saga a'a maghihinang e', pinutus isab maka bulawan. Aniya' isab saga sasabit bulawan tasasal e' sigām panagnatan kultina, maka durukan hāg tasasal min pilak aponod.

verses.name: Exodus 36:37
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' kultina tahinang e' sigām panambol lawang pagsosōran ni Luma'. Kakana' ahāp isina ya pangahinang kultina itu, binulda maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat e' a'a magbubulda.

verses.name: Exodus 36:38
verses.text: Tahinang isab e' sigām saga hāg lima hekana, jukup maka sasabit. Kōk hāg itu bay pinutus maka bulawan, batangna bay nileboran isab maka bulawan. Aniya' isab durukan tumbaga tahinang e' sigām pamat'nggehan saga hāg.  <div eID="gen1613" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.36"/> <div eID="gen1607" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv968"/><div sID="gen1614" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ba'ul Paljanji'an</title> <div sID="gen1615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv968"/> Na, makahinang ba'ul si Besalel min kayu akasya, lima h'kka taha'na, t'llu h'kka lambuna, t'llu h'kka isab langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 37:2
verses.text: Bay pinutus deyom-luwasanna maka bulawan porol, pinalingkat isab kīdna maka gipis bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:3
verses.text: Nihinang e'na mpat gallang bulawan pinatli' pehē' ni tape' ba'ul, duwa gallang min bihing ba'ul dambila', duwa isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 37:4
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' tanggungan nihinang e' si Besalel min kayu akasya, pinutus isab maka bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:5
verses.text: Pinasulug magtūy ni gallang ya ma bihing ba'ul bo' aniya' pananggungan.  <div eID="gen1615" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv969"/><div sID="gen1616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv969"/> Tahinang isab e' si Besalel turung ba'ul, ya pinagōnan Turung Pagtaubatan. Tasasal e'na min bulawan porol, lima h'kka taha'na, t'llu h'kka lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 37:7
verses.text: Pagubus, tasasal e'na duwa mala'ikat pikpikan, dakayu' min dantōng turung ba'ul, dakayu' isab min dantōng. Langkus asal bulawan mala'ikat maka bulawan turung, da-sasalan du.

verses.name: Exodus 37:8
verses.text: Pagubus, tasasal e'na duwa mala'ikat pikpikan, dakayu' min dantōng turung ba'ul, dakayu' isab min dantōng. Langkus asal bulawan mala'ikat maka bulawan turung, da-sasalan du.

verses.name: Exodus 37:9
