verses.text: Pab'llat pariyata' pikpik mala'ikat itu makalandungan turung ba'ul. Magharap duwa mala'ikat e', maka e' sigām angandomolan turung.  <div eID="gen1616" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1614" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv970"/><div sID="gen1617" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lamisahan Pamat'nna'an Tinapay Hadarat</title> <div sID="gen1618" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv970"/> Na, bay makahinang lamisahan disi Besalel min kayu akasya, mpat h'kka taha'na, duwa h'kka lambuna, t'llu h'kka isab langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 37:11
verses.text: Taputus e' sigām maka bulawan porol, maka pinalingkat mpat kīdna maka gipis bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:12
verses.text: Aniya' isab paga-paga saga da'mpāt-tangan lambuna tahinang e' sigām ma sakalibut lamisahan e', pinalingkat isab maka gipis bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:13
verses.text: Pagubus, makahinang sigām saga gallang mpat hekana bo' pinatli' pehē' ni mpat duguna, min diyata' saga tape'.

verses.name: Exodus 37:14
verses.text: Gallang itu bay pinasekot ni paga-paga bo' aniya' pamasulugan tanggungan bang subay nihangkut.

verses.name: Exodus 37:15
verses.text: Tahinang isab saga tanggungan min kayu akasya taputus maka bulawan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:16
verses.text: Manjari tahinang na isab e' disi Besalel saga kapanyapan lamisahan buwat saga lai, saga pinggan, maka saga pangisihan binu-anggul ya binu'usan pangahulmat Tuhan. Ba'anan saga kapanyapan itu bay nihinang min bulawan porol.  <div eID="gen1618" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1617" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv971"/><div sID="gen1619" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palita'an Bulawan</title> <div sID="gen1620" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv971"/> Na, tahinang palita'an he' disi Besalel, sinasal min bulawan porol. Dalos asal hinanganna min buli'na sampay ni batangna, beya' isab saga pinggan-pingganna, ya pinagukilan sali' luwa sumping.

verses.name: Exodus 37:18
verses.text: In batang palita'an itu magsanga nnom, t'llu min dambila' batang, t'llu isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 37:19
verses.text: Saga sanga itu bay kahinangan pinggan-pinggan sali' luwa sumping almon<note>Alingkat sumping almon itu, maka ahāp kinakan bigi-buwa'na.</note> t'llu hekana ma saga sanga ka'nnom pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Exodus 37:20
verses.text: Damikiyanna in baran palita'an, bay kahinangan pinggan-pinggan isab sali' luwa sumping almon, mpat hekana,

verses.name: Exodus 37:21
verses.text: dakayu' min deyo' saga sanga panagna'an, dakayu' min deyo' saga sanga t'ngnga'an, dakayu' isab min deyo' sanga ma diyata'an, jari nnom sangana.

verses.name: Exodus 37:22
verses.text: Jari langkus hinanganna kamemon, baran palita'an maka ba'anan sumping-sumpingna maka saga sangana. Bulawan porol ya pangahinang iya.  <div eID="gen1620" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv972"/><div sID="gen1621" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv972"/> Tahinang isab e' disi Besalel saga palita'an maka pangisihan ns'llan pitu' hekana, jukup maka saga sisipit pamahāp sumbuhan maka saga talam-talamna. Bulawan porol ya pangahinang.

verses.name: Exodus 37:24
verses.text: Manjari t'llumpū' maka mpat kilu ya buhat bulawan bay pangahinang palita'an maka kamemon kapanyapanna inān.  <div eID="gen1621" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1619" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv973"/><div sID="gen1622" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagtugtugan Kamanyan</title> <div sID="gen1623" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv973"/> Pasunu', aniya' lamisahan amasagi' tahinang e' sigām min kayu akasya, pagtugtugan kamanyan. Lambuna maka taha'na duwa h'kka sali'-sali', langkawna mpat h'kka. Aniya' pussuk-pussuk sali' luwa tanduk bay tahinang e' sigām ma duguna, dalos asal kayuna maka kayu bay pangahinangan baran lamisahan.

verses.name: Exodus 37:26
verses.text: Diyata' lamisahan maka saga kīdna, sampay isab saga pussuk-pussukna, bay pinutus maka bulawan porol. Aniya' isab gipis bulawan bay pinehē' ni kakīran lamisahan pamahāp luwana.

verses.name: Exodus 37:27
verses.text: Bay sigām makahinang gallang bulawan pamasulugan tanggungan. Pinasangon pehē' ni kīd lamisahan min deyo'an gipis e', dakayu' min dambila', dakayu' isab min dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 37:28
verses.text: Makahinang sigām saga tanggungan isab min kayu akasya pinutus maka bulawan.  <div eID="gen1623" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv974"/><div sID="gen1624" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv974"/> Puwas e', bay sigām makahinang ns'llan landu' asussi ya pamehed ai-ai pinasuku' ma Tuhan, maka kamanyan ahamut. Bineya' e' sigām kapandayan saga a'a ata'u angahinang pahamut.  <div eID="gen1624" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.37"/> <div eID="gen1622" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv975"/><div sID="gen1625" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapohan Pagtunu'an Kulban</title> <div sID="gen1626" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv975"/> Pagubus, aniya' lapohan pagtunu'an kulban tahinang e' disi Besalel min kayu akasya. Magpasagi' lambuna maka taha'na, sangpū' h'kka sali'-sali'. Nnom h'kka langkawna.

verses.name: Exodus 38:2
verses.text: Aniya' saga pussuk-pussuk sali' luwa tanduk bay tahinang ma duguna, dalos asal kayuna maka kayu ya pangahinangan baran lapohan. Jari taputus kamemonna maka dī tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 38:3
verses.text: Tahinang isab min tumbaga ba'anan kapanyapanna, buwat saga undam panaluran abu, saga kakagis, saga garul pangisihan laha' susumbali'an, saga tutugsuk aheya, sampay saga pangisihan baga.

verses.name: Exodus 38:4
verses.text: Aniya' pangayakan abu tahinang e' sigām min tumbaga bo' pinasangon ni deyom lapohan min deyo' paga-pagana, saga ma tonga'an kīdna.

verses.name: Exodus 38:5
verses.text: Tasasal mpat gallang tumbaga pinehē' ni dugu pangayakan ka'mpat,

verses.name: Exodus 38:6
verses.text: maka tahinang isab saga tanggungan min kayu akasya taputus maka tumbaga.

verses.name: Exodus 38:7
verses.text: In tanggungan itu bay pinasulug ni gallang ya ma kīd lapohan karuwambila' bang nihangkut. Lapohan itu bay tahinang min papan, sali' luwa tu'ung halam aniya' turungna.  <div eID="gen1626" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1625" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv976"/><div sID="gen1627" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Garul Pagailan</title> <div sID="gen1628" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv976"/> Pagubus, tahinang e' disi Besalel garul pagailan maka patinggilanna. Ya tapagguna e' sigām saga tumbaga angalinig, ya bay pagsasaminan saga kar'ndahan ya magtatabang ma atag lawang pagsosōran ni Tolda Pagsasabuhan.<note>Ya na Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan.</note>  <div eID="gen1628" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1627" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' kultina ahāp kakana'na tahinang e' sigām panasak halaman e', maka ba'anan hāgna isab panagnatan. Duwa-duwampū' heka hāg min bihingna tampal ni uttala' maka ni satan, sangpū' isab min tōngna tampal ni s'ddopan. Kamemon hāg itu bay nihinangan durukan min dī tumbaga maka sasabit pilak isab panagnatan kultina. In baran hāg isab bay nileboran pilak. Aniya' palabayan pagsōd-luwasan a'a tahinang ma tōng halaman tampal ni sobangan, maka aniya' kultina min karuwambila' lalabayan itu t'llu-t'llun d'ppa maka tonga' taha'na. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><div sID="gen1629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/> Pasunu', tahinang e' sigām halaman ma Luma' Pangarapan e', taha'na duwampū' maka limand'ppa, luhana sangpū' maka duwand'ppa maka tonga'. Aniya' kultina ahāp kakana'na tahinang e' sigām panasak halaman e', maka ba'anan hāgna isab panagnatan. Duwa-duwampū' heka hāg min bihingna tampal ni uttala' maka ni satan, sangpū' isab min tōngna tampal ni s'ddopan. Kamemon hāg itu bay nihinangan durukan min dī tumbaga maka sasabit pilak isab panagnatan kultina. In baran hāg isab bay nileboran pilak. Aniya' palabayan pagsōd-luwasan a'a tahinang ma tōng halaman tampal ni sobangan, maka aniya' kultina min karuwambila' lalabayan itu t'llu-t'llun d'ppa maka tonga' taha'na. Aniya' isab hāg t'llu hekana jukup maka durukanna pinat'nna' ma dambila' maka dambila'.

verses.name: Exodus 38:16
verses.text: Ahāp kakana' ma saga kakultinahan kamemon ya panasak halaman.

verses.name: Exodus 38:17
verses.text: Tumbaga isab ya pangahinang durukan hāg, bo' dī pilak ya pangahinang saga sasabitna maka lebod-lebodna. Saga kōk hāg isab bay pinutusan pilak, maka pilak isab ya pangalebod ma batangna.  <div eID="gen1630" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv978"/><div sID="gen1631" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv978"/> Manjari kultina ahāp kakana'na ya tahinang e' sigām panambol pagsosōran halaman e'. Kabuldahan isab kultina itu e' saga a'a magbubulda maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Lambuna limand'ppa, langkawna dand'ppa maka tonga' sin tonga', hatina dalangkaw kultina dakayu' itu maka kultina ya panasak halaman.

verses.name: Exodus 38:19
verses.text: Aniya' mpat hāg bay tahinang e' saga a'a maghihinang panagnatan kultina panambol itu, maka mpat isab durukanna tahinang min tumbaga. Dī pilak ya pangahinangan sasabit hāg itu maka lebod-lebodna, maka pilak isab ya pamutus kōkna.

verses.name: Exodus 38:20
verses.text: Dī tumbaga saga bale ya pangahengkotan Luma' Pangarapan maka ba'anan kultina ma likusan halamanna.  <div eID="gen1631" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1629" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv979"/><div sID="gen1632" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Listahan Ai-ai ya Pangahinang Luma' Pangarapan</title> <div sID="gen1633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv979"/> Na, ya na itu saga bulawan, pilak maka tumbaga ya tapaglagi e' saga a'a maghihinang ma Luma' Pangarapan, ya pinagōnan isab Luma' Pagtau'an Paljanji'an. Bay pinalista hekana e' si Musa ma saga panubu' si Libi. Si Itamar anak si Imam Harun ya tag-soho'an ma sigām itu.

verses.name: Exodus 38:22
verses.text: Si Besalel anak si Uri, mpu si Hūr min panubu' si Yuda, ya pagbebeya'an ma saga a'a maghihinang ma kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 38:23
verses.text: Ya pasehe' ma si Besalel si Oholeyab anak si Ahisamak min panubu' si Dān. A'a ya apanday magguhit suntu'an maka maghinang ai-ai ya hinangan tangan. Ata'u isab iya magbuldahan kakana' ahāp maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.  <div eID="gen1633" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv980"/><div sID="gen1634" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv980"/> Na, ya bulawan bay niangkat e' saga a'a Isra'il panukbal sigām ma Tuhan, 29 talen maka 730 sekel.<note>Hatina saga 1,000 kilu buhat bang ma bistahan tahun baha'u itu.</note> Ya na bulawan bay pangahinang ba'anan ai-ai ma Luma' Sussi (Timbangan sara' agama ya pagtimbangan e'.)  <div eID="gen1634" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv981"/><div sID="gen1635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv981"/> In pilak isab bay ta'ā' min saga a'a Isra'il ma waktu kapangitung heka sigām, saga 100 talen maka 1,775 sekel<note>Hatina 3,400 kilu.</note> bang tinimbang. (Timbangan sara' agama ya pagtimbangan e'.) Ya na pilak bay pamabayad ma kamemon saga kal'llahan Isra'il sasuku sigām duwampū' tahun umulna sampay pariyata'. 603,550 puhu' ya heka sigām bay taitung, maka tonga' sekel<note>Pisita dī pilak 15 sussuk buhatna.</note> isab ya pamabayad ma sigām magkaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: Exodus 38:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv981"/><div sID="gen1635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv981"/> In pilak isab bay ta'ā' min saga a'a Isra'il ma waktu kapangitung heka sigām, saga 100 talen maka 1,775 sekel<note>Hatina 3,400 kilu.</note> bang tinimbang. (Timbangan sara' agama ya pagtimbangan e'.) Ya na pilak bay pamabayad ma kamemon saga kal'llahan Isra'il sasuku sigām duwampū' tahun umulna sampay pariyata'. 603,550 puhu' ya heka sigām bay taitung, maka tonga' sekel<note>Pisita dī pilak 15 sussuk buhatna.</note> isab ya pamabayad ma sigām magkaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: Exodus 38:27
verses.text: Manjari, in dahatus talen pilak aponod inān bay pinagguna pangahinang saga durukan hāg dahatus hekana ma Luma' Sussi maka ma kultinana. Manjari dakayu' talen dī pilak tahinang dakayu' durukan.

verses.name: Exodus 38:28
verses.text: Pagubus, ningā' e' saga a'a maghihinang inān ya pilak aponod takapin, 1,775 sekel buhatna. Aniya' pinagguna e' sigām pangahinang saga sasabit dī pilak ma saga hāg, aniya' bay pangalebod baran saga hāg, maka aniya' bay pamutus kōk hāg e'.  <div eID="gen1635" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv982"/><div sID="gen1636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv982"/> In buhat tumbaga isab bay panukbal e' saga a'a Isra'il, 70 talen maka 2,400 sekel.<note>Hatina saga 2,400 kilu.</note>

verses.name: Exodus 38:30
verses.text: Tapagguna e' sigām pangahinang saga durukan hāg ma lawang Tolda Pagsasabuhan, maka lapohan tumbaga, jukup isab maka pangayakanna tumbaga maka kamemon kapanyapanna.

verses.name: Exodus 38:31
verses.text: Tumbaga lullun ya tapangahinang saga durukan hāg ma sasak ya pangalikus halaman, maka ma labayan pagsōd-luwasanna. Tapangahinang du isab saga bale pangahengkotan ba'anan kultina ya pangatop Luma' Pangarapan, maka saga kultina ya pangalikus halamanna.  <div eID="gen1636" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.38"/> <div eID="gen1632" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv983"/><div sID="gen1637" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pan'mmek saga Imam</title> <div sID="gen1638" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv983"/> Na aniya' saga s'mmek bay nihinang e' disi Besalel min salban bilu, taluk maka keyat, pan'mmek saga imam ya maghinang ma deyom Luma' Sussi. Aniya' isab s'mmek sussi nihinang e' sigām pamas'mmek si Harun. Jari bineya' bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1638" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv984"/><div sID="gen1639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv984"/> Tahinang epod e' sigām min kakana' ahāp, binuldahan bulawan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.

verses.name: Exodus 39:3
verses.text: Ya bulawan e' bay tinukul panipis to'ongan bo' pinagsanggi'-sanggi', jari pinalamud sanggi'anna ma salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. A'a apanday ya makahinang.

verses.name: Exodus 39:4
verses.text: Aniya' duwa sablayan pinatahi' e' sigām ni epod inān ma karuwambila'na bo' ahāp t'nna'na ma baran imam.

verses.name: Exodus 39:5
verses.text: Aniya' sambung ahāp isab nihinang e' a'a ata'u maghinang. Tahinang min kakana' ahāp bo' binuldahan sanggi' bulawan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Magdalos sambung itu maka baran epod. Jari bineya' bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1639" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv985"/><div sID="gen1640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv985"/> Pagubus, aniya' duwa palmata onek<note>Onek itu dakayu' ginis palmata jali'-jali' ettom maka pote'.</note> bay pinat'nna' ma kait bulawan bo' yampa niukilan maka ōn saga anak si Isra'il<note>Si Isra'il: hatina si Yakub, ya pang'mbo'an bangsa Isra'il.</note> l'lla kasangpū' maka duwa. Landu' anahut ukilanna, sali' ukilan singsing.

verses.name: Exodus 39:7
verses.text: Aubus pa'in, in palmata onek itu bay pinasangon ma sablayan epod e' saga a'a maghihinang, ma atag bahana, supaya aniya' pangentoman ma saga anak si Isra'il. Jari bineya' bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1640" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv986"/><div sID="gen1641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv986"/> Na aniya' puyu'-daggaha tahinang e' a'a taga-kapandayan, sali' du hinanganna maka epod, hatina kakana' ahāp isina binuldahan bulawan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat.

verses.name: Exodus 39:9
verses.text: In kakana' puyu' inān bay nilupi' duwa bo' amasagi', dah'kka taha'na, dah'kka isab lambuna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:10
verses.text: Na, aniya' saga palmata sangpū' maka duwa hekana bay pinat'nna' e' sigām ma dahuan puyu' he'. Pinagtād mpat, t'llu-t'llu heka palmata ma dantād. Palmata rubi (palmata alutu keyatna), topas (palmata kuning) maka berel (palmata jali'-jali') ya ma tād diyata'.

verses.name: Exodus 39:11
verses.text: Palmata turkwis (palmata bilu magb'ttik-b'ttik), sappir (palmata alutu biluna) maka emeral (palmata alutu' gaddungna) ya ma tād pasunu'.

verses.name: Exodus 39:12
verses.text: Palmata jasint (palmata bilu magb'ttik-b'ttik), agat (palmata magjali'-jali' kausun maka pote') maka amitis (palmata taluk) ya ma tād pasunu' gi'.

verses.name: Exodus 39:13
verses.text: Palmata krisolit (palmata biyaning), onek (palmata kausun jali'-jali') maka jasper (palmata intan gaddung) ya ma tād deyo' katapusan.

verses.name: Exodus 39:14
verses.text: Manjari in sangpū' maka duwa palmata itu bay niukilan saga ōn anak si Isra'il l'lla, ōn a'a dakayu' ma palmata dakayu' pakaniya-kaniya. Ya ukilanna sali' hantang ukilan singsing.  <div eID="gen1641" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv987"/><div sID="gen1642" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv987"/> Pagubus, aniya' duwa kili-kili bulawan tinabid-tabid tahinang e' saga a'a inān pangengkot puyu' ni epod.

verses.name: Exodus 39:16
verses.text: Tahinang isab duwa kait bulawan pinasipit ni sablayan epod min dahuanna, maka mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, ya tōng kili-kili bulawan bay niengkotan ni duwa singsing puyu', maka tōngna dakayu' isab bay niengkotan ni duwa kait ya pamat'nna'an palmata supaya pasangon ni sablayan epod min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 39:17
verses.text: Tahinang isab duwa kait bulawan pinasipit ni sablayan epod min dahuanna, maka mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, ya tōng kili-kili bulawan bay niengkotan ni duwa singsing puyu', maka tōngna dakayu' isab bay niengkotan ni duwa kait ya pamat'nna'an palmata supaya pasangon ni sablayan epod min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 39:18
verses.text: Tahinang isab duwa kait bulawan pinasipit ni sablayan epod min dahuanna, maka mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, ya tōng kili-kili bulawan bay niengkotan ni duwa singsing puyu', maka tōngna dakayu' isab bay niengkotan ni duwa kait ya pamat'nna'an palmata supaya pasangon ni sablayan epod min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 39:19
verses.text: Tahinang isab duwa kait bulawan pinasipit ni sablayan epod min dahuanna, maka mpat singsing bulawan tinahi' pehē' ni mpat dugu puyu', min bukutna. Pagubus, ya tōng kili-kili bulawan bay niengkotan ni duwa singsing puyu', maka tōngna dakayu' isab bay niengkotan ni duwa kait ya pamat'nna'an palmata supaya pasangon ni sablayan epod min dahuan baha.

verses.name: Exodus 39:20
verses.text: Aniya' isab tahinang e' sigām duwa singsing saddī bo' yampa tinahi' pehē' ni tōng sablayan epod, ma atag sambungna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:21
verses.text: Ya singsing puyu' damuli itu bay niengkotan ni singsing epod maka lubid bilu bo' mbal angalambe puyu' min baran imam. Jari bineya' e' sigām bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1642" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv988"/><div sID="gen1643" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv988"/> Pagubus, aniya' juba pangalapis epod tahinang e' saga a'a magt't'nnun min salban bilu halam aniya' lamudna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:23
verses.text: Juba itu bay nihinangan lowang ma t'ngnga'na, nila'upan bo' mbal al'kkas agese'.

verses.name: Exodus 39:24
verses.text: In kumpi' juba isab bay pina'ari-ari maka buwa'-buwa' dalima'.<note>Dalima' itu ginis buwa' kayu ahāp luwana maka ssana.</note> Salban bilu, taluk maka keyat ya pangahinang.

verses.name: Exodus 39:25
verses.text: Aniya' isab bagting-bagting bulawan tahinang e' saga a'a inān, pinag'llot-'llot maka buwa'-buwa' dalima' ma kumpi' juba.

verses.name: Exodus 39:26
verses.text: In juba itu maka ari-arihanna wajib subay sinulug e' imam alanga ma waktu kapagimamna tudju ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, buwat bay panoho'anna ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1643" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv989"/><div sID="gen1644" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv989"/> Manjari itu aniya' saga s'mmek kasehe' tahinang pamadju' disi Harun maka saga anakna l'lla. Aniya' badju' ahāp kakana' tat'nnun he' a'a apanday magt'nnun.

verses.name: Exodus 39:28
verses.text: Aniya' saga sulban ahāp kakana'na, maka porong, maka sauwal-sauwal ahāp isab t'nnunanna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:29
verses.text: Aniya' isab sabitan tahinang min kakana' pote' binuldahan maka salban bilu, taluk maka keyat. Jari bineya' bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1644" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv990"/><div sID="gen1645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv990"/> Katapusanna, aniya' tapak-tapak pangorona bay tahinang e' saga a'a magsasasal min dī bulawan. Bay kaukilan isab kabtangan itu, ‘Sussi-manussi Pamasuku' si Yawe.’ Ukilanna inān sali' ukilan singsing. Pagubus itu, aniya' lubid bilu pinasangon ni korona inān pamaengkot iya ni dahuan sulban imam, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1645" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1637" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv990"/><div sID="gen1645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv990"/> Katapusanna, aniya' tapak-tapak pangorona bay tahinang e' saga a'a magsasasal min dī bulawan. Bay kaukilan isab kabtangan itu, ‘Sussi-manussi Pamasuku' si Yawe.’ Ukilanna inān sali' ukilan singsing. Pagubus itu, aniya' lubid bilu pinasangon ni korona inān pamaengkot iya ni dahuan sulban imam, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1645" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1637" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv991"/><div sID="gen1646" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Musa Angaliling Kamemon bay Tahinang</title> <div sID="gen1647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv991"/> Manjari itu, atemos na saga hinang kamemon bay pangahinang Luma' Pangarapan, hatina Tolda Pagsasabuhan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka manusiya'. Tabeya' e' saga a'a Isra'il kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 39:33
verses.text: Tabowa e' sigām pehē' ni si Musa saga pagdayaw Luma' Pangarapan maka ai-aina kamemon. Tabowa toldana maka kapanyapanna kamemon. Tabowa saga kakansing, saga papagan dinding, saga babag, saga hāg isab maka ba'anan durukan.

verses.name: Exodus 39:34
verses.text: Tabowa saga kultina pangatop, ya kultina bay tahinang min kuwit bili-bili l'lla nianjibihan keyat, maka kultina kuwit duyung, maka kultina ya pangalikus Ba'ul.

verses.name: Exodus 39:35
verses.text: Tabowa isab Ba'ul Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an, jukup maka tanggunganna maka turungna bulawan ya pangampunan dusa,

verses.name: Exodus 39:36
verses.text: tabowa lamisahan pamat'nna'an Tinapay Hadarat, jukup isab maka kapanyapanna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:37
verses.text: Tabowa palita'an bulawan maka sumbuhanna, jukup maka saga kapanyapan maka ns'llan pamakeyat ma iya.

verses.name: Exodus 39:38
verses.text: Tabowa isab lamisahan panugtugan kamanyan, maka ns'llan sussi ya pangangg'llal ma imam, maka kamanyan ahamut, maka kultina ya panambol pagsosōran ni Luma' Pangarapan.

verses.name: Exodus 39:39
verses.text: Tabowa lapohan tumbaga maka pangayakanna, saga tanggunganna maka ba'anan kapanyapanna, tabowa isab garul pangailan maka patinggilanna.

verses.name: Exodus 39:40
verses.text: Tabowa isab saga kultina ya panasak ma halaman Luma' maka ba'anan hāg maka durukanna, tabowa isab kultina ya panambol halaman. Tabowa saga lubid maka bale pangengkot sasak, ai-ai ya pinagguna he' sigām pamat'ngge Luma' Pangarapan, ya Pagsasabuhan Tuhan maka manusiya'.

verses.name: Exodus 39:41
verses.text: Tabowa isab ni si Musa saga s'mmek tin'nnun ya pan'mmek ma saga imam waktu paghinang sigām ma deyom Luma' Sussi, hatina saga s'mmek sussi ya pamakay imam Harun maka saga anakna l'lla ma waktu kapagimam sigām.  <div eID="gen1647" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 39:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv992"/><div sID="gen1648" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv992"/> Jari aubus na saga kahinangan kamemon bay tahinang e' saga bangsa Isra'il, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 39:43
verses.text: Manjari pagliling si Musa ma kamemon kahinangan sigām, bo' ta'nda'na in bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> tabeya' na to'ongan e' sigām, magtūy iya angamu'-ngamu'an sigām kahāpan ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen1648" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Exod.39"/> <div eID="gen1646" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv993"/><div sID="gen1649" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamat'ngge Tolda ya Pangarapan Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen1650" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv993"/> Ajukup pa'in kahinangan inān kamemon, angallam gi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 40:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Pat'nggehunbi na Luma' Tolda Pagsasabuhanku maka ka'am saga bangsa Isra'il. Sahali bulan ya llaw pamat'nggebi, ma bulan panagna'an tahun.

verses.name: Exodus 40:3
verses.text: Tapat'ngge pa'in Luma', pat'nna'unbi Ba'ul Pagtau'an Sulat Paljanji'an ma deyomna to'ongan, bo' likusin maka kultina.

verses.name: Exodus 40:4
verses.text: Pareyomunbi lamisahan ya pamat'nna'an tinapay, sinakap isab maka kapanyapanna. Pareyomunbi palita'an bulawan maka tagamahunbi saga sumbuhanna.

verses.name: Exodus 40:5
verses.text: Bowahunbi lamisahan panugtugan kamanyan bo' pat'nna'unbi ma dahuwan Ba'ul. Pagubus, tambolun bowa' lawang Luma' maka kultina.  <div eID="gen1650" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv994"/><div sID="gen1651" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv994"/> “Lapohan tumbaga ya pagtunu'an kulban, pat'nna'unbi ma halaman Tolda Pagsasabuhan ilu, ma anggopan pagsosōranna.

verses.name: Exodus 40:7
verses.text: Pat'nna'unbi isab garul pagailan ma llotan Luma' maka lapohan pagtunu'an kulban e' ati isihin bohe'.

verses.name: Exodus 40:8
verses.text: Ubus, sasakinbi katilibut halaman maka pasangonunbi isab kultina panambol pagsosōranna.  <div eID="gen1651" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv995"/><div sID="gen1652" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv995"/> “Na, ngā'unbi ns'llan sussi ati busuginbi Luma' Pangarapan maka kapanyapanna kamemon supaya pinasuku' ma aku ya Tuhanbi, manjari asussi to'ongan.

verses.name: Exodus 40:10
verses.text: Busuginbi isab lapohan pagtunu'an kulban maka kapanyapanna bo' pinasuku' ma aku, manjari mahasussi to'ongan.

verses.name: Exodus 40:11
verses.text: Ya du garul pagailan maka patinggilanna, busuginbi isab pamasuku'bi ma aku.  <div eID="gen1652" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv996"/><div sID="gen1653" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv996"/> “Pagubus, bowahun si Harun maka saga anakna l'lla pehē' ni pagsosōran Tolda Pagsasabuhan bo' pinandi maka bohe'.

verses.name: Exodus 40:13
verses.text: Pasulugunbi ma si Harun saga s'mmek imam alanga. Busuginbi iya maka ns'llan sussi ati pasuku'unbi iya ma aku supaya iya tōp magimam ma matahanku.

verses.name: Exodus 40:14
verses.text: Pabadju'inbi isab saga anakna l'lla,

verses.name: Exodus 40:15
verses.text: maka busuginbi sigām ns'llan buwat bay pamusugbi ma si Harun ya mma' sigām e', supaya sigām gin'llal imam maghinang ni aku. Manjari anatas kapagimam sigām magpangkat-mamangkat salama-lama.” Buwattē' ya pagkallam Tuhan ma si Musa.

verses.name: Exodus 40:16
verses.text: Na, bineya' e' si Musa kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma iya.  <div eID="gen1653" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv997"/><div sID="gen1654" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv997"/> Sakali itu, in Luma' Pangarapan Tuhan bay pinat'ngge e' disi Musa ma waktu sahali bulan, bulan panagna'an ma tahun karuwana min bay kaluwas sigām min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Exodus 40:18
verses.text: Saga durukan hāg ya pinat'nna' e' sigām dahū, bo' yampa saga papagan dinding, bo' babagna, bo' ba'anan hāg ya pamabatukan kamemon.

verses.name: Exodus 40:19
verses.text: Bin'llat e' sigām saga kultina maglapis-lapis pangatop kaluha'an luma'. Pagubus, ya kultina akapal to'ongan. Jari bineya' e' sigām kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1654" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv998"/><div sID="gen1655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv998"/> Puwas e', ningā' e' si Musa saga papagan batu bay panulatan palman Tuhan bo' ninna' e'na ma deyom ba'ul. Binatuk pa'in saga tanggungan ni ba'ul e', tinurungan e'na maka turung bulawan ya panaubatan dusa.

verses.name: Exodus 40:21
verses.text: Pagubus, binowa ba'ul e' si Musa ni deyom Luma' Pangarapan, ni deyom Bilik Mahasussi, ati pinasagnat e'na kultina pamalikus Ba'ul, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen1655" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv999"/><div sID="gen1656" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv999"/> Puwas e' isab, in lamisahan pamat'nna'an tinapay wa'i pina'atag e' si Musa ma deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan tampal ni satan, min luwasan kultina ya angalimbuhan ba'ul.

verses.name: Exodus 40:23
verses.text: Jari pinat'nna' pahāp saga tinapay ma diyata' lamisahan itu, ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen1656" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1000"/><div sID="gen1657" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1000"/> Ya du palita'an bulawan, pina'atag e' si Musa ma deyom Tolda Pagsabuhan tampal ni uttala' bo' maganggop maka lamisahan tinapay.

verses.name: Exodus 40:25
verses.text: Sakali pinat'nna' e'na palita'an maka sumbuhanna maina'an ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen1657" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1001"/><div sID="gen1658" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1001"/> Aubus pa'in, in lamisahan bulawan bay pinat'nna' e' si Musa ma deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan, min dahuan kultina ya angalimbuhan ba'ul.

verses.name: Exodus 40:27
verses.text: Jari maina'an iya anugtug kamanyan ahamut, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.

verses.name: Exodus 40:28
verses.text: Ati pinasangon e' si Musa kultina ya panambol Luma' Pangarapan.  <div eID="gen1658" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1002"/><div sID="gen1659" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1002"/> Pagubus inān, ya lapohan pagtunu'an kulban bay pina'atag e' si Musa ma kasekotan lawang Luma' Pangarapan (ya na Tolda Pagsasabuhan) ati maina'an iya anunu' susumbali'an pagkulban sigām ni Tuhan, pinabeya' isab ginisan tirigu, buwat bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen1659" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1003"/><div sID="gen1660" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1003"/> Ya garul aheya pagailan isab bay pinat'nna' e' si Musa ma llot Tolda Pagsasabuhan maka lapohan pagkulbanan, bo' ni'isihan e'na bohe' pagail.

verses.name: Exodus 40:31
verses.text: Tapagguna bohe' itu e' si Musa maka si Harun sampay isab saga anak si Harun pangose' tape'-tangan sigām,

verses.name: Exodus 40:32
verses.text: waktu kapasōd sigām ni deyom Tolda Pagsasabuhan. Ya du ma waktu kapasekot sigām ni lapohan pagkulbanan, buwat isab bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Musa.  <div eID="gen1660" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1004"/><div sID="gen1661" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1004"/> Pagubus inān, sinasakan e' disi Musa halaman ma sakalibutan Luma' Pangarapan maka lapohan pagkulbanan e'. Pinasangon isab kultina ya panambol pagsosōran ni halaman. Minnē' atangbus e' si Musa kamemon bay panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya.  <div eID="gen1661" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1649" type="section"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1005"/><div sID="gen1662" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasahaya'an si Yawe</title> <div sID="gen1663" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1005"/> Aubus pa'in ina'an, magtūy katambunan Tolda Pagsasabuhan e' gabun-Tuhan,<note>Gabun-Tuhan: gabun patudjak pariyata' sali' luwa buhawi'.</note> maka ap'nno' deyomna e' sahaya si Yawe.

verses.name: Exodus 40:35
verses.text: Manjari mbal makasōd si Musa sabab ina'an gabun patapu' ni diyata' Luma' maka ina'an sahaya si Yawe ma deyomna.  <div eID="gen1663" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1006"/><div sID="gen1664" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1006"/> Na, in bangsa Isra'il, ma waktu kapaglatun-latun sigām min lahat dakayu' ni dakayu', subay pa'angkat gabun min diyata' Luma' Pangarapan bo' yampa sigām pauntas.

verses.name: Exodus 40:37
verses.text: Sat'ggol mbal pa'angkat, mbal isab sigām pauntas min bay paglihanan sigām.

verses.name: Exodus 40:38
verses.text: Ina'an gabun si Yawe ma diyata' Luma' Pangarapan ma waktu llaw, ina'an isab api ma deyom gabun ma waktu sangom. Jari ta'nda' e' kamemon saga a'a Isra'il pi'ingga-pi'ingga paglatunan sigām.  <div eID="gen1664" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1662" type="section"/> <div eID="gen1055" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Exod.40"/> <div eID="gen1049" osisID="Exod" type="book"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1007"/><div sID="gen1670" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nirugpak saga Bangsa Kana'an Takapin</title> <div sID="gen1671" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1007"/> Na, pagpatay pa'in si Yussa', angaru saga bangsa Isra'il ni si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām, yuk-i, “Sai min kami ya dahū angandugpak ni bangsa Kana'an?”  <div eID="gen1671" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1008"/><div sID="gen1672" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1008"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, “Panubu' si Yuda ya parahū, sabab bay pamuwanku bahagi' lahat ilu ni komkoman sigām.”  <div eID="gen1672" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1009"/><div sID="gen1673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1009"/> Manjari ah'lling saga a'a bangsa Yuda ni saga kampung sigām bangsa Simiyun, yuk-i, “Gapi'inbi kami pehē' ni paglahat ya pamasuku' kami ati magdongan kitam angandugpak ni bangsa Kana'an. Pas'lle' kami isāb anganggapi' ka'am bang pehē' ni paglahat ya pamasuku' ka'am.” Jari tinabangan bangsa Yuda e' bangsa Simiyun.  <div eID="gen1673" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1010"/><div sID="gen1674" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1010"/> Na, parugpak pa'in saga a'a bangsa Yuda, pinara'ug sigām e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min bangsa Kana'an maka bangsa Peres, ati sangpū' ngibu heka a'a bay tapapatay sigām ma lahat Besek.

verses.name: Judges 1:5
verses.text: Talanggal isāb maina'an si Adoni-Besek ya pagpanghū'an saga a'a Besek. Binowa iya magbono' ati pinalahi saga bangsa Kana'an maka bangsa Peres.

verses.name: Judges 1:6
verses.text: Si Adoni-Besek bay makalahi isab, sagō' tinurul iya e' a'a Yuda sampay tasaggaw. Pagsaggaw itu, pinōngan bokol tanganna maka bokol tape'na karuwambila'.  <div eID="gen1674" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1011"/><div sID="gen1675" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1011"/> Jari ah'lling si Adoni-Besek, yukna, “Pitumpū' heka sultan bay kapōnganku bokol tangan maka bokol tape' sigām. Ya sadja takakan e' sigām momok kinakan apakpak min lamisahanku. Angkan ma buwattina'an itiya' na aku tinungbasan e' Tuhan ma bay tahinangku ma sigām.” Manjari binowa iya e' saga a'a Yuda ni da'ira Awrusalam ati mahē' kamatayanna.  <div eID="gen1675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1012"/><div sID="gen1676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1012"/> Bay tarugpak asal da'ira Awrusalam e' saga a'a Yuda ati ta'agaw e' sigām. Pinapagpatay e' sigām saga a'ana, pinagtautunu' isāb kaluma'anna.

verses.name: Judges 1:9
verses.text: Pagubus, palūd saga a'a Yuda bo' angandugpak ni saga a'a Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma lahat kabūran, maka ma lahat Negeb, maka ma kabūd-būran tampal ni s'ddopan.

verses.name: Judges 1:10
verses.text: Tat'kka isāb e' sigām bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma kauman Hebron (ya bay niōnan Kiriyat-Arba ma waktu tagna') ati tara'ug e' sigām disi Sesay, si Ahiman maka si Talmay.  <div eID="gen1676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1013"/><div sID="gen1677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1013"/> Aubus pa'in min Hebron, parugpak sigām ni saga a'a pat'nna' ma kauman Deber (ya bay niōnan Kiriyat-Seper ma waktu tagna'.)

verses.name: Judges 1:12
verses.text: Jari ah'lling si Kaleb yukna, “Pamakawinku anakku si Aksa ma l'lla ya makatawakkal angandugpak maka angalongkop<note>Angalongkop: hatina angagaw lahat maka a'ana maka karayana.</note> Kiriyat-Seper.”

verses.name: Judges 1:13
verses.text: Si Otniyel ya makalongkop kauman inān, ati pamakawin ma iya e' si Kaleb anakna si Aksa. Si Otniyel itu siyali si Kaleb, si Kenas ya mma' sigā.  <div eID="gen1677" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1014"/><div sID="gen1678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1014"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw pinogos e' si Aksa si Otniyel, sinō' angamu' tana' min mato'ana si Kaleb. Sakali pehē' si Aksa ni mma'na. Makareyo' pa'in iya min kura'na, tinilaw iya e' si Kaleb, yuk-i, “Ai tapanabangku ma ka'a, arung?”  <div eID="gen1678" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1015"/><div sID="gen1679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1015"/> Yuk sambung si Aksa, “Dūlin aku ma kabaya'anku. Pagga aku bay buwanannu tana' ma Negeb, buwanin gi' isab aku saga tuburan bohe'.” Jari kabuwanan iya saga tuburan bohe' ma kabūd-būran maka ma kapantayan.  <div eID="gen1679" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1016"/><div sID="gen1680" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1016"/> Na, magbeya' saga a'a Yuda maka saga a'a Kēn ya panubu' mato'a si Musa. Ala'an sigām min da'ira Kapalmahan bo' papinda ni paslangan Yuda. Pasakaum sigām ma saga a'a ya asal maglahat maina'an ma Negeb, ma kasekotan kauman Arad.  <div eID="gen1680" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1017"/><div sID="gen1681" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1017"/> Pagubus, pasehe' saga a'a Yuda ma kaukampungan sigām bangsa Simiyun ati tarugpak e' sigām bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma da'ira Sepat. Jari alubu e' sigām da'ira inān maka kaluma'anna angkan pinagōnan da'ira Horma<note>Horma: hatina ‘alubu’.</note>.

verses.name: Judges 1:18
verses.text: Kalongkopan isāb e' a'a Yuda saga da'ira Gasa, Askelon maka Ekron, beya' isab tana' ma sakalingkal saga da'ira inān.  <div eID="gen1681" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1018"/><div sID="gen1682" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1018"/> Pagapi' na pa'in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma bangsa Yuda ati ta'agaw e' sigām saga kaluma'an ma kabūd-būran. Malaingkan halam takole' e' sigām tin'ggal saga bangsa ya maglahat ma kapantayan, sabab aniya' ma sigām kalesa pagdayaw basi'.

verses.name: Judges 1:20
verses.text: In kauman Hebron bay pamasuku' ma si Kaleb buwat bay panganjanji' si Musa, ati tin'ggal e' si Kaleb t'llungan tumpukan bangsa Annak ya bay pat'nna' maina'an.

verses.name: Judges 1:21
verses.text: Bo' arapun in bangsa Jibus ya maglahat asal ma Awrusalam halam bay tapala'an e' bangsa Benjamin. Angkan sigām duwa bangsa masi magsakaum maina'an.  <div eID="gen1682" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1019"/><div sID="gen1683" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1019"/> Bay isāb nirugpak e' bangsa Yusup da'ira Betel, pagka sigām ginapi' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Judges 1:23
verses.text: Waktu sigām amapehē' mata-mata ni Betel (ya bay niōnan Lūs waktu tagna'),

verses.name: Judges 1:24
verses.text: aniya' l'lla ta'nda' paluwas min da'ira inān. Yuk saga mata-mata ma iya, “Pandu'in kami bang buwattingga pasōd ni da'ira ilu ati mbal ka inay kami.”

verses.name: Judges 1:25
verses.text: Jari tinuli'an sigām pasōd pehē'. Pinapatay e' sigām kamemon a'a ya maglahat ma da'ira Betel. Saguwā' in l'lla bay anuli'an sigām niliyus magtai'anak e' saga mata-mata.

verses.name: Judges 1:26
verses.text: Puwas pa'in he'-i, pehē' a'a inān ni lahat bangsa Hīt ati mahē' iya amaniya' da'ira. Niōnan e'na Lūs, jari Lūs ya ōnna sampay ni kabuwattituhan.  <div eID="gen1683" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1020"/><div sID="gen1684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1020"/> Malaingkan halam bay tat'ggal e' bangsa Manasse saga a'a ya maglahat ma Bet-Sān, ma Ta'anak, ma Dōr, ma Ebleyam, ma Megiddo, sampay isāb ma ba'anan kaluma'an ya ma katilibut saga paglahat itu. Tu'ud magniyat bangsa Kana'an mbal ala'an min paglahat inān.

verses.name: Judges 1:28
verses.text: Aga'os pa'in bangsa Isra'il, niata e' sigām bangsa Kana'an, sinō' maghinang abuhat, sagō' halam bay tapala'an tūy.

verses.name: Judges 1:29
verses.text: Damikiyanna isāb bangsa Epra'im, halam bay makat'ggal bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma Geser angkan masi na pa'in sigām duwa bangsa magsakaum.

verses.name: Judges 1:30
verses.text: Damikiyanna bangsa Sibulun halam du isāb bay makat'ggal bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma Kitron maka ma Nahalol. Angkan masi sigām magsakaum maina'an. Sagō' niata sigām e' bangsa Sibulun sinō' maghinang abuhat.

verses.name: Judges 1:31
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab bangsa Aser, halam bay makat'ggal saga a'a pat'nna' ma Akko, ma Sidun, ma Alab, ma Aksib, ma Helba, ma Apek, maka ma Rehob.

verses.name: Judges 1:32
verses.text: Angkan bangsa Aser masi magsakaum maka bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' ma jadjahan inān.

verses.name: Judges 1:33
verses.text: Damikiyanna bangsa Naptali halam bay makat'ggal saga a'a pat'nna' ma Bet-Semes maka ma Bet-Anat, angkan ina'an sigām magsakaum maka bangsa Kana'an ya pat'nna' asal maina'an. Ya a'a Bet-Semes maka Bet-Anat tahinang ata du isab e' bangsa Naptali.  <div eID="gen1684" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1021"/><div sID="gen1685" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1021"/> In bangsa Dān isāb bay pinaghāran e' bangsa Amor ma kabūd-būran, mbal tinugutan pat'nna' ma kapantayan.

verses.name: Judges 1:35
verses.text: Ahogot isab pagniyat bangsa Amor in sigām mbal ala'an min Būd Heres, Ayjalon maka Sa'albim. Saguwā' ta'abut pa'in pasōng ga'os bangsa Yusup, ya du bangsa Amor nihinang ata.

verses.name: Judges 1:36
verses.text: Ya tobtoban tana' bangsa Amor itu anagna' min L'bbak Jalalangking sampay ni lahat Sela maka paliyu lagi' minnē'.  <div eID="gen1685" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.1"/> <div eID="gen1670" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1022"/><div sID="gen1686" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mala'ikat si Yawe Angalapal</title> <div sID="gen1687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1022"/> Na, in mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bay patukad min Gilgal ni lahat Bokim bo' ah'lling ni bangsa Isra'il, yukna, “Bay kam bowaku paluwas min lahat Misil tudju ni lahat ya bay paljanji'anku ma saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi. Yukku ma waktu ina'an, ‘Mbal balubahanku janji'ku ya pagsulutanku maka ka'am.

verses.name: Judges 2:2
verses.text: Bay kam sohō'ku subay da'a angahinang pagsulutan maka saga a'a porol ma paglahat ilu. Gom pa'in lubuhunbi saga tampat ya pagpudjihan sigām.’ Saguwā' halam aku bay beya'bi. Angay bahā'?

verses.name: Judges 2:3
verses.text: Angkan haka'anta na kam, mbal t'ggalku saga bangsa inān, angkan sigām sapantun iting makasulaman kakīranbi. Tajallat isāb kam e' ba'anan tuhan-tuhan ya tina'at e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen1687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1023"/><div sID="gen1688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1023"/> Aubus pa'in pangallam mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> inān, magtūy maglemong anangis kamemon saga a'a Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 2:5
verses.text: Angkan Bokim<note>Bokim: hatina ‘pagtangisan’.</note> ya pangōn sigām ma lahat inān, ati maina'an sigām angungsuran tutukbalan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen1688" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1686" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1024"/><div sID="gen1689" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoway ma Kabaya'an si Yawe</title> <div sID="gen1690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1024"/> Na, bay pa'in tapatulak e' si Yussa' saga a'a Isra'il, palanjal sigām minnē' bo' nirapu e' sigām saga katana'-tana'an ya pamasuku' katumpukan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Judges 2:7
verses.text: Jari sat'ggol allum si Yussa', atukid saga a'a Isra'il angisbat si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām. Angisbat na pa'in sigām sampay magpatayan na saga pagmatto'ahan sasuku bay maka'nda' saga kahinangan kawasahan ya tahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma pasalan bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen1690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1025"/><div sID="gen1691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1025"/> Jari si Yussa' anak si Nūn, ya pinagōnan ‘Sosoho'an si Yawe’, amatay ma umulna dahatus maka sangpū'.

verses.name: Judges 2:9
verses.text: Takubul iya ma lahat palsuku'anna ma Timnat Heres ya ma kabūd-būran Epra'im, tampal uttala' min Būd Ga'as.  <div eID="gen1691" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1026"/><div sID="gen1692" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1026"/> Na, magpatayan pa'in kapanubu'an ina'an-i, aniya' tubu'an baha'u pas'lle', ya mbal makakilā <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, maka halam isāb makata'u ma bay tahinang e'na ma bangsa sigām Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 2:11
verses.text: Pagga buwattē', tahinang e' bangsa Isra'il kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<note>Landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>: hatina ‘makasāk atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.’</note> ati sinumba e' sigām saga Ba'al.

verses.name: Judges 2:12
verses.text: Ang'bba sigām min si Yawe ya bay pagtuhanan saga ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām. In iya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bay amowa saga ka'mbo'-mbo'an e' paluwas min lahat Misil, sagō' bineya' maka sinumba e' sigām saga tuhan-tuhan ya tina'at e' maglalahat ma jadjahan ina'an. Akagit atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigām

verses.name: Judges 2:13
verses.text: ma sabab kataikut sigām min iya bo' papinda anumba ni Ba'al maka saga Astoret.

verses.name: Judges 2:14
verses.text: Pagka aheya ka'astol <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma bangsa Isra'il inān, bay pasagaranna sigām nilangpasan he' saga mundu. Pinasagaran isāb sigām nira'ug e' saga palbantahan ya ma katilibut paglahat sigām. Mbal sigām maka'atu,

verses.name: Judges 2:15
verses.text: sakahaba' waktu sigām angatubang amono', mbal sigām bay pinara'ug e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ya na ina'an bay panganjanji'na. Gom pa'in paheya kasukkalan sigām.  <div eID="gen1692" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1027"/><div sID="gen1693" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1027"/> Na, pagga buwattē' kahālan bangsa Isra'il, aniya' saga maghuhukum bay pinaniya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angalappas sigām min ga'osan saga mundu he'.

verses.name: Judges 2:17
verses.text: Malaingkan mbal akale bangsa Isra'il ma saga maghuhukum ya magmakōkan sigām, gom pa'in sigām ang'bba min si Yawe bo' papinda anumba ma saga tuhan-tuhan saddī. Pabidda' saga bangsa Isra'il itu min bay ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām tagna', sabab magdai'-dai' sigām pasiha' min kal'ngnganan saga ka'mbo'-mbo'an e'. Halam bineya' kabiyaksahan sigām ameya' ma panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Judges 2:18
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a pinaniya' maghukum sumiyan-sumiyan, ginapi' iya e' Tuhan bo' supaya talappas saga a'a Isra'il min komkoman saga palbantahan sigām. Buwattē' na pa'in kahālan sat'ggol masi allum a'a maghukum e'. Ma'ase' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma bangsa Isra'il pagka sigām magaruhuy ma sabab pinissoko' maka nijahulaka' e' banta sigām.

verses.name: Judges 2:19
verses.text: Saguwā' ta'abut pa'in amatay maghuhukum e', magtūy sigām pabalik maghinang kala'atan akalap lagi' la'atna min bay kahinangan kamatto'ahan sigām. Tina'at maka pinudji e' sigām saga tuhan-tuhan saddī. Minsan ni'inay, mbal sigām pataikut min kahinangan ala'at, maka magmatuwas na pa'in kōk sigām.  <div eID="gen1693" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1028"/><div sID="gen1694" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1028"/> Angkan landu' akagit atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma bangsa Isra'il. Yukna, “In bangsa itu hal anagga' ma pagsulutan ya bay janji'ku ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām, mbal isab akale ma aku.

verses.name: Judges 2:21
verses.text: Angkan mbal pala'anku min sigām saga bangsa ya halam bay tara'ug ma waktu kallum lagi' si Yussa'.

verses.name: Judges 2:22
verses.text: Jari gunaku saga bangsa itu panulayan bangsa Isra'il bo' tata'uku bang b'nnal sigām an'ppu ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām ameya' ma kabaya'anku.”

verses.name: Judges 2:23
verses.text: Angkanna saga bangsa kasehe'an bay pinasagaran pat'nna' ma lahat inān. Halam sigām bay pinala'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saru'un-du'un. Halam isāb bay dūlanna si Yussa' anganda'ug min sigām.  <div eID="gen1694" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.2"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:1
verses.text: Na, ya itu saga bangsa bay pinasagaran e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe panulayna ma saga a'a Isra'il ya halam bay makalabay pagbono' ma lahat Kana'an.

verses.name: Judges 3:2
verses.text: (Subay sigām kapandu'an amono' sabab ya kaheka'an sigām halam bay makalabay bono' ma waktu tagna'.)

verses.name: Judges 3:3
verses.text: Ina'an masi ma lahat Kana'an saga datu' lima hekana ya pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin, ina'an isāb saga bangsa Kana'an magtumpuk-manumpuk, maka ina'an isāb bangsa Sidun maka bangsa Hīb ya pat'nna' ma kabūd-būran Lebanon, min būd Ba'al-Hermon sampay ni Lebo-Hamat.

verses.name: Judges 3:4
verses.text: Tinugutan saga bangsa itu anulay ma saga a'a Isra'il bo' tata'u bang bineya' e' sigām saga panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay pang'bbana ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām labay min si Musa.  <div eID="gen1695" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1029"/><div sID="gen1696" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1029"/> Na, pasakaum saga a'a Isra'il ma bangsa Kana'an, bangsa Hīt, bangsa Amor, bangsa Pirisi, bangsa Hīb maka bangsa Jebus.

verses.name: Judges 3:6
verses.text: Magpikit-pikiti isāb bangsa Isra'il maka bangsa saddī inān, ati tabowa anumba ni saga tuhan-tuhan sigām.  <div eID="gen1696" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1689" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1030"/><div sID="gen1697" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Otniyel</title> <div sID="gen1698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1030"/> Jari tahinang e' saga bangsa Yahudi kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Takalipat e' sigām si Yawe ya pagtuhanan sigām bo' anumba ni saga tuhan-tuhan Ba'al maka Astoret.

verses.name: Judges 3:8
verses.text: Aheya kakagit atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe angkan pasagaranna bangsa Isra'il nira'ug e' si Kusan-Risataim ya sultan ma Aram Naharaim. Jari waluntahun t'ggol sigām ma komkoman sultan e'.

verses.name: Judges 3:9
verses.text: Malaingkan parahing pa'in sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, aniya' a'a pinaniya' e'na angaliyusan sigām. Ōn a'a itu si Otniyel anak si Kenas, ya siyali si Kaleb l'lla. Jari talappas saga a'a Isra'il e' si Otniyel.

verses.name: Judges 3:10
verses.text: Pahōp Rū si Yawe ma iya ati tahinang iya maghuhukum ma bangsa Isra'il. Aesog iya ma pagbono'an maka karūlan iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe angkan tara'ug e'na si Kusan-Risataim ya sultan bangsa Aram.

verses.name: Judges 3:11
verses.text: Jari aniya' na kasannangan ma lahat inān ma deyom mpatpū' tahun, sampay ni waktu kamatay si Otniyel anak si Kenas.  <div eID="gen1698" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1697" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1031"/><div sID="gen1699" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ehod</title> <div sID="gen1700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1031"/> Jari pabalik na isāb saga bangsa Isra'il angahinang kala'atan ya asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, angkan sigām taga'os e' si Eglon sultan bangsa Mowab, min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Judges 3:13
verses.text: Si Eglon inān bay mikigapi' ma bangsa Ammon maka bangsa Amalek, ati tarugpak e' sigām bangsa Isra'il bo' kalongkopan e' sigām da'ira Kapalmahan.

verses.name: Judges 3:14
verses.text: Sangpū' ka waluntahun ya t'ggol bangsa Isra'il ma komkoman si Eglon sultan bangsa Mowab e'.  <div eID="gen1700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1032"/><div sID="gen1701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1032"/> Manjari pabalik na isab saga bangsa Isra'il parahing ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ati aniya' isāb a'a bay pat'nna'na angaliyusan sigām min kasigpitan. Ōnna si Ehod anak si Gera, panubu' si Benjamin, a'a sakap gibang. Jari itu, sinoho' iya e' saga pagkahina bangsa Isra'il ang'nde'an buwis ni si Eglon ya sultan bangsa Mowab.

verses.name: Judges 3:16
verses.text: Na aniya' punyal saga t'llu h'kka taha'na bay tahinang e' si Ehod itu, kaengkotan e'na ni pa'ana kowan bo' katambunan e' s'mmekna.

verses.name: Judges 3:17
verses.text: Pagubus, binowa buwis e' si Ehod ni si Eglon sultan bangsa Mowab. Al'mmok asal si Eglon.

verses.name: Judges 3:18
verses.text: Na, ka'nde'an pa'in buwis itu, pinapole' e' si Ehod saga maghahangkut pilak pamuwis.

verses.name: Judges 3:19
verses.text: Maka'abut pa'in sigām ni saga batu ukilan ya ma tongod kauman Gilgal, si Ehod bay pabalik pehē' ni sultan Eglon bo' ah'lling ma iya, yuk-i, “Aniya' pah'llingku ma ka'a, tuwan sultan, ma halam aniya' makakale.” <div eID="gen1701" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1702" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sultan ma saga sosoho'anna, “Da'a kam asagaw!” Ati paluwas sigām minnē'.  <div eID="gen1702" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1033"/><div sID="gen1703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1033"/> Manjari pasekot si Ehod ni sultan e', hinabuna aningkō' karangan-danganan ma bilik angkap diyata' ya paghayang-hayanganna. Yuk si Ehod, “Aniya' lapal Tuhan pasampayku ni ka'a, tuwan.” Hinabu pabuhat sultan min paningkō'anna,

verses.name: Judges 3:21
verses.text: nihublut e' si Ehod punyal bay ma pa'ana kowan. Nihublut e'na maka tanganna gibang ati pangandugsu'na ni b'ttong sultan.

verses.name: Judges 3:22
verses.text: Ā, paloblob punyal sampay puhanna ni b'ttong sultan, palatus pehē' ni bukutna. Halam tahella' e' si Ehod punyalna inān sabab katambunan e' kal'mmokan sultan.

verses.name: Judges 3:23
verses.text: Jari paluwas si Ehod ni saurung luma' bo' kinunsi' e'na saga tambol ma bilik angkap diyata' inān.  <div eID="gen1703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1034"/><div sID="gen1704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1034"/> Makala'an pa'in iya, pina'an saga sosoho'an sultan ni bilikna inān ati ta'nda' e' sigām saga tambolna bay kinunsi'. “Ā,” yuk sigām, “kalu wa'i gi' ajamban.”

verses.name: Judges 3:25
verses.text: Sakali angagad-ngagad na pa'in sigām sampay sigām sinōd iya', sagō' halam taukab tambol e' sultan. Angkan sigām bay angā' kunsi' pangukab. Pagukab itu, ta'nda' e' sigām panghulu' sigām amatay pahantal ma lantay.  <div eID="gen1704" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1035"/><div sID="gen1705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1035"/> Hinabu angagad saga sosoho'an e', wa'i makalahi si Ehod. Talabay e'na saga batu ukilan bo' patudju ni lahat Se'era.

verses.name: Judges 3:27
verses.text: Pagt'kkana pa'in pehē' ni kabūd-būran ya paglahatan panubu' si Epra'im, amah'lling iya tiyup-tiyup. Sakali patimuk ni si Ehod saga bangsa Isra'il bay min kaburan inān, ati magbeya' sigām palūd minnē'.  <div eID="gen1705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1036"/><div sID="gen1706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1036"/> “Pi'itu kam ameya' ma aku,” yuk panoho'an si Ehod, “sabab saga bantabi bangsa Mowab pinara'ug e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'am.” Angkan sigām paurul ma si Ehod, ati ta'agaw e' sigām saga kababawan ma sapa' Jordan, ya palabayan ni lahat Mowab. Halam aniya' minsan sai bay tinugutan e' disi Ehod pauntas parambila' sapa' he'.

verses.name: Judges 3:29
verses.text: Jari ma llaw ina'an-i, aniya' saga sangpū' ngibu a'a Mowab tapapatay he' sigām, a'a bahani maka akosog. Halam aniya' minsan dangan bay makalahi.

verses.name: Judges 3:30
verses.text: Ma llaw he'-i du taga'os bangsa Mowab e' bangsa Isra'il ati asannang paglahat inān ma deyom walumpū' tahun.  <div eID="gen1706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1699" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1037"/><div sID="gen1707" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Samgar</title> <div sID="gen1708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1037"/> Manjari ya pas'lle' ma si Ehod itu si Samgar anak si Anat. Si Samgar itu bay makapapatay nnom hatus a'a bangsa Pilistin. Luwal tungkud panganjudjal sapi' ya pakokosna. Bay isāb iya angaliyusan bangsa Isra'il min kasigpitan sigām.  <div eID="gen1708" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.3"/> <div eID="gen1707" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1038"/><div sID="gen1709" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Debora</title> <div sID="gen1710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1038"/> Amatay pa'in si Ehod, pabalik na isab saga bangsa Isra'il maghinang kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām.

verses.name: Judges 4:2
verses.text: Jari sinōngan sigām e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ni komkoman si Jabin, sultan bangsa Kana'an ya amarinta ma da'ira Hasor. Ya magnakura' ma saga sundalu si Jabin itu si Sesera, a'a pat'nna' ma Haroset Haggoyim.

verses.name: Judges 4:3
verses.text: Aniya' ma si Jabin saga kalesa basi' siyam hatus hekana. Nijahulaka' e'na bangsa Isra'il, pinissoko' ma deyom duwampū' tahun, angkan sigām parahing ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angamu' tabang.  <div eID="gen1710" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1039"/><div sID="gen1711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1039"/> Ma waktu inān, si Debora h'nda si Lapidut ya magnakura' ma bangsa Isra'il. Nabi isab iya.

verses.name: Judges 4:5
verses.text: Ya kabiyaksahan si Debora itu bang maghukum ma saga a'a Isra'il subay ma sindungan kayu ya pinagōnan Palma,<note>Palma itu ginis kayu luwa niyug, sagō' hulma' ya buwa'na. ‘Date’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ina'an ma llot Rama maka Betel ya ma kabūran Epra'im. Pehē' ni iya saga a'a Isra'il amapasalassay ba'anan palsagga'an sigām.

verses.name: Judges 4:6
verses.text: Jari aniya' waktu kapanambuku si Debora ma si Barak, anak si Abinowam l'lla ya pat'nna' ma kauman Kedes ma lahat bangsa Naptali. Ya lapal si Debora ma si Barak, “Si Yawe ya pagtuhanan bangsatam Isra'il magpanoho'an ma ka'a. Sinō' ka pehē' ni būd Tabor, beya' isāb saga a'a sangpū' ngibu hekana min bangsa Naptali maka min bangsa Sibulun.

verses.name: Judges 4:7
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan isab, ‘Sasatku si Sesera ya pagmakōkan saga sundalu si Jabin, supaya iya tabowa pehē' ni sapa' Kisun, iya baranna maka saga kalesana basi' sampay ba'anan saga sundaluna. Ati sōnganku sigām ni ga'osannu.’ ”  <div eID="gen1711" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1040"/><div sID="gen1712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1040"/> Sakali ah'lling si Barak ni si Debora, yukna, “Aho', pehē' aku bang pa'in ka'a ya anehe'an aku. Sagō' bang ka mbal ameya', na mbal aku.”  <div eID="gen1712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1041"/><div sID="gen1713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1041"/> “Ahāp na ko' ilu,” yuk si Debora. “Ameya' aku ma ka'a. Sagō' pagka buwattilu paghona'-hona'nu, halam aniya' kamahaldika'an maka-ni ka'a bang tara'ug si Sesera. Subay d'nda ya binuwanan da'ugan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.” Jari parongan si Debora ma si Barak pehē' ni Kedes.

verses.name: Judges 4:10
verses.text: Ma Kedes pa'in, pinalinganan e' si Barak saga a'a panubu' si Sibulun maka si Naptali, ati sangpū' ngibu ya heka sigām magbeya' maka iya. Ya du si Debora bay ameya'.  <div eID="gen1713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1042"/><div sID="gen1714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1042"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an du, aniya' a'a niōnan si Heber bay pasaddī min pagkahina bangsa Kēn. In bangsa Kēn itu panubu' si Hobab, ya bay ipal si Musa l'lla. Jari si Heber itu bay amat'ngge luma'na tolda ma atag kayu Sa'anannim, dakayu' po'on kayu aheya asekot ni Kedes.  <div eID="gen1714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1043"/><div sID="gen1715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1043"/> Kahaka'an si Sesera pasal si Barak anak si Abinowam wa'i patukad ni būd Tabor.

verses.name: Judges 4:13
verses.text: Angkan tinimuk e' si Sesera saga kalesana basi' siyam hatus hekana maka kamemon kal'llahan ya tendogna, ati soho'na sigām pehē' min Haroset Haggoyim ni sapa' Kisun.  <div eID="gen1715" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1044"/><div sID="gen1716" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1044"/> Pagka buwattē', ah'lling si Debora ni si Barak, yukna, “Sūng! Ya na itu llaw panukbal si Sesera ni ka'a e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>! Tuhan ya magmunda' ma ka'am!” Angkan palūd si Barak min būd Tabor maka saga a'a sangpū' ngibu hekana.

verses.name: Judges 4:15
verses.text: Manjari itu, makarugpak pa'in disi Barak, pinalengog si Sesera e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, talapay isāb kamemon saga a'ana magkalesa maka sundaluna. Si Sesera baranna bay pakuppa min kalesana bo' alahi.

verses.name: Judges 4:16
verses.text: Saguwā' niapas e' si Barak saga kalesa maka katumpukan sundalu inān sampay ni Haroset Haggoyim. Talagut saga sundalu si Sesera kamemon, halam aniya' minsan dangan takapin allum.

verses.name: Judges 4:17
verses.text: Malaingkan si Sesera itu bay makalahi ni luma' tolda ya pat'nna'an si Ja'el h'nda si Heber bangsa Kēn. Magbagay asal si Jabin sultan Hasor maka kakampungan si Heber.  <div eID="gen1716" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1045"/><div sID="gen1717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1045"/> Na, paluwas si Ja'el min luma'na anagina si Sesera. Yukna, “Palanjal ka, tuwanku. Pasōd ka pi'itu, da'a ka tināw.” Jari pasōd iya ni luma' tolda bo' minantahan e' si Ja'el.  <div eID="gen1717" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1046"/><div sID="gen1718" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1046"/> Yuk si Sesera ma iya, “Atoho' k'llongku. Bang manjari, buwanin aku bohe'.” Ati niukab e' si Ja'el dakayu' pangisihan gatas pamainum iya. Pagubus tinambunan iya pabalik.  <div eID="gen1718" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1047"/><div sID="gen1719" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1047"/> Ah'lling gi' si Sesera ma si Ja'el, yukna, “An'ngge ka ma bowa' lawang ilu. Bang aniya' pi'itu atilaw bang aniya' gi' a'a saddī maitu, sambungin ‘halam’.”  <div eID="gen1719" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1048"/><div sID="gen1720" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1048"/> Saguwā' addok pa'in tuli si Sesera ma sabab kamale'na, niā' tuku tolda maka tukul e' si Ja'el h'nda si Heber inān. Pa'agak-agak iya ni bihing si Sesera. Tinukul e'na tuku inān ni kīd tuktukna, tinukul pahāp bo' palatus parambila' pa'abut ni tana'. Minnē' amatay si Sesera.  <div eID="gen1720" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1049"/><div sID="gen1721" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1049"/> Na, pina'an isāb si Barak amiha si Sesera ati paluwas si Ja'el amāk iya. “Pi'itu ka,” yukna, “pa'nda'anku ka'a ya a'a pihanu.” Angkan ameya' si Barak ma si Ja'el pasōd. Ta'nda' e'na si Sesera amatay pahantal, maka masi tuku tolda ma kōkna.  <div eID="gen1721" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1050"/><div sID="gen1722" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1050"/> Manjari ma llaw he'-i du, in si Jabin sultan bangsa Kana'an inān bay nilongkopan e' Tuhan ma pang'nda' saga a'a Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 4:24
verses.text: Ati bangsa Isra'il itu gom pa'in magsosōng ga'os sigām min sultan Jabin, sampay iya ta'abut magka'at e' sigām.  <div eID="gen1722" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.4"/> <div eID="gen1709" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1051"/><div sID="gen1723" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan si Debora</title> <div sID="gen1724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1051"/> Ma llaw ina'an du, magkalang si Debora maka si Barak ya anak si Abinowam. Yuk pagkalang sigā: <lg sID="gen1725"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1726"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:2
verses.text: “Pudji ni si Yawe!<l eID="gen1726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1727"/>Saga a'a bangsahan angatas na magmunda' ma pagkahi sigām bangsa Isra'il,<l eID="gen1727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1728"/>lilla' isāb saga a'a anukbalan baran sigām.<l eID="gen1728" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1729"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:3
verses.text: Pakale kam, saga sultan! Pakale kam saga a'a bangsahan.<l eID="gen1729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1730"/>Angalang aku ni si Yawe, angalang aku.<l eID="gen1730" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1731"/>Anukbal aku kalangan pamudji si Yawe ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen1731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1732"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:4
verses.text: O Yawe, pagla'annu pa'in min lahat Se'er,<l eID="gen1732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1733"/>paglanjalnu min lahat Edom,<l eID="gen1733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1734"/>ajogjog dunya, alandos makalandu' ulan,<l eID="gen1734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1735"/>patumbuk ulan min kagabunan.<l eID="gen1735" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1736"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:5
verses.text: Ajogjog saga kabūran ma kapi'itu si Yawe,<l eID="gen1736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1737"/>ya Tuhan tag-suku'an būd Turusina.<l eID="gen1737" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1738"/>Aho', ajogjog ma baihu'an si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen1738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1739"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:6
verses.text: Ma waktu kapaghukum si Samgar anak si Anat,<l eID="gen1739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1740"/>maka ma waktu si Ja'el,<l eID="gen1740" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1741"/>halam aniya' bay makalabay min lān aheya.<l eID="gen1741" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1742"/>Sasuku magtulakan subay palabay min saga lān kabiklu'-biklu'an.<l eID="gen1742" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1743"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:7
verses.text: Akulang du bay makapaglahat ma kahuma-huma'an tana' Isra'il,<l eID="gen1743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1744"/>sat'ggol halam bay patuwa' si Debora,<l eID="gen1744" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1745"/>ya kinilā pagina'an bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen1745" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1746"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:8
verses.text: Ma waktu kapapinda bangsa Isra'il ni saga tuhan-tuhan saddī,<l eID="gen1746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1747"/>waktu isāb kat'kka bono' ma pagsōran da'ira,<l eID="gen1747" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1748"/>halam aniya' tampan atawa budjak<l eID="gen1748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1749"/>ma saga l'lla bangsa Isra'il mpat ngibu hekana.<l eID="gen1749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1750"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:9
verses.text: Akōg pangatayanku ma saga a'a Isra'il bangsahan,<l eID="gen1750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1751"/>maka ma saga a'a ya magmalilla' palamud ma pagbono'.<l eID="gen1751" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1752"/>Pudji ni si Yawe!<l eID="gen1752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1753"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:10
verses.text: Pakale kam, sasuku kam pakura' ma kura' pote',<l eID="gen1753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1754"/>ya aningkō' ma lampik pakol alingkat,<l eID="gen1754" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1755"/>beya' isāb ka'am magbabaklay ma lān,<l eID="gen1755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1756"/>kalehunbi<l eID="gen1756" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1725"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:11
verses.text: lapal saga magkakalang <lg sID="gen1757"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1758"/>ya patimuk ma atag kak'ppongan.<l eID="gen1758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1759"/>Niusul e' sigām pasal kahinangan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, kahinangan a'adil lullun,<l eID="gen1759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1760"/>niusul kahinangan saga a'a Isra'il ya aesog amono'.<l eID="gen1760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1761"/>Maglūran na saga ummat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName><l eID="gen1761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1762"/>pehē' ni tongod lawang ya pagsōran da'ira.<l eID="gen1762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1763"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:12
