verses.text: ‘O Debora, pakosog ka bo' pakosog!<l eID="gen1763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1764"/>Pakosog ka magkalang!<l eID="gen1764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1765"/>O Barak, pakuyas ka!<l eID="gen1765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1766"/>O Barak, ka'a anak si Abinowam,<l eID="gen1766" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1767"/>saggawun saga a'a bay anaggaw ka'a.’<l eID="gen1767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1768"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:13
verses.text: Sasuku takapin allum ma bangsa Isra'il<l eID="gen1768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1769"/>bay patipun ni saga pagnakura'an sigām.<l eID="gen1769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1770"/>Bay patimuk ma aku saga ummat si Yawe,<l eID="gen1770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1771"/>beya' isāb saga a'a ya aesog amono'.<l eID="gen1771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1772"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:14
verses.text: Aniya' sigām kasehe'an bay min lahat Epra'im,<l eID="gen1772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1773"/>ya bay paglahatan bangsa Amalek ma waktu tagna'.<l eID="gen1773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1774"/>Ina'an isāb saga panubu' si Benjamin<l eID="gen1774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1775"/>bay palamud ma saga a'a ya anehe'an ka'a.<l eID="gen1775" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1776"/>Aniya' saga kapitan palūd pina'an bay min Makir.<l eID="gen1776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1777"/>Aniya' isāb saga a'a Sibulun amowa tungkud kapitan.<l eID="gen1777" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1778"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:15
verses.text: Saga a'a bangsahan min bangsa Issakar bay parongan ma si Debora.<l eID="gen1778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1779"/>Aho', ina'an saga panubu' si Issakar parongan ma si Barak,<l eID="gen1779" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1780"/>magdaganan maka iya ni kapantayan.<l eID="gen1780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1781"/>Saguwā' magduwa-ruwa pikilan bangsa Rubin,<l eID="gen1781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1782"/>mbal agon makapagdakayu' gara'.<l eID="gen1782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1783"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:16
verses.text: Ka'am bangsa Rubin, angay kam bay pat'ddas ma koralanbi,<l eID="gen1783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1784"/>anaenghog tiyup-tiyup ya pangalingan a'a ma bili-bili sigām?<l eID="gen1784" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1785"/>B'nnal, aheya pagduwa-ruwabi ameya' maka mbal.<l eID="gen1785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1786"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:17
verses.text: Saga a'a Giliyad bay magpa'bba ma dambila' sapa' Jordan,<l eID="gen1786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1787"/>maka bangsa Dān bay angagad sadja ma saga kumpit.<l eID="gen1787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1788"/>Bangsa Aser isāb bay pat'ddas ma bihing tahik,<l eID="gen1788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1789"/>halam sigām bay magla'anan min deyom kalo'okan.<l eID="gen1789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1790"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:18
verses.text: Malaingkan in bangsa Sibulun bay anawakkalan kallum sigām ni pagbono'an,<l eID="gen1790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1791"/>damikiyanna isab bangsa Naptali ma kabūd-būran.<l eID="gen1791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1792"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:19
verses.text: Sakali magt'kkahan saga sultan bangsa Kana'an.<l eID="gen1792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1793"/>Pakuyas sigām magbono', apaslod pagdugpak sigām<l eID="gen1793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1794"/>ma kuta' Ta'anak ya ma bihing bohe' Megiddo,<l eID="gen1794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1795"/>saguwā' halam aniya' pangalta' bay talangpas sigām.<l eID="gen1795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1796"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:20
verses.text: Palamud isāb saga bitu'un amono' ma si Sesera.<l eID="gen1796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1797"/>Anabang saga mamahi sabu pa'in maguntasan min sobangan ni s'ddopan.<l eID="gen1797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1798"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:21
verses.text: Talaran si Sesera maka saga tendogna e' s'llog,<l eID="gen1798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1799"/>talaran sigām e' sapa' Kisun, ya sapa' bay awal gi'.<l eID="gen1799" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1800"/>Ah'llingan aku di-ku. Paesog ka, yukku, palanjal ka.<l eID="gen1800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1801"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:22
verses.text: Jari takale to'ongan tagandak saga kura' si Sesera.<l eID="gen1801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1802"/>Ina'an saga kura'na aesog magdaganan na pa'in, magdaganan.<l eID="gen1802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1803"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:23
verses.text: ‘Sapdahin saga a'a ma kauman Meros,’ yuk mala'ikat si Yawe.<l eID="gen1803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1804"/>‘Sapdahin sigām to'ongan,<l eID="gen1804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1805"/>sabab halam sigām bay palamud anganggapi' ma si Yawe,<l eID="gen1805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1806"/>halam sigām bay pagapi' ma iya angatu ma saga a'a ga'osan.’<l eID="gen1806" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1807"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:24
verses.text: Bang pa'in binarakatan si Ja'el, h'nda si Heber bangsa Kēn.<l eID="gen1807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1808"/>Bang pa'in iya binarakatan labi min kamemon kar'ndahan<l eID="gen1808" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1809"/>ya pat'nna' ma luma' tolda.<l eID="gen1809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1810"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:25
verses.text: Angamu' pa'in bohe' si Sesera, gatas ya pamuwan e' si Ja'el,<l eID="gen1810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1811"/>gatas pinapīt ni'isi ma pinggan,<l eID="gen1811" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1812"/>pinggan tōp pagi'inuman a'a bangsahan.<l eID="gen1812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1813"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:26
verses.text: Pagubus, pina'abut tanganna dambila' ni tuku tolda,<l eID="gen1813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1814"/>tanganna kowan ya pang'ntanna tukul.<l eID="gen1814" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1815"/>Jari binono' e'na si Sesera, ap'ssa' kōkna,<l eID="gen1815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1816"/>nirugsu' iya ma kīd tuktukna bo' alopot kōkna.<l eID="gen1816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1817"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:27
verses.text: Ati palukbu' iya ma dahūan tape' si Ja'el.<l eID="gen1817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1818"/>Pahantal iya maina'an,<l eID="gen1818" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1819"/>jari maina'an kamatayanna.<l eID="gen1819" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1820"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:28
verses.text: Ina'an ina' si Sesera patīk min tandawan,<l eID="gen1820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1821"/>ina'an iya ma bilikna maglemong na pa'in.<l eID="gen1821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1822"/>Magtilaw-tilawan di-na, ‘Ai bahā' makat'ggolan kalesana?<l eID="gen1822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1823"/>Angay halam gi' takaleku tagandak saga kura'na?’<l eID="gen1823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1824"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:29
verses.text: Manjari sinambungan iya e' dakayu' tendogna<l eID="gen1824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1825"/>ya aladju pikilanna min kaheka'an d'nda.<l eID="gen1825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1826"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:30
verses.text: Ya du isāb ina' si Sesera ah'llingan di-na, yukna,<l eID="gen1826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1827"/>‘Tantu sigām t'ggolan magbahagi'an pangalta' ya talangpas sigām,<l eID="gen1827" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1828"/>dakayu' atawa duwangan d'nda ma dakayu' l'lla,<l eID="gen1828" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1829"/>saga s'mmek ahalga' pamahampit si Sesera,<l eID="gen1829" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1830"/>saga s'mmek buldahan, s'mmek alutu' durukanna,<l eID="gen1830" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1831"/>pamasalay ma k'llongku.<l eID="gen1831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1832"/>Tantu aheka tataban e' sigām.’<l eID="gen1832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1833"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:31
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bang pa'in alaglag kamemon palbantahannu!<l eID="gen1833" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1834"/>Malaingkan sasuku alasahan ka'a,<l eID="gen1834" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1835"/>bang pa'in sigām asahaya sapantun mata llaw bang pasinag to'ongan.”<l eID="gen1835" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1757"/> <div eID="gen1724" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1836" type="paragraph"/> Sakali aniya' kasannangan ma paglahat inān ma deyom mpatpū' tahun.  <div eID="gen1836" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.5"/> <div eID="gen1723" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1052"/><div sID="gen1837" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Gidiyun</title> <div sID="gen1838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1052"/> Pabalik na isab saga bangsa Isra'il maghinang kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, angkan sigām pinasagaran e'na gina'os e' bangsa Midiyan ma deyom pituntahun.

verses.name: Judges 6:2
verses.text: Ma sabab kabisa pamissoko' bangsa Midiyan, makalahi saga bangsa Isra'il ni kabūd-būran bo' angahinangan di-sigām kubu'-kubu' ma saga songab batu maka ma saga tapukan ya ahunit sinōd.

verses.name: Judges 6:3
verses.text: Tiyap-tiyap sigām ananom, magtūy sinōd paglahat sigām e' saga bangsa Midiyan, bangsa Amalek maka saga bangsa kasehe'an bay min sobangan.

verses.name: Judges 6:4
verses.text: Kapagpustuhan e' bangsa liyu inān saga tana' ya pananoman bangsa Isra'il ta'abut sampay ni lahat Gasa. Jari pinaka'at ai-ai bay tinanom e' bangsa Isra'il ati halam aniya' kinapinan pagkakan sigām. Pinagā' isāb kamemon saga bili-bili, sapi' maka saga kura' ya suku' bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 6:5
verses.text: Angulatap saga bangsa liyu inān pehē' ni tana' Isra'il, sapantun heka ampan dulu. Tabowa saga kahayopan sigām maka ba'anan luma' sigām tolda. Mbal agon taitung heka puhu' maka unta' ya bay pat'kka ni lahat e' bo' supaya ta'agaw ka'lluman a'a Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 6:6
verses.text: Jari magkamiskinan bangsa Isra'il e' bangsa Midiyan angkan sigām parahing angamu' tabang ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.  <div eID="gen1838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1053"/><div sID="gen1839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1053"/> Pagga sigām bay parahing ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma pasalan bangsa Midiyan,

verses.name: Judges 6:8
verses.text: bay sigām pinabeya'an dakayu' nabi. Ah'lling nabi inān, yukna, “Ya itu pangallam si Yawe ya pagtuhananbi, yukna, ‘Bay kam bowaku paluwas min lahat Misil, ya lahat bay pamanyaga'an ka'am.

verses.name: Judges 6:9
verses.text: Bay kam paluwasku min pang'ntan bangsa Misil maka min komkoman saga a'a amissoko' ka'am. Bay t'ggalku saga bantabi maka bay pamuwanku ni ka'am lahat sigām.

verses.name: Judges 6:10
verses.text: Bay sa kam haka'anku, yukku, “Aku si Yawe ya pagtuhananbi. Da'a kam anumba ni saga tuhan-tuhan bangsa Amor, ya bay tag-suku'an lahat pat'nna'anbi ilu.” Saguwā' halam aku bay ikutbi.’ ”  <div eID="gen1839" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1054"/><div sID="gen1840" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1054"/> Manjari at'kka mala'ikat si Yawe ni lahat Opra bo' aningkō' ma sindungan po'on kayu aheya, ya suku' si Jowas a'a min bangsa Abe'eser. Ina'an isāb anakna l'lla ya niōnan si Gidiyun anganggi'ikan pai-tirigu ma deyom pagp'gga'an buwa' anggul. Mahē' iya maggi'ik bo' mbal ta'nda' e' bangsa Midiyan.

verses.name: Judges 6:12
verses.text: Magpa'nda' pa'in mala'ikat ma si Gidiyun, yukna, “Ka'a ya bobono'un aesog maka akosog, pataptap si Yawe ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen1840" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1055"/><div sID="gen1841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1055"/> Ya sambung si Gidiyun, “Tuwan, bang si Yawe b'nnal pataptap ma kami, angay kami pinat'kkahan ba'anan saga pakaradja'an itu? Angay kami halam pina'nda'an saga hinang kainu-inuhan ya pinagsuli-suli e' kamatto'ahan kami? Bay kono' sigām binowa e' si Yawe paluwas min lahat Misil. Saguwā' ma buwattina'an, siniya-siya kami e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bo' tinugutan ni komkoman bangsa Midiyan.”  <div eID="gen1841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1056"/><div sID="gen1842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1056"/> Palingi' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bo' ah'lling ni si Gidiyun, yuk-i, “Pehē' na ka, gunahun kosognu ati lappasun bangsa Isra'il min ga'osan bangsa Midiyan. Aku ya anoho' ka'a.”  <div eID="gen1842" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1057"/><div sID="gen1843" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1057"/> Atilaw si Gidiyun, yukna, “Aho' panghū', sagō' buwattingga e'ku angalappas bangsa kami Isra'il? Sabab ma panubu' Manasse, in pangkatan kami ya halam to'ongan aniya' ga'osna. Maka aku itu areyo' to'ongan ma kakampungan kami.”  <div eID="gen1843" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1058"/><div sID="gen1844" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1058"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Pabeya' du aku ma ka'a ati talaglagnu kamemon saga bangsa Midiyan buwat e'nu amono' a'a dangan.”  <div eID="gen1844" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1059"/><div sID="gen1845" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1059"/> Anambung si Gidiyun, “Na, bang hati ka kasulutan ma aku, buwanin aku paltanda'an in ka'a to'ongan amissala ni aku.

verses.name: Judges 6:18
verses.text: Da'a busung, da'a lagi' ka ala'an sampay aku makabalik pi'itu amowa tutukbalan pangahulmatku ka'a.” <div eID="gen1845" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1846" type="paragraph"/> Yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, “Na, lagaranta pa'in ka sampay ka makabalik pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen1846" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1060"/><div sID="gen1847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1060"/> Sakali pehē' na si Gidiyun ni luma' bo' angadjal kambing abata'. Angaddun isāb iya saga nnom gantang tirigu nihinang tinapay halam pasuligna. Atahak pa'in, ni'isi e'na isi sumbali'an ma ambung, maka loho'na ni'isi ma kaldero bo' yampa bowana panghulmat mala'ikat Tuhan ya ma sindungan kayu.  <div eID="gen1847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1061"/><div sID="gen1848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1061"/> Jari yuk mala'ikat ni iya, “Ngā'un isi sumbali'an maka tinapay halam pasuligna bo' pat'nna'un ma batu itu, ati bu'usin loho'.” Bineya' magtūy e' si Gidiyun.

verses.name: Judges 6:21
verses.text: Jari niabut sumbali'an maka tinapay inān maka tōng tungkud ya ma tangan mala'ikat si Yawe. Saru'un-du'un pasuleyab api luwas min batu inān, ati atunu' kamemon bay tabowa e' si Gidiyun. Alanyap isāb mala'ikat si Yawe.  <div eID="gen1848" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1062"/><div sID="gen1849" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1062"/> Tata'u pa'in e' si Gidiyun mala'ikat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay papa'nda' ni iya, magtūy iya amanyabut, “Arōy, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa! Bay aku makapagbaihu' maka mala'ikatnu!”  <div eID="gen1849" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1063"/><div sID="gen1850" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1063"/> Saguwā' amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni iya, yuk-i, “Pahantap ka! Da'a ka tināw, mbal du ka amatay.”

verses.name: Judges 6:24
verses.text: Jari aniya' batu tinambak e' si Gidiyun maina'an pagtutukbalan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, niōnan e'na ‘Si Yawe ya Kasannangan.’ Ina'an masi sampay ni buwattina'an ma Opra ya ma tana' bangsa Ebe'eser.  <div eID="gen1850" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1064"/><div sID="gen1851" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1064"/> Na, ma sangom he'-i du, amissala <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ni si Gidiyun, “Angā' ka dakayu' sapi' pituntahun umulna min saga sapi' mma'nu ya pasunu' kahāpna min kasehe'an. Pagā'nu, langkatun pagtutukbalan ya pasumbahan mma'nu ni tuhan-tuhan Ba'al, maka pōngun isāb hāg si Asera ya ma bihing ina'an-i.

verses.name: Judges 6:26
verses.text: Talangkat pa'in, angahinang ka pagtutukbalan ya tōp panumbahan si Yawe ya pagtuhanannu. Hinangun mailu ma diyata' būd-būd itu. Ngā'un hāg tuhan-tuhan Asera ya bay pinagpōng-pōng, panunu' sapi' ya pasunu' kahāpna ilu pagkulbannu ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen1851" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1065"/><div sID="gen1852" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1065"/> Angkan si Gidiyun bay amowa sangpū' puhu' ya sosoho'anna bo' bineya' e'na bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya. Bo' arapun nihinang e'na ma waktu sangom sabab tināw iya ma saga kampungna maka saga a'a maglahat ma kauman inān.  <div eID="gen1852" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1066"/><div sID="gen1853" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1066"/> Pagsubu, magbati'an pa'in saga a'a maglahat maina'an, takuddat sigām pagga alubu na pagtutukbalan ni si Ba'al, maka hāg si Asera ya ma bihingna bay pinuwad, maka in sapi' karuwana bay na pangungsud ma pagtutukbalan ya baha'u nihinang.

verses.name: Judges 6:29
verses.text: Jari magtilaw-tilawan sigām di-sigām, “Sai bay magkahinangan itu?” Tapariksa' pa'in saga a'a pasal palkala' itu, tata'u na in si Gidiyun anak si Jowas ya bay magkahinangan.  <div eID="gen1853" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1067"/><div sID="gen1854" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1067"/> Magtūy pinalinganan si Jowas, sinō' pinaluwas anakna, sabab yuk sigām, “Patut iya pinapatay sabab talangkat e'na pagtutukbalan ni si Ba'al, maka tapuwad e'na hāg si Asera ya bay ma bihing pagtutukbalan e'.”  <div eID="gen1854" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1068"/><div sID="gen1855" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1068"/> Saguwā' sinambungan pakosog e' si Jowas saga a'a bilahi amapatay si Gidiyun, “Angay dapitanbi si Ba'al? Bilahi kam angalappas iya? Sasuku anganggapi' iya subay pinapatay salung subu! Bang b'nnal tuhan si Ba'al, makarapitan iya di-na bang aniya' ganta' amaka'at lugal pagtutukbalan ma iya.”

verses.name: Judges 6:32
verses.text: Angkan ma llaw he'-i du in si Gidiyun niōnan e' sigām Jerub-Ba'al ma sabab pangalangkatna ma lugal pagtutukbalan si Ba'al. Ya sambatan sigām, “Pasagaranta si Ba'al angandapitan di-na.”  <div eID="gen1855" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1069"/><div sID="gen1856" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1069"/> Na ma waktu ina'an, magsakaum bangsa Midiyan maka bangsa Amalek maka saga bangsa kasehe'an ya min lahat sobangan ati pauntas sigām kamemon min dambila' sapa' Jordan bo' magpustu ma kapantayan Jesde'el.

verses.name: Judges 6:34
verses.text: Jari pahōp Rū Yawe ma si Gidiyun, angkan iya bay amah'lling tiyup-tiyup pangalinganna ma saga panubu' Abe'eser sinō' ameya' ma iya.

verses.name: Judges 6:35
verses.text: Aniya' isāb saga sosoho'an bay pinapehē' e' si Gidiyun amasaplag bissala ma bangsa Manasse, sinō' magtakos. Pinasaplagan isāb bangsa Aser, Sibulun maka Naptali, jari ya du sigām bay pasakaum ma disi Gidiyun.  <div eID="gen1856" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1070"/><div sID="gen1857" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1070"/> Yuk si Gidiyun ni Tuhan, “Bang b'nnal in aku gunanu angalappas bangsa Isra'il ma buwat bay janji'nu,

verses.name: Judges 6:37
verses.text: na, amat'nna' aku bulbul bili-bili ma lugal paggi'ikan pai-tirigu. Bang hal bulbul ya abase' e' alu', ati atoho' tana' ya ma sakalibutna, minnē' kata'uwanku aku ya gunanu angalappas bangsa Isra'il buwat bay pangallamnu.”

verses.name: Judges 6:38
verses.text: Jari buwattē' ya kapaniya'na. Pagk'llat subu, dai'-dai' llaw gi', abati' na si Gidiyun. Piniyutan e'na bulbul bili-bili ati ap'nno' dapinggan e' bohe' alu'.  <div eID="gen1857" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1071"/><div sID="gen1858" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1071"/> Aniya' gi' pah'lling si Gidiyun ma Tuhan, yukna, “Da'a busung. Da'a pa'in ap'ddi' ataynu ma aku pagka aniya' gi' amu'ku ni ka'a. Tugutin lagi' aku amiha dakayu' paltanda'an ma bulbul bili-bili itu. Ma waktu itu, kabaya'anku subay tana' ya abase' e' alu' ati bulbul bili-bili ya atoho'.”

verses.name: Judges 6:40
verses.text: Jari ma sangom du he', tahinang e' Tuhan buwat bay pangamu' e' si Gidiyun. Hal bulbul bili-bili ya atoho'. Ya tana' ma sakalibutna inān abase' kamemon e' alu'.  <div eID="gen1858" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.6"/> <div eID="gen1837" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1072"/><div sID="gen1859" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tara'ug e' si Gidiyun saga A'a Midiyan</title> <div sID="gen1860" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1072"/> Jari dai' llaw pa'in, magpustu si Jerub-Ba'al (ya na si Gidiyun) maka kamemon saga a'ana ma atag dakayu' tigbaw ya niōnan Harod. Ina'an isāb bangsa Midiyan magpustu tampal ni uttala', ma kapantayan ya asekot ni būd More.

verses.name: Judges 7:2
verses.text: Yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ni si Gidiyun, “Mbal ka tapara'ugku min bangsa Midiyan sabab aheka makalandu' saga a'anu. Bang kam ganta' anganda'ug ma buwattilu hekabi, ya aniya' magmalangkahi kam in kosogbi ya sababan angkan kam anganda'ug.

verses.name: Judges 7:3
verses.text: Angkanna ka soho'ku amatanyagan saga a'anu buwattina'an. Ya yuknu ma sigām, ‘Sasuku kam tināw maka nileya'-leya' makajari ala'an min būd Giliyad itu bo' amole'.’ ” Jari aniya' duwampū' karuwa ngibu saga a'a bay ala'an, ati sangpū' ngibu la'a ya takapin.  <div eID="gen1860" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1073"/><div sID="gen1861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1073"/> Saguwā' yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni si Gidiyun, “Masi gi' kam aheka makalandu'. Bowahun saga a'anu ilu palūd ni tigbaw, ati mahē' aku amene' bang sai ya ameya' maka mbal. Bang yukku, ‘A'a itu subay ameya' ma ka'a’, na ameya' iya. Saguwā' bang yukku, ‘A'a itu subay mbal ameya'’, na, da'a pabeya'un.”  <div eID="gen1861" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1074"/><div sID="gen1862" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1074"/> Jari binowa e' si Gidiyun saga a'ana palūd ni tigbaw, ati maina'an iya kinallaman e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yuk-i, “Hinangun sigām duwa tumpuk. Ma tumpuk dakayu' saga a'a ya anginum min tangan sigām, hatina d'lla' sigām ni bohe' buwat ero'. Ma tumpuk dakayu' isāb saga a'a ya angōk-tu'ut bo' anginum.”

verses.name: Judges 7:6
verses.text: Jari t'llu hatus a'a ya angakup bohe' bo' anginum. Ya kasehe'an wa'i angōk-tu'ut anginum.  <div eID="gen1862" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1075"/><div sID="gen1863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1075"/> Pagubus, yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni si Gidiyun, “Gunaku saga t'llu hatus a'a ya bay anginum min tangan sigām ilu, ati lappasta kam maka buwananta kam da'ugan min saga a'a Midiyan. Soho'un saga a'a kasehe'an ilu amole' ni kalahatan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya.”

verses.name: Judges 7:8
verses.text: Jari tinimuk e' si Gidiyun ba'anan balanja' maka tiyup-tiyup ya bay ma saga bangsa Isra'il kasehe'an bo' yampa sigām papole'na. Sagō', in t'llu hatus a'a bay magpa'bba ma iya sampay ya bay tatimuk e'. <div eID="gen1863" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1864" type="paragraph"/> Jari ya pustu bangsa Midiyan ina'an ma l'bbak būd ma kapantayan.

verses.name: Judges 7:9
verses.text: Ma sangom du inān, yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Gidiyun, “Punduk ka bo' ka pehē' parugpak ni pustu inān sabab para'ugku ka min sigām.

verses.name: Judges 7:10
verses.text: Saguwā' bang ka tināw amono', bowahun tendognu si Pura panehe'.

verses.name: Judges 7:11
verses.text: Taenghogin bang ai pagsuli-sulihan sigām. Minnē' ka anawakkal parugpak ni pustu.” Angkanna palūd si Gidiyun maka tendogna si Pura pehē' ni pagjajagahan ma tōng pustu.

verses.name: Judges 7:12
verses.text: Na, angulatap saga bangsa Midiyan maka bangsa Amalek maka ba'anan bangsa kasehe' ya bay min lahat sobangan. Ina'an sigām ma kapantayan, sali' sapantun ampan dulu ya heka sigām. Ya unta' sigām isāb mbal ta'ambat ni'itung, buwat sapantun gusung ma bihing tampe.  <div eID="gen1864" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1076"/><div sID="gen1865" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1076"/> Pagt'kka pa'in si Gidiyun, magsalta' takalena dangan a'a magsuli-suli maka bagayna pasal uppina. Yuk dangan itu, “Aniya' dansolag tinapay atibulung bay tauppiku. In tinapay itu bay pagulung ni t'ngnga' pustu Midiyan bo' parugtul ni luma' tolda. Landu' akosog hamiyuna angkan abulangkayat tolda inān sampay ah'bba'.”  <div eID="gen1865" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1077"/><div sID="gen1866" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1077"/> Anambung bagayna, “Ā, tantu halam aniya' ma'anana saddī. Kalis si Gidiyun ko' ilu, ya anak si Jowas a'a bangsa Isra'il. Pinara'ug iya e' Tuhan min bangsa Midiyan ati ma iya na pustu itu maka saga a'ana.”  <div eID="gen1866" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1078"/><div sID="gen1867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1078"/> Takale pa'in e' si Gidiyun suli-suli itu pasal uppi maka ma'anana, pinudji e'na Tuhan, ati pabalik iya ni pustu Isra'il maka e'na angalingan, yuk-i, “Magsakap kam! Ma waktu itu pinara'ug kitam e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min bangsa Midiyan ati makani-kitam in pustu sigām.”

verses.name: Judges 7:16
verses.text: Jari binahagi' t'llu e' si Gidiyun saga a'ana, dahatus hekana ma datumpuk. Aniya' isāb tiyup-tiyup tanduk kambing bay pat'nna'na ma saga a'a inān dangan-parangan, maka kibut halam isihan maka isāb suwariyan.

verses.name: Judges 7:17
verses.text: Pagubus, yukna ma sigām, “Nda'unbi aku maka beya'unbi bang ai hinangku. Pagt'kkaku ni bihing pustu, sengorinbi aku.

verses.name: Judges 7:18
verses.text: Libutunbi pustu inān, jari bang takalebi aku maka saga sehe'ku amah'lling tiyup-tiyup kami, ameya'-meya' kam amah'lling saga tiyup-tiyupbi. Angolang kam pakosog isāb, yukbi, ‘Ma si Yawe maka si Gidiyun.’ ”  <div eID="gen1867" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1079"/><div sID="gen1868" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1079"/> Jari atonga' pa'in bahangi, at'kka na si Gidiyun maka saga a'a karahatus hekana pehē' ni tobtoban pustu, hinabu baha'u bay magganti' saga jaga. Magtūy tiniyup e' disi Gidiyun saga tiyup-tiyup, maka nilopot isāb saga kibut ya bay bowa sigām.

verses.name: Judges 7:20
verses.text: Magsabu in t'llu tumpukan bangsa Isra'il amah'lling tiyup-tiyup maka angalopot saga kibut. Tangan sigām gibang ya pang'ntan suwariyan, maka tangan kowan ya pang'ntan sigām tiyup-tiyup. Jari angolang sigām patanog, “Kalis si Yawe! Kalis si Gidiyun!”

verses.name: Judges 7:21
verses.text: Sakali itu, hinabu patanam saga a'a Isra'il ma katilibut pustu, maglahian kamemon a'a Midiyan maka e' sigām magpangolang.  <div eID="gen1868" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1080"/><div sID="gen1869" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1080"/> Pagh'lling pa'in saga tiyup-tiyup t'llu hatus hekana, pinapagatu e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe saga a'a Midiyan ma kaluha'an pustu ati magbono'-biyono'i sigām dampagkahian. Maglahian sigām sampay ni kauman Bet-Sita tampal ni Serera, sampay ta'abut isāb tobtoban lahat Abel Mehola ya asekot ni Tabat.

verses.name: Judges 7:23
verses.text: Jari pinalinganan saga a'a Isra'il ya min bangsa Naptali maka Aser, maka min kamemon bangsa Manasse, sinō' angapas<note>Angapas: ‘anurul’ bang ma kasehe'an.</note> bangsa Midiyan.

verses.name: Judges 7:24
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' saga sosoho'an pinapehē' e' si Gidiyun ni kabūd-būran lahat Epra'im bo' ah'lling ni saga a'a maina'an, yuk-i, “Palūd kam ni sapa' Jordan ma atag kaluma'an Bet-Bara ati hapa'inbi saga a'a Midiyan bo' mbal makauntas.” Magtūy bineya' panoho'an si Gidiyun ati maglūran bangsa Epra'im ni sapa' Jordan anunggu'an labayan sampay ni Bet-Bara.

verses.name: Judges 7:25
verses.text: Tasaggaw isāb e' sigām duwa a'a pagnakura'an bangsa Midiyan ya niōnan si Oreb maka si Se'eb. Si Oreb bay pinapatay e' sigām ma dakayu' batu, ya niōnan Batu si Oreb, maka si Se'eb bay pinapatay ma pagp'gga'an buwa' anggul, ya niōnan Pagp'gga'an si Se'eb. Pagubus, tinurul na pa'in saga bangsa Midiyan e' bangsa Epra'im. Pinonggolan e' sigām kōk si Oreb maka si Se'eb bo' binowa ni si Gidiyun, ya ina'an lagi' ma bihing sapa' Jordan.  <div eID="gen1869" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.7"/> <div eID="gen1859" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1081"/><div sID="gen1870" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Seba maka si Salmunna</title> <div sID="gen1871" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1081"/> Na, atilaw saga a'a Epra'im ni si Gidiyun, yuk-i, “Angay kami mbal pagaddatannu? Angay kami halam bay palinganannu ma waktu kapehē'bi magbono' maka bangsa Midiyan?” Ati sinoway e' sigām si Gidiyun.  <div eID="gen1871" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1082"/><div sID="gen1872" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1082"/> Saguwā' ya sambungna ni sigām, “Mbal makasali' ai-ai bay tahinangku ni bay tahinangbi. Aheya lagi' kahāpan ya kapin buwa' anggul tapuwa' ma lahat Epra'im min kamemon pungutan buwa' anggul ya tak'ttu' e' bangsa Abise'er.

verses.name: Judges 8:3
verses.text: Bay kam pinara'ug e' Tuhan ati tasaggawbi si Oreb maka si Se'eb, duwangan nakura' bangsa Midiyan. Mbal makasali' ya tahinangku ni bay tahinangbi.” Minnē' ala'an kagit atay sigām ma si Gidiyun.  <div eID="gen1872" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1083"/><div sID="gen1873" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1083"/> Na, apaya si Gidiyun maka saga a'ana t'llu hatus hekana, sagō' sinandalan na pa'in e' sigām bang pa'in ta'apas saga banta sigām. Maka'abut pa'in sigām ni sapa' Jordan, magtūy sigām pauntas parambila'.

verses.name: Judges 8:5
verses.text: Ma dambila' pa'in, yuk si Gidiyun ni saga a'a Sokkot, “Buwaninbi tinapay saga sundaluku itu. Apaya sigām sabab masi kami angapas si Seba maka si Salmunna, ya sultan bangsa Midiyan.”  <div eID="gen1873" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1084"/><div sID="gen1874" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1084"/> Saguwā' ah'lling saga pagnakura'an ma Sokkot, yuk-i, “Halam gi' tasaggawbi si Seba maka si Salmunna angkan kami mbal amuwan tinapay ma saga sundalunu.”  <div eID="gen1874" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1085"/><div sID="gen1875" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1085"/> Angkan anambung si Gidiyun, yukna, “Pagga buwattē', bang aku karūlan na e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> anaggaw si Seba maka si Salmunna, gilay-gilayku baranbi maka saga kayu itingan ya tapuwa' ma paslangan.”  <div eID="gen1875" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1086"/><div sID="gen1876" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1086"/> Pagla'an minnē', palanjal sigām ni Peniyēl ati binalikan e' si Gidiyun bay pangamu'na dahū ma a'a Sokkot. Saguwā' ya lling a'a Peniyēl ma si Gidiyun sali' du maka buwat bay lling a'a Sokkot.

verses.name: Judges 8:9
verses.text: Angkan sinambungan saga a'a Peniyēl inān e' si Gidiyun, yukna, “Bang kami makara'ug, pabalik du kami pi'itu angalubu pamantawanbi itu.”  <div eID="gen1876" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1087"/><div sID="gen1877" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1087"/> Na, si Seba maka si Salmunna wa'i ma lahat Karkor maka sundalu sigām saga sangpū' kalima ngibu hekana. Luwal sigām ya takapin ma kamemon saga a'a sobangan. Aniya' saga dahatus maka duwampū' ngibu a'a sigām magtakos kalis bay tapapatay e' disi Gidiyun.

verses.name: Judges 8:11
verses.text: Jari magtukaran disi Gidiyun labay min lān palabayan saga a'a maglilitu. In lān inān asal ma jadjahan lahat Noba maka Jogbeya, tampal ni sobangan. Pataggaha', tarugpak bangsa Midiyan e' disi Gidiyun.

verses.name: Judges 8:12
verses.text: Makalahi si Seba maka si Salmunna, ya duwangan sultan bangsa Midiyan, saguwā' niapas na pa'in e' disi Gidiyun sampay tasaggaw na. Arimpulag isāb ba'anan saga sundalu sigām.  <div eID="gen1877" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1088"/><div sID="gen1878" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1088"/> Pagubus, si Gidiyun anak si Jowas pabalik na min pagbono'an labay min lān ma llot būd, ya niōnan Lān Heres.

verses.name: Judges 8:14
verses.text: Aniya' a'a Sokkot, onde' baha'u, tasaggaw e' si Gidiyun maina'an. Sinoho' iya anulat ōn a'a ya pagnakura'an ma kauman Sokkot. Jari pitumpū' ka pitu' ōn saga pagmatto'ahan ya tasulat.

verses.name: Judges 8:15
verses.text: Pagubus, pehē' si Gidiyun ah'lling ni saga a'a Sokkot, “Itiya' na si Seba maka si Salmunna ya bay pagtunggīnganbi aku ma bay yukbi, ‘Halam gi' tasaggawbi si Seba maka si Salmunna, angkan kami mbal amuwan tinapay ni saga sundalunu magpayahan.’ ”

verses.name: Judges 8:16
verses.text: Sakali saga pagmatto'ahan ma kauman Sokkot inān bay niraplosan e' si Gidiyun maka kayu itingan ya patomo' ma paslangan. Minnē' amintāng saga kal'llahan ma lahat Sokkot.

verses.name: Judges 8:17
verses.text: Nilubu isāb e' si Gidiyun ya pamantawan ma kauman Peniyēl, maka pinapatay isāb saga kal'llahanna ma kauman inān.  <div eID="gen1878" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1089"/><div sID="gen1879" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1089"/> Pagubus, tinilaw e'na si Seba maka si Salmunna, “Buwattingga luwa saga kal'llahan bay tapapataybi ma Tabor?” <div eID="gen1879" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1880" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Kal'llahan buwat ka'a, pangluwahan balbangsa.”  <div eID="gen1880" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1090"/><div sID="gen1881" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1090"/> Yuk sambung si Gidiyun, “Saga danakanku lissi ko' he', da-ina' kami. Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe ya Tuhan kakkal salama-lama, bang sigām halam bay tapataybi, mbal du kam papatayku.”

verses.name: Judges 8:20
verses.text: Magtūy lingi'na si Jeter ya anakna kasiyakahan, “Papatayun sigām itu!” yukna. Saguwā' halam bay nihublut e' si Jeter kalisna, tu'ud iya tināw sabab masi gi' iya abata'.  <div eID="gen1881" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1091"/><div sID="gen1882" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1091"/> Yuk si Seba maka si Salmunna ni si Gidiyun, “Dai' ka, ka'a ya amapatay. Kalu takole'nu bang aniya' isāb kosognu.” Angkan pasōng si Gidiyun ni dahūan amapatay sigām. Ningā' isāb e'na saga pamulawan ya pama'alti k'llong unta' sigām.  <div eID="gen1882" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1870" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1092"/><div sID="gen1883" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Epod si Gidiyun</title> <div sID="gen1884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1092"/> Yuk saga bangsa Isra'il ni si Gidiyun, “Ka'a na pagnakura'an kami, ka'a maka anak-mpunu, sabab bay kami lappasnu min komkoman saga a'a Midiyan.”  <div eID="gen1884" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1093"/><div sID="gen1885" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1093"/> Saguwā' mbal si Gidiyun. Ya sambungna ma sigām, “Mbal kam pagnakura'anku, damikiyanna isab anakku. <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya magnakura'an ka'am.”

verses.name: Judges 8:24
verses.text: Maka yukna gi', “Aniya' dakayu' amu'ku ni ka'am dangan-parangan. Buwaninbi aku aretes min lalangpasan bay tahampitbi.” (Ya addat saga a'a Isma'il magaretes bulawan.)  <div eID="gen1885" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1094"/><div sID="gen1886" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1094"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Aho'. Amuwan kami.” Angkan bin'llat e' sigām dakayu' juba, ati dangan-parangan angalarukan aretes min bay pamahagi' ma iya.

verses.name: Judges 8:26
verses.text: Ya buhat saga aretes bulawan bay ta'amu'na, sangpū' ka pitu' hatus sekel, halam gi' beya' saga pamulawan pangalti maka saga tonton engkot k'llong. Saddī isab saga kakana' taluk ya pinagpakay e' kasultanan Midiyan, maka saga kili-kili bulawan ya ma k'llong saga unta' sigām.

verses.name: Judges 8:27
verses.text: In kamemon bulawan bay pinahinang epod e' si Gidiyun pinat'nna' e'na ma Opra, ya kauman palahatanna. Sakali kamemon saga bangsa Isra'il pataikut min Tuhan bo' anumba pina'an ni epod, ati tahinang itu sasat ma pagtali'anak si Gidiyun.  <div eID="gen1886" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1883" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1095"/><div sID="gen1887" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Gidiyun</title> <div sID="gen1888" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1095"/> Buwattē' kahālan bay paniya' ma bangsa Midiyan, tara'ug sigām e' bangsa Isra'il ati halam na sigām maka'atu pabalik. Ma waktu bay kallum si Gidiyun, aniya' mpatpū' tahun ya t'ggol kasannangan ma paglahat.  <div eID="gen1888" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1096"/><div sID="gen1889" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1096"/> Ya katapusanna, si Jerub-Ba'al ya anak si Jowas amole' na ni lahatna.

verses.name: Judges 8:30
verses.text: Aheka kah'nda'anna ati aniya' pitumpū' anakna l'lla.

verses.name: Judges 8:31
verses.text: Ya h'nda-h'ndana pat'nna' ma Sekem, bay anganak l'lla ati niōnan e'na si Abimelek.

verses.name: Judges 8:32
verses.text: Sakali si Gidiyun anak si Jowas, amatay ma kato'ana maka kinubul ma bay pangubulan mma'na ma kauman Opra ya suku' bangsa Abe'eser.  <div eID="gen1889" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1097"/><div sID="gen1890" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1097"/> Halam lagi' at'ggol kapatay si Gidiyun, pabalik na isab saga bangsa Isra'il pataikut min Tuhan bo' pasumba ni saga tuhan-tuhan Ba'al. Ba'al-Berit ya tahinang pagtuhanan sigām,

verses.name: Judges 8:34
verses.text: ati takalipat e' sigām si Yawe ya pagtuhanan sigām luggiya', ya bay angalappas sigām min pang'ntanan saga palbantahan sigām paruruwambila'.

verses.name: Judges 8:35
verses.text: Halam isāb ama'nda' kahāpan ni tautai'-anak si Jerub-Ba'al (ya na si Gidiyun) ma pasal kamemon kahāpan ya bay tahinangna ma sigām.  <div eID="gen1890" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.8"/> <div eID="gen1887" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1098"/><div sID="gen1891" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Abimelek</title> <div sID="gen1892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1098"/> Manjari itu, si Abimelek, dakayu' anak si Gidiyun l'lla, bay pehē' ni da'ira Sekem anibaw saga si'itna ya danakan ina'na l'lla. Amissala iya ni saga si'itna maka ni kaukampungan ina'na, yuk-i,

verses.name: Judges 9:2
verses.text: “Tilawunbi saga a'a lahat Sekem itu bang sai ya kabaya'an sigām magnakura'. Ingga ahāp magnakura' ma ka'am, saga kapitumpū' anak si Jerub-Ba'al atawa dakayu' a'a sadja? Entomunbi, in aku itu lissi lahasiya'bi.”  <div eID="gen1892" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1099"/><div sID="gen1893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1099"/> Na, bay pa'in bissala itu tapangahaka e' saga si'itna ni kamemon saga maglalahat ma Sekem, si Abimelek ya tapene' pagnakura'an sigām sabab in iya lahasiya' sigām lissi.

verses.name: Judges 9:4
verses.text: Jari pamuwan e' sigām ma si Abimelek pitumpū' sekel dī pilak luwas bay min langgal Ba'al-Beret, ati ginuna itu e'na panamba saga a'a bula'ug tahinang tendogna.

verses.name: Judges 9:5
verses.text: Pagubus, pehē' iya ni luma' mma'na ma Opra ati maina'an, ma dakayu' batu, pinapatay e'na saga danakanna kapitumpū'. Si Jerub-Ba'al ya mma' sigām kamemon. Malaingkan si Jotam, ya kasiyalihan, bay makalahi patapuk.

verses.name: Judges 9:6
verses.text: Sakali magsakaum kamemon saga a'a Sekem maka Bet-Milo ma atag po'on kayu aheya ma da'ira Sekem inān bo' amat'nna' si Abimelek magsultan ma sigām.  <div eID="gen1893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1100"/><div sID="gen1894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1100"/> Kahaka'an pa'in si Jotam ma pasalan itu-i, patukad iya ni puttuk būd Gerisim ati angolang ni saga a'a Sekem, yukna, “Owa', ka'am maglalahat ma Sekem ilu, kalehunbi paralilanku itu bo' supaya kam kinale e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Judges 9:8
verses.text: Dakayu' llaw, saga po'on kayu bay maggara' amiha kayu pagsultanan sigām. Yuk sigām ni po'on kayu jaitun, ‘Dai' ka magsultanan kami.’  <div eID="gen1894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1101"/><div sID="gen1895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1101"/> “Saguwā' yuk sambung kayu jaitun, ‘Angay? Bbahanku bahā' hinangku maghinang ns'llanku, ya ginuna pamaheya ma saga tuhan maka ma manusiya', bo' supaya aku tahinang alanga min ka'am saga kakayu-kayuhan?’  <div eID="gen1895" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1102"/><div sID="gen1896" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1102"/> “Pasunu', ah'lling saga po'on kayu itu ni dampo'on kayu igira, yuk-i, ‘Dai' ka magsultanan kami.’  <div eID="gen1896" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1103"/><div sID="gen1897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1103"/> “Saguwā' yuk sambung kayu igira, ‘Angay? Bbahanku bahā' buwa'ku ahāp maka amamis itu, bo' supaya aku tahinang alanga min ka'am saga kakayu-kayuhan?’  <div eID="gen1897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1104"/><div sID="gen1898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1104"/> “Ah'lling isāb saga po'on kayu itu ni tinanom anggul, yuk-i, ‘Dai' ka magsultanan kami.’  <div eID="gen1898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1105"/><div sID="gen1899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1105"/> “Ya sambung tinanom anggul, ‘Angay? Bbahanku bahā' binu-anggulku, ya makapalasig atay katuhanan maka manusiya', supaya aku palanga min kakayu-kayuhan kasehe'?’  <div eID="gen1899" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1106"/><div sID="gen1900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1106"/> “Ma kahinapusanna, ah'lling saga po'on kayu ni dampo'on kayu itingan, ‘Na, ka'a na ya magsultanan kami.’  <div eID="gen1900" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1107"/><div sID="gen1901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1107"/> “Anambung kayu itingan itu, yukna, ‘Bang aku to'ongan ya pene'bi magsultanan ka'am, pi'itu kam pasindung ma lambungku. Sagō' bang ngga'i ka aku, na, bang pa'in pasuleyab api min saga sangaku bo' magtautunu' saga po'on kayu sidro<note>Kayu sidro: po'on kayu ahāp kayuna pangahinang luma' atawa kappal. ‘Cedar’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ya ma kabūran Lebanon.’ ”  <div eID="gen1901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1108"/><div sID="gen1902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1108"/> Amissala gi' si Jotam, yukna, “Kira-kirahunbi. Abontol bahā' itikadbi ma kapangahinangbi si Abimelek magsultanan ka'am? Ahāp ka niyatbi? Taluwa' bahā' ya bay hinangbi ma mma'ku si Jerub-Ba'al maka saga panganakna? Ahāp bahā' panungbasbi ma iya ma bay kahinanganna ma ka'am?

verses.name: Judges 9:17
verses.text: Marai' halam taentombi bay hinang mma'ku ma pasalanbi, waktu kapangatuna ma bangsa Midiyan. Bay panūk kallumna supaya kam kaliyusan min komkoman sigām.

verses.name: Judges 9:18
verses.text: Saguwā' buwattina'an, bantahanbi panubu' mma'ku pagka papataybi saga anakna l'lla pitumpū' hekana. Bay papataybi ma dakayu' batu ma saukat si Abimelek ya kampungbi, ati tahinangbi iya magsultanan saga a'a Sekem. Bo' arapun in si Abimelek ilu hal anak ata ya bay h'nda-h'nda mma'ku.

verses.name: Judges 9:19
verses.text: Na, bang b'nnal to'ongan abontol itikadbi maka asaltun niyatbi tudju ni si Jerub-Ba'al magtautai'-anak, mura-murahan bang pa'in pagkōg-koyaganbi si Abimelek. Damikiyanna isāb ka'am ya pagkōganna.

verses.name: Judges 9:20
verses.text: Malaingkan bang ala'at maksudbi angkan iya hinangbi sultan, na, bang pa'in aniya' api paluwas min si Abimelek ilu angalapnas ka'am saga maglalahat ma Sekem maka ma Bet-Milo! Bang pa'in isāb aniya' api paluwas min ka'am papelleng ni si Abimelek!”  <div eID="gen1902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1109"/><div sID="gen1903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1109"/> Pagubus, alahi si Jotam patapuk ni lahat Be'er ati mahē' iya pat'nna' sabab tināw iya ma danakanna si Abimelek.  <div eID="gen1903" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1110"/><div sID="gen1904" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1110"/> Manjari itu, palabay pa'in t'lluntahun kapamarinta si Abimelek ma bangsa Isra'il,

verses.name: Judges 9:23
verses.text: aniya' pagsababan pinat'kka e' Tuhan ma si Abimelek maka saga a'a Sekem, ya po'on sigām magsagga'. Jari mbal na angaku pinagbaya'an e' si Abimelek saga maglalahat ma da'ira inān.

verses.name: Judges 9:24
verses.text: Pinat'kka e' Tuhan palkala' itu supaya kabalosan kamatay saga anak si Jerub-Ba'al pitumpū' hekana, ya bay pinapatay e' danakan sigām si Abimelek. Jari katungbasan si Abimelek maka saga a'a Sekem ya bay anabangan iya amono' saga dauranakanna.

verses.name: Judges 9:25
verses.text: Pagka in a'a Sekem mbal na angaku pinagbaya'an e' si Abimelek, aniya' min sigām pehē' ni kabūd-būran angahapa' maka angalangpasan sasuku palabay minna'an. Sagō' tapata'u si Abimelek ma pasalan itu-i.  <div eID="gen1904" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1111"/><div sID="gen1905" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1111"/> Na, aniya' a'a niōnan si Ga'al, anak si Ebed, wa'i papinda ni Sekem, beya' isab maka saga danakanna l'lla, ati pangandolan iya e' saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: Judges 9:27
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in musim pagk'ttu' buwa' anggul, pehē' na saga a'a Sekem ni kabbun sigām, ati pin'gga' buwa' anggul nihinang binu. Pagubus, bay sigām amaniya' paglami-lami ma langgal tuhan-tuhan sigām. Sabu sigām magkakan maka maginum, sinapdahan e' sigām si Abimelek.

verses.name: Judges 9:28
verses.text: Yuk si Ga'al anak si Ebed, “Sai sa si Abimelek, ya angkan kitam a'a Sekem itu subay magpatireyo' ma iya? Bang aku mbal asā', in iya hal anak si Jerub-Ba'al, maka si Sebol ya pangandolanna. Ya patut subay paghinanganbi si Hamor, ya pangkatanbi saga a'a Sekem.

verses.name: Judges 9:29
verses.text: Bang sadja saga a'a itu bay kapagbaya'anku, tantu pala'anku si Abimelek. Ya pah'llingku ma iya, ‘Pasakapun saga a'anu magbobono' bo' kitam makapagatu!’ ”  <div eID="gen1905" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1112"/><div sID="gen1906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1112"/> Na, kahaka'an pa'in si Sebol ya gubnul ma da'ira inān pasal bay pah'lling si Ga'al anak si Ebed he', akagit sidda atayna.

verses.name: Judges 9:31
verses.text: Jari aniya' sosoho'an pinapehē' e'na ni si Abimelek ma halam aniya' makata'u. Yuk lapalna, “Si Ga'al maka saga danakanna l'lla bay papinda pi'itu ni Sekem ati sinūg-sūgan saga a'a angatuhan ka'a.

verses.name: Judges 9:32
verses.text: Angkan ma sangom itu, ka'a maka saga a'anu subay pi'itu patapuk ma kaparangan,

verses.name: Judges 9:33
verses.text: ati pagk'llat mata llaw, palanjal kam angandugpak ni da'ira. Makaluwas pa'in si Ga'al maka saga a'ana magbobono' angatuhan ka'am, hinangun na bang ai kabaya'annu.”  <div eID="gen1906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1113"/><div sID="gen1907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1113"/> Angkanna, pagsangom pa'in, palanjal na si Abimelek maka kamemon saga sundaluna patapuk ma kasekotan da'ira Sekem. Mpat heka tumpukan sigām.

verses.name: Judges 9:35
verses.text: Na, wa'i si Ga'al itu an'ngge ma luwasan lawang ya pagsōran ni da'ira, salta' si Abimelek maka saga sundaluna paluwas min patapukan sigām.

verses.name: Judges 9:36
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in sigām e' si Ga'al, jari yukna ni si Sebol, “Nda'un ba, aniya' saga a'a palūd min saga puttuk būd inān.” <div eID="gen1907" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1908" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Sebol, “Asā' ka, tuwan, lambung būd ko' ilu, ngga'i ka a'a.”  <div eID="gen1908" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1114"/><div sID="gen1909" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1114"/> Saguwā' ah'lling pabalik si Ga'al, “Nda'un ba, aniya' to'ongan saga a'a palūd min kabūd-būran. Maka aniya' tumpukan dakayu' lum'ngngan tudju pi'itu min po'on kayu ya niōnan kayu saga magpuputika'.”  <div eID="gen1909" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1115"/><div sID="gen1910" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1115"/> Ah'lling si Sebol ma si Ga'al, yuk-i, “Abowa' pahāp ka'a ilu! Bay pagtunggīngannu si Abimelek pagga yuknu, ‘Sai sa si Abimelek ya angkan kitam subay magpatireyo' ma iya?’ Ilu na saga a'a ya bay pareyo'-deyo'nu. Na, paluwas na ka pehē' angatuhan sigām!”  <div eID="gen1910" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1116"/><div sID="gen1911" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1116"/> Jari palanjal si Ga'al amowa saga a'a Sekem magbono' maka disi Abimelek.

verses.name: Judges 9:40
verses.text: Niapas sigām e' si Abimelek sampay ni lawang da'ira ati aheka sigām abugtang.

verses.name: Judges 9:41
verses.text: Manjari pahanti' si Abimelek ma lahat Aruma, bo' arapun si Ga'al maka saga danakanna l'lla bay tin'ggal e' si Sebol min da'ira Sekem.  <div eID="gen1911" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1117"/><div sID="gen1912" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1117"/> Pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, kahaka'an si Abimelek in saga a'a Sekem magluwasan na ni kahuma-huma'an.

verses.name: Judges 9:43
verses.text: Angkan iya bay amowa saga a'ana magbahagi' t'llu tumpukan. Sinō' sigām patapuk ma t'ngnga' huma bo' nihapa'an saga a'a Sekem. Sakali pag'nda' si Abimelek aniya' a'a paluwas min da'ira, magtūy iya patanam amono'.

verses.name: Judges 9:44
verses.text: Magdai'-dai' iya maka dakayu' tumpukan sundaluna ni lawang da'ira bo' kajagahan labayan pagsōd-luwasan. In duwa tumpukan kasehe' wa'i angandugpak ni saga a'a Sekem ya ma kahuma-huma'an, ati nilaglag kamemon.

verses.name: Judges 9:45
verses.text: Magbono' na pa'in sigām sampay ni kakohapan, jari kalongkopan da'ira Sekem e' disi Abimelek. Pinapatay saga a'ana kamemon, nilubu kaluma'anna, maka sinabulakan asin.  <div eID="gen1912" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1118"/><div sID="gen1913" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1118"/> Makata'u pa'in saga pagnakura'an ya ma pamantawan ma Sekem pasal pakaradja'an itu, magtūy sigām pehē' ni langgal Ba'al-Berit bo' patapuk ma kuta'na ahogot.

verses.name: Judges 9:47
verses.text: Kahaka'an pa'in si Abimelek pasal kapehē' saga nakura',

verses.name: Judges 9:48
verses.text: magtukaran iya maka saga a'ana ni būd Salmon. Pagmaina'an pa'in, angā' iya kapa pamōngna saga sanga kayu bo' tinanggung e'na. Bay soho'na isāb saga a'ana anengoran iya, yuk-i, “Pakasay kam! Beya'inbi hinangku!”

verses.name: Judges 9:49
verses.text: Manjari aniya' sanga kayu pinōng e' kamemon saga sundalu inān. Magpameya' sigām ma si Abimelek ati pinabangkat ba'anan sanga kayu inān ma sakalibut lugal ya patapukan saga a'a Sekem. Tabangkat pa'in, pinarokot na ati magpatayan saga a'a ma deyom pamantawan he'. Dangibu heka a'a d'nda-l'lla bay amatay.  <div eID="gen1913" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1119"/><div sID="gen1914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1119"/> Pagubus ina'an, palanjal disi Abimelek ni kauman Tebe bo' nilibut e' sigām. Jari taga'os lahat inān.

verses.name: Judges 9:51
verses.text: Saguwā' aniya' pamantawan apagon ma deyom da'ira inān, ati maglahian pehē' kamemon saga a'a Tebe, kal'llahan maka kar'ndahan. Tinambol e' sigām pahogot bo' yampa pariyata' ni karatagan atop.

verses.name: Judges 9:52
verses.text: Jari pehē' si Abimelek ni pamantawan bang kalu tarugpak e'na. Sagō' makasekot pa'in iya ni pasōran pamantawan bo' angandokot api panunu' saga a'a ma deyom,

verses.name: Judges 9:53
verses.text: aniya' d'nda bay angahūg batu gilingan, landu' abuhat. Taluwa' kōk si Abimelek ati am'kka' peya'-peya' kōkna.  <div eID="gen1914" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1120"/><div sID="gen1915" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1120"/> Magtūy lingananna sehe'na ya magbobowa pakokosna, yuk-i, “Pakasay ka angahublut kalisnu angandugsu'an aku, bo' mbal tapagsuli-suli e' a'a, ‘In si Abimelek bay pinapatay e' d'nda.’ ” Jari nirugsu'an iya e' sosoho'anna, pinalatus parambila', angkan iya amatay.

verses.name: Judges 9:55
verses.text: Tanda' pa'in e' saga a'a Isra'il in si Abimelek amatay na, magpole'an na sigām.  <div eID="gen1915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1121"/><div sID="gen1916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1121"/> Minnē' katungbasan e' Tuhan si Abimelek ma kala'atan ya bay hinangna ma mma'na, pagka tapapatay e'na dauranakanna l'lla pitumpū' puhu'.

verses.name: Judges 9:57
verses.text: Katungbasan isāb saga a'a Sekem ma pasal kala'atan ya bay tahinang sigām. Hatina papelleng ni sigām ya bay sapda si Jotam anak si Jerub-Ba'al.  <div eID="gen1916" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.9"/> <div eID="gen1891" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1122"/><div sID="gen1917" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Tola</title> <div sID="gen1918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1122"/> Na, awapat pa'in si Abimelek, aniya' l'lla niōnan si Tola pas'lle' angalappas bangsa Isra'il. Si Tola itu anak si Puwa, ya Puwa bay anak si Dodo, min panubu' si Issakar. Pat'nna' iya ma kaluma'an Samir ma kabūd-būran Epra'im.

verses.name: Judges 10:2
verses.text: Saga duwampū' ka t'lluntahun t'ggol si Tola magmakōk ma bangsa Isra'il. Pagpatayna pa'in, kinubul iya ma Samir.  <div eID="gen1918" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1917" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1123"/><div sID="gen1919" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ja'ir</title> <div sID="gen1920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1123"/> Ya pasunu' ni si Tola si Ja'ir a'a Giliyad. Duwampū' ka duwantahun kapagmakōkna ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 10:4
verses.text: Taga-anak iya l'lla t'llumpū' puhu', ya pakura' ma t'llumpū' kura'. Kapagagihan e' sigām t'llumpū' heka da'ira ma lahat Giliyad, ya pinagōnan Kakauman si Ja'ir sampay ni kabuwattina'anan.

verses.name: Judges 10:5
verses.text: Amatay pa'in si Ja'ir, kinubul iya ma Kamun.  <div eID="gen1920" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1919" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1124"/><div sID="gen1921" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Jepta</title> <div sID="gen1922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1124"/> Pabalik na isāb saga bangsa Isra'il maghinang kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' si Yawe. Sinumba e' sigām saga tuhan-tuhan Ba'al maka Astoret, maka ba'anan tuhan-tuhan ya tina'at e' bangsa Aram, bangsa Sidun, bangsa Mowab, maka bangsa Pilistin. Kataikutan e' sigām si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām, mbal na magta'at ma iya,

verses.name: Judges 10:7
verses.text: angkan akagit atayna ma sigām. Sinōngan sigām e'na ni ga'osan bangsa Pilistin maka bangsa Ammon,

verses.name: Judges 10:8
verses.text: ya angala'ug maka amissoko' ma tahun ina'an. Sangpū' ka waluntahun ya pamissoko' saga bangsa inān ma bangsa Isra'il ya pat'nna' ma lahat Giliyad. Ina'an sigām ma dambila' sapa' Jordan tampal ni sobangan, ma paglahat bangsa Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 10:9
verses.text: Na, pauntas isāb saga sundalu bangsa Ammon ni dambila' sapa' Jordan tampal ni s'ddopan bo' magbono' maka bangsa Yuda, bangsa Benjamin maka bangsa Epra'im. Jari katiksa'an makalandu' in kamemon bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 10:10
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', parahing sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yuk-i, “Bay kami makarusa ni ka'a. Bay kami pataikut min ka'a ya pagtuhanan kami bo' maghinang ni saga tuhan-tuhan Ba'al.”  <div eID="gen1922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1125"/><div sID="gen1923" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1125"/> Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Bay sa kam liyusanku min komkoman saga bangsa Misil, Amor, Ammon, Pilistin,

verses.name: Judges 10:12
verses.text: Sidun, Amalek maka Ma'on. Bay kam parahing ni aku mikitabang waktu kapamissoko' saga bangsa inān ma ka'am, ati talappas kam e'ku.

verses.name: Judges 10:13
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan na, ilu na isāb kam pataikut min aku bo' maghinang ni saga tuhan-tuhan saddī, angkan mbal na aku bilahi angalappas ka'am pabīng.

verses.name: Judges 10:14
verses.text: Pehē' kam parahing ni saga tuhan-tuhan ya tapene'bi. Mikilappas kam ma sigām bang kam ma deyom kasigpitan!”  <div eID="gen1923" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1126"/><div sID="gen1924" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1126"/> Saguwā' anganjunjung na pa'in saga bangsa Isra'il ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yuk-i, “Bay kami makarusa. Hinangun ai-ai ya patut kat'kkahan kami, saguwā', ndū', ma waktu itu lappasun kami.”

verses.name: Judges 10:16
verses.text: Magtūy ni'bbahan e' bangsa Isra'il saga tuhan-tuhan bangsa liyu bo' angisbat si Yawe, ati mbal kasandalanna kasukkalan sigām.  <div eID="gen1924" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1127"/><div sID="gen1925" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1127"/> Na ma waktu inān, bay na pasakap ba'anan sundalu bangsa Ammon bo' magpustu ma Giliyad. Jari ina'an isāb bangsa Isra'il magtipun maka magpustu ma lahat Mispa.

verses.name: Judges 10:18
verses.text: Sakali makapah'lling saga pagnakura'an a'a Giliyad, yuk-i, “Sai-sai makarahū amono' saga a'a Ammon, iya na ya magmakōk ma kamemon maglalahat ma Giliyad itu.”  <div eID="gen1925" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.10"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:1
verses.text: Na aniya' a'a Giliyad, ōnna si Jepta, dakayu' magbobono' landu' aesog. Mma'na si Giliyad, ina'na d'nda pinagtatambahan.

verses.name: Judges 11:2
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga anak si Giliyad l'lla min h'ndana po'on. Jari asangpot pa'in saga kasehe'an anakna, tin'ggal e' sigām si Jepta. Yuk sigām ma iya, “Mbal ka makahampit pusaka' min matto'a kami, sabab anak ka min saddī ina'.”

verses.name: Judges 11:3
verses.text: Angkan alahi si Jepta min saga danakanna bo' pat'nna' ma lahat Tōb, ati aniya' ba'anan a'a bula'ug-bula'ug bay pabeya' ma iya.  <div eID="gen1926" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1128"/><div sID="gen1927" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1128"/> Palabay pa'in waktu, pagka angandugpak na bangsa Ammon ni bangsa Isra'il,

verses.name: Judges 11:5
verses.text: pehē' saga pagmatto'ahan Giliyad ni lahat Tōb bo' angā' si Jepta.

verses.name: Judges 11:6
verses.text: Yuk sigām ma iya, “Dai' ka, ka'a ya magnakura'an kami bo' ka'atuhan bangsa Ammon.”  <div eID="gen1927" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1129"/><div sID="gen1928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1129"/> Anambung si Jepta ni sigām, yukna, “Ngga'i bahā' ka'am ya bay ab'nsihan aku maka an'ggal aku min okoman mma'ku? Angay aku pangamu'anbi tabang buwattina'an pagka kam ma deyom kasigpitan na?”  <div eID="gen1928" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1130"/><div sID="gen1929" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1130"/> Jari makapah'lling ma iya saga pagmatto'ahan Giliyad, yuk-i, “Aho' b'nnal, sagō' itiya' kami angamu' tabang ni ka'a ma buwattina'an. Gapi'in kami bo' kitam maka'atu ma bangsa Ammon. Jari ka'a na ya magnakura'an kamemon saga maglalahat ma Giliyad.”  <div eID="gen1929" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1131"/><div sID="gen1930" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1131"/> Yuk sambung si Jepta, “Bang aku saupama bowabi angatuhan bangsa Ammon, bo' aku pinara'ug e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, pagnakura'anbi to'ongan bahā' aku?”  <div eID="gen1930" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1132"/><div sID="gen1931" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1132"/> Yuk sambung saga pagmatto'ahan inān, “Si Yawe ya saksi'tam, beya' kami to'ongan bang ai panoho'annu.”

verses.name: Judges 11:11
verses.text: Angkanna ameya' na si Jepta ma saga pagmatto'ahan Giliyad inān bo' tahinang pagmakōkan maka pagnakura'an sigām. Ma Mispa pa'in sigām, binalikan e' si Jepta ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe kamemon bay pah'llingna ma saga a'a Giliyad.  <div eID="gen1931" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1133"/><div sID="gen1932" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1133"/> Pagubus, aniya' saga a'a sinoho' e' si Jepta amowa lapal ni sultan bangsa Ammon, yuk-i, “Ai po'on-sababna ya angkan dugpakbi lahat kami?”  <div eID="gen1932" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1134"/><div sID="gen1933" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1134"/> Yuk sambung sultan inān ni saga sosoho'an si Jepta, “Ma waktu bay kala'an bangsa Isra'il min lahat Misil, ta'agaw e' sigām tana'ku tinagna'an min sapa' Arnon ni sapa' Jabbok, sampay isāb ni bihing sapa' Jordan. Angkan yukku ma ka'am, pabalikunbi tana' inān ni aku ma halam palsagga'an.”  <div eID="gen1933" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1135"/><div sID="gen1934" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1135"/> Jari pinabīng pehē' saga sosoho'an si Jepta, sinō' amowa lapalna dakayu' itu ni sultan bangsa Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:15
verses.text: Yuk-i, “Ya itu pangallam si Jepta: In bangsa Isra'il halam bay angagaw tana' bangsa Mowab atawa bangsa Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:16
verses.text: Ma waktu kala'an sigām min lahat Misil, in bangsa Isra'il bay at'kka ni Tahik Keyat labay min lahat paslangan, bo' pasampay isāb ni lahat Kades.

verses.name: Judges 11:17
verses.text: Ma Kades pa'in, aniya' sosoho'an bay pinapehē' e' bangsa Isra'il ni sultan bangsa Edom ama'id min iya bang pa'in dūlanna sigām palabay min lahatna. Saguwā' halam sigām bay kinale e' sultan Edom e'. Damikiyanna isāb in sultan bangsa Mowab, mbal amarūl. Angkan bay pat'ttog saga a'a Isra'il ma Kades.  <div eID="gen1934" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1136"/><div sID="gen1935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1136"/> “Pagubus, pauntas na sigām minnē' labay min paslangan. Nilibut e' sigām lahat Edom maka bihing Mowab tampal ni sobangan. Ta'abut pa'in sapa' Arnon, magpustu sigām ma dambila'na. Halam sigām bay palintas pabalik ni dambila' sapa' bo' pasōd ni lahat Mowab.

verses.name: Judges 11:19
verses.text: Na, maina'an pa'in saga a'a Isra'il ma sapa' Arnon, aniya' saga sosoho'an pinapehē' e' sigām ni si Sihon ya sultan bangsa Amor. Hesbon ya lahat pagsultananna. Jari ama'id min iya saga sosoho'an bangsa Isra'il e', yuk-i, ‘Tuwan sultan, bang makajari, tugutin kami palabay min lahatbi tudju ni lahat kami.’

verses.name: Judges 11:20
verses.text: Sagō' mbal bilahi si Sihon sabab mbal angandol ma saga a'a Isra'il. Gom pa'in pinatimuk e'na ma lahat Jahas kamemon saga a'ana magbono' bo' angandugpak bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 11:21
verses.text: Malaingkan si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il, bay amara'ug sigām min si Sihon maka saga a'ana. Ta'agaw e' saga a'a Isra'il tana' saga a'a Amor ma lahat inān.

verses.name: Judges 11:22
verses.text: Kalongkopan e' sigām tana' Amor kamemon, tinagna'an min sapa' Arnon sampay ni sapa' Jabbok, min lahat paslangan isāb sampay ni sapa' Jordan.  <div eID="gen1935" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1137"/><div sID="gen1936" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1137"/> “Hatina,” yuk lapal si Jepta ni sultan Ammon, “si Yawe ya Tuhan bangsa Isra'il bay an'ggal bangsa Amor bo' pamuwanna lahat sigām ni saga a'a suku'na. Jari ai kapatutnu angā' tana' inān pabalik?

verses.name: Judges 11:24
verses.text: Dapuhunbi pila-pila ya pamuwan ka'am e' tuhanbi si Kemos. Damikiyanna kami itu, dapu kami ai-ai bay pamuwan kami e' si Yawe ya pagtuhanan kami.

verses.name: Judges 11:25
verses.text: Angay, paliyu lagi' bahā' ga'osannu min si Balak anak si Sippor, ya sultan Mowab? Aniya' bahā' bay palsagga'anna maka pagbono'anna maka bangsa Isra'il?

verses.name: Judges 11:26
verses.text: Aniya' na t'llu hatus tahun ya t'ggol kat'nna' saga bangsa Isra'il ma Hesbon, ma Arower maka ma kaluma'an ma jadjahanna, beya' isāb saga kauman ma bihing sapa' Arnon. Angay halam bay bawi'bi paltana'anbi ma deyom t'llu hatus tahun e'?

verses.name: Judges 11:27
verses.text: Halam aniya' kasā'anku ma ka'am, saguwā' ka'am ya makasā' ma aku ma pamowabi magbono'. Pasalassayta palkala' itu ma si Yawe ya Maghuhukum, ati iya ya amene' bang sai taga-kapatut, ka'am ka bangsa Ammon atawa kami bangsa Isra'il.”

verses.name: Judges 11:28
verses.text: Saguwā' in sultan Ammon mbal angasip ma lapal ya bay pinabeya'an iya e' si Jepta.  <div eID="gen1936" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1138"/><div sID="gen1937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1138"/> Jari patongod Rū Yawe ma si Jepta ati pauntas iya min lahat Giliyad maka Manasse, bo' palabay isāb min Mispa-Giliyad. Palanjal iya minnē' bo' angatuhan bangsa Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:30
verses.text: Pagubus, anganajal si Jepta ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yukna, “Ya Tuhan, bang tugutannu in bangsa Ammon ni komkomanku,

verses.name: Judges 11:31
verses.text: ya itu pagnajalku, ‘Sai-sai paluwas dahū min luma'ku anampang bang aku amole' na min panganda'ugku min bangsa Ammon, pamasuku'ku du ni ka'a. Tunu'ku isāb pagkulban ni ka'a.’ ”  <div eID="gen1937" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1139"/><div sID="gen1938" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1139"/> Na, pehē' na si Jepta magbono' maka bangsa Ammon ati pinara'ug iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Judges 11:33
verses.text: Taligis e' si Jepta duwampū' kauman ya paglahatan bangsa Ammon, tinagna'an min Arower sampay ni kasekotan lahat Minnit. Ta'abut isāb lahat Abel-Keramim, tara'ug e' bangsa Isra'il bangsa Ammon ati halam na ga'osan sigām.  <div eID="gen1938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1140"/><div sID="gen1939" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1140"/> Na, makapole' pa'in si Jepta ni pat'nna'anna ma Mispa, anakna d'nda ya paluwas anampang iya, maka he'na angigal maka angandapu' tambul-tambulna. Anakna tunggalan ko' inān. Halam aniya' anak si Jepta saddī min iya, d'nda ka atawa l'lla.

verses.name: Judges 11:35
verses.text: Pag'nda' pa'in si Jepta ma anakna itu, magtūy gese'na badju'na. Maglemong iya, yukna, “Allō! Anakku! Arung, asukkal aku ma pasalannu sabab aniya' najalku ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe mbal kapindahanku.”  <div eID="gen1939" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1141"/><div sID="gen1940" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1141"/> Ya sambung anakna, “Mma', pagka ka bay makajanji' ni si Yawe, hinangun ma aku buwat bay tanajalnu. Sabab bay ka pinara'ug e'na min bantanu bangsa Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:37
verses.text: Na mma', aniya' sadja amu'ku ni ka'a, bang pa'in aku dūlannu angalunsulan kabūd-būran ma deyom duwambulan. Pehē' aku magdukka maka saga panonku d'nda sabab aku itu mbal na makapagh'lla.”  <div eID="gen1940" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1142"/><div sID="gen1941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1142"/> Yuk si Jepta, “Aho' arūng, pehē' na ka.” Angkan pinasagaran iya ma deyom duwambulan. Magbeya' iya maka saga bagayna kabudjangan angalunsul ma kabūd-būran. Magdukka na pa'in sigām sabab mbal na iya makapagh'lla.

verses.name: Judges 11:39
verses.text: Palabay pa'in duwambulan e', pabalik iya ni mma'na ati bineya' e' si Jepta bay najalna. Budjang lagi' iya. <div eID="gen1941" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1942" type="paragraph"/> Ya itu po'on-sababan pangaddatan bangsa Isra'il itu:

verses.name: Judges 11:40
verses.text: tahun ni tahun in kabudjangan bangsa Isra'il maglunsulan ma deya ma deyom mpat llaw pangentoman sigām ma bay pat'kka ni anak si Jepta a'a min lahat Giliyad.  <div eID="gen1942" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.11"/> <div eID="gen1921" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1143"/><div sID="gen1943" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Jepta maka Bangsa Epra'im</title> <div sID="gen1944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1143"/> Na, pinatimuk e' panubu' si Epra'im saga a'a sigām magbobono' bo' pauntas tudju ni lahat Sapon. Aniya' lapal pinabeya' e' sigām ni si Jepta, yuk-i, “Angay ka halam bay mikitabang ma kami, waktu kapehē'bi magbono' maka bangsa Ammon? Tunu' kami luma'nu sampay ka'am magtautai'-anak.”  <div eID="gen1944" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1144"/><div sID="gen1945" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1144"/> Ya sambung si Jepta, “Bay na kam palingananku tagna' kapagsagga' kami maka bangsa Ammon e', saguwā' halam kami bay gapi'bi angatu ma sigām.

verses.name: Judges 12:3
verses.text: Pagta'uku in ka'am mbal du anabang, bay panūkku ka'llumku angatuhan bangsa Ammon ma halam aniya' pagapi'. Ati min kahandak si Yawe bay aku anganda'ug. Jari angay gi' kam pi'itu buwattina'an amowa aku magbono'?”  <div eID="gen1945" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1145"/><div sID="gen1946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1145"/> Magtūy pinatimuk e' si Jepta saga a'a Giliyad bo' magbono' maka panubu' si Epra'im, ati anganda'ug disi Jepta. Minnē' kabalosan saga a'a Epra'im ma bay pagsambatan sigām, ya yuk-i, “Ē, ka'am saga a'a Giliyad, halam aniya' pūsbi, sapantun kam s'ggit tinimanan e' pagkahibi panubu' Epra'im maka Manasse.”

verses.name: Judges 12:5
verses.text: Kapagbaya'an e' a'a Giliyad kababawan sapa' Jordan, ya palabayan tudju ni lahat Epra'im. Jari bang aniya' a'a Epra'im bay min pagbono'an at'kka ni sapa' he', bo' mikipalintas parambila', tinilaw iya e' saga a'a Giliyad, yuk-i, “Panubu' si Epra'im ka bahā'?” Bang yukna “Ngga'i ka,”

verses.name: Judges 12:6
verses.text: na, sinulayan iya e' saga a'a Giliyad. Sinō' iya angabtang ‘Syibolet.’ Sagō' bang a'a inān mbal makakabtang pabontol ati yukna ‘Sibolet,’ magtūy iya sinaggaw e' a'a Giliyad bo' pinapatay ma atag sapa' Jordan. Mpatpū' ka duwangibu heka panubu' Epra'im ya bay tapapatay ma waktu pagbono' he'.  <div eID="gen1946" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1146"/><div sID="gen1947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1146"/> Nnom tahun ya t'ggol si Jepta magnakura'an bangsa Isra'il. Amatay pa'in iya, kinubul iya ma atag kaluma'anna ma lahat Giliyad.  <div eID="gen1947" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen1943" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1147"/><div sID="gen1948" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ibsan, si Elon maka si Abdon</title> <div sID="gen1949" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1147"/> Manjari, si Ibsan a'a Betlehem ya pasunu' magnakura'an bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 12:9
verses.text: Taga-anak iya l'lla t'llumpū' puhu', maka t'llumpū' isab anakna d'nda. Pinah'lla'an e'na saga anakna d'nda ni panubu' saddī. Damikiyanna saga anakna l'lla, bay ningā'an d'nda min panubu' saddī pamah'nda sigām. Pituntahun ya t'ggol si Ibsan magnakura' ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 12:10
verses.text: Amatay pa'in iya, kinubul iya ma Betlehem.  <div eID="gen1949" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1148"/><div sID="gen1950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1148"/> Si Elon panubu' Sibulun ya paganti' min si Ibsan magnakura' ma bangsa Isra'il. Sangpū' tahun ya t'ggol kapagnakura'na.

verses.name: Judges 12:12
verses.text: Amatay pa'in si Elon, kinubul iya ma Ayjalon ma lahat Sibulun.  <div eID="gen1950" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:13
