verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1149"/><div sID="gen1951" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1149"/> Amatay pa'in si Elon, si Abdon anak si Hellel, a'a min Piratun, ya paganti' magnakura'an bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 12:14
verses.text: Taga-anak iya l'lla mpatpū' hekana, maka mpu l'lla t'llumpū' hekana. In sigām pitumpū' puhu' itu bay ameya' pakaniya-pakaniya ma kura'. Waluntahun ya t'ggol kapagnakura' si Elon ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Judges 12:15
verses.text: Jari amatay pa'in iya, kinubul iya ma Piratun-Epra'im, ma kabūran ya paglahatan saga bangsa Amalek.  <div eID="gen1951" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.12"/> <div eID="gen1948" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1150"/><div sID="gen1952" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaganak ma si Samson</title> <div sID="gen1953" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1150"/> Pabalik na isab saga a'a Isra'il maghinang kala'atan ya landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, angkan sigām tugutanna ni komkoman bangsa Pilistin ma deyom mpatpū' tahun.

verses.name: Judges 13:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' a'a Sora niōnan si Manowa, min panubu' si Dān. Taga-h'nda iya mbal maka'anak.

verses.name: Judges 13:3
verses.text: Sakali magpa'nda' ni d'nda itu mala'ikat si Yawe bo' ah'lling, yukna, “Ka'a ilu, minsan ka halam bay maka'anak, angiram du ka bo' ka anganak l'lla.

verses.name: Judges 13:4
verses.text: Ya pangamay-ngamayku ma ka'a, da'a ka anginum binu atawa ai-ai makalango. Da'a ka amangan isab saga pagkakan ya mbal tahalal,

verses.name: Judges 13:5
verses.text: sabab angiram du ka maka anganak ka l'lla. Bu'unna ilu subay mbal ginuntingan sabab Nasiri<note>‘Nasiri’ hatina ‘a'a bay panukbal ma Tuhan.’</note> iya, a'a pinasuku' ni Tuhan min llaw kapaganak ma iya. Tinagna'an e'na kapangalappas bangsa Isra'il min komkoman bangsa Pilistin.”  <div eID="gen1953" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1151"/><div sID="gen1954" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1151"/> Jari pehē' na d'nda angahaka ni h'llana, yuk-i, “Aniya' sosoho'an Tuhan bay magpa'nda' ni aku. Ya pangluwahanna sali' mala'ikat Tuhan, makatāw-tāw. Halam iya bay tatilawku bang m'nningga, maka halam iya bay angōnan di-na.

verses.name: Judges 13:7
verses.text: Saguwā' ya llingna ma aku, ‘Angiram du ka maka anganak ka l'lla.’ Sinō' aku da'a anginum binu atawa ai-ai makalango, maka sinō' da'a amangan pagkakan mbal tahalal, sabab in onde' itu Nasiri, pinasaddī min kasehe'an bo' ma Tuhan sadja min llaw kapaganak ma iya sampay ni waktu kamatayna.”  <div eID="gen1954" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1152"/><div sID="gen1955" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1152"/> Sakali angamu'-ngamu' si Manowa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Bang pa'in tugutannu a'a Tuhan pabīng pi'itu amandu'an kami supaya kami ata'u pasal pangayuput onde' ya song nianakan.”  <div eID="gen1955" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1153"/><div sID="gen1956" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1153"/> Na, kinale si Manowa e' Tuhan ati pabalik mala'ikatna bo' panyata' ni d'nda hinabuna maghinang ma huma. Sagō' halam maina'an h'llana,

verses.name: Judges 13:10
verses.text: angkan iya magdai'-dai' pehē' angahaka. Yukna, “Itiya' l'lla ya bay magpa'nda' ni aku llaw he'-i.”  <div eID="gen1956" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1154"/><div sID="gen1957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1154"/> Pagubus, pabuhat si Manowa bo' paturul ni h'ndana. Pagsekotna pa'in ni a'a inān, yukna, “Ka'a bahā' ya bay amowa magbissala ma h'ndaku?” <div eID="gen1957" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1958" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', aku,” yukna.  <div eID="gen1958" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1155"/><div sID="gen1959" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1155"/> Atilaw gi' si Manowa, yuk-i, “Bang atuman na ya pangallamnu, ai na pa'in saga hatulan panunuran kami ma onde' itu ma kapaga'ana?”  <div eID="gen1959" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1156"/><div sID="gen1960" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1156"/> Yuk sambung mala'ikat Yawe, “Subay bineya' kamemon ya bay pah'llingku ma h'ndanu.

verses.name: Judges 13:14
verses.text: Subay iya mbal amangan ai-ai ta'ā' min tinanom anggul, subay mbal anginum binu atawa inuman ai-ai makalango, maka subay mbal amangan ai-ai ya mbal halal. Wajib bineya' e'na kamemon bay panoho'anku ma iya.”  <div eID="gen1960" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1157"/><div sID="gen1961" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1157"/> Yuk si Manowa ni mala'ikat, “Bang manjari, da'a gi' ka ala'an. Angadjal lagi' kami dakayu' anak kambing bo' aniya' kakannu.”  <div eID="gen1961" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1158"/><div sID="gen1962" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1158"/> Yuk sambung mala'ikat inān, “Minsan aku taggahanbi, mbal aku amangan pagkakanbi. Sagō' bang kam anakap pagkulban tinunu', na, tukbalinbi ni si Yawe.” (Halam tasayu e' si Manowa in a'a inān mala'ikat si Yawe.)  <div eID="gen1962" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1159"/><div sID="gen1963" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1159"/> Atilaw isab si Manowa ni mala'ikat, yukna, “Sai ōnnu? Sabab bilahi kami amaheya ka'a bang tatuman na ya bay pangallamnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen1963" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1160"/><div sID="gen1964" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1160"/> Yuk sambungna, “Angay tilawnu ōnku? Mbal to'ongan tahati e' manusiya'.”

verses.name: Judges 13:19
verses.text: Pagubus, bay angā' si Manowa dakayu' anak kambing, beya' isab maka tutukbalan tirigu, ati sinumbali' e'na ma diyata' batu pangahulmatna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Pataggaha', aniya' hinang makainu-inu tahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> sabu ang'nda' si Manowa maka h'ndana.

verses.name: Judges 13:20
verses.text: Aniya' api pasuleyab min pagtutukbalan inān tudju ni diyata' langit. Pasalta', in mala'ikat si Yawe ameya' pa'angkat. Pag'nda' si Manowa maka h'nda, magtūy sigā pasujud.

verses.name: Judges 13:21
verses.text: Pagka mala'ikat inān halam na magpa'nda' pabalik ni sigā maglakibini, minnē' tata'u e' si Manowa mala'ikat Yawe ko' inān.  <div eID="gen1964" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1161"/><div sID="gen1965" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1161"/> Ah'lling si Manowa ni h'ndana, yukna, “Amatay ko' kita itu, sabab ta'nda'ta Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen1965" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1162"/><div sID="gen1966" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1162"/> Saguwā' anambung h'ndana, “Bang bay aniya' niyat <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> amapatay kita, mbal tinaima' tutukbalan susumbali'an maka tirigu ya bay ungsuranta ni iya. Mbal kita bay pina'nda'an saga pakaradja'an itu, maka mbal bay nihaka'an pasal maksudna.”

verses.name: Judges 13:24
verses.text: Pagubus, in d'nda itu bay anganak l'lla, ati Samson ya pangōnna ma iya. Pasulig na pa'in onde' inān maka taptap binarakatan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: Judges 13:25
verses.text: Anagna' isab Rū Yawe pahōp ma iya hinabuna ma kauman Mahane-Dān, ya ma llot Sora maka Esta'ol.  <div eID="gen1966" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.13"/> <div eID="gen1952" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1163"/><div sID="gen1967" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagh'nda si Samson</title> <div sID="gen1968" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1163"/> Asangpot pa'in si Samson, pehē' iya ni kauman Timna ati aniya' budjang bangsa Pilistin ta'nda'na maina'an.

verses.name: Judges 14:2
verses.text: Pagpole'na, angahaka iya ni ina'-mma'na, yukna, “Maka'nda' aku budjang Pilistin ma Timna. Pah'nda'unbi aku ma iya.”  <div eID="gen1968" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1164"/><div sID="gen1969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1164"/> Yuk sambung matto'ana, “Angay, Otō'? Halam bahā' aniya' d'nda ahāp min kakampunganta atawa min pagkahitam bangsa Isra'il? Angay gi' ka subay magh'nda'an bangsa Pilistin, bangsa kapil lagi'?” <div eID="gen1969" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1970" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' angalogos si Samson ma mma'na, yuk-i, “Ngā'in aku, mma', sabab iya ya kabaya'anku.”

verses.name: Judges 14:4
verses.text: (Halam kinata'uwan e' matto'a si Samson in baya'na itu min kahandak si Yawe asal, supaya aniya' pagsababan pangatu bangsa Isra'il ma bangsa Pilistin, sabab saga Pilistin ya magparintahan bangsa Isra'il ma waktu ina'an.)  <div eID="gen1970" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1165"/><div sID="gen1971" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1165"/> Dakayu' llaw, pehē' si Samson ni Timna magbeya' maka ina'-mma'na. Sabu sigām pasekot ni pagtanoman anggul ma atag kauman inān, pataggaha' aniya' halimaw amanggohong<note>Amanggohong: lling halimaw landu' atanog, bang song angandugpak ni hayop atawa a'a.</note> parugpak ni si Samson.

verses.name: Judges 14:6
verses.text: Manjari pahōp Rū Yawe ni si Samson amuwanan iya kosog, angkan tas'kkatna halimaw itu maka tanganna, buwat pan'kkatna kambing abata'. Saguwā' halam bay tahaka pakaradja'an itu ni mma'na atawa ina'na.

verses.name: Judges 14:7
verses.text: Pagubus, palanjal iya ni Timna anuli-nulihan d'nda he', maka pasōng gom pa'in baya'na ma iya.  <div eID="gen1971" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1166"/><div sID="gen1972" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1166"/> Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, pabalik na si Samson ni Timna bo' angawinan d'nda he'. Ma labayan lagi', pasiha' iya ang'nda' ni bangkay halimaw. Pag'nda'na, na, angulatap e' ba'anan buwani maka aniya' isab gula'.

verses.name: Judges 14:9
verses.text: Niakup gula' itu e' si Samson bo' kinakan e'na ma pal'ngnganan. Binuwanan isab saga matto'ana, maka ya du sigā bay amangan. Saguwā' halam sigā bay haka'anna in gula' buwani inān bay ningā' min bangkay halimaw.  <div eID="gen1972" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1167"/><div sID="gen1973" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1167"/> Sakali itu, pehē' na mma' si Samson ni luma' d'nda. Aniya' isab paglami-lami pinaniya' e' si Samson sabab ya na addat sigām bang l'lla song kinawin.

verses.name: Judges 14:11
verses.text: Pagt'kka si Samson, pinasehe'an iya t'llumpū' l'lla Pilistin.  <div eID="gen1973" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1168"/><div sID="gen1974" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1168"/> Yuk si Samson ni saga a'a itu, “Aniya' pamatokodku ma ka'am. Bang tatokodbi ma deyom pitung'llaw ya paglami-lami itu, buwananta kam t'llumpū' heka kakana' ahāp maka t'llumpū' pangampu'an s'mmek.

verses.name: Judges 14:13
verses.text: Saguwā' bang mbal tatokodbi, ka'am ya subay amuwanan aku t'llumpū' heka kakana' ahāp maka t'llumpū' pangampu'an s'mmek.” <div eID="gen1974" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1975" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk sigām, “pē'un. Bilahi kami akale tokod-tokodnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen1975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1169"/><div sID="gen1976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1169"/> Ah'lling si Samson, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen1977"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1978"/>“Min sattuwa magtatanggal, aniya' pagkakan.<l eID="gen1978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1979"/>Min sattuwa akosog, aniya' kamamisan.”<l eID="gen1979" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1977"/> Jari halam tatokod e' saga a'a itu ma deyom t'llung'llaw.  <div eID="gen1976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1170"/><div sID="gen1980" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1170"/> Ta'abut pa'in ka'mpat llawna, ah'lling sigām ni h'nda si Samson, yuk-i, “Pipitin h'llanu angahaka'an kami pasal tokod-tokod ilu bang ai kataluwa'anna. Bang ka mbal, tunu' kami kam kamemon ya ma okoman mma'nu. Bay bahā' kami abbitbi pi'itu supaya langpasanbi?”  <div eID="gen1980" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1171"/><div sID="gen1981" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1171"/> Angkan pagapus h'nda si Samson ni iya maka e'na anangis. Yukna, “Kab'nsihannu na aku! Mbal aku kalasahannu. Bay ka amatokod ma saga kampungku sagō' halam aku haka'annu bang ai kataluwa'anna.” <div eID="gen1981" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1982" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Samson, “Minsan matto'aku halam bay haka'anku, ya lagi'na bahā' ka'a?”

verses.name: Judges 14:17
verses.text: Ati anangis h'nda si Samson animpus ma deyom pitung'llaw paglami-lami. Manjari, ta'abut llaw kapitu'na, nihaka'an iya pasal tokod-tokod inān sabab sinumu na pinogos si Samson. Angahaka isab d'nda inān ni saga kampungna pasal kataluwa'an tokod-tokod e'.  <div eID="gen1982" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1172"/><div sID="gen1983" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1172"/> Na, abay kohap pa'in ma llaw kapitu'na, ah'lling ni si Samson saga a'a kauman inān, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen1984"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1985"/>“Aniya' bahā' paliyu mamisna min gula' buwani?<l eID="gen1985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1986"/>Aniya' bahā' akosog min halimaw?”<l eID="gen1986" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1984"/> <div eID="gen1983" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1987" type="paragraph"/> Ah'lling si Samson ni sigām magparalilan, <lg sID="gen1988"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1989"/>“Bang halam bay gunabi sapi'ku d'nda pangararubi,<l eID="gen1989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1990"/>mbal tatokodbi bay pamatokodku ma ka'am.”<l eID="gen1990" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1988"/>  <div eID="gen1987" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1173"/><div sID="gen1991" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1173"/> Jari pahōp Rū Yawe ma si Samson ati palūd iya ni da'ira Askelon amapatay saga kal'llahan t'llumpū' puhu'. Nihurusan e'na kapanyapan maka pan'mmek sigām bo' pamuwanna ma saga a'a ya bay makatokod he'. Magtūy iya amole' ni luma' mma'na ma masi akagit atayna.

verses.name: Judges 14:20
verses.text: Ati in h'nda si Samson bay pamah'nda ma l'lla ya bay panonna ma pagkawinan.  <div eID="gen1991" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.14"/> <div eID="gen1967" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1174"/><div sID="gen1992" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamalos si Samson ma saga Bangsa Pilistin</title> <div sID="gen1993" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1174"/> Mbal at'ggol, ta'abut pa'in musim pagani pai-tirigu, angā' si Samson dakayu' kambing abata' bo' pehē' patibaw ni h'ndana. Yukna ni mato'ana l'lla, “Pasōd gi' aku ni bilik h'ndaku.” Saguwā' mbal amarūl mma' d'nda he'.  <div eID="gen1993" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1175"/><div sID="gen1994" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1175"/> Yukna ni si Samson, “Pangannalku ab'nsi ka ma iya, angkan tapamah'ndaku ni bagaynu. Sagō' aniya' siyalina alingkat gi' min iya. Ngā'un iya h'nda.”  <div eID="gen1994" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1176"/><div sID="gen1995" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1176"/> Yuk si Samson ni sigām, “Na, aniya' na kapatutku amalos ma ka'am bangsa Pilistin. Tantu kam mulaku.”

verses.name: Judges 15:4
verses.text: Jari paluwas iya minnē' anaggaw t'llu hatus heka ero' talun. Niengkotan e'na togel sigām pinaglingkit duwa. Pagubus, aniya' saga suwariyan binatuk e'na pehē' ni togel ero' bay pinaglingkit e'.

verses.name: Judges 15:5
verses.text: Sinū'an e'na saga suwariyan inān bo' yampa pal'ppana saga ero' ni ba'anan pai-tirigu ya ma kahuma'an saga Pilistin. Jari tatunu' p'kkosan pai baha'u bay niani maka pai halam gi' ta'ani. Tatunu' saga pagtatanoman anggul maka kabbun kayu jaitun.  <div eID="gen1995" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1177"/><div sID="gen1996" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1177"/> Atilaw saga bangsa Pilistin, yuk-i, “Sai bay magkahinangan itu?” <div eID="gen1996" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen1997" type="paragraph"/> Kahaka'an sigām magtūy, yuk-i, “Si Samson ya ayuwan a'a Timna inān, ma sabab in h'ndana wa'i pamah'nda ni bagayna.” Angkan pehē' saga Pilistin anunu' sampay amapatay d'nda ya bay h'nda si Samson beya' maka mma'na.  <div eID="gen1997" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1178"/><div sID="gen1998" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1178"/> Jari ah'lling si Samson ni saga a'a bay anunu' he', yukna, “Pagga buwattē' hinangbi, mbal aku pahali sat'ggol kam mbal kabalosanku.”

verses.name: Judges 15:8
verses.text: Minnē' magsabil si Samson bo' angalagut saga Pilistin inān ati aheka sigām amatay. Pagubus, palūd iya minna'an bo' pat'nna' ma deyom songab batu ya niōnan Etam.  <div eID="gen1998" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1179"/><div sID="gen1999" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1179"/> Manjari itu, pehē' saga a'a Pilistin magpustu ma lahat Yuda, bo' parugpak ni kauman Lehi.

verses.name: Judges 15:10
verses.text: Tinilaw sigām e' saga a'a bangsa Yuda, yuk-i, “Angay kami bono'bi?” <div eID="gen1999" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2000" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung saga Pilistin, “Bay kami pi'itu anaggaw si Samson supaya iya kabalosan ma bay hinangna ma kami.”  <div eID="gen2000" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1180"/><div sID="gen2001" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1180"/> Manjari aniya' t'llungibu kal'llahan min bangsa Yuda pehē' ni songab batu Etam bo' ah'lling ni si Samson, yuk-i, “Halam bahā' kata'uwannu in kitam pinagbaya'an asal e' bangsa Pilistin? Tantu kitam binalosan ma sabab kala'atan ya tahinangnu he'.” <div eID="gen2001" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2002" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Samson, yukna, “Ya tahinangku ma sigām buwat bay hinang sigām ma aku.”  <div eID="gen2002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1181"/><div sID="gen2003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1181"/> Yuk saga a'a Yuda, “Ya maksud kami pi'itu, amaggotan ka'a bo' ka ni'nde'an ni komkoman saga a'a Pilistin.” <div eID="gen2003" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2004" type="paragraph"/> “Ā,” yuk si Samson, “mikijanji' aku ma ka'am, bang pa'in aku mbal papataybi.”  <div eID="gen2004" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1182"/><div sID="gen2005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1182"/> Yuk sambung sigām, “Na aho'. Hal ka saggaw kami ati ni'nde'an ni komkoman bangsa Pilistin. Mbal ka papatay kami.” Jari niengkotan iya maka duwa lubid baha'u bo' binowa patukad min songab batu.

verses.name: Judges 15:14
verses.text: Asekot pa'in iya ni lahat Lehi, sinampang iya e' bangsa Pilistin maka he' sigām angolang. Sakali pahōp Rū Yawe ma si Samson amuwanan iya kosog. Ya lubid ma l'ngngonna tahinang sali' lanut bay pinasekot ni api, maka ya engkot ma tanganna magtūy ap'kkalan di-na.

verses.name: Judges 15:15
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' tapuwa'na bokog-langal min kura' baha'u bay amatay, ati ginuna e'na pamono' saga a'a Pilistin dangibu hekana.  <div eID="gen2005" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1183"/><div sID="gen2006" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1183"/> Jari angabtang si Samson, yukna, <lg sID="gen2007"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2008"/>“Tapaggunaku bokog-langal kura'<l eID="gen2008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2009"/>ati pabūd patay bantaku.<l eID="gen2009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2010"/>Tapaggunaku bokog-langal kura'<l eID="gen2010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2011"/>ati dangibu hekana bay papatayku.”<l eID="gen2011" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2007"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:17
verses.text: Aubus pa'in pangabtangna, tinimanan e'na bokog-langal. Jari Ramat Lehi<note>‘Ramat Lehi,’ hatina ‘Būd-būd Bokog Langal.’</note> ya pangōn a'a ma lugal inān.  <div eID="gen2006" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1184"/><div sID="gen2012" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1184"/> Na, pagka sidda atoho' k'llong si Samson, pajunjung iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yukna, “Aheya da'ugan bay pamuwannu ma sosoho'annu itu. Pasagarannu bahā' aku patay bohe', bo' ta'ā' mayatku e' bangsa kapil itu?”

verses.name: Judges 15:19
verses.text: Angkan aniya' bohe' pinatubud e' Tuhan min lowang ma tana' Lehi inān. Makainum pa'in si Samson, pabalik kosogna maka akuyas na iya. Angkan tuburan bohe' inān kaōnan En Hakkore<note>‘En Hakkore,’ hatina ‘Bohe' Pangajunjungan.’</note>. Ina'an masi sampay ni kabuwattituhan.  <div eID="gen2012" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1185"/><div sID="gen2013" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1185"/> Duwampū' tahun ya kapagnakura' si Samson ma bangsa Isra'il, ma waktu kapagbaya' saga bangsa Pilistin.  <div eID="gen2013" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Judg.15"/> <div eID="gen1992" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1186"/><div sID="gen2014" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Samson maka si Delila</title> <div sID="gen2015" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1186"/> Dakayu' llaw, pehē' si Samson ni da'ira Gasa. Aniya' d'nda pinagtambahan ta'nda'na maina'an, jari pahulid iya ni d'nda inān pagsangom.

verses.name: Judges 16:2
verses.text: Na, kahaka'an saga a'a Gasa in si Samson ina'an ma deyom da'ira. Angkan sigām bay angalibutan lugal inān ati pajaga sigām ma lawang pagluwasan da'ira sampay ni karai'-llawan. Ya yuk sigām, “Papataytam iya pagk'llat llaw.”  <div eID="gen2015" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1187"/><div sID="gen2016" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1187"/> Saguwā' si Samson itu halam bay atuli pat'ggol. Papunduk iya tonga' bahangi bo' pehē' ni lawang da'ira. Binalutan e'na tambolna maka lusuk-lusukna maka batang-suladna, bo' nilarut e'na patighan. Pinatanggung ma bahana, ati binowa ni diyata' būd ya maganggop maka Hebron.  <div eID="gen2016" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1188"/><div sID="gen2017" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1188"/> Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, pahōp baya' si Samson ma dakayu' d'nda ya pat'nna' ma kapantayan Sorek, niōnan si Delila.

verses.name: Judges 16:5
verses.text: Pehē' ni si Delila saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin, yuk-i, “Arung, bidjakin si Samson ilu bo' tahakana bang m'nningga pangā'anna kosogna landu' aheya. Jari ga'os kami iya bo' supaya kaengkotan pahāp maka kapagbaya'an kami na. Bang tahinangnu, tinambahan ka dangibu maka dahatus sekel<note>Hatina saga sangpū' ka t'llu kilu buhatna.</note> dī pilak e' kami dangan-parangan.”  <div eID="gen2017" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1189"/><div sID="gen2018" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1189"/> Angkan ah'lling si Delila ni si Samson, yukna, “Haka'in kono' aku m'nningga pangā'annu kosognu landu' aheya ilu. Bang aniya' saupama bilahi magbabaya'an ka'a, buwattingga e' sigām anaggaw ka'a bo' ka kaengkotan?”  <div eID="gen2018" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1190"/><div sID="gen2019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1190"/> Anambung si Samson, “Bang aku niengkotan maka pitu' engkot kuwit sapi' ya masi abase', in kosogku tahinang la'a buwat kosog-kosog kasehe'an kal'llahan.”  <div eID="gen2019" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1191"/><div sID="gen2020" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1191"/> Jari saga nakura' bangsa Pilistin inān bay amowahan si Delila pitu' engkot kuwit sapi' halam gi' bay pina'llawan. Ginuna magtūy e'na pangengkotna ma si Samson,

verses.name: Judges 16:9
verses.text: salta' aniya' saga l'lla patapuk ma deyom bilik e'. Nilinganan si Samson e' si Delila, yukna, “O Samson! Itiya' na saga Pilistin anaggaw ka'a!” Sagō' saru'un-du'un du ab'kkat e'na saga engkot inān, sali' kahantang bannang bay pinasekot ni api. Ya kaluwasanna, halam tata'u bang m'nningga kosog si Samson.  <div eID="gen2020" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1192"/><div sID="gen2021" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1192"/> Ma waktu dakayu' ah'lling na isab si Delila ni si Samson, yuk-i, “Hal aku parupangnu sabab putingannu aku. Ndū', haka'in aku kono' bang buwattingga ka kaengkotan.”  <div eID="gen2021" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1193"/><div sID="gen2022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1193"/> Anambung si Samson, “Bang aniya' makaengkotan aku maka lubid baha'u halam bay tapangengkot, in kosogku pinasali' ni kosog-kosog kasehe'an kal'llahan.”  <div eID="gen2022" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1194"/><div sID="gen2023" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1194"/> Angkan angā' lubid baha'u si Delila pangengkotna si Samson. Sakali itu, sabu aniya' saga a'a patapuk ma bilik, angalingan si Delila. “O Samson, itiya' na saga Pilistin anaggaw ka'a!” Sagō' ya du, ab'kkat e'na saga lubid ma l'ngngonna sali' salban.

verses.name: Judges 16:13
verses.text: Jari yuk si Delila ni si Samson, “Sampay buwattina'an, masi aku parupangnu maka pagputingannu. Haka'in aku sab'nnal-b'nnal bang buwattingga ka kaengkotan?” <div eID="gen2023" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2024" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Samson, “Bang ta'anyamnu pitu' sapiran bu'unku ni kakana' masi ma papagan panganyaman, maka bang pahogotnu maka sisipit, in kosogku tahinang buwat kosog-kosog l'lla kasehe'an.” Jari itu, makatuli pa'in si Samson, niā' e' si Delila pitu' sapiran bu'unna bo' nianyam ni kakana'.

verses.name: Judges 16:14
verses.text: Pinahogot isab maka sisipit. <div eID="gen2024" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2025" type="paragraph"/> Angalingan pabalik si Delila, “O Samson!” yukna. “Itiya' na saga Pilistin anaggaw ka'a!” Magtūy pabungkal si Samson min pabahakanna ati nihella' e'na sisipit maka papagan panganyaman, sampay kakana'.

verses.name: Judges 16:15
verses.text: Allā, magmahi si Delila ma si Samson, yukna, “Yuknu in aku kalasahannu, saguwā' mbal aku pangandolannu. Mint'llu na aku parupangnu, sabab halam aku pata'unu bang m'nningga ya pangā'annu kosognu aheya ilu.”

verses.name: Judges 16:16
verses.text: Llaw ni llaw, buwattē' na pa'in pamogos si Delila sampay mbal na kasabalan e' si Samson.  <div eID="gen2025" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1195"/><div sID="gen2026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1195"/> Angkan nihaka e'na bang m'nningga kosogna. Yukna, “Halam to'ongan bay kaguntingan bu'unku, sabab aku itu Nasiri, a'a bay tapanukbal ni Tuhan min waktu bay kapaganak ma aku. Bang kaguntingan bu'unku, tantu pahalam kosogku, ati tahinang la'a aku buwat kosog saga kasehe'an l'lla.”  <div eID="gen2026" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1196"/><div sID="gen2027" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1196"/> Na, tananam pa'in e' si Delila in pangahaka si Samson inān b'nnal, aniya' lapal pabeya'na ni pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin, yuk-i, “Pabalik kam pi'itu min t'dda la'a, sabab tapangahakana kamemon ma aku.” Jari pabalik pehē' saga nakura' Pilistin maka e' sigām amowa pilak buwat bay janji' sigām.

verses.name: Judges 16:19
verses.text: Tapatuli pa'in si Samson e' si Delila ma pa'ana, aniya' a'a soho'na angangguntingan kapitu' sapiran bu'un si Samson. Pagka buwattē', yampa tagaga e'na si Samson sabab pahalam na kosogna.

verses.name: Judges 16:20
verses.text: Jari angolang si Delila, “O Samson, itiya' na saga Pilistin anaggaw ka'a!” Makabati' pa'in iya, pagbā'na dai'-dai' du iya makakuyas buwat bay tagna'. Saguwā' halam tata'una in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bay na ala'an min iya.  <div eID="gen2027" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1197"/><div sID="gen2028" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1197"/> Sakali tasaggaw iya e' bangsa Pilistin ati nilugit matana bo' iya binowa ni Gasa. Niengkotan iya maka kili-kili tumbaga, ati pinagiling iya tirigu ma deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Judges 16:22
verses.text: Samantala' mahē' pa'in iya, inut-inut na pataha' bu'unna pabalik.  <div eID="gen2028" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2014" type="section"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1198"/><div sID="gen2029" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kawapat si Samson</title> <div sID="gen2030" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1198"/> Jari magtimuk na saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin bo' angungsud tutukbalan ni tuhan-tuhan sigām si Dagon. Maglami-lami sigām maka e' sigām magsibahat, yuk-i, “Pinara'ug kitam e' tuhantam, tinugutan bantatam ni komkomantam.”  <div eID="gen2030" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1199"/><div sID="gen2031" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1199"/> Pag'nda' pa'in saga a'a Gasa inān ma si Samson, magtūy pinudji tuhan-tuhan sigām, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen2032"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2033"/>“Pinara'ug kitam e' tuhantam,<l eID="gen2033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2034"/>tinugutan ni ga'osantam<l eID="gen2034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2035"/>ya a'a bay amaka'at lahattam,<l eID="gen2035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2036"/>ya bay amapatay saga a'atam lipat-manglipat.”<l eID="gen2036" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2032"/>  <div eID="gen2031" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1200"/><div sID="gen2037" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1200"/> Jari itu, hinabu sigām maglami-lami maka maglangohan, angolang sigām, yuk-i, “Paluwasunbi pi'itu si Samson amalasig kitam.” Jari pinaluwas iya min deyom kalabusu ati nihinang paglasig-lasigan. <div eID="gen2037" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2038" type="paragraph"/> Pagubus pinat'ngge iya ma atag saga hāg luma'.

verses.name: Judges 16:26
verses.text: Pasalta', ah'lling si Samson ni sosoho'an ya anonda' iya, yukna, “Pasekotun lagi' aku ni hāg ya panuku luma' pagtata'atan itu bo' aku makasandig.”

verses.name: Judges 16:27
verses.text: Na, aragsok asal luma' inān e' saga a'a l'lla-d'nda maka kamemon saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin. Aniya' sigām saga t'llu ngibu puhu' ma karatagan atop inān ang'nda'-ng'nda' ma kahinangan si Samson.  <div eID="gen2038" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1201"/><div sID="gen2039" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1201"/> Jari angamu'-ngamu' iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “O Yawe, Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, entomun aku. O Tuhan, pabalikun gi' kosogku minsan hal mint'dda. Bang pa'in aku makabalos saru'un-du'un ma saga Pilistin ma bay pangalugit sigām ma duwa mataku.”

verses.name: Judges 16:29
verses.text: Magtūy ni'ntanan e' si Samson duwa hāg a'aslag ya panuku luma' pagtata'atan ni Dagon inān. Binalutan e'na karuwa, tanganna kowan ma dakayu' hāg, maka tanganna gibang isab ma dakayu'.

verses.name: Judges 16:30
verses.text: Pagubus, anibahat si Samson, yukna, “Bang pa'in aku magunung amatay maka saga Pilistin itu!” Magtūy iya amuspusan kosogna bo' tinulak duwa hāg inān. Jari alubu luma' pagtata'atan e'. Talapay isāb ba'anan pagnakura'an Pilistin maka saga a'a bay maina'an. Minnē' aheka lagi' tapapatay e' si Samson ma kamatayna min bay tapapatayna ma waktu gi' kallumna.  <div eID="gen2039" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1202"/><div sID="gen2040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1202"/> Jari palūd pina'an saga danakan si Samson l'lla maka saga kakampunganna min mma', bo' angā' mayatna. Binowa iya amole' ni lahatna bo' kinubul ma bay pangubulan mma'na si Manowa, ya ma llot Sora maka Esta'ol. Duwampū' tahun ya t'ggol kapagnakura' si Samson ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2040" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2029" type="section"/> <div eID="gen1669" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Judg.16"/> <div eID="gen1665" osisID="Judg" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1203"/><div sID="gen2047" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Naomi maka si Rūt</title> <div sID="gen2048" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1203"/> Ma waktu pa'in aniya' maghuhukum analassay palkala' ma bangsa Isra'il, bay ginotom lahat sigām. Manjari aniya' dakayu' l'lla min kauman Betlehem magbeya' maka h'ndana maka duwa anakna l'lla bay papinda ni lahat Mowab.

verses.name: Ruth 1:2
verses.text: Ya ōn l'lla itu si Elemelek, h'ndana si Naomi, ōn duwangan anakna inān si Mahalon maka si Kiliyon. Sigām itu tumpuk Eprat min kauman Betlehem ma lahat Yuda. Bay sigām papinda ni lahat Mowab bo' mahē' maglahat.  <div eID="gen2048" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1204"/><div sID="gen2049" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1204"/> Na, at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in sigām maina'an, amatay si Elemelek ya h'lla si Naomi, ati si Naomi la'a maka karuwangan anakna tabba.

verses.name: Ruth 1:4
verses.text: Makah'nda duwangan anakna inān ni d'nda bangsa Mowab, ya ōn sigām si Orpa maka si Rūt. Palabay pa'in sangpū' tahun,

verses.name: Ruth 1:5
verses.text: amatay isab disi Mahalon maka si Kiliyon, jari si Naomi la'a takapin pagka amatay na anak-h'llana.  <div eID="gen2049" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1205"/><div sID="gen2050" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1205"/> Masi gi' sigām ma lahat Mowab, kahaka'an si Naomi pasal saga a'a ma lahatna porol, aheka kono' pagkakan sigām ma sabab kaheya tabang <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:7
verses.text: Manjari, ala'an na sigām min lahat bay pat'nna'an sigām inān bo' pabīng ni Yuda ya lahatna.  <div eID="gen2050" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1206"/><div sID="gen2051" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1206"/> Ma pal'ngnganan pa'in, ah'lling si Naomi ni saga ayuwanna inān, yukna, “Saga dayang, amole' na kam pabalik ni saga matto'abi. Mura-murahan bang pa'in kam binuwanan kahāpan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> buwat kahāpan bay tahinangbi ma aku maka saga kah'lla'anbi he'.

verses.name: Ruth 1:9
verses.text: Bang pa'in kam isab nirūlan e'na makapagh'lla maka kaniya'an kam kahāpan ma deyoman sigām.” Jari, siniyum e' si Naomi saga ayuwanna ati anangis to'ongan duwangan itu

verses.name: Ruth 1:10
verses.text: maka he' sigām ah'lling ni iya, yuk-i, “Ameya' na kami pabīng ma ka'a ni saga kampungnu.”  <div eID="gen2051" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1207"/><div sID="gen2052" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1207"/> Saguwā' anambung si Naomi, yukna, “Saga dayang, magpamole' na kam. Angay kam subay ameya' ma aku? Mbal na aku makabāk anak tapamah'llaku ma ka'am pabīng.

verses.name: Ruth 1:12
verses.text: Pehē' na kam,” yukna, “aku itu ato'a na. Mbal na aku makah'lla. Maka minsan isab aniya' h'llaku pahulid ni aku sangom ilu bo' aku maka'anak pabalik,

verses.name: Ruth 1:13
verses.text: makalagad bahā' kam sampay sigām ta'abut asubul? Tantu mbal na. Gom gi' ka'am ilu saga dayang, da'a na buwat aku itu sabab ahunit landu' ya bay pamat'kka e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma aku.”  <div eID="gen2052" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1208"/><div sID="gen2053" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1208"/> Ma pasal pamissala si Naomi he', anangis sigām pabīng. Jari pasiyum maka ama'id na si Orpa, sagō' si Rūt paunung ma mato'ana.  <div eID="gen2053" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1209"/><div sID="gen2054" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1209"/> Yuk si Naomi, “O'o, nda'un ba, bilasnu ilu amole' na ni saga matto'ana maka ni pagtuhananna. Na, pehē' na ka ameya' ma iya.”  <div eID="gen2054" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1210"/><div sID="gen2055" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1210"/> Sagō' ya sambung si Rūt, “Da'a aku pogosun ang'bba atawa anaikutan ka'a. Pi'ingga-pi'ingga ka ameya' aku. Maingga-maingga pat'nna'annu mahē' isab aku. In bangsanu ya na bangsaku, jari in Tuhannu ya na pagtuhananku.

verses.name: Ruth 1:17
verses.text: Bang ka maingga amatay, mahē' du isab aku amatay maka kinubul. Bang pa'in aku minulka'an he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang aku pa'bba min ka'a. Luwal la'a bang kamatay ya makapagbutas ma kita.”

verses.name: Ruth 1:18
verses.text: Tasayu pa'in e' si Naomi lilla' ameya' ma iya si Rūt, pahali na iya amogos.  <div eID="gen2055" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1211"/><div sID="gen2056" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1211"/> Puwas pa'in he'-i, palanjal na sigām karuwangan sampay sigām makat'kka ni Betlehem. Pag'nda' ma sigām, takuddat saga a'a ma kauman inān. Jari ah'lling saga kar'ndahan maina'an, yuk-i, “Si Naomi na bahā' ilu?”  <div eID="gen2056" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1212"/><div sID="gen2057" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1212"/> Sagō' yuk si Naomi<note>Naomi: hatina ‘koyag.’</note> ni sigām, “Da'a na aku ōninbi maka ōnku, sagō' ōninbi na aku Mara<note>Mara: hatina ‘pa'it.’</note> sabab bay aku pinat'kkahan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> kasukkalan mbal tapula'-pula'.

verses.name: Ruth 1:21
verses.text: Waktu bay kala'anku minnitu jukup-jukupan gi' aku, sagō' bay aku pinabalik he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pi'itu ma halam na aniya' ai-aiku. Angkan da'a na aku ōninbi Naomi sabab bay aku pinat'kkahan kasukkalan maka kulang-kabus he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa.”  <div eID="gen2057" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1213"/><div sID="gen2058" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1213"/> Jari makabalik si Naomi maka ayuwanna si Rūt min Mowab. At'kka sigām ni Betlehem ma timpu yampa anagna' pagani.  <div eID="gen2058" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Ruth.1"/> <div eID="gen2047" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1214"/><div sID="gen2059" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagbāk si Rūt maka si Bowas</title> <div sID="gen2060" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1214"/> Manjari, aniya' l'lla pinagōnan si Bowas, a'a taga-kaniya' maka ga'osan. Min tumpuk si Elemelek iya, pamikitan si Naomi min h'llana.  <div eID="gen2060" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1215"/><div sID="gen2061" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1215"/> Dakayu' llaw, ah'lling si Rūt ni si Naomi, yukna, “Babu', papehē'un gi' aku ni huma amuwa' kapin bay paganihan ma sai-sai ya bilahi pameya'anku.” <div eID="gen2061" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2062" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Naomi, yukna, “Aho', pehē' ka, dayang.”

verses.name: Ruth 2:3
verses.text: Jari lum'ngngan na si Rūt ni huma paturul min buli'an saga a'a maga'ani inān amuwa' kapin bay paganihan he'. In tag-dapu huma inān ya na si Bowas kampung si Elemelek.  <div eID="gen2062" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1216"/><div sID="gen2063" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1216"/> Ma waktu ina'an-i, at'kka si Bowas bay min Betlehem ati sinagina e'na saga a'a maga'ani he', yukna, “Owa'! Bang pa'in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabeya' ma ka'am!” <div eID="gen2063" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2064" type="paragraph"/> Yuk isab sambung saga a'a inān, “Bang pa'in ka binarakatan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>!”  <div eID="gen2064" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1217"/><div sID="gen2065" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1217"/> Jari atilaw si Bowas ni kapatas saga maga'ani yukna, “Sai sa d'nda inān?”  <div eID="gen2065" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1218"/><div sID="gen2066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1218"/> Anambung kapatas itu, yukna, “D'nda ilu a'a bangsa Mowab bay ameya' pi'itu ma si Naomi min lahat Mowab.

verses.name: Ruth 2:7
verses.text: Bay iya ama'id min aku bang kono' iya makajari paturul min buli'an saga maga'ani amuwa' kapin bay paganihan he'. Min abay subu lagi' kapaghinangna ilu. Ya du halianna ilu pasindung dai'-dai'.”  <div eID="gen2066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1219"/><div sID="gen2067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1219"/> Jari ah'lling si Bowas ni si Rūt yukna, “Arung, akale ka pahāp. Da'a na ka paliyu amuwa' ni huma saddī. Maitu na sadja ka magbeya' maka saga sosoho'anku kar'ndahan itu.

verses.name: Ruth 2:9
verses.text: Nda'un bang maingga paganihan saga a'aku ati pasambeya' ka ma saga kar'ndahan ilu. Bay na banda'anku saga kal'llahan maitu soho'ku ka da'a ni'inay ma sigām. Bang ka patay-bohe', pehē' pa'in ka angā' min kibut bay ni'isihan e' saga kal'llahan e'.”  <div eID="gen2067" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1220"/><div sID="gen2068" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1220"/> Pagka buwattē' ya bissala si Bowas, magtūy pasujud si Rūt ni tana' ati ah'lling, yukna, “Tuwan, angay aku pahalga'nu? Aku itu dakayu' sadja a'a liyu.”  <div eID="gen2068" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1221"/><div sID="gen2069" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1221"/> Sagō' anambung si Bowas yukna, “Bay aku kahaka'an ma pasal kahāpan bay tahinangnu ma mato'anu min bay gi' kamatay h'llanu. Bay kono' bbahannu ina'-mma'nu sampay lahatnu ati itu ka ameya' pat'nna' ma lahat halam bay kata'uwannu.

verses.name: Ruth 2:12
verses.text: Bang pa'in ka nilidjiki'an he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa ma bay tahinangnu ilu. Bang pa'in ka tinungbasan manglabi-labihan he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bangsa Isra'il, ya sapantun pikpik manuk pasindungannu.”  <div eID="gen2069" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1222"/><div sID="gen2070" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1222"/> Yuk sambung si Rūt, “Bang pa'in aku taptap makasulut pangatayannu, tuwan. Bay aluknu pangatayanku sabab kahāp sin saga bissalanu ilu minsan aku mbal makasibu' ni d'nda sosoho'annu.”  <div eID="gen2070" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1223"/><div sID="gen2071" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1223"/> Ta'abut pa'in waktu pagkakan, nilinganan si Rūt he' si Bowas, “Pi'itu ka,” yukna, “pasalu ka ma kami amangan tinapay bo' bahugun ni suka' binu-anggul itu.” <div eID="gen2071" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2072" type="paragraph"/> Maina'an pa'in ma pagkakanan, nilabot si Rūt e' si Bowas maka pai sinanglag. Jari amangan iya pahāp sampay asso maka aniya' gi' takapin.

verses.name: Ruth 2:15
verses.text: Bay pa'in he'-i, an'ngge na iya bo' pabalik ni paghinanganna. Ah'lling si Bowas ni saga sosoho'anna yukna, “Amay-amay, da'a iya lāngunbi minsan iya amuwa' ma tongod saga p'kkosan.

verses.name: Ruth 2:16
verses.text: Gom pa'in ngā'inbi iya min p'kkosan he' bo' pat'nna'unbi ma pamuwa'anna. Dūlinbi sadja iya.”  <div eID="gen2072" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1224"/><div sID="gen2073" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1224"/> Angkan mahē' na pa'in si Rūt ma huma sampay ni kasangoman. Pagt'ppana saga buwa' pai-tirigu<note>Pai-tirigu, hatina pai sigām ya pangahinang tirigu.</note> bay tapuwa'na he', magbuhat saga sangpū' gantang.

verses.name: Ruth 2:18
verses.text: Manjari binowa e'na amole' ati ta'nda' e' mato'ana bang pila heka bay tatimukna. Sinōngan isab e'na ni mato'ana ya labi min bay pamangananna he'.  <div eID="gen2073" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1225"/><div sID="gen2074" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1225"/> Sakali tinilaw iya e' mato'ana, yuk-i, “ Maingga ka bay amuwa' llaw ilu? Sai tag-dapu huma bay paghinangannu? Bang pa'in aheya kahāpan ma a'a bay amaidda ka'a ilu.” <div eID="gen2074" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2075" type="paragraph"/> Jari nihaka e' si Rūt ma si Naomi pasalan ya tag-dapu lugal bay paghinanganna he'. “Si Bowas,” yukna, “ya ōn a'a bay paghinanganku llaw itu.”  <div eID="gen2075" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1226"/><div sID="gen2076" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1226"/> “<divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> magbarakat ma si Bowas,” yuk si Naomi. “Halam pahali kahāpanna ma saga allum maka ma saga wa'i na magpatayan<note>Hatina, saga anak si Naomi l'lla ya wa'i na amatay.</note>.” Ah'lling gi' si Naomi, yukna, “Ya l'lla ōnannu ilu kampungtam du. Ya ilu taga-kapatut anabangan kita.”  <div eID="gen2076" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1227"/><div sID="gen2077" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1227"/> Ah'lling gi' si Rūt, “Bay isab iya ah'lling ma aku sinoho' gi' aku ameya' ma saga sosoho'anna sampay sigām aubus magani.”  <div eID="gen2077" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1228"/><div sID="gen2078" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1228"/> Yuk si Naomi ni si Rūt, “Ahāp ko' he' bang ka mahē' ma humana magbeya' maka saga sosoho'anna kar'ndahan. Sabab bang a'a saddī ya pameya'annu, aniya' arai' angala'at ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2078" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1229"/><div sID="gen2079" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1229"/> Jari mahē' na si Rūt maka saga sosoho'an si Bowas kar'ndahan sampay aubus musim pagani. Sagō' masi iya pat'nna' ma mato'ana.  <div eID="gen2079" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Ruth.2"/> <div eID="gen2059" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1230"/><div sID="gen2080" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Bowas maka si Rūt</title> <div sID="gen2081" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1230"/> Dakayu' llaw ah'lling si Naomi ni si Rūt, “Dayang,” yukna, “piha'anta ka pat'nna'an atotog bo' aniya' magnapaka ma ka'a.

verses.name: Ruth 3:2
verses.text: Kampungta asal si Bowas, ya tag-dapu huma bay paghinangan saga kar'ndahan bay pameya'annu he'. Sangom itu, pehē' iya ni tongod pagt'ppahan bo' magtahap saga bay niani he'.

verses.name: Ruth 3:3
verses.text: Amandi ka bo' ka amahamut di-nu. Jari sulugun badju'nu ahāp to'ongan bo' ka pehē' ni pagt'ppahan. Da'a iya pata'uhun in ka'a wa'i mahē', subay na iya aubus amangan maka anginum.

verses.name: Ruth 3:4
verses.text: Bang iya makalege na, gindanin bang ma atag ingga palegehanna. Jari pehē' ka, laisun mantana bo' ka abahak ma tape'anna. Nihaka'an du ka e'na bang ai subay hinangnu.”  <div eID="gen2081" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1231"/><div sID="gen2082" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1231"/> Anambung si Rūt yukna, “Beya'ku kamemon panoho'annu ilu, babu'.”

verses.name: Ruth 3:6
verses.text: Manjari bineya' he' si Rūt panoho'an mato'ana ati pehē' na iya ni tongod pagt'ppahan.  <div eID="gen2082" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1232"/><div sID="gen2083" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1232"/> Aubus pa'in bay amangan maka anginum si Bowas bo' hinabu ahāp palasahanna, pabahak iya ma tongod pagtau'an pai. Jari tatuli pa'in iya, pasekot pina'an si Rūt kamaya'-maya' bo' nilais manta min tape' si Bowas ati palege iya ma tape'an.

verses.name: Ruth 3:8
verses.text: Alalom pa'in bahangi, takuddat si Bowas angkan iya makahimuya, maka aniya' d'nda tasayuna palege ma atag tape'na.  <div eID="gen2083" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1233"/><div sID="gen2084" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1233"/> “Sai sa ka'a ilu?” yukna. <div eID="gen2084" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2085" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Rūt, “Aku itu si Rūt, ya sosoho'annu,” yukna. “Pagka ka'a ilu kampung kami taga-kapatut, b'llatun gi' tōng mantanu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen2085" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1234"/><div sID="gen2086" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1234"/> “Mura-murahan bang pa'in ka nilidjiki'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, dayang,” yuk si Bowas. “Ya kahāpan tahinangnu buwattina'an aheya gi' min bay tahinangnu dahū. Halam ka bay sinōd baya' ma kal'llahan abata', ai na ka miskin atawa dayahan.

verses.name: Ruth 3:11
verses.text: Angkan buwattina'an, da'a na ka asusa sabab beya'ku kamemon pangamu'nu. Makata'u du isab kamemon lūng-kampungnu in ka'a ilu d'nda abontol.

verses.name: Ruth 3:12
verses.text: B'nnal ya yuknu ilu, in aku dakayu' kampungnu taga-kapatut anabangan ka'a, sagō' aniya' gi' kampungnu labi aga'os min aku.

verses.name: Ruth 3:13
verses.text: Maitu na ka atuli sangom itu. Salung subu, pehē'ku a'a he', kalu niakuhan e'na amah'nda ka'a. Bang hati' iya angaku, ahāp. Sagō' bang mbal, na saksi'ta <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya allum salama-lama in aku itu angakuhan ka'a du. Maitu na ka atuli.”  <div eID="gen2086" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1235"/><div sID="gen2087" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1235"/> Manjari palege na si Rūt maina'an sampay ni kasubuhan. Pagdai' llaw pabangun na iya ma halam lagi' aniya' makasayuhan iya. Yuk si Bowas ma saga a'ana, “Da'a kam amata'u ni sai-na saga aniya' d'nda bay makapi'itu ni pagt'ppahan.”

verses.name: Ruth 3:15
verses.text: Ah'lling lagi' si Bowas, yukna, “Bowahun pi'itu se'ob ma barannu ilu bo' b'llatun maitu.” Pagb'llat pa'in se'ob inān, tin'ppongan iya nnom gantang pai-tirigu bay tin'ppa bo' pinadurung ma iya. Jari amole' na pabīng si Bowas ni kaumanna.  <div eID="gen2087" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1236"/><div sID="gen2088" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1236"/> Makapole' pa'in si Rūt, tinilaw iya e' mato'ana, yuk-i, “Buwattingga du, dayang?” <div eID="gen2088" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2089" type="paragraph"/> Sinuli-sulihan e' si Rūt mato'ana bang ai bay tahinang e' si Bowas ma iya.

verses.name: Ruth 3:17
verses.text: Maka yukna gi' isab, “Bay aku binuwanan nnom gantang pai-tirigu e' si Bowas, sabab bang ma iya, sinoho' aku mbal amole' bang halam aniya' tabowaku pamuwan ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2089" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1237"/><div sID="gen2090" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1237"/> Manjari ah'lling si Naomi, “Angagad-ngagad na sadja ka, dayang, sampay tata'unu bang ai kataluwa'anna. Tantu mbal pahali si Bowas llaw itu bang halam aniya' kajatuhan palkala' itu.”  <div eID="gen2090" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Ruth.3"/> <div eID="gen2080" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1238"/><div sID="gen2091" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ningā' H'nda si Rūt e' si Bowas</title> <div sID="gen2092" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1238"/> Manjari itu, hinabu magsuli-suli si Naomi maka si Rūt, pehē' si Bowas aningkō' ma atag lawang ya pagsōran kauman Betlehem e'. Sakali palabay minna'an dakayu' kampung si Naomi ya bay pinagpa'in e' si Bowas. Magtūy lingananna bo' binowa magsuli-suli. Yuk si Bowas, “O tuwan, pi'itu gi' ka aningkō'.” Na pasekot a'a inān aningkō'.  <div eID="gen2092" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1239"/><div sID="gen2093" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1239"/> Sakali pinalinganan e' si Bowas sangpū' pagmatto'ahan ma kauman inān. Yukna ni sigām, “Aningkō' kam maitu saga tuwan.” Jari aningkō' isab sigām.

verses.name: Ruth 4:3
verses.text: Makatingkō' pa'in sigām kamemon, ah'lling si Bowas ni kampung he', yukna, “Tuwan, in si Naomi, ya balu si Elemelek, bay na pabīng pi'itu min lahat Mowab maka aniya' niyatna angandagangan tana' si Elemelek ya bay kampungta.

verses.name: Ruth 4:4
verses.text: Wajib ka pahatiku, kalu ka bilahi angal'kkat. Bang ka bilahi, atiya' saga pagmatto'ahanta anaksi', beya' isab saga a'a kasehe'an ya magtingkō'an maitu. Damikiyanna isab bang ka mbal, haka'in aku bo' kata'uwanku. Sabab halam aniya' saddī taga-kapatut angal'kkat tana' inān bang ngga'i ka ka'a bo' yampa aku.” <div eID="gen2093" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2094" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', l'kkatku na,” yuk kampung si Bowas inān.  <div eID="gen2094" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1240"/><div sID="gen2095" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1240"/> Jari ah'lling si Bowas, “Pagka b'llinu na tana' min si Naomi maka ayuwanna si Rūt ya d'nda Mowab, akuhannu du isab ningā' h'nda si Rūt. Jari mbal alungay ōn si Mahalon minsan amatay, sabab kaniya'an iya anak min bay h'ndana, maka aniya' na pa'in tubu' pamusaka'an tana'na.”<note>Ya addat bangsa Yahudi ma masa ina'an, bang aniya' a'a amatay ma halam gi' taga-anak, in baluna subay niā' h'nda he' danakanna bo' supaya aniya' tubu' ma a'a mamatay he'. Jari mbal alungay ōnna maka taptap aniya' tubu'na pinusaka'an tana' ya bay pamusaka' isab ma iya.</note>  <div eID="gen2095" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1241"/><div sID="gen2096" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1241"/> Anambung kampung inān, yukna, “Bang buwattilu hatulanna, mbal aku maka'aku angal'kkat tana' ilu sabab mbal du tahinangku pusaka'. Na, ka'a na ya angal'kkat sabab mbal tagagaku.”  <div eID="gen2096" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1242"/><div sID="gen2097" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1242"/> (Na ya addat ma masa he'-i ma lahat Isra'il, bang aniya' a'a magpal'kkat atawa magdagang ai-ai pangalta'na, subay niurusan taumpa'na bo' ni'nde'an ni a'a angal'kkat inān. Ya itu hatulan sara' ma bangsa Isra'il ma takdil l'ngngan kataddangan.)

verses.name: Ruth 4:8
verses.text: Angkan yuk kampung inān ni si Bowas, “Ka'a na am'lli tana' ilu.” Magtūy niurusan taumpa'na.  <div eID="gen2097" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1243"/><div sID="gen2098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1243"/> Buwattē' pa'in, amissala si Bowas ni saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga a'a maina'an, yukna, “Kasaksi'anbi ma llaw itu aku ya makab'lli min si Naomi kamemon palsuku'an si Elemelek, si Kiliyon maka si Mahalon.

verses.name: Ruth 4:10
verses.text: Damikiyanna si Rūt ya d'nda bangsa Mowab, ya bay balu si Mahalon, ta'ā'ku na h'nda bo' supaya aniya' tubu' pinusaka'an kamemon bay palsuku'an a'a mamatay itu. Mbal isab takalipat ōnna min pangentom saga kaukampunganna atawa min lahatna. Saksi' kam llaw itu.”  <div eID="gen2098" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1244"/><div sID="gen2099" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1244"/> Anambung saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga a'a maina'an ma tongod lawang kauman e'. Yuk-i, “Aho', saksi' kami. Mura-murahan bang pa'in d'nda ya song tah'ndanu ilu binuwanan kahāpan he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pinasali' ni kahāpan bay tapamuwanna ma si Leya maka si Rakiya ya pagina'an bangsa Isra'il.” Yuk sigām gi' isab, “Bang pa'in pasōng kahaldayanu<note>Kahaldaya: atawa karaya.</note> ma tumpuk Eprat maka patanyag ōnnu ma Betlehem.

verses.name: Ruth 4:12
verses.text: Bang pa'in aniya' tubu' pamuwan ka'a he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min d'nda itu, bo' pasali' ka'anakannu ni anak si Peres, ya anak si Yuda min si Tamar.”  <div eID="gen2099" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2091" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1245"/><div sID="gen2100" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapangkatan si Da'ud</title> <div sID="gen2101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1245"/> Manjari ningā' na h'nda si Rūt he' si Bowas. Makapagdakayu' pa'in sigā, ab'ttong si Rūt min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ati anganak l'lla.

verses.name: Ruth 4:14
verses.text: Yuk saga kar'ndahan maina'an ni si Naomi, “Pudjitam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> sabab mbal ka kasiya-siyahan. Ma llaw itu du aniya' mpunu l'lla taga-kapatut amaruli ka'a. Bang pa'in atanyag onde' ilu ma katilingkal Isra'il.

verses.name: Ruth 4:15
verses.text: Iya ya amalasig ka'a maka angipat ka'a bang ka ta'abut na ato'a. Sabab ina' onde' ilu, ya na ayuwannu. Alasa iya ma ka'a, maka aheya halga'na ma ka'a min anak l'lla pitu' hekana.”  <div eID="gen2101" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1246"/><div sID="gen2102" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1246"/> Ati giniba he' si Naomi onde' inān ati ni'ipat he'na.

verses.name: Ruth 4:17
verses.text: Yuk saga kar'ndahan ma jadjahan ina'an, “Ahā, aniya' na anak si Naomi!” Jari Obed ya pangōn sigām ma iya. Na, si Obed itu ya na mma' si Jesse, si Jesse ya na mma' si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2102" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1247"/><div sID="gen2103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1247"/> Ya itu panubu' si Peres: <lg sID="gen2104"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2105"/>Si Peres ya na mma' si Hesdon,<l eID="gen2105" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2104"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:19
verses.text: si Hesdon ya na mma' si Rām. <lg sID="gen2106"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2107"/>Si Rām ya na mma' si Aminadab,<l eID="gen2107" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2106"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:20
verses.text: si Aminadab ya na mma' si Nason. <lg sID="gen2108"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2109"/>Si Nason ya na mma' si Salmon,<l eID="gen2109" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2108"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:21
verses.text: si Salmon ya na mma' si Bowas. <lg sID="gen2110"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2111"/>Si Bowas ya na mma' si Obed,<l eID="gen2111" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2110"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:22
verses.text: si Obed itu ya na mma' si Jesse, <lg sID="gen2112"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2113"/>Si Jesse itu ya na mma' si Da'ud.<l eID="gen2113" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2112"/>  <div eID="gen2103" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2100" type="section"/> <div eID="gen2046" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Ruth.4"/> <div eID="gen2041" osisID="Ruth" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1248"/><div sID="gen2121" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaganak ma si Samwel</title> <div sID="gen2122" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1248"/> Na, aniya' dakayu' l'lla niōnan si Elkana maglahat ma kauman Rama ma kabūd-būran Epra'im. Panubu' Epra'im si Elkana itu, min tumpuk si Sūp. Mma'na si Jeroham anak si Elihu, mpu si Tohu ya anak si Sūp.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:2
verses.text: Aniya' duwa h'nda si Elkana, ya si Hanna maka si Pennina. In si Pennina taga-anak bo' si Hanna halam.  <div eID="gen2122" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1249"/><div sID="gen2123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1249"/> Kahaba' tahun atulak si Elkana min kaumanna patukad ni Silo supaya pasumba maka anukbal lalabotan ni si Yawe ya Tuhan Sangat Kawasa. Ya magimam ma Silo inān si Opni maka si Pinehas, karuwangan anak imam Eli.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:4
verses.text: Sakahaba' waktu magkulban si Elkana, binahagi'an e'na si Pennina maka saga ka'anakanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:5
verses.text: Sagō' labi ahāp bahagi' ya pamuwanna ma si Hanna sabab kaheya lasana ma iya, minsan iya halam kabuwanan anak min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:6
verses.text: Na pagka halam kabuwanan anak si Hanna, sidda iya nijingki maka pinareyo'-deyo' e' kalu'ana si Pennina.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:7
verses.text: Tahun ni tahun buwattina'an na pa'in in kahālan. Sakahaba' waktu katukad sigām ni luma' pagtata'atan ni si Yawe, nijural na pa'in si Hanna e' kalu'ana sampay iya magtangis maka mbal na amangan.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:8
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling h'llana ni iya, yuk-i, “Oy rāng, angay ka anangis na pa'in ilu? Angay ka mbal minsan amangan? Ai karukka'annu? Kulang gi' bahā' halga'ku ma ka'a min sangpū' anak?”  <div eID="gen2123" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1250"/><div sID="gen2124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1250"/> Na dakayu' waktu ma Silo, pagubus sigām amangan maka anginum, pabuhat si Hanna. Ina'an asal imam Eli aningkō' ma bangku' ma atag bowa' lawang luma' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:10
verses.text: Na, landu' aheya kasukkalan si Hanna angkan iya anangis to'ongan maka e'na angamu'-ngamu' ni si Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:11
verses.text: Anganajal iya, yukna, “O Yawe Sangat Kawasa, ummatnu aku. Bang pa'in nda'nu kasukkalanku bo' aku palulinu pahāp. Bang aku dūlannu ati buwanannu anak l'lla, tukbalanku iya ni ka'a pabalik bo' maghinang ni ka'a sat'ggolna allum. Anganajal isab aku in kōkna mbal binagongan.”  <div eID="gen2124" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1251"/><div sID="gen2125" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1251"/> Ma pangamu'-ngamu' si Hanna ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, ta'nda' bowa'na e' si Eli.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:13
verses.text: Magkimut-kimut sadja bowa'na, halam magsuwala. Pangannal si Eli in iya nilango,

verses.name: I Samuel 1:14
verses.text: angkan yukna ma iya, “Arung, angay ka maglango sadja ilu? Timanin binunu!”  <div eID="gen2125" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1252"/><div sID="gen2126" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1252"/> “Halam aku nilango, tuwan,” yuk sambung si Hanna. “Tu'ud aheya karukka'anku. Halam aku maginum binu atawa ai-ai makalango, paluwasku sadja kasukkalanku ni si Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:16
verses.text: Da'a aku bistahun d'nda ala'at. Angamu'-ngamu' sadja aku sabab mbal kasandalan karukka'anku itu.”  <div eID="gen2126" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1253"/><div sID="gen2127" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1253"/> Ah'lling si Eli ni iya, “Pehē' na ka amole',” yukna, “bang pa'in ka mura-murahan asalamat maka kinale pangamu'-ngamu'nu e' Tuhan bangsatam Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen2127" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1254"/><div sID="gen2128" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1254"/> Ya panambung si Hanna, “Magsukul. Bang pa'in ka kasulutan ma aku, dakayu' sosoho'annu itu.” Jari ala'an na si Hanna minnē'. Aniya' isab takakanna ati ahāp na pamaihu'anna.  <div eID="gen2128" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1255"/><div sID="gen2129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1255"/> Pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, subu-subu lagi', pabangun disi Elkana maka saga anak-h'ndana bo' anumba ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Pagubus, amole' na sigām pabīng ni Rama ya lahat sigām. Pahulid si Elkana ni h'ndana si Hanna ati nirūlan e' si Yawe bay pangamu'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:20
verses.text: Jari ab'ttong iya ati ta'abut pa'in bulananna anganak iya l'lla. Niōnan e'na Samwel,<note>Samwel: da'anggil maka kabtangan Hibrani, hatina ‘takale e' Tuhan.’</note> sabab, yukna, “bay iya amu'ku min si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen2129" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2121" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1256"/><div sID="gen2130" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamasuku' si Samwel ma Tuhan e' si Hanna</title> <div sID="gen2131" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1256"/> Na, pagga ta'abut na bulanan Paghinang Taubat, patukad disi Elkana magtai'anak ni lahat Silo maghinang ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, ati tatuman isab e' si Elkana bay najalna ma iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:22
verses.text: Sagō' halam ameya' patukad si Hanna. Yukna ni h'llana, “Subay na alutas<note>Alutas: hatina ‘abutas min duru'.’</note> onde' itu bo' bowaku pehē', ati pamasuku'ku iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Jari mahē' iya pat'nna' sat'ggolna allum.”  <div eID="gen2131" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1257"/><div sID="gen2132" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1257"/> “Hinangun bang ai ya makasulut ka'a,” yuk si Elkana. “Maitu sadja ka sampay talutasnu onde' ilu, bang pa'in tatuman bay janji' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'a.” Jari pa'bba si Hanna ma luma' amaruru' onde' inān sampay talutas e'na.  <div eID="gen2132" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1258"/><div sID="gen2133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1258"/> Manjari talutas pa'in onde' inān, bo' ariki'-diki' lagi', binowa na iya e' ina'na ni luma' si Yawe ma Silo. Bay isab bowana dakayu' sapi' t'lluntahun umulna maka dakarut tirigu maka dapangisihan binu-anggul.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:25
verses.text: Tasumbali' pa'in sapi' he', ni'nde'an na si Samwel ni si Eli e' matto'ana.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:26
verses.text: Manjari anibahat si Hanna ma si Eli, yukna, “Sapahanku, tuwan, aku na d'nda ya bay an'ngge maitu ma bihingnu angamu'-ngamu' ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:27
verses.text: Bay aku angamu' anak ati nirūlan e'na pangamu'-ngamu'ku.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:28
verses.text: Angkan na buwattina'an, pamasuku'ku na ni iya onde' itu sat'ggolna allum.” Puwas pa'in he'-i, sinumba na si Yawe ma atag ina'an.  <div eID="gen2133" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.1"/> <div eID="gen2130" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1259"/><div sID="gen2134" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sambahayang si Hanna</title> <div sID="gen2135" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1259"/> Manjari anambahayang si Hanna, yukna, <lg sID="gen2136"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2137"/>“Akōg-koyag pangatayanku ma pasal si Yawe,<l eID="gen2137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2138"/>Pinajatu kosogku ma sabab si Yawe,<l eID="gen2138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2139"/>angkan pagtittowahanku saga bantaku,<l eID="gen2139" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2140"/>magkalasigan aku ma sabab da'ugan<l eID="gen2140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2141"/>ya pamuwannu ma aku, O Tuhan.<l eID="gen2141" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2142"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:2
verses.text: Halam aniya' manusiya' asussi buwat kasussi si Yawe.<l eID="gen2142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2143"/>Sapantun iya Batu Lakit pasindungan,<l eID="gen2143" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2144"/>halam aniya' makasibu'an iya.<l eID="gen2144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2145"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:3
verses.text: Sasuku kam magmalangkahi subay pahali.<l eID="gen2145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2146"/>Sasuku kam magabbu-abbu subay pabba,<l eID="gen2146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2147"/>sabab si Yawe ya makata'u kamemon.<l eID="gen2147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2148"/>Iya ya angahukum kamemon kahinangan manusiya'.<l eID="gen2148" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2149"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:4
verses.text: Tara'ug saga sundalu magpapana' ya tamakaesog,<l eID="gen2149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2150"/>saguwā' sasuku bay lumukbu'<l eID="gen2150" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2151"/>binuwanan kosog labi-labihan.<l eID="gen2151" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2152"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:5
verses.text: Sasuku bay asso tagna' magpatiata na<l eID="gen2152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2153"/>bo' aniya' balanja' sigām,<l eID="gen2153" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2154"/>sagō' saga a'a bay patay otas mbal na lingantu.<l eID="gen2154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2155"/>Sasuku bay mbal maka'anak,<l eID="gen2155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2156"/>maka'anak na pitu' hekana,<l eID="gen2156" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2157"/>sagō' in bay aheka anakna asiya-siya du.<l eID="gen2157" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2158"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:6
verses.text: Taga-kapatut si Yawe amakallum maka amapatay,<l eID="gen2158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2159"/>amowa saga manusiya' ni ahirat<l eID="gen2159" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2160"/>maka amangun sigām.<l eID="gen2160" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2161"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:7
verses.text: Makaparaya iya ba'anan a'a miskin<l eID="gen2161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2162"/>ati makapamiskin ba'anan a'a dayahan,<l eID="gen2162" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2163"/>makapamareyo' iya maka makapamalanga.<l eID="gen2163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2164"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:8
verses.text: Tahaun e'na saga miskin min kasigpitan sigām,<l eID="gen2164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2165"/>tapaluwas sigām min kaiya'an.<l eID="gen2165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2166"/>Pinatingkō' sigām magbeya' maka ba'anan kasultanan<l eID="gen2166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2167"/>bo' supaya sigām pinagmahaldika'.<l eID="gen2167" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2168"/>Si Yawe asal tag-suku'an alam maka po'onanna,<l eID="gen2168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2169"/>ya pamapanjarihanna dunya maka kapanyapanna.<l eID="gen2169" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2170"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:9
verses.text: Jagahanna sasuku sigām am'nnal ma iya,<l eID="gen2170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2171"/>sagō' in a'a jahulaka' amatay ma deyom kalendoman.<l eID="gen2171" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2172"/>Halam aniya' makapanganda'ug bang hal min kosogna.<l eID="gen2172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2173"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:10
verses.text: Magmula isab sai-sai anagga' si Yawe.<l eID="gen2173" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2174"/>Pinal'ggonan sigām e'na min langit.<l eID="gen2174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2175"/>Si Yawe ya angahukum katilingkal dunya.<l eID="gen2175" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2176"/>Aheya kosog pamuwanna ma a'a ya tahinangna sultan,<l eID="gen2176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2177"/>aheya da'ugan ya pamuwanna ma a'a bay tapene'na.”<l eID="gen2177" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2136"/>  <div eID="gen2135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1260"/><div sID="gen2178" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1260"/> Manjari, amole' na pabalik si Elkana maka si Hanna ni Rama. Sagō' ya si Samwel ta'bba ma Silo maghinang ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma deyo'an si Imam Eli.  <div eID="gen2178" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2134" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1261"/><div sID="gen2179" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paldusahan saga Anak si Eli L'lla</title> <div sID="gen2180" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1261"/> Na saga anak si Eli itu ala'at kahinangan sigām, mbal magaddatan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:13
verses.text: Mbal isab sigām ameya' ma kauntulan ya bineya' e' saga kaimaman bang aniya' susumbali'an binowa panukbal ni Tuhan. Ma pam'llahan pa'in isi susumbali'an inān, pinapehē' dakayu' sosoho'an imam amowa tugsukna aheya.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:14
verses.text: Jari ai-ai tatugsuk e' sosoho'an inān, ai na ka ma kaha' atawa ma kaldero, ya na suku' imam. Buwattē' na pa'in addat kaimaman ma saga bangsa Isra'il waktu kapehē' sigām ni Silo.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:15
verses.text: Sagō' buwattina'an, ma halam lagi' tatunu' lanab sumbali'an, aniya' sosoho'an imam pinapehē' ah'lling ni a'a magtukbal. Yukna, “Pamuwanun ma imam susumbali'an amata' ilu bo' tinapa e'na. Mbal tinaima' e'na bang talaga' na, luwal subay amata'.”  <div eID="gen2180" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:16
