verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1262"/><div sID="gen2181" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1262"/> Bang anambung a'a magtukbal inān, yukna, “Subay atunu' lanabna bo' ka angā' ya ingga kabilahiannu,” na, pinah'llingan iya e' sosoho'an imam e'. Yukna, “Hē! Mbal makajari! Sōngin na magtūy sabab bang ka mbal bilahi, agawku sadja min ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2181" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1263"/><div sID="gen2182" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1263"/> Na, landu' asammal ma pang'nda' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bay kahinangan saga anak si Eli itu sabab talumu' he' sigām lalabotan ya tinukbal ma iya.  <div eID="gen2182" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2179" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1264"/><div sID="gen2183" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Samwel ma Silo</title> <div sID="gen2184" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1264"/> Malaingkan, ina'an si Samwel maghinang na ni si Yawe minsan iya abata' gi'. Magbinadju' iya epod pangalampik jubana.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:19
verses.text: Tahun ni tahun, nihinangan si Samwel juba he' ina'na, binowahan iya ma waktu katukad si Hanna maka h'llana pehē' bo' maghinang Pagtaubat.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:20
verses.text: Jari, niamu'an barakat disi Elkana maglakibini e' si Eli. Yukna, “Mura-murahan bang pa'in kam kabuwanan anak e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min h'ndanu itu paganti' min onde' bay amu'na ma iya ati bay du tukbalanna pabalik ni iya.” Pagubus, amole' na sigā.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:21
verses.text: Manjari, pinagka'inagonan si Hanna e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ati kabuwanan gi' iya t'llu anak l'lla maka duwa anak d'nda. Jari pasulig na pa'in si Samwel hinabuna maghinang ni si Yawe.  <div eID="gen2184" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1265"/><div sID="gen2185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1265"/> Na, minsan ato'a na si Eli, takale e'na pasal kamemon kalumu'an ya nihinang e' saga anakna l'lla ma saga bangsa Isra'il. Maka takale du isab e'na pasal paghulid sigām maka saga kar'ndahan ya maghinang ma Luma' Tolda Pagsasabuhan inān.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:23
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling si Eli ni saga anakna, yukna, “Takaleku min saga a'a in kahinanganbi asammal! Angay kam magkahinangan buwattilu?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:24
verses.text: Saga anak, halli'inbi na saga kahinanganbi ilu sabab ala'at kinale suli-suli ya pasaplag inān ma ba'anan jama'a <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: I Samuel 2:25
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Eli, yukna, “Bang a'a makarusa ma pagkahina manusiya', makapati'llot Tuhan ma sigām. Sagō' bang a'a makarusa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, na sai na gi' magpati'llot ma iya?” Saguwā' mbal ameya' saga anak si Eli ma pami'atna, sabab asal kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pinapatay sigām.  <div eID="gen2185" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1266"/><div sID="gen2186" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1266"/> Na, pasōng na pa'in paheya si Samwel maka pasōng ta'una. Pasōng isab iya makasulut atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> sampay manusiya'.  <div eID="gen2186" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2183" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1267"/><div sID="gen2187" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hukuman Pamat'kka ni Mata'an si Eli</title> <div sID="gen2188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1267"/> Dakayu' llaw, aniya' a'a sosoho'an Tuhan pinapehē' ni si Eli amasampayan iya lling, yukna, “Buwattitu ya pangallam si Yawe ma ka'a, ‘Bay aku magpanyata' ma ka'mbo'-mbo'annu si Harun waktu sigām ma lahat Misil ma deyo'an pagparinta Pira'un.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:28
verses.text: Bay tapene'ku si Harun min kamemon kapanubu'an bangsa Isra'il bo' supaya iya pinat'nna' imam maghinang ma lugal pagtutukbalan ni aku, maka anunu' kamanyan, maka amowa epod ma waktu kasōdna ni matahanku. Bay isab buwananku bahagi' ma saga imam min ba'anan lalabotan ya tinunu'an aku he' bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:29
verses.text: Jari angay halipulubi saga kukulbanan maka lalabotan ya bay soho'ku tinukbalan ma Luma'ku? Angay paheyanu saga anaknu labi gi' min aku? Sabab ilu pagnapsuhanbi isi sumbali'an ahāp to'ongan ya ngā'bi min saga kukulbanan kamemon bay panukbal ma aku e' saga a'aku bangsa Isra'il!’ ”  <div eID="gen2188" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1268"/><div sID="gen2189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1268"/> Amissala gi' sosoho'an Tuhan inān, yukna, “Angkan buwattitu pangallam si Yawe ya Tuhanbi bangsa Isra'il, yuk-i, ‘Tagna', aniya' bay panganjanji'ku ma ka'am panubu' si Libi, luba'na ka'am ma tumpukan mma'nu, subay magimam ni aku ni kasaumulan. Sagō' mbal na. Palangaku na pa'in sasuku magmahaltabatan aku, sagō' pareyo'ku sasuku mbal magaddatan aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:31
verses.text: Kalehun pahāp, at'kka du waktu papu'utku umulnu maka umul saga anak-mpunu, jari halam aniya' ma panubu'nu magkato'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:32
verses.text: Angkan magkarukka'an kam ati mbal na takinambi kahāpan ya pamuwanku ma bangsa Isra'il. Halam na aniya' min panubu'nu maka'abut kato'a sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:33
verses.text: B'nnal aniya' tubu'nu pasagaranku magimam ma matahanku, sagō' binuta iya sampay makananam karukka'an landu' bisana. Jari in kaheka'an panubu'nu pinatay bono' ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen2189" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1269"/><div sID="gen2190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1269"/> “ ‘Ya paltanda'an, magdora' amatay karuwangan anaknu, si Hopni maka si Pinehas, ma dang'llaw.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:35
verses.text: Ati paniya'ku imam dakayu', a'a kapangandolanku, lilla' angahinang kamemon maksudku maka kabaya'anku. Patumanku saga panubu'na bo' aniya' min sigām maghinang ma matahan sultan ya pene'ku sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:36
verses.text: Manjari, in kamemon takapin ma panubu'nu magpatireyo' ma iya angamu' takakan maka pilak. Angamu' sigām junjung bang pa'in sigām binuwanan hinang minsan ai na ma saga imam, supaya aniya' takakan sigām.’ ”  <div eID="gen2190" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.2"/> <div eID="gen2187" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1270"/><div sID="gen2191" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nilinganan si Samwel e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen2192" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1270"/> Anubul-nubul pa'in si Samwel, maghinang iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma deyo'an si imam Eli. Ma waktu ina'an, alahang si Yawe amissala ni manusiya' maka alahang aniya' manusiya' pinakalehan suwalana.  <div eID="gen2192" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1271"/><div sID="gen2193" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1271"/> Dakayu' sangom, ina'an si Eli atuli ma bilikna. Ahawhaw na pang'nda'na, mbal na agon makapatong pahāp.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:3
verses.text: Si Samwel isab ina'an abahak ma luwasan bilik pagpat'nna'an Ba'ul Tuhan<note>Ba'ul Tuhan, ya na ba'ul pagtatau'an sulat pasal paljanji'an Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il.</note> ya ma deyom Luma' Pagtata'atan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Ma halam lagi' ap'dda palita'an,

verses.name: I Samuel 3:4
verses.text: nilinganan si Samwel e' si Yawe. Anambung iya, yukna, “Owa', itiya'!”

verses.name: I Samuel 3:5
verses.text: Magtūy iya parai'-dai' pehē' ni si Eli. “Itiya' aku,” yukna. “Bay aku linganannu.” <div eID="gen2193" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2194" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' anambung si Eli, yukna, “Halam ka bay lingananku, pehē' ka atuli pabalik.” Angkan pabalik si Samwel ni pabahakanna.  <div eID="gen2194" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1272"/><div sID="gen2195" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1272"/> Manjari, angalingan pabalik si Yawe, yukna, “Samwel!” <div eID="gen2195" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2196" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy pabungkal si Samwel bo' pehē' ni si Eli, “Itiya' aku,” yukna. “Bay aku linganannu.” <div eID="gen2196" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2197" type="paragraph"/> Ah'lling si Eli ni iya, “Oto',” yukna, “halam aku bay angalingan. Pehē' na ka pabalik ni patulihannu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 3:7
verses.text: Ma waktu ina'an, akulang gi' pana'u si Samwel pasal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, maka halam gi' aniya' palman <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bay pamukis ma iya.  <div eID="gen2197" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1273"/><div sID="gen2198" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1273"/> Jari, angalingan na isab si Yawe ma si Samwel, kat'lluna na. Magtūy iya magdai'-dai' pehē' ni si Eli maka he'na ah'lling, “Itiya' aku,” yukna. “Bay du aku linganannu.” <div eID="gen2198" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2199" type="paragraph"/> Na tasayu e' si Eli, si Yawe ya angalinganan onde' inān.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:9
verses.text: Angkan iya ah'lling ma si Samwel, yukna, “Oto', pabahak ka pehē'. Bang ka nilinganan pabīng, anambung ka buwattitu yuknu, ‘Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, amissala na ka sabab akale du sosoho'annu itu.’ ” Manjari, pabīng na si Samwel ni pabahakanna.  <div eID="gen2199" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1274"/><div sID="gen2200" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1274"/> Na, magpanyata' na si Yawe ma si Samwel maka e'na angalingan buwat bay dahū. Yukna, “Samwel! O Samwel!” <div eID="gen2200" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2201" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Samwel, yukna, “Amissala ka kono', sabab akale du sosoho'annu itu.”  <div eID="gen2201" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1275"/><div sID="gen2202" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1275"/> Ah'lling si Yawe ma si Samwel, “Kalehun lapal itu!” yukna. “Aniya' hinang makatāw-tāw song hinangku ma deyom bangsa Isra'il, ati tak'bbal atay sasuku makakale.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:12
verses.text: Ma waktu ina'an, hinangku du kamemon bay pangallamku ma pasal saga panubu' si Eli.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:13
verses.text: Bay na iya asal haka'anku pasalan hukuman ya pamat'kkaku ma panubu'na. Sabab halam nilāng e'na kalumu'an ya bay nihinang e' saga anakna, minsan du bay kata'uwanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:14
verses.text: Angkan aku bay anapa pasal saga panubu' si Eli, yukku, ‘Mbal ta'ampun paldusahan sigām minsan ai tataubatan atawa lalabotan.’ ”  <div eID="gen2202" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1276"/><div sID="gen2203" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1276"/> Manjari, tatuli na pabalik si Samwel sampay subu. Pagbati'na pa'in, niukab he'na lawang Luma' Pagtata'atan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe he'. Tināw iya amissalahan si Eli pasal bay takalena min Tuhan,

verses.name: I Samuel 3:16
verses.text: sagō' nilinganan iya e' si Eli. “Samwel! Otō'!” yukna. <div eID="gen2203" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2204" type="paragraph"/> Jari anambung si Samwel yukna, “Oy itiya' aku.”  <div eID="gen2204" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1277"/><div sID="gen2205" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1277"/> Atilaw si Eli yukna,“Ai bay pamissala Tuhan ma ka'a? Da'a limbungin min aku. Patut ka pinat'kkahan mulka' kaginisan e' Tuhan bang ka ganta' maglimbung ai-ai bay llingna ma ka'a.”

verses.name: I Samuel 3:18
verses.text: Angkan nihaka kamemon e' si Samwel, halam iya maglimbung. Jari ah'lling si Eli, “In iya Tuhan-asal-Tuhan taga-kapatut angahinang bang ai kabaya'anna.”  <div eID="gen2205" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1278"/><div sID="gen2206" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1278"/> Manjari, pataptap <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma si Samwel sampay iya paheya, angkan atuman kamemon pah'llingna.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:20
verses.text: Takilā iya e' kamemon bangsa Isra'il min lahat Dān sampay ni Be'erseba, in iya nabi si Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:21
verses.text: Tinagna'an minnē', magpa'nda' na pa'in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Samwel ma Silo ati maina'an iya amakilā di-na labay min lapalna.  <div eID="gen2206" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.3"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:1
verses.text: Manjari itu, pasaplag na lapal si Samwel ma kaluha'an bangsa Isra'il. <div eID="gen2207" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2191" type="section"/> <div sID="gen2208" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ta'agaw Ba'ul Paljanji'an e' Bangsa Pilistin</title> <div sID="gen2209" type="paragraph"/> Na paluwas saga sundalu Isra'il min pustu sigām bo' magbono' maka bangsa Pilistin. Ina'an bangsa Isra'il magpustu ma atag Ebeneser<note>Ebeneser, hatina ‘Batu-tabang’.</note> ati ma Apek ya pagpustuhan bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:2
verses.text: Manjari magsakap saga sundalu Pilistin angandugpak bangsa Isra'il. Aheya landu' bono' ma llaw inān, jari tara'ug bangsa Isra'il, aniya' saga mpat ngibu heka sigām amatay maina'an ma pagbono'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:3
verses.text: Makapole' pa'in ni pustu saga sundalu Isra'il ya takapin allum, tinilaw sigām he' pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il, yuk-i, “Angay angkan kitam pinasagaran e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bo' tara'ug e' ba'anan bangsa Pilistin? Ahāp lagi' kitam pehē' ni Silo angā' Ba'ul Paljanji'an si Yawe bo' pagapi' ma kitam amuwasan kitam min ga'osan saga bantatam.”  <div eID="gen2209" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1279"/><div sID="gen2210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1279"/> Manjari, magpanoho'an sigām saga a'a pehē' ni Silo angā' Ba'ul Paljanji'an si Yawe Sangat Kawasa, ya aningkō' asal min llot duwa mala'ikat pikpikan, ya ma sa'ob ba'ul inān. Ina'an isab karuwangan anak si Eli, ya si Opni maka si Pinehas, bay ameya' ma Ba'ul Paljanji'an e'.  <div eID="gen2210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1280"/><div sID="gen2211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1280"/> Pagt'kka pa'in Ba'ul Paljanji'an si Yawe ni pustu bangsa Isra'il, magtūy sigām magolang pakosog to'ongan angkan ajogjog sampay tana'.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:6
verses.text: Pagkale saga bangsa Pilistin ma pagolang bangsa Isra'il itu, magtilawan sigām di-sigām, yuk-i, “Ai bahā' kahiyulan saga Hibrani he'?” Makata'u pa'in saga bangsa Pilistin, ina'an Ba'ul si Yawe bay binowa ni pustu bangsa Isra'il,

verses.name: I Samuel 4:7
verses.text: magtūy sigām sinōd tāw. “Arōy!” yuk sigām. “Aniya' tuhan maina'an ma pustu. Mamarahi na kitam itu! Yampa aniya' buwattitu!

verses.name: I Samuel 4:8
verses.text: Magmula na kitam! Halam aniya' angalappas kitam min kawasa saga tuhan ga'osan itu! Ya na ko' ina'an saga tuhan bay amat'kka bala' kaginisan ma bangsa Misil ma lahat paslangan he'.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:9
verses.text: Oy! Ka'am saga bangsa Pilistin, pakuyas kam amono'. Paesog kam angatu, sabab bang mbal, tabanyaga' kitam e' saga Hibrani itu, buwat bay pamanyaga'tam ma sigām!”  <div eID="gen2211" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1281"/><div sID="gen2212" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1281"/> Angkan amono' pakosog to'ongan saga a'a Pilistin ati tara'ug e' sigām bangsa Isra'il. Makalandu' aheka abugtang, t'llumpū' ngibu heka sundalu Isra'il amatay. Jari sasuku bay takapin wa'i maglahian amole' ni pustu sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:11
verses.text: Ta'agaw e' bangsa Pilistin Ba'ul Tuhan min saga bangsa Isra'il maka amatay isab si Hopni maka si Pinehas, karuwangan anak si Eli.  <div eID="gen2212" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2208" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1282"/><div sID="gen2213" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Eli</title> <div sID="gen2214" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1282"/> Na, ma llaw du ina'an, aniya' dakayu' l'lla min panubu' Benjamin bay makalahi min pagbono'an tudju ni Silo. Gineret e'na badju'na maka kapē'an bagunbun kōkna, tanda' pagdukkana.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:13
verses.text: Pagt'kkana na ni Silo, ina'an asal si Eli ma tingkō'anna ma bihing lān amantaw, sabab asusa pangatayanna ma pasalan Ba'ul Tuhan. Manjari paghaka l'lla inān ma bay paniya' ma pagbono'an, magtūy maglemongan kamemon a'a ma kauman inān.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:14
verses.text: Ma waktu inān, siyampū' na maka waluntahun umul si Eli, mbal na maka'nda', hal amantaw sadja. Jari takale pa'in e' si Eli pagalud inān, atilaw iya, “Angay angkan magpangalud saga a'a itu?” <div eID="gen2214" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2215" type="paragraph"/> Sinekot iya magtūy e' a'a bay makalahi inān.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:15
verses.text: Ma waktu inān, siyampū' na maka waluntahun umul si Eli, mbal na maka'nda', hal amantaw sadja. Jari takale pa'in e' si Eli pagalud inān, atilaw iya, “Angay angkan magpangalud saga a'a itu?” <div eID="gen2214" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2215" type="paragraph"/> Sinekot iya magtūy e' a'a bay makalahi inān.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:16
verses.text: “Tuwan,” yukna, “yampa aku alahi pi'itu min pagbono'an.” <div eID="gen2215" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2216" type="paragraph"/> Atilaw pabalik si Eli, “Oto',” yukna, “ai bay tum'kka ni ka'am?”  <div eID="gen2216" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1283"/><div sID="gen2217" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1283"/> Ya sambung a'a inān, “Tuwan,” yukna, “maglahian saga sundalu Isra'il sabab tara'ug e' bangsa Pilistin. Kamatayan aheka a'atam ati talapay anaknu si Hopni maka si Pinehas. Ta'agaw isab Ba'ul Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen2217" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1284"/><div sID="gen2218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1284"/> Pagkale si Eli ma pasalan ba'ul e', magtūy iya pahantak min paningkō'an maina'an ma atag pagsosōran ni kauman. Pahantak iya ni buli'an ati apōng buli'-k'llongna. Jari amatay na iya sabab ato'a na iya maka landu' al'mmok. Mpatpū' tahun bay kapagmakōkna ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2218" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1285"/><div sID="gen2219" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1285"/> Na, ma waktu inān, bulanan na ayuwan si Eli, ya h'nda si Pinehas. Pagkale d'nda itu ma habal pasal Ba'ul Tuhan bay ta'agaw e' bangsa Pilistin, maka wa'i amatay h'llana maka mato'ana, kap'ddi'an iya sampay anganak. Sagō' kahunitan sidda iya ma paganakna.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:20
verses.text: Magkamamatay pa'in iya, amūng saga panday, yuk-i, “Ndū' nneng, da'a ka tināw. Nda'un ba, l'lla ko' anaknu itu.” Sagō' halam iya makasambung minsan ai.  <div eID="gen2219" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1286"/><div sID="gen2220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1286"/> Ma halam lagi' iya amatay, Ikabod ya pangōnna ma onde' inān. “Sabab,” yukna, “wa'i paokat in sahaya Tuhan min bangsa Isra'il.” Angkan iya makapah'lling buwattē' sabab wa'i na bay ta'agaw Ba'ul Tuhan e' bangsa Pilistin, maka in h'llana maka mato'ana wa'i na amatay.  <div eID="gen2220" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.4"/> <div eID="gen2213" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1286"/><div sID="gen2220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1286"/> Ma halam lagi' iya amatay, Ikabod ya pangōnna ma onde' inān. “Sabab,” yukna, “wa'i paokat in sahaya Tuhan min bangsa Isra'il.” Angkan iya makapah'lling buwattē' sabab wa'i na bay ta'agaw Ba'ul Tuhan e' bangsa Pilistin, maka in h'llana maka mato'ana wa'i na amatay.  <div eID="gen2220" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.4"/> <div eID="gen2213" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1287"/><div sID="gen2221" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ba'ul Paljanji'an ma Da'ira Asdod maka Ekron</title> <div sID="gen2222" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1287"/> Na, pagga ta'agaw Ba'ul Tuhan e' bangsa Pilistin, binowa na e' sigām min Ebeneser tudju ni Asdod ya da'ira sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:2
verses.text: Manjari, ma Asdod pa'in, binowa Ba'ul itu ni deyom langgal pagsusumbahan si Dagon ya pagtuhanan sigām bo' pinapagbihing maka ta'u-ta'una.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:3
verses.text: Pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, subu-subu lagi', pasōd saga a'a Asdod ni langgal si Dagon inān. Pagsōd itu, ta'nda' ta'u-ta'una pakutung ma lantay, sali' hantang pasujud ma dahuwan Ba'ul si Yawe! Jari pinat'ngge ta'u-ta'u inān e' sigām ni asal bay pamat'nna'an iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:4
verses.text: Saguwā', pag'llaw dakayu' na isab, wa'i na isab ta'u-ta'u si Dagon pakutung pabalik. Ya du, sali' pasujud ma dahuwan Ba'ul si Yawe! Magkapōng-pōng kōkna maka tanganna ina'an ma bowa' lawang. Hal du baranna ya takapin tibu'uk.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:5
verses.text: Ya itu sababanna angkan sampay ni buwattina'an saga imam Pilistin atawa sai-na ma Asdod mbal pagi'ik ma bowa' lawang bang pasōd ni langgal si Dagon inān.  <div eID="gen2222" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1288"/><div sID="gen2223" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1288"/> Na, pinat'kkahan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bala' mamarahi bisana ma katilibut Asdod maka saga kauman ma jadjahan ina'an. Kapē'an sigām saga butig a'aslag ma baran sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:7
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga a'a Asdod ma bay tumaluwa' ni sigām inān, ah'lling sigām ni dangan-parangan, yuk-i, “Halam dapat! Mbal manjari pat'nna' maitu in Ba'ul Tuhan bangsa Isra'il, sabab itiya' kitam binantahan e'na. Tantu kitam magmula sampay tuhantam si Dagon.”

verses.name: I Samuel 5:8
verses.text: Manjari pinalinganan kamemon pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin ati tinilaw sigām, yuk-i, “Ai na hinangtam ma Ba'ul ya suku' pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il itu?” <div eID="gen2223" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2224" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “In ba'ul suku' tuhan bangsa Isra'il ilu subay pinapinda ni da'ira Gāt.” Angkan pinapinda Ba'ul inān.  <div eID="gen2224" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1289"/><div sID="gen2225" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1289"/> Saguwā', bay pa'in itu pinapinda ni Gāt, pinat'kkahan bala' da'ira inān e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Ahiluhala' katilibut paglahat maina'an sabab bay du isab pinat'kkahan butig kamemon saga manusiya', min onde'-onde' ni matto'ana.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:10
verses.text: Angkan bay pinalanjal Ba'ul Tuhan inān min Gāt ni da'ira Ekron. <div eID="gen2225" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2226" type="paragraph"/> Hinabu binowa pasōd Ba'ul inān ni da'ira Ekron, magpangolang saga a'a maina'an, yuk sigām, “Arōy! Itiya' na ba'ul sin tuhan bangsa Isra'il binowahan kitam supaya kitam alaglag!”

verses.name: I Samuel 5:11
verses.text: Manjari, pinatimuk kamemon pagnakura'an ma bangsa Pilistin ati ah'lling saga a'a Ekron ma sigām, yuk-i, “Pala'anunbi m'nnitu in Ba'ul Tuhan Isra'il ilu ati pabalikunbi pehē' ni bay asal pat'nna'anna. Mamarahi na to'ongan kitam itu, magkamatay kamemon!” Angkan buwattē' pah'lling saga a'a inān sabab sinōd tāw makapatay. Tu'ud landu' abisa in bala' pinat'kkahan sigām e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:12
verses.text: Na, sasuku sigām halam amatay e' bala', bay kat'kkahan butig aheka. Jari in pagaruhuy saga a'a ma da'ira inān pa'abut sampay ni langit.  <div eID="gen2226" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.5"/> <div eID="gen2221" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1290"/><div sID="gen2227" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinabalik Ba'ul Paljanji'an</title> <div sID="gen2228" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1290"/> Ta'abut pa'in pitumbulan t'ggol Ba'ul si Yawe ma lahat Pilistin,

verses.name: I Samuel 6:2
verses.text: pinalinganan pina'an saga kaimaman maka saga magpuputika' e' saga a'a Pilistin bo' supaya pangaruhan e' sigām. Yuk panilaw sigām, “Ai subay hinang kami ma Ba'ul si Yawe itu? Haka'inbi kami bang buwattingga e' kami amabalik iya ni bay pat'nna'anna tagna'?”  <div eID="gen2228" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1291"/><div sID="gen2229" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1291"/> Anambung saga a'a pangaruhan itu, yuk-i, “Ebot-ebot, bang kam anganggara' amabalik ba'ul ya suku' tuhan bangsa Isra'il, da'a pabalikunbi ma halam aniya' ai-aina pinabeya'. Pabeya'unbi isab tutukbalan pagtaubatan dusabi bo' kam kauli'an, ati minnē' kata'uwanbi bang angay kam pinat'kkahan bala' e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen2229" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1292"/><div sID="gen2230" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1292"/> Sakali anilaw saga a'a Pilistin, yuk sigām, “Tutukbalan taubat ai ya patut pamuwan kami ma tuhan itu?” <div eID="gen2230" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2231" type="paragraph"/> Anambung saga imam maka saga magpuputika' inān, yuk-i, “Angahinang kam bulawan pinakaluwa butig maka ambaw. Subay lima-lima hekana buwat du isab heka saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin. Sabab magsali' du bala' ya makataluwa' ni ka'am maka ni saga pagnakura'anbi.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:5
verses.text: Angahinang kam bulawan pina'anggil ni butig maka ni ambaw ya angamula kaluha'an paglahattam itu, ati tukbalinbi ni Tuhan bangsa Isra'il tanda' sin pamaheyabi ma iya. Kalu iya mura-murahan ma'ase' ma ka'am ati la'ananna bala' ya pamat'kkana ni ka'am maka ni saga tuhanbi sampay lahatbi.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:6
verses.text: Da'a kam magmatuwas. Da'a kam pasali' ni bay kahinangan Pira'un maka saga bangsa Misil ma waktu tagna' he'. Subay sadja bay makalandu' kabinsana'an pinat'kkahan sigām e' Tuhan bo' yampa sigām anugutan saga bangsa Isra'il ala'an minnē'.”  <div eID="gen2231" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1293"/><div sID="gen2232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1293"/> Na, magpanoho'an saga imam bangsa Pilistin maka saga magpuputika' inān. Yuk sigām, “Pasakapunbi karitun baha'u, maka angā' kam duwa sapi' duru'an halam gi' bay kapangangguyuran karitun. Pahengkotunbi sapi' ilu ni karitun, sagō' pasaddīhun saga anak-anakna ma deyom kamalig.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:8
verses.text: Jari duwa'unbi Ba'ul si Yawe pehē' ni karitun. Ati pat'nna'unbi isab ma bihing ba'ul ilu dakayu' tu'ung pangisihan saga tataubatan bulawan ya tukbalanbi ni iya. Taruwa' pa'in, pal'ngnganunbi saga sapi' angangguyud karitun ilu pi'ingga-pi'ingga patudjuhanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:9
verses.text: Sagō' nda'unbi na pa'in. Bang patudjuhanna ilu Bet-Semes ya ma lahat bangsa Isra'il, minnē' kata'uwantam si Yawe ya bay amat'kkahan kitam bala' itu. Sagō' bang saddī patudjuhan, na ngga'i ka iya ya bay angamulahan kitam. Tu'ud magsalta' sadja.”  <div eID="gen2232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1294"/><div sID="gen2233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1294"/> Jari bineya' e' saga a'a Pilistin panoho'an inān. Ningā' e' sigām duwa sapi' d'nda bo' pinaengkot ma karitun. Saga anak-anakna bay pinagal ma kamalig.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:11
verses.text: Sakali, pinaruwa' na Ba'ul si Yawe inān ni karitun pinapagbeya' maka tu'ung ya pangisihan saga bulawan bay pina'anggil ni ambaw maka butig e'.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:12
verses.text: Manjari itu, lum'ngngan na saga sapi' inān magin'ngngong.<note>Magin'ngngong: atawa ‘magilud-ilud’ ma kasehe'an. Ya na lling sapi'.</note> Amontolan sigām tudju ni Bet-Semes ma halam pagbeklo'-beklo'na, ai na ka ni kowan atawa ni gibang. Ina'an paurul ma buli'an saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin sampay ni bihing kauman Bet-Semes.  <div eID="gen2233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1295"/><div sID="gen2234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1295"/> Ina'an isab saga a'a Bet-Semes magani pai-tirigu ma kapantayan. Jari pagtongas sigām, ta'nda' e' sigām Ba'ul Tuhan angkan landu' sigām kinōgan.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:14
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in karitun inān ni huma si Yussa' a'a Bet-Semes, pahogga' na ma bihing dakayu' batu aheya. Paghogga' pa'in itu, ningā' e' saga a'a maina'an kayu bay pangahinang karitun e' bo' tin'tta' pangayu. Sinumbali' isab saga sapi' he' bo' tinunu' tutukbalan pagtaubat ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:15
verses.text: Nihawas ba'ul e' saga kal'llahan panubu' si Libi<note>Panubu' si Libi: ya na tumpuk magi'imam maka maghihinang ma Luma' Pagtata'atan Tuhan.</note>, beya' isab maka tu'ung ya isihan pamulawan bay pina'anggil ni butig maka ambaw. Tahawas pa'in, bay pinabangkat e' sigām ni diyata' batu aheya. Jari ma llaw ina'an du, saga a'a kamemon ya pat'nna' ma Bet-Semes bay anukbal ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe saga susumbali'an pinagtunu' maka lalabotan pagtaubat.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:16
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in kahinangan itu e' saga lima pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin ya bay paurul e', magtūy sigām amole' pabalik ni Ekron, ma llaw ina'an du.  <div eID="gen2234" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1296"/><div sID="gen2235" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1296"/> Na, in butig bulawan ya pinabeya' e' bangsa Pilistin pagtaubat ni si Yawe, bay lima hekana bo' pinapagkaniya-kaniya ma saga pagnakura'an sigām lima hekana isab. Hatina dakayu' ma Asdod, dakayu' ma Gasa, dakayu' ma Askelon, dakayu' ma Gāt maka dakayu' isab ma Ekron.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:18
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab saga ambaw bulawan, pinapagkaniya-kaniya ma saga kuta' maka kauman ya suku' pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin lima hekana he'. Ya batu aheya isab bay pamat'nna'an Ba'ul si Yawe, ina'an masi ma huma si Yussa' a'a Bet-Semes, pamandogahan ma bay paniya' mahē'.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:19
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' a'a pitumpū' hekana bay pinapatay e' Tuhan ma sabab kapang'nda' sigām ni deyom Ba'ul e'. Sakali magdukka saga lūng-kampung sigām ma pasalan hukuman bay pamat'nna' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:20
verses.text: Angkan sigām magpangaruhuy, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' taga-kapatut pa'alop ni si Yawe, ya Tuhan sussi itu? Sai pamabeya'antam Ba'ul itu bo' supaya makala'an min deyomantam?”  <div eID="gen2235" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1297"/><div sID="gen2236" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1297"/> Angkan sigām bay amapehē' saga sosoho'an patukad ni Kiriyat-Jarim angahaka'an saga a'a maina'an pasal palkala' itu, yuk-i, “Itiya' pinabalik e' saga bangsa Pilistin in Ba'ul si Yawe. Bang pa'in kam pi'itu bo' bowahunbi pi'ilu ni lahatbi.”  <div eID="gen2236" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.6"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:1
verses.text: Manjari, in Ba'ul si Yawe bay ningā' pehē' ni Bet-Semes e' saga a'a min Kiriyat-Jarim, ati binowa ni luma' si Aminadab maina'an ma būd-būd. Si Eleyasar anak si Aminadab ya bay pinat'nna' anganjagahan Ba'ul si Yawe.  <div eID="gen2237" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2227" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1298"/><div sID="gen2238" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagmakōk si Samwel ma Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen2239" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1298"/> At'ggol kamaina'an Ba'ul Paljanji'an ma Kiriyat-Jarim, aniya' saga duwampū' tahun t'ggolna. Ma waktu inān, magdohon sidda kamemon saga bangsa Isra'il maka angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:3
verses.text: Manjari ah'lling si Samwel ma mahadjana'<note>Mahadjana': hatina saga a'a kamemon atawa ba'anan a'a ma deyo'an dakayu' pagparintahan.</note> Isra'il kamemon, yukna, “Bang sab'nnal-b'nnal kam magtaubat min deyom ataybi bo' kam pabalik to'ongan ni si Yawe, timaninbi na saga tuhan-tuhan maka ta'u-ta'u si Astoret ya pagtuhanan bangsa liyu. Pabontolunbi itikadbi ni si Yawe ya Tuhanbi. Ammalunbi iya sadja, ati tantu kam lappasanna min komkoman saga Pilistin itu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 7:4
verses.text: Angkan tinaikutan e' bangsa Isra'il kamemon saga Ba'al maka Astoret ya bay pagtuhan-tuhanan sigām bo' angisbat ni si Yawe ma halam aniya' tuhan saddī.  <div eID="gen2239" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1299"/><div sID="gen2240" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1299"/> Sakali ah'lling si Samwel ni saga a'a Isra'il, yukna, “Patimuk kam kamemon ma kauman Mispa bo' kam amu'-amu'anku ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”

verses.name: I Samuel 7:6
verses.text: Ma Mispa pa'in, bay sigām angā' bohe' bo' binu'usan ma matahan si Yawe pangahulmat sigām ma iya. Ma llaw du isab inān magpuwasa sigām kamemon, maka maina'an isab sigām bay magsab'nnal ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, yuk-i, “B'nnal taga-dusa kami ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.” Manjari maina'an ma Mispa si Samwel ya magmakōk ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2240" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1300"/><div sID="gen2241" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1300"/> Pagta'u pa'in bangsa Pilistin ina'an saga a'a Isra'il magtipun ma Mispa, magtūy magsakap saga nakura' sigām bo' palanjal pina'an bahasa angandugpak. Na, takale pa'in habal itu e' saga a'a Isra'il, magtūy sigām magtāwan ma saga a'a Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:8
verses.text: Sakali anganjunjung sigām ni si Samwel, yuk-i, “Palanjalun pangamu'-ngamu'nu ni si Yawe ya Tuhantam bo' supaya kitam lappasanna min saga Pilistin itu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 7:9
verses.text: Sakali, aniya' bili-bili halam gi' talutas<note>Halam gi' talutas: hatina halam gi' tabutas min duru'.</note> bay ningā' e' si Samwel. Sinumbali' e'na bo' tinunu' pagtukbalna pagtaubatan ni si Yawe. Angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in si Samwel ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma pasalan saga ummat Isra'il, jari kinale pangamu'-ngamu'na.  <div eID="gen2241" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2238" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1301"/><div sID="gen2242" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tara'ug Bangsa Pilistin e' Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen2243" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1301"/> Na, hinabu si Samwel magtukbal tataubatan ni Tuhan, ina'an na pasekot ba'anan a'a Pilistin amowa magbono' ma saga a'a Isra'il. Saguwā' ma llaw du isab inān, aniya' l'ggon makalandu' kosogna pinaniya' e' si Yawe ma saga sundalu Pilistin angkan landu' asasaw pikilan sigām. Tabowa sigām sikalahian ati tara'ug sigām e' bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:11
verses.text: Magluwasan magtūy saga magbobono' Isra'il anurul saga Pilistin e'. Jari pinagpapatay sigām e' saga a'a Isra'il ma palabayan sampay makaliyu min kauman Bet-Kār.  <div eID="gen2243" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1302"/><div sID="gen2244" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1302"/> Manjari itu, angā' batu aheya si Samwel bo' pinat'nna' e'na ma llot Mispa maka Sēn. Ebeneser ya pangōnna ma batu inān sabab, yukna, “Si Yawe ya bay anabangan kami sampay pi'itu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 7:13
verses.text: Jari tara'ug saga bangsa Pilistin ati halam na magbalik-balik parugpak ni kalahatan bangsa Isra'il. Sat'ggol si Samwel allum gi', niatuhan na pa'in e' si Yawe saga bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:14
verses.text: Ta'ā' pabalik e' bangsa Isra'il saga kaluma'an min Ekron sampay ni Gāt, kalahatan bay kalongkopan e' bangsa Pilistin ma waktu palabay. Talappas isab min komkoman bangsa Pilistin saga paglahat kasehe' ya ma jadjahan ina'an-i, maka magsulut isab bangsa Isra'il maka bangsa Amor, mbal na magbono'.  <div eID="gen2244" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1303"/><div sID="gen2245" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1303"/> Pasangdan na pa'in si Samwel magmakōk ma bangsa Isra'il sat'ggolna allum.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:16
verses.text: Tahun ni tahun, maglibutan iya saga paglahat min jadjahan Betel sampay ni Gilgal maka ni Mispa supaya auntul kapagmakōkna ma saga jama'a Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:17
verses.text: Saguwā' amole' na pa'in iya ni kauman Rama, ya lahatna porol. Maina'an isab iya amal'ngngan kapagmakōkna ma saga a'a Isra'il. Aniya' isab pagtutukbalan bay nihinang e' si Samwel ma Rama inān pangahulmat ma si Yawe.  <div eID="gen2245" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.7"/> <div eID="gen2242" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1304"/><div sID="gen2246" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angamu' Sultan in Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen2247" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1304"/> Ato'a pa'in si Samwel, pinat'nna' e'na saga anakna l'lla maghuhukum ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:2
verses.text: Si Jowel ya ōn anakna kasiyakahan, jari si Abija ya pasunu'. Lahat Be'erseba<note>Alawak kauman Be'erseba itu min Rama, ya paglahatan si Samwel.</note> ya paghuhukuman sigā.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:3
verses.text: Sagō' karuwangan anak si Samwel itu halam an'ppu iya ma addat-tabi'at, sabab napsuhan sigā ma pilak. Pagkatambahan sigā, mbal isab abontol pangahukum sigā.  <div eID="gen2247" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1305"/><div sID="gen2248" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1305"/> Angkan magtimuk kamemon pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il bo' pehē' ni si Samwel ma Rama.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:5
verses.text: Ah'lling sigām ni iya, yuk-i, “Ato'a na ka, tuwan, maka saga anaknu itu mbal ameya' ma kal'ngnganannu. Na,” yuk sigām, “ahāp lagi' pat'nna'in kami sultan magnakura'an kami buwat bangsa kasehe'.”  <div eID="gen2248" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1306"/><div sID="gen2249" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1306"/> Sagō' ab'nsi si Samwel ma pangamu' sigām, ya mikipat'nna' sultan pagnakura'an sigām, angkan iya angaru ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:7
verses.text: Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Samwel, yukna, “Dūlin bang ai ya pinahinang e' saga ummat ilu ma ka'a. Asal du ngga'i ka ka'a ya sinulak e' sigām sagō' aku maka kapagsultanku.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:8
verses.text: Min waktu gi' bay kapamowaku sigām paluwas min lahat Misil sampay ni kabuwattituhan, sinulak na pa'in aku e' sigām pagka sigām pasumba ni saga tuhan-tuhan saddī. Jari ya du isab ilu ya nihinang e' sigām ma ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:9
verses.text: Na beya'un bang ai kabilahian sigām, sagō' banda'in sigām to'ongan. Pahati'un sigām pahāp bang buwattingga palantara sultan ya song magnakura'an sigām.”  <div eID="gen2249" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1307"/><div sID="gen2250" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1307"/> Manjari, binissala e' si Samwel kamemon bay pangallam ma iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Yukna ni saga a'a ya angamu' pinat'nna'an sultan,

verses.name: I Samuel 8:11
verses.text: “Buwattitu kahinangan sultan ya song magsultanan ka'am. Ningā' e'na saga ka'anakanbi l'lla nihinang sundalu magbeya' maka saga kalesana pagbobono' maka saga a'ana magpangura'. Kasehe'an anakbi nihinang e'na magpaparagan min dahuan saga kalesana.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:12
verses.text: Kasehe'an nihinang e'na pagnakura'an ma saga tumpukan sundalu, ai na ka ma dangibu, ai na ka ma limampū'. In kasehe'an isab nihinang e'na maga'araru maka maga'ani ma humana, maka kasehe'an sinō' maghinang saga pakokos pagbobono' maka saga kapanyapan kalesa.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:13
verses.text: Ningā' e'na saga ka'anakanbi d'nda bo' maghinang saga ns'llan pahamut, maka magbab'lla, maka maga'addun saga tinapay.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:14
verses.text: Ningā' e'na saga pagtatanomanbi pai maka tirigu, maka pagtatanomanbi anggul maka jaitun, ingga-ingga ya landu' ahāp, ati pamuwanna ma saga tendogna.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:15
verses.text: Ningā' e'na bahagi' sangpū' min saga tirigu maka buwa' anggulbi bo' pamuwanna ma saga tendogna maka ma saga a'a kawakilanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:16
verses.text: Saga ipatanbi d'nda-l'lla ningā' e'na tahinang sosoho'anna. Saga sapi'bi isab maka kura'bi ya katapusan asambu tapagguna he'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:17
verses.text: Ningā' isab e'na bahagi' sangpū' min saga kahayopanbi, maka sampay ka'am baranbi binanyaga' e'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:18
verses.text: At'kka pa'in waktu inān, parahing du kam ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma sabab kabinsana'an ya pinaniya'an ka'am e' sultan bay pene'bi inān, sagō' mbal kam kinale e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma waktu ina'an.”  <div eID="gen2250" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1308"/><div sID="gen2251" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1308"/> Sagō' halam kinale si Samwel e' saga a'a inān. “Ē! Mbal!” yuk sigām. “Ya kabilahian kami subay aniya' sultan pagmakōkan kami.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:20
verses.text: Bilahi kami pasali' ni saga bangsa kasehe'an bo' aniya' sultan magnakura'an kami maka magmunda'an kami bang ni pagbono'an.”  <div eID="gen2251" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1309"/><div sID="gen2252" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1309"/> Pagkale pa'in si Samwel ma kamemon bay pinah'lling e' saga a'a inān, parahing iya pabalik ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:22
verses.text: Angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabīng ma si Samwel, yukna, “Beya'un bang ai kabilahian sigām. Pat'nna'in sigām a'a magsultanan sigām.” <div eID="gen2252" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2253" type="paragraph"/> Manjari, ah'lling si Samwel ma bangsa Isra'il, “Pehē' na kam,” yukna, “magpole'an pabalik ni kaluma'anbi.”  <div eID="gen2253" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.8"/> <div eID="gen2246" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1310"/><div sID="gen2254" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagbāk si Samwel maka si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1310"/> Na, aniya' a'a min panubu' Benjamin ga'osan asal maka taga-kaniya'. Ōnna si Kīs ya bay anak si Abiya anak si Seror. Si Seror ya bay anak si Bekorat anak si Apiya, min panubu' si Benjamin du isab.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:2
verses.text: Si Kīs itu taga-anak l'lla pinagōnan si Sa'ul. Ahāp l'lla iya, arorog maka labi alanjang min kamemon pagkahina. Halam aniya' sibu'na ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2255" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1311"/><div sID="gen2256" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1311"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw, alungay saga kura'<note>Kura': saddī ginis kura' itu, apandak lagi' min dī kura', ataha' isab taingana. Maumu kinagunahan ma lahat kasehe' panganduwa'an ai-ai atawa pangura'an a'a. ‘Donkey’ atawa ‘ass’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ya suku' si Kīs, angkan iya ah'lling ni anakna si Sa'ul, yukna, “Oto', wa'i alungay saga kura'ta. Amowa ka dakayu' sosoho'anta panehe' ma ka'a bo' piha'unbi pehē'.”

verses.name: I Samuel 9:4
verses.text: Sakali, patulak na si Sa'ul maka sosoho'an e' labay min kabūd-būran Epra'im maka min lahat Salisa sagō' halam tabāk e' sigā saga kura' e'. Palanjal na pa'in sigā ni jadjahan Sa'alim sagō' halam du mahē'. Palabay isab sigā min lahat Benjamin, sagō' halam du isab mahē'.  <div eID="gen2256" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1312"/><div sID="gen2257" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1312"/> Ta'abut pa'in jadjahan Sūp, ah'lling na si Sa'ul ma sosoho'an e', yukna, “Sūng na kita amole', ya aniya' ngga'i ka na saga kura' bay alungay ya pinagsusahan e' si mma', sagō' kita na.”  <div eID="gen2257" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1313"/><div sID="gen2258" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1313"/> Saguwā' ya sambung sosoho'an inān ma si Sa'ul, “Tuwan,” yukna, “aniya' ma kaluma'an maitu-itu dakayu' a'a sosoho'an Tuhan. Pinagmahaltabatan iya e' saga a'a kamemon maka atuman lullun pangallamna. Ahāp gi' kita pehē' ni iya, kalu-kalu kita katuli'anna lān pamiha'anta saga kura' he'.”  <div eID="gen2258" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1314"/><div sID="gen2259" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1314"/> Ah'lling si Sa'ul yukna, “Bang kita pehē' ni sosoho'an Tuhan inān, ai tapamuwanta ma iya? Aubus na saga pagkakan bay palutu'ta. Halam na aniya' kabowahanta iya.”  <div eID="gen2259" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1315"/><div sID="gen2260" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1315"/> Anambung pabalik sosoho'an inān, “Tuwan,” yukna, “aniya' gi' maitu dakayu' pisita. Ya itu pamuwanta ma iya bo' kita katuli'an e'na bang ya ingga subay palabayanta.”  <div eID="gen2260" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1316"/><div sID="gen2261" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1316"/> (Ma waktu he'-i, ‘a'a talus’ ya pangōn nabi e' bangsa Isra'il. Sai-na bilahi angaru ni Tuhan, ah'lling iya ma sehe'na yukna, “Sūng, pehē' kita ni a'a talus.”)

verses.name: I Samuel 9:10
verses.text: Yuk si Sa'ul ni sehe'na inān, “Na aho'. Sūng na kita.” Jari palanjal na sigā ni kaluma'an ya pa'atagan sosoho'an Tuhan inān.  <div eID="gen2261" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1317"/><div sID="gen2262" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1317"/> Hinabu sigām patukad ni būd tudju ni kaluma'an e', talanggal e' sigā saga kabudjangan song anauk bohe', jari tinilaw e' sigā yuk-i, “Saga arūng, itiya' bahā' maitu in a'a talus?”  <div eID="gen2262" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1318"/><div sID="gen2263" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1318"/> “Aho', tuwan,” yuk sambung saga kabudjangan inān. “Wa'i na iya makarahū min ka'am. Pasa'ut kam. Buwattina'an sadja iya makapi'itu ni kaluma'an kami, sabab aniya' pagkulban tinukbalan e' kampung kami mahē' ma tampat.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:13
verses.text: Pagsōdbi ni kaluma'an, tabākbi iya maina'an ma mbal gi' makatukad ni tampat. Mbal magkakanan saga a'a maina'an sat'ggol iya mbal at'kka. Subay ka'amu'anna barakat saga tutukbalan he' bo' magpamangan saga a'a bay tina'abbit. Na, pehē' na kam bo' iya ta'abutbi.”  <div eID="gen2263" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1319"/><div sID="gen2264" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1319"/> Manjari, hinabu si Sa'ul maka sosoho'an inān pasōd ni kaluma'an e', ilu na si Samwel paluwas song patukad ni tampat.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:15
verses.text: Aniya' asal bay pamukis e' si Yawe ma si Samwel, dang'llaw dahū lagi' min bay kapina'an si Sa'ul. Yuk pamukis e',

verses.name: I Samuel 9:16
verses.text: “Salung ma waktu buwattitu du, papi'iluku ni ka'a dakayu' a'a min panubu' Benjamin. Busugin iya ns'llan paltanda'an in iya bay tapene'ku magnakura' ma saga a'aku bangsa Isra'il. Niliyusan e'na saga a'a suku'ku min komkoman bangsa Pilistin. Ta'nda'ku asal katiksa'an sigām, maka takaleku pangandahing sigām.”  <div eID="gen2264" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1320"/><div sID="gen2265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1320"/> Pag'nda' si Samwel ma si Sa'ul, magtūy angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, yukna, “Ya na itu a'a bay pangahakaku ma ka'a. Iya ya magparinta ma saga a'a suku'ku.”  <div eID="gen2265" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1321"/><div sID="gen2266" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1321"/> Jari pasekot si Sa'ul ni si Samwel ma atag lawang ya pagsōd-luwasan ma kaluma'an inān. Atilaw iya ma si Samwel, yukna, “Tuwan, da'a busung. Makajari bahā' aku pata'unu bang maingga maitu luma' a'a talus e'?”  <div eID="gen2266" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1322"/><div sID="gen2267" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1322"/> Anambung si Samwel, yukna, “Aku na ko' ya patilawannu. Pehē' na kam parahū min aku ni tampat sabab magbeya' kam maka aku amangan llaw itu. Palanjalku kam salung ati hakaku ni ka'a kamemon ya ma deyom pamikilnu ilu.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:20
verses.text: Ma pasalan isab saga kura' ya bay alungay saga t'llung'llaw palabay, da'a na kasusahun sabab wa'i na tabāk. Sai lagi' niholatan e' bangsa Isra'il, bang ngga'i ka ka'a maka saga a'a kamemon ya pagtai'anak mma'nu?”  <div eID="gen2267" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1323"/><div sID="gen2268" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1323"/> Ya sambung si Sa'ul, “Tuwan,” yukna, “aku itu tubu' min panubu' Benjamin ko', ya tubu' ariki' asal ma bangsa Isra'il, maka pangkat kami itu areyo' min kamemon kapanubu'an Benjamin. Angay angkan ka makapah'lling buwattilu?”  <div eID="gen2268" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1324"/><div sID="gen2269" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1324"/> Manjari binowa patukad e' si Samwel si Sa'ul maka sosoho'an e' ni luma' pagkakanan bo' pinatingkō' min kōkan saga a'a bay tina'abbit he'. Kulang-labi t'llumpū' heka sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:23
verses.text: Jari, ah'lling si Samwel ni magb'b'lla, yukna, “Bowahun pi'itu ya isi sumbali'an bay soho'ku pinasaddī ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2269" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1325"/><div sID="gen2270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1325"/> Na, binowa pina'an e' magb'b'lla ya pa'a susumbali'an bay pinasaddī bo' pinat'nna' ma munda'an si Sa'ul. Yuk si Samwel ma si Sa'ul, “Ya ilu bay tinau'an ka'a. Amangan ka sabab bay ko' itu asal pinasaddīhan ka'a ma palkala' itu, dahū gi' min waktu bay kapana'abbitku saga a'a kasehe'an itu.” Sakali magbeya' amangan si Sa'ul maka si Samwel ma llaw inān.  <div eID="gen2270" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1326"/><div sID="gen2271" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1326"/> Paglūd sigām ni kaluma'an min tampat e', aniya' patulihan sinakapan si Sa'ul ma atop karatagan ya pangatop luma' si Samwel.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:26
verses.text: Pagdai' llaw pa'in, hinabu si Sa'ul masi ma diyata' atop e', nilinganan iya e' si Samwel, yukna, “Pabangun ka. Patuntulta ka ni pal'ngnganannu.” Jari asakap pa'in si Sa'ul, magbeya' sigā paluwas min luma'.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:27
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in sigā ni tōng kaluma'an inān, ah'lling si Samwel ni si Sa'ul yukna, “Soho'un na parahū sosoho'annu ilu.” Makarahū pa'in, ah'lling si Samwel ni si Sa'ul yukna, “Maitu gi' ka bo' ka pata'uku pasal lapal bay min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen2271" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.9"/> <div eID="gen2254" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1327"/><div sID="gen2272" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Sa'ul Gin'llal Sultan ma Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen2273" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1327"/> Puwas pa'in he'-i, bay angā' si Samwel poga-poga isihan ns'llan jaitun bo' binusugan e'na kōk si Sa'ul. Siniyum isab iya bo' yuk si Samwel, “Ka'a ya tapene' e' si Yawe magnakura' ma saga a'a palsuku'anna, ya na bangsa Isra'il. (Ka'a ya magmakōkan sigām maka angaliyusan sigām min komkoman saga banta sigām. Aniya' isab paltanda'an pamab'nnal in ka'a tapene' na e' si Yawe magsultanan bangsa palsuku'anna.)

verses.name: I Samuel 10:2
verses.text: Pagla'annu minnitu, makalanggal ka duwa a'a ma tongod bay pangubulan si Rakiya, ina'an ma lahat Selsa ma tobtoban tana' Benjamin. Buwattitu pamissala saga a'a inān ma ka'a, ‘Wa'i na tabāk saga kura' ya bay pihanu. Ma buwattina'an, ngga'i ka na saga kura' ya pinagsusahan e' mma'nu saguwā' ka'a na. Ya panilawna na pa'in, “Buwattingga e'ku amiha anakku?” ’ ”  <div eID="gen2273" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1328"/><div sID="gen2274" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1328"/> Ah'lling lagi' si Samwel ma si Sa'ul, yukna, “Paglanjalnu min saga a'a he', at'kka ka ni kayu paruwa'ahan ma Tabor. Sinampang ka e' t'llungan l'lla arai' na patukad ni Betel amudji ni Tuhan. Dangan inān amowa t'llu anak kambing, dangan isab amowa t'llu tinapay maka dangan amowa dapangisihan binu-anggul.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:4
verses.text: Sinagina ka pahāp e' sigām, maka binuwanan ka tinapay duwa hekana. Da'a taikutin, taima'un sadja.  <div eID="gen2274" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1329"/><div sID="gen2275" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1329"/> “Pagubus ilu-i, pehē' ka palanjal ni Gibeya ya pinagbahasa Būd Tuhan, ina'an maina'an magpustu saga sundalu Pilistin. Pagsekotnu ni kaluma'an, magbāk ka maka tumpukan nabi lūd bay min tampat. Magbissala sigām kaligawan pagka kahōpan e' Rū Yawe. Aniya' isab min dahuan sigām saga magbibiyula maka magsusuling maka a'a magtaroro'an tambul-tambul.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:6
verses.text: Ya du ka'a, kahōpan to'ongan ka e' Rū Yawe ati tabowa ka magbeya' maka saga nabi inān magbissala kaligawan. Tahinang ka sali' a'a saddī na.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:7
verses.text: Jari bang paniya' saga paltanda'an itu, hinangun bang ai ya maka'amu ma ka'a, sabab ilu Tuhan taptap pagapi' ma ka'a.  <div eID="gen2275" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1330"/><div sID="gen2276" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1330"/> “Na, palūd ka parahū min aku ni lahat Gilgal. Paturul du aku ni ka'a bo' anukbal susumbali'an tinunu' maka magduwa'a salamat. Saguwā' ka'a ya subay angagad pitu' llaw sampay aku makapi'ilu, bo' ka katō'anku bang ai subay hinangnu.”  <div eID="gen2276" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2272" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1331"/><div sID="gen2277" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nihinang Sultan si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1331"/> Manjari, song pa'in paokat si Sa'ul min si Samwel, pinindahan e' Tuhan pangatayan si Sa'ul e'. Atuman isab ma llaw ina'an kamemon saga paltanda'an bay binissala e' si Samwel.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:10
verses.text: Pagt'kka disi Sa'ul ni Gibeya, bināk sigām e' tumpukan saga nabi he'. Pahōp isab Rū Tuhan ma si Sa'ul ati tabowa iya palamud ma sigām magbissala kaligawan.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:11
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in iya he' saga a'a bay magkilahi maka iya, in iya ina'an magbeya' kahōpan e' Rū Tuhan, magtilaw-tilawan sigām dansehe'an yuk-i, “Ai bahā' makani-si Sa'ul ya anak si Kīs inān? Angay, nabi bahā' iya?”  <div eID="gen2278" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1332"/><div sID="gen2279" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1332"/> Jari anambung dakayu' a'a maglahat maina'an, yukna, “Hē, daka sai mma' saga a'a ilu.” Angkan pinagsambatan maina'an, yuk-i, “Nabi hati' si Sa'ul?”

verses.name: I Samuel 10:13
verses.text: Na, makahondong pa'in si Sa'ul magbissala, patukad iya ni tampat.  <div eID="gen2279" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1333"/><div sID="gen2280" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1333"/> Sakali tinilaw si Sa'ul maka tendogna e' dakayu' si'itna, yuk-i, “Bay kam maingga?” <div eID="gen2280" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2281" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Sa'ul, “Bay kami amiha saga kura' si Mma', Bapa'. Saguwā' pagka halam tabāk kami minsan pi'ingga pamiha'an, bay kami pehē' ni si Samwel.”  <div eID="gen2281" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1334"/><div sID="gen2282" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1334"/> Ah'lling si'itna inān, “Oto'”, yukna, “haka'in aku bang ai bay pamissala ma ka'a e' si Samwel.”  <div eID="gen2282" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1335"/><div sID="gen2283" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1335"/> Anambung si Sa'ul yukna, “Ya pamissalana ma kami in kura' si Mma' bay kono' tabāk.” Saguwā' halam nihaka e' si Sa'ul ma si'itna pasalan kapagsultanna ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen2283" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1336"/><div sID="gen2284" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1336"/> Manjari, pinalinganan e' si Samwel kamemon a'a Isra'il sinoho' pehē' ni lahat Mispa bo' magtimuk ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:18
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in sigām, yukna ma sigām, “Buwattitu in pagkallam si Yawe ya Tuhantam bangsa Isra'il, yukna, ‘Aku ya bay amowa ka'am paluwas min lahat Misil maka min pang'ntanan saga a'a tag-lahat e' maka min saga bangsa kasehe' ya bay amissoko' ka'am.’

verses.name: I Samuel 10:19
verses.text: Sagō' minsan na, tinaikutan e'bi Tuhanbi ya bay angalappas ka'am min kabinsana'an maka kasiksa'an. Angangut kam gom pa'in mikipat'nna' sultan. Na buwattina'an, pabaihu' kam ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, kamemon kam ma ba'anan kapanubu'anbi magtumpuk-manumpuk.”  <div eID="gen2284" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1337"/><div sID="gen2285" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1337"/> Tapatipun pa'in he' si Samwel kamemon bangsa Isra'il magsunu'-sunu', bangsa Benjamin ya tapene'.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:21
verses.text: Jari in panubu' si Benjamin magtumpuk-tumpuk binowa e' si Samwel ni matahan Tuhan, ati tumpukan si Matri ya tapene'. Ma kahinapusanna, si Sa'ul anak si Kīs ya tapene'. Sagō' pagpiha sigām, halam iya tabāk.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:22
verses.text: Jari angaru sigām pabīng ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yuk-i, “Makapi'itu na bahā' ya a'a tapene' inān?” <div eID="gen2285" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2286" type="paragraph"/> Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Aho', ina'an iya patapuk ma saga duwa'an.”  <div eID="gen2286" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1338"/><div sID="gen2287" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1338"/> Sakali, magdai'-dai' sigām pehē' angā' si Sa'ul bo' yampa binowa paluwas ni pagtipunan a'a inān. Na alanjang asal iya min kamemon.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:24
verses.text: Manjari, ah'lling si Samwel ni saga a'a, yukna, “Nda'unbi na a'a ya bay tapene' e' si Yawe. Halam aniya' sibu'na min kitam itu kamemon.” <div eID="gen2287" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2288" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy magdakayu' kamemon saga a'a inān angolang, yuk-i, “Mura-murahan pinataha' umul sultan ilu!”  <div eID="gen2288" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1339"/><div sID="gen2289" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1339"/> Pinahati e' si Samwel saga a'a mahadjana' inān pasal hatulan pagsultan. Tasulat e'na kamemon itu ma deyom kitab bo' pinat'nna' ma matahan si Yawe. Pagubus, pinapole' e' si Samwel saga a'a inān pakaniya-pakaniya ni luma' sigām.  <div eID="gen2289" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1340"/><div sID="gen2290" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1340"/> Ya du si Sa'ul, bay du isab amole' ni luma'na ma Gibeya, magbeya' maka saga a'a esogan magbono' ya kabuwanan baya' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:27
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' maina'an saga a'a asabul magpah'lling, yuk-i, “Buwattingga he' a'a itu angalappas kitam min saga bantatam?” Ati pinareyo'-deyo' e' sigām si Sa'ul. Halam aniya' huhulmatan binowa e' sigām pagmahaltabat ma iya. Sagō' halam du ah'lling minsan ai si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2290" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.10"/> <div eID="gen2277" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1341"/><div sID="gen2291" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tara'ug e' si Sa'ul saga Bangsa Ammon</title> <div sID="gen2292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1341"/> Na, palabay pa'in saga dambulan, tat'kka da'ira Jabes Giliyad e' si Nahas, ya sultan bangsa Ammon, ati kinumbis e'na bo' mbal makaluwas saga a'a ya maglahat maina'an. Manjari ah'lling sigām ni si Nahas yuk-i, “Magsulut kitam. Magpara'ug kami ma ka'a bang pa'in kami mbal papataynu.”  <div eID="gen2292" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1342"/><div sID="gen2293" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1342"/> Anambung si Nahas, yukna, “Aho', magsulut kitam bang pa'in talugitku dambila' matatam tampal ni kowan bo' supaya aheya kaiya'anbi ma bangsabi Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen2293" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1343"/><div sID="gen2294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1343"/> Angkan ah'lling saga pagmatto'ahan maina'an, yuk sigām, “Patangguhun kami ma deyom pitu' llaw bo' pinasaplag kahālan itu ma katilingkal Isra'il. Bang halam sai-na anabang kami, lilla' na kami magpalongkop ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2294" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1344"/><div sID="gen2295" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1344"/> Manjari, pehē' saga magbobowa lapal ni Gibeya ya kauman palahatan si Sa'ul. Kahaka'an pa'in saga a'a maina'an ma pasalan palkala' he', magtūy sigām maglemong kamemon.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:5
verses.text: Salta' ma waktu ina'an, at'kka si Sa'ul maka saga sapi'na bay min huma. Jari atilaw iya, yukna, “Ai kasusahan saga a'a itu? Angay sigām maglemongan?” Ati nihaka'an iya pasal bay pamissala saga a'a Jabes he'.  <div eID="gen2295" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1345"/><div sID="gen2296" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1345"/> Pagkale si Sa'ul ma bissala itu, magtūy pahōp ni iya Rū Tuhan, jari akagit atayna, mbal agon kasandalanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:7
verses.text: Ningā' e'na duwa sapi' bo' pinagkehet-kehet, ati pinabowa kehetanna ni katilibut Isra'il pamowahan banda'na ma saga a'a kamemon. Yukna, “Buwattitu tumaluwa' ni saga kahayopan sasuku tag-dapuna mbal maguyun ameya' ma si Sa'ul maka si Samwel.” Sakali, kasōran tāw kamemon bangsa Isra'il min kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, angkan sigām magda'atay ameya' ma si Sa'ul.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:8
verses.text: Manjari, pinatipun e' si Sa'ul ma kauman Besek saga kal'llahan, aniya' t'llu hatus ngibu heka sigām min Isra'il maka t'llumpū' ngibu min Yuda.  <div eID="gen2296" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1346"/><div sID="gen2297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1346"/> Ah'lling disi Sa'ul ma saga magbobowa lapal bay min Jabes e', yuk-i, “Pata'uhunbi saga a'a Jabes Giliyad, yukbi, ‘Salung, song pa'in ugtu llaw, alappas na kam.’ ” Kahaka'an pa'in saga a'a Jabes inān, landu' aheya kakōgan sigām,

verses.name: I Samuel 11:10
verses.text: ati yuk sigām ni saga a'a bangsa Ammon, “Pagsalung, lilla' na kami magpalongkop ma ka'am. Tahinangbi na ma kami bang ai kabaya'anbi.”  <div eID="gen2297" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1347"/><div sID="gen2298" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1347"/> Sagō' ma sangom ina'an du, bay binahagi' t'llu e' si Sa'ul saga sundaluna. Ma halam lagi' pak'llat mata llaw, tasōd e' sigām pustu saga bangsa Ammon bo' binono' e' sigām sampay ta'abut alanga llaw. Sasuku halam tapapatay bay makalahi pakaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen2298" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2291" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1348"/><div sID="gen2299" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinatuman Kapagsultan si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2300" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1348"/> Na pagka buwattē', ah'lling saga a'a Isra'il ma si Samwel, yuk sigām, “Sai sa saga a'a bay mbal bilahi pinagsultanan e' si Sa'ul? Pabowahun sigām pi'itu bo' papatay kami.”  <div eID="gen2300" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1349"/><div sID="gen2301" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1349"/> Saguwā' amissala si Sa'ul yukna, “Mbal aniya' minsan sai-na pinapatay ma llaw itu. Sabab ya itu llaw kapamuwan da'ugan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen2301" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1350"/><div sID="gen2302" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1350"/> Manjari ah'lling si Samwel ma saga a'a Isra'il yukna, “Sūng kitam ni Gilgal ati mahē' kitam amatuman pagsultan si Sa'ul.”

verses.name: I Samuel 11:15
verses.text: Sakali, pehē' ni Gilgal kamemon saga ummat Isra'il bo' pinatuman e' sigām pagsultan si Sa'ul maina'an ma matahan si Yawe. Maina'an isab sigām bay magduwa'a salamat ni si Yawe. Pagubus, aheya paglami-lami disi Sa'ul maka kamemon saga bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2302" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.11"/> <div eID="gen2299" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1351"/><div sID="gen2303" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal Pagba'iran si Samwel min Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen2304" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1351"/> Sakali ah'lling si Samwel ni saga bangsa Isra'il, yukna, “Bay na beya'ku kamemon pangamu'bi ya mikipat'nna' kam sultan.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:2
verses.text: Na buwattina'an, ilu na aniya' sultan magnakura'an ka'am. In aku itu ato'a na, sagō' ilu du saga anakku l'lla ma deyomanbi ganti'ku. Min kabata'ku sampay ni buwattina'an bay aku magnakura'an ka'am.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:3
verses.text: Itiya' aku pa'alop ma ka'am. Bang aniya' panuna'bi ma aku, saksi'inbi ma baihu'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe maka ma baihu'an sultan ya tapene'na itu. Sai bahā' ma ka'am bay katangkawanku sapi'na atawa kura'na? Sai ma ka'am bay ka'akkalanku? Sai ma ka'am bay pissoko'ku? Bay bahā' aku katambahan he' sai-na ma ka'am bo' supaya abengkok hukumanku? Bang bay tahinangku saga kahinangan itu minsan la'a hal dakayu', pabontolku na buwattina'an.”  <div eID="gen2304" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1352"/><div sID="gen2305" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1352"/> Manjari anambung saga bangsa Isra'il inān, yuk sigām, “Halam kami bay akkalannu atawa pissoko'nu. Halam ka bay anangkawan sai-na ma kami.”  <div eID="gen2305" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1353"/><div sID="gen2306" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1353"/> Yuk si Samwel ni sigām, “Llaw itu, saksi'tam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka sultan ya tapene'na itu, in aku mbal katōnganbi dusa.” <div eID="gen2306" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2307" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk sambung sigām, “<divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya saksi'tam.”  <div eID="gen2307" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1354"/><div sID="gen2308" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1354"/> Manjari ah'lling si Samwel, “Si Yawe ya bay amene' si Musa maka si Harun, maka Tuhan ya bay amowa saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi paluwas min lahat Misil.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:7
verses.text: Na, da'a kam ala'an m'nnilu sabab bontolanta kam maitu ma baihu'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pasal saga kahāpan bay tahinang he'na ma ka'am maka saga ka'mbo'anbi.  <div eID="gen2308" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1355"/><div sID="gen2309" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1355"/> “Ma Misil pa'in disi Yakub, bay sigām parahing ni si Yawe angamu' tabang, ati pinabeya'an sigām si Musa maka si Harun. Sigā ya bay amowa saga ka'mbo'anbi paluwas min Misil tudju pi'itu ni lahat ītu.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:9
verses.text: Saguwā' takalipat e' sigām si Yawe ya Tuhan sigām, angkan sigām bay pinasagaran he'na bo' tara'ug he' si Sisera ya pagnakura'an saga sundalu si Hasor. Bay isab sigām ni'nde'an ni komkoman saga bangsa Pilistin sampay sultan bangsa Mowab ya bay anguntarahan sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:10
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', bay angandahing isab saga a'a Isra'il ni <divineName>PANGHŪ',</divineName> yuk-i, ‘Ya Tuhan, aheya landu' dusa kami ma ka'a. Sabab bay ka taikutan kami pasumba ma saga ta'u-ta'u Ba'al maka Astoret. Lappasun kami min saga banta kami itu ati pabalik kami angisbat ka'a sadja.’

verses.name: I Samuel 12:11
verses.text: Sakali bay pinabeya' he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> si Jerub-Ba'al (ya niōnan isab si Gidiyun) bo' si Barak, ati bo' si Jepta, maka aku ya katapusan. Angkan kam bay kalappasan e'na min pang'ntanan saga kabantahanbi paruruwambila' bo' halam aniya' makarugpak ni lahatbi.  <div eID="gen2309" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1356"/><div sID="gen2310" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1356"/> “Saguwā',” yuk si Samwel, “pag'nda'bi pa'in song parugpak ni ka'am si Nahas ya sultan bangsa Ammon, subay kam angangut mikipat'nna' sultan magnakura'an ka'am. Buwattē' pangamu'bi ma aku minsan du Tuhan Yawe ya sultanbi.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:13
verses.text: Na”, yuk si Samwel, “itiya' na in sultan bay pene'bi, ya bay amu'bi. Nda'unbi pahāp, aniya' na sultan pinat'nna'an ka'am he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:14
verses.text: Jari ahāp kahālanbi bang pa'in kam magmatāw ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bang kam angisbat iya, bang mbal sagga'bi saga panoho'anna, bang ka'am maka sultan ya magnakura'an ka'am atukid ameya' ma si Yawe ya Tuhanbi.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:15
verses.text: Saguwā', bang kam mbal ameya' ma si Yawe ati sagga'bi gom pa'in saga panoho'anna, taptap kam pinat'kkahan bala', buwat bay pamat'kkana ma saga ka'mbo'anbi.  <div eID="gen2310" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1357"/><div sID="gen2311" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1357"/> “Na, da'a kam ala'an min pan'nggehanbi ilu bo' kam maka'nda' in hinang makainu-inu ya song nihinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma matahanbi.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:17
verses.text: Ta'abut na musim pagani tirigu, musim mbal pangulan. Sagō' angamu'-ngamu' aku ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang pa'in pinal'ggon maka pinaulan. Ati minnē' tasayubi bang buwattingga heya kala'atan bay tahinangbi ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pagka kam angangut subay mikipat'nna' sultan.”  <div eID="gen2311" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1358"/><div sID="gen2312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1358"/> Manjari angamu'-ngamu' si Samwel ati aniya' l'ggon maka ulan pinaniya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma llaw ina'an du. Angkan kamemon saga a'a maina'an sinōd tāw ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka ma si Samwel.  <div eID="gen2312" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1359"/><div sID="gen2313" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1359"/> Ah'lling sigām ni si Samwel, yuk-i, “Amu'-amu'in kami ni si Yawe ya Tuhannu bo' supaya kami mbal pinapatay. Bay ganapan kami saga dusa kami ma sabab kapangangut kami subay mikipat'nna' sultan.”  <div eID="gen2313" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1360"/><div sID="gen2314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1360"/> Anambung si Samwel yukna, “Da'a kam tināw. B'nnal aheka paldusahan bay tahinangbi, sagō' minsan na, da'a taikutinbi si Yawe. Wajib iya subay ni'isbat min deyom ataybi.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:21
verses.text: Da'a kam pasiha' min iya bo' maghinang ni saga tuhan-tuhan halam kapūsanna, sabab halam du aniya' kahāpan tahinang sigām ma ka'am. Mbal sigām makalappasan ka'am.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:22
verses.text: Kasulutan si Yawe angahinang ka'am bangsa palsuku'anna, angkan kam mbal siniya-siya he'na supaya mbal tasalla' ōnna babantugun.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:23
verses.text: In aku isab,” yuk si Samwel, “mbal bilahi amakay dusa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, angkan aku mbal pahali angamu'-ngamu'an ka'am tabang. Pandu'anta kam isab addat-tabi'at ahāp maka abontol.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:24
verses.text: Amay-amay, pagmatāwinbi si Yawe maka isbatunbi iya min deyom ataybi. Entomunbi to'ongan saga kahāpan makainu-inu ya bay tahinang e'na ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:25
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam pasangdan na pa'in angahinang kala'atan, tantu ka'am maka sultanbi ilu aligis.”  <div eID="gen2314" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.12"/> <div eID="gen2303" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:1
