verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1361"/><div sID="gen2315" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinabukagan si Sa'ul e' si Samwel</title> <div sID="gen2316" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1361"/> T'llumpū' tahun umul si Sa'ul waktu iya tahinang sultan<note>Halam tatugila' ma kasulatan tagna' bang pilantahun umul si Sa'ul ma waktu kapamat'nna' iya magsultan, maka bang pilantahun ya t'ggol kapagsultanna. In umbul 30 maka 42 itu bay ta'ā' min kasulatan Kitab bay tasalin ni bahasa Girīk.</note> ati mpatpū' maka duwantahun ya t'ggol kapagsultanna ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2316" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1362"/><div sID="gen2317" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1362"/> Na, si Sa'ul itu bay amene' sundalu t'llungibu hekana min bangsa Isra'il. Duwangibu sigām bay ma si Sa'ul ma kauman Mikmas maka ma kabūd-būran Betel, dangibu takapin bay ma si Jonatan ma Gibeya, ya ma paglahat bangsa Benjamin. Maka sasuku halam tapene' e' si Sa'ul bay pinapole' ni kaluma'an sigām.  <div eID="gen2317" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1363"/><div sID="gen2318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1363"/> Na, tarugpak e' si Jonatan pustu bangsa Pilistin ma lahat Geba angkan tasayu e' saga Pilistin in bangsa Hibrani<note>Bangsa Hibrani: hatina ‘bangsa Isra'il’.</note> angatu na. Manjari amah'lling si Sa'ul tiyup-tiyup ma katilingkal bangsa Isra'il supaya sigām magsakap amono'.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:4
verses.text: Minnē' takale e' kamemon bangsa Isra'il in habal itu, ya yukna, “Tarugpak pustu Pilistin e' si Sa'ul, ati aheya na kab'nsi sigām ma kitam bangsa Isra'il.” Angkan magpanoho'an si Sa'ul ma saga a'a Isra'il, sinō' patipun ma lahat Gilgal.  <div eID="gen2318" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1364"/><div sID="gen2319" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1364"/> Manjari, magtimukan na saga bangsa Pilistin bo' magsakap amono' bangsa Isra'il. Landu' aheka saga Pilistin e', t'llungibu heka kalesa sigām pagbobono', nnom ngibu saga sundalu magkakalesa. Ya sundalu sigām magtinape' sali' heka solagan gusung ma tampe. Patukad sigām magpustu ma Mikmas, tampal ni sobangan min Bet-Aben.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:6
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il in sigām kapilahan ma sabab kapaslod pagdugpak bangsa Pilistin, magtūy sigām sikatapukan ma saga songab batu, ma deyom kasagmotan, ma lugal kabatuhan, maka ma saga lowang bay kinalian.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga Hibrani kasehe'an bay pauntas ni dambila' sapa' Jordan tudju ni lahat Gād maka Giliyad. <div eID="gen2319" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2320" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' si Sa'ul bay magpa'bba ma Gilgal ati magpamidpid kamemon saga kasundaluhan bay ameya' ma iya kabowa tāw sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:8
verses.text: Dapitu' ya pangagad si Sa'ul maina'an buwat bay panugun e' si Samwel ma iya. Na, halam pa'in at'kka si Samwel, magkanat-kanat na saga sundalu bay maina'an ma si Sa'ul.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:9
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling si Sa'ul, yukna, “Bowahinbi aku hayop pagtaubat maka tutukbalan pagduwa'aku salamat.” Manjari bay tinukbalan e' si Sa'ul hayop tinunu'.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:10
verses.text: Pagubus, at'kka si Samwel ati paluwas si Sa'ul min kaluma'an anampang iya maka anagina.  <div eID="gen2320" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1365"/><div sID="gen2321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1365"/> Yuk si Samwel ma iya, “Ai bay hinangnu itu?” <div eID="gen2321" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2322" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Sa'ul, yukna, “Ta'nda'ku magkaukanat saga a'aku maka halam ka makat'kka ma waktu bay panugunnu. Ina'an isab saga sundalu Pilistin magtimuk ma Mikmas.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:12
verses.text: Tapikilku in bangsa Pilistin arai' parugpak pi'itu ni Gilgal ma halam aku minsan makapangaru ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Angkan aku bay magniyat magtukbal saga tutukbalan tinunu' itu.”  <div eID="gen2322" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1366"/><div sID="gen2323" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1366"/> Ya sambung si Samwel ma si Sa'ul, yukna, “Dupang pahāp ka magkahinangan buwattilu! Halam bay bogbogannu panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'a. Bang ka bay magkahagad, tuman ka'a maka saga panubu'nu pinapagsultan ma bangsa Isra'il ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:14
verses.text: Saguwā', pagka ka halam bay ameya' ma panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'a, mbal anatas kapagsultannu. Aniya' tapihana a'a makasulut pangatayanna, ati tapat'nna' na e'na magmakōk ma saga ummat ya palsuku'anna.”  <div eID="gen2323" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1367"/><div sID="gen2324" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1367"/> Pabuhat magtūy si Samwel bo' palanjal min Gilgal ni Gibeya ya ma paglahat Benjamin. Malaingkan si Sa'ul bay angitung saga sundalu ya beya' ma iya, nnom hatus heka sigām.  <div eID="gen2324" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2315" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1368"/><div sID="gen2325" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bangsa Isra'il Halam Magpakokos</title> <div sID="gen2326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1368"/> Na, ina'an disi Sa'ul maka anakna si Jonatan pahanti' ma Gibeya, beya' isab saga sundalu sigām, samantala' wa'i masi ma Mikmas magpustu saga sundalu Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:17
verses.text: Magbahagi' t'llu saga sundalu Pilistin itu bo' angandugpak bangsa Isra'il. Datumpuk inān bay patudju ni kauman Opra ya ma jadjahan lahat Suwal,

verses.name: I Samuel 13:18
verses.text: datumpuk bay pehē' tudju ni Bet-Horon, jari in tumpuk kat'lluna bay pehē' ni kareyahan min diyata'an karatagan Seboyim, ya paharap ni paslangan.  <div eID="gen2326" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1369"/><div sID="gen2327" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1369"/> Ma waktu ina'an-i, halam aniya' minsan dakayu' magsasasal ma katilingkal Isra'il sabab mbal nirūlan e' bangsa Pilistin. Tināw asal sigām in saga bangsa Isra'il angahinang pakokos di-sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:20
verses.text: Angkan saga bangsa Isra'il subay pehē' ni saga bangsa Pilistin magpa'asa' kapanyapan sigām taga-solab, buwat saga paga'araru, saga sangkul, saga kapa maka sanggot.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:21
verses.text: Duwa sīn tibu'uk ya halga' pagpa'asa' solab paga'araru maka sangkul, dakayu' sīn tibu'uk ya halga' isab pagpa'asa' tugsuk a'aslag maka kapa maka tōng tungkud.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:22
verses.text: Jari halam aniya' minsan dakayu' min sundalu Isra'il magtakos kalis atawa budjak ma llaw pagbono' inān, luwal si Sa'ul maka anakna si Jonatan.  <div eID="gen2327" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2325" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1370"/><div sID="gen2328" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tarugpak Bangsa Pilistin e' si Jonatan</title> <div sID="gen2329" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1370"/> Na, aniya' tumpukan sundalu Pilistin bay sinō' anunggu'an lān ya palabayan ma kapampangan Mikmas.  <div eID="gen2329" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.13"/> <div eID="gen2328" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1371"/><div sID="gen2330" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'ugan si Jonatan ma Mikmas</title> <div sID="gen2331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1371"/> Dakayu' llaw ah'lling si Jonatan anak si Sa'ul ni onde' baha'u ya magbobowa pakokosna, yukna, “Sūng kita pehē' ni pustu saga sundalu bangsa Pilistin ya ma dambila' inān.” Sagō' halam pinata'u mma'na.  <div eID="gen2331" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1372"/><div sID="gen2332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1372"/> Pasalta', ina'an si Sa'ul maka nnom hatus sundaluna magpustu ma deyo'an kayu dalima'<note>Dalima' itu kayu ahāp buwa'na. ‘Pomegranate’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ma Meglon, ya ma tobtoban lahat Gibeya.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:3
verses.text: Beya' isab maina'an si imam Ahidja ya tag-bowahan epod. Si Ahidja itu anak si Ahitub ya danakan si Ikabod. Mma' sigā si Pinehas anak si Eli ya bay maghinang ni si Yawe ma Silo. Sagō' halam sai-na makasayuhan kalikut si Jonatan e'.  <div eID="gen2332" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1373"/><div sID="gen2333" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1373"/> Na, aniya' pampang min karuwambila' lān ya palabayan si Jonatan tudju ni pagpustuhan saga sundalu Pilistin. Boses ya pangōn ma pampang dambila', Sene ya pangōn ma dambila'.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:5
verses.text: Pa'anggop ni Mikmas ya pampang tampal ni uttala', pa'anggop ni Geba ya pampang tampal ni tunggara'.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:6
verses.text: Sakali, ah'lling si Jonatan ni magbobowa pakokosna inān yukna, “Sūng kita pehē' ni pustu bangsa kapil inān. Kalu mura-murahan kita tinabangan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Tuman halam aniya' makapaggat bang iya ya amuwan da'ugan, ai naka aheka kitam atawa akulang.”  <div eID="gen2333" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1374"/><div sID="gen2334" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1374"/> Anambung magbobowa pakokos inān, yukna, “Pē'un tuwan, palanjalun bang ai maksudnu. Itiya' du aku ameya' ma ka'a minsan ai tumaluwa'.”  <div eID="gen2334" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1375"/><div sID="gen2335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1375"/> Ya pah'lling si Jonatan, “Sūng! Pehē' kita magpa'nda' ma sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:9
verses.text: Bang sigām ah'lling ni kita, yuk-i, ‘Angagad gi' kam mailu ati pi'ilu kami,’ na maitu sadja kita, mbal kita palanjal.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:10
verses.text: Sagō' bang yuk sigām, ‘Patukad kam pi'itu’, na patukad kita sabab ya ina'an paltanda'an in da'ugan pamuwan ma kita e' si Yawe.”  <div eID="gen2335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><div sID="gen2336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1376"/> Sakali, magpa'nda' pa'in sigā karuwangan ni pustu saga Pilistin he', magtūy sigām ah'lling, yuk-i, “Allā! Nda'unbi ba saga Hibrani ilu, ilu na sikaluwasan min saga lowang bay patapukan sigām!”

verses.name: I Samuel 14:12
verses.text: Jari angolang saga a'a ma pustu inān ni si Jonatan maka ni magbobowa pakokosna he', “Pasōng kam pi'itu bo' kam l'ggahan!” <div eID="gen2336" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2337" type="paragraph"/> Angkan ah'lling si Jonatan ni sehe'na inān yukna, “Paturul ka ma aku. Tuman pamuwan in da'ugan e' si Yawe ma bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen2337" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1377"/><div sID="gen2338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1377"/> Parāg si Jonatan min pampang ati paturul min buli'anna magbobowa pakokosna inān. Tapapatay he' si Jonatan saga sundalu Pilistin, maka ina'an isab sehe'na amapatay min buli'anna.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:14
verses.text: Jari duwampū' heka Pilistin bay tapapatay ma kapangandugpak sigā kamint'dda inān. Akiput asal lugal bay pagbono'an e'.  <div eID="gen2338" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2330" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1378"/><div sID="gen2339" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tara'ug Bangsa Pilistin</title> <div sID="gen2340" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1378"/> Manjari, ahiluhala' kamemon saga sundalu Pilistin kabowa tāw sigām. Ahiluhala' sigām ma deyom pustu, ahiluhala' sigām ma deya, ahiluhala' isab saga tumpukan magdurugpak. Magbeya' isab ajogjog tana' sabab in tāw inān bay pinaniya' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen2340" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1379"/><div sID="gen2341" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1379"/> Aniya' saga sundalu si Sa'ul ma Gibeya-Benjamin bay amantawan lahat ma sakalibut sigām, ati ta'nda' e' sigām saga sundalu Pilistin magkaukanat pehē'-pi'itu.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:17
verses.text: Magtūy ah'lling si Sa'ul ni saga a'a ya sehe'na, yukna, “Patipununbi saga sundalutam kamemon bo' nda'unbi bang sai halam maitu.” Pag'nda' sigām, luwal si Jonatan maka magbobowa pakokosna ya halam maina'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:18
verses.text: Ati ah'lling si Sa'ul ni imam Ahidja, yukna, “Bowahun pi'itu Ba'ul Paljanji'an Tuhan ilu.” (Ma waktu itu-i in Ba'ul Tuhan ina'an asal ma bangsa Isra'il.)

verses.name: I Samuel 14:19
verses.text: Na, hinabu si Sa'ul amissala ni imam e', paruhun na pa'in kalengogan ma pustu saga bangsa Pilistin. Angkan yuk si Sa'ul ma imam e', “Pasagarin na.”  <div eID="gen2341" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1380"/><div sID="gen2342" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1380"/> Sakali, magsakaum si Sa'ul maka kamemon saga sundaluna bo' pakuyas ni pagbono'an. Anā, landu' aheya in kalengogan ma saga sundalu bangsa Pilistin sabab ina'an sigām magpatay dansehe'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:21
verses.text: Aniya' saga Hibrani bay asal palamud ma bangsa Pilistin bo' dambeya'an maka sigām ma deyom pustu, sagō' papinda na sigām ni saga sundalu Isra'il ya bay ma disi Sa'ul maka si Jonatan.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:22
verses.text: Sampay saga bangsa Isra'il ya bay sikatapukan ma kabūd-būran lahat Epra'im ameya' na isab angapas pagkale sigām in saga sundalu Pilistin wa'i na maglahian.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:23
verses.text: Jari talappas bangsa Isra'il e' si <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma llaw ina'an du, ati palanjal na pa'in pagbono' inān sampay ni dambila' Bet-Aben.  <div eID="gen2342" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2339" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1381"/><div sID="gen2343" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panubali si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1381"/> Na, ma llaw ina'an-i, landu' abinsana' saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il sabab bay makasubali si Sa'ul, yukna, “Bang pa'in pinagmulka'an sai-sai anginam takakan ma mbal gi' s'ddop llaw. Subay aku makabalosan saga bantaku dahū!” Angkan halam sai-na anawakkal amangan sampay ni kakohapan.  <div eID="gen2344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1382"/><div sID="gen2345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1382"/> Sakali itu, makat'kka pa'in kamemon sundalu inān ni dakayu' gulangan, aniya' gula' buwani maina'an ma kuwit tana'.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:26
verses.text: Pagsōd sigām pehē', ta'nda' e' sigām gula' buwani inān magdayas-dayas, saguwā' halam aniya' minsan dakayu' min sigām makatawakkal an'nno'an tōng tanganna pina'an sabab kabowa tāw sigām ma bay panubali sultan Sa'ul e'.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:27
verses.text: Saguwā', pagka halam bay takale e' si Jonatan panubali mma'na, bay pina'abut tōng tungkudna ni gula' inān bo' kininaman e'na. Pagkakanna pa'in, pasawa magtūy pamaihu'anna pagka ahāp na palasahanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:28
verses.text: Nihaka'an iya magtūy e' dakayu' sundalu bay maina'an. “Tuwan,” yukna, “kami saga sundalu bay pinagsapahan e' mma'nu, sinō' mbal amangan ai-ai llaw itu. Pinagmulka'an kono' kami. Angkan ko' kami itu pinunung na e' lingantu.”  <div eID="gen2345" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1383"/><div sID="gen2346" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1383"/> Anambung si Jonatan, yukna, “Allā, aheya kasasawan pamat'kka e' mma'ku ma kitam kamemon! Nda'unbi ba kahāp palasahanku pagkakanku gula' buwani itu minsan la'a hal dangkuri'.”

verses.name: I Samuel 14:30
verses.text: Yukna lagi', “Luba'na na bahā' bang kam bay makakakan ai-ai ya tatabanbi min saga bantatam. Marai' aheka lagi' bangsa Pilistin bay tapapatay.”  <div eID="gen2346" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1384"/><div sID="gen2347" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1384"/> Ma llaw ina'an, tapapatay e' bangsa Isra'il saga bangsa Pilistin tinagna'an min Mikmas sampay ni jadjahan Ayjalon. Pagubus, landu' apaya saga a'a Isra'il sabab lingantu.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:32
verses.text: Angkan pinagagawan e' sigām saga bili-bili maka hayop bay tataban e' sigām bo' sinumbali' saru'un-du'un. Agsai pinagkakan e' sigām minsan masi laha'an, kabowa lingantu sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:33
verses.text: Ati aniya' makasumbung ma si Sa'ul, yukna, “Tuwan, makapakay dusa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga a'anu sabab wa'i sigām amangan sumbali'an masi taga-laha'.” <div eID="gen2347" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2348" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Sa'ul, “Saga panipu! Pagulungunbi saru'un-du'un pi'itu batu aheya.”

verses.name: I Samuel 14:34
verses.text: Magpanoho'an gi' iya, yukna, “Pehē'unbi saga a'a he' bo' soho'unbi amowa pi'itu saga sapi' maka bili-bili sigām dangan maka dangan. Soho'unbi sigām anumbali' maka amangan maitu. Subay sigām mbal amakay dusa ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pagka sigām amangan sumbali'an masi taga-laha'.” <div eID="gen2348" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2349" type="paragraph"/> Angkan ma sangom ina'an du, amowa sigām pakaniya-pakaniya saga sapi' maka bili-bili sigām bo' sinumbali' maina'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:35
verses.text: Anambak isab batu si Sa'ul pagkulbanan ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Yampa aniya' pagkulbanan tahinang e'na.  <div eID="gen2349" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1385"/><div sID="gen2350" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1385"/> Manjari ah'lling si Sa'ul, “Sangom itu,” yukna, “parugpak kitam ni saga bangsa Pilistin. Gora'tam ai-ai sigām kamemon ati papatayta sigām kamemon sampay ni kasubuhan.” <div eID="gen2350" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2351" type="paragraph"/> Anambung saga sundalu inān, “Hinangun tuwan bang ai taluwa' ma pikilannu.” <div eID="gen2351" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2352" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' ya panambung imam, “Subay kitam angaru dahū ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen2352" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1386"/><div sID="gen2353" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1386"/> Angkan angaru si Sa'ul ni Tuhan yukna, “Ya Tuhan, parugpak na bahā' kami ni bangsa Pilistin? Pamuwannu bahā' in da'ugan ma bangsa Isra'il?” Saguwā' halam aniya' sambung Tuhan ma llaw ina'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:38
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', ah'lling si Sa'ul ni saga nakura' ma tumpukan sundalu. “Pasōng kam pi'itu,” yukna, “bo' tata'u bang ai dusa bay tahinangtam ma llaw itu.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:39
verses.text: Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe ya Manglalappas ma bangsa Isra'il, sai-sai katōngan dusa itu minsan anakku si Jonatan, subay pinapatay.” Sagō' halam makapamūng saga a'a inān minsan dangan.  <div eID="gen2353" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1387"/><div sID="gen2354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1387"/> Ah'lling lagi' si Sa'ul ni kamemon saga a'a Isra'il, yukna, “Mailu kam ma dambila', ati aku maka anakku si Jonatan maitu isab ma dambila' itu.” <div eID="gen2354" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2355" type="paragraph"/> Jari anambung saga a'a maina'an, “Ka'a ya magkabaya'an, tuwan.”  <div eID="gen2355" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1388"/><div sID="gen2356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1388"/> Sakali angamu'-ngamu' si Sa'ul ni si Yawe ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il, yuk-i. “Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pata'uhun ni kami bang sai bay makarusa.” Magko'ot-ko'ot pa'in, tasayu ngga'i ka saga sundalu ya bay tag-dusahan, sabab si Jonatan maka si Sa'ul ya tako'ot.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:42
verses.text: Magtūy ah'lling si Sa'ul, yukna, “Pagko'ot-ko'otinbi bang sai ma kami maka si Jonatan ya bay makarusa.” Jari si Jonatan ya tako'ot.  <div eID="gen2356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1389"/><div sID="gen2357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1389"/> Na, ah'lling si Sa'ul ni si Jonatan, yukna, “ Haka'in aku bang ai bay tahinangnu?” <div eID="gen2357" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2358" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Jonatan, “Bay t'nno'anku tōng tungkudku ni gula' buwani bo' bay kinamanku dangkuri'. Na, patut bahā' aku subay pinapatay?”  <div eID="gen2358" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1390"/><div sID="gen2359" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1390"/> “Aho' Jonatan” yuk si Sa'ul. “Bang pa'in aku pinat'kkahan mulka' e' Tuhan bang ka mbal papatayku.”  <div eID="gen2359" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1391"/><div sID="gen2360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1391"/> Saguwā' yuk saga sundalu ni si Sa'ul, “Si Jonatan ya bay angaliyusan bangsatam Isra'il min kamulahan! Angay iya subay pinapatay? Mbal patut! Anapa kami ma ōn si Yawe ya Tuhan kakkal, in si Jonatan subay mbal ni'inay, sabab Tuhan ya bay anabangan iya ma bay tahinangna llaw itu.” Angkan kaliyusan si Jonatan e' saga a'a inān ati halam bay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen2360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1392"/><div sID="gen2361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1392"/> Manjari itu, pahondong na si Sa'ul angapas saga bangsa Pilistin angkan sigām magsuhutan na ni kalahatan sigām.  <div eID="gen2361" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1393"/><div sID="gen2362" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1393"/> Min waktu tagna' kapagsultan si Sa'ul ma Isra'il, niatuhan e'na saga banta sigām min paruruwambila'. Ya na bangsa Mowab, bangsa Ammon, bangsa Edom, saga sultan bangsa Soba, maka bangsa Pilistin. Minsan pi'ingga parugpakan si Sa'ul maka saga sundaluna, anganda'ug sadja sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:48
verses.text: Aesog e'na amono' ati tara'ug bangsa Amalek. Talappas e' si Sa'ul bangsa Isra'il min komkoman saga a'a bay makalangpasan ai-ai sigām.  <div eID="gen2362" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2343" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1394"/><div sID="gen2363" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Sa'ul Magtautai'anak</title> <div sID="gen2364" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1394"/> Ya itu saga anak si Sa'ul l'lla: si Jonatan bo' si Isboset maka si Malki-Suwa. Anakna d'nda kasiyakahan ya na si Merab, maka si Mikal ya kasiyalihan.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:50
verses.text: Ōn h'nda si Sa'ul ya na si Ahinowam anak si Ahima'as. Ōn a'a ya nakura' katapusan alanga ma saga sundaluna ya na si Abner. Magkaki si Sa'ul maka si Abner itu pagka

verses.name: I Samuel 14:51
verses.text: magdanakan mma' sigām. Si Kīs ya mma' si Sa'ul, maka si Nēr ya mma' si Abner. Si Abiyel ya bay mma' sigā.  <div eID="gen2364" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1395"/><div sID="gen2365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1395"/> Magbono' na pa'in bangsa Pilistin maka bangsa Isra'il sampay ni waktu kamatay si Sa'ul, halam aniya' halianna. Bang aniya' a'a akosog atawa aesog ta'nda' e' si Sa'ul ma bangsa Isra'il, ningā' magtūy e'na magsundalu.  <div eID="gen2365" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.14"/> <div eID="gen2363" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1396"/><div sID="gen2366" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinaikutan e' si Yawe Pagsultan si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2367" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1396"/> Ah'lling si Samwel ma si Sa'ul yukna, “Aku ya bay pinabeya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> amusugan ka'a ns'llan bo' ka pinat'nna' magsultan ma bangsa Isra'il, ya bangsa suku'na. Na, kalehun pahāp kallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa,

verses.name: I Samuel 15:2
verses.text: ya yuk-i, ‘Tungbasanku bangsa Amalek ma sabab bay kapangahapa' sigām bangsa Isra'il waktu kaluwas sigām min lahat Misil.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:3
verses.text: Na, buwattina'an, pehē' na ka, dugpakun bangsa inān. Laglagun sigām kamemon maka paka'atun ai-ai palsuku'an sigām. Da'a kapinin minsan dangan. Papatayun sigām kamemon d'nda-l'lla sampay ni onde'-onde' maka anak-duru'an. Papatayun isab saga kahayopan sigām, ai naka sapi', ai naka bili-bili, ai naka unta' sampay kura'. Papatayun kamemon.’ ”  <div eID="gen2367" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1397"/><div sID="gen2368" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1397"/> Sakali pinalinganan e' si Sa'ul saga a'ana magbobono', sinō' patipun ma da'ira Tela'im. Jari duwahatus ngibu sundalu magtinape' ya bay patipun pina'an, maka sangpū' ngibu isab min bangsa Yuda.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:5
verses.text: Na, pehē' disi Sa'ul tudju ni da'ira bangsa Amalek ati patapuk ma kal'bbakan bo' anipihan sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:6
verses.text: Jari magbanda' si Sa'ul ma bangsa Kēn, yukna, “Ala'an kam min deyoman saga bangsa Amalek ilu bo' kam mbal talapay pinapatay, sabab aheya kahāpan bay hinangbi ma bangsa Isra'il waktu kaluwas sigām min lahat Misil.” Angkan paokat minna'an saga bangsa Kēn.  <div eID="gen2368" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1398"/><div sID="gen2369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1398"/> Sakali itu, parugpak disi Sa'ul ni bangsa Amalek, tinagna'an min Habila sampay ta'abut Sūr, ya lahat ma bihing Misil tampal ni sobangan.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:8
verses.text: Tapapatay e' sigām kamemon saga sundalu Amalek inān sagō' si Agag ya sultan sigām hal bay sinaggaw.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:9
verses.text: In si Agag maka saga hayop ya katapusan ahāp, maka saga anak hayop ya asambu, halam bay ni'inay e' disi Sa'ul maka saga a'ana. Ahuskaw sigām amaka'at ai-ai ahāp angkan aniya' lagi' allum maka takapin. Sagō' sasuku halam kapūsanna bay nilaglag katūyan e' sigām.  <div eID="gen2369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1399"/><div sID="gen2370" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1399"/> Manjari angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Samwel, yukna,

verses.name: I Samuel 15:11
verses.text: “Magsusun aku amene' si Sa'ul magsultan sabab kataikutan aku e'na, maka halam bay beya'na saga panoho'anku.” Pagkale itu-i he' si Samwel, landu' iya asusa angkan iya angamu'-ngamu' ni si Yawe animpus dasangom inān.  <div eID="gen2370" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1400"/><div sID="gen2371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1400"/> Pag'llaw dakayu' hinabu subu-subu lagi', pabungkal na si Samwel arak amowa mag'nda' maka si Sa'ul, saguwā' aniya' angahaka'an iya, yukna, “Si Sa'ul bay ma kauman Karmel insini' amat'nggehan ta'u-ta'u pamaheyana ma kabantuganna. Wa'i na iya palūd ni Gilgal.”  <div eID="gen2371" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1401"/><div sID="gen2372" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1401"/> Makat'kka pa'in si Samwel ni Gilgal, ah'lling si Sa'ul ni iya, yuk-i, “Mura-murahan bang pa'in ka binarakatan e' si Yawe! Bay na beya'ku saga panoho'anna.”  <div eID="gen2372" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1402"/><div sID="gen2373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1402"/> Anambung magtūy si Samwel, yukna, “Na bang buwattē', ai bahā' lling bili-bili maka sapi' ya takaleku itu?”  <div eID="gen2373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1403"/><div sID="gen2374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1403"/> Anambung si Sa'ul, yukna, “Ya ilu bay ta'agaw e' saga sundaluku min bangsa Amalek. Bay kinapinan e' sigām saga bili-bili maka saga sapi' ya katapusan ahāp supaya aniya' panukbal ni si Yawe ya Tuhannu. Saddī m'nnilu bay papatay kami kamemon.”  <div eID="gen2374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1404"/><div sID="gen2375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1404"/> “Ē! Sarang na!” yuk si Samwel. “Kalehun gi' bay pangallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma aku dibuhi'.” <div eID="gen2375" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2376" type="paragraph"/> “Na, haka'in aku,” yuk si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1405"/><div sID="gen2377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1405"/> Ah'lling si Samwel yukna, “Areyo' kabantugannu arai' bang ma bistahannu, malaingkan in ka'a pagmakōkan ma saga kapanubu'an bangsa Isra'il. Tapene' ka e' si Yawe magsultan ma sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:18
verses.text: Ya panoho'anna ma ka'a, yuk-i, ‘Laglagun kamemon saga a'a Amalek, ya bangsa patila'atun inān. Bono'un sigām sampay sigām amatay kamemon.’ ”

verses.name: I Samuel 15:19
verses.text: Atilaw lagi' si Samwel yukna, “Angay halam beya'nu panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe he'? Angay magtūy agawnu saga tatabanan ya ka makahinang kala'atan makasāk atay <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>?”  <div eID="gen2377" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1406"/><div sID="gen2378" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1406"/> Anambung si Sa'ul, “Oy! Bay du aku magkahagad ma kabaya'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Bay hinangku panoho'anna ma aku. Bay papatayku kamemon bangsa Amalek maka bay saggawku si Agag ya sultan sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:21
verses.text: Suku' ma Tuhan asal saga bili-bili maka sapi' ya tataban inān, malaingkan kinapinan e' saga sundaluku saga hayop katapusan ahāp. Itiya' na ma Gilgal bo' aniya' susumbali'an tinukbalan ni si Yawe ya Tuhannu.”  <div eID="gen2378" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1407"/><div sID="gen2379" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1407"/> Yuk sambung si Samwel ma si Sa'ul, <lg sID="gen2380"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2381"/>“Kasulutan bahā' si Yawe ma saga susumbali'an tinunu'<l eID="gen2381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2382"/>maka tutukbalan pagtaubat<l eID="gen2382" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2383"/>labi lagi' min pameya'ta ma saga panoho'anna?<l eID="gen2383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2384"/>Ahāp lagi' magkahagad ma panoho'an Tuhan<l eID="gen2384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2385"/>min amowa tutukbalan.<l eID="gen2385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2386"/>Ahāp lagi' ameya' ma kabaya'anna<l eID="gen2386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2387"/>min anukbal lanab min saga bili-bili l'lla.<l eID="gen2387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2388"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:23
verses.text: Pinasali' ni dusa magpuputika'<l eID="gen2388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2389"/>ya dusa a'a anagga' ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen2389" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2390"/>maka bang a'a magmalangkahi,<l eID="gen2390" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2391"/>pasali' la'atna ni pagsumba ni saga ta'u-ta'u.<l eID="gen2391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2392"/>Ma pasalan kataikutnu min panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen2392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2393"/>tinaikutan isab he'na kapagsultannu.”<l eID="gen2393" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2380"/>  <div eID="gen2379" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1408"/><div sID="gen2394" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1408"/> Manjari ah'lling si Sa'ul ma si Samwel, yukna, “B'nnal, bay aku makalanggal panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka panoho'annu. Tu'ud aku tināw ma saga a'aku, angkan bay beya'ku pamogos sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:25
verses.text: Ndū' tuwan,” yukna, “amu'ku junjung ni ka'a, ampunun aku. Sehe'in aku bo' kita pabalik pehē' anumba ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”  <div eID="gen2394" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1409"/><div sID="gen2395" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1409"/> Saguwā' anambung si Samwel, yukna, “Hē! Mbal aku ameya' ma ka'a sabab bay taikutannu panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, maka ilu na ka tinaikutan he'na. Mbal na ka makapagsultan ma bangsa Isra'il!”  <div eID="gen2395" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1410"/><div sID="gen2396" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1410"/> Jari itu, song pa'in ala'an si Samwel, niragtu' tōng jubana e' si Sa'ul ati magtūy agese'.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:28
verses.text: Yuk si Samwel ma iya, “Nda'un na, in kapagsultannu sapantun juba itu. Taragtu' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min ka'a llaw itu, ati pamuwanna ma dakayu' pagkahinu, a'a labi ahāp min ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:29
verses.text: In Tuhan Kasahaya'an bangsa Isra'il, mbal magputing atawa amindahan pikilanna sabab ngga'i ka iya manusiya' magpinda-pinda pikilan.”  <div eID="gen2396" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1411"/><div sID="gen2397" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1411"/> Anganjunjung pabalik si Sa'ul. “Aho', bay aku makarusa,” yukna, “sagō' amu'ku ma ka'a, pagaddatin aku ma baihu'an saga pagmatto'ahan ma bangsaku Isra'il sampay ma bangsa Isra'il kamemon. Sehe'in aku bo' kita pabalik amudji ni si Yawe ya pagtuhanannu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 15:31
verses.text: Sakali pabunyug na si Samwel ma si Sa'ul ati makapudji iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen2397" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2366" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1412"/><div sID="gen2398" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinapatay si Agag</title> <div sID="gen2399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1412"/> Pagubus, ah'lling si Samwel, yukna, “Bowahunbi pi'itu si Agag ya sultan bangsa Amalek.” <div eID="gen2399" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2400" type="paragraph"/> Na, pasekot si Agag pina'an ni si Samwel ma halam aniya' kahanggawanna, sabab ma pikilanna, “Tantu palabay kapiligduhan, mbal na ko' aku itu pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen2400" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1413"/><div sID="gen2401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1413"/> Saguwā' yuk si Samwel, <lg sID="gen2402"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2403"/>“Ma pasalan aheka ina' kalungayan anak sabab bay papataynu,<l eID="gen2403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2404"/>damikiyanna amatay du ka isab ati kalungayan anak ina'nu.”<l eID="gen2404" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2402"/> Jari pinaglagut-lagut si Agag e' si Samwel ma matahan si Yawe, maina'an ma Gilgal.  <div eID="gen2401" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1414"/><div sID="gen2405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1414"/> Puwas pa'in e'-i, amole' na sigā karuwangan, si Samwel ni Rama bo' si Sa'ul ni Gibeya.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:35
verses.text: Min waktu inān sampay ni llaw kamatay si Samwel halam na iya amowa mag'nda' ma si Sa'ul. Sagō' magdukka na pa'in si Samwel ma kahālan si Sa'ul. Magsusun isab si Yawe sabab kapamene'na ma si Sa'ul magsultan ma bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2405" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.15"/> <div eID="gen2398" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1415"/><div sID="gen2406" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud Pinene' Magsultan</title> <div sID="gen2407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1415"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw, magkallam si Yawe ma si Samwel, yukna, “Sarang na pagdukkanu ma si Sa'ul pagka kataikutan e'ku pagsultanna ma bangsa Isra'il. Isihun ns'llan jaitun ni tanduk ya bowanu ilu bo' ka pehē' ni Betlehem ni a'a pinagōnan si Jesse. Sabab aniya' anakna l'lla tapene'ku magsultan.”  <div eID="gen2407" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1416"/><div sID="gen2408" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1416"/> Sagō' atilaw si Samwel, yukna, “Buwattingga kapehē'ku? Bang tasayu e' si Sa'ul, tantu aku pinapatay e'na.” <div eID="gen2408" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2409" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe, “Amowa ka dakayu' anak sapi' d'nda bo' haka'in saga a'a mahē' in ka'a pehē' amowa tutukbalan pagkulbannu ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:3
verses.text: Ta'abbitun si Jesse ni pagkulbanan ati pata'uku ni ka'a bang ai subay hinangnu. Busugin ns'llan ya a'a tō'ku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1417"/><div sID="gen2410" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1417"/> Bineya' e' si Samwel panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ati pehē' iya ni Betlehem. Pagt'kkana, bināk iya e' saga pagmatto'ahan maina'an maka he' sigām amidpid. Atilaw sigām ma iya, yuk-i, “Tuwan, kahāpan bahā' ya pagpi'itunu ilu?”  <div eID="gen2410" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1418"/><div sID="gen2411" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1418"/> “Aho',” yuk sambung si Samwel. “Pi'itu aku anukbal tutukbalan kulban ni si Yawe. Sussihunbi pamarananbi bo' kam pi'itu ameya' ma aku.” Sinussi isab e' si Samwel si Jesse maka saga anakna l'lla bo' ta'abbitna sigām ni pagkulban.  <div eID="gen2411" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1419"/><div sID="gen2412" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1419"/> Pagt'kka sigām, ta'nda' e' si Samwel si Eliyab ya anak si Jesse kasiyakahan, angkan pangannalna, “Tantu ya na itu bay tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”  <div eID="gen2412" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1420"/><div sID="gen2413" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1420"/> Saguwā' angallam <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Samwel, yukna, “Da'a nda'un luwana atawa lanjangna sabab ngga'i ka iya bay tapene'ku. Magbidda' asal e'ku ang'nda' min pang'nda' manusiya'. Sabab in manusiya' mag'nda' sadja ma pangluwahan saguwā' aku si Yawe ang'nda' ma pangatayan.”  <div eID="gen2413" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1421"/><div sID="gen2414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1421"/> Sakali pinalinganan e' si Jesse si Abinadab ya anakna pasunu' bo' binowa palabay min matahan si Samwel. Saguwā' yuk si Samwel, “Ngga'i ka iya bay tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: I Samuel 16:9
verses.text: Jari si Samma, ya anak si Jesse kat'llu na, pinalabay min si Samwel, sagō' yuk si Samwel, “Ngga'i ka du isab iya bay tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: I Samuel 16:10
verses.text: Tapalabay e' si Jesse kapitu' anakna l'lla min matahan si Samwel sagō' buwattē' na pa'in pah'lling si Samwel, yukna, “Halam sai-na ma sigām bay tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: I Samuel 16:11
verses.text: Angkan atilaw si Samwel ma si Jesse yukna, “Halam na aniya' saddī anaknu min sigām itu?” <div eID="gen2414" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2415" type="paragraph"/> “Aniya' gi' kasiyalihan,” yuk sambung si Jesse, “saguwā' wa'i magipat saga bili-bili.” <div eID="gen2415" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2416" type="paragraph"/> Ah'lling si Samwel, “Soho'un iya pinabowa pi'itu. Mbal kitam makatagna' sat'ggolna mbal at'kka.”  <div eID="gen2416" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1422"/><div sID="gen2417" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1422"/> Angkan pina'ā' e' si Jesse anakna kasiyalihan. Onde' arorog iya, amanis, maka ahāp isab ninda' matana. <div eID="gen2417" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2418" type="paragraph"/> Jari yuk <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma si Samwel, “Ya na ilu tapene'ku. Pē'un na, busugin iya ns'llan tanda' kapagsultanna.”  <div eID="gen2418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1423"/><div sID="gen2419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1423"/> Manjari ningā' e' si Samwel tanduk isihan ns'llan e' bo' busuganna si Da'ud ma matahan saga danakanna. Tinagna'an min llaw inān pataptap Rū si Yawe ma si Da'ud. Sakali amole' na pabalik si Samwel ni Rama.  <div eID="gen2419" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2406" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1424"/><div sID="gen2420" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud ma Deyoman Sultan Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2421" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1424"/> Sakali ala'an na Rū si Yawe min si Sa'ul ati aniya' saitan pinapehē' e' si Yawe aminsana' iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:15
verses.text: Ah'lling saga tendogna, yuk-i, “Tuwan sultan, tantu ka bininsana' e' saitan bay min Tuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:16
verses.text: Angkan tuwan, soho'un kami saga sosoho'annu itu amiha dakayu' a'a ata'u magbiyula. Ati sakahaba' ka tin'kka e' saitan, magbiyula iya supaya pahāp palasahannu.”  <div eID="gen2421" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1425"/><div sID="gen2422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1425"/> Angkan magpanoho'an si Sa'ul ma saga tendogna inān, yukna, “Na aho', piha'inbi aku a'a apanday magbiyula bo' bowahunbi pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen2422" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1426"/><div sID="gen2423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1426"/> Jari ah'lling dakayu' sosoho'an inān yukna, “Tuwan, aniya' kata'uwanku apanday magbiyula. Anak iya si Jesse a'a min Betlehem. Aesog iya maka bobono'un. Ahantap isab himumūnganna maka arorog pamarananna. Ina'an isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pat'ttog ma iya.”  <div eID="gen2423" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1427"/><div sID="gen2424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1427"/> Manjari amabeya' lapal si Sa'ul ni si Jesse, yuk-i, “Papi'ituhun anaknu si Da'ud ya magi'ipat bili-bili ilu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 16:20
verses.text: Pagkale si Jesse, magtūy iya anganduwa' ni kura' ba'anan tinapay maka dapangisihan binu-anggul maka dakayu' anak kambing. Aubus pa'in niruwa' e'na, pinatulak e'na si Da'ud pehē' ni si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2424" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1428"/><div sID="gen2425" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1428"/> Sakali anagna' na maghinang si Da'ud ma deyoman sultan Sa'ul. Kasulutan sidda si Sa'ul ma iya angkan iya nihinang dakayu' magbobowa pakokosna.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:22
verses.text: Amabeya' lapal isab si Sa'ul pehē' ni si Jesse, yuk-i, “Pamaituhun na si Da'ud ma deyomanku sabab kasulutan aku ma iya.”  <div eID="gen2425" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1429"/><div sID="gen2426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1429"/> Na, sakahaba' si Sa'ul bininsana' e' saitan bay min Tuhan, magbiyula magtūy si Da'ud. Bay pa'in iya makabiyula, pahāp palasahan si Sa'ul maka ala'an isab saitan min iya.  <div eID="gen2426" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.16"/> <div eID="gen2420" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1430"/><div sID="gen2427" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinukas Kaesog Bangsa Isra'il e' si Golayat</title> <div sID="gen2428" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1430"/> Manjari magtipun saga sundalu bangsa Pilistin bo' pasakap magbono'. Magpūn sigām ma kauman Soko ya ma lahat Yuda, ati magpustu sigām ma Epes-Dammim ma llot Soko maka Aseka.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:2
verses.text: Ina'an isab magtimuk disi Sa'ul maka saga sundalu Isra'il bo' magpustu ma L'bbak Ela. Patanam isab sigām bo' angatu ma bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:3
verses.text: In bangsa Pilistin ina'an ma dakayu' būd, maka ina'an saga bangsa Isra'il ma būd saddī. Aniya' l'bbak-būd isab ma llot sigām.  <div eID="gen2428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1431"/><div sID="gen2429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1431"/> Sakali aniya' paluwas min pustu bangsa Pilistin dakayu' a'a bobono'un maka babantugun. Ōnna si Golayat, a'a min da'ira Gāt. Kulang-labi dand'ppa maka tonga'<note>Dand'ppa maka tonga', atawa siyam tape'.</note> lanjangna.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:5
verses.text: Magsinaruk tumbaga si Golayat itu, maka magbinadju' badju' sisikan tumbaga, buhatna saga limampū' ka lima kilu.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:6
verses.text: Tinampanan tape'na maka tumbaga, maka aniya' budjak tumbaga pasalay ma bukutna.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:7
verses.text: Aniya' budjakna dakayu' da'aslag batangna maka batang pagt'nnunan kakana'. Ya solabna dī basi', ya buhatna saga pitu' kilu. Aniya' magbobowa tamingna parahū min iya.  <div eID="gen2429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1432"/><div sID="gen2430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1432"/> Na, an'ngge si Golayat itu ma anggopan saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il, maka e'na angamahit, yukna, “Angay kam subay paluwas magbono'? Aku itu dakayu' ko' sundalu Pilistin, bo' ka'am ilu banyaga' sadja si Sa'ul! Pene'unbi,” yukna, “dakayu' a'abi bo' soho'unbi pi'itu angatuhan aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:9
verses.text: Bang saupama aku tara'ugna, magpabanyaga' kami ma ka'am. Sagō' bang iya ya tara'ugku, ka'am ya hinang kami banyaga'.”

verses.name: I Samuel 17:10
verses.text: Ah'lling lagi' si Golayat, yukna, “Buwattina'an tukasku kaesogbi bangsa Isra'il! Papi'ituhunbi bang aniya' angatuhan aku.”

verses.name: I Samuel 17:11
verses.text: Ā, pagkale bissala si Golayat itu e' si Sa'ul maka kamemon saga sundalu Isra'il, magtūy sigām angalogmay maka sinōd tāw.  <div eID="gen2430" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2427" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1433"/><div sID="gen2431" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal si Da'ud</title> <div sID="gen2432" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1433"/> Na, ina'an si Da'ud anak si Jesse, ya min tumpuk Eprata. Si Jesse inān bay pat'nna' ma Betlehem ma lahat Yuda. Walu' heka anakna, maka ato'a na iya ma waktu kapagsultan si Sa'ul.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:13
verses.text: T'llungan anak si Jesse kasiyakahan bay ameya' ma sultan Sa'ul ma pagbono'an. Ya siyaka to'ongan si Iliyab, bo' si Abinadab, bo' si Samma,

verses.name: I Samuel 17:14
verses.text: maka si Da'ud ya kasiyalihan. Jari ya t'llungan anak siyaka ameya' na pa'in ma si Sa'ul ma pagbono'an,

verses.name: I Samuel 17:15
verses.text: ati si Da'ud ya magpehē'-pi'itu. Bay pa'in iya maghinang ma si Sa'ul, amole' iya pabalik ni Betlehem angipat saga bili-bili mma' sigām.  <div eID="gen2432" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1434"/><div sID="gen2433" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1434"/> Manjari magmairan na pa'in si Golayat ma matahan bangsa Isra'il, waktu subu maka waktu kohap ma deyom mpatpū' llaw.  <div eID="gen2433" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1435"/><div sID="gen2434" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1435"/> Dakayu' llaw, magpanoho'an si Jesse ma si Da'ud, yukna, “Oto', pasa'ut ka pehē' ni pustu saga siyakanu. Bowahin sigām dakarut pai-tirigu bay sinanglag maka sangpū' solag tinapay itu.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:18
verses.text: Bowahin isab nakura' tumpukan sigām sangpū' solag gatas apīt<note>Ya ‘gatas apīt’ itu, ‘cheese’ ma bahasa Ingglis.</note>. Maka nda'un isab kahālan saga siyakanu mahē', ati bowahin aku lapal in sigām asalamat du.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:19
verses.text: Wa'i sigām magbeya' maka sultan Sa'ul maka kamemon sundalu Isra'il ma L'bbak Ela, magbono' na pa'in maka bangsa Pilistin.”  <div eID="gen2434" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1436"/><div sID="gen2435" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1436"/> Dai' llaw pa'in, pabangun na si Da'ud bo' pang'bbana saga bili-bili ma dakayu' magi'ipat bili-bili du isab. Palanjal na iya amowa saga balanja' buwat bay panoho'an mma'na, ati makat'kka iya pehē' hinabu ma pal'ngnganan pa'in saga magbobono' bangsa Isra'il ni atag pagbono'an. Ina'an sigām angolang panukas palbantahan sigām bangsa Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:21
verses.text: Sakali, magharap na sundalu Isra'il maka sundalu Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:22
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', pang'bba e' si Da'ud ma magjajaga balanja' ai-ai bay bowana bo' magdai'-dai' pehē' angowa' ma saga siyakana.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:23
verses.text: Hinabuna lagi' magbissala maka sigām, ina'an na si Golayat a'a Gāt an'ngge min dahuwan saga pagkahina sundalu Pilistin, maka he'na isab anukas kaesog bangsa Isra'il buwat bay kahaba'. Jari takale itu he' si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:24
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il ma si Golayat, magtūy sigām magdauragan kabowa tāw sigām.  <div eID="gen2435" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1437"/><div sID="gen2436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1437"/> Magupama na pa'in saga sundalu inān, yuk-i, “Nda'unbi ba a'a inān. Llaw-llaw iya paluwas min pustuna anukas bangsatam Isra'il. Yuk suli-suli, sai ya makapapatay ma si Golayat tinungbasan alta' aheka e' sultan Sa'ul. Pamah'nda isab e'na anakna budjang ma a'a makapatay si Golayat, ati saga anak-kampungna mbal na pinabayad buwis parinta.”  <div eID="gen2436" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1438"/><div sID="gen2437" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1438"/> Atilaw gi' si Da'ud ma saga a'a ya ma atagna, yukna “Ai kono' panungbas ma a'a makapatay a'a bangsa Pilistin itu, maka amuwas kaiya'antam bangsa Isra'il? Sai sa kapil itu ya makatawakkal anukas saga sundalu ya suku' Tuhan kakkal salama-lama?”  <div eID="gen2437" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1439"/><div sID="gen2438" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1439"/> Binalikan e' saga a'a inān ya bay pagupama sigām, yuk-i, “Buwattē' ya panungbas e' sultan ma sai ya makapatay ma Pilistin ilu.”  <div eID="gen2438" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1440"/><div sID="gen2439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1440"/> Na, pagkale si Eliyab ya siyaka si Da'ud ma bay panilawna ma saga sundalu inān, magtūy akagit atayna. Angkan pah'llinganna si Da'ud, yukna, “Magay ka mailu? Sai bay pang'bbahannu saga bili-bili salat-salat ma paslangan he'? Kata'uwanku ka'a maka pagabbunu. Mamarahi to'ongan la'at pikilannu. Hal ko' ka ilu bay pi'itu ang'nda'-ng'nda' pagbono' itu!”  <div eID="gen2439" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1441"/><div sID="gen2440" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1441"/> Ya sambung si Da'ud, “Angay?” yukna. “Ai bay hinangku? Halam bahā' aniya' kapatutku minsan hal atilaw?”

verses.name: I Samuel 17:30
verses.text: Jari pataikut si Da'ud min siyakana bo' atilaw ma a'a saddī ma pasal ina'an-i. Sakali magsali' du panambung sigām ma iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:31
verses.text: Na, takale suli-suli si Da'ud itu ati tahaka ni si Sa'ul, angkan iya pinalinganan sinō' pehē' ni sultan.  <div eID="gen2440" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1442"/><div sID="gen2441" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1442"/> Pagt'kka si Da'ud, ah'lling iya ni si Sa'ul, “Tuwan sultan,” yukna, “subay kitam mbal niumagad ma a'a Pilistin ilu! Aku ya pehē', tuwan, angatuhan iya!”  <div eID="gen2441" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1443"/><div sID="gen2442" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1443"/> Ya sambung si Sa'ul ma iya, “Oy! Mbal ka maka'atuhan Pilistin ilu. Onde'-onde' gi' ka, bo' iya inān magbobono' asal min bay lagi' kabata'na.”  <div eID="gen2442" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1444"/><div sID="gen2443" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1444"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Da'ud ni si Sa'ul, yukna, “Tuwan, aku itu magi'ipat saga bili-bili mma'ku. Sakahaba' aniya' bili-bili tatanga' e' halimaw atawa baruwang,<note>Baruwang itu sattuwa talun landu' aesog. ‘Bear’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:35
verses.text: aku iya magbaran anurul ati puwasanku bili-bili min bowa' sattuwa he'. Tabīng pa'in aku e' sattuwa he', magtūy lurayku ma bū-langalna bo' papatayku.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:36
verses.text: Aho', tuwan sultan, aheka saga halimaw maka baruwang bay tapapatayku angkan pasali'ku a'a kapil bangsa Pilistin itu ni dakayu' sattuwa inān, pagka tatukas e'na kasundaluhan suku' Tuhan, ya kakkal salama-lama.”

verses.name: I Samuel 17:37
verses.text: Ah'lling lagi' si Da'ud, yukna, “Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bay angalappasan aku min kukku halimaw maka min kukku baruwang, ya du isab Tuhan angalappasan aku min pang'ntan a'a Pilistin itu.” <div eID="gen2443" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2444" type="paragraph"/> Pagka buwattē' pa'in, ah'lling si Sa'ul ni si Da'ud, yukna, “Na, pehē' ka angatu. Bang pa'in <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pabeya' ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2444" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1445"/><div sID="gen2445" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1445"/> Manjari, pinasulug he' si Sa'ul saga pamakayna pagbono' ma si Da'ud. Pinasulug sarukna tumbaga ni kōk si Da'ud, badju'na basi' ma puhu'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:39
verses.text: Pagubus itu, magtinakos si Da'ud kalis si Sa'ul, pinakambotan pehē' ni badju'na pagbobono'. Sagō' agon iya mbal makal'ngngan pagka mbal biyaksa, angkan iya ah'lling ni si Sa'ul. <div eID="gen2445" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2446" type="paragraph"/> “Tuwan sultan,” yukna, “mbal aku makapamono' bang aku magbinadju' saga pakayan itu sabab halam aku biyaksa.” Minnē' niurusan e' si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:40
verses.text: Jari ningā' e'na tungkudna bo' pehē' ni sapa' amene' lima batu-batu alanu', pinat'nna' e'na ni deyom puyu'-puyu' ya asal pinagbowa e'na ma waktu kapangipatna saga bili-bili. Binowa isab pitikanna bo' pal'ngngan tudju ni si Golayat ya a'a Pilistin e'.  <div eID="gen2446" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1446"/><div sID="gen2447" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1446"/> Salta', pina'an si Golayat tudju ni si Da'ud, maka ina'an isab magbobowa tamingna min dahuanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:42
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Golayat ma si Da'ud in iya onde' baha'u lagi' maka ahāp luwana, magtūy iya niudju' e'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:43
verses.text: Yukna ma si Da'ud, “Hōy! Ai pangannalnu ma aku? Ero' bahā', angkan ka pi'itu ni aku maka kayu-kayunu ilu?” Sinabbut isab e'na saga tuhan ya pagtuhanan bangsa sigām Pilistin bang pa'in si Da'ud taluwa' sukna'.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:44
verses.text: Amissala lagi' iya ma si Da'ud, “Pasōng ka pi'itu,” yukna, “bo' pamakanku isinu ilu ma saga manuk-manuk maka saga sattuwa talun!”  <div eID="gen2447" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1447"/><div sID="gen2448" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1447"/> Anambung si Da'ud ma Pilistin e', yukna, “Ka'a ilu magbowa kalis, budjak aheya maka budjak ariki', sagō' atuhanta ka ma ōn si Yawe, ya Tuhan tatukasnu itu. In iya Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, ya pagtuhanan saga sundalu Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:46
verses.text: Ma llaw itu, tinukbal ka ni aku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ati papatayta ka maka ponggolanku kōknu. Pakakanku bangkaybi bangsa Pilistin ma saga manuk-manuk maka saga sattuwa talun, ati tasayu e' kamemon manusiya' aniya' Tuhan sab'nnal-b'nnal ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:47
verses.text: Kamemon saga a'a sikatimukan itu song makata'u in si Yawe makalappas saga a'a suku'na minsan halam aniya' kalis atawa budjak pakokosna. Ma iya asal in da'ugan ma pagbono' itu, ati tinukbal kam e'na ni komkoman kami.”  <div eID="gen2448" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1448"/><div sID="gen2449" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1448"/> Na, pagsekot na pa'in si Golayat, arak parugpak, magtūy paragan si Da'ud amāk iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:49
verses.text: Kino'ot e'na dakayu' batu-batu min deyom puyu'-puyu'na bo' magtūy pinitik si Golayat. Taluwa' iya ma tuktukna ati paloblob batu he'. Magtūy iya humantak para'ub.  <div eID="gen2449" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1449"/><div sID="gen2450" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1449"/> Sakali anganda'ug si Da'ud minsan hal pitikan maka batu ma tanganna. Minsan halam kalisna, tabono'na maka tapatayna si Golayat.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:51
verses.text: Paghantak si Golayat itu, paragan magtūy si Da'ud bo' an'ngge ma atagna. Nihublut e'na kalis si Golayat bo' papatayna. Pagubus, pinonggolan e'na kōk. <div eID="gen2450" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2451" type="paragraph"/> Na, pag'nda' bangsa Pilistin in sundalu sigām babantugun amatay na, magtūy sigām maglahian.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:52
verses.text: Sakali, magolangan saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il maka bangsa Yuda maka e' sigām pasōng ni dahuwan bo' angapas saga Pilistin sampay ni bihing da'ira Gāt maka ni pagsosōran ni Ekron. Sikahantalan bangkay saga sundalu Pilistin ma bihing lān min Sa'araim sampay ni Gāt maka ni Ekron.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:53
verses.text: Pagbalik saga sundalu Isra'il min bay panurulan ma saga sundalu Pilistin, tataban magtūy e' sigām kamemon ai-ai takapin ma pustu saga sundalu Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:54
verses.text: Jari binowa e' si Da'ud kōk si Golayat ni Awrusalam, sagō' saga pakokos si Golayat bay bowana ni toldana.  <div eID="gen2451" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1450"/><div sID="gen2452" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1450"/> Maka'nda' pa'in si Sa'ul ma kapangatu si Da'ud ma si Golayat, atilaw iya ma si Abner ya nakura' saga sundaluna. “Abner,” yukna, “anak sai sa onde' baha'u inān?” <div eID="gen2452" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2453" type="paragraph"/> “Minsan aku pasapanu tuwan sultan, mbal kata'uwanku,” yuk sambung si Abner.  <div eID="gen2453" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1451"/><div sID="gen2454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1451"/> Yuk sultan lagi', “Panilawun bang anak sai iya.”  <div eID="gen2454" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1452"/><div sID="gen2455" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1452"/> Manjari makabalik pa'in si Da'ud min kapamono'na ma si Golayat, binowa iya e' si Abner paharap ni si Sa'ul, salta' ina'an lagi' kōk si Golayat binenten e'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:58
verses.text: Atilaw si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud, “Anak sai ka, oto'?” yukna. <div eID="gen2455" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2456" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Da'ud, “Tuwan sultan,” yukna, “aku itu anak dakayu' tendognu si Jesse, a'a min Betlehem.”  <div eID="gen2456" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.17"/> <div eID="gen2431" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1453"/><div sID="gen2457" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angimbū si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud</title> <div sID="gen2458" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1453"/> Na, aubus pa'in pagbissala si Da'ud maka si Sa'ul, makapagda'atay iya maka si Jonatan ya anak si Sa'ul. In lasa si Jonatan ma si Da'ud sali' du lasana ma baranna.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:2
verses.text: Tinagna'an min llaw ina'an, halam na pinapole' e' si Sa'ul si Da'ud ni okoman mma'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:3
verses.text: Sakali itu, pagka alasa si Jonatan ma si Da'ud buwat e'na alasahan baranna, bay iya magjanji' maka si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:4
verses.text: Nihurusan e' si Jonatan jubana bo' pamuwanna ma si Da'ud, beya' isab s'mmekna pagbobono' maka kalisna sampay pana'na maka kambotna.  <div eID="gen2458" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1454"/><div sID="gen2459" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1454"/> Pi'ingga-pi'ingga panoho'an si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud, aheya sadja da'uganna angkan iya tahinang nakura' alanga ma saga sundalu. In kapat'nna' ma si Da'ud itu makasulut pangatayan kamemon saga a'a Isra'il sampay saga pagnakura'an sundalu si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2459" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1455"/><div sID="gen2460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1455"/> Manjari waktu lagi' bay kapamole' saga sundalu Isra'il puwas bay tapatay e' si Da'ud si Golayat, pina'an pabāk ni si Sa'ul saga kar'ndahan min katilingkal kauman Isra'il magpangigal maka magkalangan, magbowa sigām tambul-tambul maka biyula.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:7
verses.text: Hinabu sigām magpangigal, angalang sigām buwattitu, <lg sID="gen2461"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2462"/>“Ibuhan tapatay e' sultan Sa'ul,<l eID="gen2462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2463"/>maka hatusan ibu isab ma si Da'ud.”<l eID="gen2463" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2461"/>  <div eID="gen2460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1456"/><div sID="gen2464" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1456"/> Pagkale si Sa'ul ma pagkalang itu, landu' iya angastol angkan yukna ma deyom atayna, “Bang ma saga a'a itu hatusan ibu ya bay tapatay e' si Da'ud bo' aku itu ibuhan sadja. Na, ai lagi' bahā' takapin ya makajari niagaw e'na? Luwal la'a pagsultanku.”

verses.name: I Samuel 18:9
verses.text: Angkan tinagna'an min llaw inān ala'at na pang'nda' si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud kabowa pangimbūna.  <div eID="gen2464" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1457"/><div sID="gen2465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1457"/> Manjari pag'llaw dakayu', aniya' saitan bay min Tuhan pasangon ni si Sa'ul. Binelaw iya, maka magligaw e'na amissala ma deyom luma'na, hinabu si Da'ud magbiyula buwat kabiyaksahanna. Na, aniya' budjak ma tangan si Sa'ul,

verses.name: I Samuel 18:11
verses.text: ati yukna ma deyom atayna, “Gom lagbasku si Da'ud itu ni dinding.” Sakali, binudjak si Da'ud e' si Sa'ul, daipara katangkisan e'na min duwa.  <div eID="gen2465" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1458"/><div sID="gen2466" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1458"/> Aheya tāw si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud sabab tinabang na pa'in iya e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe bo' si Sa'ul tinaikutan na.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:13
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', pinatulak e'na si Da'ud bo' pinagmakōk ma tumpukan sundalu dangibu hekana. Jari magmakōk si Da'ud ma saga sundaluna pi'ingga-pi'ingga ya pagbono'an sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:14
verses.text: Ajatu kamemon kahinanganna sabab ina'an asal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pat'ttog ma iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:15
verses.text: Ya itu sababan angkan pasōng gom pa'in tāw si Sa'ul ma si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:16
verses.text: Malaingkan in kamemon a'a Isra'il maka Yuda palasa ma si Da'ud sabab ahāp e'na magmakōkan sigām ma pagbono'an.  <div eID="gen2466" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1459"/><div sID="gen2467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1459"/> Na, aniya' waktu ah'lling si Sa'ul ni si Da'ud, yukna, “Bang aesog e'nu amogbogan aku maka bang t'nggehannu pahāp pagbono' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pamah'ndaku ma ka'a si Merab, ya anakku siyaka.” Buwattē' pamissala si Sa'ul sabab ma pikilanna ngga'i ka iya ya amapatay si Da'ud, sagō' saga bangsa Pilistin.  <div eID="gen2467" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1460"/><div sID="gen2468" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1460"/> Saguwā' anambung si Da'ud. “Tuwan,” yukna, “aku maka saga matto'a-danakanku sampay na saga ka'mbo'anku itu a'a areyo' du ko' ma bangsa Isra'il. Angkan mbal aku patut amikit ni sultan.”

verses.name: I Samuel 18:19
verses.text: Malaingkan, ta'abut pa'in waktu bay panugun pamakawin si Merab ma si Da'ud, pinakawin na iya ma l'lla saddī ya pinagōnan si Adare'el, a'a min Mehola.  <div eID="gen2468" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1461"/><div sID="gen2469" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1461"/> Na, si Mikal, ya anak si Sa'ul budjang kasiyalihan, bilahi sidda ma si Da'ud. Jari pagta'u si Sa'ul ma pasalan itu-i kasulutan iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:21
verses.text: Yukna ma deyom atayna, gom pamah'ndaku si Mikal ma si Da'ud supaya iya takatina amono' bo' pinapatay e' saga bangsa Pilistin. Angkan binalikan e' si Sa'ul bay llingna ma si Da'ud, yukna, “Makajari na ka tahinang ayuwanku.”  <div eID="gen2469" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1462"/><div sID="gen2470" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1462"/> Manjari magpanoho'an si Sa'ul ma saga tendogna sinō' magbissala maka si Da'ud ma halam aniya' makata'u. Sinō' sigām amissalahan iya buwattitu, “Kasulutan sultan ma ka'a, maka kinalasahan ka e' kamemon saga tendogna, angkan ahāp lagi' bang ngā'nu na h'nda anakna he'.”  <div eID="gen2470" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1463"/><div sID="gen2471" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1463"/> Jari buwattē' pamissala saga tendog inān ma si Da'ud, sagō' anambung iya, yukna, “Angay, taluhay-luhaybi bahā' tahinang dakayu' ayuwan sultan? Aku itu a'a miskin maka ngga'i ka babantugun.”  <div eID="gen2471" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1464"/><div sID="gen2472" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1464"/> Makata'u pa'in si Sa'ul pasal bay kabtangan si Da'ud he',

verses.name: I Samuel 18:25
verses.text: yuk panambungna, “Haka'inbi si Da'ud buwattitu, ‘Halam aniya' saddī ungsud niamu' min ka'a e' sultan, luwal dahatus kuwit bay pangislaman min bangsa Pilistin. Minnē' makabalos in sultan ma saga bantana.’ ” Sagō' ya to'ongan mohot si Sa'ul in si Da'ud tapapatay e' bangsa Pilistin.  <div eID="gen2472" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1465"/><div sID="gen2473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1465"/> Pagkale si Da'ud ma pamissala saga tendog inān, sulut na iya tahinang ayuwan sultan Sa'ul. Angkan minsan halam lagi' ta'abut waktu bay panugun,

verses.name: I Samuel 18:27
verses.text: parugpak si Da'ud maka saga sundaluna ni bangsa Pilistin, ati tapatay e' sigām saga duwa hatus puhu'. Pagubus, binowa e' si Da'ud duwa hatus kuwit bay pangislaman min saga Pilistin e'. Ni'nde'an e'na ni si Sa'ul supaya iya makajari na ayuwan sultan. Pagka buwattē', bay pamakawin e' si Sa'ul anakna si Mikal ma si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2473" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1466"/><div sID="gen2474" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1466"/> Tasayu pa'in e' si Sa'ul in si Da'ud tinabang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka kinalasahan e' anakna si Mikal,

verses.name: I Samuel 18:29
verses.text: gom pa'in magduruhun tāwna. Jari binantahan si Da'ud e' si Sa'ul sat'ggolna allum.  <div eID="gen2474" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1467"/><div sID="gen2475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1467"/> Na, masi na pa'in saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin amowa magbono' maka bangsa Isra'il buwat asal daran nihinang e' sigām. Jari kahaba' sigām parugpak ni saga Pilistin, aheya da'ugan si Da'ud min kasehe'an saga nakura' sundalu si Sa'ul. Minnē' landu' abantug ōn si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2475" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.18"/> <div eID="gen2457" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1468"/><div sID="gen2476" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasulay si Sa'ul Amono' si Da'ud</title> <div sID="gen2477" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1468"/> Na, magsuli-suli si Sa'ul ma anakna si Jonatan maka saga tendogna pangandolan pasal si Da'ud subay pinapatay. Sagō' alasa to'ongan si Jonatan ma si Da'ud,

verses.name: I Samuel 19:2
verses.text: angkan iya binanda'an e'na. Yuk si Jonatan, “Angamohot mma'ku si Sa'ul amapatay ka'a, angkan ka subay pahalli' salung subu. Amiha ka lugal patapukannu. Ebot-ebot, da'a ka magluwas-luwas.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:3
verses.text: Pagsalung, magbeya' aku maka mma'ku ni huma ya patapukannu. Bissalahanku iya ma pasalannu, jari haka'anta pa'in ka bang ai ya kaluwasanna.”  <div eID="gen2477" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1469"/><div sID="gen2478" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1469"/> Sakali pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, binissalahan si Sa'ul e' si Jonatan pasalan kahāp si Da'ud. Yukna, “Mma', da'a inayun si Da'ud sabab halam iya bay angala'at ka'a. Bang pina'amu, in kamemon bay tahinangna aheya sidda katabanganna ma ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:5
verses.text: Bay paglilla'na kallumna waktu kapamono'na si Golayat ati aheya da'ugan bay pamuwan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma kitam bangsa Isra'il. Kasaksi'annu itu kamemon maka kinōgan ka isab. Na, angay la'atnu a'a halam dusahan buwat si Da'ud angkan iya subay papataynu?”  <div eID="gen2478" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1470"/><div sID="gen2479" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1470"/> Tabowa si Sa'ul ma pamissala si Jonatan inān angkan iya ah'lling, yukna, “Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe ya kakkal salama-lama, in si Da'ud mbal na pinapatay.”

verses.name: I Samuel 19:7
verses.text: Sakali pinalinganan si Da'ud e' si Jonatan bo' pangahakana kamemon bay kapagbissalahanna maka mma'na. Manjari binowa si Da'ud ni si Sa'ul, ati maghinang iya ma deyo'an sultan buwat bay ka'ina tagna'.  <div eID="gen2479" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1471"/><div sID="gen2480" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1471"/> Malaingkan paniya' na isab bono' aheya, jari pehē' si Da'ud angandugpak ni bangsa Pilistin. Apaslod sidda pangandugpakna angkan maglahian sadja saga sundalu Pilistin.  <div eID="gen2480" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1472"/><div sID="gen2481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1472"/> Sagō' aniya' na saitan bay min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pasōd ni si Sa'ul hinabuna aningkō' ma deyom luma'na maka he'na ang'ntanan budjakna. Sakali itu, hinabu si Da'ud magbiyula,

verses.name: I Samuel 19:10
verses.text: binudjak iya magtūy e' si Sa'ul. Daipara makatangkis si Da'ud, bo' budjak inān tumaluwa' sadja ni dinding. Jari ma sangom du inān, alahi si Da'ud minna'an.  <div eID="gen2481" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1473"/><div sID="gen2482" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1473"/> Sakali, magpanoho'an si Sa'ul ma saga tendogna sinō' anganjagahan luma' si Da'ud, ati sinō' iya pinapatay pagsubu. Daipara binanda'an si Da'ud e' h'ndana si Mikal, yukna, “Tuwanku, bang ka mbal alahi sangom itu, tantu ka binono' salung.”

verses.name: I Samuel 19:12
verses.text: Angkan pinaluwas si Da'ud e' si Mikal labay min tandawan bo' iya magtūy alahi.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:13
verses.text: Manjari aniya' ta'u-ta'u bay ningā' e' si Mikal. Pinabahak e'na ma kantil bo' yampa minantahan e'na, maka pinat'nna'an bū kambing isab ma kōkna.  <div eID="gen2482" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1474"/><div sID="gen2483" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1474"/> Pagt'kka pina'an saga tendog si Sa'ul bahasa anaggaw si Da'ud, ah'lling si Mikal ni sigām in si Da'ud ina'an asaki.  <div eID="gen2483" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:15
