verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1475"/><div sID="gen2484" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1475"/> Kahaka'an pa'in si Sa'ul, magtūy iya magpanoho'an ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Pabalik kam pehē' bo' bowahunbi pi'itu si Da'ud beya' maka pabahakanna. Aku magbaran ya amapatay iya.”

verses.name: I Samuel 19:16
verses.text: Anā, pagsōd pa'in saga sosoho'an inān ni deyom bilik, luwal ta'u-ta'u ya ta'nda' sigām pat'nna' ma pabahakan e', maka bū kambing ma kōkna.  <div eID="gen2484" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1476"/><div sID="gen2485" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1476"/> Pinah'llingan si Mikal e' si Sa'ul, yukna, “Angay aku akkalannu? Angay dūlannu bantaku alahi?” <div eID="gen2485" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2486" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Mikal ni mma'na, “Ya llingna ma aku, in aku papatayna kono' bang iya mbal tugutanku alahi.”  <div eID="gen2486" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2476" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1477"/><div sID="gen2487" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinabangan si Da'ud e' si Samwel</title> <div sID="gen2488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1477"/> Manjari makalahi pa'in si Da'ud, pehē' iya ni Rama bo' angahaka'an si Samwel pasal kamemon bay kahinangan si Sa'ul ma iya. Pagka buwattē' pa'in, magbeya' sigā karuwangan ni lūngan Nayot bo' mahē' pat'nna'.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:19
verses.text: Kahaka'an pa'in si Sa'ul in si Da'ud kono' wa'i ma Nayot, ma kauman Rama,

verses.name: I Samuel 19:20
verses.text: magtūy iya anoho' saga tendogna pehē' anaggaw iya. Saguwā' pagt'kka saga tendog itu, ta'nda' e' sigām dakayu' tumpukan nabi amaluwas bissala mbal tahati, maka ina'an isab si Samwel pagmakōkan sigām. Jari pahōp Rū Tuhan ma saga tendog inān, maka ya du sigām tabowa amaluwas bissala ya mbal tahati.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:21
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in si Sa'ul pasal itu-i, aniya' tendogna saddī bay soho'na pehē'. Ya du sigām tabowa amaluwas bissala buwattē'. Jari aniya' gi' tendog kasehe' pinapehē' e' si Sa'ul, kamint'lluna na, ati ya du sigām isab amaluwas bissala mbal tahati.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:22
verses.text: Katapusanna, magbaran si Sa'ul pehē' ni Rama bo' ni k'ppong aheya ya ma lahat Seku. Maina'an pa'in, atilaw iya, yukna, “Maingga bahā' si Samwel maka si Da'ud?” <div eID="gen2488" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2489" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung saga a'a bay panilawan, “Tuwan sultan, wa'i sigā ma Rama, ma lūngan Nayot.”  <div eID="gen2489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1478"/><div sID="gen2490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1478"/> Sakali, palanjal si Sa'ul ni Nayot, sagō' ya du iya kahōpan e' Rū Tuhan ati aniya' bissala mbal tahati pinaluwas e'na sampay tat'kkana lūngan Nayot e'.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:24
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, nihurusan e' si Sa'ul pan'mmekna maka ya du iya tabowa magbissala kaligawan ma matahan si Samwel. Jari pabahak iya maka panantangna animpus dang'llaw dambahangi. Ya itu sababan angkan pinagsambatan e' a'a, “Nabi bahā' sampay si Sa'ul?”  <div eID="gen2490" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.19"/> <div eID="gen2487" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1479"/><div sID="gen2491" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud maka si Jonatan</title> <div sID="gen2492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1479"/> Manjari, alahi na isab si Da'ud min lūngan Nayot ya ma Rama inān tudju ni si Jonatan. Ya panilawna ma si Jonatan e', “Ai kasā'an bay tahinangku? Ai dusaku ma mma'nu angkan iya angamohot amapatay aku?”  <div eID="gen2492" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1480"/><div sID="gen2493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1480"/> Yuk sambung si Jonatan. “Oy, s'lle' bale puhu'nu! Mbal ko' ka'a ilu pinapatay e' si mma'! Ai-ai kahinanganna aheya-ariki', subay pangaru e'na dahū ni aku.” Yuk lagi' si Jonatan, “Angay angkan limbunganna min aku niyatna amapatay ka'a? Suli-suli sadja ko' ilu, da'a beya'-beya'un.”  <div eID="gen2493" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1481"/><div sID="gen2494" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1481"/> Sagō' anapa si Da'ud bo' anambung, yukna, “Kinata'uwan e' mma'nu in aku makasulut pangatayannu angkan pangannalna in ka'a subay mbal pinata'u sabab ya aniya' magkarukka'an lagi' ka.” Anubahat lagi' si Da'ud, yukna, “Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe ya Tuhan kakkal salama-lama, maka ma ōnnu isab, in aku itu marai' na pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen2494" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1482"/><div sID="gen2495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1482"/> Na, ah'lling si Jonatan, yukna, “Haka'in aku bang ai kabaya'annu. Tantu hinangku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2495" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1483"/><div sID="gen2496" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1483"/> Ya panambung si Da'ud, “Salung,” yukna, “Paghinang Bulan Baha'u, maka subay aku pajamu ma sultan. Sagō' dūlin lagi' aku patapuk ma kahuma'an deya sampay ni kasangoman ma llaw sumuddai.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:6
verses.text: Bang saupama tasayuna in aku alikut, ah'lling ka ni iya, yuknu, ‘Bay ama'id si Da'ud min aku bo' pasa'ut amole' ni Betlehem, ya lahatna luggiya'. Subay tasabuna hinang Pagtaubat sigām maglaulahasiya'.’ ”

verses.name: I Samuel 20:7
verses.text: Amissala lagi' si Da'ud, yukna, “Bang hal angaho' mma'nu, hatina asalamat aku. Sagō' bang iya angastol, tantu aniya' niyatna angala'at aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:8
verses.text: Aniya' isab panganjunjungku ni ka'a, tuwan. Atanu asal aku, jari hinangin aku kahāpan ma sabab paljanji'an ya bay pagsapahanta ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Bang b'nnal aniya' kasā'an bay tahinangku, na, ka'a na ya magbaran amapatay aku! Da'a sadja aku tukbalun ni mma'nu.”  <div eID="gen2496" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1484"/><div sID="gen2497" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1484"/> Ya sambung si Jonatan ma si Da'ud, “Oy! Da'a ka magpikil buwattilu,” yukna. “Bang hati tasayuku b'nnal-b'nnal aniya' niyat mma'ku angamula ka'a, pata'uta ka magtūy.”  <div eID="gen2497" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1485"/><div sID="gen2498" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1485"/> Atilaw si Da'ud, yukna, “Bang saupama akasla panambung mma'nu ma ka'a, sai amata'u aku?”  <div eID="gen2498" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1486"/><div sID="gen2499" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1486"/> Anambung si Jonatan yukna, “Sūng kita kaleya.” Jari pehē' na sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:12
verses.text: Ma huma pa'in, yuk si Jonatan ma si Da'ud, “Saksi'ta si Yawe ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il, salung atawa sumuddai ma sali' waktu buwattitu du, bowaku magbissala si mma'. Bang hati ahāp pamikilna ma pasalannu, pabeya'anta pa'in ka lapal.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:13
verses.text: Saguwā' bang iya magmohot angala'at ka'a, bang pa'in aku pinagmulka'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang ka mbal magtūy pata'uku bo' supaya ka makalahi. Mura-murahan bang pa'in ka ginapi' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> buwat bay panganggapi'na ma mma'ku.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:14
verses.text: Malaingkan pangamu'ku isab ma ka'a bang pa'in aku pa'nda'annu kahāpan sat'ggolku allum, buwat kahāpan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Maka bang aku saupama amatay,

verses.name: I Samuel 20:15
verses.text: da'a b'kkatun kahāpannu ma saga panubu'ku, minsan aligis e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> kamemon palbantahannu min babaw dunya itu.”  <div eID="gen2499" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1487"/><div sID="gen2500" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1487"/> Sakali aniya' lagi' paljanji'an si Jonatan ma si Da'ud maka panubu'na, yukna, “Bang pa'in tinungbasan e' Tuhan saga palbantahan si Da'ud.”

verses.name: I Samuel 20:17
verses.text: Kinalasahan si Da'ud e' si Jonatan buwat e'na alasahan baranna, angkan soho'na si Da'ud amatuman janji'na, ma sabab lasana isab ma si Jonatan.  <div eID="gen2500" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1488"/><div sID="gen2501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1488"/> Pagubus, ah'lling si Jonatan ma si Da'ud, yukna, “Salung na in Paghinang Bulan Baha'u, angkan tantu ko' ka'a ilu piniha he' si mma' pagka halam a'a ma tingkō'annu.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:19
verses.text: Na, ma sumuddai he', saga abay kohap, pehē' ka ni lugal ya bay patapukannu waktu panagna' paniya' palkala' itu. Angagad ka mahē' ma tambak batu ya niōnan Esel,

verses.name: I Samuel 20:20
verses.text: ati amana' aku mint'llu ni kīd batu patapukannu he', buwat hantang to'ongan aniya' pana'ku.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:21
verses.text: Soho'ku dakayu' onde' l'lla angā' pana' he'. Jari bang yukku ma iya, ‘Ina'an saga pana' ma atag batu tampal pi'itu, bowahun pi'itu,’ makajari ka paluwas. Sapahanta ka ma kallum <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, halam aniya' la'at tum'kka ni ka'a. Asalamat ka.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:22
verses.text: Sagō' bang yukku ni onde' ya soho'ku inān, ‘Wa'i ma katāhan saga pana',’ hatina subay ka pasa'ut alahi sabab ya na kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:23
verses.text: Maka pasal bay paljanji'anta inān, entomun pahāp, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya saksi'ta sampay salama-lama.”  <div eID="gen2501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1489"/><div sID="gen2502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1489"/> Buwattē' pa'in, patapuk na si Da'ud ma lugal bay kapagisunanna maka si Jonatan. Ta'abut pa'in Paghinang Bulan Baha'u, ina'an na sultan Sa'ul aningkō' ma pagjamuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:25
verses.text: Maina'an iya aningkō' ma bihing dinding, buwat kabiyaksahanna. Magalop iya maka si Jonatan, maka ina'an isab si Abner ma bihingna. Sagō' in paningkō'an si Da'ud halam maga'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:26
verses.text: Halam ah'lling-h'lling si Sa'ul itu, sabab ma pikilanna, kalu aniya' bay tahinang e' si Da'ud ya makabatal iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:27
verses.text: Sagō' pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, llaw karuwana ma bulan inān, halam na isab maga'a paningkō'an si Da'ud. Angkan atilaw si Sa'ul ma anakna si Jonatan, yukna, “Angay sangay di'ilaw, halam pajamu pi'itu anak si Jesse ilu?”  <div eID="gen2502" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1490"/><div sID="gen2503" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1490"/> Anambung si Jonatan, yukna, “Bay iya ama'id min aku, mma', amole' kono' iya ni Betlehem.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:29
verses.text: Yukna ma aku, ‘Dūlin lagi' aku amole' sabab in kami magkaukampung maghinang pagkulban ma kauman kami. Bay aku niamay-amayan e' danakanku,’ yukna, ‘sinō' pahadil.’ Bang kono' makajari ma aku,” yuk si Jonatan, “tinugutan iya amole' bo' mag'nda' maka dauranakanna. Na, ya ilu sababan angkan halam makapi'itu si Da'ud ni pagjamuhan.”  <div eID="gen2503" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1491"/><div sID="gen2504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1491"/> Angastol to'ongan si Sa'ul pagkalena ma bissala si Jonatan itu, angkan yukna, “Ē! Halambiyara' itu, mamarahi tuwas kōknu. Aheya to'ongan dapitnu ma si Da'ud. Kaiya'an aheya ko' ilu ma ka'a sampay ma ina'nu!

verses.name: I Samuel 20:31
verses.text: Halam tasayunu sat'ggol masi allum anak si Jesse ilu ma babaw dunya itu, mbal ka makapagsultanan paglahat itu. Na, soho'un iya binowa pi'itu sabab patut iya subay pinapatay!”  <div eID="gen2504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1492"/><div sID="gen2505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1492"/> Anambung si Jonatan yukna, “Angay angkan subay pinapatay si Da'ud? Ai dusana?”

verses.name: I Samuel 20:33
verses.text: Pagka buwattē' panambung si Jonatan, magtūy iya nihiyak e' si Sa'ul maka budjak. Minnē' kinata'uwan e' si Jonatan in mma'na magmohot to'ongan amapatay si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2505" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1493"/><div sID="gen2506" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1493"/> Sakali akagit to'ongan atay si Jonatan ati an'ngge iya magtūy min pagkakanan. Manjari ma llaw pagjamu karuwana, halam iya amangan sabab ap'ddi' landu' atayna pasalan pangahina' mma'na ma si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2506" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1494"/><div sID="gen2507" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1494"/> Na, pag'llaw dakayu', pehē' na si Jonatan ni huma bay kapagisunanna pagbākanna maka si Da'ud. Aniya' isab onde' l'lla ameya' ma si Jonatan,

verses.name: I Samuel 20:36
verses.text: manjari ah'lling iya ni onde' inān, yukna, “Paragan ka pehē' bo' piha'un saga pana' ya pamana'ku itu.” Sakali, hinabu paragan onde' itu, pinaleyang e' si Jonatan dakayu' pana' pinaliyu min iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:37
verses.text: Pagt'kka onde' ni lugal kahūgan pana' he', niolangan iya e' si Jonatan, yuk-i, “Ilu pana' ma dahuannu!

verses.name: I Samuel 20:38
verses.text: Na, pal'kkasun dagannu ilu! Da'a ka maghogga'-hogga'!” Pinuwa' na pana' inān he' onde' bo' ni'nde'an ni nakura'na si Jonatan.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:39
verses.text: Tu'ud halam panghati onde' inān ma saga palkala' he', luwal si Jonatan maka si Da'ud ya makata'u.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:40
verses.text: Pagubus itu, sinōngan e' si Jonatan pana'na ni onde' l'lla inān bo' soho'na amole'. “Pehē' na ka,” yukna, “bowahun saga pana' itu amole' ni kauman.”  <div eID="gen2507" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1495"/><div sID="gen2508" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1495"/> Makala'an pa'in onde' he', paluwa' na si Da'ud min liyu batu bay patapukanna bo' pasujud mint'llu ma dahuwan si Jonatan. Manjari, maggapus sigām karuwangan maka he' sigām magtangis. Saguwā' palabi heya tangis si Da'ud min si Jonatan.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:42
verses.text: Yuk si Jonatan ma iya, “Na, bagay, bang pa'in ka mura-murahan asalamat. Ma takdil kapagbagayta, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya saksi' ma saga paljanji'anta karuwangan sampay ma saga panubu'ta magsuring-magsaingsing.” Pagubus itu, ala'an na si Da'ud minnē', bo' si Jonatan pabalik na ni kauman.  <div eID="gen2508" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.20"/> <div eID="gen2491" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1496"/><div sID="gen2509" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud ma Kauman Nōb</title> <div sID="gen2510" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1496"/> Pabutas pa'in si Da'ud min si Jonatan, pehē' na iya ni kauman Nōb bo' tibawna imam Ahimelek. Pagbāk si Ahimelek itu ma si Da'ud, amidpid iya kabowa tāwna. Atilaw iya, yuk-i, “Angay ka karangan-danganan ilu? Angay halam sehe'nu?”  <div eID="gen2510" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1497"/><div sID="gen2511" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1497"/> Yuk sambung si Da'ud, “Aniya' bay panoho'an aku e' sultan. Bay aku binanda'an e'na sinō' mbal amata'u minsan ma sai pasalan l'ngngan itu. Ma takdil saga a'aku, bay na sigām haka'anku bang maingga pagsabuhan kami.”

verses.name: I Samuel 21:3
verses.text: Atilaw gi' si Da'ud, yukna, “Na, aniya' bahā' takakanta? Buwanin gi' aku limansolag tinapay, atawa ai-ai na aniya' mailu.”  <div eID="gen2511" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1498"/><div sID="gen2512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1498"/> Anambung si Ahimelek, yukna, “Halam aniya' tinapay maitu luwal ya tinapay bay pamasuku' Tuhan, sagō' wajib sadja itu kinakan e' saga a'abi bang sigām halam bay makapaghulid maka d'nda sōngbi pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen2512" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1499"/><div sID="gen2513" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1499"/> Ah'lling si Da'ud yukna, “Ma addat kami, pangalāngan asal maghulid maka d'nda bang song ni pagbono'an. Asussi saga a'aku sampay pamaranan sigām minsan ma l'ngngan m'ssa' bidda'. Ya lagi'na bang ni l'ngngan aheya buwat na itu-i!”

verses.name: I Samuel 21:6
verses.text: Sakali, pamuwan e' imam inān ma si Da'ud tinapay bay pamasuku' Tuhan, ya bay nila'anan min matahan Tuhan bo' ginanti'an magtūy maka tinapay baha'u. Halam aniya' takakan saddī tapamuwan e' imam liyu minnē'.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:7
verses.text: Na, aniya' dakayu' sosoho'an si Sa'ul bay pasabu maina'an pagka aniya' hinangna tudju ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ōnna si Do'eg bangsa Edom, ya aesog to'ongan ma saga magi'ipat bili-bili si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2513" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1500"/><div sID="gen2514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1500"/> Jari atilaw si Da'ud ma si Ahimelek, yukna, “Aniya' budjak atawa kalis maitu? Halam aku bay magbowa pakokos pagka asa'ut panoho'an sultan he'.”  <div eID="gen2514" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1501"/><div sID="gen2515" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1501"/> Yuk sambung imam, “Itiya' maitu kalis si Golayat a'a Pilistin ya bay tapataynu ma L'bbak Ela. Itiya' ma liyu epod, pinutus maka kakana'. Bang hati kabilahiannu, ngā'un na sabab halam aniya' saddī kalis minnilu.” <div eID="gen2515" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2516" type="paragraph"/> Jari ah'lling si Da'ud, “Na, ndiya ma aku sabab halam na aniya' pahāp minnilu.”  <div eID="gen2516" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2509" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1502"/><div sID="gen2517" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud ma Gāt</title> <div sID="gen2518" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1502"/> Jari itu palanjal na si Da'ud ma kalahina min si Sa'ul bo' pehē' ni si Akis, ya sultan ma da'ira Gāt.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:11
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in, ah'lling ni si Akis saga tendogna pangandolan, yuk-i, “Ya na ko' ilu si Da'ud ya sultan ma paglahat Isra'il. Iya na a'a pinagkalangan e' saga kar'ndahan hinabu sigām magpangigal, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen2519"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2520"/>‘Ibuhan tapatay e' sultan Sa'ul,<l eID="gen2520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2521"/>jari hatusan ibu ma si Da'ud’.”<l eID="gen2521" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2519"/>  <div eID="gen2518" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1503"/><div sID="gen2522" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1503"/> Tinali'-tali' pahāp e' si Da'ud pah'lling saga a'a itu, jari sinōd iya tāw landu' aheya ma sultan Akis.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:13
verses.text: Angkan iya magbelaw-belaw di-na sakahaba' aniya' a'a ang'nda' iya. Hinabuna binalutan e' sigām, magbau'-bau' iya kinangog. Maggudlis iya indalupaginis ma saga tambol lawang ya ma ād da'ira inān, maka pinatū' isab bohelona ni p'ngngotna.  <div eID="gen2522" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1504"/><div sID="gen2523" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1504"/> Sakali ah'lling sultan Akis ni saga tendogna, yukna, “ Nda'unbi ba a'a binelaw ilu! Angay iya bay bowabi pi'itu?

verses.name: I Samuel 21:15
verses.text: Akulang bahā' a'a dupang ma aku, angkan bowabi a'a itu bo' magbelaw-belaw ma kamaituhanku? Pala'anunbi iya minnitu!”  <div eID="gen2523" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.21"/> <div eID="gen2517" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1505"/><div sID="gen2524" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud ma Lahat Adullam maka Mispa</title> <div sID="gen2525" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1505"/> Manjari, ala'an si Da'ud min Gāt bo' alahi ni dakayu' songab batu ma lahat Adullam. Pagta'u pa'in itu e' saga matto'a-danakanna, pehē' sigām parakayu' ma iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:2
verses.text: Parakayu' isab ma si Da'ud kamemon saga a'a sasuku kasigpitan maka ma deyom utang atawa taga-koto'-koto' ma deyom atay, ati tahinang iya pagnakura'an sigām. Saga mpat hatus puhu' ya heka sigām.  <div eID="gen2525" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1506"/><div sID="gen2526" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1506"/> Palanjal si Da'ud minnē' ni da'ira Mispa ma lahat bangsa Mowab bo' ah'lling ni sultan sigām, yukna, “Tuwan, angamu' aku junjung bang pa'in parūlnu ina'-mma'ku pahanti' ma deyomannu sampay kata'uwanku bang ai ya kahandak Tuhan ma aku.”

verses.name: I Samuel 22:4
verses.text: Jari pang'bba e'na ina'-mma'na ma sultan Mowab he', ati mahē' sigām pahanti' sat'ggol si Da'ud pahanti' ma patapukan ahogot.  <div eID="gen2526" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1507"/><div sID="gen2527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1507"/> Sagō' binanda'an si Da'ud e' nabi Gād, yukna, “Da'a ka pat'ggol ma tapukan ilu. Pehē' ka ni jadjahan Yuda.” Angkan ala'an si Da'ud minnē' bo' pehē' ni katalunan ma Heret.  <div eID="gen2527" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2524" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1508"/><div sID="gen2528" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinapatay saga Imam ma Kauman Nōb</title> <div sID="gen2529" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1508"/> Mbal at'ggol, takale e' si Sa'ul pasal si Da'ud maka saga tendogna tabāk na. Pasalta', ina'an si Sa'ul ma Gibeya, aningkō' ma sindungan kayu tamaris<note>Kayu tamaris itu alabung dahunna maka ahāp pasindungan. ‘Tamarisk’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ya ma būd e'. Aniya' asal budjak ma tanganna. Ina'an isab saga a'a kawakilanna an'ngge ma katilibutna.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:7
verses.text: Jari ah'lling si Sa'ul ni sigām, yuk-i, “Akale kam pahāp, ka'am saga panubu' Benjamin! Ma pikilanbi bahā', kabuwanan kam kabbun anggul maka tana' paghuma'an e' anak si Jesse<note>Anak si Jesse, hatina si Da'ud.</note> inān? Tahinang bahā' kam e'na nakura' alanga ma saga ibuhan atawa hatusan sundaluna?

verses.name: I Samuel 22:8
verses.text: Ya bahā' ilu sababanna angkan kam magisunan aku? Angay halam aniya' minsan dangan min ka'am amata'uwan aku in anakku maka anak si Jesse<note>Anak si Jesse, hatina si Da'ud.</note> bay makapagjanji'? Halam aniya' pagka'inagonbi ma aku atawa minsan hal la'a angahaka'an aku in anakku bay amidjakan iya amapatay aku ma labayan. Ina'an na iya anipihan aku buwattina'an!”  <div eID="gen2529" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1509"/><div sID="gen2530" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1509"/> Na ina'an isab si Do'eg, a'a bangsa Edom, samat'ngge maka saga pagnakura'an tendog si Sa'ul. Ah'lling si Do'eg itu, yukna, “Bay ta'nda'ku anak si Jesse pehē' ni kauman Nōb bo' patibaw ni si Ahimelek anak si Ahitub.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:10
verses.text: Bay angaru si Ahimelek ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pasal si Da'ud bang ai subay hinangna, maka bay pamuwanna isab ma iya balanja' maka kalis ya bay pakokos si Golayat a'a Pilistin.”  <div eID="gen2530" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1510"/><div sID="gen2531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1510"/> Manjari, magpanoho'an si Sa'ul pina'ā' si Ahimelek sampay kamemon saga kampungna ya magimam ma Nōb. Jari pina'an na sigām ni sultan.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:12
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, ah'lling si Sa'ul, yukna, “Akale ka Ahimelek!” <div eID="gen2531" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2532" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', tuwan sultan,” yuk si Ahimelek.  <div eID="gen2532" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1511"/><div sID="gen2533" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1511"/> Atilaw si Sa'ul ma iya, yuk-i, “Angay ka bay magisun maka anak si Jesse inān bo' angatu ma aku? Bay iya buwanannu tinapay maka kalis, maka bay ka isab angaru ni Tuhan ma pasalanna, angkan iya anagga' pagsultanku maka angamohot amapatay aku ma labayan! Ina'an na iya anipihan aku buwattina'an!”  <div eID="gen2533" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1512"/><div sID="gen2534" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1512"/> Anambung si Ahimelek, yukna, “Tuwan, aniya' bahā' tendog kapangandolan labi min si Da'ud? Ayuwannu iya, maka pagnakura'an ma saga sundalu ya anganjagahan ka'a. Pinagaddatan isab iya e' a'a kamemon ma deyomannu.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:15
verses.text: In pasal pangaruku ni Tuhan ma pasalanna, tuwan, ya na tu'ud kabiyaksahanku. Arapun in pasal kapagisun angatu ma ka'a, ndū' tuwan, da'a aku tuna'un atawa minsan sai-na ma kami maglaulahasiya', sabab halam aniya' pana'uku ma pasal palkala' inān.”  <div eID="gen2534" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1513"/><div sID="gen2535" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1513"/> Jari yuk si Sa'ul, “Ahimelek, ka'a maka saga kakampungannu ilu subay pinapatay!”

verses.name: I Samuel 22:17
verses.text: Magtūy magpanoho'an sultan ma saga jaga ya ma bihingna, yuk-i, “Papatayun kamemon saga imam si Yawe itu sabab ya du sigām pagapi' na ma si Da'ud. Kinata'uwan e' sigām in iya alahi min aku sagō' halam bay anumbung ni aku.” Sagō' halam sai-na min saga jaga inān makatawakkal amapatay saga imam e' pagka imam si Yawe.  <div eID="gen2535" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1514"/><div sID="gen2536" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1514"/> Pagubus, si Do'eg ya sinoho' e' si Sa'ul. Yukna, “Na ka'a! Papatayun saga imam itu.” Jari pinapatay e' si Do'eg kamemon saga imam he'. Walumpū' maka lima ya heka sigām magpamakay epod.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:19
verses.text: Min panoho'an si Sa'ul isab, talaglag kamemon d'nda-l'lla, kamemon saga kaonde'-onde'an, sampay isab kamemon saga hayop ya bay ma kauman Nōb.  <div eID="gen2536" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1515"/><div sID="gen2537" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1515"/> Luwal si Abiyatar anak si Ahimelek, mpu si Ahitub, ya bay makaliyus bo' alahi pehē' ni si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:21
verses.text: Kahaka'an e'na si Da'ud in kamemon saga kaimaman si Yawe bay pinapatay e' si Sa'ul.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:22
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling si Da'ud ma si Abiyatar, yukna, “Llaw he', pagta'uku in si Do'eg bangsa Edom bay mahē' ma Nōb, makatantu aku in iya anumbung du ni si Sa'ul. Aku palsababan ya angkan amatay saga lahasiya'nu kamemon.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:23
verses.text: Na, maitu na ka ma aku sabab in a'a bilahi amapatay ka'a anganiyat isab amapatay aku. Da'a ka agawa sabab halam kamulahannu bang pa'in ka ma deyomanku.”  <div eID="gen2537" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.22"/> <div eID="gen2528" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1516"/><div sID="gen2538" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lappasan e' si Da'ud saga A'a Kela</title> <div sID="gen2539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1516"/> Na, aniya' lapal pinasampay ni si Da'ud, yuk-i, “Wa'i parugpak saga bangsa Pilistin ni kauman Kela maka pinagtangkaw na pa'in he' sigām saga pai baha'u bay niani, ya ina'an ma pagt'ppahan.”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:2
verses.text: Manjari angaru si Da'ud ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> yukna, “Ya Tuhan, parugpak bahā' aku ni saga Pilistin inān?” <div eID="gen2539" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2540" type="paragraph"/> Anambung Tuhan, “Aho'” yukna. “Dugpakun sigām bo' lappasun kauman Kela.”  <div eID="gen2540" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1517"/><div sID="gen2541" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1517"/> Saguwā' ah'lling ni si Da'ud saga a'ana, yuk-i, “Tuwan, minsan maitu kitam ma paglahat Yuda, landu' kitam tināw, ya lagi'na bang kitam pehē' ni Kela bahasa parugpak ni saga sundalu Pilistin.”  <div eID="gen2541" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1518"/><div sID="gen2542" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1518"/> Manjari angaru na isab pabalik si Da'ud ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, jari buwattitu ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya, yuk-i, “Palūd ka pehē' ni Kela sabab pamarūlku ma ka'a in da'ugan min saga bangsa Pilistin.”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:5
verses.text: Angkan palanjal na disi Da'ud maka saga a'ana ni Kela. Tarugpak e' sigām saga bangsa Pilistin maka ta'ā' e' sigām saga kahayopan sigām. Aheka bangsa Pilistin bay tapapatay e' sigām bo' arapun lappasan saga a'a ma Kela.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:6
verses.text: (Ma waktu bay kalahi si Abiyatar anak si Abimelek pina'an ni si Da'ud, bay asal bowana epod<note>Epod itu bay ginuna e' imam pang'nda'anna kahandak Tuhan.</note>.)  <div eID="gen2542" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2538" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1519"/><div sID="gen2543" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Niapas e' si Sa'ul si Da'ud</title> <div sID="gen2544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1519"/> Na, kahaka'an si Sa'ul pasal si Da'ud ina'an ma lahat Kela, angkan yukna, “Itiya' tinukbalan e' Tuhan si Da'ud ni komkomanku sabab wa'i iya bay angalikusan kauman kinuta', ya mbal agon kaluwasan.”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:8
verses.text: Sakali, pinalinganan e' si Sa'ul kamemon sundaluna sinō' magsakap amono' bo' palūd ni Kela angahapa'an si Da'ud maka saga a'ana bo' mbal makaluwas min kauman e'.  <div eID="gen2544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1520"/><div sID="gen2545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1520"/> Pagta'u pa'in si Da'ud ma kagara'an si Sa'ul itu, magpanoho'an iya ma imam Abiyatar, yukna, “Bowahun pi'itu epod ilu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:10
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, angamu'-ngamu' si Da'ud ni Tuhan. Yukna, “O Yawe, Tuhan bangsa Isra'il, takaleku in si Sa'ul maggara' angalubu kauman Kela ma sababku.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:11
verses.text: Tinukbalan bahā' aku e' saga a'a maitu-itu ni si Sa'ul? Pi'itu bahā' iya buwat bay pangalapal itu? Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> kami bangsa Isra'il, sambungin lagi' sosoho'annu itu.” <div eID="gen2545" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2546" type="paragraph"/> Sakali anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> yukna, “Aho', tantu pi'ilu si Sa'ul.”  <div eID="gen2546" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1521"/><div sID="gen2547" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1521"/> Manjari, angamu'-ngamu' pabalik si Da'ud yukna, “Tinukbalan bahā' aku maka saga a'aku ni si Sa'ul e' saga a'a Kela?” <div eID="gen2547" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2548" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, “Aho'.”  <div eID="gen2548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1522"/><div sID="gen2549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1522"/> Pagka buwattē', si Da'ud maka saga a'ana kulang-labi nnom hatus hekana magla'anan na min Kela bo' maglatun-latun ma kalahatan. Tata'u pa'in e' si Sa'ul in si Da'ud wa'i na makalahi min Kela he', halam na iya pehē'.  <div eID="gen2549" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2543" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1523"/><div sID="gen2550" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Patapuk si Da'ud ma Paslangan</title> <div sID="gen2551" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1523"/> Manjari itu, pahanti' na pa'in disi Da'ud ma saga patapukan ahogot ma paslangan Sīp maka ma kabūd-būran. Piniha iya e' si Sa'ul sakahaba' llaw, sagō' mbal iya tinugutan e' Tuhan ni komkoman si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2551" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1524"/><div sID="gen2552" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1524"/> Dakayu' llaw, ma Hores pa'in si Da'ud, ma paslangan Sīp, tata'una in si Sa'ul song pina'an amapatay iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:16
verses.text: Sakali pina'an si Jonatan ni si Da'ud hinabuna ma Hores, bo' pinahogot e'na iman si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:17
verses.text: Yuk si Jonatan ma si Da'ud, “Da'a ka tināw sabab tantu mbal ka tainay e' mma'ku si Sa'ul. Kata'uwanna asal in ka'a magsultan ma Isra'il maka aku itu ma deyo'annu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:18
verses.text: Jari magpaljanji'an sigā karuwangan ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Pagubus itu, amole' na pabalik si Jonatan, saguwā' magpa'bba si Da'ud ma Hores.  <div eID="gen2552" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1525"/><div sID="gen2553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1525"/> Manjari aniya' saga a'a min Sīp patukad ni si Sa'ul ma Gibeya bo' anumbungan iya pasal si Da'ud. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan sultan, wa'i si Da'ud patapuk ma lūngan kami ma Hores, maina'an ma būd Hakila tampal ni satan min lahat Jesemon.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:20
verses.text: Palūd pa'in ka sumiyan-sumiyan katanamannu sabab tantu kami ya atas-pikil anukbalan iya ni ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1526"/><div sID="gen2554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1526"/> Anambung si Sa'ul yukna, “Mura-murahan kam binarakatan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma sabab pagka'inagonbi ma aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:22
verses.text: Pehē' na kam bo' nda'unbi pahāp bang maingga si Da'ud maka bang sai ya bay maka'nda' iya. Kahaka'an aku in si Da'ud aillag makalandu'.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:23
verses.text: Ta'uhunbi kamemon patapukanna bo' kam pabalik pi'itu amissalahan aku bang maingga iya. Jari bang iya masi mahē', ameya' aku ma ka'am. Pihaku iya minsan alatag e'ku kamemon jadjahan ma sakalibut lahat Yuda.”  <div eID="gen2554" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1527"/><div sID="gen2555" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1527"/> Na, palanjal na saga a'a Sīp inān bo' parahū min si Sa'ul. Pasalta', ina'an si Da'ud maka saga a'ana ma paslangan Ma'on, ma jadjahan Araba tampal ni satan min Jesemon.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:25
verses.text: Si Sa'ul isab maka saga sundaluna anagna' na amiha si Da'ud. Jari tasumbung pa'in ni si Da'ud pasalan pagpiha inān, magtūy iya palanjal ni būd abatu ma paslangan Ma'on ati maina'an iya pahanti'. Pagta'u si Sa'ul isab ma pasalan itu-i, niurul e'na pehē' si Da'ud.  <div eID="gen2555" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1528"/><div sID="gen2556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1528"/> Sakali, ina'an disi Sa'ul ma dambila' būd, ati ina'an isab si Da'ud maka saga a'ana ma dambila' magdai'-dai' bo' alahi. Na, baya-baya asekot pa'in si Sa'ul maka saga sundaluna anaggaw si Da'ud,

verses.name: I Samuel 23:27
verses.text: aniya' at'kka pina'an ni si Sa'ul dakayu' sosoho'anna amowa habal, yuk-i, “Tuwan sultan, pakasay lagi' ka. Wa'i kalangpasan lahattam e' saga Pilistin!”

verses.name: I Samuel 23:28
verses.text: Magtūy pahali si Sa'ul min pangapasna ma si Da'ud bo' pehē' angatuhan saga Pilistin. Ya itu sababan angkan kaōnan lugal inān Sela Hammalekot.<note>Sela Hammalekot, hatina ‘Būd Pagokatan’.</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:29
verses.text: Sakali in si Da'ud bay patukad minnē' bo' pat'nna' ma saga patapukan ahogot ya ma kabūran En Gedi.  <div eID="gen2556" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.23"/> <div eID="gen2550" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1529"/><div sID="gen2557" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud Mbal Angamula si Sa'ul</title> <div sID="gen2558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1529"/> Na, makabalik pa'in si Sa'ul min kapanurulna ma saga Pilistin, kahaka'an iya in si Da'ud wa'i ma Paslangan En Gedi.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:2
verses.text: Angkan amowa si Sa'ul t'llungibu a'a Isra'il magbobono', a'a bay pene'na, bo' magsakap amiha si Da'ud maka saga a'ana pehē' ni atag Pampang Kambing-talun.  <div eID="gen2558" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1530"/><div sID="gen2559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1530"/> Sakali maka'abut disi Sa'ul ni pagkukuralan saga bili-bili ya ina'an ma bihing lān. Aniya' isab songab batu maina'an, ati pasōd si Sa'ul pehē' bo' ajamban. Ina'an asal si Da'ud maka saga a'ana ma deyomna to'ongan.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:4
verses.text: Yuk a'a inān ni si Da'ud, “Tuwan, ya na itu waktu bay pagkallam si Yawe, ya yuk-i, ‘Tukbalanku bantanu ni komkomannu bo' supaya tahinangnu bang ai ya kabilahiannu.’ ” Jari itu, kamaya'-maya' si Da'ud palele ma halam aniya' makasayuhan iya ati kin'ttob e'na tōng juba si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2559" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1531"/><div sID="gen2560" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1531"/> Tatali'-tali' pa'in e' si Da'ud kapang'ttobna itu, magsusun iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:6
verses.text: Yukna ni saga a'ana, “He! S'lle' bale puhu'! Bang pa'in aku sinagga' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bo' mbal makamula a'a bay pene'na nihinang sultan. Halam aniya' kapatutku angahinang kamulahan ma sultanku sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay amat'nna' iya.”

verses.name: I Samuel 24:7
verses.text: Minnē' pinabukagan e' si Da'ud saga a'ana maka sinō' sigām da'a angamula si Sa'ul. Jari ala'an na si Sa'ul min songab batu he'.  <div eID="gen2560" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1532"/><div sID="gen2561" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1532"/> Pagubus, paluwas si Da'ud bo' angalingan ni si Sa'ul, yukna, “Owa', tuwan Sultan!” Paglingi' si Sa'ul, magtūy pasujud si Da'ud tanda' sin pagaddatna ma iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:9
verses.text: Ah'lling si Da'ud yuk-i, “Angay ka akale ma pamitna saga a'a ya ah'lling in aku itu magniyat angamula ka'a?

verses.name: I Samuel 24:10
verses.text: Kasaksi'annu na in ka'a bay pamarūl ma aku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> hinabunu lagi' bay ma deyom songab batu. Aniya' sehe'ku bay anoho' aku amapatay ka'a, sagō' halam ka bay inayku. Ya yukku ma sigām, ‘Mbal aku anawakkal angamula nakura'ku sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay amene' iya.’

verses.name: I Samuel 24:11
verses.text: Nda'un ba, bapa', itiya' ma tanganku ya pīs-pīs kakana' bay min jubanu! Bay k'ttobku sagō' halam ka bay papatayku. Na, dongdongin pahāp, in aku itu alipuwas na min dusa niyat amantahan ka'a. Halam aku bay angala'at ka'a sagō' ka'a na pa'in ya angapas aku supaya aku papataynu.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:12
verses.text: Na baya'-baya' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> na angahukum kita karuwangan. <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> na isab anungbasan saga kala'atan bay tahinangnu ma aku sagō' in aku baranku mbal anawakkal angamula ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:13
verses.text: Buwat na yuk papata, ‘Min a'a ala'at paluwas kala'atan,’ angkan mbal ka inayku.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:14
verses.text: In ka'a sultan bangsa Isra'il, ati turulnu a'a halam aniya' pūsna? Aku itu hal sadja ko' kahantang patay ero' atawa kammut.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:15
verses.text: Na baya'-baya' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angahukum bang sai ma kita taga-kasā'an. Bang pa'in aku binogbogan e'na maka pinuwasan min komkomannu.”  <div eID="gen2561" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1533"/><div sID="gen2562" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1533"/> Pagubus si Da'ud ah'lling itu, atilaw si Sa'ul. Yukna, “Oto'? Da'ud? Ka'a ka amissala ilu?” Jari anangis to'ongan si Sa'ul.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:17
verses.text: “Abontol lagi' ka min aku,” yukna. “Ahāp ka ma aku saguwā' aku ya bay angala'at ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:18
verses.text: Na, aheya landu' kahāpan ya tahinangnu ma aku sabab minsan aku bay tinukbalan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni komkomannu, halam ka anawakkal angamula aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:19
verses.text: Aniya' bahā' amasagad bantana alahi ma halam bay minula e'na dahū? Tantu halam. Na, mura-murahan bang pa'in ka tinungbasan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni kahāpan ma sabab kapangahāpnu aku ma llaw itu.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:20
verses.text: Manantuhi aku in ka'a ilu magsultan maka ahogot in kapagsultannu ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:21
verses.text: Buwattina'an, sapahin aku ma matahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> in aku sampay saga panubu'ku mbal papataynu. Mbal isab lungaynu ōnku min salsila kapanubu'an kami.”  <div eID="gen2562" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1534"/><div sID="gen2563" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1534"/> Sakali anapa si Da'ud ma si Sa'ul buwat bay amu'na. Pagubus, amole' na si Sa'ul ni luma'na. Malaingkan si Da'ud maka saga a'ana bay patukad pabalik ni bay patapukan sigām e'.  <div eID="gen2563" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.24"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:1
verses.text: Manjari amatay na si Samwel ati magtipun kamemon saga a'a Isra'il magdukkahan iya bo' yampa iya kinubul ma atag luma'na ma Rama. Pagubus, in si Da'ud bay palūd ni paslangan Ma'on.  <div eID="gen2564" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2557" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1535"/><div sID="gen2565" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud, si Nabal maka si Abigail</title> <div sID="gen2566" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1535"/> Na, aniya' a'a Ma'on landu' dayahan, taga-tana' isab ma kauman Karmel. Aniya' kambingna dangibu hekana maka t'llungibu bili-bilina, jari ina'an iya ma Karmel sabab waktu na panganggunting bulbul saga hayop.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:3
verses.text: Si Nabal ōn a'a itu, maka si Abigail ya ōn h'ndana. Ahāp d'nda si Abigail itu maka ataha' akkalna, saguwā' ab'ngngis sidda h'llana maka ala'at kaul-pi'ilna. Ya si Nabal itu dakayu' panubu' si Kaleb.  <div eID="gen2566" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1536"/><div sID="gen2567" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1536"/> Hinabu lagi' si Da'ud bay ma paslangan, aniya' makahaka'an iya in si Nabal kono' wa'i magguntingan bulbul saga bili-bilina.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:5
verses.text: Sakali magpanoho'an si Da'ud ma saga onde' baha'u sangpū' hekana. Yukna ma sigām, “Pehē' kam ni si Nabal wa'i ma Karmel bo' iya saginahunbi ma ōnku.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:6
verses.text: Buwattitu pamissalahunbi ma iya, ‘Tuwan, mura-murahan bang pa'in ataha' umulnu. Bang pa'in isab ahāp kuwat-anggawta'nu lapay sampay anak-h'ndanu maka kamemon sasuku ma okomannu.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:7
verses.text: Kahaka'an nakura' kami si Da'ud waktu na kono' pagpagunting saga bili-bili. Ya pamissalana ma ka'a, tuwan, sat'ggol bay kamahē' saga magi'ipat bili-bilinu ma atag pahanti'an kami, halam sigām bay la'at kami. Maka ma waktu kamahē' sigām ma Karmel, halam sigām kalungayan minsan ai na.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:8
verses.text: Tilawun pa'in saga tendognu ilu, tantu du ka nihaka'an e' sigām. Angkan amu'ku ma ka'a, tuwan, pa'nda'in kahāpan saga sosoho'anku itu, pagka kami pasabu ma waktu pagjamu itu. Ndū' tuwan, buwanin lagi' saga sosoho'annu itu maka lahasiya'nu si Da'ud ai-ai na tapamuwannu.’ ”  <div eID="gen2567" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1537"/><div sID="gen2568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1537"/> Pagt'kka saga sosoho'an itu ni si Nabal, magtūy iya pinasampayan lapal bay min si Da'ud. Pagubus, angagad sadja sigām bang ai panambung.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:10
verses.text: Jari anambung si Nabal buwattitu yukna, “Sai sa si Da'ud itu? Sai sa anak si Jesse itu? Ma waktu itu-i aheka na landu' saga banyaga' alahi min pagnakura'an sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:11
verses.text: Angay subay pamuwanku tinapayku maka bohe'ku ni saga a'a mbal minsan takilāku bang minningga? Maka isi susumbali'an bay tagamahanku saga a'a magguguntingan bulbul bili-biliku, pamuwanku bahā' ma daka sai?”  <div eID="gen2568" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1538"/><div sID="gen2569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1538"/> Pagka buwattē' panambung si Nabal, amole' ni si Da'ud saga a'ana inān bo' angahaka'an iya kamemon ya bay binissala he' si Nabal.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:13
verses.text: Pagkale si Da'ud magtūy iya magpanoho'an ma saga tendogna, “Takosunbi kalisbi!” Magtūy isab sigām magtinakos. Magtakos kalis isab si Da'ud bo' patukad minnē' maka saga magbobono' mpat hatus hekana. Malaingkan aniya' duwa hatus bay magpa'bba anganjagahan saga balanja' maka kapanyapan sigām.  <div eID="gen2569" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1539"/><div sID="gen2570" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1539"/> Na, aniya' sosoho'an disi Nabal bay amowa lapal ma si Abigail ya h'ndana, yuk-i, “Babu', si Da'ud bay magpanoho'an ma saga tendogna min paslangan deya lagi'. Sinō' sigām pehē' ni nakura' kami amowa pagaddat si Da'ud ma iya, sagō' bay tumpalakna si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:15
verses.text: Parahāl ahāp sidda addat saga a'a inān ma kami. Halam sigām bay anganjahulaka' kami, maka t'ggol kami ma atag sigām, halam kalungayan minsan dansolag ai-ai kami.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:16
verses.text: Sat'ggol kami magipat saga kahayopan kami ma atag sigām, sigām ya jaga kami llaw-sangom, kahantang ād apagon angalikusan kami.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:17
verses.text: Angkan na, babu', subay ka amikil pahāp bang ai ya tahinangnu ma pasalan palkala' itu, sabab tantu aniya' bala' tum'kka ni nakura' kami sampay ni anak-kampungna. Abigsi' landu' iya angkan halam sai-na makabissalahan iya.”  <div eID="gen2570" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1540"/><div sID="gen2571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1540"/> Pagkale si Abigail ma lapal itu, magtūy iya magdai'-dai' magsakap. Angā' iya duwa hatus solag tinapay, duwa kuwit kambing pangisihan binu-anggul, lima bili-bili bay niadjal, lima karut pai-tirigu bay sinanglag, dahatus tundun anggul bay pina'llawan, maka duwa hatus kompolan buwa' pigi, ati pinaruwa' kamemon ni saga kura'.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:19
verses.text: Pagubus, ah'lling iya ni saga sosoho'anna, yukna, “Parahū na kam min aku ati paturul pa'in aku.” Saguwā' halam pinata'u e'na h'llana.  <div eID="gen2571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1541"/><div sID="gen2572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1541"/> Hinabu si Abigail pakura' labay min t'ngnga' kapampangan, ina'an isab si Da'ud maka saga a'ana tudju ni iya. Jari bināk sigām he'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:21
verses.text: Baha'u du bay makapah'lling si Da'ud, yuk-i, “Kaliman hulas-sangsā'ku anganjagahan palsuku'an a'a inān mahē' ma paslangan. Halam aniya' bay alungay ma saga ai-aina, sagō' kala'atan ya panungbasna ma kahāpan bay tahinangku.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:22
verses.text: Bang pa'in aku pinagmulka'an e' Tuhan bang aniya' dakayu' l'lla min okoman si Nabal kakapinanku allum pagabut subu!”  <div eID="gen2572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1542"/><div sID="gen2573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1542"/> Pag'nda' si Abigail ma si Da'ud, magtūy iya paruwa'i min kura'na bo' pasujud ma dahuwan si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:24
verses.text: Pasekot-sekot gi' iya bo' magmalulus ma atag tape'na. Yukna ma si Da'ud, “Tuwan, amu'ku ma ka'a, aku ya bīngin. Parūlun lagi' sosoho'annu itu amissala ni ka'a. Kalehun bissalaku itu, tuwan.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:25
verses.text: Ya pangamu'ku ma ka'a, da'a asipun a'a patila'atun inān, ya si Nabal. Magtaluwa' iya maka ōnna, hatina Dupang, pagka karupangan sadja ya kaluwasan saga hinangna. Bo' arapun, ma tongod sin sosoho'annu itu, tuwan, tu'ud halam ta'nda'ku saga a'a ya bay papehē'nu ni h'llaku.  <div eID="gen2573" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1543"/><div sID="gen2574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1543"/> “Na, tuwanku, kahandak <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> asal angkan halam kalanjalannu amalos magbaran maka amapatay. Angkan sapahanku min ōn si Yawe ya kakkal salama-lama, maka min ōnnu, bang pa'in pasali' ni si Nabal saga palbantahannu maka sasuku anganiyat angamula ka'a.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:27
verses.text: Taima'un isab, tuwan, saga huhulmatan bay bowaku itu bo' pamuwanun ma saga bebeya'annu ilu.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:28
verses.text: Amu'ku junjung isab ni ka'a bang pa'in ampunnu kasā'an ummatnu itu. Tantu pinatatas e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> in kapagsultannu sampay ni saga panubu'nu magsuring-magsaingsing, sabab palbantahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> asal saga a'a ya bowanu magbono'. Mura-murahan, tuwan, bang pa'in ka mbal makahinang dusa sat'ggolnu allum.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:29
verses.text: Malaingkan minsan ka pinagturul bo' pinapatay, mbal ka magmula sabab asalamat nyawanu, tinau' pahogot e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma deyom tatau'anna. Sagō' in kallum saga bantanu sapantun batu pinitikan, mbal na tapiha.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:30
verses.text: Bistahun, tuwan, bang ta'abut waktu kapanuman e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> kamemon saga kahāpan bay panganjanji'na ma ka'a, ati tahinang ka pagmakōkan ma bangsa Isra'il,

verses.name: I Samuel 25:31
verses.text: wajib subay halam aniya' dusanu pagsusunannu. Angkan subay mbal nilanjalan niyatnu amalos atawa amapatay a'a ma halam aniya' po'on-sababna tantu. Jari bang ka nianughala'an na e' Tuhan, ndū', da'a aku kalipatun.”  <div eID="gen2574" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1544"/><div sID="gen2575" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1544"/> Jari ah'lling si Da'ud ni si Abigail yukna, “Pudji ni si Yawe, ya pagtuhanan bangsa Isra'il, sabab in iya bay anoho' ka'a amāk aku.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:33
verses.text: Bang pa'in iya amuwanan ka'a kahāpan ma sabab kahāp akkalnu llaw itu. Ka'a ya sababan angkan halam kalanjalanku niyatku amapatay a'a llaw itu. Arak aku bay amalos magbaran.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:34
verses.text: Malaingkan, sapahanku min ōn si Yawe, ya Tuhan bangsa Isra'il, in iya bay anagga' aku angamula ka'a. Sabab, bang ka bay halam makasa'ut pi'itu, arak mbal kakapinan minsan dakayu' l'lla min panubu' si Nabal pagk'llat llaw.”  <div eID="gen2575" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1545"/><div sID="gen2576" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1545"/> Sakali tinaima' na e' si Da'ud saga bobowahan si Abigail maka e'na ah'lling, yuk-i, “Amole' na ka ma halam aniya' kahanggawannu. Beya'ku kamemon ya bay junjungnu ilu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen2576" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1546"/><div sID="gen2577" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1546"/> Manjari amole' na si Abigail. Magsalta', si Nabal bay amaniya' paglami-lami ma luma'na, buwat sapantun kahinangan pagjamu sultan. Nilango to'ongan si Nabal maka magkakoyagan, angkan halam iya binissalahan ai-ai e' si Abigail sampay ni kasubuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:37
verses.text: Pagsubu pa'in bo' palabay na lango si Nabal, binissalahan iya e' h'ndana pasal kamemon bay paniya' ma pagsampangna maka si Da'ud. Pagkale si Nabal, magtūy ap'ddi' kōk atayna ati anuwas baranna.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:38
verses.text: Palabay pa'in saga sangpū' llaw, amatay iya min kawasa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen2577" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1547"/><div sID="gen2578" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1547"/> Pagta'u si Da'ud ma pasal kamatay si Nabal, ah'lling iya, yukna, “Pudji ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay amalosan aku ma si Nabal ma sabab kapangahina'na ma aku. Tuhan ya bay angaliyusan aku min hinang kala'atan ati papelleng ni a'a inān saga kahinanganna ala'at.” <div eID="gen2578" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2579" type="paragraph"/> Pagubus magpanoho'an si Da'ud amah'nda si Abigail ati

verses.name: I Samuel 25:40
verses.text: pehē' saga sosoho'anna ni Karmel amowa lapal ni si Abigail, yuk-i, “Bay kami pinapi'itu e' nakura' kami si Da'ud supaya amah'nda ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2579" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1548"/><div sID="gen2580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1548"/> Pasujud magtūy si Abigail maka he'na anambung, yukna, “Aku itu atabi, sakap aku amahilala' ka'am sampay angose'an tape'bi.”

verses.name: I Samuel 25:42
verses.text: Ati magdai'-dai' ya pakura' ni kura'na bo' pabunyug ma saga sosoho'an si Da'ud. Sinehe'an isab iya e' lima ipatanna d'nda. Minnē' iya ta'ā' h'nda e' si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:43
verses.text: Tah'nda isab e' si Da'ud si Ahinowam d'nda min Jesde'el, jari magkalu'a sigām karuwangan.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:44
verses.text: Saguwā' si Mikal, ya bay h'nda si Da'ud po'on, wa'i pamah'nda e' si Sa'ul ma si Paltiyel ya anak si Lais, a'a min Galim.  <div eID="gen2580" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.25"/> <div eID="gen2565" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1549"/><div sID="gen2581" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Sa'ul Mbal Ni'inay e' si Da'ud, Kaminduwana na</title> <div sID="gen2582" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1549"/> Na, aniya' saga a'a min lahat Sīp bay pehē' ni si Sa'ul hinabuna ma Gibeya supaya anumbung pasal si Da'ud. “Tuwan sultan,” yuk sigām, “ina'an si Da'ud patapuk ma būd Hakila ya ma anggopan Jesemon.”  <div eID="gen2582" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1550"/><div sID="gen2583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1550"/> Manjari, pehē' ni paslangan Sīp si Sa'ul maka t'llungibu a'a Isra'il magbobono' ya bay pene'na, bo' amiha si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:3
verses.text: Bay magpustu asal si Sa'ul ma bihing lān, ina'an ma būd Hakila ma anggopan Jesemon, malaingkan in si Da'ud wa'i ma paslangan. Pagta'u si Da'ud pasal si Sa'ul bay anurul iya pina'an,

verses.name: I Samuel 26:4
verses.text: aniya' saga a'a soho'na pehē' ang'nda'. Jari tata'una min sigām, b'nnal, ina'an na si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1551"/><div sID="gen2584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1551"/> Sakali, magsakap si Da'ud bo' pehē' ni atag pagpustuhan si Sa'ul. Ta'nda'na bang maingga patulihan si Sa'ul maka si Abner ya pagnakura'an kamemon saga sundaluna. Si Abner itu anak si Nēr. Na, ma waktu inān, in si Sa'ul atuli ma pustu, ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' ba'anan saga bobono'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:6
verses.text: Na, atilaw si Da'ud ma si Ahimelek a'a bangsa Hīt maka si Abisai ya danakan si Jowab. (Si Seruya ya ina' sigām). Yuk panilaw si Da'ud, “Sai ameya' ma aku palūd ni si Sa'ul ma pustu inān?” <div eID="gen2584" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2585" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Abisai. “Aku,” yukna.  <div eID="gen2585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1552"/><div sID="gen2586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1552"/> Angkan sangom he'-i du, nil'ngngan pustu si Sa'ul e' si Da'ud maka si Abisai ati ta'nda' sigām si Sa'ul atuli maina'an. Ina'an paosol budjakna ma tana' min kōkanna, maka ina'an isab si Abner maka saga sundalu kasehe' atuli ma katilibutna.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:8
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, pahigung-higung si Abisai ni si Da'ud, yukna, “Tuwan, ya na itu waktu panukbal bantanu ni ka'a e' Tuhan. Dūlin aku amudjak iya ni tana'. Pamint'ddaku sadja.”  <div eID="gen2586" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1553"/><div sID="gen2587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1553"/> Saguwā' yuk sambung si Da'ud, “Oy! Da'a iya bono'un! Sabab tantu tinungbasan e' Tuhan sasuku angamula sultan ya tapene'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:10
verses.text: Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe, ya Tuhan kakkal salama-lama,” yuk si Da'ud, “Tuhan sadja ya magkahandak ma ganta'an si Sa'ul. Bang ngga'i ka patay saki atawa patay to'a, amatay iya ma pagbono'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:11
verses.text: Sagō' s'lle'-bale puhu' pinatā e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang pa'in mbal tamulaku a'a bay tapene'na magsultan ilu. Na, ngā'un na budjak maka pangisihan bohe' ya ma atag kōkna ilu bo' kita sūng na!”  <div eID="gen2587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1554"/><div sID="gen2588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1554"/> Jari ningā' e' si Da'ud budjak maka pangisihan bohe' ya bay ma kōkan si Sa'ul ati ala'an na sigā. Halam aniya' minsan sai makata'u atawa maka'nda' sigām maka halam minsan sai bay makabati'. Ahaluk sidda tuli sigām kamemon sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay amahaluk sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:13
verses.text: Sakali itu, palintas na si Da'ud ni dambila' kapantayan bo' an'ngge maina'an ma būd, atā-tā min disi Sa'ul. Asal aluha pag'llotan sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:14
verses.text: Manjari, angolang si Da'ud ni saga sundalu si Sa'ul maka ni si Abner, yukna, “Owa' Abner! Mbal aku sambungannu?” <div eID="gen2588" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2589" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Abner yukna, “Sai sa ka angolangan sultan ilu?”  <div eID="gen2589" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1555"/><div sID="gen2590" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1555"/> Yuk si Da'ud, “L'lla ka bahā' Abner? Bang pina'amu, halam sali'nu ma Isra'il! Na, angay halam jagahannu pahāp sultan ya pagpanghū'annu ilu? Sabab aniya' a'a bay pasōd pi'ilu arak angamula iya.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:16
verses.text: Mbal ahāp hinangnu ilu! Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe ya kakkal salama-lama, in ka'a maka saga sehe'nu ilu patut subay pinapatay sabab halam bay jagahannu nakura'nu, ya bay tapene' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ang'nda' ka ni katilibutnu. Maingga na budjak sultan maka pangisihanna bohe' ya bay ma kōkanna ilu?”  <div eID="gen2590" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1556"/><div sID="gen2591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1556"/> Takilā magtūy e' si Sa'ul suwala si Da'ud angkan iya ah'lling, yukna, “Da'ud, oto'! Ka'a ka amissala ilu?” <div eID="gen2591" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2592" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Da'ud, yukna, “Aho' tuwan sultan, aku ko' itu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 26:18
verses.text: Ah'lling lagi' si Da'ud, “Tuwan,” yukna, “kasā'an ai bay tahinang e' sosoho'annu itu angkan aku subay papataynu? Abontol sadja itikadku angkan mbal aku katōngan dusa.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:19
verses.text: Da'a busung, tuwan sultan, kalehun lagi' pah'llingku itu. Bang hati <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya bay anoho' ka'a amantahan aku, na, tukbalun lalabotan ni iya. Kalu tinaima' e'na. Saguwā' bang manusiya' ya amitnahan ka'a, bang pa'in sigām taluwa' sukna' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Sabab itiya' aku tin'ggal paluwas min lahat bay pamusaka' aku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, lāgi sinoho' isab aku magsumba ni saga katuhan-tuhanan bangsa liyu.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:20
verses.text: Ndū' tuwan,” yuk si Da'ud, “da'a aku pasagarin amatay ma lahat bangsa liyu, alawak min matahan si Yawe. Angay aku subay piniha e' sultan bangsa Isra'il? Aku itu sapantun kutu ero' ya pihanu ma kabūd-būran, buwat a'a amiha manuk-manuk.”  <div eID="gen2592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1557"/><div sID="gen2593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1557"/> Jari anambung si Sa'ul, yukna, “Bay aku makarusa. Ndū' Da'ud, oto', bang pa'in ka pabalik ni aku. Pagka ahalga' ma ka'a kallumku itu, mbal na balikanku niyatku amapatay ka'a. Sali' aku dupang, aheya kasā'an bay tahinangku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1558"/><div sID="gen2594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1558"/> “Ā, itiya' budjaknu tuwan sultan,” yuk sambung si Da'ud ma si Sa'ul. “Soho'un pi'itu dakayu' tendognu ilu angā'.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:23
verses.text: Baya'-baya' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> na anungbas ni kahāpan ma saga a'a sasuku abontol maka kapangandolan.” Ah'lling gi' si Da'ud yukna, “Ka'a tuwan, bay tinukbalan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni komkomanku insini', sagō' halam aku makatawakkal angamula ka'a sabab in ka'a sultan bay tapene' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:24
verses.text: Mura-murahan bang pa'in aku pinagka'inagonan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maka niliyusan e'na min kamemon katiksa'anku, buwat bay pagka'inagonku ma ka'a insini'.”  <div eID="gen2594" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1559"/><div sID="gen2595" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1559"/> Sakali ah'lling na si Sa'ul ni si Da'ud, yukna, “Oto', bang pa'in ka nilidjiki'an e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Tantu ajatu ai-ai kamemon ya tagna'annu, maka anganda'ug sadja ka ma pagbono'an.” <div eID="gen2595" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2596" type="paragraph"/> Pagubus, palanjal na si Da'ud ni pal'ngngananna, maka amole' na si Sa'ul ni lahatna.  <div eID="gen2596" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.26"/> <div eID="gen2581" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1560"/><div sID="gen2597" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Da'ud Paokom ma Bangsa Pilistin</title> <div sID="gen2598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1560"/> Saguwā' minsan buwattē' bissala si Sa'ul, maghona'-hona' na pa'in si Da'ud bo' yukna ma deyom atayna, “Tantu aku binono' e' si Sa'ul ma llaw sinosōng. Ahāp lagi' aku alahi pehē' ni lahat Pilistin. Pahali si Sa'ul amiha aku bang aubus e'na angalatag katilingkal lahat Isra'il, ati alipuwas aku min iya.”

verses.name: I Samuel 27:2
verses.text: Jari si Da'ud maka saga a'ana nnom hatus hekana bay palanjal minna'an bo' palain ni da'ira Gāt, ni sultan Akis ya anak si Ma'ok.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:3
verses.text: Sakali maina'an sigām pahanti' ma Gāt, ma okoman si Akis. Maina'an sigām pahanti' ma okoman sultan e', sigām kaniya-kaniya maka anak-h'nda sigām. Ina'an isab si Da'ud maka duwa h'ndana, ya na si Ahinowam min Jesde'el maka si Abigail min Karmel, ya bay balu si Nabal.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:4
verses.text: Jari kahaka'an pa'in si Sa'ul in si Da'ud wa'i na makalahi ni Gāt, pahali na iya amiha.  <div eID="gen2598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1561"/><div sID="gen2599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1561"/> Palabay pa'in waktu, ah'lling si Da'ud ni si Akis, yukna, “Tuwan, bang ka kasulutan du ma aku, pamarūlun ma aku dakayu' kaumannu bo' supaya aku makapaglahat mahē'. Mbal patut sosoho'annu itu paokom ma ka'a ma da'ira bangsahan itu.”

verses.name: I Samuel 27:6
verses.text: Angkan ma llaw ina'an du, pamuwan e' si Akis ma si Da'ud kauman Siklag. Jari in kauman inān tahinang palsuku'an saga sultan bangsa Yuda sampay ni kabuwattina'anan.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:7
verses.text: Saga dantahun maka mpat bulan ya kapaglahat si Da'ud ma deyoman saga bangsa Pilistin.  <div eID="gen2599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1562"/><div sID="gen2600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1562"/> Na ma waktu inān, angalangpas na pa'in si Da'ud maka saga tendogna ni saga bangsa Gesur, bangsa Girsi maka bangsa Amalek. Saga bangsa itu bay asal maina'an min awal lagi'. Ya paglahat sigām pa'abut ni Sūr, sampay isab ni lahat Misil.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:9
verses.text: Sakahaba' waktu kalangpas si Da'ud ni kaluma'an saga bangsa itu, halam aniya' kapinanna allum minsan dakayu' d'nda ka atawa l'lla. Ya nilangpas e'na saga bili-bili maka sapi' sampay saga kura' maka unta' maka pan'mmek. Jari pabalik na pa'in iya ni si Akis.  <div eID="gen2600" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1563"/><div sID="gen2601" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1563"/> Bang tinilaw si Da'ud e' si Akis bang pi'ingga bay parugpakanna, anambung iya buwattitu, yukna, “Bay kami parugpak ni lahat Yuda tampal ni satan.” Suma'an buwattitu panambungna, “Bay kami ni lahat Jerame'el tampal ni paslangan.” Atawa, “Bay kami pehē' ni kauman bangsa Kēn ya ma paslangan isab.”

verses.name: I Samuel 27:11
verses.text: Mbal kinapinan allum e' si Da'ud minsan dakayu' d'nda atawa l'lla allum, sabab ma pikilanna, “Ya aniya', bang aniya' l'lla atawa d'nda binowa ni Gāt, makasumbung lagi' sigām bang ai bay tahinangku.” Buwattē' kahinangan si Da'ud t'ggolna pat'nna' ma lahat Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:12
verses.text: Manjari, pangandolan iya e' si Akis sabab yukna ni baranna, “Tantu kinab'nsihan na si Da'ud itu e' saga pagkahina bangsa Isra'il, angkan halam dapat bang iya mbal amogbogan aku sat'ggolna allum.”  <div eID="gen2601" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.27"/> <div eID="gen2597" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1564"/><div sID="gen2602" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Sa'ul maka D'nda Maglilingan Umagad</title> <div sID="gen2603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1564"/> Manjari palabay pa'in waktu, pinapagtipun saga sundalu bangsa Pilistin supaya amowa magbono' ma bangsa Isra'il. Ah'lling si Akis ni si Da'ud, yukna, “Tahatinu du in ka'a maka saga tendognu ilu subay pagapi' ma aku ma pagbono'an.”  <div eID="gen2603" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1565"/><div sID="gen2604" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1565"/> Anguyun si Da'ud, yukna, “Na, tuwan, song ta'nda'nu bang ai tahinang e' sosoho'annu itu.” <div eID="gen2604" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2605" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Akis, “Ahāp ko' ilu. Angkan na ka hinangku jaga ma baranku sat'ggolku allum.”  <div eID="gen2605" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1566"/><div sID="gen2606" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1566"/> Malaingkan in si Samwel bay na asal amatay. Bay na iya pinagdukka'an e' kamemon saga jama'a Isra'il, ati wa'i bay kinubul e' sigām ma Rama, ya lahatna luggiya'. Ma waktu he'-i, bay na asal tin'ggal e' si Sa'ul kamemon saga a'a magpang'nda' umagad maka saga magjijīn min lahat Isra'il.  <div eID="gen2606" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1567"/><div sID="gen2607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1567"/> Sakali itu, magtipun na saga sundalu Pilistin bo' pehē' magpustu ma Sunem. Pasalta' in si Sa'ul bay amatimuk saga sundaluna bangsa Isra'il bo' magpustu ma Gilbowa.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:5
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Sa'ul ma ba'anan sundalu Pilistin, magtūy iya sinōd tāw mbal tapula'-pula'.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:6
verses.text: Angkan iya angaru ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang ai subay hinangna, sagō' halam aniya' lapal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pinasampay ma iya, ai naka ma uppina, ai naka min Urim<note>Urim: ōn kapanyapan ya pang'nda'an kahandak Tuhan e' imam alanga.</note> atawa min saga nabi.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:7
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', ah'lling si Sa'ul ni saga tendog ya pangandolanna, yukna, “Piha'inbi aku d'nda maglilingan umagad bo' supaya aku makapangaru ma iya.” <div eID="gen2607" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2608" type="paragraph"/> “Tuwan,” yuk sambung saga tendog inān, “aniya' kono' maina'an ma kauman Endor.”  <div eID="gen2608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1568"/><div sID="gen2609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1568"/> Sakali itu, magbinadju' saddī si Sa'ul supaya halam aniya' makakilā iya. Jari sangom inān pehē' na iya maka duwa tendogna ni luma' d'nda. Makat'kka pa'in, yuk si Sa'ul ni iya, “Bilahi aku angaru ni umagad a'a bay amatay. Tugila'ku pa'in ma ka'a bang sai subay linganannu.”  <div eID="gen2609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1569"/><div sID="gen2610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1569"/> Sagō' yuk sambung d'nda, “Tantu kasakupannu bang ai ya bay panoho'an si Sa'ul. Bay pala'anna min lahat Isra'il kamemon saga a'a maglilingan umagad maka saga magjijīn. Tu'ud ko' ka'a ilu pasulay anganjallat aku bo' supaya aku pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay.”  <div eID="gen2610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1570"/><div sID="gen2611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1570"/> Pagga buwattē' anapa si Sa'ul, yukna, “Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe, ya kakkal salama-lama, halam aniya' kamulahan tum'kka ni ka'a ma sabab palkala' itu.”  <div eID="gen2611" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1571"/><div sID="gen2612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1571"/> Jari tinilaw na iya e' d'nda inān, yukna, “Umagad sai kabilahiannu lingananku?” <div eID="gen2612" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2613" type="paragraph"/> “Umagad si Samwel,” yuk sambung si Sa'ul.  <div eID="gen2613" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1572"/><div sID="gen2614" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1572"/> Pag'nda' pa'in d'nda inān ma umagad si Samwel, magtūy iya angolang pakosog maka e'na atilaw ma si Sa'ul, yukna, “Angay aku bay akkalannu? Ka'a tuwi' sultan Sa'ul!”  <div eID="gen2614" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1573"/><div sID="gen2615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1573"/> Sakali yuk sultan ma iya, “Da'a ka tināw. Ai ta'nda'nu ilu?” <div eID="gen2615" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2616" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung d'nda, “Tuwan,” yukna, “maka'nda' aku umagad pabungkal min tana'.”  <div eID="gen2616" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1574"/><div sID="gen2617" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1574"/> Atilaw si Sa'ul, yukna, “Buwattingga luwana?” <div eID="gen2617" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2618" type="paragraph"/> “Matto'a l'lla magjinuba,” yuk sambung d'nda inān. Manjari kinata'uwan magtūy e' si Sa'ul si Samwel na ko' inān, angkan iya pasujud.  <div eID="gen2618" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1575"/><div sID="gen2619" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1575"/> Yuk si Samwel ni iya, “Angay lagi' aku sasatnu pagka aku bay soho'nu pinabangun?” <div eID="gen2619" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2620" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Sa'ul, yukna, “Landu' aheya kasukkalanku. Itiya' aku binono' e' saga a'a Pilistin, maka tinaikutan na aku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Mbal na sinambungan pangaruku, ai naka ma uppi atawa pinalabay min saga nabi. Angkan ka bay soho'ku pinalinganan bo' supaya aku pituwahannu bang ai subay hinangku.”  <div eID="gen2620" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1576"/><div sID="gen2621" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1576"/> Yuk si Samwel, “Angay lagi' aku subay pangaruhannu saukat ka bay tinaikutan maka binantahan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>?

verses.name: I Samuel 28:17
verses.text: Tahinang na e'na ya bay pagkallamna labay min aku. Ilu na niragtu' e'na min ka'a kapagsultannu bo' pamuwanna na ma dakayu' pagkahinu, ya na si Da'ud.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:18
verses.text: Angkan itu nihinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma ka'a buwattina'an sabab halam bay beya'nu panoho'anna. Halam bay pasampaynu mulka'na ma saga bangsa Amalek.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:19
verses.text: Jari in ka'a maka saga bangsa Isra'il marai' na tinukbalan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni komkoman bangsa Pilistin. Pagsalung,” yuk umagad si Samwel, “ka'a maka saga anaknu l'lla parakayu' du ma aku maitu ma ahirat. Damikiyanna isab saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il, tinukbalan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni komkoman bangsa Pilistin.”  <div eID="gen2621" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1577"/><div sID="gen2622" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1577"/> Saru'un-du'un du magtūy kum'ppang si Sa'ul ni tana', maka sinōd iya tāw landu' aheya ma pasalan pamissala si Samwel he'. Na, alamma si Sa'ul pagka halam bay amangan animpus dang'llaw maka dasangom.  <div eID="gen2622" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1578"/><div sID="gen2623" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1578"/> Manjari pasekot d'nda he', ati ta'nda'na ina'an si Sa'ul amidpid kabowa tāwna, angkan yukna, “Tuwan sultan, bay na beya'ku panoho'annu.
