Bay panūkku kallumku ni kamatay sabab pameya'ku ma panoho'annu.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:22
verses.text: Ndū' Tuwan,” yukna, “da'a busung, kalehun lagi' pamissala sosoho'annu itu maka dūlin aku angadjalan ka'a takakan bo' supaya pabalik kosognu ati bo' ka makalanjal ni pal'ngnganannu.”  <div eID="gen2623" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1579"/><div sID="gen2624" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1579"/> “Ē! Mbal aku amangan!” yuk sambung si Sa'ul. <div eID="gen2624" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2625" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' magbeya' saga tendog maka d'nda inān amogos na pa'in si Sa'ul, sampay iya tapogosna. Pagubus, pabangun iya min tana' bo' aningkō' ma pabahakanna.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:24
verses.text: Na, aniya' anak sapi' al'mmok taipat e' d'nda inān, magtūy sinumbali' e'na. Angaddun isab iya tirigu bo' hinangna tinapay halam taga-pasulig.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:25
verses.text: Atahak pa'in, pinat'nna' na e'na ni si Sa'ul maka saga tendogna ati amangan sigām. Pagubus, ma sangom he'i du, palanjal na sigām amole'.  <div eID="gen2625" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.28"/> <div eID="gen2602" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1580"/><div sID="gen2626" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinulak si Da'ud e' Sultan Bangsa Pilistin</title> <div sID="gen2627" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1580"/> Na, magtipun na kamemon sundalu bangsa Pilistin ma Apek, ati in sundalu bangsa Isra'il ina'an magpustu ma atag tigbaw ma Jesde'el.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:2
verses.text: Pal'ngngan na pa'in saga pagnakura'an bangsa Pilistin magbeya' maka saga tumpukan sundalu sigām ma hatusan maka ma ibuhan. Pasalta', ina'an isab si Da'ud maka saga a'ana pal'ngngan min buli'an magabay maka sultan Akis.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:3
verses.text: Atilaw isab saga nakura' kasundaluhan Pilistin ma si Akis, yuk-i, “Magay saga Hibrani itu?” <div eID="gen2627" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2628" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Akis, yukna, “Si Da'ud ko' ilu, ya bay tendog si Sa'ul, ya sultan bangsa Isra'il e'. Aniya' na iya labi dantahun ma deyomanku. Min waktu lagi' kala'anna min okoman si Sa'ul sampay ni kabuwattina'anan, halam iya karapatanku.”  <div eID="gen2628" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1581"/><div sID="gen2629" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1581"/> Sagō' akagit atay saga nakura' sundalu inān ma si Akis angkan yuk sigām, “Papole'un a'a ilu ni kauman bay pamuwannu paglahatan ma sigām. Mbal iya wajib pabunyug ma kitam ni pagbono'an! Sabab ya aniya' papinda angatuhan kitam hinabu ma pagbono'an. Tantu iya amonggolan kōk saga sundalutam bo' supaya iya makapaghāp maka sultan ya bay nakura'na.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:5
verses.text: Ya na ko' ilu si Da'ud, ya pinagkalang e' saga kar'ndahan, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen2630"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2631"/>‘Ibuhan tapapatay e' sultan Sa'ul,<l eID="gen2631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2632"/>ati hatusan ibu isab ma si Da'ud’.”<l eID="gen2632" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2630"/>  <div eID="gen2629" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1582"/><div sID="gen2633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1582"/> Manjari, pinalinganan si Da'ud e' si Akis bo' binowa magbissala. Yuk si Akis ma iya, “Sapahanku ma ōn si Yawe, ya kakkal salama-lama, in ka'a ilu kapangandolan angkan kasulutan sidda aku bang ka ganta' pabunyug ma aku maka saga sundaluku. Min waktu lagi' kat'kkanu sampay ni kabuwattina'anan, halam aniya' kasā'an tabākku ma ka'a. Sagō' mbal kasulutan saga pagkahiku nakura' Pilistin.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:7
verses.text: Angkan amole' na ka ma halam aniya' lengog. Maka da'a ka angahinang ai-ai ya makala'at pangatayan sigām kasehe' itu.”  <div eID="gen2633" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1583"/><div sID="gen2634" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1583"/> “Angay tuwan? Ai dusaku?” yuk si Da'ud. “Ai kasā'an bay tahinang e' tendognu itu min waktu katagna'ku paokom ma ka'a sampay ni waktu itu? Ai sababanna ya angkan aku mbal makajari ameya' ma ka'a amono' saga a'a ya amantahan ka'a, tuwan sultan?”  <div eID="gen2634" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1584"/><div sID="gen2635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1584"/> Anambung si Akis, yukna, “Kasulutan sidda aku ma ka'a, sapantun ka mala'ikat Tuhan ma pang'nda'ku. Malaingkan, bay makakabtang saga nakura' Pilistin in ka'a kono' mbal wajib ameya' ma kami ni pagbono'an.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:10
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'a, in ka'a maka saga tendog si Sa'ul ya sehe'nu ilu subay angawal salung bo' magla'anan minnilu ma halam gi' pak'llat llaw.”  <div eID="gen2635" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1585"/><div sID="gen2636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1585"/> Sakali, pagdai' llaw pa'in, pabungkal na si Da'ud maka saga a'ana bo' amole' pabīng ni lahat Pilistin. Sagō' in saga sundalu Pilistin patukad na ni da'ira Jesde'el.  <div eID="gen2636" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.29"/> <div eID="gen2626" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1586"/><div sID="gen2637" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nilaglag e' si Da'ud saga Bangsa Amalek</title> <div sID="gen2638" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1586"/> Manjari itu, pagpuwas pa'in t'llung'llaw, at'kka na si Da'ud maka saga a'ana ni Siklag ya kauman sigām. Sagō' waktu sigām lagi' bay ma labayan, in kauman Siklag sampay lahat Yuda tampal ni s'ddopan inān bay nirugpak e' bangsa Amalek. Tatunu' isab e' sigām saga kaluma'an ma kauman Siklag,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:2
verses.text: tasaggaw isab kamemon kar'ndahan sampay saga a'a kamemon onde'-matto'a ya bay maina'an. Malaingkan halam aniya' bay pinapatay minsan dakayu', hal bay sinaggaw e' saga a'a Amalek bo' binowa ala'an.  <div eID="gen2638" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1587"/><div sID="gen2639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1587"/> Na, pagt'kka si Da'ud maka saga a'ana ni kauman Siklag inān, ta'nda' e' sigām atunu' kamemon, maka saga anak-h'nda sigām wa'i bay nilahiyan.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:4
verses.text: Angkan maglemong disi Da'ud sampay sigām apaya na e' paglemong sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:5
verses.text: Ya karuwangan h'nda si Da'ud, ya si Abigail maka si Ahinowam, wa'i du talapay tasaggaw.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:6
verses.text: Aheya isab kasusahan si Da'ud sabab pinagbambahan iya binantung e' saga a'ana kabowa astol sigām ma pasalan kasaggaw saga anak sigām d'nda-l'lla. Malaingkan pakosog iman si Da'ud ma sabab pangandolna ma si Yawe ya Tuhanna.  <div eID="gen2639" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1588"/><div sID="gen2640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1588"/> Manjari ah'lling si Da'ud ni imam Abiyatar ya anak si Ahimelek. Yukna, “Tuwan, bowahin aku pi'itu epod e'.” Sakali binowa na ni iya e' si Abiyatar.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:8
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, angaru si Da'ud ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Wajib bahā' aku paturul ni saga a'a bay parugpak ni kauman itu? Ta'abutku bahā' sigām?” <div eID="gen2640" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2641" type="paragraph"/> Anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Aho', turulun sigām pehē'. Tantu sigām ta'abutnu maka talappasnu saga anak-h'ndabi.”  <div eID="gen2641" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1589"/><div sID="gen2642" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1589"/> Sakali, lum'ngngan na si Da'ud magbeya' maka saga a'ana nnom hatus puhu'. Makat'kka pa'in sigām ni L'bbak Besor, magpa'bba maina'an in kasehe'an sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:10
verses.text: Aniya' duwa hatus puhu' ma sigām magbale'an to'ongan angkan mbal makatukad ni pampang ya ma dambila' l'bbak inān. Malaingkan in si Da'ud maka mpat hatus a'ana bay palanjal angapas saga bangsa Amalek.  <div eID="gen2642" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1590"/><div sID="gen2643" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1590"/> Na, aniya' a'a Misil talanggal e' sigām ma huma, jari binowa iya e' sigām ni si Da'ud. Binuwanan iya takakan maka bohe' ni'inum.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:12
verses.text: Ya pamakan sigām ma iya buwa' igira bay kinompol maka duwa tundun anggul bay pina'llawan. Bay pa'in iya makakakan, pahāp na palasahanna pabalik, sabab halam iya bay makakakan ai-ai atawa makainum bohe' ma deyom t'llung'llaw t'llumbahangi.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:13
verses.text: Manjari, tinilaw iya e' si Da'ud, yukna, “Sai nakura'nu, maka m'nningga ka?” <div eID="gen2643" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2644" type="paragraph"/> Anambung l'lla inān, yukna, “Tuwan, aku itu bangsa Misil. Banyaga' aku ma dakayu' a'a bangsa Amalek. Bay aku pinasagaran e'na t'llung'llaw na palabay pagka aku bay asaki.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:14
verses.text: Bay kami parugpak ni lahat s'ddopan, ni tana' bangsa Keret maka ni kauman ya palsuku'an saga bangsa Yuda, maka ni tana' isab saga panubu' si Kaleb. Bay isab tunu' kami kauman Siklag.”  <div eID="gen2644" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1591"/><div sID="gen2645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1591"/> Atilaw si Da'ud pabalik, yukna, “Katuli'annu aku pehē' ni saga bangsa Amalek he'?” <div eID="gen2645" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2646" type="paragraph"/> “Aho' tuwan,” yuk sambung l'lla inān. “Kasehe'anta ka pehē' ni sigām bang pa'in sapahannu ma matahan Tuhan in aku mbal papataynu atawa tukbalannu pabalik ni bay nakura'ku.”  <div eID="gen2646" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1592"/><div sID="gen2647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1592"/> Na, sinehe'an na si Da'ud e' l'lla bangsa Misil inān palūd pehē' ni saga bangsa Amalek. Ina'an sigām magkaukanat ma lugal pagpustuhan sigām, magkakanan maka maginuman. Aheya paglami-lami sigām ma sabab kaheka pangalta' bay tataban sigām min paglahat bangsa Pilistin maka min Yuda.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:17
verses.text: Binono' magtūy sigām e' disi Da'ud min kohap inān sampay ni kasangoman ma llaw dakayu'. Halam aniya' minsan dangan min saga a'a Amalek bay makal'ppa, luwal mpat hatus onde' baha'u bay pakura' ma unta' alahi.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:18
verses.text: Ta'ā' pabalik e' si Da'ud kamemon bay tataban e' bangsa Amalek, beya' na duwangan h'ndana.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:19
verses.text: Ta'ā' e'na kamemon, halam kakulangan minsan dansolag, ai naka onde'-matto'a, d'nda ka atawa l'lla. Ta'ā' sampay saga pangalta' bay tataban aheya-ariki'.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:20
verses.text: Ta'ā'na isab kamemon saga bili-bili maka saga kahayopan, bo' pinal'ngngan e' saga a'ana min dahuwan sigām. Ya pagpa'in sigām, “Palsuku'an si Da'ud tatabanan itu kamemon.”  <div eID="gen2647" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1593"/><div sID="gen2648" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1593"/> Na, pabīng na si Da'ud ni saga a'ana duwa hatus hekana ya ina'an bay magpa'bba ma L'bbak Besor pagka sigām bay landu' apaya. Jari pasōng saga a'a itu amāk si Da'ud maka ba'anan saga sehe'na. Asekot pa'in disi Da'ud, sinagina sigām pahāp.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:22
verses.text: Malaingkan aniya' saga a'a asabul maka ala'at kasuddahanna pabeya' asal ma si Da'ud. Yuk saga a'a itu, “Mbal sigām patut pinahampit saga tatabanan ilu sabab halam sigām bay ameya' ma kitam. Sagō' makajari sigām angā' saga anak-h'nda sigām bo' magpole'an na.”  <div eID="gen2648" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1594"/><div sID="gen2649" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1594"/> “Mbal manjari, saga danakan,” yuk sambung si Da'ud. “Da'a kam maghinang buwattilu ma bay tahinang e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma kitam. Bay kitam nihampanan e'na, maka bay tukbalanna ni deyom komkomantam saga a'a ya bay amono' kitam.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:24
verses.text: Mbal tabeya' kabilahianbi ilu, kalna' in bahagi' a'a bay magpa'bba anunggu'an saga balanja' subay pinapagsali' maka bahagi' a'a bay ameya' ni pagbono'an. Pinapagtopod in bahagi' dangan maka dangan.”

verses.name: I Samuel 30:25
verses.text: Ya sara' bay pinaniya' e' si Da'ud itu binogbogan na pa'in e' bangsa Isra'il sampay ni kabuwattina'anan.  <div eID="gen2649" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1595"/><div sID="gen2650" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1595"/> Na, makabalik pa'in si Da'ud ni Siklag, bay pinabeya' e'na kasehe' tatabanan ni saga bagayna ya pagmatto'ahan ma Yuda. Aniya' isab lapalna, yukna, “Itu saga tatabanan bahagi'bi min saga a'a banta <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”

verses.name: I Samuel 30:27
verses.text: Bay isab binahagi'an e'na saga a'a ma Betel, ma Ramot-ni-S'ddopan maka ma Jattir.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:28
verses.text: Binahagi'an isab saga a'a ma Arower, ma Sepmot, ma Estemowa,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:29
verses.text: maka ma Rakal. Ya du saga a'a ya magsakaum ma bangsa Jerame'el maka bangsa Kēn,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:30
verses.text: saga a'a isab ma Horma, ma Bōr Asan, maka ma Atak,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:31
verses.text: sigām isab ma Hebron sampay ma kasehe'an paglahat ya bay pahanti'an si Da'ud maka saga a'ana.  <div eID="gen2650" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.30"/> <div eID="gen2637" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1596"/><div sID="gen2651" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Sa'ul maka Saga Anakna</title> <div sID="gen2652" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1596"/> Manjari itu, parugpak saga Pilistin ni saga sundalu bangsa Isra'il ati aheka bangsa Isra'il amatay ma Būd Gilbowa. Malaingkan in kasehe'an bay makalahi.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:2
verses.text: In si Sa'ul magtai'anak bay niabut-abut e' saga sundalu Pilistin ati tapapatay e' sigām si Jonatan, si Abinadab maka si Malki-Suwa.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:3
verses.text: Paruhun na pa'in pagbono' ma atag si Sa'ul, ati tasekot pa'in iya e' a'a magpapana', ahalol iya e' sigām.  <div eID="gen2652" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1597"/><div sID="gen2653" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1597"/> Angkan iya ah'lling ni a'a magbobowa pakokosna, yukna, “Hublutun na kalisnu ilu bo' aku papatayun, pād-pād saga kapil itu angandugsu'an aku maka anganjahulaka'an baranku.” <div eID="gen2653" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2654" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' landu' tināw magbobowa pakokos inān angkan mbal tahinangna panoho'an si Sa'ul e'. Pagka buwattē', ningā' e' si Sa'ul kalisna bo' iya amapatay di-na.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:5
verses.text: Pag'nda' magbobowa pakokos in si Sa'ul amatay na, ya du iya bay angahublut kalisna bo' amapatay di-na.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:6
verses.text: Angkan ma llaw inān, magbeya' amatay si Sa'ul maka t'llungan anakna l'lla, maka magbobowa pakokosna, sampay isab kamemon saga sundalu bay ma iya.  <div eID="gen2654" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1598"/><div sID="gen2655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1598"/> Na, pasampay habal itu ni saga a'a Isra'il ya maglahat ma kapantayan Jesde'el maka ma dambila' sapa' Jordan, ati tata'u na e' sigām in saga sundalu Isra'il wa'i maglahian maka in si Sa'ul sampay saga anakna wa'i na amatay. Pagta'u itu, ni'bbahan e' sigām saga kaluma'an sigām bo' alahi. Jari pina'an na saga bangsa Pilistin maglahat ma bay kaluma'an bangsa Isra'il e'.  <div eID="gen2655" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1599"/><div sID="gen2656" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1599"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', makapina'an pa'in saga bangsa Pilistin ni būd Gilbowa angā' ai-ai kagunahan min bangkay saga bangsa Isra'il, tabāk e' sigām mayat si Sa'ul maka saga anakna.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:9
verses.text: Pinonggolan e' sigām kōk si Sa'ul maka niurusan saga pakokosna, ati sinō' pinasaplag habal itu ma katilingkal paglahat Pilistin sampay ma langgal saga tuhan-tuhan sigām.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:10
verses.text: Manjari pinat'nna' pakokos si Sa'ul ma langgal saga tuhan-tuhan sigām Astoret, ati in baranna bay nilansang ma ād ya ma likusan da'ira Bet-Sān.  <div eID="gen2656" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1600"/><div sID="gen2657" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1600"/> Pagta'u saga a'a Jabes Giliyad ma bay tahinang a'a Pilistin ma bangkay si Sa'ul,

verses.name: I Samuel 31:12
verses.text: magtūy palanjal saga a'a sigām ya tamakaesog. Animpus sigām sangom bo' pehē' ni Bet-Sān. Ningā' e' sigām saga bangkay disi Sa'ul maka saga anakna min ād Bet-Sān inān bo' binowa ni Jabes, ati mahē' tinunu'.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:13
verses.text: Tatunu' pa'in, ningā' saga to'olang inān ati kinubul ma deyo'an kayu tamaris ya maina'an ma lahat Jabes. Pagubus, magpuwasa saga a'a Jabes inān ma deyom pitung'llaw.  <div eID="gen2657" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2651" type="section"/> <div eID="gen2120" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1Sam.31"/> <div eID="gen2114" osisID="1Sam" type="book"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1601"/><div sID="gen2664" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dayang-dayang Basti Pinalessad</title> <div sID="gen2665" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1601"/> Buwattitu bay kahālan ma waktu sultan Serses ya bay ang'ntanan pagparinta ma saga paglahat dahatus maka duwampū' maka pitu' hekana, tinagna'an min lahat Indiya sampay ni lahat Eteyopa.

verses.name: Esther 1:2
verses.text: Ma waktu he', sultan Serses pat'nna' ma kuta'na ma da'ira Susa bo' amarinta ma pagsultananna.

verses.name: Esther 1:3
verses.text: Ta'abut tahun kat'lluna ma kapamarinta si Serses itu, bay iya amaniya' paglami-lami ma kamemon saga a'a bangsahan ya beya' ma iya maka saga pagnakura'an. Ina'an isab saga nakura' sundalu bangsa Persiya maka Midiya, maka saga anak sultan maka saga a'a bangsahan min ba'anan paglahat e'.  <div eID="gen2665" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1602"/><div sID="gen2666" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1602"/> Ma deyom dahatus maka walumpū' llaw pina'nda'an na pa'in pangalta' landu' aheka ya beya' ma pagsultananna, pina'nda'an isab kabantugan maka kasanglitan sin kapagsultanna.

verses.name: Esther 1:5
verses.text: Palabay pa'in waktu inān, in sultan itu bay amaniya' paglami-lami dapitu' t'ggolna ma halaman astana'na. Ya tina'abbit inān kamemon saga a'a alanga-areyo' ya pat'nna' ma kuta' Susa.

verses.name: Esther 1:6
verses.text: In halaman inān bay niari-arihan, pinagantungan kakana' pote' maka bilu bay niengkotan ni gallang pilak ya pinikit ni saga hāg batu marbol. Lanay pote' maka kakana' taluk ya pangengkot. Aniya' isab saga paningkō'an bulawan maka pilak pat'nna' ma lantay batu niari-ari isab maka batu gaddung, marbol pote', kuwit mussa', maka kaginisan batu ahalga'.

verses.name: Esther 1:7
verses.text: Saga inuman ya pangalabot ma saga luruk bay ni'isi ni saga sawan bulawan magginisan, maka aheka isab binu-anggul landu' ahāp, ya makatōp karaya sultan.

verses.name: Esther 1:8
verses.text: Aniya' panoho'an sultan ma pasal inuman, hatina in luruk inān manjari anginum ma buwat kabaya'anna dangan maka dangan. Aniya' asal bay panoho'anna ma kamemon saga magbubuhat inuman, sinō' amainum saga luruk inān ma buwat kabaya'an sigām pakaniya-pakaniya.  <div eID="gen2666" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1603"/><div sID="gen2667" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1603"/> Aniya' isab paglami-lami bay pinaniya' e' dayang-dayang Basti, ya h'nda sultan, ma saga kar'ndahan ya pat'nna' ma astana' sultan Serses.  <div eID="gen2667" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1604"/><div sID="gen2668" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1604"/> Ma llaw kapitu', nilango-lango pa'in sultan Serses e' binu-anggul, magpanoho'an iya ma saga sosoho'anna yunuk<note>Yunuk itu a'a bay kinabili, hatina a'a bay kala'anan napsuna ma d'nda.</note> pitu' hekana, ya niōnan si Mehuman, si Bista, si Harbona, si Bigta, si Abagta, si Setor maka si Karkas.

verses.name: Esther 1:11
verses.text: Sinoho' sigām angā' dayang-dayang Basti binowa pinaharap ni iya magkinorona, bo' supaya ta'nda' kalingkatna e' saga luruk maka saga a'a bangsahan, ma sabab amanis iya ni'nda'.

verses.name: Esther 1:12
verses.text: Sagō' tata'u pa'in e' si Basti bang ai panoho'an sultan ya pinasampay ni iya e' saga sosoho'an e', magtūy iya magin'mbal. Angkan akagit to'ongan atay sultan.  <div eID="gen2668" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1605"/><div sID="gen2669" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1605"/> Na, ya kabiyaksahan sultan inān subay angaru ma saga a'ana taga-pangita'u ma ba'anan addat maka sara', angkan bay bowana magsuli-suli saga a'a ya alalom pangita'una ma pasal waktu palabay maka waktu sinōng.

verses.name: Esther 1:14
verses.text: Ya pangaruhanna saga a'a pasunu' ni iya, ya na disi Karsena, Setar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena maka si Memokan, a'a bangsahan min bangsa Persiya maka bangsa Midiya. Sigām pitu' puhu' itu a'a bangsahan, a'a asekot ni sultan maka alanga isab ma pagparintahanna.  <div eID="gen2669" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1606"/><div sID="gen2670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1606"/> Atilaw sultan Serses ma saga a'a itu, yukna, “Bang ma bowahan sara'tam, hukuman ai subay pinat'kka ni dayang-dayang Basti? Sabab halam bay bineya' e'na panoho'anku ya bay pinasampay ni iya e' saga yunuk.”  <div eID="gen2670" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1607"/><div sID="gen2671" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1607"/> Ati sinambungan e' si Memokan panilaw sultan itu maina'an ma matahan sultan maka saga a'ana bangsahan, “Mbal taluwa' bay hinang dayang-dayang Basti. Ngga'i ka sadja sultan ya nirusahan, sagō' kamemon saga a'a bangsahan maka kamemon saga a'a ya maglahat ma pagsultanan sultan Serses.

verses.name: Esther 1:17
verses.text: Tantu patanyag ni kamemon kar'ndahan in bay hinang dayang-dayang Basti itu, ati amabiyal sigām ma kah'lla'an sigām. Ya yuk sigām, ‘Si sultan Serses bay magpanoho'an ma dayang-dayang Basti, sinoho' paharap ni iya, sagō' halam iya bay bineya'.’

verses.name: Esther 1:18
verses.text: Ma llaw itu du, in saga d'nda alanga ma bangsa Persiya maka ma bangsa Midiya, sasuku bay makakale ma pasal palkala' itu, ameya'-meya' isab amabiyal ma saga kah'lla'an sigām, a'a kawakilan e' sultan. Jari halam aniya' katobtoban ma pagsasaw maka paghalipulu ma sakalibut lahat.  <div eID="gen2671" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1608"/><div sID="gen2672" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1608"/> “Na, tuwan sultan, bang makasulut ma ka'a, angahinang ka panoho'an sara' pinasulat ma saga sara' bangsa Persiya maka Midiya, ya mbal manjari pinindahan. In si Basti mbal na manjari makasekot ni matahan sultan Serses. Bang makasulut isab ma ka'a, tuwan sultan, in kapagdayang-dayang si Basti subay pinaganti' ni d'nda saddī labi ahāp addatna min iya.

verses.name: Esther 1:20
verses.text: Jari bang tapatanyag na sara' panoho'an sultan ma kamemon lahat ya beya' ma iya, kamemon saga kar'ndahan magaddat ma saga kah'lla'an sigām, ai na ka areyo' atawa alanga.”  <div eID="gen2672" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1609"/><div sID="gen2673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1609"/> Kasulutan to'ongan sultan maka saga a'ana bangsahan ma gara' itu, angkan bay bineya' e'na gara' si Memokan.

verses.name: Esther 1:22
verses.text: Bay iya amabeya' sulat pasal panoho'an sara' itu ni sakalibut pagparintahanna, ni kamemon paglahatna maka kamemon bangsana, pamata'u sigām in l'lla kamemon subay magnakura' ma anak-h'nda sigām. Sinulat isab ma bahasa maka sulatan sigām pakaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen2673" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.1"/> <div eID="gen2664" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1610"/><div sID="gen2674" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ester ya Tapene' Nihinang Dayang-dayang</title> <div sID="gen2675" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1610"/> Na, apuwas pa'in bay kagit atay sultan Serses, taentom e'na bay hinang si Basti maka sara' ya bay pinat'kka e'na ni iya.

verses.name: Esther 2:2
verses.text: Jari aniya' gara' pamuwan ma sultan e' saga tendogna, yuk-i, “Bang makasulut ma ka'a, tuwan, amapiha ka saga budjang alingkat binowahan ka'a.

verses.name: Esther 2:3
verses.text: Amat'nna' ka isab saga wakil ma kamemon saga paglahat ma katilingkal pagsultanannu. Soho'un binowa saga budjang alingkat inān ni libunan karayang-dayangan maitu ma kuta' Susa itu. Patuntulun sigām ma si Hegay, ya yunuk sultan angupiksa' ma kar'ndahan, maka soho'un pinal'ssin.

verses.name: Esther 2:4
verses.text: Manjari sai budjang makasulut atay sultan, ya he' nihinang dayang-dayang pangangganti' si Basti.” Ka'amuhan sultan ma gara' itu ati bineya' e'na.  <div eID="gen2675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1611"/><div sID="gen2676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1611"/> Ma waktu inān aniya' Yahudi niōnan si Murdikay bay ma kuta' Susa. Si Murdikay itu dakayu' panubu' si Benjamin, mma'na si Jair, mbo'na si Simay ya anak si Kīs l'lla.

verses.name: Esther 2:6
verses.text: Si Murdikay itu bay tasaggaw e' sultan Nebukadnesar bo' binowa ala'an min Awrusalam tudju ni Babilon. Dambeya'an iya maka si Jehoyakin<note>Si Jehoyakin itu kaōnan isab Jekonaya.</note> ya bay sultan lahat Yuda, maka saga a'a kasehe' isab.

verses.name: Esther 2:7
verses.text: Aniya' kaki si Murdikay budjang taipat e'na pagka amatay na ina'-mma'na. Ōn budjang itu si Hadasa, ya isab niōnan si Ester. Alingkat d'nda iya maka ahāp pamarananna. Niniyat iya e' si Murdikay buwat anakna lissi.  <div eID="gen2676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1612"/><div sID="gen2677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1612"/> Manjari, abeya' pa'in bay panoho'an sultan, aheka saga kabudjangan bay binowa ni da'ira Susa bo' pinatuntul ma si Hegay ya magnakura' ma libunan saga karayang-dayangan ma deyom astana'. Lamud na mahē' si Ester, pinatuntul isab ma si Hegay

verses.name: Esther 2:9
verses.text: Na si Ester ya makasulut atay si Hegay ati kinahāpan e'na. Angkan magtūy bay ni'nde'an ni iya e' si Hegay kamemon saga pagpal'ssin maka pagkakan ahāp. Aniya' isab pamat'nna' ma si Ester pitu' sosoho'an d'nda ya bay tapene' min astana', ati binowa iya maka saga sosoho'an he' papinda ni lugal ya katapusan ahāp ma deyom libunan karayang-dayangan.  <div eID="gen2677" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1613"/><div sID="gen2678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1613"/> Halam bay nihaka e' si Ester in bangsana maka pagka'a'ana, sabab ya he' bay pangalāngan iya e' si Murdikay.

verses.name: Esther 2:11
verses.text: Sakahaba' llaw si Murdikay itu maglabay-labay na pa'in ma halaman ya ma luwasan libunan karayang-dayangan supaya ana'u bang ai kahālan si Ester.  <div eID="gen2678" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1614"/><div sID="gen2679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1614"/> Manjari, saga budjang itu halam magtūy pinaharap ni sultan Serses. Ya untulan pamat'nna' ma sigām subay nilibun ma deyom dantahun maka pinal'ssin pahāp bo' yampa aniya' waktuna paharap ni sultan e'. Nilipa' sigām nnom bulan maka ns'llan mira, nnom bulan isab pinahamut-hamutan maka niari-ari.

verses.name: Esther 2:13
verses.text: Buwattitu kal'ngnganan budjang bang ta'abut na pinaharap ni sultan. Ai-ai niamu' e' budjang inān min libunan kar'ndahan pamarūl ma iya, bo' tapakay e'na pehē' ni astana'.

verses.name: Esther 2:14
verses.text: Sangom ya waktu kapaharapna ni sultan, ati pagk'llat llaw pabalik iya ni libunan karayang-dayangan, sagō' saddī bilikna. Pinaupiksa' iya ma si Sasgas, yunuk sultan ya makapagbaya' ma saga kah'nda-h'nda'an sultan. Mbal ya manjari paharap ni sultan pabīng, luwal bang kasulutan sultan ma iya bo' palingananna ma ōnna.  <div eID="gen2679" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1615"/><div sID="gen2680" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1615"/> Na, ta'abut na waktu kapaharap si Ester ni sultan. (Si Ester itu bay anak si Abiha'il, ya si'it si Murdikay. Taipat isab iya e' si Murdikay.) Halam aniya' niamu' e' si Ester saddī min bay pamat'nna' ma iya e' si Hegay, yunuk sultan ya nakura' ma libunan kabudjangan. Manjari ka'amuhan ma iya saga a'a kamemon ya bay maka'nda' iya.

verses.name: Esther 2:16
verses.text: Bulan Tebet ya waktu kapamowa si Ester ni sultan Serses ma deyom astana'na. Ya na bulan kasangpū'na maka pituntahun kapagsultan si Serses.  <div eID="gen2680" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1616"/><div sID="gen2681" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1616"/> Na, sinōd baya' sultan itu ma si Ester labi lagi' min saga d'nda kasehe'an. Angkanna kinoronahan e'na kōk si Ester nihinang dayang-dayang pangangganti'na si Basti.

verses.name: Esther 2:18
verses.text: Pagubus pa'in, amaniya' iya paglami-lami pangamahaltabat ma si Ester, ati lamud kamemon saga a'ana bangsahan maka saga pagnakura'an ya wakilna. Ma waktu inān aniya' panoho'an isab bay pinatanyag e' sultan ni saga paglahat ma katilingkal pagsultananna, magpanoho'an subay halam aniya' hinang ma sai-sai ma deyom dang'llaw. Bay isab pagmura e'na saga pangalta', ya na addat sultan.  <div eID="gen2681" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2674" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1617"/><div sID="gen2682" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Murdikay maka Panumbungna</title> <div sID="gen2683" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1617"/> Waktu pa'in pamatimuk pabalik saga kabudjangan, kawakilan si Murdikay aningkō' ma lawang kuta' sultan.

verses.name: Esther 2:20
verses.text: Masi na pa'in nilimbungan e' si Ester ya bangsana maka pagka'a'ana buwat bay pamandu' si Murdikay ma iya. Buwattē' asal kabiyaksahan si Ester sangay min katagna' kapangipat si Murdikay ma iya.  <div eID="gen2683" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1618"/><div sID="gen2684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1618"/> Na, ma waktu kapaningkō' si Murdikay ma lawang kuta', kinap'ddi'an atay sultan Serses e' si Bigtana maka si Teres, yunuk pangandolan sultan ya jaga ma lawang e'. Magisun sigā amapatay sultan.

verses.name: Esther 2:22
verses.text: Sagō' tata'u pa'in e' si Murdikay pagisun itu, sinumbung e'na ni dayang-dayang Ester, maka si Ester ya bay amalatun sumbung ni sultan, samantala' si Murdikay ya pinagsarang-sukulan.

verses.name: Esther 2:23
verses.text: Manjari, tapariksa' pa'in bay panumbung e', katōngan dusa duwangan wakil inān ati sinoho' ginantung pinapatay. Na, tasulat saga kahālan itu kamemon ma Kitab Pagsusulatan Sultan, maina'an ma matahan sultan.  <div eID="gen2684" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.2"/> <div eID="gen2682" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1619"/><div sID="gen2685" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Gara' si Haman Binono' saga Bangsa Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen2686" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1619"/> Pagubus pa'in saga palkala' itu, minahaldika' e' sultan Serses si Haman anak si Hammedata l'lla, ya bangsa Agag. Pinalanga gi' kapatutna min saga a'a bangsahan kasehe'an.

verses.name: Esther 3:2
verses.text: Manjari, kamemon saga wakil sultan ya ma lawang kuta'na angōk-tu'ut pagmahaltabat sigām ma iya buwat bay panoho'an sultan. Sagō' mbal angōk-tu'ut si Murdikay maka mbal magaddat ma si Haman e'.

verses.name: Esther 3:3
verses.text: Ati atilaw ni si Murdikay saga wakil sultan ya ma lawang kuta'na, yuk-i, “Angay pabiyalnu panoho'an sultan?”

verses.name: Esther 3:4
verses.text: Sakahaba' llaw pinamūngan na pa'in si Murdikay e' saga wakil e', sagō' in iya mbal to'ongan ameya' ma pamogos sigām. “Sabab,” yukna, “In aku itu bangsa Yahudi ko'.” Sakali anumbung saga wakil inān pehē' ni si Haman bo' kinata'uwan e' sigām bang kasandalan palangay si Murdikay inān.  <div eID="gen2686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1620"/><div sID="gen2687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1620"/> Pagka ta'nda' e' si Haman in si Murdikay mbal angōk-tu'ut atawa magaddat ma iya, akagit to'ongan atayna.

verses.name: Esther 3:6
verses.text: Tata'u pa'in e'na in si Murdikay bangsa Yahudi, magniyat iya ngga'i ka hal si Murdikay ya pinapatay. Angkan amikil-mikil na pa'in si Haman bang buwattingga kapangalaglag kamemon saga bangsa Yahudi ya maglahat ma katilingkal pagsultanan si Serses.  <div eID="gen2687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1621"/><div sID="gen2688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1621"/> Ma kasangpū' karuwantahun kapagsultan sultan Serses, ma bulan Nisan ya bulan panagna'an ma tahun ina'an-i, magko'ot-ko'ot<note>Pur: ya pangōn pagko'ot itu bang ma bahasa Persiya.</note> saga a'a ma matahan si Haman bo' tapene' llaw maka bulan ya patut pamalanjal pagniyat itu. Jari ya tako'ot e' saga a'a inān bulan Adar ya bulan kasangpū' karuwa.  <div eID="gen2688" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1622"/><div sID="gen2689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1622"/> Na, ah'lling si Haman ni sultan Serses yukna, “Aniya' dakayu' bangsa akaukanat ma kamemon paglahat ma pagsultanannu, maglamud-lamugay maka saga bangsa kasehe'an. Saddī saga pangaddatan sigām min saga bangsa kasehe'an, maka mbal tabeya' e' sigām saga sara' ya panoho'annu. Jari bang sigām pasagarannu na pa'in, mbal makahāp ma pagsultanannu.

verses.name: Esther 3:9
verses.text: Angkan Tuwan sultan, bang makasulut ma ka'a, amaniya' ka sara' pamaka'at ma bangsa Yahudi inān.” Ah'lling gi' si Haman yukna, “Amuwan aku sangpū' ngibu heka pilak tibu'uk ninna' ma pagtatau'an pangalta' sultan panamba saga a'a ya makahinang itu-i.”  <div eID="gen2689" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1623"/><div sID="gen2690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1623"/> Manjari nihurusan e' sultan singsingna ya taga-gindan pagsultanna, bo' sinōngan e'na ni si Haman. Na si Haman itu anak si Hammedata bangsa Agag, ya banta saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Esther 3:11
verses.text: Yuk sultan ni si Haman, “Mailuhun na sīn ilu. Hinangun bang ai kabaya'annu nihinang ma sigām.”  <div eID="gen2690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1624"/><div sID="gen2691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1624"/> Ta'abut pa'in kasangpū' ka t'llung'llaw ma bulan panagna'an, pinalinganan e' sultan saga sosoho'anna magsusulat. Sinoho' sigām anulat kamemon panoho'an si Haman bo' pinabeya' ni saga gubnul katapusan alanga<note>Satrap ya pangōn saga gubnul alanga itu bang ma bahasa Persiya.</note>, maka ni saga gubnul ya magmakōk ma ba'anan paglahat, maka ni saga a'a bangsahan min bangsa kaginisan. In sulat itu bay sinulat ma bahasa maka sulatan saga bangsa inān kaniya-kaniya. Bay sinulat isab ma deyo'an ōn sultan Serses bo' sināpan maka singsingna.

verses.name: Esther 3:13
verses.text: Tasulat pa'in saga sulat itu, pinabowa na ma saga magbobowa sulat bo' pinasampay ni kamemon paglahat ya beya' ma pagsultanan si Serses. Yuk panoho'an itu in bangsa Yahudi subay pinaka'at maka nilaglag bo' halam aniya' takapin. Onde'-matto'a, kar'ndahan maka kaonde'-onde'an, subay pinapatay ma deyom dang'llaw, ma pitsa sangpū' maka t'llu ma kasangpū' karuwa bulan, ya na bulan Adar. Saga pangalta' sigām isab subay pinagtaban.

verses.name: Esther 3:14
verses.text: Manjari, ai-ai bay panoho'an e' si Haman inān bay tahinang sara' sultan, ati sinoho' pinasampay ni kamemon saga paglahat pamata'u saga a'a kamemon, minsan ai bangsa, supaya sigām sakap amono' bang ta'abut na waktu ina'an.  <div eID="gen2691" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1625"/><div sID="gen2692" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1625"/> Pinarai'-dai' e' sultan saga a'a magbobowa sulat ati pauntas na sigām. Pinasaplag isab panoho'an si Haman ma deyom da'ira Susa. Sultan Serses maka si Haman ina'an aningkō' maginum sagō' magkalengogan saga a'a maina'an.  <div eID="gen2692" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.3"/> <div eID="gen2685" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1626"/><div sID="gen2693" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Murdikay Mikitabang ma si Ester</title> <div sID="gen2694" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1626"/> Tata'u pa'in e' si Murdikay kamemon bay tahinang e', ginese' e'na s'mmekna ati abadju' iya karut maka amehē'an di-na abu, paltanda'an kasusahanna. Paluwas iya ni saga kaluma'an maka e'na maglemong pakosog.

verses.name: Esther 4:2
verses.text: Saguwā' halam iya bay palabay min lawang kuta', sabab halam aniya' minsan sai tinugutan pasōd ni deyom kuta' bang magbinadju' karut.

verses.name: Esther 4:3
verses.text: Aheya to'ongan karukka'an ma sasuku bangsa Yahudi maina'an ma kamemon saga paglahat ya bay kapabeya'an panoho'an maka sara' sultan inān. Maglemong sigām maka amuwasa. Aheka isab sigām magbinadju' karut maka palesseg ma abu.  <div eID="gen2694" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1627"/><div sID="gen2695" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1627"/> Manjari itu, bay pa'in kahaka'an si Ester e' saga sosoho'anna d'nda maka saga yunuk pasal kahālan si Murdikay, sidda aheya kasukkalanna. Bay iya amabeya' s'mmek ni si Murdikay pamasalinan badju'na karut, sagō' halam tinaima' e'na.

verses.name: Esther 4:5
verses.text: Pagubus, pinalinganan e' si Ester si Hatak, dakayu' yunuk pangandolan sultan ya sinoho' angupiksa' ma iya. Jari sinoho' tina'u ma si Hatak itu e' si Ester bang ai makalengog ma si Murdikay, maka bang ai sababna.  <div eID="gen2695" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1628"/><div sID="gen2696" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1628"/> Sakali itu, paluwas si Hatak ni si Murdikay, ya ina'an ma mairan ma anggopan lawang kuta' si Serses.

verses.name: Esther 4:7
verses.text: Nihaka'an si Hatak e' si Murdikay pasal kamemon bay pat'kka ni iya. Kahaka'an isab pasal halga' pilak bay panganjanji' si Haman pamat'nna'na ma pagtatau'an pangalta' sultan bang pa'in nilaglag bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Esther 4:8
verses.text: Bay isab ni'nde'an e' si Murdikay ni si Hatak dakayu' sulat panulatan sara' ya bay pinasaplag ma lahat Susa ma pasal pangalaglag bangsa Yahudi. Sinō' pina'nda'an sulat itu ma si Ester, maka sinoho' iya pinata'u pasal kahālan itu. Aniya' isab panoho'an si Murdikay panganjunjungna ma si Ester yuk-i, “Bang pa'in ka pabaihu' ni sultan magpatiase' ma pasal saga pagkahitam Yahudi.”  <div eID="gen2696" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1629"/><div sID="gen2697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1629"/> Pagubus pa'in, pabalik na si Hatak ni si Ester angahaka'an iya pasal bay pah'lling si Murdikay.

verses.name: Esther 4:10
verses.text: Jari aniya' lapal bay pinabowa e' si Ester ma si Hatak, sinō' pinasampay ni si Murdikay.

verses.name: Esther 4:11
verses.text: Yuk lapal e', “Bapa', kinata'uwan asal e' kamemon saga wakil sultan maka kamemon saga a'a ma sakalingkal lahat pagsultananna, sasuku l'lla atawa d'nda pasōd ni halaman deyom bo' pasekot ni sultan ma halam bay pinalinganan, subay pinapatay. Halam na aniya' sara' saddī liyu minnē', luwal la'a bang pinabantang bastun bulawan e' sultan pamapuwas a'a inān min hukuman kamatay. Saguwā',” yuk si Ester, “ya kagawahanku aniya' na t'llumpū' llaw halam aku bay nilingangan pehē' ni sultan.” Minnē' aubus lapal si Ester.  <div eID="gen2697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1630"/><div sID="gen2698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1630"/> Kahaka'an pa'in si Murdikay pasal lling si Ester itu,

verses.name: Esther 4:13
verses.text: anambung iya buwattitu, labay isab min si Hatak. Yukna, “Halam bahā' tapikilnu saukat na ka pat'nna' ma astana' sultan, mbal na ka talapay pinapatay ma saga pagkahinu bangsa Yahudi?

verses.name: Esther 4:14
verses.text: Bang mbal tawakkalannu ah'lling, tantu aniya' saddī amuwasan bangsata Yahudi min kasusahan sigām. Bo' pa'in ka'a maka saga kakampungannu alaglag. Mbal kata'uwanta,” yuk lagi' panambung si Murdikay, “kalu ka'a iya bay tapene' pinat'nna' dayang-dayang supaya ka makatabang ma waktu buwattitu.”  <div eID="gen2698" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1631"/><div sID="gen2699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1631"/> Buwattitu isab lapal ya pinabeya' e' si Ester panambungna ma si Murdikay.

verses.name: Esther 4:16
verses.text: Yukna, “Na, bapa', timukun kamemon saga Yahudi ya ma lahat Susa bo' aku puwasahinbi. Da'a kam amangan maka anginum ma deyom t'llung'llaw maka t'llumbahangi. Ya du isab aku maka saga sosoho'anku d'nda, amuwasa du isab buwat ka'am. Ati bang jukup na t'llung'llaw pagpuwasatam, pabaihu' aku ni sultan minsan langgal sara'. Bang aku pinapatay lilla' du aku.”

verses.name: Esther 4:17
verses.text: Manjari, palanjal na si Murdikay bo' bineya' e'na kamemon bay panoho'an si Ester.  <div eID="gen2699" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.4"/> <div eID="gen2693" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1632"/><div sID="gen2700" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maksud si Ester ni Sultan</title> <div sID="gen2701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1632"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in kat'llung llaw pagpuwasa disi Ester, sinulug e'na s'mmekna pagdayang-dayang bo' an'ngge pehē' ni halaman ma deyom astana', ma anggopan bilik paningkō'an sultan. Ina'an isab sultan aningkō' ma paningkō'an sultan, paharap ni lawang.

verses.name: Esther 5:2
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in e'na dayang-dayang Ester an'ngge ma halaman inān, kasulutan iya. Magtūy pinabantang e' sultan tudju ni si Ester in bastun bulawan ya ma tanganna. Manjari pasekot isab si Ester ang'ntanan tōng bastun he'.  <div eID="gen2701" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1633"/><div sID="gen2702" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1633"/> Tinilaw iya e' sultan yukna, “O dayang-dayang, ai maksudnu? Minsan lagi' santonga' pagsultananku pamuwanku du ni ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2702" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1634"/><div sID="gen2703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1634"/> Yuk sambung si Ester, “Bang makasulut ma ka'a, tuwan sultan, pahadil pa'in ka llaw itu ni pagjamu ya sakapku. Magbeya' ka maka si Haman.”  <div eID="gen2703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1635"/><div sID="gen2704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1635"/> Ah'lling sultan ni sosoho'anna, yukna, “Soho'un si Haman pasa'ut pi'itu, bo' abeya' e'ta bay pangamu' si Ester.” <div eID="gen2704" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2705" type="paragraph"/> Ati pahadil na sultan maka si Haman ni pagjamu ya bay sinakap e' si Ester.

verses.name: Esther 5:6
verses.text: Hinabu sigām anginum binu-anggul, tinilaw pabalik e' sultan si Ester. “Na, ai to'ongan maksudnu? Tantu ka dūlanku. Maka ai pangamu'nu? Minsan gi' santonga' pagsultananku, pamuwanku du.”  <div eID="gen2705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1636"/><div sID="gen2706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1636"/> Anambung si Ester, “Ya itu panganjunjungku:

verses.name: Esther 5:8
verses.text: Bang aku makasulut ma ka'a, tuwan Sultan, maka bang aku dūlannu, amu'ku ni ka'a bang pa'in ka magbeya' maka si Haman pahadil salung ni pagjamu ya song paniya'ku. Jari sambunganku panilawnu salung, tuwan Sultan.”  <div eID="gen2706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2700" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1637"/><div sID="gen2707" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Akagit Atay si Haman ma si Murdikay</title> <div sID="gen2708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1637"/> Ma waktu inān, pagluwas si Haman min pagjamuhan, kinōgan iya maka alampung baranna. Sagō' pag'nda' si Haman itu ma si Murdikay ma lawang kuta', bo' kamatahan e'na halam bay an'ngge atawa magmatāw ma iya, magtūy akagit atayna.

verses.name: Esther 5:10
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan buwattingga kagit atayna bay katahanan e'na ati palanjal iya amole'. <div eID="gen2708" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2709" type="paragraph"/> Manjari pinalinganan e' si Haman saga bagayna maka h'ndana si Seresa, sinō' patimuk ma iya.

verses.name: Esther 5:11
verses.text: Pagbantug e' si Haman ni sigām pangalta'na landu' aheka, maka heka saga anakna l'lla, maka kaginisan pangamahaltabat ma iya e' sultan. Pagbantugna isab in iya pinalanga labi lagi' min kasehe'an a'a bangsahan, maka min kamemon saga wakil.

verses.name: Esther 5:12
verses.text: “Ngga'i ka hal itu,” yuk si Haman. “Hal aku dangan-danganku ya bay tina'abbit e' dayang-dayang Ester anehe'an sultan ni paglami-lami ya bay pinaniya' e'na. Maka bay lagi' kami isab sinoho' pabalik maka sultan ma waktu salung.

verses.name: Esther 5:13
verses.text: Sagō' mbal du ahalga' ma aku saga kahāpan itu sat'ggol masi ta'nda'ku si Murdikay ya bangsa Yahudi aningkō' na pa'in ma lawang kuta'.”  <div eID="gen2709" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1638"/><div sID="gen2710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1638"/> Jari ah'lling ni iya h'ndana si Seresa maka saga bagayna, yuk-i. “Amahinang ka panganggantungan saga sangpū' maka dda d'ppa langkawna. Pagsubu, angamu' ka ni sultan bang pa'in soho'na ginantung si Murdikay maina'an. Pagubus, magbeya' ka maka sultan paluruk ni pagjamu bo' magkalasigan.” Palampung pangatayan si Haman ma sabab gara' itu ati amahinang iya panganggantungan.  <div eID="gen2710" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.5"/> <div eID="gen2707" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1639"/><div sID="gen2711" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapananglit ma si Murdikay</title> <div sID="gen2712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1639"/> Ma sangom he' mbal makatuli sultan angkan bay soho'na ningā' kitab Pagsusulatan Sultan ya panulatan saga kahālan ma pagsultananna. Sinoho' binassa ma matahanna.

verses.name: Esther 6:2
verses.text: Pagbassa itu, ta'nda' ma deyom kitab in sulat pasal si Murdikay maka kapanumbungna pasal kagara'an si Bigta maka si Teres, duwangan tendog sultan ya magjajaga ma bowa' lawang astana'. Bay sigām magisun amapatay sultan Serses.

verses.name: Esther 6:3
verses.text: Atilaw sultan yukna, “Ai pagmahaltabat maka tungbas bay tataima' e' si Murdikay ma kahinangan itu?” <div eID="gen2712" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2713" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung saga sosoho'anna, “Halam.”  <div eID="gen2713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1640"/><div sID="gen2714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1640"/> Yuk sultan, “Sai sa ma halaman e'?” Sabu baha'u bay pasōd si Haman ni halaman ya min luwasan astana'. Angamaksud iya angamu' ni sultan bang pa'in soho'na ginantung si Murdikay ma panganggantungan ya bay pahinangna.  <div eID="gen2714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1641"/><div sID="gen2715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1641"/> Ya sambung saga sosoho'an sultan, “Si Haman ko' he', angalagaran ka'a.” <div eID="gen2715" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2716" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sultan, “Pasōrun iya pi'itu.”

verses.name: Esther 6:6
verses.text: Pagsōd pa'in si Haman, tinilaw iya e' sultan, “Ai patut nihinang ma a'a bang kabaya'an sultan magmahaltabatan iya?” <div eID="gen2716" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2717" type="paragraph"/> Manjari amikil-mikilan di-na si Haman yukna, “Sai lagi' bahā' a'a pinagmahaltabatan e' sultan saddī min aku?”

verses.name: Esther 6:7
verses.text: Angkan ya sambungna ni sultan, “Bang aniya' a'a ganta' pinagmahaltabatan e' sultan,

verses.name: Esther 6:8
verses.text: in a'a inān subay binowahan badju' bay pamadju' sultan, maka kura' isab bay pangura'an sultan, kura' pina'alti maka porong bulawan.

verses.name: Esther 6:9
verses.text: Manjari soho'un pangandol badju' maka kura' itu ni dakayu' a'anu, ya bangsahan to'ongan. Jari in a'a ya kabaya'annu pinagmahaltabatan, subay pinabadju'an s'mmek sultan bo' pinakura'. Maka in a'a bangsahan inān subay parahū min iya anonda' kura'na ma mata mairan, maka e'na amatanyag lling ma kamemon saga a'a yukna, ‘Buwattitu ya tahinang ma a'a bang kabaya'an sultan magmahaltabatan iya!’ ”  <div eID="gen2717" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1642"/><div sID="gen2718" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1642"/> Yuk panoho'an sultan ma si Haman, “Na, pasa'ut ka angā' badju' maka kura' he' bo' hinangun kamemon bay pah'llingnu ilu ma si Murdikay a'a Yahudi ya aningkō' ma lawang kuta' inān. Da'a palehom-lehomun ai-ai ya bay pah'llingnu.”  <div eID="gen2718" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1643"/><div sID="gen2719" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1643"/> Manjari, ningā' e' si Haman in badju' sultan maka kura'na. Pinasulug e'na ma si Murdikay, ati tinonda' kura' ya pakura'anna ma mata mairan. Pinatanyag isab lling itu e' si Haman, yukna, “Buwattitu ya tahinang ma a'a bang kabaya'an sultan magmahaltabatan iya!”  <div eID="gen2719" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1644"/><div sID="gen2720" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1644"/> Pagubus pa'in, pabalik na si Murdikay ni lawang kuta'. Saguwā' si Haman bay magdai'-dai' amole' ni luma'na maka e'na anurungan kōkna paltanda'an karukka'anna maka kaiya'anna.

verses.name: Esther 6:13
verses.text: Manjari nihaka'an e'na h'ndana si Seresa maka kamemon saga bagayna ma pasal kamemon ya bay pat'kka ni iya. <div eID="gen2720" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2721" type="paragraph"/> Ah'lling h'ndana maka saga a'a ya anganggara' ma iya, yuk-i, “Pagga luggiya' bangsa Yahudi si Murdikay ya a'a amareyo' ka'a, tantu ka mbal maka'atu ma iya. Gom pa'in ka magkangī'-ngī' ma sababna!”

verses.name: Esther 6:14
verses.text: Sabu sigām masi magsuli-suli, at'kka pina'an saga yunuk sultan amasa'ut si Haman pehē' ni paglami-lamihan ya bay pinaniya' e' dayang-dayang Ester.  <div eID="gen2721" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.6"/> <div eID="gen2711" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1645"/><div sID="gen2722" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinapatay si Haman e' Sultan</title> <div sID="gen2723" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1645"/> Manjari, in sultan maka si Haman bay pehē' ni pagjamuhan ya bay pinaniya' e' dayang-dayang Ester.

verses.name: Esther 7:2
verses.text: Ma llaw inān, sabu sigām anginum binu-anggul, atilaw pabalik sultan ni si Ester yukna, “Na, haka'in aku bang ai pangamu'nu, bo' ka dūlanku. Ai panganjunjungnu? Minsan santonga' pagsultananku pamuwanku du ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen2723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1646"/><div sID="gen2724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1646"/> Ya sambung dayang-dayang Ester, “Bang aku makasulut ma ka'a, tuwan sultan, bang ka ka'amuhan isab ma pangamu'ku, pamarūlun ma aku kallumku. Ya panganjunjungku isab ma ka'a, bang pa'in liyusannu saga bangsaku min kamatay.

verses.name: Esther 7:4
verses.text: Sabab in aku maka saga bangsaku bay pinab'llihan supaya niligis maka nilaglag. Bang hal kami bay pinab'llihan binanyaga', bay na pasagaranku sabab palkala' buwattitu mbal patut pangalengogan sultan.”  <div eID="gen2724" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1647"/><div sID="gen2725" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1647"/> Atilaw sultan Serses ma dayang-dayang Ester, yukna, “Sai sa makapikil magkajarihan angahinang la'at buwattilu? Wa'i maingga a'a ilu?”  <div eID="gen2725" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1648"/><div sID="gen2726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1648"/> Ya sambung si Ester, “Ya banta kami, ya a'a ab'nsihan kami, ya a'a jahallis, ya na si Haman!” <div eID="gen2726" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2727" type="paragraph"/> Na, magtūy tināw maka amidpid si Haman ma matahan sultan maka dayang-dayang.

verses.name: Esther 7:7
verses.text: Manjari, an'ngge sultan kabowa astolna ati nibbahan e'na inumanna bo' paluwas ni halaman astana'. Sali' ta'nda'-nda' e' si Haman bang ai hukuman pinat'kkahan iya e' sultan ma buwat ganta'anna, angkan magpa'bba iya maina'an supaya magpatiase' ma dayang-dayang Ester ma pasal kallumna.  <div eID="gen2727" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1649"/><div sID="gen2728" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1649"/> Ma pagbalik sultan min halaman ni bay pagjamuhan, ta'nda' e'na si Haman pak'ppang ma tingkō'an ya pasandigan si Ester. Angkan angasla to'ongan sultan, yukna, “Iya gi' itu! Ya makatawakkal angusiba'an dayang-dayang maitu gi' ma deyomanku?” <div eID="gen2728" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2729" type="paragraph"/> Ma halam gi' aubus bay h'lling sultan, magtūy tinambunan na kōk si Haman e' saga sosoho'an sultan.

verses.name: Esther 7:9
verses.text: Ah'lling dakayu' yunuk tendog sultan ya niōnan si Harbona, yuk-i, “Aniya' panganggantungan sangpū' maka dda d'ppa langkawna maina'an ma atag luma' si Haman. Bay pinahinang e'na arak panganggantungan si Murdikay, ya a'a bay amaluwas llingna supaya ka nihāp, tuwan sultan!” <div eID="gen2729" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen2730" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy ah'lling sultan, “Gantungunbi mahē' si Haman!”

verses.name: Esther 7:10
verses.text: Angkan mahē' bay ginantung si Haman ma panganggantungan arak bay pamapatayan si Murdikay. Jari yampa pakō' kagit atay sultan.  <div eID="gen2730" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.7"/> <div eID="gen2722" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1650"/><div sID="gen2731" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' Panoho'an Sultan Panabang ma saga Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen2732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1650"/> Ma llaw he'-i du, bay pamuwan e' sultan Serses ma dayang-dayang Ester kamemon pangalta' bay suku' si Haman ya banta bangsa Yahudi. Si Murdikay isab bay binuwanan kapatut pahadil ni sultan, sabab kahaka'an e' dayang-dayang Ester in iya maka si Murdikay maglahasiya'.

verses.name: Esther 8:2
verses.text: Nihurusan e' sultan singsingna ati sōnganna ni si Murdikay. Ya na singsing taga-gindan bay ma si Haman tagna', sagō' tabawi' na e' sultan. Pinat'nna' isab si Murdikay e' si Ester magatas-pikil ma bay pangalta' si Haman.  <div eID="gen2732" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1651"/><div sID="gen2733" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1651"/> Pagubus, pabalik si Ester anganjunjung ma sultan, maka he'na pasujud maka anangis ma tape'na. Ya pangamu'na bang pa'in pinahalam kagara'an si Haman bangsa Agag, arak pangamula saga bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Esther 8:4
verses.text: Pinabantang e' sultan bastunna bulawan tudju ni si Ester ati pabuhat iya bo' an'ngge ma dahuan sultan e'.  <div eID="gen2733" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1652"/><div sID="gen2734" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1652"/> Ah'lling si Ester, yukna, “Tuwan sultan, bang ka bilahi, maka bang ka ka'amuhan ma aku, maka bang taluwa' isab ma kira-kirahannu, aniya' panganjunjungku ma ka'a. Tuwan, bang pa'in ka amasulat panoho'an pamahalam sara' bay pinasulat e' si Haman anak si Hammedata, ya bangsa Agag e'. Ya maksud si Haman subay nilaglag kamemon saga bangsa Yahudi ma katilibut pagsultanannu.

verses.name: Esther 8:6
verses.text: Buwattitu panganjunjungku sabab mbal kasandalanku bang tum'kka kala'atan ni saga pagkahiku bangsa Yahudi. Ya lagi'na bang alaglag saga kakampunganku.”  <div eID="gen2734" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1653"/><div sID="gen2735" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1653"/> Ya sambung sultan Serses ni si Ester maka ni si Murdikay bangsa Yahudi, yukna, “Ma sabab bay pangala'at si Haman ma saga bangsabi angkan bay pamuwanku pangalta'na ma dayang-dayang Ester. Bay iya ginantung isab pinapatay ma panganggantungan.

verses.name: Esther 8:8
verses.text: Na, ma buwattina'an anulat ka saddī sara'-panoho'an ma deyo'an ōnku. Sulatun bang ai kabaya'annu pasal saga bangsanu Yahudi. Pagubus, sāpin maka singsingku. Sabab ai-ai tasulat ma deyo'an ōnku mbal tapahalam bang bay na kasāpan e' singsingku.”  <div eID="gen2735" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1654"/><div sID="gen2736" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1654"/> Jari itu, ma kat'llumbulan, karuwampū' ka t'llung'llaw ma bulan Siban, pinalinganan saga magsusulat ya sosoho'an sultan. Tasulat e' sigām kamemon panoho'an si Murdikay ma saga bangsa Yahudi, maka ma saga gubnul katapusan alanga, maka ma saga kagubnulan pasunu' sampay saga a'a bangsahan ma saga dahatus maka duwampū' maka pitu' paglahat tinagna'an min lahat Indiya sampay ni lahat Eteyopa. Tasulat saga panoho'an itu ma bahasa maka sulatan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya maka ma bahasa bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Esther 8:10
verses.text: Tasulat kamemonna itu e' si Murdikay ma deyo'an ōn sultan Serses bo' sināpan maka singsingna. Pagubus, pinabowa e'na ma saga magbobowa sulat ya pakura' ma saga kura' al'kkas ya asal sinakapan sultan.  <div eID="gen2736" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1655"/><div sID="gen2737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1655"/> Bang ma panoho'an sultan itu, in bangsa Yahudi kabuwanan kapatut magdakayu' angatuhan di-sigām. Binuwanan sigām kapatut amono' maka angalaglag saga sundalu, minsan ai bangsa, minsan maingga lahat, sasuku ya parugpak ma sigām maka anak-h'nda sigām. Binuwanan sigām kapatut isab angalangpas pangalta' saga palbantahan sigām.

verses.name: Esther 8:12
verses.text: Jari ni'iddahan llaw kasangpū' ka t'llu ma bulan Adar, ya bulan kasangpū' ka duwa. Ya na llaw kapangahinang saga Yahudi ma panoho'an itu maina'an ma kamemon saga paglahat ya suku' sultan Serses.

verses.name: Esther 8:13
verses.text: Jari in sara'-panoho'an itu sinō' sinulat pinaheka bo' pinatanyag ni kamemon paglahat maka ni kamemon manusiya' ya magsaddī-saddī bangsa, bo' supaya sakap saga bangsa Yahudi amalos ma saga banta sigām bang ta'abut na llaw bay pangidda he'.

verses.name: Esther 8:14
verses.text: Pinarai'-dai' e' sultan saga a'a magbobowa sulat ati pauntas na ma saga kura' ya asal sinakapan sultan. Pinasaplag isab panoho'an itu ma kuta' Susa.  <div eID="gen2737" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1656"/><div sID="gen2738" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1656"/> Manjari paluwas si Murdikay min matahan sultan maka e'na magbinadju' s'mmek bangsahan walna' bilu maka pote'. Magsinaruk isab iya korona bulawan aheya, magjuba iya kakana' taluk ahāp hinanganna. Ati aheya paglami-lami ma da'ira Susa ma waktu inān.

verses.name: Esther 8:16
verses.text: Aheya kakōgan maka kalasigan ma saga Yahudi, pinagmahaltabatan isab sigām e' kamemon.

verses.name: Esther 8:17
verses.text: Sakali aniya' aheya to'ongan kakōgan saga bangsa Yahudi ma kamemon paglahat maka da'ira ya bay kapasampayan sara' panoho'an sultan inān. Magjamu sigām maka maglami-lami. Aheka isab saddī bangsa bay magyahudi-yahudi di-sigām ma sabab kaheya tāw sigām ma bangsa Yahudi.  <div eID="gen2738" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.8"/> <div eID="gen2731" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1657"/><div sID="gen2739" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'ugan saga Bangsa Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen2740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1657"/> Ma kasangpū' ka t'llung'llaw ma bulan Adar, ya bulan kasangpū' karuwa, ta'abut na waktu pamatuman bay panoho'an sultan. Ya du ina'an llaw bay niholat asal e' saga palbantahan bangsa Yahudi, ya llaw arak panganda'ug sigām. Sagō' ya kaluwasanna, bangsa Yahudi ya anganda'ug ma saga a'a ab'nsihan sigām.

verses.name: Esther 9:2
verses.text: Bay magtipun saga bangsa Yahudi ma saga da'ira ya kat'nna'an sigām ma katilibut paglahat ya beya' ma sultan Serses. Magsakap sigām angatuhan sasuku angamohot angala'at sigām. Jari halam aniya' sai-sai bay maka'atu ma bangsa Yahudi ma llaw ina'an, sabab tināw ma sigām saga a'a kamemon min saddī-saddī bangsa.

verses.name: Esther 9:3
verses.text: Tinabangan isab bangsa Yahudi itu e' kamemon saga a'a bangsahan ma kalahat-lahatan inān, e' saga gubnul katapusan alanga, maka saga kagubnulan pasunu' sampay saga wakil sultan, sabab sinōd du isab sigām tāw ma si Murdikay.

verses.name: Esther 9:4
verses.text: Alanga asal kag'llal si Murdikay itu ma deyom astana' maka atanyag na isab pagka'a'ana ma katilibut paglahat. Pasōng na pa'in kawasana.  <div eID="gen2740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1658"/><div sID="gen2741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1658"/> Jari tapapatay e' saga bangsa Yahudi saga banta sigām, binono' maka kalis sampay abugtang na kamemon, ati tahinang e' saga Yahudi ai-ai kabaya'an sigām ma sasuku ab'nsihan sigām.

verses.name: Esther 9:6
verses.text: Lima hatus heka a'a bay tapapatay sigām ma kuta' Susa sadja.

verses.name: Esther 9:7
verses.text: Bay isab tapapatay e' sigām disi Parsandata, Dalpon, Aspata,

verses.name: Esther 9:8
verses.text: Porata, Adarya, Aridata,

verses.name: Esther 9:9
verses.text: Palmasta, Arisai, Aridai maka si Baysata,

verses.name: Esther 9:10
verses.text: sangpū' puhu' anak si Haman l'lla. Si Haman itu anak si Hammedata, banta asal saga bangsa Yahudi. Sagō' halam aniya' pangalta' bay tataban e' saga Yahudi ma waktu ina'an.  <div eID="gen2741" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1659"/><div sID="gen2742" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1659"/> Ma llaw he'-i du bay kahaka'an sultan bang pila puhu' bay tapapatay ma kuta' Susa.

verses.name: Esther 9:12
verses.text: Yuk sultan ni dayang-dayang Ester, “Bang hal ma kuta' Susa itu lima hatus heka a'a maka sangpū' puhu' anak si Haman ya bay tapapatay e' saga bangsa Yahudi, ai lagi' bahā' tahinang e' sigām ma saga kasehe'an paglahat? Na, ai pangamu'nu, pamuwanku du ma ka'a. Minsan ai panganjunjungnu, tantu ka dūlanku.”  <div eID="gen2742" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1660"/><div sID="gen2743" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1660"/> Ya sambung dayang-dayang Ester, “Bang makasulut ma ka'a, tuwan sultan, tugutin saga Yahudi ma Susa angahinang panoho'annu itu salung buwat du bay kapangahinang sigām llaw itu. Maka soho'un ginantung bangkay saga anak si Haman l'lla sangpū' hekana inān.”  <div eID="gen2743" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1661"/><div sID="gen2744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1661"/> Angkan magpanoho'an sultan, sinō' bineya' pangamu' si Ester itu. Pinatanyag panoho'anna ma da'ira Susa ati ginantung bangkay saga anak si Haman sangpū' hekana.

verses.name: Esther 9:15
verses.text: Manjari saga bangsa Yahudi ma Susa inān bay magdakayu' ma kasangpū' ka'mpat llaw ma bulan Adar, ati tapapatay e' sigām t'llu hatus heka a'a ma Susa, sagō' halam sigām bay anaban maina'an.

verses.name: Esther 9:16
verses.text: Salta', kasehe'an saga Yahudi ya ma saga paglahat beya' ma pagsultanan e', bay isab magdakayu' angatu ma saga banta sigām bo' sigām makalimaya. Pitumpū' ka lima ngibu heka a'a ya tapapatay e' sigām, sagō' halam sigām bay anaban minsan ai.

verses.name: Esther 9:17
verses.text: Tahinang saga kahinangan itu ma bulan Adar, ma kasangpū' ka t'llu'ng'llaw, ati ta'abut pa'in kasangpū' ka mpat llawna in kaheka'an sigām bay pahali. Manjari in llaw inān tahinang e' sigām llaw pagjamu maka paglami-lami.  <div eID="gen2744" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2739" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1662"/><div sID="gen2745" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Hinang Purim</title> <div sID="gen2746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1662"/> Malaingkan saga Yahudi ma da'ira Susa bay magtimuk ma kasangpū' ka t'llu'ng'llaw sampay ni sangpū' ka mpat llaw ma bulan inān. Ta'abut pa'in kasangpū' ka limang'llaw, ya na llaw kahali sigām, tahinang llaw inān pagjamu maka paglami-lami sigām.

verses.name: Esther 9:19
verses.text: Ya he' sababanna angkan saga bangsa Yahudi ya pat'nna' ma kareya-reyahan amogbogan llaw kasangpū' ka mpat ma bulan Adar e'. Ya na inān llaw pagjamu maka paglami-lami sigām, llaw isab pagbuwan-buwan sigām dansehe'an.  <div eID="gen2746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1663"/><div sID="gen2747" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1663"/> Manjari tasulat e' si Murdikay pasal saga kahālan itu. Aniya' isab sulat bay pinabeya' e'na ni kamemon bangsa Yahudi ma saga paglahat atā-asekot ya beya' ma pagsultanan si Serses.

verses.name: Esther 9:21
verses.text: Sinoho' sigām amogbogan karuwa llaw itu sakahaba' tahun ma bulan Adar, hatina kasangpū' ka mpat llaw sampay kasangpū' ka lima llaw.

verses.name: Esther 9:22
verses.text: Pangentoman ko' inān ma waktu bay kalimaya sigām min saga banta sigām, waktu isab kapamapinda kasusahan sigām ni kakōgan, maka karukka'an sigām ni kalami-lamihan. Ya panulat isab e' si Murdikay ma sigām, in llaw mulliya itu subay llaw pagjamu maka paglami-lami sigām, llaw isab pagbuwan-buwan pagkakan ni kasehe'an sigām maka waktu pagbuwan sarakka ma saga miskin.  <div eID="gen2747" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1664"/><div sID="gen2748" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1664"/> Manjari magdakayu' pikilan saga Yahudi pasal pagjamu ya bay tinagna'an e' sigām ma waktu inān, hatina subay binogbogan na pa'in buwat bay panulat si Murdikay ma sigām e'.

verses.name: Esther 9:24
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', sabab si Haman anak si Hammedata bangsa Agag, ya amantahan saga Yahudi, bay magisun angalaglag sigām kamemon. Bay iya magko'ot-ko'ot isab bo' tatugpang bang ai llaw pangalaglag maka pangaligis ma sigām. (‘Pur’ ya ōn pagko'ot e'.)

verses.name: Esther 9:25
verses.text: Sagō' kahaka'an pa'in sultan pasal kaisunan si Haman itu, bay ya amaniya' sulat panoho'an bo' pinapelleng ni si Haman saga kala'atan bay pagisunanna pasal bangsa Yahudi. Panoho'an sultan isab in si Haman subay ginantung pinapatay sambeya' maka bangkay saga anakna l'lla.

verses.name: Esther 9:26
verses.text: (‘Purim’ ya pangōn saga Yahudi ma llaw inān sabab ‘pur’ ya ōn pagko'ot e'.) Manjari itu, ma sabab kamemon ya bay pinasulat inān e' si Murdikay, maka ma sabab ai-ai bay ta'nda' e' sigām maka bay kalabayan sigām,

verses.name: Esther 9:27
verses.text: aniya' niniyat e' saga bangsa Yahudi. Hatina in duwa llaw Purim itu subay binogbogan sakahaba' tahun e' sigām magtubu'-manubu' sampay saga saddī bangsa ya palamud ma sigām. In untulan maka waktu bay pangidda ma jaman ina'an subay binogbogan na pa'in e' sigām.

verses.name: Esther 9:28
verses.text: Saga llaw Purim itu subay nientom maka binogbogan e' kamemon saga Yahudi magtautai'anak, magtubu'-manubu', ma saga paglahat kamemon maka ma da'ira kamemon. Subay mbal nibbahan atawa alungay min pangentom saga panubu' sigām.  <div eID="gen2748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1665"/><div sID="gen2749" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1665"/> Manjari dayang-dayang Ester anak si Abiha'il, maka si Murdikay ya Yahudi, bay magdakayu' amasulat sulat karuwana itu supaya pinasab'nnal saga panoho'an pasal Hinang Purim. Tu'ud alanga kapatut sigām magpanoho'an buwattē'.

verses.name: Esther 9:30
verses.text: Aniya' isab sulat bay pinabeya' e' si Murdikay ni kamemon saga Yahudi ma dahatus duwampū' ka pitu' paglahat ya beya' ma pagsultanan sultan Serses. Ya lapal sulat inān lapal pamahāp pangatayan maka pamohogot iman,

verses.name: Esther 9:31
verses.text: supaya pinatantu llaw Purim itu ma waktu bay pangidda e' disi Murdikay ya Yahudi maka dayang-dayang Ester. Abeya' isab kamemon saga Yahudi. Bay sigām amat'nna'an di-sigām waktu maka untulan ma pasal pagpuwasa maka pagdukka ya pameya'an sigām magtubu'-manubu'.

verses.name: Esther 9:32
verses.text: Jari in kal'ngnganan itu bay pinatuman ma panoho'an ya tapasulat e' si Ester ma pasal Purim ati tasulat isab ma kitab pagsusulatan.  <div eID="gen2749" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Esth.9"/> <div eID="gen2745" type="section"/>

verses.name: Esther 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1666"/><div sID="gen2750" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabantugan si Murdikay</title> <div sID="gen2751" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1666"/> Na, bay amabayad buwis sultan Serses ma kamemon saga paglahat ya beya' ma pagsultananna, sampay ni saga lahatna katapusan alawak.

verses.name: Esther 10:2
verses.text: Kamemon kahinangan ya tahinang e' sultan itu min kosogna maka min ga'osna, maka salsila pasal kapamalangana ma si Murdikay maka kabantugan ya pamuwan ma iya e' sultan, na, wa'i tasulat ma kitab pagsusulatan sultan, ya panulatan saga kahālan ma kasultanan bay ma lahat Persiya maka Midiya.

verses.name: Esther 10:3
verses.text: Si Murdikay ya pasunu' langana ni sultan Serses, maka in iya katapusan alanga ma bangsana Yahudi. Landu' to'ongan iya pinagaddatan e' saga pagkahina Yahudi sabab atukid iya angahinang kahāpan ma sigām. Aheya isab pagka'inagonna ma sigām magtubu'-manubu'.  <div eID="gen2751" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen2750" type="section"/> <div eID="gen2663" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Esth.10"/> <div eID="gen2658" osisID="Esth" type="book"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1667"/><div sID="gen2760" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 1</title> <lg sID="gen2761"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1667"/> Aheya kahāpan ma a'a<l eID="gen2762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2763"/>sasuku mbal ameya' gara' min a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen2763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2764"/>sasuku isab mbal pasehe' ma a'a pangandusa.<l eID="gen2764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2765"/>Mbal iya palamud ma saga a'a ya angandali'it Tuhan,<l eID="gen2765" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2766"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:2
verses.text: saguwā' kahōpan iya ma sara' ya panoho'anna ma manusiya'.<l eID="gen2766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2767"/>Ya he' kinannal e'na llaw-sangom.<l eID="gen2767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2768"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:3
verses.text: A'a inān sali' sapantun kayu tinanom ma bihing sapa',<l eID="gen2768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2769"/>ya amuwan buwa' ma musimna du.<l eID="gen2769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2770"/>Minsan painay mbal pak'llos dahunna.<l eID="gen2770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2771"/>Ai-ai hinangna, ahāp sadja tungbasna.<l eID="gen2771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:4
verses.text: Malaingkan saga a'a jahulaka' mbal buwattē'.<l eID="gen2772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2773"/>Sapantun sigām hampa' pai ya tabowa paleyang e' baliyu.<l eID="gen2773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2774"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:5
verses.text: Ya he' sababna angkan saga a'a jahulaka'<l eID="gen2774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2775"/>mbal makara'awa bang ta'abut nihukum,<l eID="gen2775" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2776"/>mbal isab pinalamud ma sasuku abontol atayna tudju ni Tuhan.<l eID="gen2776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:6
verses.text: Saga a'a abontol niayura na pa'in e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen2777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2778"/>sagō' saga a'a jahulaka' ala'at sadja kat'kkahan sigām.<l eID="gen2778" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2761"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.1"/> <div eID="gen2760" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1668"/><div sID="gen2779" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 2</title> <lg sID="gen2780"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1668"/> Angay angkan magbantu saga kabangsa-bangsahan,<l eID="gen2781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2782"/>angay sigām magisun ma halam aniya' pūsna?<l eID="gen2782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2783"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:2
verses.text: Magsakap di-sigām saga kasultanan,<l eID="gen2783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2784"/>magsakaum saga pagnakura'an<l eID="gen2784" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2785"/>bo' angatu ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen2785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2786"/>maka ma Al-Masi ya tapene'na.<l eID="gen2786" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2787"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:3
verses.text: Maghimumungan saga a'a inān, yuk-i,<l eID="gen2787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2788"/>“Gom kitam papuwas min komkoman sigām,<l eID="gen2788" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2789"/>gom b'kkattam saga kili-kili ya pangengkot sigām.”<l eID="gen2789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2790"/>
