verses.name: Psalms 2:4
verses.text: Saguwā' pagtittowahan sigām he' Tuhan,<l eID="gen2790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2791"/>ya aningkō' ma sulga' magkabaya'an ma kamemon.<l eID="gen2791" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2792"/>Pinagtunggīngan sigām e' Panghū'.<l eID="gen2792" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2793"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:5
verses.text: Pinabukagan saga a'a inān kabowa pangastolna,<l eID="gen2793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2794"/>pinakitāw sigām ma sabab landu' akagit atayna.<l eID="gen2794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2795"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:6
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan ma sigām, “O'o, sultan bay tapatingkō'ku,<l eID="gen2795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2796"/>ina'an ma Būd Siyun, ya būd kamulliyahanku.”<l eID="gen2796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2797"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:7
verses.text: Ya panambung sultan e', “Pasaplagku lapal<l eID="gen2797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2798"/>ya pangallam aku he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.”<l eID="gen2798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2799"/>Yukna ma aku, “Ka'a ilu tahinang anakku na.<l eID="gen2799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2800"/>Aku ya Mma'nu tinagna'an min llaw itu.<l eID="gen2800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2801"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:8
verses.text: Bang aku ya pangamu'annu,<l eID="gen2801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2802"/>pamusaka'ku ma ka'a kamemon bangsa,<l eID="gen2802" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2803"/>pamasuku'ku ma ka'a sakalibutan dunya.<l eID="gen2803" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2804"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:9
verses.text: Ka'a ya amarinta ma kabangsa-bangsahan,<l eID="gen2804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2805"/>ati apaslod pamarintanu sapantun tungkud basi'.<l eID="gen2805" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2806"/>Alopot sigām kamemon sali' dalil paliyuk.”<l eID="gen2806" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2807"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:10
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am saga sultan, “Pata'u kam.<l eID="gen2807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2808"/>Pahalli' kam, sasuku magbabaya' ma babaw dunya.<l eID="gen2808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2809"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:11
verses.text: Magpatireyo' kam ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen2809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2810"/>pagkoyaginbi iya hinabubi magpamidpid.<l eID="gen2810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2811"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:12
verses.text: Pasiyum kam ma Anakna, ya aniya' kakagit atayna,<l eID="gen2811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2812"/>ati taggaha' kam t'kkahan mulka'na.<l eID="gen2812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2813"/>Sabab pasulapput astolna saru'un-du'un,<l eID="gen2813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2814"/>malaingkan aheya kahāpan ma sasuku makabāk patapukan ma iya.”<l eID="gen2814" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2780"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.2"/> <div eID="gen2779" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1669"/><div sID="gen2815" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 3</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud ma waktu kalahina min anakna si Absalom</title> <lg sID="gen2816"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1669"/> O Yawe, aheka saga a'a amantahan aku!<l eID="gen2817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2818"/>Kapilahan aku e' saga a'a magpanagga' aku.<l eID="gen2818" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2819"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:2
verses.text: Aheka isab saga a'a anunggīngan aku, yuk-i,<l eID="gen2819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2820"/>“Mbal iya pinuwas e' Tuhan min kamulahan.”<l eID="gen2820" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2821"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:3
verses.text: Saguwā' ka'a ya tampanku, O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen2821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2822"/>Ka'a ya amuwanan aku kasahaya'an.<l eID="gen2822" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2823"/>Ka'a ya amahogot kamahaldika'anku.<l eID="gen2823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:4
verses.text: Bang aku parahing ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen2824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2825"/>sinambungan aku e'na min būdna mulliya.<l eID="gen2825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2826"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:5
verses.text: Ahāp e'ku atuli, asannang isab kabati'ku,<l eID="gen2826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2827"/>sabab binogbogan aku e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen2827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2828"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:6
verses.text: Mbal aku tināw ma saga bantaku ibu-ibuhan,<l eID="gen2828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2829"/>ya angalibutan aku ma paruruwambila'.<l eID="gen2829" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2830"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:7
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pasa'ut ka,<l eID="gen2830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2831"/>lappasun aku min ka'aniban.<l eID="gen2831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2832"/>Suntukun palbantahanku ma baihu' sigām,<l eID="gen2832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2833"/>paglopotun empon sigām.<l eID="gen2833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2834"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:8
verses.text: Si Yawe ya angaliyusan aku min kamulahan.<l eID="gen2834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2835"/>Bang pa'in buwanannu kahāpan saga a'a suku'nu.<l eID="gen2835" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2816"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.3"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1670"/><div sID="gen2836" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 8</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen2837"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1670"/> O Yawe, ka'a pagpanghū'an kami,<l eID="gen2838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2839"/>kaheya du pa'in mahaltabatnu ma kaluha'an dunya!<l eID="gen2839" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2840"/>Alanga sahayanu min kapitu' lapis langit.<l eID="gen2840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2841"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:2
verses.text: Min kahandaknu saga kamanahutan amudji ōnnu,<l eID="gen2841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2842"/>saga anak duru'an lagi' ananglitan ka'a.<l eID="gen2842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2843"/>Angkan mbal maka'atu saga palbantahan,<l eID="gen2843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2844"/>mbal makatukas saga magbabalos.<l eID="gen2844" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2845"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:3
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bang aku pahangad ni langit<l eID="gen2845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2846"/>bo' angira-ngira kahinangan tangannu,<l eID="gen2846" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2847"/>bang nda'ku bulan maka saga bitu'un<l eID="gen2847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2848"/>ya bay pat'nna'nu ma b'ttong langit,<l eID="gen2848" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2849"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:4
verses.text: tabowa aku atilaw pasal kami manusiya'.<l eID="gen2849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2850"/>Ai kapūsan kami angkan kami pagka'inagonannu?<l eID="gen2850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2851"/>Angay kannalnu bangsa manusiya' ya mbal anatas itu?<l eID="gen2851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2852"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:5
verses.text: Pat'nna'nu kami areyo' dangkuri' min saga bangsa mala'ikat ya porol ma sulga'.<l eID="gen2852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2853"/>Buwanannu kami kasanglitan maka kabantugan.<l eID="gen2853" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2854"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:6
verses.text: Buwanannu kami kapatut magbaya'<l eID="gen2854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2855"/>ma kamemon ai-ai bay paniya'nu,<l eID="gen2855" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2856"/>bo' kami makapagnakura' ma kamemon papanjarihan,<l eID="gen2856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2857"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:7
verses.text: saga sapi' maka saga bili-bili, hayop ni'ipat,<l eID="gen2857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2858"/>maka saga sattuwa talun.<l eID="gen2858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2859"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:8
verses.text: Makapagagi kami ma saga manuk-manuk,<l eID="gen2859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2860"/>maka ma kaginisan daing tahik maka sattuwa dilaut.<l eID="gen2860" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2861"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:9
verses.text: O Yawe, ya pagpanghū'an kami,<l eID="gen2861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2862"/>kaheya du pa'in mahaltabatnu ma kaluha'an dunya!<l eID="gen2862" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2837"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.8"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1671"/><div sID="gen2863" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 13</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen2864"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1671"/> O Yawe, sumiyan aku patandung pabalik ni ataynu?<l eID="gen2865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2866"/>Sumiyan ka pabaihu' ni aku pabīng?<l eID="gen2866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2867"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:2
verses.text: Sumiyan bahā' pahondong kalengog pikilanku itu,<l eID="gen2867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2868"/>sabab llaw-sangom pasangdan na pa'in kasusahanku.<l eID="gen2868" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2869"/>Sumiyan pahali saga bantaku anganda'ug min aku?<l eID="gen2869" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2870"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:3
verses.text: O Yawe, Tuhanku, palingi' gi' ka anambungan aku.<l eID="gen2870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2871"/>Pasawahun pang'nda'ku, da'a aku pasagarin amatay.<l eID="gen2871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2872"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:4
verses.text: Sabab bang aku mbal dūlannu,<l eID="gen2872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2873"/>tantu aku niudju' e' kuntaraku, yuk-i,<l eID="gen2873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2874"/>“Nē! Tara'ug na ka!”<l eID="gen2874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2875"/>Ati magkalasigan saga banta ma sabab kaiya'anku.<l eID="gen2875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2876"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:5
verses.text: Saguwā' angandol sadja aku ma kasi-lasanu tuman,<l eID="gen2876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2877"/>maka magkōg-koyag ma sabab kapanglappasnu.<l eID="gen2877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2878"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:6
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, magkalang aku ni ka'a,<l eID="gen2878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2879"/>sabab kahāpnu ma aku mbal tapula'-pula'.<l eID="gen2879" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2864"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.13"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1672"/><div sID="gen2880" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 16</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen2881"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1672"/> Ya Tuhan, hampanin aku,<l eID="gen2882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2883"/>sabab ka'a ya patapukanku.<l eID="gen2883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2884"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: Yukku ni si Yawe, “Ka'a ya Panghū'ku,<l eID="gen2884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2885"/>Halam aniya' palsuku'anku ahāp saddī min ka'a.”<l eID="gen2885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2886"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: Babantugun saga a'a ma lahat itu,<l eID="gen2886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2887"/>ya atotog ameya' ma kabaya'an Tuhan.<l eID="gen2887" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2888"/>Landu' aku kasulutan ma sigām.<l eID="gen2888" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2889"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: Malaingkan bang a'a ameya' ma tuhan-tuhan saddī,<l eID="gen2889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2890"/>pak'nnop na pa'in kasusahan sigām.<l eID="gen2890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2891"/>Mbal aku palamud ma a'a inān anukbal laha',<l eID="gen2891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2892"/>mbal minsan sibahatku ōn saga pagtuhanan sigām.<l eID="gen2892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2893"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: Ka'a <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, sapantun pusaka'ku,<l eID="gen2893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2894"/>Ka'a ya palsuku'anku,<l eID="gen2894" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2895"/>ahāp kasōngan ya pangangganta'nu ma aku.<l eID="gen2895" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2896"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: Kabuwanan aku tana' ma lahat kasalamatan,<l eID="gen2896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2897"/>landu' ahāp ya pamusaka'nu aku.<l eID="gen2897" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2898"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: Sanglitanku si Yawe ya angahūgan aku gara'.<l eID="gen2898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2899"/>Minsan ma waktu sangom, kapandu'an aku<l eID="gen2899" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2900"/>luwas min pandu' ya ma deyom pangatayanku.<l eID="gen2900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2901"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: Si Yawe ya pataptap ma pangatayanku.<l eID="gen2901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2902"/>Itiya' iya ma bihingku,<l eID="gen2902" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2903"/>angkan aku mbal tabowa pajudjal.<l eID="gen2903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2904"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: Magkōg-koyag aku sampay min deyom atay,<l eID="gen2904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2905"/>asalamat pamarananku,<l eID="gen2905" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2906"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: sabab mbal aku siya-siyanu ma deyom ahirat.<l eID="gen2906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2907"/>Mbal aku pasagarannu angahalu' ma deyom paliyangan.<l eID="gen2907" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2908"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: Tantu aku tuli'annu lān ya amowa ni kallum.<l eID="gen2908" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2909"/>Sinōd aku kōg-koyag ma sabab kamaitunu ma aku,<l eID="gen2909" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2910"/>kahōpan aku e' kalasigan ya anatas ni kasaumulan<l eID="gen2910" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2911"/>bang ta'abutku na haddaratnu.<l eID="gen2911" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2881"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.16"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.17"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:50
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.18"/> <div eID="gen2880" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1673"/><div sID="gen2912" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 19</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen2913"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1673"/> Atanyag sanglit-sahaya Tuhan<l eID="gen2914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2915"/>ma sabab paltanda'an ya ta'nda'ta ma b'ttong langit.<l eID="gen2915" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2916"/>Abantug kapandayan Tuhan<l eID="gen2916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2917"/>ma sabab saga pandoga ma tonga'an ayan.<l eID="gen2917" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2918"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: Kahaba'-kahaba' llaw binuwanan kitam lapal,<l eID="gen2918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2919"/>kahaba'-kahaba' sangom binuwanan kitam panghati.<l eID="gen2919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2920"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
verses.text: In bitu'un maka llaw itu ta'nda' asal ma sabarang lahat,<l eID="gen2920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2921"/>pa'abut lapal sigām ni kalibutan dunya.<l eID="gen2921" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2922"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: Pasaplag pandu' sigām ni kamemon bangsa,<l eID="gen2922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2923"/>Pasampay bissala sigām ni mpat pidju alam.<l eID="gen2923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2924"/>In mata llaw sali' sapantun l'lla pangantin<l eID="gen2924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2925"/>bay nihinangan luma' e' Tuhan ma langit, tampal ni sobangan.<l eID="gen2925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2926"/>Ati paluwas iya minnē' buwat a'a bastigan<l eID="gen2926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2927"/>ya kinōgan magdagan ma paglomba'an.<l eID="gen2927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: Pasaplag pandu' sigām ni kamemon bangsa,<l eID="gen2922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2923"/>Pasampay bissala sigām ni mpat pidju alam.<l eID="gen2923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2924"/>In mata llaw sali' sapantun l'lla pangantin<l eID="gen2924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2925"/>bay nihinangan luma' e' Tuhan ma langit, tampal ni sobangan.<l eID="gen2925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2926"/>Ati paluwas iya minnē' buwat a'a bastigan<l eID="gen2926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2927"/>ya kinōgan magdagan ma paglomba'an.<l eID="gen2927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: Pasobang mata llaw min bihing langit dakayu'<l eID="gen2928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2929"/>bo' pas'ddop ni bihingna dakayu',<l eID="gen2929" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2930"/>maka halam aniya' minsan ai mbal taluwa' pasu'na.<l eID="gen2930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2931"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: Ajukup asal sara' bay pinat'nna' e' si Yawe,<l eID="gen2931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2932"/>ya na sara' makahayang palnyawahan manusiya'.<l eID="gen2932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2933"/>Kapangandolan ai-ai pangahatul e' si Yawe,<l eID="gen2933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2934"/>ya na hatulan pangā'an pangita'u e' a'a bilahi pinandu'an.<l eID="gen2934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2935"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: Abontol saga pamandu' si Yawe,<l eID="gen2935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2936"/>ya na pandu' makalasig deyom pikilan.<l eID="gen2936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2937"/>Asawa panoho'an si Yawe,<l eID="gen2937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2938"/>ya na panoho'an makaranta' panghati manusiya'.<l eID="gen2938" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2939"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: Asussi pagmatāw ma si Yawe,<l eID="gen2939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2940"/>sabab taptap anatas ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen2940" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2941"/>Atuman kamemon pangahandak si Yawe,<l eID="gen2941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2942"/>a'adil lullun, halam aniya' salla'na minsan ai.<l eID="gen2942" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2943"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: Labi ahalga' pangahandakna min bulawan,<l eID="gen2943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2944"/>minsan bulawan porol landu' aheka.<l eID="gen2944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2945"/>Labi amamis min gula' buwani<l eID="gen2945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2946"/>minsan gula' masi am'ttak min sāng buwani.<l eID="gen2946" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2947"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:11
verses.text: Binanda'an sosoho'annu e' ai-ai pangahandaknu,<l eID="gen2947" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2948"/>maka aheya tungbas ma sasuku angisbat.<l eID="gen2948" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2949"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:12
verses.text: Sai bahā' makakilā kasā'an baranna?<l eID="gen2949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2950"/>Bang manjari ampunin aku ya dusa halam tasayuku.<l eID="gen2950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2951"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:13
verses.text: Hawirin aku bo' mbal magtu'ud angandusa.<l eID="gen2951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2952"/>Da'a aku pasagarin pinagbaya'an e' dusa pagtu'ud-tu'uran.<l eID="gen2952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2953"/>Jari mbal aku katōngan dusa,<l eID="gen2953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2954"/>ati abontol itikadku pagka halam bay makahinang dusa aheya.<l eID="gen2954" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2955"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:14
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bang pa'in ka kasulutan ma bissalaku maka ma hona'-hona'ku,<l eID="gen2955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2956"/>sabab ka'a ya batu-lakit pamalutanku,<l eID="gen2956" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2957"/>ka'a ya Manglalappas ma aku.<l eID="gen2957" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2913"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.19"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.20"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.21"/> <div eID="gen2912" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1674"/><div sID="gen2958" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 22</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen2959"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1674"/> O Tuhanku, angay aku siya-siyanu?<l eID="gen2960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2961"/>Angay ka palawak na pa'in min aku?<l eID="gen2961" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2962"/>Angay halam takalenu pangandahingku?<l eID="gen2962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: O Tuhanku, anganjunjung aku ni ka'a kahaba' llaw,<l eID="gen2963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2964"/>saguwā' mbal aku sambungannu.<l eID="gen2964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2965"/>Angamu'-ngamu' aku ni ka'a kahaba' sangom,<l eID="gen2965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2966"/>sagō' halam aniya' halianku.<l eID="gen2966" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2967"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: Malaingkan ilu ka aningkō' ma deyom kamahaldika'an.<l eID="gen2967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2968"/>Ka'a ya Tunggal Mahasussi, ya pinudji e' bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen2968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2969"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: Bay angiman ma ka'a saga kamatto'ahan kami,<l eID="gen2969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2970"/>bay sigām pasangdol ni ka'a ati liyusannu min kasigpitan.<l eID="gen2970" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2971"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: Bay sigām parahing ni ka'a, ati lappasannu,<l eID="gen2971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2972"/>bay sigām angandol ma ka'a, ati halam karapatan.<l eID="gen2972" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2973"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: Saguwā' aku itu sali' kalog tana', sali' ngga'i ka manusiya'.<l eID="gen2973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2974"/>Niudju' aku he' pagkahiku, nihalipulu e' kampungku.<l eID="gen2974" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2975"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:7
verses.text: Pinakaiya' aku he' sasuku ang'nda'.<l eID="gen2975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2976"/>Nihina' aku, pinagelong-elongan, pinagtunggīng.<l eID="gen2976" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2977"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:8
verses.text: Ya lling sigām ma aku, “A'a itu angandol ma si Yawe,<l eID="gen2977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2978"/>na, patabangta iya ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.<l eID="gen2978" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2979"/>Kalu iya pinuwas min kasigpitan,<l eID="gen2979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2980"/>pagka aheya lasa PANGHŪ' ma iya.”<l eID="gen2980" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2981"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:9
verses.text: Malaingkan, Tuhanku, ka'a ya bay amaluwas aku min kulunan ina'ku.<l eID="gen2981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2982"/>Tabowa aku angandol ma ka'a min kariki'-diki'ku gi',<l eID="gen2982" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2983"/>min waktuku onde' duru'an lagi'.<l eID="gen2983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2984"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:10
verses.text: Ka'a ya kaholatanku min llaw kapaganak ma aku,<l eID="gen2984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2985"/>ka'a ya Tuhanku sangay min kapangiram ma aku.<l eID="gen2985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:11
verses.text: Da'a kono' ka pala'an min aku,<l eID="gen2986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2987"/>sabab itiya' aku marai' taluwa' kasusahan.<l eID="gen2987" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2988"/>Luwal ka'a ya makatabang.<l eID="gen2988" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2989"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:12
verses.text: Sikapūn-pūnan ni aku ba'anan palbantahanku,<l eID="gen2989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2990"/>sapantun sapi' mandangan min lahat Basan.<l eID="gen2990" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2991"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:13
verses.text: Pinabanga' bowa' sigām tudju ni aku,<l eID="gen2991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2992"/>sapantun halimaw marai' na an'kkob, an'kkat.<l eID="gen2992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2993"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:14
verses.text: Angalongkoy anggauta'ku, magsalisi' lullun to'olangku.<l eID="gen2993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2994"/>Angalunuk atayku, ibarat lansuk atunaw e' pasu'.<l eID="gen2994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2995"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:15
verses.text: Katoho'an k'llongku, buwat katoho' buli' lapohan.<l eID="gen2995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2996"/>Angakkot d'lla'ku ni isi emponku,<l eID="gen2996" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2997"/>tahinangnu aku anginam bagunbun nalka'.<l eID="gen2997" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2998"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:16
verses.text: Aniya' sapantun ero' ma sakalibutku,<l eID="gen2998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2999"/>pinagtipunan aku he' a'a jahulaka'.<l eID="gen2999" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3000"/>Nilagbas e' sigām tape'-tanganku.<l eID="gen3000" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3001"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:17
verses.text: Ta'nda'an di-na bokogku kamemon,<l eID="gen3001" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3002"/>pinatong aku e' saga a'a ab'nsihan aku,<l eID="gen3002" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3003"/>kinōgan sigām ma kala'at pangluwahanku.<l eID="gen3003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3004"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:18
verses.text: Pinagbahagi'an s'mmekku he' sigām,<l eID="gen3004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3005"/>pinagko'ot-ko'ot badju'ku bang sai makarapu.<l eID="gen3005" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3006"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:19
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, da'a pa'in ka palawak min aku.<l eID="gen3006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3007"/>Ka'a ya ga'osanku, bang pa'in ka pasa'ut anabang.<l eID="gen3007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3008"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:20
verses.text: Tampanin aku bo' mbal taōk e' kalis.<l eID="gen3008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3009"/>Ahalga' ma aku nyawaku, angkan amu'ku pinuwas min kosog saga ero' itu.<l eID="gen3009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3010"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:21
verses.text: Liyusun aku min bowa' halimaw,<l eID="gen3010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3011"/>papuwasun aku min tanduk sapi' talun.<l eID="gen3011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:22
verses.text: Ati pasaplagku ōnnu ni dauranakanku,<l eID="gen3012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3013"/>pudjiku ka ma palhimpunan saga jama'anu.<l eID="gen3013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3014"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:23
verses.text: Ka'am ya magmatāw ma si Yawe, pudjihunbi!<l eID="gen3014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3015"/>Ka'am saga panubu' si Yakub, pagmahaltabatinbi!<l eID="gen3015" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3016"/>Ka'am bangsa Isra'il kamemon, hulmatunbi!<l eID="gen3016" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3017"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:24
verses.text: Sabab halam pabiyalna pagdahing saga a'a asukkal,<l eID="gen3017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3018"/>halam bay pasagaranna ma deyom kasigpitan.<l eID="gen3018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3019"/>Halam bay taikutanna sasuku angamu'-ngamu',<l eID="gen3019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3020"/>gom pa'in tabangna.<l eID="gen3020" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3021"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:25
verses.text: O Tuhan, ka'a ya pagpudjihanku ma palhimpunan aheya,<l eID="gen3021" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3022"/>suhulku isab najalku ma matahan saga a'a magmatāwan ka'a.<l eID="gen3022" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3023"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:26
verses.text: Amangan saga miskin ma sinosōng sampay sigām asso.<l eID="gen3023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3024"/>Sasuku kam angangut ma si Yawe ananglit du ma iya.<l eID="gen3024" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3025"/>Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam allum saumul-umul.<l eID="gen3025" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3026"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:27
verses.text: Kinannal si Yawe he' a'a kamemon ma mpat pidju alam itu,<l eID="gen3026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3027"/>ati papinda sigām magta'at ni iya.<l eID="gen3027" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3028"/>Magpudji sabarang bangsa ma alopanna,<l eID="gen3028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3029"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:28
verses.text: sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya tag-parintahan ma dunya.<l eID="gen3029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3030"/>Iya ya makapagagi ma kabangsa-bangsahan.<l eID="gen3030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3031"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:29
verses.text: Sasuku taga-karaya ma dunya itu, sigām balkanan,<l eID="gen3031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3032"/>pasujud du ma alopan Tuhan.<l eID="gen3032" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3033"/>Sasuku amole' lahat kamatayan magpatireyo' ma iya,<l eID="gen3033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3034"/>sampay saga a'a ya mbal makapakalluman di-sigām, pasujud du.<l eID="gen3034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3035"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:30
verses.text: Ni'isbat Tuhan e' panubu' magsuring-magsaingsing,<l eID="gen3035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3036"/>pinandu'an sigām pasal si Yawe ma sinosōng.<l eID="gen3036" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3037"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:31
verses.text: Ati sigām ya pas'lle' amatanyag ni saga a'a halam gi' palahil<l eID="gen3037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3038"/>pasal kabontolan ya tahinang e' Tuhan ma sabab a'a suku'na.<l eID="gen3038" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2959"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.22"/> <div eID="gen2958" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1675"/><div sID="gen3039" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 23</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3040"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1675"/> Si Yawe ya angipat aku, sapantun a'a angipat bili-bilina,<l eID="gen3041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3042"/>angkan halam aniya' kulang ma aku.<l eID="gen3042" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3043"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: Kahinangan aku he'na pahalian ma parang-parang alunuk,<l eID="gen3043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3044"/>niambit aku he'na ni atag bohe' kasannangan.<l eID="gen3044" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3045"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: Pinahayang nyawaku,<l eID="gen3045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3046"/>minaliman aku he'na ma lān abontol, ma sabab Ōnna kabantugan.<l eID="gen3046" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3047"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: Minsan palabayanku kal'ddoman lambung kamatay,<l eID="gen3047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3048"/>mbal aku atāw pinuhinga' sabab ka'a ya gapi'ku, O Tuhan.<l eID="gen3048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3049"/>Ilu tungkudnu maka soha'nu amuwanan aku kasalamatan baran.<l eID="gen3049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3050"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: Sakapannu aku jamuhan ma alopan palbantahanku.<l eID="gen3050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3051"/>Ni'ns'llanan he'nu kōkku, tanda' sin lasanu ma aku.<l eID="gen3051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3052"/>Palasay sawanku pagka ap'nno' he' pahala'.<l eID="gen3052" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3053"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: Tantu aku pinasuku'an kahāpan,<l eID="gen3053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3054"/>tantu tinogolan lasanu ma aku sat'ggolku allum.<l eID="gen3054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3055"/>Ati luma' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya pat'nna'anku saumul-umul.<l eID="gen3055" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3040"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.23"/> <div eID="gen3039" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1676"/><div sID="gen3056" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 24</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1676"/> Suku' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> dunya itu sampay kapanyapanna.<l eID="gen3058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3059"/>Suku'na alam itu sampay kabangsa-bangsahanna.<l eID="gen3059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3060"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: Pinat'nna' e'na gintana'an ma t'ngnga' s'llang,<l eID="gen3060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3061"/>pinahogot he'na ma t'ngnga' kas'llogan.<l eID="gen3061" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3062"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: Sai bahā' makatukad ni būd <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>?<l eID="gen3062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3063"/>Sai bahā' makat'ngge ma deyom luma' pangarapan ni iya?<l eID="gen3063" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3064"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: Luwal a'a ya asussi tanganna min dusa,<l eID="gen3064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3065"/>ya apote' deyom pangatayanna.<l eID="gen3065" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3066"/>Luwal isab a'a ya mbal anumba ni ta'u-ta'u,<l eID="gen3066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3067"/>maka mbal magsapa pagputingan.<l eID="gen3067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3068"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: Makasambut pahala' min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> bang a'a buwattē' kajarihanna.<l eID="gen3068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3069"/>Tinungbasan iya kabontolan itikad e' Tuhan Manglalappas.<l eID="gen3069" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3070"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: Buwattē' isab kahālan saga a'a ya angangut Tuhan,<l eID="gen3070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3071"/>ya atuyu' paharap ni ka'a, O Tuhan si Yakub.<l eID="gen3071" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3072"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
verses.text: Bang pa'in paukab saga tambol!<l eID="gen3072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3073"/>Bang pa'in paukab saga lawang awal-jaman,<l eID="gen3073" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3074"/>bo' supaya makasōd Sultan Sanglit-sahaya!<l eID="gen3074" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3075"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: Sai sa Sultan Sanglit-sahaya itu?<l eID="gen3075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3076"/>Si Yawe ko' itu, ya landu' akosog, landu' aesog.<l eID="gen3076" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3077"/><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ko' itu, ya makaga'os ma pagbono'.<l eID="gen3077" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3078"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: Bang pa'in paukab saga tambol!<l eID="gen3078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3079"/>Bang pa'in paukab saga lawang awal-jaman,<l eID="gen3079" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3080"/>bo' supaya makasōd Sultan Sanglit-sahaya!<l eID="gen3080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3081"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: Sai sa Sultan Sanglit-sahaya itu?<l eID="gen3081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3082"/>Si Yawe ko' itu, ya Sangat Kawasa.<l eID="gen3082" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3083"/>Ya na Sultan Sanglit-sahaya!<l eID="gen3083" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3057"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.24"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:22
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.25"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.26"/> <div eID="gen3056" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1677"/><div sID="gen3084" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 27</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3085"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1677"/> Si Yawe ya amuwanan aku kasawahan maka kalappasan,<l eID="gen3086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3087"/>angkan halam aniya' katāwanku.<l eID="gen3087" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3088"/><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya sapantun kuta' pangahampan kallumku,<l eID="gen3088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3089"/>angkan halam aniya' kagawahanku.<l eID="gen3089" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3090"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: Bang aku sinekot e' a'a jahallis,<l eID="gen3090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3091"/>ya bilahi angamula baranku,<l eID="gen3091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3092"/>bang aku nirugpak e' ba'anan bantaku,<l eID="gen3092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3093"/>tantu sigām makarugtul, makahantak.<l eID="gen3093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3094"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: Minsan aku nilikusan he' tumpukan ba'anan sundalu,<l eID="gen3094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3095"/>mbal kin'bba-k'bba atayku.<l eID="gen3095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3096"/>Minsan aku t'kkahan pagbono',<l eID="gen3096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3097"/>ahantap na pa'in pangatayanku.<l eID="gen3097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3098"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: Luwal itu ya pangamu'ku ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen3098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3099"/>luwal itu ya pagmatayanku,<l eID="gen3099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3100"/>bang pa'in aku paokom ma luma' Tuhan<l eID="gen3100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3101"/>sat'ggolku allum ma babaw dunya itu.<l eID="gen3101" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3102"/>Landu' aku bilahi ang'nda' ma kahāp palantarana,<l eID="gen3102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3103"/>maka angaruhan iya ma luma'na pangarapan.<l eID="gen3103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', sabab tinampanan aku he'na<l eID="gen3104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3105"/>ma waktu katumbuk kasusahan.<l eID="gen3105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3106"/>Pinakuta'an aku e'na ma pussuk batu-lakit,<l eID="gen3106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3107"/>tinapukan aku sakuli-kuli ma luma' pagtata'atan ni iya.<l eID="gen3107" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: Minnē' aku anganda'ug min palbantahanku,<l eID="gen3108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3109"/>pinalanga aku min saga banta ma katilibutku.<l eID="gen3109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3110"/>Tukbalanku pagkulban ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe<l eID="gen3110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3111"/>ma langgal ya pangarapan iya,<l eID="gen3111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3112"/>hinabuku angolang kabowa kakōganku.<l eID="gen3112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3113"/>Angalang isab aku, pagpudjiku <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3113" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3114"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, kalehun lagi' panganjunjungku,<l eID="gen3114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3115"/>ka'ase'in aku, sambungin aku.<l eID="gen3115" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3116"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: Ah'llingan aku di-ku, “Panuyu'in si Yawe.”<l eID="gen3116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3117"/>Jari patuyu' aku ma ka'a, O PANGHŪ'.<l eID="gen3117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: Da'a kono' ka pataikut min aku sabab sosoho'annu aku.<l eID="gen3118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3119"/>Da'a pa'in akagit ataynu, da'a aku taikutin,<l eID="gen3119" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3120"/>sabab ka'a ya pananabang ma aku.<l eID="gen3120" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3121"/>Da'a aku palehomun, da'a aku bbahin,<l eID="gen3121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3122"/>sabab ka'a ya Tuhanku Manglalappas.<l eID="gen3122" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: Abila aku siniya-siya he' ina'-mma'ku,<l eID="gen3123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3124"/>tantu aku tinaima' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3124" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: Ya, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pandu'in aku lānnu, ya amowa ni kahāpan.<l eID="gen3125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3126"/>Malimin aku ma lān abontol,<l eID="gen3126" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3127"/>sabab aheka a'a angangut angala'at aku.<l eID="gen3127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: Da'a aku pasagarin pinagbaya'an e' saga kuntaraku,<l eID="gen3128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3129"/>sabab aniya' a'a anuna'an aku kaputingan.<l eID="gen3129" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3130"/>Ya kab'ngngis sigām mbal kaliyuhan.<l eID="gen3130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan buwattē', aniya' kaholatanku tuman.<l eID="gen3131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3132"/>Tantu aku makabāk kahāpan min si Yawe,<l eID="gen3132" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3133"/>hinabuku lagi' ma dunya dakayu' itu.<l eID="gen3133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: Angkan yukku, “Pangasahin si Yawe.<l eID="gen3134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3135"/>Pahogotunbi imanbi, pataptapunbi pangatayanbi,<l eID="gen3135" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3136"/>pangaholatinbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe.”<l eID="gen3136" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3085"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.27"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.28"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.29"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1678"/><div sID="gen3137" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 32</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3138"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1678"/> Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku niampun kala'atanna,<l eID="gen3139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3140"/>sasuku pinapasan paldusahanna.<l eID="gen3140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku abontol ma bistahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen3141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3142"/>sasuku halam aniya' kaputingan ma pangatayanna.<l eID="gen3142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: Sat'ggol limbunganku dusaku, anitis na pa'in bokogku<l eID="gen3143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3144"/>ma sabab pangandahingku kahaba' llaw.<l eID="gen3144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: Kabuhatan aku llaw-sangom,<l eID="gen3145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3146"/>sali' kahantang tangannu ya makabuhat.<l eID="gen3146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3147"/>Angalongkoy kuwat-anggauta'ku,<l eID="gen3147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3148"/>buwat a'a apanggang ma musim pang'llaw.<l eID="gen3148" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: Malaingkan bay tapamattanku dusaku ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3150"/>halam bay limbunganku kala'atanku.<l eID="gen3150" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3151"/>Yukku, “Gom aku magpasab'nnal ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,”<l eID="gen3151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3152"/>magtūy ta'ampunnu kasā'anku kamemon.<l eID="gen3152" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3153"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: Angkan sasuku magtata'at subay angamu'-ngamu' ni ka'a<l eID="gen3153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3154"/>ma waktu kahanggawna.<l eID="gen3154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3155"/>Bang pasōng kasusahanna sapantun latap alalom,<l eID="gen3155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3156"/>mbal iya alimun he' susa.<l eID="gen3156" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3157"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: O Tuhan, ka'a ya patapukanku,<l eID="gen3157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3158"/>ka'a ya angahampanan aku min kajahatan.<l eID="gen3158" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3159"/>Alibut aku e' saga a'a magkalangan aku<l eID="gen3159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3160"/>ma sabab kalappasnu ma aku.<l eID="gen3160" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3161"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan ni aku, “Pandu'anta ka lān ya wajib palabayannu.<l eID="gen3161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3162"/>Hūganta ka gara' ati peyananku ka.<l eID="gen3162" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3163"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: Da'a ka pasali' ni kajarihan kura',<l eID="gen3163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3164"/>ya halam aniya' akkalna.<l eID="gen3164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3165"/>Mbal tasoho' hayop inān, mbal tapasekot ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3166"/>luwal bang sangonannu kakkang maka engkot.”<l eID="gen3166" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3167"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: Aheya karukka'an saga a'a ya ala'at kajarihanna,<l eID="gen3167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3168"/>saguwā' sasuku angandol ma si Yawe,<l eID="gen3168" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3169"/>ap'nno' iya e' kasi-lasa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3169" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3170"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: Kalasiginbi si Yawe. Pakoyag kam sasuku ahāp kajarihanbi.<l eID="gen3170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3171"/>Magkalang kam sasuku abontol itikadbi.<l eID="gen3171" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3138"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.32"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.33"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.34"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1679"/><div sID="gen3172" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 37</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3173"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1679"/> Da'a kahanggawinbi saga a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen3174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3175"/>da'a isab pangihirinbi saga a'a maghinang kala'atan!<l eID="gen3175" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3176"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: Sapantun sigām parang-parang al'kkas alanos,<l eID="gen3176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3177"/>sapantun dahun ak'llos magdai'-dai'.<l eID="gen3177" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3178"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: Angandol sadja kam ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen3178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3179"/>hinangunbi kahāpan.<l eID="gen3179" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3180"/>Pat'nna' kam ma lahatbi porol,<l eID="gen3180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3181"/>pat'nna' kam ma deyom kasannangan.<l eID="gen3181" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3182"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: Paglasiginbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName><l eID="gen3182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3183"/>ati kabuwanan kam ai-ai ya makasulut pangatayanbi.<l eID="gen3183" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3184"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: Pama'andolunbi kahālanbi ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen3184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3185"/>pasangdolinbi iya, ati tahinang e'na ya amu'bi.<l eID="gen3185" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: Pinabukis he'na ka'adilanbi,<l eID="gen3186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3187"/>sapantun sawa ya pabukis dai'-llaw,<l eID="gen3187" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3188"/>pinasaplag kabontol palkala'bi,<l eID="gen3188" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3189"/>sapantun sinag llaw bang augtu.<l eID="gen3189" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3190"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: Pat'mmun kam ma alopan si Yawe, lagarinbi iya.<l eID="gen3190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3191"/>Da'a kam asusa bang auntung saga a'a kasehe'an,<l eID="gen3191" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3192"/>bang tahinang kagara'an sigām ajahallis.<l eID="gen3192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3193"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: Da'a kam angastol! Da'a kam angamahit!<l eID="gen3193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3194"/>Da'a papasu'un ataybi, tantu ala'at kat'kkahanna.<l eID="gen3194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3195"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: Sabab pinahalam saga a'a ala'at kajarihanna,<l eID="gen3195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3196"/>saguwā' sasuku angasa ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> pinusaka'an lahat itu.<l eID="gen3196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: Mbal at'ggol, pahalam saga a'a ala'at itu.<l eID="gen3197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3198"/>Minsan painay e'bi amiha, mbal tabāk.<l eID="gen3198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3199"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a areyo' pangatayanna pinasuku'an lahat itu,<l eID="gen3199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3200"/>ati halam aniya' makasasaw kasannangan sigām.<l eID="gen3200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: Binantuhan a'a ahāp atayna he' a'a jahulaka'.<l eID="gen3201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3202"/>Ang'ttop le'e saga a'a inān, tanda' sin kab'nsi sigām ma a'a ahāp.<l eID="gen3202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: Malaingkan pinagtittowahan he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> saga a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen3203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3204"/>sabab kata'uwanna aniya' llaw pangangganta' ma sigām.<l eID="gen3204" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3205"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: Angahublut kalis saga a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen3205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3206"/>anakap ba'ugan pana' sigām,<l eID="gen3206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3207"/>bo' tapana' e' sigām saga a'a kamiskinan maka kasigpitan.<l eID="gen3207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3208"/>Ya maksud sigām amapatay saga a'a abontol atayna.<l eID="gen3208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3209"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: Saguwā' papelleng kalis inān angandugsu' jantung sigām,<l eID="gen3209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3210"/>pinagpōng-pōng isab saga ba'ugan pana' sigām.<l eID="gen3210" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3211"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: Minsan akulang ai-ai ya palsuku'an ma saga a'a abontol,<l eID="gen3211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3212"/>labi ahalga' ko' inān min alta' manglabi-labihan<l eID="gen3212" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3213"/>ya palsuku'an saga a'a ala'at.<l eID="gen3213" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3214"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: Sabab pahalam ya ga'osan saga a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen3214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3215"/>sagō' angandapit <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma saga a'a abontol palangayna.<l eID="gen3215" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3216"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: Niayuput e' si Yawe kallum sasuku mbal katōngan dusa<l eID="gen3216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3217"/>ati anatas pusaka' sigām sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen3217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3218"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: Mbal sigām aiya' bang t'kkahan kasigpitan.<l eID="gen3218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3219"/>Minsan ma waktu gotom, maka'ssohan kinakan sigām.<l eID="gen3219" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3220"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: Malaingkan saga a'a jahulaka' magka'at lullun.<l eID="gen3220" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3221"/>Palanyap saga palbantahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, ibarat humbu.<l eID="gen3221" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3222"/>Ibarat sigām kalingkat sumping ya patomo' ma deya,<l eID="gen3222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3223"/>dai'-dai' du palanos bo' halam na.<l eID="gen3223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3224"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: Angutang saga a'a ala'at sagō' mbal amayad.<l eID="gen3224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3225"/>Saguwā' saga a'a ahāp magmura sadja,<l eID="gen3225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3226"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: sabab sai-sai kabuwanan pahala' he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName><l eID="gen3226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3227"/>pinusaka'an lahat itu.<l eID="gen3227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3228"/>Saguwā' sai-sai sinapdahan e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, tantu magmula.<l eID="gen3228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3229"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: Bang kasulutan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma kaul-pi'il a'a,<l eID="gen3229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3230"/>pinatotog e'na tekangna.<l eID="gen3230" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3231"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: Minsan iya makarugtul, mbal tabowa pahantak,<l eID="gen3231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3232"/>sabab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya amalutan tanganna.<l eID="gen3232" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3233"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: Min kaonde'-onde'ku sampay ni kato'aku itu,<l eID="gen3233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3234"/>halam aniya' a'a abontol bay ta'nda'ku pinasagaran he' Tuhan.<l eID="gen3234" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3235"/>Halam isab ta'nda'ku anak a'a inān tabowa angamu' kinakan.<l eID="gen3235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3236"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: Magmura sadja sigām amuwan maka amautang,<l eID="gen3236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3237"/>angkan pinaniya'an pahala' saga anak sigām e'.<l eID="gen3237" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3238"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: Angkan yukku, pataikut kam min kala'atan bo' patukid ma kahāpan,<l eID="gen3238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3239"/>ati taptap kam pat'nna' ma lahatbi porol.<l eID="gen3239" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3240"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', sabab kasulutan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma a'a angahinang kabontolan.<l eID="gen3240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3241"/>Mbal palehomna saga a'a ya atukid angisbat iya.<l eID="gen3241" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3242"/>Nihampanan e'na saga a'a suku'na sampay ni kasaumulan,<l eID="gen3242" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3243"/>saguwā' bin'kkat e'na napas saga a'a maghinang kala'atan.<l eID="gen3243" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3244"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: Pamusaka' ma a'a ahāp ya lahat sigām porol,<l eID="gen3244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3245"/>ati maglahat sigām maina'an salama-lama tahun.<l eID="gen3245" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3246"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: Bang a'a asussi pangatayanna, amissala iya pangita'u,<l eID="gen3246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3247"/>abontol maka asaltun himumūnganna.<l eID="gen3247" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3248"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: Ina'an ma deyom atayna sara'-manara' min Tuhanna,<l eID="gen3248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3249"/>angkan mbal parasdas tape'na.<l eID="gen3249" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3250"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: Tinipu saga a'a ahāp palangayna he' a'a ala'at,<l eID="gen3250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3251"/>sabab angamohot amapatay,<l eID="gen3251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: saguwā' mbal pinasagaran he' si Yawe saga a'ana gina'os he' a'a jahulaka'.<l eID="gen3252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3253"/>Bang sigām pinaharap ni huwis, mbal tugutanna sigām taluwa' hukuman.<l eID="gen3253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3254"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: Pangaholatinbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bogboginbi panoho'anna<l eID="gen3254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3255"/>ati pinalanga kam bo' pinusaka'an lahatbi porol.<l eID="gen3255" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3256"/>Song isab ta'nda'bi saga a'a jahulaka' pinahalam.<l eID="gen3256" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3257"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: Aniya' bay ta'nda'ku a'a landu' ajahat maka abigsi',<l eID="gen3257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3258"/>ahāp sadja kahālanna, sapantun kayu alabung dahunna,<l eID="gen3258" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3259"/>ya patomo' ma tana' bay asal patomo'anna.<l eID="gen3259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3260"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: Sagō' da'a ka pilang'llaw paglabayku minnē', na halam na.<l eID="gen3260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3261"/>Minsan painay he'ku amiha iya, halam to'ongan tabākku.<l eID="gen3261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi a'a halam dusahan, pangli'unbi a'a abontol palangayna,<l eID="gen3262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3263"/>sabab ahāp kasōngan ma saga a'a mbal bilahi maglugat.<l eID="gen3263" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3264"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: Saguwā' tantu pinaka'at kamemon saga baldusa,<l eID="gen3264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3265"/>halam aniya' kasōngan a'a maghinang kala'atan.<l eID="gen3265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3266"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: Lappasan sasuku asussi pangatayanna, sabab min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen3266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3267"/>ya sapantun kuta' pasindungan a'ana bang t'kkahan bala'.<l eID="gen3267" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3268"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: Tinabang sigām e' si Yawe, pinuwas e'na min kasigpitan.<l eID="gen3268" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3269"/>Niliyus sigām e'na min ga'osan saga a'a jahallis,<l eID="gen3269" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3270"/>nilappas isab sigām sabab Tuhan iya pangandolan.<l eID="gen3270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3173"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.38"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.39"/> <div eID="gen3172" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1680"/><div sID="gen3271" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 40</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3272"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1680"/> Angagad na pa'in aku ma si Yawe minsan mbal anambung saru'un-du'un,<l eID="gen3273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3274"/>jari palingi' iya ni aku bo' akale ma panabbutku.<l eID="gen3274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3275"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: Bay aku binuhat e'na min kal'bbohan,<l eID="gen3275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3276"/>pinaluwas aku min lowang kapisakan.<l eID="gen3276" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3277"/>Pinat'ngge aku ma batu, pinahogot pat'nggehanku.<l eID="gen3277" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3278"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: Aniya' kalangan baha'u pamakalangna ma aku,<l eID="gen3278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3279"/>kalangan pamudji Tuhantam.<l eID="gen3279" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3280"/>Aheka a'a magmatāw pag'nda'na ma pakaradja'an itu,<l eID="gen3280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3281"/>ati angandol sigām ma si Yawe.<l eID="gen3281" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3282"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku apagon pangandolna ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>,<l eID="gen3282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3283"/>ya mbal ameya' ma saga a'a magabbu-abbu,<l eID="gen3283" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3284"/>atawa ma a'a ya magta'at ma tuhan-tuhan puting!<l eID="gen3284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3285"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: O Yawe, Tuhanku, aheka hinangnu makainu-inu.<l eID="gen3285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3286"/>Mbal taitung saga kahāpan ya mohotnu ma kami.<l eID="gen3286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3287"/>Bang aku bay pasulay anuli-nuli kamemon,<l eID="gen3287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3288"/>mbal takole' sinuli-suli pagga kumarukan hekana.<l eID="gen3288" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3289"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: Ngga'i ka tutukbalan maka tapung ya pagmatayannu,<l eID="gen3289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3290"/>ngga'i ka susumbali'an tinunu',<l eID="gen3290" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3291"/>ngga'i ka tataubatan dusa ya kagunahannu.<l eID="gen3291" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3292"/>Saguwā' tin'bbok e'nu taingaku, hatina pinakale aku.<l eID="gen3292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3293"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: Magtūy aku ah'lling, yukku, “Itiya' aku, sakap aku,<l eID="gen3293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3294"/>buwat tasulat ma Kitab ma pasalanku.<l eID="gen3294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3295"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: O Tuhanku, ahutu aku angahinang kabaya'annu.<l eID="gen3295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3296"/>Itiya' ma aku sara'nu, ma deyom pangatayanku.”<l eID="gen3296" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: Bay pasaplagku kabontol pangahandak si Yawe ma palhimpunan aheya.<l eID="gen3297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3298"/>Kata'uwannu asal, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, halam bay tambolku bowa'ku.<l eID="gen3298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: Mbal tahananku ma atay kabontolnu,<l eID="gen3299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3300"/>ah'lling na pa'in aku pasal kapangandolannu maka kalappasnu.<l eID="gen3300" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3301"/>Halam bay limbunganku kasi-lasanu maka kab'nnalnu,<l eID="gen3301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3302"/>gom pa'in pagnasihatku ma palhimpunan aheya.<l eID="gen3302" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3303"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, da'a pa'in ka'llogin ase'nu ma aku.<l eID="gen3303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3304"/>Hampanin aku sakahaba' waktu maka lasanu kakkal, maka kab'nnalannu.<l eID="gen3304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3305"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: Sabab itiya' aku t'kkahan susa-manusa ya mbal taitung<l eID="gen3305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3306"/>itiya' aku kapilahan e' ba'anan dusaku.<l eID="gen3306" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3307"/>Palabi hekana min heka lamba bu'unku,<l eID="gen3307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3308"/>angkan aku mbal na maka'nda' pahāp,<l eID="gen3308" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3309"/>angahimāt pangatayanku pagka halam aniya' pangasa.<l eID="gen3309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3310"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bang pa'in aku lappasnu,<l eID="gen3310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3311"/>O Yawe, bang pa'in ka pasa'ut anulung!<l eID="gen3311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3312"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: Bang pa'in pinahina' maka pinaligoto' e'nu<l eID="gen3312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3313"/>saga a'a kamemon ya anganiyat amapatay aku.<l eID="gen3313" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3314"/>Bang pa'in hawirannu saga a'a bilahi angamula aku,<l eID="gen3314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3315"/>bang pa'in sigām tahinang pagtunggīngan.<l eID="gen3315" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3316"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: Saga a'a isab ya bay anittowahan aku,<l eID="gen3316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3317"/>bang pa'in sigām kapam'ngngangan ma sabab iya' sigām.<l eID="gen3317" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3318"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: Saguwā' saga a'a ya angaholat ma ka'a, Tuhan,<l eID="gen3318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3319"/>bang pa'in sigām kinōgan maka ka'amuhan ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3319" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3320"/>Sasuku kasulutan ma kakosog panglappasnu,<l eID="gen3320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3321"/>subay anabbut sararan-daran:<l eID="gen3321" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3322"/>“Akawasa si Yawe! Akawasa si Yawe!”<l eID="gen3322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3323"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: Maka aku itu, minsan kamiskinan maka kasigpitan,<l eID="gen3323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3324"/>kinannal isab aku he' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3325"/>O Tuhan, ka'a ya Mananabang maka Manglalappas ma aku,<l eID="gen3325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3326"/>Pasa'ut ka kono'.<l eID="gen3326" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3272"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.40"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.41"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.42"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.44"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1681"/><div sID="gen3327" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 46</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan saga Anak si Kora</title> <lg sID="gen3328"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1681"/> Tuhan ya patapukanta maka pangā'anta kosog,<l eID="gen3329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3330"/>asakap iya anabang bang aniya' kasukkalan.<l eID="gen3330" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3331"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: Angkan kita mbal tināw minsan ajogjog dunya,<l eID="gen3331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3332"/>minsan al'bbos kabūd-būran tudju ni timbang.<l eID="gen3332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3333"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: Aho', minsan magabal tahik, minsan amukal,<l eID="gen3333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3334"/>minsan isab ahenggol saga būd he' kosog haus.<l eID="gen3334" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3335"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' sapa' anasahan amowa kakōgan ni da'ira Tuhan,<l eID="gen3335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3336"/>ni lugal sussi ya haddarat Tuhan Mahatinggi.<l eID="gen3336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3337"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: Ina'an Tuhan ma deyom da'irana, angkan mbal pajudjal.<l eID="gen3337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3338"/>Pagk'llat llaw, tinabang he' Tuhan.<l eID="gen3338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: Maglengogan kabangsa-bangsahan. Pah'bba' kapagsultanan.<l eID="gen3339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3340"/>Angabtang sadja Tuhan, magtūy atunaw dunya.<l eID="gen3340" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3341"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: Pataptap <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa ma kita,<l eID="gen3341" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3342"/>kuta' pasindunganta ya Tuhan pangkatta si Yakub.<l eID="gen3342" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3343"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: Dai' kam, nda'unbi kahinangan si Yawe,<l eID="gen3343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3344"/>ya hinang makak'bbal atay bay tahinangna ma dunya.<l eID="gen3344" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3345"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: Pinahondong he'na ba'anan pagbono' ma kaluha'an dunya.<l eID="gen3345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3346"/>Pinagpōng he'na ba'ugan pana', pinagp'ppot saga budjak,<l eID="gen3346" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3347"/>Pinagtunu' tampan sundalu ma deyom api.<l eID="gen3347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3348"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: “Pahali kam, pahati kam in aku Tuhan.<l eID="gen3348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3349"/>Patut aku pinalanga he' kabangsa-bangsahan.<l eID="gen3349" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3350"/>Patut aku pinalanga to'ongan ma dunya.”<l eID="gen3350" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3351"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: Pataptap <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Sangat Kawasa ma kita,<l eID="gen3351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3352"/>Kuta' pasindunganta ya Tuhan pangkatta si Yakub.<l eID="gen3352" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3328"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.46"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1682"/><div sID="gen3353" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 51</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud Pangamu' Ka'ampunan</title> <lg sID="gen3354"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1682"/> O Tuhan, ka'ase'in aku ma sabab lasanu kakkal.<l eID="gen3355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3356"/>Patiase'un ka,<l eID="gen3356" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3357"/>angkan amu'ku pinapasan paldusahanku.<l eID="gen3357" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3358"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: Kose'in aku min kasā'anku,<l eID="gen3358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3359"/>sussihun aku min dusaku.<l eID="gen3359" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3360"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanku na kala'atanku,<l eID="gen3360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3361"/>mbal takalipatku, pamikilanku na pa'in sakahaba' waktu.<l eID="gen3361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: Ya dusaku itu dusa ni ka'a sadja, ngga'i ka dusa ni manusiya'.<l eID="gen3362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3363"/>B'nnal, bay aku amakay dusa ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3364"/>angkan taluwa' bang aku katōngannu dusa. Abontol ka.<l eID="gen3364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3365"/>Taluwa' isab bang aku pat'nna'annu hukuman.<l eID="gen3365" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3366"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: Tantu aku dusahan waktu lagi' kapaganak ma aku,<l eID="gen3366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3367"/>dusahan aku min waktu kapangiraman ina'ku ma aku.<l eID="gen3367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3368"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: Tantu isab, ya kabaya'annu subay aniya' kab'nnalan sampay min deyom atay.<l eID="gen3368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3369"/>Ya pamandu'nu pasal pangita'u itiya' pasobsob ni itikadku.<l eID="gen3369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3370"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: Sussihun aku maka sayul hissup, ati alanu' aku.<l eID="gen3370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3371"/>Pandihun aku, ati apote' aku min pote' gapas.<l eID="gen3371" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3372"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: Pakalehun aku lling pagkoyagan, paglasigan.<l eID="gen3372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3373"/>Pakōrun kuwat-anggauta'ku, ya bay pinananaman kakagit ataynu.<l eID="gen3373" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3374"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: O Tuhan, bang pa'in ka pakeleng min paldusahanku,<l eID="gen3374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3375"/>maka papasin kasā'anku kamemon.<l eID="gen3375" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3376"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: Paniya'in aku atay sussi,<l eID="gen3376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3377"/>pabaha'uhun itikadku bo' mbal magpinda-pinda.<l eID="gen3377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3378"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: Da'a kono' aku paluwasun min haddaratnu.<l eID="gen3378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3379"/>Da'a la'anin min aku Rū-nu Sussi.<l eID="gen3379" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3380"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: Pabīngun ni aku kalasigan ya bay ma aku tagna' kapangalappasnu ma aku.<l eID="gen3380" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3381"/>Buwanin aku kajarihan ahutu bo' tahinangku kabaya'annu.<l eID="gen3381" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3382"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: Jari pandu'anku saga a'a ya angalanggal sara'nu,<l eID="gen3382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3383"/>pandu'anku sigām pasal kaul-pi'il ya makasulut ataynu.<l eID="gen3383" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3384"/>Ati aniya' saga a'a dusahan pabalik ni ka'a.<l eID="gen3384" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3385"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: O Tuhan, ka'a Tuhan Manglalappas, puwasin aku min dusa amapatay a'a<l eID="gen3385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3386"/>ati angalang aku pasal kabontol pangahandaknu.<l eID="gen3386" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3387"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: O Tuhan, <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pakalangun aku,<l eID="gen3387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3388"/>bo' ka sanglitanku labay min suwalaku,<l eID="gen3388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3389"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: Bang pagkulban ya kabaya'annu, bay du ka bowahanku.<l eID="gen3389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3390"/>Mbal ka kasulutan ma susumbali'an pinagtunu'.<l eID="gen3390" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3391"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: Ya huhulmatan pagmatayan Tuhan, ya na atay ata'u magsusun.<l eID="gen3391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3392"/>O Tuhan, mbal sowaynu atay pagsususun maka atay areyo'-deyo'.<l eID="gen3392" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3393"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: Bangunun da'ira Siyun ma sabab lasanu hilas.<l eID="gen3393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3394"/>Pahāpun tambak batu ya bay pangād ma da'ira Awrusalam.<l eID="gen3394" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3395"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: Minnē' aniya' tutukbalan abontol pangahulmat ka'a.<l eID="gen3395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3396"/>Aniya' susumbali'an pinagtunu' ma katibu'ukanna,<l eID="gen3396" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3397"/>maka aniya' sapi' l'lla pinagkulban ma panukbalan ya ma luma'nu.<l eID="gen3397" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3354"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.51"/>
