verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1683"/><div sID="gen3398" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 61</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3399"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1683"/> Ya Tuhan, kalehun panangisku,<l eID="gen3400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3401"/>taima'un pangamu'-ngamu'ku.<l eID="gen3401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3402"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: Angalingan aku ni ka'a min lahat ya katapusan alawak<l eID="gen3402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3403"/>pagka halam aniya' holatanku.<l eID="gen3403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3404"/>Malimin aku ni batu alanga ya mbal ta'abutku.<l eID="gen3404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3405"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: Sabab ka'a ya bay patapukanku,<l eID="gen3405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3406"/>ibarat kuta' mbal tasōd e' saga bantaku.<l eID="gen3406" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3407"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: Landu' aku bilahi pat'nna' ma Luma' Pangarapan ni ka'a<l eID="gen3407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3408"/>bo' magluma' mailu sat'ggolku allum,<l eID="gen3408" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3409"/>ati pasindung aku ma deyo' kepetnu sapantun anak manuk.<l eID="gen3409" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: Ya Tuhanku, tasambutnu bay janji'ku ma ka'a,<l eID="gen3410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3411"/>ati kabuwanan aku kahāpan ya pamusaka'nu<l eID="gen3411" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3412"/>ma sasuku magmatāw ma ōnnu.<l eID="gen3412" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: Bang pa'in pataha'nu umul sultan,<l eID="gen3413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3414"/>bang pa'in pahogotnu pagsultanna sampay ma panubu'na.<l eID="gen3414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3415"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in iya magsultan ma matahannu salama-lama tahun.<l eID="gen3415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3416"/>Hampanin iya pahāp ma sabab lasanu maka janji'nu ya mbal magkapinda.<l eID="gen3416" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3417"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: Jari aku itu angalang na pa'in pamudjiku ōnnu,<l eID="gen3417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3418"/>ati suhulku ai-ai bay panganajalku ma ka'a,<l eID="gen3418" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3419"/>tukbalanku ni ka'a kahaba' llaw.<l eID="gen3419" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3399"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.61"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.62"/> <div eID="gen3398" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1684"/><div sID="gen3420" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 63</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3421"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1684"/> O Tuhan, ka'a ya Tuhanku,<l eID="gen3422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3423"/>landu' aku angentom ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3423" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3424"/>Bang aku alawak min haddaratnu,<l eID="gen3424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3425"/>ya sapantunna lahat paslangan halam aniya' bohe'na.<l eID="gen3425" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3426"/>Patay bohe' palnyawahanku, apanggang baranku<l eID="gen3426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3427"/>ma sabab katuyu'ku ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: Bay ka ta'nda'ku ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan ka'a,<l eID="gen3428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3429"/>bay ta'nda'ku kawasanu maka sahayanu.<l eID="gen3429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3430"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: Ahalga' lasanu, labi ahalga' min kallumku,<l eID="gen3430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3431"/>angkan ka sanglitanku luwas min k'llongku.<l eID="gen3431" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3432"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: Pudjiku ka sat'ggolku allum.<l eID="gen3432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3433"/>Anangga aku hinabuku anabbut ōnnu.<l eID="gen3433" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3434"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: Asalamat nyawaku, sapantun a'a asso he' kinakan ahāp lanabna,<l eID="gen3434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3435"/>angkan aku angalang pamudji ka'a luwas min k'llongku.<l eID="gen3435" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3436"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: Taentomku ka'a hinabuku palege ma pabahakanku,<l eID="gen3436" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3437"/>ati ka'a ya paghona'-hona'ku kahaba'-kahaba' sangom.<l eID="gen3437" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: Ka'a ya anabangan aku, angkan aku tabowa angalang<l eID="gen3438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3439"/>hinabuku pasindung ma pikpiknu, sali' manuk-manuk.<l eID="gen3439" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3440"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: Pabalut pangatayanku ma ka'a,<l eID="gen3440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3441"/>pinatotog aku he' tangannu sakap kowan.<l eID="gen3441" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3442"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: Bang pa'in palurus ni kalaloman ahirat<l eID="gen3442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3443"/>saga a'a ya magisun amapatay aku.<l eID="gen3443" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3444"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: Bang pa'in sigām tinugutan binono' patay kalis<l eID="gen3444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3445"/>bo' pinagkakan he' saga ero' paslangan.<l eID="gen3445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3446"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: Pagubus, magkalasigan sultan ma Tuhan.<l eID="gen3446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3447"/>Sinanglitan isab Tuhan e' sasuku anganjanji' ma ōnna.<l eID="gen3447" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3448"/>Malaingkan pinakittup bowa' saga a'a magputing.<l eID="gen3448" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3421"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.63"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:10

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.65"/> <div eID="gen3420" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1685"/><div sID="gen3449" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 66</title> <lg sID="gen3450"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1685"/> Ka'am kamemon ma dunya,<l eID="gen3451" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3452"/>olanginbi Tuhan ma sabab kakoyagbi!<l eID="gen3452" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3453"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: Magkalang kam pamaheyabi ōnna kawasahan!<l eID="gen3453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3454"/>Pudjihunbi iya bo' pasōng kabantuganna!<l eID="gen3454" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3455"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: Amissala kam ni Tuhan, yukbi, “Ya Tuhan,<l eID="gen3455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3456"/>akawasa du pa'in kahinangannu, mbal tasipat!<l eID="gen3456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3457"/>Magpatiata saga palbantahannu ni ka'a<l eID="gen3457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3458"/>sabab kawasanu mbal tasagga'.<l eID="gen3458" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3459"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: Pasujud ni ka'a sabarang bangsa ma deyom dunya.<l eID="gen3459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3460"/>Angalang sigām pananglit ka'a,<l eID="gen3460" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3461"/>pinudji ōnnu ma kalangan sigām.”<l eID="gen3461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3462"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: Pi'itu kam ang'nda' ma bay tahinang he' Tuhan.<l eID="gen3462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3463"/>Makatāw-tāw saga kahinangan ya tahinang e'na<l eID="gen3463" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3464"/>pangahāp kitam panubu' si Mbo' Adam.<l eID="gen3464" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3465"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: Ya tahik bay tahinang he'na katoho'an,<l eID="gen3465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3466"/>bo' magtinape' saga a'a parambila'.<l eID="gen3466" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3467"/>Angkan kitam subay magkōg-koyagan Tuhan,<l eID="gen3467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3468"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: ya magparinta sampay saumul-umul ma sabab kawasana.<l eID="gen3468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3469"/>Pineyanan he'na palbangsa-bangsahan,<l eID="gen3469" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3470"/>supaya halam aniya' min sigām angatu ma iya.<l eID="gen3470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3471"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: Ka'am saga bangsa, pudjihunbi Tuhantam,<l eID="gen3471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3472"/>patanogunbi suwalabi pananglit ma iya.<l eID="gen3472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3473"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: Niliyusan kitam min kamatay,<l eID="gen3473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3474"/>pineyanan kitam bo' mbal parasdas tape'tam.<l eID="gen3474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3475"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: Bay kami sulayannu, Tuhan, bay kami tatabnu,<l eID="gen3475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3476"/>sapantun pilak tinatab ma panarulan.<l eID="gen3476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3477"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: Bay kami kalabusunu, sapantun daing ma pokot,<l eID="gen3477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3478"/>bay kami patanggungnu tanggungan abuhat.<l eID="gen3478" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3479"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: Makahantak pa'in kami,<l eID="gen3479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3480"/>bay tugutannu saga a'a angura' palabay min kōk kami.<l eID="gen3480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3481"/>Bay kami palabay isab min deyom api maka min bohe',<l eID="gen3481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3482"/>arak amatay, manda' kami paluwasnu<l eID="gen3482" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3483"/>bo' pinasampay ni lahat magdayas-dayas ma kinakan.<l eID="gen3483" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3484"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: Pi'ilu aku ni luma'nu angungsuran pagkulban tinunu',<l eID="gen3484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3485"/>maka hinangku bay pagnajalku ni ka'a.<l eID="gen3485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3486"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: Hinangku in janji' bay kak'bbatan bowa'ku, hinabuku bay kasigpitan.<l eID="gen3486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3487"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: Tukbalanku ni ka'a bili-bili al'mmok maka kambing l'lla tinunu' ma katibu'ukanna.<l eID="gen3487" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3488"/>Ungsuranku ni ka'a susumbali'an sapi' maka kambing.<l eID="gen3488" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3489"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: Sasuku kam magmatāw ma Tuhan, pi'itu kam akale<l eID="gen3489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3490"/>ati pangahakaku ma ka'am bay kahinanganna ma aku.<l eID="gen3490" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3491"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: Bay aku parahing ni iya,<l eID="gen3491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3492"/>bay iya sanglitanku maka pangallam bowa'ku.<l eID="gen3492" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3493"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: Abila aku bay anganapsuhan la'at ma deyom atayku,<l eID="gen3493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3494"/>mbal aku kinale he' Panghū'ku.<l eID="gen3494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3495"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: Saguwā' tantu aku kinale he' Tuhan,<l eID="gen3495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3496"/>ta'asip e'na pangamu'-ngamu'ku.<l eID="gen3496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3497"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: Pudjitam Tuhan,<l eID="gen3497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3498"/>ya halam bay amabiyal pagduwa'aku,<l eID="gen3498" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3499"/>ya halam bay pahali alasahan aku.<l eID="gen3499" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3450"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.66"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1686"/><div sID="gen3500" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 84</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan saga Anak si Kora</title> <lg sID="gen3501"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1686"/> Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, Tuhan Sangat Kawasa!<l eID="gen3502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3503"/>Kalingkat du pa'in pat'nna'annu ilu!<l eID="gen3503" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3504"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: Sali' aku apunung e' baya'ku pi'ilu ni halaman luma' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3505"/>Magkalang aku ni Tuhan kakkal ma sabab kakōranku,<l eID="gen3505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3506"/>luwas min palnyawahanku maka min ginhawa-baranku.<l eID="gen3506" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3507"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: Minsan saga manuk-manuk paupit<l eID="gen3507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3508"/>makabāk pat'ppakan ma atag paghinangan kulban ni ka'a.<l eID="gen3508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3509"/>Sampay saga manuk-manuk baliyu<l eID="gen3509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3510"/>makahinang pugaranna mailu pangint'llohanna.<l eID="gen3510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3511"/>Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, Tuhan Sangat Kawasa!<l eID="gen3511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3512"/>Ka'a ya Sultanku, ka'a ya Tuhanku.<l eID="gen3512" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3513"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku pat'nna' ma deyom luma'nu,<l eID="gen3513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3514"/>sabab makasanglit sigām ma ka'a ma halam aniya' hogga'anna.<l eID="gen3514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3515"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku makasambut kosog min ka'a,<l eID="gen3515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3516"/>ya angangut patukad ni Awrusalam bo' anambahayang.<l eID="gen3516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3517"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: Pasalta' sigām palabay min l'bbak Baka<note>Baka: hatina ‘Panangisan’ atawa ‘po'on kayu balsam’.</note>,<l eID="gen3517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3518"/>tahinang lugal pagbohe'an.<l eID="gen3518" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3519"/>Ta'abut pa'in waktu pangulan, ap'nno' l'bbak inān<l eID="gen3519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3520"/>e' kalowang-lowangan taga-bohe'.<l eID="gen3520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3521"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: Paganap na pa'in kosog sigām, bo' paganap,<l eID="gen3521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3522"/>sampay sigām paharap pakaniya-kaniya ni Tuhan ma da'ira Siyun.<l eID="gen3522" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3523"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, Tuhan si Yakub,<l eID="gen3523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3524"/>bang pa'in sambutnu pangamu'-ngamu'ku itu.<l eID="gen3524" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3525"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: O Tuhan, nda'un gi' sultan ya makatampanan kami.<l eID="gen3525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3526"/>Nda'un pamaihu'anna, in iya a'a tapene'nu.<l eID="gen3526" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3527"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: Aku itu, pād-pād dangibu llaw maingga-maingga lahat,<l eID="gen3527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3528"/>gom lagi' dang'llaw ma deyom halaman luma'nu.<l eID="gen3528" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3529"/>Pād-pād aku pat'nna' ma kaluma'an saga a'a jahulaka',<l eID="gen3529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3530"/>gom lagi' ma luma'nu, minsan hal an'ngge ma atag bowa' lawang.<l eID="gen3530" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3531"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: Sabab Tuhan Yawe sali' ād maka tampan ma saga a'ana.<l eID="gen3531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3532"/>Amuwan iya hulmat maka mahaltabat.<l eID="gen3532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3533"/>Sasuku ahongpot tebongna<l eID="gen3533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3534"/>mbal kinaiskutan he' Tuhan ai-ai ahāp.<l eID="gen3534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3535"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: O Tuhan Sangat Kawasa<l eID="gen3535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3536"/>aheya kahāpan ma sasuku angandol ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3536" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3501"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.84"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1687"/><div sID="gen3537" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 91</title> <lg sID="gen3538"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1687"/> Sasuku pat'nna' ma sindungan Tuhan Mahatinggi<l eID="gen3539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3540"/>pahali-hali ma limbuhan Sangat Kawasa.<l eID="gen3540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: Buwattitu pah'llingku, “Si Yawe ya pahogotanku.<l eID="gen3541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3542"/>Sapantun iya kuta' patapukanku, pangandolanku iya.”<l eID="gen3542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3543"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: Tantu iya amuwasan ka'a min jallat ya pinat'nna'an ka'a,<l eID="gen3543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3544"/>maka min saki makapatay.<l eID="gen3544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3545"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: Tinambunan ka e'na ma sabakanna, ibarat manuk.<l eID="gen3545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3546"/>Pasindung ka ma deyo' pikpikna.<l eID="gen3546" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3547"/>Tuhan ya sapantun ād makahampanan ka'a<l eID="gen3547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3548"/>sabab mbal to'ongan apinda kajarihanna.<l eID="gen3548" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3549"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: Mbal kagawahannu bangsa magl'l'ngngan ma kalendoman,<l eID="gen3549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3550"/>atawa budjak ya nihiyak waktu llaw.<l eID="gen3550" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3551"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: Mbal isāb katāwannu saki maglunsulan ma sangom,<l eID="gen3551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3552"/>atawa bonglay ya makalaglag bang ugtu llaw.<l eID="gen3552" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3553"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: Abugtang pa'in dangibu a'a ma atagnu kowan,<l eID="gen3553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3554"/>sangpū' ngibu pa'in ma atagnu gibang, mbal ka talapay.<l eID="gen3554" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3555"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: Ta'nda' hal he' matanu bang ai panungbas Tuhan ma saga a'a jahulaka'.<l eID="gen3555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3556"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: Bang Tuhan Mahatinggi ya pataptapannu,<l eID="gen3556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3557"/>hatina si Yawe ya patapukanku isab,<l eID="gen3557" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3558"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: mbal ka t'kkahan bala',<l eID="gen3558" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3559"/>mbal sinekot luma'nu he' saki bonglay,<l eID="gen3559" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3560"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: sabab aniya' saga mala'ikat sinō' he' Tuhan<l eID="gen3560" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3561"/>angahampanan ka'a pi'ingga-pi'ingga pal'ngnganannu.<l eID="gen3561" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3562"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: Tinayak ka e' sigām bo' mbal makasantuk tape'nu ni batu.<l eID="gen3562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: Gi'ikannu halimaw maka sowa d'ppong,<l eID="gen3563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3564"/>kagindasan e'nu halimaw maka buwaya.<l eID="gen3564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3565"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: Angallam si Yawe, yukna, “Alasa a'a itu ma aku,<l eID="gen3565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3566"/>angkan liyusku iya min kajahatan,<l eID="gen3566" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3567"/>Angaku iya ma ōnku, angkan iya hampananku.<l eID="gen3567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3568"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: Pagsabbutna ma aku, sambunganku magtūy.<l eID="gen3568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3569"/>Pataptap aku ma iya hinabuna ma deyom sukkal.<l eID="gen3569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3570"/>Tabangku iya ma deyom kasigpitan,<l eID="gen3570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3571"/>maka buwananku iya ōn abantug.<l eID="gen3571" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3572"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: Ka'amuhan iya pagga pataha'ku umulna.<l eID="gen3572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3573"/>Pata'uku iya bang buwattingga pangalappasku.”<l eID="gen3573" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3538"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.91"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.92"/> <div eID="gen3537" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1688"/><div sID="gen3574" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 93</title> <lg sID="gen3575"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1688"/> Si Yawe ya magsultan ma kamemon,<l eID="gen3576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3577"/>pagmahaldika'an sultan mahatinggi ya pamakayna.<l eID="gen3577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3578"/>Ga'osan sultan iya pakambot hawakanna.<l eID="gen3578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3579"/>Magsin'mmek iya kamahaltabatan.<l eID="gen3579" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3580"/>Ahogot papagan dunya itu, mbal tajudjal.<l eID="gen3580" level="1"/> <l sID="gen3581"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: Ya Tuhan, ahogot kapagsultannu, sangay min awal tagna'.<l eID="gen3581"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3582"/>Ka'asalnu dahū gi' min kapamapanjari dunya.<l eID="gen3582" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3583"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: O Yawe, ang'llub saga s'llang,<l eID="gen3583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3584"/>angabal tahik, alandos pangabalna,<l eID="gen3584" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3585"/>angalagublub kalumbagan tahik.<l eID="gen3585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: Landu' aheya pangulattub goyak,<l eID="gen3586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3587"/>aheya isab pang'llub goyak pasampoyak.<l eID="gen3587" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3588"/>Saguwā' labi lagi' aheya ga'osan si Yawe,<l eID="gen3588" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3589"/>ya katapusan alanga.<l eID="gen3589" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3590"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: Atantu pangahatulnu, mbal magpinda-pinda.<l eID="gen3590" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3591"/>Alingkat luma'nu e' kasussina.<l eID="gen3591" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3592"/>Alingkat ni kasaumulan, O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3592" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3575"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.93"/>

verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.94"/> <div eID="gen3574" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1689"/><div sID="gen3593" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 95</title> <lg sID="gen3594"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1689"/> Dai' na kam, magkalang kitam ni si Yawe kabowa kakōgan,<l eID="gen3595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3596"/>Patanogtam suwalatam ni iya,<l eID="gen3596" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3597"/>ya pinagsambatan Batu-Lakit panglappasan.<l eID="gen3597" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3598"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: Sūng kitam anukbal pagsukulan ni iya,<l eID="gen3598" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3599"/>paheyatam iya labay min kalangan maka tarasul.<l eID="gen3599" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3600"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: Sababna si Yawe ya Tuhan makaga'os,<l eID="gen3600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3601"/>sultan abantug, alanga min katuhan-tuhanan kamemon.<l eID="gen3601" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3602"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: Tinayak he'na po'onan dunya itu.<l eID="gen3602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3603"/>Dapuna asal saga kapussukan būd.<l eID="gen3603" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: Suku'na asal saga katahikan, sabab iya ya bay amapanjari.<l eID="gen3604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3605"/>Iya na isab bay angompol gintana'an.<l eID="gen3605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3606"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: Dai' na kam, pasujud kitam amudji iya.<l eID="gen3606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3607"/>Angōk-tu'ut kitam ma alopan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> Magpapanjari,<l eID="gen3607" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3608"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: kalna' in iya pagtuhanantam,<l eID="gen3608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3609"/>maka kitam saga a'ana, sapantun bili-bili ma pangipatanna.<l eID="gen3609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3610"/>Na, ma llaw itu, bang takalebi bissala Tuhan, yukna,<l eID="gen3610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: “Da'a patuwasunbi kōkbi buwat bay ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi ma Meriba,<l eID="gen3611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3612"/>buwat bay ma Massa isab, ma lahat paslangan.<l eID="gen3612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3613"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: Bay aku sinulayan maka tinukas he' ka'mbo'anbi,<l eID="gen3613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3614"/>sinulayan aku he' sigām,<l eID="gen3614" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3615"/>minsan du bay kalabayan he' sigām kahinanganku.<l eID="gen3615" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3616"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: Mpatpū' tahun bay kap'ddi' atayku ma pangkatan ina'an-i.<l eID="gen3616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3617"/>Saga a'a itu,” yukku, “mbal makatotog ameya' ma aku.<l eID="gen3617" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3618"/>Halam tata'u e' sigām kaul-pi'il ya kabaya'anku.<l eID="gen3618" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3619"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: Bay akagit atayku ati pagsapahanku sigām,” yukku,<l eID="gen3619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3620"/>“Saga a'a itu mbal to'ongan pasōd ni lahat pahalian bay tagamaku.”<l eID="gen3620" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3594"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.95"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1690"/><div sID="gen3621" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 100</title> <lg sID="gen3622"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1690"/> Ka'am kamemon ma dunya itu,<l eID="gen3623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3624"/>patanogun suwalabi amudji si Yawe,<l eID="gen3624" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3625"/>kabowa kakōganbi.<l eID="gen3625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: Ta'atunbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe luwas min kakoyaganbi,<l eID="gen3626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3627"/>pabaihu' kam ma iya maka kalanganbi makalasig.<l eID="gen3627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3628"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: Ta'uhunbi si Yawe, in iya Tuhan.<l eID="gen3628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3629"/>Si Yawe ya bay amapanjari kitam, ati suku'na kitam.<l eID="gen3629" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3630"/>A'ana kitam, sapantun bili-bili ma pangipatanna.<l eID="gen3630" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3631"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: Palabay kam min saga lawangna salta' kam magsarang-sukul.<l eID="gen3631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3632"/>Pasōd kam ni halaman luma'na hinabubi magpudji.<l eID="gen3632" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3633"/>Pagsukulinbi iya, pudjihunbi ōnna!<l eID="gen3633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: Sabab ahāp kasuddahan <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, maka taptap lasana kasi.<l eID="gen3634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3635"/>Kapangandolan iya salama-lama tahun.<l eID="gen3635" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3622"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1691"/><div sID="gen3636" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 103</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3637"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1691"/> Pudjiku si Yawe min deyom pangatayanku.<l eID="gen3638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3639"/>Pudjiku ōnna sussi min palnyawahanku<l eID="gen3639" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3640"/>maka min kuwat-anggauta'ku.<l eID="gen3640" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3641"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: Aho', pudjiku <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> min deyom pangatayanku,<l eID="gen3641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3642"/>mbal takalipat kamemon kahāpan ya bay pamuwanna.<l eID="gen3642" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3643"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: Sabab iya ya angampun kamemon paldusahanbi.<l eID="gen3643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3644"/>Iya ya amauli' kamemon sakibi.<l eID="gen3644" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3645"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: Iya isāb angal'kkat kallumbi min lahat kamatayan.<l eID="gen3645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3646"/>Iya isab amalipatan ka'am lasa maka ase'.<l eID="gen3646" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3647"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: Iya ya amuwanan ka'am ginisan kahāpan ya makahāp palasahanbi,<l eID="gen3647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3648"/>angkan tabawi' bay kosog kabata'bi.<l eID="gen3648" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3649"/>Sapantun kam belle' ya mbal ata'u binale'.<l eID="gen3649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3650"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: Abontol <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ma kahinanganna kamemon,<l eID="gen3650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3651"/>pinabontol e'na hukuman ma sasuku pininjala' e' sara'.<l eID="gen3651" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3652"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: Bay pata'una si Musa pasal kaniyatanna.<l eID="gen3652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3653"/>Bay pa'nda'na hinangna ni bangsa Isra'il.<l eID="gen3653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3654"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: Patiase'un maka patilasahun asal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen3654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3655"/>mbal akagit atayna magdai'-dai',<l eID="gen3655" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3656"/>gom pa'in palabi lasana tuman.<l eID="gen3656" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3657"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: Mbal iya paddas amabukag,<l eID="gen3657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3658"/>mbal anatas ka'astolna sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen3658" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: Mbal kita pinat'nna'an kabinasahan ya makatōpan dusata.<l eID="gen3659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3660"/>Mbal kita tinungbasan e'na ma buwat hinangta ala'at.<l eID="gen3660" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3661"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: Sabab-kalna', landu' aheya lasana ma sasuku magmatāwan iya.<l eID="gen3661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3662"/>Mbal tabista kaheya lasana itu, buwat diyata' langit<l eID="gen3662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3663"/>mbal tabista langkawna min babaw dunya.<l eID="gen3663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3664"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: Pinalawak e'na paldusahantam,<l eID="gen3664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3665"/>buwat lawak sobangan maka s'ddopan.<l eID="gen3665" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3666"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: Aheya ase' ma sasuku magmatāw ma iya,<l eID="gen3666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3667"/>buwat ka'ase' matto'a ma panganakna.<l eID="gen3667" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3668"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: Sabab kinata'uwan asal e'na ya bay pangompolan kitam manusiya'.<l eID="gen3668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3669"/>Taentomna in kitam bay nihinang min bagunbun tana'.<l eID="gen3669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3670"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: Ya niōnan manusiya' itu mbal anatas,<l eID="gen3670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3671"/>sapantun parang-parang dai'-dai' patubu'.<l eID="gen3671" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3672"/>Sapantun sumping huma dai'-dai' manisna.<l eID="gen3672" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3673"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: Pagtumbuk pa'in baliyu, magtūy halam na.<l eID="gen3673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3674"/>Mbal taentom bay kamahē'na.<l eID="gen3674" level="2"/> <l sID="gen3675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: Malaingkan ya kasi-lasa <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni sasuku magmatāw ma iya<l eID="gen3675"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3676"/>anatas min awal tagna' sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen3676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3677"/>Pasampay kahandakna abontol ni anak-mpu saga a'a kamemon,<l eID="gen3677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3678"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: sasuku amogbogan kapagsulutan sigām maka Tuhan,<l eID="gen3678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3679"/>maka atukid ameya' ma pandu'na.<l eID="gen3679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3680"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: Pinatuman e' si Yawe pagparintana ma sulga'<l eID="gen3680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3681"/>ati magtuhan iya ma papanjarihanna kamemon.<l eID="gen3681" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3682"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: Pudjihunbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe,<l eID="gen3682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3683"/>ka'am saga mala'ikatna patikawasahun<l eID="gen3683" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3684"/>ya angahinang kahandak Tuhan,<l eID="gen3684" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3685"/>ya ameya' ma panoho'anna.<l eID="gen3685" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3686"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: Pudjihunbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, ka'am kalaksa'-laksa'an<l eID="gen3686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3687"/>ya sosoho'anna ma deyom sulga',<l eID="gen3687" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3688"/>maka ka'am ya maghinang kabaya'anna.<l eID="gen3688" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3689"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: Pudjihunbi <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, ka'am papanjarihanna,<l eID="gen3689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3690"/>pudjihunbi iya maingga-maingga ma pagparintahanna.<l eID="gen3690" level="2"/> <l sID="gen3691"/>Pudjiku isab <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> sampay min buli'-atayku.<l eID="gen3691"/> <lg eID="gen3637"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.103"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1692"/><div sID="gen3692" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 119</title> <lg sID="gen3693"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1692"/> Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku mbal katōngan dusa,<l eID="gen3694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3695"/>ya atukid ameya' ma bay panara' si Yawe.<l eID="gen3695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3696"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma saga a'a ya magkahagad ma pandu'na,<l eID="gen3696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3697"/>ya magmatayan Tuhan sadja.<l eID="gen3697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3698"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: Mbal sigām angahinang kala'atan,<l eID="gen3698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3699"/>gom pa'in sigām an'ppu kajarihanna.<l eID="gen3699" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3700"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bay ka amat'nna'an kami hatulan<l eID="gen3700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3701"/>ya wajib bineya' to'ongan.<l eID="gen3701" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3702"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: Mura-murahan bang pa'in aku makatuyu'<l eID="gen3702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3703"/>ameya' ma ai-ai pangahandaknu.<l eID="gen3703" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3704"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: Mbal aku tahinang pagiya'an,<l eID="gen3704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3705"/>bang tahona'-hona'ku panoho'annu kamemon.<l eID="gen3705" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3706"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: Pudjiku ka magatay pote',<l eID="gen3706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3707"/>hinabuku angadji' panara'nu ya landu' abontol.<l eID="gen3707" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3708"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: Ameya' du aku ma pangahandaknu,<l eID="gen3708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3709"/>da'a pa'in aku siya-siyahun.<l eID="gen3709" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3710"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: Buwattingga he' subul anussi kajarihanna?<l eID="gen3710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3711"/>Luwal bang panunuranna palmannu.<l eID="gen3711" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3712"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: Ka'a ya pagmatayanku, Tuhan,<l eID="gen3712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3713"/>da'a aku tugutin pasā' min panoho'annu.<l eID="gen3713" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3714"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: Tatau'ku palmannu ma deyom pangatayanku<l eID="gen3714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3715"/>bo' supaya mbal amakay dusa ni ka'a.<l eID="gen3715" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3716"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: O Yawe, bang pa'in aheya barakat ma ka'a,<l eID="gen3716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3717"/>pandu'in lagi' aku pasal kahandaknu.<l eID="gen3717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3718"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: Usulku na pa'in<l eID="gen3718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3719"/>saga panara' bay pangallamnu.<l eID="gen3719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3720"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: Kinōgan aku ameya' ma pandu'nu,<l eID="gen3720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3721"/>buwat a'a magkōgan pangalta' aheya.<l eID="gen3721" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3722"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: Panoho'annu ya pagtali'anku kahaba' waktu,<l eID="gen3722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3723"/>pamikilanku na pa'in kajarihannu.<l eID="gen3723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3724"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: Ka'amuhan aku ma pangahandaknu,<l eID="gen3724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3725"/>mbal palehomku palmannu.<l eID="gen3725" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3726"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: Pagmurahun sosoho'annu itu, ati allum aku,<l eID="gen3726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3727"/>maka amogbog pahāp ma palmannu.<l eID="gen3727" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3728"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: Pasawahun lagi' pikilanku<l eID="gen3728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3729"/>bo' ahāp e'ku ang'nda' ma sara'nu makainu-inu.<l eID="gen3729" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3730"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, palmannu itu sapantun palita'an ma pal'ngngananku,<l eID="gen3730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3731"/>suwariyan ma labayanku.<l eID="gen3731" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3732"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: Bay aku makasapa maka bay patumanku,<l eID="gen3732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3733"/>in aku ameya' to'ongan ma panara'nu, ya adil lullun.<l eID="gen3733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3734"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: Makainu-inu pamandu'nu, angkan bogboganku to'ongan.<l eID="gen3734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3735"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: Palmannu ya pangā'an sawa pamaranta' pikilan manusiya',<l eID="gen3735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3736"/>minsan a'a akulang pangadji'na makahati du isab.<l eID="gen3736" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3693"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.119"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: <chapter eID="Ps.120"/> <div eID="gen3692" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1693"/><div sID="gen3737" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 121</title> <lg sID="gen3738"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1693"/> Pahangad aku ang'nda' tudju ni kabūran.<l eID="gen3739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3740"/>Minningga aku makabāk tabang?<l eID="gen3740" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3741"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: Tinabang aku he' si Yawe,<l eID="gen3741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3742"/>ya bay amapanjari langit maka dunya.<l eID="gen3742" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: Mbal pasagaranna tape'nu parasdas ma lān.<l eID="gen3743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3744"/>Mbal tatuli ya anganjagahan ka'a.<l eID="gen3744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3745"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: Mbal talilap ya anunggu'an bangsa Isra'il,<l eID="gen3745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3746"/>tantu iya mbal tatuli.<l eID="gen3746" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: Si Yawe ya anganjagahan ka'a,<l eID="gen3747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3748"/>pasindungannu si Yawe pataptap ma bihingnu kowan.<l eID="gen3748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3749"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: Mbal ka kinapiyalu bang llaw,<l eID="gen3749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3750"/>mbal ka taluwa' bulan bang sangom.<l eID="gen3750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3751"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe ya angahampanan ka'a bo' mbal ta'abut la'at.<l eID="gen3751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3752"/><divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya ameyanan kallum-nyawanu.<l eID="gen3752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3753"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ya anganjagahan ka'a ma katulaknu maka ma kapole'nu,<l eID="gen3753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3754"/>min llaw itu sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen3754" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3738"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1694"/><div sID="gen3755" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 139</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3756"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1694"/> O Yawe, bay aku tatabnu,<l eID="gen3757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3758"/>kata'uwannu aku maka kapaga'aku.<l eID="gen3758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3759"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: Ata'u ka ma katingkō'ku maka ma kapundukku,<l eID="gen3759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3760"/>kasakupannu pamikilku minsan min kalawakan.<l eID="gen3760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3761"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: Ata'u ka ma kalunsulku maka kalegeku,<l eID="gen3761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3762"/>tahimangkannu kajarihanku kamemon.<l eID="gen3762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3763"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: O Yawe, bang aku sōng amaluwas bissala,<l eID="gen3763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3764"/>asal kata'uwannu kamemonna ma halam gi' tak'bbat.<l eID="gen3764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3765"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: Nilikusan aku e'nu min dahuwan maka min bukutan,<l eID="gen3765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3766"/>kapat'nna'an aku tangannu.<l eID="gen3766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3767"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: Landu' makahaylan pangita'u buwattilu, mbal takannalku.<l eID="gen3767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3768"/>Landu' alanga, mbal ta'abutku.<l eID="gen3768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3769"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pi'ingga aku bo' makalahi min Rū-nu?<l eID="gen3769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3770"/>Pi'ingga palahianku bo' kaillaganku haddaratnu?<l eID="gen3770" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3771"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: Bang aku pa'angkat ni langit diyata', mailu ka asal.<l eID="gen3771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3772"/>Bang aku pabahak ma lahat kamatay, mailu isab ka.<l eID="gen3772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3773"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: Bang aku paleyang ni pasobangan llaw<l eID="gen3773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3774"/>ati maglahat aku ma dambila' s'llang,<l eID="gen3774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3775"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: ina'an ka isab angamaliman aku,<l eID="gen3775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3776"/>komkomannu aku maka tangannu sakap kowan.<l eID="gen3776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: Bang aku angupama, yukku, “Tantu aku katambunan e' kalendoman,<l eID="gen3777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3778"/>papinda isab llaw ni sangom ma katilibutku,”<l eID="gen3778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: halam aniya' dapat, sabab halam aniya' lendom ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3780"/>Minsan sangom anahaya sali' llaw,<l eID="gen3780" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3781"/>sabab sali' du lendom maka sawa bang ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3782"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: Ka'a <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, bay amapanjari ginhawa-baranku,<l eID="gen3782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3783"/>tabatuk e'nu pagdayawku hinabuku lagi' ma deyom kandang ina'ku.<l eID="gen3783" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3784"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: Aheya pudjiku ni ka'a, sabab ainu-inu aku, sinōd aku tāw,<l eID="gen3784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3785"/>ma sabab ginhawa-baran ya hinangannu aku.<l eID="gen3785" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3786"/>Tata'uku asal, makainu-inu kahinangan kamemon.<l eID="gen3786" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3787"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: Halam katapukan min ka'a pagdayaw baranku<l eID="gen3787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3788"/>waktu lagi' kapagbatuk ma aku ma kuta' kuddarat.<l eID="gen3788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3789"/>Waktu isab kapanganyam ma aku ma kalaloman gumi,<l eID="gen3789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3790"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: ta'nda'nu aku ma halam gi' ajukup kapaga'aku.<l eID="gen3790" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3791"/>Tasulat asal saga llaw ya pangangganta'nu ma aku,<l eID="gen3791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3792"/>tasulat ma deyom kitabnu,<l eID="gen3792" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3793"/>tasulat dahū lagi' min llaw kalahilku.<l eID="gen3793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3794"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: Ya Tuhan, ahalga' ma aku kahona'-hona'nu,<l eID="gen3794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3795"/>kumarukan hekana, mbal tasipat.<l eID="gen3795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3796"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: Bang aku angitung kahona'-hona'annu,<l eID="gen3796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3797"/>paheka lagi' min solagan gusung ma kaluha'an dunya.<l eID="gen3797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3798"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: Ya Tuhan, bang pa'in papataynu saga a'a jahallis!<l eID="gen3798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3799"/>Ka'am saga bula'ug, ala'an kam min aku!<l eID="gen3799" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3800"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: Tuhan, pinamūng-mūngan ka pangkal e' saga a'a inān,<l eID="gen3800" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3801"/>pinahina' ōnnu e' palbantahannu.<l eID="gen3801" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3802"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: O Yawe, aheya kab'nsiku ma sasuku ab'nsihan ka'a.<l eID="gen3802" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3803"/>Sasuku angatu ma kapagbaya'nu, asammal ma pang'nda'ku.<l eID="gen3803" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3804"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: Mbal kasandalan kab'nsiku ma saga a'a inān,<l eID="gen3804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3805"/>itungku sigām sali' bantaku.<l eID="gen3805" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3806"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: O Tuhan, lilingun aku bo' tata'unu deyom pangatayanku,<l eID="gen3806" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3807"/>tatabun aku bo' tata'unu bang ai kahanggawanku.<l eID="gen3807" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3808"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: Tandingun aku, ya aniya' makala'at ma iman-nyawaku,<l eID="gen3808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3809"/>ati malimin aku ma lān ya kakkal min awal ni ahil.<l eID="gen3809" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3756"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1695"/><div sID="gen3810" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 143</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="psalm">Kalangan si Da'ud</title> <lg sID="gen3811"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1695"/> O Yawe, kalehun lagi' pangamu'-ngamu'ku.<l eID="gen3812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3813"/>Kalehun panganjunjungku, ka'ase'in aku.<l eID="gen3813" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3814"/>Pasa'ut ka kono' anabangan aku,<l eID="gen3814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3815"/>sabab kapangandolan ka maka abontol.<l eID="gen3815" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3816"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: Aku itu sosoho'annu, da'a aku sara'un,<l eID="gen3816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3817"/>sabab halam aniya' manusiya' abontol ma pang'nda'nu.<l eID="gen3817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: Tinurul aku he' bantaku,<l eID="gen3818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3819"/>ginindasan aku e'na, pinodjak aku.<l eID="gen3819" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3820"/>Pinat'ddas aku he'na ma deyom kalendoman,<l eID="gen3820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3821"/>sapantun a'a at'ggol na kamatayna.<l eID="gen3821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3822"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' kaholatanku, alamma palnyawahanku,<l eID="gen3822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3823"/>angaloyot pangatayanku kabowa sukkalna.<l eID="gen3823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: Amagtak ni atay saga patahunan palabay,<l eID="gen3824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3825"/>angahona'-hona' aku pasal kahinangannu,<l eID="gen3825" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3826"/>amikil-mikil pasal hinang tangannu kamemon.<l eID="gen3826" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3827"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: Jari anangga aku tudju ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3828"/>mbal kasandalan pagmatay ma ka'a,<l eID="gen3828" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3829"/>sapantun a'a patay bohe' ma lahat apanggang.<l eID="gen3829" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3830"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pasa'ut lagi' ka anambung,<l eID="gen3830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3831"/>sabab angalongkoy iman-nyawaku.<l eID="gen3831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3832"/>Bang ka pataikut min aku,<l eID="gen3832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3833"/>tantu aku pasali' ni saga a'a ya amole' lahat.<l eID="gen3833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3834"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: Bang pa'in aniya' habal pagdai'-llaw<l eID="gen3834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3835"/>angalapalan aku pasal lasanu kakkal,<l eID="gen3835" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3836"/>sabab angandol du aku ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3836" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3837"/>Pandu'in aku lān ya wajib pal'ngngananku,<l eID="gen3837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3838"/>sabab ka'a ya pangaholatan palnyawahanku.<l eID="gen3838" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3839"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: O Yawe, liyusun aku kono' min saga bantaku,<l eID="gen3839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3840"/>sabab ka'a ya patapukanku.<l eID="gen3840" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3841"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: Pandu'in aku bo' tabeya'ku ai-ai pangahandaknu aku,<l eID="gen3841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3842"/>sabab ka'a ya Tuhanku.<l eID="gen3842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3843"/>Bang pa'in aku minaliman he' Rū-nu ahāp,<l eID="gen3843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3844"/>supaya aku makal'ngngan ma lān aratag.<l eID="gen3844" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3845"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: Ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, pakallumun aku ma sabab kabantug ōnnu.<l eID="gen3845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3846"/>Puwasin aku min kasukkalan ma sabab kabontol palangaynu.<l eID="gen3846" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3847"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: Laglagun lagi' palbantahanku ma sabab lasanu kakkal.<l eID="gen3847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3848"/>Pahalamun saga a'a kamemon ya anguntarahan aku, sabab atanu du aku.<l eID="gen3848" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3811"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1696"/><div sID="gen3849" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan 148</title> <lg sID="gen3850"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1696"/> Pudji ni si Yawe!<l eID="gen3851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3852"/>Pudjihunbi iya min deyom sulga',<l eID="gen3852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3853"/>pudjihunbi min kalangahan langit.<l eID="gen3853" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3854"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: Ka'am saga mala'ikatna, pudjihunbi iya,<l eID="gen3854" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3855"/>ka'am sosoho'anna patikawasahun, pudjihunbi.<l eID="gen3855" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3856"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: Ka'am mata llaw maka bulan, pudjihunbi si Yawe,<l eID="gen3856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3857"/>ka'am saga bitu'un magsasahaya, pudjihunbi iya.<l eID="gen3857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3858"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: Saga ma kalangkawan katapusan, amudji kam ma iya,<l eID="gen3858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3859"/>Saga bohe' ma diyata'an langit, amudji kam.<l eID="gen3859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3860"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: Patut pinabantug ōn si Yawe e' ai-ai pinapanjari<l eID="gen3860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3861"/>sabab angallam sadja iya ati paniya' magtūy.<l eID="gen3861" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3862"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: Pinat'nna'an sigām lugal min kahandakna,<l eID="gen3862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3863"/>pinat'nna'an sigām ganta'an ya anatas ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen3863" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3864"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: Pudjihunbi si Yawe ma kaluha'an dunya,<l eID="gen3864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3865"/>ka'am saga sattuwa maka sasuku ma kategob-tegoban,<l eID="gen3865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3866"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: l'tte' maka tigtigan aes, alu' aes maka gabun,<l eID="gen3866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3867"/>saga badju ya angahinang kabaya'anna,<l eID="gen3867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3868"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: kamemon kabūd-būran maka kabīd-bīran,<l eID="gen3868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3869"/>saga kabbun maka saga kayu sidro,<note>Sidro: po'on kayu landu' ahāp kayuna pangahinangan luma' atawa kappal.</note><l eID="gen3869" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3870"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: kaginisan sattuwa talun maka kamemon sapi' ni'ipat,<l eID="gen3870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3871"/>manuk-manuk palē maka manuk-manuk pikpikan<l eID="gen3871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3872"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: saga kasultanan ma dunya maka palbangsa-bangsahan,<l eID="gen3872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3873"/>saga a'a balbangsa maka saga magbabaya',<l eID="gen3873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3874"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: saga onde' baha'u subul-budjang,<l eID="gen3874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3875"/>kamanahutan maka kato'ahan.<l eID="gen3875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3876"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: Papudjihun kamemon pinapanjari itu,<l eID="gen3876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3877"/>soho'un amabantug ōn si Yawe<l eID="gen3877" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3878"/>sabab luwal ōnna ya patut binantug.<l eID="gen3878" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3879"/>Minsan maingga ma dunya, minsan isab ma sulga'<l eID="gen3879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3880"/>halam aniya' makaliyu min kamahaldika'an si Yawe.<l eID="gen3880" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3881"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: Aniya' a'a patikosogun pinaniya' e'na panabang saga a'ana,<l eID="gen3881" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3882"/>a'a pinagmahaltabatan e' kamemon suku'na,<l eID="gen3882" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3883"/>e' saga panubu' si Isra'il, ya bangsa kalasahanna.<l eID="gen3883" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3850"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.148"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1697"/><div sID="gen3891" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalahi si Nabi Yunus min Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen3892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1697"/> Aniya' lapal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pasampay ni si Yunus anak si Amittai.

verses.name: Jonah 1:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Pehē' ka ni da'ira Niniba, ya da'ira aheya inān. Magnasihat ka pehē' ni saga a'ana. Pata'uhun sigām in da'ira sigām song pinat'kkahan mulka', sabab ta'nda'ku kala'atan sigām.”  <div eID="gen3892" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1698"/><div sID="gen3893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1698"/> Sagō' mbal bilahi si Yunus, gom pa'in alahi iya min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. Ya tudjuna lahat saddī niōnan Tarsis, angkan iya palūd ni Joppa amiha kappal pameya'anna pehē'. Pagbayadna pa'in sukay, pariyata' na iya bo' yampa patulak ni lahat Tarsis ya lahat palahianna min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.  <div eID="gen3893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1699"/><div sID="gen3894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1699"/> Manjari aniya' baliyu akosog pinatumbuk e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni dilaut kablangan e'. Alandos goyak agon makaka'at kappal.

verses.name: Jonah 1:5
verses.text: Sinōd tāw saga a'a kamemon maghihinang ma kappal inān ati angalemong sigām ni tuhan-tuhan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya bang pa'in tinabangan. Puwas e' tinimanan e' sigām ba'anan duwa'an ni tahik supaya angalampung kappal.  <div eID="gen3894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1700"/><div sID="gen3895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1700"/> Sagō' bay pareyo' si Yunus ni deyom mohang. Palege iya maina'an sampay ahaluk tulina. Manjari ta'abut iya maina'an e' kapitan kappal. Yukna ma iya, “Oy! Makatuli gi' ka, ā! Pabungkal ka! Angamu'-ngamu' ka ni Tuhannu! Kalu kitam kinale ati lappasan kitam!”  <div eID="gen3895" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1701"/><div sID="gen3896" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1701"/> Sakali magsuli-suli saga a'a maghinang ma kappal, yuk sigām, “Sūng, magko'ot-ko'ot kitam bo' kata'uwantam bang sai sababan bala' itu.” Manjari magko'ot pa'in sigām, ōn si Yunus ya tako'ot.  <div eID="gen3896" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1702"/><div sID="gen3897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1702"/> Yuk saga a'a inān ma iya, “Haka'in kami bang sai makasabab ya angkan kitam kat'kkahan bala' itu. Ai usahanu? Minningga ka? Ai lahatnu? Bangsa ai ka?”  <div eID="gen3897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1703"/><div sID="gen3898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1703"/> Anambung si Yunus, yukna, “Aku itu bangsa Hibrani. Ya pagta'atanku si Yawe, Tuhan tag-sulga' ya magpapanjari deya maka dilaut.”  <div eID="gen3898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1704"/><div sID="gen3899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1704"/> Na, ag'mma sumangat sigām pagka takale haka si Yunus in iya alahi min <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>. “Arōy!” yuk sigām. “Daka ai tahinangnu itu!”

verses.name: Jonah 1:11
verses.text: Sakali pakosog na pa'in bo' pakosog goyak. Manjari tinilaw e' sigām si Yunus, yuk-i, “Ai subay hinang kami ma ka'a supaya pat'ddo' tahik itu?”  <div eID="gen3899" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1705"/><div sID="gen3900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1705"/> “Hūgunbi aku ni tahik,” yukna, “bo' pat'ddo' pabalik. Kata'uwanku aku ya sababan angkan kam taluwa' goyak aheya itu.”  <div eID="gen3900" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1706"/><div sID="gen3901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1706"/> Sagō' mbal bilahi saga a'a ma kappal inān. Gom pa'in sigām amuspus magtindayung kalu makasampay ni bihing. Sagō' mbal takole' e' sigām sabab akalap lagi' goyak min bay dahū.

verses.name: Jonah 1:14
verses.text: Puwas e' angamu'-ngamu' sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe. Yuk sigām, “O Yawe, ma'ase' ka. Da'a kami papatayun bang a'a itu amatay e' kami. Da'a kami dusahin bang kami am'kkat nyawa a'a halam aniya' dusana. Ka'a sadja ya magbaya'.”

verses.name: Jonah 1:15
verses.text: Manjari binuhat e' sigām si Yunus bo' nihūg ni tahik. Magtūy pahondong goyak ati t'ddo' na pabalik.

verses.name: Jonah 1:16
verses.text: Minnē' aheya tāw saga a'a inān ma <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> si Yunus. Sakali aniya' kulban tinukbal e' sigām ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> e' maka aniya' pagnajal sigām ma iya.  <div eID="gen3901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1707"/><div sID="gen3902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1707"/> Malaingkan aniya' daing landu' aheya bay pinabeya' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> an'llon si Yunus. Manjari t'llung'llaw t'llumbahangi ya t'ggol si Yunus ma deyom b'ttong daing e'.  <div eID="gen3902" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jonah.1"/> <div eID="gen3891" type="section"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1708"/><div sID="gen3903" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angamu'-ngamu' si Yunus</title> <div sID="gen3904" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1708"/> Ma deyom b'ttong daing pa'in si Yunus, angamu'-ngamu' iya ni si Yawe ya Tuhanna.

verses.name: Jonah 2:2
verses.text: Yukna, <lg sID="gen3905"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3906"/>“Pagka aku ma deyom kasigpitan<l eID="gen3906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3907"/>bay lingananku <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName><l eID="gen3907" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3908"/>ati kasambungan aku e'na.<l eID="gen3908" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3909"/>Pagka aku ma lahat kamatayan,<l eID="gen3909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3910"/>bay aku angamu' tabang, ati takalenu pangamu'ku.<l eID="gen3910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3911"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:3
verses.text: Bay aku larukannu pehē' ni s'llang<l eID="gen3911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3912"/>ni lalom tegob-tegoban, ni buliluk s'llog.<l eID="gen3912" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3913"/>Bay aku tabowa e' abalnu,<l eID="gen3913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3914"/>Bay aku kasampoyakan e' goyaknu.<l eID="gen3914" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3915"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:4
verses.text: Ya pangannalku, ‘In aku palawaknu min matahannu.’<l eID="gen3915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3916"/>Magniyat aku mbal na maka'nda' pabalik<l eID="gen3916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3917"/>ma langgalnu sussi.<l eID="gen3917" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3918"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:5
verses.text: Agon-agon aku alembo ma tahik,<l eID="gen3918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3919"/>Alimun aku ma tahik tegob-tegoban,<l eID="gen3919" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3920"/>Kaleboran aku e' sagmot tahik.<l eID="gen3920" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3921"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:6
verses.text: Pat'nde aku sampay ni deyo' katapusan.<l eID="gen3921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3922"/>Pa'abut aku ni lahat kamatayan,<l eID="gen3922" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3923"/>ni lahat atambol lawangna salama-lama.<l eID="gen3923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3924"/>Daipara ka'a Tuhan, ka'a Panghū'ku,<l eID="gen3924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3925"/>bay angalappasan aku min deyo' katobtoban.<l eID="gen3925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3926"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:7
verses.text: Song pa'in ab'kkat napasku,<l eID="gen3926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3927"/>taentomku ka'a, O <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>.<l eID="gen3927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3928"/>Bay sabbutku ōnnu,<l eID="gen3928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3929"/>bay pasampayku panganduwa'aku ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3929" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3930"/>ni deyom langgalnu sussi.<l eID="gen3930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3931"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:8
verses.text: Sai-sai ameya'an tuhan-tuhan halam pūsna<l eID="gen3931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3932"/>alungay pangandolna ma ka'a.<l eID="gen3932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3933"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:9
verses.text: Sagō' aku itu anukbalan kulban ni ka'a<l eID="gen3933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3934"/>hinabu angalang pamudji.<l eID="gen3934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3935"/>Tumanku bay najalku ni ka'a,<l eID="gen3935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3936"/>sabab ka'a ya si Yawe ya <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> maglalappas.”<l eID="gen3936" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3905"/>  <div eID="gen3904" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1709"/><div sID="gen3937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1709"/> Puwas e', in daing aheya tasoho' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> angutta'an si Yunus pehē' ni bihing tampe.  <div eID="gen3937" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jonah.2"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:1
verses.text: Puwas e' pasampay lapal <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ni si Yunus, kaminduwana na.

verses.name: Jonah 3:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Pehē' ka ni Niniba, ya da'ira aheya inān. Magnasihat ka ma sigām ya lapal pangahakaku itu ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen3938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1710"/><div sID="gen3939" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1710"/> Jari bineya' e' si Yunus panoho'an <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ati pehē' iya ni Niniba. Aheya sidda da'ira Niniba inān, saga t'llung'llaw nil'ngngan.

verses.name: Jonah 3:4
verses.text: Na, makal'ngngan pa'in si Yunus dang'llaw, magnasihat na iya. Yukna, “Ta'abut mpatpū'-ng'llaw minnitu nilubu da'ira Niniba itu.”

verses.name: Jonah 3:5
verses.text: Pagkale saga a'a Niniba ma lapal Tuhan itu, magtūy sigām am'nnal ma iya. Magdakayu' sigām gara' subay magpuwasa, jari saga a'a inān kamemon aheya-ariki' magsin'mmek karut paltanda'an in sigām pataikut na min dusa sigām.  <div eID="gen3939" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1711"/><div sID="gen3940" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1711"/> Na, makasampay pa'in haka itu ni sultan ma lahat Niniba, magtūy iya an'ngge min paningkō'anna pagsultanan. Nihurusan pamakayna bangsahan bo' mags'mmek karut maka e'na aningkō' ma abu.

verses.name: Jonah 3:7
verses.text: Pagubus, aniya' lling bay pinatanyag e' sultan itu ma saga a'a Niniba, yukna, “Lling itu min sultan maka saga a'ana bangsahan: Ai na ka manusiya' atawa hayop, subay da'a amangan atawa anginum, maka mbal animtim minsan ai.

verses.name: Jonah 3:8
verses.text: Kamemon saga manusiya' maka kamemon hayop subay pinat'nna'an karut. In kamemon a'a subay amuspus angamu' duwa'a ni Tuhan. Subay nibbahan e' sigām in kahinangan sigām asabul maka jahulaka'.

verses.name: Jonah 3:9
verses.text: Kalu mura-murahan apinda pikilan Tuhan bo' ma'ase'. Jari mbal lanjalanna mulka'na ati kitam itu mbal magmula.”  <div eID="gen3940" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1712"/><div sID="gen3941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1712"/> Na, pag'nda' Tuhan ma bay kahinangan sigām e', in sigām pataikut na min kala'atan bay kabiyaksahan sigām, jari apinda pikilanna. Ma'ase' iya ma sigām ati halam nilanjalan niyatna angamulka'an sigām.  <div eID="gen3941" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jonah.3"/> <div eID="gen3903" type="section"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1713"/><div sID="gen3942" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Akagit atay si Yunus ma sabab ka'ase' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName></title> <div sID="gen3943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1713"/> Saguwā' akagit atay si Yunus, halam to'ongan iya kasulutan.

verses.name: Jonah 4:2
verses.text: Angamu'-ngamu' iya ni <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “O Yawe, ya na ko' itu bay kagawahanku mahē' lagi' aku ma lahatku. Angkan na aku bay pasa'ut alahi tudju ni lahat Tarsis. Kata'uwanku kasuddahannu, in ka'a-i Tuhan pananabang maka patiase'un, mbal magdai'-dai' angastol. Patilasahun ka asal, ata'u amindahan niyatnu arak amat'kka bala'.

verses.name: Jonah 4:3
verses.text: Angkan ko', <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, b'kkatun na napasku sabab ahāp lagi' aku amatay.”  <div eID="gen3943" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1714"/><div sID="gen3944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1714"/> Sagō' anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName> ma iya yukna, “Aniya' bahā' kapatutnu angastol buwattilu?”  <div eID="gen3944" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1715"/><div sID="gen3945" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1715"/> Puwas e' paluwas si Yunus min da'ira inān maka e'na aningkō' ma luwasan, tampal ni sobangan. Aniya' panggung tahinangna maina'an, jari aningkō' iya ma sindunganna angagad-ngagad bo' kata'uwanna bang ai katobtoban da'ira he'.

verses.name: Jonah 4:6
verses.text: Sakali aniya' bahan dahunan pinatomo' e' <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>-Yawe pamalimbu kōk si Yunus bo' mbal ala'at palasahanna. Jari kinōgan si Yunus ma sabab bahan e'.

verses.name: Jonah 4:7
verses.text: Sagō' pagdai'-llaw, aniya' ulat pinapehē' e' Tuhan amangan batang bahan bo' angalanos.

verses.name: Jonah 4:8
verses.text: Alanga pa'in llaw, aniya' isab baliyu pabeya'na min sobangan, baliyu landu' apasu', jari kasilakan kōk si Yunus sampay iya kinapiyalu. Bilahi na iya amatay, yukna, “Gom gi' aku amatay.”  <div eID="gen3945" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1716"/><div sID="gen3946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1716"/> Manjari ah'lling Tuhan ma si Yunus, yukna, “Taga-kapatut ka bahā' angastol ma sabab kalanos bahan e'?” <div eID="gen3946" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen3947" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk sambung si Yunus. “Ahāp lagi' aku amatay sabab mbal kasandalanku ka'astolku itu.”  <div eID="gen3947" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jonah 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1717"/><div sID="gen3948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1717"/> Sagō' anambung <divineName>PANGHŪ'</divineName>, yukna, “Bahan ilu bay pasaha' waktu sangom bo' pak'llos waktu llaw. Ngga'i ka ka'a ya bay angipat iya atawa amatomo', bo' pa'in pagsusahannu.

verses.name: Jonah 4:11
verses.text: Ya lagi'na saga a'a ma da'ira Niniba itu. Labi sigām dahatus maka duwampū' ngibu puhu', a'a mbal makasilang gibang min kowan<note>Mbal makasilang ma gibang maka kowan: hatina arai', mbal ata'u ma pagbidda'an hāp maka la'at.</note> bang ai bidda'na. Aheka isab kahayop-hayopan maina'an. Angkan subay pagsusahanku da'ira itu maka saga a'ana landu' aheka.”  <div eID="gen3948" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen3942" type="section"/> <div eID="gen3890" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Jonah.4"/> <div eID="gen3884" osisID="Jonah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1718"/><div sID="gen3955" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapangkatan si Isa Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.3.23-Luke.3.28">Lukas 3:23-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen3956" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1718"/> Ya itu kapangkatan si Isa Al-Masi, panubu' si Da'ud ya panubu' si Ibrahim. <lg sID="gen3957"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3958"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:2
verses.text: Si Ibrahim bay mma' si Isa'ak,<l eID="gen3958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3959"/>ya Isa'ak bay mma' si Yakub.<l eID="gen3959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3960"/>Si Yakub bay mma' si Yuda maka saga danakanna,<l eID="gen3960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3961"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:3
verses.text: si Yuda bay mma' si Peres maka si Sera (si Tamar ya ina' sigām).<l eID="gen3961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3962"/>Si Peres bay mma' si Hesdon,<l eID="gen3962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3963"/>ya si Hesdon bay mma' si Aram.<l eID="gen3963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3964"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:4
verses.text: Si Aram bay mma' si Amminadab,<l eID="gen3964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3965"/>ya Amminadab bay mma' si Nasson.<l eID="gen3965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3966"/>Si Nasson bay mma' si Salmon,<l eID="gen3966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3967"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:5
verses.text: ya Salmon bay mma' si Bowas (si Rahab ya ina'na).<l eID="gen3967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3968"/>Si Bowas bay mma' si Obed, ina'na bay si Rūt.<l eID="gen3968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3969"/>Si Obed bay mma' si Jesse,<l eID="gen3969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3970"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:6
verses.text: ya Jesse bay mma' sultan Da'ud.<l eID="gen3970" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3957"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3971"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3972"/>Si Da'ud inān bay mma' si Sulayman, ina'na bay h'nda si Uriya.<l eID="gen3972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3973"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:7
verses.text: Si Sulayman bay mma' si Rehobowam,<l eID="gen3973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3974"/>ya Rehobowam bay mma' si Abiya,<l eID="gen3974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3975"/>ya Abiya bay mma' si Asa.<l eID="gen3975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3976"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:8
verses.text: Si Asa bay mma' si Josapat,<l eID="gen3976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3977"/>ya Josapat bay mma' si Joram,<l eID="gen3977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3978"/>ya Joram bay mma' si Usiya.<l eID="gen3978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3979"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:9
verses.text: Si Usiya bay mma' si Jotam,<l eID="gen3979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3980"/>ya Jotam bay mma' si Ahas,<l eID="gen3980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3981"/>ya Ahas bay mma' si Hijikiya.<l eID="gen3981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3982"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:10
verses.text: Si Hijikiya bay mma' si Manasse,<l eID="gen3982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3983"/>ya si Manasse bay mma' si Amon,<l eID="gen3983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3984"/>ya Amon bay mma' si Jusiya.<l eID="gen3984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3985"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:11
verses.text: Si Jusiya bay mma' si Jekoniya maka saga danakanna.<l eID="gen3985" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3971"/> <lb/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:12
verses.text: Min waktu kapamowa bangsa Isra'il ni lahat Babilon sampay ni waktu kapaganak ma si Isa, buwattitu ya sugsuganna. <lg sID="gen3986"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3987"/>Si Jekoniya inān bay mma' si Salati,<l eID="gen3987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3988"/>ya Salati bay mma' si Sirubbabil.<l eID="gen3988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3989"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:13
verses.text: Si Sirubbabil bay mma' si Abiyud,<l eID="gen3989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3990"/>ya Abiyud bay mma' si Eliyakim,<l eID="gen3990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3991"/>ya Eliyakim bay mma' si Asor.<l eID="gen3991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3992"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:14
verses.text: Si Asor bay mma' si Sadok,<l eID="gen3992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3993"/>ya Sadok bay mma' si Akim,<l eID="gen3993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3994"/>ya Akim bay mma' si Eliyud.<l eID="gen3994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3995"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:15
verses.text: Si Eliyud bay mma' si Eleyasar,<l eID="gen3995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3996"/>ya Eleyasar bay mma' si Mattan,<l eID="gen3996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3997"/>ya Mattan bay mma' si Yakub.<l eID="gen3997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3998"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:16
verses.text: Si Yakub bay mma' si Yusup<l eID="gen3998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3999"/>ya h'lla si Mariyam ina' si Isa,<l eID="gen3999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4000"/>ya niōnan Al-Masi.<l eID="gen4000" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3986"/>  <div eID="gen3956" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1719"/><div sID="gen4001" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1719"/> Manjari aniya' sangpū' maka mpat pangkatan min si Ibrahim sampay ni si Da'ud, sangpū' maka mpat pangkatan min si Da'ud sampay ni waktu bay pamala'an saga a'a Isra'il ni Babilon, ati sangpū' maka mpat pangkatan isab minnē' sampay ni waktu kapaganak ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen4001" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen3955" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:18
