verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1720"/><div sID="gen4002" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanganak ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.2.1-Luke.2.7">Lukas 2:1-7</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1720"/> Buwattitu ya kal'ngnganan kapanganak ma si Isa Al-Masi. Ina'na si Mariyam bay makapagbintak asal maka si Yusup, sagō' ma halam gi' sigā takawin tananam e' si Mariyam in iya angiram sabab min kawasa Rū Sussi.<note>‘Rū Sussi’, hatina Rū Tuhan, ya pinagōnan isab Nyawa Tuhan.</note>

verses.name: Matthew 1:19
verses.text: A'a adil asal si Yusup ya tunang si Mariyam e', angkan iya agara' pabaibad min iya ma halam aniya' makata'u. Mbal iya bilahi amuwanan si Mariyam kaiya'an ma mata mairan.

verses.name: Matthew 1:20
verses.text: Na, sabu pa'in si Yusup amikil-mikil pasal pakaradja'an itu, aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan pauppi ni iya. Yuk mala'ikat, “O Yusup panubu' si Da'ud, da'a ka ahawal-hawal magdakayu' maka si Mariyam ilu, sabab min kawasa Rū Tuhan ya angkan aniya' kab'ttonganna.

verses.name: Matthew 1:21
verses.text: Anganak du iya l'lla, ati Isa ya pangōnnu ma iya sabab iya ya angalappas bangsana Isra'il min paldusahan sigām.”  <div eID="gen4003" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1721"/><div sID="gen4004" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1721"/> Na, pinat'kka saga pakaradja'an itu kamemon bo' aniya' katumanan ma bay pangallam Tuhan ma dakayu' nabi, ya yuk-i,

verses.name: Matthew 1:23
verses.text: “Aniya' inān budjang angiram, ati anganak iya l'lla, Emmanuwel ya pangōn sigām ma iya.” Hatina ‘Tuhan pat'nna' ma kitam.’  <div eID="gen4004" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1722"/><div sID="gen4005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1722"/> Pagbati' pa'in si Yusup min uppina, bineya' e'na panoho'an mala'ikat ati pah'ndana si Mariyam.

verses.name: Matthew 1:25
verses.text: Sagō' subay na apuwas bay kapanganak si Mariyam bo' yampa sigā magpūn. Jari anganak si Mariyam l'lla ati Isa ya pangōn si Yusup ma iya.  <div eID="gen4005" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.1"/> <div eID="gen4002" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1723"/><div sID="gen4006" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a min Sobangan</title> <div sID="gen4007" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1723"/> Si Isa bay nianakan ma kaluma'an Betlehem ma lahat Yahudiya, ma masa kapagsultan si Herod. Mbal at'ggol, aniya' saga a'a alim bay min sobangan at'kka pehē' ni Awrusalam. Saga a'a itu pangangadji' ma saga bitu'un.

verses.name: Matthew 2:2
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām ni Awrusalam magtūy sigām atilaw, yuk-i, “Maingga na onde'-onde' bay nianakan, ya ginanta' magsultan ma bangsa Yahudi? Ta'nda' kami bitu'un ya pamandogahan iya, paluwa' min sobangan, jari itiya' kami pi'itu amudji iya.”  <div eID="gen4007" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1724"/><div sID="gen4008" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1724"/> Pagkale itu e' Sultan Herod, magtūy landu' asasaw pikilanna. Sampay saga a'a kamemon ma deyom da'ira inān magkasasawan du isab.

verses.name: Matthew 2:4
verses.text: Magpanoho'an si Herod subay magtipun saga nakura' kaimaman maka saga guru sara' agama. Atilaw iya ma sigām, yukna, “Maingga kono' panganakan Al-Masi?”  <div eID="gen4008" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1725"/><div sID="gen4009" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1725"/> Anambung saga a'a inān, yuk-i, “Ma kaluma'an Betlehem, ma lahat Yahudiya, sabab tasulat asal e' nabi ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i: <lg sID="gen4010"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4011"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:6
verses.text: ‘In kauman Betlehem, ya ma lahat Yahudiya,<l eID="gen4011" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4012"/>aheya kabantuganna min saga da'ira babantugun ma lahat Yahudiya,<l eID="gen4012" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4013"/>sabab aniya' palahil minnē' dakayu' a'a magmakōk,<l eID="gen4013" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4014"/>a'a angupiksa' saga a'aku bangsa Isra'il!’ ”<l eID="gen4014" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4010"/>  <div eID="gen4009" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1726"/><div sID="gen4015" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1726"/> Puwas e' pinalinganan e' sultan Herod saga a'a alim e', binowa magbissala ma halam aniya' makata'u. Tinilaw sigām e'na bang sumiyan waktu bay kasobang bitu'un.

verses.name: Matthew 2:8
verses.text: Kahaka'an pa'in sultan, pinapehē' sigām ni Betlehem. Buwattitu panoho'anna ma sigām, yuk-i, “Pehē' kam, piha'unbi to'ongan onde'-onde' inān. Bang iya tabākbi, pata'uhunbi aku supaya aku isab pehē' amudji iya.”  <div eID="gen4015" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1727"/><div sID="gen4016" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1727"/> Aubus pa'in sigām binissalahan e' sultan, palanjal na sigām tudju ni Betlehem. Ma labayan pa'in, parahū min sigām bitu'un ya bay ta'nda' sigām ma lahat sobangan lagi'. Pag'nda' itu, landu' aheya kakōgan sigām. Jari patongod bitu'un inān min diyata' luma' ya pat'nna'an onde'.

verses.name: Matthew 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1727"/><div sID="gen4016" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1727"/> Aubus pa'in sigām binissalahan e' sultan, palanjal na sigām tudju ni Betlehem. Ma labayan pa'in, parahū min sigām bitu'un ya bay ta'nda' sigām ma lahat sobangan lagi'. Pag'nda' itu, landu' aheya kakōgan sigām. Jari patongod bitu'un inān min diyata' luma' ya pat'nna'an onde'.

verses.name: Matthew 2:11
verses.text: Makasōd pa'in saga a'a alim inān ni deyom luma', ta'nda' e' sigām onde'-onde' maka ina'na si Mariyam. Jari pasujud sigām amudji iya, maka pinaluwas isab saga huhulmatan bay bowa sigām pamuwan ma onde' inān. Aniya' bulawan, kamanyan, maka pahamut mira.<note>‘Mira:’ ginis bulitik ahāp hamutna.</note>  <div eID="gen4016" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1728"/><div sID="gen4017" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1728"/> Puwas e' binanda'an sigām e' Tuhan ma deyom uppi, sinō' da'a pabalik ni si Herod. Manjari amole' sigām ni lahat labay min lān saddī.  <div eID="gen4017" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4006" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1729"/><div sID="gen4018" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalahi disi Yusup ni Lahat Misil</title> <div sID="gen4019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1729"/> Pagla'an sigām, aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan magpanyata' ni si Yusup ma deyom uppi. Yuk mala'ikat, “Punduk ka. Bowahun onde' maka ina'na ilu ati alahi kam ni lahat Misil. Mahē' gi' kam sat'ggol kam mbal pala'anku minnē'. Ilu si Herod amiha onde' ilu pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen4019" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1730"/><div sID="gen4020" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1730"/> Magtūy punduk si Yusup. Niā' e'na onde' maka ina'na bo' sigām pauntas minnē' tudju ni lahat Misil ma sangom du inān.

verses.name: Matthew 2:15
verses.text: Mahē' sigām sampay amatay si Herod. Jari aniya' kamaksuran ma bay pangallam Tuhan, ya tasulat ma Kitab e' nabi Hoseya. Yukna, “Bay soho'ku anakku pi'itu min lahat Misil.”  <div eID="gen4020" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4018" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1731"/><div sID="gen4021" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamapatay saga Onde'</title> <div sID="gen4022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1731"/> Pagta'u pa'in e' si Herod in iya bay niakkalan he' saga a'a alim e', apasu' to'ongan atayna. Magtūy iya magpanoho'an pinapatay saga onde'-onde' l'lla kamemon ma Betlehem sampay ma sakalibutna, sasuku angumul duwantahun sampay pareyo' gi' minnē'. Binista e' si Herod umul saga onde' inān tinagna'an min waktu bay pamata'u iya e' saga a'a alim pasal waktu katuwa' bitu'un.  <div eID="gen4022" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1732"/><div sID="gen4023" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1732"/> Minnē' aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat e' nabi Irimiya, ya yukna, <lg sID="gen4024"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4025"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:18
verses.text: “Aniya' lengog takale ma lahat Rama,<l eID="gen4025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4026"/>lengog a'a magkarukka'an maka maglemong.<l eID="gen4026" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4027"/>Si Rakiya anangisan saga anakna.<l eID="gen4027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4028"/>Mbal tapahali paglemongna,<l eID="gen4028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4029"/>sabab wa'i pinapatay anakna kamemon.”<l eID="gen4029" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4024"/>  <div eID="gen4023" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4021" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1733"/><div sID="gen4030" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amole' disi Yusup ni Nasaret</title> <div sID="gen4031" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1733"/> Amatay pa'in si Herod, aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan bay pauppi ni si Yusup mahē' ma lahat Misil.

verses.name: Matthew 2:20
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat, “Punduk ka. Bowahun onde' maka ina'na pabalik ni lahat Isra'il, sabab magpatayan na saga a'a bilahi amapatay onde' ilu.”

verses.name: Matthew 2:21
verses.text: Sakali pabangun si Yusup. Binowa e'na onde' maka ina'na pabalik ni lahat Isra'il.  <div eID="gen4031" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1734"/><div sID="gen4032" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1734"/> Pagta'u pa'in e' si Yusup in si Arkilas paganti' na min mma'na si Herod magsultan ma lahat Yahudiya, atāw iya palahat maina'an. Binanda'an iya pabalik ma deyom uppi, ya angkan sigām magtai'anak pehē' ni lahat Jalil

verses.name: Matthew 2:23
verses.text: bo' pat'nna' ma kaluma'an niōnan Nasaret. Jari aniya' kamaksuran ma bay pinagkallam e' saga kanabihan pasal Al-Masi, ya yuk-i, “Niōnan iya a'a Nasaret.”  <div eID="gen4032" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.2"/> <div eID="gen4030" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1735"/><div sID="gen4033" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagnasihat si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.1-Mark.1.8">Markus 1:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.3.1-Luke.3.18">Lukas 3:1-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.1.19-John.1.28">Yahiya 1:19-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4034" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1735"/> Manjari ma waktu he'-i at'kka si Yahiya Magpapandi pehē' ni paslangan Yahudiya magnasihat.

verses.name: Matthew 3:2
verses.text: Yuk nasihatna ni saga a'a bay patimuk pina'an, “Pataikut kam min dusabi sabab asekot na waktu kapagparinta Tuhan ma kitam.”

verses.name: Matthew 3:3
verses.text: Si Yahiya itu bay pinagbissala asal e' nabi Isaya, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4035"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4036"/>“Aniya' a'a angalingan ma lahat paslangan, yukna,<l eID="gen4036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4037"/>‘Lanu'inbi lān ya palabayan Panghū'.<l eID="gen4037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4038"/>Pabontolunbi pal'ngngananna.’ ”<l eID="gen4038" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4035"/>  <div eID="gen4034" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1736"/><div sID="gen4039" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1736"/> Ya pas'mmek si Yahiya inān kakana' hinangan bulbul unta', maka dakayu' sabitan kuwit sapi' pakambot ma hawakanna. Ya pagkakanna ampan maka gula' buwani.

verses.name: Matthew 3:5
verses.text: Na, pehē' ni si Yahiya saga a'a min da'ira Awrusalam, min kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya, maka min saga kaluma'an ma karuwambila' sapa' Jordan.

verses.name: Matthew 3:6
verses.text: Magpasab'nnal sigām pasal bay dusa sigām, ati pinandi sigām e' si Yahiya ma sapa' Jordan e'.  <div eID="gen4039" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1737"/><div sID="gen4040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1737"/> Sagō' pag'nda' si Yahiya ma ba'anan a'a Parisi maka a'a Saddusi pina'an ni iya mikipandi, yukna ni sigām, “Ē, ka'am ilu, addatbi sapantun sowa pangangakkal! Sai bahā' bay amanda'an ka'am subay papuwas min mulka' Tuhan ya song pat'kka?

verses.name: Matthew 3:8
verses.text: Bang kam sab'nnal-b'nnal pataikut na min dusabi, hinangunbi hinang ahāp, palsaksi'an in addatbi apinda na.

verses.name: Matthew 3:9
verses.text: Da'a kam magpikil in ka'am mbal minulka'an saukat na kam panubu' si Ibrahim. Haka'anta kam, minsan saga batu itu tahinang du panubu' si Ibrahim e' Tuhan!

verses.name: Matthew 3:10
verses.text: Ka'am ilu hantang saga kayu arai' na pinuwad maka kapa, tobtob min po'onna. Sabab kayu kamemon mbal ahāp buwa'na pinuwad du, nilarukan ni deyom api tinunu'.

verses.name: Matthew 3:11
verses.text: Aku itu,” yuk si Yahiya, “hal bohe' ya pamandiku ka'am, tanda' saksi' in ka'am pataikut min dusabi. Sagō' aniya' pi'itu damuli min aku aheya gi' kawasana min kawasaku. Minsan hal taumpa'na mbal aku tinōp amenten. Saddī bowahan pamandina ma ka'am, sabab in iya amahōp Rū Sussi ni deyom baranbi. Saga a'a kasehe' isab pinandi e'na maka api.

verses.name: Matthew 3:12
verses.text: Sinilang du e'na a'a ahāp maka a'a ala'at, buwat sapantun a'a anahapan pai. Ya paina tinau' ma deyom tau'anna, saguwā' hampa'na tinunu' e'na ma api mbal kap'ddahan.”  <div eID="gen4040" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4033" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1738"/><div sID="gen4041" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandi ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.9-Mark.1.11">Markus 1:9-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.3.21-Luke 3.22">Lukas 3:21-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4042" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1738"/> Jari itu, ma waktu he'-i, at'kka si Isa min lahat Jalil pina'an ni sapa' Jordan, bo' mikipandi ma si Yahiya.

verses.name: Matthew 3:14
verses.text: Sagō' mbal bilahi si Yahiya. Yukna ni si Isa, “Angay ka mikipandi ma aku? Aku itu subay pandinu!”  <div eID="gen4042" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1739"/><div sID="gen4043" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1739"/> Saguwā' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Hinangun na ma waktu itu, sabab patut du bang beya'ta panoho'an Tuhan kamemon.” Jari pasulut si Yahiya ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4043" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1740"/><div sID="gen4044" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1740"/> Aubus pa'in si Isa bay pinandi, pariyata' na iya min deyom bohe'. Sakali paukab langit, ati ta'nda'na Rū Tuhan sali' luwa assang pareyo' minnē' pat'ppak ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 3:17
verses.text: Aniya' isab suwala ah'lling min deyom sulga' yuk-i, “Iya na itu Anakku kalasahanku, landu' makasulut atayku.”  <div eID="gen4044" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.3"/> <div eID="gen4041" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1741"/><div sID="gen4045" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanulay ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.12-Mark.1.13">Markus 1:12-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.1-Luke.4.13">Lukas 4:1-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4046" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1741"/> Manjari si Isa inān binowa e' Rū Tuhan kaleya ni lahat paslangan, ati sinasat iya e' nakura' saitan, kalu tabowa magdusa.

verses.name: Matthew 4:2
verses.text: Halam bay makatimtim si Isa ai-ai ma deyom mpatpū' ng'llaw maka mpatpū' bahangi. Puwas e' landu' iya lingantu,

verses.name: Matthew 4:3
verses.text: jari pehē' ni iya nakura' saitan, ya mananasat, yukna, “Bang ka sab'nnal-b'nnal Anak Tuhan, soho'un saga batu itu papinda ni tinapay.”  <div eID="gen4046" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1742"/><div sID="gen4047" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1742"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Tasulat asal ma Kitab Tawrat, ya yuk-i, ‘Ngga'i ka hal kinakan baran ya makakallum ma manusiya', saguwā' lapal kamemon ya binissala e' Tuhan.’ ”  <div eID="gen4047" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1743"/><div sID="gen4048" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1743"/> Puwas e' binowa si Isa e' nakura' saitan ni da'ira Awrusalam, ya niōnan Da'ira Mahasussi, ati pinatongod iya ma puttuk langgal pagkulbanan ya maina'an.

verses.name: Matthew 4:6
verses.text: Yuk saitan, “Bang ka sab'nnal-b'nnal Anak Tuhan, pakuppa ka minnilu, sabab tasulat asal ma Kitab Jabul, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4049"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4050"/>‘Aniya' mala'ikat sinoho' e' Tuhan angahampanan ka'a.<l eID="gen4050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4051"/>Tinayak ka e' sigām<l eID="gen4051" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4052"/>bo' mbal makahantak tape'nu ni batu.’ ”<l eID="gen4052" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4049"/>  <div eID="gen4048" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1744"/><div sID="gen4053" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1744"/> Yuk si Isa, “Tasulat isab buwattitu: ‘Da'a sulayinbi kawasa Panghū'bi Tuhan.’ ”  <div eID="gen4053" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1745"/><div sID="gen4054" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1745"/> Puwas e' binowa si Isa e' nakura' saitan ni diyata' būd alanga to'ongan, bo' yampa pina'nda'an lahat kamemon ma kaluha'an dunya, maka kawasa saga a'a ya magnakura'an kalahat-lahatan inān.

verses.name: Matthew 4:9
verses.text: Yuk nakura' saitan ni si Isa, “Bang ka pasujud ma aku amudji, pamuwanku ina'an kamemon ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4054" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1746"/><div sID="gen4055" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1746"/> Ya sambung si Isa ni iya, “Ala'an ka, saitan! Sabab tasulat asal ma Kitab Tawrat, yuk-i, ‘Panghū'bi Tuhan sadja ya subay pudjibi. Tunggal iya paghinanganbi!’ ”  <div eID="gen4055" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1747"/><div sID="gen4056" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1747"/> Puwas e' ala'an nakura' saitan min si Isa, ati aniya' saga mala'ikat pina'an ni si Isa angayura iya.  <div eID="gen4056" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4045" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1748"/><div sID="gen4057" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anagna' si Isa Amandu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.14-Mark.1.15">Markus 1:14-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.14-Luke.4.15">Lukas 4:14-15</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4058" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1748"/> Manjari pagkale e' si Isa in si Yahiya Magpapandi wa'i bay takalabusu, pehē' iya ni lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Matthew 4:13
verses.text: Ala'an iya min kauman Nasaret, bo' pat'nna' ma da'ira Kapirnaum ya ina'an ma bihing danaw Jalil, ma paglahat Sibulun maka Naptali.

verses.name: Matthew 4:14
verses.text: Jari aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat e' si Isaya, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4059"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4060"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:15
verses.text: “Lahat Sibulun maka lahat Naptali,<l eID="gen4060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4061"/>ya ma llot sapa' Jordan maka tahik s'ddopan,<l eID="gen4061" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4062"/>lahat Jalil, ya kalamugayan bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi.<l eID="gen4062" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4063"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:16
verses.text: Saga a'a bay hantang pat'nna' ma deyom kalendoman,<l eID="gen4063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4064"/>maka'nda' kasawahan landu' asahaya.<l eID="gen4064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4065"/>Saga a'a bay kalokoban e' kamatay,<l eID="gen4065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4066"/>taluwa' kasawahan.”<l eID="gen4066" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4059"/>  <div eID="gen4058" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1749"/><div sID="gen4067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1749"/> Tinagna'an minnē' magnasihat na si Isa, yuk-i, “Taikutinbi na dusabi sabab asekot na waktu kapagparinta Tuhan ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen4067" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4057" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1750"/><div sID="gen4068" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mpat A'a Binowa Pamulid ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.16-Mark.1.20">Markus 1:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.1-Luke.5.11">Lukas 5:1-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4069" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1750"/> Na, hinabu si Isa lum'ngngan ma bihing danaw Jalil, aniya' ta'nda'na duwangan magdanakan. Dakayu' inān si Simun, ya niōnan isab si Petros. Dakayu' inān si Andariyas. Ina'an sigā angahūg pokot ma danaw, sabab magdaraing asal sigā.

verses.name: Matthew 4:19
verses.text: Jari ah'lling si Isa ni sigā, yukna, “Pi'itu kam ameya' ma aku. Bay kam asal magā' daing, sagō' pandu'anta kam magā' pagkahibi manusiya' ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Matthew 4:20
verses.text: Takale pa'in lling si Isa e' duwangan itu, magtūy ni'bbahan pokot sigā bo' yampa ameya' ma iya.  <div eID="gen4069" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1751"/><div sID="gen4070" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1751"/> Makalanjal pa'in si Isa minnē', aniya' isab ta'nda'na duwangan magdanakan, si Yakub maka si Yahiya, anak si Sibidi. Ina'an sigā ma diyata' bayanan magbeya' maka mma' sigā amahāp pokot. Nilinganan e' si Isa duwangan itu, sinō' ameya' ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 4:22
verses.text: Magtūy ni'bbahan mma' sigā maka bayanan, bo' ameya' ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4070" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4068" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1752"/><div sID="gen4071" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kauli'an e' si Isa Saki Kaginisan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.17-Luke.6.19">Lukas 6:17-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4072" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1752"/> Na, nilatag e' si Isa kaluha'an lahat Jalil inān. Amandu' na pa'in iya ma deyom kalanggalan. Magnasihat iya lapal ahāp pasal kapagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya'. Kauli'an e'na saga a'a kamemon ya taluwa' saki maka kalammahan indaginis.

verses.name: Matthew 4:24
verses.text: Jari pasaplag kabantuganna ni kaluha'an lahat Siriya. Angkan saga a'a maina'an bay amowa pagkahi sigām ni si Isa, sai-sai kap'ddi'an atawa taluwa' saki indaginis, saga a'a sinōd saitan, a'a binawi-bawi, maka a'a amatay ugat sigām. Kauli'an sigām kamemon e' si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 4:25
verses.text: Jari landu' aheka saga a'a bay paturul ma iya, a'a min lahat Jalil maka min Sangpū' Da'ira. Aniya' isab saga a'a min da'ira Awrusalam, min kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya, sampay min dambila' sapa' Jordan.  <div eID="gen4072" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.4"/> <div eID="gen4071" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1753"/><div sID="gen4073" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kahāpan Sab'nnal-b'nnal</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.20-Luke.6.23">Lukas 6:20-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4074" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1753"/> Manjari pag'nda' pa'in si Isa ma manusiya' sikatimukan inān, patukad iya ni bīd bo' aningkō' mahē'. Pina'an ni iya saga mulidna,

verses.name: Matthew 5:2
verses.text: ati anagna' iya amandu' ma sigām, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4075"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4076"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:3
verses.text: “Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku kata'uwanna<l eID="gen4076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4077"/>halam aniya' pasangdolanna saddī min Tuhan,<l eID="gen4077" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4078"/>sabab tantu aniya' okomanna ma pagparintahan Tuhan.<l eID="gen4078" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4079"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:4
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku magkarukka'an,<l eID="gen4079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4080"/>sabab pinahantap pangatayanna e' Tuhan.<l eID="gen4080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4081"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:5
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku areyo' pangatayanna,<l eID="gen4081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4082"/>sabab makataima' iya pusaka' min Tuhan.<l eID="gen4082" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4083"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:6
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku magmatayan itikad abontol,<l eID="gen4083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4084"/>sabab karūlan iya e' Tuhan.<l eID="gen4084" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4085"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:7
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku ma'ase' ma kasehe'anna,<l eID="gen4085" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4086"/>sabab ya du iya kina'ase'an e' Tuhan.<l eID="gen4086" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4087"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:8
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku apote' atayna tudju ni Tuhan,<l eID="gen4087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4088"/>sabab makapag'nda' du iya maka Tuhan.<l eID="gen4088" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4089"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:9
verses.text: Aheya isab kahāpan sasuku amapagsulut ma saga pagkahina,<l eID="gen4089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4090"/>sabab kaōnan iya anak Tuhan.<l eID="gen4090" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4091"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:10
verses.text: Aheya isab kahāpan sasuku nila'at ma sabab pameya'na ma kabaya'an Tuhan,<l eID="gen4091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4092"/>sabab aniya' okomanna ma pagparintahan Tuhan.<l eID="gen4092" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4075"/>  <div eID="gen4074" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1754"/><div sID="gen4093" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1754"/> “Aheya isab kahāpanbi bang kam ganta' niudju' maka pininjala', maka bang kam nilimut ngga'i ka b'nnal ma sabab pameya'bi ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 5:12
verses.text: Subay kam akōd to'ongan bang buwattē', sabab tantu du aheya tungbasbi ma deyom sulga'. Buwattē' isab bay paminjala' ma saga nabi ya bay ma dunya itu ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4093" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4073" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1755"/><div sID="gen4094" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Asin maka Sawa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.50">Markus 9:50</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.14.34-Luke.14.35">Lukas 14:34-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4095" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1755"/> Amandu' lagi' si Isa, yuk-i, “Ka'am bebeya'anku dalil asin ma bangsa manusiya'. Sagō' bang asin itu magtinu' na, halam aniya' pamabalik nanamna. Halam aniya' kagunahanna, hal tinimanan bo' pinaggi'ikan e' a'a.  <div eID="gen4095" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1756"/><div sID="gen4096" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1756"/> “Ka'am ilu dalil sawa pamasawa bangsa manusiya'. Bang aniya' kaluma'an pat'nna' ma diyata' būd, ta'nda'an di-na du.

verses.name: Matthew 5:15
verses.text: Halam aniya' anū'an palita'an bo' turunganna maka undam, sagō' pinat'nna' ma diyata' pat'nna'anna bo' amuwan sawa ma sasuku ma deyom luma'.

verses.name: Matthew 5:16
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab kam, subay kam amuwan sawa ma pagkahibi manusiya'. Hatina subay ta'nda' kahinanganbi ahāp e' a'a kasehe', bo' sigām tabowa ananglitan Mma'bi ma sulga'.”  <div eID="gen4096" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4094" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1757"/><div sID="gen4097" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' si Musa maka Kamaksuranna</title> <div sID="gen4098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1757"/> “Da'a kam maghimangkan saga aku pi'itu amapasan sara' ya bay pang'bba e' si Musa, maka pandu' bay min kanabi-nabihan. Ya gawiku pi'itu subay pahatiku pasal sara' he' bang ai kamaksuranna to'ongan.

verses.name: Matthew 5:18
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan: sat'ggol masi langit maka dunya itu, halam du aniya' kinulangan min sara' itu minsan la'a hal dambatang sulatna maka balisna. Subay asampulna' kamemon bo' yampa pahalam kapūsanna.

verses.name: Matthew 5:19
verses.text: Angkan sai-sai angalanggal sara' itu minsan la'a hal ma kariki'an, maka bang bidjakanna sehe'na ameya' ma iya angalanggal, a'a inān areyo' to'ongan ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan. Sagō' sai-sai ya ameya' ma sara' sampay amandu'an sehe'na subay ameya', alanga du iya ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 5:20
verses.text: Sagō' haka'anta kam, mbal kam makasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan bang mbal palabi ka'adilanbi min ka'adilan saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' agama.”  <div eID="gen4098" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4097" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1758"/><div sID="gen4099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pamapatay Pagkahi Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen4100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1758"/> “Bay na takalebi panoho'an ma saga a'a ma masa awal e', ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam da'a amapatay pagkahibi manusiya'. Sai-sai amapatay pagkahina pinat'nna'an hukuman.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:22
verses.text: Sagō' buwattitu na pamandu'ku ma ka'am: sai-sai angastol ma pagkahina subay nihukum. Maka sai-sai angōn ‘dupang’ ma sehe'na subay binowa ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum.<note>Tumpukan Maghuhukum: tumpukan saga a'a pitumpū' ka dda hekana ya amal'ngngan sara' Yahudi. Ya kaheka'anna saga Parisi, bo' Sadduki maka guru' sara' agama.</note> Sai-sai isab amah'llingan pagkahina, yukna, ‘Ē! Babbal ka! Halam aniya' pūsnu!’ Piligdu a'a inān pinalabay min api nalka'.

verses.name: Matthew 5:23
verses.text: Angkanna, bang ka ganta' ma deyom langgal song anukbal ai-ai ni Tuhan, bo' taentomnu aniya' pagkahinu ap'ddi' atayna ma ka'a,

verses.name: Matthew 5:24
verses.text: mailuhun lagi' panukbalnu ati pasa'ut ka ni pagkahinu inān maghāp maka iya dahū bo' yampa ka pabīng angungsuran panukbalnu ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen4100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1759"/><div sID="gen4101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1759"/> “Abila ka tinuntutan e' a'a bo' tin'kkahan ni sara', bowahun iya magsulut ma halam gi' makatampal ni sara'. Sabab bang kam mbal magsulut dahū, tin'kkahan ka ni huwis, ati ni'nde'an ka e' huwis ni saga pulis bo' ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Matthew 5:26
verses.text: Jari ka'ddasan ka maina'an. Subay puwasannu bay kataksilannu kamemon bo' yampa ka makaluwas minnē'.”  <div eID="gen4101" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4099" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1760"/><div sID="gen4102" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangaliyu-lakad</title> <div sID="gen4103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1760"/> “Bay na takalebi panoho'an ītu, ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam da'a angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'bi.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:28
verses.text: Sagō' buwattitu na pamandu'ku ma ka'am: sai-sai ang'nda' ni d'nda maka e'na anganapsuhan iya, a'a inān katōngan dusa sabab makalandu' na iya angandusa ni d'nda he' ma deyom pikilanna.

verses.name: Matthew 5:29
verses.text: Bang matanu kowan ganta' amowa ka'a magdusa, subay paggatun. Gom lagi' lugitnu matanu ilu bo' tinimanan. Ahāp lagi' abuta matanu dambila', bang pa'in da'a nilarukan katibu'ukannu ni deyom nalka' ma ajukup matanu karuwambila'.

verses.name: Matthew 5:30
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab bang tangannu kowan ganta' amowa ka'a magdusa, paggatun. Gom lagi' pinukulan dambila' tangannu bo' tinimanan. Ahāp lagi' apukul dambila' tangannu, bang pa'in da'a nilarukan katibu'ukannu ni deyom nalka' ma ajukup tangannu karuwambila'.”  <div eID="gen4103" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4102" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1761"/><div sID="gen4104" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagtiman A'a Maglakibini</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.9">Matiyu 19:9</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.11-Mark.10.12">Markus 10:11-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.16.18">Lukas 16:18</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4105" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1761"/> “Aniya' isab bay panoho'an sara', ya yuk-i, ‘Sai-sai animanan h'ndana subay iya amuwan pagpasahan.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:32
verses.text: Sagō' buwattitu na pamandu'ku ma ka'am: sai-sai animanan h'ndana ma halam aniya' sababanna, ma halam du bay angaliyu-lakad min iya, taga-dusa l'lla inān ma h'ndana he'. Sabab bang d'nda he' aminda h'lla, taga-dusa iya angaliyu-lakad min h'llana tagna'. Maka dusahan isab l'lla angah'nda d'nda inān.”  <div eID="gen4105" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4104" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1762"/><div sID="gen4106" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagsapa</title> <div sID="gen4107" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1762"/> “Bay na takalebi isab panoho'an ma saga a'a masa awal e', ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam da'a magputing bang bay makasapa. Wajib isab sinuhul bang aniya' najalbi ni Tuhan.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:34
verses.text: Sagō' buwattitu na pamandu'ku ma ka'am: da'a kam magsapa. Da'a sibahatunbi sulga' pagsapahanbi sabab paningkō'an Tuhan ko' inān.

verses.name: Matthew 5:35
verses.text: Da'a sibahatunbi dunya sabab pat'kkaran tape'na. Sampay da'ira Awrusalam, da'a sibahatunbi isab sabab suku' Tuhan, ya Sultan Mahatinggi.

verses.name: Matthew 5:36
verses.text: Minsan kōkbi, subay mbal sibahatbi pagsapahanbi sabab ngga'i ka ka'am ya bay amapanjari. Minsan dalamba bu'unbi mbal kapindahanbi walna'na ni ettom atawa ni pote'.

verses.name: Matthew 5:37
verses.text: Bang kam angaho', subay aho' sadja, bang kam magin'mbal, subay mbal sadja. Ai-ai pamasugpatbi saddī minnē', min saitan patila'atun ko' itu.”  <div eID="gen4107" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4106" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1763"/><div sID="gen4108" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pamalos</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.29-Luke.6.30">Lukas 6:29-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4109" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1763"/> “Bay na takalebi panara', ya yuk-i, ‘Bang aniya' amaka'at dambila' mata sehe'na subay binalosan pinaka'at dambila' matana. Damikiyanna bang aniya' angalutu empon sehe'na subay binalosan nilutu emponna.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:39
verses.text: Sagō' ya na itu pamandu'ku ma ka'am: da'a kam amalos bang aniya' makarusa ma ka'am. Abila aniya' a'a anampak baihu'nu dambila', patampalun isab dambila' panampakanna.

verses.name: Matthew 5:40
verses.text: Abila aniya' ganta' anuntutan ka'a bo' niamu' multa kamisitanu, pamuwanun ma iya sampay badju'nu.

verses.name: Matthew 5:41
verses.text: Abila aniya' a'a magmandahan ka'a pasehe' ma iya dabatu lawakna, sehe'in gi' iya duwa batu.

verses.name: Matthew 5:42
verses.text: Sai-sai angamu' ni ka'a, buwanin. Maka sai-sai bilahi angindam, paindamin.”  <div eID="gen4109" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4108" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1764"/><div sID="gen4110" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Lasa ma saga Banta</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.27-Luke.6.28">Lukas 6:27-28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.32-Luke.6.36">Lukas 6:32-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4111" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1764"/> “Bay na takalebi isab pamandu' dakayu' itu, ya yuk-i, ‘Kalasahinbi bagaybi, sagō' kab'nsihinbi bantabi.’

verses.name: Matthew 5:44
verses.text: Sagō' ya na itu pamandu'ku ma ka'am: kalasahinbi bantabi. Amu'-amu'inbi kahāpan min Tuhan sasuku angala'at ka'am

verses.name: Matthew 5:45
verses.text: bo' supaya kam an'ppu addat Tuhan, ya Mma'bi ma sulga'. Sabab Tuhan ya amasilak llaw ma a'a kamemon ahāp ka atawa ala'at. Amap'ttak iya ulan ma saga a'a maghinang kabontolan sampay isab ma a'a maghinang kala'atan.

verses.name: Matthew 5:46
verses.text: Bang hal a'a alasahan ka'am ya kalasahanbi, da'a kam aholat tinungbasan pahala' e' Tuhan. Minsan saga a'a magā' sukay parinta, alasa du ma sasuku alasahan sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 5:47
verses.text: Bang hal bagaybi ya saginabi pahāp, sali' du kam maka saga a'a mbal magta'at ma Tuhan, sabab ya du sigām magsagina dakabagayan. Mbal pabidda' kahāp addatbi min sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 5:48
verses.text: Ka'am ilu subay ajukup ma kaul maka pi'il tudju ni a'a kamemon, buwat Mma'bi ma sulga'.”  <div eID="gen4111" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.5"/> <div eID="gen4110" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1765"/><div sID="gen4112" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagtabang ma Miskin</title> <div sID="gen4113" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1765"/> “Kamaya'-maya' kam. Bang aniya' kahāpan hinangbi pagta'atbi ni Tuhan, da'a hinangunbi ma mata mairan. Sabab bang buwattē' hinangbi, halam aniya' tungbasbi min Tuhan, ya Mma'bi ma sulga'.  <div eID="gen4113" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1766"/><div sID="gen4114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1766"/> “Angkanna, bang aniya' pamuwanbi ma a'a kulang-kabus, da'a pagbantugunbi. Da'a s'ppuhunbi a'a maglaku-laku in sigām ahāp, ya anarakka ma matahan saga a'a kamemon, ma deyom langgal ka atawa ma paglabayan. Tu'ud sigām bilahi sinanglitan e' saga manusiya'. Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sanglit min manusiya' ya panungbas sigām, halam saddī.

verses.name: Matthew 6:3
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu, bang aniya' tabangbi a'a miskin, subay halam aniya' makata'uwan iya, minsan bagaybi.

verses.name: Matthew 6:4
verses.text: Subay halam aniya' makata'u. Jari bang buwattē', tinungbasan du kam e' Mma'bi Tuhan, ya maka'nda' ma ai-ai hinangbi minsan halam aniya' makata'u.”  <div eID="gen4114" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4112" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1767"/><div sID="gen4115" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Panambahayang</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.2-Luke.11.4">Lukas 11:2-4</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1767"/> “Bang kam anambahayang, da'a sengorinbi saga a'a maglaku-laku in addat sigām ahāp. Sabab tagian sigām an'ngge anambahayang ma deyom langgal atawa ma paglalabayan a'a bo' supaya ta'nda' e' kamemon. Haka'anta kam to'ongan, bang sigām kasanglitan e' a'a, ya na he' panungbas sigām. Halam aniya' saddī.

verses.name: Matthew 6:6
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu, bang kam anambahayang, pasōd kam ni deyom bilik. Tambolunbi lawang bo' yampa kam anambahayang ni Mma'bi Tuhan, ya mbal ta'nda'. Ati Mma'bi, ya maka'nda' ma ai-ai hinangbi minsan halam aniya' makata'u, anungbas du ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen4116" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1768"/><div sID="gen4117" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1768"/> “Bang kam anambahayang, da'a paggunahunbi ba'anan kabtangan halam aniya' pūsna, buwat panambahayang saga a'a ya magta'at ma tuhan-tuhan saddī. Sabab kinabā' e' sigām in panambahayang sigām kinale e' Tuhan saukat na ataha' sidda.

verses.name: Matthew 6:8
verses.text: Da'a sigām sengorinbi, sabab kinata'uwan asal e' Mma'bi Tuhan bang ai kasusahanbi minsan mbal pah'llingbi.

verses.name: Matthew 6:9
verses.text: Jari itu, bang kam anambahayang subay buwattitu kal'ngngananna: <lg sID="gen4118"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4119"/>‘O Mma' kami Tuhan ma sulga',<l eID="gen4119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4120"/>bang pa'in pinagaddatan ōnnu e' kamemon,<l eID="gen4120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4121"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:10
verses.text: Bang pa'in mbal at'ggol bo' ka magparinta ma kamemon manusiya',<l eID="gen4121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4122"/>Bang pa'in bineya' kabaya'annu ma dunya itu<l eID="gen4122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4123"/>buwat asal bineya' mailu ma sulga'.<l eID="gen4123" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4124"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:11
verses.text: Jukupin kami balanja' ma llaw itu.<l eID="gen4124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4125"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:12
verses.text: Ampunun saga dusa kami,<l eID="gen4125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4126"/>buwat kapangampun kami ma sai-sai makarusa ma kami.<l eID="gen4126" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4127"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:13
verses.text: Da'a kami tugutin binowa ni deyom sasat,<l eID="gen4127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4128"/>sagō' papuwasun kami min nakura' saitan, ya patila'atun.’<l eID="gen4128" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4118"/>  <div eID="gen4117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1769"/><div sID="gen4129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1769"/> “Bang kam angampun saga a'a makarusa ni ka'am, ya du ka'am niampun e' Mma'bi ma sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 6:15
verses.text: Ya balikna, bang mbal ampunbi a'a bay makarusa ni ka'am, ya du ka'am mbal niampun e' Mma'bi Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4129" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4115" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1770"/><div sID="gen4130" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagpuwasa</title> <div sID="gen4131" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1770"/> “Bang kam amuwasa da'a subay pala'atunbi pamaihu'anbi, buwat a'a maglaku-laku inān in sigām ahāp. Mbal sigām angupiksa' di-sigām, pangilahan a'a kasehe' in sigām magpuwasa. Haka'anta kam to'ongan, bang sigām kasanglitan e' manusiya', ya na he' panungbas sigām. Halam aniya' saddī.

verses.name: Matthew 6:17
verses.text: Saguwā' ka'am ilu, bang kam amuwasa, kula'upinbi baihu'bi maka surayunbi bu'unbi,

verses.name: Matthew 6:18
verses.text: bo' mbal kinata'uwan e' a'a kasehe'an in ka'am amuwasa. Ya sadja makata'u Mma'bi Tuhan ya mbal ta'nda' e' manusiya'. Ati Mma'bi ilu, ya maka'nda' ma ai-ai hinangbi sampay ma kalimbungan, anungbas du ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen4131" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4130" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1771"/><div sID="gen4132" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Karaya ma Deyom Sulga'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.12.33-Luke.12.34">Lukas 12:33-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1771"/> “Da'a kam magtimuk alta' maitu ma dunya, sabab hal magka'at, suma'an pinagkeket e' ulat, suma'an ginaha', suma'an isab nilangpasan.

verses.name: Matthew 6:20
verses.text: Sagō' maghinang kam ahāp bo' aniya' karayabi tinau'an ka'am ma deyom sulga', sabab karaya mahē' mbal takeket e' ulat, mbal magkagaha', maka mbal kalangpasan.

verses.name: Matthew 6:21
verses.text: Sababna maingga-maingga panau'anbi alta'bi, mahē' ya pataptapan pangatayanbi.”  <div eID="gen4133" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4132" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1772"/><div sID="gen4134" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Palita'an ma Deyom Baranta</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.34-Luke.11.36">Lukas 11:34-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4135" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1772"/> “Matabi itu sapantun palita'an amuwan sawa ma deyom ginhawabi. Bang ahāp matabi, asawa sampay deyom ginhawabi.

verses.name: Matthew 6:23
verses.text: Sagō' bang matabi mbal ahāp, angalendom sampay ginhawabi. Bang yukbi aniya' ma ka'am kasawahan bo' pa'in halam, na aheya kalendomanbi.  <div eID="gen4135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1773"/><div sID="gen4136" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1773"/> “Ya niōnan sosoho'an mbal makapagduwa nakura', sabab tantu kab'nsihanna nakura'na dakayu' maka kalasahanna dakayu'. Amalut iya ma dakayu' ati taikutanna dakayu'. Hatina mbal kam manjari maghinang ma Tuhan bang pilak ya paheyabi ma atay.”  <div eID="gen4136" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4134" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1774"/><div sID="gen4137" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'a Magsusa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.16.13">Lukas 16:13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.12.22-Luke.12.31">Lukas 12:22-31</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4138" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1774"/> “Angkanna kam soho'ku da'a sakit magsusa pasal kallumanbi, bang ai kakanbi maka bang ai inumbi. Da'a kam magsusa isab pasal ginhawa baranbi bang ai kapan'mmekbi. Sabab kallumta itu labi ahalga' ma kita min kapamanganta. Ya du baranta, labi ahalga' min pan'mmekta.

verses.name: Matthew 6:26
verses.text: Nda'unbi saga manuk-manuk paleyang. Mbal magtanom, mbal magani. Mbal isab anau' kinakan ma llaw damuli. Sagō' binalanja'an du sigām e' Mma'bi ma sulga'. Bo' ka'am ilu, ahalga' gi' to'ongan min kamanuk-manukan.

verses.name: Matthew 6:27
verses.text: Sai bahā' makapataha' umulna minsan la'a hal danjām, ma sabab kasusahanna?  <div eID="gen4138" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1775"/><div sID="gen4139" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1775"/> “Angay isab kam magmasusa ma pasal pan'mmekbi? Nda'unbi saga sumping ma deyom kaparangan bang buwattingga katomo'na. Mbal magsangsā' maghinang, mbal magt'nnun.

verses.name: Matthew 6:29
verses.text: Sagō' haka'anta kam, minsan sultan Sulayman maka kahaldayana ma masa awal e', mbal du maka'atu lingkat pamakayna ma dakayu' sumping itu.

verses.name: Matthew 6:30
verses.text: Bang Tuhan ya makapayakun kaparangan ya tatasanna dang'llaw du, bo' pagsalung alanos sampay tinunu', tantu Tuhan amas'mmekan ka'am. Akulang pahāp pangandolbi ma iya!  <div eID="gen4139" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1776"/><div sID="gen4140" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1776"/> “Angkanna kam subay mbal magmasusa. Da'a kam magupama buwattitu: ai pagkakanta, ai paginumta, ai bahā' pas'mmekta?

verses.name: Matthew 6:32
verses.text: Saga a'a mbal ata'u magta'at ma Tuhan, ya na pa'in he'-i kinasusahan e' sigām. Sagō' ka'am ilu, kinata'uwan e' Mma'bi ma sulga' in ina'an kagunahanbi asal.

verses.name: Matthew 6:33
verses.text: Sagō' muna-muna kannalunbi pagparinta Tuhan maka kabontolan atay ya kabaya'anna. Manjari pinaniya'an du kam ai-ai kulang-kabusbi.

verses.name: Matthew 6:34
verses.text: Angkan kam subay mbal magkasusahan pasal llaw salung sabab saddī kasusahan ma llaw sinōng. Sarang na pagsusahanbi hal ma llaw itu.”  <div eID="gen4140" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.6"/> <div eID="gen4137" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1777"/><div sID="gen4141" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Panoway Pagkahi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.37-Luke.6.42">Lukas 6:37-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4142" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1777"/> “Da'a sā'unbi pagkahibi bo' kam mbal sinā' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 7:2
verses.text: Sabab bang kam ganta' amat'nna' hukuman ma sehe'bi, ya du ka'am pinat'nna'an hukuman e' Tuhan, pinapagtongod maka bay pangahukumbi sehe'bi he'. Ai-ai pan'ppongbi ma sehe'bi, ya du isab pan'ppong Tuhan ma ka'am.

verses.name: Matthew 7:3
verses.text: Ka'am magsoway sehe'bi ilu, angay ta'nda'bi bukbuk ma mata sehe'bi, ati mbal ta'nda'bi batang kayu ya ma deyom matabi?

verses.name: Matthew 7:4
verses.text: Mamarahi pahāp ka'am ilu! Yukbi, ‘Tabiya', la'ananta bukbuk min matanu ilu.’ Bo' pa'in aniya' batang kayu ma deyom matabi!

verses.name: Matthew 7:5
verses.text: In ka'am ilu maglaku-laku halam taga-sā'! La'aninbi gi' dahū ya bukbuk ma matabi ilu supaya asawa pang'nda'bi, bo' yampa kam angala'anan bukbuk min mata sehe'bi.  <div eID="gen4142" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1778"/><div sID="gen4143" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1778"/> “Da'a kam amuwan ai-ai asussi ma saga a'a ala'at, ya sali' sapantun ero'. Ya aniya' pabibud angal'kkob ka'am. Lapalbi ahalga', ya pinagbahasa mussa'bi, da'a larukinbi ni saga bawi. Ya aniya' pinaggi'ik-gi'ikan e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen4143" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4141" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1779"/><div sID="gen4144" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angamu'-ngamu', Amiha, Mikiukab</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.9-Luke.11.13">Lukas 11:9-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4145" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1779"/> “Angamu'-ngamu' kam, ati binuwanan du. Amiha kam, ati makabāk du kam. Mikiukab kam, ati niukaban du kam.

verses.name: Matthew 7:8
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai angamu' kabuwanan du. Sai-sai amiha makabāk du. Sai-sai isab mikiukab niukaban du.

verses.name: Matthew 7:9
verses.text: Ka'am taga-anak ilu, abila kam pangamu'an tinapay e' anakbi, buwananbi bahā' batu?

verses.name: Matthew 7:10
verses.text: Atawa bang angamu' daing, buwananbi bahā' sowa?

verses.name: Matthew 7:11
verses.text: Minsan ka'am dusahan ilu ata'u amuwanan anakbi ai-ai makahāp, luba'-lagi'na na Mma'bi ma sulga' ata'u du amuwanan ai-ai makahāp ni sasuku angamu' ni iya.  <div eID="gen4145" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1780"/><div sID="gen4146" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1780"/> “Manjari bang kabaya'anbi kinahāpan e' a'a, subay isab sigām kahāpanbi. Ya na he' kamaksuran sara' ya bay tasulat e' si Musa maka saga kanabi-nabihan.”  <div eID="gen4146" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4144" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1781"/><div sID="gen4147" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lawang Akiput</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.13.24">Lukas 13:24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4148" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1781"/> “Pasōd kam min lawang akiput, sabab ya lān tudju ni nalka' aluha pasōranna maka aluhay nil'ngngan. Aheka isab manusiya' ameya' min lān inān.

verses.name: Matthew 7:14
verses.text: Saguwā' ya pasōran tudju ni sulga' akiput maka ahunit nil'ngngan. Akulang isab a'a makatuli' iya.”  <div eID="gen4148" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4147" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1782"/><div sID="gen4149" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kayu maka Buwa'na</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.43-Luke.6.44">Lukas 6:43-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4150" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1782"/> “Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' kam mbal ka'akkalan e' saga a'a magbau'-bau' in sigām nabi. Ahāp pangluwahan sigām bang ma pang'nda'ta, sali' sapantun bili-bili mbal makamula. Sagō' ma deyom atay sigām sali' sigām ero' talun, sidda ab'ngngis.

verses.name: Matthew 7:16
verses.text: Takilābi du sigām min kahinangan sigām, buwat kayu takilā min buwa'na. Mbal kita angā' buwa' anggul min kayu puhung, atawa buwa' kayu igira<note>Kayu igira: kayu ahāp buwa'na. ‘Fig’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> min sampinit.

verses.name: Matthew 7:17
verses.text: Bang kayu ahāp, ahāp isab buwa'na. Sagō' bang kayu mbal ahāp, mbal isab ahāp buwa'na.

verses.name: Matthew 7:18
verses.text: Bang kayu ahāp mbal makabuwan buwa' ala'at. Damikiyanna bang kayu ala'at suligna, mbal makabuwan buwa' ahāp.

verses.name: Matthew 7:19
verses.text: Bang aniya' kayu mbal ahāp pagbuwa'na, pinuwad du bo' tinimanan ni deyom api.

verses.name: Matthew 7:20
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am, takilābi du saga nabi ya ngga'i ka b'nnal sabab min kahinangan sigām.”  <div eID="gen4150" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4149" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1783"/><div sID="gen4151" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Mbal Takilā</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.13.25-Luke.13.27">Lukas 13:25-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4152" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1783"/> “Ngga'i ka a'a kamemon ya anabbut aku ‘Panghū', O Panghū',’ makasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan. Luwal saga a'a ya ameya' ma kabaya'an Mma'ku ma sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 7:22
verses.text: Bang ta'abut na llaw pangahukum ma manusiya', aheka du amissala ni aku, yuk-i: ‘O Panghū', bay kami amatanyag lapal Tuhan min kawasa ōnnu. Bay kami amala'an ba'anan saitan min deyom baran a'a, maka aheka isab saga hinang makainu-inu bay tahinang kami, min kawasa ōnnu.’

verses.name: Matthew 7:23
verses.text: Sakali bontolanku sigām, yukku, ‘Mbal kam takilāku. Ala'an kam min aku, ka'am kamemon maghinang kala'atan ilu.’ ”  <div eID="gen4152" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4151" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1784"/><div sID="gen4153" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwa Ginis A'a Magpat'ngge Luma'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.47-Luke.6.49">Lukas 6:47-49</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4154" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1784"/> “Na, sasuku a'a akale ma bissalaku itu sampay ameya', in iya sali' a'a ahāp akkalna, ya bay makahinang luma'na ma papagan abatu.

verses.name: Matthew 7:25
verses.text: Manjari aniya' ulan alandos bay patumbuk, maka angandunuk kasapa'an, maka taluwa' hunus luma' inān. Sagō' halam ah'bba' sabab ahogot papaganna.

verses.name: Matthew 7:26
verses.text: Sasuku isab akale ma bissalaku bo' mbal ameya', sali' kahantang a'a kulang akkalna, ya makahinang luma'na ma kal'bbohan.

verses.name: Matthew 7:27
verses.text: Jari aniya' ulan alandos patumbuk, bo' angandunuk kasapa'an, bo' taluwa' hunus luma' inān. Magtūy ah'bba', alubu to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4154" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1785"/><div sID="gen4155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1785"/> Aubus pa'in e' si Isa amissala, kinainu-inuhan pandu'na e' ba'anan a'a bay makakale inān.

verses.name: Matthew 7:29
verses.text: Ya angkan buwattē' sabab magbidda' to'ongan pandu' si Isa maka pandu' saga guru sigām. Taga-kawasa asal si Isa bang amandu'.  <div eID="gen4155" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.7"/> <div eID="gen4153" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1786"/><div sID="gen4156" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Ni'ipul Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.40-Mark.1.45">Markus 1:40-45</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.12-Luke.5.16">Lukas 5:12-16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4157" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1786"/> Makalūd pa'in si Isa min bīd-bīd inān, aheka to'ongan a'a bay paturul ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 8:2
verses.text: Manjari aniya' a'a ni'ipul pina'an ni si Isa bo' angōk-tu'ut min dahuanna. Yukna, “Tuwan, bang ka bilahi, kauli'annu aku.”  <div eID="gen4157" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1787"/><div sID="gen4158" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1787"/> Magtūy tin'ppak a'a inān e' si Isa. Yuk si Isa, “Bilahi sadja aku. Kauli'an na ka!” Saru'un-du'un du kauli'an ipul a'a inān.

verses.name: Matthew 8:4
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Pakale ka. Da'a ka angahaka ni sai-sai ya bay tahinang ma ka'a ilu. Sagō' pehē' ka patūy ni imam bo' palilingun barannu ma iya. Puwas e' tukbalin kukulbanan ni Tuhan buwat bay pamandu' e' si Musa, tanda' saksi' ni kaheka'an a'a in ka'a ilu alanu' na.”  <div eID="gen4158" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4156" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1788"/><div sID="gen4159" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sosoho'an Kapitan Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.7.1-Luke.7.10">Lukas 7:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4160" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1788"/> Manjari itu, pasōd pa'in si Isa ni deyom da'ira Kapirnaum, aniya' dakayu' kapitan bangsa Rōm bay pasampang ni iya angamu' tabang.

verses.name: Matthew 8:6
verses.text: Yukna ni si Isa, “Tuwan, aniya' sosoho'anku ma luma'. Ina'an iya palege, mbal minsan makaosegan di-na. Kap'ddi'an iya to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4160" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1789"/><div sID="gen4161" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1789"/> Yuk si Isa, “Pehē' du aku amauli' iya.”  <div eID="gen4161" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1790"/><div sID="gen4162" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1790"/> “Da'a ka pehē', Tuwan,” yuk kapitan. “In luma'ku mbal tōp papehe'annu. Angabtang sadja ka minnilu ati kauli'an du sosoho'anku he'.

verses.name: Matthew 8:9
verses.text: Minsan aku itu, biyaksa du pinagbaya'an e' a'a min diyata'anku, maka aniya' isab sundalu pagbaya'anku. Bang sō'ku dangan pehē', pehē' du iya. Bang sō'ku dangan pi'itu, pi'itu du iya ni aku. Damikiyanna bang aniya' pahinangku ma sosoho'anku, magtūy nihinang e'na.”  <div eID="gen4162" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1791"/><div sID="gen4163" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1791"/> Pagkale pa'in pah'lling kapitan itu e' si Isa, ainu-inu iya. Yukna ni saga a'a paturul ma iya inān, “Haka'anta kam to'ongan. Minsan ma deyom bangsatam Isra'il halam aku bay makabāk a'a buwat kapitan itu, akosog imanna.

verses.name: Matthew 8:11
verses.text: Pakale kam. Ma waktu sinōng aheka a'a min bangsa kaginisan, a'a bay min sobangan maka min s'ddopan, magtingkō'an magsalu maka disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.

verses.name: Matthew 8:12
verses.text: Sagō' saga bangsa Isra'il itu, ya suku' ma pagparintahan Tuhan, nilarukan du tudju ni kalendoman, ati maina'an magalud maka magtage'ot empon sigām sabab min kapagsusun sigām.”  <div eID="gen4163" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1792"/><div sID="gen4164" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1792"/> Sakali amissala si Isa ni kapitan inān, yukna, “Amole' na ka. Tahinang ma ka'a buwat bay pagkahagadnu.” Manjari saru'un-du'un kauli'an sosoho'anna ma waktu he'-i du.  <div eID="gen4164" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4159" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1793"/><div sID="gen4165" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka A'a Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.29-Mark.1.34">Markus 1:29-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.38-Luke.4.41">Lukas 4:38-41</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4166" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1793"/> Sakali palanjal si Isa pehē' ni luma' disi Simun. Pagsōdna ni deyom luma' inān, ta'nda'na mato'a si Simun d'nda palege maina'an, nil'mmun.

verses.name: Matthew 8:15
verses.text: Ni'ntanan e' si Isa tangan d'nda itu, ati pahali magtūy bay l'mmunna. Puwas e' punduk iya angalabotan disi Isa.  <div eID="gen4166" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1794"/><div sID="gen4167" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1794"/> Ta'abut pa'in pas'ddop llaw, aheka a'a sinōd saitan bay binowa pina'an ni si Isa. Ati pinala'an e'na saga saitan, min kabtanganna sadja. Maka a'a taga-saki inān kamemon bay kauli'an e'na.

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: Buwattē' hinangna bo' aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat ma Kitab e' nabi Isaya, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4168"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4169"/>“Bay iya anguli'an saga kalammahantam,<l eID="gen4169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4170"/>bay iya ananggung saga sakitam.”<l eID="gen4170" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4168"/>  <div eID="gen4167" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4165" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1795"/><div sID="gen4171" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Maghawal-hawal Ameya' ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.9.57-Luke.9.62">Lukas 9:57-62</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4172" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1795"/> Ta'nda' pa'in e' si Isa aheka a'a ma sakalibutna, yukna ni saga mulidna, “Sūng kitam pauntas ni dambila' danaw.”  <div eID="gen4172" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1796"/><div sID="gen4173" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1796"/> Ma halam gi' sigām makauntas, aniya' dakayu' guru sara' agama bay pina'an ni si Isa. Yukna, “Tuwan Guru, lilla' aku ameya' ma ka'a pi'ingga-pi'ingga papehe'annu.”  <div eID="gen4173" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1797"/><div sID="gen4174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1797"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Gom hayop talun aniya' patapukanna, maka saga kamanuk-manukan aniya' pugaranna. Sagō' aku Anak Manusiya' itu, halam aniya' minsan patulihanku luggiya'.”  <div eID="gen4174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1798"/><div sID="gen4175" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1798"/> Aniya' isab dakayu' mulid inān ah'lling ni si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan, paba'irun lagi' aku pabīng ni luma'. Subay na apuwas pangubulku ma mma'ku bo' yampa aku ameya' ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4175" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1799"/><div sID="gen4176" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1799"/> Sagō' yuk si Isa, “Ameya' na ka ma aku. Patut bang a'a amatay pinakubul ma saga a'a ya halam kaniya'an kallum taptap.”  <div eID="gen4176" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4171" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1800"/><div sID="gen4177" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Baliyu maka Goyak</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.35-Mark.4.41">Markus 4:35-41</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.22-Luke.8.25">Lukas 8:22-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4178" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1800"/> Puwas e' paruwa' si Isa ni bayanan, maka ameya' isab saga mulidna.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: Makauntas pa'in, parugpak hunus ni danaw inān. Agon-agon sigām abuhaw sabab sinasay e' goyak, sagō' ina'an si Isa atuli.

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: Pasekot ni iya saga mulidna amati' iya. “O Tuwan,” yuk sigām, “anabang ka sabab abuhaw na kitam!”  <div eID="gen4178" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1801"/><div sID="gen4179" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1801"/> Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Angay kam tināw? Kulang pahāp imanbi!” Manjari pabungkal si Isa bo' yampa soho'na baliyu maka goyak inān pahondong. Saru'un-du'un du magtūy at'ddo' lahat inān.  <div eID="gen4179" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1802"/><div sID="gen4180" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1802"/> Ainu-inu saga mulid e'. “Ai bahā' a'a itu?” yuk sigām. “Minsan baliyu maka goyak kapagagihan e'na.”  <div eID="gen4180" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4177" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1803"/><div sID="gen4181" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwangan A'a Kapala'anan Saitan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.5.1-Mark.5.20">Markus 5:1-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.26-Luke.8.39">Lukas 8:26-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4182" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1803"/> Pagubus, makatandan disi Isa pehē' ni dambila' danaw, ni lahat saga a'a Gadara. Makarunggu' pa'in, aniya' pasampang ni iya duwangan a'a bay paluwas min kakubulan, a'a sinōd saga saitan. Landu' ab'ngngis saga a'a itu angkan halam aniya' makatawakkal palabay minna'an.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: Magtūy sigā angolang, yuk-i, “O Anak Tuhan! Ai lamudnu ma kami? Pi'itu ka bahā' aminasa kami ma mbal gi' ta'abut ganta'an?”  <div eID="gen4182" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1804"/><div sID="gen4183" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1804"/> Na, atā-tā lagi' minnē', aniya' ba'anan bawi magkakanan.

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: Sakali anganjunjung saga saitan e' ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Bang kami subay pala'annu, pasōrun kami ni deyom baran saga bawi inān.”  <div eID="gen4183" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1805"/><div sID="gen4184" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1805"/> “Pehē' na kam,” yuk si Isa. Sakali ala'an saga saitan min baran a'a he' bo' pasalin pehē' ni deyom baran ba'anan bawi. Magtūy maglumpat paragan ba'anan bawi he' min pampang tudju ni deyom danaw, ati alembo kamemon.  <div eID="gen4184" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1806"/><div sID="gen4185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1806"/> Jari saga magi'ipat bawi inān paragan pehē' ni kaluma'an angahaka'an saga a'a maina'an pasal bay tahinang e' si Isa ma saga a'a sinōd saitan e'.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: Angkan paluwas saga a'a min kaluma'an inān amāk si Isa. Magbāk pa'in, angamu' sigām junjung ni iya, bang pa'in iya ala'an min lahat sigām.  <div eID="gen4185" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.8"/> <div eID="gen4181" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1807"/><div sID="gen4186" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Amatay Ugatna Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.2.1-Mark.2.12">Markus 2:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.17-Luke.5.26">Lukas 5:17-26</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4187" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1807"/> Paruwa' na si Isa ni bayanan bay pameya'anna bo' yampa pabīng ni dambila' danaw, ni kauman ya pat'nna'anna.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: Jari maina'an pa'in, aniya' binowa ni iya a'a amatay ugatna, hal pabahak la'a ma palegehanna. Makata'u pa'in si Isa in a'a amowa inān angandol ma iya, yukna ni a'a amatay ugatna, “Otō', da'a ka asusa. Niampun na paldusahannu.”  <div eID="gen4187" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1808"/><div sID="gen4188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1808"/> Aniya' maina'an saga guru sara' agama magupama dansehe'an. Yuk sigām, “Oy! A'a itu ah'lling kupul ma Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen4188" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1809"/><div sID="gen4189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1809"/> Sagō' asal kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai ma pikilan sigām. Yukna, “Angay ala'at hona'-hona'bi ilu?

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: Kumpasunbi bang ingga ya aluhay: bang yukku ni a'a, ‘niampun na dusanu’, atawa bang yukku, ‘pabungkal ka bo' ka lum'ngngan?’

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: Na, buwananta kam tanda' palsaksi'an bo' kata'uwanbi in aku, Anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut angampun dusa ma deyom dunya itu.” Jari amissala si Isa ni a'a amatay ugatna inān. “Pabungkal na ka,” yukna. “Bowahun palegehannu ilu bo' ka amole'.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: Sakali pabungkal a'a inān sampay amole'.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga a'a inān ma hinang si Isa, sinōd sigām tāw. Sinanglitan Tuhan e' sigām ma sabab kawasa bay pamuwanna ma manusiya' makahinang buwattē'.  <div eID="gen4189" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4186" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1810"/><div sID="gen4190" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Matiyu Binowa Ameya' ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.2.13-Mark.2.17">Markus 2:13-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.27-Luke.5.32">Lukas 5:27-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1810"/> Makal'ngngan pa'in si Isa, aniya' ta'nda'na dakayu' a'a niōnan Matiyu aningkō' ma deyom upis pagā'anna sukay parinta. Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Pi'itu na ka ameya' ma aku.” An'ngge magtūy si Matiyu bo' ameya' ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4191" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1811"/><div sID="gen4192" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1811"/> Jari amangan si Isa ma luma' si Matiyu. Aheka isab saga maga'ā' sukay parinta maka saga a'a baldusa kasehe', ina'an pasalu ni si Isa maka saga mulidna.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: Hinabu sigām magsalu, aniya' saga Parisi ang'nda' ni sigām. Yuk saga Parisi itu ni mulid si Isa, “Angay gurubi ilu magsalu maka saga maga'ā' sukay parinta maka saga a'a dusahan kasehe'?”  <div eID="gen4192" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1812"/><div sID="gen4193" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1812"/> Takale e' si Isa patilaw sigām ati yukna, “Bang a'a abasag mbal na magpadoktol. Ya magpadoktol bang a'a taga-saki.

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi ya bay tasulat ma Kitab Jabul, ya yuk-i, ‘Mbal ahalga' ma aku susumbali'an ya pagkulbanbi. Ya kabaya'anku to'ongan subay kam ma'ase' ma pagkahibi.’ ” Yuk si Isa gi', “Ngga'i ka a'a a'adil ya maksudku pi'itu, sagō' a'a baldusa supaya sigām ameya' ma aku.”  <div eID="gen4193" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4190" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1813"/><div sID="gen4194" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagpuwasa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.2.18-Mark.2.22">Markus 2:18-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.33-Luke.5.39">Lukas 5:33-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4195" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1813"/> Manjari pehē' saga mulid si Yahiya Magpapandi ni si Isa atilaw iya, yuk-i, “Tuwan, kami maka saga Parisi magpuwasa na pa'in, sagō' mulidnu ilu mbal amuwasa. Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen4195" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1814"/><div sID="gen4196" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1814"/> Anambung si Isa magparalilan. “Asusa bahā' saga luruk ni pagkawinan sat'ggol maina'an lagi' pangantin l'lla ma atag sigām? Tantu mbal. Sagō' ma llaw sinōng, bang ta'abut na waktu kapamala'an pangantin l'lla min sigām, minnē' sigām anagna' amuwasa.”  <div eID="gen4196" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1815"/><div sID="gen4197" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1815"/> Puwas e' magparalilan si Isa pasal pamandu'na, yukna, “Halam aniya' a'a amatupak kakana' baha'u, kakana' halam bay nirakdakan, ni badju' ndang. Sabab bang buwattē' pakongkong du tupak baha'u, ati agese' du min kakana' ndang. Jari paheya gom pa'in gese'na.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: Pinaralil isab pamandu'na ni binu-anggul baha'u, yukna, “Halam aniya' angisi binu baha'u ni deyom pangisihan kuwit hayop bang ndang na. Bang ganta' buwattē' tantu abustak. Abu'us du binu, ati kaliman bay pangisihan e'. Sagō' in binu baha'u subay ni'isi ni pangisihan baha'u. Jari ya binu maka pangisihanna anatas sali'-sali'.”  <div eID="gen4197" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4194" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1816"/><div sID="gen4198" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Amatay maka D'nda Asaki</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.5.21-Mark.5.43">Markus 5:21-43</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.40-Luke.8.56">Lukas 8:40-56</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4199" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1816"/> Sabu si Isa masi amandu' ma sigām, aniya' pina'an ni iya dakayu' nakura' langgal. Pasujud iya ma dahuan si Isa. Yukna, “Tuwan, yamboho' amatay anakku d'nda. Sagō' bang ka ameya' ma aku amat'nna' tangannu ma iya, tantu iya allum.”  <div eID="gen4199" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1817"/><div sID="gen4200" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1817"/> Sakali an'ngge si Isa bo' paturul ma nakura' inān. Pabeya' isab ma iya saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen4200" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1818"/><div sID="gen4201" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1818"/> Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' d'nda sakihan. Sangpū' na maka duwantahun halam bay atitis laha'na. Pasekot iya ni si Isa min buli'an, bo' ama'abut tanganna ni tōng juba si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21
verses.text: Yukna ma deyom pikilanna, “Bang sadja tasagidku minsan la'a hal tōng s'mmekna, pauli' du sakiku.”  <div eID="gen4201" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
