verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1819"/><div sID="gen4202" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1819"/> Jari palingi' si Isa ati ta'nda'na d'nda itu. Yukna, “Arung, da'a ka asusa. Pauli' na sakinu sabab min pangandolnu.” Magtūy saru'un-du'un kauli'an d'nda itu.  <div eID="gen4202" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1820"/><div sID="gen4203" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1820"/> Pagt'kka si Isa ni luma' nakura' inān, ta'nda'na maina'an saga a'a magsuling maka ba'anan a'a magkasensongan.

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Paluwas kam kamemon. Halam amatay onde' ilu, hal iya atuli.” Minnē' pinagtittowahan si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: Aubus pa'in bay pinaluwas saga a'a inān, pasōd si Isa ni deyom bilik onde' d'nda inān bo' yampa balutanna ma tangan. Magtūy iya punduk min baina.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: Jari in suli-suli pasal hinang si Isa itu bay pasaplag ni kaluha'an lahat e'.  <div eID="gen4203" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4198" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1821"/><div sID="gen4204" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwangan A'a Buta Kauli'an</title> <div sID="gen4205" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1821"/> Palanjal pa'in si Isa minnē', aniya' duwa a'a buta bay paturul ma iya. Angalingan sigā pakosog, yuk-i, “Oy! Tubu' si Da'ud! Ma'ase' na ka ma kami!”  <div eID="gen4205" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1822"/><div sID="gen4206" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1822"/> Jari pagsōd pa'in si Isa ni deyom luma', pasekot ni iya duwangan buta inān. Yuk si Isa ma sigā, “Magsab'nnal kam in aku makapauli' du?” <div eID="gen4206" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4207" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', Tuwan,” yuk sigā.  <div eID="gen4207" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1823"/><div sID="gen4208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1823"/> Jari pinat'nna' e' si Isa tanganna ni mata sigā maka e'na ah'lling, yukna, “Tahinang ma ka'am buwat bay pagsab'nnalbi.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:30
verses.text: Magtūy du sigā maka'nda' pabīng, ati niebot-ebotan e' si Isa, yukna, “Da'a kam angahaka ni sai-sai pasal itu-i.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:31
verses.text: Sagō' ala'an pa'in duwangan itu minnē', amatanyag sigā pasal si Isa ma sakalingkal lahat inān.  <div eID="gen4208" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4204" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1824"/><div sID="gen4209" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Aumaw Kauli'an</title> <div sID="gen4210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1824"/> Ma sabu pa'in ala'an duwangan inān, aniya' saga a'a pina'an ni si Isa amowa sehe' sigām ya mbal makabissala ma sabab sinōd saitan.

verses.name: Matthew 9:33
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e' si Isa bay amala'an saitan min baran a'a itu, magtūy iya makabissala. Ainu-inu saga a'a maina'an kamemon. Yuk sigām, “Halam aniya' bay ta'nda'tam buwattitu ma kaluha'an lahat Isra'il itu. Yampa.”  <div eID="gen4210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1825"/><div sID="gen4211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1825"/> Sagō' yuk saga Parisi, “A'a itu taga-barakat min nakura' saitan, ya angkan tapaluwasna saga saitan.”  <div eID="gen4211" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4209" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1826"/><div sID="gen4212" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kulang A'a Maga'ani</title> <div sID="gen4213" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1826"/> Manjari talatag e' si Isa kamemon da'ira maka kaluma'an ma jadjahan e'-i. Amandu' na pa'in iya ma deyom langgal, anganasihat na pa'in lapal ahāp pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Kauli'an e'na saga saki maka kalammahan indaginis.

verses.name: Matthew 9:36
verses.text: Pag'nda'na ma a'a kamemon inān, landu' iya ma'ase', sabab ina'an sigām ma deyom kasusahan ma halam aniya' anabangan sigām. Sali' sigām sapantun bili-bili halam aniya' angupiksa' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 9:37
verses.text: Sakali yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Saga a'a itu sali' dalil huma atiguma' na buwa'na. Aluha tana', sagō' kulang a'a magani.

verses.name: Matthew 9:38
verses.text: Angkan kam subay angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ya tag-dapu tana', bo' supaya iya anoho' saga a'a magani pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen4213" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.9"/> <div eID="gen4212" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1827"/><div sID="gen4214" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mulid si Isa Kasangpū' maka Duwa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.3.13-Mark.3.19">Markus 3:13-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.12-Luke.6.16">Lukas 6:12-16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4215" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1827"/> Manjari nilinganan e' si Isa saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa bo' buwananna sigām kawasa pamala'an saitan min deyom baran a'a sampay pamauli' saki maka lamma indaginis.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2
verses.text: Ya na itu ōn a'a kasangpū' maka duwa bay kawakilan e' si Isa: kaissa, si Simun ya niōnan isab si Petros, maka danakanna si Andariyas, bo' si Yakub maka danakanna si Yahiya, saga anak si Sibidi.

verses.name: Matthew 10:3
verses.text: Pasunu' si Pilip maka si Bartolome maka si Tomas, bo' si Matiyu ya bay magā' sukay parinta, bo' si Yakub ya anak si Alpa. Pasunu' isab si Taddiyu,

verses.name: Matthew 10:4
verses.text: bo' si Simun a'a pangangatu. Katapusan si Judas Iskariyut, ya anukbalan si Isa ni saga bantana ma waktu damuli minnē'.  <div eID="gen4215" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4214" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1828"/><div sID="gen4216" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasangpū' maka Duwa Mulid Sinō' Magnasihat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.7-Mark.6.13">Markus 6:7-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.1-Luke.9.6">Lukas 9:1-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4217" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1828"/> In sangpū' maka duwa a'a itu bay pinandu'an e' si Isa bo' yampa sinō' pal'ngngan. Yukna, “Da'a kam pehē' ni kaluma'an a'a ngga'i ka bangsa Isra'il, atawa ni kaluma'an a'a Samariya.

verses.name: Matthew 10:6
verses.text: Sagō' pehē' kam ni bangsa Isra'il sadja, ya sapantun bili-bili alungay.

verses.name: Matthew 10:7
verses.text: Pehē' kam magnasihat in waktu kapagparinta Tuhan song na at'kka.

verses.name: Matthew 10:8
verses.text: Pauli'unbi sasuku asaki. Pakallumunbi saga a'a bay magpatayan, palanu'unbi sasuku ni'ipul, maka paluwasunbi saga saitan min deyom baran a'a. Bay kam anaima' kapatut min aku ma halam aniya' bayadna, angkan kam subay anabang ma halam aniya' tongodna.

verses.name: Matthew 10:9
verses.text: Da'a kam amowa bulawan atawa pilak minsan hal pisita ma deyom sabitanbi.

verses.name: Matthew 10:10
verses.text: Da'a kam amowa paglutu'anan, atawa badju' pasalinanbi, atawa taumpa' atawa tungkud. Sabab bang a'a maghinang, wajib iya binuwanan napakana.<note>Napakana: hatina gastuna atawa kallumanna.</note>  <div eID="gen4217" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1829"/><div sID="gen4218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1829"/> “Bang kam at'kka ni da'ira atawa ni kaluma'an, piha'unbi a'a maina'an ahāp kasuddahanna, ati pahanti' kam ma iya sampay ta'abut waktu kala'anbi min lahat ina'an-i.

verses.name: Matthew 10:12
verses.text: Bang kam pasōd ni luma' a'a, saginahunbi buwattitu, ‘Bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan!’

verses.name: Matthew 10:13
verses.text: Jari bang ahāp kasuddahan sigām ma luma' inān, kat'kkahan du sigām kasannangan ya bay pangamu'bi. Sagō' bang mbal ahāp kasuddahan sigām, papellengunbi ni ka'am kasannangan he'.

verses.name: Matthew 10:14
verses.text: Bang ganta' aniya' saga a'a mbal anagina ka'am, atawa mbal bilahi akale ma ka'am, ala'an kam min luma' atawa min kauman inān. Paspasinbi dahū bagunbunna min tape'bi, tanda' saksi' in ka'am apuwas min sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 10:15
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya', kalabihan gi' buhatna ma saga a'a ma lahat inān min bay hukuman ma da'ira Sodom maka da'ira Gomora, lahat abantug ma sabab dusa a'ana ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4218" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4216" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1830"/><div sID="gen4219" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kabinasahan Sōng Pat'kka</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.9-Mark.13.13">Markus 13:9-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.12-Luke.21.17">Lukas 21:12-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1830"/> “Pakale kam,” yuk si Isa. “Ilu kam song papehē'ku ni deyoman saga a'a ala'at. Sali' kam sapantun bili-bili pinapehē' ni deyoman ba'anan ero' talun, ya magpangal'kkob. Angkan subay ataha' akkalbi, maka subay ahatul kajarihanbi.

verses.name: Matthew 10:17
verses.text: Pahalli' kam, sabab aniya' a'a an'kkahan kam ni paghukuman maka angandaplosan kam ma deyom kalanggalan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:18
verses.text: Pinaharap kam ni saga gubnul maka ni saga sultan bo' pinapariksa' e' sigām, ati makasaksi' du kam ma pasalanku ni sigām sampay ni saga a'a ya ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: Matthew 10:19
verses.text: Jari bang kam tinandanan ni sara', da'a kam magsusa bang ai pamissalabi atawa bang buwattingga e'bi ah'lling. Tantu kam binuwanan lapal pamissalabi bang ta'abut waktuna.

verses.name: Matthew 10:20
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka baranbi ya ah'lling ma waktu he'-i, sagō' Rū Mma'bi Tuhan ya anabangan ka'am amissala.  <div eID="gen4220" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1831"/><div sID="gen4221" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1831"/> “Ma waktu sinosōng inān aniya' du saga a'a anukbalan danakan sigām bo' pinapatay. Aniya' du isab saga matto'a l'lla anukbalan anak sigām bo' pinapatay. Saga anak isab amantahan matto'a sigām, anoho' isab subay pinapatay.

verses.name: Matthew 10:22
verses.text: Maka ka'am saga mulidku,” yuk si Isa, “kinab'nsihan du e' a'a kamemon ma sabab aku ya pameya'anbi. Sagō' sasuku ahogot imanna sampay ni kahinapusan, makasampay ni kasalamatan ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 10:23
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' bininasa ma kaluma'an dakayu', alahi kam ni kaluma'an saddī. Haka'anta kam, ma halam gi' talatagbi kalahatan Isra'il kamemon, in aku Anak Manusiya' pabalik du pi'itu.  <div eID="gen4221" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1832"/><div sID="gen4222" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1832"/> “Halam aniya' mulid palanga min guruna. Halam aniya' ata palanga min nakura'na.

verses.name: Matthew 10:25
verses.text: In mulid subay magsukul bang makasali' ni guruna, maka sosoho'an subay magsukul bang makasali' ni nakura'na. Na, bang aku nakura'bi pinagōnan e' sigām Be'elsebul, hatina nakura' saitan, luba'-lagi'na na ka'am sosoho'anku niōnan ala'at du e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen4222" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4219" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1833"/><div sID="gen4223" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sai Subay Kinatāwan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.12.2-Luke.12.7">Lukas 12:2-7</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4224" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1833"/> “Da'a kam tināw ma saga manusiya'. Kamemon bay nilimbungan tantu du pinaluwas. Kamemon bay tinau' ma deyom atay tantu du pinata'u.

verses.name: Matthew 10:27
verses.text: Ai-ai pangahakaku ka'am ma deyom kalendoman, pah'llingunbi ma kasawahan. Maka ai-ai nihagas-hagas ma taingabi, patanyagunbi ma mairan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:28
verses.text: Da'a kam tināw ma a'a ya makapatay baranbi, sabab mbal ta'abut palnyawahanbi. Ahāp lagi' bang Tuhan ya katāwanbi, sabab in iya taga-kawasa aniksa' baranbi sampay nyawabi ma deyom nalka'.

verses.name: Matthew 10:29
verses.text: Pikilunbi manuk-manuk paupit ilu, tab'llita duwa hekana maka pisita, sagō' minsan areyo' halga'na halam aniya' paupit minsan dakayu' ahūg ni tana' bang ngga'i ka min kabaya'an Mma'bi Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:30
verses.text: Ya lagi'na ka'am. Minsan lamba bu'unbi ilu, taitung e' Tuhan bang pila hekana.

verses.name: Matthew 10:31
verses.text: Angkan kam subay mbal tināw, sabab ahalga' gi' kam min ba'anan paupit.”  <div eID="gen4224" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4223" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1834"/><div sID="gen4225" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsab'nnal Pasal si Isa ya Pameya'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.12.8-Luke.12.9">Lukas 12:8-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4226" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1834"/> “Sai-sai angahaka ma alopan kaheka'an a'a in aku pameya'anna, angahaka du aku ma alopan Mma'ku ma deyom sulga', in a'a inān palsuku'anku.

verses.name: Matthew 10:33
verses.text: Sagō' sai-sai amalilu ma alopan kaheka'an in aku ngga'i ka pameya'anna, paliluhanku du isab a'a inān ma alopan Mma'ku ma deyom sulga'.”  <div eID="gen4226" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4225" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1835"/><div sID="gen4227" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pagsagga'an A'a</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.12.51-Luke.12.53">Lukas 12:51-53</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.14.26-Luke.14.27">Lukas 14:26-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4228" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1835"/> “Arai' pangannalbi in maksudku pi'itu amowa kasannangan ni dunya, bo' ngga'i ka. Ya maksudku pi'itu ngga'i ka kasannangan sagō' pagsagga'an.

verses.name: Matthew 10:35
verses.text: Bay aku pi'itu amapagsagga' manusiya' dangan maka dangan. Anak l'lla magbono' maka mma'na, anak d'nda maka ina'na, ayuwan d'nda maka mato'ana d'nda.

verses.name: Matthew 10:36
verses.text: Binantahan a'a e' sehe'na magdaluma'.  <div eID="gen4228" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1836"/><div sID="gen4229" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1836"/> “Bang a'a alasahan mma'na maka ina'na palabi min aku, mbal iya wajib tahinang mulidku. Damikiyanna isab bang a'a alasahan anakna l'lla-d'nda palabi min aku, mbal iya manjari tahinang mulidku.

verses.name: Matthew 10:38
verses.text: Sai-sai bilahi anunuran aku subay tanggungna hāgna pamapatayan iya. Bang hati mbal paglilla'na, mbal iya manjari tahinang mulidku.

verses.name: Matthew 10:39
verses.text: Sai-sai allogan kallum baranna, halam du aniya' kallumna taptap. Sagō' sai-sai mbal allogan kallum baranna bo' lilla' isab amatay ma sababku, makabāk iya kallum kakkal.”  <div eID="gen4229" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4227" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1837"/><div sID="gen4230" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tungbas min Tuhan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.41">Markus 9:41</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4231" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1837"/> “Sai-sai anaima' ka'am, aku ya tinaima' e' sigām, sampay Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku ni dunya.

verses.name: Matthew 10:41
verses.text: Sasuku anaima' nabi ma sabab lapal Tuhan ya pamissalana, a'a inān katungbasan kahāpan ya panungbas nabi. Damikiyanna, sasuku anaima' a'a adil ma sabab ka'adilna, katungbasan iya kahāpan ya panungbas saga a'a adil.

verses.name: Matthew 10:42
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sai-sai amuwan minsan la'a hal dasawan bohe' dingin ma dakayu' a'a areyo' kapaga'ana pagka mulidku iya, tantu a'a inān tinungbasan kahāpan.”  <div eID="gen4231" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.10"/> <div eID="gen4230" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1838"/><div sID="gen4232" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.7.18-Luke.7.35">Lukas 7:18-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1838"/> Aubus pa'in e' si Isa bay magpanoho'an ma mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa inān, ala'an iya minnē'. Pehē' iya ni saga kaluma'an ma lahat Jalil bo' magpandu' maka magnasihat.  <div eID="gen4233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1839"/><div sID="gen4234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1839"/> Na, si Yahiya Magpapandi bay takalabusu asal. Pagkalena pasal kahinangan Al-Masi, anoho' iya saga mulidna kasehe' pehē' ni si Isa

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: atilaw iya, yuk-i, “Ka'a bahā' ya bay pinagbissala e' si Yahiya pi'itu ni dunya? Atawa aniya' gi' saddī nilagaran?”  <div eID="gen4234" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1840"/><div sID="gen4235" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1840"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Pabīng kam pehē'. Haka'inbi si Yahiya pasal ai-ai takalebi maka ai-ai ta'nda'bi itu.

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: Saga a'a bay buta maka'nda' na, a'a bay pengka' makal'ngngan na, a'a bay ni'ipul tapalanu' na, a'a bay bisu makakale na, maka a'a bay amatay tapakallum na pabīng. Sampay saga a'a kulang-kabus pinagnasihatan na lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku mbal magduwa-ruwa pikilanna ma aku.”  <div eID="gen4235" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1841"/><div sID="gen4236" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1841"/> Pasalta' pa'in saga mulid si Yahiya inān ala'an min si Isa, amissala iya ni katimukan a'a inān pasal si Yahiya. Yukna, “Ai bahā' bay pihabi, ya angkan kam pehē' ni paslangan? Bilahi kam bahā' ang'nda' a'a sapantun dansolag parang-parang, tabowa pap'llay e' baliyu?

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: Bang ngga'i ka he'-i, na ai bahā' pihabi pehē'? A'a magsin'mmek ahalga'? Arai' ngga'i ka, sabab bang a'a magsin'mmek buwattē', astana' ya pat'nna'anna.

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: Haka'inbi aku to'ongan bang ai bay pihabi pehē'. Dakayu' nabi bahā'? Aho', nabi, sagō' alanga lagi' min nabi.

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: Sabab si Yahiya itu bay pinagbissala ma Kitab Kanabi-nabihan, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4237"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4238"/>‘Soho'ku a'a kawakilanku parahū min ka'a, yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen4238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4239"/>bo' supaya sakapna lān palabayannu.’<l eID="gen4239" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4237"/>  <div eID="gen4236" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1842"/><div sID="gen4240" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1842"/> “Haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “pasal si Yahiya Magpapandi itu: halam aniya' abangsa labi gi' min iya. Sagō' sai-sai ma deyoman pagparintahan Tuhan, minsan a'a areyo' kapaga'ana, alanga lagi' iya min si Yahiya.

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: Min waktu tagna' kapagnasihat si Yahiya sampay ni llaw itu, amanuyu' to'ongan saga a'a bo' makasōd pehē' ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: In pagparintahan Tuhan itu pinagkallam na pa'in ma Kitab Tawrat maka ma Kitab Jabul sampay ta'abut waktu kalahil si Yahiya.

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: Jari bang kam ahutu magkahagad, si Yahiya ya na si Elija ya pinagsambatan e' kanabi-nabihan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: Sasuku kam makakale, kalehunbi to'ongan.  <div eID="gen4240" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1843"/><div sID="gen4241" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1843"/> “Manjari,” yuk si Isa, “ai pamaralilanku saga a'a ahil jaman itu? Sali' sigām hantang onde'-onde' magtingkō'an ma halaman tabu' magongka'-ongka'. Angalingan saga onde'-onde' min dambila' ni kasehe'an sigām, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4242"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4243"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: ‘Oy! Ka'am ilu! Bay kami angandapu'an ka'am<l eID="gen4243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4244"/>sagō' ka'am ilu mbal angigal.<l eID="gen4244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4245"/>Bay kami magsindilan<l eID="gen4245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4246"/>sagō' ka'am ilu mbal ameya' magtangis.’<l eID="gen4246" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4242"/>  <div eID="gen4241" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1844"/><div sID="gen4247" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1844"/> “Buwattē' isab ma si Yahiya. Amuwasa iya maka mbal anginum inuman makalango, ati yukbi in iya sinōd saitan!

verses.name: Matthew 11:19
verses.text: Puwas e' aku, Anak Manusiya', bay pi'itu magkakan maka maginum. Magtūy aku pinah'llingan e' a'a kamemon, yuk-i, ‘He! Nda'unbi a'a itu, dahaga'! Panginginum! Magbagay iya maka a'a magā' sukay parinta, sampay baldusa kasehe'an!’ Saguwā',” yuk si Isa, “ta'nda'tam min kahinangan Tuhan in pangita'una asal taluwa'.”  <div eID="gen4247" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4232" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1845"/><div sID="gen4248" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maka'ase'-ase' saga A'a Mbal Magkahagad</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.10.13-Luke.10.15">Lukas 10:13-15</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4249" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1845"/> Puwas e' anagna' si Isa amabukagan saga a'a ma deyom kada'irahan bay pangahinanganna kaheka'an saga hinangna makainu-inu, malaingkan halam bay pataikut min karusahan sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 11:21
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Allā, ka'am saga a'a Korasin maka a'a Betsaida, maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am! Aheka hinang makainu-inu bay pina'nda'an ni ka'am sagō' halam bay b'nnalbi. Bang bay tahinang saga hinangku makainu-inu inān ma da'ira Tira maka da'ira Sidun, tantu saga a'a maina'an bay pataikut min dusa sigām. Tantu sigām bay mags'mmek karut, maka magbusugan di-sigām abu, tanda' sin pagsusun sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 11:22
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan, abuhat lagi' hukuman ya pinat'kka ni ka'am min bay hukuman ma saga a'a da'ira Tira maka da'ira Sidun ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Matthew 11:23
verses.text: Ka'am isab saga a'a Kapirnaum,” yuk si Isa, “ilu kam magbantug-bantug di-bi in ka'am pinalanga sampay ni sulga'! Sagō' nalka' sadja ya pasampayanbi! In hinang makainu-inu bay pina'nda'an ni ka'am, bang bay kapa'nda'an ni saga a'a Sodom, tantu masi da'ira sigām sampay ni kabuwattina'anan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:24
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum, abuhat gi' hukuman ya pinat'kkahan ka'am min bay pinat'kkahan saga a'a Sodom ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4249" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4248" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1846"/><div sID="gen4250" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pahalian saga A'a Kabuhatan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.10.21-Luke.10.22">Lukas 10:21-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4251" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1846"/> Manjari itu, ma waktu ina'an, amissala si Isa ni Tuhan. Yukna, “O Mma', ka'a ya makapagbaya' ma langit maka ma dunya. Aheya pagsukulanku ni ka'a sabab in bay limbungannu min a'a taga-pangadji' sampay min a'a alalom pangita'una, pata'unu na ni a'a akulang pangita'una.

verses.name: Matthew 11:26
verses.text: Aho', Mma', min kōgnu maka baya'nu angkan buwattē'.”  <div eID="gen4251" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1847"/><div sID="gen4252" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1847"/> Yuk si Isa ni saga a'a inān, “Bay na pangandol ai-ai kamemon ma aku e' Mma'ku. Halam aniya' makata'uwan aku, luwal Mma'ku. Damikiyanna, halam aniya' makata'uwan iya, luwal aku anakna lissi, beya' isab sasuku tapene'ku.  <div eID="gen4252" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1848"/><div sID="gen4253" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1848"/> “Ameya' kam ma aku, sasuku kam binale' maka kabuhatan, bo' kam buwananku pahalian.

verses.name: Matthew 11:29
verses.text: Taima'unbi pandu' ya pamatanggungku ma ka'am, ati anganad kam min aku sabab ahantap asal aku, maka areyo' pangatayanku. Minnitu kam makabāk kahayangan ma nyawabi.

verses.name: Matthew 11:30
verses.text: Sabab aluhay ya pamahinangku ma ka'am, maka alampung isab ya pandu' pamatanggungku ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen4253" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.11"/> <div eID="gen4250" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1849"/><div sID="gen4254" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Llaw Paghali</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.2.23-Mark.2.28">Markus 2:23-28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.1-Luke.6.5">Lukas 6:1-5</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1849"/> Dakayu' Sabtu', lum'ngngan disi Isa labay min t'ngnga' huma pananoman pai-tirigu. Jari itu, pagka lingantu saga mulidna, aniya' batang pai bay kin'ttu' e' sigām bo' ni'inta' isina.

verses.name: Matthew 12:2
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga Parisi ma bay tahinang e' saga mulid itu, yuk sigām ni si Isa, “Nda'un ba saga mulidnu ilu. Langgal sara' ko' hinang sigām pagka pasabu ma llaw Sabtu'.”  <div eID="gen4255" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1850"/><div sID="gen4256" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1850"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Angay, halam tabassabi bang ai bay tahinang e' si Da'ud ma masa awal e', waktu bay kaotas sigām maka saga a'ana?

verses.name: Matthew 12:4
verses.text: Bay pasōd si Da'ud ni deyom langgal Pangarapan ni Tuhan bo' yampa ngā'na saga tinapay ya panukbal ni Tuhan. Pinagkakan e' sigām tinapay inān minsan langgal sara', sabab luwal saga kaimaman ya wajib amangan tinapay bay tinukbalan inān.

verses.name: Matthew 12:5
verses.text: Halam bahā' isab bay tabassabi ma Kitab Tawrat pasal saga imam ya maghinang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan sabu ma llaw paghali ni Tuhan? Minsan sigām makalanggal sara' agama halam du sigām bay magdusa.

verses.name: Matthew 12:6
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, aniya' maitu aheya kapatutna min langgal pagkulbanan inān.

verses.name: Matthew 12:7
verses.text: Aniya' lling Tuhan bay tasulat ma Kitab Kanabi-nabihan, ya yuk-i, ‘Mbal ahalga' ma aku susumbali'an ya pagkulbanbi. Sagō' ya kabaya'anku to'ongan subay kam ma'ase' ma pagkahibi.’ Bang bay tahatibi to'ongan pandu' itu, mbal du kam bay amat'kka hukuman ni saga a'a ya halam bay magdusa.

verses.name: Matthew 12:8
verses.text: Sabab aku, Anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut magbaya' ma llaw Sabtu', ya llaw mulliya.”  <div eID="gen4256" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4254" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1851"/><div sID="gen4257" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Pakongkong Tanganna Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.3.1-Mark.3.6">Markus 3:1-6</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.6-Luke.6.11">Lukas 6:6-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4258" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1851"/> Manjari palanjal si Isa minnē' ni lahat dakayu', ati pasōd iya ni deyom langgal sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 12:10
verses.text: Aniya' maina'an a'a pakongkong tanganna, maka aniya' isab saga a'a bilahi amiha dusa ma si Isa panuntut sigām ma iya. Tinilaw iya e' sigām, yuk-i, “Langgal sara' bahā' ma agamatam bang kita amauli' a'a ma llaw paghali ni Tuhan?”  <div eID="gen4258" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1852"/><div sID="gen4259" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1852"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ai bahā' hinangbi bang aniya' dakayu' bili-bilibi ahūg ni deyom lowang hinabu ma llaw paghali? Mbal bahā' ngā'bi hayop inān, pinaluwas min deyom lowang?

verses.name: Matthew 12:12
verses.text: In kita binangsa manusiya' labi gi' ahalga' min bili-bili. Angkan wajib bang kita maghinang kahāpan ma llaw paghali ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4259" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1853"/><div sID="gen4260" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1853"/> Sakali ah'lling si Isa ni a'a pakongkong tanganna inān, yukna, “Pah'nnatun tangannu ilu.” Na, pinah'nnat e'na, magtūy kauli'an tanganna pasali' na ni tanganna dambila'.

verses.name: Matthew 12:14
verses.text: Sagō' paluwas saga Parisi min deyom langgal inān bo' magisun bang buwattingga e' sigām amapatay ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4260" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4257" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1854"/><div sID="gen4261" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sosoho'an Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen4262" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1854"/> Pagta'u si Isa ma kaisunan saga Parisi e', ala'an iya min lahat ina'an. Aheka a'a bay paturul ma iya, ati kauli'an e'na sigām kamemon sasuku magsakian.

verses.name: Matthew 12:16
verses.text: Bay sigām banda'anna da'a sinō' anuli-nuli pasal iya.

verses.name: Matthew 12:17
verses.text: Minnē' aniya' katumanan ma bay pinagkallam e' Tuhan, ya tasulat e' nabi Isaya.

verses.name: Matthew 12:18
verses.text: Yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4263"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4264"/>“Itiya' sosoho'anku bay pene'ku.<l eID="gen4264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4265"/>Kalasahanku iya, landu' aku kasulutan ma iya.<l eID="gen4265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4266"/>Pahōpku ni iya Rū-ku,<l eID="gen4266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4267"/>ati iya ya magpasaplag kabontol hukumanku<l eID="gen4267" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4268"/>ni sabarang bangsa.<l eID="gen4268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4269"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:19
verses.text: Mbal iya angalugat, mbal isab angamahit.<l eID="gen4269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4270"/>Mbal iya amatanog suwalana ma paglabayan a'a.<l eID="gen4270" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4271"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:20
verses.text: Ma'ase' iya ma sasuku alamma pangandolna,<l eID="gen4271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4272"/>maka tabangna sasuku mbal makakole'an di-na,<l eID="gen4272" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4273"/>sampay ni waktu kapat'nna'na hukuman abontol<l eID="gen4273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4274"/>maka tara'ug kamemon kala'atan.<l eID="gen4274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4275"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:21
verses.text: Jari iya ya pangasahan e' kamemon palbangsahan.”<l eID="gen4275" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4263"/>  <div eID="gen4262" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4261" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1855"/><div sID="gen4276" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Be'elsebul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.3.20-Mark.3.30">Markus 3:20-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.11.14-Luke.11.23">Lukas 11:14-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4277" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1855"/> Sakali aniya' binowa ni si Isa dakayu' a'a umaw maka buta sabab sinōd saitan. Kauli'an a'a itu e' si Isa, jari makabissala maka maka'nda' na iya.

verses.name: Matthew 12:23
verses.text: Ainu-inu saga a'a bay maina'an. Yuk sigām, “Ya itu bahā' tubu' si Da'ud dakayu'-kayu'?”  <div eID="gen4277" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1856"/><div sID="gen4278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1856"/> Pagkale lling inān e' saga Parisi, yuk sigām, “Angkan a'a itu makapala'an saitan min deyom baran a'a sabab taga-kawasa iya bay min si Be'elsebul, ya pagnakura'an saitan.”  <div eID="gen4278" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1857"/><div sID="gen4279" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1857"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa bang ai pinikil e' sigām, angkan yukna, “Bang saupama aniya' pagsultanan abahagi' duwa saga a'ana, bo' magbono' sali'-sali', mbal at'ggol magka'at pagsultanan e'. Damikiyanna bang aniya' a'a magdalahat atawa magdaokom, bo' abahagi' duwa magsagga'an di-sigām, al'kkas sigām magkaukanat.

verses.name: Matthew 12:26
verses.text: Angkan ko', bang nakura' saitan amaluwas pagkahina saitan, hatina magkuntarahan iya di-na. Tantu mbal anatas kapagbaya'na.

verses.name: Matthew 12:27
verses.text: Yukbi in aku itu makapaluwas saitan ma sabab aniya' kawasaku pamuwan aku e' si Be'elsebul. Bang he'-i b'nnal, minningga bahā' pangā'an mulidbi kawasa, ya angkan sigām isab makapaluwas saitan? Mulidbi luggiya' ya amabukis kasā'anbi.

verses.name: Matthew 12:28
verses.text: Sagō' ya b'nnalna, ya angkan aku makapala'an saitan sabab taga-kawasa aku deyo' bay min Rū Tuhan. Ya na ko' ilu paltanda'an in Tuhan itiya' na magparinta ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen4279" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1858"/><div sID="gen4280" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1858"/> “Nakura' saitan inān sali' dalil a'a aga'os. Luma'na mbal tasōd, pangalta'na mbal kalangpasan. Luwal bang a'a ga'osan inān niengkotan dahū bo' yampa kalangpasan deyom luma'na.  <div eID="gen4280" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1859"/><div sID="gen4281" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1859"/> “Sai-sai mbal amogbogan aku,” yuk si Isa, “anagga' aku du. Maka sai-sai mbal anabangan aku amatipun saga suku'ku, amakaukanat du iya.

verses.name: Matthew 12:31
verses.text: Angkan kam haka'anku, sai-sai kam angandusa maka amah'lling pangkal tudju ni Tuhan, niampun du kam. Sagō' sai-sai amah'lling pangkal ni Rū Sussi, mbal ka'ampunan.

verses.name: Matthew 12:32
verses.text: Sai-sai amah'lling la'at ma aku, Anak Manusiya', makajari niampun dusana. Sagō' sai-sai amah'lling la'at ma Rū Sussi, mbal to'ongan niampun dusana, ai na ka ma masa itu, ai na ka ma masa sinōng.”  <div eID="gen4281" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4276" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1860"/><div sID="gen4282" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kayu maka Buwa'na</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.6.43-Luke.6.45">Lukas 6:43-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4283" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1860"/> “Bang saupama kayu ahāp,” yuk si Isa, “ahāp isab buwa'na. Damikiyanna isab bang kayu ala'at, buwa'na mbal ahāp. Sabab takilā asal kayu min buwa'na.

verses.name: Matthew 12:34
verses.text: Ka'am saga pangangakkal ilu! Mbal kam makabissala ahāp sabab ala'at deyom ataybi. Ai-ai bay ma deyom atay manusiya', gana-gana paluwas min bowa'na.

verses.name: Matthew 12:35
verses.text: Bang a'a ahāp, ahāp du isab kaul-pi'ilna sabab luwas min kahāpan ya bay tau'na ma deyom atayna. Sagō' bang a'a ala'at, ala'at du isab kaul-pi'ilna sabab luwas min kala'atan bay tau'na ma deyom atayna.  <div eID="gen4283" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1861"/><div sID="gen4284" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1861"/> “Haka'anta kam, bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya', in a'a kamemon subay angahaka pasal bissala kamemon bay tapah'llingna ma halam aniya' kapūsanna.

verses.name: Matthew 12:37
verses.text: Sabab min pamissalana ya sababan angkan a'a nihukum, bang niampun atawa bininasa.”  <div eID="gen4284" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4282" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1862"/><div sID="gen4285" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Guru maka Parisi Mikipa'nda' Paltanda'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.11-Mark.8.12">Markus 8:11-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.11.29-Luke.11.32">Lukas 11:29-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4286" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1862"/> Manjari aniya' saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi bay maina'an. Yuk sigām ni si Isa, “Tuwan Guru, bilahi kami ang'nda' dakayu' paltanda'an luwas min barakatnu.”  <div eID="gen4286" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1863"/><div sID="gen4287" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1863"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Dusahan pahāp saga a'a tahun itu-i, mbal to'ongan bilahi magta'at ma Tuhan. Ka'am ilu mikipa'nda' paltanda'an panulayanbi aku. Sagō' halam aniya' paltanda'an pa'nda'anku ka'am, luwal paltanda'an bay min si Yunus ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Matthew 12:40
verses.text: Sabab si Yunus bay t'llung'llaw t'llumbahangi ma deyom b'ttong sattuwa dilaut. Damikiyanna aku, Anak Manusiya', t'llung'llaw t'llumbahangi du aku ma deyom gumi ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Matthew 12:41
verses.text: Bang ta'abut na llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya', magt'nggehan du saga a'a bay ma da'ira Niniba ma masa awal e', ati sigām ya anaksi' in ka'am taga-dusa. Sabab sigām ya bay akale ma nasihat si Yunus, magtūy apinda min dusa sigām. Haka'anta kam, itiya' na dakayu' a'a labi lagi' alanga min si Yunus e', sagō' mbal iya b'nnalbi.

verses.name: Matthew 12:42
verses.text: Bang ta'abut isab llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya' aniya' du an'ngge dakayu' sultan d'nda bay ma lahat Seba ma masa awal e'. Anaksi' du iya in ka'am taga-dusa. Ya angkan d'nda inān taga-kapatut anaksi', sabab bay pi'itu min lahatna ma bihing dunya supaya takalena bissala pangita'u min sultan Sulayman. Haka'anta kam, ma buwattina'an aniya' maitu pasōng lagi' pangita'una min bay ta'u si Sulayman, sagō' mbal b'nnalbi.”  <div eID="gen4287" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4285" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1864"/><div sID="gen4288" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabalik Saitan ni Baina</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.24-Luke.11.26">Lukas 11:24-26</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4289" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1864"/> “Na, bang takdil ni saitan,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' saitan paluwas min baran a'a, nilunsul e'na lahat halam bay kaulanan amiha pahalian. Jari bang halam aniya' tabākna,

verses.name: Matthew 12:44
verses.text: ah'lling saitan inān ni baranna, yukna, ‘Gom na aku pabīng ni deyom baran a'a bay pat'nna'anku he'.’ Pagbīng pa'in, ta'nda'na halam gi' aniya' pat'nna' maina'an, maka wa'i bay sinapuhan maka minomos.

verses.name: Matthew 12:45
verses.text: Puwas e' pehē' iya angā' pitu' saitan akalap gi' la'at sigām min iya, ati pasōd sigām kamemon ni deyom baran a'a pat'nna' maina'an. Jari in a'a inān pala'at gom pa'in kahālanna damuli min bay dahū. Buwattē' isab ma saga a'a baldusa ya allum ma tahun itu-i.”  <div eID="gen4289" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4288" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1865"/><div sID="gen4290" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ina' si Isa maka Saga Danakanna L'lla</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.3.31-Mark.3.35">Markus 3:31-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.19-Luke.8.21">Lukas 8:19-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4291" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1865"/> Na, hinabu si Isa masi amissala ni saga a'a inān, at'kka pina'an ina'na maka saga danakanna l'lla. Ina'an sigām angagad ma luwasan pagka bilahi magsuli-suli maka iya.

verses.name: Matthew 12:47
verses.text: Jari aniya' bay anambuku ma si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan, ina'an ina'nu maka saga danakannu ma luwasan. Bilahi magsuli-suli maka ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4291" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1866"/><div sID="gen4292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1866"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Sai bahā' ina'ku maka saga danakanku?”

verses.name: Matthew 12:49
verses.text: Jari tinō' e'na saga mulidna. Yukna, “Ya na ko' itu ina'ku maka dauranakanku.

verses.name: Matthew 12:50
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai angahinang kabaya'an Mma'ku ma sulga', ya na ko' ina'an saga danakanku l'lla-d'nda, maka ina'ku.”  <div eID="gen4292" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.12"/> <div eID="gen4290" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1867"/><div sID="gen4293" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Panabod Bigi-Tinanom</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.1-Mark.4.9">Markus 4:1-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.4-Luke.8.8">Lukas 8:4-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1867"/> Ma llaw he'-i paluwas si Isa min luma' bo' pehē' ni bihing danaw aningkō' mahē' magpandu'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:2
verses.text: Aheka makalandu' a'a bay patimuk ni iya, angkan iya paruwa' aningkō' ma bayanan bay parunggu' mahē'. Bo' ba'anan a'a inān magt'nggehan ma bihing tampe.

verses.name: Matthew 13:3
verses.text: Aheka pamandu' e' si Isa ma sigām, pandu' pamaralilan. <div eID="gen4294" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4295" type="paragraph"/> Yukna, “Aniya' inān dakayu' a'a pehē' ni humana anaboran bigi-tinanom.

verses.name: Matthew 13:4
verses.text: Pagsabodna itu, aniya' bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni bihing lān. Sakali pina'an saga manuk-manuk anittuk iya.

verses.name: Matthew 13:5
verses.text: Aniya' isab bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni kabatuhan, ariki' tana'na. Bigi inān al'kkas patomo' sabab mbal alalom tana'na.

verses.name: Matthew 13:6
verses.text: Sagō' pasilak pa'in llaw, magtūy alūs ugbusna sampay alanos, sabab mbal alalom gamutna.

verses.name: Matthew 13:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab bigi-tinanom apakpak ni t'ngnga' sagmot itingan. Patomo' pa'in sagmot inān, magtūy kasembolan tinanom e'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:8
verses.text: Na, ya bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni tana' ahāp, pasōng-sōng amuwa' du pahāp. Aniya' batang kasehe' amuwan buwa' lumandu'an to'ongan hekana, aniya' kasehe' amuwan buwa' aheka, maka aniya' isab kasehe' sarang-sarang hekana.

verses.name: Matthew 13:9
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “sasuku kam makakale, kalehunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4295" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4293" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1868"/><div sID="gen4296" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angkan si Isa Magparalilan bang Amandu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.10-Mark.4.12">Markus 4:10-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.9-Luke.8.10">Lukas 8:9-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1868"/> Manjari pehē' ni si Isa saga mulidna atilaw iya. Yuk sigām, “Angay ka magparalilan bang ka amandu'an saga a'a itu?”  <div eID="gen4297" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1869"/><div sID="gen4298" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1869"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ka'am ilu kabuwanan kata'u bo' supaya tahatibi pasal kapagparinta Tuhan ma saga a'ana, ya halam bay pata'una ni manusiya' kasehe'. Sagō' saga a'a kasehe'an halam kabuwanan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:12
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai aniya' ta'una, ginanapan gi' kata'una sampay manglabi-labihan. Sagō' sai-sai halam aniya' ta'una kinulangan du min iya bay ta'una dangkuri'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:13
verses.text: Ya na itu sababanna angkan aku magparalilan ma saga a'a itu: <lg sID="gen4299"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4300"/>sabab ang'nda' sigām sagō' mbal maka'nda'.<l eID="gen4300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4301"/>Pakale isab sigām sagō' mbal takale to'ongan maka mbal tahati.<l eID="gen4301" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4299"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:14
verses.text: Na, aniya' katumanan ma bay pinagkallam e' nabi Isaya, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4302"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4303"/>‘Asal akale kam, sagō' mbal tahatibi.<l eID="gen4303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4304"/>Asal papatong kam, sagō' mbal tapanhidbi.<l eID="gen4304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4305"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:15
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' pasobsob ni pikilan saga a'a itu.<l eID="gen4305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4306"/>Tainga sigām bay tinaplokan,<l eID="gen4306" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4307"/>mata sigām bay tinambunan.<l eID="gen4307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4308"/>Bang ngga'i ka buwattē', bay du ta'nda' e' mata sigām,<l eID="gen4308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4309"/>bay du takale e' tainga sigām,<l eID="gen4309" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4310"/>bay du isab tahati sampay ma deyom pikilan sigām,<l eID="gen4310" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4311"/>Ati pabalik sigām magta'at ni aku, bo' kauli'anku.’<l eID="gen4311" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4302"/>  <div eID="gen4298" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1870"/><div sID="gen4312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1870"/> “Sagō' ka'am ilu,” yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “aheya kahāpanbi, sabab ai-ai ta'nda'bi tapanhidbi du, maka ai-ai takalebi tahatibi du.

verses.name: Matthew 13:17
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan, aheka saga nabi maka a'a suku' Tuhan ma masa awal e' bay bilahi to'ongan ang'nda' ma kahālan ya ta'nda'bi ma buwattitu, sagō' halam tasabu e' sigām. Bilahi to'ongan sigām akale ma takalebi itu, sagō' halam ta'abut e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen4312" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4296" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1871"/><div sID="gen4313" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamahati si Isa Pasal Bigi-Tinanom</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.13-Mark.4.20">Markus 4:13-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.11-Luke.8.15">Lukas 8:11-15</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1871"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “pakale kam to'ongan bo' tahatibi paralilan pasal a'a bay magsaboran bigi-tinanom he'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:19
verses.text: Saga bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ma lān inān paralilan a'a bay makakale pasal kapagparinta Tuhan, sagō' halam tahati e' sigām. Jari pina'an ni sigām saitan patila'atun angandagtu' lapal ya bay tinanom e' Tuhan ma deyom atay sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 13:20
verses.text: Saga bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ni tana' kabatuhan, paralilan a'a bay makakale ma palman Tuhan. Magtūy sigām kinōgan anaima' lapal palman e',

verses.name: Matthew 13:21
verses.text: sagō' palman Tuhan e' halam bay anganggamut palalom ma deyom atay sigām. Mbal anatas pagiman sigām. Ta'abut pa'in sigām t'kkahan susa atawa nila'at e' pagkahi sigām ma sabab pameya' sigām ma palman Tuhan, magtūy sigām ang'bba min pagiman sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 13:22
verses.text: Saga bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ni deyom sagmot itingan e' paralilan a'a bang am'nnal ma palman Tuhan. Sagō' bay pa'in am'nnal, magtūy alimbit pikilan sigām e' kahālan deyom dunya itu. Ya na pa'in ahalga' ma sigām pangalta' sigām. Angkanna palman Tuhan, ya bay takale e' sigām, sali' dalil tinanom kasembolan mbal amuwan buwa'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:23
verses.text: Na, saga bigi-tinanom bay sinaboran ma deyom tana' ahāp e', paralilan saga a'a bang am'nnal ma palman Tuhan maka makahati to'ongan. Magtūy palman inān sali' dalil tinanom, amuwan buwa' ma deyom atay sigām. Kasehe' aheka to'ongan buwa'na, kasehe' isab aheka-heka, maka kasehe'an sarang-sarang.”  <div eID="gen4314" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4313" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1872"/><div sID="gen4315" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Sagmot</title> <div sID="gen4316" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1872"/> Manjari magparalilan na isab si Isa pabalik. Yukna, “In kapagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya' sali' dalil a'a anaboran bigi-tinanom ahāp ma tana'na.

verses.name: Matthew 13:25
verses.text: Manjari itu ma waktu sangom, sabu pa'in magtulihan a'a kamemon, aniya' banta tag-huma inān pina'an anaboran bigi-sagmot ma bay panaboran bigi ahāp. Puwas e' ala'an banta he'.

verses.name: Matthew 13:26
verses.text: Na, patomo' pa'in tinanom ahāp inān sampay anagna' na magbuwa', ta'nda' isab kasagmotan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:27
verses.text: Manjari pina'an saga tendog ni a'a tag-huma. Yuk sigām, ‘Tuwan, ahāp bigi-tinanom bay saborannu ma tana'nu. Minningga bahā' kasagmotan itu?’

verses.name: Matthew 13:28
verses.text: Anambung tag-huma, yukna, ‘Aniya' banta bay makahinang e'-i.’ Yuk saga tendog, ‘Bilahi ka bahā' bang kami angandarutan saga sagmot inān?’

verses.name: Matthew 13:29
verses.text: ‘Da'a,’ yukna, ‘sabab bang darutbi sagmot inān, kalu ameya' alarut saga batang ahāp.

verses.name: Matthew 13:30
verses.text: Sagarinbi na magbeya' magtomo' sampay ta'abut waktu pagani. Jari buwattitu du panoho'anku ma saga a'a magani: darutunbi sagmot dahū. P'kkosunbi bo' yampa tinunu'. Puwas e' anihunbi buwa' min bay tinanom ilu bo' tau'unbi ni deyom kamaligku.’ ”  <div eID="gen4316" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4315" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1873"/><div sID="gen4317" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Bigi-Tinanom Sidda Anahut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.30-Mark.4.32">Markus 4:30-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.13.18-Luke.13.19">Lukas 13:18-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1873"/> Puwas e' magparalilan si Isa pabalik. Yukna, “In kapagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya' sali' dalil dansolag bigi-tinanom ariki'-diki', ya tinanom e' a'a ma tana'na.

verses.name: Matthew 13:32
verses.text: Bigi itu anahut min bigi-tinanom kamemon, sagō' bang anomo' na palabi heyana min tinanom kamemon. Tahinang kayu du, ati patapu' pina'an saga manuk-manuk angahinang pugaran ma sangana.”  <div eID="gen4318" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4317" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1874"/><div sID="gen4319" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Pasulig</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.33-Mark.4.34">Markus 4:33-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.13.20-Luke.13.21">Lukas 13:20-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4320" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1874"/> Magparalilan gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ya kapagparinta Tuhan sali' dalil pasulig ya ginuna e' d'nda pinalamud ni tirigu aheka, saga duwampū' maka lima kilu. Puwas e' niaddun e'na, gana-gana anulig kamemonna.”  <div eID="gen4320" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1875"/><div sID="gen4321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1875"/> Kahaba' si Isa magpandu' ma kaheka'an a'a, magparalilan sadja iya. Mbal iya amissala ma sigām bang ngga'i ka min paralilan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:35
verses.text: Minnē' aniya' mattan ma bay tasulat e' dakayu' nabi, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4322"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4323"/>“Bang aku amandu' ma sigām subay bissala pamaralilan.<l eID="gen4323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4324"/>Haka'anku sigām pasal ai-ai ya halam kinata'uwan sangay min tagna' kapamapanjari dunya.”<l eID="gen4324" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4322"/>  <div eID="gen4321" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4319" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1876"/><div sID="gen4325" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinahati e' si Isa Paralilanna Pasal Sagmot</title> <div sID="gen4326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1876"/> Puwas e' ni'bbahan e' si Isa kaheka'an a'a inān bo' pasōd ni deyom luma'. Pina'an ni iya saga mulidna. Yuk sigām, “Pahatiun kono' kami paralilan pasal kasagmotan ma huma inān.”  <div eID="gen4326" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1877"/><div sID="gen4327" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1877"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Aku, Anak Manusiya', dalil a'a anaboran bigi-tinanom ahāp inān.

verses.name: Matthew 13:38
verses.text: Huma inān, ya na dunya itu. Bigi ahāp inān, ya na saga a'a ameya' pinarintahan e' Tuhan. Kasagmotan inān, ya na saga a'a ameya' ma nakura' saitan, ya patila'atun.

verses.name: Matthew 13:39
verses.text: Banta bay anaboran bigi-sagmot inān, ya na nakura' saitan. Ya waktu kapagani, ya na llaw pangiyamat dunya. Ya a'a magani inān, saga mala'ikat.

verses.name: Matthew 13:40
verses.text: Bang takdil ni kasagmotan ya tinimuk inān bo' yampa tinunu', buwattē' du isab pakaradja'anna bang ta'abut na llaw kiyamat.

verses.name: Matthew 13:41
verses.text: Aku Anak Manusiya', soho'ku du saga mala'ikatku pi'itu ni dunya animuk saga a'a dusahan, sasuku bay amowa pagkahina angandusa maka sasuku bay maghinang kala'atan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:42
verses.text: Tatimuk pa'in, nilarukan sigām ni deyom api nalka'. Mahē' sigām magolang, saga magtage'ot empon sigām, sabab min kapagsusun sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 13:43
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a suku' Tuhan anahaya du, pinaluwa ni mata llaw, bang ma deyom pagparintahan Mma' sigām Tuhan. Sasuku kam makakale, kalehunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4327" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4325" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1878"/><div sID="gen4328" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Alta' bay Tinapukan</title> <div sID="gen4329" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1878"/> Magparalilan isab si Isa, yukna, “In kapagparinta Tuhan ma saga a'ana sali' dalil alta' bay tinapukan ma deyom tana'. Sakali aniya' a'a bay makabāk iya. Tabākna pa'in itu, magtūy tambunanna pabalik. Landu' iya kinōgan, angkan iya pehē' amab'llian ai-aina kamemon bo' yampa b'llina tana' ya bay kabākanna alta' he'.”  <div eID="gen4329" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4328" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1879"/><div sID="gen4330" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Mussa'</title> <div sID="gen4331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1879"/> “Buwattitu isab kapagparinta Tuhan,” yuk si Isa. “Sali' dalil palilitu amiha saga mussa' ahāp.

verses.name: Matthew 13:46
verses.text: Bang iya ganta' makapuwa' dakayu' mussa' ahalga' to'ongan, pinab'llihan e'na ai-aina kamemon bo' tab'llina mussa' dakayu' he'.”  <div eID="gen4331" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4330" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1880"/><div sID="gen4332" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Pokot</title> <div sID="gen4333" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1880"/> “Buwattitu isab kapagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya',” yuk si Isa. “Sali' dalil pokot nihūg ni deyom tahik, sinōd daing ginis-ginisan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:48
verses.text: Ap'nno' pa'in pokot e', na ginuyud e' saga a'a magdaraing inān tudju ni daplakan. Aningkō' sigām maina'an bo' pinagsaddī ba'anan daing inān. Ingga ahāp, ni'isi e' sigām ni deyom ambung, ingga mbal tapagguna, tinimanan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:49
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab bang kiyamat na dunya itu. Paluwas saga mala'ikat ati pinagsaddī e' sigām manusiya' ahāp maka ala'at.

verses.name: Matthew 13:50
verses.text: Ya ala'at nilarukan du ni deyom api nalka'. Mahē' sigām magolang, saga magtage'ot empon sigām, sabab min pagsusun sigām.”  <div eID="gen4333" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4332" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1881"/><div sID="gen4334" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pandu' Baha'u maka Pandu' bay Tagna'</title> <div sID="gen4335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1881"/> Tinilaw e' si Isa saga mulidna, yukna, “Tahatibi bahā' kamemon bay pamissalaku ma ka'am e'?” <div eID="gen4335" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4336" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk sambung sigām.  <div eID="gen4336" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1882"/><div sID="gen4337" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1882"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' guru sara' agama kapandu'an pasal kapagparinta Tuhan, sali' iya dalil a'a dayahan taga-luma'. Aheka asal alta'na baha'u maka ndang, hatina pangita'una pasal pandu' tagna' sampay pandu' baha'u.”  <div eID="gen4337" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4334" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1883"/><div sID="gen4338" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sinulak e' saga A'a Nasaret</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.1-Mark.6.6">Markus 6:1-6</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.16-Luke.4.30">Lukas 4:16-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4339" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1883"/> Pagubus pa'in bay magparalilan si Isa, ala'an iya min lahat inān

verses.name: Matthew 13:54
verses.text: bo' amole' ni kauman ya luggiya' lahatna. Anagna' iya amandu'an saga a'a maina'an, ma deyom langgal sigām. Ainu-inu sigām ma pamandu'na, yuk-i, “Oy! Minningga bahā' pangā'anna pangita'una, maka barakat ya pangahinangna saga kahinanganna makainu-inu he'?

verses.name: Matthew 13:55
verses.text: Bang kami mbal asā', ya na itu anak karpentero. Ina'na si Mariyam. Saga danakanna disi Yakub, si Yusup, si Judas maka si Simun.

verses.name: Matthew 13:56
verses.text: Maka saga danakanna d'nda, itiya' du isab ma lūnganta itu. Minningga bahā' pangā'anna ta'una itu?”

verses.name: Matthew 13:57
verses.text: Jari kinap'ddi'an atay si Isa e' saga a'a inān. <div eID="gen4339" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4340" type="paragraph"/> Sakali ah'lling iya ni sigām, yuk-i, “Pinagaddatan asal saga nabi ma sabarang lahat. Luwal saga a'a ma lahatna luggiya' maka sehe'na magdaluma' ya mbal magaddatan iya.”

verses.name: Matthew 13:58
verses.text: Jari salat saga hinang makainu-inu tahinang e' si Isa ma kaumanna inān sabab mbal angandol ma iya saga a'ana.  <div eID="gen4340" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.13"/> <div eID="gen4338" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1884"/><div sID="gen4341" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.14-Mark.6.29">Markus 6:14-29</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.7-Luke.9.9">Lukas 9:7-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4342" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1884"/> Ma waktu he'-i sultan Herod ya bay magbaya' ma lahat Jalil. Manjari itu makakale iya pasal kahinangan si Isa

verses.name: Matthew 14:2
verses.text: ati ah'lling iya ni saga a'ana pangandolan, yukna, “Si Yahiya Magpapandi ko' inān, pinakallum na pabīng min kamatayna. Angkan tahinangna saga hinang makainu-inu inān.”  <div eID="gen4342" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1885"/><div sID="gen4343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1885"/> Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Herod, sabab iya ya bay magpanoho'an amapatay si Yahiya. Buwattitu bay kahālanna, sultan Herod itu bay magkabaya' maka ipalna si Herodiyas, bo' allum lagi' siyalina si Pilip, ya h'lla si Herodiyas e'. Pinabukagan na pa'in si Herod e' si Yahiya, yukna, “Mbal manjari bang ka magtimbul maka h'nda danakannu! Dusahan ka!” Angkanna si Yahiya bay sinō' sinaggaw e' sultan, sinō' niekang-ekangan bo' yampa ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Matthew 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1885"/><div sID="gen4343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1885"/> Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Herod, sabab iya ya bay magpanoho'an amapatay si Yahiya. Buwattitu bay kahālanna, sultan Herod itu bay magkabaya' maka ipalna si Herodiyas, bo' allum lagi' siyalina si Pilip, ya h'lla si Herodiyas e'. Pinabukagan na pa'in si Herod e' si Yahiya, yukna, “Mbal manjari bang ka magtimbul maka h'nda danakannu! Dusahan ka!” Angkanna si Yahiya bay sinō' sinaggaw e' sultan, sinō' niekang-ekangan bo' yampa ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Matthew 14:5
verses.text: Bilahi si Herod amapatay si Yahiya sagō' tināw iya ma kaheka'an a'a, sabab magkahagad sigām in si Yahiya nabi.  <div eID="gen4343" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1886"/><div sID="gen4344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1886"/> Jari magpajamu sultan Herod panabuna ma llaw kapaganak ma iya. Angigal anak si Herodiyas budjang ma pang'nda' saga luruk ati kasulutan sidda si Herod,

verses.name: Matthew 14:7
verses.text: angkan janji'anna budjang inān. Yukna, “Janji'anta ka. Ai-ai amu'nu ni aku pamuwanku to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1887"/><div sID="gen4345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1887"/> Na, in budjang inān bay kapitnahan asal e' ina'na angkan yukna ni sultan, “Buwanin aku kōk si Yahiya Magpapandi, pinat'nna' ma talam.”  <div eID="gen4345" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1888"/><div sID="gen4346" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1888"/> Sidda asusa sultan inān, sagō' mbal kapindahan bay panganjanji'na ma alopan saga luruk e', angkan soho'na subay nirūlan budjang inān ma bay amu'na he'.

verses.name: Matthew 14:10
verses.text: Jari magpanoho'an si Herod subay pinonggolan kōk si Yahiya ma deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Matthew 14:11
verses.text: Puwas e' pinat'nna' kōkna ma talam bo' yampa binowa ni budjang, ati ni'nde'an e'na ni ina'na.

verses.name: Matthew 14:12
verses.text: Sakali pina'an saga mulid si Yahiya angā' mayatna kinubul. Puwas e' pehē' sigām ni si Isa angahaka'an iya.  <div eID="gen4346" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4341" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1889"/><div sID="gen4347" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Limangibu Heka A'a Pinakan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.6.1-John.6.14">Yahiya 6:1-14</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4348" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1889"/> Na, pagkale si Isa ma pasal ina'an-i, ala'an iya minnē' amusay ni lahat halam maga'a, hal iya dangan-danganna. Kinata'uwan pa'in kamahē'anna, magla'anan saga a'a min ba'anan kauman sigām bo' paturul ma iya, amaklay min bihing susulan.

verses.name: Matthew 14:14
verses.text: Pagdeyo' pa'in si Isa min bayananna, ta'nda'na saga a'a inān landu' to'ongan aheka. Sakali t'kkahan iya ase' ma sigām, maka kauli'an e'na sasuku taga-saki.  <div eID="gen4348" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1890"/><div sID="gen4349" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1890"/> Pagka abay kohap na, pehē' ni si Isa saga mulidna. Yuk sigām, “Sōng sangom na, maka itiya' kitam ma lahat l'ngngaw-l'ngngawan. Sō'un lagi' saga a'a itu pehē' ni kaluma'an inān bo' makab'llihan di-sigām kinakan.”  <div eID="gen4349" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1891"/><div sID="gen4350" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1891"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Minsan sigām mbal ala'an minnitu. Ka'am na ya amakan sigām.”  <div eID="gen4350" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1892"/><div sID="gen4351" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1892"/> Yuk saga mulid e', “Lima du tinapay ma kami maka duwa du daing!”  <div eID="gen4351" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1893"/><div sID="gen4352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1893"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “bowahunbi pi'itu.”

verses.name: Matthew 14:19
verses.text: Jari pinatingkō' sigām e'na ma kaparangan. Puwas e' niā' e'na lima tinapay maka duwa daing bo' pahangad ni langit magsukul ni Tuhan. Pinagpōng-pōng e'na tinapay bo' yampa sōnganna ni saga mulidna, ati tinopod-toporan e' sigām saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Matthew 14:20
verses.text: Magkakanan na saga a'a inān kamemon sampay mag'ssohan. Pagubus sigām amangan, tinipun kapin kinakan inān e' saga mulid e' ati ap'nno' sangpū' maka duwa ambung aheya.

verses.name: Matthew 14:21
verses.text: Aniya' saga limangibu a'a bay amangan inān, bang hal l'lla ya ni'itung. Saddī gi' d'nda maka onde'-onde'.  <div eID="gen4352" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4347" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1894"/><div sID="gen4353" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Lum'ngngan ma Kuwit Tahik</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.45-Mark.6.52">Markus 6:45-52</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.6.15-John.6.21">Yahiya 6:15-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1894"/> Puwas e' sinoho' e' si Isa saga mulidna paruwa' ni bayanan. Pinarahū sigām min iya tudju ni dambila' danaw, sabuna amapole' kaheka'an a'a inān.

verses.name: Matthew 14:23
verses.text: Tapapole' pa'in saga a'a he', patukad si Isa dangan-danganna anambahayang ma bīd-bīd. Sangom pa'in lahat, maina'an iya dangan-danganna,

verses.name: Matthew 14:24
verses.text: bo' saga mulidna atā na min bihing. Taluwa' sigām goyak sabab anagga' baliyu.  <div eID="gen4354" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1895"/><div sID="gen4355" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1895"/> Pagdai' llaw pa'in, pehē' na si Isa tudju ni sigām, lum'ngngan min kuwit tahik.

verses.name: Matthew 14:26
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in iya e' saga mulidna lum'ngngan min kuwit tahik, nileya'-leya' sigām. “Umagad ko' ilu,” yuk sigām, maka e' sigām magsilawak kabowa tāw.  <div eID="gen4355" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1896"/><div sID="gen4356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1896"/> Sagō' amissala magtūy si Isa ni sigām. “Paiman kam!” yukna. “Aku ko' itu. Da'a kam tināw.”  <div eID="gen4356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1897"/><div sID="gen4357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1897"/> Sakali ah'lling si Petros, yukna, “Nakura', bang ka'a to'ongan ilu, sō'un aku pi'ilu ni ka'a lum'ngngan min kuwit tahik.”  <div eID="gen4357" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1898"/><div sID="gen4358" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1898"/> “Na, pi'itu na ka,” yuk si Isa. <div eID="gen4358" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4359" type="paragraph"/> Jari pareyo' si Petros min bayanan inān anagna' lum'ngngan min kuwit tahik tudju ni si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 14:30
verses.text: Sagō' pagnanamna ma baliyu inān, sinōd iya tāw ati inut-inut iya pat'nnob. Magtūy iya angalingan, yukna, “Nakura', tabangun aku!”  <div eID="gen4359" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1899"/><div sID="gen4360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1899"/> Magtūy iya niabut e' si Isa bo' binalutan. Yuk si Isa, “Kulang pahāp imannu ilu! Angay aku pagduwa-duwahannu?”  <div eID="gen4360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1900"/><div sID="gen4361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1900"/> Makariyata' pa'in sigā ni bayanan e', pahali na baliyu.

verses.name: Matthew 14:33
verses.text: Pinudji si Isa e' saga mulid kasehe'an inān, yuk-i, “B'nnal, ka'a ilu Anak Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen4361" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4353" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1901"/><div sID="gen4362" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Gennesaret Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.6.53-Mark.6.56">Markus 6:53-56</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4363" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1901"/> Jari itu, makat'kka pa'in sigām ni dambila' danaw, parunggu' sigām ni lahat Gennesaret.

verses.name: Matthew 14:35
verses.text: Takilā si Isa e' saga a'a mahē', ya angkan sigām bay anambukuhan sasuku taga-saki ma jadjahan ina'an-i, sinō' binowa ni si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 14:36
verses.text: Angamu' sigām junjung ni si Isa, bang pa'in dūlanna saga a'a sakihan ang'ntan minsan la'a hal tōng s'mmekna. Manjari sai-sai bay maka'ntanan s'mmek si Isa saru'un-du'un kauli'an sakina.  <div eID="gen4363" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.14"/> <div eID="gen4362" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1902"/><div sID="gen4364" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Usulan bay Pang'bba e' Ka'mbo'-mbo'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.7.1-Mark.7.13">Markus 7:1-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1902"/> Manjari aniya' pina'an ni si Isa saga a'a Parisi maka guru sara' agama bay min da'ira Awrusalam. Atilaw sigām ma iya,

verses.name: Matthew 15:2
verses.text: yuk-i, “Angay saga mulidnu ilu mbal angisbat usulan bay pang'bba e' kamatto'ahantam? Amangan sigām minsan halam bay angose'an tangan sigām pahāp.”  <div eID="gen4365" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1903"/><div sID="gen4366" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1903"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Na, ka'am ilu. Angay langgalbi panoho'an Tuhan ati beya'bi saga usulan bay min kamatto'ahanbi?

verses.name: Matthew 15:4
verses.text: Entomunbi panoho'an Tuhan, ya yukna, ‘Wajib kam magaddatan mma'bi maka ina'bi.’ Maka itu gi', ‘Sai-sai anukna'an mma'na atawa ina'na, a'a inān subay pinapatay.’

verses.name: Matthew 15:5
verses.text: Sagō' bang ma pamandu'bi, bang aniya' a'a ganta' amissala ni matto'ana, yukna: ‘Kaniya'ku itu, arak bay panabangku ka'am sagō' pasuku'ku na ni Tuhan.’

verses.name: Matthew 15:6
verses.text: Minnē' iya apuwas kono' min sara' pasal pagaddat ma kamatto'ahan. Jari tasulakbi dī panoho'an Tuhan pagka pagmatayanbi saga usulan bay pang'bba e' ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi.

verses.name: Matthew 15:7
verses.text: In ka'am ilu hal magbau'-bau' ameya' ma Tuhan, bo' halam. B'nnal asal ya kallam Tuhan bay tasulat e' nabi Isaya,

verses.name: Matthew 15:8
verses.text: yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4368"/>‘Saga a'a itu angahulmat aku maka lapal kabtangan sigām,<l eID="gen4368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4369"/>sagō' alawak deyom atay sigām min aku.<l eID="gen4369" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4370"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:9
verses.text: Ya pagpudji sigām ma aku halam aniya' pūsna,<l eID="gen4370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4371"/>sabab ya pamandu' e' sigām saga panoho'an bay pinahinang e' manusiya'.’ ”<l eID="gen4371" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4367"/>  <div eID="gen4366" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4364" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1904"/><div sID="gen4372" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Makatamak Pangatayan Manusiya'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.7.14-Mark.7.23">Markus 7:14-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1904"/> Puwas e', nilinganan ba'anan a'a inān e' si Isa, sinō' patimuk pabīng ni atagna. Yukna ni sigām, “Pakale kam ma bissalaku. Pahati kam to'ongan.

verses.name: Matthew 15:11
verses.text: Ngga'i ka kinakan pasōd ni deyom bowa' ya makalumu' a'a. Ya makalumu' saga bissala ala'at paluwas min bowa'na.”  <div eID="gen4373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1905"/><div sID="gen4374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1905"/> Sakali pina'an ni si Isa saga mulidna. Yuk sigām, “Kata'uwannu bahā' ap'ddi' atay saga Parisi ma bay bissalanu insini'?”  <div eID="gen4374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1906"/><div sID="gen4375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1906"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Kamemon tinanom ya halam bay tinanom e' Mma'ku ma deyom sulga', nilarut du.

verses.name: Matthew 15:14
verses.text: Da'a kam magsusa pasal sigām. Sigām angamalim, sagō' ibarat sigām a'a buta. Bang buta angambit sehe'na buta, tantu sigām ahūg karuwangan ni deyom lowang.”  <div eID="gen4375" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1907"/><div sID="gen4376" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1907"/> Sakali ah'lling si Petros, yukna, “Pahatiun kami pasal bay pamaralilnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen4376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1908"/><div sID="gen4377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1908"/> Yuk si Isa, “Oy! Sampay ka'am ilu masi a'awam!

verses.name: Matthew 15:17
verses.text: Halam bahā' tahatibi? Bang aniya' kinakan pasōd ni deyom bowa' a'a, pasampay du ni deyom b'ttongna bo' yampa paluwas min baranna.

verses.name: Matthew 15:18
verses.text: Sagō' ya bissala ala'at paluwas min bowa' a'a, bay pino'onan asal min deyom atayna. Ya he' makalumu' iya.

verses.name: Matthew 15:19
verses.text: Sabab deyom atay manusiya' ya paluwasan hona'-hona'na ala'at, ya angkan iya maghinang kala'atan kaginisan, buwat saga amapatay, angaliyu-lakad, angahinang kahina'an d'nda-l'lla, anangkaw, magputing, maka angalimut.

verses.name: Matthew 15:20
verses.text: Kamemon itu makalumu' a'a. Sagō' bang kita amangan ma halam bay angose'an tanganta buwat pamandu' saga Parisi, ngga'i ka he'-i makabuwan kalumu'an.”  <div eID="gen4377" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4372" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:21
