verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1909"/><div sID="gen4378" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangandol Dakayu' D'nda min Lahat Kana'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.7.24-Mark.7.30">Markus 7:24-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4379" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1909"/> Sakali palanjal si Isa minnē' tudju ni jadjahan da'ira Tira maka da'ira Sidun.

verses.name: Matthew 15:22
verses.text: Aniya' d'nda bangsa Kana'an min lahat inān bay pehē' ni si Isa anganjunjung. “O Tuwan,” yukna, “tubu' si Da'ud, ma'ase' ka ma aku. Anakku d'nda sinōd saitan, abinsana' sidda.”  <div eID="gen4379" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1910"/><div sID="gen4380" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1910"/> Sagō' halam makasambung si Isa minsan dakabtang. Jari pasekot saga mulidna amogos iya pasal d'nda inān, yuk-i, “Soho'un iya ala'an! Mbal iya pahali angalinganan kitam!”  <div eID="gen4380" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1911"/><div sID="gen4381" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1911"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bay aku sinō' pi'itu anabang saga a'a bangsa Isra'il sadja, ya sali' dalil bili-bili alungay min labayan.”  <div eID="gen4381" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1912"/><div sID="gen4382" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1912"/> Sagō' takale pa'in lling itu e' d'nda, magtūy iya pasujud ni tongod tape' si Isa. “O Tuwan,” yukna, “tabangun aku.”  <div eID="gen4382" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1913"/><div sID="gen4383" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1913"/> Sinambungan iya e' si Isa pinaralilan, yukna, “Mbal manjari niā' kinakan saga anak lissi bo' nilarukan ni saga ero'.”  <div eID="gen4383" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1914"/><div sID="gen4384" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1914"/> “B'nnal, Tuwan,” yuk d'nda. “Sagō' minsan saga ero' amangan du momok kinakan ya apakpak min lamisahan tag-ipatan ma sigām.”  <div eID="gen4384" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1915"/><div sID="gen4385" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1915"/> Sakali anambung si Isa, yukna, “Arung, ahogot imannu. Nirūlan du bay pangamu'nu ilu.” Manjari ma waktu he'-i saru'un-du'un du kauli'an anakna d'nda he'.  <div eID="gen4385" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4378" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1916"/><div sID="gen4386" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka A'a Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen4387" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1916"/> Puwas e' ala'an si Isa min lahat ina'an, amaklay min bihing danaw Jalil. Jari patukad iya ni bīd-bīd aningkō' mahē'.

verses.name: Matthew 15:30
verses.text: Landu' aheka a'a bay pina'an ni iya amowa saga pengka', saga a'a aku'il, saga buta, saga umaw, sampay ba'anan a'a sasuku taluwa' ginisan saki. Pinat'nna' sigām e' sehe' sigām ma tongod tape' si Isa, ati kauli'an sigām e'na kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:31
verses.text: Ainu-inu to'ongan saga a'a inān, pag'nda' sigām ma a'a bay umaw makapah'lling na, a'a bay aku'il kauli'an na, bay pengka' makal'ngngan na pabontol, bay buta maka'nda' na. Manjari sinanglitan e' sigām Tuhan, ya pagta'atan bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen4387" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4386" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1917"/><div sID="gen4388" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mpat Ngibu A'a Pinakan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.1-Mark.8.10">Markus 8:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4389" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1917"/> Sakali nilinganan e' si Isa saga mulidna bo' yukna, “Ma'ase' aku ma saga a'a itu, sabab kat'lluna llaw itu ya kamaitu sigām ma aku, maka halam na aniya' kinakan sigām. Mbal aku bilahi amapole' sigām ma halam bay amangan dahū, arakala' pinunung sigām ma pal'ngnganan.”  <div eID="gen4389" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1918"/><div sID="gen4390" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1918"/> Tinilaw iya e' saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Maingga bahā' pangā'anta kinakan sarang pamakan ba'anan a'a itu? Itiya' kitam ma lahat halam aniya' kaluma'anna!”  <div eID="gen4390" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1919"/><div sID="gen4391" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1919"/> Yuk si Isa, “Pila heka tinapaybi ilu?” <div eID="gen4391" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4392" type="paragraph"/> “Pitu' tinapay,” yuk sigām, “maka saga daing ariki' mbal aheka.”  <div eID="gen4392" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1920"/><div sID="gen4393" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1920"/> Manjari sinoho' e' si Isa kaheka'an a'a inān magtingkō'an ma tana'.

verses.name: Matthew 15:36
verses.text: Niā' e'na kapitu' tinapay maka saga daing e', bo' yampa magsukul ni Tuhan. Puwas e' pinagpōng-pōng e'na tinapay maka daing-daing e' bo' sōnganna ni saga mulidna. Ati tinopod-toporan saga a'a inān e' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 15:37
verses.text: Magkakanan sigām kamemon sampay mag'ssohan na. Aubus pa'in bay amangan, aniya' pitu' ambung aheya ap'nno' e' kapin kinakan bay tatimuk e' saga mulid e'.

verses.name: Matthew 15:38
verses.text: Saga a'a bay magkakanan inān aniya' saga mpat ngibu bang l'lla sadja ni'itung, saddī d'nda maka onde'-onde'.

verses.name: Matthew 15:39
verses.text: Jari pinapole' saga a'a inān e' si Isa. Pariyata' iya ni bayanan bo' yampa pauntas ni lahat Magadan.  <div eID="gen4393" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.15"/> <div eID="gen4388" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1921"/><div sID="gen4394" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Parisi Mikipa'nda' Paltanda'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.11-Mark.8.13">Markus 8:11-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.12.54-Luke.12.56">Lukas 12:54-56</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4395" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1921"/> Manjari aniya' saga Parisi maka saga Saddusi bay pina'an ni si Isa. Bilahi sigām anulayan iya bo' supaya iya tajallat ma bissalana. Angkanna sigām mikipa'nda' paltanda'an, palsaksi'an in iya b'nnal taga-kapatut min Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 16:2
verses.text: Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am ilu, bang pas'ddop llaw, yukbi, ‘Ā, t'ddo' du salung sabab ilu akeyat bihing langit.’

verses.name: Matthew 16:3
verses.text: Pagsubu-subu isab, yukbi, ‘Ulan llaw itu sabab akeyat bihing langit maka angandom.’ Ata'u kam ang'nda' pandoga ma b'ttong langit, sagō' mbal kapandogahanbi paltanda'an ya ta'nda'bi ma masa itu-i.

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: Saga a'a ma patahunan itu ala'at sidda, maka mbal bilahi magta'at ma Tuhan. Bilahi kam bahā' ang'nda' paltanda'an barakatan? Halam aniya' paltanda'an pina'nda'an ka'am, luwal paltanda'an bay min nabi Yunus ma masa awal e'.” Puwas e' ni'bbahan saga a'a inān e' si Isa, ati ala'an iya minnē'.  <div eID="gen4395" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4394" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1922"/><div sID="gen4396" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' Pasal Pamandu' Parisi maka Saddusi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.14-Mark.8.21">Markus 8:14-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4397" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1922"/> Pagt'kka saga mulid si Isa ni dambila' danaw, halam sigām bay makaentom amowa tinapay palutu' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Kamaya'-maya' kam. Halli'inbi pasulig tinapay min saga Parisi maka min saga Saddusi.”  <div eID="gen4397" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1923"/><div sID="gen4398" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1923"/> Magsuli-suli saga mulidna pasal pah'llingna he', sabab halam tahati e' sigām. Yuk pangannal sigām, “Angkan arai' buwattē' pah'lling si Isa sabab halam kita bay amowa tinapay.”  <div eID="gen4398" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1924"/><div sID="gen4399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1924"/> Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa bang ai ya pinagsuli-suli e' sigām, angkan yukna, “Angay pagsuli-sulibi pasal halam aniya' tinapaybi? Ariki' pahāp pangandolbi ma aku!

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: Halam gi' tahatibi bahā'? Halam taentombi bay waktu kapagpōng-pōngku tinapay lima hekana pamakan saga limangibu a'a he'? Entomunbi bang pila ambung aheya bay pangisihanbi kapin kinakan e'?

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: Maka tinapay pitu' hekana bay pamakan mpat ngibu a'a he'. Pila ambung bay pangisihanbi kapin?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: Daka angay kam mbal makahati. Ngga'i ka tinapay ya bay pagbissalaku he'. Yukku, halli'inbi pasulig tinapay saga Parisi maka Saddusi!”

verses.name: Matthew 16:12
verses.text: Minnē' yampa tahati e' sigām ngga'i ka pasulig pamasulig tinapay ya bay pah'llingna, sagō' pandu' min saga Parisi maka min saga Saddusi. Ya na he' subay nihalli'an pahāp.  <div eID="gen4399" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4396" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1925"/><div sID="gen4400" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Petros Magpasab'nnal Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.27-Mark.8.30">Markus 8:27-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.18-Luke.9.21">Lukas 9:18-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1925"/> Na, palintas disi Isa ni jadjahan lahat ma kasekotan da'ira Kesareya Pilipi. Maina'an pa'in, tinilaw e'na saga mulidna, yukna, “Bang ma pangupama a'a, sai kono' aku Anak Manusiya' itu?”  <div eID="gen4401" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1926"/><div sID="gen4402" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1926"/> Yuk sambung saga mulid e', “Bang ma a'a kasehe'an ka'a kono' si Yahiya Magpapandi. Bang ma a'a kasehe' in ka'a nabi Elija atawa nabi Irimiya. Maka bang ma a'a kasehe' isab dakayu' nabi ka bay ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4402" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1927"/><div sID="gen4403" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1927"/> “Na, bang ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “ai yukbi? Sai sa aku itu?”  <div eID="gen4403" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1928"/><div sID="gen4404" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1928"/> Anambung si Simun Petros. “Ka'a Al-Masi,” yukna, “Anak Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama.”  <div eID="gen4404" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1929"/><div sID="gen4405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1929"/> “Aheya kahāpan ma ka'a, Simun anak si Jona,” yuk si Isa, “sabab ngga'i ka min manusiya' ya angkan kata'uwannu ilu-i. Bay pamata'u ka'a e' Mma'ku ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 16:18
verses.text: Na, ya na itu pangahakaku ma ka'a: ka'a si Petros, hatina batu. Ati ma diyata' batu lakit ilu pangahinanganku langgalku, hatina saga jama'aku kamemon. Mbal sigām tara'ug minsan amatay.

verses.name: Matthew 16:19
verses.text: Buwananta ka kunsi', hatina kapatut angukab pasōran manusiya' tudju ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan. Ai-ai lāngnu ma deyom dunya itu nilāng du isab ma deyom sulga', maka ai-ai pamarūlnu ma deyom dunya itu pinarūl du isab ma deyom sulga'.”

verses.name: Matthew 16:20
verses.text: Puwas e' binanda'an e' si Isa saga mulidna, da'a sinō' angahaka ni sai-sai in iya Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen4405" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4400" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1930"/><div sID="gen4406" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala si Isa Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.8.31-Mark.9.1">Markus 8:31-9:1</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.22-Luke.9.27">Lukas 9:22-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1930"/> Manjari puwas minnē', anagna' si Isa amahatian saga mulidna pasal ai tum'kka ni iya ma sinosōng. Yukna, “Subay aku pehē' ni da'ira Awrusalam. Aheka du kabinasahan pinat'kka ni aku e' saga pagmatto'ahan, e' saga kaimaman alanga, maka e' saga guru sara' agama. Pinapatay du aku, sagō' bang palabay na t'llumbahangi pinakallum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4407" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1931"/><div sID="gen4408" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1931"/> Sakali si Petros bay amowa si Isa paokat min kasehe'an, bo' yampa pabukaganna, yuk-i, “S'lle' bale puhu', pinatā e' Tuhan ya yuknu he' bo' mbal makani-ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4408" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1932"/><div sID="gen4409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1932"/> Sagō' nialop si Petros e' si Isa. Yukna, “Ala'an ka min aku, saitan! Kabimbangan aku e'nu. Ya pamikilnu ilu pikilan manusiya' ko', ngga'i ka pikilan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1933"/><div sID="gen4410" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1933"/> Puwas e' amissala si Isa ni saga mulidna. “Bang aniya' bilahi ameya' ma aku,” yukna, “subay ngga'i ka kabaya'an baranna ya dūlanna. Subay tinanggung e'na hāgna pamapatayan iya, hatina kabinasahan ma sababku. Minnē' iya makajari ameya' ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 16:25
verses.text: Sai-sai allogan kallum baranna, amutawan du kallum-nyawana min Tuhan. Sagō' sai-sai mbal allogan ma kallum-baranna, lilla' isab amatay ma sababku, makabāk du iya kallum kakkal.

verses.name: Matthew 16:26
verses.text: Sababna,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' a'a ganta' kaniya'an alta' deyom dunya kamemon, aheya lugi'na bang halam aniya' kallumna kakkal. Sabab halam aniya' tapangal'kkatna kallum-nyawana bang amutawan na.

verses.name: Matthew 16:27
verses.text: Aku Anak Manusiya' pabīng du pi'itu, aliput e' sahaya Mma'ku, maka sinehe'an aku e' saga mala'ikatna. Tungbasanku manusiya' kamemon, pinapagtongod maka bay hinang sigām dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Matthew 16:28
verses.text: B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am, aniya' maitu ma ka'am mbal amatay sat'ggol halam gi' pi'itu in Anak Manusiya' bo' magparinta ma deyom dunya. Subay na aku ta'nda' e' sigām bo' yampa sigām amatay.”  <div eID="gen4410" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.16"/> <div eID="gen4406" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1934"/><div sID="gen4411" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapinda Pangluwahan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.2-Mark.9.13">Markus 9:2-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.28-Luke.9.36">Lukas 9:28-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4412" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1934"/> Palabay pa'in nnom llaw min waktu he'-i, binowa e' si Isa si Petros maka duwangan magdanakan, ya si Yakub maka si Yahiya, patukad ni diyata' būd alanga, sigām-sigām sadja.

verses.name: Matthew 17:2
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in sigām, apinda luwa si Isa ma pang'nda' sigām. Asahaya pamaihu'anna buwat mata llaw. Makasilaw sidda pote' s'mmekna.

verses.name: Matthew 17:3
verses.text: Sakali panyata' pina'an si Musa maka si Elija<note>Si Elija itu dakayu' nabi bay ma waktu awal.</note>, ta'nda' e' saga mulid inān magsuli-suli maka si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 17:4
verses.text: Ah'lling si Petros ni si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan Panghū', ahāp to'ongan itiya' kami maitu. Bilahi ka bahā' bang aku angahinang t'llu panggung-panggung pasindunganbi maitu, dakayu' ma ka'a, dakayu' ma si Musa itu, maka dakayu' ma si Elija?”  <div eID="gen4412" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1935"/><div sID="gen4413" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1935"/> Sabu pa'in iya ah'lling, aniya' gabun asahaya bay angalandungan sigām, maka aniya' suwala ah'lling min deyomna. Yuk suwala he', “Anakku ko' itu kalasahanku. Landu' aku kasulutan ma iya. Iya ya kalehunbi.”  <div eID="gen4413" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1936"/><div sID="gen4414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1936"/> Pagkale pa'in suwala itu e' saga mulid inān, landu' to'ongan sigām tināw angkan kum'ppang magtūy sigām ni tana'.

verses.name: Matthew 17:7
verses.text: Sagō' pina'an si Isa ni sigām amat'ppak tanganna ma sigām. Yukna, “Pabungkal kam, da'a kam tināw.”

verses.name: Matthew 17:8
verses.text: Pagtongas sigām, halam aniya' saddī ta'nda' e' sigām, luwal si Isa.  <div eID="gen4414" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1937"/><div sID="gen4415" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1937"/> Manjari itu, sabu pa'in sigām palūd min būd e', binanda'an e' si Isa saga mulidna, yukna, “Da'a kam angahaka ni sai-sai pasal bay ta'nda'bi mahē' ma diyata' būd e'. Subay na aku, Anak Manusiya' itu, tapakallum pabīng min kamatayku bo' yampa kam angahaka.”  <div eID="gen4415" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1938"/><div sID="gen4416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1938"/> Sakali tinilaw si Isa e' sigām, yuk-i, “Angay saga guru sara' agama magpina'in in si Elija subay dahū palahil pi'itu?”  <div eID="gen4416" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1939"/><div sID="gen4417" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1939"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “B'nnal ko' ilu, si Elija palahil dahū min Al-Masi anakapan kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: Sagō' haka'anta kam, bay na palahil si Elija pi'itu ati halam iya bay takilā e' saga manusiya'. Bay tahinang e' sigām ma iya ai-ai kabaya'an sigām. Damikiyanna aku, Anak Manusiya', bininasa du isab e' sigām.”

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: Minnē' tahati e' saga mulidna si Yahiya Magpapandi iya pinagbissala e' si Isa.  <div eID="gen4417" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4411" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1940"/><div sID="gen4418" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Kapala'anan Saitan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.14-Mark.9.29">Markus 9:14-29</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.37-Luke.9.43">Lukas 9:37-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1940"/> Na, makabīng pa'in disi Isa ni kaheka'an a'a he', aniya' dakayu' a'a pina'an ni iya angōk-tu'ut.

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: Yukna ni si Isa, “Tuwan, ma'ase' pa'in ka ma anakku l'lla. Binawi-bawi iya, landu' iya abinasa. Araran iya pahantak ni api atawa ni bohe'.

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: Bay bowaku iya ni saga mulidnu sagō' mbal iya kauli'an e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen4419" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1941"/><div sID="gen4420" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1941"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am saga a'a ma tahun itu-i, asā' landu' pikilanbi! Halam to'ongan aniya' imanbi! Subay buwattingga gi' t'ggolku ma ka'am anandalan kabuwattilubi bo' yampa kam magkahagad? Bowahun pi'itu onde' ilu,” yukna.

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: Tabowa pa'in onde' inān ni si Isa, magtūy pabukaganna saitan. Pinaluwas e'na min baran onde' ati saru'un-du'un du pahali sakina.  <div eID="gen4420" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1942"/><div sID="gen4421" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1942"/> Puwas e' tinilaw si Isa e' saga mulidna, sigām-sigām sadja. Yuk sigām, “Angay kami bay mbal makapaluwas saitan e'?”  <div eID="gen4421" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1943"/><div sID="gen4422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1943"/> Yuk si Isa, “Sabab akulang pangandolbi ma Tuhan. Haka'anta kam to'ongan, abila bay makasali' heya pangandolbi ni buwat heya bigi-tinanom anahut, tahinangbi du kamemon minsan buwattingga hunitna. Bang saupama soho'bi būd itu papinda minnitu pina'an, papinda du. [

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: Sagō' in ginis saitan ina'an-i mbal tapaluwas, luwal bang kam angamu'-ngamu' maka amuwasa dahū.]”  <div eID="gen4422" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4418" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1944"/><div sID="gen4423" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amissala Pabīng Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.30-Mark.9.32">Markus 9:30-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.43-Luke.9.45">Lukas 9:43-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1944"/> Aniya' dakayu' waktu magtimuk saga mulid ma lahat Jalil. Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Aku itu, Anak Manusiya', arai' na sinōngan ni pagbaya'an saga a'a,

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: ati pinapatay aku e' sigām. Sagō' t'llumbahangi puwas min kamatayku allum du aku pabīng.” Minnē' asusa to'ongan saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen4424" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4423" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1945"/><div sID="gen4425" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sukay Langgal Binayaran e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen4426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1945"/> Pagt'kka si Isa maka saga mulidna ni da'ira Kapirnaum, aniya' pina'an ni si Petros saga a'a angā' sukay langgal. Yuk sigām ni iya, “Gurubi ilu, amayad sukay langgal bahā'?”  <div eID="gen4426" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1946"/><div sID="gen4427" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1946"/> “Aho',” yuk sambung si Petros. <div eID="gen4427" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4428" type="paragraph"/> Makasōd pa'in si Petros ni deyom luma' arak angahaka, makarahū si Isa ah'lling ni iya, yukna, “Simun, bang ma ka'a, sai niā'an sukay e' saga sultan ma babaw dunya itu? Anak-kampungna ka, atawa a'a saddī?”  <div eID="gen4428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1947"/><div sID="gen4429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1947"/> “A'a saddī,” yuk si Petros. <div eID="gen4429" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4430" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “bang buwattilu, hatina in kitam panganak Tuhan itu mbal wajib magsukay.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: Sagō' mbal kitam bilahi kinap'ddi'an atay e' saga a'a inān, angkan ka subay pehē' ni bihing danaw inān amuwang. Pagtinduk daing, hella'un magtūy. Makabāk du ka sīn ma deyom bowa'na, sarang pamayadta sukay langgal. Ngā'un sīn inān bo' pamayarun pehē'.”  <div eID="gen4430" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.17"/> <div eID="gen4425" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1948"/><div sID="gen4431" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sai ya Katapusan Alanga?</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.33-Mark.9.37">Markus 9:33-37</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.46-Luke.9.48">Lukas 9:46-48</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4432" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1948"/> Ma waktu he'-i du, pina'an ni si Isa saga mulidna atilaw iya, yuk sigām, “Sai alanga katapusan ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan?”  <div eID="gen4432" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1949"/><div sID="gen4433" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1949"/> Sakali nilinganan e' si Isa dakayu' onde'-onde', sinō' an'ngge ma dahuwan sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sai-sai mbal apinda palantarana ni buwat palantara onde'-onde' itu, mbal to'ongan pinasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: Sai-sai amareyo' atayna, pinasali' ni buwat atay onde'-onde' itu, ya na katapusan alanga ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5
verses.text: Sai-sai isab anaima' dakayu' onde'-onde' buwattitu ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutanna, sali' aku baranku ya tinaima' e'na.”  <div eID="gen4433" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4431" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1950"/><div sID="gen4434" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Amowa Pagkahina Magdusa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.42-Mark.9.48">Markus 9:42-48</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.17.1-Luke.17.2">Lukas 17:1-2</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4435" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1950"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Bang aniya' a'a makaparusa ma dakayu' onde'-onde' buwattitu ya taga-pangandol ma aku, ahāp lagi' kadal a'a inān bang pa'in iya pinagantungan batu abuhat ma k'llongna bo' nihūg ni timbang.  <div eID="gen4435" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1951"/><div sID="gen4436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1951"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' to'ongan saga manusiya' itu, sabab aniya' na pa'in sasat makaparusa ma sigām. Tantu paniya' saga sasat-manasat, sagō' maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ma sasuku anasat sehe'na amowa magdusa.

verses.name: Matthew 18:8
verses.text: Bang tanganbi atawa tape'bi ganta' amowa ka'am magdusa, subay paggatunbi. Gom na pa'in pukulinbi bo' tinimanan. Ahāp lagi' kam allum ma deyom sulga' ma apukul dambila' tanganbi atawa tape'bi, bang pa'in kam da'a nilarukan ni deyom api nalka' ya mbal kap'ddahan ma ajukup tape'-tanganbi.

verses.name: Matthew 18:9
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab bang matabi ganta' amowa ka'am magdusa, gom lagi' lugitunbi bo' tinimanan. Ahāp lagi' kam allum ma deyom sulga' ma abuta dambila' matabi, bang pa'in kam da'a nilarukan ni deyom api nalka' ma ajukup matabi karuwambila'.”  <div eID="gen4436" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4434" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1952"/><div sID="gen4437" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bili-bili Alungay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.15.3-Luke.15.7">Lukas 15:3-7</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4438" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1952"/> “Kamaya'-maya' kam. Da'a palehomunbi saga kamanahutan itu. Sabab haka'anta kam, ina'an anunggu'an sigām saga mala'ikat ya paharap na pa'in ni Mma'ku Tuhan ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 18:11
verses.text: (In aku, Anak Manusiya', bay pi'itu ni dunya angalappas saga a'a ya alawak min Tuhan.)  <div eID="gen4438" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1953"/><div sID="gen4439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1953"/> “Bistahunbi: bang saupama aniya' a'a taga-bili-bili dahatus hekana, bo' wa'i pasiha' dakayu', ai bahā' hinangna? Tantu pasagaranna siyampū' maka siyam mahē' ma kabīd-bīran bo' iya pasa'ut pehē' amiha dakayu' bay pasiha' he'.

verses.name: Matthew 18:13
verses.text: Jari bang tabākna na, haka'anta kam, kinōgan iya to'ongan. Palabi lagi' kakōganna ma bili-bili dakayu' inān min siyampū' maka siyam ya halam bay alungay.

verses.name: Matthew 18:14
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab Mma'bi ma deyom sulga', mbal iya bilahi aniya' alungay dakayu' onde'-onde' min okomanna.”  <div eID="gen4439" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4437" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1954"/><div sID="gen4440" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bang A'a Makarusa ma Pagkahina</title> <div sID="gen4441" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1954"/> “Na, bang aniya' pagkahinu ganta' makarusa ma ka'a, pehē' ka ni iya ati haka'in iya pasal kasā'anna. Sagō' subay hal ka'am duwangan magbissala. Bang ka kinale e'na, bo' kabaya'anna maghāp maka ka'a, pahogot gom pa'in kapagbagaybi.

verses.name: Matthew 18:16
verses.text: Sagō' bang hati mbal akuhanna dusana, bowahun dakayu' atawa duwa a'a saddī anaksi'an ai-ai pagbissalahanbi, bo' supaya tabeya' panoho'an bay ma Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Bang aniya' palkala'bi subay aniya' duwangan atawa t'llungan amuwan saksi' bo' supaya pinagsab'nnal.’

verses.name: Matthew 18:17
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a inān agagga angasip ma saga a'a saddī ya bowanu inān, na, haka'in saga sehe'bi dajama'ahan kamemon. Jari bang iya mbal bilahi akale ma kagara'an saga jama'a kamemon, a'a inān subay niniyat e'bi sali' a'a halam aniya' tuhanna, atawa a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta.”  <div eID="gen4441" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4440" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1955"/><div sID="gen4442" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangalāngan maka Pamarūl</title> <div sID="gen4443" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1955"/> “Haka'anta kam to'ongan, ai-ai lāngbi ma deyom dunya itu nilāng du isab ma deyom sulga', maka ai-ai parūlbi ma deyom dunya itu pinarūl du isab ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 18:19
verses.text: Aniya' isab pangahakaku ma ka'am, bang duwangan kam ma dunya itu maguyun angamu'-ngamu' ai-ai, tantu kam nirūlan e' Mma'ku ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 18:20
verses.text: Sababna bang aniya' duwangan atawa t'llungan a'a magtimuk pagka ōnku ya pamanyabutan sigām, ina'an du aku ma deyoman sigām.”  <div eID="gen4443" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4442" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1956"/><div sID="gen4444" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Mbal Angampun Sehe'na</title> <div sID="gen4445" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1956"/> Puwas ina'an pehē' si Petros ni si Isa atilaw. “Tuwan Panghū',” yukna, “min pila subay ampunku pagkahiku bang iya makarusa ma aku? Min pitu' bahā'?”  <div eID="gen4445" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1957"/><div sID="gen4446" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1957"/> Yuk si Isa, “Ngga'i ka hal min pitu', sagō' min pitumpū' maka pitu'.”

verses.name: Matthew 18:23
verses.text: Jari magparalilan si Isa, yukna, “In kapagparinta Tuhan sali' dalil dakayu' sultan ya bilahi amista palutangan saga tendogna.

verses.name: Matthew 18:24
verses.text: Sakali itu, hinabuna magbista utang, aniya' binowa ni iya dakayu' tendogna taga-utang laksa'an pilak.

verses.name: Matthew 18:25
verses.text: Jari in sīn ma tendog inān mbal makabayaran utangna, angkan magpanoho'an sultan in a'a inān sampay anak-h'ndana subay pinab'llihan nihinang ata. Subay pinab'llihan isab ai-aina kamemon pamayad utangna.

verses.name: Matthew 18:26
verses.text: Na, angōk-tu'ut magtūy tendog itu ma alopan sultan angamu' junjung ni iya. ‘O tuwan,’ yukna, ‘patangguhun gi' aku. Bayaranku du utangku kamemon.’

verses.name: Matthew 18:27
verses.text: Manjari ma'ase' sultan inān ma tendogna. Pinahalam na utangna ati pinapole' iya.  <div eID="gen4446" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1958"/><div sID="gen4447" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1958"/> “Na, pagluwas tendog inān min alopan sultan, aniya' talanggalna pagkahina, tendog sultan isab. In tendog damuli itu taga-utang dangkuri' ma tendog tagna'. Magtūy iya niragtu' maka pin'kkol e' tendog tagna'. Yukna, ‘Bayarin na utangnu ma aku.’

verses.name: Matthew 18:29
verses.text: Magtūy angōk-tu'ut tendog damuli itu anganjunjung, yukna, ‘Patangguhun gi' aku. Bayaranta du ka.’

verses.name: Matthew 18:30
verses.text: Sagō' mbal pinatanggu, gom pa'in ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu sat'ggol mbal makapuwasan utangna kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 18:31
verses.text: Pag'nda' pa'in e' saga tendog kasehe'an ma kahinangan tendog tagna' inān, magtūy sigām landu' asukkal, ati pehē' ni sultan angahaka pasal pakaradja'an inān.  <div eID="gen4447" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1959"/><div sID="gen4448" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1959"/> “Jari pinalinganan e' sultan tendog bay aheka utangna he'. ‘Jahulaka' pahāp ka ilu!’ yukna. ‘Bay pahalamku utangnu kamemon ma sabab panganjunjungnu ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 18:33
verses.text: Arapun ka'ase'annu pagkahinu he', buwat bay ka'ase'ku ma ka'a!’

verses.name: Matthew 18:34
verses.text: Jari sidda angastol sultan inān ma iya, angkan soho'na tendog e' ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu sampay tiniksa' sat'ggol halam gi' kabayaranna utangna.”  <div eID="gen4448" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1960"/><div sID="gen4449" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1960"/> Yuk si Isa, “Buwattē' du isab nihinang e' Mma'ku ma sulga' ma ka'am dangan maka dangan, bang mbal ampunbi pagkahibi min deyom ataybi.”  <div eID="gen4449" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.18"/> <div eID="gen4444" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1961"/><div sID="gen4450" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagtiman A'a Maglakibini</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.1-Mark.10.12">Markus 10:1-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4451" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1961"/> Aubus pa'in pamissala si Isa buwattē', ala'an iya min lahat Jalil tudju ni lahat Yahudiya, ni jadjahan ma liyu sapa' Jordan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:2
verses.text: Aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay ameya' ma iya, ati kauli'an e'na saga saki sigām maina'an.  <div eID="gen4451" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1962"/><div sID="gen4452" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1962"/> Sakali aniya' pina'an saga Parisi anulayan iya bo' supaya iya tajallat ma bissalana. Yuk sigām ma iya, “Bang ma sara'tam, makajari bahā' bang l'lla animanan h'ndana, minsan ai sababanna?”  <div eID="gen4452" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1963"/><div sID="gen4453" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1963"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Kilāku halam bay tabassabi ya tasulat ma Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Ma tagna' pamapanjari Tuhan ma manusiya', bay sigām pinapanjari e'na l'lla maka d'nda?’

verses.name: Matthew 19:5
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan e', ‘Angkanna l'lla ang'bba min ina'-mma'na bo' parakayu' ni h'ndana. Manjari in bay duwa baran, dabaran na.’

verses.name: Matthew 19:6
verses.text: Ngga'i ka na sigā duwa baran,” yuk si Isa, “sagō' dabaran na sigā karuwangan. Angkan subay mbal pinapagbutas e' manusiya' ya bay pinapagdakayu' e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4453" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1964"/><div sID="gen4454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1964"/> Atilaw saga Parisi ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Na angay bahā'? Bang ma pandu' si Musa, makajari l'lla animanan h'ndana bang pa'in aniya' sulatna pagpasahan.”  <div eID="gen4454" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1965"/><div sID="gen4455" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1965"/> Ya sambung si Isa, “Ya angkan kam pinarūl e' si Musa animanan h'ndabi, sabab agagga kam pinandu'an. Saguwā' ngga'i ka buwattē' bay ma waktu tagna'.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, sai-sai animanan h'ndana ma halam bay angaliyu-lakad min iya, ati magh'nda iya saddī, taga-dusa iya angaliyu-lakad min h'ndana po'on.”  <div eID="gen4455" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1966"/><div sID="gen4456" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1966"/> Yuk saga mulid si Isa ma iya, “Bang buwattē' kahālanna ma a'a maglakibini, ahāp lagi' subay mbal magpūn.”  <div eID="gen4456" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1967"/><div sID="gen4457" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1967"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Pandu' ilu mbal kabogbogan e' manusiya' kamemon, luwal sigām ya kabuwanan kosog e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: Magginis isab pagsababan ya angkan l'lla mbal magh'nda. Aniya' a'a mbal makapagh'nda sabab aniya' salla' ma baranna. Aniya' mbal makapagh'nda sabab kinabili e' a'a, maka aniya' isab magniyat subay mbal magh'nda ma sabab pagparinta Tuhan ya pagmatayanna. Sai-sai makataima' pandu' itu, subay anaima' to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4457" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4450" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1968"/><div sID="gen4458" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalasa si Isa ma Kamanahutan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.13-Mark.10.16">Markus 10:13-16</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.15-Luke.8.17">Lukas 18:15-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4459" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1968"/> Na, aniya' saga a'a bay amowa saga anak sigām ni si Isa bo' supaya pinat'nna'an tanganna maka niamu'an kahāpan min Tuhan. Sagō' bay pinabukagan saga a'a amowa inān e' kamuliran si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: Ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Parūlunbi pi'itu ni aku saga kamanahutan itu. Da'a lāngunbi. Sabab sai-sai makasali' kaul-pi'ilna ni buwat kamanahutan ilu, taga-palsuku'an du ma pagparintahan Tuhan.”

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: Jari pinat'nna' e' si Isa tanganna ni saga onde' inān, bo' yampa ala'an minnē'.  <div eID="gen4459" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4458" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1969"/><div sID="gen4460" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Taga-Karaya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.17-Mark.10.31">Markus 10:17-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.18-Luke.18.30">Lukas 18:18-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1969"/> Manjari itu aniya' dakayu' a'a pehē' ni si Isa. Yukna, “Tuwan Guru, kahāpan ai subay hinangku bo' supaya aku kaniya'an kallum taptap ni kasaumulan?”  <div eID="gen4461" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1970"/><div sID="gen4462" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1970"/> Yuk si Isa, “Angay aku tilawnu pasal kahāpan? Tunggal du Tuhan ahāp. Bang ka bilahi pinasuku'an kallum taptap, subay bogbogannu panoho'an Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4462" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1971"/><div sID="gen4463" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1971"/> Atilaw gi' l'lla, yukna, “Panoho'an ingga?” <div eID="gen4463" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4464" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Isa, “Da'a ka amapatay a'a. Da'a ka angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'nu. Da'a ka anangkaw. Da'a ka anaksi' puting.

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: Pagaddatin ina'-mma'nu. Maka kalasahin pagkahinu manusiya' buwat e'nu alasahan barannu.”  <div eID="gen4464" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1972"/><div sID="gen4465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1972"/> Yuk l'lla inān, “Ā, bay na kabogboganku ina'an-i kamemon. Ai gi' subay hinangku?”  <div eID="gen4465" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1973"/><div sID="gen4466" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1973"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Bang ka bilahi tubus kahāp addat-tabi'atnu, pehē' ka, pab'llihin alta'nu kamemon bo' pamuwanun b'llihanna ma saga a'a miskin. Manjari aniya' du karayanu ma deyom sulga'. Puwas e' pi'itu ka ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: Pagkale a'a inān ma bissala si Isa, magtūy iya ala'an, maka e'na asusa sabab landu' aheka alta'na.  <div eID="gen4466" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1974"/><div sID="gen4467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1974"/> Sakali ah'lling si Isa ni saga mulidna, yukna, “Haka'anta kam to'ongan, in a'a dayahan kahunitan pasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:24
verses.text: Aho', haka'anta kam, kaluhayan gi' unta' palabay min buli' jalum min a'a dayahan pasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4467" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1975"/><div sID="gen4468" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1975"/> Ainu-inu to'ongan saga mulid pagkale sigām ma bissala si Isa itu. “Bang buwattē',” yuk sigām, “sai bahā' makasampay ni kasalamatan ma deyom sulga'?”  <div eID="gen4468" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1976"/><div sID="gen4469" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1976"/> Pinandang e' si Isa saga mulidna he' maka e'na anambung. Yukna, “Bang manusiya' mbal to'ongan makarapat. Sagō' halam aniya' ahunit ma Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4469" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1977"/><div sID="gen4470" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1977"/> Anambung lagi' si Petros, “Nda'un ba kami itu,” yukna. “Bay bbahan kami ai-ai kami kamemon bo' ameya' ma ka'a. Ai bahā' panungbas kami?”  <div eID="gen4470" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1978"/><div sID="gen4471" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1978"/> Yuk si Isa, “Haka'anta kam to'ongan: in aku Anak Manusiya', bang ta'abut na waktu kapaningkō'ku ma deyom kasahaya'an, magagi du aku ma dunya baha'u. Ya du ka'am saga bebeya'anku, pinatingkō' du isab ma tingkō'an sangpū' maka duwa hekana, ati nihukum e'bi saga bangsa panubu' si Isra'il kasangpū' maka duwa.

verses.name: Matthew 19:29
verses.text: Sasuku bay ang'bbahan luma'na atawa danakanna, atawa ina'-mma'na, atawa panganakna, atawa tana'na, ma sabab katuyu'na ma aku, tinungbasan du iya paheka e' Tuhan, lipat manglipat min bay bbahanna. Maka kaniya'an du iya kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:30
verses.text: Sagō' aheka a'a makarahū buwattina'an, pinaramuli ma waktu sinōng. Aheka isab taramuli ma buwattina'an, pinarahū ma waktu sinōng.”  <div eID="gen4471" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.19"/> <div eID="gen4460" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1979"/><div sID="gen4472" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal A'a Maghinang ma Kabbun</title> <div sID="gen4473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1979"/> Magparalilan si Isa, yukna, “In kapagparinta Tuhan sali' dalil a'a tag-dapu kabbun pananoman bahan anggul. Dai' llaw pa'in, pal'ngngan tag-dapu angā' a'a maghinang ma kabbunna.

verses.name: Matthew 20:2
verses.text: Tinambahan kono' sigām dakayu' denari, ya panamba dangan a'a ma dang'llaw. Magsulut pa'in, sinō' sigām pehē' maghinang ma kabbunna.  <div eID="gen4473" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1980"/><div sID="gen4474" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1980"/> “Na, ta'abut pa'in lisag siyam subu, pehē' tag-dapu ni pagtabu'an, ati aniya' ta'nda'na maina'an saga a'a hal an'ngge-n'ngge.

verses.name: Matthew 20:4
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, ‘Pehē' kam isab maghinang ma kabbunku. Tambahanku du kam pila-pila ya katongoranbi.’

verses.name: Matthew 20:5
verses.text: Na, pehē' na sigām. Augtu pa'in llaw, pehē' na isab tag-dapu amiha a'a kasehe' maghinang ma kabbunna. Buwattē' du isab paglisag t'llu kohap.

verses.name: Matthew 20:6
verses.text: Jari itu, song pa'in lisag lima kohap, pabīng iya ni pagtabu'an, ati aniya' ta'nda'na saga a'a hal an'ngge-n'ngge maina'an. Yukna ma sigām, ‘Angay animpus llaw mbal kam maghinang?’  <div eID="gen4474" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1981"/><div sID="gen4475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1981"/> “Yuk sambung sigām, ‘Tu'ud halam aniya' anoho' kami maghinang’. ‘Na,’ yuk tag-dapu, ‘pehē' kam maghinang ma kabbunku’.  <div eID="gen4475" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1982"/><div sID="gen4476" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1982"/> “Manjari itu, pagabay kohap na, amissala tag-dapu ni mandul pangandolanna, yukna, ‘Linganin saga maghihinang ilu bo' tambahin. Tambahin dahū saga a'a bay ta'ā'ku damuli ilu, bo' yampa sigām ya bay ta'ā'ku dahū.’

verses.name: Matthew 20:9
verses.text: Jari ya panamba saga a'a ya bay anagna' maghinang lisag lima kohap, magtongod maka hinang dang'llaw, minsan dai'-dai' du ya kapangahinang sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 20:10
verses.text: Na, ta'abut pa'in tinambahan saga a'a ya bay ta'ā' waktu subu lagi', aholat sigām tinambahan aheya. Sagō' sali' du tambahan ya tasambut sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 20:11
verses.text: Pagsambut pa'in, pinagmusmuran e' sigām tag-dapu.

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: Yuk sigām, ‘Angay itu? Saga a'a bay ngā'nu damuli, danjām du bay pangahinang sigām. Bo' kami itu bay animpus min subu-subu sampay ni kakohapan, maghulas-sangsā' ma kapasu'an llaw! Sagō', papagsali'nu tambahan sigām maka tambahan kami.’

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: Yuk tag-dapu kabbun ni dangan inān, ‘Bagay, halam ka bay akkalanku. Ya kapagsulutanta tambahan pinapagtongod maka hinang dang'llaw.

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: Na, ngā'un na tambahannu itu bo' ka amole'. Tu'ud kabaya'anku pinapagsali' tambahan a'a bay ta'ā'ku damuli maka bay panambaku ka'a.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: Angay, halam bahā' aniya' kapatutku magbaya' ma sīnku? Angimbū ka bahā' pagga pagmuraku sīnku?’ ”  <div eID="gen4476" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1983"/><div sID="gen4477" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1983"/> Yuk si Isa isāb, “Sai-sai taramuli ma buwattina'an, pinarahū ma sinosōng. Maka sai-sai makarahū ma buwattina'an, pinaramuli ma waktu sinōng.”  <div eID="gen4477" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4472" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1984"/><div sID="gen4478" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amissala si Isa Pabīng Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.32-Mark.10.34">Markus 10:32-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.31-Luke.18.34">Lukas 18:31-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4479" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1984"/> Na, patukad disi Isa tudju ni da'ira Awrusalam. Jari ma labayan pa'in, binowa e' si Isa mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa pasaddī min a'a kasehe'an bo' yampa sigām bissalahanna.

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: Yukna, “Pakale kam. Itiya' kitam patukad ni Awrusalam. Mahē' pa'in, in aku Anak Manusiya' sinōngan du ni pang'ntanan kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Pinat'kkahan aku e' sigām hukuman ni kamatay.

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: Puwas e' ni'nde'an du aku ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, ati pinagudju'-udju' aku e' sigām. Pinagdaplosan du aku bo' yampa nilansang ni hāg pinapatay. Sagō' ta'abut t'llumbahangi min kamatayku allum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4479" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4478" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1985"/><div sID="gen4480" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Pangamu' e' H'nda si Sibidi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.35-Mark.10.45">Markus 10:35-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1985"/> Sakali pina'an ni si Isa h'nda si Sibidi beya' maka anakna l'lla duwangan, mulid si Isa asal. Pasujud d'nda itu ma dahuan si Isa angamu' junjung.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: Tinilaw iya e' si Isa, yukna, “Ai amu'nu?” <div eID="gen4481" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4482" type="paragraph"/> Yuk d'nda, “Bang ta'abut waktu kapagparintanu, patingkō'un kono' duwangan anakku itu min karuwambila'nu.”  <div eID="gen4482" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1986"/><div sID="gen4483" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1986"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Mbal kata'uwanbi bang ai ya amu'bi ilu. Makasandal kam bahā' pinananaman kabinasahan buwat paminasa ma aku?” <div eID="gen4483" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4484" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', makasandal du kami,” yuk sigā.  <div eID="gen4484" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1987"/><div sID="gen4485" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1987"/> Yuk si Isa, “Asal makananam du kam kabinasahan buwat kabinasahan ya song pat'kka ni aku. Sagō' halam aniya' kapatutku amene' bang sai pinatingkō' ma bihingku kowan atawa ma bihingku gibang. Suku' ko' inān saga a'a ya tinagamahan paningkō'an ina'an-i e' Mma'ku Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4485" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1988"/><div sID="gen4486" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1988"/> Takale pa'in e' saga sangpū' mulid kasehe' pasal bay niamu' e' h'nda si Sibidi, magtūy ap'ddi' atay sigām ma duwangan magdanakan e'.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: Angkan sigām kamemon sinoho' e' si Isa patimuk ni atagna. Yukna, “Kata'uwanbi kajarihan saga a'a ma dunya itu. Ya ang'ntanan pagparinta ma bangsa inān magmanda asal ma saga a'a ma deyo'an sigām. Ya du saga puntuk nakura' sigām, angahagda na pa'in.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu subay mbal magbuwattē'. Sai-sai kam bilahi taga-ōn ma deyomanbi, subay magsosoho'an ni kasehe'an.

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: Sai-sai kam bilahi pinalanga, subay magpa'ata ni pagkahina.

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: Buwat aku, ya Anak Manusiya'. Ya maksudku pi'itu ni dunya ngga'i ka aku subay pinaghulas-sangsā'an e' a'a kasehe', sagō' aku ya maghulas-sangsā' panabang sigām. Pi'itu aku bo' paglilla'ku kallumku pangal'kkatku saga a'a aheka min paldusahan sigām.”  <div eID="gen4486" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4480" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1989"/><div sID="gen4487" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwa A'a Buta Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.10.46-Mark.10.52">Markus 10:46-52</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.35-Luke.18.43">Lukas 18:35-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1989"/> Manjari atulak pa'in disi Isa min da'ira Ariha, aheka a'a bay paturul ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: Sakali aniya' maina'an duwa l'lla buta aningkō' ma bihing lān palabayan sigām. Makata'u pa'in saga buta itu in si Isa ina'an palabay, magtūy sigā angalingan pakosog. “O Tuwan, tubu' Sultan Da'ud!” yuk sigā. “Ma'ase' ka ma kami.”

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: Pinabukagan sigā e' kaheka'an a'a inān, sinō' da'a maghibuk. Sagō' pinakosog gom pa'in pangalingan sigā, yuk-i, “O Tuwan! Tubu' si Da'ud! Ma'ase' na ka ba!”  <div eID="gen4488" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1990"/><div sID="gen4489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1990"/> Pahogga' si Isa bo' angalingan ni duwangan buta inān, yukna, “Ai kabaya'anbi hinangku ma ka'am?”  <div eID="gen4489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1991"/><div sID="gen4490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1991"/> “Tuwan,” yuk sigā, “bilahi kami maka'nda' pabīng.”

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: Jari ma'ase' si Isa ma sigā, ati pinat'nna' tanganna ma mata sigā. Saru'un-du'un du sigā maka'nda' pabīng ati ameya' sigā paturul ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4490" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.20"/> <div eID="gen4487" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1992"/><div sID="gen4491" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmahaldika' ma si Isa Pagsōdna ni Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.11.1-Mark.11.11">Markus 11:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.28-Luke.19.40">Lukas 19:28-40</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.12.12-John.12.19">Yahiya 12:12-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1992"/> Jari itu, asekot pa'in disi Isa ni da'ira Awrusalam, bo' ma tongod būd Kayu Jaitun na, ta'abut e' sigām kaluma'an Betpage. Mahē' pa'in, sinoho' e' si Isa duwangan mulidna parahū.

verses.name: Matthew 21:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Pehē' na kam ni kaluma'an ya ma dahuanbi ilu. Pagt'kkabi pina'an, makabāk du kam kura'<note>In kura' itu saddī ginisna min dī kura'. ‘Donkey’ atawa ‘ass’ ōnna ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> maka anakna paengkot maina'an. Hubarinbi bo' bowahunbi pi'itu.

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' atilaw ka'am bang angay ngā'bi, haka'inbi buwattitu, yukbi, ‘Tu'ud pagguna e' nakura'.’ Jari pinasagaran du kam magtūy e'na.”  <div eID="gen4492" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1993"/><div sID="gen4493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1993"/> Pinaniya' buwattē' bo' magtanda' ya bay pinagkallam e' dakayu' nabi, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4494"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4495"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:5
verses.text: “Haka'inbi saga a'a Awrusalam,<l eID="gen4495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4496"/>Ilu na sultanbi at'kka ni ka'am.<l eID="gen4496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4497"/>Areyo' pangatayanna,<l eID="gen4497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4498"/>angura' iya ma anak kura'.”<l eID="gen4498" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4494"/>  <div eID="gen4493" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1994"/><div sID="gen4499" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1994"/> Na, pehē' duwangan mulid e', nihinang e' sigā ya bay panoho'an si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 21:7
verses.text: Binowa e' sigā kura' maka anakna, nilampikan maka badju' sigā bo' yampa pangura'an e' si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 21:8
verses.text: Angura' pa'in iya, landu' aheka a'a bay am'llat s'mmek sigām ma lān palabayanna. Saga a'a kasehe' bay anabulakan pina'an saga engas-engas dahunan bay labasan sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 21:9
verses.text: Manjari ba'anan saga a'a ya magl'ngnganan min dahuan si Isa, sampay sigām paturul min buli'anna, magpangolang sama-sama yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4500"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4501"/>“Mahaldika' ni tubu' sultan Da'ud!<l eID="gen4501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4502"/>Bang pa'in binarakatan ya kawakilan e' Tuhan pi'itu!<l eID="gen4502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4503"/>Sanglitantam Tuhan Mahatinggi!”<l eID="gen4503" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4500"/>  <div eID="gen4499" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1995"/><div sID="gen4504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1995"/> Manjari pagt'kka si Isa ni Awrusalam, ahiluhala' deyom da'ira inān kamemon. Yuk saga a'a maina'an, “Sai bahā' a'a ilu?”  <div eID="gen4504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1996"/><div sID="gen4505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1996"/> Anambung kaheka'an, yuk sigām, “Si Isa ko' itu, nabi min Nasaret ma lahat Jalil.”  <div eID="gen4505" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4491" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1997"/><div sID="gen4506" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.11.15-Mark.11.19">Markus 11:15-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.45-Luke.19.48">Lukas 19:45-48</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.2.13-John.2.22">Yahiya 2:13-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4507" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1997"/> Sakali itu pasōd si Isa ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan bo' yampa pinala'an e'na sasuku maglilitu maka magdagang maina'an. Binaliskat e'na lamisahan saga a'a magsambi'an sīn bangsa liyu ni sīn Yahudi. Ya du binaliskat e'na paningkō'an saga a'a magdagang assang pagkulban.

verses.name: Matthew 21:13
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni saga a'a inān, “Tasulat asal ma Kitab Kanabi-nabihan bay pagkallam Tuhan, ya yuk-i, ‘Luma'ku itu niōnan luma' pagsambahayangan saga a'a.’ Sagō' tahinangbi na sali' luma' patapukan mundu.”  <div eID="gen4507" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1998"/><div sID="gen4508" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1998"/> Maina'an lagi' si Isa ma deyom langgal, pina'an ni iya saga a'a buta maka a'a pengka' ati kauli'an sigām e'na.

verses.name: Matthew 21:15
verses.text: Sagō' angastol saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama, pag'nda' sigām ma hinang si Isa makainu-inu inān, maka pagkale sigām ma saga onde' magpangolang ma deyom langgal, ya yuk-i, “Mahaldika' ni tubu' Sultan Da'ud!”  <div eID="gen4508" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1999"/><div sID="gen4509" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1999"/> Jari ah'lling saga nakura' inān ni si Isa, yuk sigām, “Takalenu bahā' ya pinah'lling e' saga onde'-onde' itu?” <div eID="gen4509" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4510" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk si Isa. “Angay? Kilāku halam tabassabi ya tasulat ma Kitab Jabul, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4511"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4512"/>‘Min kahandaknu saga kamanahutan amudji ōnnu,<l eID="gen4512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4513"/>saga anak duru'an lagi' ananglitan ka'a.’ ”<l eID="gen4513" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4511"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: Puwas e' ala'an si Isa min sigām bo' paluwas min da'ira tudju ni kaluma'an Betani. Pahanti' iya mahē' dambahangi.  <div eID="gen4510" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4506" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2000"/><div sID="gen4514" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kayu Igira Halam Aniya' Buwa'na</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.11.12-Mark.11.14">Markus 11:12-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.11.20-Mark.11.24">Markus 11:20-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4515" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2000"/> Pagk'llat llaw, ma labayan pa'in si Isa tudju ni Awrusalam pabīng, lingantu iya.

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: Ta'nda'na dampo'on kayu igira ma bihing lān, sagō' pagpehē'na, halam aniya' buwa' tabākna maina'an, luwal dahun. Jari sinapdahan e' si Isa kayu inān, yukna, “Puwas minnitu, kayu itu mbal to'ongan magbuwa' pabīng.” Magtūy alanos kayu inān.  <div eID="gen4515" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2001"/><div sID="gen4516" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2001"/> Pag'nda' saga mulidna, ainu-inu sigām. “Allā,” yuk sigām, “angay kayu igira itu alanos saru'un-du'un?”  <div eID="gen4516" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2002"/><div sID="gen4517" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2002"/> “Na, haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “bang kam angandol to'ongan ma halam aniya' hawal-hawal deyom ataybi, makahinang du kam buwat bay hinangku ma kayu igira itu. Maka ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Minsan būd inān, bang soho'bi ala'an min baina bo' pat'nna' ni deyom s'llang, tantu du ameya'.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: Bang kam angandol, tasambutbi du ai-ai pangamu'-ngamu'bi ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4517" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4514" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2003"/><div sID="gen4518" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinilaw si Isa Pasal Kapatutna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.11.27-Mark.11.33">Markus 11:27-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.1-Luke.20.8">Lukas 20:1-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4519" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2003"/> Jari pabīng na si Isa ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan bo' amandu'. Sabuna pa'in amandu', pina'an ni iya saga kaimaman alanga maka saga pagmatto'ahan Yahudi. Yuk sigām, “Ai kapatutnu maghinang ka buwattilu? Sai bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut?”  <div eID="gen4519" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2004"/><div sID="gen4520" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2004"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' dakayu' patilawku ma ka'am dahū. Bang itu sambunganbi, haka'anta du kam bang ai kapatutku maghinang buwattitu.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: Ya bay kapatut si Yahiya magpandi saga a'a, kapatut min Tuhan bahā' atawa min manusiya' sadja?” <div eID="gen4520" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4521" type="paragraph"/> Na, magisun-isun sigām, yuk-i, “Bang saupama yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān bay min Tuhan, tantu kitam tinilaw e'na bang angay kitam halam bay magkahagad ma si Yahiya.

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: Sagō' bang yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān min manusiya' sadja, na piligdu kitam. Sabab saga a'a itu magkahagad kamemon in si Yahiya nabi min Tuhan.”

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu ya panambung saga nakura' ma panilaw si Isa, yuk-i, “Mbal kata'uwan kami.” <div eID="gen4521" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4522" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ya du aku mbal angahaka'an ka'am bang minningga ya kapatutku maghinang saga hinang itu.”  <div eID="gen4522" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4518" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2005"/><div sID="gen4523" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Duwangan Magdanakan</title> <div sID="gen4524" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2005"/> Amissala si Isa, yukna, “Pikilunbi paralilanku itu. Aniya' a'a duwa anakna l'lla. Na pehē' a'a itu ni anakna siyaka, yukna, ‘Otō', pehē' ka llaw ilu maghinang ma kabbun.’

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: Yuk sambung siyaka he', ‘Mbal aku.’ Saguwā' apinda pikilanna ati pehē' iya ni kabbun maghinang.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: Jari pehē' a'a itu ni anakna siyali, anoho' iya maghinang buwat bay panoho'anna ma siyaka. ‘Aho', Mma',’ yuk sambung siyali. Sagō' halam iya bay pehē'.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa ni saga a'a inān, “bang ma ka'am, sai ya bay ameya' ma kabaya'an mma'na?” <div eID="gen4524" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4525" type="paragraph"/> “Ya anak siyaka,” yuk sambung sigām. <div eID="gen4525" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4526" type="paragraph"/> “Haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “saga a'a dusahan, ya buwat maga'ā' sukay parinta maka d'nda ala'at, parahū sigām min ka'am ameya' ma pagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: Sabab si Yahiya Magpapandi bay pi'ilu ni ka'am amata'uwan ka'am bang ingga ya lān abontol, sagō' halam iya bay kahagadbi. Malaingkan saga a'a magā' sukay parinta maka saga d'nda ala'at, bay magkahagad. Maka minsan ta'nda'bi ina'an-i, halam bay apinda pikilanbi bo' kam magkahagad ma si Yahiya.”  <div eID="gen4526" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4523" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2006"/><div sID="gen4527" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal saga Magtutunggu' ma Kabbun Anggul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.1-Mark.12.12">Markus 12:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.9-Luke.20.19">Lukas 20:9-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4528" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2006"/> “Pakale kam ma paralilan dakayu' itu,” yuk si Isa. “Aniya' dakayu' a'a tag-dapu tana' bay ananom bahan anggul ma kabbunna. Nilikus e'na maka ād, kinali e'na lowang pagp'gga'an buwa' anggul, maka nihinang e'na pamantawan alanga. Puwas e' patunggu'anna kabbun inān ma saga magtutunggu', bo' yampa iya atulak ni lahat saddī.

verses.name: Matthew 21:34
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in musim pagpusu' buwa' anggul, sinoho' e' tag-dapu kabbun saga sosoho'anna pehē' ni saga magtutunggu' angā' palsuku'anna.  <div eID="gen4528" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2007"/><div sID="gen4529" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2007"/> “Sagō' pagt'kka pehē' saga sosoho'an itu, sinaggaw sigām e' magtutunggu'. Dakayu' sosoho'an inān bay niraplosan, dakayu' bay pinapatay, dakayu' isab bay pinagbantung.

verses.name: Matthew 21:36
verses.text: Puwas e' in tag-dapu bay amapehē' saga sosoho'an saddī, aheka lagi' min bay dahū. Ya du sigām bay nila'at e' saga tunggu', buwat bay pangala'at sigām ma sosoho'an tagna'.

verses.name: Matthew 21:37
verses.text: Na, ma katapusan, bay pinapehē' anak tag-dapu, sabab pangannalna, ‘Tantu pinagaddatan anakku e' saga tunggu' he'.’  <div eID="gen4529" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2008"/><div sID="gen4530" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2008"/> “Sagō' pag'nda' saga tunggu' ma anak tag-dapu itu, magtūy sigām magisun, yuk-i, ‘Ya na ko' ilu anak tag-dapu. Sūng kitam, papataytam iya bo' ta'ā'tam tana'na.’

verses.name: Matthew 21:39
verses.text: Manjari sinaggaw e' sigām anak tag-dapu. Nijudjalan iya paluwas min likusan, bo' pinapatay.  <div eID="gen4530" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2009"/><div sID="gen4531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2009"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “bang at'kka tag-dapu kabbun pehē', ai bahā' hinangna ma saga a'a magtutunggu'?”  <div eID="gen4531" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2010"/><div sID="gen4532" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2010"/> Anambung sigām, yuk-i, “Tantu papatayna saga pilliyu inān. Patunggu'anna kabbunna ma a'a saddī, ya bilahi ang'nde'an palsuku'anna bang ta'abut musimna.”  <div eID="gen4532" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2011"/><div sID="gen4533" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2011"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Halam bahā' tabassabi ayat Kitab ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4534"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4535"/>‘Ya batu bay sinulak e' a'a maghinang luma',<l eID="gen4535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4536"/>ya na batu manjari pamapagon luma'.<l eID="gen4536" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4537"/>Hinang Tuhan ko' inān,<l eID="gen4537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4538"/>landu' ahāp ma pang'nda' kami.’<l eID="gen4538" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4534"/>  <div eID="gen4533" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2012"/><div sID="gen4539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2012"/> “Angkan kam haka'anku,” yuk si Isa, “nila'anan du min ka'am bay palsuku'anbi ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan bo' pinapinda ni a'a saddī bangsa. Jari sigām ya amaluwas kahāpan ya tōp ma pagparintahan Tuhan. [

verses.name: Matthew 21:44
verses.text: Sasuku ahūg ni batu itu atumu-tumu du baranna. Maka sasuku kahūgan batu itu apipis du kamemonna.]”  <div eID="gen4539" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2013"/><div sID="gen4540" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2013"/> Pagkale e' saga kaimaman alanga maka e' saga Parisi ya pamaralil e' si Isa itu, magtūy tasayu in sigām ya pina'andigan e'na.

verses.name: Matthew 21:46
verses.text: Angkan sigām bilahi anaggaw si Isa, sagō' halam kalandu'an. Tināw sigām ma kaheka'an a'a inān sabab dī nabi si Isa bang ma bistahan sigām.  <div eID="gen4540" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.21"/> <div eID="gen4527" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2014"/><div sID="gen4541" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Jamuhan Pagkawin</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.14.15-Luke.14.24">Lukas 14:15-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4542" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2014"/> Manjari magparalilan si Isa pabīng ma saga a'a, yukna,

verses.name: Matthew 22:2
verses.text: “In kapagparinta Tuhan sali' dalil sultan bay magsakap pagjamu ma waktu kapagkawin anakna l'lla.

verses.name: Matthew 22:3
verses.text: Sinoho' e' sultan saga ipatanna amata'u saga a'a ya bay sinō' paluruk. Sagō' mbal ameya'.  <div eID="gen4542" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2015"/><div sID="gen4543" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2015"/> “Angkan aniya' ipatan saddī pinapehē' e' sultan. Yukna ni sigām, ‘Pata'uhunbi saga a'a ya soho'ku paluruk in pagjamuku sakap na. Bay na sinumbali' saga sapi'ku l'lla maka saga anak sapi' al'mmok. Sakap na kamemon. Sō'un sigām paluruk na ni pagkawinan.’

verses.name: Matthew 22:5
verses.text: Sagō' agagga saga a'a inān, sabab aniya' gawi sigām saddī. Dangan inān wa'i ni humana maghinang, dangan ni tindana,

verses.name: Matthew 22:6
verses.text: kasehe'an bay anaggaw saga sosoho'an sultan inān. Niraplosan e' sigām maka pinapatay.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: Pagta'u pa'in sultan, landu' akagit atayna angkan soho'na tumpukan sundaluna pehē' amapatay saga pamomono' he'. Sinō' isab tinunu' kaluma'an sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: Puwas e' nilinganan e' sultan saga ipatanna, yukna, ‘Sakap na jamu pagkawin sagō' mbal na tōp saga a'a bay ta'abbitku.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: Jari pehē' kam ni lān aheka a'ana, ati sō'unbi paluruk sasuku tabākbi mahē'.’

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: Angkan pehē' saga ipatan inān ni kalān-lānan amatimuk sasuku a'a tabāk e' sigām, a'a ahāp ka atawa ala'at. Jari in luma' pagkawinan e' ap'nno' e' luruk.  <div eID="gen4543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2016"/><div sID="gen4544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2016"/> “Sakali itu, makasōd pa'in sultan pehē' ang'nda' ma saga luruk, aniya' ta'nda'na maina'an dakayu' a'a amakay s'mmek mbal tōp ma pagkawinan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: Yuk sultan ni a'a itu, ‘Bagay, buwattingga kasōdnu pi'itu ma halam aniya' s'mmeknu tōp ma pagkawinan?’ Sagō' halam anambung a'a inān.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling sultan ni saga sosoho'anna, yukna, ‘Engkotinbi tape'-tangan a'a itu, bo' larukinbi iya pehē' ni deyom kalendoman. Magtangis saga a'a maina'an maka magtage'ot empon kabowa susun sigām.’  <div eID="gen4544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2017"/><div sID="gen4545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2017"/> “Sababna,” yuk si Isa, “aheka a'a tina'abbit ameya' ma pamarinta Tuhan, sagō' salat du tapene'.”  <div eID="gen4545" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4541" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2018"/><div sID="gen4546" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagbayad Sukay ni Parinta</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.13-Mark.12.17">Markus 12:13-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.20-Luke.20.26">Lukas 20:20-26</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4547" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2018"/> Na, paluwas saga Parisi minnē' bo' magisun bang buwattingga e' sigām anganjallat si Isa ma bissalana.

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: Jari aniya' saga mulid sigām maka saga bebeya'an si Herod pinapehē' ni si Isa. “Tuwan Guru,” yuk sigām ma iya, “kata'uwan kami in ka'a apote' asal ataynu. B'nnal sadja pamandu'nu pasal kaul-pi'il ya kinabaya'an e' Tuhan. Mbal ka tināw sinoway e' sai-sai, sabab sali' du bowahannu ma a'a kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: Na, haka'in kami kono' bang ai pikilannu pasal itu-i: bang kita ganta' amayad sukay ni parinta Rōm, ya deyo' min Sultan Mahatinggi he', langgalta bahā' sara' agamatam?”  <div eID="gen4547" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2019"/><div sID="gen4548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2019"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa aniya' kala'atan minaksud e' sigām, angkan yukna ni sigām, “Ka'am ilu hal magbau'-bau' atilaw buwattilu. Tu'ud kam bilahi anganjallat aku ma panambungku.

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: Panda'in aku sīn, ya pamayad sukay parinta.” Jari binowahan iya sīn atibu'uk.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Patta' sai maka ōn sai ma sīn itu?”  <div eID="gen4548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
