verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2020"/><div sID="gen4549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2020"/> “Patta' Sultan Mahatinggi maka ōnna,” yuk sambung sigām. <div eID="gen4549" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4550" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka suku' sultan, pamayarunbi ni sultan. Damikiyanna, bang aniya' ai-ai suku' Tuhan, tukbalinbi isab ni Tuhan.”

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: Pagkale saga a'a inān ma panambung si Isa itu, magtūy sigām ainu-inu ati ang'bba sigām min iya bo' ala'an minnē'.  <div eID="gen4550" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4546" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2021"/><div sID="gen4551" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kallum Balik ma A'a Magpatayan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.18-Mark.12.27">Markus 12:18-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.27-Luke.20.40">Lukas 20:27-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4552" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2021"/> Na ma llaw du ina'an, aniya' pina'an ni si Isa saga a'a min umpigan Saddusi.<note>Saddusi: daginis agama Yahudi ya am'nnal halam aniya' allum pabīng ma llaw damuli.</note> Atilaw sigām ma iya,

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: “Tuwan guru, aniya' sara' bay min si Musa pasal l'lla amatay ma halam taga-tubu'. In baluna subay niā' h'nda e' siyalina bo' supaya aniya' anak binista tubu' min a'a bay amatay he'.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: Na,” yuk sigām, “aniya' bay ma lahat kami pitu' l'lla magdanakan. Taga-h'nda kasiyakahan he', sagō' amatay ma halam aniya' tubu'na. Jari baluna bay ta'ā' h'nda e' siyali pasunu'.

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: Sagō' ya du siyali itu, bay amatay ma halam taga-tubu'. Damikiyanna isab siyali pasunu'. Papu'utta na, in pitu' magdanakan bay makah'nda ni dakayu' d'nda he', bo' amatay sigām kamemon ma halam taga-anak.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: Ma katapusanna amatay isab d'nda.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: Na, Tuwan,” yuk sigām, “bang ta'abut llaw pagpakallum pabalik saga a'a magpatayan, h'nda sai bahā' d'nda he'? Sabab bay iya ta'ā' h'nda e' sigām kapitu' magdanakan.”  <div eID="gen4552" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2022"/><div sID="gen4553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2022"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Asā' kam, sabab halam kata'uwanbi bang ai tasulat ma Kitab, maka mbal kata'uwanbi kosog kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: Sabab bang ta'abut waktu kallum pabīng min kamatay, in manusiya' makasali' du ni bangsa mala'ikat ma deyom sulga'. Mbal na sigām magh'nda-magh'lla.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31
verses.text: Ya pasal isab saga a'a pinakallum pabīng min kamatay, kilāku halam tabassabi bay pangallam Tuhan ma ka'am, ya yuk-i,

verses.name: Matthew 22:32
verses.text: ‘Aku ya Tuhan disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.’ In Tuhan itu,” yuk si Isa, “pagtuhanan asal ma saga a'a allum, ngga'i ka ma a'a magpatayan.”  <div eID="gen4553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2023"/><div sID="gen4554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2023"/> Makakale pa'in kaheka'an a'a inān ma bissala si Isa inān, sidda sigām ainu-inu.  <div eID="gen4554" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4551" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2024"/><div sID="gen4555" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an Ahalga' Min Kamemon</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.28-Mark.12.34">Markus 12:28-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.10.25-Luke.10.28">Lukas 10:25-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2024"/> Sakali itu, pagkale saga Parisi in si Isa bay makatambol bowa' saga Saddusi he', pina'an sigām patimuk ni iya.

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: Aniya' ma sigām dakayu' guru sara' agama bay atilaw si Isa, kalu tajallat ma panambungna.

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: Yukna, “Tuwan Guru, ma sara' agama, ingga ya panoho'an ahalga' min kamemon?”  <div eID="gen4556" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2025"/><div sID="gen4557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2025"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Wajib kam alasa to'ongan ma Panghū'bi Tuhan. Ya lasabi ma iya subay min deyom ataybi maka min deyom tawhidbi maka min panahu'anbi.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: Ya na ko' he' panoho'an umbul dakayu', ahalga' min kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: Maka ya na itu panoho'an karuwana, ahalga' isab: wajib kam alasahan pagkahibi manusiya' buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi.

verses.name: Matthew 22:40
verses.text: Ya panoho'an kamemon bay pang'bba e' si Musa, sampay pamandu' saga nabi, luwas du min duwa panoho'an tasabbutku itu.”  <div eID="gen4557" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4555" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2026"/><div sID="gen4558" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.35-Mark.12.37">Markus 12:35-37</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.41-Luke.20.44">Lukas 20:41-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2026"/> Hinabu magtimuk maina'an saga Parisi, aniya' tinilaw e' si Isa ma sigām,

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: yuk-i, “Ai pikilanbi pasal Al-Masi? Tubu' sai iya?” <div eID="gen4559" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4560" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Tubu' sultan Da'ud.”  <div eID="gen4560" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2027"/><div sID="gen4561" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2027"/> “Na bang buwattē',” yuk si Isa, “angay angkan si Da'ud bay angōn ‘Panghū'’ ma Al-Masi, ma waktu kapagbaya' Rū Tuhan ma iya? Buwattitu bay pagkallam si Da'ud e', <lg sID="gen4562"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4563"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: ‘Bay angabtang Tuhan ni Panghū'ku, yukna,<l eID="gen4563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4564"/>dai' ka aningkō' ma bihingku kowan,<l eID="gen4564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4565"/>ati bowaku palbantahannu<l eID="gen4565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4566"/>tatau' ma deyo' pād-tape'nu.’<l eID="gen4566" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4562"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka Al-Masi itu niōnan Panghū' e' sultan Da'ud, tantu iya ngga'i ka hal panubu' si Da'ud.”

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: Jari halam aniya' a'a makapanambung ma si Isa minsan dakabtang. Puwas minna'an halam aniya' makatawakkal anilaw iya.  <div eID="gen4561" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.22"/> <div eID="gen4558" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2028"/><div sID="gen4567" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katiksa'an Pitu' Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.37-Luke.11.53">Lukas 11:37-53</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2028"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni katimukan a'a maka ni saga mulidna.

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Aniya' kapatut saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi amandu'an a'a pasal saga sara' si Musa.

verses.name: Matthew 23:3
verses.text: Angkan subay beya'bi ai-ai pamandu' sigām. Subay ikutbi pahāp pamissala sigām. Sagō' da'a panunurinbi kahinangan sigām, sabab halam tabeya' e' sigām ya bay pamandu' sigām ma a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: Pinabuhat e' sigām saga panoho'an ya pamatanggung sigām ma saga a'a kasehe'an, sagō' mbal sigām bilahi anabang ma saga a'a inān, minsan la'a hal tabang ariki'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:5
verses.text: Ai-ai nihinang e' saga Parisi maka saga guru he' subay ma matahan kaheka'an a'a. Nda'unbi kaheya puyu'-puyu' pangisihan ayat Kitab ya pin'kkos ma tuktuk maka ma l'ngngon sigām. Nda'unbi isab juba sigām, kataha' jambayna.

verses.name: Matthew 23:6
verses.text: Bang sigām ganta' ma pagjamuhan, kabilahian sigām subay pinatingkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan. Ya du bang sigām ma deyom langgal, subay paningkō'an ya tinau'an a'a alanga.

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: Bilahi sigām nihulmat bang ma mairan, bilahi isab pinagsabbut ‘Tuwan Guru.’  <div eID="gen4568" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2029"/><div sID="gen4569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2029"/> “Sagō' ka'am ilu subay mbal angangut niōnan ‘Tuwan Guru’ e' pagkahibi, sabab in ka'am magdauranakan kamemon, maka dakayu' du gurubi luggiya'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: Da'a panabbutinbi ‘Mma'’ sai-sai ma deyom dunya itu, sabab dakayu' du pag'mma'anbi, ya Tuhan ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: Da'a kam mikiōn nakura', sabab tunggal Al-Masi ya pagnakura'anbi.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: Sai-sai bilahi alanga ma deyomanbi, subay iya magpa'ata ma kasehe'anna.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: Sai-sai magpalanga ma baranna, pinareyo' du iya, maka sai-sai amareyo' di-na pinalanga du isab.”  <div eID="gen4569" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4567" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2030"/><div sID="gen4570" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Magbau'-bau' in Sigām Ahāp</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.38">Markus 12:38</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.11.39-Luke.11.44">Lukas 11:39-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.47">Lukas 20:47</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2030"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi!” yuk si Isa. “Magbau'-bau' sadja kam in ka'am ahāp addatbi, sagō' tambolanbi saga a'a bo' supaya sigām mbal makasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan. Ka'am baranbi ilu mbal bilahi pasōd pina'an, maka lāngbi isab sasuku bilahi pasōd. [

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi, ya magbau'-bau' in ka'am ahāp! Ni'inyaya e'bi saga d'nda balu bo' ta'ā'bi luma' sigām, ati pataha'bi panambahayangbi paglaku-lakubi in ka'am bal-iman, bo' pa'in katapukan kahinanganbi ala'at. Angkan pinakalap kabinasahanbi ma ahirat.]  <div eID="gen4571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2031"/><div sID="gen4572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2031"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru maka saga Parisi! Magbau'-bau' kam ahāp addatbi! Atuyu' kam amasaplag pandu'bi, ya angkan lintasbi deya-dilaut bang pa'in aniya' tabowabi ameya' ma pandu'bi minsan la'a hal dakayu' a'a. Ati bang aniya' ganta' makabeya', akalap gi' iya min ka'am pinaganta'an nalka', ma sabab pamandu'bi ya pameya'anna.  <div eID="gen4572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2032"/><div sID="gen4573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2032"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am! Sali' kam sapantun a'a buta angambit pagkahina. Yuk pamandu'bi, bang aniya' anganjanji' bo' sabbutna langgal pagkulbanan palsaksi'an janji'na, halam du aniya' dusana minsan mbal suhulna bay janji'na he'. Sagō' bang kapanyapan bulawan ma deyom langgal ya panabbutanna, wajib kono' subay suhulna to'ongan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: Asā' landu' pikilanbi, bā'nu kam abuta! Langgal inān asal pangarapan ni Tuhan, angkan yukta asussi kapanyapanna.

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: Aniya' isab pamandu'bi dakayu', yuk-i, sai-sai anabbut tongod pagkulbanan palsaksi'an janji'na, makajari minsan mbal sinuhul janji'na. Sagō' bang panabbutanna ai-ai tinukbalan ni Tuhan ma diyata' pagkulbanan e', in janji'na kono' wajib subay sinuhul to'ongan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: Asā' landu' pikilanbi! Ingga aheya gunana, ya ai-ai tinukbalan ma diyata' pagkulbanan, atawa pagkulbanan sussi, ya makabuwan kasussihan isab ma tutukbalan e'?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: Angkanna, bang aniya' a'a ganta' anabbut pagkulbanan, panabbutanna isab kamemon ya tinukbalan ni Tuhan maina'an.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: Damikiyanna, bang aniya' anabbut langgal pagkulbanan, panabbutanna isab Tuhan ya pat'nna' asal maina'an.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: Bang aniya' anabbut sulga', panabbutanna isab paningkō'an Tuhan maka panabbutanna isab Tuhan.  <div eID="gen4573" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2033"/><div sID="gen4574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2033"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru sara' maka saga Parisi! Magbau'-bau' kam ahāp addatbi. Atukid sidda kam anukbal ni Tuhan bahagi' sangpū' min ai-aibi kamemon, minsan la'a hal ginisan sayul-sayul ya pamapābi kinakan. Ahāp isab kapanukbalbi buwattē', da'a subay ni'bbahan, sagō' ya panoho'an ahalga' min kamemon halam kabogboganbi. Mbal kam a'adil, mbal kam ma'ase' ma pagkahibi, mbal kam kapangandolan. Arapun ilu-i panuyu'anbi to'ongan dahū min kamemon.

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: Sali' kam a'a buta ya angambit sehe'na. Sapantun kam a'a angayak inumanna bo' mbal makainum kammut, bo' pa'in tat'llonna unta' ma katibu'ukanna.  <div eID="gen4574" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2034"/><div sID="gen4575" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2034"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru maka saga Parisi! Magbau'-bau' kam ahāp addatbi. Sali' kam sapantun sawan maka lai. Kose'anbi luwasanna sagō' haram deyomna sabab ap'nno' e' pangalangpasbi maka pagnapsubi dumasiyaw.

verses.name: Matthew 23:26
verses.text: Ka'am saga Parisi, asā' sidda pikilanbi! Lanu'inbi dahū deyomna ati alanu' sampay luwasanna.  <div eID="gen4575" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2035"/><div sID="gen4576" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2035"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru maka saga Parisi! Magbau'-bau' kam ahāp addatbi. Sali' kam sapantun kubul bay pininta pote' luwasanna bo' ahāp ninda', sagō' deyomna akansang e' to'olang mayat maka ginis kahalu'an.

verses.name: Matthew 23:28
verses.text: Buwattē' isab hantangbi. Bang pangluwahanbi ta'nda' e' a'a, ahāp sadja, sagō' deyom ataybi ilu ap'nno' e' pagbau'-bau'bi maka kala'atanbi.”  <div eID="gen4576" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4570" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2036"/><div sID="gen4577" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kadal saga Guru Agama maka saga Parisi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.11.47-Luke.11.51">Lukas 11:47-51</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4578" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2036"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru maka saga Parisi! Magbau'-bau' kam ahāp addatbi. Tahinangbi tampat ma kanabi-nabihan, tapa'altibi saga kubul bay pangubulan a'a ka'adilan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:30
verses.text: Yukbi isab, ‘Bang bay kami allum ma waktu ka'mbo'an kami he', mbal du kami bay palamud ma hinang saga a'a kasehe'an, ya kapamapatay sigām ma saga nabi he'.’

verses.name: Matthew 23:31
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka buwattilu pah'llingbi, magpasab'nnal kam in ka'am panubu' min saga a'a bay amono' kanabihan e'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:32
verses.text: Pehē'unbi na, talusunbi saga dusa ya bay tinagna'an e' ka'mbo'anbi.  <div eID="gen4578" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2037"/><div sID="gen4579" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2037"/> “Mbal tasipat la'atbi! Halam aniya' kaholatanbi papuwas min hukuman nalka'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:34
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, papi'iluku du ni ka'am saga nabi, saga a'a bal-akkal, maka saga guru. Bono'bi du sigām kasehe', kasehe' isab lansangbi du ni hāg pinapatay, kasehe' daplosanbi ma deyom langgal, maka kasehe'an turulbi du min kaluma'an dakayu' ni dakayu'.

verses.name: Matthew 23:35
verses.text: Angkan kam pinat'kkahan hukuman, ma sabab kapamapataybi ma saga a'a halam taga-dusa, tinagna'an min si Habil anak si Adam, sampay ni si Jakariya anak si Baraki. Si Jakariya he' bay pinapatay e' bangsabi ma llotan langgal maka tongod pagkulbanan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:36
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan, ka'am ma ahil jaman itu pamatanggungan du karusahan saga a'a inān kamemon.”  <div eID="gen4579" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4577" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2038"/><div sID="gen4580" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lasa si Isa ma saga A'a Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.13.31-Luke.13.35">Lukas 13:31-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4581" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2038"/> Magkarukka'an si Isa yukna, “Arōy! Ka'am saga a'a Awrusalam, makasusa ko' ka'am ilu! Saga nabi min Tuhan hal papataybi. Saga sosoho'an Tuhan hal bantungbi bang pinapi'ilu ni ka'am. Min pila aku bay bilahi animuk ka'am ma sabakanku, sali' sapantun manuk d'nda bang magsabak anak-anakna ma deyo' pikpikna. Sagō' mbal kam.

verses.name: Matthew 23:38
verses.text: Nda'unbi na, asiya-siya lahatbi e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:39
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, mbal na aku ta'nda'bi pabalik sampay ni waktu kapananglitbi ma aku, ya yukbi, ‘Bang pa'in binarakatan ya pinapi'itu kawakilan e' Tuhan.’ ”  <div eID="gen4581" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.23"/> <div eID="gen4580" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2039"/><div sID="gen4582" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandogahan ma Llaw Kiyamat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.1-Mark.13.13">Markus 13:1-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.5-Luke.21.19">Lukas 21:5-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2039"/> Manjari itu, makaluwas pa'in si Isa min langgal pagkulbanan, pasekot ni iya saga mulidna anudlu' hinangan langgal e'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:2
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Ta'nda'bi kahāpna. Sagō' haka'anta kam, ma sinosōng in langgal itu alubu du. Halam aniya' batuna angapin magbangkat, kinanat du kamemon.”  <div eID="gen4583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2040"/><div sID="gen4584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2040"/> Puwas e', aningkō' pa'in si Isa mahē' ma būd Jaitun, pehē' ni iya saga mulidna, sigām-sigām sadja. Yuk sigām, “Pahatiun kono' kami bang sumiyan paniya' ya bay yuknu insini', maka bang paltanda'an ai pinatuwa' bo' kinata'uwan in kapi'itunu asekot na, maka dunya itu song kiyamat na?”  <div eID="gen4584" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2041"/><div sID="gen4585" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2041"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' kam mbal ka'akkalan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:5
verses.text: Sabab ma sinosōng aheka pi'itu anabbut ōnku, maglaku-laku in sigām Al-Masi, ati aheka tabowa-bowa niakkalan e' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 24:6
verses.text: Makakale du kam pasal pagbono' ma kasekotan. Makakale kam isab hunub-hunub pasal pagbono' ma lahat saddī. Sagō' da'a kam tināw. Tantu paniya' pagbono' sagō' ngga'i ka ina'an-i llaw kiyamat.

verses.name: Matthew 24:7
verses.text: Magbono' du bangsa dakayu' maka dakayu', parinta dakayu' isab maka parinta dakayu'. Paniya' isab gotom ma sabarang lahat, maka linug ma kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Matthew 24:8
verses.text: Sagō' in bala' kamemon itu hal tagna'anna sadja, sali' dalil d'nda ab'ttong bang yampa tananamna amuka' puhu'.  <div eID="gen4585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2042"/><div sID="gen4586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2042"/> “Bang at'kka saga pakaradja'an ina'an-i, sinaggaw du kam, tinukbalan ni saga a'a bo' kam bininasa sampay pinapatay. Kinab'nsihan du kam e' a'a kamemon ma sabab pameya'bi ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 24:10
verses.text: Ma waktu ina'an aheka a'a bay bebeya'anku ang'bba min pagiman sigām. Aheka isab magla'at-liya'ati maka anukbal pagkahi sigām ni saga a'a ab'nsi ma si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 24:11
verses.text: Aheka maglaku-laku in sigām nabi min Tuhan, maka aheka tabowa niakkalan e' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 24:12
verses.text: Pasōng na pa'in kala'atan indaginis ma waktu sinōng inān, angkan kaheka'an manusiya' mbal na maglasa-liyasahi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:13
verses.text: Sagō' lappasan du sai-sai ahogot imanna sampay ni kahinapusan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:14
verses.text: Maka lapal ahāp pasal kapagparinta Tuhan, pinagnasihat na pa'in ma kaluha'an dunya supaya pasaplag saksi' pasal si Isa ni sabarang bangsa. Puwas e' kiyamat na dunya.”  <div eID="gen4586" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4582" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2043"/><div sID="gen4587" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katiksa'an Landu' Abisa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.14-Mark.13.23">Markus 13:14-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.20-Luke.21.24">Lukas 21:20-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2043"/> “Takallam asal e' nabi Daniyel ma pasal waktu sinōng inān, yukna, aniya' ‘kasammalan makaharam’ pat'nna' ma deyom langgal mahasussi. Sasuku kam amassa, sinō' pahati. Bang ta'nda'bi ina'an-i,

verses.name: Matthew 24:16
verses.text: sasuku a'a pat'nna' ma lahat Yahudiya subay alahi pehē' ni kabūd-būran.

verses.name: Matthew 24:17
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a ganta' ma luwasan luma'na subay mbal sōdna luma'na angā' ai-aina.

verses.name: Matthew 24:18
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a ma humana subay mbal batukna badju'na paghaggut.

verses.name: Matthew 24:19
verses.text: Ndū', maka'ase'-ase' saga d'nda ab'ttong ma masa ina'an-i, maka saga d'nda taga-anak duru'an lagi'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:20
verses.text: Amu'inbi ase' ni Tuhan bang pa'in ya llaw kalahibi inān mbal magsabu maka musim haggut atawa llaw Sabtu', ya paghalibi ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:21
verses.text: Sababna saga kabinasahan ya patumbuk ma masa sinōng inān,” yuk si Isa, “akalap gi' bisana min kabinasahan kamemon bay kalabayan manusiya' sangay min tagna' kapaniya' dunya, sampay ni kabuwattina'anan. Maka mbal isab kabalikan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:22
verses.text: Daipara kinulangan du e' Tuhan t'ggol kabinasahan inān. Bang bay mbal, halam aniya' angapin allum. Kinulangan du e' Tuhan ma sabab saga a'ana, ya asal tapene'na.  <div eID="gen4588" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2044"/><div sID="gen4589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2044"/> “Na, bang ta'abut waktu ina'an-i, bo' aniya' ganta' anuhuma ni ka'am, yuk-i, ‘Nda'unbi! Itiya' na Al-Masi,’ atawa ‘Ina'an na iya maina'an’, da'a to'ongan kahagarunbi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:24
verses.text: Sabab ma waktu ina'an aniya' du patuwa' saga a'a magnahu'-nahu' in sigām Al-Masi, atawa in sigām nabi min Tuhan. Magpa'nda' sigām saga hinang barakatan maka saga paltanda'an kainu-inuhan a'a, bo' supaya ka'akkalan sampay a'a suku' Tuhan, bang hati' tabowa niakkalan.

verses.name: Matthew 24:25
verses.text: Pakale kam,” yuk si Isa. “bay na kam pata'uku ma pasal ina'an-i ma halam gi' ta'abut waktuna.  <div eID="gen4589" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2045"/><div sID="gen4590" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2045"/> “Angkan ko', bang aniya' angupama ni ka'am, yuk-i, ‘Ina'an Al-Masi ma lahat halam maga'a’, da'a kam pehē'. Atawa bang yukna, ‘Ina'an iya patapuk maina'an’, da'a beya'unbi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:27
verses.text: Sabab aku Anak Manusiya' itu, bang aku pabalik na, ta'nda' du kapi'ituku, buwat lāt aninagan b'ttong langit min sobangan sampay ni s'ddopan.”

verses.name: Matthew 24:28
verses.text: Magparalilan si Isa, yukna, “Maingga-maingga lahat kaniya'an patay, ina'an du patipun saga owak.”  <div eID="gen4590" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4587" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2046"/><div sID="gen4591" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapabalik Al-Masi Pi'itu ni Dunya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.24-Mark.13.27">Markus 13:24-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.25-Luke.21.28">Lukas 21:25-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2046"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “apuwas pa'in saga kabinasahan bay sabbutku he', <lg sID="gen4593"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4594"/>‘Angalendom mata llaw,<l eID="gen4594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4595"/>mbal amuwan sawa mata bulan.<l eID="gen4595" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4596"/>Saga bitu'un magkapakpak na min diyata' langit,<l eID="gen4596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4597"/>saga pandoga ma tonga'an ayan tabowa maglensa.’<l eID="gen4597" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4593"/>  <div eID="gen4592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2047"/><div sID="gen4598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2047"/> “Ma waktu ina'an, patuwa' du paltanda'an ma b'ttong langit, paltanda'an sin Anak Manusiya'. Jari magdukka kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon ma deyom dunya. Ta'nda' e' sigām in Anak Manusiya' pi'itu labay min gabun, aheya barakatna maka sanglit sahayana.

verses.name: Matthew 24:31
verses.text: Puwas e' pinah'lling tiyup-tiyup bo' yampa soho'na saga mala'ikatna pehē' ni mpat pidju alam animuk saga a'a bay tapene'na, min bihing langit dambila' maka dambila'.”  <div eID="gen4598" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4591" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2048"/><div sID="gen4599" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamintāngan min Kayu Igira</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.28-Mark.13.31">Markus 13:28-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.29-Luke.21.33">Lukas 21:29-33</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2048"/> “Pamintānginbi po'on kayu igira,” yuk si Isa. “Bang ta'nda'bi kayu igira itu angugbus tōng engas-engasna, sampay angandahun na to'ongan, minnē' kata'uwanbi song musim pang'llaw na.

verses.name: Matthew 24:33
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang ta'nda'bi paniya' na bay pamissalaku ma ka'am e', minnē' isab kata'uwanbi in kabalikku ni dunya asekot na.

verses.name: Matthew 24:34
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “ma halam gi' magpatayan kamemon saga a'a ya allum ma buwattina'an, paniya' du pakaradja'an kamemon bay pamissalaku he'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:35
verses.text: Papinda du langit maka dunya, sagō' kabtanganku itu mbal to'ongan magkapinda.”  <div eID="gen4600" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4599" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2049"/><div sID="gen4601" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Waktu Kabalik si Isa Mbal Kinata'uwan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.13.32-Mark.13.37">Markus 13:32-37</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.17.26-Luke.17.36">Lukas 17:26-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4602" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2049"/> “Halam aniya' makata'u bang sumiyan llaw maka waktu kabalikku pi'itu ni dunya. Minsan bangsa mala'ikat ma deyom sulga', mbal kinata'uwan e' sigām. Minsan aku, Anak Tuhan, mbal kata'uwanku. Luwal Mma'ku Tuhan ya makata'u.

verses.name: Matthew 24:37
verses.text: Bang ta'abut waktu kabalikku pi'itu, sali' du kahālanna maka kahālan bay ma masa si Nū he'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:38
verses.text: Saga a'a ma masa dahū lagi' min latap aheya, hal magkakanan maka maginuman. Bay sigām magh'nda-h'lla, sampay ta'abut waktu kasakat disi Nū ni diyata' adjung.

verses.name: Matthew 24:39
verses.text: Halam tata'u e' saga a'a inān bang ai song tum'kka ni sigām. Yampa kinata'uwan bang sigām katumbukan latap na, maka tabowa alaglag kamemon. Buwattē' isab kahālan saga a'a ma dunya itu bang aku, Anak Manusiya', pabalik na pi'itu.

verses.name: Matthew 24:40
verses.text: Ma waktu inān aniya' duwangan a'a maghinang ma huma, jari niā' dakayu' ati tabba dakayu'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:41
verses.text: Aniya' duwangan d'nda magtabang anganggiling tirigu, niā' dakayu' ati tabba dakayu'.  <div eID="gen4602" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2050"/><div sID="gen4603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2050"/> “Angkan kam subay pajaga, sabab mbal kata'uwanbi bang sumiyan waktu pabalik Panghū'bi pi'itu.

verses.name: Matthew 24:43
verses.text: Sagō' pahati kam, bang a'a tag-dapu luma' bay ata'u bang lisag pila ya kasakat panangkaw ni luma'na, tantu du iya magjaga bo' mbal tasōd luma'na.

verses.name: Matthew 24:44
verses.text: Angkan kam soho'ku subay patanam sakahaba' waktu, sabab pabalik du Anak Manusiya' ma waktu mbal kata'uwanbi.”  <div eID="gen4603" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4601" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2051"/><div sID="gen4604" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sosoho'an Kapangandolan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.12.41-Luke.12.48">Lukas 12:41-48</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4605" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2051"/> “Bang aniya' sosoho'an ahāp akkalna, a'a kapangandolan, ya na ina'an pinene' e' nakura'na magmandul ma saga sosoho'an kasehe'an. Iya na isab magatas-pikil ma balanja' sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 24:46
verses.text: Na, bang bay alikut nakura' inān bo' at'kka na pabīng, aheya kahāpan sosoho'an inān bang iya ta'abut e' nakura'na anogol ma bay pamahinang iya.

verses.name: Matthew 24:47
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, tantu pangandol e' nakura' inān alta'na kamemon ma sosoho'an kapangandolan e'.

verses.name: Matthew 24:48
verses.text: Sagō' bang sosoho'an inān bay ala'at addatna, bo' yukna ma deyom atayna in nakura'na at'ggol gi' at'kka,

verses.name: Matthew 24:49
verses.text: anagna' iya angala'ugan saga pagkahina sosoho'an e'. Maglami-lami iya maka saga a'a paglalango. Magkakan iya sampay maginum maka sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 24:50
verses.text: Sakali patagha' sadja ya t'kka nakura' inān, ma waktu halam kinata'uwan e' sosoho'an.

verses.name: Matthew 24:51
verses.text: Tantu iya nilagut e' nakura'na, sampay abugtang. Pinakadalan iya nalka' sali'-sali' maka saga a'a ya magbau'-bau' in addat sigām ahāp. Maina'an sigām magtangis maka magtage'ot empon sigām.”  <div eID="gen4605" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.24"/> <div eID="gen4604" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2052"/><div sID="gen4606" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sangpū' Budjang</title> <div sID="gen4607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2052"/> Magparalilan si Isa pabalik, yukna, “Buwattitu ya kapagparinta Tuhan ma waktu kabīngku pi'itu: sali' dalil sangpū' budjang bay amowa palita'an sigām pakaniya-kaniya, patanam pehē' anampang pangantin l'lla.

verses.name: Matthew 25:2
verses.text: Lima budjang inān sali' arupang, bo' lima inān ataha' asal akkal sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 25:3
verses.text: Na, in lima budjang arupang itu bay amowa palita'an sagō' halam bay amowa ns'llan maglabi pangisi ni palita'an sigām bang song ap'dda.

verses.name: Matthew 25:4
verses.text: Ya lima budjang taga-akkal bay amowa pangisihan ap'nno' e' ns'llan, saddī isab ya ma deyom palita'an.

verses.name: Matthew 25:5
verses.text: Na, pagka at'ggol t'kka pangantin l'lla, kinaru' na sigām kamemon angkan tatuli.  <div eID="gen4607" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2053"/><div sID="gen4608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2053"/> “Ta'abut pa'in tonga' bahangi, aniya' angalingan yukna, ‘Ilu na pangantin l'lla. Dai' na kam anampang iya.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:7
verses.text: Abati' na kasangpū' budjang inān ati pinahāp e' sigām keyat palita'an sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 25:8
verses.text: Yuk saga budjang arupang ni budjang taga-akkal, ‘Amuwan kam kono' ns'llanbi ilu, sabab song na ap'dda palita'an kami.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:9
verses.text: ‘Ē, mbal,’ yuk budjang taga-akkal e'. ‘Mbal maka'abut ns'llan itu ma kitam kamemon. Pehē' kam ni tinda am'llihan di-bi.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:10
verses.text: Na, pehē' na ni tinda saga budjang arupang inān am'lli ns'llan. Alikut pa'in sigām, magtūy at'kka pangantin l'lla. Ya lima budjang asal asakap bay ameya' ma iya pasōd ni deyom luma' pagkawinan bo' yampa tinambol lawang.  <div eID="gen4608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2054"/><div sID="gen4609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2054"/> “Mbal at'ggol at'kka budjang kasehe'an min tinda, ati angalingan ni pangantin l'lla. ‘O Tuwan,’ yuk sigām, ‘ukabin kami.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:12
verses.text: Sagō' anambung pangantin l'lla yuk-i, ‘Mbal ukabku, mbal kam takilāku.’  <div eID="gen4609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2055"/><div sID="gen4610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2055"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “subay kam pajaga to'ongan, sabab mbal kata'uwanbi bang sumiyan llaw atawa waktu kabalikku pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen4610" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4606" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2056"/><div sID="gen4611" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">T'llungan Sosoho'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.19.11-Luke.19.27">Lukas 19:11-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2056"/> “Buwattitu ya kapagparinta Tuhan ma waktu kabīngku pi'itu, sali' dalil dakayu' a'a magbantu atulak ni lahat saddī. Ma halam lagi' iya palanjal, pinatimuk e'na saga sosoho'anna bo' pajagahanna alta'na ma sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 25:15
verses.text: Ya pang'bbana ma sigām dangan maka dangan inān pinapagtongod maka akkal-kapandayanna. Dangan bay pang'bbahan limangibu pilak, dangan duwangibu pilak, maka dangan dangibu. Puwas e' atulak na a'a tag-alta' he'.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: Na, ya tendog bay pang'bbahan limangibu pilak inān, magtūy magusaha'an sīn ma iya ati makauntung iya limangibu pilak.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: Damikiyanna sosoho'an pasunu', ya bay pang'bbahan duwangibu pilak, makauntung iya duwangibu pilak isab.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: Sagō' ya sosoho'an bay pang'bbahan dangibu pilak e', pehē' angali' lowang panapukan sīn nakura'na ma deyom tana'.  <div eID="gen4612" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2057"/><div sID="gen4613" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2057"/> “At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in minnē' amole' na nakura' sigām. Pagt'kkana, magbista iya maka sosoho'anna.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: Ya sosoho'an bay pang'bbahan limangibu pilak e' ang'nde'an limangibu pilak bay tauntungna. Yukna ni nakura', ‘Tuwan, bay aku pang'bbahannu limangibu pilak pagpo'on. Itiya' isab limangibu pilak bay tauntungku.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: Yuk nakura', ‘Ahāp hinangnu. Ahantap ka maka kapangandolan. Pagka ka'a ilu kapangandolan ma alta' ariki', pangandolku du isab ma ka'a alta' aheka to'ongan. Dai' ka, palamud ka ma kakoyaganku.’  <div eID="gen4613" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2058"/><div sID="gen4614" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2058"/> “Puwas e' pina'an isab sosoho'an pasunu', ya bay pang'bbahan duwangibu pilak e'. Yukna ni nakura', ‘Tuwan, bay pang'bbahannu aku duwangibu pilak pagpo'on. Itiya' isab untungna duwangibu pilak.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: Yuk nakura'na, ‘Ahāp ko' hinangnu ilu. Ahantap ka maka kapangandolan. Pagka ka kapangandolan ma alta' ariki', pangandolku isab ma ka'a alta' aheka. Dai' ka, palamud ka ma kakoyaganku.’  <div eID="gen4614" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2059"/><div sID="gen4615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2059"/> “Puwas e' pina'an isab sosoho'an dakayu', ya bay pang'bbahan dangibu pilak. Yukna ni nakura', ‘Tuwan, kata'uwanku asal in ka'a akuriput. Angani ka minsan ngga'i ka ka'a ya bay magsangsā' ananom. Amatimuk ka, minsan ngga'i ka ka'a ya bay maghampa'.

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: Tināw aku ma ka'a, angkan bay tapukanku sīnnu ma deyom tana'. Ā! Itiya' na.’  <div eID="gen4615" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2060"/><div sID="gen4616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2060"/> “Anambung nakura' inān, yukna, ‘Ala'at ka! Lisu'an sidda! Kata'uwannu bahā' in aku anguntung min ngga'i ka paglu'uganku, angā' aku buwa' isab min halam bay tanomku?

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: Na, bang buwattē', arapun bay patau'nu sīnku ma deyom bangko. Jari pagt'kkaku ta'ā'ku du sīnku sampay anakna.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: Puwas e' ah'lling nakura' ni sosoho'an saddī, yukna, ‘Ngā'unbi sīn min iya itu ati pamuwanun ni a'a dakayu', ya aniya' sīnna sangpū' ngibu pilak inān.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: Sabab sasuku kapangandolan ma aheka, kin'nnopan du ma iya sampay ni manglabi-labihan. Sagō' sasuku mbal kapangandolan minsan ma ariki', kinulangan du ai-ai bay ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: Na, ya sosoho'an halam aniya' kapūsanna itu, larukinbi iya pehē' ni deyom kalendoman. Magaluran saga a'a mahē', magtage'ot isab empon sigām.’ ”  <div eID="gen4616" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4611" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2061"/><div sID="gen4617" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Hukuman ma Llaw Kahinapusan</title> <div sID="gen4618" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2061"/> Masi amandu' si Isa, yukna, “Bang aku Anak Manusiya' pabalik pi'itu maka sanglit-sahayaku, sinehe'an du aku e' kamemon saga mala'ikat. Aningkō' isab aku ma tingkō'an sultan.

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: Jari makatimuk pa'in palbangsa-bangsahan ma alopanku, papagsaddīku sigām, buwat a'a magipat hayop amapagsaddī bili-bilina maka kambingna.

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: Saga a'a adil, ya sali' hantang bili-bili, pasaddīku tampal ni kowan. A'a kasehe'an, ya hantang kambing, pasaddīku tampal ni gibang.

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: Jari angallam aku, ya pagsultanan sigām. Yukku ma saga a'a ma atagku tampal ni kowan, ‘Ka'am kabuwanan kahāpan e' Mma'ku, pi'itu na kam bo' kaniya'an palsuku'an ma deyom pagparintahanku, ya bay tinagamahan ka'am asal e' Tuhan sangay min waktu kapaniya' dunya itu.

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: Ya na ilu panungbas ka'am. Sabab bay aku lingantu ati pakanbi aku. Bay aku patay bohe' ati painumbi aku. Bay aku a'a liyu ati pa'iddabi aku ma deyom luma'bi.

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: Bay halam aniya' s'mmekku ati pas'mmekanbi aku. Bay aku asaki ati ussapbi aku. Bay aku ma deyom kalabusu ati tibawbi.’  <div eID="gen4618" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2062"/><div sID="gen4619" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2062"/> “Anambung du saga a'a adil inān, yuk-i, ‘Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' kami lingantu, ati pakan kami ka, atawa patay bohe' ati painum kami ka?

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' kami sali' a'a liyu, ati pa'idda kami ka ma deyom luma' kami? Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' halam aniya' s'mmeknu, ati pas'mmekan kami ka?

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' kami asaki atawa ma deyom kalabusu, ati tibaw kami ka?’

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: Sambunganku du saga a'a inān, yukku, ‘Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sumiyan-sumiyan aniya' bay kahinanganbi buwattē' ma dakayu' bebeya'anku areyo' kapaga'ana ilu, aku ya kahinanganbi.’  <div eID="gen4619" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2063"/><div sID="gen4620" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2063"/> “Puwas e', ah'lling aku ni saga a'a kasehe'an inān, ya ma atagku tampal ni gibang. Yukku, ‘Ala'an kam min aku, saga pagmulka'an Tuhan. Pehē' kam ni api nalka', ya tinagamahan nakura' saitan maka saga tendogna.

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: Ya na ina'an panungbas ka'am, sabab bay aku lingantu sagō' halam aku bay pakanbi. Bay aku patay bohe' sagō' halam aku bay painumbi.

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: Bay aku a'a liyu sagō' halam aku bay pa'iddabi ma deyom luma'bi. Bay halam aniya' s'mmekku sagō' halam aku bay pas'mmekanbi. Bay aku asaki, bay aku ma deyom kalabusu, sagō' halam aku bay tibawbi.’  <div eID="gen4620" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2064"/><div sID="gen4621" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2064"/> “Jari anambung du saga a'a inān, yuk sigām, ‘Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' kami lingantu, atawa patay bohe', atawa pina'an ni lahat kami sali' a'a liyu? Sumiyan ka bay ta'nda' kami halam aniya' s'mmeknu, atawa asaki, atawa ma deyom kalabusu, ati halam bay tinabang e' kami?’

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: Sambunganku sigām, yukku, ‘Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sumiyan-sumiyan kam halam bay anabang ma dakayu' bebeya'anku areyo' kapaga'ana itu, sali' aku ya halam bay tabangbi.’

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: Manjari saga a'a inān pinehē' du ni kabinasahan ya anatas ni kasaumulan. Sagō' in saga a'a adil pinaniya'an kalluman kakkal ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen4621" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.25"/> <div eID="gen4617" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2065"/><div sID="gen4622" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinagisunan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.1-Mark.14.2">Markus 14:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.1-Luke.22.2">Lukas 22:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.31-John.13.35">Yahiya 11:45-53</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4623" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2065"/> Aubus na e' si Isa pamandu'na kamemon, ati ah'lling iya ni saga mulidna.

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Asal kata'uwanbi, Hinang Paglakad na simuddai. Ya na ko' ina'an llaw pamatukbal Anak Manusiya' ni saga a'a bo' nilansang ni hāg pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen4623" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2066"/><div sID="gen4624" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2066"/> Manjari saga imam alanga maka saga pagmatto'ahan magtimuk pehē' ni astana' si Kayapas ya Imam Muwallam.

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: Magisun sigām bang buwattingga e' sigām anaggaw si Isa ma halam aniya' makata'u, bo' supaya iya pinapatay.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: “Sagō',” yuk sigām, “da'a pasalta'ta ma pagjamu, bo' mbal ahiluhala' saga a'a kamemon.”  <div eID="gen4624" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4622" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2067"/><div sID="gen4625" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Binu'usan Ns'llan Pahamut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.3-Mark.14.9">Markus 14:3-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.12.1-John.12.8">Yahiya 12:1-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4626" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2067"/> Na, ina'an si Isa ma Betani, ma deyom luma' si Simun, a'a bay ni'ipul.

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: Ma pagkakanan pa'in si Isa, aniya' pina'an ni iya dakayu' d'nda amowa bingki'-bingki' hinangan batu pote', isihan ns'llan pahamut landu' ahalga'. Jari binusugan e'na kōk si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga mulid, magtūy ap'ddi' atay sigām. “Ahalga' ns'llan itu, angay pinaka'at?” yuk sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: “Arapun du pa'in bay pinab'llihan ma hatusan pilak ati b'llihanna pamuwan ni saga a'a miskin.”  <div eID="gen4626" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2068"/><div sID="gen4627" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2068"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai pinagbissala e' saga mulid inān, angkan yukna, “Angay sasawbi d'nda itu? Ahāp sidda hinangna ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 26:11
verses.text: Paddas na pa'in aniya' a'a miskin ma ka'am, sagō' aku itu dai'-dai' du.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: Ya angkan d'nda itu bay amu'usan ns'llan pahamut ni baranku, pangawal llaw pagkubul ma aku.

verses.name: Matthew 26:13
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “pi'ingga-pi'ingga lahat pagnasihatan lapal ahāp ma kaluha'an dunya, kinissa du pasal bay hinang d'nda itu, pangentoman ma iya.”  <div eID="gen4627" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4625" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2069"/><div sID="gen4628" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanipu si Judas Iskariyut ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.10-Mark.14.11">Markus 14:10-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.3-Luke.22.6">Lukas 22:3-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4629" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2069"/> Puwas pa'in ina'an, si Judas Iskariyut, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa, bay pehē' ni kaimaman alanga amowa sigām magbissala.

verses.name: Matthew 26:15
verses.text: Yukna, “Ai pamuwanbi aku bang si Isa sōnganku ni ka'am?” Ni'itungan iya t'llumpū' solag sīn dī pilak panamba iya.

verses.name: Matthew 26:16
verses.text: Pagubus, amiha na si Judas waktu ahāp panōngna si Isa ni sigām.  <div eID="gen4629" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4628" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2070"/><div sID="gen4630" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsakap ma Hinang Paglakad<note>Hinang Paglakad: hinang pangentoman waktu bay kapaglakad ma bangsa Isra'il e' Mala'ikat Pangmumulka'.</note></title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.12-Mark.14.21">Markus 14:12-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.7-Luke.22.14">Lukas 22:7-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.21-Luke.22.23">21-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.21-John.13.30">Yahiya 13:21-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4631" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2070"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in tagna'an llaw pangisbat Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna, pehē' ni si Isa saga mulidna atilaw iya, yuk-i, “Maingga kabaya'annu panakapan kami pagjamuhannu ma Hinang Paglakad?”  <div eID="gen4631" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2071"/><div sID="gen4632" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2071"/> Yuk si Isa, “Aniya' dakayu' a'a ma deyom da'ira ilu, pehē' kam ni iya ati haka'inbi. Yukbi, ‘Sinō' ka nihaka'an e' guru, asekot na kono' waktu ya pangangganta' iya. Bilahi iya magjamu maka saga mulidna ma luma'nu bo' maghinang Hinang Paglakad.’ ”

verses.name: Matthew 26:19
verses.text: Na bineya' e' saga mulid inān bay panoho'an si Isa, ati sinakap e' sigām pagjamu Paglakad.  <div eID="gen4632" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2072"/><div sID="gen4633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2072"/> Pagabay kohap pa'in, magtingkō'an na si Isa maka saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa ma pagkakanan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:21
verses.text: Amangan pa'in, amissala si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am, aniya' dangan min ka'am magbantu anōngan aku ni bantaku.”  <div eID="gen4633" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2073"/><div sID="gen4634" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2073"/> Magtūy landu' asusa saga mulid he', ati atilaw sigām ma si Isa magsunu'-sunu', yuk-i, “Ngga'i ka bahā' aku, tuwan?”  <div eID="gen4634" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2074"/><div sID="gen4635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2074"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ya sehe'ku magt'nno'an tinapayna ni deyom pinggan itu, ya na iya anōngan aku.

verses.name: Matthew 26:24
verses.text: Aku itu, Anak Manusiya',” yuk si Isa, “amatay du buwat bay tasulat ma pasalanku. Sagō' asiya-siya du a'a anōngan Anak Manusiya' ni bantana. Ahāp lagi' a'a inān halam bay nianakan.”  <div eID="gen4635" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2075"/><div sID="gen4636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2075"/> Jari ah'lling si Judas, ya song anukbalan si Isa ni bantana. “Tuwan Guru,” yukna, “aku na bahā' ya pagbissalanu ilu?” <div eID="gen4636" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4637" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa, “Aho', buwat na yuknu ilu.”  <div eID="gen4637" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4630" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2076"/><div sID="gen4638" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Jamuhan Pangentoman ma Panghū' Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.22-Mark.14.26">Markus 14:22-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.14-Luke.22.20">Lukas 22:14-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="1Cor.11.23-1Cor.11.25">1 Kurintu 11:23-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2076"/> Hinabu sigām masi amangan, niā' tinapay e' si Isa. Niamu'an e'na pagsukulan bo' yampa pinagpōng-pōng e'na, ati pamuwanna ma saga mulidna. “Sambutunbi bo' kakanunbi,” yukna, “sabab in tinapay itu baranku ko'.”  <div eID="gen4639" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2077"/><div sID="gen4640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2077"/> Niā' isab e'na dakayu' sawan isihan binu-anggul, ati niamu'an isab pagsukulan bo' yampa sōnganna ni sigām. “Ka'am kamemon,” yukna, “inumunbi isi sawan itu.

verses.name: Matthew 26:28
verses.text: Laha'ku ko' itu, tanda' sin kapagsulutan Tuhan maka manusiya'. Song pinabu'us laha'ku ma sabab a'a aheka, pangampunan dusa sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, puwas itu mbal na aku anginum binu-anggul itu pabīng. Subay na kitam magbeya' anginum binu-anggul baha'u ma deyom pagparintahan Mma'ku bo' yampa aku makainum pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4640" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2078"/><div sID="gen4641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2078"/> Aubus pa'in e' sigām angalang dakayu' kalangan pamudji Tuhan, paluwas na sigām tudju ni būd Kayu Jaitun.  <div eID="gen4641" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4638" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2079"/><div sID="gen4642" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Papata si Isa Pasal Pamalilu si Petros</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">((<reference osisRef="Mark.14.27-Mark.14.31">Markus 14:27-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.31-Luke.22.34">Lukas 22:31-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.36-John.13.38">Yahiya 13:36-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4643" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2079"/> Manjari amūng si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Sangom itu alahi du kam kamemon ang'bba min aku, buwat tasulat ma Kitab Kanabi-nabihan, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4645"/>‘Bono'ku,’ yuk Tuhan, ‘a'a angupiksa' bili-bili,<l eID="gen4645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4646"/>ati akaukanat saga bili-bili bay daumpigan.’<l eID="gen4646" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4644"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:32
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku tapakallum na pabīng min kamatayku, parahū aku min ka'am tudju ni lahat Jalil.”  <div eID="gen4643" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2080"/><div sID="gen4647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2080"/> Ah'lling si Petros ni si Isa, yukna, “Mbal ka bbahanku minsan ka ni'bbahan e' kasehe'an.”  <div eID="gen4647" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2081"/><div sID="gen4648" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2081"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Haka'anta ka to'ongan. Ma sangom itu, ma halam gi' angukku'uk manuk, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal takilānu.”  <div eID="gen4648" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2082"/><div sID="gen4649" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2082"/> Yuk sambung si Petros, “Minsan aku paunung amatay ma ka'a, mbal du ka paliluhanku.” Buwattē' du isab pah'lling saga mulid kasehe'an.  <div eID="gen4649" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4642" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2083"/><div sID="gen4650" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Kabbun Getsemane</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.32-Mark.14.42">Markus 14:32-42</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.39-Luke.22.46">Lukas 22:39-46</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4651" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2083"/> Manjari palanjal na disi Isa ni kabbun niōnan Getsemane. Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Maitu kam aningkō'. Pina'an lagi' aku anabbut Tuhan.”

verses.name: Matthew 26:37
verses.text: Ya binowa e' si Isa panehe', si Petros maka duwangan anak si Sibidi. Sakali magkasusahan si Isa, magk'bba-k'bba deyom atayna.

verses.name: Matthew 26:38
verses.text: Yukna ni t'llungan mulidna he', “Aku itu agon-agon magkamamatay ma sabab kasusahan itu. Angagad kam maitu, sehe'inbi aku magjaga.”  <div eID="gen4651" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2084"/><div sID="gen4652" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2084"/> Makalawak-lawak pa'in iya min sigām, kum'ppang iya ni tana' maka e'na anabbut ni Tuhan. Yukna, “Arōy, Mma'! Bang makajari, la'anin lagi' min aku sawan kabinasahan itu. Sagō' ngga'i ka kabaya'anku subay nirūlan, bang pa'in min kabaya'annu du.”  <div eID="gen4652" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2085"/><div sID="gen4653" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2085"/> Puwas e' pabīng si Isa ni sehe'na kat'llungan, bo' tabākna sigām magtulihan. Yukna ni si Petros, “Angay kam mbal makatatas magjaga maka aku minsan la'a hal danjām?

verses.name: Matthew 26:41
verses.text: Pajaga kam, angamu' kam tabang ni Tuhan bo' kam mbal tabowa-bowa e' sasat. Lilla' asal deyom ataybi sagō' abuhat pamarananbi.”  <div eID="gen4653" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2086"/><div sID="gen4654" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2086"/> Sakali pehē' si Isa ni baina angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan pabīng. Yukna, “O Mma', bang mbal kala'anan kabinasahan itu, luwal bang kalabayanku, na, ka'a du iya abeya'.”

verses.name: Matthew 26:43
verses.text: Makabalik pa'in iya ni disi Petros, tabākna na isab sigām magtulihan pabīng sabab kinaru' sidda.  <div eID="gen4654" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2087"/><div sID="gen4655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2087"/> Manjari pehē' si Isa ni baina angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan pabīng buwat bay dahū, kamint'lluna na.

verses.name: Matthew 26:45
verses.text: Puwas e' pabalik iya ni mulidna kat'llungan. Yukna, “Oy, atuli gi' kam? Pahali-hali gi' kam? Nda'unbi ba, ta'abut na waktuku. Aku, Anak Manusiya' itu, arai' na tinukbalan ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ala'at.

verses.name: Matthew 26:46
verses.text: Pabungkal kam. Sūng kitam, sabab ilu na a'a ya anōngan aku ni sigām.”  <div eID="gen4655" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4650" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2088"/><div sID="gen4656" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsaggaw ma Si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.43-Mark.14.50">Markus 14:43-50</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.47-Luke.22.53">Lukas 22:47-53</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.3-John.18.12">Yahiya 18:3-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4657" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2088"/> Na, hinabu lagi' si Isa ah'lling ni saga mulidna, magtūy at'kka pina'an si Judas, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa he'. Aheka a'a magbeya' maka iya magpamowa takos maka saga kakakal. Bay sigām sinō' pina'an e' saga kaimaman alanga maka e' saga pagmatto'ahan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:48
verses.text: Bay sigām asal kabuwanan pandoga e' si Judas bo' aniya' pangilāhan sigām ma si Isa. Ya pamissalana ma sigām, “In a'a siyumku, ya na he' saggawunbi.”  <div eID="gen4657" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2089"/><div sID="gen4658" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2089"/> Pagt'kka si Judas pina'an magtūy iya pa'abut ni si Isa magaddat ma iya, yukna, “Salam, Tuwan Guru,” ati siyumna si Isa.  <div eID="gen4658" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2090"/><div sID="gen4659" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2090"/> “Bagay,” yuk si Isa ni iya, “lanjalin hinangnu.” <div eID="gen4659" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4660" type="paragraph"/> Sakali pasekot ni si Isa saga a'a inān anaggaw iya, amalutan iya pahogot.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' sehe' si Isa dakayu' bay angahurusan pakokosna. Nilagut e' a'a itu dakayu' sosoho'an Imam Muwallam, autas magtūy dambila' taingana.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Pabalikun takosnu ni tagubanna ilu, sabab sasuku amowa kalis pamapatay a'a, amatay du isab iya e' kalis.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi, bang aku angamu' tabang ni Mma'ku nirūlan sadja aku? Pinabeya'an du aku mala'ikatna ma ibuhan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku ganta' angamu' tabang, mbal magmaksud ya bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yukna in saga pakaradja'an itu subay pat'kka buwattitu.”  <div eID="gen4660" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2091"/><div sID="gen4661" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2091"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni ba'anan a'a inān, yukna, “Pangannalbi bahā' in aku itu mundu, ya po'on kam subay amowa takos maka kakakal panaggawbi aku? Llaw-llaw na pa'in aku bay mahē' aningkō' amandu' ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, sagō' halam aku saggawbi.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: Patut bang saga pakaradja'an itu kamemon pinat'kkahan aku bo' supaya aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat e' kanabi-nabihan ma deyom Kitab.” Magtūy maglahian saga mulid si Isa kamemon. Jari pinasagaran na iya.  <div eID="gen4661" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4656" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2092"/><div sID="gen4662" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Paharap ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.53-Mark.14.65">Markus 14:53-65</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.54-Luke.22.55">Lukas 22:54-55</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.63-Luke.22.71">63-71</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.13-John.18.24">Yahiya 18:13-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4663" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2092"/> Manjari binowa si Isa e' a'a bay anaggaw iya pina'an ni luma' si Kayapas ya Imam Muwallam. Ina'an magtimuk saga guru sara' agama maka pagmatto'ahan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: Si Petros bay paturul ma si Isa sagō' min katahan. Paturul iya sampay pasōd na ni deyom halaman luma' Imam Muwallam. Ma deyom pa'in, magtingkō'an iya maka saga jaga imam bang pa'in ta'nda'na bang ai kamattihan si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: Saga kaimaman alanga maka saga a'a ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum inān amiha sababan panuntut sigām ma si Isa, minsan ngga'i ka b'nnal, bang pa'in aniya' pagsababan pamapatay sigām ma iya.

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan aheka a'a bay anaksi' puting pasal si Isa, halam aniya' pagsababan b'nnal tabāk sigām. Ma katapusanna, aniya' duwangan a'a pa'alop ma palhimpunan ah'lling,

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: yuk sigā, “Bay takale kami a'a itu ah'lling in iya angalubu langgal pagkulbanan, ati ma deyom t'llung'llaw kono' tapat'nggena pabalik.”  <div eID="gen4663" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2093"/><div sID="gen4664" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2093"/> Manjari an'ngge Imam Muwallam amissala ma si Isa, yukna, “Ka'a ilu, halam bahā' aniya' da'awanu ma panuntut ka'a itu?”

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: Sagō' halam anambung si Isa. Amissala pabīng Imam Muwallam, yukna, “Pasapata ka ma ōn Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama. Haka'in kami to'ongan bang ka'a Al-Masi, Anak Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4664" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2094"/><div sID="gen4665" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2094"/> “Aho',” yuk si Isa, “ya na yuknu. Sagō' haka'anta kam, mbal du at'ggol ta'nda'bi du Anak Manusiya' aningkō' ma bihing Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, tampal ni kowan. Maka ta'nda'bi du iya pi'itu ameya' ma gabun min deyom sulga'.”  <div eID="gen4665" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2095"/><div sID="gen4666" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2095"/> Manjari ginese' e' Imam Muwallam pakayanna, kabowa astolna. Yukna, “A'a itu amah'lling pangkal ni Tuhan! Da'a na kitam amiha saksi' saddī! Takalebi na llingna pangkal!

verses.name: Matthew 26:66
verses.text: Ai pangahukumbi?” <div eID="gen4666" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4667" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung sigām, “Subay iya pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay.”  <div eID="gen4667" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2096"/><div sID="gen4668" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2096"/> Puwas e' niludja'an si Isa e' sigām ma baihu'na, maka pinagtibu'. Aniya' isab sigām bay anampak iya,

verses.name: Matthew 26:68
verses.text: maka e' sigām ah'lling, yuk-i, “Bang ka'a Al-Masi, tokorun bang sai ya bay anampak ka'a!”  <div eID="gen4668" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4662" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2097"/><div sID="gen4669" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamalilu si Petros Pasal si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.14.66-Mark.14.72">Markus 14:66-72</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.56-Luke.22.62">Lukas 22:56-62</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.15-John.18.18">Yahiya 18:15-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.25-John.18.27">25-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2097"/> Manjari ina'an si Petros aningkō' ma halaman luma' he'. Aniya' pehē' ni iya dakayu' d'nda, ipatan Imam Muwallam. Yuk d'nda itu ni iya, “Ka'a ilu, bay sa ka ameya' ma si Isa, ya a'a Jalil inān.”  <div eID="gen4670" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2098"/><div sID="gen4671" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2098"/> Sagō' amalilu si Petros ma alopan a'a inān kamemon. “Mbal kata'uwanku,” yukna, “bang ai ya pah'llingnu ilu.”

verses.name: Matthew 26:71
verses.text: Puwas e' pehē' iya tudju ni bowa' lawang, ati aniya' ipatan d'nda saddī bay maka'nda' iya. Pag'nda' d'nda itu ma si Petros, yukna ni saga a'a maina'an, “A'a itu bay ameya' ma si Isa, a'a Nasaret inān.”  <div eID="gen4671" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2099"/><div sID="gen4672" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2099"/> Magtūy amalilu si Petros pabīng maka anapahan iya di-na. “Mbal kata'uwanku a'a inān!” yukna.  <div eID="gen4672" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2100"/><div sID="gen4673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2100"/> Mbal at'ggol, pina'an ni si Petros saga a'a ya asal magt'nggehan maina'an. Yuk sigām, “Kata'uwan kami in ka'a b'nnal bay sehe' disi Isa sabab tapangli'ta ka ma bissalanu.”  <div eID="gen4673" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:74
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2101"/><div sID="gen4674" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2101"/> Minnē' magbalik-balik si Petros anapahan di-na. Ya pah'llingna, “Mbal takilāku a'a inān!” <div eID="gen4674" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4675" type="paragraph"/> Saru'un-du'un du angukku'uk manuk,

verses.name: Matthew 26:75
verses.text: ati taentom e' si Petros bay lling si Isa ma iya, ya bay yukna, “Ma mbal gi' angukku'uk manuk sangom itu, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.” Magtūy paluwas si Petros minnē'. Anangis iya maka he'na magdukka to'ongan.  <div eID="gen4675" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.26"/> <div eID="gen4669" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2102"/><div sID="gen4676" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinaharap ni Gubnul Pilatu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.1">Markus 15:1</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.1-Luke.23.2">Lukas 23:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.28-John.18.32">Yahiya 18:28-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2102"/> Ta'abut pa'in pagk'llat llaw, maggara' kaimaman alanga kamemon maka saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Yahudi bang buwattingga pamapatay sigām ma si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 27:2
verses.text: Manjari kinarenahan si Isa bo' yampa tin'kkahan ni si Pilatu, gubnul bangsa Rōm.  <div eID="gen4677" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4676" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2103"/><div sID="gen4678" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Judas</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Acts.1.18-Acts.1.19">Kahinangan 1:18-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2103"/> Pagta'u si Judas, in si Isa pinat'nna'an hukuman na ni kamatay, magtūy iya magsusun ma bay hinangna anukbalan iya ni bantana. Jari pehē' iya ni kaimaman alanga maka ni pagmatto'ahan, arak ang'nde' sīn bay panamba iya, t'llumpū' solag sīn Yahudi, dī pilak.

verses.name: Matthew 27:4
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Aheya dusaku sabab katukbalanku a'a halam taga-dusa, maka itiya' iya arai' na pinapatay.” <div eID="gen4679" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4680" type="paragraph"/> “Min ka'a ko' ilu,” yuk sigām. “Ngga'i ka min kami.”  <div eID="gen4680" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2104"/><div sID="gen4681" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2104"/> Sakali nihantakan sīn inān e' si Judas ni lantay langgal bo' yampa paluwas minnē' maggantung di-na bo' amatay.  <div eID="gen4681" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2105"/><div sID="gen4682" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2105"/> Manjari kaimaman inān amuwa' sīn bay nihantakan e' si Judas e'. Yuk sigām, “Sīn itu haram bang ma agamata sabab bay tambahan pamapatay a'a. Mbal manjari pinatimbul ni sīn langgal.”

verses.name: Matthew 27:7
verses.text: Arakayu' pa'in paggara' sigām pasal sīn inān, bo' wa'i tapam'lli tana' min a'a magtatampa, ati ginuna pangubulan saga a'a liyu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:8
verses.text: Angkan tana' inān niōnan, ‘Tana' tambahan laha'’ sampay ni kabuwattituhan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:9
verses.text: Na, ma sabab hinang inān, aniya' kamaksuranna ma bay tasulat e' nabi Irimiya, ya yukna, “Niā' e' sigām t'llumpū' solag sīn dī pilak ya halga' baran a'a bang ma bangsa Isra'il,

verses.name: Matthew 27:10
verses.text: ati ginuna pam'lli tana' min a'a magtatampa. Ya na he' bay panoho'an aku e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4682" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4678" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2106"/><div sID="gen4683" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sinumariya e' si Pilatu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.2-Mark.15.5">Markus 15:2-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.3-Luke.23.5">Lukas 23:3-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.33-John.18.38">Yahiya 18:33-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2106"/> Manjari ina'an si Isa an'ngge ma dahuan gubnul Pilatu, sinumariya e'na. “Na,” yuk gubnul, “sultan ka bahā' ma bangsa Yahudi?” <div eID="gen4684" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4685" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya na yuknu ilu.”

verses.name: Matthew 27:12
verses.text: Sagō' halam bay sambunganna saga tuntut bay panuntut iya e' kaimaman alanga maka pagmatto'ahan.  <div eID="gen4685" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2107"/><div sID="gen4686" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2107"/> Ah'lling si Pilatu ni iya, yukna, “Halam bahā' takalenu panuntut saga a'a itu ma ka'a?”  <div eID="gen4686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2108"/><div sID="gen4687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2108"/> Sagō' halam anambung si Isa minsan dakabtang, angkan ainu-inu to'ongan gubnul e'.  <div eID="gen4687" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4683" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2109"/><div sID="gen4688" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinat'nna'an Hukuman ni Kamatay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.6-Mark.15.15">Markus 15:6-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.13-Luke.23.25">Lukas 23:13-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.39-John.19.16">Yahiya 18:39-19:16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2109"/> Na, kahaba' tahun, ma waktu paghinang bangsa Yahudi ma Hinang Paglakad, ya kabiyaksahan gubnul subay aniya' dakayu' pilisu pinaluwas, sai-sai pinene' e' saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Matthew 27:16
verses.text: Ma waktu ina'an aniya' dakayu' pilisu babantugun, ōnna si Barabbas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:17
verses.text: Manjari, makapagtimuk pa'in pina'an kaheka'an a'a, tinilaw sigām e' si Pilatu. “Sai kabaya'anbi,” yukna, “subay paluwasku? Si Barabbas atawa si Isa, ya niōnan Al-Masi itu?”

verses.name: Matthew 27:18
verses.text: Malaingkan kinata'uwan e' gubnul bang ai sababanna angkan si Isa bay tin'kkahan ni iya. Tu'ud sigām angihid ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4689" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2110"/><div sID="gen4690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2110"/> Aningkō' pa'in si Pilatu ma lugal paghukuman, aniya' lapal pinabeya' ni iya e' h'ndana. Yuk lapal, “Da'a ka palamud ni hukuman a'a a'adil ilu. Sabab aniya' tauppiku dibuhi' pasalanna, sidda aku bay maglimpa-limpa.”  <div eID="gen4690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2111"/><div sID="gen4691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2111"/> Manjari ba'anan a'a inān bay tapogos e' kaimaman alanga maka e' pagmatto'ahan subay angamu' pinaluwas si Barabbas, bo' si Isa ya sinō' pinapatay.

verses.name: Matthew 27:21
verses.text: Sagō' tinilaw sigām pabīng e' gubnul e'. “Sai ma deyom duwangan pilisu itu,” yukna, “subay paluwasku?” <div eID="gen4691" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4692" type="paragraph"/> “Si Barabbas,” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen4692" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2112"/><div sID="gen4693" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2112"/> Atilaw si Pilatu ma sigām, yukna, “Inayku bahā' si Isa itu, ya niōnan Al-Masi?” <div eID="gen4693" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4694" type="paragraph"/> “Lansangun iya ni hāg,” yuk sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen4694" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2113"/><div sID="gen4695" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2113"/> Sagō' atilaw gi' si Pilatu. Yukna, “Ai bay hinangna ala'at?” <div eID="gen4695" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4696" type="paragraph"/> Luhūy pakosog pangolang saga a'a he', yuk-i, “Lansangun iya ni hāg!”  <div eID="gen4696" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2114"/><div sID="gen4697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2114"/> Pagta'u si Pilatu in katimukan a'a inān mbal pahawid maka arai' na aheya kahiluhala'an, magtūy iya angā' bohe' bo' yampa kose'anna tanganna ma dahuan sigām, paltanda'an in iya papuwas min palkala' he'. Yukna ni sigām, “Bang pa'in ngga'i ka min aku bang a'a itu pinapatay. Min kahinanganbi na.”  <div eID="gen4697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2115"/><div sID="gen4698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2115"/> Anambung saga a'a inān kamemon, yuk-i, “Akuhan kami kamatayna, minsan kami kapellengan sampay ni magsuring-magsaingsing.”  <div eID="gen4698" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2116"/><div sID="gen4699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2116"/> Sakali si Barabbas ya pinaluwas e' si Pilatu tudju ni ba'anan a'a he'.
