Sagō' si Isa pinaraplosan e'na ma saga sundalu. Pagubus, sinōngan iya ni saga a'a ya angalansang iya ni hāg.  <div eID="gen4699" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4688" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2117"/><div sID="gen4700" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinagtunggīng e' Saga Sundalu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.16-Mark.15.20">Markus 15:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.2-John.19.3">Yahiya 19:2-3</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2117"/> Manjari binowa si Isa e' saga sundalu gubnul pehē' ni deyom astana', ati tinimuk iya he' damba'an sundalu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:28
verses.text: Nila'anan e' sigām s'mmekna bo' pamajuba ma iya manta keyat sali' hantang sultan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:29
verses.text: Nilangbid isab bahan itingan e' sigām, nihinang sali' panumping sultan pinat'nna' ni kōkna. Puwas e' pina'ntanan iya tungkud ma tanganna kowan, bo' yampa sigām angōk-tu'ut ni dahuanna magtunggīng iya, yuk-i, “Mahaldika'! Mahaldika'! Sultan Yahudi!”

verses.name: Matthew 27:30
verses.text: Pinagludja'an iya e' sigām, niā' e' sigām tungkud bay ma tanganna bo' pam'ppok kōkna.

verses.name: Matthew 27:31
verses.text: Na, aubus pa'in kapagtunggīng sigām ma iya, magtūy niurusan manta bay pajubana inān ati pinas'mmekan iya maka bay s'mmekna tagna'. Puwas e' binowa iya paluwas minnē' bo' nilansang ni hāg pamapatayan iya.  <div eID="gen4701" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4700" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2118"/><div sID="gen4702" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Nilansang ni Hāg</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.21-Mark.15.32">Markus 15:21-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.26-Luke.23.43">Lukas 23:26-43</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.17-John.19.27">Yahiya 19:17-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2118"/> Salta' pa'in sigām paluwas min da'ira inān, aniya' talanggal sigām l'lla min lahat Kirini, ōnna si Simun. Minandahan iya e' saga sundalu, sinō' ananggung hāg si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 27:33
verses.text: Pagt'kka pa'in sigām ni jadjahan lahat niōnan Golgota, hatina lahat ‘Peya'-peya' Kōk’,

verses.name: Matthew 27:34
verses.text: arak pamainum sigām ma si Isa binu-anggul kalamuran tambal apa'it. Sagō' pag'ssana, mbal iya anginum.  <div eID="gen4703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2119"/><div sID="gen4704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2119"/> Aubus pa'in e' saga sundalu bay angalansang si Isa ni hāg sampay amat'ngge hāgna, maglegot na sigām bo' pinagtokoran e' sigām s'mmekna bang sai kat'nna'anna.

verses.name: Matthew 27:36
verses.text: Puwas e' aningkō' sigām maina'an anganjaga.

verses.name: Matthew 27:37
verses.text: Aniya' sulat panuntut bay pinat'nna' e' sigām ma hāg min diyata' kōk si Isa. Yuk sulat e', <div eID="gen4704" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4705" type="paragraph"/> ‘SI ISA, SULTAN BANGSA YAHUDI.’  <div eID="gen4705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2120"/><div sID="gen4706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2120"/> Aniya' isab duwangan mundu pinasambeya' ma si Isa. Nilansang sigām ma hāg, dakayu' ma bihing si Isa tampal ni kowan, dakayu' tampal ni gibang.  <div eID="gen4706" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2121"/><div sID="gen4707" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2121"/> Na, pinagudju' na pa'in si Isa e' a'a maglaulabay, pinaghanduk-handukan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:40
verses.text: “Allā,” yuk sigām, “ka'a iya angalangkat langgal pagkulbanan inān, ati pabangunnu kono' pabīng ma deyom t'llung'llaw! Angalappasan ka di-nu bang ka b'nnal Anak Tuhan. Pareyo' ka min hāg ilu!”

verses.name: Matthew 27:41
verses.text: Ya du magpangudju' saga imam alanga maka saga guru sara' agama maka saga pagmatto'ahan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:42
verses.text: “A'a itu,” yuk sigām, “ata'u angalappas ma a'a saddī sagō' mbal makalappas di-na. Sultan bangsa Isra'il kono' iya! Bang iya ganta' makapareyo'an di-na min hāg, am'nnal kitam ma iya!

verses.name: Matthew 27:43
verses.text: Angandol iya ma Tuhan, maka in iya kono' Anak Tuhan. Nda'ta kono' bang Tuhan bilahi angalappas iya!”

verses.name: Matthew 27:44
verses.text: Ya du duwangan mundu bay nilansang pinasambeya' ma si Isa, ameya'-meya' isab angudju' iya.  <div eID="gen4707" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4702" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2122"/><div sID="gen4708" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.33-Mark.15.41">Markus 15:33-41</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.44-Luke.23.49">Lukas 23:44-49</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.28-John.19.30">Yahiya 19:28-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4709" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2122"/> Na, augtu pa'in llaw, taluwa' lendom kaluha'an lahat e' sampay ni lisag t'llu kohap.

verses.name: Matthew 27:46
verses.text: Paglisag t'llu saga, akosog e' si Isa angalingan, yukna, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Hatina, “Tuhanku, O Tuhanku, angay aku pasagarannu?”  <div eID="gen4709" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2123"/><div sID="gen4710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2123"/> Pagkale itu e' saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an, yuk sigām kasehe', “Angalinganan iya nabi Elija.”

verses.name: Matthew 27:48
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' dakayu' a'a parai'-dai' ang'ggoman l'ppus ni deyom binu al'ssom bo' yampa pasagnatna ni tōng kayu-kayu. Arak pamainumna ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4710" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2124"/><div sID="gen4711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2124"/> Sagō' magin'mbal saga a'a kasehe', yuk-i, “Sagarinbi iya. Nda'ta lagi' bang patuwa' nabi Elija angalappas iya.”  <div eID="gen4711" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2125"/><div sID="gen4712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2125"/> Sakali angolang si Isa pabalik, magtūy ab'kkat napasna.  <div eID="gen4712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2126"/><div sID="gen4713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2126"/> Saru'un-du'un du ya kultina bay pangagpang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan inān agese' duwa min diyata'na tudju pareyo'. Ajogjog deyom dunya, maka magkabila' saga batu lakit.

verses.name: Matthew 27:52
verses.text: Aniya' isab kakubulan aukab maka aheka saga a'a suku' Tuhan bay pabungkal, allum pabīng min kamatay sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 27:53
verses.text: Magluwasan sigām min deyom kubul, jari allum pa'in si Isa pabīng, pasōd sigām ni Awrusalam, ya da'ira Mahasussi. Aheka a'a isab bay maka'nda' sigām.  <div eID="gen4713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2127"/><div sID="gen4714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2127"/> Tananam pa'in linug maka pakaradja'an inān kamemon e' kapitan maka saga sundaluna ya bay anganjaga ma kamatay si Isa, magtūy sigām sidda sinōd tāw. Yuk sigām, “B'nnal a'a itu Anak Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen4714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2128"/><div sID="gen4715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2128"/> Aheka isab saga d'nda bay maina'an ang'nda' min katahan. Sigām ya bay ameya' paumpig ma si Isa angussap iya, tinagna'an ma lahat Jalil lagi'.

verses.name: Matthew 27:56
verses.text: Ina'an si Mariyam min Magdala, si Mariyam ina' si Yakub maka si Yusup, maka h'nda si Sibidi.  <div eID="gen4715" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4708" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2129"/><div sID="gen4716" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkubul ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.15.42-Mark.15.47">Markus 15:42-47</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.50-Luke.23.56">Lukas 23:50-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.38-John.19.42">Yahiya 19:38-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2129"/> Pagabay kohap na, aniya' at'kka pina'an dakayu' a'a dayahan, a'a min lahat Arimati. Ōnna si Yusup.

verses.name: Matthew 27:58
verses.text: Na pehē' si Yusup itu pa'alop ni si Pilatu angamu' mayat si Isa. Jari magpanoho'an si Pilatu inān ni saga sundaluna, sinō' ni'nde'an mayat si Isa ni si Yusup.

verses.name: Matthew 27:59
verses.text: Ta'ā' pa'in mayat, sinaput e' si Yusup maka kakana' baha'u

verses.name: Matthew 27:60
verses.text: bo' yampa palegena ma kubul bay tagamahanna di-na, kubul baha'u bay kinehe'an ma deyom batu lakit. Puwas e' ginulungan e'na batu aheya panaplok bowa' lowang e' bo' yampa iya ala'an minna'an.

verses.name: Matthew 27:61
verses.text: Maina'an asal si Mariyam a'a Magdala, maka Mariyam isayna, aningkō' ma dahuan kubul inān.  <div eID="gen4717" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4716" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2130"/><div sID="gen4718" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nijagahan Kubul e' Umpigan Sundalu</title> <div sID="gen4719" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2130"/> Pagk'llat llaw dakayu', hatina llaw Sabtu', patimuk ni si Pilatu saga kaimaman alanga maka saga Parisi.

verses.name: Matthew 27:63
verses.text: Yuk sigām ni iya, “Tuwan, taentom kami ya bay lling a'a putingan inān ma waktu kallumna lagi'. Yukna bang ta'abut t'llung'llaw min kamatayna in iya allum du pabīng.

verses.name: Matthew 27:64
verses.text: Angkan kubulna inān subay soho'nu nijagahan sakuli-kuli sampay ta'abut kat'llung'llawna. Kalu pehē' saga mulidna anangkaw mayatna bo' angahaka ni kasehe'an in iya allum pabīng min kamatayna. Bang ganta' buwattē' akalap lagi' puting sigām damuli min bay dahū.”  <div eID="gen4719" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2131"/><div sID="gen4720" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2131"/> “Na,” yuk si Pilatu. “Bowahunbi sundalu pehē' ni kubul bo' pajagahunbi sakuli-kuli.”  <div eID="gen4720" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2132"/><div sID="gen4721" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2132"/> Manjari magla'anan na sigām minnē'. Aniya' gindan pinikit e' sigām ni taplok batu bo' kinata'uwan bang aniya' bay angukab iya. Sinō' isab saga sundalu anganjaga maina'an.  <div eID="gen4721" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.27"/> <div eID="gen4718" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2133"/><div sID="gen4722" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kallum si Isa Pabīng min Kamatay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.16.1-Mark.16.10">Markus 16:1-10</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.1-Luke.24.12">Lukas 24:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.1-John.20.10">Yahiya 20:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4723" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2133"/> Pagka palabay na llaw Sabtu', bo' pagk'llat llaw Ahad, ina'an si Mariyam a'a Magdala maka dakayu' isayna pehē' ang'nda' kubul si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 28:2
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un ajogjog lahat e' linug akosog. Aniya' dakayu' mala'ikat min Tuhan bay pareyo' min sulga' anganggulungan taplok batu min lowang kubul bo' yampa aningkō' ma diyata' batu he'.

verses.name: Matthew 28:3
verses.text: Asahaya pangluwahan mala'ikat inān buwat sawa lāt, maka s'mmekna apote' to'ongan.

verses.name: Matthew 28:4
verses.text: Saga sundalu anganjaga inān bay sinōd tāw angkan magpamidpid. Sali' sigām a'a amatay, halam makasayu.  <div eID="gen4723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2134"/><div sID="gen4724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2134"/> Manjari amissala mala'ikat ni duwangan d'nda he'. “Da'a kam tināw,” yukna. “Kata'uwanku in ka'am amiha si Isa, ya bay pinapatay ma hāg.

verses.name: Matthew 28:6
verses.text: Halam na iya maitu sabab allum na pabīng, buwat bay llingna. Pi'itu kam ang'nda' ni bay palegehanna.

verses.name: Matthew 28:7
verses.text: Puwas e', pasa'ut kam pehē' ni saga mulidna amowahan sigām haka in iya pinakallum min kamatayna. Parahū du iya min sigām ni lahat Jalil, ati maina'an sigām ang'nda' iya. Entomunbi bay pangahakaku itu ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen4724" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2135"/><div sID="gen4725" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2135"/> Magtūy sakadjap sadja sigām ala'an min kubul. Tināw sigām dambila', kinōgan isab dambila'. Paragan sigām pehē' angahaka ni saga mulid si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 28:9
verses.text: Ma labayan pa'in, saru'un-du'un du patuwa' si Isa amāk sigām. “Ka'am sa ilu,” yukna. Pa'abut sigām ni iya amalutan tape'na maka e' sigām amudji iya.

verses.name: Matthew 28:10
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Da'a kam tināw. Pehē' na kam angahaka'an saga danakanku inān in sigām subay pehē' ni lahat Jalil. Mahē' sigām ang'nda' aku.”  <div eID="gen4725" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4722" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2136"/><div sID="gen4726" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangahaka saga Jaga ma Kaimaman</title> <div sID="gen4727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2136"/> Sabu pa'in duwangan d'nda inān palanjal ni pal'ngnganan sigām, aniya' pabalik ni deyom da'ira saga sundalu kasehe' bay anganjagahan kubul. Kahaka'an e' sigām kaimaman alanga pasal bay pakaradja'an ma pagkubulan e'.

verses.name: Matthew 28:12
verses.text: Manjari magtimuk kaimaman maka saga pagmatto'ahan maggara'. Ya paggara' sigām in saga sundalu inān subay binuwanan sīn aheka.

verses.name: Matthew 28:13
verses.text: Yuk saga imam e', “Haka'inbi saga a'a in kamuliran si Isa bay pehē' waktu sangom anangkaw mayatna hinabubi bay atuli.

verses.name: Matthew 28:14
verses.text: Sagō' da'a kam asusa bang itu ganta' tata'u e' gubnul. Binissalahan iya pahāp bo' supaya kam mbal pinagamahan.”

verses.name: Matthew 28:15
verses.text: Manjari niā' sīn inān e' saga sundalu ati pangahaka e' sigām buwat bay panoho'an kaimaman e'. Sampay ni kabuwattituhan ya na he' hunub-hunub pinasaplag ma deyom bangsa Yahudi, hatina in mayat si Isa bay tinangkaw e' saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen4727" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4726" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2137"/><div sID="gen4728" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an Mbal Kaliyuhan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.16.14-Mark.16.18">Markus 16:14-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.36-Luke.24.49">Lukas 24:36-49</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.19-John.20.23">Yahiya 20:19-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Acts.1.6-Acts.1.8">Kahinangan 1:6-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4729" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2137"/> Manjari in kasangpū' maka dda mulid si Isa wa'i ni lahat Jalil, patukad ni būd ya bay pangahaka si Isa ma sigām.

verses.name: Matthew 28:17
verses.text: Pag'nda' sigām ma si Isa, magtūy sigām amudji iya, sagō' aniya' sigām kasehe'an magduwa-ruwa ma deyom atay sigām bang ina'an-i b'nnal si Isa.

verses.name: Matthew 28:18
verses.text: Pasekot si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Bay na aku kabuwanan kawasa magbaya' ma dunya sampay ma sulga'.

verses.name: Matthew 28:19
verses.text: Angkan kam soho'ku pehē' ni sabarang bangsa bo' sigām bowahunbi pamulid ma aku. Pandihunbi sigām min ōn Tuhan Mma', maka min ōn Anak, maka min ōn Rū<note>‘Rū Sussi’, hatina Rū Tuhan, ya pinagōnan isab Nyawa Sussi.</note> Sussi.

verses.name: Matthew 28:20
verses.text: Pandu'inbi sigām subay ameya' ma kamemon bay panoho'anku ka'am. Maka itu entomunbi pahāp, pagapi' du aku ma ka'am sampay niabutan masa.” <signed sID="gen4730"/> Tammat<signed eID="gen4730"/>  <div eID="gen4729" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4728" type="section"/> <div eID="gen3954" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Matt.28"/> <div eID="gen3949" osisID="Matt" type="book"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2138"/><div sID="gen4739" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagnasihat si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.1-Matt.3.12">Matiyu 3:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.3.1-Luke.3.18">Lukas 3:1-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.1.19-John.1.28">Yahiya 1:19-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2138"/> Ya na itu tagna'an lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi Anak Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 1:2
verses.text: Tasulat asal e' nabi Isaya ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4741"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4742"/>“Itiya' sosoho'anku,” yuk Tuhan.<l eID="gen4742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4743"/>“Soho'ku iya parahū min ka'a<l eID="gen4743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4744"/>bo' supaya sakapna lān palabayannu.”<l eID="gen4744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4745"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:3
verses.text: Aniya' a'a angalingan ma lahat paslangan, yukna,<l eID="gen4745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4746"/>“Lanu'inbi lān palabayan Panghū',<l eID="gen4746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4747"/>pabontolunbi pal'ngngananna.”<l eID="gen4747" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4741"/>  <div eID="gen4740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2139"/><div sID="gen4748" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2139"/> Manjari itu patuwa' si Yahiya pina'an ni lahat paslangan maka e'na amandi saga a'a tanda' saksi' in sigām ang'bba na min dusa sigām. Magnasihat iya ma saga a'a maina'an, yukna, “Pataikut kam min dusabi bo' kam pinandi, ati niampun dusabi e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Mark 1:5
verses.text: Jari aheka a'a pehē' ni si Yahiya min kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya maka min da'ira Awrusalam. Magpasab'nnal sigām pasal bay dusa sigām ati pinandi sigām e' si Yahiya ma sapa' Jordan.  <div eID="gen4748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2140"/><div sID="gen4749" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2140"/> Ya pas'mmek si Yahiya inān bulbul hayop unta' bay tin'nnun,<note>‘Tin'nnun’, hatina nihinang kakana'. ‘Nianyam’ bang ma kasehe'an.</note> maka dakayu' sabitan kuwit sapi' pakambot ma hawakanna. Ya kinakanna ampan dulu maka gula' buwani.

verses.name: Mark 1:7
verses.text: Anganasihat isab iya, yukna, “Aniya' pi'itu damuli min aku a'a akawasa lagi' min aku. Minsan engkot taumpa'na, mbal aku tinōp angahubaran iya.

verses.name: Mark 1:8
verses.text: Aku itu, hal bohe' ya pamandiku ka'am. Sagō' iya inān, saddī bowahan pamandina ma ka'am, hatina in iya amasangon Rū Sussi ni deyom baranbi.”  <div eID="gen4749" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4739" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2141"/><div sID="gen4750" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandi ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.13-Matt.3.17">Matiyu 3:13-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.3.21-Luke 3.22">Lukas 3:21-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4751" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2141"/> Jari itu, ma waktu he'-i, at'kka si Isa bay min Nasaret, dakayu' kauman mahē' ma lahat Jalil. Pinandi iya e' si Yahiya ma sapa' Jordan.

verses.name: Mark 1:10
verses.text: Na, makariyata' pa'in iya min deyom bohe' magtūy ta'nda'na paukab langit maka Rū Tuhan pareyo' tudju ni iya magpabaran magpasalupa assang.

verses.name: Mark 1:11
verses.text: Aniya' isab suwala ah'lling min deyom sulga', yuk-i, “Ka'a ya anakku kalasahanku, landu' makasulut atayku.”  <div eID="gen4751" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4750" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2142"/><div sID="gen4752" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanulay ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.4.1-Matt.4.11">Matiyu 4:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.1-Luke.4.13">Lukas 4:1-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4753" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2142"/> Jari pinapehē' magtūy si Isa e' Rū Tuhan ni lahat paslangan.

verses.name: Mark 1:13
verses.text: Mpatpū' llaw mpatpū' bahangi ya kamahe'na, sinasat na pa'in e' nakura' saitan, kalu tabowa magdusa. Ya sehe'na maina'an saga hayop talun, maka aniya' saga mala'ikat angayura iya.  <div eID="gen4753" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4752" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2143"/><div sID="gen4754" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amene' Mpat A'a Pamulid ma Iya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.4.12-Matt.4.22">Matiyu 4:12-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.14-Luke.4.15">Lukas 4:14-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.1-Luke.5.11">5:1-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4755" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2143"/> Na, takalabusu pa'in si Yahiya, pehē' si Isa ni lahat Jalil magnasihat pasal lapal ahāp min Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 1:15
verses.text: “Ta'abut na waktu bay pinagkallam,” yukna. “Asekot na waktu pagparinta Tuhan maitu ma manusiya'. Taikutinbi na dusabi maka kahagarunbi na lapal ahāp itu.”  <div eID="gen4755" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2144"/><div sID="gen4756" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2144"/> Manjari itu, hinabu si Isa pal'ngngan ma bihing danaw Jalil, aniya' ta'nda'na duwangan l'lla magdanakan, si Simun maka si Andariyas. Ina'an sigā angahūg pokot ma danaw, sabab magdaraing asal.

verses.name: Mark 1:17
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma sigā, “Pi'itu kam ameya' ma aku. Asal kam bay magā' daing sagō' bang aku ya pameya'anbi pandu'anta kam magā' pagkahibi manusiya' ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Mark 1:18
verses.text: Na, takale pa'in lling si Isa e' duwangan inān, magtūy ni'bbahan e' sigā pokot sigā ati ameya' na ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4756" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2145"/><div sID="gen4757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2145"/> Jari makalawak-lawak pa'in si Isa minnē' aniya' isab ta'nda'na duwangan l'lla magdanakan, si Yakub maka si Yahiya, anak si Sibidi. Ina'an sigā ma diyata' bayanan amahāp pokot.

verses.name: Mark 1:20
verses.text: Nilinganan magtūy sigā e' si Isa, jari ni'bbahan mma' sigā maina'an ma diyata' bayanan beya' maka saga tendogna ginagadjihan. Ati ameya' sigā ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4757" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4754" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2146"/><div sID="gen4758" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Kapala'anan Saitan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.4.31-Luke.4.37">Lukas 4:31-37</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2146"/> At'kka disi Isa pehē' ni da'ira Kapirnaum. Jari ta'abut pa'in llaw Sabtu', llaw mulliya ma bangsa Yahudi, pasōd si Isa ni deyom langgal maina'an amandu'an saga a'a.

verses.name: Mark 1:22
verses.text: Ainu-inu saga a'a makakale ma pamandu'na sabab atā pagbidda'anna maka pamandu' saga guru sara' agama. Taga-kawasa asal si Isa bang amandu'.  <div eID="gen4759" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2147"/><div sID="gen4760" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2147"/> Manjari ma waktu ina'an du aniya' l'lla sinōd saitan ma deyom langgal e'. Angolang iya pakosog, yukna,

verses.name: Mark 1:24
verses.text: “O Isa min Nasaret! Ai maksudnu pi'itu? Pi'itu ka bahā' amaka'at kami? Kata'uwanku bang sai ka. Ka'a ya Dakayu'-kayu' Asussi ya pi'itu min Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen4760" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2148"/><div sID="gen4761" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2148"/> Saguwā' nilāng saitan inān e' si Isa, yukna, “Pahali ka! Paluwas ka min a'a ilu!”  <div eID="gen4761" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2149"/><div sID="gen4762" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2149"/> Jari pinapaspad a'a inān e' saitan ati angolang iya pakosog bo' yampa paluwas min baranna.

verses.name: Mark 1:27
verses.text: Takuddat saga a'a kamemon bay maina'an, ya po'on sigām magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām, yuk-i, “Ai bahā' itu? Pandu' baha'u marai'. A'a itu taga-kawasa magpanoho'an minsan ma saga saitan ati bineya' iya e' sigām!”  <div eID="gen4762" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2150"/><div sID="gen4763" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2150"/> Manjari pasaplag magtūy kabantugan si Isa ni kaluha'an lahat Jalil e'.  <div eID="gen4763" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4758" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2151"/><div sID="gen4764" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka A'a Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.14-Matt.8.17">Matiyu 8:14-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.38-Luke.4.41">Lukas 4:38-41</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4765" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2151"/> Puwas e', paluwas disi Isa min langgal bo' pehē' ni luma' disi Simun maka si Andariyas. Parongan isab ma iya si Yakub maka si Yahiya.

verses.name: Mark 1:30
verses.text: Na, mato'a d'nda si Simun wa'i palege sabab ni'mmunan. Kahaka'an magtūy si Isa pasal sakina,

verses.name: Mark 1:31
verses.text: ati pina'an iya ni atag palegehanna. Binalutan e'na tangan d'nda he', tinabang papunduk. Manjari kauli'an mmunna ati pabuhat iya angalabot disi Isa.  <div eID="gen4765" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2152"/><div sID="gen4766" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2152"/> Pas'ddop pa'in llaw, binowa ni si Isa sasuku magsakihan atawa sinōd saitan.

verses.name: Mark 1:33
verses.text: Sikatimukan lawang luma' inān he' saga a'a kamemon min da'ira inān.

verses.name: Mark 1:34
verses.text: Aheka a'a bay kauli'an e' si Isa saki sigām kaginisan, maka aheka isab saitan bay pinaluwas e'na. Halam bay pasagaranna ah'lling saga saitan inān sabab kinata'uwan e' sigām bang sai si Isa.  <div eID="gen4766" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4764" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2153"/><div sID="gen4767" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anambahayang si Isa ma Lahat Halam Maga'a</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.4.42-Luke.4.44">Lukas 4:42-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4768" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2153"/> Pagsalung pa'in, ma halam gi' minsan apote' sobangan, punduk si Isa bo' ala'an min luma'. Pehē' iya ni jadjahan halam maga'a bo' anambahayang.

verses.name: Mark 1:36
verses.text: Na, pagka iya halam ma luma', piniha iya e' disi Simun.

verses.name: Mark 1:37
verses.text: Jari tabāk pa'in, ah'lling sigām ni iya, yuk-i, “Ina'an saga a'a kamemon amiha ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4768" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2154"/><div sID="gen4769" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2154"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Sūng kitam palintas ni kaluma'an kasehe'. Subay aku magnasihat isab mahē' sabab ya na he' po'onna angkan aku pi'itu ni dunya.”

verses.name: Mark 1:39
verses.text: Jari nilatag e' si Isa kaluha'an lahat Jalil inān. Magnasihat iya ma deyom kalanggalan sigām maka pinaluwas e'na saga saitan bay ma deyom baran a'a.  <div eID="gen4769" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4767" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2155"/><div sID="gen4770" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Ni'ipul Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.1-Matt.8.4">Matiyu 8:1-4</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.12-Luke.5.16">Lukas 5:12-16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4771" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2155"/> Manjari aniya' a'a ni'ipul pehē' ni si Isa. Pasujud iya ma atag si Isa, maka e'na anganjunjung, yukna, “Bang ka bilahi, kauli'annu du aku.”  <div eID="gen4771" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2156"/><div sID="gen4772" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2156"/> T'kkahan ase' si Isa ma a'a inān ati pa'abutna tanganna ni iya. “Bilahi sadja aku,” yukna. “Palanu' ka.”

verses.name: Mark 1:42
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du ala'an ipul a'a inān, ati kauli'an na iya.

verses.name: Mark 1:43
verses.text: Magtūy iya pinaba'id amole' e' si Isa maka niamay-amayan isab e'na.

verses.name: Mark 1:44
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Da'a ka angahaka ni sai-sai ya bay tahinang itu ma ka'a. Saguwā' pehē' ka patūy ni imam bo' palilingun barannu ma iya. Puwas e' tukbalin pagkulban ni Tuhan buwat bay pamandu' si Musa, tanda' saksi' ni kaheka'an a'a in ka'a ilu alanu' na min sakinu.”  <div eID="gen4772" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2157"/><div sID="gen4773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2157"/> Sagō' a'a inān paluwas minnē' maka e'na anuli-nuli to'ongan pasal ipulna bay kauli'an. Pasaplag suli-sulina, angkan si Isa mbal na makatampal ma deyoman kauman. Maina'an sadja iya ma jadjahan kulang a'ana. Sagō' pehē' na pa'in ni iya saga a'a min kalahat-lahatan.  <div eID="gen4773" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.1"/> <div eID="gen4770" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2158"/><div sID="gen4774" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Amatay Ugatna Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.1-Matt.9.8">Matiyu 9:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.17-Luke.5.26">Lukas 5:17-26</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4775" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2158"/> Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, pabīng si Isa pehē' ni da'ira Kapirna'um ati tata'u in iya ina'an na ma luma'.

verses.name: Mark 2:2
verses.text: Jari landu' aheka a'a patimuk pina'an ni luma' pat'nna'an si Isa ya angkan halam aniya' palabayan minsan ma luwasan bowa' lawang. Ati ninasihatan sigām e' si Isa lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 2:3
verses.text: Pasalta', aniya' pina'an ni iya mpat a'a magtanggung a'a dangan amatay ugatna.

verses.name: Mark 2:4
verses.text: Sagō' mbal sigām makasekot ni si Isa sabab kaheka a'a inān, ya angkan sigām bay angalangkat atop min diyata' kōk si Isa. Tahinang pa'in pasōran e' sigām, pinatonton a'a amatay ugatna inān palege ma diyata' palegehanna.

verses.name: Mark 2:5
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in si Isa in a'a ananggung inān angandol ma iya, yukna ni a'a amatay ugatna, “Oto', niampun na dusanu.”  <div eID="gen4775" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2159"/><div sID="gen4776" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2159"/> Na, aniya' magtingkō'an maina'an saga guru sara' agama. Amikil-mikil sigām pasal bay pah'lling si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 2:7
verses.text: “Oy!” yuk sigām. “Angay a'a itu! Bissala kupul ko' ya pah'llingna ma Tuhan. Halam aniya' maka'ampun dusa, luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'!”  <div eID="gen4776" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2160"/><div sID="gen4777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2160"/> Kinata'uwan magtūy e' si Isa bang ai ya pinikil e' sigām angkan yukna ma sigām, “Angay kam magtilaw-tilaw buwattilu ma deyom pikilanbi!

verses.name: Mark 2:9
verses.text: Kumpasunbi bang ingga ya aluhay, bang yukku ma a'a, ‘Niampun na dusanu’, atawa bang yukku, ‘Pabungkal ka, bowahun palegehannu bo' ka lum'ngngan na’?

verses.name: Mark 2:10
verses.text: Na, buwananta kam tanda' palsaksi'an bo' kata'uwanbi in aku, Anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut du angampun dusa ma deyom dunya itu.” Jari ah'lling si Isa ni a'a amatay ugatna he', yukna,

verses.name: Mark 2:11
verses.text: “Ya na itu llingku ma ka'a, pabungkal na ka. Bowahun palegehannu ilu amole'.”  <div eID="gen4777" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2161"/><div sID="gen4778" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2161"/> Jari pabungkal a'a inān, maka e'na amowa palegehanna. Paluwas iya minnē' min pang'nda' saga a'a inān kamemon. Landu' sigām ainu-inu kamemon, ati sinanglitan Tuhan e' sigām, yuk-i, “Yamboho' kitam maka'nda' buwattitu.”  <div eID="gen4778" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4774" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2162"/><div sID="gen4779" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Libi Binowa Pamulid ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.9-Matt.9.13">Matiyu 9:9-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.27-Luke.5.32">Lukas 5:27-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2162"/> Jari itu pabīng na si Isa pehē' ni bihing danaw Jalil. Patimuk ni iya saga a'a landu' aheka ati pandu'anna sigām.

verses.name: Mark 2:14
verses.text: Pasalta' pa'in iya lum'ngngan, ta'nda'na si Libi anak si Alpa aningkō' ma deyom upisna, ya pagbabayaran sukay parinta. Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Pi'itu na ka ameya' ma aku.” An'ngge magtūy si Libi bo' ameya' ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2163"/><div sID="gen4781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2163"/> Puwas minna'an, hinabu si Isa amangan ma luma' si Libi, aheka saga magā' sukay parinta maka saga a'a baldusa kasehe', pina'an pasalu ni iya maka saga mulidna. Aheka asal bay pamulid ma iya.

verses.name: Mark 2:16
verses.text: Jari aniya' maina'an guru sara' agama Yahudi min umpigan Parisi. Pag'nda' sigām ma si Isa dangkakanan maka saga a'a baldusa maka saga maga'ā' sukay parinta, ah'lling sigām ni saga mulid si Isa, yuk-i, “Angay si Isa palamud magsalu maka a'a baldusa ilu?”  <div eID="gen4781" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2164"/><div sID="gen4782" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2164"/> Takale e' si Isa patilaw saga guru inān ati yukna ma sigām, “Bang a'a abasag mbal magpadoktol. Ya magpadoktol bang a'a taga-saki. Ngga'i ka a'a ahāp ya bay mohotku pi'itu ni dunya, sagō' a'a taga-dusa, bo' supaya sigām ameya' ma aku.”  <div eID="gen4782" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4779" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2165"/><div sID="gen4783" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagpuwasa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.14-Matt.9.17">Matiyu 9:14-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.5.33-Luke.5.39">Lukas 5:33-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4784" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2165"/> Ma dakayu' llaw, pasalta' pa'in magpamuwasa saga mulid si Yahiya maka saga a'a Parisi, aniya' a'a pehē' ni si Isa atilaw iya. Yuk sigām, “Magpuwasa saga mulid si Yahiya Magpapandi maka saga mulid Parisi, sagō' mulidnu mbal amuwasa. Angay bahā'?”  <div eID="gen4784" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2166"/><div sID="gen4785" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2166"/> Anambung si Isa magparalilan, yukna, “Amuwasa bahā' saga luruk sat'ggol maina'an lagi' pangantin l'lla ma atag sigām? Tantu mbal. Mbal sigām amuwasa sat'ggol ina'an ma sigām pangantin l'lla.

verses.name: Mark 2:20
verses.text: Sagō' ma llaw sinōng, bang ta'abut llaw pamala'an pangantin l'lla min sigām, ya na he' waktu pagpuwasa.”  <div eID="gen4785" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2167"/><div sID="gen4786" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2167"/> Amaralil gi' si Isa pasal pamandu' tagna' maka pamandu'na, yukna, “Halam aniya' a'a amatupak kakana' baha'u ni badju' ndang. Bang ganta' buwattē' hinangna, pakongkong tupak baha'u, ati agese' min badju' ndang e'. Jari paheya gom pa'in gese'na.”

verses.name: Mark 2:22
verses.text: Pinaralil isab pamandu'na ni binu-anggul baha'u, yukna, “Halam aniya' angisi binu baha'u, ya masi gi' amukal, ni deyom pangisihan ndang. Bang ganta' buwattē' hinangna tantu abustak pangisihan e' binu-anggul. Abu'us binu ati kaugun bay pangisihan e'. Sagō' in binu baha'u subay ni'isi ni pangisihan baha'u.”  <div eID="gen4786" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4783" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2168"/><div sID="gen4787" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pandu' Pasal Llaw Paghali</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.1-Matt.12.8">Matiyu 12:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.1-Luke.6.5">Lukas 6:1-5</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4788" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2168"/> Ma dakayu' llaw Sabtu', llaw mulliya ma saga Yahudi, ina'an disi Isa lum'ngngan labay min t'ngnga' huma pananoman pai-tirigu. Jari itu, salta' ma pal'ngnganan, aniya' pai kin'ttu' e' saga mulid e'.

verses.name: Mark 2:24
verses.text: Ah'lling saga Parisi ni si Isa, yuk sigām, “Nda'un ba saga mulidnu ilu! Talanggal e' sigām sara' agamatam maghinang buwattilu ma llaw Sabtu'!”  <div eID="gen4788" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2169"/><div sID="gen4789" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2169"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Angay, halam bahā' bay tabassabi pasal bay tahinang e' si Da'ud ma waktu si Abiyatar bay Imam Muwallam? Bay aotas si Da'ud maka saga a'ana pagka halam aniya' ai-ai takakan sigām. Jari bay pasōd si Da'ud ni deyom luma' pangarapan ni Tuhan ati takakanna saga tinapay ya pinat'nna' maina'an panukbal ni Tuhan. Na bang ma agamatam, luwal du saga kaimaman wajib amangan tinapay bay tinukbalan inān, malaingkan kinakan e' si Da'ud maka bay pamuwanna isab ma saga sehe'na. Saguwā' halam iya bay makarusa maghinang buwattē'.

verses.name: Mark 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2169"/><div sID="gen4789" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2169"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Angay, halam bahā' bay tabassabi pasal bay tahinang e' si Da'ud ma waktu si Abiyatar bay Imam Muwallam? Bay aotas si Da'ud maka saga a'ana pagka halam aniya' ai-ai takakan sigām. Jari bay pasōd si Da'ud ni deyom luma' pangarapan ni Tuhan ati takakanna saga tinapay ya pinat'nna' maina'an panukbal ni Tuhan. Na bang ma agamatam, luwal du saga kaimaman wajib amangan tinapay bay tinukbalan inān, malaingkan kinakan e' si Da'ud maka bay pamuwanna isab ma saga sehe'na. Saguwā' halam iya bay makarusa maghinang buwattē'.

verses.name: Mark 2:27
verses.text: Llaw paghali itu,” yuk si Isa ma saga Parisi inān, “bay pinaniya' e' Tuhan panabang ma manusiya'. Ngga'i ka manusiya' ya pinapanjari ma sabab aniya' llaw Sabtu'.

verses.name: Mark 2:28
verses.text: Aku itu, anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut magbaya' ma llaw Sabtu', ya llaw paghali ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4789" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.2"/> <div eID="gen4787" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2170"/><div sID="gen4790" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Pakongkong Tanganna Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.9-Matt.12.14">Matiyu 12:9-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.6-Luke.6.11">Lukas 6:6-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4791" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2170"/> Manjari pasōd pabalik si Isa ni deyom langgal. Aniya' maina'an a'a pakongkong tanganna.

verses.name: Mark 3:2
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga Parisi maina'an amiha palsababan panuntut sigām ma si Isa, angkan iya nijagahan e' sigām kalu iya amauli' saki a'a he' ma llaw Sabtu'.

verses.name: Mark 3:3
verses.text: Jari ah'lling si Isa ni a'a pakongkong tanganna, yukna, “Pi'itu ka an'ngge ma t'ngnga' itu.”

verses.name: Mark 3:4
verses.text: Puwas e' tinilaw e' si Isa saga a'a he', yukna, “Ai ya apatut nihinang ma llaw paghali? Hinang makahāp ka atawa hinang makala'at? Amakallum ka atawa amapatay?” <div eID="gen4791" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4792" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' halam aniya' panambung sigām.

verses.name: Mark 3:5
verses.text: Pinatongan sigām dangan maka dangan e' si Isa. Angastol iya maka asusa sabab agagga sigām alasahan pagkahi sigām. Jari yukna ma a'a pakongkong tanganna inān, “Pah'nnatun tangannu ilu.” Na, pinah'nnat e'na ati kauli'an iya.

verses.name: Mark 3:6
verses.text: Paluwas magtūy saga Parisi min langgal e' ati parai'-dai' sigām magisun maka saga bebeya'an sultan Herod bang buwattingga e' sigām amapatay si Isa.  <div eID="gen4792" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4790" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2171"/><div sID="gen4793" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Landu' Aheka A'a Paurul ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen4794" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2171"/> Manjari itu magla'anan disi Isa maka saga mulidna tudju ni bihing danaw. Sidda aheka a'a bay paturul, ngga'i ka hal min lahat Jalil

verses.name: Mark 3:8
verses.text: sagō' min lahat Yahudiya isab maka min da'ira Awrusalam. Aniya' isab a'a min lahat Idumiya maka min dambila' sapa' Jordan, maka min lahat isab ya ma jadjahan da'ira Tira maka Sidun. Saga a'a aheka itu pina'an ni si Isa sabab takale e' sigām pasal saga hinang bay tahinangna.

verses.name: Mark 3:9
verses.text: Jari sinoho' e' si Isa saga mulidna angal'bbos bayanan paruwa'anna bo' supaya iya mbal tagipit e' katimukan a'a inān.

verses.name: Mark 3:10
verses.text: Pagka aheka a'a bay kauli'an e'na, sasuku taga-saki pajudjal na pa'in bo' supaya pa'abut tangan sigām ni iya.

verses.name: Mark 3:11
verses.text: Pag'nda' isab saga a'a sinōd saitan ma iya, magpatihantak sigām ma dahuanna maka e' sigām angolang, yuk-i, “Ka'a ilu Anak Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen4794" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2172"/><div sID="gen4795" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2172"/> Sagō' nilāng saga saitan e' si Isa, sinō' da'a angahaka ni a'a bang sai iya.  <div eID="gen4795" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4793" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2173"/><div sID="gen4796" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangwakil saga Mulid si Isa Kasangpū' maka Duwa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.1-Matt.10.4">Matiyu 10:1-4</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.6.12-Luke.6.16">Lukas 6:12-16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2173"/> Manjari itu patukad si Isa pehē' ni lorosan būd. Nilinganan e'na pina'an saga a'a kabaya'anna nihinang mulid, ati patukad sigām pehē' ni iya.

verses.name: Mark 3:14
verses.text: Jari pinene' e'na sangpū' maka duwa a'a ati ōnanna sigām a'a kawakilanna. Yukna ma sigām, “Ka'am ilu bay pene'ku anehe'an aku. Soho'ta kam lum'ngngan isab magnasihat lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 3:15
verses.text: Pinaniya'an du kam kawasa pamala'an saga saitan min deyom baran a'a.”  <div eID="gen4797" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2174"/><div sID="gen4798" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2174"/> Ya na itu ōn a'a kasangpū' maka duwa ya bay tapene' e' si Isa: si Simun, ya bay ōnanna isab Petros,

verses.name: Mark 3:17
verses.text: bo' si Yakub maka si Yahiya, saga anak si Sibidi. Niranglay duwangan itu e' si Isa “Bowanerges”, hatina a'a sali' dalil l'ggon.

verses.name: Mark 3:18
verses.text: Pasunu' si Andariyas maka si Pilip, si Bartolome maka si Matiyu, si Tomas maka si Yakub anak si Alpa. Pasunu' isab si Taddiyu, bo' si Simun a'a pangangatu.

verses.name: Mark 3:19
verses.text: Katapusan si Judas Iskariyut ya anukbalan si Isa ni saga bantana ma waktu damuli minnē'.  <div eID="gen4798" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4796" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2175"/><div sID="gen4799" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka Be'elsebul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.22-Matt.12.33">Matiyu 12:22-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.11.14-Luke.11.23">Lukas 11:14-23</reference> <reference osisRef="Luke.12.10">12:10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4800" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2175"/> Pagubus, pasōd disi Isa ni luma' ati aheka a'a patimuk pabīng pina'an, ya po'on si Isa maka mulidna mbal makaluhaya minsan amangan.

verses.name: Mark 3:21
verses.text: Jari itu, pagka takale e' saga matto'a-danakan si Isa pasal itu-i, pehē' sigām angā' iya. Sabab na maghimumungan saga a'a in si Isa kono' inān kulang pikilanna.  <div eID="gen4800" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2176"/><div sID="gen4801" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2176"/> Aniya' isab saga guru sara' agama bay palūd pina'an min Awrusalam. Angupama sigām, yuk-i, “Si Isa itu sinōd Be'elsebul ya pagnakura'an saga saitan, angkan iya makapala'an saga saitan min deyom baran a'a.”  <div eID="gen4801" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2177"/><div sID="gen4802" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2177"/> Jari nilinganan saga a'a inān e' si Isa, ati magparalilan iya ma sigām, yuk-i, “Na, buwattingga e' saitan amala'an saitan? Mbal makajari!

verses.name: Mark 3:24
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' pagsultanan abahagi' duwa saga a'ana bo' magbono'-biyono'i, mbal anatas pagsultanan e'.

verses.name: Mark 3:25
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang aniya' a'a magdaokom abahagi' duwa ati magsagga'an di-sigām, magkaukanat sadja sigām.

verses.name: Mark 3:26
verses.text: Angkanna, bang nakura' saitan magsagga' maka pagkahina saitan ati abahagi' duwa, mbal du anatas pagnakura'na. Al'kkas du pahalam.

verses.name: Mark 3:27
verses.text: Nakura' saitan itu sali' dalil a'a aga'os taga-luma'. Luma'na mbal tasōd, ai-aina mbal kalangpasan, luwal bang a'a ga'osan inān niengkotan dahū bo' yampa kalangpasan deyom luma'na.  <div eID="gen4802" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2178"/><div sID="gen4803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2178"/> “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa. “Niampun du e' Tuhan kamemon dusa manusiya' sampay lling sigām pangkal ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 3:29
verses.text: Sagō' bang Rū Sussi ya pinah'llingan pangkal e' a'a, halam to'ongan aniya' ka'ampunan a'a inān sabab angakkot dusana ma iya saumul-umul.”

verses.name: Mark 3:30
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Isa sabab aniya' amūng-mūng in iya sinōd saitan.  <div eID="gen4803" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4799" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2179"/><div sID="gen4804" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ina' si Isa maka Dauranakanna L'lla</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.46-Matt.12.50">Matiyu 12:46-50</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.19-Luke.8.21">Lukas 8:19-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2179"/> Jari itu at'kka pina'an ina' si Isa maka saga danakanna l'lla. Angagad sigām ma luwasan luma' he' ati amabeya' sigām haka ni si Isa sinō' paluwas.

verses.name: Mark 3:32
verses.text: Aheka a'a bay magtingkō'an ma sakalibut si Isa, yuk sigām ma iya, “Tuwan, ilu ina'nu maka saga danakannu ma luwasan. Amiha ka'a kono'.”  <div eID="gen4805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2180"/><div sID="gen4806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2180"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Sai bahā' ina'ku maka sai saga danakanku?”

verses.name: Mark 3:34
verses.text: Ang'nda' iya ma saga a'a magtingkō'an ma sakalibutna ati yukna, “Ya na ko' itu ina'ku maka dauranakanku.

verses.name: Mark 3:35
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai angahinang kabaya'an Tuhan, ya na ko' ina'an saga danakanku l'lla-d'nda maka ina'ku.”  <div eID="gen4806" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.3"/> <div eID="gen4804" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2181"/><div sID="gen4807" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Anaboran Bigi-tinanom</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.1-Matt.13.9">Matiyu 13:1-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.4-Luke.8.8">Lukas 8:4-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4808" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2181"/> Pabalik na isab si Isa amandu' ma bihing danaw Jalil. Landu' aheka a'a bay patimuk pina'an ni atagna, angkan iya paruwa' aningkō' ma bayanan bay palayo asal maina'an. Ina'an isab sikatimukan saga a'a ma bihing tampe, ma gintana'an.

verses.name: Mark 4:2
verses.text: Jari aheka pamandu' e' si Isa ma saga a'a inān, pandu' pamaralilan. Buwattitu pamandu'na, yukna,

verses.name: Mark 4:3
verses.text: “Pakale kam. Aniya' inān dakayu' a'a pehē' ni humana anaboran bigi-tinanom.

verses.name: Mark 4:4
verses.text: Pagsabodna itu, aniya' bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni bihing lān. Sakali pina'an saga manuk-manuk anittuk iya.

verses.name: Mark 4:5
verses.text: Aniya' isab bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni kabatuhan ariki' tana'na. Bigi-tinanom inān al'kkas patomo' sabab mbal alalom tana'na.

verses.name: Mark 4:6
verses.text: Sagō' pasilak pa'in llaw, magtūy alūs ugbusna inān sampay alanos, sabab halam alalom gamutna.

verses.name: Mark 4:7
verses.text: Aniya' du isab bigi-tinanom apakpak ni t'ngnga' sagmot itingan. Makasubud pa'in sagmot inān, magtūy kasembolan tinanom ati mbal magbuwa'.

verses.name: Mark 4:8
verses.text: Na, ya bigi kasehe' wa'i apakpak ni tana' ahāp. Manjari saga bigi-tinanom itu patomo' maka pasulig ati magbuwa' ahāp. Aniya' batang kasehe' amuwan buwa' sarang-sarang, aniya' kasehe' amuwan buwa' aheka, maka aniya' isab kasehe' amuwan buwa' lumandu'an to'ongan hekana.

verses.name: Mark 4:9
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “sasuku kam makakale, ikutunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4808" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4807" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2182"/><div sID="gen4809" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angkan si Isa Magparalilan Bang Amandu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.10-Matt.13.17">Matiyu 13:10-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.9-Luke.8.10">Lukas 8:9-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4810" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2182"/> Manjari itu, magla'anan pa'in katimukan a'a he', pasekot ni si Isa saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa maka saga a'a kasehe'an bay maina'an. Tinilaw iya e' sigām pasal kissa bay pamaralilna ma sigām bang ai hatina.

verses.name: Mark 4:11
verses.text: Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am ilu kabuwanan pangita'u bo' supaya tahatibi pasal kapagparinta Tuhan ma saga a'a suku'na, ya halam pata'una ni manusiya' kasehe'. Saguwā' saga a'a kasehe'an, ya ma luwasan, subay kinissahan saga kissa pamaralilan,

verses.name: Mark 4:12
verses.text: supaya sigām makasali' ni bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4811"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4812"/>‘Ang'nda' du sigām sagō' mbal maka'nda'.<l eID="gen4812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4813"/>Akale du sigām sagō' mbal makahati.<l eID="gen4813" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4814"/>Bang ngga'i ka buwattē', bay du sigām pabalik<l eID="gen4814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4815"/>magta'at ni Tuhan bo' niampun dusa sigām.’ ”<l eID="gen4815" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4811"/>  <div eID="gen4810" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4809" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2183"/><div sID="gen4816" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamahati Pasal A'a Anaboran Bigi-tinanom</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.18-Matt.13.23">Matiyu 13:18-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.11-Luke.8.15">Lukas 8:11-15</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4817" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2183"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa ma sigām, “halam bahā' tahatibi bay pamaralilku ma ka'am he'? Bang he'-i mbal tahatibi daka buwattingga e'bi angahati ma pamaralilan kamemon ya pamandu'ku.

verses.name: Mark 4:14
verses.text: Ya a'a magsabod bigi-tinanom he', ya na a'a magnasihat palman Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 4:15
verses.text: Maka saga a'a kasehe'an sali' dalil lān bay kapakpakan bigi-tinanom inān. Pagkale pa'in sigām ma palman Tuhan, magtūy pina'an nakura' saitan angandagtu' palman Tuhan ya patanom ma deyom atay sigām.

verses.name: Mark 4:16
verses.text: Saga a'a kasehe'an sali' dalil tana' kabatuhan bay kapakpakan bigi-tinanom inān. Pagkale sigām ma palman Tuhan, magtūy tinaima' e' sigām maka kinōgan sigām.

verses.name: Mark 4:17
verses.text: Sagō' palman Tuhan itu halam bay anganggamut palalom ma deyom atay sigām, angkan pagiman sigām mbal anatas pat'ggol. Ta'abut pa'in sigām t'kkahan susa atawa nila'at e' pagkahi sigām ma sabab pameya' sigām ma palman Tuhan, magtūy sigām ang'bba min pagiman sigām.

verses.name: Mark 4:18
verses.text: Saga a'a kasehe'an isab sali' dalil tana' bay katomo'an sagmot itingan. Takale e' sigām palman Tuhan,

verses.name: Mark 4:19
verses.text: saguwā' abimbang pikilan sigām e' kahālan deyom dunya itu. Ya na pa'in ahalga' ma sigām pangalta' maka ai-ai kinanapsuhan. Jari palman Tuhan mbal amuwa' ma deyom atay sigām, sali' dalil tinanom bang kasembolan e' sagmot.

verses.name: Mark 4:20
verses.text: Saguwā' saga a'a kasehe'an sali' dalil tana' ahāp. Takale e' sigām palman Tuhan ati tinaima' e' sigām. Jari magbuwa' du palman Tuhan ma deyom atay sigām, sali' dalil tinanom. Kasehe'an amuwan buwa' sarang-sarang hekana, kasehe'an buwa' aheka, maka kasehe'an isab amuwan buwa' lumandu'an to'ongan hekana.”  <div eID="gen4817" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4816" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2184"/><div sID="gen4818" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palita'an Tinambunan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.8.16-Luke.8.18">Lukas 8:16-18</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2184"/> Ah'lling isab si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Aniya' bahā' magpalita'an bo' turunganna maka undam atawa pat'nna'na ma deyo' kantil? Tantu mbal. Subay pat'nna'na ma diyata' papaganna.

verses.name: Mark 4:22
verses.text: Bang itu niralil,” yukna, “ai-ai kamemon tinapukan ma buwattina'an pinaluwas du ma sinosōng, maka ai-ai mbal tahati ma buwattina'an tahati du ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Mark 4:23
verses.text: Sasuku kam makakale, ikutunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2185"/><div sID="gen4820" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2185"/> Yuk si Isa isab ma sigām, “Isbatunbi pahāp ai-ai takalebi sabab bang ahāp pangisbatbi ahāp isab palsuku'an ya pinaniya'an ka'am, maka kin'nnopan lagi' ma ka'am.

verses.name: Mark 4:25
verses.text: Hatina itu bang a'a aniya' kata'una kin'nnopan gi' ta'una. Saguwā' sai-sai mbal makahati, kinulangan lagi' bay panghatina.”  <div eID="gen4820" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4818" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2186"/><div sID="gen4821" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Kapasulig Bigi-tinanom</title> <div sID="gen4822" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2186"/> Amandu' gi' si Isa, yukna, “Buwattitu isab pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya', ya dalilna sali' bigi-tinanom sinaboran e' a'a ma tana'na.

verses.name: Mark 4:27
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e'na anabod, atuli iya ma waktu sangom ati abati' waktu llaw bo' maghinang hinangna kasehe'. Jari bigi-tinanom bay saboranna patomo' maka pasuligan di-na, sagō' mbal kinata'uwan e' a'a inān bang buwattingga kasuligna.

verses.name: Mark 4:28
verses.text: Patomo' asal bigi-tinanom pagka ma deyom tana' na, ati pasōng amuwan buwa'. Tagna' pasaha', bo' anungkalling, bo' buwa' atiguma' na.

verses.name: Mark 4:29
verses.text: Pagtahak pa'in buwa' itu, magtūy pinak'ttu' e' tag-dapu tana' sabab ta'abut na waktuna.”  <div eID="gen4822" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4821" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2187"/><div sID="gen4823" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Bigi-tinanom Landu' Anahut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.31-Matt.13.34">Matiyu 13:31-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.13.18-Luke.13.19">Lukas 13:18-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2187"/> Amandu' gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ai pamasali'antam pagparinta Tuhan? Ai pamaralilantam?

verses.name: Mark 4:31
verses.text: Ya pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya',” yukna, “sali' dalil dansolag bigi-tinanom ariki'-diki'. Tagna' tinanom bigi itu ma deyom tana' anahut asal min bigi-tinanom kamemon ma deyom dunya.

verses.name: Mark 4:32
verses.text: Sagō' pagtanom pa'in, anomo' du ati palabi heyana min tinanom kamemon. Pa'aslag saga sangana, angkan pina'an saga manuk-manuk angahinang pugaran ma sindunganna.”  <div eID="gen4824" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2188"/><div sID="gen4825" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2188"/> Aheka saga paralilan buwattē' bay pagguna e' si Isa pagnasihatna ma saga a'a, ingga-ingga ya takannal e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 4:34
verses.text: Mbal iya amissala ma saga a'a kasehe' bang ngga'i ka paralilan ya pamissalana. Sagō' bang hal iya maka saga mulidna, pinahati e'na bissalana kamemon ma sigām.  <div eID="gen4825" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4823" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2189"/><div sID="gen4826" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Baliyu maka Goyak</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.23-Matt.8.27">Matiyu 8:23-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.22-Luke.8.25">Lukas 8:22-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2189"/> Manjari itu ma llaw ina'an-i, bo' abay kohap na, ah'lling si Isa ma saga mulidna. “Sūng kitam,” yukna, “pauntas ni dambila' danaw e'.”

verses.name: Mark 4:36
verses.text: Ni'bbahan kaheka'an a'a inān ati paruwa' saga mulid inān ni bayanan ya asal paningkō'an si Isa, ati binowa iya e' sigām. Aniya' isab saga bayanan kasehe' pa'abay ma sigām.

verses.name: Mark 4:37
verses.text: Sakali itu aniya' hunus parugpak ni danaw inān. Sōng-sōng na sigām abuhaw sabab sinasa' e' goyak.

verses.name: Mark 4:38
verses.text: Bo' si Isa iya ina'an ma buli', atuli pasandig ma ū'an. Na, binati' iya e' saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, mbal ka bahā' asusa? Itiya' kitam song abuhaw!”  <div eID="gen4827" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2190"/><div sID="gen4828" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2190"/> Jari punduk si Isa bo' yampa soho'na baliyu maka goyak inān pahali. “Sarang na,” yukna ma danaw. “Pat'ddo' ka!” Magtūy pahali baliyu maka t'ddo' to'ongan danaw inān.

verses.name: Mark 4:40
verses.text: Yukna isab ma saga mulidna, “Angay kam tināw? Mbal gi' bahā' kam angandol ma aku?”  <div eID="gen4828" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2191"/><div sID="gen4829" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2191"/> Sagō' sidda sigām sinōd tāw, angkan sigām magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' a'a itu? Minsan baliyu maka goyak ameya' du ma panoho'anna!”  <div eID="gen4829" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.4"/> <div eID="gen4826" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2192"/><div sID="gen4830" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Sinōd Saitan Kapala'anan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.28-Matt.8.34">Matiyu 8:28-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.26-Luke.8.39">Lukas 8:26-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4831" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2192"/> Manjari itu patandan disi Isa ni dambila' danaw Jalil, ni lahat saga a'a Gerasa.

verses.name: Mark 5:2
verses.text: Pagdeyo' pa'in si Isa ni gintana'an aniya' pasampang ni iya dangan a'a bay paluwas min deyom kakubulan maina'an, a'a sinōd saitan.

verses.name: Mark 5:3
verses.text: Pat'nna' asal iya ma deyom kakubulan. Mbal iya kaengkotan e' a'a minsan kilikili basi' ya pangengkot iya.

verses.name: Mark 5:4
verses.text: Min heka iya bay niengkotan ma tape'-tanganna sagō' ab'kkat sadja e'na saga kilikili. Tab'kkat isab e'na engkot tape'na ati halam aniya' makahawiran iya sabab kosogna.

verses.name: Mark 5:5
verses.text: Ya sadja hinangna llaw-sangom hal magpehē'-pi'itu ma deyom kakubulan maka ma kabūd-būran. Angolang na pa'in iya pakosog sampay magkanaman di-na maka batu.  <div eID="gen4831" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2193"/><div sID="gen4832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2193"/> Na, pag'nda' a'a itu ma si Isa min katāhan lagi', paragan iya bo' pasujud ma dahuanna.

verses.name: Mark 5:7
verses.text: Akosog pangalinganna ma si Isa, yukna, “O Isa, Anak Tuhan Mahatinggi! Ai kagunahannu ma aku? Anapa ka ma ōn Tuhan, da'a aku binasahun.”

verses.name: Mark 5:8
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' junjungna sabab aniya' bay panoho'an si Isa ma saitan e', ya yukna, “Ala'an ka min deyom baran a'a ilu, saitan!”  <div eID="gen4832" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2194"/><div sID="gen4833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2194"/> Tinilaw iya e' si Isa, yukna, “Sai ōnnu?” <div eID="gen4833" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4834" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung l'lla inān, “Ōnku Laksa'an sabab kami itu asal aheka.”

verses.name: Mark 5:10
verses.text: Ati angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in saga saitan inān ma si Isa bang pa'in sigām mbal pinala'an min lahat inān.  <div eID="gen4834" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2195"/><div sID="gen4835" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2195"/> Jari aniya' ba'anan bawi magkakanan maina'an ma lorosan būd, landu' aheka.

verses.name: Mark 5:12
verses.text: Sakali angamu'-ngamu' saga saitan ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Soho'un kami pehē' ni saga bawi inān, pasōrun kami ni deyom baran sigām.”

verses.name: Mark 5:13
verses.text: Na, pinaba'id e' si Isa saga saitan inān ati paluwas sigām min baran a'a bo' yampa pasōd ni baran saga bawi. Magtūy maglumpat magdaganan ba'anan bawi inān min pampang tudju ni deyom danaw bo' yampa alembo kamemon. Ya heka bawi maglembohan inān aniya' kulang-labi duwangibu.  <div eID="gen4835" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2196"/><div sID="gen4836" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2196"/> Pag'nda' itu e' saga magi'ipat inān, paragan sigām ni da'ira maka ni saga a'a maghuma angahaka pasal pakaradja'an itu. Jari sasuku makakale bay pehē' ang'nda'.

verses.name: Mark 5:15
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām ni atag si Isa, ta'nda' a'a bay sinōd saitan laksa'an e'. Ina'an iya aningkō', magsin'mmek na maka ahāp na akkal-pikilanna. Jari tināw sigām.

verses.name: Mark 5:16
verses.text: Sinuli-sulihan isab sigām e' saga a'a bay maka'nda' pasal bay tajari ma a'a sinōd saitan maka ma pasal saga bawi.

verses.name: Mark 5:17
verses.text: Jari angamu' junjung saga a'a inān ma si Isa bang pa'in iya ala'an min lahat sigām.  <div eID="gen4836" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2197"/><div sID="gen4837" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2197"/> Manjari itu, pasalta' pa'in si Isa paruwa' ni bayanan, angamu' a'a bay sinōd saitan inān ameya' ma iya.  <div eID="gen4837" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2198"/><div sID="gen4838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2198"/> Sagō' mbal si Isa. Yukna ma iya, “Amole' na ka ni lahatnu, ni saga lūng-kampungnu. Haka'in sigām pasal hinang aheya ya bay tahinang e' Tuhan ma ka'a maka pasal ka'ase'na ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2199"/><div sID="gen4839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2199"/> Manjari ala'an a'a inān minnē' bo' angalatag lahat niōnan Sangpū' Da'ira angahaka'an saga a'a mahē' pasal hinang aheya bay tahinang ma iya e' si Isa. Ati ainu-inu ma iya saga a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen4839" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4830" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2200"/><div sID="gen4840" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Amatay maka D'nda Asaki</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.18-Matt.9.26">Matiyu 9:18-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.8.40-Luke.8.56">Lukas 8:40-56</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2200"/> Na, amayan si Isa pehē' ni dambila' danaw Jalil bo' pabīng ni bay baina. Jari itu, pagt'kkana ni bihing, aheka to'ongan saga a'a patimuk ni iya.

verses.name: Mark 5:22
verses.text: Aniya' isab pina'an dakayu' nakura' langgal, ōnna si Jayrus. Pag'nda'na ma si Isa, pasujud iya ni atag tape'na

verses.name: Mark 5:23
verses.text: maka e'na angamu'-ngamu'. “Tuwan,” yukna, “arai' na amatay anakku d'nda-d'nda. Dai' lagi' ka amat'nna' tangannu ma iya bo' pauli' sakina ati allum.”

verses.name: Mark 5:24
verses.text: Sakali ameya' si Isa ma iya. Aheka to'ongan saga a'a parongan isab ma iya, angkan sidda asembol.  <div eID="gen4841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2201"/><div sID="gen4842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2201"/> Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' d'nda sakihan, sangpū' na maka duwantahun halam atitis laha'na.

verses.name: Mark 5:26
verses.text: Minsan aheka doktol bay kalabayanna sampay aubus na kamemon sīnna panamba, halam aniya' kagām-gāmanna. Gom pa'in anambahina sakina.

verses.name: Mark 5:27
verses.text: Manjari takale e' d'nda itu suli-suli pasal si Isa, angkan iya palamud ma ba'anan a'a inān ati pasekot iya ni si Isa min buli'an.

verses.name: Mark 5:28
verses.text: Ah'lling iya ni baranna, yukna, “Bang sadja tasagidku minsan la'a hal tōng s'mmekna, kauli'an du aku.”  <div eID="gen4842" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2202"/><div sID="gen4843" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2202"/> Pagsagidna pa'in, saru'un-du'un pahondong laha'na ati tananamna ma deyom baranna in iya kauli'an na.

verses.name: Mark 5:30
verses.text: Magtūy tananam isab e' si Isa aniya' barakat bay paluwas min baranna, angkan iya pahondong bo' palingi' ni saga a'a ma buli'anna. Yukna, “Sai bay ang'ntanan aku?”  <div eID="gen4843" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2203"/><div sID="gen4844" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2203"/> Ya sambung saga mulidna, “Tuwan, ta'nda'nu heka a'a pagipit itu ni ka'a! Ati tilawnu bang sai ang'ntanan ka'a!”  <div eID="gen4844" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2204"/><div sID="gen4845" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2204"/> Sagō' amiha-miha lagi' si Isa bang sai bay ang'ntanan iya.

verses.name: Mark 5:33
verses.text: Jari d'nda inān, pagka kata'uwanna in iya kauli'an na, pehē' ni si Isa maka e'na amidpid sabab tināw sidda. Pasujud iya ma atag tape' si Isa bo' magsab'nnal.

verses.name: Mark 5:34
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Arung, kauli'an na ka ma sabab pangandolnu ma aku. Pehē' na ka, da'a ka asusa. Kauli'an na ka to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4845" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2205"/><div sID="gen4846" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2205"/> Manjari itu, hinabu pa'in si Isa amissala ni d'nda inān, aniya' saga a'a at'kka pina'an min luma' si Jayrus amowahan iya lling, yuk-i, “Amatay na anaknu. Da'a pamale'un guru ilu!”  <div eID="gen4846" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2206"/><div sID="gen4847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2206"/> Sagō' halam niasip e' si Isa lling sigām. Yukna ni si Jayrus, “Da'a ka tināw, angandol sadja ka.”

verses.name: Mark 5:37
verses.text: Jari halam aniya' nirūlan e' si Isa pabeya' ma iya, luwal si Petros maka duwangan magdanakan e', si Yakub maka si Yahiya.

verses.name: Mark 5:38
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in sigām pehē' ni luma' si Jayrus, anā, ta'nda'na aheka a'a maghiluhala'. Magtangisan sigām maka maglemong pakosog.

verses.name: Mark 5:39
verses.text: Pasōd si Isa ni deyom luma' bo' yukna ma saga a'a maina'an, “Magay kam maghiluhala' maka magtangis ilu? Halam du amatay onde' ilu. Hal iya atuli.”  <div eID="gen4847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2207"/><div sID="gen4848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2207"/> Pinagtittowahan iya e' sigām, angkan sigām sinō' paluwas kamemon. Binowa e'na ina'-mma' onde' maka mulidna t'llungan pasōd ni deyom bilik ya kamaina'anan d'nda-d'nda.

verses.name: Mark 5:41
verses.text: Binalutan e' si Isa tanganna ati yukna ni iya ma buwat bahasa sigām, “Talita kum.” (Hatina ma bahasatam, “Arung, soho'ta ka papunduk.”)  <div eID="gen4848" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2208"/><div sID="gen4849" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2208"/> Saru'un-du'un du papunduk onde' inān bo' pal'ngngan ma deyom luma'. Umulna sangpū' maka duwantahun. Jari ainu-inu to'ongan saga a'a inān kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 5:43
verses.text: Binanda'an sigām e' si Isa sinō' da'a angahaka ni sai-sai pasal ina'an-i. Soho'na isab pinakan onde' inān.  <div eID="gen4849" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.5"/> <div eID="gen4840" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2209"/><div sID="gen4850" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sinulak e' saga A'a Nasaret</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.53-Matt.13.58">Matiyu 13:53-58</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.4.16-Luke.4.30">Lukas 4:16-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4851" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2209"/> Ala'an si Isa minnē' bo' pabīng ni da'ira Nasaret ya kauman luggiya'. Ameya' isab saga mulidna.

verses.name: Mark 6:2
verses.text: Manjari itu, pag'llaw Sabtu' pa'in, anagna' iya amandu' ma deyom langgal, ati ainu-inu kaheka'an saga a'a ya akale ma iya. Yuk sigām, “Oy! Minningga bahā' pangā'anna pangadji'na itu? Pangita'u ai bahā' bay pamuwan ma iya, angkan iya makahinang saga hinangna kawasahan itu?

verses.name: Mark 6:3
verses.text: Bang kami mbal asā', ya na ko' itu karpentero, anak si Mariyam, danakan disi Yakub maka si Joses maka si Judas maka si Simun. Maka saga danakanna d'nda itiya' isab ma lūngantam itu.” Ati ala'at atay sigām ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen4851" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2210"/><div sID="gen4852" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2210"/> Angkan yukna ma sigām, “In nabi pinagaddatan asal ma sabarang lahat. Ya sadja mbal magaddat ma iya bang a'a min lahatna luggiya' maka saga lahasiya'na maka saga sehe'na magdaluma'.”  <div eID="gen4852" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2211"/><div sID="gen4853" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2211"/> Jari halam aniya' hinang makainu-inu tahinang e' si Isa mahē'. Luwal saga a'a sakihan salat bay pat'nna'anna tanganna bo' kauli'an.

verses.name: Mark 6:6
verses.text: Ainu-inu to'ongan iya bang angay saga a'a maina'an mbal angandol ma iya. <div eID="gen4853" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4850" type="section"/> <div sID="gen4854" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasangpū' maka Duwa Mulid Sinō' Magnasihat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.5-Matt.10.15">Matiyu 10:5-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.1-Luke.9.6">Lukas 9:1-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4855" type="paragraph"/> Na, talatag e' si Isa saga kaluma'an ma jadjahan inān amandu'an saga a'a.

verses.name: Mark 6:7
verses.text: Nilinganan e'na saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa pehē' ni iya, ati soho'na sigām pal'ngngan duwangan-duwangan magnasihat lapal Tuhan. Bay sigām buwananna kawasa pamala'an saga saitan min deyom baran a'a,

verses.name: Mark 6:8
verses.text: ati soho'na sigām subay mbal amowa lutu', atawa puyu' pamowahan ai-ai, atawa sīn ma deyom sabitan sigām. Luwal tungkud ya makajari binowa e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 6:9
verses.text: Makajari sigām magtaumpa', sagō' mbal sigām tinugutan amowa badju' pagsalinan.

verses.name: Mark 6:10
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Bang kam ganta' sinagina e' a'a sinō' pasōd ni luma'na, subay maina'an pahanti'anbi sampay ta'abut waktu katulakbi min lahat inān.

verses.name: Mark 6:11
verses.text: Maka bang aniya' lahat pat'kkahanbi bo' mbal anagina ka'am saga a'ana, atawa mbal bilahi akale ma ka'am, ala'an kam min kaluma'an ina'an. Paspasinbi dahū bagunbunna min tape'bi, tanda' saksi' in ka'am apuwas min sigām.”  <div eID="gen4855" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2212"/><div sID="gen4856" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2212"/> Jari magl'ngnganan na saga mulid magnasihat. Yuk pagnasihat sigām in manusiya' subay ang'bba to'ongan min dusa sigām sampay papinda ni Tuhan.
