verses.name: Mark 6:13
verses.text: Aheka saga saitan bay tapala'an e' saga mulid e' min deyom baran a'a, maka aheka a'a sakihan bay sinapuhan maka ns'llan, manjari kauli'an.  <div eID="gen4856" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4854" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2213"/><div sID="gen4857" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.1-Matt.14.12">Matiyu 14:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.7-Luke.9.9">Lukas 9:7-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4858" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2213"/> Manjari itu takale e' Sultan Herod pasal kahinangan si Isa, sabab abantug ōnna ma kalahat-lahatan. Magupama isab saga a'a ma pasalna. Aniya' a'a kasehe'an magpa'in, yuk-i, “Si Yahiya Magpapandi bay pinakallum pabīng min kamatayna ya angkan tahinangna saga hinang kawasahan inān.”  <div eID="gen4858" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2214"/><div sID="gen4859" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2214"/> Yuk a'a kasehe', “Nabi Elija ko' inān!” <div eID="gen4859" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4860" type="paragraph"/> Aniya' isab a'a kasehe' ah'lling, yuk-i, “Nabi ko' inān buwat saga kanabi-nabihan bay ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4860" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2215"/><div sID="gen4861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2215"/> Sagō' pagkale itu e' si Herod, yukna, “Si Yahiya ko' inān, ya bay soho'ku pinonggolan kōkna. Allum na iya pabīng.”

verses.name: Mark 6:17
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Herod sabab iya ya bay magpanoho'an anaggaw si Yahiya. Sinō' iya nihengkotan maka kilikili bo' yampa ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu. Buwattitu ya kahālanna: sultan Herod itu bay angah'nda si Herodiyas h'nda siyalina si Pilip, bo' pa'in allum lagi' si Pilip e'. Manjari itu, pagka magtimbul na sigām, pinabukagan sultan Herod e' si Yahiya, yuk-i, “Mbal manjari bang ka magtimbul maka h'nda danakannu! Dusahan ka!”  <div eID="gen4861" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:18
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Herod sabab iya ya bay magpanoho'an anaggaw si Yahiya. Sinō' iya nihengkotan maka kilikili bo' yampa ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu. Buwattitu ya kahālanna: sultan Herod itu bay angah'nda si Herodiyas h'nda siyalina si Pilip, bo' pa'in allum lagi' si Pilip e'. Manjari itu, pagka magtimbul na sigām, pinabukagan sultan Herod e' si Yahiya, yuk-i, “Mbal manjari bang ka magtimbul maka h'nda danakannu! Dusahan ka!”  <div eID="gen4861" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2216"/><div sID="gen4862" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2216"/> Na, ya ina'an sababanna angkan ala'at atay si Herodiyas ma si Yahiya. Ya kabilahianna subay pinapatay. Sagō' halam iya karūlan sabab

verses.name: Mark 6:20
verses.text: aloman si Herod ma si Yahiya. Kinata'uwan asal e'na in si Yahiya a'a abontol maka a'adil. Angkan iya bay nihampanan e' si Herod. Bilahi sidda akale si Herod ma pagnasihat si Yahiya, minsan makasasaw pikilanna.  <div eID="gen4862" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2217"/><div sID="gen4863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2217"/> Sakali aniya' waktu pamarūl kabaya'an si Herodiyas. Ta'abut pa'in llaw panabu kapaganak ma sultan Herod, magpajamu iya ma saga bag'llal ma pagsultananna, maka ma saga nakura' kasundaluhanna, maka ma saga a'a taga-ōn ma lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Mark 6:22
verses.text: Na, atimuk pa'in saga a'a, pasōd pina'an anak si Herodiyas budjang angigal, ati kasulutan sidda si Herod maka saga a'a maglurukan e'. Jari amissala sultan ni budjang inān, yukna, “Angamu' sadja ka. Ai-ai kabaya'annu, pamuwanku du ma ka'a.”

verses.name: Mark 6:23
verses.text: Anapa lagi' iya, yukna, “Sapahanta ka, ai-ai amu'nu ni aku, pamuwanku to'ongan ma ka'a minsan santonga' alta'ku kamemon.”  <div eID="gen4863" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2218"/><div sID="gen4864" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2218"/> Paluwas budjang minnē' bo' tilawna ina'na. “Ina',” yukna, “ai subay amu'ku?” <div eID="gen4864" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4865" type="paragraph"/> Anambung ina'na, yukna, “Amu'un kōk si Yahiya Magpapandi.”  <div eID="gen4865" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2219"/><div sID="gen4866" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2219"/> Magtūy parai'-dai' budjang angamu' ni sultan, yukna, “Tuwan sultan, ya itu amu'ku ni ka'a, pamuwanun ma aku saru'un-du'un kōk si Yahiya Magpapandi, pinat'nna' ma talam!”  <div eID="gen4866" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2220"/><div sID="gen4867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2220"/> Anā, aheya kasusahan sultan sagō' mbal iya bilahi amindahan janji'na sabab bay iya makasapa ma alopan saga luruk e'.

verses.name: Mark 6:27
verses.text: Magtūy iya magpanoho'an ma dakayu' sundaluna, sinō' pehē' angā' kōk si Yahiya. Jari pehē' na sundalu inān bo' amonggolan kōk si Yahiya ma deyom kalabusu lagi'.

verses.name: Mark 6:28
verses.text: Puwas e' pinat'nna' e'na ma talam bo' yampa bowana pehē' ni budjang e'. Jari sinōngan e' budjang ni ina'na.

verses.name: Mark 6:29
verses.text: Makakale pa'in saga mulid si Yahiya pasal ina'an-i, pehē' sigām angā' mayatna kinubul.  <div eID="gen4867" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4857" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2221"/><div sID="gen4868" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Limangibu Heka A'a Pinakan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.6.1-John.6.14">Yahiya 6:1-14</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4869" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2221"/> Na, pabīng ni si Isa saga a'a kawakilanna ati nihaka'an iya pasal kamemon bay tahinang sigām maka bay tapamandu' sigām ma saga a'a.

verses.name: Mark 6:31
verses.text: Na, aheka a'a magpehē'-pi'itu ma atag ina'an, ya po'on sigām mbal makaluhaya minsan magkakan. Angkan yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Sūng kitam ni lahat halam maga'a, kitam-kitam sadja, bo' supaya kam makahali-hali minsan mbal at'ggol.”

verses.name: Mark 6:32
verses.text: Jari amusay sigām minnē' tudju ni lahat l'ngngaw-l'ngngawan, hal sigām sadja.  <div eID="gen4869" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2222"/><div sID="gen4870" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2222"/> Saguwā' aheka a'a bay maka'nda' katulak sigām, ati takilā sigām. Manjari aheka saga a'a min kaluma'an inān kamemon, magdai'-dai' amaklay min bihing susulan tudju ni patandanan disi Isa ati makarahū at'kka pehē'.

verses.name: Mark 6:34
verses.text: Pagdeyo' pa'in si Isa, ta'nda'na ba'anan a'a itu, landu' to'ongan aheka. T'kkahan iya ase' ma sigām sabab sapantun sigām bili-bili halam aniya' angupiksa'. Jari aheka pamandu' ma sigām.

verses.name: Mark 6:35
verses.text: Pagka abay kohap na, pehē' saga mulidna ni iya. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan, sōng sangom na, maka itiya' kitam ma lahat l'ngngaw-l'ngngawan.

verses.name: Mark 6:36
verses.text: Soho'un lagi' saga a'a itu pehē' ni kaluma'an maka ni saga maghuhuma ma kareya-reyahan itu bo' makab'llihan di-sigām kinakan.”  <div eID="gen4870" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2223"/><div sID="gen4871" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2223"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am na ya amakan sigām,” yukna. <div eID="gen4871" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4872" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sigām ma iya, “Ē! Ba'anan a'a itu, subay tamba a'a walumbulan t'ggolna bo' aniya' makab'llihan sigām tinapay! Ati soho'nu kami am'lli?”  <div eID="gen4872" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2224"/><div sID="gen4873" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2224"/> Atilaw si Isa, yukna, “Pila heka tinapaybi ilu? Nda'unbi pehē'.” <div eID="gen4873" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4874" type="paragraph"/> Pagta'u pa'in, yuk sigām, “Lima du tinapay maka duwa daing.”  <div eID="gen4874" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2225"/><div sID="gen4875" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2225"/> Manjari magpanoho'an si Isa ma saga mulidna. Sinō' pinatingkō' saga a'a inān kamemon magtumpuk-tumpuk ma kaparangan.

verses.name: Mark 6:40
verses.text: Makatingkō' pa'in sigām, aniya' limampū', atawa dahatus a'a ma datumpuk.

verses.name: Mark 6:41
verses.text: Jari niā' e' si Isa lima tinapay maka duwa daing he' bo' pahangad tudju ni langit magsukul ni Tuhan. Pinagpōng-pōng e'na tinapay ati sōnganna ni saga mulidna bo' pinagtopod-toporan saga a'a. Ya du duwa daing, bay pinagbahagi'-bahagi' e'na isab ma sigām kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 6:42
verses.text: Magkakanan na saga a'a inān kamemon sampay mag'ssohan na.

verses.name: Mark 6:43
verses.text: Pagubus pa'in sigām amangan, tinipun e' saga mulid kapin tinapay maka daing, ati ap'nno' sangpū' maka duwa ambung aheya.

verses.name: Mark 6:44
verses.text: Ya a'a bay amangan inān aniya' saga limangibu bang hal l'lla ni'itung.  <div eID="gen4875" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4868" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2226"/><div sID="gen4876" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Lum'ngngan ma Kuwit Tahik</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.22-Matt.14.33">Matiyu 14:22-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.6.15-John.6.21">Yahiya 6:15-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4877" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2226"/> Puwas inān magtūy anoho' si Isa ma saga mulidna subay paruwa' ni bayanan. Pinarahū sigām e'na pauntas ni dambila' danaw ni da'ira Betsaida, sabuna amapole' kaheka'an a'a inān.

verses.name: Mark 6:46
verses.text: Tapapole' pa'in, patukad si Isa anambahayang ma bīd-bīd.

verses.name: Mark 6:47
verses.text: Sangom pa'in lahat, ina'an saga mulidna ma t'ngnga' danaw bo' si Isa ina'an ma deya dangan-danganna.

verses.name: Mark 6:48
verses.text: Ta'nda'na saga mulidna kahunitan magdayung sabab anagga' sigām baliyu. Jari itu, pagdai' llaw pa'in, pehē' iya tudju ni sigām pal'ngngan min kuwit tahik. Arāk kalabayan e'na saga mulidna,

verses.name: Mark 6:49
verses.text: saguwā' ta'nda' iya e' sigām pal'ngngan ma kuwit tahik, ati pangannal sigām umagad. Magsilahak to'ongan sigām,

verses.name: Mark 6:50
verses.text: sabab niumagad sigām kamemon pag'nda' sigām ma iya. <div eID="gen4877" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4878" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' amissala magtūy si Isa ma sigām. “Paiman kam,” yukna. “Aku ko' itu. Da'a kam tināw.”

verses.name: Mark 6:51
verses.text: Jari paruwa' si Isa ni bayanan bo' pabihing ni saga mulid e'. Pagduwa' pa'in, pahali baliyu. Tak'bbal isab atay sigām.

verses.name: Mark 6:52
verses.text: Sabab halam tahati e' sigām pasal kahinang si Isa ma tinapay. Tu'ud sigām atuwas pinandu'an.  <div eID="gen4878" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4876" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2227"/><div sID="gen4879" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Gennesaret Kauli'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.34-Matt.14.36">Matiyu 14:34-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4880" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2227"/> Jari itu, at'kka pa'in sigām ni dambila' danaw, parunggu' sigām ni bihing ma Gennesaret.

verses.name: Mark 6:54
verses.text: Pagdeyo' pa'in sigām min bayanan, takilā magtūy si Isa e' saga a'a

verses.name: Mark 6:55
verses.text: ati magdauragan sigām angalatag kalahatan ma jadjahan ina'an-i. Binowa e' sigām a'a taga-saki maka palegehan sigām, maingga-maingga lahat ya kakalehan sigām kamahe'an si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 6:56
verses.text: Maingga-maingga kat'kkahanna, ai na ka ma kaluma'an, ai na ka ma da'ira, ai na ka ma lahat deya, pinalege magtūy saga a'a asaki ma halaman tabu'. Ati angamu' sigām junjung ni si Isa, bang pa'in pina'abut ni iya tangan saga a'a sakihan minsan la'a hal tōng s'mmekna. Manjari sai-sai bay maka'ntan ma s'mmek si Isa kauli'an du magtūy.  <div eID="gen4880" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.6"/> <div eID="gen4879" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2228"/><div sID="gen4881" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Usulan Manusiya' maka Panoho'an Tuhan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.15.1-Matt.15.9">Matiyu 15:1-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4882" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2228"/> Na, aniya' patimuk ni si Isa saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' agama bay palūd pina'an min Awrusalam.

verses.name: Mark 7:2
verses.text: Ta'nda' e' sigām saga mulid si Isa amangan bo' halam bay angose' tangan sigām. Haram kono' bang ma saga Parisi.

verses.name: Mark 7:3
verses.text: Ya addat saga Parisi maka kamemon bangsa sigām Yahudi, mbal amangan bang halam bay makakose' tangan dahū, sabab amogbog usulan bay pang'bba e' ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām.

verses.name: Mark 7:4
verses.text: Bang sigām tapole' min tabu' mbal amangan bang halam bay angose' dahū. Aheka gi' isab saga usulan binogbogan e' sigām, buwat pangose' saga sawan maka sili' maka saga pamanganan tumbaga.  <div eID="gen4882" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2229"/><div sID="gen4883" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2229"/> Angkan tinilaw si Isa e' saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' agama inān, yuk-i, “Angay saga mulidnu mbal amogbog usulan bay pang'bba e' ka'mbo'-mbo'antam ati amangan minsan halam bay sinussi tangan sigām dahū?”  <div eID="gen4883" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2230"/><div sID="gen4884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2230"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am ilu hal magbau'-bau' ameya' ma Tuhan, bo' halam. B'nnal to'ongan ya bay tasulat e' si Isaya ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen4885"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4886"/>‘Saga a'a itu, yuk Tuhan, angahulmat aku maka lapal kabtangan sigām,<l eID="gen4886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4887"/>sagō' alawak deyom atay sigām min aku.<l eID="gen4887" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4888"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:7
verses.text: Ya pagpudji sigām ma aku halam aniya' pūsna,<l eID="gen4888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4889"/>sabab ya pamandu' e' sigām hal panoho'an<l eID="gen4889" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4890"/>bay pinahinang e' manusiya', ngga'i ka deyo' bay min aku.’<l eID="gen4890" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4885"/>  <div eID="gen4884" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2231"/><div sID="gen4891" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2231"/> “Ya du ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “anaikutan panoho'an Tuhan ati usulan manusiya' ya bogboganbi.

verses.name: Mark 7:9
verses.text: Apanday kam pahāp!” yukna. “Taikutanbi panoho'an Tuhan supaya bogboganbi saga usulan bay pang'bba e' kamatto'ahanbi!

verses.name: Mark 7:10
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi sara'-panoho'an ya bay tasulat e' si Musa, ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam magaddatan mma'bi maka ina'bi.’ Maka itu gi', ‘Sai-sai ah'lling ala'at ma mma'na atawa ina'na, a'a inān subay pinapatay.’

verses.name: Mark 7:11
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “magsaddī-saddī ya pamandu'bi ma saga a'a. Ma pamandu'bi, bang aniya' ganta' amissala ni ina'-mma'na, yukna, ‘Mma', atawa Ina', arak bay panabangku ka'a kaniya'ku itu, sagō' mbal na sabab pagkulban.<note>Kulban, hatina ‘pamasuku' ni Tuhan’.</note>’

verses.name: Mark 7:12
verses.text: Na, bang buwattē' pamissala a'a ina'an,” yuk si Isa, “mbal na iya pahinangbi ai-ai panabangna ma mma'na atawa ina'na.

verses.name: Mark 7:13
verses.text: Manjari minnē' pahalambi dī panoho'an Tuhan ati pandu'anbi saga usulan bay pang'bba e' ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi. Maka aheka gi' isab saga kahinanganbi buwattē'.”  <div eID="gen4891" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4881" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2232"/><div sID="gen4892" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Makatamak Pangatayan Manusiya'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.15.10-Matt.15.20">Matiyu 15:10-20</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2232"/> Puwas e' nilinganan ba'anan a'a inān e' si Isa, sinō' patimuk pabīng ni atagna. Yukna ma sigām, “Pakale kam kamemon ma bissalaku itu. Hatiunbi to'ongan.

verses.name: Mark 7:15
verses.text: Ngga'i ka kinakan pasōd ni deyom baran a'a ya makalumu' iya. Ya makalumu' iya saga ai-ai ya paluwas min deyom atayna.

verses.name: Mark 7:16
verses.text: Sasuku kam makakale, ikutunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen4893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2233"/><div sID="gen4894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2233"/> Jari makala'an pa'in si Isa min saga a'a inān, pasōd iya ni deyom luma' ati tinilaw e' saga mulidna pasal bay pamandu'na he'.

verses.name: Mark 7:18
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Ka'am isab, halam aniya' panghatibi? Angay mbal kata'uwanbi? Bang aniya' kinakan pasōd ni deyom baran a'a bay min luwasan, mbal makalumu' iya.

verses.name: Mark 7:19
verses.text: Sabab mbal makasampay ni pangatayanna sagō' pasōd ni deyom b'ttongna bo' yampa paluwas min baranna.” Minnē' tapahati e' si Isa in kinakan kamemon halal asal.  <div eID="gen4894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2234"/><div sID="gen4895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2234"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Ya paluwas min deyom pangatayan manusiya', ya na he' makalumu' iya.

verses.name: Mark 7:21
verses.text: Sabab deyom atayna to'ongan ya paluwasan hona'-hona'na ala'at. Ya he' po'onna angkan iya maghinang kala'atan, buwat saga angahinang kahina'an ma d'nda, anangkaw, amapatay, angaliyu-lakad,

verses.name: Mark 7:22
verses.text: anganapsuhan kaniya' a'a kasehe'an, angakkal, magba'is, angimbū, angalimut, magmalangkahi, maka magkarupangan.

verses.name: Mark 7:23
verses.text: Saga kala'atan itu kamemon,” yuk si Isa, “paluwas min deyom pangatayan a'a, angkan iya alumu'.”  <div eID="gen4895" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4892" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2235"/><div sID="gen4896" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangandol D'nda Bangsa Girīk</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.15.21-Matt.15.28">Matiyu 15:21-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2235"/> Jari palanjal si Isa minnē' tudju ni jadjahan da'ira Tira. Mahē' pa'in, pasōd iya ni dakayu' luma' bo' pahanti' mahē'. Kabaya'anna subay halam aniya' makata'u pasal kamahē'na, sagō' mbal kalimbungan.

verses.name: Mark 7:25
verses.text: Aniya' d'nda maina'an bay makakale pasal si Isa. D'nda itu taga-anak d'nda-d'nda sinōd saitan. Jari pagkalena pasal kamahē' si Isa magtūy iya pehē' pasujud ni atag tape'na.

verses.name: Mark 7:26
verses.text: In d'nda itu ngga'i ka Yahudi sagō' bangsa Piniki min lahat Siriya. Jari angamu' iya junjung ni si Isa bang pa'in pinala'an saitan min baran anakna.

verses.name: Mark 7:27
verses.text: Sagō' anambung si Isa magparalilan, yukna, “Subay pina'sso dahū saga anak lissi sabab mbal manjari niā' kinakanna bo' nilarukan ni saga ero'.”  <div eID="gen4897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2236"/><div sID="gen4898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2236"/> “B'nnal, Tuwan,” yuk d'nda. “Sagō' minsan saga ero' ma deyo' lamisahan amangan du momok kinakan ya apakpak e' onde'.”  <div eID="gen4898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2237"/><div sID="gen4899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2237"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ma iya, yukna, “Amole' na ka. Nirūlan du ka ma sabab bissalanu ilu. Ala'an na saitan min deyom baran anaknu.”  <div eID="gen4899" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2238"/><div sID="gen4900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2238"/> Amole' na d'nda ati tabākna anakna palege ma pabahakanna. Halam na saitan.  <div eID="gen4900" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4896" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2239"/><div sID="gen4901" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Bisu maka Umaw Kauli'an</title> <div sID="gen4902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2239"/> Ala'an si Isa min jadjahan Tira inān pabalik ni atag danaw Jalil. Niuntas e'na lahat Sidun, labay isab min lahat niōnan Sangpū' Da'ira.

verses.name: Mark 7:32
verses.text: Na, aniya' a'a bisu mbal agon makabissala pabontol, binowa ni si Isa e' saga a'a. Angamu' sigām junjung ni si Isa bang pa'in pinat'nna' tanganna ma sehe' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 7:33
verses.text: Jari binowa iya e' si Isa pasaddī min deyom kaheka'an, ati tinampongan e' si Isa tainga a'a he'. Angaludja' isab si Isa, bo' yampa ntananna d'lla' a'a he'.

verses.name: Mark 7:34
verses.text: Puwas e' pahangad si Isa ni langit bo' anganapas paheya. Yukna ni a'a bisu maka aumaw inān, “Eppata!” Hatina “Paukab na kam!”  <div eID="gen4902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2240"/><div sID="gen4903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2240"/> Makakale magtūy tainga a'a inān. Pinausay magtūy d'lla'na ati abontol na e'na amissala.

verses.name: Mark 7:36
verses.text: Jari niamay-amayan saga a'a inān e' si Isa, sinō' da'a angahaka ni sai-sai ma pasal ina'an-i. Sagō' mangkinna sigām sinō' da'a angahaka, mangkinna sigām angahaka.

verses.name: Mark 7:37
verses.text: Jari ainu-inu to'ongan sasuku makakale. “A'a itu,” yuk sigām, “ahāp sidda kahinanganna kamemon. Minsan a'a bisu tapakale e'na, a'a umaw tapabissala e'na.”  <div eID="gen4903" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.7"/> <div eID="gen4901" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2241"/><div sID="gen4904" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mpat Ngibu A'a Pinakan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.15.32-Matt.15.39">Matiyu 15:32-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4905" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2241"/> Mbal at'ggol minnē' aheka isab saga a'a patimuk pina'an. Pagka halam aniya' kinakan sigām, nilinganan e' si Isa saga mulidna pehē' ni iya. Yukna ma sigām,

verses.name: Mark 8:2
verses.text: “Ma'ase' aku ma ba'anan a'a itu sabab kat'llu na llaw itu ya kamaitu sigām ma aku, maka halam aniya' kinakan sigām.

verses.name: Mark 8:3
verses.text: Bang sigām papole'ku ma halam bay makakakan, arakala' pinunung sigām ma pal'ngnganan, sabab aniya' kasehe' atā pamole'an sigām.”  <div eID="gen4905" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2242"/><div sID="gen4906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2242"/> Yuk saga mulidna ma iya, “Na, maingga bahā' pangā'anta kinakan sarang pamakan kaheka a'a itu? Itiya' kitam ma lahat halam aniya' kaluma'anna itu!”  <div eID="gen4906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2243"/><div sID="gen4907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2243"/> Atilaw si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Pila solag tinapaybi ilu?” <div eID="gen4907" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4908" type="paragraph"/> “Pitu',” yuk sambung sigām.  <div eID="gen4908" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2244"/><div sID="gen4909" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2244"/> Manjari sinoho' e' si Isa katimukan a'a inān magtingkō'an ma tana'. Niā' e'na pitu' tinapay inān bo' magsarang-sukul ni Tuhan. Puwas e' pinagpōng-pōng e'na bo' yampa sōnganna ni saga mulidna, ati tinopod-toporan ba'anan a'a inān e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 8:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab ma sigām saga daing anahut, salat hekana. Pinagsukulan e' si Isa bo' tinopod-topod isab e' mulidna ma saga a'a he'.

verses.name: Mark 8:8
verses.text: Jari magkakanan sigām kamemon sampay asso. Puwas e' aniya' pitu' ambung aheya ap'nno' e' kapin kinakan bay tatimuk e' saga mulid.

verses.name: Mark 8:9
verses.text: Saga a'a bay magkakanan inān, aniya' kulang-labi mpat ngibu. Manjari pinapole' na sigām e' si Isa,

verses.name: Mark 8:10
verses.text: ati paruwa' iya maka saga mulidna ni bayanan bo' pauntas pehē' ni lahat Dalmanuta.  <div eID="gen4909" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4904" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2245"/><div sID="gen4910" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Parisi Mikipa'nda' Paltanda'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.1-Matt.16.4">Matiyu 16:1-4</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4911" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2245"/> Pagt'kka disi Isa ni Dalmanuta, aniya' pehē' ni iya saga a'a Parisi amowa iya magsu'al. Bilahi sigām anulayan iya, ya po'on sigām mikipa'nda' paltanda'an, palsaksi'an in iya b'nnal taga-kapatut min Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 8:12
verses.text: Manjari anganapas si Isa paheya sabab kasusa deyom atayna, ati yukna ma sigām, “Angay bahā' saga a'a ma patahunan itu, hal angamu' paltanda'an? B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am, halam aniya' paltanda'an pina'nda'an ka'am.”  <div eID="gen4911" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2246"/><div sID="gen4912" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2246"/> Jari ala'an iya min sigām. Pariyata' iya pabīng ni bay pameya'anna bo' pauntas iya pehē' ni dambila' danaw.  <div eID="gen4912" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4910" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2247"/><div sID="gen4913" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' Pasal Pandu' saga Parisi maka si Herod</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.5-Matt.16.12">Matiyu 16:5-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2247"/> Na, halam aniya' lutu' tabowa e' saga mulid si Isa, halam taentom. Luwal dansolag tinapay bay ma deyom bayanan asal.

verses.name: Mark 8:15
verses.text: Jari pinandu'an sigām e' si Isa, yukna, “Kamaya'-maya' kam. Halli'inbi pasulig tinapay min saga Parisi maka pasulig sultan Herod!”  <div eID="gen4914" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2248"/><div sID="gen4915" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2248"/> Magsuli-suli saga mulid pasal pah'llingna itu sabab halam tahati e' sigām. Yuk sigām, “Angkan marai' buwattē' pah'lling si Isa sabab halam kitam bay amowa tinapay.”  <div eID="gen4915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2249"/><div sID="gen4916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2249"/> Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa bang ai ya pagsuli-suli sigām, angkan yukna, “Angay kam magsuli-suli pasal halam aniya' tinapaybi? Halam gi' tahatibi bahā'? Akulang bahā' akkalbi?

verses.name: Mark 8:18
verses.text: Aniya' matabi sagō' mbal kam maka'nda'. Aniya' taingabi sagō' mbal makakale. Arai' halam taentombi bay hinangku llaw ina'an-i,

verses.name: Mark 8:19
verses.text: waktu bay kapagpōng-pōngku tinapay lima hekana pamakan saga limangibu a'a. Pila heka ambung aheya bay pangisihanbi kapin kinakan?” <div eID="gen4916" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4917" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sigām, “Sangpū' maka duwa.”  <div eID="gen4917" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2250"/><div sID="gen4918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2250"/> “Maka tinapay pitu' hekana-i,” yuk si Isa, “ya bay pagpōng-pōngku ma saga a'a mpat ngibu. Pila ambung bay pangisihanbi?” <div eID="gen4918" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4919" type="paragraph"/> “Pitu',” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen4919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2251"/><div sID="gen4920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2251"/> “Na,” yukna, “mbal na pa'in kam makahati.”  <div eID="gen4920" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4913" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2252"/><div sID="gen4921" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Buta Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen4922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2252"/> Jari at'kka na disi Isa ni kaluma'an Betsaida, maka aniya' saga a'a amowa a'a buta. Angamu' sigām junjung bang pa'in iya pinat'nna'an tangan si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 8:23
verses.text: Sakali binalutan e' si Isa tangan a'a buta he' ati niambit e'na paluwas min kaluma'an inān. Ma luwasan pa'in, niludja'an e'na matana bo' yampa pat'nna'na tanganna ni iya. Puwas e' tinilaw iya e' si Isa, “Aniya' bahā' ta'nda'nu?”  <div eID="gen4922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2253"/><div sID="gen4923" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2253"/> Patongas a'a he' ang'nda' ni dahuanna. “Aho',” yukna, “aniya' ta'nda'ku saga a'a, sagō' luwana sali' po'on kayu sikal'ngnganan.”  <div eID="gen4923" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2254"/><div sID="gen4924" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2254"/> Pinat'nna' e' si Isa tanganna ni mata a'a itu, kaminduwana na, jari pagpatongna ma buwattina'an kauli'an na matana maka asawa na e'na ang'nda' ma kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 8:26
verses.text: Puwas e' pinapole' iya e' si Isa maka e'na ah'lling, yuk-i, “Da'a ka pasōd pabīng ni deyom kaluma'an.”  <div eID="gen4924" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4921" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2255"/><div sID="gen4925" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Petros Magpasab'nnal Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.13-Matt.16.20">Matiyu 16:13-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.18-Luke.9.21">Lukas 9:18-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4926" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2255"/> Manjari itu palanjal si Isa maka mulidna ni saga kaluma'an ma sakalibut da'ira Kesareya Pilipi. Na, ma labayan pa'in, atilaw si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Sai kono' aku bang ma pah'lling saga a'a?”  <div eID="gen4926" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2256"/><div sID="gen4927" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2256"/> Yuk sambung saga mulid e', “Bang ma a'a kasehe'an ka'a kono' si Yahiya Magpapandi. Bang ma a'a kasehe' in ka'a nabi Elija. Maka bang ma a'a kasehe' isab dakayu' nabi ka bay ma masa awal e'.”  <div eID="gen4927" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2257"/><div sID="gen4928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2257"/> “Na, bang ma ka'am,” yuk tilaw si Isa, “sai sa aku itu?” <div eID="gen4928" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4929" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Petros. “Ka'a Al-Masi,” yukna, “ya tapene' e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Mark 8:30
verses.text: Puwas e' binanda'an e' si Isa saga mulidna, sinō' da'a angahaka ni sai-sai in iya Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen4929" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4925" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2258"/><div sID="gen4930" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala si Isa Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.21-Matt.16.28">Matiyu 16:21-16:28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.22-Luke.9.27">Lukas 9:22-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4931" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2258"/> Na, minnē' anagna' si Isa amandu'an saga mulidna pasal ai song tum'kka ni iya. “Aku,” yukna, “Anak Manusiya', aheka du kabinasahan song pat'kka ni aku. Maka sinulak du aku e' saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Pinapatay du aku sagō' ta'abut pa'in kat'llu llawna, allum du aku pabīng.”

verses.name: Mark 8:32
verses.text: Pinapasti' to'ongan e' si Isa pah'llingna itu ma sigām, jari binowa iya e' si Petros paokat min kasehe'an bo' supaya pinabukagan.

verses.name: Mark 8:33
verses.text: Sagō' palingi' si Isa ang'nda' ma saga mulidna ati pabukaganna si Petros. “Ala'an ka min aku, saitan! Ya pamikilnu ilu pikilan manusiya' ko', ngga'i ka pikilan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4931" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2259"/><div sID="gen4932" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2259"/> Jari pinatimuk e' si Isa kaheka'an a'a inān maka saga mulidna. Yukna, “Bang aniya' a'a bilahi ameya' ma aku, subay ngga'i ka kabaya'an baranna ya dūlanna. Subay tanggungna hāgna pamapatayan iya, hatina subay paglilla'na kabinasahan. Minnē' iya makajari ameya' ma aku.

verses.name: Mark 8:35
verses.text: Sai-sai allogan kallum-baranna amutawan du kallum-nyawana min Tuhan. Sagō' sai-sai mbal allog ma kallum-baranna, lilla' isab amatay ma sababku maka ma sabab lapal ahāp itu, tantu iya makabāk kallum kakkal.

verses.name: Mark 8:36
verses.text: Sababna,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' a'a ganta' kaniya'an kamemon alta' deyom dunya itu, bo' halam aniya' kallumna kakkal, aheya lugi'na.

verses.name: Mark 8:37
verses.text: Halam aniya' tapangal'kkatna kallum-nyawana bang amutawan na min iya.

verses.name: Mark 8:38
verses.text: Saga a'a ma tahun itu, dusahan asal kaheka'an sigām maka mbal angisbat Tuhan. Sasuku aiya' angahaka'an saga a'a pasal kapameya'na ma aku maka ma pandu'ku, kinaiya'an isab e'ku. In aku Anak Manusiya' mbal angakuhan a'a inān ma waktu kapi'ituku pabalik. Pabalik du aku aliput e' sahaya Mma'ku, sinehe'an isab aku e' saga mala'ikat asussi.”  <div eID="gen4932" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.8"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:1
verses.text: Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am, aniya' maitu ma ka'am mbal amatay sat'ggol halam ta'nda'na pagparinta Tuhan pinat'nna' beya' maka kawasa aheya.”  <div eID="gen4933" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4930" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2260"/><div sID="gen4934" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapinda Pangluwahan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.1-Matt.17.13">Matiyu 17:1-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.28-Luke.9.36">Lukas 9:28-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2260"/> Na, palabay pa'in nnom llaw min waktu he'-i, si Petros maka si Yakub maka si Yahiya wa'i binowa e' si Isa patukad ni būd alanga, hal sigām sadja. Maina'an pa'in, apinda pangluwahan si Isa ma pang'nda' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 9:3
verses.text: Apote' to'ongan s'mmekna, makasilaw sidda. Halam aniya' magdarakdak ma deyom dunya itu makapapote' s'mmek buwat kapote' s'mmekna inān.

verses.name: Mark 9:4
verses.text: Panyata' isab pina'an nabi Elija maka nabi Musa, ta'nda' e' saga mulid e' magsuli-suli maka si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 9:5
verses.text: Ah'lling si Petros ni si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, ahāp to'ongan isab itiya' kami maitu. Angahinang kami t'llu panggung-panggung pasindunganbi maitu, dakayu' ma ka'a, dakayu' ma si Musa, maka dakayu' ma si Elija.”

verses.name: Mark 9:6
verses.text: Buwattē' tapamūngna sabab mbal kata'uwanna bang ai subay pah'llingna. Aheya sidda tāw saga mulid e'.  <div eID="gen4935" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2261"/><div sID="gen4936" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2261"/> Sakali aniya' gabun bay angalandungan sigām, maka aniya' suwala ah'lling minnē'. Yuk suwala he', “Anakku ko' itu, ya kalasahanku. Iya ya kalehunbi.”

verses.name: Mark 9:8
verses.text: Pag'nda' sigām paruruwambila' ma sigām, halam aniya' a'a ta'nda' sigām, luwal si Isa.  <div eID="gen4936" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2262"/><div sID="gen4937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2262"/> Manjari itu, paglūd pa'in sigām min būd e', binanda'an sigām e' si Isa, yukna, “Da'a kam angahaka ni sai-sai pasal bay ta'nda'bi ma diyata' būd. Subay na aku, Anak Manusiya', tapakallum pabīng min kamatayku bo' yampa kam angahaka.”  <div eID="gen4937" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2263"/><div sID="gen4938" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2263"/> Niasip e' sigām kabtangan si Isa itu sagō' magtilaw-tilaw sigām kat'llungan bang ai hatina ya bay yukna pasal kapakallum min kamatay.

verses.name: Mark 9:11
verses.text: Sakali tinilaw iya e' sigām, yuk-i, “Angay magpa'in saga guru sara' agama in si Elija subay palahil dahū pi'itu?”  <div eID="gen4938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2264"/><div sID="gen4939" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2264"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “B'nnal ko' ilu, palahil dahū si Elija min Al-Masi bo' anakapan kamemon. Saguwā' tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab pasal Anak Manusiya' in iya subay makalabay kabinasahan aheya maka subay nihalipulu. Angay bahā'?

verses.name: Mark 9:13
verses.text: Sagō' haka'anta kam pasal si Elija. Bay na iya palahil ati tahinang ma iya e' saga manusiya' ai-ai kabaya'an sigām, buwat bay tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab ma pasalna.”  <div eID="gen4939" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4934" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2265"/><div sID="gen4940" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Sinōd Saitan Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.14-Matt.17.21">Matiyu 17:14-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.37-Luke.9.43">Lukas 9:37-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2265"/> Na, makabalik pa'in disi Isa ni saga mulid kasehe'an, lumandu'an aheka a'a ta'nda' e' sigām magtimuk. Aniya' isab saga guru sara' agama ta'nda' e' sigām magjawab maka saga mulid si Isa kasehe'.

verses.name: Mark 9:15
verses.text: Pag'nda' kaheka'an a'a itu ma si Isa, aheya kainu-inuhan sigām ati paragan sigām anampang iya.

verses.name: Mark 9:16
verses.text: Atilaw si Isa, yukna, “Ai pagjawabanbi ilu?”  <div eID="gen4941" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2266"/><div sID="gen4942" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2266"/> Jari aniya' anambung min deyom katimukan a'a inān, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, bay bowaku ni ka'a anakku l'lla sabab sinōd iya saitan umaw.

verses.name: Mark 9:18
verses.text: Kahaba' waktu, bang iya kasangonan e' saitan itu, pinahantak iya ni tana'. Anuput-nuput bowa'na, magtage'ot emponna, maka anuwas isab baranna. Bay amu'ku pinala'an e' saga mulidnu itu sagō' mbal takole' e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen4942" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2267"/><div sID="gen4943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2267"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am saga a'a ma tahun itu, halam to'ongan aniya' imanbi! Subay buwattingga gi' t'ggolku ma ka'am anandalan kabuwattilubi? Bowahun pi'itu onde' ilu,” yukna.

verses.name: Mark 9:20
verses.text: Jari binowa iya ni si Isa. <div eID="gen4943" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4944" type="paragraph"/> Ta'nda' pa'in si Isa e' saitan, magtūy sinawan e'na onde' inān ati pinahantak ni tana' amaspad. Anuput-nuput isab bowa'na.

verses.name: Mark 9:21
verses.text: Atilaw si Isa ma mma' onde' inān, yukna, “Sumiyan gi' bay kabuwattituna itu?” <div eID="gen4944" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4945" type="paragraph"/> “Sangay min kariki'-diki'na,” yuk mma'na.

verses.name: Mark 9:22
verses.text: “Araran iya pinahantak e' saitan ni deyom api atawa ni deyom bohe' bo' pinapatay. Ndū' tuwan, bang takole'nu, ma'ase' ka ba. Tabangun kami!”  <div eID="gen4945" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2268"/><div sID="gen4946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2268"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Angay tilawnu bang takole'ku? Bang a'a taga-iman,” yukna, “takole'na kamemon.”  <div eID="gen4946" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2269"/><div sID="gen4947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2269"/> Atanog magtūy pah'lling mma' onde' he', yukna, “Aniya' imanku sagō' kulang lagi'. Tabangin aku bo' supaya pasōng kosogna.”  <div eID="gen4947" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2270"/><div sID="gen4948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2270"/> Pag'nda' si Isa ma kaheka'an a'a inān song na pagipit ni iya, magtūy lāngna saitan e'. “Ka'a saitan umaw maka bisu,” yukna, “soho'ta ka ala'an min deyom baran onde' ilu. Da'a ka pasōd pi'ilu pabīng!”  <div eID="gen4948" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2271"/><div sID="gen4949" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2271"/> Jari itu, aubus pa'in e' saitan angolang pakosog maka e'na amaspad onde' inān, paluwas iya min baranna. Sakali angaluwa patay onde' inān, angkan yuk kaheka'an a'a inān, “Na! Amatay na!”

verses.name: Mark 9:27
verses.text: Sagō' binalutan tangan onde' ina'an e' si Isa bo' tabanganna papunduk. An'ngge iya magtūy.  <div eID="gen4949" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2272"/><div sID="gen4950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2272"/> Na, makasōd pa'in si Isa ni deyom luma', tinilaw iya e' saga mulidna pagka sigām-sigām la'a. Yuk-i, “Angay kami bay mbal makapaluwas saitan e'?”  <div eID="gen4950" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2273"/><div sID="gen4951" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2273"/> Yuk si Isa, “Ya ginis saitan ina'an mbal tapaluwas, luwal bang niamu'an tabang min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4951" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4940" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2274"/><div sID="gen4952" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amissala Pabīng Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.22-Matt.17.23">Matiyu 17:22-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.43-Luke.9.45">Lukas 9:43-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4953" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2274"/> Manjari palanjal na disi Isa minna'an bo' palabay min t'ngnga' lahat Jalil. Ya kabaya'an si Isa subay halam aniya' makata'u bang pi'ingga pal'ngngananna,

verses.name: Mark 9:31
verses.text: sabab ina'an iya amandu'an saga mulidna. Yukna ni sigām, “Aku, Anak Manusiya' itu, arai' na sinōngan ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ati pinapatay du aku e' sigām. Sagō' puwas t'llumbahangi min kapamapatay ma aku, allum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4953" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2275"/><div sID="gen4954" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2275"/> Saguwā' halam tahati bissala si Isa inān e' saga mulidna, maka mbal isab sigām makatawakkal anilaw iya.  <div eID="gen4954" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4952" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2276"/><div sID="gen4955" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sai Ya Katapusan Alanga?</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.18.1-Matt.18.5">Matiyu 18:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.46-Luke.9.48">Lukas 9:46-48</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4956" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2276"/> Manjari itu at'kka na sigām ni da'ira Kapirnaum. Makasōd pa'in si Isa ni deyom luma', tinilaw e'na saga mulidna, yukna, “Ai bay paglugatanbi ma labayan e'?”  <div eID="gen4956" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2277"/><div sID="gen4957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2277"/> Sagō' mbal sigām bilahi anambung sabab ya paglugatan sigām bang sai ya katapusan alanga.

verses.name: Mark 9:35
verses.text: Jari aningkō' si Isa bo' lingananna saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa ina'an pabihing ni iya. Yukna ma sigām, “Sai-sai bilahi pinalanga to'ongan subay magpatireyo' di-na min kamemon. Subay iya magsosoho'an ni pagkahina kamemon.”

verses.name: Mark 9:36
verses.text: Sakali niā' e' si Isa dakayu' onde'-onde' pinat'ngge e'na ma dahuwan sigām. Ginapus pa'in e'na onde' itu, yukna ni sigām,

verses.name: Mark 9:37
verses.text: “Sai-sai anaima' dakayu' onde'-onde' buwattitu ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutanna, sali' du baranku ya tinaima' e'na. Maka sai-sai isab anaima' aku, ngga'i ka hal aku ya taima'na. Taima'na isab Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku ni dunya.”  <div eID="gen4957" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4955" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2278"/><div sID="gen4958" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sasuku Mbal Anagga' Kitam Amogbog du</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.9.49-Luke.9.50">Lukas 9:49-50</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4959" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2278"/> Jari itu aniya' pah'lling si Yahiya ni si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, aniya' dakayu' a'a ta'nda' kami anabbut ōnnu pamaluwasna saitan min deyom baran a'a. Bay iya lāng kami sabab ngga'i ka sehe'tam.”  <div eID="gen4959" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2279"/><div sID="gen4960" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2279"/> Saguwā' ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Da'a iya lāngunbi sabab bang a'a makahinang hinang kawasahan ma sabab aku ya panabbutanna, mbal magtūy tapah'llingna la'at ma pasalan aku.

verses.name: Mark 9:40
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai mbal anagga' kitam amogbog du ma kitam.

verses.name: Mark 9:41
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan, sai-sai amuwanan ka'am minsan la'a hal dasawan bohe' ma sabab suku' kam Al-Masi, tantu a'a inān tinungbasan kahāpan.”  <div eID="gen4960" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4958" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2280"/><div sID="gen4961" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Amowa Pagkahina Magdusa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.18.6-Matt.18.9">Matiyu 18:6-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.17.1-Luke.17.2">Lukas 17:1-2</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4962" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2280"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Bang aniya' ganta' makaparusa ma dakayu' a'a areyo' buwat hantang onde' itu, a'a taga-pangandol ma aku, ahāp lagi' bang a'a makaparusa inān pinagantungan batu abuhat ma k'llongna bo' yampa nihūg ni timbang, bang pa'in mbal kalandu'an hinangna buwattē'.

verses.name: Mark 9:43
verses.text: Bang tanganbi ganta' amowa ka'am magdusa gom lagi' pōnganbi bo' mbal kalandu'an dusa he'. Ahāp lagi' kam pasōd ni deyom sulga' ma apukul dambila' tanganbi, bang pa'in kam da'a nilarukan ni deyom api nalka' ya mbal kap'ddahan ma ajukup tanganbi karuwambila'. [

verses.name: Mark 9:44
verses.text: Ya kabinasahan a'a ma deyom nalka' he' halam aniya' hāranna, ya p'ddi'na halam aniya' tobtobanna.]

verses.name: Mark 9:45
verses.text: Bang tape'bi isab ganta' amowa ka'am magdusa, gom lagi' pōnganbi. Ahāp lagi' kam pasōd ni deyom sulga' ma apukul dambila' tape'bi, bang pa'in kam da'a nilarukan ni deyom api nalka' ma ajukup tape'bi karuwambila'. [

verses.name: Mark 9:46
verses.text: Ya kabinasahan a'a ma deyom nalka' he' halam aniya' hāranna, ya p'ddi'na halam aniya' tobtobanna.]

verses.name: Mark 9:47
verses.text: Bang matabi isab amowa ka'am magdusa, gom na pa'in lugitunbi bo' mbal kalandu'an dusa he'. Ahāp lagi' kam pasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan ma abuta dambila' matabi, bang pa'in kam da'a nilarukan ni deyom api nalka' ma ajukup matabi karuwambila'.

verses.name: Mark 9:48
verses.text: Ya kabinasahan a'a ma deyom nalka' he' halam aniya' hāranna, ya p'ddi'na halam aniya' tobtobanna.”  <div eID="gen4962" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2281"/><div sID="gen4963" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2281"/> Magparalilan gi' si Isa. “Niasinan saga a'a kamemon, pinalabay min katiksa'an ya sapantun api.

verses.name: Mark 9:50
verses.text: Ahāp asal asin itu sagō' halam aniya' pamabalik nanamna bang magtinu' na. Angkan ka'am isab,” yukna, “subay aniya' asin ma ka'am, hatina subay kam pahatul-hatul bo' aniya' kasulutanbi.”  <div eID="gen4963" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.9"/> <div eID="gen4961" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2282"/><div sID="gen4964" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagtiman A'a Maglakibini</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.1-Matt.19.12">Matiyu 19:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.16.18">Lukas 16:18</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4965" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2282"/> Manjari ala'an si Isa min lahat ina'an bo' pehē' ni lahat Yahudiya maka ni jadjahan lahat ma liyu sapa' Jordan. Aheka isab saga a'a patimuk ni iya, ati pandu'anna sigām buwat asal kabiyaksahanna.  <div eID="gen4965" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2283"/><div sID="gen4966" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2283"/> Na, aniya' pina'an ni iya saga a'a Parisi ya magniyat anulayan iya bo' supaya tajallat ma bissalana. Yuk sigām ma iya, “Bang ma sara'tam, makajari bahā' bang l'lla animanan h'ndana?”  <div eID="gen4966" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2284"/><div sID="gen4967" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2284"/> Anambung si Isa yukna, “Ai bay panoho'an ka'am ma sara' si Musa?”  <div eID="gen4967" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2285"/><div sID="gen4968" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2285"/> Yuk sambung sigām, “Bang ma sara' si Musa, makajari l'lla animanan h'ndana bang pa'in aniya' sulatna pagpasahan.”  <div eID="gen4968" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2286"/><div sID="gen4969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2286"/> Yuk si Isa, “Ya angkan kam sinulatan sara' buwattilu e' si Musa sabab agagga kam.

verses.name: Mark 10:6
verses.text: Ma awal tagna', ma waktu kapamapanjari Tuhan ma manusiya', bay sigā pinapanjari e'na l'lla maka d'nda, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i,

verses.name: Mark 10:7
verses.text: ‘Angkanna l'lla ang'bba min ina'-mma'na bo' parakayu' ni h'ndana.

verses.name: Mark 10:8
verses.text: Manjari in bay duwa baran, dabaran na.’ Ngga'i ka na sigā duwa baran,” yuk si Isa, “sagō' dabaran na sigā karuwangan.

verses.name: Mark 10:9
verses.text: Angkan subay mbal pinapagbutas e' manusiya' ya bay pinagdakayu' e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4969" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2287"/><div sID="gen4970" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2287"/> Maka-mareyom luma' pa'in disi Isa pabīng, tinilaw iya e' saga mulidna pasal pagtiman itu.

verses.name: Mark 10:11
verses.text: Yukna ni sigām, “Sai-sai animanan h'ndana bo' magh'nda iya saddī, taga-dusa iya angaliyu-lakad min h'ndana po'on.

verses.name: Mark 10:12
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang d'nda ya animanan h'llana bo' magh'lla saddī, taga-dusa isab iya angaliyu-lakad.”  <div eID="gen4970" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4964" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2288"/><div sID="gen4971" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalasa si Isa ma Kamanahutan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.13-Matt.19.15">Matiyu 19:13-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.15-Luke.8.17">Lukas 18:15-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4972" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2288"/> Na, aniya' saga a'a amowa anak sigām ni si Isa bo' supaya pinat'nna'an tanganna. Sagō' a'a amowa inān bay pinabukagan e' kamuliran si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 10:14
verses.text: Jari pag'nda' itu e' si Isa, angastol iya ma saga mulid e' ati yukna, “Parūlunbi pi'itu ni aku saga kamanahutan ilu. Da'a lāngunbi. Sabab sai-sai makasali' kaul-pi'ilna ni buwat kamanahutan ilu, taga-palsuku'an du ma deyoman pagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 10:15
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am, bang a'a mbal pasulut ma pagparinta Tuhan buwat kapasulut onde'-onde', a'a inān mbal pasōd ni pagparintahan Tuhan.”

verses.name: Mark 10:16
verses.text: Jari ginapus e'na saga onde'-onde' inān, pinat'nna' e'na tanganna ni sigām bo' yampa amu'anna kahāpan.  <div eID="gen4972" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4971" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2289"/><div sID="gen4973" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Taga-Karaya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.16-Matt.19.30">Matiyu 19:16-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.18-Luke.18.30">Lukas 18:18-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4974" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2289"/> Manjari itu, song pa'in pauntas si Isa ni pal'ngngananna pabīng, aniya' dakayu' l'lla paragan tudju ni iya. Angōk-tu'ut a'a itu ma dahuan si Isa maka e'na atilaw, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, asal ka ahāp. Ai subay hinangku bo' supaya aku kaniya'an kallum ya taptap ni kasaumulan?”  <div eID="gen4974" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2290"/><div sID="gen4975" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2290"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Angay yuknu in aku ahāp? Halam aniya' ahāp, luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'.

verses.name: Mark 10:19
verses.text: Kata'uwannu asal bay panoho'an Tuhan: Da'a ka amono'. Da'a ka angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'nu. Da'a ka anangkaw, da'a ka anaksi' puting. Da'a ka angulli'an pagkahinu bo' ta'ā' alta'na. Pagaddatin ina'-mma'nu.”  <div eID="gen4975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2291"/><div sID="gen4976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2291"/> Yuk l'lla ni iya, “Tuwan Guru, bay na kabogboganku ina'an-i kamemon sangay min kaonde'-onde'ku.”  <div eID="gen4976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2292"/><div sID="gen4977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2292"/> Pag'nda' si Isa ma a'a itu, t'kkahan iya lasa ati yukna, “Aniya' gi' dakayu' halam tahinangnu. Pehē' ka, pab'llihin alta'nu kamemon bo' pamuwanun b'llihanna ma saga a'a miskin. Manjari aniya' du karayanu ma deyom sulga'. Puwas e' pi'itu ka ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Mark 10:22
verses.text: Pagkale a'a itu ma bissala si Isa, ala'at magtūy s'mmuna. Ala'an iya minnē' maka e'na asusa sabab landu' aheka pangalta'na.  <div eID="gen4977" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2293"/><div sID="gen4978" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2293"/> Ang'nda' si Isa ni saga mulidna bo' yukna ma sigām, “Saga a'a dayahan kahunitan pinasōd ni deyoman pagparinta Tuhan!”

verses.name: Mark 10:24
verses.text: Takuddat saga mulidna ma bissalana itu, sagō' aniya' gi' sinugpatan, yuk-i, “Saga bagay, ahunit sidda kasōd a'a ni deyoman pagparinta Tuhan!

verses.name: Mark 10:25
verses.text: Kaluhayan gi' unta' palabay min buli' jalum min a'a dayahan pasōd ni pagparintahan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4978" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2294"/><div sID="gen4979" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2294"/> Pasōng gom pa'in kainu-inu saga mulid, ati yuk sigām ni iya, “Oy! Bang buwattē', sai bahā' makasampay ni kasalamatan ni deyom sulga'?”  <div eID="gen4979" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2295"/><div sID="gen4980" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2295"/> Pinandang e' si Isa saga mulidna maka e'na ah'lling, yukna, “Bang manusiya' mbal to'ongan makarapat sagō' tarapat du e' Tuhan sabab halam aniya' ahunit ma iya.”  <div eID="gen4980" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2296"/><div sID="gen4981" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2296"/> Sakali ah'lling si Petros, yukna, “Nda'un ba kami itu. Bay na bbahan kami ai-ai kamemon bo' ameya' ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen4981" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2297"/><div sID="gen4982" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2297"/> “Aho',” yuk si Isa ma sigām, “maka haka'anta kam to'ongan, sasuku bay ang'bbahan luma'na, atawa danakanna, atawa ina'-mma'na, atawa panganakna, atawa tana'na, tinungbasan du iya. Bang he'-i bay bbahanna ma sabab katuyu'na ma aku maka ma sabab lapal ahāp,

verses.name: Mark 10:30
verses.text: tinungbasan du iya paheka e' Tuhan ma dunya itu-i. Tinungbasan iya luma', danakan, ina', panganak, maka tana', lipat manglipat min bay bbahanna. Sagō' pinat'kkahan iya kala'atan isab ma dunya itu ma sabab pameya'na ma aku. Ma dunya ahirat pinasuku'an du iya kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Mark 10:31
verses.text: Sagō' aheka a'a makarahū buwattina'an pinaramuli du ma waktu sinōng. Aheka isab taramuli ma buwattina'an pinarahū du ma waktu sinōng.”  <div eID="gen4982" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4973" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2298"/><div sID="gen4983" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amissala Pabīng Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.20.17-Matt.20.19">Matiyu 20:17-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.31-Luke.18.34">Lukas 18:31-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4984" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2298"/> Na, ma labayan pa'in disi Isa patukad tudju ni da'ira Awrusalam, parahū si Isa min saga mulidna. Jari' tak'bbal deyom atay sigām, tināw isab saga a'a kasehe'an ya paturul min buli'an. Manjari binowa e' si Isa mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa pasaddī min a'a kasehe'an inān bo' pahatina sigām pasal pakaradja'an ya song pat'kka ni iya.

verses.name: Mark 10:33
verses.text: “Pakale kam,” yukna. “Itiya' kitam patukad ni Awrusalam, ati maina'an pa'in, in aku, ya pinagōnan Anak Manusiya', sinōngan du ni pang'ntanan saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Pinataluwa'an aku hukuman ni kamatay. Puwas e' ni'nde'an aku ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi,

verses.name: Mark 10:34
verses.text: ati pinagudju'-udju' aku e' bangsa inān sampay pinagludja'an. Pinagdaplosan du aku bo' yampa nilansang pinapatay. Sagō' apuwas pa'in t'llumbahangi min kamatayku allum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4984" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4983" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2299"/><div sID="gen4985" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapangamu' si Yakub maka si Yahiya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.20.20-Matt.20.28">Matiyu 20:20-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4986" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2299"/> Sakali pina'an ni si Isa si Yakub maka si Yahiya ya anak si Sibidi karuwangan. “Tuwan Guru,” yuk sigā, “aniya' amu' kami bang pa'in hinangannu kami.”  <div eID="gen4986" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2300"/><div sID="gen4987" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2300"/> Yuk si Isa, “Ai amu'bi?”  <div eID="gen4987" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2301"/><div sID="gen4988" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2301"/> Anambung sigā, yuk-i, “Bang ta'abut waktu kapaningkō'nu ma kasahaya'annu, ya kabaya'an kami subay pinatingkō' e'nu ma bihingnu, dakayu' ma kowan, dakayu' ma gibang.”  <div eID="gen4988" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2302"/><div sID="gen4989" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2302"/> Yuk si Isa, “Mbal kata'uwanbi bang ai amu'bi ilu. Makasandal kam bahā' pinananaman kasukkalan buwat pamasukkal aku ma sinosōng ilu? Atawa makasandal kam pinalabay min kabinasahan ya song labayanku?”  <div eID="gen4989" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2303"/><div sID="gen4990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2303"/> “Aho', makasandal du kami,” yuk duwangan e'. <div eID="gen4990" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4991" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa, “Asal makananam du kam kasukkalan buwat song pat'kka ni aku. Makalabay du kam min kabinasahan ya song labayanku.

verses.name: Mark 10:40
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' kapatutku amene' bang sai pinatingkō' ma bihingku kowan atawa ma bihingku gibang. Suku' ko' inān saga a'a ya tinagamahan paningkō'an ina'an-i e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen4991" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2304"/><div sID="gen4992" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2304"/> Takale pa'in e' saga sangpū' mulid si Isa pasal bay niamu' e' si Yakub maka si Yahiya, magtūy in sigā karuwangan itu kinap'ddi'an atay.

verses.name: Mark 10:42
verses.text: Angkan sigām sinō' e' si Isa patimuk ni atagna. Yukna, “Kata'uwanbi kajarihan saga a'a ma dunya itu. Ya binista taga-kapatut ma saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi, ya na a'a magparintahan sigām maka magmandahan sasuku ma deyo'an sigām. Ya du saga puntuk nakura' sigām, angahagda asal ma sigām.

verses.name: Mark 10:43
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu mbal subay magbuwattē'. Sai-sai kam bilahi taga-ōn ma deyomanbi, subay magsosoho'an ni kasehe'an.

verses.name: Mark 10:44
verses.text: Sai-sai kam bilahi pinalanga subay magpa'ata ni a'a kamemon bo' anabangan sigām.

verses.name: Mark 10:45
verses.text: Subay iya pa'anggil ni aku ya Anak Manusiya' itu,” yuk si Isa. “Ya pi'ituku ni dunya ngga'i ka aku subay pinaghinangan e' saga manusiya', sagō' sigām ya subay tabangku. Pi'itu isab aku bo' paglilla'ku kallumku pangal'kkatku saga a'a aheka min paldusahan sigām.”  <div eID="gen4992" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen4985" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2305"/><div sID="gen4993" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Bartimiyus Kauli'an e' si Si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.20.29-Matt.20.34">Matiyu 20:29-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.18.35-Luke.18.43">Lukas 18:35-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen4994" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2305"/> Na, at'kka na disi Isa ni da'ira Ariha. Jari itu, atulak pa'in iya maka saga mulidna minnē', maka aheka isab a'a parongan ma sigām, aniya' a'a buta aningkō' ma bihing lān palabayan sigām. Si Bartimiyus ōnna, ya anak si Timiyu. Hinangna anantili'.<note>Santili': hatina a'a pangangamu' ni a'a maglaulabay.</note>

verses.name: Mark 10:47
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in iya in si Isa min Nasaret ina'an palabay, magtūy iya angalingan pakosog. “O Isa,” yukna, “tubu' sultan Da'ud, ma'ase' ka ba ma aku!”  <div eID="gen4994" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2306"/><div sID="gen4995" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2306"/> Pinabukagan iya e' kaheka'an a'a inān, sinō' da'a ahidjul. Sagō' pinakosog gom pa'in pangalinganna, yukna, “O Isa, tubu' Sultan Da'ud, ma'ase' na ka!”  <div eID="gen4995" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2307"/><div sID="gen4996" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2307"/> Pahogga' si Isa bo' ah'lling ni saga sehe'na. “Linganinbi iya pi'itu,” yukna. <div eID="gen4996" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4997" type="paragraph"/> Jari nilinganan na iya, yuk-i, “Palasig ka. An'ngge ka sabab ina'an si Isa angalinganan ka'a.”

verses.name: Mark 10:50
verses.text: Magtūy palaksu buta itu min baina maka e'na angala'anan manta bay pak'mmosna bo' pasekot ni si Isa.  <div eID="gen4997" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2308"/><div sID="gen4998" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2308"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Ai kabaya'annu hinangku ma ka'a?” <div eID="gen4998" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen4999" type="paragraph"/> “Tuwan Guru,” yukna, “bilahi aku maka'nda' pabīng.”  <div eID="gen4999" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2309"/><div sID="gen5000" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2309"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Amole' na ka. Pauli' na matanu ma sabab pangandolnu ma aku.” Saru'un-du'un du iya maka'nda' pabīng ati ameya' iya paturul ma si Isa ma pal'ngngananna.  <div eID="gen5000" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.10"/> <div eID="gen4993" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2310"/><div sID="gen5001" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmahaldika' ma si Isa Pagsōdna ni Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.1-Matt.21.11">Matiyu 21:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.28-Luke.19.40">Lukas 19:28-40</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.12.12-John.12.19">Yahiya 12:12-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2310"/> Jari itu, asekot-sekot pa'in disi Isa ni da'ira Awrusalam bo' ma atag kaluma'an Betpage maka Betani na, ta'abut e' sigām būd Kayu Jaitun. Mahē' pa'in, sinoho' e' si Isa duwangan mulidna parahū.

verses.name: Mark 11:2
verses.text: “Pehē' na kam,” yukna, “ni kaluma'an ma dahuanbi ilu. Pagt'kkabi pina'an makabāk du kam dakayu' anak kura' pahengkot, kura' halam bay tapangura'an a'a. Hubarinbi bo' bowahunbi pi'itu.

verses.name: Mark 11:3
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' atilaw ka'am bang angay ngā'bi, haka'inbi buwattitu. Yukbi, ‘Tu'ud pagguna e' nakura'. Mbal du at'ggol tinūran du e'na.’ ”  <div eID="gen5002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2311"/><div sID="gen5003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2311"/> Na, pehē' duwangan mulid e' ati tabāk e' sigā anak kura' ma lān, pahengkot ma tambol luma' maina'an. Sabu pa'in sigā angahubad,

verses.name: Mark 11:5
verses.text: tinilaw sigā e' saga a'a bay magt'nggehan asal ma atag ina'an-i, yuk-i, “Angay hubaranbi ilu?”  <div eID="gen5003" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2312"/><div sID="gen5004" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2312"/> Anambung duwangan mulid inān buwat bay pangidda si Isa ma sigā ati pinasagaran palanjal.

verses.name: Mark 11:7
verses.text: Binowa kura' e' sigā ni si Isa ati nilampikan bukutna maka badju' sigā bo' yampa pangura'an e' si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 11:8
verses.text: Sakali itu aheka a'a am'llat s'mmek sigām ma lān palabayanna. Kasehe'an isab bay anagpe' saga engas-engas dahunan min huma bo' sinabulakan e' sigām ma lān.

verses.name: Mark 11:9
verses.text: Manjari ba'anan saga a'a ya pal'ngngan min dahuan si Isa sampay sigām paturul min buli'anna, maglinganan sama-sama, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5006"/>“Mahaldika'! Bang pa'in binarakatan ya kawakilan e' Tuhan pi'itu!<l eID="gen5006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5007"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:10
verses.text: Bang pa'in binarakatan pamarintana ya song pat'nna'na,<l eID="gen5007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5008"/>buwat pamarinta pangkatantam si Da'ud.<l eID="gen5008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5009"/>Mahaldika' ni Tuhan Mahatinggi!”<l eID="gen5009" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5005"/>  <div eID="gen5004" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2313"/><div sID="gen5010" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2313"/> Manjari pat'ngnga'-t'ngnga' si Isa ni da'ira Awrusalam bo' yampa pasōd ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Nililing e'na ai-ai kamemon ma deyomna inān, sagō', pagka song sangom na, paluwas iya minnē'. Pabīng iya maka saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa ni kauman Betani.  <div eID="gen5010" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5001" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2314"/><div sID="gen5011" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kayu Igira Taluwa' Sapda</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.18-Matt.21.19">Matiyu 21:18-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5012" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2314"/> Pag'llaw dakayu' pa'in, hinabu sigām pauntas min Betani he', lingantu na si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 11:13
verses.text: Jari aniya' ta'nda'na min katāhan dakayu' kayu igira alapat e' dahun, angkan iya pina'an ang'nda' bang taga-buwa'. Sagō' pagpina'anna, luwal du dahun ya ta'nda' maina'an sabab ngga'i ka gi' musimna pagbuwa'.

verses.name: Mark 11:14
verses.text: Sinapdahan e' si Isa kayu inān, yukna, “Puwas minnitu halam du aniya' amangan buwa' min kayu itu sampay ni kasaumulan.” Na, takale sapda itu e' saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen5012" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5011" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2315"/><div sID="gen5013" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasōd si Isa ni Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.12-Matt.21.17">Matiyu 21:12-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.45-Luke.19.48">Lukas 19:45-48</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.2.13-John.2.22">Yahiya 2:13-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5014" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2315"/> Na, at'kka pa'in sigām ni Awrusalam, pasōd si Isa ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan bo' yampa anagna' amala'an saga magdaragang maka maglilitu maina'an. Binulangkayat e'na lamisahan saga magsasambi' sīn bangsa liyu ni sīn Yahudi. Ya du paningkō'an saga a'a magdagang assang pagkulban, binulangkayat isab e'na.

verses.name: Mark 11:16
verses.text: Halam aniya' bay pasagaranna angahangkut ai-ai labay min deyom langgal e'.

verses.name: Mark 11:17
verses.text: Jari amandu' si Isa ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Tasulat asal pangallam Tuhan ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5015"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5016"/>‘Luma'ku itu niōnan luma' pagsambahayangan<l eID="gen5016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5017"/>ma saga a'a kabangsa-bangsahan.’<l eID="gen5017" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5015"/> Sagō' hinangbi na sali' luma' patapukan mundu!”  <div eID="gen5014" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2316"/><div sID="gen5018" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2316"/> Kahaka'an saga imam alanga maka saga guru sara' agama pasal hinang si Isa itu, ya po'on sigām anagna' maggara' bang buwattingga e' sigām amapatay iya. Tināw asal sigām ma iya sabab kinainu-inuhan pandu'na e' a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen5018" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2317"/><div sID="gen5019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2317"/> Pagabay kohap pa'in, magla'anan disi Isa min Awrusalam e'.  <div eID="gen5019" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5013" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2318"/><div sID="gen5020" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamintāngan min Kayu Igira</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.20-Matt.21.22">Matiyu 21:20-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5021" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2318"/> Subu-subu pa'in, hinabu pa'in disi Isa pabalik ni Awrusalam, ta'nda' e' sigām in kayu igira bay sapdahanna he', alanos na min gamut sampay pariyata'.

verses.name: Mark 11:21
verses.text: Taentom e' si Petros bay lling si Isa ati yukna, “Nda'un ba, Tuwan! Alanos na kayu igira bay sapdahannu he'!”  <div eID="gen5021" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2319"/><div sID="gen5022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2319"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Angandol kam ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 11:23
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan, bang saupama soho'bi būd itu ala'an min pa'ataganna bo' pat'nna' ni deyom s'llang, tahinang du ma ka'am bang pa'in halam aniya' hawal-hawal ma deyom ataybi, bang pa'in kam am'nnal isab in bay amu'bi tahinang du.

verses.name: Mark 11:24
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am, bang aniya' ai-ai amu'bi ni Tuhan, tantu kam pinaniya'an bang pa'in kam am'nnal in ka'am makasambut na.

verses.name: Mark 11:25
verses.text: Maka bang kam an'ngge angarap ni Tuhan, bo' aniya' akon-akon ma deyom ataybi ni a'a, ampununbi iya bo' supaya kam niampun isab e' Tuhan ma kala'atan bay tahinangbi. [

verses.name: Mark 11:26
verses.text: Ya balikna na, bang mbal ampunbi a'a bay amakay dusa ni ka'am, ya du ka'am mbal niampun e' Mma'bi Tuhan ma deyom sulga'.]”  <div eID="gen5022" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5020" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:27
