verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2320"/><div sID="gen5023" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw Pasal Kapatut si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.23-Matt.21.27">Matiyu 21:23-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.1-Luke.20.8">Lukas 20:1-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5024" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2320"/> Na, at'kka sigām pabīng ni Awrusalam. Manjari itu, pasalta' pa'in si Isa palunsul ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, pehē' ni iya saga kaimaman alanga, maka saga guru sara' agama, maka saga pagmatto'ahan Yahudi.

verses.name: Mark 11:28
verses.text: Yuk sigām ni iya, “Ai kapatutnu maghinang buwattilu? Sai bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut?”  <div eID="gen5024" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2321"/><div sID="gen5025" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2321"/> Yuk si Isa, “Aniya' panilawku ma ka'am dahū. Bang itu sambunganbi, haka'anta du kam bang ai kapatutku maghinang buwattitu.

verses.name: Mark 11:30
verses.text: Ya bay kapatut si Yahiya magpandi saga a'a, kapatut min Tuhan bahā' atawa min manusiya' sadja? Sambunginbi aku.”  <div eID="gen5025" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2322"/><div sID="gen5026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2322"/> Sakali magisun saga pagnakura'an inān, yuk-i, “Bang saupama yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān bay min Tuhan, tinilaw du kitam e'na itu bang angay kitam halam bay magkahagad ma iya.

verses.name: Mark 11:32
verses.text: Sagō' bang yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān min manusiya' sadja, allā, piligdu.” Tināw asal sigām sabab magkahagad saga a'a kamemon in si Yahiya dī nabi min Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 11:33
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu ya panambung saga nakura' inān ma panilaw si Isa, yuk-i, “Mbal kata'uwan kami bang minningga kapatutna.” <div eID="gen5026" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5027" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ya du isab aku mbal aku angahaka'an ka'am bang minningga kapatutku maghinang saga hinangku itu.”  <div eID="gen5027" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.11"/> <div eID="gen5023" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2323"/><div sID="gen5028" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal saga Magtutunggu' ma Kabbun Anggul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.33-Matt.21.46">Matiyu 21:33-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.9-Luke.20.19">Lukas 20:9-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5029" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2323"/> Manjari anagna' si Isa amissala kissa paralilan. “Aniya',” yukna, “dakayu' a'a tag-tana' bay ananom bahan anggul ma kabbunna. Bay nilikus e'na maka ād, bay kinali'an lowang pagp'gga'an buwa' anggul panaluran bohe'na. Nihinang isab e'na dakayu' balung-balung alanga pamantawan. Puwas e' bay patunggu'anna kabbun inān ma saga a'a magtutunggu' bo' yampa iya atulak ni lahat saddī.

verses.name: Mark 12:2
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in musim pagpusu' buwa' anggul e', sinoho' e' tag-dapu kabbun inān dakayu' sosoho'anna pehē' ni saga a'a magtutunggu' angā' bahagi'na.

verses.name: Mark 12:3
verses.text: Sagō' pagt'kka sosoho'an itu, sinaggaw iya magtūy e' a'a magtutunggu'. Niraplosan iya e' sigām bo' yampa pinapole' ma halam aniya' tabowana.

verses.name: Mark 12:4
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' sosoho'an saddī pinapehē' e' tag-kabbun inān. Jari in sosoho'an dakayu' itu kinakal ma kōkna e' saga magtutunggu'. Nihalipulu isab iya.

verses.name: Mark 12:5
verses.text: Puwas e' anoho' na isab tag-dapu inān dakayu' sosoho'an saddī pehē', ati pinapatay e' sigām. Aheka gi' isab sosoho'an bay pinabeya', sagō' ya du sigām nila'at e' saga a'a magtutunggu' inān. Kasehe' bay niraplosan, kasehe' bay pinapatay.

verses.name: Mark 12:6
verses.text: Luwal du anak tag-dapu ya takapin, ya anakna l'lla kalasahanna. Jari itu, ma damuli katapusan, bay soho'na pehē' anakna lahasiya' itu. Yukna ma deyom pikilanna, ‘Tantu pinagaddatan anakku itu e' saga tunggu' he'.’

verses.name: Mark 12:7
verses.text: Sagō' pag'nda' saga tunggu' ma anak tag-kabbun itu, magtūy sigām magisun. Yuk sigām, ‘Ya na ko' ilu anak tag-dapu. Sūng kitam, papataytam iya bo' ta'ā'tam tana'na.’

verses.name: Mark 12:8
verses.text: Manjari sinaggaw iya e' sigām, bo' binono' maka tinimanan patayna paluwas min likusan.  <div eID="gen5029" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2324"/><div sID="gen5030" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2324"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ai bahā' nihinang e' tag-dapu kabbun? Tantu du iya pina'an amapatay saga a'a magtutunggu' he' ati patunggu'anna tana'na ma a'a saddī.”

verses.name: Mark 12:10
verses.text: Atilaw iya ni saga a'a inān, “Halam bahā' tabassabi deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5031"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5032"/>‘In batu bay tasulak e' saga a'a maghinang luma',<l eID="gen5032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5033"/>ya kinabā' halam aniya' gunana,<l eID="gen5033" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5034"/>ya na ina'an batu aheya to'ongan kalagihanna.<l eID="gen5034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5035"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:11
verses.text: Hinang Tuhan ko' inān, landu' ahāp ma pang'nda' kami.’ ”<l eID="gen5035" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5031"/>  <div eID="gen5030" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2325"/><div sID="gen5036" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2325"/> Tahati e' saga nakura' Yahudi inān in sigām ya pina'andigan e' si Isa, angkan iya arak sinaggaw e' sigām. Sagō' halam kalandu'an sabab tināw sigām ma kaheka'an saga a'a, ya po'on ang'bba min iya saga pagnakura'an inān bo' ala'an minnē'.  <div eID="gen5036" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5028" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2326"/><div sID="gen5037" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagbayad Sukay ni Parinta</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.15-Matt.22.22">Matiyu 22:15-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.20-Luke.20.26">Lukas 20:20-26</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5038" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2326"/> Na, aniya' pinapehē' ni si Isa saga Parisi maka saga bebeya'an si Herod. Sinō' sigām atilaw iya pahāp bo' supaya tajallat ma panambungna.

verses.name: Mark 12:14
verses.text: Jari itu pehē' sigām ah'lling ni si Isa, yuk-i “Tuwan Guru, kata'uwan kami in ka'a apote' asal ataynu. Mbal ka tināw sinoway e' sai-sai sabab sali' du bowahannu ma a'a kamemon. B'nnal sadja pamandu'nu pasal kaul-pi'il ya kinabaya'an e' Tuhan. Na, bang ma ka'a, bang kita ganta' amayad sukay ni parinta Rōm ya ma deyo'an Sultan Mahatinggi, langgalta bahā' sara' agamatam? Wajib kita amayad atawa mbal?”  <div eID="gen5038" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2327"/><div sID="gen5039" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2327"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa kapagnahu'-nahu' sigām, angkan yukna, “Angay kam bilahi anganjallat aku ma bissalaku? Bowahinbi aku dakayu' sīn tibu'uk bo' talilingku.”  <div eID="gen5039" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2328"/><div sID="gen5040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2328"/> Binowahan iya dakayu' pisita ati tilawna sigām, yukna, “Patta' sai maka ōn sai ma sīn itu?” <div eID="gen5040" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5041" type="paragraph"/> “Patta' Sultan Mahatinggi maka sulatna,” yuk sambung sigām.  <div eID="gen5041" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2329"/><div sID="gen5042" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2329"/> “Na!” yuk si Isa. “Suku' sultan ko' itu, angkan pamayarunbi ni iya. Damikiyanna ai-ai suku' Tuhan, tukbalinbi isab ni Tuhan.” Ainu-inu magtūy saga a'a inān ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen5042" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5037" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2330"/><div sID="gen5043" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kallum Balik ma saga A'a Magpatayan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.23-Matt.22.33">Matiyu 22:23-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.27-Luke.20.40">Lukas 20:27-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5044" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2330"/> Puwas e' aniya' pina'an ni si Isa saga a'a Saddusi, daginis agama Yahudi ya magpina'in halam aniya' allum pabīng ma llaw damuli. Atilaw sigām ma si Isa, yuk-i,

verses.name: Mark 12:19
verses.text: “Tuwan Guru, aniya' sara' bay pang'bba kitam e' si Musa pasal a'a amatay ma halam taga-tubu'. In baluna subay niā' h'nda e' siyalina bo' supaya aniya' anak binista tubu' min a'a bay amatay he'.

verses.name: Mark 12:20
verses.text: Na,” yuk sigām, “aniya' bay pitu' l'lla magdanakan. Magh'nda siyaka he' sagō' amatay ma halam taga-anak.

verses.name: Mark 12:21
verses.text: Jari baluna he' niā' h'nda e' siyali pasunu' ati amatay isab iya ma halam taga-anak. Damikiyanna isab siyali kat'lluna.

verses.name: Mark 12:22
verses.text: Papu'utta na, in pitu' magdanakan bay makah'nda ni dakayu' du d'nda he', bo' amatay sigām kamemon ma halam taga-anak. Ma katapusanna amatay isab d'nda.

verses.name: Mark 12:23
verses.text: Na, Tuwan,” yuk sigām, “bang ta'abut llaw pagpakallum pabalik saga a'a magpatayan, h'nda sai bahā' d'nda he'? Sabab bay iya ta'ā' h'nda e' sigām kapitu' magdanakan.”  <div eID="gen5044" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2331"/><div sID="gen5045" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2331"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Ya angkan kam asā' sabab mbal kata'uwanbi bang ai ma deyom Kitab, maka mbal kata'uwanbi kosog kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: Mark 12:25
verses.text: Sabab bang manusiya' itu pinakallum na min kamatay, makasali' du kitam ni bangsa mala'ikat ma deyom sulga' sabab mbal na magh'nda-h'lla.

verses.name: Mark 12:26
verses.text: Na, ya pasal isab saga a'a pinakallum pabīng min kamatay, kilāku halam tabassabi ma deyom Kitab si Musa, ya pasal po'on puhung arokot. Yuk Tuhan ma iya, ‘Aku ya Tuhan disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.’

verses.name: Mark 12:27
verses.text: Tuhan itu,” yuk si Isa, “pagtuhanan asal e' saga a'a allum, ngga'i ka e' a'a magpatayan<note>Hatina masi allum disi Ibrahim inān ma deyom ahirat minsan at'ggol na kamatay ginhawa-baran sigām.</note>. Aheya pahāp kasā'anbi ilu!”  <div eID="gen5045" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5043" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2332"/><div sID="gen5046" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an ya Katapusan Aheya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.34-Matt.22.40">Matiyu 22:34-40</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.10.25-Luke.10.28">Lukas 10:25-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5047" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2332"/> Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' guru sara' agama, ati takalena pagbissala si Isa maka saga Saddusi he'. Tapikilna pa'in, ahāp panambung si Isa ma sigām, pasekot iya ni si Isa atilaw, yukna, “Ya ingga panoho'an Tuhan ahalga' min kamemon?”  <div eID="gen5047" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2333"/><div sID="gen5048" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2333"/> Yuk si Isa, “Muna-muna panoho'an ītu: ‘Pakale kam bangsa Isra'il! Ya Panghū' pagtuhanantam dakayu' du.

verses.name: Mark 12:30
verses.text: Wajib kam alasa to'ongan ma Tuhan. Ya lasabi ma iya subay min deyom ataybi, min panahu'anbi, min deyom tawhidbi, maka min kosogbi.’

verses.name: Mark 12:31
verses.text: Ya na itu panoho'an karuwana, ya yuk-i, ‘Wajib kam alasahan pagkahibi manusiya' buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi’. Halam aniya' panoho'an makaliyu min duwa panoho'an itu.”  <div eID="gen5048" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2334"/><div sID="gen5049" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2334"/> “Taluwa', Tuwan Guru,” yuk guru inān ni si Isa. “B'nnal ya yuknu ilu. In Tuhantam dakayu' du, halam aniya' saddī min iya.

verses.name: Mark 12:33
verses.text: Maka manusiya' itu wajib alasa ma Tuhan min deyom atayna maka min deyom tawhidna maka min kosogna. Wajib isab iya alasahan pagkahina manusiya' buwat e'na alasahan baranna. Ahalga' panoho'an karuwa itu, wajib binogbogan labi gi' min hinang panukbal susumbali'an atawa lalabotan indaginis ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5049" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2335"/><div sID="gen5050" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2335"/> Ta'nda' pa'in e' si Isa kalalom pangita'u a'a inān anambung buwattē', angkan yukna ma iya, “Ka'a ilu asekot ni pagparintahan Tuhan.” Puwas e' halam aniya' makatawakkal atilaw ma si Isa minsan ai na.  <div eID="gen5050" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5046" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2336"/><div sID="gen5051" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.41-Matt.22.46">Matiyu 22:41-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.41-Luke.20.44">Lukas 20:41-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5052" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2336"/> Manjari itu, hinabu pa'in si Isa amandu' ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, aniya' panilawna, yukna, “Angay saga guru sara' agama magpina'in pasal Al-Masi in iya tubu' sultan Da'ud?

verses.name: Mark 12:36
verses.text: Sabab si Da'ud baranna bay magkallam, waktu kapagbaya' Rū Sussi ma iya. Buwattitu bay pagkallamna he': <lg sID="gen5053"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5054"/>‘Bay angabtang Tuhan ni Panghū'ku, yukna,<l eID="gen5054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5055"/>Dai' ka aningkō' ma bihingku kowan,<l eID="gen5055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5056"/>ati bowaku palbantahannu tatau' ma deyo' pād-tape'nu.’<l eID="gen5056" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5053"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:37
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka Al-Masi niōnan Panghū' e' si Da'ud, tantu iya ngga'i ka hal panubu' si Da'ud.” <div eID="gen5052" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5051" type="section"/> <div sID="gen5057" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' si Isa Pasal saga Guru Sara' Agama</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.23.1-Matt.23.36">Matiyu 23:1-36</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.20.45-Luke.20.47">Lukas 20:45-47</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5058" type="paragraph"/> Manjari landu' aheka a'a kinōgan akale ma si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 12:38
verses.text: Yukna ma pamandu'na, “Halli'inbi saga guru sara' agama, ya tagihan maglunsul magpamakay juba ataha'. Tagihan isab sigām nihulmat bang ma mairan.

verses.name: Mark 12:39
verses.text: Bang sigām ma deyom langgal bilahi pinatingkō' ma tingkō'an bangsahan. Ya du bang sigām ma pagjamuhan, subay paningkō'an ya tinau'an a'a alanga.

verses.name: Mark 12:40
verses.text: Ni'inyaya e' sigām saga balu d'nda supaya ta'ā' luma' sigām, maka pinataha' e' sigām sambahayang sigām paglaku-laku in sigām bal-iman. Angkan pinalabi kabinasahan sigām ma ahirat.”  <div eID="gen5058" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5057" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2337"/><div sID="gen5059" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sīn ya Panukbal e' Balu D'nda</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.21.1-Luke.21.4">Lukas 21:1-4</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5060" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2337"/> Na, aningkō' pa'in si Isa ma deyom langgal, ma anggopan tu'ung pangahūgan sīn pagjakat, ang'nda'-ng'nda' iya ma saga a'a magpangahūg sīn pagjakat sigām. Aheka a'a dayahan wa'i angahūg pilak aheka.

verses.name: Mark 12:42
verses.text: Manjari aniya' pina'an dakayu' d'nda balu, miskin to'ongan, angahūg duwa unud sīn, halga'na dakayu' unud sīn tumbaga.

verses.name: Mark 12:43
verses.text: Sakali sinoho' e' si Isa saga mulidna patimuk ni iya bo' yukna ma sigām, “B'nnal ya pamissalaku ni ka'am itu, ya duwa unud sīn tahūg e' d'nda miskin itu ahalga' gi' min pilak kamemon ya nihūg e' kasehe'an.

verses.name: Mark 12:44
verses.text: Sabab kasehe'an inān bay amuwan min alta' sigām manglabi-labihan. Saguwā' d'nda itu, minsan iya miskin, bay pamuwanna sīn kamemon ya arak pam'llina napakana.”  <div eID="gen5060" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.12"/> <div eID="gen5059" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2338"/><div sID="gen5061" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandogahan ma Llaw Kiyamat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.1-Matt.24.2">Matiyu 24:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.5-Luke.21.6">Lukas 21:5-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5062" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2338"/> Manjari itu, pasalta' pa'in si Isa paluwas min langgal pagkulbanan, aniya' dakayu' mulidna ah'lling ni iya, “Nda'un ba, tuwan!” yukna. “Alingkat landu' langgal itu maka saga batu bay pangahinang iya!”  <div eID="gen5062" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2339"/><div sID="gen5063" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2339"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ta'nda'nu kaheya langgal itu kamemon, ā? Sagō' haka'anta ka, ma sinosōng in langgal itu alubu du. Halam du aniya' batuna angapin magbangkat, kinanat du kamemon.”  <div eID="gen5063" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5061" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2340"/><div sID="gen5064" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasigpitan maka Kabinasahan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.3-Matt.24.14">Matiyu 24:3-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.7-Luke.21.19">Lukas 21:7-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5065" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2340"/> Puwas e', aningkō' pa'in si Isa ma būd Kayu Jaitun, ma anggopan langgal pagkulbanan, pina'an ni iya si Petros, si Yakub, si Yahiya maka si Andariyas, hal sigām-sigām sadja.

verses.name: Mark 13:4
verses.text: Yuk sigām ni si Isa, “Pahatiun kono' kami bang sumiyan paniya' ya bay yuknu insini', maka bang paltanda'an ai pinatuwa' bo' kinata'uwan in pakaradja'an inān kamemon song pat'kka na?”  <div eID="gen5065" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2341"/><div sID="gen5066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2341"/> Anambung si Isa yukna, “Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' mbal niakkalan.

verses.name: Mark 13:6
verses.text: Sabab ma sinosōng aheka pi'itu anabbut ōnku, maglaku-laku in sigām Al-Masi, ati aheka tabowa-bowa niakkalan e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 13:7
verses.text: Bang aniya' takalebi hunub-hunub pagbono' ma kasekotan atawa habal pasal pagbono' ma lahat saddī, da'a kam agawa. Tantu paniya' pagbono', sagō' ngga'i ka gi' ina'an-i llaw kiyamat.

verses.name: Mark 13:8
verses.text: Magbono' du bangsa dakayu' maka dakayu', parinta dakayu' isab maka parinta dakayu'. Paniya' du isab linug ma sabarang lahat, maka paniya' isab gotom. Saguwā' in bala' itu kamemon hal tagna'anna sadja, sali' dalil d'nda ab'ttong bang yampa tananamna amuka' puhu'.  <div eID="gen5066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2342"/><div sID="gen5067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2342"/> “Sagō' ka'am ilu,” yuk si Isa, “subay painsap to'ongan sabab sinaggaw du kam bo' tinandanan ni paghukuman. Pinagdaplosan du kam ma deyom kalanggalan Yahudi. Pinatampal kam ni saga gubnul maka ni saga sultan ma sabab aku ya pameya'anbi, ati makasaksi' du kam ni sigām ma pasalanku.  <div eID="gen5067" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2343"/><div sID="gen5068" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2343"/> “Lapal ahāp itu subay pinagnasihat dahū ni sabarang bangsa bo' yampa ta'abut llaw kiyamat dunya.

verses.name: Mark 13:11
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' sinaggaw bo' tinandanan ni sara', da'a kam magsusa bang ai subay pamissalabi. Pamissalahunbi lapal ai-ai ya pamatulun ka'am bang ta'abut waktuna. Sababna ngga'i ka baranbi ya ah'lling ma waktu e'-i, sagō' Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Mark 13:12
verses.text: Ma waktu sinōng inān aniya' du saga a'a anukbalan danakan sigām ni sai-na bo' pinapatay. Aniya' du isab saga matto'a l'lla anukbalan anakna bo' pinapatay. Saga anak isab amantahan matto'a sigām, anoho' isab subay pinapatay.

verses.name: Mark 13:13
verses.text: Maka ka'am saga mulidku,” yuk si Isa, “kinab'nsihan du e' a'a kamemon ma sabab aku ya pameya'anbi. Sagō' lappasan du sasuku ahogot imanna ma deyom kabinasahan sampay ni kahinapusan.”  <div eID="gen5068" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5064" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2344"/><div sID="gen5069" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katiksa'an Sangat Abisa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.15-Matt.24.28">Matiyu 24:15-28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.20-Luke.21.24">Lukas 21:20-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5070" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2344"/> “Ma sinosōng aniya' ta'nda'bi ‘kasammalan makaharam’ pat'nna' ma ngga'i ka pat'nna'anna (sai-sai amassa itu sinō' pahati). Bang he'-i paniya' na, sasuku pat'nna' ma tana' Yahudiya subay alahi pehē' ni kabūd-būran.

verses.name: Mark 13:15
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a ma luwasan luma'na subay mbal sōdna luma'na angā' ai-aina.

verses.name: Mark 13:16
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a ma humana subay mbal pabīng ni luma' angā' badju'na paghaggut.

verses.name: Mark 13:17
verses.text: Ndū', maka'ase'-ase' saga d'nda ab'ttong ma masa ina'an-i maka saga d'nda taga-anak duru'an lagi'.

verses.name: Mark 13:18
verses.text: Amu'inbi ase' ni Tuhan bang pa'in pakaradja'an inān mbal magsabu maka musim paghaggut.

verses.name: Mark 13:19
verses.text: Sabab ya kabinasahan patumbuk ma masa sinōng ilu,” yuk si Isa, “akalap gi' bisana min kabinasahan kamemon bay kalabayan manusiya' sangay min waktu kapamapanjari dunya e' Tuhan, sampay ni waktu itu. Maka mbal isab kabalikan.

verses.name: Mark 13:20
verses.text: Daipara kinulangan e' Tuhan t'ggol kabinasahan inān. Bang bay mbal, halam du aniya' angapin allum. Kinulangan du e' Tuhan ma sabab saga a'ana ya asal tapene'na.  <div eID="gen5070" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2345"/><div sID="gen5071" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2345"/> “Na, bang ta'abut waktu ina'an-i bo' aniya' ganta' anuhuma ni ka'am, yuk-i, ‘Nda'unbi! Itiya' na Al-Masi,’ atawa, ‘Ina'an na iya maina'an,’ da'a to'ongan kahagarunbi.

verses.name: Mark 13:22
verses.text: Sababna ma waktu sinōng inān aniya' du patuwa' saga a'a magnahu'-nahu' in sigām Al-Masi atawa in sigām nabi min Tuhan. Magpa'nda' sigām hinang barakatan maka saga paltanda'an kainu-inuhan a'a bo' supaya ka'akkalan sampay a'a suku' Tuhan ya asal tapene'na, bang tabowa niakkalan.

verses.name: Mark 13:23
verses.text: Sagō' painsap kam,” yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna he'. “Bay na kam pata'uku pasal pakaradja'an ilu kamemon ma halam gi' ta'abut waktuna.”  <div eID="gen5071" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5069" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2346"/><div sID="gen5072" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapabalik Al-Masi Pi'itu ni Dunya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.29-Matt.24.31">Matiyu 24:29-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.25-Luke.21.28">Lukas 21:25-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5073" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2346"/> “Ma llaw sinōng ilu,” yuk si Isa, “apuwas pa'in saga kabinasahan bay sabbutku he', <lg sID="gen5074"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5075"/>‘angalendom mata llaw,<l eID="gen5075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5076"/>mbal amuwan sawa mata bulan.<l eID="gen5076" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5077"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:25
verses.text: Saga bitu'un magkapakpak min diyata' langit,<l eID="gen5077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5078"/>saga pandoga ma tonga'an ayan tabowa maglensa.’<l eID="gen5078" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5074"/>  <div eID="gen5073" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2347"/><div sID="gen5079" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2347"/> “Puwas e' maka'nda' du saga manusiya' ma aku, in Anak Manusiya', ameya' min gabun tudju pi'itu. Ta'nda' du e' sigām kosog barakatku maka sahayaku.

verses.name: Mark 13:27
verses.text: Papehē'ku saga mala'ikatku ni mpat pidju alam animuk saga a'a bay tapene'ku, min bihing langit dambila' maka dambila'.”  <div eID="gen5079" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5072" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2348"/><div sID="gen5080" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandogahan ma Pagbalik Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.32-Matt.24.35">Matiyu 24:32-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.21.29-Luke.21.33">Lukas 21:29-33</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5081" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2348"/> “Pamintānginbi po'on kayu igira,” yuk si Isa. “Bang ta'nda'bi angugbus tōng engas-engasna sampay angandahun na to'ongan, minnē' kata'uwanbi song musim pang'llaw na.

verses.name: Mark 13:29
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang ta'nda'bi paniya' na bay pamissalaku ma ka'am e', minnē' isab kata'uwanbi in kabalikku ni dunya asekot na.

verses.name: Mark 13:30
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, ma mbal gi' magpatayan saga a'a ya allum ma buwattina'an, paniya' du pakaradja'an kamemon ya pamissalaku itu.

verses.name: Mark 13:31
verses.text: Papinda du langit maka dunya sagō' kabtanganku itu mbal to'ongan magkapinda.”  <div eID="gen5081" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5080" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2349"/><div sID="gen5082" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Waktu Kapabalik si Isa Mbal Kinata'uwan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.36-Matt.24.44">Matiyu 24:36-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5083" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2349"/> “Halam aniya' makata'u,” yuk si Isa, “bang sumiyan llaw maka waktu kabalikku pi'itu ni dunya. Minsan bangsa mala'ikat ma deyom sulga', mbal kinata'uwan e' sigām. Minsan aku, Anak Tuhan, mbal kata'uwanku. Luwal Mma'ku Tuhan ya makata'u.

verses.name: Mark 13:33
verses.text: Painsap kam! Pajaga kam, sabab mbal kata'uwanbi ina'an-i bang sumiyan waktu kapamaniya' iya.

verses.name: Mark 13:34
verses.text: Ya dalilna sali' a'a magbamba ala'an min luma'na atulak ni lahat saddī. Pajagahanna ai-aina ma saga sosoho'anna. Pat'nna'anna sigām hinang pakaniya-pakaniya, ati amay-amayanna tunggu' lawang, sinō' pajaga to'ongan.  <div eID="gen5083" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2350"/><div sID="gen5084" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2350"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ya du ka'am subay pajaga sabab mbal kata'uwanbi bang sumiyan waktu kat'kka tag-dapu luma', bang abay-kohap ka, tonga' bahangi ka, waktu pangukku'uk manuk ka, atawa waktu pagk'llat llaw.

verses.name: Mark 13:36
verses.text: Minsan patagha' t'kkana subay kam mbal tabāk e'na magtulihan.

verses.name: Mark 13:37
verses.text: Ya pangamay-ngamayku ma ka'am sali' du maka llingku ma kamemon: ‘Pajaga kam!’ ”  <div eID="gen5084" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.13"/> <div eID="gen5082" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2351"/><div sID="gen5085" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinagisunan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.1-Matt.26.5">Matiyu 26:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.1-Luke.22.2">Lukas 22:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.31-John.13.35">Yahiya 11:45-53</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5086" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2351"/> Na, duwang'llaw gi' bo' Hinang Paglakad maka Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna. Manjari saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama magisun na pa'in bang buwattingga e' sigām anaggaw si Isa ma halam aniya' makata'u, bo' supaya iya pinapatay.

verses.name: Mark 14:2
verses.text: “Da'a pasalta'ta ma pagjamu,” yuk sigām, “bo' mbal ahiluhala' saga a'a kamemon.”  <div eID="gen5086" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5085" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2352"/><div sID="gen5087" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Binusugan Ns'llan Pahamut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.6-Matt.26.13">Matiyu 14:3-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.12.1-John.12.8">Yahiya 12:1-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5088" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2352"/> Na, ina'an si Isa ma Betani, ma luma' si Simun a'a bay ni'ipul. Ma pagkakanan pa'in si Isa, aniya' pina'an ni iya dakayu' d'nda amowa bingki'-bingki' nihinang min batu pote', isihan ns'llan pahamut. Ns'llan itu ns'llan narda halam aniya' lamudna, landu' ahalga'. Jari pinate' e' d'nda k'llong bingki'-bingki' ati binusugan kōk si Isa maka ns'llanna.

verses.name: Mark 14:4
verses.text: Aniya' maina'an saga a'a magdugal kabowa kagit atay sigām. Magbissala sigām dangan-parangan, yuk-i, “Angay ns'llan ahalga' itu pinaka'at?

verses.name: Mark 14:5
verses.text: Arapun pinab'llihan labi t'llu hatus pilak ati b'llihanna inān pamuwan ni kamiskinan.” Jari sinoway sidda e' sigām d'nda bay amusug ns'llan e'.  <div eID="gen5088" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2353"/><div sID="gen5089" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2353"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Pasagarinbi na iya. Angay iya sasawbi? Ahāp sidda hinangna ma aku itu.

verses.name: Mark 14:7
verses.text: Sabab paddas na pa'in aniya' a'a miskin ma ka'am. Makatabang du kam ma sigām bang sumiyan-sumiyan kabaya'anbi. Saguwā' aku itu mbal du paddas ma ka'am.

verses.name: Mark 14:8
verses.text: D'nda itu bay makahinang ya takole'na, hatina bu'usanna ns'llan pahamut ni baranku pangawal llaw pagkubul ma aku.

verses.name: Mark 14:9
verses.text: B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “pi'ingga-pi'ingga lahat pagnasihatan lapal ahāp ma kaluha'an dunya, kinissa du pasal bay hinang d'nda itu pangentoman ma iya.”  <div eID="gen5089" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5087" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2354"/><div sID="gen5090" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panipu si Judas Iskariyut ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.14-Matt.26.16">Matiyu 26:14-16</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.3-Luke.22.6">Lukas 22:3-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5091" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2354"/> Puwas pa'in ina'an, si Judas Iskariyut, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa, bay pehē' ni kaimaman alanga magisun anōngan si Isa ni sigām.

verses.name: Mark 14:11
verses.text: Pagkale sigām bang ai gawi si Judas itu, magtūy sigām kinōgan ati anganjanji' sigām anambahan iya maka sīn. Pagubus, amiha iya waktu ahāp panōngna si Isa ni sigām.  <div eID="gen5091" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5090" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2355"/><div sID="gen5092" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsakap ma Hinang Paglakad</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.17-Matt.26.25">Matiyu 26:17-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.7-Luke.22.23">Lukas 22:7-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.36-John.13.38">Yahiya 13:21-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5093" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2355"/> Na, ta'abut tagna'an llaw paghinang saga Yahudi ma Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna. Ya na ina'an llaw panumbali' saga anak bili-bili ya kinakan e' sigām pangentoman waktu bay kapangalappas Tuhan ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām. Tinilaw si Isa e' saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Maingga kabaya'annu panakapan kami pagjamuhannu ma Hinang Paglakad?”  <div eID="gen5093" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2356"/><div sID="gen5094" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2356"/> Jari sinoho' e' si Isa duwangan mulidna, yukna, “Pehē' kam ni deyom da'ira inān. Sinampang du kam e' dakayu' l'lla amowa kibut isihan bohe'. Turulunbi iya

verses.name: Mark 14:14
verses.text: sampay iya pasōd na ni deyom luma'. Amissala kam isab ni tag-dapu luma' ya pasōranna, yukbi, ‘Sinō' ka tinilaw e' Guru bang maingga bilik pagjamuhanna maka saga mulidna ma Hinang Paglakad?’

verses.name: Mark 14:15
verses.text: Jari pina'nda'an du kam bilik aluha ma diyata' angkap,” yuk si Isa. “Panyap asal bilik inān ati maina'an kam magsakap kinakantam.”  <div eID="gen5094" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2357"/><div sID="gen5095" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2357"/> Na, pehē' duwangan mulid e' ni deyom da'ira. Ta'nda' e' sigā mahē' buwat bay pamissala ma sigā e' si Isa, ati sinakap e' sigā kinakan ma Hinang Paglakad.  <div eID="gen5095" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2358"/><div sID="gen5096" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2358"/> Ta'abut pa'in abay kohap magbeya' si Isa maka mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa pina'an ni luma' pagsakapan kinakan e'.

verses.name: Mark 14:18
verses.text: Jari itu, hinabu sigām amangan, amissala si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “B'nnal ya pamissalaku itu ma ka'am, aniya' dangan min ka'am magbantu anōngan aku ni bantaku. Itiya' iya maitu magsalu maka aku.”  <div eID="gen5096" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2359"/><div sID="gen5097" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2359"/> Magtūy kat'kkahan susa saga mulid e' ati atilaw sigām ma si Isa magsunu'-sunu'. Yuk-i, “Ngga'i ka bahā' aku?”  <div eID="gen5097" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2360"/><div sID="gen5098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2360"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “A'a du min ka'am kasangpū' maka duwa, sehe'ku magsalu an'nno'an tinapayna ni deyom pinggan itu.

verses.name: Mark 14:21
verses.text: Aku itu, Anak Manusiya',” yuk si Isa, “amatay du buwat bay tasulat ma pasalanku ma deyom Kitab. Saguwā' siya-siya du a'a ya anōngan Anak Manusiya' ni bantana. Ahāp lagi' a'a inān halam bay nianakan.”  <div eID="gen5098" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5092" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2361"/><div sID="gen5099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Jamuhan Pangentoman ma Panghū' Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.26-Matt.26.30">Matiyu 26:26-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.14-Luke.22.20">Lukas 22:14-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="1Cor.11.23-1Cor.11.25">1 Kurintu 11:23-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2361"/> Sabu sigām masi amangan, niā' tinapay e' si Isa. Niamu'an e'na pagsukulan bo' yampa pinagpōng-pōng e'na ati pamuwanna ma saga mulidna. “Sambutunbi,” yukna, “sabab tinapay itu baranku ko'.”  <div eID="gen5100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2362"/><div sID="gen5101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2362"/> Niā' isab e'na dakayu' sawan ati niamu'an e'na isab pagsukulan bo' yampa sōnganna ni sigām panginuman sigām kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 14:24
verses.text: Yukna, “Laha'ku ko' itu, tanda' sin kapagsulutan Tuhan maka manusiya'. Laha'ku song pinabu'us ma sababan a'a aheka, supaya sigām kalappasan.

verses.name: Mark 14:25
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, puwas itu mbal na aku anginum binu-anggul itu pabīng. Subay aku ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan na bo' yampa aku anginum binu-anggul pabalik.”  <div eID="gen5101" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2363"/><div sID="gen5102" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2363"/> Puwas e', aubus pa'in e' sigām bay angalang dakayu' kalangan pamudji Tuhan, paluwas na sigām minnē' tudju ni būd Kayu Jaitun.  <div eID="gen5102" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5099" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2364"/><div sID="gen5103" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Papata si Isa Pasal Pamalilu si Petros</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.31-Matt.26.35">Matiyu 26:31-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.31-Luke.22.34">Lukas 22:31-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.36-John.13.38">Yahiya 13:36-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5104" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2364"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Alahi du kam kamemon ang'bba min aku sabab tasulat ko' inān ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5105"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5106"/>‘Bono'ku,’ yuk Tuhan, ‘a'a bay angupiksa' bili-bili<l eID="gen5106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5107"/>ati akaukanat saga bili-bili bay daumpigan.’<l eID="gen5107" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5105"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:28
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku tapakallum na pabīng min kamatayku, parahū du aku min ka'am tudju ni lahat Jalil.”  <div eID="gen5104" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2365"/><div sID="gen5108" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2365"/> Ah'lling si Petros ni iya, yukna, “Mbal to'ongan ka bbahanku minsan ka ni'bbahan e' kasehe'an itu.”  <div eID="gen5108" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2366"/><div sID="gen5109" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2366"/> Yuk si Isa, “Haka'anta ka to'ongan, ma sangom itu, ma halam gi' kaminduwa pangukku'uk manuk, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.”  <div eID="gen5109" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2367"/><div sID="gen5110" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2367"/> Gom pa'in akosog e' si Petros ah'lling, yukna, “Minsan aku paunung amatay ma ka'a mbal du ka paliluhanku.” Ya du saga mulid kasehe'an, buwattē' isab pah'lling sigām.  <div eID="gen5110" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5103" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2368"/><div sID="gen5111" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Kabbun Getsemane</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.36-Matt.26.46">Matiyu 26:36-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.39-Luke.22.46">Lukas 22:39-46</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5112" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2368"/> Manjari palanjal gi' sigām ni kabbun niōnan Getsemane ati yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Maitu gi' kam aningkō'. Pina'an lagi' aku anabbut ni Tuhan.”

verses.name: Mark 14:33
verses.text: Ya binowa e' si Isa sehe'na pina'an si Petros, si Yakub maka si Yahiya. Sakali magkasusahan iya, magk'bba-k'bba atayna.

verses.name: Mark 14:34
verses.text: Yukna ni t'llungan mulidna he', “Aku itu agon magkamamatay ma sabab kasusahan itu. Angagad kam maitu magjaga.”  <div eID="gen5112" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2369"/><div sID="gen5113" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2369"/> Makalawak-lawak pa'in iya min sigām, pahantak iya ni tana' maka e'na anabbut ni Tuhan. Ya niamu' e'na bang makajari, mbal na iya pinat'kkahan kabinasahan ya song ta'abutna.

verses.name: Mark 14:36
verses.text: “Arōy, Mma'!” yukna. “Bang makajari la'anin lagi' min aku sawan kabinasahan itu. Sagō' ngga'i ka kabaya'anku subay nirūlan, bang pa'in min kabaya'annu.”  <div eID="gen5113" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2370"/><div sID="gen5114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2370"/> Puwas e' pabīng si Isa ni saga mulidna t'llungan ati tabākna sigām magtulihan. Yukna ni si Petros, “O Simun, atuli ka? Mbal ka bahā' makatatas anganjaga minsan la'a hal danjām?

verses.name: Mark 14:38
verses.text: Pajaga kam. Angamu' kam tabang ni Tuhan bo' kam mbal tabowa-bowa e' sasat. Lilla' deyom ataybi sagō' abuhat pamarananbi.”  <div eID="gen5114" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2371"/><div sID="gen5115" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2371"/> Sakali pehē' si Isa ni baina anabbut ni Tuhan pabīng buwat bay panabbutna dahū.

verses.name: Mark 14:40
verses.text: Makabalik pa'in iya ni disi Petros tabākna isab sigām magtulihan pabīng sabab kinaru' sidda. Mbal kinata'uwan e' sigām bang ai panambung sigām ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen5115" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2372"/><div sID="gen5116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2372"/> Pagbalik si Isa kamint'lluna, yukna ni sigām, “Oy, atuli gi' kam? Pahali-hali gi' kam? Sarang na ko' ilu. Ta'abut na waktu. Aku, Anak Manusiya' itu, song na tinukbalan ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ala'at.

verses.name: Mark 14:42
verses.text: Pabungkal na kam! Sūng na kitam sabab ilu na a'a ya anōngan aku ni sigām.”  <div eID="gen5116" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5111" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2373"/><div sID="gen5117" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsaggaw ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.47-Matt.26.56">Matiyu 26:47-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.47-Luke.22.53">Lukas 22:47-53</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.3-John.18.12">Yahiya 18:3-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5118" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2373"/> Na, hinabu si Isa ah'lling gi' ni saga mulidna, magtūy at'kka pina'an si Judas, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa. Aheka a'a magbeya' maka iya magpamowa takos maka saga kakakal. Saga a'a inān bay sinō' pina'an e' saga kaimaman alanga sampay e' saga guru sara' agama maka saga pagmatto'ahan.  <div eID="gen5118" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2374"/><div sID="gen5119" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2374"/> Aniya' asal pandoga bay pamuwan si Judas ma saga a'a he'. Bay yukna ma sigām, “Ya a'a siyumku, ya na he' saggawbi. Bowahunbi iya pehē' maka jagahinbi iya pahāp.”

verses.name: Mark 14:45
verses.text: Pagt'kka si Judas pina'an, magtūy iya pa'abut ni si Isa. “Tuwan Guru,” yukna. Jari siyumna.

verses.name: Mark 14:46
verses.text: Sinaggaw si Isa e' saga a'a inān, binalutan pahogot.

verses.name: Mark 14:47
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' dakayu' min saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an angahurusan patakosna. Nilagut e'na dakayu' sosoho'an Imam Muwallam ati autas dambila' taingana.  <div eID="gen5119" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2375"/><div sID="gen5120" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2375"/> Ah'lling si Isa ni saga a'a bay anaggaw iya, yukna, “Kabā'bi bahā' in aku itu mundu, ya po'on kam subay amowa takos maka kakakal panaggawbi aku?

verses.name: Mark 14:49
verses.text: Llaw-llaw aku bay amandu' ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan e'. Mahē' aku ma ka'am bo' halam aku bay saggawbi. Sagō' ai-ai bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab subay aniya' kamaksuranna.”

verses.name: Mark 14:50
verses.text: Manjari maglahian saga mulid si Isa kamemon ati pinasagaran iya maina'an.  <div eID="gen5120" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2376"/><div sID="gen5121" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2376"/> Aniya' isab maina'an dakayu' subul paturul ma si Isa. Luwal hōs ya pas'mmekna. Na, arak iya sinaggaw e' sigām,

verses.name: Mark 14:52
verses.text: sagō' ni'bbahan e'na hōsna ati alahi iya magpanantang.  <div eID="gen5121" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5117" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2377"/><div sID="gen5122" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinaharap ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.57-Matt.26.68">Matiyu 26:57-68</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.54-Luke.22.55">Lukas 22:54-55</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.63-Luke.22.71">63-71</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.13-John.18.14">Yahiya 18:13-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.19-John.18.24">Yahiya 18:19-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2377"/> Manjari itu binowa si Isa e' sigām ni luma' Imam Muwallam. Ina'an magsakaum saga kaimaman alanga kamemon maka saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga guru sara' agama.

verses.name: Mark 14:54
verses.text: Bay paturul isab si Petros ma si Isa sagō' min katahan. Paturul iya sampay pasōd na ni deyom halaman luma' Imam Muwallam ati maina'an iya magtingkō'an maka saga jaga imam e', parangka ma bihing api.  <div eID="gen5123" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2378"/><div sID="gen5124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2378"/> Ya kaimaman alanga maka kamemon saga a'a ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum<note>Tumpukan Maghuhukum: tumpukan saga a'a pitumpū' ka dda hekana ya amal'ngngan sara' Yahudi. Ya kaheka'anna Parisi, bo' Sadduki maka guru' sara' agama.</note> amiha sababan panuntut sigām ma si Isa bo' supaya iya pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay. Saguwā' halam aniya' panuntutan tabāk e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 14:56
verses.text: Aheka magsaksi' puting bahasa iya katuntutan sagō' mbal maguyun saksi' sigām.  <div eID="gen5124" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2379"/><div sID="gen5125" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2379"/> Aniya' a'a kasehe' bay an'ngge amuwan saksi' itu panuntut sigām ma si Isa bo' pa'in putingan.

verses.name: Mark 14:58
verses.text: Yuk-i, “Bay takale kami a'a itu angupama in iya angalubu langgal pagkulbanan ya hinangan tangan manusiya' inān. Ma deyom t'llung'llaw kono' amat'ngge iya langgal saddī, sagō' ngga'i ka manusiya' ya angahinang iya.”

verses.name: Mark 14:59
verses.text: Malaingkan minsan buwattē' panaksi' sigām mbal du maguyun bissala sigām.  <div eID="gen5125" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2380"/><div sID="gen5126" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2380"/> Manjari an'ngge Imam Muwallam ma t'ngnga' sigām atilaw ma si Isa. Yukna, “Ka'a ilu, halam bahā' aniya' panganda'awanu ma panuntutan ka'a itu?”  <div eID="gen5126" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2381"/><div sID="gen5127" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2381"/> Saguwā' halam ah'lling si Isa, halam iya anambung. Amissala pabīng Imam Muwallam, yukna, “Ka'a bahā' Al-Masi, Anak Tuhan?”  <div eID="gen5127" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2382"/><div sID="gen5128" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2382"/> “Aho', aku na,” yuk si Isa. “Ati ta'nda'bi du aku, Anak Manusiya' itu, aningkō' ma bihing Sangat Kawasa, tampal ni kowan. Maka ta'nda'bi du aku pi'itu ameya' ma gabun min deyom sulga'.”  <div eID="gen5128" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2383"/><div sID="gen5129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2383"/> Manjari ginese' e' Imam Muwallam jubana kabowa astolna. Yukna, “Mbal na kitam amiha saksi' saddī!

verses.name: Mark 14:64
verses.text: Takalebi na llingna pangkal ni Tuhan! Ai pangahukumbi?” Sakali dauyunan na pangahukum sigām kamemon, in si Isa patut subay pinapatay.  <div eID="gen5129" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2384"/><div sID="gen5130" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2384"/> Jari aniya' sigām kasehe'an anagna' angaludja'an si Isa. Tinambunan isab matana e' sigām bo' yampa pinagtibu'. Yuk sigām ma iya, “Tokorun kono' bang sai anibu' ka'a!” Jari binowa si Isa e' saga jaga inān bo' binutug.  <div eID="gen5130" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5122" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2385"/><div sID="gen5131" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamalilu si Petros Pasal si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.69-Matt.26.75">Matiyu 26:69-75</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.56-Luke.22.62">Lukas 22:56-62</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.15-John.18.18">Yahiya 18:15-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.25-John.18.27">25-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5132" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2385"/> Na, ma halaman luma' pa'in si Petros, aniya' palabay minna'an dakayu' d'nda sosoho'an Imam Muwallam.

verses.name: Mark 14:67
verses.text: Pag'nda'na ma si Petros parangka ma api, magtūy nda'na pahāp ati yukna, “Ka'a ilu, bay ameya' ma si Isa, ya a'a Nasaret inān!”  <div eID="gen5132" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2386"/><div sID="gen5133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2386"/> Sagō' amalilu magtūy si Petros. “Mbal kata'uwanku,” yukna. “Mbal tahatiku bang ai pah'llingnu ilu.” Ati ala'an iya minnē' tudju ni bowa' lawang ya paluwasan min halaman e'. Jari angukku'uk manuk.  <div eID="gen5133" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2387"/><div sID="gen5134" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2387"/> Ta'nda' na iya pabīng e' sosoho'an d'nda he' ati ah'lling iya ni saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an. Ni'isaban e'na bay pah'llingna tagna'. “A'a ilu,” yukna, “bay sehe' sigām.”

verses.name: Mark 14:70
verses.text: Sagō' amalilu na isab si Petros. <div eID="gen5134" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5135" type="paragraph"/> Mbal at'ggol, ah'lling ni si Petros saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an. Yuk sigām, “Kata'uwan kami in ka'a b'nnal bay sehe' disi Isa sabab a'a Jalil du ka isab!”  <div eID="gen5135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2388"/><div sID="gen5136" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2388"/> Sakali anukna'an di-na si Petros ati yukna, “Mbal kata'uwanku a'a pagbissalabi ilu!”  <div eID="gen5136" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2389"/><div sID="gen5137" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2389"/> Saru'un-du'un du angukku'uk manuk, kaminduwana na, ati taentom e' si Petros ya bay lling si Isa ma iya, ya bay yukna, “Ma mbal gi' angukku'uk manuk min duwa, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.” Pagentom itu e' si Petros, magtūy iya anangis, magdukka to'ongan.  <div eID="gen5137" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.14"/> <div eID="gen5131" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2390"/><div sID="gen5138" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinaharap ni Gubnul Pilatu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.1-Matt.27.2">Matiyu 27:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.27.11-Matt.27.14">11-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.1-Luke.23.5">Lukas 23:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.28-John.18.38">Yahiya 18:28-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5139" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2390"/> Ta'abut pa'in pagk'llat llaw, magtūy pasa'ut saga kaimaman alanga magsakaum maka pagmatto'ahan maka saga guru sara' agama. Jari magisun sigām maka Tumpukan Maghuhukum kamemon bang inay sigām si Isa. Pagisun pa'in, niengkotan iya e' sigām bo' binowa pehē', tinukbalan ni si Pilatu.

verses.name: Mark 15:2
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in, atilaw si Pilatu ma si Isa, yukna, “Ka'a ilu, sultan ka bahā' ma bangsa Yahudi?” <div eID="gen5139" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5140" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya na yuknu ilu.”  <div eID="gen5140" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2391"/><div sID="gen5141" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2391"/> Na, aheka panuntut saga kaimaman alanga inān ma iya,

verses.name: Mark 15:4
verses.text: angkan iya tinilaw pabīng e' si Pilatu, yukna, “Halam aniya' panambungnu? Nda'un kaheka panuntut sigām itu ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5141" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2392"/><div sID="gen5142" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2392"/> Sagō' halam aniya' sambung si Isa, angkan ainu-inu to'ongan si Pilatu he'.  <div eID="gen5142" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5138" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2393"/><div sID="gen5143" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinat'nna'an Hukuman ni Kamatay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.15-Matt.27.26">Matiyu 27:15-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.13-Luke.23.25">Lukas 23:13-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.39-John.19.16">Yahiya 18:39-19:16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5144" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2393"/> Na, kahaba' tahun, ma waktu paghinang bangsa Yahudi ma Hinang Paglakad, ya kabiyaksahan si Pilatu subay aniya' dakayu' pilisu pal'ppana, sai-sai pinene' e' saga a'a Yahudi.

verses.name: Mark 15:7
verses.text: Jari ma waktu ina'an aniya' a'a bay takalabusu, ōnna si Barabbas. In iya inān maka saga sehe'na bay amapatay a'a ma waktu panagga' sigām ma parinta.

verses.name: Mark 15:8
verses.text: Sakali itu aheka saga a'a pa'alop ni si Pilatu angamu' pinal'ppa e'na dakayu' pilisu buwat kabiyaksahan kahaba'-kahaba' tahun.

verses.name: Mark 15:9
verses.text: Tinilaw sigām e' si Pilatu, yukna, “Bilahi kam bahā' bang pal'ppahanku ka'am sultan bangsa Yahudi itu?”

verses.name: Mark 15:10
verses.text: Angkan sigām tilawna buwattē' sabab kata'uwanna asal bang ai sababanna angkan si Isa bay tin'kkahan ni iya. Tu'ud angihid saga kaimaman ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen5144" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2394"/><div sID="gen5145" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2394"/> Sagō' ba'anan a'a inān bay pinitnahan asal e' kaimaman e', sinō' angamu' si Barabbas pinal'ppa e' si Pilatu, ngga'i ka si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 15:12
verses.text: Amissala si Pilatu ni sigām pabīng, yukna, “Inayku bahā' a'a itu, ya ōnanbi sultan bangsa Yahudi?”  <div eID="gen5145" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2395"/><div sID="gen5146" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2395"/> Angolang sigām pakosog, yuk-i, “Lansangun iya ni hāg!”  <div eID="gen5146" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2396"/><div sID="gen5147" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2396"/> “Angay?” yuk si Pilatu. “Ai bay hinangna ala'at?” <div eID="gen5147" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5148" type="paragraph"/> Luhūy pakosog pangolang sigām e', yuk-i, “Lansangun iya ni hāg!”  <div eID="gen5148" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2397"/><div sID="gen5149" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2397"/> Na, bilahi si Pilatu amarūl saga a'a magtimukan e', angkan pal'ppana si Barabbas ni sigām. Bo' arapun in si Isa tinukbalan ni saga sundalu, sinō' niraplosan bo' pinalansang ni hāg pinapatay.  <div eID="gen5149" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5143" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2398"/><div sID="gen5150" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinagtunggīngan e' saga Sundalu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.27-Matt.27.31">Matiyu 27:27-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.2-John.19.3">Yahiya 19:2-3</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5151" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2398"/> Manjari binowa na si Isa e' saga sundalu pehē' ni halaman astana' ati nilinganan patimuk pehē' damba'an sundalu inān kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 15:17
verses.text: Pinajubahan si Isa s'mmek taluk pinaka luwa pakayan sultan. Nilangbid isab bahan itingan e' sigām, nihinang sali' panumping sultan pinat'nna' ni kōkna.

verses.name: Mark 15:18
verses.text: Jari anagna' sigām magbau'-bau' magaddat ma iya. Yuk sigām, “Mahaldika'! Mahaldika'! Sultan Yahudi!”

verses.name: Mark 15:19
verses.text: Pinagp'ppok kōkna e' sigām maka tungkud, maka niludja'an iya. Angōk-tu'ut sigām pagmahaltabat sigām ma iya.

verses.name: Mark 15:20
verses.text: Na, aubus pa'in e' sigām magtunggīng inān, niurusan e' sigām s'mmek taluk bay pajubana bo' yampa iya pinas'mmekan bay s'mmekna tagna'. Puwas e' binowa iya paluwas minnē' bo' nilansang ni hāg pamapatayan iya.  <div eID="gen5151" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5150" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2399"/><div sID="gen5152" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Nilansang ni Hāg</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.32-Matt.27.44">Matiyu 27:32-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.26-Luke.23.43">Lukas 23:26-43</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.17-John.19.27">Yahiya 19:17-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5153" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2399"/> Manjari aniya' a'a palabay minna'an, ōnna si Simun, bay min deya. Si Simun itu mma' si Iskandar maka si Rupus, a'a iya min lahat Kirini. Jari minandahan iya e' saga sundalu, sinō' ananggung hāg ya song pangalansangan si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 15:22
verses.text: Binowa iya patukad ni jadjahan lahat niōnan Golgota, hatina lahat Peya'-peya' Kōk.

verses.name: Mark 15:23
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in, aniya' arak pamainum saga sundalu ma si Isa binu-anggul kalamuran tambal niōnan mira, sagō' halam taima'na.

verses.name: Mark 15:24
verses.text: Puwas e' nilansang iya ni hāg e' saga sundalu, bo' yampa pinat'ngge hāgna. Pinagbahagi'an e' sigām saga s'mmekna, pinagko'ot-ko'otan bo' kinata'uwan bang s'mmek ingga ma sigām dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Mark 15:25
verses.text: Ya waktu kapangalansang sigām ma si Isa saga lisag siyam subu.

verses.name: Mark 15:26
verses.text: Buwattitu in sulat bay pinat'nna' panuntut iya, yuk-i: “SULTAN BANGSA YAHUDI.”

verses.name: Mark 15:27
verses.text: Aniya' isab duwangan mundu bay pinasambeya' ma si Isa nilansang ma hāg sigā. Dakayu' hāg inān bay pinat'ngge ma bihing si Isa kowan, dakayu' ma bihingna gibang.

verses.name: Mark 15:28
verses.text: (Minnē' aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Talapay iya ma saga a'a langgal sara'.”)  <div eID="gen5153" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2400"/><div sID="gen5154" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2400"/> Na, pinaggunyak-gunyak si Isa e' a'a maglaulabay. Pinaghanduk-handukan iya e' sigām pangudju'. “Nē!” yuk sigām. “Ka'a na ya arak angalangkat langgal pagkulbanan inān ati pabangunnu kono' pabīng ma deyom t'llung'llaw!

verses.name: Mark 15:30
verses.text: Pareyo' ka min hāg ilu bo' ka angalappasan di-nu!”  <div eID="gen5154" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2401"/><div sID="gen5155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2401"/> Ya du magpangudju' saga imam alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Yuk suli-suli sigām ma pasalna, “A'a itu ata'u angalappas ma a'a saddī sagō' mbal makalappasan di-na!

verses.name: Mark 15:32
verses.text: Al-Masi kono' iya, sultan bangsa Isra'il. Subay iya pareyo'an di-na min hāg inān. Bang iya ta'nda'tam pareyo', am'nnal kitam ma iya!” <div eID="gen5155" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5156" type="paragraph"/> Ya du duwangan a'a bay nilansang ni hāg pinasambeya' ma si Isa, ameya'-meya' isab angudju' iya.  <div eID="gen5156" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5152" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2402"/><div sID="gen5157" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.45-Matt.27.56">Matiyu 27:45-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.44-Luke.23.49">Lukas 23:44-49</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.28-John.19.30">Yahiya 19:28-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5158" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2402"/> Jari itu, augtu pa'in llaw, taluwa' lendom kaluha'an lahat e' sampay ni lisag t'llu kohap.

verses.name: Mark 15:34
verses.text: Paglisag t'llu, akosog e' si Isa angalingan, yukna, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” Hatina, “Tuhanku, O Tuhanku, angay aku pasagarannu?”  <div eID="gen5158" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2403"/><div sID="gen5159" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2403"/> Pagkale itu e' saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an, yuk sigām kasehe', “Pakale kam. Angalinganan iya nabi Elija.”

verses.name: Mark 15:36
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' dakayu' a'a parai'-dai' ang'ggoman l'ppus ni deyom binu al'ssom. Puwas e' pinasagnat e'na ni tōng kayu-kayu bo' yampa sōnganna ni si Isa pamas'ssopna ma iya. Yuk a'a-i, “Angagad gi' kam. Nda'ta lagi' bang patuwa' si Elija amareyo' iya min hāg.”  <div eID="gen5159" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2404"/><div sID="gen5160" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2404"/> Sakali angolang si Isa min t'dda, magtūy ab'kkat napasna.  <div eID="gen5160" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2405"/><div sID="gen5161" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2405"/> Saru'un-du'un du in kultina bay pangagpang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan inān agese' duwa min diyata'na tudju pareyo'.

verses.name: Mark 15:39
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in e' kapitan ya paharap ma hāg inān bang buwattingga kab'kkat napas si Isa, anibahat iya, yukna, “B'nnal a'a itu Anak Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen5161" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2406"/><div sID="gen5162" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2406"/> Aniya' isab maina'an saga d'nda magpang'nda' min katāhan. Ina'an ma sigām disi Mariyam min Magdala maka si Salome, ina'an isab si Mariyam ina' si Joses maka Yakub dakayu', ya abata' gi'.

verses.name: Mark 15:41
verses.text: Saga d'nda itu bay ameya' paumpig ma si Isa angussap iya waktu kamahē'na lagi' ma lahat Jalil. Aheka isab saga d'nda saddī maina'an, a'a bay ameya' ma iya tudju ni Awrusalam.  <div eID="gen5162" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5157" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2407"/><div sID="gen5163" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkubul ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.57-Matt.27.61">Matiyu 27:57-61</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.50-Luke.23.56">Lukas 23:50-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.38-John.19.42">Yahiya 19:38-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5164" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2407"/> Llaw Pagsakap ko' inān, hatina dang'llaw dahū min llaw Sabtu'. Jari itu, pagkohap pa'in ma llaw inān,

verses.name: Mark 15:43
verses.text: at'kka pina'an si Yusup a'a min kauman Arimati. Dakayu' iya pagmatto'ahan ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum, a'a abantug. Atuyu' asal iya angalagaran waktu pamat'nna' kapagparinta Tuhan. Sakali anawakkal iya pa'alop ni si Pilatu angamu' mayat si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 15:44
verses.text: Ainu-inu si Pilatu pagka takalena amatay na si Isa. Nilinganan e'na kapitan, ya bay mahē', ati tilawna bang b'nnal amatay na.

verses.name: Mark 15:45
verses.text: Pagkale si Pilatu ma lapal kapitan in si Isa amatay na, patugutanna si Yusup angā' mayatna.

verses.name: Mark 15:46
verses.text: Am'lli si Yusup kakana' panaput ati pinareyo' e'na mayat si Isa min diyata' hāg bo' yampa sinaput e'na. Puwas e' pinat'nna' e'na ma deyom pagkubulan bay kinehean ma deyom batu lakit ati ginulungan e'na batu ya panaplok bowa' lowang e'.

verses.name: Mark 15:47
verses.text: Ina'an ang'nda'-ng'nda' si Mariyam min Magdala maka si Mariyam ina' si Joses, ati tapandoga e' sigā bang maingga pangubulan si Isa.  <div eID="gen5164" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Mark.15"/> <div eID="gen5163" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2408"/><div sID="gen5165" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Allum Pabalik</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.1-Matt.28.8">Matiyu 28:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.1-Luke.24.12">Lukas 24:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.1-John.20.10">Yahiya 20:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5166" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2408"/> Palabay pa'in llaw Sabtu', ina'an si Mariyam a'a Magdala, maka si Salome, maka si Mariyam ina' si Joses, am'lli laksi' maka ns'llan pahamut pamahilala' sigām ma mayat si Isa.

verses.name: Mark 16:2
verses.text: Manjari pagk'llat llaw Ahad, bo' subu-subu to'ongan, pehē' sigām ni pagkubulan.

verses.name: Mark 16:3
verses.text: Magsuli-suli na pa'in sigām ma labayan, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' anganggulungan batu panaplok lowang e' bo' kitam makasōd?” Sabab aheya asal batu inān.

verses.name: Mark 16:4
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām pina'an ta'nda' e' sigām batu wa'i na bay ginulungan.

verses.name: Mark 16:5
verses.text: Jari pasōd sigām ni deyom lowang kubul ati aniya' ta'nda' e' sigām dakayu' l'lla abata' lagi' magnijuba pote', aningkō' tampal ni kowan. Magtūy sigām takuddat sidda.  <div eID="gen5166" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2409"/><div sID="gen5167" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2409"/> Yuk l'lla itu ma sigām, “Da'a kam tināw. Kata'uwanku asal, ya pihabi si Isa a'a Nasaret ya bay nilansang ni hāg pinapatay. Halam na iya maitu. Allum na iya pabīng! Nda'unbi lugal bay pamalegehan iya.

verses.name: Mark 16:7
verses.text: Na, pehē' na kam,” yukna, “amowa haka itu ni saga mulidna maka ni si Petros. Yukbi ni sigām, ‘Parahū du iya min ka'am ni lahat Jalil. Mahē' du kam ang'nda' ma iya buwat bay llingna ma ka'am.’ ”  <div eID="gen5167" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2410"/><div sID="gen5168" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2410"/> Manjari paluwas saga d'nda he' ati paragan min kubul. Angenog-ngenog sigām maka halam aniya' pah'lling sigām ni sai-sai sabab tināw sigām.  <div eID="gen5168" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5165" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2411"/><div sID="gen5169" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Panyata' Magbaran ni si Mariyam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.9-Matt.28.10">Matiyu 28:9-10</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.11-John.20.18">Yahiya 20:11-18</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5170" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2411"/> Na, allum pa'in si Isa pabīng min kamatayna ma dai'-llaw Ahad inān, magtūy iya patuwa' dahū ni si Mariyam d'nda min Magdala, ya bay kapaluwasan e'na pitu' saitan.

verses.name: Mark 16:10
verses.text: Maka si Mariyam itu bay pehē' angahaka'an saga mulid si Isa. Ina'an sigām magdukka maka magtangis.

verses.name: Mark 16:11
verses.text: Sagō' kahaka'an pa'in sigām e' si Mariyam in si Isa allum maka bay kono' ta'nda'na, mbal sigām am'nnal.  <div eID="gen5170" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5169" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2412"/><div sID="gen5171" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpanyata' si Isa ni Duwa Mulidna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.24.13-Luke.24.35">Lukas 24:13-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5172" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2412"/> Puwas e' magpanyata' isab si Isa ni duwangan mulidna hinabu sigā lum'ngngan tudju kaleya, bo' saddī pangluwahanna.

verses.name: Mark 16:13
verses.text: Manjari pabalik duwangan mulid e' ni Awrusalam angahaka'an saga sehe' sigā. Sagō' ya du sigā halam bin'nnal e' kasehe'an inān.  <div eID="gen5172" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5171" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2413"/><div sID="gen5173" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpanyata' si Isa ni Mulidna Kasangpū' ka Ssa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.16-Matt.28.20">Matiyu 28:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.36-Luke.24.49">Lukas 24:36-49</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.19-John.20.23">Yahiya 20:19-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Acts.1.6-Acts.1.8">Kahinangan 1:6-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2413"/> Puwas e' magpanyata' na si Isa ni mulidna kasangpū' maka ssa hinabu sigām amangan. Pinabukagan sigām e'na sabab mbal am'nnal maka atuwas kōk sigām. Mbal sigām bilahi magkahagad minsan sigām nihaka'an e' saga a'a bay maka'nda' si Isa maka kallumna pabīng min kamatayna.

verses.name: Mark 16:15
verses.text: Manjari amissala iya ni sigām, yukna, “Pehē' kam ni sabarang lahat ma kaluha'an dunya bo' nasihatunbi lapal ahāp itu ni manusiya' kamemon.

verses.name: Mark 16:16
verses.text: Sai-sai am'nnal sampay pinandi tanda' in sigām angandol ma aku,” yuk si Isa, “lappasan du saumul-umul. Saguwā' sai-sai mbal am'nnal, pinat'nna'an du iya hukuman.

verses.name: Mark 16:17
verses.text: Saga a'a angandol ma aku kabuwanan du kawasa maghinang saga hinang makainu-inu. Makapala'an du sigām saga saitan sabab min kawasa ōnku. Makabissala isab sigām ma saga bahasa saddī halam bay kinata'uwan e' sigām.

verses.name: Mark 16:18
verses.text: Bang sigām ganta' maka'ntanan sowa, atawa makainum ai-ai makamula, mbal du makainay ma sigām. Maka bang pina'abut tangan sigām ni a'a taga-saki, kauli'an du saga a'a inān.”  <div eID="gen5174" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5173" type="section"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2414"/><div sID="gen5175" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pa'angkat si Isa Tudju ni Sulga'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Luke.24.50-Luke.24.53">Lukas 24:50-53</reference>, <reference osisRef="Acts.1.9-Acts.1.11">Kahinangan 1:9-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5176" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2414"/> Manjari itu, aubus pa'in Panghū' Isa bay magbissala maka saga mulidna, tabowa iya pa'angkat tudju ni sulga' ati aningkō' iya ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan.

verses.name: Mark 16:20
verses.text: Jari lum'ngngan na saga mulidna magnasihat lapal ahāp ma sabarang lahat. Ginapi' sigām e' Panghū' Isa, binuwanan sigām barakat maghinang saga hinang kawasahan bo' supaya kinata'uwan in pandu' sigām asal b'nnal. <signed sID="gen5177"/> Tammat<signed eID="gen5177"/>  <div eID="gen5176" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5175" type="section"/> <div eID="gen4738" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Mark.16"/> <div eID="gen4731" osisID="Mark" type="book"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2415"/><div sID="gen5185" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sulat min si Lukas ni si Teyopilus</title> <div sID="gen5186" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2415"/> Aheka a'a bay makatawakkal anulat pasal kamemon bay tahinang ma deyoman kami.

verses.name: Luke 1:2
verses.text: Ya tasulat e' sigām ai-ai bay pang'bba ma kami e' saga a'a bay maka'nda' kahinangan si Isa sangay min katagna'. Sigām isab ya magnasihat palman Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 1:3
verses.text: Na, tuwan Teyopilus, pagka tapariksa'ku pahāp kamemon bay tahinang itu sangay min katagna'na, tapikilku in aku taga-kapatut anulatan ka'a. Usulku saga pakaradja'an itu kamemon min katagna' sampay ni katapusan

verses.name: Luke 1:4
verses.text: bo' supaya ka manantuhi pasal ai-ai bay pamandu' ka'a.  <div eID="gen5186" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5185" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2416"/><div sID="gen5187" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapaganak ma si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <div sID="gen5188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2416"/> Buwattitu ya tagna'anna: ma timpu lagi' bay pagsultan sultan Herod ma lahat Yahudiya aniya' imam niōnan si Jakariya. Dakayu' imam iya ma tumpukan pagimam si Abiya. Ya du h'ndana si Elesabet, min panubu' kaimaman isab sabab tubu' min si Harun.

verses.name: Luke 1:6
verses.text: Abontol sadja sigā duwangan ma pang'nda' Tuhan. Binogbogan e' sigā usulanna maka panoho'anna kamemon ma halam aniya' sā'na.

verses.name: Luke 1:7
verses.text: Sagō' halam sigā taga-anak sabab mbal maka'anak si Elesabet, maka ato'a na sigā.  <div eID="gen5188" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2417"/><div sID="gen5189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2417"/> Jari itu aniya' dakayu' llaw paghinang si Jakariya maka umpiganna ma langgal pagkulbanan, bo' ta'abut na waktu kapagimamna.

verses.name: Luke 1:9
verses.text: Ya addat kaimaman subay magko'ot-ko'ot bo' tata'u bang sai pinene' pasōd ni deyom langgal pangarapan ni Panghū' bo' anugtug kamanyan. Jari si Jakariya ya tapene'.

verses.name: Luke 1:10
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in waktu pagtugtug kamanyan, anambahayang na saga a'a ya magtimuk ma halaman langgal e'.  <div eID="gen5189" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2418"/><div sID="gen5190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2418"/> Jari aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan panyata' ni si Jakariya, ina'an an'ngge ma bihing panugtugan kamanyan, tampal ni kowan.

verses.name: Luke 1:12
