verses.text: Pag'nda' si Jakariya ma mala'ikat itu, magtūy iya takuddat maka sinōd tāw.

verses.name: Luke 1:13
verses.text: Saguwā' ah'lling mala'ikat ni iya, yukna, “Da'a ka tināw, Jakariya, sabab takale e' Tuhan ya bay amu'nu ilu. H'ndanu si Elesabet anganak du l'lla, ati Yahiya ya pangōnbi iya.

verses.name: Luke 1:14
verses.text: Aheya kalasiganbi ma sababna, magkōg-koyag kam maka aheka isab a'a kasehe'an palamud ma kalasiganbi bang iya nianakan na.

verses.name: Luke 1:15
verses.text: Bangsahan iya ma pang'nda' Tuhan. Mbal iya anginum binu atawa ai-ai makalango. Kahōpan iya e' Rū Sussi tinagna'an min llaw kapanganak ma iya.

verses.name: Luke 1:16
verses.text: Aheka isab a'a Isra'il tabowana magta'at pabīng ni Tuhan ya pagpanghū'an sigām.

verses.name: Luke 1:17
verses.text: Parahū iya min Panghū' pagka kapagagihan e' Rū Sussi maka pinasuku'an kawasa buwat bay kahālan nabi Elija masa awal e'. Pinapaghāp e'na matto'a maka anak bay magsagga'. Pinapinda e'na pikilan saga a'a ya bay amabiyal ma panoho'an Tuhan, tabowa sigām amikilan pangita'u ya suku' ma a'a a'adil. Tinagamahan e'na saga a'a bo' aniya' bangsa sakap anambut Panghū' sigām.”  <div eID="gen5190" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2419"/><div sID="gen5191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2419"/> Atilaw si Jakariya ma mala'ikat, yukna, “Buwattingga kata'uku in bissalanu ilu b'nnal? Ato'a na aku maka ato'a isab h'ndaku.”  <div eID="gen5191" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2420"/><div sID="gen5192" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2420"/> Ya sambung mala'ikat, “Aku itu si Jibra'il, ya pat'nna' na pa'in ma haddarat Tuhan. Bay aku soho'na pi'itu amissalahan ka'a bo' takalenu lapal ahāp itu.

verses.name: Luke 1:20
verses.text: Sagō' aumaw du ka pagka halam tab'nnalnu bissalaku, bo' pa'in tatuman kamemon bang ta'abut waktuna. Jari mbal ka makapah'lling min llaw itu sampay pat'kka ya bay pangahakaku ma ka'a. Angkan buwattē', sabab halam b'nnalnu lapalku ma ka'a, ya lapal tantu atuman bang ta'abut waktuna.”  <div eID="gen5192" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2421"/><div sID="gen5193" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2421"/> Pasalta', nilagaran si Jakariya e' saga a'a ma halaman langgal e'. Ainu-inu sigām bang ai kat'ggolanna ma deyom langgal.

verses.name: Luke 1:22
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in iya paluwas, mbal na makapah'lling ma sigām, angkan kinata'uwan e' sigām aniya' bay panyata' ni iya hinabuna ma deyom langgal. Aninyal sadja iya ma sigām sabab mbal makapaluwas bissala.  <div eID="gen5193" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2422"/><div sID="gen5194" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2422"/> Manjari, aubus pa'in waktu paghinangna ma deyom langgal e', magtūy iya amole' ni lahatna.

verses.name: Luke 1:24
verses.text: Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, ab'ttong na h'ndana si Elesabet ati limambulan ya t'ggolna mbal makapagluwas-luwas min luma'.

verses.name: Luke 1:25
verses.text: Yukna, “Ahāp tabang Tuhan ma aku. Karūlan aku e'na maka kala'anan kaiya'anku ma deyoman lūng-kampungku.”  <div eID="gen5194" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5187" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2423"/><div sID="gen5195" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pata'u Pasal Paganak ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5196" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2423"/> Ta'abut pa'in nnom bulan kab'ttong si Elesabet, pinabeya' e' Tuhan mala'ikatna si Jibra'il pehē' ni kauman Nasaret ya ma lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Luke 1:27
verses.text: Sinō' iya panyata' ni dakayu' budjang ōnna si Mariyam, ya magtunang asal maka si Yusup, dakayu' panubu' sultan Da'ud.

verses.name: Luke 1:28
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat itu ni si Mariyam, “Bang pa'in ka asalamat. Aheya kahāpan Tuhan ma ka'a, Mariyam. Ilu Tuhan pataptap ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5196" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2424"/><div sID="gen5197" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2424"/> Sagō' pagkale pa'in itu e' si Mariyam asasaw pikilanna. Kinira-kira e'na bang ai hatina angkan iya binissalahan buwattē'.

verses.name: Luke 1:30
verses.text: Manjari ah'lling gi' mala'ikat ni iya, yukna, “Da'a ka agawa, Mariyam, sabab kasulutan Tuhan ma ka'a.

verses.name: Luke 1:31
verses.text: Pakale ka. Sōng ka ab'ttong. Anganak ka l'lla ati Isa ya pangōnnu iya.

verses.name: Luke 1:32
verses.text: Bangsahan to'ongan iya, pinagōnan iya Anak Tuhan Mahatinggi. Pinat'nna' iya magsultan e' Panghū' Tuhan, buwat bay kapagsultan mbo'na si Da'ud ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Luke 1:33
verses.text: Ati magsultan iya ma bangsa Isra'il, ya panubu' si Yakub, sampay ni kasaumulan. Halam aniya' katobtoban pagsultanna.”  <div eID="gen5197" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2425"/><div sID="gen5198" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2425"/> Yuk si Mariyam ni mala'ikat, “Buwattingga kapaniya' ya yuknu ilu, pagka aku itu budjang masi?”  <div eID="gen5198" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2426"/><div sID="gen5199" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2426"/> Ya sambung mala'ikat, “Pahōp du ni ka'a Rū Sussi maka kalandungan ka e' barakat Tuhan Mahatinggi. Angkan asussi ya nianakan e'nu ati gin'llal iya Anak Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 1:36
verses.text: Sampay kampungnu isab si Elesabet, song anganak minsan ato'a na. Nnom bulan ya kab'ttongna minsan iya bay pinagbahasa d'nda mbal maka'anak.

verses.name: Luke 1:37
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' ahunit ma Tuhan,” yuk mala'ikat e'.  <div eID="gen5199" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2427"/><div sID="gen5200" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2427"/> Jari ah'lling si Mariyam, yukna, “Aku itu sosoho'an Tuhan. Maglilla' aku ma pah'llingnu ilu.” Magtūy alanyap mala'ikat.  <div eID="gen5200" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5195" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2428"/><div sID="gen5201" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinibaw si Elesabet e' si Mariyam</title> <div sID="gen5202" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2428"/> Na, mbal at'ggol minnē', magsakap si Mariyam bo' parai'-dai' pehē' ni dakayu' kauman ma kabūd-būran ma lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: Luke 1:40
verses.text: At'kka pa'in iya pehē', pasōd iya ni luma' disi Jakariya bo' magaddatan kampungna si Elesabet.

verses.name: Luke 1:41
verses.text: Takale pa'in e' si Elesabet bissala si Mariyam, magtūy anikad onde' ma deyom b'ttongna. Kahōpan iya e' Rū Sussi,

verses.name: Luke 1:42
verses.text: ati amissala iya patanog ma si Mariyam, yukna, “Ka'a ilu kabuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan labi min d'nda kamemon. Damikiyanna isab onde' ya song nianakan e'nu, ballabihan kahāpan ya pamuwan Tuhan ma iya.

verses.name: Luke 1:43
verses.text: Angay aku subay pinaheya e' ina' Panghū'ku, ya po'on ka anibaw aku?

verses.name: Luke 1:44
verses.text: Pagkaleku ma bissalanu insini' magtūy maghibal onde' ya ma deyom b'ttongku itu, kabowa kakōranna.

verses.name: Luke 1:45
verses.text: Aheya kalasigan ma d'nda ya makapam'nnal in lapal Tuhan ma iya tatuman du!”  <div eID="gen5202" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5201" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2429"/><div sID="gen5203" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan si Mariyam</title> <div sID="gen5204" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2429"/> Manjari ah'lling si Mariyam, yukna, <lg sID="gen5205"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5206"/>“Sanglitanku Tuhan sampay min deyom atayku.<l eID="gen5206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5207"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:47
verses.text: Magkōg-koyag aku ma Tuhan ya angalappas ma aku.<l eID="gen5207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5208"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:48
verses.text: Atana aku, ati pinagka'inagonan aku e'na<l eID="gen5208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5209"/>minsan areyo' kapaga'aku.<l eID="gen5209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5210"/>Puwas minnitu, sinuli-suli aku e' a'a kamemon magsuring-magsaingsing,<l eID="gen5210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5211"/>in aku d'nda pinasuku'an kahāpan,<l eID="gen5211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5212"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:49
verses.text: sabab makainu-inu kahinangan Tuhan Patikawasa<l eID="gen5212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5213"/>ya panabangna ma aku.<l eID="gen5213" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5214"/>Mahasussi asal iya.<l eID="gen5214" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5215"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:50
verses.text: Ma'ase' iya ma a'a kamemon magtubu'-manubu',<l eID="gen5215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5216"/>sasuku magmahaltabatan iya.<l eID="gen5216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5217"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:51
verses.text: Pina'nda'an e'na kawasana labay min kahinanganna,<l eID="gen5217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5218"/>pinagkaukanat e'na saga a'a ya magabbu-abbu ma deyom pangatayan.<l eID="gen5218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5219"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:52
verses.text: Nila'anan e'na saga sultan min pagsultanan sigām,<l eID="gen5219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5220"/>pinabangsa e'na saga a'a areyo'-deyo'.<l eID="gen5220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5221"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:53
verses.text: Saga a'a atiksa' binuwanan e'na lidjiki' aheka,<l eID="gen5221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5222"/>maka a'a dayahan pinala'an e'na ma halam aniya' tabowa sigām.<l eID="gen5222" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5223"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:54
verses.text: Tinabang e' Tuhan sosoho'anna bangsa Isra'il,<l eID="gen5223" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5224"/>ka'ase'anna sigām buwat bay panganjanji'na<l eID="gen5224" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5225"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:55
verses.text: ma si Ibrahim maka saga panubu'na sampay ni kasaumulan,<l eID="gen5225" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5226"/>tatuman isab bay pangallam Tuhan ma kamatto'ahan.”<l eID="gen5226" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5205"/>  <div eID="gen5204" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2430"/><div sID="gen5227" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2430"/> Na, kulang-labi t'llumbulan ya kat'nna' si Mariyam ma si Elesabet bo' yampa amole'.  <div eID="gen5227" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5203" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2431"/><div sID="gen5228" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaganak ma si Yahiya</title> <div sID="gen5229" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2431"/> Ta'abut pa'in llaw panganak si Elesabet, l'lla ya anakna.

verses.name: Luke 1:58
verses.text: Makakale pa'in saga lūng-kampungna maka lahasiya'na pasal kaheya kahāpan Tuhan ma iya, magbeya' sigām maka iya magkōg-koyag.  <div eID="gen5229" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2432"/><div sID="gen5230" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2432"/> Na, pagka walung'llaw na onde' ma luwasan, waktu pangislam ma iya, patimuk pehē' ba'anan kaukampung. Arak iya niōnan Jakariya buwat ōn mma'na,

verses.name: Luke 1:60
verses.text: sagō' mbal si Elesabet. Yukna, “Da'a. Subay iya niōnan Yahiya.”  <div eID="gen5230" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2433"/><div sID="gen5231" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2433"/> “Angay?” yuk sigām. “Halam aniya' min kahekanu niōnan Yahiya.”

verses.name: Luke 1:62
verses.text: Manjari aninyal sigām ni mma' onde' bo' kinata'uwan bang ai kabaya'anna.  <div eID="gen5231" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2434"/><div sID="gen5232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2434"/> Aninyal isab si Jakariya angamu' panulatan ati anulat buwattitu: “Ōnna Yahiya!” Ainu-inu makalandu' saga a'a inān kamemon.

verses.name: Luke 1:64
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du makabissala si Jakariya pabīng maka sinanglitan e'na Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 1:65
verses.text: Sinōd tāw saga lūng-kampung disi Jakariya, maka habal pasal bay tahinang inān pasaplag na pa'in ni kareya-reyahan ma lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: Luke 1:66
verses.text: Amikil-mikil na pa'in sasuku makakale pasal pakaradja'an itu, yuk-i, “Ai bahā' pangangganta' Tuhan ma onde' inān?” Sabab atampal in onde' inān kaniya'an barakat min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5232" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5228" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2435"/><div sID="gen5233" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalangan si Jakariya</title> <div sID="gen5234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2435"/> Manjari si Jakariya, mma' si Yahiya, bay kahōpan Rū Sussi ati pinaluwas e'na lapal deyo' bay min Tuhan, yukna, <lg sID="gen5235"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5236"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:68
verses.text: “Sanglitantam Panghū', ya pagtuhanan bangsatam Isra'il,<l eID="gen5236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5237"/>sabab pi'itu na iya anabangan kitam suku'na,<l eID="gen5237" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5238"/>maka angaliyusan kitam min kasigpitan.<l eID="gen5238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5239"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:69
verses.text: Pinaniya'an kitam a'a ga'osan angalappas kitam,<l eID="gen5239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5240"/>panubu' sultan Da'ud, ya bay sosoho'an Tuhan e'.<l eID="gen5240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5241"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:70
verses.text: Paljanji'an Tuhan ko' itu,<l eID="gen5241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5242"/>ya bay pangallam e' kanabi-nabihan sussi ma masa awal.<l eID="gen5242" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5243"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:71
verses.text: Yuk janji' he', in kitam pinuwasan e'na min ga'osan palbantahantam.<l eID="gen5243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5244"/>maka min pang'ntanan saga a'a ab'nsihan kitam.<l eID="gen5244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5245"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:72
verses.text: Jari ta'nda' minnē' kaheya ase' Tuhan ma ka'mbo'-mbo'antam.<l eID="gen5245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5246"/>Tinuman isab janji' ya bay pagsulutanna maka sigām.<l eID="gen5246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5247"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:73
verses.text: Ya na janji' bay panganjanji'na ma si Ibrahim,<l eID="gen5247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5248"/>pinapagtapil maka sibahatna.<l eID="gen5248" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5249"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:74
verses.text: Bay iya anibahat in kitam panubu' si Ibrahim<l eID="gen5249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5250"/>pinuwasan du min pang'ntanan saga bantatam,<l eID="gen5250" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5251"/>jari makaisbat kitam ma Tuhan ma halam aniya' amakitāw,<l eID="gen5251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5252"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:75
verses.text: ma asussi pangatayantam maka abontol kahinangantam<l eID="gen5252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5253"/>sat'ggol kitam ma dunya itu.”<l eID="gen5253" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5235"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:76
verses.text: Amissala lagi' si Jakariya ma anakna, yukna, <lg sID="gen5254"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5255"/>“Ka'a, Oto', niōnan du ka nabi min Tuhan Mahatinggi.<l eID="gen5255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5256"/>Ka'a ya parahū min Panghū'nu amahāp lān palabayanna.<l eID="gen5256" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5257"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:77
verses.text: Pata'unu saga a'ana in sigām lappasan min mulka',<l eID="gen5257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5258"/>pagka niampun dusa sigām.<l eID="gen5258" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5259"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:78
verses.text: Sabab patiase'un Tuhantam, alunuk pangatayanna.<l eID="gen5259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5260"/>Angkan kitam pinabeya'an sawa min deyom sulga',<l eID="gen5260" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5261"/>sali' hantang llaw pasobang.<l eID="gen5261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5262"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:79
verses.text: Sasuku bay ka'ddasan ma deyom kalendoman<l eID="gen5262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5263"/>ma sabab katāw sigām ma kamatay, taluwa' sahaya na,<l eID="gen5263" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5264"/>ati pinandu'an kitam lān ahāp ya amowa kita ni kasannangan.”<l eID="gen5264" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5254"/>  <div eID="gen5234" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:80
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2436"/><div sID="gen5265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2436"/> Manjari anak si Jakariya inān pasulig na pa'in maka pasōng akkal-pikilanna. Pat'nna' na pa'in iya ma lahat paslangan sampay ta'abut llaw katuwa'na ni saga a'a Isra'il.  <div eID="gen5265" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.1"/> <div eID="gen5233" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2437"/><div sID="gen5266" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaganak ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.1.18-Matt.1.25">Matiyu 1:18-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5267" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2437"/> Ma waktu ina'an si Agustus ya Sultan Mahatinggi ma bangsa Rōm. Manjari anguldin iya subay sinulat ōn a'a kamemon ma sabarang lahat ma kaluha'an pagsultananna.

verses.name: Luke 2:2
verses.text: (Yampa aniya' uldin buwattē' pamasulat ōn a'a kamemon, ma waktu kapaggubnul si Kirinu ma katilingkal lahat Siriya).

verses.name: Luke 2:3
verses.text: Jari magpole'an saga a'a kamemon ni lahat ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām bo' magpasulat ōn sigām.  <div eID="gen5267" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2438"/><div sID="gen5268" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2438"/> Jari si Yusup bay pauntas min Nasaret ma lahat Jalil tudju ni lahat Yahudiya, ni kauman Betlehem ya lahat panganakan sultan Da'ud ma masa awal e'. Pina'an iya magpasulat ōnna sabab tubu' iya min si Da'ud.

verses.name: Luke 2:5
verses.text: Magbeya' iya maka si Mariyam, ya bay pinah'nda'an iya, supaya tasulat ōn sigā. Ab'ttong asal si Mariyam.

verses.name: Luke 2:6
verses.text: Jari mahē' pa'in sigā ma Betlehem, ta'abut llawna,

verses.name: Luke 2:7
verses.text: ati nianakan e'na anakna siyaka, l'lla. Pinalampinan e'na maka s'mmek bo' yampa pinalege ma deyom tu'ung pamanganan hayop ni'ipat, sabab halam aniya' lugal ma luma' paghahanti'an e'.  <div eID="gen5268" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5266" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2439"/><div sID="gen5269" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tunggu' Bili-bili maka Mala'ikat</title> <div sID="gen5270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2439"/> Na, aniya' ma jadjahan ina'an-i saga a'a anunggu' bili-bili sigām ma deya, waktu sangom pa'in.

verses.name: Luke 2:9
verses.text: Sakali aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan panyata' ni sigām, maka aninag sahaya Tuhan ma sakalibut sigām. Jari tināw sidda sigām.

verses.name: Luke 2:10
verses.text: Sagō' yuk mala'ikat ni sigām, “Da'a kam tināw sabab aniya' lapal ahāp pamowahanku ka'am, lapal makakōd atay saga a'a kamemon.

verses.name: Luke 2:11
verses.text: Aniya' Manglalappas nianakan ma ka'am, in iya Al-Masi ya Panghū'bi. Llaw itu du ya kapaganak ma iya, ma Betlehem, kauman sultan Da'ud.

verses.name: Luke 2:12
verses.text: Ya na itu paltanda'an pamab'nnal ka'am: makabāk du kam onde' pinalampinan maka s'mmek, ina'an palege ma deyom tu'ung pamanganan hayop.”  <div eID="gen5270" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2440"/><div sID="gen5271" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2440"/> Patagha' aniya' bangsa sulga' laksa'an ta'nda' e' saga tunggu' bili-bili inān pabeya' ma mala'ikat dakayu'. Amudji sigām Tuhan, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5272"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5273"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:14
verses.text: “Mahaldika' ni Tuhan Mahatinggi.<l eID="gen5273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5274"/>Bang pa'in aniya' kasannangan isab ma dunya itu,<l eID="gen5274" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5275"/>ma sasuku makasulut iya!”<l eID="gen5275" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5272"/>  <div eID="gen5271" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2441"/><div sID="gen5276" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2441"/> Makala'an pa'in saga mala'ikat inān pabalik ni sulga', magtūy magsuli-suli saga tutunggu' bili-bili inān, yuk-i, “Sūng na kitam ni Betlehem. Nda'tam bang ai paniya' inān, ya bay pamata'u kitam e' Panghū'.”  <div eID="gen5276" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2442"/><div sID="gen5277" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2442"/> Jari magdai'-dai' sigām pehē' ati tabāk e' sigām si Mariyam maka si Yusup. Ta'nda' isab e' sigām onde' palege ma deyom tu'ung pamanganan hayop.

verses.name: Luke 2:17
verses.text: Maka'nda' pa'in sigām ma onde', magtūy pangahaka e' sigām bay pamissala mala'ikat pasal onde' inān.

verses.name: Luke 2:18
verses.text: Ainu-inu to'ongan sasuku makakale ma haka saga tunggu' he'.

verses.name: Luke 2:19
verses.text: Sagō' tinau' kamemon saga pakaradja'an itu e' si Mariyam ma deyom atayna bo' tali'-tali'na pahāp.

verses.name: Luke 2:20
verses.text: Jari pabīng na saga tunggu' inān ni kahayopan sigām, maka e' sigām ananglitan maka amudji Tuhan ma sabab kamemon bay takale maka bay ta'nda' e' sigām. Sabab b'nnal to'ongan bay pamissala mala'ikat ma sigām.  <div eID="gen5277" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5269" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2443"/><div sID="gen5278" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangislam ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5279" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2443"/> Walung'llaw pa'in onde' inān ma luwasan, ni'islam iya ati niōnan Isa, ōn bay pangōn iya e' mala'ikat ma halam gi' pinangiraman.  <div eID="gen5279" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2444"/><div sID="gen5280" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2444"/> Ajukup pa'in waktu pagsussi ya pangahād ma si Mariyam ma sabab sara' si Musa, binowa si Isa pehē' ni Awrusalam e' si Yusup maka si Mariyam bo' tinukbalan ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 2:23
verses.text: (Tasulat asal ma Sara' min Panghū': “Kamemon saga anak l'lla siyaka subay pamasuku' ma Tuhan.”)

verses.name: Luke 2:24
verses.text: Tinukbalan isab e' sigām pagkulban buwat bay tasulat ma Sara' Panghū' he', ya yuk-i, “duwa assang atawa duwa anak malapati'<note>‘Malapati: ginis manuk-manuk pa'anggil-anggil ni luwa assang.</note> ya subay pagkulbanbi.”  <div eID="gen5280" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2445"/><div sID="gen5281" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2445"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an aniya' dakayu' matto'a l'lla ōnna si Simiyun maglahat ma Awrusalam. Ahāp addatna, magtata'at asal ma Tuhan. Nilagaran e'na waktu pangalappas ma bangsa Isra'il, maka kapagbaya'an iya e' Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Luke 2:26
verses.text: Bay iya pinata'u asal e' Rū Sussi in iya mbal amatay sat'ggol halam gi' ta'nda'na Al-Masi, ya panganjanji' e' Panghū'.

verses.name: Luke 2:27
verses.text: Manjari si Simiyun itu pinapina'an ni langgal pagkulbanan e' Rū Tuhan. Salta' pa'in si Isa binowa pina'an e' matto'ana bo' bineya' e' sigā usulan Sara' si Musa,

verses.name: Luke 2:28
verses.text: nihambin onde' e' si Simiyun. Magpudji iya, yukna, <lg sID="gen5282"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5283"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:29
verses.text: “O Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, atanu du aku.<l eID="gen5283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5284"/>Ahantap pangatayanku minsan aku papole'nu na,<l eID="gen5284" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5285"/>sabab tatuman na janji'nu.<l eID="gen5285" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5286"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:30
verses.text: Ta'nda' na e' mataku a'anu Manglalappas,<l eID="gen5286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5287"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:31
verses.text: ya bay sakapnu ma matahan manusiya' kamemon.<l eID="gen5287" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5288"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:32
verses.text: Onde' itu sapantun sawa pamabukis kahandaknu<l eID="gen5288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5289"/>ma saga bangsa ya ngga'i ka bangsa Isra'il,<l eID="gen5289" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5290"/>pamaheya kabantugan saga a'anu bangsa Isra'il.”<l eID="gen5290" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5282"/>  <div eID="gen5281" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2446"/><div sID="gen5291" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2446"/> Na, ainu-inu to'ongan ina'-mma' si Isa ma sabab kabtangan si Simiyun itu ma pasalan anak sigā.

verses.name: Luke 2:34
verses.text: Pagubus, niamu'an sigām kahāpan e' si Simiyun. Yukna isab ni si Mariyam ya ina' inān, “Ya pangangganta' Tuhan ma anaknu itu, in iya sababan angkan aheka a'a bangsa Isra'il makabāk kalappasan, maka aheka isab magni-kala'atan. Paltanda'an iya min Tuhan sagō' sinulak iya e' kaheka'an a'a,

verses.name: Luke 2:35
verses.text: bo' kasakupan bang ai to'ongan pinikil e' sigām. Maka ka'a ilu, Mariyam,” yuk si Simiyun, “makananam du ka kasusahan sali' hantang kalis parugsu' ni deyom ataynu.”  <div eID="gen5291" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2447"/><div sID="gen5292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2447"/> Aniya' isab maina'an dakayu' nabi d'nda niōnan si Anna, anak si Panu'al, min panubu' si Aser. Ato'a na iya to'ongan, walumpū' maka mpat tahun umulna. Pituntahun du bay kapagpūnna maka h'llana ati abalu iya sangay minnē'. Atukid iya magni-langgal pagkulbanan, ati maina'an iya llaw-sangom amudji Tuhan. Amuwasa iya sampay anambahayang.

verses.name: Luke 2:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2447"/><div sID="gen5292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2447"/> Aniya' isab maina'an dakayu' nabi d'nda niōnan si Anna, anak si Panu'al, min panubu' si Aser. Ato'a na iya to'ongan, walumpū' maka mpat tahun umulna. Pituntahun du bay kapagpūnna maka h'llana ati abalu iya sangay minnē'. Atukid iya magni-langgal pagkulbanan, ati maina'an iya llaw-sangom amudji Tuhan. Amuwasa iya sampay anambahayang.

verses.name: Luke 2:38
verses.text: Manjari pasabu si Anna itu ma waktu ina'an-i ati magsukul to'ongan iya ni Tuhan maka anuli-nuli pasal onde' inān ni a'a kamemon, sasuku angalagaran waktu panglappas saga a'a Awrusalam.  <div eID="gen5292" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2448"/><div sID="gen5293" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2448"/> Manjari itu, aubus pa'in si Yusup maka si Mariyam maghinang kamemon bay panoho'an ma deyom Sara' Panghū', pabīng na sigām ni lahat Jalil, ni kauman Nasaret ya pat'nna'an sigām luggiya'.

verses.name: Luke 2:40
verses.text: Pasulig onde' inān sampay pakosog baranna. Alalom pangita'una maka pinaniya'an iya barakat min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5293" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5278" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2449"/><div sID="gen5294" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <div sID="gen5295" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2449"/> Na, magtukad saga matto'a si Isa ni Awrusalam kahaba'-kahaba' tahun bo' maghinang Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: Luke 2:42
verses.text: Jari itu, ta'abut pa'in sangpū' maka duwantahun umul si Isa, magbeya' sigām pehē' ni paghinangan buwat kabiyaksahan bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Luke 2:43
verses.text: Atammat pa'in paghinang e', amole' na sigā ni lahat sagō' ta'bba si Isa ma Awrusalam ma halam kinata'uwan e' matto'ana.

verses.name: Luke 2:44
verses.text: Pangannal sigā ina'an du iya magbeya' pa'abay ma sigā. Jari dang'llaw ya kal'ngngan sigā bo' yampa sigā amiha iya ma deyom kabagayan maka kaheka'an sigā, sagō' halam iya tabāk maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 2:45
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', pabīng sigā tudju ni Awrusalam amiha iya mahē'.

verses.name: Luke 2:46
verses.text: Apuwas pa'in t'llumbahangi, yamboho' iya tabāk ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan magsamatingkō' maka saga guru. Ina'an iya akale maka atilaw na pa'in ma sigām.

verses.name: Luke 2:47
verses.text: Sasuku makakale ma iya ainu-inu to'ongan sabab alalom pangita'una, maka taluwa' panambungna.

verses.name: Luke 2:48
verses.text: Pag'nda' matto'ana ma iya landu' sigā ainu-inu. Yuk ina'na, “Otō', angay buwattilu hinangnu ma kami? Asusa to'ongan aku maka mma'nu amiha ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5295" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2450"/><div sID="gen5296" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2450"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigā, “Angay aku pihabi? Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi in aku subay maitu ma luma' Mma'ku?”

verses.name: Luke 2:50
verses.text: Saguwā' halam tahati e' sigā bang ai pamissalana.  <div eID="gen5296" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2451"/><div sID="gen5297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2451"/> Jari magbeya' si Isa maka matto'ana pabīng ni Nasaret ati bineya' e'na panoho'an sigā. Malaingkan si Mariyam bay anau' pakaradja'an itu kamemon ma deyom pangatayanna.

verses.name: Luke 2:52
verses.text: Pasōng na pa'in paheya si Isa maka pasōng ta'una. Pasōng isab iya makasulut atay Tuhan sampay manusiya'.  <div eID="gen5297" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.2"/> <div eID="gen5294" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2452"/><div sID="gen5298" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yahiya Magpapandi Anagna' Amandu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.1-Matt.1.12">Matiyu 3:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.1-Mark.1.8">Markus 1:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.1.19-John.1.28">Yahiya 1:19-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5299" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2452"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in kasangpū' maka limantahun kapagsultan si Tibirus, ya Sultan Mahatinggi ma bangsa Rōm, aniya' palman Tuhan at'kka ni si Yahiya anak si Jakariya, waktu kamahe'na ma lahat paslangan. Ma waktu ina'an Puntus Pilatu ya maggubnul ma lahat Yahudiya, si Herod ya magparinta ma lahat Jalil, danakanna si Pilip ya magparinta ma lahat Ituriya maka ma lahat Tarakunit, maka si Lisani ya ma lahat Abilene. Si Annas maka si Kayapas bay Imam Muwallam.

verses.name: Luke 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2452"/><div sID="gen5298" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Yahiya Magpapandi Anagna' Amandu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.1-Matt.1.12">Matiyu 3:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.1-Mark.1.8">Markus 1:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.1.19-John.1.28">Yahiya 1:19-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5299" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2452"/> Na, ta'abut pa'in kasangpū' maka limantahun kapagsultan si Tibirus, ya Sultan Mahatinggi ma bangsa Rōm, aniya' palman Tuhan at'kka ni si Yahiya anak si Jakariya, waktu kamahe'na ma lahat paslangan. Ma waktu ina'an Puntus Pilatu ya maggubnul ma lahat Yahudiya, si Herod ya magparinta ma lahat Jalil, danakanna si Pilip ya magparinta ma lahat Ituriya maka ma lahat Tarakunit, maka si Lisani ya ma lahat Abilene. Si Annas maka si Kayapas bay Imam Muwallam.

verses.name: Luke 3:3
verses.text: Manjari pal'ngngan na si Yahiya angalatag kalahat-lahatan ma jadjahan sapa' Jordan magnasihat palman Tuhan. Yukna, “Pataikut kam min dusabi bo' kam pinandi taubat ati niampun du dusabi e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Luke 3:4
verses.text: Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab nabi Isaya ma awal lagi'. Yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5300"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5301"/>“Aniya' a'a angalingan ma lahat paslangan, yuk-i,<l eID="gen5301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5302"/>‘Sōng na at'kka Panghū'. Lanu'inbi lān palabayanna,<l eID="gen5302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5303"/>pabontolunbi pal'ngngananna.<l eID="gen5303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5304"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:5
verses.text: Saga l'bbak kamemon subay pinapantay,<l eID="gen5304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5305"/>kabūd-būran kamemon subay pinaratag.<l eID="gen5305" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5306"/>Saga lān abengkok subay pinabontol,<l eID="gen5306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5307"/>maka palabayan magtinggil-l'bbak subay pinalanu'.<l eID="gen5307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5308"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:6
verses.text: Manjari ta'nda' e' manusiya' kamemon<l eID="gen5308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5309"/>kapanglappas Tuhan ma sigām.’ ”<l eID="gen5309" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5300"/>  <div eID="gen5299" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2453"/><div sID="gen5310" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2453"/> Na, landu' aheka a'a pina'an ni si Yahiya mikipandi, angkan yukna ma sigām, “Ka'am ilu, addatbi sali' sapantun addat sowa pangangakkal. Sai bahā' bay angahaka'an ka'am in ka'am subay papuwas min mulka' ya song pat'kka?

verses.name: Luke 3:8
verses.text: Bang kam sab'nnal-b'nnal pataikut na min dusabi, hinangunbi hinang ahāp, tanda' saksi' in addatbi apinda na. Da'a kam magpina'in in ka'am mbal minulka'an saukat na kam panubu' si Ibrahim. Haka'anta kam, minsan saga batu itu tahinang du panubu' si Ibrahim e' Tuhan!

verses.name: Luke 3:9
verses.text: Ka'am ilu sali' hantang kayu arai' na pinuwad maka kapa, tobtob min po'onna. Sabab kayu kamemon sasuku mbal ahāp buwa'na, pinuwad du bo' nilarukan ni deyom api tinunu'.”  <div eID="gen5310" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2454"/><div sID="gen5311" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2454"/> Manjari tinilaw si Yahiya e' ba'anan a'a inān. Yuk sigām, “Ai subay hinang kami?”  <div eID="gen5311" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2455"/><div sID="gen5312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2455"/> Yuk si Yahiya, “Sasuku kam magduwa badju' pamuwanunbi dakayu' ma a'a halam taga-badju'. Sasuku isab kam taga-kinakan pamahagi'unbi ma a'a atiksa'.”  <div eID="gen5312" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2456"/><div sID="gen5313" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2456"/> Aniya' isab pehē' mikipandi ma si Yahiya Magpapandi saga a'a magā' sukay parinta. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan Guru, kami itu? Ai subay hinang kami?”  <div eID="gen5313" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2457"/><div sID="gen5314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2457"/> Yuk si Yahiya, “Bang kam angā' sukay da'a palabihunbi min bay panoho'an ka'am e' parinta.”  <div eID="gen5314" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2458"/><div sID="gen5315" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2458"/> Ya du saga sundalu, bay atilaw ma si Yahiya. Yuk sigām, “Kami sundalu itu, ai subay hinang kami?” <div eID="gen5315" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5316" type="paragraph"/> Ya sambung si Yahiya, “Da'a kam angalangpas, da'a kam anumbung ni sara' ma ngga'i ka b'nnal. Maka da'a kam anawad ma gadjibi.”  <div eID="gen5316" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2459"/><div sID="gen5317" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2459"/> Na, makakale pa'in saga a'a inān ma si Yahiya, magtūy sigām aholat-holat bang kalu si Yahiya in Al-Masi, ya nilagaran e' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 3:16
verses.text: Angkan ah'lling si Yahiya ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Aku itu, hal bohe' ya pamandiku ka'am. Saguwā' aniya' a'a song pi'itu labi bangsahan sidda min aku. Minsan engkot taumpa'na mbal aku tinōp angahubaran iya. Saddī bowahan pamandina ma ka'am. Hatina in iya amasangon Rū Sussi ni deyom baranbi. Kasehe'an isab pinandi e'na maka api.

verses.name: Luke 3:17
verses.text: Sinilang du e'na a'a ahāp maka a'a ala'at, buwat sapantun a'a anahapan pai. Ya paina tinau' e'na ma deyom tatau'anna, sagō' hampa'na tinunu' ma api mbal kap'ddahan.”  <div eID="gen5317" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2460"/><div sID="gen5318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2460"/> Aheka isab bissala si Yahiya saddī bay pagnasihatna lapal ahāp ma saga a'a. Bay soho'na isab sigām amindahan kaul-pi'il sigām.  <div eID="gen5318" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2461"/><div sID="gen5319" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2461"/> Na, aniya' waktu pamabukag si Yahiya ma gubnul Herod. Sabab dusahan si Herod magpūn maka si Herodiyas ya bay h'nda siyalina, maka ma sabab kahinanganna ala'at kasehe'.

verses.name: Luke 3:20
verses.text: Manjari karuhunan si Herod maghinang ala'at sabab pinakalabusu e'na si Yahiya.  <div eID="gen5319" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5298" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2462"/><div sID="gen5320" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandi ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.13-Matt.3.17">Matiyu 3:13-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.9-Mark.1.11">Markus 1:9-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2462"/> Ma waktu kapamandi lagi' si Yahiya ma a'a kamemon, pinandi isab e'na si Isa. Pagubus, hinabu si Isa anabbut ni Tuhan, magtūy paukab deyom sulga',

verses.name: Luke 3:22
verses.text: ati pareyo' Rū Sussi pinaka luwa assang, patapu' ma iya. Aniya' isab suwala ah'lling min deyom sulga', yuk-i, “Ka'a ya Anakku kalasahanku, landu' makasulut atayku.”  <div eID="gen5321" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5320" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2463"/><div sID="gen5322" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapangkatan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.1.1-Matt.1.17">Matiyu 1:1-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5323" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2463"/> Na, ma waktu kapanagna' si Isa magnasihat pandu'na ma manusiya', aniya' saga t'llumpū' tahun umulna. Anak si Yusup iya bang ma pangannal saga a'a, <lg sID="gen5324"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5325"/>si Yusup ya bay anak si Hili.<l eID="gen5325" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5324"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:24
verses.text: Si Hili ya bay anak si Mattat, <lg sID="gen5326"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5327"/>ya Mattat bay anak si Libi, ya Libi bay anak si Malki,<l eID="gen5327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5328"/>ya Malki bay anak si Janni, ya Janni bay anak si Yusup.<l eID="gen5328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5329"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:25
verses.text: Si Yusup bay anak si Mattati, ya Mattati bay anak si Amos,<l eID="gen5329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5330"/>ya Amos bay anak si Nahum, ya Nahum bay anak si Esli,<l eID="gen5330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5331"/>ya Esli bay anak si Naggay.<l eID="gen5331" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5326"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:26
verses.text: Si Naggay ya bay anak si Ma'at, <lg sID="gen5332"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5333"/>ya Ma'at bay anak si Mattati dakayu', ya Mattati itu bay anak si Simain,<l eID="gen5333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5334"/>ya Simain bay anak si Yosek, ya Yosek bay anak si Joda.<l eID="gen5334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5335"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:27
verses.text: Si Joda ya bay anak si Jo'anan, ya Jo'anan bay anak si Resa,<l eID="gen5335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5336"/>ya Resa bay anak si Sirubbabil, si Sirubbabil bay anak si Salati,<l eID="gen5336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5337"/>ya Salati bay anak si Niri.<l eID="gen5337" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5332"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:28
verses.text: Si Niri ya bay anak si Malki, <lg sID="gen5338"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5339"/>ya Malki bay anak si Addi, si Addi bay anak si Kosam,<l eID="gen5339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5340"/>ya Kosam bay anak si Elmadam, si Elmadam bay anak si Ēr.<l eID="gen5340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5341"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:29
verses.text: Si Ēr ya bay anak si Yussa', si Yussa' bay anak si Ele'eser,<l eID="gen5341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5342"/>ya Ele'eser bay anak si Jurim, si Jurim bay anak si Mattat,<l eID="gen5342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5343"/>ya Mattat bay anak si Libi,<l eID="gen5343" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5338"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:30
verses.text: si Libi bay anak si Simiyun, <lg sID="gen5344"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5345"/>si Simiyun bay anak si Yuda, ya Yuda bay anak si Yusup,<l eID="gen5345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5346"/>ya Yusup bay anak si Jonam, ya Jonam bay anak si Eliyakim.<l eID="gen5346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5347"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:31
verses.text: Si Eliyakim ya bay anak si Meleya, ya Meleya bay anak si Menna,<l eID="gen5347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5348"/>ya Menna bay anak si Mattata, ya Mattata bay anak si Natan,<l eID="gen5348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5349"/>ya Natan bay anak si Da'ud.<l eID="gen5349" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5344"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:32
verses.text: Si Da'ud e' bay anak si Jesse, <lg sID="gen5350"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5351"/>ya Jesse bay anak si Obed, ya Obed bay anak si Bowas,<l eID="gen5351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5352"/>ya Bowas bay anak si Sala, ya Sala bay anak si Nasson.<l eID="gen5352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5353"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:33
verses.text: Si Nasson ya bay anak si Amminadab, ya Amminadab bay anak si Admin,<l eID="gen5353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5354"/>ya Admin bay anak si Arni, ya Arni bay anak si Hesdon,<l eID="gen5354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5355"/>ya Hesdon bay anak si Peres, ya Peres bay anak si Yuda.<l eID="gen5355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5356"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:34
verses.text: Si Yuda ya bay anak si Yakub, si Yakub e' bay anak si Isa'ak,<l eID="gen5356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5357"/>ya Isa'ak bay anak si Ibrahim, ya Ibrahim bay anak si Tera,<l eID="gen5357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5358"/>ya Tera bay anak si Nahor.<l eID="gen5358" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5350"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:35
verses.text: Si Nahor ya bay anak si Sirug, <lg sID="gen5359"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5360"/>ya Sirug bay anak si Reyo, ya Reyo bay anak si Peleg,<l eID="gen5360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5361"/>ya Peleg bay anak si Eber, ya Eber bay anak si Sela.<l eID="gen5361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5362"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:36
verses.text: Si Sela ya bay anak si Kainan, ya Kainan bay anak si Arpaksad,<l eID="gen5362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5363"/>ya Arpaksad bay anak si Sēm anak si Nū, ya Nū bay anak si Lamek.<l eID="gen5363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5364"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:37
verses.text: Si Lamek bay anak si Metosela, ya Metosela bay anak si Idris,<l eID="gen5364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5365"/>ya Idris bay anak si Jared, ya Jared bay anak si Mahalalel,<l eID="gen5365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5366"/>ya Mahalalel bay anak si Kenan.<l eID="gen5366" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5359"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:38
verses.text: Si Kenan ya bay anak si Enos, <lg sID="gen5367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5368"/>ya Enos bay anak si Sēt, ya Sēt bay anak si mbo' Adam,<l eID="gen5368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5369"/>maka si Adam bay anak Tuhan.<l eID="gen5369" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5367"/>  <div eID="gen5323" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.3"/> <div eID="gen5322" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2464"/><div sID="gen5370" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanulay ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.4.1-Matt.4.11">Matiyu 4:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.12-Mark.1.13">Markus 1:12-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2464"/> Manjari itu pabīng si Isa min sapa' Jordan. Kahōpan iya e' Rū Sussi ati binowa iya kaleya ni lahat paslangan.

verses.name: Luke 4:2
verses.text: Mpatpū' ng'llaw, mpatpū' bahangi ya kamahe'na sinasat na pa'in e' nakura' saitan, kalu tabowa magdusa. Halam iya bay makatimtim ai-ai t'ggolna mahē'. Pagpuwas ina'an-i aheya lingantuna.  <div eID="gen5371" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2465"/><div sID="gen5372" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2465"/> Ah'lling nakura' saitan ma iya, yukna, “Bang ka'a sab'nnal-b'nnal Anak Tuhan soho'un saga batu itu papinda ni tinapay.”  <div eID="gen5372" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2466"/><div sID="gen5373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2466"/> Saguwā' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘ngga'i ka hal kinakan baran ya makakallum ma manusiya'.’ ”  <div eID="gen5373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2467"/><div sID="gen5374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2467"/> Puwas e' binowa iya e' nakura' saitan ni kalangkawan bo' yampa pina'nda'an kalahatan kamemon ma deyom dunya, pinalaman sadja min matana.

verses.name: Luke 4:6
verses.text: Yuk nakura' saitan ni iya, “Buwananta ka kapatut bo' ka makapagbaya' ma saga kalahatan itu maka karayana kamemon. Sabab bay pamasuku' ma aku kamemonna itu, ya angkan aku taga-kapatut amuwan ma sai-sai kabaya'anku.

verses.name: Luke 4:7
verses.text: Na, bang ka amudji aku pamuwanku itu kamemon ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2468"/><div sID="gen5375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2468"/> Ya sambung si Isa ma saitan e', “Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, ‘Panghū'bi Tuhan sadja ya subay pudjibi. Tunggal iya paghinanganbi!’ ”  <div eID="gen5375" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2469"/><div sID="gen5376" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2469"/> Puwas e' binowa si Isa e' nakura' saitan ni da'ira Awrusalam ati pina'atag iya ma puttuk langgal pagkulbanan. Yuk saitan e' ni iya, “Bang ka b'nnal Anak Tuhan, pakuppa ka minnilu

verses.name: Luke 4:10
verses.text: sabab aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Sinoho' e' Tuhan saga mala'ikatna anganjagahan ka'a.’

verses.name: Luke 4:11
verses.text: Aniya' isab dakayu' sulat, ya yuk-i, ‘Tinayak ka e' sigām bo' mbal makahantak tape'nu ni batu.’ ”  <div eID="gen5376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2470"/><div sID="gen5377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2470"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Yuk Kitab, ‘Da'a sulayinbi kawasa Panghū'bi Tuhan.’ ”  <div eID="gen5377" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2471"/><div sID="gen5378" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2471"/> Na, aubus pa'in kaginisan sasat ya panasat e' nakura' saitan, ang'bba iya min si Isa, bo' amiha llaw saddī.  <div eID="gen5378" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5370" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2472"/><div sID="gen5379" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinulak si Isa e' saga A'a Nasaret</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.53-Matt.13.58">Matiyu 13:53-58</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.6.1-Mark.6.6">Markus 6:1-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5380" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2472"/> Manjari itu pabīng si Isa ni lahat Jalil, abarakat asal e' Rū Sussi. Jari pasaplag habal ma pasalanna ni saga a'a ma kaluha'an lahat inān.

verses.name: Luke 4:15
verses.text: Amandu' na pa'in iya ma kalanggal-langgalan sigām ati sinanglitan iya e' a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen5380" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2473"/><div sID="gen5381" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2473"/> Pina'an iya ni Nasaret, ya lahat pasuliganna. Ta'abut pa'in llaw Sabtu', pehē' iya ni langgal buwat kabiyaksahanna. Ma langgal pa'in, an'ngge iya amassa Kitab.

verses.name: Luke 4:17
verses.text: Sinōngan ni iya lūnan jūd nabi Isaya. Pagb'llatna, tabassana saga ayat itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5382"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5383"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:18
verses.text: “Itiya' aku kapagbaya'an e' Rū Panghū',<l eID="gen5383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5384"/>sabab tapene' aku e'na<l eID="gen5384" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5385"/>amasampay lapal ahāp ni saga a'a kamiskinan.<l eID="gen5385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5386"/>Sinoho' aku pi'itu angahaka'an saga pilisu in sigām pinaluwas du,<l eID="gen5386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5387"/>saga a'a buta in sigām maka'nda' du pabīng.<l eID="gen5387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5388"/>Sinoho' aku e'na amuwasan sasuku ni'inyaya,<l eID="gen5388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5389"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:19
verses.text: amasaplag isab in waktu pangalappas Panghū'<l eID="gen5389" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5390"/>ma saga a'ana, ta'abut na.”<l eID="gen5390" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5382"/>  <div eID="gen5381" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2474"/><div sID="gen5391" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2474"/> Puwas e' nilūn e' si Isa jūd bay pamassahanna he'. Ni'nde'an e'na ni bilal bo' yampa aningkō'. Sakali pinatongan iya e' a'a kamemon ma deyom langgal inān,

verses.name: Luke 4:21
verses.text: ati anagna' iya amissala ni sigām, yukna, “Ma llaw itu taga-kamaksuran na saga ayat bay tabassaku ma pangalehanbi.”  <div eID="gen5391" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2475"/><div sID="gen5392" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2475"/> Ka'amuhan saga a'a inān kamemon ma si Isa. Ainu-inu sigām ma sabab kapanday bissalana. Sagō' aniya' pah'lling sigām, yuk-i, “Bang kami mbal asā', anak si Yusup ko' itu!”  <div eID="gen5392" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2476"/><div sID="gen5393" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2476"/> Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Tantu du kam amah'llingan aku buwat bay papata kamatto'ahan, ya yuk-i, ‘Pagka ka ata'u anambal, anambalan ka di-nu.’ Tantu isab kam anoho' aku subay angahinang maitu ma lahatku luggiya' saga hinang ya takalebi bay hinangku ma lahat Kapirnaum e'.

verses.name: Luke 4:24
verses.text: Haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “in nabi mbal du pinagaddatan ma lahatna luggiya'.

verses.name: Luke 4:25
verses.text: Halam aniya' duwa-ruwana, ma masa lagi' nabi Elija halam bay angulan ma deyom t'lluntahun maka tonga', maka landu' ginotom kaluha'an lahat inān. B'nnal aheka balu d'nda bay maitu ma lahat Isra'il ma waktu gotom inān,

verses.name: Luke 4:26
verses.text: sagō' ngga'i ka d'nda Isra'il ya bay pamapehē'an si Elija. D'nda bangsa saddī ko' inān, a'a min Sarepta, ma jadjahan Sidun.

verses.name: Luke 4:27
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ma bay waktu nabi Elisa,” yuk si Isa. “Aheka a'a ni'ipul ma bangsa Isra'il sagō' halam aniya' minsan dakayu' bay kauli'an ipulna. Luwal a'a min bangsa Siriya niōnan si Na'aman.”  <div eID="gen5393" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2477"/><div sID="gen5394" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2477"/> Takale pa'in bissala si Isa itu e' saga a'a ma deyom langgal inān, magtūy ap'ddi' to'ongan atay sigām.

verses.name: Luke 4:29
verses.text: Magpan'ngge sigām kamemon bo' angahella' si Isa paluwas min kauman inān. Binowa iya ni diyata' būd ya pa'atagan da'ira he', bo' nihūg min diyata' pampang e'.

verses.name: Luke 4:30
verses.text: Daipara pas'llot iya min t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām ati ala'an na minnē'.  <div eID="gen5394" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5379" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2478"/><div sID="gen5395" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amauli' A'a Pasōran Saitan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.1.21-Mark.1.28">Markus 1:21-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5396" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2478"/> Palūd na si Isa min Nasaret inān tudju ni Kapirnaum, dakayu' kauman ma lahat Jalil. Pagka llaw Sabtu' na, amandu' iya ma saga a'a.

verses.name: Luke 4:32
verses.text: Ainu-inu ma pamandu'na saga a'a makakale inān sabab taga-kawasa iya bang amissala.

verses.name: Luke 4:33
verses.text: Na, aniya' ma deyom langgal inān a'a sinōd saitan. Angolang iya pakosog,

verses.name: Luke 4:34
verses.text: yuk-i, “Allō! Isa min Nasaret! Ai maksudnu pi'itu? Pi'itu ka bahā' amaka'at kami? Kata'uwanku bang sai ka. Ka'a ya Dakayu'-kayu' Asussi ya pi'itu min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5396" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2479"/><div sID="gen5397" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2479"/> Saguwā' nilāng saitan inān e' si Isa, yukna, “Pahali ka! Paluwas ka min a'a ilu!” Magtūy a'a bay sinōd inān pinahantak e' saitan ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' saga a'a. Puwas e' paluwas na saitan, bo' halam du ainay baran a'a he'.  <div eID="gen5397" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2480"/><div sID="gen5398" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2480"/> Landu' ainu-inu saga a'a inān kamemon. Magsuli-suli sigām dangan maka dangan, yuk-i, “Minningga bahā' pamandu'na itu? Taga-kawasa iya maka taga-kapatut magpanoho'an saga saitan paluwas min a'a ati bineya' iya.”

verses.name: Luke 4:37
verses.text: Manjari pasaplag na pa'in habal pasal si Isa ni kaluha'an lahat ma jadjahan ina'an-i.  <div eID="gen5398" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5395" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2481"/><div sID="gen5399" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka A'a Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.14-Matt.8.17">Matiyu 8:14-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.29-Mark.1.34">Markus 1:29-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5400" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2481"/> Puwas e' paluwas si Isa min langgal Kapirnaum bo' pina'an ni luma' si Simun. Na, mato'a si Simun d'nda ni'mmunan sidda, ati sinabi si Isa e' sigām amauli' iya.

verses.name: Luke 4:39
verses.text: Pina'an si Isa an'ngge ma atag palegehan d'nda he' ati soho'na ala'an mmunna. Jari pahali bay mmunna he' ati punduk iya magtūy bo' angalabot disi Isa.  <div eID="gen5400" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2482"/><div sID="gen5401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2482"/> Pas'ddop pa'in llaw, binowa ni si Isa sasuku taga-saki indaginis. Pina'abut e'na tanganna ma sigām dangan maka dangan ati kauli'an.

verses.name: Luke 4:41
verses.text: Aheka isab saga a'a bay kapaluwasan saitan. Angolang pakosog saga saitan inān, yuk-i, “Ka'a ya Anak Tuhan!” Sagō' nilāng sigām e' si Isa, sinō' da'a angahaka buwattē' sabab kinilā iya e' sigām in iya Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen5401" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2483"/><div sID="gen5402" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2483"/> Dai' llaw pa'in, ala'an si Isa minnē' ni jadjahan halam maga'a. Piniha iya e' saga a'a ati tabāk iya maina'an. Arak iya tinaggahan e' sigām bo' mbal makala'an minnē',

verses.name: Luke 4:43
verses.text: sagō' ah'lling si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Subay aku pehē' isab ni saga kauman saddī bo' magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal pagparinta Tuhan, sabab ya na itu po'onanna angkan aku pinapi'itu e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Luke 4:44
verses.text: Jari magnasihat na pa'in si Isa ma deyom kalanggal-langgalan mahē' ma lahat Yahudiya.  <div eID="gen5402" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.4"/> <div eID="gen5399" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2484"/><div sID="gen5403" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Anagna' Amene' A'a Pamulid ma Iya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.4.18-Matt.4.22">Matiyu 4:18-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.16-Mark.1.20">Markus 1:16-20</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5404" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2484"/> Manjari aniya' llaw dakayu' an'ngge si Isa ma bihing danaw Gennesaret. Magtimuk na pa'in saga a'a ni bihingna supaya sigām makakale palman Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 5:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' ta'nda' e' si Isa duwa bayanan pasanglad ma bihing danaw. Bay ni'bbahan e' saga a'a magdaraing hinabu sigām angose'an pokot.

verses.name: Luke 5:3
verses.text: Paruwa' si Isa ni bayanan dakayu' ya suku' si Simun, ati angamu' iya ma si Simun pinatā-tā dangkuri' min bihing tampe. Jari aningkō' si Isa ma bayanan bo' amandu' ma saga a'a.  <div eID="gen5404" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2485"/><div sID="gen5405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2485"/> Na, aubus pa'in e' si Isa amandu', ah'lling iya ni si Simun, yukna, “Pasōngun gi' ni kalaloman, ati hūgunbi pokot bo' kam maka'ā'.”  <div eID="gen5405" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2486"/><div sID="gen5406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2486"/> Anambung si Simun, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, lu'ugan na kami amokot dibuhi' sampay ni ka'llawan bo' halam kami bay maka'ā'. Sagō' pagka ka'a ya anoho', hūg kami na.”

verses.name: Luke 5:6
verses.text: Tahūg pa'in pokot inān, aheka to'ongan daing ta'ā'. Agon na agese' saga pokot e',

verses.name: Luke 5:7
verses.text: angkan sininyalan e' disi Petros saga abay sigām, sinō' anabang angahella'. Makapina'an pa'in saga abay, magtūy niruwa' daing inān ni diyata' bayanan. A'llop karuwa bayanan inān e' daing, sa'agon-agon pat'nde.

verses.name: Luke 5:8
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Simun Petros ma ba'anan daing inān, magtūy iya pasujud ma si Isa. Yukna, “O Tuwan, palawak ka min aku sabab dusahan aku.”  <div eID="gen5406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2487"/><div sID="gen5407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2487"/> Angkan buwattē' llingna, sabab ainu-inu iya maka saga abayna ma pasal heka daing bay ta'ā' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 5:10
verses.text: Ya du ainu-inu saga sehe' si Simun magdaraing e', ya si Yakub maka si Yahiya duwangan anak si Sibidi. Manjari ah'lling si Isa ma si Simun, yukna, “Da'a ka tināw. Puwas min llaw ītu, ya hinangnu subay magā' manusiya' ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Luke 5:11
verses.text: Manjari nihella' bayanan sigām ni gintana'an ati ni'bbahan kaniya' sigām kamemon bo' yampa ameya' ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen5407" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5403" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2488"/><div sID="gen5408" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Ni'ipul Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.1-Matt.8.4">Matiyu 8:1-4</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.40-Mark.1.45">Markus 1:40-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2488"/> Ma llaw dakayu', waktu pa'in si Isa ma dakayu' kauman, aniya' maina'an a'a ni'ipul. Alapat baranna e' sakina. Maka'nda' pa'in a'a itu ma si Isa, magtūy iya pasujud ma dahuanna anganjunjung. “Tuwan,” yukna, “bang ka bilahi kauli'annu du aku.”  <div eID="gen5409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2489"/><div sID="gen5410" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2489"/> Sakali pina'abut e' si Isa tanganna ma a'a inān. Yuk si Isa, “Bilahi sadja aku. Kauli'an na ka.” Saru'un-du'un du ala'an ipulna.

verses.name: Luke 5:14
verses.text: Niamay-amayan iya e' si Isa, yukna, “Da'a ka angahaka ni sai ni sai pasal itu-i. Saguwā' pehē' ka patūy ni imam bo' palilingun barannu ma iya. Pagubus tukbalin pagkulban ni Tuhan buwat bay pamandu' e' si Musa, tanda' saksi' ni kaheka'an a'a in ka'a ilu alanu' na min sakinu.”  <div eID="gen5410" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2490"/><div sID="gen5411" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2490"/> Sagō' minsan buwattē' pangalāng si Isa, pasaplag gom pa'in suli-suli pasalna, angkan aheka saga a'a patimuk ni iya bo' akale ma pandu'na sampay angamu' pinauli' saga saki sigām.

verses.name: Luke 5:16
verses.text: Saguwā' bang pasān, ala'an si Isa min kaheka'an a'a inān ni lahat kulang a'ana bo' anambahayang mahē'.  <div eID="gen5411" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5408" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2491"/><div sID="gen5412" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Amatay Ugatna Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.1-Matt.9.8">Matiyu 9:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.2.1-Mark.2.12">Markus 2:1-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5413" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2491"/> Dakayu' llaw, hinabu si Isa amandu', aniya' saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' agama Yahudi aningkō' ma atagna. Saga a'a itu bay pina'an min da'ira Awrusalam maka min kamemon lūngan ma lahat Jalil maka lahat Yahudiya. Taga-kawasa asal si Isa min Panghū' angkan iya makauli' saga a'a sakihan.

verses.name: Luke 5:18
verses.text: Manjari aniya' at'kka pina'an saga a'a ananggung a'a amatay ugatna. Pasulay sigām pasekot ni atag si Isa,

verses.name: Luke 5:19
verses.text: sagō' mbal makalabay sabab sikatimukan saga a'a maina'an. Angkan sigām parāg ni diyata' luma' angalangkat atop bo' amatonton a'a amatay ugatna maka palegehanna. Jari pinat'nna' iya ma dahuwan si Isa ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' katimukan a'a.

verses.name: Luke 5:20
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in si Isa in a'a amowa inān angandol ma iya, ah'lling iya ni a'a amatay ugatna, yukna, “Bagay, niampun na dusanu.”  <div eID="gen5413" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2492"/><div sID="gen5414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2492"/> Na, takale pa'in lling si Isa itu e' saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi, magtūy sigām magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām dangan maka dangan, “Sai sa a'a itu?” yuk-i. “Amah'lling iya kupul ni Tuhan magbissala buwattē' sabab halam aniya' maka'ampun dusa, luwal Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5414" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2493"/><div sID="gen5415" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2493"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai pinikil e' sigām, ati yukna ma sigām, “Angay kam magpikil-pikil buwattilu?

verses.name: Luke 5:23
verses.text: Kumpasunbi bang ingga aluhay: bang yukku ma a'a, ‘niampun na dusanu’, atawa bang yukku, ‘pabungkal ka bo' ka pal'ngngan?’

verses.name: Luke 5:24
verses.text: Na, buwananta kam tanda' palsaksi'an bo' kata'uwanbi in aku, Anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut angampun dusa ma deyom dunya itu.” Jari ah'lling si Isa ni a'a amatay ugatna he', yukna, “Soho'ta ka pabungkal. Bowahun pabahakannu ilu amole'.”  <div eID="gen5415" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2494"/><div sID="gen5416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2494"/> Saru'un-du'un du pabungkal iya ma matahan sigām kamemon. Binuhat e'na bay pabahakanna bo' yampa amole' ni luma'na, maka e'na ananglitan Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 5:26
verses.text: Ainu-inu to'ongan saga a'a inān kamemon maka sinōd sigām tāw. Ananglit sigām ma Tuhan, yuk-i, “Hinang makainu-inu ya ta'nda'ta llaw itu!”  <div eID="gen5416" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5412" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2495"/><div sID="gen5417" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Libi Binowa Ameya' ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.9-Matt.9.13">Matiyu 9:9-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.2.13-Mark.2.17">Markus 2:13-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5418" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2495"/> Pagubus, paluwas si Isa minna'an ati aniya' ta'nda'na maga'ā' sukay parinta, ōnna si Libi. Ina'an iya aningkō' ma deyom upisna pangā'anna sukay. Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Pi'itu na ka ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Luke 5:28
verses.text: Pabuhat magtūy si Libi. Ni'bbahan e'na kamemonna bo' ameya' ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen5418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2496"/><div sID="gen5419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2496"/> Manjari aniya' jamu pinat'nna' e' si Libi ma luma'na pamaheyana ma si Isa. Aheka isab maga'ā' sukay parinta maka saga a'a kasehe'an bay magbeya' amangan maka sigām.

verses.name: Luke 5:30
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a Parisi maka saga guru sara' ya daumpigan maka sigām bay anoway si Isa. Yuk sigām ni mulidna, “Angay kam palamud magsalu maka saga maga'ā' sukay parinta maka ba'anan a'a dusahan?”  <div eID="gen5419" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2497"/><div sID="gen5420" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2497"/> Anambung si Isa ma saga a'a atilaw inān, yukna, “Bang a'a abasag mbal magpadoktol. Ya magpadoktol bang a'a taga-saki.

verses.name: Luke 5:32
verses.text: Ngga'i ka a'a ahāp ya mohotku pi'itu ni dunya, sagō' ya pi'ituku a'a taga-dusa bo' supaya ang'bba min dusa sigām.”  <div eID="gen5420" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5417" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2498"/><div sID="gen5421" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw Pasal Pagpuwasa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.14-Matt.9.17">Matiyu 9:14-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.2.18-Mark.2.22">Markus 2:18-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2498"/> Manjari aniya' saga a'a ah'lling ni si Isa, yuk-i, “Saga mulid si Yahiya araran magpuwasa maka anambahayang. Ya du saga mulid Parisi, sagō' mulidnu mbal. Amangan sadja sigām maka anginum.”  <div eID="gen5422" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2499"/><div sID="gen5423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2499"/> Anambung si Isa ma saga a'a he', labay min paralilan. Yukna, “Amuwasa bahā' saga luruk bang masi gi' ma sigām pangantin l'lla? Tantu mbal.

verses.name: Luke 5:35
verses.text: Sagō' ma llaw sinōng, bang ta'abut waktu kapamala'an pangantin l'lla, ya na he' waktu pagpuwasa sigām.”  <div eID="gen5423" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2500"/><div sID="gen5424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2500"/> Manjari amaralil gi' si Isa pasal pamandu' tagna' maka pamandu'na, yukna, “Halam aniya' anganggeret badju' baha'u panupakna ni badju' ndang. Bang buwattē', ageret badju' baha'u. Sabab s'mmek baha'u mbal tōp panupak s'mmek ndang.”

verses.name: Luke 5:37
verses.text: Pinaralil isab e' si Isa pamandu'na ni binu-anggul baha'u nihinang bang ni'isi ni deyom pangisihan kuwit kambing. Yukna, “Halam aniya' angisi binu baha'u, bang masi gi' amukal, ni deyom pangisihan ndang. Bang buwattē' hinangna, tantu abustak pangisihan ndang e' binu baha'u. Jari abu'us binu ati kaugun bay pangisihanna.

verses.name: Luke 5:38
verses.text: Sagō' in binu baha'u subay ni'isi ni pangisihan baha'u.”

verses.name: Luke 5:39
verses.text: Amaralil gi' si Isa, yukna, “Bang a'a biyaksa anginum binu-anggul at'ggol bay ma tau'an, mbal iya bilahi anginum binu baha'u. Sabab bang ma iya, ahāp lagi' nanam binu-anggul at'ggol bay ma tau'an.”  <div eID="gen5424" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.5"/> <div eID="gen5421" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2501"/><div sID="gen5425" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pandu' si Isa Pasal Llaw Paghali</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.1-Matt.12.8">Matiyu 12:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.2.23-Mark.2.28">Markus 2:23-28</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2501"/> Ma dakayu' llaw Sabtu',<note>Sabtu': Llaw paghali ni Tuhan bang ma agama Yahudi.</note> ina'an disi Isa lum'ngngan labay min t'ngnga' huma pananoman pai-tirigu. Aniya' batang pai kin'ttu' e' saga mulidna e', pinisi-pisi e' sigām bo' yampa ni'inta'.

verses.name: Luke 6:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' saga Parisi atilaw ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Angay langgalbi sara' agamatam?”  <div eID="gen5426" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2502"/><div sID="gen5427" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2502"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Angay, halam tabassabi bahā' pasal bay tahinang e' si Da'ud ma masa awal e', waktu bay kaotas sigām maka saga a'ana?

verses.name: Luke 6:4
verses.text: Bay pasōd si Da'ud ni deyom luma' pangarapan ni Tuhan bo' ningā' e'na saga tinapay ya panukbal ni Tuhan. Jari kinakan e'na minsan mbal wajib kinakan e' saddī min saga kaimaman. Bay pamuwanna isab ni saga sehe'na pagkakan sigām. Sagō' halam aniya' dusana maghinang buwattē'.”

verses.name: Luke 6:5
verses.text: Yuk si Isa isab, “Aku itu, Anak Manusiya', taga-kapatut magbaya' ma llaw Sabtu'.”  <div eID="gen5427" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5425" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2503"/><div sID="gen5428" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Pakongkong Tanganna Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.9-Matt.12.14">Matiyu 12:9-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.3.1-Mark.3.6">Markus 3:1-6</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2503"/> Ma llaw Sabtu' dakayu', pasōd si Isa ni deyom langgal bo' amandu'. Pasalta', aniya' ma deyom langgal inān a'a pakongkong tanganna kowan.

verses.name: Luke 6:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab maina'an saga guru sara' agama maka saga Parisi amiha pagsababan panuntut sigām ma si Isa. Angkan iya pineyanan e' sigām bang kalu amauli' saki ma llaw paghali.

verses.name: Luke 6:8
verses.text: Sagō' kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai pinikil e' sigām, ati ah'lling iya ni a'a pakongkong tanganna inān. “Pi'itu ka,” yukna. “An'ngge ka ma t'ngnga' itu.” Sakali pabuhat a'a inān an'ngge.

verses.name: Luke 6:9
verses.text: Puwas e' ah'lling si Isa ni saga a'a inān, yukna, “Aniya' tilawku ni ka'am. Bang ma sara'tam, ai ya apatut nihinang ma llaw paghali? Hinang makahāp ka atawa hinang makala'at? Amakallum a'a ka, atawa amapatay?”

verses.name: Luke 6:10
verses.text: Pinatongan e' si Isa saga a'a inān kamemon bo' yampa ah'lling ni a'a pakongkong tanganna. “Pah'nnatun tangannu ilu,” yukna. Na, pinah'nnat e'na, manjari kauli'an na to'ongan.  <div eID="gen5429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2504"/><div sID="gen5430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2504"/> Sagō' akagit to'ongan atay saga Parisi maka saga guru inān, angkan sigām magisun-isun bang inay sigām si Isa.  <div eID="gen5430" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5428" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2505"/><div sID="gen5431" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Amene' saga Mulidna Kasangpū' maka Duwa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.1-Matt.10.4">Matiyu 10:1-4</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.3.13-Mark.3.19">Markus 3:13-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5432" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2505"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an patukad si Isa ni būd angarap ni Tuhan. Maina'an iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan animpus sangom.

verses.name: Luke 6:13
verses.text: Pagk'llat llaw, nilinganan e'na saga mulidna pina'an ni iya. Pinene' e'na min sigām sangpū' maka duwa a'a ati ōnanna sigām a'ana kawakilan.

verses.name: Luke 6:14
verses.text: Ya na itu ōn saga a'a bay kawakilan inān: si Simun ya ōnanna isab Petros, maka si Andariyas danakan si Simun, bo' si Yakub maka si Yahiya, si Pilip maka si Bartolome.

verses.name: Luke 6:15
verses.text: Pasunu' si Matiyu maka si Tomas, bo' si Yakub anak si Alpa, maka si Simun ya niōnan e' sigām Pangangatu,

verses.name: Luke 6:16
verses.text: bo' si Judas anak si Yakub, maka si Judas Iskariyut ya anōngan si Isa ni saga bantana ma waktu damuli minnē'.  <div eID="gen5432" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5431" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2506"/><div sID="gen5433" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kahāpan maka Katiksa'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.4.23-Matt.4.25">Matiyu 4:23-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5434" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2506"/> Manjari puwas ina'an, palūd si Isa maka saga a'a kawakilanna, ati an'ngge iya ma lugal apantay. Aheka saga mulid bay maina'an maka landu' aheka a'a kasehe'an, a'a min lahat Yahudiya, min da'ira Awrusalam, maka min Tira maka Sidun ya ma bihing tahik.

verses.name: Luke 6:18
verses.text: Bay sigām pina'an bo' akale ma pandu' si Isa. Bilahi isab kauli'an saga saki sigām. Sasuku isab sigām sinasat e' saitan bay kauli'an.

verses.name: Luke 6:19
verses.text: Ati ba'anan a'a inān kamemon bay pasulay ama'abut tangan sigām ni iya sabab aniya' barakat paluwas min baranna, ya angkan sigām kauli'an kamemon.  <div eID="gen5434" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5433" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2507"/><div sID="gen5435" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kakōgan maka Kasusahan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.5.1-Matt.5.12">Matiyu 5:1-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2507"/> Manjari pinatongan e' si Isa saga mulidna bo' yampa ah'lling, yukna, <lg sID="gen5437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5438"/>“Aheya kahāpan sasuku kam halam aniya' kaniya'bi ma dunya itu,<l eID="gen5438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5439"/>sabab tantu du aniya' palsuku'anbi ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.<l eID="gen5439" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5440"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:21
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan sasuku kam kasigpitan ma buwattina'an,<l eID="gen5440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5441"/>sabab mag'ssohan du kam ma sinosōng.<l eID="gen5441" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5442"/>Aheya kahāpan sasuku kam magtangis ma buwattina'an,<l eID="gen5442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5443"/>sabab magtittowa du kam ma sinosōng.<l eID="gen5443" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5437"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:22
