verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma ka'am abila kam kinab'nsihan e' a'a, <lg sID="gen5444"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5445"/>bang kam mbal tinaima' e' sigām,<l eID="gen5445" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5446"/>bang kam nihalipulu maka pinamūng-mūngan ala'at<l eID="gen5446" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5447"/>ma sabab pameya'bi ma aku, Anak Manusiya'.<l eID="gen5447" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5444"/>  <div eID="gen5436" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2508"/><div sID="gen5448" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2508"/> “Buwattē' isab bay hinang kamatto'ahan sigām ma saga kanabi-nabihan. Angkan kam subay magkalasigan maka magkōg-koyag bang kam nila'at buwattē' sabab tantu aheya tungbasbi ma deyom sulga'. <lg sID="gen5449"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5450"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:24
verses.text: Sagō' maka'ase'-ase' ka'am saga dayahan ma buwattina'an,<l eID="gen5450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5451"/>sabab tasambutbi kahāpanbi ma dunya itu sadja.<l eID="gen5451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5452"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:25
verses.text: Maka'ase'-ase' isab ka'am ya mag'ssohan ma buwattina'an,<l eID="gen5452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5453"/>sabab aniya' waktu ma sinosōng lingantu du kam.<l eID="gen5453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5454"/>Maka'ase'-ase' isab ka'am magtittowa ilu,<l eID="gen5454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5455"/>sabab aniya' waktu ma sinosōng magkasusahan kam maka magkarukka'an.<l eID="gen5455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5456"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:26
verses.text: Maka'ase'-ase' ka'am bang kam sinanglitan e' a'a kamemon,<l eID="gen5456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5457"/>sabab ya du saga a'a maglaku-laku in sigām nabi.<l eID="gen5457" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5458"/>Bay du isab sigām sinanglitan e' ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi.”<l eID="gen5458" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5449"/>  <div eID="gen5448" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5435" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2509"/><div sID="gen5459" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lasa ma Palbantahan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.5.38-Matt.5.48">Matiyu 5:38-48</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.7.12">Matiyu 7:12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2509"/> Amandu' gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ya na itu pah'llingku ma ka'am sasuku kam akale ma aku, kalasahinbi bantabi. Hinangunbi ahāp ma saga a'a ab'nsihan ka'am.

verses.name: Luke 6:28
verses.text: Amu'-amu'inbi kahāpan min Tuhan sasuku anukna'an ka'am. Sambahayanginbi sasuku angala'at ka'am.

verses.name: Luke 6:29
verses.text: Abila aniya' anampak ka'a ma baihu'nu dambila', patampalun isab dambila' panampakanna. Abila aniya' angagaw badju'nu, pangahilasun sampay kamisitanu.

verses.name: Luke 6:30
verses.text: Sai-sai angamu' ni ka'a, buwanin. Maka bang aniya' ganta' angā' palsuku'annu da'a na pa'nde'in pabalik.

verses.name: Luke 6:31
verses.text: Ai-ai kabaya'anbi nihinang ma ka'am e' a'a kasehe'an, ya na he' subay hinangunbi ma sigām.  <div eID="gen5460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2510"/><div sID="gen5461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2510"/> “Bang hal a'a alasahan ka'am ya kalasahanbi, angay kam subay tinungbasan pahala'? Sabab minsan a'a ala'at, alasa du ma sasuku alasahan sigām.

verses.name: Luke 6:33
verses.text: Damikiyanna, bang hal a'a bay makatabangan ka'am ya tabanganbi, angay kam subay binuwanan pahala'? Sabab minsan a'a ala'at, buwattē' du isab addat sigām.

verses.name: Luke 6:34
verses.text: Bang ya sadja pautanganbi a'a tantu amayad, angay kam subay aholat pinahala'an? Sabab minsan a'a ala'at amaindam du ma sehe' sigām ala'at, bang pa'in tantu binayaran.

verses.name: Luke 6:35
verses.text: Sagō' ya na itu pamandu'ku ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa. “Kalasahinbi bantabi maka tabanginbi sigām. Bang aniya' angutang ni ka'am, pautanginbi minsan halam aniya' bayad niholat. Jari aheya pahala' panungbas ka'am ati manjari na kam anak Tuhan Mahatinggi. Sabab ahāp kajarihan Tuhan minsan ma saga a'a ala'at, minsan ma a'a mbal magsukul.

verses.name: Luke 6:36
verses.text: Subay kam ma'ase', buwat ka'ase' Mma'bi Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5461" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5459" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2511"/><div sID="gen5462" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Panoway ma Pagkahi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.7.1-Matt.7.5">Matiyu 7:1-5</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5463" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2511"/> “Da'a sā'unbi pagkahibi bo' kam mbal sinā' e' Tuhan. Da'a pat'kkahunbi dusa ni a'a kasehe'an bo' kam mbal pinat'kkahan dusa e' Tuhan. Ampununbi pagkahibi bo' kam niampun isab e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 6:38
verses.text: Amuwan kam ma kasehe'anbi ati aniya' pamuwan ka'am e' Tuhan. Ya sapantun t'ppongan aheya bang tinumpahan ni deyom pangisihanbi. Minsan nirasok, minsan pinaponod, mbal paisi sabab hekana. Hatina ai-ai pan'ppongbi ma sehe'bi ya du isab pan'ppong Tuhan ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen5463" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2512"/><div sID="gen5464" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2512"/> Binissala e' si Isa dakayu' kissa pamaralil. Yukna ma saga a'a, “Bang buta angambit sehe'na buta, tantu sigā karuwangan ahūg ni deyom lowang.

verses.name: Luke 6:40
verses.text: Halam aniya' mulid palanga min guruna. Sagō' in mulid kamemon, bang atammat na pangadji'na, magsali' du maka guruna.  <div eID="gen5464" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2513"/><div sID="gen5465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2513"/> “Ka'am magsoway sehe'bi ilu, angay ta'nda'bi bukbuk kayu ma deyom mata sehe'bi ati mbal tananambi batang kayu ya ma matabi?

verses.name: Luke 6:42
verses.text: Mamarahi pahāp ka'am ilu! Yukbi ma sehe'bi, ‘Tabiya', la'ananta bukbuk min matanu ilu,’ bo' pa'in halam tananambi batang kayu ya ma matabi! Maglaku-laku kam in ka'am ilu halam taga-sā'! La'aninbi gi' dahū ya batang kayu ma matabi, manjari asawa pang'nda'bi ati makala'anan kam bukbuk kayu min mata sehe'bi.”  <div eID="gen5465" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5462" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2514"/><div sID="gen5466" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kayu maka Buwa'na</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.7.16-Matt.7.20">Matiyu 7:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.12.33-Matt.12.35">12:33-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2514"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Bang saupama kayu ahāp, mbal amuwan buwa' ala'at. Damikiyanna isab bang kayu ala'at suligna, mbal amuwan buwa' ahāp.

verses.name: Luke 6:44
verses.text: Kinata'uwan asal kayu min buwa'na. Mbal kita angā' buwa' igira min puhung atawa buwa' anggul min sampinit.

verses.name: Luke 6:45
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab ma manusiya', sali' dalil kayu. Bang a'a ahāp addatna makapaluwas iya bissala ahāp ma sabab kahāpan ya bay tau'na ma deyom atayna. Sagō' bang a'a ala'at, luwal kala'atan ya pinaluwas e'na sabab ala'at ya tatau'na ma deyom atayna. Ai-ai ma deyom atay manusiya', ya na he' paluwas min bowa'na.”  <div eID="gen5467" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5466" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2515"/><div sID="gen5468" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwa Ginis A'a Magpat'ngge Luma'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.7.24-Matt.7.27">Matiyu 7:24-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5469" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2515"/> “Angay yukbi in aku Panghū'bi, bo' pa'in mbal hinangbi panoho'anku ma ka'am?

verses.name: Luke 6:47
verses.text: Sasuku pi'itu ni aku bo' akale ma pandu'ku sampay ameya', pahatita kam bang buwattingga kahālanna.

verses.name: Luke 6:48
verses.text: A'a inān sali' hantang a'a maghinang luma'. Niosolan hāgna ma diyata' batu. Aubus pa'in nihinang, angandunuk kasapa'an ati sinampoyakan luma' inān sagō' mbal tajogjog sabab ahogot asal osolanna.

verses.name: Luke 6:49
verses.text: Bang a'a isab akale ma pandu'ku bo' mbal ameya', ya dalilna a'a maghinang luma' ma halam ahogot paosolanna. Bang luma' ina'an-i taluwa' dunuk ah'bba' magtūy, abulangkayat to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen5469" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.6"/> <div eID="gen5468" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2516"/><div sID="gen5470" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangandol Kapitan ya Bangsa Rōm</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.5-Matt.8.13">Matiyu 8:5-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5471" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2516"/> Aubus pa'in kamemon bissala si Isa itu ma saga a'a, pasōd iya ni deyom da'ira Kapirnaum.

verses.name: Luke 7:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' kapitan bangsa Rōm taga-sosoho'an kalasahanna. Asaki na sosoho'an itu, song na magkamamatay.

verses.name: Luke 7:3
verses.text: Makakale pa'in kapitan pasal si Isa, magtūy aniya' pagmatto'ahan bangsa Yahudi pinapina'an e'na ni si Isa angamu' pinauli' sosoho'anna e'.

verses.name: Luke 7:4
verses.text: Manjari pasampay saga pagmatto'ahan inān ni si Isa bo' anganjunjung to'ongan, yuk-i, “Patut subay tabangannu kapitan itu,

verses.name: Luke 7:5
verses.text: sabab amagay to'ongan iya ma bangsatam Yahudi, maka iya ya bay magbaran anganggastuhan langgaltam.”  <div eID="gen5471" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2517"/><div sID="gen5472" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2517"/> Jari ameya' si Isa ma sigām. Asekot pa'in iya ni luma', sinoho' e' kapitan saga bagayna amowahan si Isa lapal, yuk-i, “Tuwan, da'a ka amalu'ug di-nu pasampay pi'itu sabab mbal aku tōp amapi'itu ka'a ni luma'ku.

verses.name: Luke 7:7
verses.text: Bangsahan to'ongan ka angkan pikilku in aku mbal tōp anampang ka'a magbaran. Sagō' angalapal sadja ka minnilu ati kauli'an du sosoho'anku itu.

verses.name: Luke 7:8
verses.text: Minsan aku, biyaksa aku pinagbaya'an e' a'a min diyata'anku maka aniya' isab sundalu pagbaya'anku. Bang soho'ku dangan pehē', pehē' du iya. Bang soho'ku dangan pi'itu, pi'itu du iya. Damikiyanna bang aniya' pahinangku ma saga sosoho'anku, magtūy du nihinang e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen5472" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2518"/><div sID="gen5473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2518"/> Pagkale pa'in pah'lling kapitan inān e' si Isa, ainu-inu iya. Jari palingi' iya ni saga kaheka'an a'a ya paurul min buli'anna. Yukna ma sigām, “Haka'anta kam, minsan ma deyom bangsatam Isra'il, halam aku bay makabāk a'a buwattitu kosog imanna.”

verses.name: Luke 7:10
verses.text: Jari amole' na saga a'a bay sinō' e' kapitan. Pagt'kka sigām ni luma', ta'nda' e' sigām sosoho'an inān kauli'an na.  <div eID="gen5473" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5470" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2519"/><div sID="gen5474" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anak Balu D'nda Pinakallum e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2519"/> Mbal at'ggol minna'an pehē' si Isa ni dakayu' kaluma'an niōnan Nain. Sinehe'an iya e' saga mulidna maka ba'anan saga a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 7:12
verses.text: Makasekot pa'in iya ni lawang ya pasōran kauman inān, aniya' maina'an saga a'a ananggung patay a'a, binowa paluwas ni pagkubulan. L'lla ya amatay he', anak tunggal dakayu' balu d'nda. Jari aheka a'a min kaluma'an inān bay pabunyug angubul.

verses.name: Luke 7:13
verses.text: Na, pag'nda' pa'in Panghū' Isa ma d'nda itu, magtūy iya t'kkahan ase'. Yukna ma d'nda inān, “Da'a ka anangis.”

verses.name: Luke 7:14
verses.text: Puwas e' pasōng si Isa ni tanggungan bo' ntananna, angkan pahogga' saga a'a ananggung e'. Ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Oto', punduk ka!”

verses.name: Luke 7:15
verses.text: Magtūy allum pabalik a'a amatay he'. Punduk iya maka e'na amissala, ati sinōngan iya e' si Isa ni ina'na.  <div eID="gen5475" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2520"/><div sID="gen5476" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2520"/> Sinōd tāw saga a'a maina'an kamemon maka sinanglitan Tuhan e' sigām, yuk-i, “Aniya' na nabi abarakat palahil pi'itu. Makapi'itu na Tuhan anabangan kitam saga a'a suku'na.”

verses.name: Luke 7:17
verses.text: Manjari ya habal pasal bay hinang si Isa itu pasaplag na pa'in ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya, sampay ma sakalibutna.  <div eID="gen5476" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5474" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2521"/><div sID="gen5477" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw e' si Yahiya Magpapandi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt11.2-Matt.11.19">Matiyu 11:2-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5478" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2521"/> Na, kahaka'an si Yahiya e' saga mulidna pasal pakaradja'an itu. Jari nilinganan e'na duwangan mulidna,

verses.name: Luke 7:19
verses.text: sinoho' pehē' ni Panghū' Isa. Sinō' sigā atilaw iya bang iya bahā' bay pinagbissala pi'itu ni dunya, atawa bang aniya' gi' saddī nilagaran.

verses.name: Luke 7:20
verses.text: Jari pagt'kka duwangan itu ni si Isa, yuk sigā, “Sinō' kami pi'itu e' si Yahiya Magpapandi sabab aniya' tilawna ni ka'a. Ka'a bahā' ya pinagbissala pi'itu ni dunya? Atawa aniya' gi' saddī min ka'a subay lagaran kami?”  <div eID="gen5478" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2522"/><div sID="gen5479" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2522"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an-i aheka a'a kauli'an e' si Isa ya lamma maka saki sigām indaginis, maka aheka bay kapaluwasan saitan. Aheka isab saga a'a buta bay tapa'nda'na pabīng.

verses.name: Luke 7:22
verses.text: Manjari sinambungan e' si Isa duwangan mulid si Yahiya he'. Yukna, “Pabīng kam pehē'. Haka'inbi si Yahiya pasal ai-ai ta'nda'bi maka takalebi maitu. Saga a'a bay buta maka'nda' na. A'a bay pengka' makal'ngngan na to'ongan. A'a bay ni'ipul tapalanu' na. A'a bay bisu makakale na, maka a'a bay amatay tapakallum na pabīng. Sampay a'a kulang-kabus kanasihatan na lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Luke 7:23
verses.text: Aheya du kahāpan sasuku mbal magduwa-ruwa pikilanna ma aku.”  <div eID="gen5479" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2523"/><div sID="gen5480" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2523"/> Makala'an pa'in minnē' saga sosoho'an si Yahiya he', amissala si Isa ni kaheka'an a'a inān pasal si Yahiya. Yukna, “Ai bahā' bay pihabi, ya angkan kam bay pehē' ni lahat paslangan? Kabaya'anbi bahā' ang'nda' dakayu' a'a sapantun dansolag parang-parang, tabowa pap'llay e' baliyu?

verses.name: Luke 7:25
verses.text: Bang ngga'i ka he'-i, ai bahā' bay nda'bi pehē'? A'a bahā' magsin'mmek ahalga'? Marai' ngga'i ka, sabab bang a'a magsin'mmek buwattē' maka magpalasahan to'ongan, ina'an sigām ma deyom astana'.

verses.name: Luke 7:26
verses.text: Haka'in aku to'ongan bang ai bay nda'bi pehē'? Dakayu' nabi bahā'? Aho', b'nnal nabi, sagō' labi gi' min saga nabi kamemon.

verses.name: Luke 7:27
verses.text: Sabab si Yahiya itu bay pinagbissala ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5481"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5482"/>‘Itiya' sosoho'anku, yuk Tuhan.<l eID="gen5482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5483"/>Soho'ku iya parahū min ka'a,<l eID="gen5483" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5484"/>bo' supaya sakapanna lān palabayannu.’<l eID="gen5484" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5481"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:28
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “si Yahiya Magpapandi itu halam aniya' abangsa saddī min iya ma deyom binangsa manusiya'. Sagō' sai-sai ma deyoman pagparinta Tuhan, minsan a'a areyo' kapaga'ana, alanga lagi' min si Yahiya.”  <div eID="gen5480" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2524"/><div sID="gen5485" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2524"/> Saga a'a kamemon bay akale to'ongan ma si Isa, ya lagi'na saga maga'ā' sukay parinta. Angaho' sigām in kahandak Tuhan asal abontol, ya angkan sigām bay pinandi taubat e' si Yahiya.

verses.name: Luke 7:30
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a Parisi maka saga guru apanday ma sara' agama, mbal bilahi pinandi taubat e' si Yahiya sabab sinulak e' sigām ya pamat'nna' Tuhan ma sigām.  <div eID="gen5485" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2525"/><div sID="gen5486" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2525"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ai pamaralilanku saga a'a ahil jaman itu? Ai pamasali'an sigām?

verses.name: Luke 7:32
verses.text: Sali' sigām hantang onde'-onde' magtingkō'an ma halaman tabu' magpangongka'. Angalingan saga onde' min dambila' ni kasehe'an sigām, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen5487"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5488"/>‘Oy! Ka'am ilu! Bay kami angalisagan ka'am<l eID="gen5488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5489"/>sagō' halam kam magpangigal!<l eID="gen5489" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5490"/>Bay kami magsindilan sagō' halam kam ameya' magtangis.’<l eID="gen5490" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5487"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:33
verses.text: Ka'am ilu sali' sapantun onde' mbal tasulut. Bay pi'itu si Yahiya Magpapandi, a'a magpupuwasa maka mbal anginum inuman makalango. Jari pah'llinganbi iya in iya kono' sinōd saitan.

verses.name: Luke 7:34
verses.text: Puwas e' aku, Anak Manusiya', bay pi'itu amangan maka anginum. Magtūy aku pah'llinganbi. Yukbi, ‘He! Nda'unbi a'a itu, dahaga'! Panginginum! Magbagay iya maka saga a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta maka a'a baldusa kasehe'an.’

verses.name: Luke 7:35
verses.text: Sagō',” yuk si Isa, “kata'uwanbi na min sasuku ameya' ma Tuhan in pangita'una taluwa' sadja.”  <div eID="gen5486" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5477" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2526"/><div sID="gen5491" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Nihulmat e' D'nda Dusahan</title> <div sID="gen5492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2526"/> Aniya' dakayu' a'a Parisi bay amowa si Isa amangan ma luma'na. Jari pehē' si Isa ati aningkō' ma pagkakanan.

verses.name: Luke 7:37
verses.text: Na, aniya' dakayu' d'nda ma lahat inān ala'at asal hinangna. Makata'u pa'in iya in si Isa ina'an amangan ma luma' Parisi, pina'an iya amowa bingki'-bingki' bay nihinang min batu pote', isihan ns'llan pahamut.

verses.name: Luke 7:38
verses.text: Pina'an iya an'ngge min bukutan si Isa, ma tongod tape'na. Anangis na pa'in iya sampay abase' na tape' si Isa e' bohe' matana. Sinapuhan e'na maka bu'unna, siniyum isab e'na tape' si Isa bo' yampa binu'usan e'na maka ns'llan pahamut e'.

verses.name: Luke 7:39
verses.text: Ta'nda' pa'in itu e' Parisi ya bay amowa si Isa amangan, yukna ma deyom atayna, “Bang si Isa itu nabi to'ongan bay du kata'uwanna bang sai d'nda ya ang'ntanan tape'na itu. Bay kata'uwanna in d'nda itu asal dusahan.”  <div eID="gen5492" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2527"/><div sID="gen5493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2527"/> Sinambungan iya e' si Isa. “Simun,” yukna, “aniya' pah'llingku ni ka'a.” <div eID="gen5493" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5494" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', Tuwan Guru, pah'llingun kono',” yuk si Simun.  <div eID="gen5494" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2528"/><div sID="gen5495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2528"/> Amissala si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' duwangan a'a taga-utang sali'-sali' ma a'a pangutangan. Dangan inān taga-utang lima hatus pilak, dangan taga-utang limampū'.

verses.name: Luke 7:42
verses.text: Sali'-sali' sigām mbal makabayad angkan pinapasan utang sigām e' a'a bay pangutangan he'. Na,” yuk si Isa ma si Simun, “bang ma ka'a, ingga ma a'a duwangan e' ya aheya lasana ma a'a bay pangutangan sigām?”  <div eID="gen5495" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2529"/><div sID="gen5496" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2529"/> Anambung si Simun, yukna, “Bang ma aku, ya a'a bay pinapasan utang aheya.” <div eID="gen5496" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5497" type="paragraph"/> “Tauwa' sambungnu ilu,” yuk si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 7:44
verses.text: Jari niharap d'nda e' si Isa ati ah'lling iya ni si Simun, yukna, “Ta'nda'nu d'nda itu? Makasōd pa'in aku ni luma'nu insini', halam aku bay sakapannu bohe' pangose' tape'ku. Sagō' d'nda itu bay angose'an tape'ku maka bohe' matana, ati sapuhanna maka bu'unna.

verses.name: Luke 7:45
verses.text: Halam aku bay siyumnu, sagō' d'nda itu, sangay min kapi'ituku, halam bay pahali aniyum tape'ku.

verses.name: Luke 7:46
verses.text: Halam bay ns'llanannu kōkku pagaddatnu ma aku, sagō' d'nda itu bay amu'usan ns'llan ahalga' ma tape'ku.

verses.name: Luke 7:47
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu pangahakaku ma ka'a, aheya lasa d'nda itu ma aku sabab ta'ampun dusana aheka. Bang a'a akulang dusana niampun, kulang du isab lasana.”  <div eID="gen5497" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2530"/><div sID="gen5498" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2530"/> Jari ah'lling si Isa ni d'nda, yukna, “Niampun na paldusahannu.”  <div eID="gen5498" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2531"/><div sID="gen5499" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2531"/> Minnē' saga sehe' si Isa magsalu inān anagna' magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' a'a itu angampun saga dusa?”  <div eID="gen5499" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2532"/><div sID="gen5500" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2532"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Isa ni d'nda inān, yukna, “Apuwas du ka min mulka' Tuhan ma sabab pangandolnu ma aku. Palanjal na ka ma halam aniya' kasusahannu.”  <div eID="gen5500" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.7"/> <div eID="gen5491" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2533"/><div sID="gen5501" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga D'nda ya Parongan ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2533"/> Mbal at'ggol minnē', nilatag e' si Isa saga da'ira maka kaluma'an anganasihat lapal ahāp pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Ameya' ma iya mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa,

verses.name: Luke 8:2
verses.text: maka aniya' isab saga d'nda parongan. Kasehe'an saga d'nda itu bay kapaluwasan saitan e' si Isa, kasehe'an bay kauli'an saki sigām. Ina'an si Mariyam, d'nda min Magdala ya bay kapaluwasan saitan pitu' hekana.

verses.name: Luke 8:3
verses.text: Ina'an isab si Joanna h'nda si Kusa, ya alanga kapatutna ma deyom astana' sultan Herod, maka ina'an si Susanna, maka aheka gi' saga d'nda saddī. Saga d'nda he' bay angatasan disi Isa.  <div eID="gen5502" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5501" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2534"/><div sID="gen5503" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Panabod Bigi-tinanom</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.1-Matt.13.9">Matiyu 13:1-9</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.4.1-Mark.4.9">Markus 4:1-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2534"/> Na, aheka saga a'a min ba'anan kauman patimuk na pa'in pehē' ni si Isa. Pasalta, binissalahan sigām kissa paralilan. Yukna,

verses.name: Luke 8:5
verses.text: “Aniya' inān dakayu' a'a pehē' ni humana anaboran bigi-tinanom. Pagsabodna itu aniya' bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni bihing lān, sagō' gini'ik e' a'a maglaulabay maka tinittuk e' saga manuk-manuk sampay halam na aniya' takapin.

verses.name: Luke 8:6
verses.text: Aniya' bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni tana' kabatuhan. Makatomo' pa'in, al'kkas alanos sabab tana' he' halam aniya' bohe'na.

verses.name: Luke 8:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni t'ngnga' sagmot itingan ati katalungan<note>Katalungan: atawa ‘kasembolan’.</note> tinanom sabab magbeya' patomo' maka sagmot e'.

verses.name: Luke 8:8
verses.text: Na, ya bigi-tinanom kasehe' apakpak ni tana' ahāp, ati ahāp tomo'na. Pasōng amuwan buwa' lumandu'an hekana. <div eID="gen5504" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5505" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “sasuku kam makakale, ikutunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen5505" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2535"/><div sID="gen5506" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2535"/> Tinilaw si Isa e' saga mulidna bang ai hati kissa ya bay pamaralilna inān.

verses.name: Luke 8:10
verses.text: Anambung iya, yukna, “Ka'am ilu kabuwanan kata'u bo' supaya tahatibi pasal kapagparinta Tuhan ma saga a'ana, ya halam bay pinata'u e'na ni manusiya' kasehe'. Sagō' saga a'a kasehe'an inān subay kinissahan saga kissa pamaralilan, <lg sID="gen5507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5508"/>ati ninda' sadja e' sigām sagō' mbal pasobsob ni deyom pikilan sigām.<l eID="gen5508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5509"/>Kinale e' sigām sagō' mbal tahati.<l eID="gen5509" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5507"/>  <div eID="gen5506" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2536"/><div sID="gen5510" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2536"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ya na itu hati kissa bay pamaralilku he'. Ya bigi-tinanom inān, ya na palman Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 8:12
verses.text: Ya bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ni lān inān, ya dalilna saga a'a makakale palman Tuhan. Manjari pina'an nakura' saitan angagaw palman min deyom pikilan sigām bo' supaya sigām mbal am'nnal ati mbal alappas.

verses.name: Luke 8:13
verses.text: Ya bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ni tana' kabatuhan inān, ya dalilna saga a'a makakale ma palman Tuhan. Magtūy sigām kinōgan anaima' lapal palman e' sagō' mbal anganggamut palalom ma deyom atay sigām. Dai'-dai' du pagkahagad sigām. Ta'abut pa'in sigām sinasat e' nakura' saitan, magtūy sigām ang'bba min bay pagkahagad sigām.

verses.name: Luke 8:14
verses.text: Ya bigi-tinanom bay apakpak ni sagmot itingan inān, ya dalilna saga a'a makakale ma palman Tuhan. Sagō' alimbit pikilan sigām e' kahālan deyom dunya itu. Ya na pa'in ahalga' ma sigām saga pangalta' maka napsu sigām. Sali' sigām dalil tinanom katalungan, mbal magkato'a buwa'na.

verses.name: Luke 8:15
verses.text: Manjari ya bay sinaboran ni tana' ahāp inān, ya dalilna saga a'a akale ma palman Tuhan magatay pote'. Tinau' e' sigām ma deyom itikad maka atuyu' sigām ameya'an iya. Jari palman inān sali' dalil tinanom amuwan buwa' ma deyom atay, hatina ahāp kamaujuranna.”  <div eID="gen5510" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5503" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2537"/><div sID="gen5511" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palita'an Tinambunan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.4.21-Mark.4.25">Markus 4:21-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2537"/> Amandu' gi' si Isa, yukna, “Halam aniya' a'a amakeyat palita'an bo' yampa sa'obanna maka undam atawa pat'nna'na ma deyo' kantil. Tantu subay pinat'nna' e'na ma diyata' papaganna bo' ta'nda' sawana e' sasuku pasōd ni deyom luma'.

verses.name: Luke 8:17
verses.text: Sabab ai-ai tinapukan ma buwattina'an pinaluwas du ma sinosōng, maka ai-ai nilimbungan ma buwattina'an tahati du ma waktu sinōng.

verses.name: Luke 8:18
verses.text: Angkan subay kalehunbi pahāp sabab sai-sai aniya' kata'una, kin'nnopan gi' ma iya. Saguwā' sai-sai mbal makahati, kinulangan lagi' bay panghatina.”  <div eID="gen5512" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5511" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2538"/><div sID="gen5513" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ina' si Isa maka Danakanna L'lla</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.46-Matt.12.50">Matiyu 12:46-50</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.3.31-Mark.3.35">Markus 3:31-35</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2538"/> Manjari itu at'kka pina'an ina' si Isa maka saga danakanna l'lla sagō' mbal sigām makasekot ni iya ma sabab kaheka a'a.

verses.name: Luke 8:20
verses.text: Aniya' anambukuhan si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan, ina'an ina'nu maka saga danakannu an'ngge ma luwasan, bilahi mag'nda' maka ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5514" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2539"/><div sID="gen5515" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2539"/> Ah'lling si Isa ni saga a'a maina'an, yukna, “Sai-sai akale ma palman Tuhan maka ameya', sigām ya ina'ku maka dauranakanku.”  <div eID="gen5515" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5513" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2540"/><div sID="gen5516" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagagi si Isa ma Baliyu maka Goyak</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.23-Matt.8.27">Matiyu 8:23-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.4.35-Mark.4.41">Markus 4:35-41</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5517" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2540"/> Pagabut llaw dakayu', paruwa' si Isa maka saga mulidna ni bayanan. Yukna ni sigām, “Sūng kitam pauntas ni dambila' danaw e'.”

verses.name: Luke 8:23
verses.text: Aleha pa'in sigām, tatuli si Isa. Sakali itu aniya' hunus parugpak ni danaw inān. Sōng-sōng na sigām abuhaw sabab sinampoyakan e' goyak, maka aheya kapiligduhan sigām.  <div eID="gen5517" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2541"/><div sID="gen5518" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2541"/> Pasekot ni si Isa saga mulidna amati' iya. “O Tuwan! Tuwan!” yuk sigām, “Abuhaw na kitam!” <div eID="gen5518" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5519" type="paragraph"/> Jari pabungkal si Isa bo' yampa soho'na baliyu maka goyak inān pahondong. Saru'un-du'un du pahali, ati t'ddo' na to'ongan.

verses.name: Luke 8:25
verses.text: Puwas e' ah'lling si Isa ni saga mulidna, yukna, “Angay? Mbal kam bahā' angandol ma aku?” <div eID="gen5519" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5520" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' tināw sigām maka ainu-inu angkan sigām magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' a'a itu? Tasoho'na baliyu maka goyak ati bineya' iya.”  <div eID="gen5520" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5516" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2542"/><div sID="gen5521" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kauli'an A'a Sinōd Saitan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.28-Matt.8.34">Matiyu 8:28-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.5.1-Mark.5.20">Markus 5:1-20</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5522" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2542"/> Manjari palanjal sigām sampay makatandan ni lahat bangsa Gerasa, ya ma anggopan lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Luke 8:27
verses.text: Pagdeyo' pa'in si Isa, sinampang iya e' a'a min da'ira inān, a'a sinōd saitan. At'ggol na iya halam magsin'mmek atawa pat'nna' ma deyom luma' sagō' lowang kubul ya pat'nna'anna na pa'in.

verses.name: Luke 8:28
verses.text: Na, pag'nda' a'a itu ma si Isa, angolang iya pakosog maka pasujud ma dahuanna. Akosog pangalinganna, yukna, “O Isa, Anak Tuhan Mahatinggi! Ai kabaya'annu min aku? Angamu' aku junjung ni ka'a, da'a aku binasahun.”

verses.name: Luke 8:29
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' junjungna sabab in saitan ma deyom baranna inān bay sinō' e' si Isa paluwas. Araran asal a'a inān pagkasangonan saitan. Minsan nihengkotan tape'-tanganna maka kilikili, nijagahan isab e' saga a'a, ab'kkat sadja e'na ati binowa iya e' saitan maglunsul ni lahat halam maga'a.  <div eID="gen5522" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2543"/><div sID="gen5523" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2543"/> Jari tinilaw iya e' si Isa, yukna, “Sai ōnnu?” <div eID="gen5523" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5524" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung saitan inān, “Ōnku Laksa'an.” Sabab aheka saitan bay pasōd ni deyom baran a'a inān.

verses.name: Luke 8:31
verses.text: Anganjunjung saga saitan e' ni si Isa bang pa'in sigām mbal papehē'na ni deyom nalka'.  <div eID="gen5524" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2544"/><div sID="gen5525" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2544"/> Ma jadjahan ina'an aniya' ba'anan bawi, aheka to'ongan, magkakan ma lorosan būd. Na, angamu'-ngamu' saga saitan inān ma si Isa bang makajari pinasōd ni deyom saga bawi he' ati pinaba'id sigām e'na.

verses.name: Luke 8:33
verses.text: Jari paluwas saitan min baran a'a inān bo' pasōd ni bawi. Magtūy maglumpat paragan saga bawi he' min pampang tudju ni deyom danaw bo' yampa alembo kamemon.  <div eID="gen5525" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2545"/><div sID="gen5526" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2545"/> Pag'nda' itu e' saga a'a bay angipat bawi he', paragan sigām pehē' ni da'ira maka ni kaluma'an deya, angahaka'an saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 8:35
verses.text: Jari pina'an sigām ang'nda' bang ai bay paniya' inān. Pagt'kka sigām ni tongod si Isa, ta'nda' a'a bay sinōd saitan aningkō' maina'an ma bihing tape' si Isa. Magsin'mmek na iya maka ahāp na akkal-pikilanna. Manjari tināw sigām.

verses.name: Luke 8:36
verses.text: Sinuli-sulihan isab sigām e' saga a'a bay maka'nda' bang buwattingga iya bay kauli'an.

verses.name: Luke 8:37
verses.text: Manjari saga a'a min kalahat-lahatan Gerasa inān kamemon angamu' ma si Isa bang pa'in iya ala'an minna'an sabab mbal kasandalan tāw sigām. Angkan paruwa' si Isa ni bayanan bo' pauntas parambila'.  <div eID="gen5526" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2546"/><div sID="gen5527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2546"/> A'a bay kapaluwasan saitan e' angamu' ameya' ma si Isa sagō' pinapole' iya. Yuk si Isa ma iya,

verses.name: Luke 8:39
verses.text: “Amole' na ka ni luma'nu. Haka'in saga a'a maina'an pasal hinang aheya bay tahinang e' Tuhan ma ka'a.” Manjari ala'an minnē' bo' angalatag deyom da'ira he' angahaka pasal bay tahinang ma iya e' si Isa.  <div eID="gen5527" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5521" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2547"/><div sID="gen5528" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Amatay maka D'nda Asaki</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.9.18-Matt.9.26">Matiyu 9:18-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.5.21-Mark.5.43">Markus 5:21-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5529" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2547"/> Na, makatandan pa'in si Isa ni dambila' danaw, kinōgan saga a'a maina'an anampang iya sabab nilagaran iya.

verses.name: Luke 8:41
verses.text: Sakali itu, aniya' pina'an ni iya dakayu' nakura' langgal ma lahat inān, ōnna si Jayrus. Pasujud iya ni si Isa angamu' iya pehē' ni luma'na,

verses.name: Luke 8:42
verses.text: sabab aniya' anakna d'nda dakayu'-kayu', sangpū' maka duwantahun umulna, song magkamamatay. Jari ameya' si Isa ma iya. <div eID="gen5529" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5530" type="paragraph"/> Na, ma labayan pa'in si Isa tudju ni luma' nakura' inān, kasigpitan iya e' ba'anan a'a.

verses.name: Luke 8:43
verses.text: Aniya' ma kaheka'an a'a inān dakayu' d'nda sakihan. Sangpū' na maka duwantahun halam atitis paglaha'na. Aubus na sīnna kamemon panamba doktol sagō' halam aniya' makapauli'.

verses.name: Luke 8:44
verses.text: Pasekot iya min buli'an bo' ama'abut tanganna ni tōng s'mmek si Isa. Saru'un-du'un magtūy pahondong paglaha'na.

verses.name: Luke 8:45
verses.text: Ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Sai bay ang'ntanan aku?” <div eID="gen5530" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5531" type="paragraph"/> Amalilu saga a'a inān kamemon. Yuk si Petros, “Tuwan, kaheka a'a ma sakalibutnu maggipit ni ka'a, atilaw gi' ka?”  <div eID="gen5531" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2548"/><div sID="gen5532" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2548"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' bay ang'ntanan aku sabab tananamku aniya' barakat paluwas min baranku.”

verses.name: Luke 8:47
verses.text: Sakali itu, pagka kinata'uwan e' d'nda in hinangna kasakupan na, pehē' iya pasujud ni atag tape' si Isa maka e'na amidpid. Minsan aheka a'a makakale, nihaka'an e'na si Isa bang angay iya bay ama'abut tanganna ni iya, maka pasal sakina kauli'an magtūy.

verses.name: Luke 8:48
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Arung, kauli'an na ka ma sabab pangandolnu ma aku. Palanjal ka ma halam aniya' kasusahan.”  <div eID="gen5532" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2549"/><div sID="gen5533" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2549"/> Manjari itu, hinabu si Isa amissala ni d'nda, aniya' a'a at'kka pina'an min luma' si Jayrus. Yukna ni si Jayrus, “Amatay na anaknu. Da'a pamale'un guru ilu!”  <div eID="gen5533" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2550"/><div sID="gen5534" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2550"/> Sagō' takale llingna itu e' si Isa ati yukna ni si Jayrus, “Da'a ka tināw. Magparassaya sadja ka. Allum du anaknu.”  <div eID="gen5534" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2551"/><div sID="gen5535" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2551"/> Pagt'kka si Isa ni luma' nakura' inān, halam aniya' bay tugutanna magbeya' maka iya pasōd, luwal si Petros, si Yahiya, si Yakub, maka matto'a onde'.

verses.name: Luke 8:52
verses.text: Magtangisan maka magolang asal saga a'a maina'an kamemon. Sagō' nilāng sigām e' si Isa, yukna, “Da'a kam magtangis. Halam amatay onde' itu. Hal iya atuli!”

verses.name: Luke 8:53
verses.text: Pinagtittowahan iya e' sigām sabab kasakupan e' sigām amatay na onde'.

verses.name: Luke 8:54
verses.text: Jari binalutan e' si Isa tangan onde' bo' yampa pinatanog suwalana, yukna, “Arung, punduk ka.”

verses.name: Luke 8:55
verses.text: Sakali pabalik nyawana ati pabuhat magtūy. Sinoho' iya e' si Isa subay pinakan.

verses.name: Luke 8:56
verses.text: Ainu-inu to'ongan matto'ana sagō' sinō' sigām e' si Isa da'a angahaka ni sai ni sai pasal ina'an-i.  <div eID="gen5535" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.8"/> <div eID="gen5528" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2552"/><div sID="gen5536" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasangpū' maka Duwa Mulid Sinō' Magnasihat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.5-Matt.10.15">Matiyu 10:5-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.6.7-Mark.6.13">Markus 6:7-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5537" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2552"/> Na, tapatimuk pa'in e' si Isa mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa buwananna sigām kawasa pamala'an saitan min deyom baran a'a sampay amauli' saki indaginis.

verses.name: Luke 9:2
verses.text: Puwas e' sinō' sigām pal'ngngan magnasihat pasal pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya'. Sinō' sigām amauli' isab sasuku taluwa' saki.

verses.name: Luke 9:3
verses.text: Yukna ni sigām, “Da'a kam amowa ai-ai ma pal'ngngananbi. Da'a kam amowa tungkud atawa puyu' pamowahan ai-aibi atawa lutu' atawa sīn. Da'a isab kam amowa badju' pasalinanbi.

verses.name: Luke 9:4
verses.text: Maingga-maingga lahat kat'kkahanbi, bang kam sinagina e' a'a sinō' pariyata' ni luma'na, subay kam pahanti' maina'an sat'ggolbi ma kaluma'an ina'an-i.

verses.name: Luke 9:5
verses.text: Bang ganta' aniya' kaluma'an papehē'anbi, bo' a'ana inān mbal magaddatan ka'am, ala'an kam minna'an. Paspasinbi dahū bagunbunna min tape'bi tanda' saksi' in ka'am apuwas min sigām.”  <div eID="gen5537" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2553"/><div sID="gen5538" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2553"/> Manjari magl'ngnganan na saga mulid si Isa angalatag kalahat-lahatan. Pi'ingga-pi'ingga pat'kkahan sigām, pinagnasihat e' sigām lapal ahāp maka pinauli' e' sigām saga a'a asaki.  <div eID="gen5538" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5536" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2554"/><div sID="gen5539" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Asasaw Pikilan si Herod</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.1-Matt.14.12">Matiyu 14:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.6.14-Mark.6.29">Markus 6:14-29</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5540" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2554"/> Manjari itu takale e' si Herod, ya ang'ntan pagparinta ma lahat Jalil, pasal pakaradja'an itu kamemon. Asasaw pikilanna sabab magsaddī-saddī pangupama saga a'a. Bang ma a'a kasehe' si Yahiya Magpapandi ko' inān, allum na pabīng min kamatayna.

verses.name: Luke 9:8
verses.text: Bang ma kasehe' nabi Elija ko' inān panyata' pi'itu ni dunya. Bang ma kasehe' isab, dakayu' nabi ko' inān bay ma masa awal, bo' allum na pabalik.

verses.name: Luke 9:9
verses.text: Yuk si Herod, “Si Yahiya bay sō'ku pinonggolan kōkna. Daka sai a'a ya takaleku pinagbissala itu.” Sakali pasulay na pa'in si Herod amowa mag'nda' maka si Isa.  <div eID="gen5540" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5539" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2555"/><div sID="gen5541" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Limangibu Heka A'a Pinakan e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.6.1-John.6.14">Yahiya 6:1-14</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5542" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2555"/> Na, saga a'a bay kawakilan e' si Isa pabīng na ni iya min kal'ngnganan sigām. Nihaka'an iya pasal kamemon bay tahinang sigām. Manjari binowa sigām e' si Isa pina'an ni da'ira Betsaida, sigām-sigām sadja.

verses.name: Luke 9:11
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in ba'anan a'a inān bang pi'ingga si Isa, magtūy sigām paturul ma iya. Sinagina sigām e' si Isa ati pandu'anna sigām pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Pinauli' isab sasuku taga-saki.  <div eID="gen5542" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2556"/><div sID="gen5543" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2556"/> Sōng pa'in pas'ddop llaw, pehē' ni iya mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa. Yuk sigām, “Sō'un lagi' ba'anan a'a itu pehē' ni saga kaluma'an ma katilibutta itu, maka ni luma' saga a'a maghuhuma, bo' supaya sigām amiha balanja' maka pahanti'an. Sabab halam aniya' luma' ma lahat itu.”  <div eID="gen5543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2557"/><div sID="gen5544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2557"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Ka'am na amakan sigām.” <div eID="gen5544" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5545" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sigām, “Lima du tinapay ma kami maka duwa du daing. Luwal bang kami pehē' am'lli tinapay pamakan ba'anan a'a itu!”

verses.name: Luke 9:14
verses.text: (Aniya' saga limangibu bang hal l'lla ni'itung) <div eID="gen5545" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5546" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Sō'unbi sigām magtingkō'an limampū'-limampū' ma datumpuk.”

verses.name: Luke 9:15
verses.text: Aubus pa'in sigām pinatingkō' kamemon,

verses.name: Luke 9:16
verses.text: niā' e' si Isa lima tinapay maka duwa daing e'. Pahangad iya ni langit bo' yampa magsukul ni Tuhan. Puwas e' pinagpōng-pōng e'na kinakan inān bo' sōnganna ni saga mulidna pinagtopod-topod ma saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Luke 9:17
verses.text: Magkakan sigām kamemon sampay mag'ssohan na. Pagubus sigām amangan, tinipun e' saga mulid si Isa kapinna, aniya' sangpū' maka duwa ambung aheya ap'nno'.  <div eID="gen5546" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5541" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2558"/><div sID="gen5547" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Petros Magpasab'nnal Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.13-Matt.16.19">Matiyu 16:13-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.8.27-Mark.8.29">Markus 8:27-29</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2558"/> Aniya' dakayu' llaw, sabu pa'in si Isa dangan-danganna angarap ni Tuhan, pehē' ni iya saga mulidna. Tinilaw sigām e'na, yukna, “Sai kono' aku, bang ma pangupama saga a'a?”  <div eID="gen5548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2559"/><div sID="gen5549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2559"/> Yuk sambung saga mulid e', “Bang ma a'a kasehe'an ka'a kono' si Yahiya Magpapandi. Bang ma a'a kasehe' in ka'a nabi Elija, maka bang ma a'a kasehe' isab dakayu' nabi ka bay ma masa awal, allum na pabīng.”  <div eID="gen5549" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2560"/><div sID="gen5550" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2560"/> “Na, bang ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa. “Ai yukbi? Sai sa aku itu?” <div eID="gen5550" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5551" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Petros, yukna, “Ka'a ya Al-Masi ya tapene' e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5551" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5547" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2561"/><div sID="gen5552" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala si Isa Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.20-Matt.16.28">Matiyu 16:20-16:28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.8.30-Mark.9.1">Markus 8:30-9:1</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2561"/> Puwas e' binanda'an e' si Isa saga mulidna sinō' da'a angahaka ni sai-sai bang sai iya.

verses.name: Luke 9:22
verses.text: Yukna isab ni sigām, “Aku itu, Anak Manusiya', pinat'kkahan kabinasahan aheka. Pinagin'mbal du isab aku e' saga pagmatto'ahan maka e' saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Pinapatay du aku sagō' ta'abut pa'in kat'llu llawna, allum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen5553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2562"/><div sID="gen5554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2562"/> Jari ah'lling si Isa ni sigām kamemon, yukna, “Bang aniya' a'a bilahi ameya' ma aku, subay ngga'i ka kabaya'an baranna ya dūlanna. Kahaba' llaw subay tanggungna hāgna pamapatayan iya. Minnē' iya makajari ameya' ma aku.

verses.name: Luke 9:24
verses.text: Sai-sai allogan kallum-baranna amutawan du kallum-nyawana min Tuhan. Sagō' sai-sai mbal allog ma kallum-baranna, bo' lilla' isab amatay ma sababku, makabāk du iya kallum kakkal.

verses.name: Luke 9:25
verses.text: Sababna,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' a'a ganta' kaniya'an alta' deyom dunya kamemon, aheya lugi'na bang halam aniya' kallumna kakkal, maka bang iya amutawan min Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 9:26
verses.text: Sai-sai aiya' angahaka patampal in iya suku'ku maka pandu'ku ya pameya'anna, jari aku itu, Anak Manusiya', aiya' isab angakuhan a'a inān ma waktu kapi'ituku pabalik. Pabalik du aku aliput e' sahayaku, maka sahaya Mma'ku Tuhan, sampay sahaya ba'anan mala'ikatna asussi.

verses.name: Luke 9:27
verses.text: B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “aniya' ma ka'am mbal amatay sat'ggol halam ta'nda'na pagparinta Tuhan pinat'nna'.”  <div eID="gen5554" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5552" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2563"/><div sID="gen5555" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapinda Pangluwahan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.1-Matt.17.8">Matiyu 17:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.2-Mark.9.8">Markus 9:2-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2563"/> Na, palabay pa'in saga dapitu' min bay pamissala si Isa inān, binowa e'na si Petros maka si Yahiya maka si Yakub patukad ni diyata' būd bo' angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan mahē'.

verses.name: Luke 9:29
verses.text: Hinabuna angamu'-ngamu', apinda pangluwahanna maka apote' sidda s'mmekna, landu' makasilaw.

verses.name: Luke 9:30
verses.text: Sakali aniya' duwangan l'lla, ya na nabi Musa maka nabi Elija,

verses.name: Luke 9:31
verses.text: magpanyata' pina'an aliput e' sahaya, ati magsuli-suli sigām maka si Isa pasal kamatay ya pamakadal Tuhan ma iya, ya song kalabayanna ma da'ira Awrusalam.

verses.name: Luke 9:32
verses.text: Na, si Petros maka saga sehe'na bay atuli sagō' pagbati' sigām, ta'nda' e' sigām sahaya si Isa maka a'a duwangan ya an'ngge ma bihingna.

verses.name: Luke 9:33
verses.text: Jari itu, song pa'in ala'an duwangan inān min si Isa, ah'lling si Petros ma iya, yuk-i, “Tuwan guru, ahāp kami makamaitu. Angahinang kami t'llu panggung-panggung pasindunganbi maitu, dakayu' ma ka'a, dakayu' ma si Musa itu, maka dakayu' ma si Elija.” (Amūng-mūng sadja iya, sagō' halam kata'uwanna bang ai kat'nna'an llingna.)  <div eID="gen5556" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2564"/><div sID="gen5557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2564"/> Ma sabu pa'in ah'lling si Petros, aniya' gabun patuwa' angalandungan sigām ati tināw saga mulid inān pagka kalandungan e' gabun.

verses.name: Luke 9:35
verses.text: Aniya' suwala ah'lling min deyom gabun e', yuk-i, “Anakku ko' itu bay pene'ku. Kalehunbi iya.”  <div eID="gen5557" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2565"/><div sID="gen5558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2565"/> Paghondong pa'in suwala inān, luwal si Isa la'a ya ta'nda' e' saga mulid inān. Halam sigām bay ah'lling-h'lling pasal bay ta'nda' e' sigām inān.  <div eID="gen5558" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5555" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2566"/><div sID="gen5559" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Onde'-onde' Sinōd Saitan Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.14-Matt.17.18">Matiyu 17:14-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.14-Mark.9.27">Markus 9:14-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5560" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2566"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', makalūd pa'in disi Isa min būd inān, aheka to'ongan a'a pasampang ni iya.

verses.name: Luke 9:38
verses.text: Aniya' l'lla angalingan min deyom katimukan inān, yuk-i, “O Tuwan! Angamu' aku junjung ni ka'a, ka'ase'in kono' anakku tunggalan itu!

verses.name: Luke 9:39
verses.text: Bang pasān sinōd iya saitan. Patagha' sadja iya angolang, amaspad saga baranna maka anuput-nuput bowa'na. Landu' iya minula e' saitan, sali' halam aniya' kahondonganna.

verses.name: Luke 9:40
verses.text: Bay amu'ku saga mulidnu itu amaluwas sagō' mbal tapaluwas e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen5560" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2567"/><div sID="gen5561" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2567"/> Yuk si Isa, “Ka'am saga a'a ma patahunan itu, asā' pahāp pikilanbi! Halam to'ongan aniya' imanbi! Subay buwattingga gi' t'ggolku ma ka'am anandalan kabuwattilubi bo' yampa kam magkahagad?” Jari ah'lling iya ni mma' onde', “Bowahun pi'itu anaknu,” yukna.  <div eID="gen5561" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2568"/><div sID="gen5562" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2568"/> Na, sabu pa'in onde' inān binowa ni si Isa, nihantakan iya ni tana' e' saitan maka pinapaspad. Sagō' pinabukagan saitan e' si Isa ati pinauli' onde' inān bo' ni'nde'an ni mma'na.

verses.name: Luke 9:43
verses.text: Jari ainu-inu saga a'a maina'an kamemon, pag'nda' sigām ma kaheya kawasa Tuhan. <div eID="gen5562" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5559" type="section"/> <div sID="gen5563" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amissala si Isa Pabalik ma Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.17.22-Matt.17.23">Matiyu 17:22-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.30-Mark.9.32">Markus 9:30-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5564" type="paragraph"/> Hinabu masi magkainu-inuhan saga a'a inān ma saga hinang si Isa kamemon, ah'lling iya ni saga mulidna, yukna,

verses.name: Luke 9:44
verses.text: “Pandogahinbi to'ongan ya pamissalaku itu ma ka'am. Aku itu, Anak Manusiya', arai' na sinōngan ni pagbaya'an saga a'a.”

verses.name: Luke 9:45
verses.text: Saguwā' in bissala si Isa inān halam tahati e' saga mulidna. Tu'ud nilimbungan hatina min sigām. Mbal isab sigām makatawakkal atilaw iya bang ai hatina bay yukna he'.  <div eID="gen5564" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5563" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2569"/><div sID="gen5565" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sai ya Katapusan Alanga?</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.18.1-Matt.18.5">Matiyu 18:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.33-Mark.9.37">Markus 9:33-37</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5566" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2569"/> Ma llaw dakayu' magjawab saga mulid si Isa bang sai ma sigām ya katapusan alanga.

verses.name: Luke 9:47
verses.text: Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa bang ai ma deyom pikilan sigām, angkan niā' e'na dakayu' onde'-onde' ariki', pinat'ngge e'na ma bihingna.

verses.name: Luke 9:48
verses.text: Yukna ni sigām, “Sasuku anaima' dakayu' onde'-onde' ariki' buwattitu ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutanna, baranku ya tinaima' e'na. Maka sasuku anaima' aku, taima'na isab Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku ni dunya. Sai-sai areyo' pagatayna min kasehe'anna, ya ina'an katapusan alanga.”  <div eID="gen5566" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5565" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2570"/><div sID="gen5567" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sasuku Mbal Anagga' Kitam Amogbog du</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.9.38-Mark.9.40">Markus 9:38-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2570"/> Jari ah'lling si Yahiya, yukna, “Tuwan, aniya' ta'nda' kami dakayu' a'a anabbut ōnnu pamaluwasna saitan min deyom baran a'a. Bay iya lāng kami sabab in iya ngga'i ka sehe'tam.”  <div eID="gen5568" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2571"/><div sID="gen5569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2571"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Da'a iya lāngunbi sabab sasuku mbal anagga' ka'am amogbog du.”  <div eID="gen5569" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5567" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2572"/><div sID="gen5570" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Mbal Tinaima' e' saga A'a Samariya</title> <div sID="gen5571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2572"/> Manjari itu, pagka song ta'abut na waktu pama'angkat si Isa ni sulga', amanuyu' to'ongan iya pehē' ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Luke 9:52
verses.text: Aniya' saga a'a soho'na parahū min iya, ati pehē' sigām pal'ngngan tudju ni dakayu' kauman ma lahat Samariya anakapan pahanti'anna mahē'.

verses.name: Luke 9:53
verses.text: Saguwā' saga a'a ma kauman inān mbal bilahi anaima' si Isa sabab Awrusalam ya patudjuhanna.

verses.name: Luke 9:54
verses.text: Kinata'uwan pa'in itu e' duwa mulidna, si Yakub maka si Yahiya, yuk sigām ni si Isa, “Tuwan Panghū', bilahi ka bahā' bang kami anoho' api pahūg min sulga' pangamula saga a'a inān?”  <div eID="gen5571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2573"/><div sID="gen5572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2573"/> Sagō' niharap duwangan itu e' si Isa bo' pah'llinganna.

verses.name: Luke 9:56
verses.text: Manjari palanjal sigām minnē' bo' ni kaluma'an saddī.  <div eID="gen5572" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5570" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2574"/><div sID="gen5573" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Maghawal-hawal Ameya' ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.8.19-Matt.8.22">Matiyu 8:19-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2574"/> Ma pal'ngnganan pa'in sigām, aniya' dakayu' a'a amissala ni si Isa, yukna, “Tuwan, bilahi aku ameya' ma ka'a pi'ingga-pi'ingga papehe'annu.”  <div eID="gen5574" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2575"/><div sID="gen5575" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2575"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Gōm hayop talun aniya' pat'nna'anna, maka kamanuk-manukan aniya' pugaranna. Saguwā' aku itu, Anak Manusiya', halam taga-pahanti'an luggiya'.”  <div eID="gen5575" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2576"/><div sID="gen5576" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2576"/> Ah'lling si Isa ni a'a dakayu', yukna, “Pi'itu ka ameya' ma aku.” <div eID="gen5576" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5577" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' magtumagal a'a he', yukna, “Tuwan, paba'irun gi' aku pabīng ni luma'. Subay na apuwas pangubulku ma mma'ku bo' yampa aku ameya' ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5577" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2577"/><div sID="gen5578" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2577"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Patut bang a'a amatay pinakubul ma saga a'a kasehe'an ya halam kaniya'an kallum taptap. Sagō' ka'a, pehē' ka pal'ngngan magnasihat pasal pagparinta Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5578" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2578"/><div sID="gen5579" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2578"/> Aniya' isab a'a dangan ah'lling ma si Isa, yukna, “Ameya' aku ma ka'a, Tuwan, sagō' dūlin aku ama'id min matto'a-danakanku dahū.”  <div eID="gen5579" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2579"/><div sID="gen5580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2579"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Bang aniya' a'a magararu ma humana bo' hal palingi' ang'nda' ni buli'anna, mbal taluwa'. Damikiyanna bang a'a bilahi ameya' ma aku bo' abimbang ma ai-ai bay bbahanna he', mbal iya tōp maghinang ma pagparintahan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5580" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.9"/> <div eID="gen5573" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2580"/><div sID="gen5581" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinal'ngngan e' si Isa Mulidna Pitumpū' maka Duwa</title> <div sID="gen5582" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2580"/> Puwas e' aniya' pitumpū' maka duwa a'a saddī kawakilan e' si Isa. Sinō' sigām parahū min iya ni kamemon da'ira maka kaluma'an ya song papehē'anna. Pinal'ngngan sigām e'na duwa-duwa magbeya'.

verses.name: Luke 10:2
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Saga a'a inān sali' dalil huma atiguma' na buwa'na. Aluha tana' sagō' kulang a'a magani, angkan yukku ma ka'am: angamu'-ngamu' kam tabang ni tag-dapu tana' bo' supaya iya anoho' saga a'a pehē' magani.

verses.name: Luke 10:3
verses.text: Na, lum'ngngan na kam. Sali' kam sapantun anak bili-bili pinapehē' ni t'ngnga' saga ero' talun magpangal'kkob.

verses.name: Luke 10:4
verses.text: Da'a kam amowa pitaka atawa puyu' pamowahan ai-aibi atawa taumpa'. Bang aniya' a'a tasampangbi ma labayan da'a kam pahogga' magsagina.  <div eID="gen5582" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2581"/><div sID="gen5583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2581"/> “Bang aniya' luma' pariyata'anbi pah'llinginbi dahū, yuk-i, ‘Bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan!’

verses.name: Luke 10:6
verses.text: Manjari bang aniya' pat'nna' ma luma' inān a'a patut binuwanan kasannangan, kat'kkahan du iya kasannangan bay pangamu'bi he'. Sagō' bang halam, papelleng ni ka'am kasannangan e'.

verses.name: Luke 10:7
verses.text: Pat'nna' kam ma dakayu' luma' sadja. Da'a kam magpinda-pinda pat'nna'an. Amangan kam maka anginum ai-ai pangalabot ka'am e' saga a'a ma deyom luma' he' sabab bang a'a maghinang, wajib iya binuwanan napakana.  <div eID="gen5583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2582"/><div sID="gen5584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2582"/> “Maingga-maingga kaluma'an kat'kkahanbi, bang kam sinagina e' saga a'ana, kakanunbi ai-ai pinat'nna'an ka'am e' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 10:9
verses.text: Pauli'unbi saga a'a sakihan mahē' maka haka'anbi sigām, ta'abut na waktu pagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 10:10
verses.text: Saguwā' bang aniya' kaluma'an kat'kkahanbi bo' kam mbal ganta' sinagina e' a'ana, paluwas kam ni lān bo' pah'llinginbi.

verses.name: Luke 10:11
verses.text: Yukbi, ‘Itiya' paspasan kami min tape' kami bagunbun lahatbi itu, tanda' saksi' in kami apuwas na min ka'am. Sagō' subay kata'uwanbi in pagparinta Tuhan asekot na.’

verses.name: Luke 10:12
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya' abuhat lagi' hukumanna ma saga a'a ma lahat ina'an-i min bay hukuman ma lahat Sodom ma masa awal.”  <div eID="gen5584" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5581" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2583"/><div sID="gen5585" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maka'ase'-ase' saga A'a Mbal Magkahagad</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.11.20-Matt.11.24">Matiyu 11:20-24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2583"/> “Allā!” yuk si Isa. “Ka'am saga a'a Korasin maka a'a Betsaida, maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am! Aheka hinang makainu-inu bay pina'nda'an ni ka'am sagō' halam ikutbi. Bang da'ira Tira maka da'ira Sidun ma masa awal e' bay pangahinangan saga hinangku makainu-inu itu, tantu saga a'a maina'an bay pataikut min dusa sigām. Tantu sigām bay magsin'mmek karut, maka magbusugan di-sigām abu, tanda' sin pagsusun sigām.

verses.name: Luke 10:14
verses.text: Bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan, abuhat lagi' hukuman ya pinat'kka ni ka'am min bay hukuman ma saga a'a da'ira Tira maka da'ira Sidun.

verses.name: Luke 10:15
verses.text: Ka'am isab a'a Kapirnaum,” yuk si Isa, “ilu kam magbantug-bantug di-bi in ka'am pinalanga sampay ni sulga'! Luwal nalka' ya pasampayanbi!”  <div eID="gen5586" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2584"/><div sID="gen5587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2584"/> Ah'lling si Isa ni saga mulidna, yukna, “Sasuku anaima' pandu'bi, sali' aku ya tataima'na. Sai-sai isab anulak ka'am, sali' aku ya tasulakna. Maka sai-sai anulak aku, tasulakna Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku ni dunya.”  <div eID="gen5587" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5585" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2585"/><div sID="gen5588" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbalik ni si Isa Mulidna Pitumpū' maka Duwa</title> <div sID="gen5589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2585"/> Mbal at'ggol, makabalik na ni si Isa saga mulidna pitumpū' maka duwa ya bay soho'na pal'ngngan. Landu' sigām akōd. Yuk sigām ni iya, “Tuwan, minsan saga saitan, bay ameya' ma panoho'an kami pagsabbut kami ōnnu!”  <div eID="gen5589" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2586"/><div sID="gen5590" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2586"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bay ta'nda'ku nakura' saitan sali' luwa lāt apakpak min b'ttong langit, halam na aniya' ga'osna.

verses.name: Luke 10:19
verses.text: Kabuwanan kam e'ku kawasa bo' kam mbal ainay minsan tagi'ikbi sowa atawa jalalangking. Taga'osbi isab kawasa nakura' saitan ya magbabanta, ati halam aniya' makamula ka'am minsan ai.

verses.name: Luke 10:20
verses.text: Sagō' da'a kam magkalasigan ma sabab kapagbaya'anbi saga saitan. Gom gi' kam magkōg-koyag ma sabab ōnbi wa'i tasulat e' Tuhan ma deyom sulga'.”  <div eID="gen5590" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5588" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2587"/><div sID="gen5591" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magkōg-koyag si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.11.25-Matt.11.27">Matiyu 11:25-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.13.16-Matt.13.17">13:16-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2587"/> Manjari ma waktu ina'an sinōd kōg si Isa sabab min Rū Sussi. Yukna ni Tuhan, “O Mma', ka'a ya makapagbaya' ma sulga' maka ma dunya. Aheya pagsukulanku ni ka'a sabab in bay limbungannu min a'a taga-pangadji' sampay min a'a alalom pangita'una, pata'unu na ni saga a'a akulang ta'una. Aho', Mma', min kōg maka baya'nu angkan buwattē'.  <div eID="gen5592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2588"/><div sID="gen5593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2588"/> “Bay na pangandol ai-ai kamemon ma aku e' Mma'ku. Halam aniya' makata'uwan Anak Tuhan bang sai iya, luwal Mma'ku'. Damikiyanna isab, halam aniya' makata'uwan Mma'ku bang sai iya, luwal aku anakna lissi, sampay isab sasuku tapene'ku pinata'u.”  <div eID="gen5593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2589"/><div sID="gen5594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2589"/> Jari paharap si Isa ni saga mulidna bo' ah'lling ni sigām sadja. “Aheya kahāpanbi,” yukna, “ma sabab paka'nda'bi pakaradja'an itu.

verses.name: Luke 10:24
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, aheka saga nabi maka saga sultan ma masa awal e' bay bilahi to'ongan ang'nda' pakaradja'an ya ta'nda'bi ma buwattina'an, sagō' halam ta'nda' e' sigām. Bilahi isab sigām akale ma ai-ai takalebi itu, sagō' halam bay makakale.”  <div eID="gen5594" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5591" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2590"/><div sID="gen5595" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kissa Pasal A'a Samariya ya Ahāp Addatna</title> <div sID="gen5596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2590"/> Manjari aniya' dakayu' guru sara' agama pehē' ni si Isa. Aniya' panilawna ma si Isa panulayan iya, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, ai subay hinangku bo' supaya aku pinasuku'an kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan?”  <div eID="gen5596" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2591"/><div sID="gen5597" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2591"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ai bahā' tasulat ma deyom sara' Tuhan, ya bay pang'bba ma si Musa? Ai hatina ya tabassanu mahē'?”  <div eID="gen5597" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2592"/><div sID="gen5598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2592"/> Yuk sambung a'a inān, “Wajib kam alasa to'ongan ma Panghū'bi Tuhan. Ya lasabi ma iya subay min deyom ataybi maka min deyom tawhidbi maka min panahu'anbi maka min kosogbi. Maka wajib isab kam alasahan pagkahibi manusiya' buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi.”  <div eID="gen5598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2593"/><div sID="gen5599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2593"/> “Taluwa' sambungnu,” yuk si Isa. “Hinangun ilu ati pinasuku'an du ka kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen5599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2594"/><div sID="gen5600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2594"/> Sagō' guru inān mbal bilahi tara'ug angkan yukna ma si Isa, “Manjari sai bahā' pagkahiku ya subay kalasahanku?”  <div eID="gen5600" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2595"/><div sID="gen5601" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2595"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' dakayu' a'a bangsa Yahudi palūd min Awrusalam tudju ni da'ira Ariha. Ma labayan pa'in, nirugpakan iya e' saga mundu. Nila'ugan iya maka nilangpasan kamemon alta'na sampay s'mmek bay ma baranna. Ahalol pa'in iya, pinasagaran iya maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 10:31
verses.text: Pasalta', aniya' palabay min lān inān dakayu' imam Yahudi sagō' pag'nda'na ma a'a ahalol e', palikuwad iya min dambila'.

verses.name: Luke 10:32
verses.text: Damikiyanna, aniya' a'a saddī makapina'an, Yahudi isab min tubu' si Libi, a'a anabangan imam. Sagō' pag'nda'na ma a'a ahalol e', palikuwad isab iya min dambila'.

verses.name: Luke 10:33
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' dakayu' a'a bangsa Samariya pal'ngngan min lān ina'an ati ta'abutna a'a ahalol e'. Pag'nda'na, magtūy iya t'kkahan ase'.

verses.name: Luke 10:34
verses.text: Pasekot iya pina'an ati tambalanna pali'na maka ns'llan maka binu, bo' yampa p'kkosna. Puwas e' pinasakat a'a inān ma kura'na ati binowa ni luma' paghahanti'an bo' niayura e'na maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 10:35
verses.text: Pagsalung amuwan iya sīn ma tag-dapu luma' he' ati yukna ma iya, ‘Ayurahin aku a'a itu. Bang ka makagastu palabi min sīn itu, bayaranku pa'in ma kabalikku pi'itu.’ ”  <div eID="gen5601" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2596"/><div sID="gen5602" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2596"/> Jari atilaw si Isa ni guru inān, yukna, “Na, ma a'a t'llungan inān, ingga bang ma pikilannu maghinang sangkahāpan ma a'a bay kalangpasan e' mundu he'?”  <div eID="gen5602" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2597"/><div sID="gen5603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2597"/> Anambung guru, yukna, “Ya a'a dangan ma'ase' ma iya sampay anabang.” <div eID="gen5603" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5604" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “pehē' na ka. Hinangun buwat hinang a'a inān.”  <div eID="gen5604" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5595" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2598"/><div sID="gen5605" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Luma' disi Marta maka si Mariyam</title> <div sID="gen5606" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2598"/> Manjari itu, makalanjal pa'in disi Isa maka saga mulidna minnē', at'kka sigām ni dakayu' kaluma'an ati sinagina iya e' d'nda niōnan si Marta, sinō' pariyata' ni luma'na.

verses.name: Luke 10:39
verses.text: Aniya' danakan si Marta d'nda niōnan si Mariyam. Si Mariyam iya aningkō' na pa'in ma atag tape' si Isa akale ma pamandu'na.

verses.name: Luke 10:40
verses.text: Si Marta alengog pikilanna sabab kaheka hinangna magadjal lalabotan, angkan iya pehē' ni si Isa magmahi. “Tuwan,” yukna, “mbal bahā' ahalga' ma ka'a itiya' aku pinasagaran e' danakanku magadjal dangan-danganku. Sō'un iya anabang.”  <div eID="gen5606" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2599"/><div sID="gen5607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2599"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ka'a Marta, asasaw ka maka aheka hinang kasusahannu,

verses.name: Luke 10:42
verses.text: sagō' dakayu' du hinang aheya kagunahanna. Ahāp ya pinene' e' si Mariyam, mbal du kala'anan min iya.”  <div eID="gen5607" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.10"/> <div eID="gen5605" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2600"/><div sID="gen5608" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandu' si Isa Pasal Sambahayang</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.6.9-Matt.6.13">Matiyu 6:9-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.7.7-Matt.7.11">7:7-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2600"/> Aniya' dakayu' llaw anambahayang si Isa. Aubus pa'in, ah'lling ni iya dakayu' mulidna, yukna, “Tuwan, pandu'in kono' kami magsambahayang buwat bay pamandu' si Yahiya ma mulidna.”  <div eID="gen5609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2601"/><div sID="gen5610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2601"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bang kam anambahayang subay buwattitu kal'ngngananna. Yukbi, <lg sID="gen5611"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5612"/>‘O Mma' kami Tuhan, bang pa'in pinagaddatan ōnnu e' kamemon.<l eID="gen5612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5613"/>Bang pa'in mbal at'ggol bo' ka magparinta ma manusiya' kamemon ma dunya itu.<l eID="gen5613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5614"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:3
verses.text: Jukupin kami balanja' llaw-llaw.<l eID="gen5614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5615"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:4
verses.text: Ampunun saga dusa kami,<l eID="gen5615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5616"/>sabab ampun kami isab sai-sai makarusa ni kami.<l eID="gen5616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5617"/>Da'a kami tugutin binowa ni deyom sasat.’ ”<l eID="gen5617" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5611"/>  <div eID="gen5610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2602"/><div sID="gen5618" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2602"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Saupama aniya' min ka'am taga-bagay. Jari pehē' kam tonga' bahangi ni luma'na bo' yukbi, ‘O bagay, pasambi'un kono' aku tinapay t'llu solagna,

verses.name: Luke 11:6
verses.text: sabab aniya' bagayku dakayu' at'kka baha'u min l'ngngananna. Ina'an iya ma luma' kami, bo' halam ai-ai tapamakanku iya.’

verses.name: Luke 11:7
verses.text: Sakali anambung bagaybi min deyom luma', yukna, ‘Oy! Da'a aku sasawun. Ahogot na tambol lawang maka itiya' na kami magtai'anak maglegehan. Mbal aku makabungkal amuwanan ka'a ai-ai.’

verses.name: Luke 11:8
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “minsan buwattē' panambung bagaybi he', tantu iya pabungkal bo' kam buwananna ai-ai kagunahanbi. Ngga'i ka ma sabab kapagbagaybi, sagō' ma sabab katuyu'bi angamu'.  <div eID="gen5618" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:9
