verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2603"/><div sID="gen5619" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2603"/> “Angkan haka'anta kam, angamu'-ngamu' kam ati binuwanan du kam. Amiha kam ati makabāk du kam. Mikiukab kam ati niukaban du kam.

verses.name: Luke 11:10
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai angamu' kabuwanan du, sai-sai amiha makabāk du, sai-sai mikiukab niukaban du.

verses.name: Luke 11:11
verses.text: Ka'am taga-anak ilu, abila kam pangamu'an daing e' anakbi, buwananbi bahā' sowa?

verses.name: Luke 11:12
verses.text: Atawa bang amu'na nt'llo, buwananbi bahā' jalalangking?

verses.name: Luke 11:13
verses.text: Ka'am ilu, minsan taga-dusa, ata'u du amuwanan anakbi ai-ai makahāp. Luba'-lagi'na na Mma'bi ma deyom sulga' ata'u du amuwanan ka'am Rū Sussi ni sasuku angamu' ni iya.”  <div eID="gen5619" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5608" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2604"/><div sID="gen5620" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka Be'elsebul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.22-Matt.12.30">Matiyu 12:22-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.3.20-Mark.3.27">Markus 3:20-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5621" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2604"/> Aniya' saitan makaumaw pinala'an e' si Isa. Makala'an pa'in saitan-i, makabissala na a'a bay umaw. Ainu-inu ba'anan a'a bay maina'an,

verses.name: Luke 11:15
verses.text: sagō' aniya' ah'lling, yuk-i, “Kabuwanan iya kawasa e' Be'elsebul ya pagnakura'an saga saitan, angkan iya makapala'an saga saitan.”  <div eID="gen5621" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2605"/><div sID="gen5622" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2605"/> Aniya' isab saga a'a kasehe' bay mikipa'nda' ma si Isa hinang makainu-inu, panulayan sigām bang b'nnal min Tuhan kawasana.

verses.name: Luke 11:17
verses.text: Sagō' kasakupan asal e' si Isa bang ai pinikil e' sigām, angkan yukna ma sigām, “Bang saupama aniya' pagsultanan abahagi' duwa saga a'ana ati magbono' sali'-sali', mbal at'ggol magka'at pagsultanan e'. Damikiyanna bang aniya' a'a magdaokom abahagi' duwa bo' magsagga'an di-sigām, al'kkas sigām magkaukanat.

verses.name: Luke 11:18
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab bang nakura' saitan amaluwas saitan, hatina magsagga' iya maka panendogna, mbal at'ggol, kamulahan sigām. Na, yukbi in aku itu kabuwanan kawasa e' nakura' saitan ya angkan aku makapaluwas saitan.

verses.name: Luke 11:19
verses.text: Bang he'-i b'nnal, minningga bahā' pangā'an mulidbi kawasa ya angkan sigām isab makapaluwas saitan? Mulidbi luggiya' ya amatampal kasā'anbi.

verses.name: Luke 11:20
verses.text: Sagō' ya b'nnalna, ya angkan aku makapala'an saitan sabab kawasaku deyo' bay min Tuhan. Ya na ko' ilu paltanda'an in Tuhan itiya' na magparinta ma deyomanbi.  <div eID="gen5622" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2606"/><div sID="gen5623" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2606"/> “Saupama a'a aga'os sakap asal maka pakokosna, bang iya ganta' anganjagahan luma'na mbal ainay pangalta'na.

verses.name: Luke 11:22
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' a'a akalap gi' kosogna parugpak pina'an bo' anganda'ug, kalangpasan du saga pakokos bay pangandolan e' a'a tag-luma' he'. Pinagbahagi'-bahagi'an isab pangalta'na ati pamuwan ma saga kasehe'an.”  <div eID="gen5623" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2607"/><div sID="gen5624" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2607"/> Ah'lling isab si Isa, yukna, “Sai-sai mbal amogbogan aku anagga' aku du. Maka sai-sai mbal anabangan aku magpatipun saga suku'ku, amakaukanat du iya.”  <div eID="gen5624" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5620" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2608"/><div sID="gen5625" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabalik Saitan ni Baina</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.43-Matt.12.45">Matiyu 12:43-45</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5626" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2608"/> “Na, bang takdil ni saitan,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' saitan paluwas min baran a'a, nilunsul e'na lahat halam bay kaulanan pamiha'anna pahalian. Sagō' halam aniya' tabākna. Jari ah'lling saitan inān ni baranna, yukna, ‘Gom aku pabīng ni baran a'a bay pat'nna'anku he'.’

verses.name: Luke 11:25
verses.text: Pagbīng pa'in, ta'nda'na wa'i bay sinapuhan maka minomos.

verses.name: Luke 11:26
verses.text: Puwas e' pehē' iya angā' pitu' saitan saddī, akalap gi' la'at sigām min iya, ati pasōd sigām kamemon ni deyom baran a'a he', bo' pat'nna' maina'an. Jari in kahālan a'a he' ala'at gi' min bay dahū.”  <div eID="gen5626" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5625" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2609"/><div sID="gen5627" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kakōgan B'nnal</title> <div sID="gen5628" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2609"/> Manjari aubus pa'in pamissala si Isa, aniya' d'nda min katimukan a'a inān ah'lling patanog. Yukna ma si Isa, “Kinōgan sidda d'nda bay anganakan ka'a maka bay amaruru'!”  <div eID="gen5628" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2610"/><div sID="gen5629" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2610"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Aheya gi' kakōgan sasuku akale ma palman Tuhan sampay ameya' ma panoho'anna.”  <div eID="gen5629" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5627" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2611"/><div sID="gen5630" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paltanda'an min Nabi Yunus</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.12.38-Matt.12.42">Matiyu 12:38-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5631" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2611"/> Paheka na pa'in saga a'a maghuru-huru pina'an ni si Isa ati yukna ma sigām, “Ala'at kahinangan saga a'a patahunan itu. Mikipa'nda' kam paltanda'an panulayanbi aku bang sab'nnal-b'nnal aku min Tuhan. Sagō' halam aniya' paltanda'an pina'nda'an ni ka'am, luwal paltanda'an nabi Yunus bay ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Luke 11:30
verses.text: Si Yunus bay tahinang paltanda'an e' Tuhan pagbanda' ma saga a'a ma da'ira Niniba. Damikiyanna isab aku, Anak Manusiya', tahinang paltanda'an ma ka'am saga a'a patahunan itu.

verses.name: Luke 11:31
verses.text: Bang ta'abut na llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya', aniya' du an'ngge maina'an dakayu' sultan d'nda bay min lahat Seba ma masa awal e'. Anaksi' du iya in ka'am taga-dusa. Ya angkan iya taga-kapatut anaksi' sabab in iya bay pi'itu min lahatna ma bihing dunya supaya takalena bissala sultan Sulayman, ya bay alalom to'ongan pangita'una he'. Sagō' haka'anta kam, ma buwattina'an aniya' maitu ma ka'am pasōng lagi' pangita'una min sultan Sulayman, sagō' mbal ikutbi.

verses.name: Luke 11:32
verses.text: Bang ta'abut na llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya', magt'nggehan saga a'a bay ma da'ira Niniba ma masa awal e', bo' anaksi'an ka'am in ka'am taga-dusa. Angkan buwattē' sabab sigām ya bay apinda min dusa sigām pagkale sigām ma pandu' si Yunus. Haka'anta kam, aniya' maitu ma ka'am alanga lagi' min nabi Yunus, sagō' mbal iya ikutbi.”  <div eID="gen5631" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5630" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2612"/><div sID="gen5632" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kasawahan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.5.15">Matiyu 5:15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.6.22-Matt.6.23">6:22-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2612"/> Amandu' gi' si Isa, yukna, “Halam aniya' anū'an palita'an bo' yampa tapukanna atawa turunganna maka undam, sagō' pat'nna'na du ma diyata' papagan supaya ta'nda' sawana e' sasuku pasōd ni deyom luma' he'.

verses.name: Luke 11:34
verses.text: Matata itu sali' dalil palita'an amuwan sawa ma deyom ginhawata. Bang ahāp pang'nda'ta, asawa sampay deyom ginhawata. Sagō' bang matata mbal ahāp, sali' angalendom sampay deyom ginhawata itu.

verses.name: Luke 11:35
verses.text: Tantuhunbi in kasawahan ma deyom ginhawabi b'nnal sadja, ngga'i ka kalendoman.

verses.name: Luke 11:36
verses.text: Sagō' bang asawa lullun deyom ginhawabi, maka bang halam aniya' lendomna minsan dangkuri', asawa to'ongan kamemonna. Ya dalilna aniya' palita'an amasawahan iya.”  <div eID="gen5633" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5632" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2613"/><div sID="gen5634" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Katiksa'an Nnom Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.23.1-Matt.23.36">Matiyu 23:1-36</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.38-Mark.12.40">Markus 12:38-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5635" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2613"/> Aubus pa'in e' si Isa amissala, aniya' dakayu' a'a Parisi amowa iya ni luma'na amangan. Jari pasōd iya pina'an amangan.

verses.name: Luke 11:38
verses.text: Ainu-inu Parisi he' ma si Isa sabab halam iya bay angose'an tanganna dahū bo' yampa amangan.

verses.name: Luke 11:39
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Ka'am saga Parisi, kose'anbi sawanbi maka laibi sampay luwasanna, sagō' ap'nno' deyom ataybi e' pangalangpasbi maka kala'atanbi.

verses.name: Luke 11:40
verses.text: Dupang pahāp kam! Kabā'bi bahā' hal luwasan baranbi ya pinapanjari e' Tuhan, bo' deyomna halam?

verses.name: Luke 11:41
verses.text: Sagō' isi sawanbi maka laibi subay panarakkabi ma saga miskin, jari halal du kamemonbi.  <div eID="gen5635" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2614"/><div sID="gen5636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2614"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga Parisi! Atukid sidda kam anukbal ni Tuhan bahagi' sangpū' min ai-aibi kamemon, minsan la'a hal ginisan sayul-sayul ya pamapābi kinakan. Sagō' halam kabogboganbi saga hinang ahalga', hatina hinang abontol ma pagkahibi maka lasa tudju ni Tuhan. Ahāp isab hinangbi anukbal bahagi' min ai-aibi, sagō' da'a taikutinbi saga hinang labi ahalga' he'.  <div eID="gen5636" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2615"/><div sID="gen5637" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2615"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga Parisi! Bang kam ma deyom langgal, ya kabaya'anbi subay aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan. Bang kam ma mairan, ya kabaya'anbi subay nihulmat e' saga a'a.  <div eID="gen5637" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2616"/><div sID="gen5638" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2616"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am. Sali' kam sapantun kakubulan hal pinasagaran, manjari tagi'ik e' a'a bo' halam kinata'uwan e' sigām in ina'an makabatal.”  <div eID="gen5638" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2617"/><div sID="gen5639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2617"/> Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' guru sara' agama ah'lling ni si Isa, yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, pagka buwattē' pah'llingnu ma saga Parisi, sampay kami isab talapaynu pinakaiya'.”  <div eID="gen5639" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2618"/><div sID="gen5640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2618"/> “Aho',” yuk si Isa, “maka'ase'-ase' isab ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru sara' agama! Sabab pabuhatanbi saga a'a maka sara'-panara' ya mbal takole' binogbogan e' sigām. Sagō' mbal kam anabang amowa, minsan la'a hal tabang ariki'.  <div eID="gen5640" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2619"/><div sID="gen5641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2619"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' ya pamakadal ka'am! Sabab pa'altibi tampat ma saga nabi, bo' nabi inān bay tabono' e' ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Luke 11:48
verses.text: Jari ka'am ilu anaksi'an di-bi in ka'am pauyun du ma kahinangan ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi he'. Sigām bay amapatay saga nabi he', ati ka'am ya ama'alti kubul sigām.

verses.name: Luke 11:49
verses.text: Angkanna Tuhan, ya alalom asal ta'una, bay angallam, yuk-i, ‘Pabeya'ku pehē' ni bangsa Isra'il saga nabi maka saga a'a kawakilanku. Saguwā' kasehe'an a'a pabeya'ku pinapatay du e' sigām, kasehe'an nila'at.’

verses.name: Luke 11:50
verses.text: Angkanna,” yuk si Isa, “ka'am saga a'a patahunan itu tin'kkahan du kabinasahan ma sabab bay dusa ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi amono' kanabi-nabihan sangay min waktu pamapanjari dunya.

verses.name: Luke 11:51
verses.text: Bininasa du kam ma sabab kamatay saga nabi kamemon, tinagna'an min si Habil anak si Adam, sampay ni si Jakariya ya pinapatay e' sigām ma llotan tongod pagkulbanan maka baran langgal e'. Aho', haka'anta kam saga a'a ma ahil jaman itu, tantu kam pamatanggungan karusahan sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen5641" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2620"/><div sID="gen5642" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2620"/> “Maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ka'am, saga guru sara' agama, sabab tambolanbi saga a'a bo' mbal kaniya'an pangita'u. Ya sapantunna pangalta' tinau' sakuli-kuli, in ka'am mbal bilahi angukay iya, maka lāngbi isab sasuku bilahi.”  <div eID="gen5642" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2621"/><div sID="gen5643" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2621"/> Pagla'an si Isa minna'an, magtūy saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' anagna' anoway iya. Ala'at sidda panoway sigām, maka aheka isab panilaw sigām ma iya,

verses.name: Luke 11:54
verses.text: bang kalu tasaggaw amah'lling kasā'an, manjari katuntutan iya ni sara'.  <div eID="gen5643" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.11"/> <div eID="gen5634" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2622"/><div sID="gen5644" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' Pasal Pandu' Parisi maka Saddusi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.26-Matt.10.27">Matiyu 10:26-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2622"/> Pasalta' ina'an-i, ibu-ibuhan saga a'a magtimukan, sikaselot-selotan. Manjari amanda' si Isa dahū ma saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Halli'inbi pasulig tinapay min saga Parisi, hatina hinang sigām maglaku-laku in sigām ahāp.

verses.name: Luke 12:2
verses.text: Kamemon bay nilimbungan,” yukna, “tantu pinaluwas. Maka kamemon bay tatau' ma deyom atay tantu pinabukis du.

verses.name: Luke 12:3
verses.text: Ai-ai pagsuli-sulibi ma deyom kalendoman kinale du ma kasawahan. Ai-ai paghigung-higungbi ma deyom bilik pinatanyag du ma mairan.”  <div eID="gen5645" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5644" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2623"/><div sID="gen5646" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sai Subay Pinagmatāwan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.28-Matt.10.31">Matiyu 10:28-31</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2623"/> “Haka'anta kam, saga bagay,” yuk si Isa, “da'a katāwinbi saga a'a ya makapatay baranbi sabab mbal ta'abut palnyawahanbi.

verses.name: Luke 12:5
verses.text: Sagō' pandu'anta kam bang sai iya subay pagmatāwanbi: katāwinbi Tuhan sabab taga-kapatut iya angalarukan nyawabi ni deyom nalka' bang tapapatay na baranbi.  <div eID="gen5647" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2624"/><div sID="gen5648" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2624"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Pikilunbi saga manuk-manuk paupit ilu, tab'llita lima hekana maka duwa unud sīn. Saguwā' minsan manuk-manuk ariki' halga'na, mbal takalipat e' Tuhan minsan dakayu'.

verses.name: Luke 12:7
verses.text: Na, luba'-lagi'na ka'am isab mbal takalipat e' Tuhan. Minsan lamba bu'unbi ilu taitung asal e'na. Angkan kam subay mbal tināw sabab ahalga' gi' kam min ba'anan paupit ilu.”  <div eID="gen5648" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5646" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2625"/><div sID="gen5649" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsab'nnal Pasal si Isa ya Pameya'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.32-Matt.10.33">Matiyu 10:32-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.12.32">12:32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.10.19-Matt.10.20">10:19-20</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5650" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2625"/> “Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “sai-sai angahaka ma matahan kaheka'an a'a in iya ameya' ma aku, Anak Manusiya', angahaka du aku ma matahan saga mala'ikat Tuhan in a'a inān palsuku'anku du.

verses.name: Luke 12:9
verses.text: Sagō' sai-sai amalilu ma matahan kaheka'an a'a in aku ngga'i ka pameya'anna, paliluhanku isab a'a inān ma matahan saga mala'ikat Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 12:10
verses.text: Sai-sai amah'lling la'at ma aku, Anak Manusiya', makajari niampun dusana, sagō' sai-sai amah'llingan Rū Sussi ala'at, mbal to'ongan niampun.  <div eID="gen5650" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2626"/><div sID="gen5651" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2626"/> “Ma sinosōng, bang kam sinaggaw e' a'a bo' binowa ni langgal sigām nihukum atawa ni alopan saga gubnul maka saga parinta, da'a kam magsusa bang buwattingga e'bi anganda'awahan di-bi atawa bang ai pamissalabi.

verses.name: Luke 12:12
verses.text: Sabab pinandu'an du kam e' Rū Sussi ma waktu ina'an-i bang ai subay pamissalabi.”  <div eID="gen5651" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5649" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2627"/><div sID="gen5652" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal A'a Dayahan</title> <div sID="gen5653" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2627"/> Manjari aniya' dangan min katimukan a'a inān ah'lling. Yukna ni si Isa, “Tuwan, soho'un lagi' danakanku amahagi'an aku pusaka' bay pang'bba e' mma' kami.”  <div eID="gen5653" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2628"/><div sID="gen5654" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2628"/> Sagō' yuk si Isa ma iya, “Sehe', halam aku kabuwanan kapatut anara' ka'am, maka halam aniya' kapatutku amahagi' alta'bi.”

verses.name: Luke 12:15
verses.text: Sinugpatan isab lling si Isa ma saga a'a inān, yuk-i, “Kamaya'-maya' kam. Halli'inbi napsu indaginis sabab minsan kam dayahan makalandu', ngga'i ka karayabi aheka ya makabuwanan ka'am kallum.”  <div eID="gen5654" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2629"/><div sID="gen5655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2629"/> Puwas e' aniya' pamaralil e' si Isa ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Aniya' a'a dayahan taga-huma aheka sidda buwa'na.

verses.name: Luke 12:17
verses.text: Manjari a'a itu amikilan di-na, yukna, ‘Ai bahā' subay hinangku pagka halam aniya' kamalig sarang panau'anku buwa' tinanom itu?

verses.name: Luke 12:18
verses.text: Ā, kata'uwanku na bang ai subay hinangku. Langkatku saga kamaligku bo' hinangku kamalig baha'u, aheya lagi' min bay tagna'. Jari tau'ku mahē' buwa' tinanomku kamemon maka alta'ku kamemon.

verses.name: Luke 12:19
verses.text: Puwas e' ah'llingan aku di-ku, yukku, ahāp asal sukudku. Aheka na tatau'ku panganggastuku sampay ma tahunan. Pahali-hali na aku. Amangan aku maka anginum, maka pahāpku palasahanku.’

verses.name: Luke 12:20
verses.text: Sagō' amissala Tuhan ma iya, yukna, ‘Dupang pahāp ka! Ma sangom ilu amatay du ka. Ma sai na bahā' alta' bay tau'annu barannu ilu?’

verses.name: Luke 12:21
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “buwattē' du ya kamaujuran a'a bang amabūd alta' pamahāp palasahanna, bo' pa'in miskin iya ma pang'nda' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5655" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5652" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2630"/><div sID="gen5656" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangandol ma Tuhan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.6.25-Matt.6.34">Matiyu 6:25-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5657" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2630"/> Jari amissala gi' si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Angkan kam soho'ku da'a sakit magsusa pasal kallumanbi bang ai kakanbi, atawa pasal ginhawa-baranbi bang ai kapan'mmekbi.

verses.name: Luke 12:23
verses.text: Sabab labi ahalga' kallumta min pagkakanta, maka ahalga' gi' baranta min pan'mmekta.

verses.name: Luke 12:24
verses.text: Nda'unbi saga owak. Mbal magtanom, mbal magani, maka halam aniya' pagtatau'an sigām kinakan, sagō' binalanja'an asal sigām e' Tuhan. Bo' ka'am ilu, ahalga' gi' to'ongan min kamanuk-manukan.

verses.name: Luke 12:25
verses.text: Sai bahā' makapataha' umulna saga danjām sadja, minsan buwattingga e'na magmasusa?

verses.name: Luke 12:26
verses.text: Manjari bang mbal tapataha'bi umulbi minsan dangkuri', angay pagsusahanbi ai-ai kasehe'?

verses.name: Luke 12:27
verses.text: Nda'unbi saga sumping bang buwattingga katomo'na. Mbal magsangsā' maghinang, mbal magt'nnun. Sagō' haka'anta kam, minsan sultan Sulayman maka kahaldayana ma masa awal e', mbal maka'atu kahāp s'mmekna ma dakayu' sumping itu.

verses.name: Luke 12:28
verses.text: Bang Tuhan ya makapayakun sumping kasagmotan itu, ya tatasanna dang'llaw du, pagsalung tinunu', ya lagi'na ka'am pas'mmekanna du. Akulang pahāp pangandolbi ma iya!  <div eID="gen5657" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2631"/><div sID="gen5658" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2631"/> “Angkan kam soho'ku da'a magsusa, da'a kam magpikil na pa'in bang ai kakanbi atawa inumbi.

verses.name: Luke 12:30
verses.text: Saga a'a mbal ata'u magta'at ma Tuhan, ya na he' kinasusahan na pa'in e' sigām. Sagō' ka'am ilu, kinata'uwan e' Mma'bi Tuhan in ina'an kagunahanbi asal.

verses.name: Luke 12:31
verses.text: Sagō' muna-muna kannalunbi pagparinta Tuhan, manjari pinaniya'an du kam ai-ai kulang-kabusbi.”  <div eID="gen5658" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5656" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2632"/><div sID="gen5659" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Karaya ma Sulga'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.6.19-Matt.6.21">Matiyu 6:19-21</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5660" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2632"/> “Ka'am saga mulidku,” yuk si Isa, “da'a kam tināw minsan kam mbal aheka. Sabab ka'amuhan Mma'bi Tuhan amuwanan ka'am palsuku'an ma deyom pagparintahanna.

verses.name: Luke 12:33
verses.text: Pab'llihinbi alta'bi ati panarakkahunbi b'llihanna ma saga a'a miskin. Bang hinangbi itu-i sali' kam dalil ang'nna' alta'bi ma deyom pitaka mbal magka'ndang. Hatina aniya' karayabi ma deyom sulga', karaya mbal pakulang. Bang ganta' maina'an karayabi, mbal ta'abut e' a'a panangkaw maka halam aniya' ulat amaka'at iya.

verses.name: Luke 12:34
verses.text: Sabab hatina, maingga-maingga ya panau'anbi alta'bi, ya na ina'an pataptapan pangatayanbi.”  <div eID="gen5660" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5659" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2633"/><div sID="gen5661" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinajaga e' si Isa saga Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen5662" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2633"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Subay kam patanam ma ai-ai pat'kka, buwat saga sosoho'an angalagaran kapole' nakura' sigām min pagkawinan. As'mmek na pa'in sigām maka mbal am'ddahan palita'an. Pagt'kka nakura' sigām bo' pagkuku'na ma lawang, magtūy iya niukaban.

verses.name: Luke 12:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2633"/><div sID="gen5661" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinajaga e' si Isa saga Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen5662" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2633"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Subay kam patanam ma ai-ai pat'kka, buwat saga sosoho'an angalagaran kapole' nakura' sigām min pagkawinan. As'mmek na pa'in sigām maka mbal am'ddahan palita'an. Pagt'kka nakura' sigām bo' pagkuku'na ma lawang, magtūy iya niukaban.

verses.name: Luke 12:37
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan saga sosoho'an inān pagka masi sigām magjaga maka asakap asal ma pagt'kka nakura' sigām. Haka'anta kam to'ongan,” yuk si Isa, “nakura' inān angamomosan di-na du ati patingkō'na saga sosoho'anna he' bo' yampa sigām buhatanna.

verses.name: Luke 12:38
verses.text: Minsan tonga' bahangi atawa dai' llaw ya kat'kkana, bang ta'abutna saga sosoho'anna asal ajaga, tantu aheya kahāpan sigām.

verses.name: Luke 12:39
verses.text: Saupama a'a tag-dapu luma', bang kata'uwanna waktu kat'kka panangkaw, tantu mbal pasagaranna luma'na nilangkat maka sinōd.

verses.name: Luke 12:40
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am, subay kam sakap sadja sabab aku, Anak Manusiya', at'kka du pi'itu pabīng ma waktu mbal kata'uwanbi.”  <div eID="gen5662" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5661" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2634"/><div sID="gen5663" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sosoho'an Kapangandolan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.45-Matt.24.51">Matiyu 24:45-51</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5664" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2634"/> Manjari atilaw si Petros, yukna, “Tuwan, sai bissalahannu paralilan ilu? Kami sadja atawa a'a kamemon?”  <div eID="gen5664" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2635"/><div sID="gen5665" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2635"/> Anambung si Isa magparalilan pabīng. “Bang aniya' sosoho'an ahāp akkalna, a'a kapangandolan,” yukna, “iya na ina'an pinene' e' nakura'na magmandul ma saga sosoho'an kasehe'an. Iya na isab magatas-pikil ma balanja' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 12:43
verses.text: Na, bang bay alikut nakura'na inān bo' amole' na, aheya kahāpan ma magmandul inān bang iya ta'abut e' nakura'na anogol ma bay pamahinang iya.

verses.name: Luke 12:44
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, tantu pangandol e' nakura' inān alta'na kamemon ma sosoho'an kapangandolan e'.

verses.name: Luke 12:45
verses.text: Sagō' in mandul itu, bang saupama pangannalna ma deyom atayna in nakura'na at'ggol gi' at'kka, anagna' iya angala'ugan saga sosoho'an kasehe'an l'lla maka d'nda. Ya na pa'in hinangna magkakan maka maginum maka maglango.

verses.name: Luke 12:46
verses.text: Sakali patagha' sadja t'kka nakura' inān, ma llaw halam nilagaran e' magmandul, ma waktu halam kata'uwanna. Manjari nilagut iya e' nakura'na sampay abugtang. Pinakadalan iya nalka' sali'-sali' maka saga a'a mbal magkahagad ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5665" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2636"/><div sID="gen5666" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2636"/> “Bang sosoho'an ata'u bang ai kabaya'an nakura'na subay hinangna, bo' mbal sakap maghinang, tantu iya niraplosan to'ongan.

verses.name: Luke 12:48
verses.text: Sagō' bang sosoho'an a'awam asal pasal kabaya'an nakura'na, bo' aniya' tahinangna patut paminasahan iya, niraplosan du isab iya sagō' mbal sakit abuhat. Sai-sai kabuwanan aheka, aheka isab niholat min iya. Damikiyanna bang a'a pangandolan ma aheka, pasōng isab aheka niholat min iya.”  <div eID="gen5666" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5663" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2637"/><div sID="gen5667" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pagsagga'an A'a</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.34-Matt.10.36">Matiyu 10:34-36</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5668" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2637"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Bay aku pi'itu amowa api ni dunya itu ati kabaya'anku bangsi' wa'i na arokot.

verses.name: Luke 12:50
verses.text: Aniya' kabinasahan subay kalabayanku ati kabuhatan aku sat'ggol mbal gi' aubus.

verses.name: Luke 12:51
verses.text: Arai' pangannalbi in aku pi'itu amowa kasannangan ni dunya. Sagō' haka'anta kam, ngga'i ka kasannangan. Palsagga'an ya bowaku pi'itu.

verses.name: Luke 12:52
verses.text: Sabab puwas minnitu, bang aniya' lima puhu' magdakayu' luma', magkalukassa sigām. T'llungan sigām anagga' duwangan, maka duwangan inān angatu ma t'llungan.

verses.name: Luke 12:53
verses.text: Mma' anagga' anakna l'lla, maka l'lla anagga' mma'na. Ina' anagga' anakna d'nda, maka d'nda anagga' ina'na. Mato'a d'nda anagga' ayuwanna d'nda, maka ayuwan d'nda anagga' mato'ana.”  <div eID="gen5668" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5667" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2638"/><div sID="gen5669" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandogahan Pasal Pakaradja'an ma Sinosōng</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.16.2-Matt.16.3">Matiyu 16:2-3</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2638"/> Ah'lling isab si Isa ni kaheka'an a'a inān. “Bang takdil ni luwa lahat,” yukna, “bang ta'nda'bi angandom langit tampal ni s'ddopan, magtūy yukbi, ‘Sōng ulan’. Maka angulan du isab.

verses.name: Luke 12:55
verses.text: Bang patumbuk satan, yukbi, ‘Ā, song apasu' lahat,’ ati apasu' du.

verses.name: Luke 12:56
verses.text: Mamarahi pahāp ka'am ilu magbau'-bau'. Ata'u kam ang'nda' pamandogahan ma b'ttong langit maka ma dunya, jari angay mbal tapandogabi pakaradja'an ya pat'kka ma masa ītu?  <div eID="gen5670" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2639"/><div sID="gen5671" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2639"/> “Angay kam mbal ata'u magpikilan di-bi bang ingga ya apatut subay hinangbi?

verses.name: Luke 12:58
verses.text: Abila kam tinuntutan e' a'a ma sabab utangbi ati binowa e'na ni sara', pasulay kam to'ongan maghāp maka iya ma halam gi' makatandan ni sara'. Sabab bang mbal, ya aniya' tinandanan ka ni huwis ati ni'nde'an ni pulis bo' kinalabusu.

verses.name: Luke 12:59
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, ka'ddasan du kam ma deyom kalabusu inān. Subay puwasanbi bay kataksilanbi kamemon bo' yampa kam makaluwas minnē'.”  <div eID="gen5671" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.12"/> <div eID="gen5669" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2640"/><div sID="gen5672" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pang'bba min Dusa maka Kapamutawan min Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen5673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2640"/> Na, ma waktu ina'an-i aniya' saga a'a anuli-nuli ni si Isa pasal saga a'a Jalil, ya bay sinō' binono' e' gubnul Pilatu pasalta' ma waktu kapanumbali' sigām hayop pagkulban ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 13:2
verses.text: Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Pangannalbi bahā' in dusa saga a'a inān labi gi' min a'a kamemon maitu ma lahat Jalil, ya angkan sigām t'kkahan bala' buwattē'?

verses.name: Luke 13:3
verses.text: Ngga'i ka! Sagō' haka'anta kam, bang ka'am ilu mbal ang'bba min dusabi, ya du ka'am amatay buwat saga a'a Jalil e'.

verses.name: Luke 13:4
verses.text: Saga a'a isab sangpū' maka walu' hekana, ya bay amatay mahē' ma Silowam pagka kah'bba'an e' luma' pamantawan, pangannalbi bahā' in sigām dusahan lagi' min a'a Awrusalam kasehe'.

verses.name: Luke 13:5
verses.text: Tantu ngga'i ka! Sagō' bang ka'am ilu mbal ang'bba to'ongan min dusabi, amatay du kam buwat sigām.”  <div eID="gen5673" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2641"/><div sID="gen5674" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2641"/> Manjari aniya' paralilan pangissa si Isa ma sigām. Yukna, “Aniya' a'a taga-kayu igira patomo' ma deyom kabbunna, ya panomo'an bahan anggul. Pina'an iya amiha buwa' igira sagō' halam aniya' tapihana,

verses.name: Luke 13:7
verses.text: angkan yukna ni tunggu' kabbun inān, ‘Nda'un, t'lluntahun na kapagpi'itu-pi'ituku ni kayu igira itu amiha buwa' sagō' halam aniya' tapihaku. Puwarun na, sabab kaliman tana' itu.’

verses.name: Luke 13:8
verses.text: Saguwā' anambung tunggu' kabbun e', yukna, ‘Da'a, tuwan. Pasagaranta gi' dantahun. Kalutku pahāp tana'na, tambalanku maka tai' hayop.

verses.name: Luke 13:9
verses.text: Bang hati' amuwan buwa' ma musim sinōng itu, ahāp isab. Bang mbal, na minsan puwadnu na.’ ”  <div eID="gen5674" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5672" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2642"/><div sID="gen5675" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">D'nda Buggul Kauli'an ma Llaw Paghali</title> <div sID="gen5676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2642"/> Ma dakayu' llaw Sabtu', ina'an si Isa amandu' ma deyom langgal.

verses.name: Luke 13:11
verses.text: Aniya' maina'an dakayu' d'nda asaki sabab min saitan, sangpū' na maka waluntahun t'ggolna. Parukkug sidda bukutna, mbal tapah'nnat.

verses.name: Luke 13:12
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Isa ma d'nda itu, sinō' iya pasekot. Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Arung, apuwas na ka min sakinu ilu.”

verses.name: Luke 13:13
verses.text: Jari pina'abut e' si Isa tanganna ma iya. Magtūy iya pah'nnat ati ananglit ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2643"/><div sID="gen5677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2643"/> Sagō' nakura' langgal inān, apasu' atayna pagka si Isa amauli' a'a ma llaw Sabtu'. Yukna ma saga a'a maina'an, “Nnom llaw ma deyom dapitu' wajib paghinangtam ai-ai. Pi'itu kam ma deyom nnom llaw inān bang kam bilahi kauli'an sakibi, da'a bang llaw Sabtu'.”  <div eID="gen5677" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2644"/><div sID="gen5678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2644"/> Sinambungan nakura' inān e' si Isa, yukna, “Magbau'-bau' pahāp ka'am ilu. Aniya' bahā' ma ka'am mbal angahubaran sapi'na atawa kura'na bo' yampa guyudbi ni bohe' supaya painumbi, minsan pasabu ma llaw Sabtu'?

verses.name: Luke 13:16
verses.text: D'nda itu panubu' si Ibrahim du buwat ka'am. Aniya' na sangpū' maka waluntahun t'ggolna bay katahanan e' nakura' saitan. Mbal bahā' iya wajib pinuwasan min susana ma llaw Sabtu'?”

verses.name: Luke 13:17
verses.text: Magtūy kaiya'an saga a'a ya anagga' si Isa ma sabab panambungna he'. Sagō' saga a'a inān akōd kamemon ma sabab hinang makainu-inu kamemon ya tahinang e'na.  <div eID="gen5678" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5675" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2645"/><div sID="gen5679" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Bigi-tinanom Landu' Anahut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.31-Matt.13.32">Matiyu 13:31-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.4.30-Mark.4.32">Markus 4:30-32</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5680" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2645"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ai pamasali'antam pagparinta Tuhan ma bangsa manusiya'? Ai pamaralilanku iya?

verses.name: Luke 13:19
verses.text: Ya pagparinta Tuhan,” yuk si Isa, “sali' dalil dansolag bigi-tinanom ariki'-diki', tinanom e' a'a ma tana'na. Patomo' pa'in itu, manjari tahinang kayu na, ati pina'an saga manuk-manuk patapu' ma sangana.”  <div eID="gen5680" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5679" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2646"/><div sID="gen5681" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Pasulig ya Pangalamud Tirigu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.13.33">Matiyu 13:33</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5682" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2646"/> Ah'lling si Isa pabīng, yukna, “Ai pamaralilanku pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya'?

verses.name: Luke 13:21
verses.text: Ya pagparinta Tuhan,” yukna, “sali' dalil pasulig ginuna e' d'nda pinalamud ni tirigu aheka, saga duwampū' maka lima kilu. Pagaddun pa'in, abuskag kamemon addunan.”  <div eID="gen5682" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5681" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2647"/><div sID="gen5683" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lawang Akiput</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.7.13-Matt.7.14">Matiyu 7:13-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.7.21-Matt.7.23">21-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2647"/> Jari palanjal si Isa tudju ni da'ira Awrusalam hinabuna angalatag saga kaluma'an aheya-ariki' amandu' ma saga a'a.

verses.name: Luke 13:23
verses.text: Aniya' inān dakayu' a'a atilaw iya, yuk-i, “Tuwan, akulang bahā' saga a'a lappasan e' Tuhan min mulka'?” <div eID="gen5684" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5685" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa ma saga a'a inān,

verses.name: Luke 13:24
verses.text: “Bang kam bilahi pasōd ni deyoman Tuhan subay kam amuspus bo' kam makasōd min lawangna akiput. Sabab haka'anta kam, aheka a'a anulay pasōd sagō' mbal makasōd.

verses.name: Luke 13:25
verses.text: Makabungkal pa'in tag-dapu luma' anambol lawang, mbal na kam makasōd. Ma luwasan lawang sadja kam anguku' maka angalingan. Yukbi, ‘O tuwan, ukabin kami.’ Sinambungan du kam e'na, yukna, ‘Mbal kata'uwanku kam bang minningga!’

verses.name: Luke 13:26
verses.text: Jari yukbi, ‘Takalipatnu bahā' kami? Bay kami dakakanan maka ka'a. Bay ka amandu' ma lahat kami.’

verses.name: Luke 13:27
verses.text: Sagō' balikanna du bay llingna ma ka'am, yukna, ‘Haka'anta kam, mbal kata'uwanku bang kam minningga. Ala'an kam min aku, ka'am kamemon maghinang kala'atan ilu!’

verses.name: Luke 13:28
verses.text: Manjari magalud du kam, magtage'ot isab emponbi ma waktu ina'an bang ta'nda'bi ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi disi Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub, sampay saga kanabi-nabihan kamemon wa'i bay pinasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan. Malaingkan ka'am ya nilarukan paluwas.

verses.name: Luke 13:29
verses.text: Patimuk du isab pina'an saga a'a min mpat pidjū alam ati magtingkō'an sigām maina'an bo' magjamu ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 13:30
verses.text: Pata'u kam, aniya' saga a'a taramuli ma buwattina'an, pinarahū du ma sinosōng. Maka aniya' saga a'a makarahū ma buwattina'an, pinaramuli isab ma waktu sinōng.”  <div eID="gen5685" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5683" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2648"/><div sID="gen5686" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lasa si Isa ma saga A'a Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.23.37-Matt.23.39">Matiyu 23:37-39</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2648"/> Manjari ma waktu ina'an, aniya' pina'an ni si Isa saga a'a Parisi. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan, subay ka ala'an minnitu sabab sultan Herod inān bilahi amapatay ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2649"/><div sID="gen5688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2649"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Pehē' kam angahaka'an si Herod pangangakkal inān bang ai hinangku. Llaw itu maka salung landu'anku hinangku amala'an saitan min baran a'a, sampay amauli' saga a'a asaki. Ati ma llaw kat'lluna atangbus e'ku hinangku.

verses.name: Luke 13:33
verses.text: Sagō' subay aku palanjal ni pal'ngngananku llaw itu maka salung sampay isab ni kasimuddayan. Halam du aniya' la'at makani-aku maitu sabab Awrusalam ya lahat pamapatayan kaheka'an saga nabi.”  <div eID="gen5688" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2650"/><div sID="gen5689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2650"/> Sakali magkarukka'an si Isa ma pasal da'ira Awrusalam. “Arōy!” yukna. “Ka'am saga a'a Awrusalam, makasusa ko' kam ilu! Saga nabi min Tuhan hal papataybi. Saga sosoho'an Tuhan isab hal bantungbi bang sigām pinapi'ilu ni ka'am. Min pila aku bay bilahi animuk ka'am ma sabakanku? Sali' sapantun manuk d'nda bang pasabakna anak-anakna ma deyo' pikpikna. Sagō' mbal kam bilahi.

verses.name: Luke 13:35
verses.text: Nda'unbi na, asiya-siya du langgalbi e' Tuhan. Maka haka'anta kam, song na aku mbal ta'nda'bi sat'ggol halam ta'abut waktu pananglitbi aku. Subay yukbi, ‘Bang pa'in binarakatan iya pinapi'itu kawakilan e' Tuhan,’ bo' yampa aku ta'nda'bi.”  <div eID="gen5689" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.13"/> <div eID="gen5686" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2651"/><div sID="gen5690" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Luma' A'a Parisi</title> <div sID="gen5691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2651"/> Ma dakayu' Sabtu', pina'an si Isa amangan ma luma' dakayu' nakura' Parisi abantug. Jari maina'an pa'in, pinatongan iya e' saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 14:2
verses.text: Aniya' isab ma tongod si Isa a'a taga-saki, am'ngkong tape'-tanganna.

verses.name: Luke 14:3
verses.text: Atilaw si Isa ni saga guru sara' agama inān maka ni saga Parisi, yukna, “Bang kita saupama amauli' saki a'a ma llaw Sabtu', langgal sara' agamatam bahā', atawa mbal?”  <div eID="gen5691" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2652"/><div sID="gen5692" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2652"/> Sagō' halam sigām anambung. Jari ni'ntanan e' si Isa a'a asaki inān ati pinauli' e'na bo' yampa papole'na.

verses.name: Luke 14:5
verses.text: Puwas e' atilaw si Isa ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Bang saupama aniya' anakbi atawa sapi'bi ahūg ni deyom lowang ma llaw paghali, ai hinangbi? Tantu ngā'bi pinaluwas min deyom lowang e' minsan pasabu ma llaw paghali.”

verses.name: Luke 14:6
verses.text: Jari halam aniya' panganjawab sigām.  <div eID="gen5692" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2653"/><div sID="gen5693" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2653"/> Tapandoga e' si Isa bowahan saga a'a maglurukan pina'an. Amene' sigām magtūy paningkō'an ahāp ya tōp ma a'a bangsahan, angkan buwattitu pamaralilanna ma sigām, yuk-i,

verses.name: Luke 14:8
verses.text: “Bang kam ganta' niabbit paluruk ni pagkawinan, da'a kam magtūy aningkō' ma kōkan, ma paningkō'an ahāp. Kalu aniya' a'a bangsahan gi' min ka'am bay sinō' paluruk.

verses.name: Luke 14:9
verses.text: Jari pi'ilu ni ka'am a'a tag-hinangan, ya bay angabbit ka'am karuwangan paluruk pehē', ati yukna, ‘Papinda ka minnilu bo' patingkō'un lagi' a'a itu.’ Jari kaiya'-iya'an kam ati papinda kam aningkō' ni tape'an.

verses.name: Luke 14:10
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam sinō' paluruk, aningkō' kam magtūy ma tape'an. Jari pi'ilu du ni ka'am tag-hinangan ati yukna ni ka'am, ‘Bagay, papinda ka ni kōkan, ni paningkō'an labi ahāp.’ Manjari ta'nda' kam e' saga luruk inān kamemon in ka'am patut pinagaddatan.

verses.name: Luke 14:11
verses.text: Sabab hatina sasuku maglanga-langa di-na pinareyo' du. Maka sasuku magpatireyo' di-na pinalanga du.”  <div eID="gen5693" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2654"/><div sID="gen5694" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2654"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni a'a bay angabbit iya amangan ma luma'na, yukna, “Na, ka'a isab, bagay, bang ka angahinang pagjamuhan, da'a soho'un paluruk saga bagaynu, atawa saga danakannu, atawa kahekanu, atawa lūng-kampungnu dayahan. Sabab bang sigām ya sō'nu paluruk, ya du ka'a sinō' paluruk e' sigām ma waktu dakayu'. Jari katungbasan ka magtūy.

verses.name: Luke 14:13
verses.text: Saguwā' bang ka ganta' angahinang pagjamuhan, ya soho'nu paluruk subay saga a'a miskin maka a'a pengka', a'a aku'il maka a'a abuta.

verses.name: Luke 14:14
verses.text: Bang itu hinangnu, aheya du kahāpannu sabab halam aniya' ai-ai sigām panungbas ma ka'a. Tuhan ya anungbasan ka'a ma llaw damuli, ma waktu pamakallum pabalik saga a'a abontol.”  <div eID="gen5694" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5690" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2655"/><div sID="gen5695" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Jamuhan Aheya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.1-Matt.22.10">Matiyu 22:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5696" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2655"/> Takale pa'in bissala si Isa itu e' a'a dangan ya amangan maina'an, magtūy iya ah'lling, yukna, “Saga a'a palamud magjamu ma deyom pagparintahan Tuhan, aheya asal kahāpan sigām.”  <div eID="gen5696" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2656"/><div sID="gen5697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2656"/> Anambung si Isa, kissa pamaralilan lagi', yukna, “Aniya' a'a bay magsakap jamuhan aheya, ati aheka a'a bay abbitna paluruk.

verses.name: Luke 14:17
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in llaw pagjamu, sinoho' ipatanna pehē' amata'uwan saga a'a bay ta'abbitna. ‘Dai' na kam,’ yuk ipatan e'. ‘Sakap na kamemon.’

verses.name: Luke 14:18
verses.text: Saguwā' sali'-sali' sigām kamemon magpanumagal. Yuk a'a ya papehē'anna tagna', ‘Mbal aku makaluruk sabab aniya' tana' bay b'lliku subay nda'ku dahū. Pehē'ku lagi'.’

verses.name: Luke 14:19
verses.text: Yuk a'a dangan, ‘Bay na aku makab'lli saga sapi' paga'araru, sangpū' hekana. Subay sulayanku gi' kosog sigām. Pehē'ku gi'.’

verses.name: Luke 14:20
verses.text: Yuk isab a'a dangan, ‘Baha'u aku bay kinawin, angkan aku mbal makaluruk.’

verses.name: Luke 14:21
verses.text: Manjari amole' ipatan inān angahaka'an nakura'na. Ap'ddi' to'ongan atay nakura' he', ati yukna ma ipatanna, ‘Pasa'ut ka pehē' ni saga lān aluha maka lān akiput ya paglalabayan a'a ma da'ira itu. Bowahun pi'itu saga miskin, saga a'a aku'il, saga a'a buta maka saga a'a pengka'.’

verses.name: Luke 14:22
verses.text: Jari pehē' iya. Makapole' pa'in, ah'lling iya ni nakura'na, yuk-i, ‘Tahinangku na bay panoho'annu-i sagō' masi gi' aniya' paningkō'an ma pagjamuhan.’

verses.name: Luke 14:23
verses.text: Yuk nakura', ‘Pehē' ka ni paglalabayan a'a ma deya, ati logosun saga a'a pi'itu bo' supaya ap'nno' luma'ku.

verses.name: Luke 14:24
verses.text: Sabab haka'anta kam,’ yukna, ‘in a'a bay ta'abbitku dahū, halam aniya' min sigām makananam saga kinakan bay sakapku.’ ”  <div eID="gen5697" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5695" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2657"/><div sID="gen5698" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pameya' ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.10.37-Matt.10.38">Matiyu 10:37-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2657"/> Palanjal isab si Isa ni pal'ngngananna maka landu' aheka a'a ameya' parongan ma iya. Manjari harapna sigām ati yukna,

verses.name: Luke 14:26
verses.text: “Bang aniya' a'a bilahi ameya' ma aku nihinang mulidku, ya lasana ma aku subay palabi min lasana ma ina'-mma'na maka ma anak-h'ndana, sampay ma saga danakanna l'lla-d'nda. Minsan lasana ma baranna subay mbal palabi min lasana ma aku. Bang ngga'i ka buwattē' lasana mbal iya manjari mulidku.

verses.name: Luke 14:27
verses.text: Subay paglilla'na kabinasahan sampay ni kamatay ma sabab pameya'na ma aku. Ya sapantunna a'a ananggung hāgna pamapatayan iya. Bang mbal akuhanna, mbal iya manjari mulidku.  <div eID="gen5699" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2658"/><div sID="gen5700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2658"/> “Bang saupama aniya' ma ka'am bilahi angahinang luma' pamantawan, subay iya amikil-mikil dahū bo' tabista bang pila gastuna, ati kata'uwanna bang maka'abut sīnna pangahinang luma' inān atawa mbal.

verses.name: Luke 14:29
verses.text: Sabab bang taosol na hāg, bo' mbal maka'abut sīnna pangubusna luma', pinagtunggīngan iya e' a'a kamemon ang'nda' pina'an.

verses.name: Luke 14:30
verses.text: Yuk sigām, ‘A'a itu bay makalandu' angahinang luma' sagō' mbal taubusna.’  <div eID="gen5700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2659"/><div sID="gen5701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2659"/> Atawa bang saupama aniya' sultan sangpū' ngibu sundaluna, song palanjal magbono' maka sultan saddī, aningkō' gi' iya dahū amikil-mikil bang tara'ugna sultan dakayu' inān, ya taga-sundalu duwampū' ngibu hekana.

verses.name: Luke 14:32
verses.text: Bang hati mbal tara'ugna, magtūy iya amabeya' suluhan pasampang ni sultan dakayu' ma masi gi' atala, bo' mikipagkahāp.

verses.name: Luke 14:33
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “subay kam amikil-mikil dahū sabab mbal kam manjari mulidku bang kam mbal maglilla' anaikutan kaniya'bi kamemon.”  <div eID="gen5701" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5698" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2660"/><div sID="gen5702" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Asin Halam Aniya' Nanamna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.5.13">Matiyu 5:13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.50">Markus 9:50</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2660"/> Magparalilan na isab si Isa, yukna, “Kata'uwanbi, ahāp asal asin sagō' halam aniya' pamabalik nanamna bang magtinu' na.

verses.name: Luke 14:35
verses.text: Halam na aniya' kagunahanna. Mbal minsan taguna panambal tana' atawa pangalamud ni tai' hayop, hal tinimanan sadja. Na,” yuk si Isa, “sasuku kam makakale, kalehunbi to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen5703" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.14"/> <div eID="gen5702" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2661"/><div sID="gen5704" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bili-bili Alungay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.18.12-Matt.18.14">Matiyu 18:12-14</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2661"/> Ma dakayu' llaw aheka saga a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta maka saga a'a baldusa kasehe' patimuk pina'an ni si Isa sabab bilahi akale ma pandu'na.

verses.name: Luke 15:2
verses.text: Manjari saga Parisi maka saga guru sara' agama magdugal na, yuk-i, “A'a itu anaima' saga a'a baldusa, magsalu isab maka sigām!”

verses.name: Luke 15:3
verses.text: Angkan binissala e' si Isa kissa pamaralilan itu, yukna.  <div eID="gen5705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2662"/><div sID="gen5706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2662"/> “Bang saupama aniya' ma ka'am taga-bili-bili dahatus hekana, bo' wa'i alungay dakayu', ai bahā' hinangna? Tantu pasagaranna siyampū' maka siyam maina'an ma deya bo' yampa pehē' amiha dakayu' ya alungay sat'ggol mbal tabākna.

verses.name: Luke 15:5
verses.text: Tabākna pa'in, tinanggung e'na tudju amole' maka e'na kinōgan sidda.

verses.name: Luke 15:6
verses.text: Pagt'kkana ni luma', magtūy lingananna saga bagayna maka kakampunganna. Soho'na sigām magtimuk ati yukna ma sigām, ‘Maglami-lami kitam sabab tabākku na bili-biliku bay alungay.’

verses.name: Luke 15:7
verses.text: Damikiyanna,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' a'a dangan magsusun sampay ang'bba min dusana, aheya kalasigan ma deyom sulga'. In kalasigan ina'an palabi lagi' min kalasigan ma siyampū' maka siyam a'a abontol ya halam aniya' dusa sigām pinagsusunan.”  <div eID="gen5706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5704" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2663"/><div sID="gen5707" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dublun Alungay</title> <div sID="gen5708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2663"/> “Saupama isab,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' d'nda taga-dublun sangpū' hekana, bo' alungay dakayu', ai bahā' hinangna? Tantu iya anū' palita'an magtūy bo' sapuhanna deyom luma' ati pihana pahāp-hāp sampay tabākna.

verses.name: Luke 15:9
verses.text: Jari bang tabākna na, nilinganan e'na bagayna maka kakampunganna. Sinō' sigām magtimuk ati yukna ma sigām, ‘Maglami-lami kitam sabab tabākku na dublunku bay alungay.’

verses.name: Luke 15:10
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab,” yuk si Isa, “aheya kakōgan ma saga mala'ikat Tuhan bang a'a dakayu' a'a magsusun sampay ang'bba min dusana.”  <div eID="gen5708" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5707" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2664"/><div sID="gen5709" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anak L'lla Alungay</title> <div sID="gen5710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2664"/> Anuli-nuli gi' si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' inān dakayu' a'a taga-anak duwa l'lla.

verses.name: Luke 15:12
verses.text: Dakayu' llaw ah'lling anak siyali ni mma'na, yukna, ‘Mma', bahagi'un na alta'nu ati pamuwanun ma aku bahagi'ku.’ Jari binahagi' e' matto'a inān kaniya'na ma anakna karuwangan.

verses.name: Luke 15:13
verses.text: Mbal at'ggol, pinab'llihan e' siyali itu bahagi'na ati binowa e'na b'llihanna ni lahat atala. Mahē' pa'in iya, pinaka'at e'na sīnna kamemon ma ai-ai kanapsuhanna.

verses.name: Luke 15:14
verses.text: Sakali itu, pagubus na sīnna kamemon, ginotom sidda lahat inān. Manjari aheya na kasukkalanna,

verses.name: Luke 15:15
verses.text: angkan iya pehē' ni dakayu' a'a ma lahat inān bo' magpatiata ma iya. Jari sinoho' iya e' a'a inān pehē' ni humana angipat saga bawi.

verses.name: Luke 15:16
verses.text: Na, pagka mbal kasandalan lingantuna, bilahi iya amangan minsan kinakan bawi sagō' halam aniya' bay amuwanan iya minsan ai.  <div eID="gen5710" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2665"/><div sID="gen5711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2665"/> “Daipara tasayuna karupanganna angkan yukna ma deyom atayna, ‘Saga ipatan mma'ku he' maglabi-labi kinakan sigām, sagō' aku itu itiya' na song amatay e' otas.

verses.name: Luke 15:18
verses.text: Gom na aku amole' pehē' ni si Mma'. Yukku ma iya, “Mma', taga-dusa aku ni Tuhan sampay ni ka'a.

verses.name: Luke 15:19
verses.text: Mbal na aku manjari ōnannu anak. Bistahun aku sali' hal dakayu' tendognu.” ’

verses.name: Luke 15:20
verses.text: Jari pabuhat iya min baina bo' pal'ngngan tudju ni mma'na pabīng. <div eID="gen5711" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5712" type="paragraph"/> “Sagō' atā-tā lagi' iya min luma', ta'nda' iya e' mma'na. Ma'ase' to'ongan mma'na ati paragan pehē' bo' gapusna maka siyumna.

verses.name: Luke 15:21
verses.text: Yuk anakna inān ma iya, ‘Mma', taga-dusa aku ni Tuhan sampay ni ka'a. Mbal na aku manjari ōnannu anak.’

verses.name: Luke 15:22
verses.text: Sagō' nilinganan e' mma' inān saga ipatanna. Yukna ma sigām, ‘Pal'kkas kam. Bowahunbi pi'itu badju' kapuspusan ahāp ati pabadju'inbi iya itu. Pasingsinginbi isab, maka pataumpa'inbi.

verses.name: Luke 15:23
verses.text: Puwas e' pehē' kam angā' anak sapi' ya bay pal'mmokta he', bo' sumbali'unbi. Magjamu kitam, maka maglami-lami.

verses.name: Luke 15:24
verses.text: Sabab anakku itu bay niyatku amatay, sagō' itiya' na allum pabīng. Pangannalku bay na alungay sagō' itu na tapole'.’ Manjari anagna' sigām maglami-lami.  <div eID="gen5712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2666"/><div sID="gen5713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2666"/> “Na, pasalta' pa'in itu-i, in anak siyaka wa'i magusaha ma huma. Ma labayan pa'in iya tudju amole' bo' asekot-sekot na ni luma', aniya' takalena magkulintangan maka magpangigal ma deyom luma'.

verses.name: Luke 15:26
verses.text: Nilinganan e'na dakayu' ipatan bo' tilawna bang magay ma luma' he'.

verses.name: Luke 15:27
verses.text: Yuk ipatan, ‘Tapole' na siyalinu, maka bay sinō' e' mma'nu sinumbali' anak sapi' ya pinal'mmok inān, sabab at'kka na anakna ma halam aniya' baya-bayana.’

verses.name: Luke 15:28
verses.text: Sagō' akagit atay magtūy anak siyaka he', ya angkan mbal bilahi pasōd ni deyom luma'. Paluwas mma'na angamu' iya pasōd sagō' mbal iya.

verses.name: Luke 15:29
verses.text: Yukna ni mma'na, ‘Nda'un, Mma', ma tahunan na aku maghinang ma ka'a sali' banyaga'nu. Halam aniya' panoho'annu minsan dakayu' bay sagga'ku, sagō' halam aku bay buwanannu minsan la'a dakayu' anak kambing supaya aku makapagjamu maka saga bagayku.

verses.name: Luke 15:30
verses.text: Talkala' makapole' pa'in pi'itu anaknu ilu, magtūy sumbali'annu anak sapi' pinal'mmok e', minsan bay paka'atna alta'nu panambana saga d'nda maghinang ala'at.’

verses.name: Luke 15:31
verses.text: Anambung mma'na, yukna, ‘Otō', kakkal du ka ma aku, maka suku'nu asal kaniya'ku itu kamemon.

verses.name: Luke 15:32
verses.text: Patut du bang kita maglami-lami maka magkalasigan sabab allum du siyalinu ya bay niyatta amatay-i. Pangannalta alungay sagō' tapole' na iya.’ ”  <div eID="gen5713" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.15"/> <div eID="gen5709" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2667"/><div sID="gen5714" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Magmandul Ataha' Akkalna</title> <div sID="gen5715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2667"/> Manjari itu amissala gi' si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Aniya' a'a dayahan maka aniya' isab magmandul ma alta'na. Manjari tinuntutan magmandul itu in iya kono' hal amaka'at alta' nakura'na.

verses.name: Luke 16:2
verses.text: Angkan tinambukuhan magmandul inān e' nakura', sinō' patampal ni iya. Yuk nakura', ‘Ai bahā' takaleku pasal ka'a itu? Bistahun kamemon bay pangandolku ma ka'a, sabab mbal na ka magmandulan alta'ku.’

verses.name: Luke 16:3
verses.text: Amikil-mikilan di-na magmandul itu, yukna, ‘Ai tahinangku buwattina'an sabab itiya' na aku pinala'an min bay hinangku. Mbal na aku makakole' magkalga, maka aiya' aku angamu' sin.

verses.name: Luke 16:4
verses.text: Ā, kata'uwanku na bang ai subay hinangku supaya aniya' bagay angokoman aku bang aku pinala'an na min hinangku.’  <div eID="gen5715" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2668"/><div sID="gen5716" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2668"/> “Jari nilinganan e'na saga a'a taga-utang ma nakura'na, dangan maka dangan. Yukna ni a'a dahū pina'an ni iya, ‘Pila utangnu ma nakura'ku?’  <div eID="gen5716" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2669"/><div sID="gen5717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2669"/> “Ya sambungna, ‘Dahatus mital ns'llan pagb'lla.’ <div eID="gen5717" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5718" type="paragraph"/> “Yuk mandul ma iya, ‘Ā, itiya' katasnu. Pasa'ut ka aningkō', sulatun limampū' mital sadja.’

verses.name: Luke 16:7
verses.text: Yukna isab ni a'a taga-utang pasunu', ‘Ka'a, pila utangnu?’ <div eID="gen5718" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5719" type="paragraph"/> “Yuk a'a he', ‘Dahatus karut pai-tirigu.’ <div eID="gen5719" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5720" type="paragraph"/> “Yuk mandul ma iya, ‘Itiya' katasnu. Sulatun mailu walumpū' karut sadja.’  <div eID="gen5720" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2670"/><div sID="gen5721" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2670"/> “Na, makakale pa'in nakura' pasal hinang sosoho'anna angakkal itu, magtūy sanglitanna ma sabab kataha' akkalna.” Yuk si Isa isab, “Saga a'a mbal ameya' ma Tuhan, ataha' gi' akkal sigām min saga a'a ya ameya' ma Tuhan, sabab ata'u sigām anguntungan pagkahi sigām.  <div eID="gen5721" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2671"/><div sID="gen5722" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2671"/> “Angkan pituwahanta kam,” yuk si Isa, “paggunahunbi alta'bi maitu ma dunya bo' supaya kam makabāk bagay. Manjari bang ta'abut waktu kahalam alta'bi, tinaima' du kam mahē' ma paglahatanbi kakkal.

verses.name: Luke 16:10
verses.text: Bang a'a kapangandolan ma alta' ariki', kapangandolan du isab ma alta' aheya. Damikiyanna isab bang a'a mbal pangandolan ma alta' ariki', mbal isab kapangandolan ma alta' aheya.

verses.name: Luke 16:11
verses.text: Na, abila kam pinasuku'an alta' maitu ma dunya itu, bo' mbal kapangandolan, mbal du pinangandol ma ka'am alta' b'nnal.

verses.name: Luke 16:12
verses.text: Maka bang kam mbal kapangandolan ang'ntan alta' ngga'i ka suku'bi, mbal du pangandol ma ka'am alta' ya dī palsuku'anbi.  <div eID="gen5722" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2672"/><div sID="gen5723" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2672"/> “Halam aniya' ipatan makapagduwa nakura' sabab tantu kab'nsihanna nakura' dakayu' maka kalasahanna dakayu'. Amalut iya ma dakayu' ati taikutanna dakayu'. Hatina mbal kam manjari maghinang ma Tuhan bang pilak ya paheyabi ma atay.”  <div eID="gen5723" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5714" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2673"/><div sID="gen5724" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandu' si Isa Kasehe'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.11.12-Matt.11.13">Matiyu 11:12-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.5.31-Matt.5.32">5:31-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.11-Mark.10.12">Markus 10:11-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5725" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2673"/> Takale pa'in pandu' si Isa itu e' saga Parisi, magtūy iya tinittowahan e' sigām sabab napsuhan sigām ma pilak.

verses.name: Luke 16:15
verses.text: Sagō' ah'lling si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Ka'am ilu hal magbontol-bontol di-bi ma pang'nda' a'a, sagō' kinata'uwan asal deyom ataybi e' Tuhan. Ya pinahalga' ma atay e' manusiya' halam du aniya' kagunahanna bang ma Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5725" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2674"/><div sID="gen5726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2674"/> Yukna isab, “Ma waktu halam gi' pi'itu si Yahiya Magpapandi, ya na pa'in pinagnasihat usulan sara' bay pang'bba e' si Musa maka sulat bay tasulat e' kanabi-nabihan. Sagō' buwattina'an, sangay min waktu kapi'itu si Yahiya sampay ni llaw itu, ya pinagnasihat lapal ahāp pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Ati amanuyu' to'ongan saga a'a kamemon pasōd ni deyom pagparintahanna.

verses.name: Luke 16:17
verses.text: Sagō' in sara' bay pang'bba e' si Musa mbal du apinda kapatutna. Aluhay gi' nilanyapan dunya itu maka langit, min dakayu' balis ma sara' pinindahan.”  <div eID="gen5726" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2675"/><div sID="gen5727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2675"/> Yukna isab, “Sai-sai animanan h'ndana bo' angah'nda saddī, taga-dusa iya angaliyu-lakad min h'ndana po'on. Maka sai-sai angah'nda bitu'anun taga-dusa isab buwattē'.”  <div eID="gen5727" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5724" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2676"/><div sID="gen5728" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Dayahan maka si Lasarus</title> <div sID="gen5729" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2676"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' a'a dayahan asal mags'mmek ahalga', maka ahāp sadja kinakanna sakahaba' llaw.

verses.name: Luke 16:20
verses.text: Aniya' isab a'a miskin ōnna si Lasarus, aliput baranna e' dugsul. Ya kabiyaksahanna binowa iya palege ma atag lawang luma' a'a dayahan inān.

verses.name: Luke 16:21
verses.text: Sabab aholat iya kabuwanan l'bbi kinakan bang aniya' apakpak min pagkakanan a'a dayahan. Pehē' isab saga ero' angandelatan ba'anan dugsulna.  <div eID="gen5729" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2677"/><div sID="gen5730" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2677"/> “Manjari amatay miskin itu ati binowa iya e' saga mala'ikat ni deyom sulga', ni pangayurahan si Ibrahim. Puwas e' amatay isab a'a dayahan ati kinubul.

verses.name: Luke 16:23
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in ma ahirat, kap'ddi'an to'ongan a'a dayahan e'. Jari pahangad iya ati ta'nda'na si Ibrahim mahē' ma kalawakan, maka si Lasarus isab mahē' ma bihingna.

verses.name: Luke 16:24
verses.text: Angkan iya angalingan magtūy ni si Ibrahim. ‘O mbo' Ibrahim,’ yukna, ‘ma'ase' ka ma aku! Soho'un si Lasarus pi'itu. Bang pa'in t'nno'anna hal tōng tudlu'na ni deyom bohe' bo' p'ttakanna ni d'lla'ku, sabab kap'ddi'an aku to'ongan ma deyom api itu.’  <div eID="gen5730" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2678"/><div sID="gen5731" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2678"/> “Sagō' anambung si Ibrahim. ‘Oto',’ yukna, ‘entomun jaman bay kallumnu lagi'. Bay ka pinaniya'an kahāpan indaginis, bo' si Lasarus ya bay pinaniya'an kala'atan. Sagō' ma buwattina'an itiya' iya taga-palasahan ahāp, bo' ka'a ya kabinasahan.

verses.name: Luke 16:26
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka hal ilu-i, sabab aniya' butasan alalom pinat'nna' ma llotantam angkan sai-sai bilahi pi'ilu minnitu, mbal makalintas. Damikiyanna, halam aniya' minnilu makalintas pi'itu.’  <div eID="gen5731" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2679"/><div sID="gen5732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2679"/> “Yuk a'a dayahan e', ‘Na, bang buwattilu, mbo', ya amu'ku junjung ni ka'a: sō'un sadja si Lasarus ilu pehē' ni luma' mma'ku,

verses.name: Luke 16:28
verses.text: sabab aniya' lima danakanku l'lla mahē'. Soho'un sigām pinituwahan ma si Lasarus bo' mbal pi'itu ni lahat pangananaman p'ddi' itu.’  <div eID="gen5732" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2680"/><div sID="gen5733" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2680"/> “Yuk si Ibrahim, ‘Ina'an ma sigām kasulatan si Musa maka kanabi-nabihan pamituwa sigām. Ya na ina'an subay ni'ikut e' sigām.’  <div eID="gen5733" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2681"/><div sID="gen5734" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2681"/> “Yuk a'a dayahan, ‘Mbal sigām angikut, mbo'. Saguwā' bang aniya' pina'an ni sigām a'a bay amatay pabungkal na min kamatay, tantu du sigām ang'bba min dusa sigām.’  <div eID="gen5734" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2682"/><div sID="gen5735" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2682"/> “Yuk sambung si Ibrahim, ‘Bang mbal tabeya' e' sigām bay tasulat e' si Musa maka kanabi-nabihan, mbal sigām tabowa am'nnal minsan aniya' a'a pabungkal min kamatayna.’ ”  <div eID="gen5735" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.16"/> <div eID="gen5728" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2683"/><div sID="gen5736" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Amowa Pagkahina Magdusa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.18.6-Matt.18.7">Matiyu 18:6-7</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.18.21-Matt.18.22">21-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.9.42">Markus 9:42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2683"/> Amandu' lagi' si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Tantu aniya' sasat-manasat paniya' na pa'in ma manusiya' makaparusa sigām. Saguwā' maka'ase'-ase' sidda ya pamakadal ma sasuku anasat sehe'na amowa magdusa, sabab bininasa du iya e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 17:2
verses.text: Ahāp lagi' a'a inān pinagantungan batu abuhat ma k'llongna bo' yampa nihūg ni timbang, bang pa'in da'a kalandu'an hinangna magparusa ma dakayu' a'a areyo' itu, ya taga-pangandol ma aku.

verses.name: Luke 17:3
verses.text: Angkan kam soho'ku subay kamaya'-maya',” yukna. <div eID="gen5737" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5738" type="paragraph"/> “Bang aniya' pagkahinu ganta' makabuwan dusa ma ka'a, subay iya tō'annu bang ai dusana. Jari bang pagsusunanna dusana sampay bbahanna, subay iya ampunnu.

verses.name: Luke 17:4
verses.text: Bang min pitu' iya makabuwan dusa ma ka'a ma deyom dang'llaw, ati min pitu' iya magni-ka'a angamu' ampun, subay iya ampunnu.”  <div eID="gen5738" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5736" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2684"/><div sID="gen5739" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangandol</title> <div sID="gen5740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2684"/> Manjari ah'lling ni Panghū' Isa saga mulidna bay kawakilanna. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan, pakosogun kono' pangandol kami tudju ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2685"/><div sID="gen5741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2685"/> Yuk Panghū', “Abila bay makasali' heya pangandolbi ni buwat heya bigi-tinanom landu' anahut, makajari kam magpanoho'an ma kayu aheya itu, yukbi, ‘Pabubut ka minnilu bo' ka pat'nna' ni deyom s'llang.’ Jari bineya' du buwat yukbi he'.”  <div eID="gen5741" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2686"/><div sID="gen5742" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2686"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Bang saupama aniya' sosoho'anbi, ya hinangna magararu ma tana'bi atawa magipat saga hayopbi bili-bili. Bang iya tapole' min paghinanganna, ah'lling bahā' kam ma iya, ‘Dai' na ka amangan’?

verses.name: Luke 17:8
verses.text: Tantu mbal. Gom pa'in yukbi, ‘Adjalun kinakanku bo' yampa ka asalin amuhatan aku. Subay na aku aubus amangan bo' yampa ka'a!’

verses.name: Luke 17:9
verses.text: Magsukul kam bahā' ma sosoho'anbi pagga hinangna panoho'anbi? Tantu mbal.

verses.name: Luke 17:10
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am ilu bang hinangbi kamemon bay panoho'an ka'am, subay yukbi, ‘Kami itu hal sosoho'an. Patut kami maghinang ai-ai ya panoho'an ma kami.’ ”  <div eID="gen5742" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5739" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2687"/><div sID="gen5743" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sangpū' A'a Ni'ipul Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2687"/> Manjari itu, ma pal'ngnganan pa'in si Isa tudju ni Awrusalam, palabay iya min llot lahat Samariya maka lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Luke 17:12
verses.text: Pagt'kkana pa'in ni dakayu' kauman, aniya' pasampang ni iya sangpū' a'a ni'ipul. An'ngge sigām ma kalawakan lagi'

verses.name: Luke 17:13
verses.text: angalingan minnē'. Yuk sigām, “O Isa! Tuwan! Ma'ase' na ka ma kami.”  <div eID="gen5744" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2688"/><div sID="gen5745" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2688"/> Pag'nda' si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Pehē' kam patūy ni saga imam bo' palilingunbi baranbi ma sigām, ta'nda' in ka'am kauli'an na.” Sakali itu, pasalta' sigām pal'ngngan pehē' ni imam, na, kauli'an na.

verses.name: Luke 17:15
verses.text: Jari aniya' dangan min kasangpū' inān, tananamna pa'in in iya kauli'an na, pabīng iya magtūy maka atanog e'na ananglitan Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 17:16
verses.text: Pasujud iya ni si Isa magsukul ni iya. A'a itu bangsa Samariya asal.

verses.name: Luke 17:17
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Sangpū' puhu' kam bay kauli'an. Ma'ai na siyam-i?

verses.name: Luke 17:18
verses.text: Angay hal a'a liyu itu ya pabalik pi'itu magsukul ni Tuhan?”

verses.name: Luke 17:19
verses.text: Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni a'a Samariya he', yukna, “An'ngge na ka bo' ka palanjal na. Kauli'an ka ma sabab pangandolnu.”  <div eID="gen5745" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5743" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2689"/><div sID="gen5746" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapagparinta Tuhan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.23-Matt.24.28">Matiyu 24:23-28</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.24.37-Matt.24.41">37-41</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5747" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2689"/> Ma dakayu' llaw aniya' saga Parisi atilaw si Isa bang sumiyan waktu pamat'nna' e' Tuhan pagparintana ma manusiya'. Yuk sambung si Isa, “Bang pat'nna' pi'itu pagparinta Tuhan mbal ta'nda' kapi'ituna.

verses.name: Luke 17:21
verses.text: Halam du aniya' ah'lling, ‘Nda'unbi, itiya' maitu pagparintahan Tuhan!’ atawa ‘Ina'an na maina'an!’ Sababna ilu na parinta Tuhan ma deyomanbi.”  <div eID="gen5747" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2690"/><div sID="gen5748" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2690"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Aniya' du llaw ma sinosōng in ka'am ilu bilahi to'ongan ang'nda' aku, Anak Manusiya'. Bilahi kam ang'nda' minsan ma dang'llaw sadja. Sagō' mbal gi' ta'nda'bi.

verses.name: Luke 17:23
verses.text: Aniya' a'a angahaka'an ka'am, yukna, ‘Ina'an iya maina'an!’ atawa ‘Itiya' iya maitu!’ Sagō' da'a kam pehē' amiha aku.

verses.name: Luke 17:24
verses.text: Sabab bang ta'abut llaw kapi'itu Anak Manusiya' pabalik, ta'nda' du e' kamemon. Buwat du paka'nda' sigām ma lāt bang aninagan b'ttong langit min bihing paruwambila'.

verses.name: Luke 17:25
verses.text: Sagō' subay aku makananam kabinasahan aheya dahū gi' minnē'. Subay aku sinulak e' saga a'a ahil jaman itu bo' yampa ta'abut llaw kapi'ituku pabalik.

verses.name: Luke 17:26
verses.text: Jari bang ta'abut waktu ina'an-i, sali' du kahālanna maka kahālan bay ma masa si Nū. Bay sigām magkakanan na pa'in maka maginuman. Bay sigām magh'nda-magh'lla sampay ni llaw karuwa' disi Nū ni diyata' adjung. Manjari nilatapan dunya e' Tuhan ati magmula manusiya' kamemon. Na, buwattē' du isab ya kahālan manusiya' bang aku Anak Manusiya' pabīng ni dunya.  <div eID="gen5748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:27
verses.text: Jari bang ta'abut waktu ina'an-i, sali' du kahālanna maka kahālan bay ma masa si Nū. Bay sigām magkakanan na pa'in maka maginuman. Bay sigām magh'nda-magh'lla sampay ni llaw karuwa' disi Nū ni diyata' adjung. Manjari nilatapan dunya e' Tuhan ati magmula manusiya' kamemon. Na, buwattē' du isab ya kahālan manusiya' bang aku Anak Manusiya' pabīng ni dunya.  <div eID="gen5748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2691"/><div sID="gen5749" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2691"/> “Damikiyanna isab saga a'a bay ma jaman lagi' si Lōt. Magkakanan na pa'in sigām maka maginuman, magb'lli maka magdagang, magtanom maka maghinang luma'.

verses.name: Luke 17:29
