verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in waktu kapala'an si Lōt min da'ira Sodom e', magtūy aniya' api maka mailang pinatumbuk sali' ulan min deyom langit. Jari magmula saga a'a inān kamemon.  <div eID="gen5749" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2692"/><div sID="gen5750" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2692"/> “Na, buwattē' du isab kahālan saga a'a ma dunya itu bang ta'abut llaw pama'nda' aku, in Anak Manusiya' itu.

verses.name: Luke 17:31
verses.text: Pagt'kka llaw ina'an, bang aniya' a'a ganta' ma luwasan luma'na bo' aniya' palsuku'anna tabba ma deyom luma', subay mbal sōdna luma' inān. Damikiyanna isab bang aniya' a'a ma humana, subay mbal balikna luma'na.

verses.name: Luke 17:32
verses.text: Pamintānginbi ya bay pat'kka ni h'nda si Lōt bay ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Luke 17:33
verses.text: Sai-sai allogan kallum baranna, halam du aniya' kallumna taptap. Sagō' sai-sai mbal allogan baranna ma sababku, minsan iya amatay, makabāk du kallum kakkal.

verses.name: Luke 17:34
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “ma waktu pabalikku pi'itu, aniya' a'a duwangan atuli ma dakayu' du palegehan, jari niā' dakayu' inān ati tabba dakayu'.

verses.name: Luke 17:35
verses.text: Aniya' du inān duwangan d'nda magtabang anganggiling tirigu. Niā' dakayu' ati ta'bba dakayu'.

verses.name: Luke 17:36
verses.text: Aniya' isab duwangan maghinang ma huma. Niā' dakayu' ati tabba dakayu'.”  <div eID="gen5750" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2693"/><div sID="gen5751" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2693"/> Manjari tinilaw si Isa e' saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Tuwan, maingga pat'kkahan ya yuknu ilu?” <div eID="gen5751" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5752" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa magparalilan, yukna, “Ma'ingga-ma'ingga lahat aniya' patay, maina'an du pagtipunan saga owak.”  <div eID="gen5752" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.17"/> <div eID="gen5746" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2694"/><div sID="gen5753" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal Balu D'nda maka Huwis</title> <div sID="gen5754" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2694"/> Manjari aniya' paralilan pangissa e' si Isa ma saga mulidna supaya sigām mbal sinumu angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu.

verses.name: Luke 18:2
verses.text: Yukna, “Ma dakayu' lahat aniya' huwis mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan, mbal isab magaddat ma pagkahina manusiya'.

verses.name: Luke 18:3
verses.text: Aniya' isab ma lahat inān dakayu' d'nda balu. Na, d'nda itu taga-palkala' ati pehē' na pa'in ni huwis inān angamu' tabang. Angalogos iya mikipatuntul, yukna, ‘Tuwan, tabangin aku bo' mbal tara'ug e' kuntaraku.’

verses.name: Luke 18:4
verses.text: Tagna' mbal anabang huwis inān, sagō' pagt'ggol-t'ggol, ah'llingan iya di-na, yukna, ‘Aku itu mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan, mbal isab magaddat ma manusiya'.

verses.name: Luke 18:5
verses.text: Sagō' d'nda itu hal makasasaw pikilanku angkan subay tabanganku. Bang iya mbal dūlanku, sinumu du aku ma pagpi'ituna.’  <div eID="gen5754" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2695"/><div sID="gen5755" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2695"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “hatiunbi bay pah'lling huwis ya mbal abontol inān.

verses.name: Luke 18:7
verses.text: Mbal bahā' anabang Tuhan ma saga a'a tapene'na, ya angamu' tabang ni iya llaw-sangom? Magtanggu-tanggu gi' iya bahā' amatuntul ma sigām?

verses.name: Luke 18:8
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “al'kkas du e' Tuhan amatuntul sigām. Sagō' ma sinosōng, bang aku Anak Manusiya' pabalik pi'itu ni dunya, aniya' bahā' tabākku atotog angandol ma aku?”  <div eID="gen5755" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5753" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2696"/><div sID="gen5756" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Parisi maka A'a Maga'ā' Sukay Parinta</title> <div sID="gen5757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2696"/> Na, aniya' isab paralilan pinah'lling e' si Isa ma saga a'a ya amista di-sigām abontol ati amareyo'-deyo' ma saga a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 18:10
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “Aniya' duwangan a'a bay patukad pehē' ni langgal pagkulbanan bo' anambahayang. Dangan inān a'a Parisi, dangan a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta.

verses.name: Luke 18:11
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in sigām ma deyom langgal, an'ngge a'a Parisi dangan-danganna ati anambahayang iya ni Tuhan. Yukna, ‘O Tuhanku, aheya pagsukulanku ni ka'a. Sabab in aku itu mbal buwat a'a kasehe'an, ya napsuhan maka angulli' maka angaliyu-lakad min h'nda sigām. Magsukul isab aku in aku ngga'i ka buwat a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta itu.

verses.name: Luke 18:12
verses.text: Aku itu, min duwa magpuwasa ma deyom dapitu', maka jakatanku isab kamemon tausahaku.’  <div eID="gen5757" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2697"/><div sID="gen5758" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2697"/> “Sagō' in a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta inān wa'i an'ngge ma tōng langgal, mbal minsan paharap ni sulga'. Tin'ppak e'na daggahana kabowa susana. ‘O Tuhan,’ yukna, ‘ma'ase' pa'in ka ma aku sabab dusahan aku.’  <div eID="gen5758" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2698"/><div sID="gen5759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2698"/> “Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “amole' pa'in a'a duwangan min langgal, a'a magā' sukay ya abontol ma bistahan Tuhan, ngga'i ka a'a Parisi. Sababna sai-sai magpalanga ma baranna pinareyo' du, maka sai-sai magpareyo' di-na pinalanga du isab.”  <div eID="gen5759" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5756" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2699"/><div sID="gen5760" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kalasa si Isa ma Kamanahutan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.13-Matt.19.15">Matiyu 19:13-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.13-Mark.10.16">Markus 10:13-16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5761" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2699"/> Na, aniya' saga a'a amowa anak sigām ni si Isa bo' supaya pinat'nna'an tanganna. Pag'nda' itu e' saga mulidna, magtūy pinah'llingan e' sigām saga a'a amowa inān.

verses.name: Luke 18:16
verses.text: Manda' nilinganan onde'-onde' inān e' si Isa. Yukna ni saga mulidna, “Parūlunbi saga kamanahutan ilu pi'itu ni aku. Da'a sigām lāngunbi sabab sai-sai makasali' ni onde' itu taga-palsuku'an du ma pagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 18:17
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am, bang a'a mbal pasulut ma pagparinta Tuhan buwat kapasulut onde'-onde', na, a'a inān mbal makasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5761" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5760" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2700"/><div sID="gen5762" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Taga-Karaya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.19.16-Matt.19.30">Matiyu 19:16-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.17-Mark.10.31">Markus 10:17-31</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5763" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2700"/> Ma dakayu' llaw aniya' Yahudi alanga pehē' ni si Isa atilaw iya. “Tuwan Guru,” yukna, “ka'a ilu asal ahāp. Ai subay hinangku bo' kaniya'an kallum ya taptap ni kasaumulan?”  <div eID="gen5763" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2701"/><div sID="gen5764" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2701"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Angay yuknu in aku itu ahāp? Halam aniya' ahāp, luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'.

verses.name: Luke 18:20
verses.text: Kata'uwannu asal bay panoho'an Tuhan, da'a ka angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'nu. Da'a ka amono'. Da'a ka anangkaw. Da'a ka anaksi' puting. Pagaddatin ina'-mma'nu.”  <div eID="gen5764" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2702"/><div sID="gen5765" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2702"/> Yuk l'lla inān ni iya, “Tuwan, sangay min kaonde'-onde'ku bay kabogboganku ina'an-i kamemon.”  <div eID="gen5765" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2703"/><div sID="gen5766" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2703"/> Takale pa'in itu e' si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' gi' dakayu' halam tahinangnu. Pehē' ka, pab'llihin alta'nu kamemon bo' pamuwanun b'llihanna ma saga a'a miskin. Manjari aniya' du karayanu maina'an ma deyom sulga'. Puwas e', pi'itu ka ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: Sagō' pagkale a'a itu ma bissala si Isa magtūy iya asusa sidda sabab landu' aheka alta'na.  <div eID="gen5766" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2704"/><div sID="gen5767" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2704"/> Ta'nda' e' si Isa kasusana ati yukna ni iya, “Saga a'a dayahan kahunitan asal pasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan!

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: Kaluhayan gi' unta' palabay min buli' jalum min a'a dayahan pasōd ni deyoman pagparinta Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5767" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2705"/><div sID="gen5768" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2705"/> Takale pa'in lling si Isa itu e' saga a'a, yuk sigām, “Bang buwattē', sai bahā' makasampay ni kasalamatan ma deyom sulga'?”  <div eID="gen5768" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2706"/><div sID="gen5769" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2706"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ya mbal takole' e' manusiya' takole' du e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5769" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2707"/><div sID="gen5770" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2707"/> Sakali ah'lling si Petros, yukna, “Nda'un ba kami itu. Bay na bbahan kami ai-ai kamemon bo' ameya' ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5770" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2708"/><div sID="gen5771" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2708"/> “Aho',” yuk si Isa, “maka haka'anta kam to'ongan, sasuku bay ang'bbahan luma'na, atawa h'ndana, atawa danakanna, atawa ina'-mma'na, atawa panganakna, ma sabab katuyu'na ma pagparinta Tuhan,

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: tinungbasan du iya e' Tuhan ma dunya dakayu' itu, lipat manglipat min bay bbahanna. Ati ma ahirat pinasuku'an iya kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen5771" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5762" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2709"/><div sID="gen5772" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amissala si Isa Pabīng Pasal Kamatayna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.20.17-Matt.20.19">Matiyu 20:17-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.32-Mark.10.34">Markus 10:32-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2709"/> Manjari binowa e' si Isa mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa pasaddī min a'a kasehe'an bo' yampa sigām haka'anna. “Pakale kam,” yukna. “Itiya' na kitam patukad ni Awrusalam. Maina'an pa'in kitam, pinamattan du kamemon bay tasulat e' kanabi-nabihan ma pasalku, Anak Manusiya'.

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: Sinōngan aku ni pang'ntanan saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, ati pinagudju'-udju' aku e' sigām. Nihalipulu isab aku, pinagludja'an, pinagdaplosan maka pinapatay.

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in t'llumbahangi min kamatayku allum du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen5773" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2710"/><div sID="gen5774" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2710"/> Saguwā' halam tahati e' saga mulidna bang ai bissala si Isa inān. Halam makasobsob ni deyom pikilan sigām, maka halam tahati e' sigām bang ai pinah'lling e'na.  <div eID="gen5774" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5772" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2711"/><div sID="gen5775" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Buta Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.20.29-Matt.20.34">Matiyu 20:29-34</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.10.46-Mark.10.52">Markus 10:46-52</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5776" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2711"/> Manjari, asekot pa'in disi Isa ni da'ira Ariha, aniya' a'a buta aningkō' ma bihing lān palabayan sigām. Hinangna angamu' sīn.

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: Makakale pa'in buta itu ma ba'anan a'a maglaulabay minna'an, tinilaw e'na bang ai sababanna.

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: Nihaka'an iya e' saga a'a, yuk-i, “Ilu palabay si Isa, a'a min Nasaret.”  <div eID="gen5776" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2712"/><div sID="gen5777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2712"/> Pagkalena itu, magtūy iya angalingan pakosog. “O Isa,” yukna, “tubu' Sultan Da'ud, ma'ase' ka ba ma aku!”

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: Pinah'llingan iya e' saga a'a ma munda'an inān, sinō' iya da'a maghibuk. Sagō' pinakosog gom pa'in pangalinganna. “O Isa, tubu' Sultan Da'ud,” yukna, “ma'ase' na ka!”  <div eID="gen5777" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2713"/><div sID="gen5778" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2713"/> Jari pahondong si Isa ati soho'na a'a buta inān binowa ni iya. Makasekot pa'in, atilaw si Isa, yukna,

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: “Ai kabaya'annu hinangku ma ka'a?” <div eID="gen5778" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5779" type="paragraph"/> “Tuwan,” yukna, “kabaya'anku maka'nda' pabīng.”  <div eID="gen5779" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2714"/><div sID="gen5780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2714"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Maka'nda' na ka. Pauli' na matanu ma sabab pangandolnu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen5780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2715"/><div sID="gen5781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2715"/> Saru'un-du'un du iya maka'nda' pabīng ati ameya' paturul ma si Isa maka e'na ananglitan Tuhan. Pag'nda' itu e' ba'anan a'a inān, ya du sigām kamemon ameya' ananglitan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5781" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.18"/> <div eID="gen5775" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2716"/><div sID="gen5782" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Sakkiyas</title> <div sID="gen5783" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2716"/> Pasōd na si Isa ni da'ira Ariha bo' palabay min t'ngnga' kaluma'anna.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' a'a maglahat mahē', ōnna si Sakkiyas. Nakura' asal iya ma saga a'a maga'ā' sukay parinta, maka dayahan iya.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: Bilahi to'ongan a'a itu ang'nda' bang sai si Isa, sagō' mbal ta'nda'na sabab apandak iya maka aheka a'a magtimukan.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: Angkan iya paragan parahū min kaheka'an a'a inān bo' parāg ni diyata' kayu sikamor supaya ta'nda'na si Isa bang palabay na minnē'.  <div eID="gen5783" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2717"/><div sID="gen5784" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2717"/> Pagt'kka si Isa ni tongod kayu inān, pahogga' iya bo' pahangad, maka yukna ma si Sakkiyas, “O Sakkiyas, pal'kkas ka pareyo' sabab pahanti' aku ma luma'nu llaw itu.”  <div eID="gen5784" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2718"/><div sID="gen5785" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2718"/> Jari parai'-dai' si Sakkiyas pareyo', maka kinōgan iya amowa si Isa ni luma'na.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: Sakali magpanoway saga a'a kamemon, yuk-i, “Allā! Wa'i iya pehē' amangan ma luma' a'a baldusa!”  <div eID="gen5785" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2719"/><div sID="gen5786" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2719"/> Ma luma' pa'in, an'ngge si Sakkiyas ati yukna ni si Isa, “Tuwan, pakale ka. Santonga' alta'ku panarakkaku na ma saga miskin. Maka bang aniya' a'a bay akkalanku, papole'ku na ni iya sīnna nilipat mpat.”  <div eID="gen5786" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2720"/><div sID="gen5787" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2720"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Llaw itu lappasan ka sampay anak-h'ndanu sabab tubu' ka isab si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: Aku Anak Manusiya', ya maksudku pi'itu ni dunya subay amiha saga a'a atala min Tuhan bo' sigām lappasan.”  <div eID="gen5787" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5782" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2721"/><div sID="gen5788" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paralilan Pasal T'llungan Sosoho'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.25.14-Matt.25.30">Matiyu 25:14-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5789" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2721"/> Hinabu pa'in akale saga a'a ma si Isa, aniya' kissa pamaralilan pah'llingna ma sigām, sabab asekot na iya ni da'ira Awrusalam. Ya pangannal sigām in pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya' arai' na tinagna'an to'ongan.

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: Buwattitu pamaralilna: “Aniya',” yukna, “a'a bangsahan magbamba palintas ni lahat atala bo' gin'llal sultan mahē'. Puwas e', pabalik kono' iya ni lahatna magsultan.

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: Manjari itu, ma song pa'in atulak, nilinganan e'na sangpū' sosoho'anna. Binuwanan sigām e'na dublun bulawan pakaniya-pakaniya. Yukna ma sigām, ‘Pangalituhunbi alta' itu t'ggolku alikut.’  <div eID="gen5789" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2722"/><div sID="gen5790" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2722"/> “Sagō' kinab'nsihan a'a bangsahan itu e' saga a'a ma lahatna, angkan sigām amabeya' a'a amowahan iya lapal, yuk-i, ‘Mbal kami bilahi bang ka'a ya pagsultanan kami.’  <div eID="gen5790" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2723"/><div sID="gen5791" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2723"/> “Sagō' gin'llal iya magsultan ati pabīng ni lahatna. Pagt'kkana na, magtūy soho'na pa'alop ni iya saga sosoho'an bay buwananna dublun bo' kata'uwanna bang pila tauntung e' sigām dangan maka dangan.  <div eID="gen5791" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2724"/><div sID="gen5792" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2724"/> “Jari pa'alop ni iya sosoho'an dahū, yukna, ‘Tuwan, ya dublun dakayu' bay pamuwannu aku taga-untung na sangpū' dublun.’  <div eID="gen5792" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2725"/><div sID="gen5793" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2725"/> “ ‘Ahāp hinangnu,’ yuk sultan. ‘Sosoho'an ahantap ka. Pagka ka kapangandolan ma alta' ariki'-diki', buwananta ka kapatut magagi ma sangpū' da'ira.’  <div eID="gen5793" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2726"/><div sID="gen5794" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2726"/> “Puwas e' pa'alop ni iya sosoho'an karuwana. ‘Tuwan,’ yukna, ‘ya dublun bay pamuwannu aku taga-untung na lima.’  <div eID="gen5794" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2727"/><div sID="gen5795" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2727"/> “Yuk sultan ni iya, ‘Ahāp. Ka'a isab buwananku kapatut magagi ma lima da'ira.’  <div eID="gen5795" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2728"/><div sID="gen5796" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2728"/> “Jari pa'alop isab pina'an sosoho'an dakayu' ati yukna, ‘Tuwan, o'o, itiya' du dublunnu. Bay putusku maka panyu' bo' tau'ku sakuli-kuli.

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: Tu'ud aku tināw sabab ka'a ilu mbal ma'ase' ma a'a. Ngā'nu ya halam bay paghulas-sangsā'annu, maka aninu ya halam bay paglu'ugannu.’  <div eID="gen5796" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2729"/><div sID="gen5797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2729"/> “Yuk sultan ni iya, ‘Oy! Pilliyu! Sosoho'an ala'at ka. Papellengku ni ka'a bay llingnu sī' bo' ka taluwa' hukuman. Kata'uwannu bahā' in aku mbal ma'ase'? Ngā'ku bahā' ya halam bay paghulas-sangsā'anku? Aniku bahā' ya halam bay paglu'uganku?

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: Bang hati' buwattē', angay halam bay patau'nu sīnku ni deyom bangko bo' aniya' anakna? Manjari bang aku makapole', ta'ā'ku du sīnku sampay anakna.’  <div eID="gen5797" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2730"/><div sID="gen5798" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2730"/> “Puwas e' ah'lling sultan ni saga a'a magpan'ngge maina'an. ‘Ngā'unbi dublun min iya ati pamuwanunbi ni sosoho'an dakayu', ya taga-dublun sangpū' inān.’  <div eID="gen5798" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2731"/><div sID="gen5799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2731"/> “Yuk saga a'a inān, ‘Tuwan! Aniya' na sangpū' dublunna!’  <div eID="gen5799" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2732"/><div sID="gen5800" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2732"/> “ ‘Haka'anta kam,’ yuk sultan, ‘sasuku kapangandolan ma aheka, kin'nnopan du ma iya, sagō' sasuku mbal kapangandolan minsan ma ariki', kinulangan du ai-ai bay ma iya.

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: Na, saga bantaku inān,’ yuk sultan, ‘a'a mbal bilahi bang aku pagsultanan sigām, bowahunbi pi'itu. Papatayunbi sigām maitu ma matahanku.’ ”  <div eID="gen5800" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5788" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2733"/><div sID="gen5801" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagmahaldika' ma si Isa Pagsōdna ni Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.1-Matt.21.11">Matiyu 21:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.11.1-Mark.11.11">Markus 11:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.12.12-John.12.19">Yahiya 12:12-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5802" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2733"/> Aubus pa'in bissala si Isa itu, lum'ngngan iya parahū min sigām tudju ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: Makasekot pa'in iya ni kauman Betpage maka Betani, ya ma kasekotan būd Jaitun inān, anoho' iya duwangan mulidna parahū min kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: Yukna ma sigā, “Pehē' na kam ni kaluma'an ma dahuanbi ilu. Jari pagt'kkabi pina'an, makabāk du kam dakayu' anak kura' pahengkot, kura' halam bay tapangura'an a'a. Hubaranbi bo' bowahunbi pi'itu.

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' atilaw ka'am bang angay hubaranbi, haka'inbi, ‘Tu'ud pagguna e' nakura'.’ ”  <div eID="gen5802" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2734"/><div sID="gen5803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2734"/> Sakali pehē' na duwangan mulid e', ati tabāk e' sigā buwat bay panoho'an si Isa.  <div eID="gen5803" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2735"/><div sID="gen5804" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2735"/> Sabu pa'in sigā angahubad anak kura', ah'lling saga tag-dapuna ma sigā, yuk-i, “Oy! Angay hubaranbi ilu?”  <div eID="gen5804" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2736"/><div sID="gen5805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2736"/> Ya sambung sigām, “Tu'ud pagguna e' nakura'.”  <div eID="gen5805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2737"/><div sID="gen5806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2737"/> “Jari binowa e' sigā anak kura' inān ni si Isa. Nilampikan bukutna maka saga badju' sigā bo' yampa si Isa pinatingkō' ma diyata'.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: Na, makakura' pa'in iya, bin'llat e' saga a'a s'mmek sigām ma lān palabayanna.  <div eID="gen5806" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2738"/><div sID="gen5807" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2738"/> Pagka asekot na si Isa ni Awrusalam, bo' ina'an na ma lān ma lūran būd Jaitun, ya ba'anan anak-mulidna inān kamemon anagna' magpananglit ma Tuhan. Pinatanog suwala sigām ananglitan iya ma sabab saga hinang barakatan bay ta'nda' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: Yuk sanglit sigām, <lg sID="gen5808"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5809"/>“Bang pa'in binarakatan sultan itu,<l eID="gen5809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5810"/>ya kawakilan e' Tuhan pi'itu.<l eID="gen5810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5811"/>Kasannangan asal ma deyom sulga',<l eID="gen5811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5812"/>maka sanglit ma Tuhan Mahatinggi!”<l eID="gen5812" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5808"/>  <div eID="gen5807" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2739"/><div sID="gen5813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2739"/> Jari ah'lling ni si Isa saga Parisi bay ma deyom kaheka'an a'a, yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, sō'un saga mulidnu itu pahali!”  <div eID="gen5813" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2740"/><div sID="gen5814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2740"/> Anambung iya, yukna, “Haka'anta kam, bang sigām mbal ah'lling, paganti' saga batu ma lān itu angolang magmahaldika'an aku.”  <div eID="gen5814" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5801" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2741"/><div sID="gen5815" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinagtangisan Da'ira Awrusalam e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen5816" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2741"/> Asekot-sekot pa'in si Isa ni da'ira Awrusalam, bo' ta'nda'na saga kaluma'anna, tatangis iya.

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: Yukna, “Allā, minsan ma llaw itu na, bang bay kata'uwanbi bang ai ya makabowahan kam kasannangan. Malaingkan kalimbungan na min ka'am.

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: Ma waktu sinōng aniya' bala' at'kka ni ka'am. Niagpangan da'irabi e' saga bantabi, kinuta'an sakalibutna e' sigām bo' kam mbal makalahi.

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: Nilubu e' sigām kaluma'anbi ilu kamemon sampay halam na aniya' batu pagdayaw luma' takapin magbangkat-bangkat. Maka ka'am kamemon magtai'anak ya maglahat mailu, pinapatay isab e' sigām. Paniya' du bala' itu ma ka'am sabab halam takannalbi waktu kapangalappas Tuhan ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen5816" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5815" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2742"/><div sID="gen5817" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.12-Matt.21.17">Matiyu 21:12-17</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.11.15-Mark.11.19">Markus 11:15-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.2.13-John.2.22">Yahiya 2:13-22</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5818" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2742"/> Manjari pagt'kka si Isa pehē', pasōd iya ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan ati anagna' amala'an saga a'a magdagang maina'an.

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Tasulat asal bay pagkallam Tuhan ya yuk-i, ‘Luma'ku itu niōnan luma' pagsambahayangan saga a'a.’ Sagō' hinangbi na sali' luma' patapukan mundu.”  <div eID="gen5818" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2743"/><div sID="gen5819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2743"/> Amandu' na pa'in si Isa llaw-llaw ma deyom langgal inān. Bilahi amapatay iya saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama maka saga a'a pagbebeya'an.

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' lān tapiha sigām, sabab in a'a kamemon inān atuyu' to'ongan akale ma pamissalana.  <div eID="gen5819" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.19"/> <div eID="gen5817" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2744"/><div sID="gen5820" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinilaw si Isa Pasal Kapatutna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.23-Matt.21.27">Matiyu 21:23-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.11.27-Mark.11.33">Markus 11:27-33</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5821" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2744"/> Ma dakayu' llaw, ina'an isab si Isa ma langgal pagkulbanan amandu'an saga a'a maka magnasihatan sigām lapal ahāp. Jari pehē' ni iya saga kaimaman alanga, maka saga guru sara' agama, maka saga pagmatto'ahan.

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: Yuk sigām ni iya, “Ai kapatutnu maghinang buwattilu? Sai bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut ilu?”  <div eID="gen5821" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2745"/><div sID="gen5822" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2745"/> Yuk sambungna, “Aniya' dakayu' panilawku ma ka'am dahū. Haka'inbi aku:

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: ya kapatut si Yahiya magpandi a'a he', kapatut min Tuhan bahā' atawa min manusiya' sadja?”  <div eID="gen5822" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2746"/><div sID="gen5823" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2746"/> Sakali magisun-isun saga a'a, yuk-i, “Bang saupama yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān bay min Tuhan, tantu kitam tinilaw e'na bang angay kitam halam bay am'nnal ma si Yahiya.

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: Sagō' bang yukta in kapatut si Yahiya inān min manusiya' sadja, na, piligdu kitam. Pinagbantung kitam e' saga a'a itu kamemon sabab magkahagad asal sigām in si Yahiya nabi bay min Tuhan.”

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu panambung saga nakura' inān ma panilaw si Isa, yuk-i, “Sitta'a. Mbal kata'uwan kami bang minningga kapatutna.”  <div eID="gen5823" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2747"/><div sID="gen5824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2747"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ya du isab aku, mbal kam haka'anku bang minningga ya kapatutku maghinang saga hinangku itu.”  <div eID="gen5824" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5820" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2748"/><div sID="gen5825" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal saga Magtutunggu' ma Kabbun Anggul</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.33-Matt.21.46">Matiyu 21:33-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.1-Mark.12.12">Markus 12:1-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5826" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2748"/> Manjari amaralilan lagi' si Isa ma saga a'a. “Aniya',” yukna, “dakayu' a'a tag-kabbun bay ananom bahan anggul ma kabbunna. Bay patunggu'anna ma saga magtutunggu'. Puwas e' atulak iya ni lahat saddī ati at'ggol mahē'.

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in musim pagpusu' buwa' anggul-i, sinoho' e' tag-dapu kabbun inān dakayu' sosoho'anna pehē' ni saga magtutunggu' bo' angā' bahagi'na. Sagō' niraplosan sosoho'an itu e' sigām ati pinapole' ma halam aniya' tabowana.

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' sosoho'an saddī pinapehē' e' tag-kabbun. Ya du iya niraplosan e' sigām, nihalipulu maka pinapole' ma halam aniya' tabowana.

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: Puwas e' soho'na isab sosoho'an saddī pehē', kamint'lluna na. Jari sosoho'an damuli itu binakatan e' sigām bo' yampa nijudjalan paluwas min likusan anggul e'.

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: Manjari yuk tag-kabbun, ‘Ai bahā' subay hinangku? Papehē'ku gi' anakku luggiya', ya kalasahanku. Tantu iya pinagaddatan e' sigām.’  <div eID="gen5826" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2749"/><div sID="gen5827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2749"/> “Sagō' pag'nda' saga tunggu' ma anak tag-dapu, magtūy sigām magisun, yuk-i, ‘Ya na ko' ilu anak tag-dapu. Sūng na kitam, papataytam na bo' ta'ā'tam tana' itu.’

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: Jari nijudjalan iya e' sigām paluwas min likusan, pinapatay. <div eID="gen5827" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5828" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “ai bahā' nihinang e' tag-dapu kabbun e'?

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: Tantu iya pehē' amapatay saga tunggu' inān, ati patunggu'anna kabbunna ma a'a saddī.” <div eID="gen5828" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5829" type="paragraph"/> Pagkale pa'in saga a'a ma bissala si Isa itu, yuk sigām, “Ē! S'lle' bale puhu', bang pa'in mbal kinabbul bowa'nu!”  <div eID="gen5829" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2750"/><div sID="gen5830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2750"/> Sagō' pinatongan sigām e' si Isa, yukna, “Bang ma ka'am, ai hatina, ya tasulat ma Kitab, ya yuk-i: <lg sID="gen5831"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5832"/>‘Ya batu bay sinulak e' a'a maghinang luma', kinabā' halam aniya' gunana,<l eID="gen5832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5833"/>ya na ina'an batu aheya to'ongan kagunahanna.’ ”<l eID="gen5833" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5831"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: Yuk si Isa gi', “Sasuku ahūg ni batu itu atumu-tumu du baranna. Maka sasuku kahūgan batu itu apodjak du kamemonna.”  <div eID="gen5830" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5825" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2751"/><div sID="gen5834" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagbayad Sukay ni Parinta</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.15-Matt.22.22">Matiyu 22:15-22</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.13-Mark.12.17">Markus 12:13-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5835" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2751"/> Angkan saga guru sara' agama maka saga kaimaman alanga bilahi anaggaw si Isa saru'un-du'un, sabab tahati e' sigām in sigām ya bay pa'andiganna ma paralilan pasal tunggu' kabbun inān. Sagō' halam iya tasaggaw e' sigām sabab tināw ma saga a'a mahadjana'.<note>Mahadjana': hatina saga a'a kamemon ma deyo'an dakayu' pagparintahan.</note>

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: Amiha gi' sigām waktu ahāp bo' supaya iya tinandanan e' sigām pehē' ni pang'ntanan gubnul. Jari aniya' saga a'a tinambahan e' sigām, a'a magbau'-bau' in sigām asaltun. Pinapehē' sigām ni si Isa, kalu iya tajallat ma bissalana.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: Yuk saga a'a tinambahan itu ni si Isa, “Tuwan guru, “kata'uwan kami in bissalanu maka pamandu'nu abontol to'ongan. Mbal ka amapagbidda' ma a'a minsan sai, maka b'nnal sadja pamandu'nu pasal kaul maka pi'il ya kinabaya'an e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: Haka'in kami kono'. Bang kita ganta' amayad sukay ni parinta Rōm, ya deyo' min Sultan Mahatinggi he', langgalta bahā' sara' agamatam?”  <div eID="gen5835" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2752"/><div sID="gen5836" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2752"/> Sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa pangangakkal sigām, angkan yukna ma sigām,

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: “Pa'nda'in aku sīn.” Pag'nda' si Isa ma sīn, yukna, “Patta' sai maka ōn sai ma sīn itu?” <div eID="gen5836" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5837" type="paragraph"/> “Patta' Sultan Mahatinggi maka sulatna,” yuk sambung sigām.  <div eID="gen5837" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2753"/><div sID="gen5838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2753"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka suku' sultan ko' itu, pamayarunbi ni iya. Damikiyanna, bang aniya' ai-ai suku' Tuhan, tukbalinbi isab ni Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2754"/><div sID="gen5839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2754"/> Manjari mbal iya takole' nijallat e' sigām ma pasal pah'llingna ma mairan. Landu' sigām ainu-inu ma panambungna, angkan sigām mbal makapamissala.  <div eID="gen5839" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5834" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2755"/><div sID="gen5840" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kallum Balik ma saga A'a Magpatayan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.23-Matt.22.33">Matiyu 22:23-33</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.18-Mark.12.27">Markus 12:18-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2755"/> Puwas e' aniya' pina'an ni si Isa saga a'a Saddusi, daginis agama Yahudi ya amandu' halam aniya' a'a magpatayan allum pabīng ma llaw damuli.

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: Atilaw sigām ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, aniya' sara' bay pang'bba kitam e' si Musa pasal a'a amatay ma halam taga-tubu'. In baluna subay niā' h'nda e' siyalina, bo' supaya aniya' anak binista tubu' min a'a bay amatay he'.

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: Na,” yuk sigām, “aniya' bay pitu' l'lla magdanakan. Magh'nda siyaka sagō' amatay iya ma halam taga-anak.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: Jari nih'nda balu e' danakan pasunu' ati amatay isāb ma halam taga-anak.

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab siyali kat'lluna. Jari in pitu' magdanakan bay makah'nda ni dakayu' d'nda he', bo' amatay sigām kamemon ma halam taga-anak.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: Ma katapusanna amatay isab d'nda.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: Na, Tuwan,” yuk sigām, “bang ta'abut llaw pagpakallum pabalik saga a'a magpatayan, h'nda sai bahā' d'nda he'? Sabab bay iya ta'ā' h'nda e' sigām kapitu' magdanakan.”  <div eID="gen5841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2756"/><div sID="gen5842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2756"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Saga a'a ma dunya itu magh'nda asal maka magh'lla.

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a ya binista e' Tuhan makajari pinakallum pabalik min kamatay, ya tōp isab maglahat mahē' ma sulga', mbal na sigām magh'nda-h'lla.

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: Sabab mbal na sigām magkamatay sagō' parasali' na sigām ni saga mala'ikat. Anak Tuhan na sigām sabab pinakallum na pabīng min kamatay sigām.

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: Pinatampal isab e' si Musa pasal kapakallum a'a min kamatay. Sabab ma waktu ka'nda'na po'on puhung bay sabbutna Panghū' Tuhan, yuk-i, ‘Tuhan pagtuhanan disi Ibrahim maka si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.’

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: Hatina Tuhan itu pagtuhanan asal e' saga a'a allum, ngga'i ka e' a'a magpatayan. Allum asal a'a kamemon ma pang'nda' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5842" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2757"/><div sID="gen5843" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2757"/> Ah'lling saga guru sara' agama kasehe', yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, ahāp sambungnu ilu.”

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: Jari halam aniya' makatawakkal anilaw iya pabalik.  <div eID="gen5843" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5840" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2758"/><div sID="gen5844" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panilaw pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.22.41-Matt.22.46">Matiyu 22:41-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.35-Mark.12.37">Markus 12:35-37</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5845" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2758"/> Jari atilaw si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Angay saga a'a magpina'in in Al-Masi tubu' sultan Da'ud?

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: Sabab si Da'ud magbaran bay angallam ma deyom Kitab Jabul, yukna, <lg sID="gen5846"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5847"/>‘Bay angabtang Tuhan ni Panghū'ku, yukna,<l eID="gen5847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5848"/>“Dai' ka, aningkō' ka ma bihingku kowan,<l eID="gen5848" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5849"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: ati bowaku palbantahannu ni deyo' pād-tape'nu.” ’<l eID="gen5849" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5846"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Isa, “pagka Al-Masi niōnan Panghū' e' sultan Da'ud, tantu iya ngga'i ka hal panubu' si Da'ud.”  <div eID="gen5845" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5844" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2759"/><div sID="gen5850" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamituwa si Isa Pasal saga Guru Sara' Agama</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.23.1-Matt.23.36">Matiyu 23:1-36</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.12.38-Mark.12.40">Markus 12:38-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5851" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2759"/> Pasalta' pa'in pakale saga a'a inān kamemon, ah'lling si Isa ni saga mulidna, yukna,

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: “Halli'inbi saga guru sara' agama, ya tagihan maglunsul magpamakay juba ataha'. Tagihan isab sigām nihulmat bang ma mairan. Bang ma deyom langgal, bilahi sigām pinatingkō' ma tingkō'an bangsahan. Damikiyanna bang sigām ma pagjamuhan, subay paningkō'an a'a alanga ya paningkō'an sigām.

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: Ni'inyaya e' sigām saga balu d'nda bo' ta'ā' luma' sigām, ati pinataha' sambahayang sigām, paglaku-laku in sigām bal-iman. Angkan pinakalap kabinasahan sigām.”  <div eID="gen5851" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.20"/> <div eID="gen5850" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2760"/><div sID="gen5852" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sīn ya Panukbal e' Balu D'nda</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.12.41-Mark.12.44">Markus 12:41-44</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5853" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2760"/> Manjari patongas si Isa ati ta'nda'na saga a'a dayahan magpangahūg sīn pagjakat sigām ni tu'ung ma deyom langgal inān.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: Aniya' isab ta'nda'na dakayu' d'nda balu, miskin to'ongan, angahūg duwa unud sīn.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: Yuk si Isa, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am itu, ya duwa unud sīn tahūg e' d'nda miskin itu labi gi' halga'an min pilak bay tahūg e' kamemon saga a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: Sabab,” yuk si Isa, “bay sigām amuwan min alta' sigām manglabi-labihan. Saguwā' d'nda itu, minsan iya miskin sidda, bay amuwan sīnna kamemon ya arak pam'llina napakana.”  <div eID="gen5853" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5852" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2761"/><div sID="gen5854" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandogahan Pasal Llaw Kiyamat</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.1-Matt.24.2">Matiyu 24:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.13.1-Mark.13.2">Markus 13:1-2</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5855" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2761"/> Aniya' saga mulidna kasehe' magsuli-suli pasal langgal pagkulbanan. Ahāp kono' ninda' saga batu bay ginuna pangahinang langgal e', maka aheka alti-altina bay panukbal ni Tuhan. Takale pa'in suli-suli sigām itu e' si Isa, yukna,

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: “Ma sinōng nilubu du kamemon ya ta'nda'bi ilu. Halam du aniya' batuna angapin magbangkat, sabab pinagkaukanat kamemon.”  <div eID="gen5855" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5854" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2762"/><div sID="gen5856" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasigpitan maka Katiksa'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.3-Matt.24.14">Matiyu 24:3-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.13.3-Mark.13.13">Markus 13:3-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5857" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2762"/> Tinilaw iya e' sigām. “Tuwan Guru,” yuk sigām, “sumiyan paniya' ya bay yuknu insini'? Maka ai pandogana bo' kinata'uwan in pakaradja'an inān at'kka na?”  <div eID="gen5857" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2763"/><div sID="gen5858" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2763"/> Anambung iya, yukna, “Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' kam mbal ka'akkalan. Sabab ma sinosōng ilu aheka pi'itu anabbut ma ōnku, maglaku-laku in sigām Al-Masi. Ya pah'lling sigām, ‘Kiyamat na!’ Sagō' da'a kam magkahagad ma sigām.

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: Bang aniya' takalebi hunub-hunub pasal pagbono' atawa pasal lengog, da'a kam agawa. Tantu paniya' saga pagbono' sagō' ngga'i ka gi' ina'an-i llaw kiyamat.”  <div eID="gen5858" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2764"/><div sID="gen5859" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2764"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Magbono' du bangsa dakayu' maka dakayu', parinta dakayu' isab maka dakayu'.

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: Paniya' du saga linug aheya maka gotom maka saki bonglay ma kaluha'an dunya. Aniya' isab saga paltanda'an ta'nda' ma b'ttong langit, paltanda'an makainu-inu maka makatāw-tāw.

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: Sagō' dahū min ina'an-i sinaggaw kam e' saga a'a maka nila'at. Binowa du kam ni langgal sigām bo' kam nihukum maka ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu. Tinukbalan du isab kam ni saga sultan maka ni gubnul bo' kam nihukum ma sabab pameya'bi ma aku.

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: Bang kam ma alopan sigām, ya na ina'an waktu kapangahakabi ma sigām lapal ahāp pasal aku.

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: Sagō' da'a kasusahinbi bang ai panganda'awabi waktu kapanumariya ka'am,

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: sabab aku ya amuwanan ka'am ta'u bo' kam makasambungan sigām. Jari halam aniya' kuntarabi makasagga' ka'am, maka mbal katangkisan bissalabi.

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: Minsan saga matto'abi maka dauranakanbi, minsan saga lūng-kampungbi maka saga kabagayanbi, sinōngan du kam e' sigām ni kuntarabi. Maka aniya' min ka'am pinapatay du e' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: Kinab'nsihan du kam e' a'a kamemon ma sabab pameya'bi ma aku.

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: Sagō' mbal kam kalungayan ai-ai minsan dalamba bu'unbi.

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: Lappasan du kam bang pa'in pahogotbi pangandolbi.”  <div eID="gen5859" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5856" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2765"/><div sID="gen5860" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katiksa'an Sangat Abisa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.15-Matt.24.21">Matiyu 24:15-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.13.14-Mark.13.19">Markus 13:14-19</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2765"/> “Bang ta'nda'bi da'ira Awrusalam itu alibut e' sundalu, na, kata'uwanbi song na waktu pamaka'at iya.

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: Jari sasuku pat'nna' ma lahat Yahudiya subay alahi pehē' ni kabūd-būran. Sasuku ma deyom da'ira Awrusalam subay paluwas magdai'-dai', maka sasuku ma deya da'a subay pabīng pehē' ni deyom da'ira.

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: Sabab ya ina'an waktu pangamulka' Tuhan ma manusiya'. Minnē' aniya' kamaujuran ma kamemon bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: Ndū', maka'ase'-ase' sidda saga d'nda ab'ttong ma masa ina'an-i, maka saga d'nda taga-anak duru'an lagi'. Sabab aniya' kabinasahan aheya pinat'kka ni kaluha'an lahat itu. Pinat'kkahan du mulka' Tuhan saga a'ana.

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: Aniya' sigām kasehe'an nilagut e' sundalu, pinapatay. Aniya' a'a kasehe'an sinaggaw, nihinang pilisu bo' binowa ni sabarang lahat. Da'ira Awrusalam itu pinaka'at du e' saga kabangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi. Subay na ajukup ganta'an pagparinta bangsa inān bo' yampa sigām ala'an.”  <div eID="gen5861" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5860" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2766"/><div sID="gen5862" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kabalik Al-Masi Pi'itu ni Dunya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.29-Matt.24.31">Matiyu 24:29-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.13.24-Mark.13.27">Markus 13:24-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2766"/> “Ma waktu sinōng ilu aniya' paltanda'an paniya' ma mata llaw maka ma bulan maka ma saga bitu'un. Saga kabangsa-bangsahan maitu ma dunya isab ag'mma du sumangat sigām. Alengog pikilan sigām sabab mbal manjari pang'llub tahik maka landos goyak.

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: Agon amatay saga a'a sabab min tāw maka susa sigām, pagka aniya' bala' niagaran e' sigām song pat'kka ni dunya. Sabab saga pandoga ma tonga'an ayan pinala'an du min pat'nna'an sigām.

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: Puwas ina'an-i,” yuk si Isa, “maka'nda' du saga a'a ma aku, Anak Manusiya', pi'itu labay min gabun. Ta'nda' e' sigām barakatku maka kosog sahayaku.

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: Jari bang anagna' saga pakaradja'an ya yukku itu, pabuhat kam maka patongas sabab mbal na at'ggol, lappasan du kam.”  <div eID="gen5863" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5862" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2767"/><div sID="gen5864" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamintāngan min Kayu Igira</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.24.32-Matt.24.35">Matiyu 24:32-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.13.28-Mark.13.31">Markus 13:28-31</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5865" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2767"/> Jari aniya' paralilan pinah'lling e' si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Pandogahinbi kayu igira maka saga kayu kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: Bang ta'nda'bi angugbus dahunna, minnē' kata'uwanbi song musim pang'llaw na.

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: Damikiyanna itu bang ta'nda'bi paniya' bay pamissalaku ma ka'am insini' he', minnē' isab kata'uwanbi asekot na waktu pagparinta Tuhan ma dunya.

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa. “Ma mbal gi' magpatayan kamemon saga a'a ya allum ma buwattina'an, paniya' du pakaradja'an kamemon bay yukku-i.

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: Papinda du langit maka dunya sagō' kabtanganku itu mbal to'ongan magkapinda.”  <div eID="gen5865" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5864" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2768"/><div sID="gen5866" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Bebeya'an si Isa Sinō' Pahalli'</title> <div sID="gen5867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2768"/> “Subay kam pahalli',” yuk si Isa, “bo' kam mbal ta'abutku magdūl-baya'an di-bi, maka maglango-lango, maka kabuhatan e' legot dunya itu. Sabab tagha' sadja t'kka llaw ina'an-i, sapantun litag bang pinassik,

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: ati taluwa' saga a'a kamemon ma babaw dunya itu.

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: Pajaga kam to'ongan. Da'a kam pahali angamu' tabang ni Tuhan bang pa'in aniya' kosogbi, bo' kasandalanbi kamemon pakaradja'an inān. Angamu' kam tabang isab bang pa'in kam makatampal ni aku, Anak Manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen5867" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2769"/><div sID="gen5868" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2769"/> Na, kahaba'-kahaba' llaw amandu' na pa'in si Isa ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, sagō' pagsangom paluwas iya min da'ira tudju ni būd Jaitun bo' pahanti' mahē'.

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: Dai'-llaw lagi' pina'an na pa'in saga a'a kamemon ni langgal pagkulbanan bo' akale ma pandu'na.  <div eID="gen5868" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.21"/> <div eID="gen5866" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2770"/><div sID="gen5869" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinagisunan si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.1-Matt.26.5">Matiyu 26:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.1-Mark.14.2">Markus 14:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.31-John.13.35">Yahiya 11:45-53</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5870" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2770"/> Na, marai' na Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna, ya pinagōnan isab Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: Saga imam alanga maka saga guru sara' agama amikil-mikil bang buwattingga e' sigām amapatay si Isa ma halam aniya' makata'u. Tu'ud sigām tināw ma saga a'a katimukan.  <div eID="gen5870" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5869" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2771"/><div sID="gen5871" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapanipu si Judas ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.14-Matt.26.16">Matiyu 26:14-16</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.10-Mark.14.11">Markus 14:10-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5872" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2771"/> Manjari pasōd nakura' saitan ni deyom pikilan si Judas, ya niōnan Judas Iskariyut, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa.

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: Pehē' si Judas itu ni saga imam alanga maka ni saga nakura' ma jaga langgal pagkulbanan, bo' sigām bowana magisun bang buwattingga e'na anōngan si Isa ni sigām.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: Kinōgan sigām to'ongan ati anganjanji' sigām anambahan iya maka sīn.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: Angaho' magtūy si Judas ati anagna' iya amiha waktu ahāp panōngna ma si Isa ni saga bantana ma halam aniya' a'a saddī maina'an.  <div eID="gen5872" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5871" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2772"/><div sID="gen5873" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsakap ma Hinang Paglakad</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.17-Matt.26.25">Matiyu 26:17-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.12-Mark.14.21">Markus 14:12-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.21-John.13.30">Yahiya 13:21-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5874" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2772"/> Manjari ta'abut na Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna. Ya na ina'an llaw panumbali' anak bili-bili ma Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: Sinō' e' si Isa si Petros maka si Yahiya, yukna, “Pehē' kam magsakap ai-ai pagkakantam ma Hinang Paglakad.”  <div eID="gen5874" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2773"/><div sID="gen5875" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2773"/> Yuk sigā ma iya, “Tuwan, maingga kabaya'annu panakapan kami?”  <div eID="gen5875" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2774"/><div sID="gen5876" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2774"/> Yukna ni sigā, “Makasōd pa'in kam ni deyom da'ira ilu, sinampang du kam e' dakayu' l'lla amowa kibut isihan bohe'. Turulunbi iya ni luma' pasōranna,

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: ati yukbi ma tag-dapu luma', ‘Sinō' ka tinilaw e' guru bang ma'ai kono' bilik pagtimukanna maka saga mulidna?’

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: Jari pina'nda'an du kam bilik aluha ma diyata' angkap,” yuk si Isa. “Panyap asal bilik inān. Maina'an kam magsakap pagkakantam.”  <div eID="gen5876" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2775"/><div sID="gen5877" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2775"/> Jari pehē' na sigā. Ta'nda' e' sigā mahē' buwat bay pangahaka si Isa, ati sinakap e' sigā pagkakan ma Hinang Paglakad.  <div eID="gen5877" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5873" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2776"/><div sID="gen5878" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Jamuhan Pangentoman ma Panghū' Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.26-Matt.26.30">Matiyu 26:26-30</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.22-Mark.14.26">Markus 14:22-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="1Cor.11.23-1Cor.11.25">1 Kurintu 11:23-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5879" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2776"/> Ta'abut pa'in waktu pagjamu, aningkō' na si Isa maka saga a'a bay kawakilanna bo' sigām magkakan.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: Ah'lling iya ni sigām, yukna, “Ya itu kabaya'anku to'ongan, subay magsalu maka ka'am amangan ma Hinang Paglakad itu, ma mbal lagi' aku makalabay kabinasahan.

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: Sabab haka'anta kam, puwas itu mbal na aku amangan jamu itu pabīng, subay na asampulna' pagparinta Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5879" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2777"/><div sID="gen5880" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2777"/> Manjari niā' e' si Isa dakayu' sawan. Niamu'an e'na pagsukulan bo' yampa ah'lling ni sigām, yukna, “Sambutunbi inuman itu bo' inumunbi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: Sabab haka'anta kam, puwas minnitu mbal na aku anginum binu-anggul itu sat'ggol halam gi' pat'nna' pagparinta Tuhan ma manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen5880" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2778"/><div sID="gen5881" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2778"/> Puwas e' niā' e'na tinapay. Niamu'an e'na pagsukulan bo' yampa pagpōng-pōngna ati pamuwanna ma saga mulidna. “Tinapay itu baranku ko', ya pamalilla'ku ma pasalbi. Hinangunbi itu pangentomanbi aku.”

verses.name: Luke 22:20
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab, pagubus sigām amangan, pamuwan e'na inuman ma sigām. “Inuman itu,” yukna, “ta'nda' sin kapagsulutan Tuhan maka manusiya', ya hinangna baha'u itu. Ati tatuman du pagka pinabu'us laha'ku ma sababbi.  <div eID="gen5881" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2779"/><div sID="gen5882" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2779"/> “Sagō' nda'unbi,” yuk si Isa, “ya a'a song anōngan aku ni bantaku, itiya' maitu magsalu maka aku.

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: Sabab aku Anak Manusiya' itu, amatay du buwat asal pangangganta' Tuhan ma aku. Saguwā' asiya-siya du a'a ya anōngan aku ni bantaku.”

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: Jari magtilaw-tilawan di-sigām saga mulid inān bang sai min sigām ya anganiyat anōngan si Isa ni bantana.  <div eID="gen5882" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5878" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2780"/><div sID="gen5883" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paglugat saga Mulid bang Sai Sigām Alanga</title> <div sID="gen5884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2780"/> Na, maglugat saga mulid inān bang sai ma sigām subay pinalanga.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: Sagō' yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Maitu ma dunya, saga sultan ma kabangsa-bangsahan magmanda asal ni saga a'a ma deyo'an sigām. Maka saga nakura' sigām pagmakōkan bilahi nihulmat e' a'a kamemon, in sigām kono' po'onan kahāpan ma deyom lahat e'.

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu da'a subay magbuwattē'. Ya bangsahan to'ongan ma ka'am subay sumali' bowahanna ni bowahan kasiyalihan. Maka a'a pagnakura'an subay sumali' ni sosoho'an.

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: Sai bahā' bangsahan? A'a aningkō' amangan atawa a'a magbubuhat kinakan? Ya tantu bangsahan a'a aningkō' amangan. Sagō' aku itu, itiya' ma ka'am sali' sosoho'anbi.  <div eID="gen5884" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2781"/><div sID="gen5885" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2781"/> “Ka'am ilu bay pataptap ma aku minsan aku ma deyom kasusahan.

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: Manjari itu, pagka aku kabuwanan kapatut e' Mma'ku mag'ntan parinta ma sinosōng, pamuwanku isab ma ka'am kapatut buwattē'.

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: Magbeya' du kitam amangan ma deyom pagparintahanku. Patingkō'ta du kam ma paningkō'an bangsahan bo' kam angahukum ma sangpū' maka duwa bangsa panubu' si Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen5885" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5883" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2782"/><div sID="gen5886" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Papata si Isa Pasal Pamalilu si Petros</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.31-Matt.26.35">Matiyu 26:31-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.27-Mark.14.31">Markus 14:27-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.13.36-John.13.38">Yahiya 13:36-38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5887" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2782"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ma si Simun Petros. “Simun!” yukna. “Niamu' ka e' nakura' saitan bo' niayak e'na sapantun tirigu.

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: Sagō' bay ka amu'anku tabang ni Tuhan, Simun, bang pa'in mbal apinda pangandolnu ma aku. Taikutannu du aku, sagō' bang ka pabīng ni aku subay ka amat'ttog iman saga dauranakannu.”  <div eID="gen5887" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2783"/><div sID="gen5888" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2783"/> Yuk si Petros, “Tuwan Panghū', mbal ka taikutanku. Bang ka ganta' pinakalabusu, parongan du aku ma ka'a. Bang ka pinapatay, lilla' du aku paunung ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen5888" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2784"/><div sID="gen5889" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2784"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Haka'anta ka, Petros, ma sangom itu ma halam gi' angukku'uk manuk, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.”  <div eID="gen5889" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5886" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2785"/><div sID="gen5890" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pitaka, Paglutu'anan maka Pakokos</title> <div sID="gen5891" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2785"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa ma saga mulidna, yukna, “Waktu bay kapanoho'ku ka'am pal'ngngan magnasihat ma halam aniya' pitaka atawa paglutu'anan atawa taumpa' tabowabi, aniya' bahā' bay kulang ma ka'am?” <div eID="gen5891" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5892" type="paragraph"/> “Halam,” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen5892" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2786"/><div sID="gen5893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2786"/> “Sagō' buwattina'an,” yuk si Isa, “bang aniya' sīnbi atawa paglutu'ananbi, bowahunbi na ma pal'ngngananbi. Maka sasuku halam aniya' patakosna subay pab'llihanna badju'na bo' aniya' pam'llina kalis.

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: Sabab haka'anta kam, song na maujud lapal Kitab ya bay tasulat ma sabab aku, ya yuk-i, ‘Talapay iya ma saga a'a angalanggal sara'.’ ”  <div eID="gen5893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2787"/><div sID="gen5894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2787"/> Yuk saga mulid, “Nda'un, Tuwan, aniya' maitu duwa kalis.” <div eID="gen5894" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5895" type="paragraph"/> “Sarang na ko' ilu,” yuk si Isa.  <div eID="gen5895" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5890" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2788"/><div sID="gen5896" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Kabbun Getsemane</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.36-Matt.26.46">Matiyu 26:36-46</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.32-Mark.14.42">Markus 14:32-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2788"/> Jari paluwas si Isa min da'ira tudju ni būd Jaitun buwat asal kabiyaksahanna, maka ameya' ma iya saga mulidna.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: Pagt'kkana ni papehē'anna, yukna ma sigām, “Angamu' kam tabang ni Tuhan bo' kam mbal tabowa e' sasat.”  <div eID="gen5897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2789"/><div sID="gen5898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2789"/> Puwas e' ala'an iya min sigām, saga dabantungan lawakna, ati pasujud iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: Yukna, “O Mma', bang ka bilahi, la'anin lagi' min aku sawan kabinasahan itu. Sagō' ngga'i ka kabaya'anku subay nirūlan, bang pa'in kabaya'annu du.”

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: Manjari aniya' panyata' ni iya dakayu' mala'ikat min sulga' amuwanan iya kosog panandalna.

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: Na, pagka mbal manjari dukkana, akosog gom pa'in panganjunjungna ni Tuhan ati am'ttak hulasna ni tana', pinaka na luwa laha'.  <div eID="gen5898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2790"/><div sID="gen5899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2790"/> Aubus pa'in e'na angamu'-ngamu', an'ngge iya bo' pabalik pehē' ni saga mulidna ati tabākna sigām magtulihan kabowa sukkal sigām.

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Angay kam atuli? Punduk kam angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan bo' kam mbal tabowa e' sasat.”  <div eID="gen5899" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5896" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2791"/><div sID="gen5900" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsaggaw ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.47-Matt.26.56">Matiyu 26:47-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.43-Mark.14.50">Markus 14:43-50</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.3-John.18.12">Yahiya 18:3-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2791"/> Na, hinabu lagi' si Isa ah'lling ni saga mulidna, aheka a'a at'kka pina'an. Ya pameya'an sigām si Judas, dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa he'. Pa'abut iya magtūy ni si Isa arak aniyum iya.

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: Sagō' ah'lling si Isa ma iya, yukna, “Buwattitu bahā', Judas, pangakkalnu ma Anak Manusiya'?”  <div eID="gen5901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2792"/><div sID="gen5902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2792"/> Kinata'uwan pa'in e' saga mulid ma atag si Isa bang ai song nihinang ma iya, atilaw sigām, “Tuwan, guna kami na bahā' kalis kami?”

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: Jari nilagut sosoho'an Imam Muwallam e' dakayu' mulid inān, ati autas magtūy dambila' taingana.  <div eID="gen5902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2793"/><div sID="gen5903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2793"/> Sagō' yuk si Isa, “Sarang na ko' ilu.” Jari ni'ntanan e'na tainga a'a he' ati kauli'an magtūy.  <div eID="gen5903" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2794"/><div sID="gen5904" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2794"/> Ah'lling si Isa ni saga a'a bay pina'an anaggaw iya, ya na saga imam alanga maka saga nakura' jaga langgal, maka saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Yahudi. Yukna ma sigām, “Kabā'bi ba in aku itu mundu, ya po'on kam amowa kalis maka kakakal?

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: Llaw-llaw mahē' na pa'in aku ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, sagō' halam aku bay tasaggawbi. Saguwā' ya na itu waktu pamasuku' ka'am bo' aku tasaggawbi, maka waktu isab kapagagi nakura' saitan.”  <div eID="gen5904" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5900" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2795"/><div sID="gen5905" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamalilu si Petros Pasal si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.57-Matt.26.58">Matiyu 26:57-58</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.26.69-Matt.26.75">69-75</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.53-Mark.14.54">Markus 14:53-54</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.66-Mark.14.72">66-72</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.12-John.18.18">Yahiya 18:12-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.25-John.18.27">25-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2795"/> Manjari sinaggaw si Isa e' sigām, binowa ala'an minnē' tudju ni luma' Imam Muwallam. Paturul si Petros ma si Isa min katāhan.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: Aniya' api bay pinakeyat e' saga sundalu ma halaman luma' Imam Muwallam ati parakayu' si Petros ni sigām magtingkō'an ma atag api he'.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: Jari itu, sabu pa'in iya aningkō' ma kasinagan api, ta'nda' iya e' dakayu' d'nda ipatan Imam Muwallam. Pinatongan iya pahāp-hāp e' d'nda itu maka e'na ah'lling, yukna, “A'a itu bay ameya' ma si Isa.”  <div eID="gen5906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2796"/><div sID="gen5907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2796"/> Sagō' amalilu si Petros, yukna, “Arung, mbal iya kata'uwanku!”  <div eID="gen5907" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2797"/><div sID="gen5908" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2797"/> Mbal at'ggol minnē' aniya' dakayu' l'lla ang'nda' ma si Petros ati yukna, “Ya du ka'a dambeya'an maka sigām!” <div eID="gen5908" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5909" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Petros, yukna, “Ngga'i ka aku, tuwan!”  <div eID="gen5909" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2798"/><div sID="gen5910" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2798"/> Palabay pa'in danjām aniya' isab a'a saddī angegot-ngegot, yukna, “Kata'uwanku a'a itu bay du sehe'na, sabab a'a Jalil isab iya!”  <div eID="gen5910" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2799"/><div sID="gen5911" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2799"/> Anambung si Petros, yukna, “Tuwan, mbal kata'uwanku bang ai pah'llingnu ilu!” <div eID="gen5911" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5912" type="paragraph"/> Hinabu si Petros masi ah'lling, magtūy angukku'uk manuk.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: Jari palingi' si Isa ang'nda' ma si Petros ati taentom e' si Petros bay pah'lling si Isa ma iya, ya yukna, “Ma mbal gi' angukkugu'uk manuk sangom itu, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.”

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: Magtūy paluwas si Petros minnē'. Anangis iya, magdukka to'ongan.  <div eID="gen5912" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5905" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2800"/><div sID="gen5913" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinagtunggīng maka Pinagtibu'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.67-Matt.26.68">Matiyu 26:67-68</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.65">Markus 14:65</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2800"/> Pinagtunggīngan si Isa e' saga a'a anganjagahan iya, maka pinagtibu' iya e' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: Tinambunan matana bo' yampa nilata. “Tokorun kono',” yuk sigām, “bang sai anibu' ka'a!”

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: Aheka gi' isab pamūng-mūng sigām pamahina' sigām ma iya.  <div eID="gen5914" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5913" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2801"/><div sID="gen5915" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinaharap si Isa ni saga Pagnakura'an</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.59-Matt.26.66">Matiyu 26:59-66</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.55-Mark.14.64">Markus 14:55-64</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.19-John.18.24">Yahiya 18:19-18:24</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2801"/> Pagk'llat llaw na, magtimuk saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Yahudi maka saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama. Jari binowa si Isa paharap ni palhimpunan sigām.

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: Yuk sigām ma iya, “Haka'in kami to'ongan bang ka'a ya Al-Masi.” <div eID="gen5916" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5917" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Minsan kam haka'anku mbal du aku kahagadbi.

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: Maka bang aniya' tilawku ma ka'am, mbal du kam anambung.

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: Sagō' puwas min llaw itu in aku, Anak Manusiya', aningkō' du ma atag Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, ma bihingna kowan.”  <div eID="gen5917" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2802"/><div sID="gen5918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2802"/> Yuk sigām kamemon, “Na, bang buwattē', Anak Tuhan ka bahā'?” <div eID="gen5918" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5919" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ya na yukbi, aku na.”  <div eID="gen5919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2803"/><div sID="gen5920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2803"/> Jari ah'lling sigām, yuk-i, “Angay kitam amiha saksi' saddī!
