Sabab takaleta himumūnganna itu.”  <div eID="gen5920" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.22"/> <div eID="gen5915" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2804"/><div sID="gen5921" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Binowa si Isa Paharap ni Gubnul Pilatu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.1-Matt.27.2">Matiyu 27:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.1-Mark.15.5">Markus 15:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.28-John.18.38">Yahiya 18:28-18:38</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2804"/> Manjari magt'nggehan saga a'a palhimpunan kamemon ati binowa si Isa e' sigām paharap ni gubnul Pilatu.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, tinuntutan e' sigām si Isa, yuk-i, “Ta'abut kami a'a itu amowa bangsa kami anagga' ma parinta. Tasoho'na saga a'a subay da'a amayad sukay ni Sultan Mahatinggi. Maglaku-laku isab iya in iya Al-Masi, ya tapene' e' Tuhan magsultan.”  <div eID="gen5922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2805"/><div sID="gen5923" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2805"/> Atilaw si Pilatu ma si Isa. “Ka'a ilu,” yukna, “sultan ka bahā' ma bangsa Yahudi?” <div eID="gen5923" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5924" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya na yuknu ilu.”  <div eID="gen5924" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2806"/><div sID="gen5925" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2806"/> Yuk si Pilatu ni saga kaimaman alanga maka ni kaheka'an a'a inān, “Halam aniya' tapihaku sababan pamat'nna'anku iya hukuman.”  <div eID="gen5925" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2807"/><div sID="gen5926" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2807"/> Saguwā' angegot na pa'in sigām, yuk-i, “Pinalengog e'na saga a'a ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya sabab min pamandu'na. Bay tagna'anna hinangna ma lahat Jalil, manjari itiya' na iya pasampay pi'itu ni Awrusalam.”  <div eID="gen5926" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5921" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2808"/><div sID="gen5927" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tin'kkahan si Isa ni Sultan Herod</title> <div sID="gen5928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2808"/> Na, pagkale itu e' si Pilatu, magtūy tilawna bang min lahat Jalil si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: Makata'u pa'in si Pilatu in si Isa asal min lahat pagsultanan si Herod, sinō' iya tin'kkahan ni si Herod sabab ina'an iya ma Awrusalam pasalta' ma waktu ina'an-i.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Herod ma si Isa, akōd iya to'ongan sabab at'ggol na baya'na ang'nda' iya. Aheka bay takalena pasal si Isa angkan bilahi ang'nda' iya hinabuna maghinang hinang kawasahan.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: Aheka panilaw si Herod ma si Isa, sagō' mbal iya anambung.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: Manjari pasekot pina'an saga kaimaman alanga maka saga guru sara' agama, ati akosog e' sigām anuntutan si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: Manjari pinagtunggīngan si Isa e' si Herod maka saga sundaluna, nihalipulu isab e' sigām. Pinas'mmekan iya maka juba landu' alingkat bo' yampa pinabīng ni si Pilatu he'.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: Na, ya na ina'an llaw kapaghāp si Herod maka si Pilatu, sabab bay sigām magbanta tagna'.  <div eID="gen5928" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5927" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2809"/><div sID="gen5929" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinat'nna'an si Isa Hukuman ni Kamatay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.15-Matt.27.26">Matiyu 27:15-26</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.6-Mark.15.15">Markus 15:6-15</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.18.39-John.19.16">Yahiya 18:39-19:16</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5930" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2809"/> Manjari nilinganan e' si Pilatu saga kaimaman alanga maka saga pagnakura'an maka saga a'a kamemon. Sinō' sigām patimuk ni iya.

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Bay bowabi a'a itu ni aku, pagka yukbi in iya amidjakan saga a'a anagga' ma parinta. Bay na iya pariksa'ku maitu ma pang'nda'bi sagō' halam aku makabāk dusa ma iya buwat panuntutbi.

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: Buwattē' isab ma si Herod, angkan pabowana si Isa pabalik pi'itu. Atampal ko' itu, halam aniya' la'at bay tahinang e' a'a itu pamat'nna'an iya hukuman ni kamatay.

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: Angkan sō'ku iya niraplosan sadja bo' yampa pinal'ppa.” <div eID="gen5930" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5931" type="paragraph"/> [

verses.name: Luke 23:17
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pah'lling si Pilatu sabab ya kabiyaksahanna kahaba' tahun, bang maghinang saga Yahudi ma Hinang Paglakad, subay iya amal'ppa dakayu' pilisu.]  <div eID="gen5931" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2810"/><div sID="gen5932" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2810"/> Makakale pa'in saga katimukan a'a ma lling si Pilatu, magtūy sigām magpangolang kamemon. Yuk sigām, “Papatayun a'a ilu! Si Barabbas ya kabaya'an kami pinal'ppa.”

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: Na, si Barabbas itu bay pinakalabusu ma sabab hiluhala' bay tahinangna ma da'ira Awrusalam, maka ma sabab hinangna amono'.  <div eID="gen5932" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2811"/><div sID="gen5933" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2811"/> Jari amissala pabalik si Pilatu ni saga a'a he', sabab bilahi amal'ppa si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: Sagō' magpangolang sidda sigām, yuk-i, “Lansangun iya ni hāg! Lansangun iya ni hāg!”  <div eID="gen5933" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2812"/><div sID="gen5934" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2812"/> Ah'lling gi' si Pilatu, kamint'lluna na. “Angay?” yukna. “Ai bay hinangna ala'at? Halam aniya' tabākku sababan pamapatay iya. Sō'ku sadja iya niraplosan bo' yampa pinal'ppa.”  <div eID="gen5934" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2813"/><div sID="gen5935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2813"/> Sagō' angabut-ngabut sigām angolang pakosog in si Isa subay nilansang ni hāg. Jari hal magpabeya' la'a si Pilatu,

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: angkan pat'nna'na hukuman ma si Isa buwat pangamu' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: Pinal'ppa e'na a'a ya niamu' e' sigām pinaluwas, a'a bay takalabusu ma sabab panagga'na ma parinta maka ma sabab pamono'na. Sagō' tinukbalan si Isa ni sigām bo' tahinang buwat kabaya'an sigām.  <div eID="gen5935" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5929" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2814"/><div sID="gen5936" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Nilansang si Isa ni Hāg</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.32-Matt.27.44">Matiyu 27:32-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.21-Mark.15.32">Markus 15:21-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.17-John.19.27">Yahiya 19:17-27</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2814"/> Manjari itu binowa si Isa e' saga sundalu paluwas minnē'. Pasalta', aniya' a'a talanggal e' sigām palūd min deya tudju ni Awrusalam. Ōnna si Simun, a'a min lahat Kirini. Minandahan iya e' saga sundalu, pinatanggung ma iya hāg ya song pangalansangan si Isa. Sinō' iya ananggung min buli'an si Isa.  <div eID="gen5937" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2815"/><div sID="gen5938" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2815"/> Aheka to'ongan saga a'a paturul ma si Isa, maka aniya' isab saga d'nda angolang maka magtangis ma sababna.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: Palingi' si Isa ang'nda' ma sigām ati yukna, “Ka'am saga d'nda Awrusalam, da'a aku panangisanbi. Baranbi maka panganakbi ya subay panangisinbi.

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: Sabab aniya' llaw at'kka ma sinosōng in ka'am amissala du, ‘Ahāp sukud saga d'nda halam bay makapangiram, ya halam bay maka'anak maka halam bay makaparuru' onde'.’

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: Ya na ko' inān waktu kapanukna' manusiya' di-sigām, yuk-i, ‘Bang pa'in paligid ni aku saga būd itu! Bang pa'in aku katambunan e' saga kabūd-būran!’ ”

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Bang maka'ase'-ase' kahālanbi ma buwattina'an, akalap lagi' ma waktu sinōng inān. Buwat sapantun po'on kayu, bang tatunu' ma masi lagi' allum, luba'-lagi'na bang atoho' na.”  <div eID="gen5938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2816"/><div sID="gen5939" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2816"/> Aniya' gi' duwangan a'a saddī min si Isa binowa e' sigām pinapatay, a'a bay makalanggal sara'.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: Jari pagt'kka sigām ni lahat niōnan “Peya'-peya' Kōk”, na nilansang si Isa e' sigām ni hāg inān. Nilansang isab saga a'a makalanggal sara' ma hāg sigām. Dakayu' inān pinat'ngge ma bihing si Isa kowan maka dakayu' ma bihingna gibang.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: Anabbut si Isa ni Tuhan. “O Mma',” yukna, “ampunun saga a'a angalansang aku itu, sabab mbal tahati e' sigām bang ai hinang sigām.” <div eID="gen5939" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5940" type="paragraph"/> Maglegot saga sundalu, pinagtokoran e' sigām saga s'mmek si Isa bang ma sai dapuna.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: Magt'nggehan maina'an saga a'a ang'nda'-ng'nda' ma si Isa, maka pinagudju' iya e' saga pagnakura'an bangsa Yahudi. Yuk sigām, “A'a itu, makalappas a'a saddī. Subay iya angalappas di-na bang sab'nnal-b'nnal iya Al-Masi, ya tapene' e' Tuhan magsultan!”  <div eID="gen5940" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2817"/><div sID="gen5941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2817"/> Pinagtunggīng isab iya e' saga sundalu. Pasekot sigām ni iya anōngan binu al'ssom pamainum iya.

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Bang ka sab'nnal-b'nnal sultan saga Yahudi, angalappas ka di-nu!”  <div eID="gen5941" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2818"/><div sID="gen5942" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2818"/> Maka aniya' sulat bay pinat'nna' ma hāg min diyata' kōkna, yuk-i, “SULTAN BANGSA YAHUDI.”  <div eID="gen5942" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2819"/><div sID="gen5943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2819"/> Pinamūng-mūngan isab si Isa e' dakayu' a'a langgal sara' bay nilansang inān. Yukna, “Ka'a ya Al-Masi bahā'? Angalappas ka di-nu, bo' kami isab bowahun.”  <div eID="gen5943" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2820"/><div sID="gen5944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2820"/> Sagō' pinah'llingan iya e' a'a langgal sara' dakayu', yukna, “Angay? Halam aniya' tāwnu ma Tuhan? Sali'-sali' hukuman ma kitam t'llungan.

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: Sagō' kita duwangan itu, wajib kita subay pinapatay buwattitu sabab ya na tungbas saga kahinanganta. Sagō' a'a itu, halam aniya' la'at bay tahinangna.”

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: Jari yukna ni si Isa, “Isa, entomun aku bang ta'abut na waktu kapagparintanu.”  <div eID="gen5944" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2821"/><div sID="gen5945" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2821"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'a, llaw itu du magbeya' kita ma lahat Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen5945" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5936" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2822"/><div sID="gen5946" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.45-Matt.27.56">Matiyu 27:45-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.33-Mark.15.41">Markus 15:33-41</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.28-John.19.30">Yahiya 19:28-30</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2822"/> Jari itu, augtu pa'in llaw, angalendom mata llaw ati taluwa' lendom kaluha'an lahat e' sampay ni lisag t'llu kohap.

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: Maka agese' duwa in kultina ya pangagpang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan inān.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: Manjari angolang si Isa pakosog, yukna, “O Mma', sōnganku na nyawaku ni komkomannu.” Aubus pa'in pah'llingna itu, magtūy ab'kkat napasna.  <div eID="gen5947" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2823"/><div sID="gen5948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2823"/> Pag'nda' kapitan sundalu ma pakaradja'an itu, sanglitanna Tuhan. Yukna, “B'nnal a'a itu ahāp asal addatna.”

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: Sampay saga a'a magtimuk maina'an, pag'nda' sigām ma bay paniya' inān, magpamole' sigām an'ppak daggaha sigām sabab kaheya susa sigām.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: Ina'an isab magpan'ngge min katāhan saga bagay si Isa kamemon sampay saga d'nda bay ameya' paumpig ma iya min lahat Jalil lagi'. Ang'nda'-ng'nda' sigām ma pakaradja'an itu kamemon.  <div eID="gen5948" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5946" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2824"/><div sID="gen5949" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkubul ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.57-Matt.27.61">Matiyu 27:57-61</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.42-Mark.15.47">Markus 15:42-47</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.38-John.19.42">Yahiya 19:38-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2824"/> Na, aniya' a'a maina'an niōnan si Yusup, a'a min kaluma'an Arimati ya ma lahat Yahudiya. A'a abontol asal iya, ahāp addat-tabi'atna. Atuyu' iya angagad ma waktu pamat'nna' parinta Tuhan ma manusiya'. Dakayu' iya pagmatto'ahan, sagō' halam iya bay pauyun ma kagara'an maka kahinangan pagkahina pamapatay ma si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2824"/><div sID="gen5949" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkubul ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.57-Matt.27.61">Matiyu 27:57-61</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.42-Mark.15.47">Markus 15:42-47</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.19.38-John.19.42">Yahiya 19:38-42</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2824"/> Na, aniya' a'a maina'an niōnan si Yusup, a'a min kaluma'an Arimati ya ma lahat Yahudiya. A'a abontol asal iya, ahāp addat-tabi'atna. Atuyu' iya angagad ma waktu pamat'nna' parinta Tuhan ma manusiya'. Dakayu' iya pagmatto'ahan, sagō' halam iya bay pauyun ma kagara'an maka kahinangan pagkahina pamapatay ma si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: Jari pehē' si Yusup itu pa'alop ni si Pilatu angamu' mayat si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: Pinareyo' e'na min hāg ati sinaput e'na bo' yampa pat'nna'na ma deyom pagkubulan bay kinehean ma deyom batu lakit. Baha'u asal kubul inān, halam lagi' bay kapangubulan.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: Kohap Juma'at na ma buwattē', song llaw Sabtu', arai' na pas'ddop llaw.  <div eID="gen5950" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2825"/><div sID="gen5951" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2825"/> Bay ameya' isab ma si Yusup saga d'nda bay paumpig ma si Isa min lahat Jalil lagi', ati ta'nda' e' sigām kubul maka buwattingga e' si Yusup amat'nna' mayat si Isa.

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: Jari amole' na sigām anakap saga laksi' maka ns'llan pahamut pamahilala' sigām ma mayatna. <div eID="gen5951" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5952" type="paragraph"/> Ta'abut pa'in llaw Sabtu', pahali na sigām buwat panoho'an sara' agama.  <div eID="gen5952" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.23"/> <div eID="gen5949" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2826"/><div sID="gen5953" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Allum Pabīng</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.1-Matt.28.10">Matiyu 28:1-10</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.16.1-Mark.16.8">Markus 16:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.1-John.20.10">Yahiya 20:1-10</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5954" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2826"/> Pagk'llat llaw Ahad bo' subu-subu to'ongan, pehē' saga d'nda he' ni kubul amowa saga laksi' bay sakap sigām.

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: Pagt'kka pehē', ta'nda' e' sigām taplok batu wa'i bay ginulungan min lowang kubul.

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: Pasōd sigām ni deyom sagō' ta'nda' in mayat si Isa halam na maina'an,

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: ati asasaw pikilan sigām ma sabab ina'an-i. Sakali aniya' an'ngge ma bihing sigām duwangan l'lla, makasilaw sidda s'mmek sigā.

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: Sinōd tāw saga d'nda ina'an, angkan sigām hal patondok. Sagō' yuk duwangan l'lla inān, “Angay pihabi a'a allum maitu ma deyom kakubulan saga a'a magpatayan?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: Halam na maitu si Isa. Allum na iya pabalik. Entomunbi bay pah'llingna ma ka'am, waktu kamahe'na lagi' ma lahat Jalil.

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: Yukna he', ‘In aku, Anak Manusiya', sinōngan du pehē' ni pang'ntanan saga a'a dusahan bo' nilansang e' sigām ni hāg pinapatay. Ma kat'llu llawna, allum du aku pabīng.’ ”  <div eID="gen5954" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2827"/><div sID="gen5955" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2827"/> Jari taentom e' saga d'nda itu bay pah'lling si Isa he',

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: ati amole' sigām min kubul ni luma'. Nihaka e' sigām saga pakaradja'an itu kamemon ma saga mulid si Isa kasangpū' maka ssa, maka ma saga mulidna kasehe'.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: Ya d'nda angahaka itu si Mariyam a'a min Magdala, maka si Joanna, maka si Mariyam ina' si Yakub, maka saga d'nda saddī bay sehe' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: Sagō' mbal am'nnal saga a'a kawakilan ma haka saga d'nda inān sabab kinabā' hal magligaw.

verses.name: Luke 24:12
verses.text: Sagō' an'ngge si Petros min baina bo' paragan ni kubul. Pagt'kkana pehē', pakuru' iya pasīb, sagō' halam aniya' ta'nda'na ma deyom, luwal saga saput pat'nna'an di-na. Jari ala'an iya minnē' maka e'na ainu-inu ma bay paniya' inān.  <div eID="gen5955" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5953" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2828"/><div sID="gen5956" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Labayan Tudju ni Kauman Emmaus</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.16.12-Mark.16.13">Markus 16:12-13</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2828"/> Ma llaw ina'an-i aniya' duwangan mulid si Isa pal'ngngan tudju ni kaluma'an Emmaus, lawakna saga sangpū' maka dda kilometro (atawa batu) min Awrusalam.

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: Magsuli-suli na pa'in sigā pasal kamemon ya baha'u bay pat'kka inān.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: Hinabu pa'in sigā magsuli-suli, pasekot pina'an si Isa bo' magdongan maka sigā.

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: Ta'nda' iya e' sigā sagō' halam takilā in iya si Isa.  <div eID="gen5957" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2829"/><div sID="gen5958" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2829"/> Yukna ma sigā, “Ai pagsuli-sulihanbi ma pal'ngngananbi ilu?” <div eID="gen5958" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5959" type="paragraph"/> Pahogga' sigā magtūy, maka ala'at pamaihu'an sigā sabab asusa.

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: Jari anambung dangan inān, ya niōnan Kleyopas. “Alō!” yukna, “Hal du ka'a ma deyom da'ira Awrusalam a'awam pasal pakaradja'an ya baha'u bay pat'kka maina'an si', sabab kinata'uwan na e' a'a kamemon!”  <div eID="gen5959" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2830"/><div sID="gen5960" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2830"/> “Angay? Pakaradja'an ai?” yuk si Isa. <div eID="gen5960" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5961" type="paragraph"/> “Ya tahinang ma si Isa, a'a Nasaret,” yuk sigā. “Nabi asal iya, taga-kawasa ma pamissalana kamemon maka ma kahinanganna kamemon ma pang'nda' Tuhan maka ma pang'nda' manusiya'.

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: Bay iya ni'nde'an ni gubnul e' saga kaimaman kami alanga maka e' saga a'a pagnakura'an kami. Ni'nde'an iya pehē' supaya pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay, ati nilansang iya ni hāg bo' pinapatay.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
verses.text: Na, bay kami angasa-ngasa to'ongan in iya itu dakayu'-kayu' pinabeya' e' Tuhan amaluwas kami saga tubu' si Isra'il min kasigpitan. Saguwā' halam dapat, sabab aniya' na t'llumbahangi min bay kapamapatay sigām ma iya.

verses.name: Luke 24:22
verses.text: Lāgi, aniya' isab saga d'nda sehe' kami bay amowahan kami haka makakuddat insini'. Dai' llaw sī' bay sigām pehē' kono' palu'aw ni kubul si Isa,

verses.name: Luke 24:23
verses.text: sagō' halam na maina'an mayatna. Jari pabalik sigām ni kamaina'anan kami. Yuk sigām aniya' saga mala'ikat bay magpanyata' ni sigām. Bay ah'lling kono' mala'ikat e' in si Isa allum na.

verses.name: Luke 24:24
verses.text: Sakali aniya' saga sehe' kami bay anganyata' pehē' ni kubul ati ta'nda' e' sigām buwat bay pangahaka saga kar'ndahan e'. Sagō' halam ta'nda' si Isa.”  <div eID="gen5961" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2831"/><div sID="gen5962" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2831"/> Manjari ah'lling si Isa ni duwangan itu, yukna, “Ndū', babbal pahāp ka'am ilu! Angay halam kahagadbi kamemon bay pangabtang e' kanabi-nabihan?

verses.name: Luke 24:26
verses.text: Sabab bang ma sigām in Al-Masi wajib subay makalabay kabinasahan dahū bo' yampa pinabangsa.”

verses.name: Luke 24:27
verses.text: Jari pinahati duwangan itu e' si Isa pasal kamemon ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab ma sababna. Tinagna'an e'na min kasulatan si Musa, sampay ni kasulatan kanabi-nabihan kamemon.  <div eID="gen5962" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2832"/><div sID="gen5963" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2832"/> Makasekot pa'in sigā ni kaluma'an ya papehe'an sigā, magbau'-bau' si Isa palanjal gi'.

verses.name: Luke 24:29
verses.text: Manda' iya tinaggahan e' sigā, yuk-i, “Pi'itu na ka ameya' ma kami sabab kohap na to'ongan. Sōng na sangom.” Angkan pasōd si Isa bo' pahanti' ma sigā.

verses.name: Luke 24:30
verses.text: Makatingkō' pa'in sigām magsalu, niā' e'na tinapay ati niamu'an pagsukulan ni Tuhan. Puwas e' pinagpōng-pōng e'na bo' yampa pamuwanna ma sigā.

verses.name: Luke 24:31
verses.text: Minnē' pasawa pang'nda' sigā ati takilā iya. Sagō' alanyap iya magtūy.

verses.name: Luke 24:32
verses.text: Jari magsuli-suli sigā duwangan. “Angkan du kita landu' kahōpan ma h'llingna ma pal'ngnganan e', pagpahatina ma kita pasal Kitab.”  <div eID="gen5963" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2833"/><div sID="gen5964" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2833"/> Pabuhat sigā magtūy bo' pabīng ni Awrusalam. Pagt'kka sigā pehē', tabāk saga mulid si Isa kasangpū' maka ssa magtimuk maka mulid kasehe'an.

verses.name: Luke 24:34
verses.text: Yuk sigām ma duwangan itu, “Allum na Panghū'tam pabalik! Allum iya to'ongan! Bay iya patuwa' ni si Simun!”

verses.name: Luke 24:35
verses.text: Manjari anuli-nuli isab duwangan itu pasal bay kalabayan sigā ma lān, maka pasal pakakilā sigā ma si Isa ma salta'na magpōng-pōng tinapay.  <div eID="gen5964" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5956" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2834"/><div sID="gen5965" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Magpa'nda' na ma saga Mulidna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.16-Matt.28.20">Matiyu 28:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.16.14-Mark.16.18">Markus 16:14-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="John.20.19-John.20.23">Yahiya 20:19-23</reference>, <reference osisRef="Acts.1.6-Acts.1.8">Kahinangan 1:6-8</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5966" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2834"/> Hinabu pa'in magsuli-suli duwangan e', pina'an si Isa an'ngge ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām. Ah'lling iya, yukna, “Bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan.”  <div eID="gen5966" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2835"/><div sID="gen5967" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2835"/> Takuddat sigām magtūy maka nileya'-leya' to'ongan, sabab pangannal sigām in si Isa inān umagad.

verses.name: Luke 24:38
verses.text: Sagō' yukna ma sigām, “Angay tak'bbal deyom ataybi? Angay kam masi magduwa-ruwa?

verses.name: Luke 24:39
verses.text: Nda'unbi tanganku maka tape'ku itu. Aku na ko' itu. Ntaninbi ba baranku itu bo' kata'uwanbi in aku itu ngga'i ka umagad. Sabab umagad itu halam aniya' baranna aponod. Ta'nda'bi du aku, aniya' baranku.”  <div eID="gen5967" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2836"/><div sID="gen5968" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2836"/> Buwattē' pah'llingna ma sigām. Ati pa'nda'anna tanganna maka tape'na ma sigām.

verses.name: Luke 24:41
verses.text: Sagō' masi sigām kahunitan magkahagad in ina'an b'nnal, sabab mamarahi sidda kakōgan maka kainu-inuhan sigām. Angkan yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Aniya' bahā' maitu ai-ai takakan?”

verses.name: Luke 24:42
verses.text: Sinōngan iya dangkuri' daing tinapa.

verses.name: Luke 24:43
verses.text: Niā' e'na ati kinakan e'na ma pang'nda' sigām.

verses.name: Luke 24:44
verses.text: Puwas e' ah'lling iya, yukna, “Ya na ko' itu bay pah'llingku ma ka'am tagna', waktu kapameya'ku gi' ma ka'am. Yukku tantu aniya' kamaujuran ma kamemon bay tasulat ma pasal aku, ya tasulat ma Kitab Tawrat maka ma Kanabi-nabihan, maka ma Jūd Kalangan. Ai-ai pat'kka itu ma aku, ya na kamaujuran saga sulat sigām.”  <div eID="gen5968" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2837"/><div sID="gen5969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2837"/> Manjari pinasawa e' si Isa pikilan sigām bo' supaya makahati ma lapal Kitab e'.

verses.name: Luke 24:46
verses.text: Yukna ma sigām, “Ya na itu asal tasulat ma deyom Kitab: in Al-Masi subay pinananaman kabinasahan sampay pinapatay. Jari ta'abut pa'in kat'llu llaw min kamatayna allum du iya pabīng.

verses.name: Luke 24:47
verses.text: Subay pinagnasihatan isab saga bangsa kamemon pasal ka'ampunan dusa. Bang sigām magtaubat sampay ang'bbahan dusa sigām, niampun sigām e' Tuhan ma sabab Al-Masi. Subay tinagna'an pagnasihat itu min Awrusalam.

verses.name: Luke 24:48
verses.text: Ka'am ya bay maka'nda' ma ai-ai pat'kka ma aku, jari ka'am ya subay amuwan saksi'.

verses.name: Luke 24:49
verses.text: Pabeya'anku ka'am ya bay panganjanji' Mma'ku Tuhan. Sagō' da'a kam ala'an min da'ira itu sat'ggol kam halam pinahōpan kawasa min sulga'.”  <div eID="gen5969" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5965" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2838"/><div sID="gen5970" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pa'angkat si Isa Tudju ni Sulga'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.16.19-Mark.16.20">Markus 16:19-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Acts.1.9-Acts.1.11">Kahinangan 1:9-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5971" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2838"/> Jari binowa sigām e' si Isa paluwas min Awrusalam sampay maka'abut na ni kauman Betani. Pagabut sigām pina'an, pinat'ngge e' si Isa tanganna pangamu'na kahāpan ma sigām.

verses.name: Luke 24:51
verses.text: Pasalta' pa'in iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan, ala'an iya min sigām ati tabowa pa'angkat ni sulga'.

verses.name: Luke 24:52
verses.text: Amudji sigām ma iya maina'an bo' yampa pabīng tudju ni Awrusalam. Landu' aheya kakōgan sigām,

verses.name: Luke 24:53
verses.text: ati maina'an na pa'in sigām ananglitan Tuhan ma langgal pagkulbanan. <signed sID="gen5972"/> Tammat<signed eID="gen5972"/>  <div eID="gen5971" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5970" type="section"/> <div eID="gen5184" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Luke.24"/> <div eID="gen5178" osisID="Luke" type="book"/>

verses.name: John 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2839"/><div sID="gen5982" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palman maka Sawa</title> <div sID="gen5983" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2839"/> Ma halam gi' aniya' dunya, asal na Palman. Magdakayu' asal Palman itu maka Tuhan, maka Tuhan isab Palman.

verses.name: John 1:2
verses.text: Sangay min katagna' magdakayu' asal Palman maka Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5983" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2840"/><div sID="gen5984" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2840"/> Bay pinapanjari ai-ai kamemon e' Palman itu, bo' pa'in min kahandak Tuhan. Halam aniya' pinapanjari minsan ai bang ngga'i ka min Palman.

verses.name: John 1:4
verses.text: Palman ya po'onan kallum, maka kallum itu ya amuwan kasawahan ma panghati manusiya'.

verses.name: John 1:5
verses.text: Asinag na pa'in Sawa ma deyom kalendoman, sago' mbal kap'ddahan e' kalendoman.  <div eID="gen5984" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2841"/><div sID="gen5985" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2841"/> Aniya' a'a bay pinapi'itu e' Tuhan, niōnan si Yahiya.

verses.name: John 1:7
verses.text: Sinoho' iya amata'uwan bangsa manusiya' pasal Sawa, supaya makakale maka magkahagad saga a'a kamemon.

verses.name: John 1:8
verses.text: Ngga'i ka si Yahiya ya pinagōnan Sawa itu. Ya hinangna pi'itu ni dunya subay amuwan saksi' pasal Sawa.

verses.name: John 1:9
verses.text: Sawa b'nnal ko' inān, ya palahil ni dunya bo' amuwan kasawahan ma panghati maka itikad saga a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen5985" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2842"/><div sID="gen5986" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2842"/> Ma dunya pa'in Palman, halam iya takilā e' saga a'a maina'an, minsan sigām bay pinapanjari e'na min kahandak Tuhan.

verses.name: John 1:11
verses.text: Bay iya pi'itu ni lahatna luggiya', sagō' halam tataima' e' bangsana.

verses.name: John 1:12
verses.text: Saguwā' sasuku anaima' Palman itu sampay magkahagad ma iya, buwananna sigām kapatut bo' supaya sigām manjari anak Tuhan.

verses.name: John 1:13
verses.text: Tahinang sigām anak Tuhan, ngga'i ka buwat katubu' manusiya', atawa min kabaya'an manusiya', atawa min napsu l'lla. Ya angkan sigām tahinang anak Tuhan sabab min kahandak Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5986" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2843"/><div sID="gen5987" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2843"/> Manjari ya pinagōnan Palman itu bay palahil pi'itu magpabaran manusiya' bo' pat'nna' ma deyomantam. Jukup asal ma iya ase' maka lasa maka kasab'nnalan. Ta'nda' kami barakatna maka sahayana, ya palsuku'an Anak Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'.  <div eID="gen5987" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2844"/><div sID="gen5988" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2844"/> Anaksi' si Yahiya pasal Palman. Atanog pah'llingna yukna, “Ya na ko' itu bay pangahakaku ni ka'am, ya yukku, ‘Aniya' pi'itu damuli min aku, sagō' alanga gi' iya min aku sabab asal na iya ma halam gi' aku bay nianakan’.”

verses.name: John 1:16
verses.text: Ap'nno' Palman e' ase' maka lasa ati makasambut kitam min iya saga kahāpan manglabi-labihan.

verses.name: John 1:17
verses.text: Kapat'nna'an kitam sara'-panoho'an Tuhan labay min si Musa. Kapahampitan kitam ase' maka lasa sampay kasab'nnalan labay min si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: John 1:18
verses.text: Halam aniya' manusiya' bay maka'nda' Tuhan, luwal Anakna tunggalan ya pataptap ma bihingna. Pinata'u kitam e'na pasal kajarihan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen5988" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5982" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2845"/><div sID="gen5989" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Haka si Yahiya Magpapandi Pasal Al-Masi</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.3.1-Matt.3.12">Matiyu 3:1-12</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.1.1-Mark.1.8">Markus 1:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.3.1-Luke.3.18">Lukas 3:1-18</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen5990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2845"/> Na, buwattitu ya panambung si Yahiya waktu kapanilosa iya e' saga imam maka saga tatabang,<note>Tatabang: saga panubu' si Libi ya taga-kapatut anabang ma imam waktu kapaghinang ni Tuhan. Kaōnan ‘Levite’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> ya bay sinō' pehē' e' pagnakura'an Yahudi min da'ira Awrusalam. Tinilosa si Yahiya bang sai iya.

verses.name: John 1:20
verses.text: Halam ya bay magmarī' sagō' atampal sadja sambungna. Yukna, “Ngga'i ka aku Al-Masi.<note>Al-Masi, hatina a'a bay pinagba'atan e' kanabi-nabihan ma awal lagi'. In iya kono' pinene' e' Tuhan palahil ni dunya angaliyusan bangsa Isra'il min kasigpitan.</note>”  <div eID="gen5990" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2846"/><div sID="gen5991" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2846"/> “Na, sai ka?” yuk sigām. “Si Elija ka bahā'?” <div eID="gen5991" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5992" type="paragraph"/> “Ngga'i ka,” yuk si Yahiya. <div eID="gen5992" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5993" type="paragraph"/> Yuk gi' saga imam, “Ka'a bahā' dakayu' nabi ya nilagaran e' bangsatam Yahudi?” <div eID="gen5993" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen5994" type="paragraph"/> “Ngga'i ka,” yukna.  <div eID="gen5994" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2847"/><div sID="gen5995" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2847"/> Ma katapusanna tino'ongan patilaw sigām, yuk-i, “Haka'in kami to'ongan bang sai ka, sabab kami itu sinō' amowa haka ni saga a'a bay amapi'itu kami. Ai yuknu ma pasal ka'a barannu?”  <div eID="gen5995" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2848"/><div sID="gen5996" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2848"/> Manjari sali' du sambung si Yahiya maka bay tasulat e' nabi Isaya, yuk-i, “Aku itu a'a angalingan pakosog ma lahat paslangan. Ya pangalinganku, ‘Hawaninbi lān palabayan Panghū'’.”  <div eID="gen5996" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2849"/><div sID="gen5997" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2849"/> Na aniya' saga Parisi<note>Parisi: umpigan bangsa Yahudi maga'agama, ya atukid paokat min ai-ai makalumu'.</note> pinapehē'

verses.name: John 1:25
verses.text: atilaw si Yahiya, yuk-i, “Angay ka angkan magpandi saga a'a bang ka ngga'i ka Al-Masi atawa nabi Elija atawa Nabi dakayu'?”  <div eID="gen5997" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2850"/><div sID="gen5998" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2850"/> Yuk sambung si Yahiya, “Bohe' sadja ya pagpandiku ma saga a'a, sagō' aniya' an'ngge ma t'ngnga'bi ilu dakayu' a'a mbal kata'uwanbi.

verses.name: John 1:27
verses.text: Damuli gi' iya min aku, sagō' mbal aku tōp minsan angahubaran engkot taumpa'na, sabab alanga to'ongan iya min aku.”  <div eID="gen5998" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2851"/><div sID="gen5999" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2851"/> Bay paniya' pakaradja'an itu ma kauman Betani, ya ma dambila' sapa' Jordan ma lugal bay pagpandihan si Yahiya.  <div eID="gen5999" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen5989" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2852"/><div sID="gen6000" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinagsambatan Bili-bili Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen6001" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2852"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', ta'nda' e' si Yahiya si Isa tudju pehē' ni iya. Jari magsambatan si Yahiya yukna, “Nda'unbi, ilu na Bili-bili ya pamuwan e' Tuhan pagkulban ma sabab bangsa manusiya' supaya pinuwasan paldusahan sigām.

verses.name: John 1:30
verses.text: Ya na ko' itu bay pangahakaku ma ka'am, ya yukku, ‘Aniya' a'a pi'itu damuli min aku. Alanga gi' iya min aku sabab asal na iya ma halam gi' aku nianakan.’

verses.name: John 1:31
verses.text: Tagna', halam kata'uwanku bang sai iya. Sagō' pi'itu aku magpandi a'a ma bohe' supaya pinakilā si Isa ni bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen6001" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2853"/><div sID="gen6002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2853"/> “Halam iya bay kata'uwanku, manda' aku pinata'u e' Tuhan ya anoho' aku magpandi a'a maka bohe'. Yukna ma aku, ‘Bang ta'nda'nu Rū Sussi pat'ppak ma dakayu' a'a sampay pat'ttog ma iya, ya na ko' a'a magpapandi a'a maka Rū Sussi.’ ” Buwattitu isab panaksi' si Yahiya pasal si Isa, yuk-i, “Bay ta'nda'ku Rū Sussi paruwa'i min sulga' buwat luwa assang. Bay ta'nda'ku pat'ppak maka pat'ttog ma si Isa.

verses.name: John 1:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2853"/><div sID="gen6002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2853"/> “Halam iya bay kata'uwanku, manda' aku pinata'u e' Tuhan ya anoho' aku magpandi a'a maka bohe'. Yukna ma aku, ‘Bang ta'nda'nu Rū Sussi pat'ppak ma dakayu' a'a sampay pat'ttog ma iya, ya na ko' a'a magpapandi a'a maka Rū Sussi.’ ” Buwattitu isab panaksi' si Yahiya pasal si Isa, yuk-i, “Bay ta'nda'ku Rū Sussi paruwa'i min sulga' buwat luwa assang. Bay ta'nda'ku pat'ppak maka pat'ttog ma si Isa.

verses.name: John 1:34
verses.text: Ta'nda'ku to'ongan,” yukna, “angkan kasaksi'anku in si Isa Anak Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6002" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6000" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 1:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2854"/><div sID="gen6003" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Mulid si Isa Tagna'</title> <div sID="gen6004" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2854"/> Pagk'llat llaw dakayu', ina'an si Yahiya an'ngge pabalik ma dambila' sapa' Jordan, beya' maka duwangan mulidna.

verses.name: John 1:36
verses.text: Pag'nda'na si Isa palabay, ah'lling iya, yukna, “Nda'unbi. Ina'an Bili-bili min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6004" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2855"/><div sID="gen6005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2855"/> Takale pa'in h'lling si Yahiya itu e' duwangan mulidna, papinda sigā paturul ma si Isa.

verses.name: John 1:38
verses.text: Paglingi' si Isa, ta'nda'na duwangan a'a paturul ma iya ati tilawna sigā, yukna, “Ai gawibi?” <div eID="gen6005" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6006" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung sigā, “Tuwan Rabbi (hatina Tuwan Guru), maingga pat'nna'annu?”  <div eID="gen6006" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2856"/><div sID="gen6007" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2856"/> Yuk si Isa, “Dai' kam bo' ta'nda'bi.” <div eID="gen6007" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6008" type="paragraph"/> Jari ameya' sigā ma iya ati ta'nda' bang maingga pat'nna'anna. Maina'an sigā ma iya sampay ni kasangoman. Saga lisag mpat kohap ya waktu kapangabbitna ma sigām.  <div eID="gen6008" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2857"/><div sID="gen6009" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2857"/> Ōn dangan bay paturul inān si Andariyas, danakan si Simun Petros.

verses.name: John 1:41
verses.text: Jari patūy si Andariyas amiha danakanna he'. Tabākna pa'in, yukna ni si Simun, “Tabāk kami na Al-Masi.” (Hatina a'a tapene' e' Tuhan angaliyusan bangsana min kasigpitan.)

verses.name: John 1:42
verses.text: Jari binowa si Simun ni si Isa e' si Andariyas. <div eID="gen6009" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6010" type="paragraph"/> Pinatongan iya e' si Isa ati yukna ma iya, “Ka'a si Simun anak si Yahiya, sagō' ōnanta ka Kipas.” (Ōn Kipas itu sali' du maka Petros, hatina, ‘Batu’.)  <div eID="gen6010" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6003" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 1:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2858"/><div sID="gen6011" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Natanael maka si Pilip Binowa Pamulid ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6012" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2858"/> Pagsalung pa'in, agara' si Isa pehē' ni lahat Jalil. Tabākna si Pilip mahē' ati yukna ni iya, “Dai' ka ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: John 1:44
verses.text: Si Pilip itu a'a min kauman Betsaida, lahat si Andariyas maka si Petros.

verses.name: John 1:45
verses.text: Puwas e' piniha e' si Pilip si Natanael. Tabākna pa'in, magtūy haka'anna si Natanael, yukna, “Ta'nda' kami a'a bay pinapata e' si Musa ma deyom Kitab Tawrat, maka pinapata isab e' kanabi-nabihan ma kasulatan sigām. Si Isa iya, anak si Yusup min kauman Nasaret.”  <div eID="gen6012" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2859"/><div sID="gen6013" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2859"/> “He!” yuk si Natanael. “Aniya' bahā' kahāpan paluwas min Nasaret?” <div eID="gen6013" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6014" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Pilip, “Dai' ka anganyata'.”  <div eID="gen6014" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2860"/><div sID="gen6015" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2860"/> Pag'nda' si Isa ma si Natanael ina'an patudju ni iya, yukna, “A'a itu a'a Isra'il to'ongan, a'a mbal ata'u angakkal!”  <div eID="gen6015" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2861"/><div sID="gen6016" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2861"/> Yuk si Natanael, “Buwattingga kata'unu ma aku?” <div eID="gen6016" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6017" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Bay ka asal ta'nda'ku ma deyo' kayu igira ma halam gi' nilinganan e' si Pilip.”  <div eID="gen6017" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2862"/><div sID="gen6018" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2862"/> Anambung si Natanael, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, ka'a Anak Tuhan. Sultan ka ma bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen6018" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2863"/><div sID="gen6019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2863"/> Atilaw si Isa ma si Natanael, yukna, “Magkahagad ka bahā' ma aku saukat na yukku in ka'a bay ta'nda'ku ma deyo' kayu igira? Ma sinosōng aniya' du ta'nda'bi saga hinangku akalap gi' barakatna minnitu.”

verses.name: John 1:51
verses.text: Yukna isab ma sigām, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am. Ma sinosōng maka'nda' kam sulga' aukab, maka saga mala'ikat Tuhan magdeyo'-diyata' min aku, Anak Manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen6019" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.1"/> <div eID="gen6011" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2864"/><div sID="gen6020" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkawin ma Kaluma'an Kana</title> <div sID="gen6021" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2864"/> Palabay pa'in duwang'llaw, aniya' pagkawin ma kaluma'an Kana ya ma lahat Jalil. Wa'i ina' si Isa paluruk pehē'.

verses.name: John 2:2
verses.text: Ya du disi Isa maka saga mulidna bay sinō' paluruk.

verses.name: John 2:3
verses.text: Ahagin pa'in binu-anggul, ah'lling ina' si Isa ni iya, yukna, “Halam na aniya' binu-anggul sigām.”  <div eID="gen6021" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2865"/><div sID="gen6022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2865"/> Ya sambung si Isa, “Ina', minsan aku mbal soho'nu, aku ya magkabaya'an. Halam gi' ta'abut waktu pamatuwa' barakatku.”  <div eID="gen6022" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2866"/><div sID="gen6023" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2866"/> Jari anoho' ina' si Isa ma saga ipatan ma luma' inān. “Ai-ai panoho'anna ma ka'am,” yukna, “hinangunbi.”  <div eID="gen6023" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2867"/><div sID="gen6024" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2867"/> Na aniya' nnom poga batu maina'an pangisihan bohe' pagailan saga a'a, pagka addat sigām bangsa Yahudi. Dakayu' poga inān isihan saga dahatus litru.

verses.name: John 2:7
verses.text: Ah'lling si Isa ni saga ipatan e', yukna, “P'nno'inbi saga poga ilu maka bohe'.” Magtūy pin'nno'an e' sigām, pinagsamaintib maka bowa'na.

verses.name: John 2:8
verses.text: Puwas e' anoho' si Isa, yukna, “Saukunbi min poga ilu bo' binowa ni nakura' ya tag-jamuhan.” Magtūy binowa e' sigām pehē' ni nakura' he',

verses.name: John 2:9
verses.text: ati kininaman e'na binu-anggul bay bohe'. Halam kata'uwanna bang minningga binu inān sagō' kinata'uwan asal e' saga ipatan ya bay anauk iya. Pagkinam pa'in e' nakura', magtūy lingananna pangantin l'lla.

verses.name: John 2:10
verses.text: “Kamaumuhanna,” yukna, “bang ma pagkawinan, binu ahāp ya pamainum dahū ma saga a'a maglurukan. Subay aheka tainum e' sigām bo' yampa pamainum binu kulang hāpna. Sagō' bang ka'a,” yukna, “binu ahāp ya tau'nu sampay ma buwattina'an.”  <div eID="gen6024" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2868"/><div sID="gen6025" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2868"/> Ya na itu paltanda'an tagna' nihinang e' si Isa. Nihinang e'na mahē' ma Kana ya ma lahat Jalil. Minnē' pina'nda'an e'na kawasana, manjari magkahagad ma iya saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen6025" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2869"/><div sID="gen6026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2869"/> Puwas e', palūd disi Isa pehē' ni da'ira Kapirnaum. Ya sehe'na inān ina'na maka saga danakanna maka saga mulidna. Ina'an sigām pahanti' daka pilambahangi.  <div eID="gen6026" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6020" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2870"/><div sID="gen6027" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.12-Matt.21.13">Matiyu 21:12-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.11.15-Mark.11.19">Markus 11:15-19</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.45-Luke.19.48">Lukas 19:45-48</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6028" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2870"/> Manjari itu asekot na waktu paghinang Yahudi ya niōnan Hinang Paglakad, angkan si Isa patukad ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: John 2:14
verses.text: Pagt'kkana pehē', pasōd iya ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Aniya' ta'nda'na ma deyomna inān saga a'a magdagang sapi' maka bili-bili maka assang. Ta'nda'na isab saga a'a pagsasambi'an sīn aningkō' ma lamisahan sigām.

verses.name: John 2:15
verses.text: Pag'nda' itu e' si Isa, angā' iya lubid nihinang lulubak bo' s'ssolna saga a'a kamemon paluwas min deyom langgal, beya' isab saga sapi' maka saga bili-bili. Binulangkayat e'na saga lamisahan a'a magsasambi' sīn, maka pinakaukanat sīn sigām.

verses.name: John 2:16
verses.text: Yukna ni saga magdaragang assang. “La'aninbi daganganbi ilu! Langgal itu mbal manjari nihinang tabu' sabab luma' Mma'ku Tuhan!”

verses.name: John 2:17
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga mulid si Isa ma hinangna itu, taentom e' sigām sulat Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Pagtuyu'ku ma luma'nu, O Tuhan, sali' hantang api ma deyom atayku agon makamula.”  <div eID="gen6028" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2871"/><div sID="gen6029" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2871"/> Sakali tinilaw si Isa e' saga nakura' Yahudi, yuk-i, “Ai kapatutnu maghinang saga hinangnu ilu? Panda'in kami hinang makainu-inu tanda' saksi' in ka'a taga-kapatut.”  <div eID="gen6029" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2872"/><div sID="gen6030" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2872"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Lubuhunbi langgal itu ati bangunku pabalik ma deyom t'llung'llaw.”  <div eID="gen6030" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2873"/><div sID="gen6031" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2873"/> “Ōy!” yuk saga nakura' he'. “Langgal itu, mpatpū' maka nnom tahun bay kapangahinang iya. Tabangunnu pabīng bahā' ma deyom t'llung'llaw sadja?”

verses.name: John 2:21
verses.text: Malaingkan ya langgal pinagbissala e' si Isa inān baranna du.

verses.name: John 2:22
verses.text: Angkanna, ta'abut pa'in waktu kallum si Isa pabalik min kamatayna, taentom e' saga mulidna bissalana itu ati tapagkahagad e' sigām sulat Kitab maka bissala si Isa.  <div eID="gen6031" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2874"/><div sID="gen6032" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2874"/> Mahē' pa'in si Isa ma Awrusalam salta' ma Hinang Paglakad, aheka a'a magkahagad ma iya pagka ta'nda' e' sigām saga hinangna makainu-inu.

verses.name: John 2:24
verses.text: Sagō' mbal angandol si Isa ma sigām, sabab kata'uwanna asal kajarihan sigām kamemon.

verses.name: John 2:25
verses.text: Minsan halam aniya' amata'u, kata'uwanna asal bang ai ma deyom atay manusiya'.  <div eID="gen6032" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.2"/> <div eID="gen6027" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2875"/><div sID="gen6033" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Nikudimas</title> <div sID="gen6034" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2875"/> Manjari itu aniya' a'a min umpigan Parisi, ōnna si Nikudimus.

verses.name: John 3:2
verses.text: Ma dakayu' sangom pehē' iya ni si Isa bo' ah'lling, yukna, “Tuwan Guru, kata'uwan kami in ka'a guru pinapi'itu e' Tuhan. Sabab mbal ka makahinang saga hinang makainu-inu ya hinangnu ilu, luwal bang ka tinabang e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6034" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2876"/><div sID="gen6035" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2876"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'a, halam aniya' manusiya' maka'nda' pagparinta Tuhan, luwal bang a'a nianakan min duwa.”  <div eID="gen6035" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2877"/><div sID="gen6036" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2877"/> Yuk si Nikudimus, “Buwattingga a'a nianakan pabalik bang aumul na? Tantu iya mbal makasōd pabalik ni deyom kandang ina'na bo' nianakan pabalik!”  <div eID="gen6036" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2878"/><div sID="gen6037" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2878"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'a, halam aniya' a'a makasōd ni pagparintahan Tuhan, luwal bang a'a nianakan min bohe' maka min Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: John 3:6
verses.text: Ya nianakan e' manusiya', manusiya' asal, sagō' ya nianakan min Rū Tuhan tahinang anak Tuhan taga-rū isab.

verses.name: John 3:7
verses.text: Da'a ka ainu-inu pagka yukku ma ka'a in ka'am subay nianakan pabalik.

verses.name: John 3:8
verses.text: Dalilta baliyu, ya ameya' pi'ingga-pi'ingga kabaya'anna. Takalenu bahonosna, sagō' mbal kata'uwannu bang minningga atawa pi'ingga. Buwattē' du isab bang a'a nianakan min Rū Tuhan, mbal kinata'uwan bang minningga kaniya'na.”  <div eID="gen6037" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2879"/><div sID="gen6038" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2879"/> “Buwattingga kajarina itu?” yuk tilaw si Nikudimus.  <div eID="gen6038" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2880"/><div sID="gen6039" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2880"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Mbal tahatinu bahā'? Guru babantugun lagi' ka ma bangsata Isra'il?

verses.name: John 3:11
verses.text: B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'a, amissala kami pasal ai-ai kata'uwan kami, maka anaksi' kami pasal bay ta'nda' kami. Sagō' ka'am ilu mbal magkahagad.

verses.name: John 3:12
verses.text: Buwattingga e'bi magkahagad ma bissalaku pasal sulga', bang minsan bissalaku pasal dunya mbal pagkahagadbi?

verses.name: John 3:13
verses.text: Halam aniya' bay makapehē' ni sulga', luwal aku Anak Manusiya', ya pi'itu asal deyo' bay min sulga'.  <div eID="gen6039" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2881"/><div sID="gen6040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2881"/> “Ma waktu awal, hinabu ma lahat paslangan lagi' bangsa Isra'il, aniya' sowa dī tumbaga bay niangkat e' si Musa ma hāg bo' ta'nda' e' saga a'a bay keket sowa. Jari sai-sai maka'nda' bay kauli'an. Damikiyanna in aku Anak Manusiya' subay niangkat ma hāg,

verses.name: John 3:15
verses.text: jari sasuku angandol ma aku pinaniya'an kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen6040" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2882"/><div sID="gen6041" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2882"/> “Aheya to'ongan lasa Tuhan ma manusiya', ya po'on paglilla'na Anakna tunggal pinapatay bo' supaya sasuku angandol ma Anakna itu mbal binutawanan min Tuhan, sagō' kakkal kallumna sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: John 3:17
verses.text: Ngga'i ka hukuman dusa ya minaksud e' Tuhan angkan papi'ituna Anakna. Ya maksudna subay lappasan min hukuman bangsa manusiya' kamemon labay min si Isa.

verses.name: John 3:18
verses.text: Sasuku angandol ma Anak Tuhan mbal taluwa' hukuman Tuhan. Sagō' sasuku mbal angandol, asal taluwa' hukuman, sabab halam sigām bay angandol ma si Isa, ya tunggal anak Tuhan.

verses.name: John 3:19
verses.text: Buwattitu ya pangahukuman Tuhan: si Isa ya bay pi'itu ni dunya amasawa deyom pikilan manusiya' sagō' manusiya' itu mbal bilahi ma kasawahan. Ya kabaya'an sigām subay kalendoman sabab ala'at saga hinang sigām.

verses.name: John 3:20
verses.text: Sasuku maghinang ala'at ab'nsi to'ongan ma kasawahan, maka mbal pasekot ni kasawahan sabab mbal bilahi ta'nda' saga hinang sigām ala'at.

verses.name: John 3:21
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku maghinang abontol bilahi ni kasawahan supaya talhakit in hinang sigām ameya' du ma panoho'an Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6041" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6033" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2883"/><div sID="gen6042" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Yahiya</title> <div sID="gen6043" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2883"/> Puwas e' pehē' si Isa maka saga mulidna ni lahat Yahudiya. At'ggol-t'ggol kamahē'na maka sigām. Magpandi isab iya saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: John 3:23
verses.text: Pasalta', magpandi na pa'in si Yahiya ma lahat Anon ya ma atag kauman Salim, sabab aheka bohe' maina'an maka angabut-ngabut saga a'a pina'an ni iya mikipandi. Dahū ko' inān min waktu kapangalabusu ma iya.

verses.name: John 3:24
verses.text: Pasalta', magpandi na pa'in si Yahiya ma lahat Anon ya ma atag kauman Salim, sabab aheka bohe' maina'an maka angabut-ngabut saga a'a pina'an ni iya mikipandi. Dahū ko' inān min waktu kapangalabusu ma iya.

verses.name: John 3:25
verses.text: Jari aniya' pagsu'alan saga mulid si Yahiya maka dakayu' Yahudi pasal addat sigām magail.

verses.name: John 3:26
verses.text: Pehē' sigām ah'lling ni si Yahiya, yuk-i, “Tuwan Guru, taentomnu bahā' a'a bay ma ka'a ma dambila' sapa' Jordan e', ya bay saksi'annu? Na, ina'an iya magpandi saga a'a buwattina'an. Pina'an ni iya saga a'a kamemon.”  <div eID="gen6043" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2884"/><div sID="gen6044" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2884"/> Anambung si Yahiya, yukna, “Halam aniya' kapatut manusiya' bang ngga'i ka Tuhan ya amuwanan iya.

verses.name: John 3:28
verses.text: Ka'am ilu makasaksi'an aku du, bay na sa yukku in aku ngga'i ka Al-Masi. Tu'ud aku sinō' parahū min iya anakapan ai-ai.

verses.name: John 3:29
verses.text: Sapantun magkawin, pangantin l'lla ya tag-h'nda. Sagō' panonna, ya an'ngge ma atag ina'an akale-kale, kinōgan asal pagka takalena lagam pangantin l'lla. Buwattē' kahālanna ma kami maka si Isa,” yuk si Yahiya. “Halam aniya' kulang ma kakōganku pagka iya inān takale na.

verses.name: John 3:30
verses.text: Subay pasōng kabantugan si Isa, maka aku itu subay pakō'-kō'.”  <div eID="gen6044" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6042" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2885"/><div sID="gen6045" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Pi'itu min Sulga'</title> <div sID="gen6046" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2885"/> Ya pi'itu min sulga' alanga asal min kamemon. Hal kahālan dunya ya tasuli-suli e' a'a min dunya, sabab suku' dunya iya. Sagō' alanga asal min kamemon ya pi'itu min sulga'.

verses.name: John 3:32
verses.text: Pamandu'na ai-ai bay ta'nda'na maka takalena mahē' ma sulga', sagō' halam aniya' magkahagad ma lapalna.

verses.name: John 3:33
verses.text: Ya balikna, sasuku magkahagad, angaho' du in pangallam Tuhan asal b'nnal kamemon.

verses.name: John 3:34
verses.text: Bang aniya' pinapi'itu e' Tuhan, lapal Tuhan ya pamissalana sabab kabuwanan iya Rū Tuhan ma halam aniya' kulangna.

verses.name: John 3:35
verses.text: Alasa Tuhan ma Anakna ati pamuwanna ma iya kapatut ang'ntanan kamemon.

verses.name: John 3:36
verses.text: Taga-kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan sasuku angandol ma Anak Tuhan. Sasuku mbal angandol maka mbal ameya' ma Anak Tuhan, halam aniya' kallum sigām kakkal sagō' pat'ddas du sigām ma mulka' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6046" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.3"/> <div eID="gen6045" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2886"/><div sID="gen6047" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Magbissala maka D'nda min Samariya</title> <div sID="gen6048" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2886"/> Jari itu takale e' saga Parisi pasal saga a'a pinandi e' si Isa nihinang mulidna. Labi aheka kono' min saga a'a ya tahinang mulid si Yahiya.

verses.name: John 4:2
verses.text: Sagō' ya b'nnalna, ngga'i ka si Isa baranna ya magpandi, luwal saga mulidna.

verses.name: John 4:3
verses.text: Na, pagka kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai pinagsuli-suli he', ala'an iya maka saga mulidna min lahat Yahudiya bo' pabīng ni lahat Jalil.

verses.name: John 4:4
verses.text: Ya lān pal'ngnganan sigām palabay asal min t'ngnga' lahat Samariya.  <div eID="gen6048" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2887"/><div sID="gen6049" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2887"/> Mahē' sigām ma lahat Samariya, at'kka sigām pehē' ni dakayu' da'ira niōnan Sikar. Asekot lahat itu ni tana' bay pamuwan e' si Yakub ni anakna si Yusup ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: John 4:6
verses.text: Aniya' ma tana' inān bohe' kali bay tahinang e' si Yakub ati aningkō' si Isa ma bihing bohe' inān sabab binale' iya ma pagl'ngnganan. Augtu na llaw ma buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen6049" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2888"/><div sID="gen6050" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2888"/> Halam maina'an saga mulidna sabab wa'i sigām ni da'ira am'lli kinakan sigām. Sakali itu aniya' d'nda Samariya pina'an anambu' bohe'. Ah'lling si Isa ni iya, yukna, “Buwanin kono' aku bohe' inumku.”  <div eID="gen6050" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2888"/><div sID="gen6050" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2888"/> Halam maina'an saga mulidna sabab wa'i sigām ni da'ira am'lli kinakan sigām. Sakali itu aniya' d'nda Samariya pina'an anambu' bohe'. Ah'lling si Isa ni iya, yukna, “Buwanin kono' aku bohe' inumku.”  <div eID="gen6050" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2889"/><div sID="gen6051" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2889"/> Anambung d'nda, yukna, “Oy, bangsa Yahudi ka, maka aku itu bangsa Samariya ko'! Angay aku pangamu'annu bohe'?” Angkan buwattē' pah'lling d'nda sabab bangsa Yahudi mbal bilahi angangguna kapanyapan saga a'a Samariya.  <div eID="gen6051" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2890"/><div sID="gen6052" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2890"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bangsi' kata'uwannu bang ai pamuwan Tuhan ma manusiya', maka bang sai aku ya angamu' bohe' itu ni ka'a, tantu du ka angamu' bohe' ni aku. Jari painumta du ka bohe' makakallum.”  <div eID="gen6052" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2891"/><div sID="gen6053" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2891"/> “Tuwan,” yuk d'nda, “minningga panambu'annu bohe' makakallum? Halam aniya' panambu'nu, maka alalom pahāp pagbohe'an itu.

verses.name: John 4:12
verses.text: Bohe' kali itu bay pang'bba kami e' ka'mbo'-mbo'antam si Yakub. Sigām magtai'anak sampay saga hayop sigām bay anginum min bohe' itu. Palabi bahā' kawasanu min kawasa si Yakub e'?”  <div eID="gen6053" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2892"/><div sID="gen6054" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2892"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Tantu patay bohe' pabīng sasuku anginum bohe' kali itu.

verses.name: John 4:14
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku anginum bohe' pamainumku, mbal to'ongan iya patay bohe' pabīng. Sabab bohe' pamainumku iya sapantun tuburan bohe' amuwal ma deyom atayna, amuwanan iya bohe' makakallum saumul-umul.”  <div eID="gen6054" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2893"/><div sID="gen6055" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2893"/> “Tuwan,” yuk d'nda, “buwanin aku bohe' ya pah'llingnu itu bo' aku mbal patay bohe' pabīng. Ati mbal na aku pi'itu anambu' bohe'.”  <div eID="gen6055" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2894"/><div sID="gen6056" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2894"/> “Pehē' ka, ngā'un h'llanu,” yuk si Isa, “ati bowahun iya pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen6056" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2895"/><div sID="gen6057" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2895"/> “Halam aniya' h'llaku,” yuk sambung d'nda. <div eID="gen6057" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6058" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “B'nnal ya yuknu ilu, halam aniya' h'llanu.

verses.name: John 4:18
verses.text: Sabab min lima ka bay magh'lla sagō' ya l'lla parakayu'annu buwattitu ngga'i ka h'llanu. Taluwa' llingnu ilu.”  <div eID="gen6058" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2896"/><div sID="gen6059" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2896"/> Yuk d'nda, “Tuwan, ta'nda'ku in ka'a nabi.

verses.name: John 4:20
verses.text: Bay anambahayang ka'mbo'-mbo'an kami bangsa Samariya maitu ma būd itu. Sagō' bang ma ka'am saga Yahudi, Awrusalam ya panambahayangantam Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6059" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2897"/><div sID="gen6060" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2897"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Arung, b'nnalun llingku itu. Aniya' du waktu ma sinosōng, bang a'a magpamudji ma Mma'tam Tuhan, ngga'i ka ma būd itu atawa mahē' ma Awrusalam ya lugal pagpudjihan sigām.

verses.name: John 4:22
verses.text: Ka'am saga a'a Samariya mbal ata'u bang ai ya pagta'atanbi. Saguwā' in kami makata'u asal, sabab in paglappas ma manusiya' paluwa' min bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: John 4:23
verses.text: Sagō' buwattitu, at'kka na waktu bay nilagaran, waktu kapamudji Mma'tam Tuhan e' saga a'a magpamudji sab'nnal-b'nnal, min itikad maka min kasab'nnalan. Buwattē' asal kabaya'an Tuhan.

verses.name: John 4:24
verses.text: In Tuhan rū asal, maka sasuku amudji iya subay min itikad sigām maka min kasab'nnalan.”  <div eID="gen6060" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2898"/><div sID="gen6061" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2898"/> Yuk d'nda ni si Isa, “Asal kata'uwanku, ma sinosōng pi'itu du Al-Masi (ya pinene' e' Tuhan angaliyusan bangsana min kasigpitan).”  <div eID="gen6061" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2899"/><div sID="gen6062" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2899"/> Yuk si Isa, “Aku na ko', ya amissala itu ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen6062" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2900"/><div sID="gen6063" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2900"/> Sakali at'kka saga mulid si Isa pabīng pehē'. Ati ainu-inu sigām pagka ta'nda' si Isa e' sigām magsuli-suli maka d'nda. Sagō' halam aniya' min sigām anilaw d'nda inān bang ai gawina, atawa anilaw si Isa bang angay iya magsuli-suli maka iya.  <div eID="gen6063" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2901"/><div sID="gen6064" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2901"/> Manjari itu ni'bbahan e' d'nda inān kibut pagbohe'anna bo' yampa pabalik pehē' ni kaluma'an. Pagt'kkana pehē' ah'lling iya ni saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: John 4:29
verses.text: “Dai' na kam,” yukna. “Nda'unbi a'a bay angahaka'an aku pasal kamemon bay hinangku. Ya itu bahā' Al-Masi?”

verses.name: John 4:30
verses.text: Jari paluwas saga a'a inān min da'ira bo' pal'ngngan pehē' ang'nda' si Isa.  <div eID="gen6064" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2902"/><div sID="gen6065" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2902"/> Na, makala'an pa'in d'nda he', anganjunjung saga mulid si Isa bang pa'in iya amangan. Yuk sigām, “Tuwan, amangan ka.”  <div eID="gen6065" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2903"/><div sID="gen6066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2903"/> Sagō' anambung si Isa, yukna, “Aniya' kinakanku mbal kata'uwanbi.”  <div eID="gen6066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2904"/><div sID="gen6067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2904"/> Magtilawan di-sigām saga mulid e', yuk-i, “Aniya' bahā' bay amowahan iya kinakan?”  <div eID="gen6067" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2905"/><div sID="gen6068" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2905"/> Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Ya maka'ssohan aku bang tahinangku kabaya'an Tuhan, ya amapi'itu aku. Maka subay talusku saga hinang bay pamahinangna ma aku.

verses.name: John 4:35
verses.text: Inggay aniya' bissalabi, ya yuk-i, ‘Mpat bulan gi' bo' yampa waktu pagani?’ Sagō' haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “ta'abut na waktu pagani. Nda'unbi saga a'a magpi'itu inān. Sapantun sigām buwa' huma atiguma' na, sakap na pinagani.

verses.name: John 4:36
verses.text: Ahāp tungbas ma sasuku animuk buwa' itu. Hatina animuk iya manusiya' pinaniya'an kallum kakkal. Angkan magdakayu' magkōg-koyagan saga a'a magtanom maka a'a magtimuk.

verses.name: John 4:37
verses.text: B'nnal bissala inān ya yuk-i, ‘Saddī a'a magtanom, saddī a'a magani.’

verses.name: John 4:38
verses.text: Bay soho'ku ka'am magani buwa' minsan ngga'i ka paglu'uganbi. Saddī iya bay maglu'ug, sagō' makahampit du kam min paglu'ugan sigām.”  <div eID="gen6068" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2906"/><div sID="gen6069" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2906"/> Manjari aheka saga a'a Samariya min da'ira Sikar magkahagad ma si Isa ma sabab bay lling d'nda, ya yuk-i, “Kahaka'an aku e'na pasal kamemon bay tahinangku.”

verses.name: John 4:40
verses.text: Angkan pagt'kka saga a'a Samariya pehē' ni si Isa, nilogos iya e' sigām subay pat'nna' gi' ma lahat sigām. Jari duwambahangi ya pahanti'na maina'an.  <div eID="gen6069" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2907"/><div sID="gen6070" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2907"/> Pasalta' pa'in si Isa maina'an, aheka lagi' saga a'a magkahagad ma iya ma sabab pamandu'na.

verses.name: John 4:42
verses.text: Yuk saga a'a itu ma d'nda, “Buwattina'an magkahagad na kami ma si Isa, ngga'i ka ma sabab pangahakanu ma kami sagō' ma sabab baran kami makakale na ma pamandu'na. Kata'uwan kami na in iya sab'nnal-b'nnal maglalappas ma saga manusiya' ma deyom dunya itu.”  <div eID="gen6070" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6047" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 4:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2908"/><div sID="gen6071" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anak Bag'llal Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6072" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2908"/> Apuwas pa'in duwambahangi kahanti' disi Isa ma da'ira Sikar e', ala'an sigām minnē' tudju ni lahat Jalil.

verses.name: John 4:44
verses.text: (Aniya' asal bay pamissala si Isa, ya yuk-i, “In nabi mbal pinagaddatan e' saga a'a ma lahatna luggiya'.”)

verses.name: John 4:45
verses.text: Pagt'kka disi Isa ni lahat Jalil, pasampang ni iya saga a'a maina'an, sabab bay sigām ma Awrusalam pasabu ma waktu Hinang Paglakad, ati ta'nda' e' sigām kamemon ya tahinang e' si Isa maina'an.  <div eID="gen6072" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2909"/><div sID="gen6073" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2909"/> Manjari pabalik si Isa pehē' ni Kana ma lahat Jalil. Ya na ko' he' lahat bay pamindahanna bohe' ni binu-anggul. Sakali itu aniya' dakayu' bag'llal sultan pasabu pehē'. Wa'i anakna l'lla asaki ma da'ira Kapirnaum.

verses.name: John 4:47
verses.text: Pagkale bag'llal itu in si Isa ina'an bay at'kka ni lahat Jalil min lahat Yahudiya, magtūy iya pehē' ni si Isa anganjunjung bang pa'in pinauli' anakna, sabab song na magkamamatay.

verses.name: John 4:48
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Tantu kam mbal magkahagad, luwal bang kam maka'nda' saga paltanda'an nihinang pagkainu-inuhan a'a.”  <div eID="gen6073" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2910"/><div sID="gen6074" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2910"/> Yuk bag'llal ni iya, “Ndū', Tuwan, pasa'ut lagi' ka ma aku sabab sa'at-sa'at amatay anakku.”  <div eID="gen6074" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2911"/><div sID="gen6075" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2911"/> “Pehē' na ka,” yuk si Isa. “Pauli' du anaknu.” <div eID="gen6075" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6076" type="paragraph"/> Pinarassaya e' bag'llal pah'lling si Isa itu ati ala'an iya tudju amole'.

verses.name: John 4:51
verses.text: Ma labayan pa'in, tasampang iya e' saga sosoho'anna ati nihaka'an iya e' sigām, yuk-i, “Kauli'an na anaknu.”

verses.name: John 4:52
verses.text: Tinilaw sigām e'na bang lisag pila bay kauli' sakina ati yuk sambung sigām, “Lisag dakayu' kohap-in bay kala'an pasu'na.”

verses.name: John 4:53
verses.text: Jari nientom e' mma' onde' inān ya na to'ongan waktu bay kapah'lling si Isa ni iya, ya yuk-i, “Pauli' du anaknu.” Angkanna bag'llal inān sampay saga a'a kamemon ma okomanna magkahagad na ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen6076" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2912"/><div sID="gen6077" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2912"/> Paltanda'an si Isa karuwana itu bay tahinang e'na pagkainu-inuhan a'a ma lahat Jalil, waktu kabalikna pehē' min lahat Yahudiya.  <div eID="gen6077" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.4"/> <div eID="gen6071" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2913"/><div sID="gen6078" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a ma Bihing Tigbaw Kauli'an e' si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6079" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2913"/> Puwas e' patukad disi Isa ni Awrusalam sabab aniya' paghinang saga Yahudi mahē'.

verses.name: John 5:2
verses.text: Na, aniya' ma Awrusalam inān bohe' tigbaw, ōnna Betsata bang ma bissala Hibrani. Bohe' itu asekot ni lawang pagsōd-luwasan da'ira, ya niōnan Lawang Bili-bili, maka aniya' lima saurung maina'an pagsindungan a'a.

verses.name: John 5:3
verses.text: Na, ma waktu ina'an aheka a'a asaki maglegehan ma ba'anan pagsindungan inān. Aniya' sigām abuta, aniya' apengka' maka aniya' amatay ugatna. [Ya nilagaran e' sigām kagawgaw bohe'.

verses.name: John 5:4
verses.text: Sababna bang pasān aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan pareyo' ni bohe' inān anganggawgaw. Jari sai-sai makarahū pehē' ni deyom bohe' aubus pa'in bay ginawgaw, kauli'an du minsan ai sakina.]

verses.name: John 5:5
verses.text: Jari itu aniya' maina'an a'a taga-saki, t'llumpū' na maka waluntahun ya t'ggol sakina.

verses.name: John 5:6
verses.text: Ta'nda' iya e' si Isa palege maina'an, maka kata'uwanna at'ggol na kasaki a'a inān. Jari atilaw ma iya si Isa, yukna, “Bilahi ka bahā' kauli'an?”  <div eID="gen6079" type="paragraph"/>
