verses.name: John 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2914"/><div sID="gen6080" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2914"/> Anambung a'a sakihan, yukna, “Aho', Tuwan, sagō' halam aniya' amuhat aku pehē' ni tigbaw bang pagawgaw bohe'na. Hinabuku paingsud pehē', aniya' parahū min aku.”  <div eID="gen6080" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2915"/><div sID="gen6081" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2915"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Pabungkal ka, bowahun palegehannu bo' ka magtūy lum'ngngan.”

verses.name: John 5:9
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du kauli'an a'a inān, magtūy iya lum'ngngan amowa palegehanna. <div eID="gen6081" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6082" type="paragraph"/> Na, llaw ina'an llaw Sabtu',

verses.name: John 5:10
verses.text: angkan buwattitu pamissala saga Yahudi ma a'a bay kauli'an sakina inān, yuk-i, “Oy, llaw paghali ko' itu! Talanggalnu sara'tam pagka buhatnu palegehannu.”  <div eID="gen6082" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2916"/><div sID="gen6083" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2916"/> Anambung iya ma sigām, yukna, “Ya a'a bay amauli' aku bay anoho' aku amowa palegehanku, maka anoho' aku lum'ngngan.”  <div eID="gen6083" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2917"/><div sID="gen6084" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2917"/> “Sai a'a bay anoho' ka'a?” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen6084" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2918"/><div sID="gen6085" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2918"/> Sagō' mbal kinata'uwan e' a'a inān bang sai, sabab bay pas'llot si Isa magtūy min katimukan a'a.  <div eID="gen6085" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2919"/><div sID="gen6086" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2919"/> Puwas e' tabāk a'a itu e' si Isa ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Nda'un ba, kauli'an na sakinu, angkan ka subay ang'bba min saga dusanu. Ya aniya', pat'kkahan ka la'at akosog gi' min bay dahū.”  <div eID="gen6086" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2920"/><div sID="gen6087" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2920"/> Manjari ala'an a'a inān minna'an ati pehē' angahaka'an saga nakura' Yahudi in si Isa bay amauli' iya.

verses.name: John 5:16
verses.text: Angkanna si Isa nila'at e' saga Yahudi, sabab kauli'an e'na saki a'a pasalta' ma llaw paghali.

verses.name: John 5:17
verses.text: Ah'lling si Isa ni sigām, yukna, “Mma'ku Tuhan maghinang na pa'in sampay ni kabuwattina'an, damikiyanna aku subay maghinang isab.”  <div eID="gen6087" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2921"/><div sID="gen6088" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2921"/> Ya he' po'onna angkan saga Yahudi inān luhūy amanuyu' amapatay iya. Ngga'i ka ma sabab kalanggalna ma sara' pasal llaw paghali, sagō' ma sabab h'llingna pasal in Tuhan Mma'na lissi, hatina in iya magsali' maka Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6088" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6078" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2922"/><div sID="gen6089" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapatut si Isa min Mma'na Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen6090" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2922"/> Manjari sinambungan e' si Isa saga a'a inān, yukna, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, halam aniya' tahinangku bang min baran-baranku. Sagō' ai-ai ta'nda'ku nihinang e' Mma'ku, ya na ina'an hinangku. Kamemon nihinang e' Mma', ya du isab nihinang e' Anak.

verses.name: John 5:20
verses.text: Kinalasahan asal aku e' Mma'ku, maka pamata'una isab ma aku kamemon ya hinangna. Ma sinosōng isab pahinangna gi' ma aku saga hinang labi abarakat min bay tahinangku dahū, ati ainu-inu du ka'am kamemon.

verses.name: John 5:21
verses.text: Mma'ku Tuhan ya amakallum saga a'a magpatayan. Damikiyanna aku itu, Anak Tuhan, amakallum isab sai-sai kabaya'anku.

verses.name: John 5:22
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka Mma'ku ya angahukum saga manusiya', sagō' pamuwanna na ma aku kapatut angahukum

verses.name: John 5:23
verses.text: bo' supaya aku pinagmahaldika'an e' kamemon, buwat pagmahaldika' sigām ma Tuhan. Sai-sai mbal angamahaldika' aku, Anak Tuhan, mbal isab mahaldika'na Mma'ku ya bay amapi'itu aku.  <div eID="gen6090" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2923"/><div sID="gen6091" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2923"/> “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, sasuku makakale ma saga pamissalaku, maka magkahagad isab ma bay amapi'itu aku, kakkal du kallumna sampay ni kasaumulan. Mbal iya taluwa' hukuman Tuhan ma sabab dusana, sagō' apuwas iya min mulka' ati allum salama-lama.

verses.name: John 5:25
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “ta'abut na waktu bay pangalagad. Jari akale saga a'a magpatayan ma suwala Anak Tuhan ati allum salama-lama sasuku akale.

verses.name: John 5:26
verses.text: Mma'ku ya po'onan kallum, maka kabuwanan aku e'na kapatut amakallum ma manusiya'.

verses.name: John 5:27
verses.text: Pamuwanna isab ma aku kapatut angahukum saga manusiya', sabab Anak Manusiya' asal aku.  <div eID="gen6091" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2924"/><div sID="gen6092" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2924"/> “Da'a kainu-inuhinbi h'llingku itu,” yuk si Isa. “Ma sinosōng, akale saga a'a magpatayan kamemon ma suwalaku.

verses.name: John 5:29
verses.text: Pagkale itu, paluwas du sigām min deyom kakubulan sigām. Paluwas saga a'a bay maghinang ahāp bo' allum salama-lama. Paluwas isab saga a'a bay maghinang ala'at bo' taluwa' hukuman ma sabab dusa sigām.”  <div eID="gen6092" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6089" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2925"/><div sID="gen6093" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Saksi' Pasal si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6094" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2925"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Halam aniya' tahinangku bang hal min baran-baranku. Angahukum sadja aku buwat bay panoho'an aku e' Tuhan, angkan abontol hukumanku. Sabab ngga'i ka kabaya'anku ya tuyu'anku nihinang, sagō' kabaya'an Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 5:31
verses.text: Bang hal aku anaksi'an di-ku, mbal du aku bin'nnal.

verses.name: John 5:32
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' saddī anaksi'an aku, maka kata'uwanku in panaksi'na ma aku b'nnal sadja.”  <div eID="gen6094" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2926"/><div sID="gen6095" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2926"/> Yuk si Isa gi' ni saga Yahudi, “Bay papehē'bi saga a'abi ni si Yahiya atilaw iya, maka b'nnal bay pangahakana ma pasalku.

verses.name: John 5:34
verses.text: Sagō' ngga'i ka saksi' min manusiya' ya pasangdolanku. Sabbutku si Yahiya inān bo' supaya kam lappasan min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: John 5:35
verses.text: Si Yahiya itu sapantun palita'an amuwan sawa ma pikilan manusiya', maka ka'am ilu bay ka'amuhan dai'-dai' ma sawana.  <div eID="gen6095" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2927"/><div sID="gen6096" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2927"/> “Sagō' aniya' saksi' ma aku labi gi' akosog min panaksi' si Yahiya, hatina saga hinang ya bay pamahinang aku e' Mma'ku Tuhan. Saga hinangku itu anaksi'an aku in aku b'nnal bay pinapi'itu e' Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 5:37
verses.text: Maka Mma'ku, ya bay amapi'itu aku, anaksi' isab ma pasalku. Sagō' ka'am ilu, halam kam bay makakale suwalana atawa maka'nda' baihu'na.

verses.name: John 5:38
verses.text: Halam isab bay pasobsob lapalna ni deyom pangatayanbi sabab mbal kam magkahagad ma aku, ya pinapi'itu e'na ni dunya.

verses.name: John 5:39
verses.text: Atuyu' kam sidda angadji' Kitab sabab pangannalbi minnē' kam kaniya'an kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan. Sagō' aku ya binissala ma kakitaban itu.

verses.name: John 5:40
verses.text: Malaingkan ka'am ilu mbal bilahi pi'itu ni aku supaya kam pinaniya'an kallum kakkal.”  <div eID="gen6096" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2928"/><div sID="gen6097" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2928"/> Amissala gi' si Isa ni saga nakura' inān, yukna, “Mbal aku anambut sanglit min manusiya'.

verses.name: John 5:42
verses.text: Saguwā' kata'uwanku bang ai ma deyom ataybi maka kata'uwanku halam aniya' lasabi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: John 5:43
verses.text: Minsan aku pi'itu taga-kapatut deyo' bay min Mma'ku, mbal aku taima'bi. Sagō' bang aniya' a'a saddī pi'itu amapatut di-na, taima'bi du iya.

verses.name: John 5:44
verses.text: Buwattingga e'bi magkahagad ma aku bang ya angutbi sanglit min pagkahibi manusiya', ati mbal angutbi sanglit min Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'.  <div eID="gen6097" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2929"/><div sID="gen6098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2929"/> “Da'a pikilunbi in aku anuntutan ka'am ni Mma'ku ma llaw hukuman. Ya anuntutan ka'am si Musa, ya pangaholatanbi.

verses.name: John 5:46
verses.text: Bang kam bay magkahagad sab'nnal-b'nnal ma si Musa, ya du aku kahagadbi du isab, sabab aku ya pinagsulat e'na ma Kitab Tawrat.

verses.name: John 5:47
verses.text: Sagō' buwattingga pagkahagadbi ma bissalaku, pagka mbal kahagadbi bay tasulat si Musa?”  <div eID="gen6098" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.5"/> <div eID="gen6093" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><div sID="gen6099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamakan si Isa ma saga A'a Limangibu Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/> Dakayu' llaw, sōng pa'in waktu paghinang Hinang Paglakad, pehē' si Isa ni dambila' danaw Jalil (ya niōnan isab danaw Tibiri). Aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay paturul ni iya sabab ta'nda' e' sigām hinangna kawasahan ma saga a'a taga-saki. Manjari patukad si Isa maka saga mulidna ni bīd-bīd bo' aningkō' mahē'.  <div eID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><div sID="gen6099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamakan si Isa ma saga A'a Limangibu Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/> Dakayu' llaw, sōng pa'in waktu paghinang Hinang Paglakad, pehē' si Isa ni dambila' danaw Jalil (ya niōnan isab danaw Tibiri). Aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay paturul ni iya sabab ta'nda' e' sigām hinangna kawasahan ma saga a'a taga-saki. Manjari patukad si Isa maka saga mulidna ni bīd-bīd bo' aningkō' mahē'.  <div eID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><div sID="gen6099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamakan si Isa ma saga A'a Limangibu Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/> Dakayu' llaw, sōng pa'in waktu paghinang Hinang Paglakad, pehē' si Isa ni dambila' danaw Jalil (ya niōnan isab danaw Tibiri). Aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay paturul ni iya sabab ta'nda' e' sigām hinangna kawasahan ma saga a'a taga-saki. Manjari patukad si Isa maka saga mulidna ni bīd-bīd bo' aningkō' mahē'.  <div eID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><div sID="gen6099" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamakan si Isa ma saga A'a Limangibu Hekana</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.13-Matt.14.21">Matiyu 14:13-21</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.6.30-Mark.6.44">Markus 6:30-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.9.10-Luke.9.17">Lukas 9:10-17</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/> Dakayu' llaw, sōng pa'in waktu paghinang Hinang Paglakad, pehē' si Isa ni dambila' danaw Jalil (ya niōnan isab danaw Tibiri). Aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay paturul ni iya sabab ta'nda' e' sigām hinangna kawasahan ma saga a'a taga-saki. Manjari patukad si Isa maka saga mulidna ni bīd-bīd bo' aningkō' mahē'.  <div eID="gen6100" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2931"/><div sID="gen6101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2931"/> Sakali pag'nda' si Isa aheka to'ongan saga a'a patudju ni iya, ah'lling iya ma si Pilip dakayu' mulidna, yukna, “Maingga pam'llihanta kinakan pamakan ba'anan a'a itu?”

verses.name: John 6:6
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' patilaw si Isa, sabab sinulayan e'na pangandol si Pilip. Malaingkan kinata'uwan e' si Isa bang ai song hinangna.  <div eID="gen6101" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2932"/><div sID="gen6102" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2932"/> Anambung si Pilip, yukna, “Minsan gadji walumbulan mbal makab'llihan tinapay sarang pamakan saga a'a itu, minsan hal dangkuri' pararangan.”  <div eID="gen6102" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2933"/><div sID="gen6103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2933"/> Manjari ah'lling gi' dakayu' mulid si Isa saddī, si Andariyas danakan si Simun Petros.

verses.name: John 6:9
verses.text: Yukna ni si Isa, “Itiya' maitu dakayu' onde'-onde' l'lla, aniya' lima tinapayna maka duwa daingna. Sagō' pamagayta bang hal itu pamakan ba'anan a'a itu?”  <div eID="gen6103" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2934"/><div sID="gen6104" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2934"/> Yuk si Isa, “Sō'unbi saga a'a ilu aningkō'.” Aniya' maina'an parang-parang aluha ati magtingkō'an sigām kamemon. Aniya' sigām limangibu a'a bang l'lla sadja ni'itung, saddī d'nda maka onde'-onde'.

verses.name: John 6:11
verses.text: Ningā' e' si Isa tinapay he'. Pinagsukulan e'na bo' yampa pagbahagi'na ma saga a'a magtingkō'an inān. Damikiyanna daing, bay binahagi' e'na ma sigām pila-pila ya kabaya'an sigām.

verses.name: John 6:12
verses.text: Asso pa'in sigām kamemon, ah'lling si Isa ni saga mulidna, yukna, “Timukunbi kapinna ilu bo' mbal kaugun.”

verses.name: John 6:13
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' sangpū' maka duwa ambung pin'nno'an e' sigām maka kapin tinapay lima hekana inān.  <div eID="gen6104" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2935"/><div sID="gen6105" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2935"/> Pag'nda' saga a'a ma paltanda'an bay tahinang e' si Isa inān, yuk sigām, “B'nnal ko' itu, ya na itu nabi asal lagarantam pi'itu ni dunya.”

verses.name: John 6:15
verses.text: Kinata'uwan e' si Isa in saga a'a inān anganiyat anaggaw iya bo' nilogos magsultan. Angkan iya ala'an magtūy minnē' ati patukad dangan-danganna ni būd.  <div eID="gen6105" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6099" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2936"/><div sID="gen6106" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Lum'ngngan ma Kuwit Tahik</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.14.22-Matt.14.23">Matiyu 14:22-23</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.6.45-Mark.6.52">Markus 6:45-52</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6107" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2936"/> Logob-logob pa'in lahat, palūd saga mulid si Isa ni bihing danaw.

verses.name: John 6:17
verses.text: Pasakat sigām ni bayanan bo' pauntas ni dambila' danaw, tudju ni da'ira Kapirnaum. Sangom na, sagō' halam gi' si Isa bay maka'abut ni sigām.

verses.name: John 6:18
verses.text: Akosog na baliyu maka anganggoyak na tahik.

verses.name: John 6:19
verses.text: Makabusay pa'in sigām saga lima atawa nnom kilometro lawakna, ta'nda' e' sigām si Isa lum'ngngan min kuwit tahik, pasekot na tudju ni bayanan sigām. Jari tināw sigām to'ongan.

verses.name: John 6:20
verses.text: Sagō' ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Da'a kam tināw. Aku ko' itu.”

verses.name: John 6:21
verses.text: Minnē' sigām bilahi amasakat iya ni bayanan. Pagsakatna pa'in, magtūy sigām saru'un-du'un at'kka ni patudjuhan sigām.  <div eID="gen6107" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2937"/><div sID="gen6108" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2937"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', ina'an ma dambila' danaw saga a'a bay pinakan e' si Isa. Tata'u asal e' sigām dakayu' du bayanan bay pameya'an saga mulid e'. Maka kinata'uwan isab in si Isa halam bay paruwa' ameya' ma saga mulidna. Luwal saga mulid bay pauntas parambila'.

verses.name: John 6:23
verses.text: Jari itu aniya' saga bayanan saddī bay min da'ira Tibiri parunggu' ni kasekotan bay pagkakanan sigām tinapay, puwas bay pagsukulan e' Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: John 6:24
verses.text: Na, pag'nda' saga a'a itu in si Isa maka saga mulidna halam na maina'an, paruwa' sigām ni saga bayanan inān bo' anumpang tudju ni Kapirnaum amiha si Isa.  <div eID="gen6108" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6106" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2938"/><div sID="gen6109" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sapantun Pagkakan Makakallum</title> <div sID="gen6110" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2938"/> Tabāk pa'in si Isa e' sigām ma dambila' danaw, yuk sigām ni iya, “Tuwan Guru, sumiyan kapi'itunu?”  <div eID="gen6110" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2939"/><div sID="gen6111" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2939"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, ya angkan aku pihabi sabab asso kam e' tinapay. Sagō' halam tahatibi paltanda'an makainu-inu ya bay tahinangku inān ma pang'nda'bi.

verses.name: John 6:27
verses.text: Da'a pagtuyu'inbi kinakan magkabalos. Ya pagtuyu'anbi subay kinakan mbal magkabalos, ya makakallum saumul-umul. Aku Anak Manusiya' ya amuwanan ka'am kinakan itu sabab aniya' kapatut pamuwan aku e' Mma'ku Tuhan, bainat in aku makasulut atayna.”  <div eID="gen6111" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2940"/><div sID="gen6112" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2940"/> Manjari atilaw sigām ni si Isa, yuk-i, “Na, ai na pa'in subay hinang kami bo' tabeya' kami kabaya'an Tuhan?”  <div eID="gen6112" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2941"/><div sID="gen6113" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2941"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya na itu kabaya'an Tuhan subay hinangbi: subay kam angandol ma aku, ya pinapi'itu e'na.”  <div eID="gen6113" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2942"/><div sID="gen6114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2942"/> Yuk sigām isab ni si Isa, “Paltanda'an ai pa'nda'annu kami supaya kami magkahagad ma ka'a? Ka'mbo'-mbo'antam ma masa awal e' bay amangan manna mahē' ma lahat paslangan. Tasulat ko' inān ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Bay sigām buwananna kinakan min sulga'.’ Jari ai hinangnu?”  <div eID="gen6114" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2942"/><div sID="gen6114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2942"/> Yuk sigām isab ni si Isa, “Paltanda'an ai pa'nda'annu kami supaya kami magkahagad ma ka'a? Ka'mbo'-mbo'antam ma masa awal e' bay amangan manna mahē' ma lahat paslangan. Tasulat ko' inān ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Bay sigām buwananna kinakan min sulga'.’ Jari ai hinangnu?”  <div eID="gen6114" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2943"/><div sID="gen6115" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2943"/> Ya sambung si Isa ma sigām, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'am, ngga'i ka si Musa ya bay amuwanan kinakan min sulga'. Mma'ku Tuhan ya amuwanan ka'am kinakan b'nnal min sulga'.

verses.name: John 6:33
verses.text: Sabab in kinakan pamuwan e' Tuhan, ya na a'a deyo' bay min sulga', ya amuwan kallum ma manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen6115" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2944"/><div sID="gen6116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2944"/> Manjari angamu' saga a'a inān ni si Isa, yuk-i, “Tuwan, sat'ggol kami allum buwanin kami kinakan ya pagbissalanu ilu.”  <div eID="gen6116" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2945"/><div sID="gen6117" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2945"/> Yuk si Isa, “Aku na ko' kinakan makabuwan kallum. Sasuku ameya' ma aku mbal lingantu pabīng. Maka sasuku angandol ma aku mbal patay bohe' pabīng.

verses.name: John 6:36
verses.text: Sagō' bay na sa kam haka'anku, minsan aku ta'nda'bi mbal du kam magkahagad.

verses.name: John 6:37
verses.text: Ameya' du ma aku a'a kamemon ya pamasuku' aku e' Mma'ku, maka mbal sulakku sasuku ameya' ma aku.

verses.name: John 6:38
verses.text: Ya angkan aku pi'itu min sulga' ngga'i ka angahinang kabaya'an baranku, sagō' kabaya'an Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 6:39
verses.text: Ya kabaya'an Tuhan subay halam aniya' lungayku saga a'a bay pamasuku'na ma aku. Gom pa'in pakallumku sigām kamemon ma llaw katapusan.

verses.name: John 6:40
verses.text: Sababna ya kabaya'an Mma'ku Tuhan ma a'a kamemon, sasuku ang'nda' maka magkahagad ma Anakna, tantu sigām kaniya'an kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan. Pakallumku isab sigām ma llaw katapusan.”  <div eID="gen6117" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2946"/><div sID="gen6118" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2946"/> Sakali itu magdugal saga nakura' inān ma pasal pah'lling si Isa he', ya yuk-i, “Aku itu kinakan min sulga'.”

verses.name: John 6:42
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Bang kitam mbal asā', a'a itu si Isa anak si Yusup! Kata'uwanta ina'-mma'na. Jari angay iya ah'lling buwattē', in iya kono' min sulga'?”  <div eID="gen6118" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2947"/><div sID="gen6119" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2947"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna. “Pahali kam magdugal.

verses.name: John 6:44
verses.text: Halam aniya' makapameya' ma aku, luwal bang kabuwanan baya' e' Mma'ku ya bay amapi'itu aku. Ati sasuku ameya' ma aku pakallumku du ma llaw katapusan.

verses.name: John 6:45
verses.text: Aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab Kanabi-nabihan buwatittu: ‘Pinandu'an sigām kamemon e' Tuhan.’ Sai-sai,” yuk si Isa, “akale maka angikut ma pamandu' Mma'ku, ameya' du isab ma aku.

verses.name: John 6:46
verses.text: Halam aniya' bay maka'nda' Tuhan, luwal aku ya pi'itu min Tuhan.

verses.name: John 6:47
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, sasuku magkahagad ma aku aniya' kallumna kakkal ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: John 6:48
verses.text: Aku ya kinakan makabuwan kallum,” yuk si Isa.

verses.name: John 6:49
verses.text: “Saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi bay makakakan manna ma lahat paslangan, sagō' wa'i du sigām magpatayan.

verses.name: John 6:50
verses.text: Malaingkan saddī in kinakan min sulga' itu. Bang aniya' a'a amangan kinakan itu, a'a inān mbal amatay.

verses.name: John 6:51
verses.text: Aku ya kinakan min sulga', aku ya kinakan makabuwan kallum. Bang aniya' amangan kinakan itu-i, allum du iya sampay ni kasaumulan. Ya pamakanku manusiya' isiku ko', ya paglilla'ku bo' supaya allum saga manusiya' kamemon sampay ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen6119" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2948"/><div sID="gen6120" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2948"/> Manjari maglugat saga Yahudi ma sabab pamissala si Isa inān, yuk-i “A'a itu, buwattingga kapamuwanna isina pamakan ma kitam?”  <div eID="gen6120" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2949"/><div sID="gen6121" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2949"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, bang mbal kakanbi isi Anak Manusiya' maka bang mbal inumbi laha'na, halam aniya' kallumbi b'nnal.

verses.name: John 6:54
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku amangan isiku maka anginum laha'ku, kakkal du kallumna sampay ni kasaumulan. Maka pakallumku iya bang ta'abut llaw kahinapusan,

verses.name: John 6:55
verses.text: sabab isiku itu asal kinakan b'nnal, maka laha'ku itu inuman b'nnal.

verses.name: John 6:56
verses.text: Sasuku amangan isiku maka anginum laha'ku pataptap ma aku, maka aku isab pataptap ma iya.

verses.name: John 6:57
verses.text: Bay aku pinapi'itu e' Mma'ku ya kakkal salama-lama, maka kakkal isab kallumku ma sababna. Damikiyanna saga a'a amangan isiku, allum du isab ma sababku.

verses.name: John 6:58
verses.text: Ya na itu kinakan deyo' bay min sulga',” yuk si Isa. “Saddī ko' itu min kinakan niōnan manna ya bay takakan e' ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi ma masa awal e'. Minsan sigām bay amangan manna he', magpatayan na pa'in sigām bang ta'abut ganta'an. Sagō' sasuku amangan kinakan min sulga' itu, allum sampay ni kasaumulan.”

verses.name: John 6:59
verses.text: Binissala itu e' si Isa waktu kapamandu'na ma deyom langgal Kapirnaum.  <div eID="gen6121" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6109" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2950"/><div sID="gen6122" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka Bebeya'an Ang'bba min si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2950"/> Takale pa'in pandu' si Isa itu, aheka bebeya'anna ah'lling, yuk-i, “Ahunit makalandu' pamandu' itu. Halam aniya' makasandal akale.”  <div eID="gen6123" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2951"/><div sID="gen6124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2951"/> Halam aniya' bay angahaka'an si Isa sagō' kata'uwanna asal in pamandu'na inān pagdugalan e' sigām. Angkan yukna ni sigām, “Ala'at bahā' ataybi ma sabab pamandu'ku inān?

verses.name: John 6:62
verses.text: Na, buwattingga bahā' bang ta'nda'bi aku, Anak Manusiya', pabīng ni lahat bay baiku?

verses.name: John 6:63
verses.text: Haka'anta kam,” yuk si Isa, “Rū Tuhan ya taga-kawasa amuwan kallum b'nnal, pangita'u manusiya' mbal. Makakallum pamandu'ku itu, sabab luwas ko' itu min Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: John 6:64
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' ma ka'am mbal magkahagad ma aku.” Buwattē' pah'lling si Isa sabab kata'uwanna sangay min katagna' bang sai mbal magkahagad ma iya, maka bang sai song anukbalan iya ni bantana.

verses.name: John 6:65
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ya itu sababanna angkan yukku ma ka'am, halam aniya' ameya' ma aku bang ngga'i ka Mma'ku Tuhan ya amuwanan iya baya'.”  <div eID="gen6124" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2952"/><div sID="gen6125" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2952"/> Pagka buwattē' pah'lling si Isa, aheka saga mulidna bay ala'an min iya maka mbal na ameya' ma iya.

verses.name: John 6:67
verses.text: Angkan si Isa atilaw ni saga mulidna kasangpū' maka duwa, yukna, “Ya du ka'am bahā', ala'an isab?”  <div eID="gen6125" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2953"/><div sID="gen6126" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2953"/> Anambung si Simun Petros, yukna, “Tuwan, sai pameya'an kami bang ngga'i ka ka'a? Luwal ka'a taga-lapal bissala ya amuwan kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: John 6:69
verses.text: Magkahagad kami ma ka'a, maka kata'uwan kami in ka'a Dakayu'-kayu' Asussi ya bay pi'itu min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6126" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2954"/><div sID="gen6127" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2954"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Bay kam pene'ku kasangpū' maka duwa, sagō' aniya' dangan min ka'am ilu pasōran saitan.”

verses.name: John 6:71
verses.text: Ya pinagbissala inān e' si Isa si Judas anak si Simun Iskariyut. Sabab si Judas itu, minsan iya dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa, tukbalanna du si Isa ni saga bantana ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen6127" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.6"/> <div eID="gen6122" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2955"/><div sID="gen6128" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka Dauranakanna</title> <div sID="gen6129" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2955"/> Puwas e' magl'ngngan si Isa ma lahat Jalil sadja. Mbal iya makalanjal ni lahat Yahudiya sabab bilahi amapatay iya saga nakura' Yahudi mahē'.

verses.name: John 7:2
verses.text: Sagō' asekot pa'in waktu paghinang bangsa Yahudi ma niōnan Hinang Panggung,

verses.name: John 7:3
verses.text: ah'lling ni si Isa saga danakanna l'lla, yuk-i, “Ahāp bang ka palanjal minnitu. Subay ka pehē' ni lahat Yahudiya supaya ta'nda' e' saga mulidnu bang ai hinangnu.

verses.name: John 7:4
verses.text: Sababna bang a'a bilahi abantug, subay mbal limbunganna hinangna. Pagka ka'a ilu maghinang saga hinang makainu-inu itu, subay ka magpata'u ni a'a kamemon.”

verses.name: John 7:5
verses.text: Minsan saga danakanna itu mbal amarassaya ma iya.  <div eID="gen6129" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2956"/><div sID="gen6130" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2956"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Halam gi' ta'abut waktu kapama'nda'ku di-ku. Sagō' bang ka'am, minsan ai waktu makajari sadja,

verses.name: John 7:7
verses.text: sabab ka'am ilu mbal kinab'nsihan e' saga a'a ma dunya itu, ya mbal angisbat Tuhan. Malaingkan kinab'nsihan aku e' sigām sabab pah'llinganku na pa'in kahinangan sigām ala'at.

verses.name: John 7:8
verses.text: Pehē' kam ni paghinangan,” yuk si Isa ni saga danakanna. “Aku itu mbal gi' pehē' sabab ngga'i ka gi' waktuku.”

verses.name: John 7:9
verses.text: Aubus pa'in bay llingna itu, maina'an gi' iya ma lahat Jalil.  <div eID="gen6130" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6128" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2957"/><div sID="gen6131" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ma Paghinangan Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6132" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2957"/> Makalikut pa'in saga danakanna ni paghinangan, mbal at'ggol paturul isab si Isa pehē' sagō' mbal iya parongan ma kaheka'an a'a inān angkan halam kinata'uwan kapehē'na.

verses.name: John 7:11
verses.text: Pinagpiha iya e' saga nakura' Yahudi mahē' ma paghinangan. Magtilaw sigām bang maingga iya.  <div eID="gen6132" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2958"/><div sID="gen6133" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2958"/> Aheka saga a'a ma deyom katimukan inān maghigung-higung ma pasalan si Isa. Yuk kasehe'an, “A'a ahāp si Isa.” Yuk isab kasehe'an, “Mbal, sabab parupangna saga a'a.”

verses.name: John 7:13
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' makatawakkal anuli-nuli patampal ma pasalna sabab tināw sigām ma saga pagnakura'an.  <div eID="gen6133" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2959"/><div sID="gen6134" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2959"/> Sōng-sōng pa'in atonga' paghinang, pehē' si Isa ni langgal pagkulbanan ati anagna' iya amandu'.

verses.name: John 7:15
verses.text: Ainu-inu saga Yahudi ma pamandu'na, yuk-i, “A'a itu halam bay makapagguru. Minningga bahā' pangā'anna kata'una?”  <div eID="gen6134" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2960"/><div sID="gen6135" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2960"/> Anambung si Isa ma sigām, yukna, “Pamandu'ku itu ngga'i ka min kata'uku, sagō' min Tuhan ya amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 7:17
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a bilahi angahinang kabaya'an Tuhan, kata'uwanna du pamandu'ku itu bang min Tuhan atawa min paghona'-hona'ku sadja.

verses.name: John 7:18
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' amissala min hona'-hona'na hal, ya angutna kabantugan ma baranna. Sagō' bang angutna kabantugan ma bay anoho' iya, na, abontol a'a inān maka mbal angakkal.”

verses.name: John 7:19
verses.text: Ah'lling gi' si Isa ni saga nakura' inān, yukna, “Bay kam kapang'bbahan sara' e' si Musa, sagō' halam aniya' min ka'am minsan dakayu' amogbogan sara' he'. Angay kam bilahi amapatay aku?”  <div eID="gen6135" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2961"/><div sID="gen6136" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2961"/> Anambung kaheka'an a'a, yuk sigām, “Ka'a ilu sinōd saitan! Sai bilahi amapatay ka'a?”  <div eID="gen6136" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2962"/><div sID="gen6137" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2962"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Min t'dda du aku bay angahinang hinang makainu-inu pasalta' ma llaw Sabtu', ati kainu-inuhanbi kamemon.

verses.name: John 7:22
verses.text: Bay kam sinoho' e' si Musa subay angislam saga anakbi l'lla, bo' ngga'i ka min si Musa usulan itu sagō' min ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi tagna'. Angkan islambi anakbi bang ta'abut llawna, minsan magsalta' maka llaw Sabtu'.

verses.name: John 7:23
verses.text: Na, bang ta'islambi anakbi l'lla ma llaw Sabtu' supaya mbal talanggal sara' si Musa, angay angkan akagit ataybi ma aku pagka pauli'ku saki a'a ma llaw Sabtu' du isab?

verses.name: John 7:24
verses.text: Da'a kam magdai'-dai' anōngan aku dusa ma saukat na kam mbal ka'amuhan ma bay hinangku. In hukumanbi subay abontol.”  <div eID="gen6137" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6131" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2963"/><div sID="gen6138" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Itu Bahā' Al-Masi?</title> <div sID="gen6139" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2963"/> Manjari aniya' saga a'a Awrusalam magsuli-suli, yuk-i, “Ya na itu bahā' a'a piniha e' saga nakura' pinapatay?

verses.name: John 7:26
verses.text: Nda'unbi,” yuk sigām. “Itiya' iya amissala patampal sagō' mbal sinagga' e' saga nakura'. Makatantu bahā' sigām, in iya b'nnal Al-Masi?

verses.name: John 7:27
verses.text: Bang pi'itu Al-Masi, mbal iya kinata'uwan bang minningga. Sagō' a'a itu, kata'uwantam asal bang minningga.”  <div eID="gen6139" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2964"/><div sID="gen6140" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2964"/> Amandu' pa'in si Isa ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, pinatanog suwalana, yukna, “Aho'. Kata'uwanbi aku bang minningga. Halam aku bay pi'itu hal min kabaya'anku. Bay aku sinoho' pi'itu e' Tuhan, ya mbal magputing. Mbal iya kata'uwanbi,

verses.name: John 7:29
verses.text: sagō' aku,” yuk si Isa, “ata'u du ma iya sabab minnē' asal aku, maka iya ya bay anoho' aku pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen6140" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2965"/><div sID="gen6141" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2965"/> Manjari pasulay sigām anaggaw iya, sagō' halam aniya' minsan maka'ntanan iya sabab halam gi' ta'abut waktu pamapatay iya.

verses.name: John 7:31
verses.text: Malaingkan aheka a'a maina'an magkahagad ma iya. Yuk sigām, “Ya na itu Al-Masi sabab halam aniya' makahinang hinang kawasahan palabi gi' hekana min saga hinang si Isa itu.”  <div eID="gen6141" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2966"/><div sID="gen6142" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2966"/> Manjari takale e' saga Parisi bang ai pinaghigung-higung e' kaheka'an a'a inān ma pasal si Isa, angkan sigām maka saga imam alanga bay anoho' saga jaga langgal pehē' anaggaw iya.

verses.name: John 7:33
verses.text: Amissala si Isa ni saga a'a magtimukan inān, yukna, “Mbal aku at'ggol maitu ma ka'am. Sōng na aku amole' pehē' ni bay anoho' aku pi'itu.

verses.name: John 7:34
verses.text: Pihabi du aku, sagō' mbal aku tabākbi sabab mbal kam makaturul ni papehē'anku inān.”  <div eID="gen6142" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2967"/><div sID="gen6143" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2967"/> Manjari magsuli-suli saga nakura' Yahudi, yuk sigām, “Pi'ingga bahā' a'a itu angkan iya mbal tabāktam? Pehē' iya bahā' ni kalahatan Girīk, ya paglahatan bangsatam magpulak-palik e'? Pehē' bahā' iya amandu'an bangsa Girīk?

verses.name: John 7:36
verses.text: Ai hatina ya yukna inān, in kitam amiha iya, sagō' mbal tabāktam. Maka mbal kitam makaturul ni papehē'anna?”  <div eID="gen6143" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6138" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2968"/><div sID="gen6144" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bohe' Makabuwan Kallum Kakkal</title> <div sID="gen6145" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2968"/> Manjari ta'abut pa'in llaw katangbus paghinang inān, ya llaw aheya, an'ngge si Isa amissala. Pinatanog la'a suwalana, yukna, “Sasuku kam patay bohe', pi'itu kam ni aku bo' kam painumku.

verses.name: John 7:38
verses.text: Sasuku magkahagad ma aku kataluwa'an sulat Kitab ya yuk-i, ‘aniya' patubud min deyom atayna sali' dalil bohe' anasahan, bohe' makabuwan kallum.’ ”

verses.name: John 7:39
verses.text: Ya bohe' patubud pinagbissala e' si Isa itu, hatina Rū Tuhan ya song pamuwan ma saga a'a magkahagad ma iya. Sagō' ma waktu ina'an in Rū Tuhan halam gi' bay tapamuwan sabab halam gi' ta'abut waktu pamabangsa si Isa e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6145" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2969"/><div sID="gen6146" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2969"/> Makakale pa'in saga a'a ma bissala si Isa itu, yuk sigām kasehe', “B'nnal ko' itu, ya na itu nabi asal lagarantam.”  <div eID="gen6146" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2970"/><div sID="gen6147" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2970"/> Yuk kasehe', “Al-Masi iya.” <div eID="gen6147" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6148" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' saddī lling kasehe'an. Yuk sigām, “Ngga'i ka iya Al-Masi, sabab Al-Masi ngga'i ka min lahat Jalil.

verses.name: John 7:42
verses.text: Yuk Kitab in Al-Masi subay panubu' sultan Da'ud, maka subay nianakan ma kaluma'an Betlehem sabab ya na lahat sultan Da'ud.”

verses.name: John 7:43
verses.text: Jari magsaddī pamikil saga a'a ma pasalan si Isa.

verses.name: John 7:44
verses.text: Aniya' sigām bilahi anaggaw si Isa, sagō' halam aniya' minsan maka'ntan ma iya.  <div eID="gen6148" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6144" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2971"/><div sID="gen6149" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mbal Magkahagad Pagnakura'an Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6150" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2971"/> Ma katapusanna pabalik na saga jaga inān. Tinilaw sigām e' Imam Muwallam maka Parisi ya bay anoho' sigām anaggaw si Isa yuk-i, “Angay iya halam tabowabi pi'itu?”  <div eID="gen6150" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2972"/><div sID="gen6151" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2972"/> Anambung saga jaga he', “Halam to'ongan aniya' a'a amandu' buwat pamandu' a'a inān.”  <div eID="gen6151" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2973"/><div sID="gen6152" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2973"/> Yuk saga Parisi, “Ya du ka'am bahā' taparupang e'na?

verses.name: John 7:48
verses.text: Aniya' bahā' nakura' atawa Parisi magkahagad ma iya? Tantu halam, minsan dakayu'.

verses.name: John 7:49
verses.text: Ya sadja magkahagad saga a'a katimukan itu, a'a awam ma pasal sara' si Musa. Angkanna sigām taluwa' mulka' Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen6152" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2974"/><div sID="gen6153" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2974"/> Sakali ah'lling si Nikudimus, ya bay makapehē' ni si Isa waktu sangom e'. Yukna ma saga pagkahina Parisi,

verses.name: John 7:51
verses.text: “Bang ma sara'tam mbal kita manjari amat'nna'an hukuman ma a'a abila halam bay pinabissala dahū, supaya kinata'uwan bang ai bay hinangna.”  <div eID="gen6153" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2975"/><div sID="gen6154" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2975"/> Anambung sigām, yukna, “Oy! Ka'a isab min Jalil bahā'? Ang'nda' ka ma deyom Kitab. Halam aniya' nabi paluwas min lahat Jalil.”

verses.name: John 7:53
verses.text: [Manjari magpole'an saga a'a inān kamemon.]  <div eID="gen6154" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.7"/> <div eID="gen6149" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2976"/><div sID="gen6155" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal D'nda Ta'abut Maghinang Ala'at</title> <div sID="gen6156" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2976"/> Sagō' patukad si Isa pehē' ni būd Kayu Jaitun.

verses.name: John 8:2
verses.text: Pagdai' llaw pa'in, pehē' iya pabīng ni langgal pagkulbanan. Magtipunan ni iya saga a'a aheka ati aningkō' iya amandu'an sigām.

verses.name: John 8:3
verses.text: Manjari aniya' dakayu' d'nda binowa ni iya e' saga guru sara' agama maka e' saga Parisi. D'nda itu bay ta'abut angaliyu-lakad. Pinatampal iya ma kaheka'an a'a inān kamemon.

verses.name: John 8:4
verses.text: Yuk saga Parisi ni si Isa, “Tuwan guru, d'nda itu bay ta'abut angaliyu-lakad.

verses.name: John 8:5
verses.text: Na, bang ma sara' bay pang'bbahan kitam e' si Musa, ya hukuman ma d'nda buwattitu subay binantung maka batu pinapatay. Na, bang ma ka'a?”

verses.name: John 8:6
verses.text: Buwattē' pamissala sigām panulay sigām ma si Isa, kalu aniya' sā' ma panambungna, jari aniya' sababan panuntut sigām ma iya. Saguwā' patondok sadja si Isa anulat ma kuwit tana' maka tōng tudlu'na.  <div eID="gen6156" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2977"/><div sID="gen6157" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2977"/> Na sabu pa'in iya sinumariya e' sigām, patongas iya ati yukna ni sigām, “Sai-sai kam halam taga-dusa, wajib iya parahū amantung d'nda itu.”

verses.name: John 8:8
verses.text: Jari patondok iya pabīng anulat isab ma kuwit tana'.

verses.name: John 8:9
verses.text: Pagkale pa'in e' sigām pah'lling si Isa itu, magtūy sigām ala'an kamemon dangan maka dangan, tinagna'an min matto'a sampay ni kasehe'an. Luwal si Isa tabba maina'an, maka d'nda masi ma bay pan'nggehanna.

verses.name: John 8:10
verses.text: Pagtongas si Isa pabīng, yukna ni d'nda, “Maingga na sigām, arung? Halam aniya' amat'nna'an ka'a hukuman?”  <div eID="gen6157" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2978"/><div sID="gen6158" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2978"/> “Halam aniya', Tuwan,” yuk sambung d'nda. <div eID="gen6158" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6159" type="paragraph"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “minsan aku, mbal du aku amat'nna'an ka'a hukuman. Amole' na ka pehē' sagō' da'a angandusa pabīng.”  <div eID="gen6159" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6155" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2979"/><div sID="gen6160" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Ibarat Sawa</title> <div sID="gen6161" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2979"/> Puwas e' amissala si Isa ma saga Parisi pabīng, yukna, “Aku itu sawa pamasawa pikilan manusiya'. Sasuku ameya' ma aku, mbal to'ongan pal'ngngan ma deyom kalendoman sabab aniya' ma deyom pikilanna sawa ya makabuwan kallum ma manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen6161" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2980"/><div sID="gen6162" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2980"/> Yuk saga Parisi ni si Isa, “Ka'a ilu anaksi'an di-nu na. Mbal tab'nnal saksi'nu bang ka hal anaksi'an di-nu.”  <div eID="gen6162" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2981"/><div sID="gen6163" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2981"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Minsan aku anaksi'an di-ku, mattan asal panaksi'ku sabab kata'uwanku du bang minningga aku, maka bang pi'ingga papehē'anku. Sagō' ka'am ilu, mbal kata'uwanbi bang minningga aku atawa bang pi'ingga.

verses.name: John 8:15
verses.text: Bang aniya' hukumbi, paghona'-hona' manusiya' ya pameya'anbi. Aku itu mbal angahukum a'a.

verses.name: John 8:16
verses.text: Sagō' abila aku saupama angahukum, abontol du hukumanku sabab ngga'i ka aku dangan-danganku ya angahukum. Duwangan kami angahukum sabab ginapi' aku e' Mma'ku, ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 8:17
verses.text: Tasulat ma deyom sara'bi,” yuk si Isa, “bang duwangan ya anaksi' bo' maguyun panaksi' sigā, magtaluwa' na.

verses.name: John 8:18
verses.text: Jari b'nnal bissalaku sabab duwa saksi'ku maguyun. Anaksi'an aku di-ku, maka Mma'ku, ya bay amapi'itu aku, anaksi'an aku du isab.”  <div eID="gen6163" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2982"/><div sID="gen6164" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2982"/> Tinilaw si Isa e' saga Parisi, yuk sigām, “Maingga mma'nu?” <div eID="gen6164" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6165" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Mbal kata'uwanbi Mma'ku, maka aku isab mbal kata'uwanbi. Sabab bang bay aku kata'uwanbi, ya du Mma'ku bay du isab kata'uwanbi.”

verses.name: John 8:20
verses.text: Binissala itu e' si Isa sabuna magpandu' ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, ma atag pamat'nna'an saga tu'ung pangahūgan sarakka. Sagō' halam aniya' makasaggaw iya sabab halam gi' ta'abut waktu ya pangangganta' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6165" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2983"/><div sID="gen6166" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2983"/> Manjari itu binalik e' Isa bay pamissalana ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Sōng na aku ala'an. Pihabi du aku sagō' mbal aku tabākbi. Amatay sadja kam ma mbal ta'ampun dusabi. Mbal kam makapehē' ni papehē'anku.”  <div eID="gen6166" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2984"/><div sID="gen6167" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2984"/> Angkan magtilaw-tilaw saga nakura' Yahudi, yuk sigām, “Amapatay iya di-na bahā', ya angkan yukna in kita mbal makapehē' ni papehē'anna?”  <div eID="gen6167" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2985"/><div sID="gen6168" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2985"/> Amissala gi' si Isa, yukna, “Ka'am ilu porol asal ma babaw dunya itu. Sagō' aku itu, sulga' ya lahatku. Kajarihanbi asal min dunya, bo' kajarihanku ngga'i ka.

verses.name: John 8:24
verses.text: Angkan kam haka'anku, in ka'am amatay sadja ma mbal ta'ampun dusabi. Sabab bang mbal pagkahagadbi bay pah'llingku ma pasal baranku bang sai aku, tantu kam amatay ma dusabi.”  <div eID="gen6168" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2986"/><div sID="gen6169" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2986"/> “Sai ka to'ongan?” yuk tilaw sigām. <div eID="gen6169" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6170" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Buwat bay pangahakaku ma ka'am sangay min katagna'.

verses.name: John 8:26
verses.text: Maka aheka gi' pah'llingku pangahukum paldusahanbi. Daipara b'nnal sadja ya bay amapi'itu aku. Jari ai-ai takaleku min iya, ya he' sadja pangahakaku ma saga manusiya' ma dunya itu.”  <div eID="gen6170" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2987"/><div sID="gen6171" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2987"/> Saguwā' halam tahati e' sigām in Mma'na Tuhan ya pinagbissala itu e' si Isa.

verses.name: John 8:28
verses.text: Angkan yukna ni sigām, “Bang aku Anak Manusiya' ta'angkatbi na ni hāg, minnē' kata'uwanbi in aku baranku ya pah'llingku. Kata'uwanbi isab halam aniya' tahinangku bang min baran-baranku sadja, maka ai-ai pamandu'ku bay pamandu' aku e' Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 8:29
verses.text: Taptap pagapi' ma aku ya bay amapi'itu aku. Mbal aku pinasagaran e'na, sabab hinangku sadja ai-ai makasulut iya.”

verses.name: John 8:30
verses.text: Pagkale saga a'a inān ma pamissala si Isa, aheka sigām angandol ma iya.  <div eID="gen6171" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6160" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2988"/><div sID="gen6172" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Banyaga' maka A'a Ngga'i Ka Banyaga'</title> <div sID="gen6173" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2988"/> Jari itu ah'lling si Isa ni saga Yahudi ya am'nnal ma iya. “Bang kam atuyu' ameya' ma pandu'ku,” yukna, “mulidku na kam sab'nnal-b'nnal.

verses.name: John 8:32
verses.text: Makata'u du kam bang ingga ya kasab'nnalan min Tuhan, jari kasab'nnalan ya angaliyus ka'am min pagbanyaga'an.”  <div eID="gen6173" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2989"/><div sID="gen6174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2989"/> Anambung sigām, yuk-i, “Oy! Kami itu panubu' si Ibrahim. Halam kami bay tabanyaga' e' sai-sai. Angay ka makabissala in kami papuwas min pagbanyaga'an?”  <div eID="gen6174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2990"/><div sID="gen6175" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2990"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, sasuku magdusa binanyaga' du e' baya'na magdusa.

verses.name: John 8:35
verses.text: Banyaga' itu mbal kakkal ma okoman tag-dapu. Ya kakkal maina'an anakna lissi.

verses.name: John 8:36
verses.text: Angkan bang Anak Tuhan ya amalimaya ka'am min pagbanyaga'an, tantu du kam alimaya.

verses.name: John 8:37
verses.text: Kata'uwanku, panubu' kam asal si Ibrahim. Sagō' bilahi kam amapatay aku sabab mbal tataima'bi pandu'ku.

verses.name: John 8:38
verses.text: Ya pamandu'ku ma ka'am itu bay pamata'u aku e' Mma'ku. Sagō' nihinang e'bi saga hinang bay pamata'u ka'am e' pag'mma'anbi.”  <div eID="gen6175" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2991"/><div sID="gen6176" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2991"/> Yuk saga Yahudi, “Si Ibrahim ya pag'mma'an kami.” <div eID="gen6176" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6177" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa, “Bang bay kam b'nnal saga panubu' si Ibrahim, bay du tas'ppubi si Ibrahim maghinang saga hinangna.

verses.name: John 8:40
verses.text: Sagō' bilahi kam amapatay aku saukat na kam bay haka'anku pasal kasab'nnalan bay takaleku min Tuhan. Halam bay makahinang buwattē' si Ibrahim.

verses.name: John 8:41
verses.text: Ya hinangbi na pa'in saga kahinangan mma'bi!” <div eID="gen6177" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6178" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy anambung saga a'a inān, yuk sigām, “Luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' ya pag'mma'an kami. Maka kami itu anakna lissi.”  <div eID="gen6178" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2992"/><div sID="gen6179" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2992"/> Yuk si Isa, “Bang Tuhan b'nnal pag'mma'anbi, bay du kam alasahan aku sabab min Tuhan aku angkanna aku maitu. Halam aku bay pi'itu min pagnahu'-nahu'ku, sagō' pinapi'itu aku e' Tuhan.

verses.name: John 8:43
verses.text: Angay mbal tahatibi bissalaku? Sabab mbal kam makatatas akale ma lapal pamandu'ku.”

verses.name: John 8:44
verses.text: Yuk si Isa gi' ni sigām, “Nakura' saitan ya pag'mma'anbi. Ya angutbi subay ameya' ma kabaya'an mma'bi. Pamapatay asal iya min katagna'. Halam iya bay ameya' ma kasab'nnalan sabab halam aniya' b'nnal ma deyom kajarihanna. Kabiyaksahanna magputing angkan iya magputing na pa'in. Putingan to'ongan iya maka po'onan iya kaputingan kamemon.

verses.name: John 8:45
verses.text: Sagō' aku,” yuk si Isa, “b'nnal sadja pah'llingku, ya po'on ka'am mbal magkahagad ma aku.

verses.name: John 8:46
verses.text: Halam aniya' ma ka'am makatōngan aku dusa. B'nnal sadja pah'llingku, jari angay aku mbal pagkahagadbi?

verses.name: John 8:47
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' suku' Tuhan, ameya' iya ma pandu' Tuhan. Sagō' ka'am ilu ngga'i ka suku' Tuhan, angkan kam mbal bilahi ameya'.”  <div eID="gen6179" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6172" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2993"/><div sID="gen6180" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Ibrahim</title> <div sID="gen6181" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2993"/> Sakali sinambungan si Isa e' saga nakura' Yahudi he', yuk sigām, “Taluwa' ya bay yuk kami, in ka'a ngga'i ka Yahudi. A'a Samariya ka, maka pasōran ka saitan!”  <div eID="gen6181" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2994"/><div sID="gen6182" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2994"/> Yuk si Isa, “Halam aku pasōran saitan. Aku itu, mahaldika'ku sadja Mma'ku, sagō' ka'am ilu hal angahalipulu aku.

verses.name: John 8:50
verses.text: Mbal aku amiha kamahaldika'anku. Aniya' saddī amiha, jari in iya angahukum.

verses.name: John 8:51
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, sasuku ameya' ma pamandu'ku mbal to'ongan amatay salama-lama.”  <div eID="gen6182" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2995"/><div sID="gen6183" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2995"/> “Na,” yuk sigām, “makatantu kami to'ongan in ka'a kasōran saitan! Minsan si Ibrahim maka kanabi-nabihan kamemon, wa'i magpatayan. Ati yuknu mbal magkamatay salama-lama sasuku ameya' ma pamandu'nu.

verses.name: John 8:53
verses.text: Angay, palabi bahā' kawasanu min kawasa ka'mbo'an kami si Ibrahim? Minsan si Ibrahim, minsan saga kanabi-nabihan kamemon, bay du sigām amatay. Sai ka bahā' angkan ka magnahu'-nahu' buwattilu?”  <div eID="gen6183" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2996"/><div sID="gen6184" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2996"/> Anambung isab si Isa, yukna, “Bang aku saupama angamahaldika' di-ku, halam aniya' kapūsanna. Sagō' Mma'ku ya angamahaldika' aku, ya yukbi in iya pagtuhananbi.

verses.name: John 8:55
verses.text: Mbal minsan kata'uwanbi Tuhan, sagō' aku ya ata'uwan iya. Bang saupama yukku in aku mbal makata'uwan Tuhan, na, putingan aku buwat ka'am. Daipara kata'uwanku asal Tuhan, maka beya'ku saga panoho'anna.

verses.name: John 8:56
verses.text: Ka'mbo'anbi si Ibrahim inān, bay kinōgan pagka kata'uwanna aniya' waktu sinosōng kapang'nda'na ma aku pi'itu ni dunya. Manjari pag'nda'na ma kapi'ituku landu' iya akōd.”  <div eID="gen6184" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2997"/><div sID="gen6185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2997"/> Anambung sigām ma si Isa, yuk-i, “Buwattingga kapag'nda'nu maka si Ibrahim? Mbal gi' minsan limampū' tahun umulnu.”  <div eID="gen6185" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2998"/><div sID="gen6186" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2998"/> Yuk si Isa gi' ni sigām, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, ma halam gi' si Ibrahim bay nianakan, asal na aku.”

verses.name: John 8:59
verses.text: Manjari saga Yahudi inān angā' batu pamantung sigām ma si Isa, daipara palimbu iya ati paluwas min langgal pagkulbanan e'.  <div eID="gen6186" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.8"/> <div eID="gen6180" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2999"/><div sID="gen6187" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kauli'an A'a bay Buta min Deyom Kandang</title> <div sID="gen6188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2999"/> Pal'ngngan pa'in si Isa, aniya' dakayu' l'lla ta'nda'na, a'a bay abuta min deyom kandang.

verses.name: John 9:2
verses.text: Tinilaw si Isa e' saga mulidna, yuk-i, “Tuwan guru, angay a'a itu abuta? Min dusana atawa min dusa ina'-mma'na?”  <div eID="gen6188" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3000"/><div sID="gen6189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3000"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ya kabutana itu ngga'i ka ma sabab dusana atawa dusa matto'ana. Abuta iya supaya iya pama'nda'an kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: John 9:4
verses.text: Sat'ggol halam pas'ddop llaw, subay hinangta saga hinang Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku,” yuk si Isa. “Bang ta'abut na sangom, halam aniya' makapaghinang.

verses.name: John 9:5
verses.text: Sat'ggolku maitu ma dunya amuwan aku kasawahan ma pikilan manusiya'.”  <div eID="gen6189" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3001"/><div sID="gen6190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3001"/> Apuwas pah'lling si Isa itu, angaludja' iya ni tana'. Pinapaglamugay ludja' maka tana' nihinang pisak, ati niakup e'na bo' pineheran ni mata a'a abuta inān.

verses.name: John 9:7
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Pehē' ka ni tigbaw Silowam akula'up.” (Ya hati Silowam itu, ‘pinabeya'’.) Manjari pehē' na l'lla buta inān akula'up. Pagbīngna minnē', maka'nda' na iya.  <div eID="gen6190" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3002"/><div sID="gen6191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3002"/> Ta'nda' iya e' saga sehe'na dalūng maka e' saga a'a bay maka'nda' iya angamu' sarakka. Yuk sigām, “Ya na itu bahā' a'a bay aningkō' angamu' sarakka inān?”  <div eID="gen6191" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3003"/><div sID="gen6192" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3003"/> Yuk kasehe'an, “Aho', ya na ko'.” <div eID="gen6192" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6193" type="paragraph"/> Yuk kasehe'an isab, “Ngga'i ka. Hal iya angaluwa a'a buta he'.” <div eID="gen6193" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6194" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' ah'lling magbaran in a'a buta, yukna, “Aku na ko' itu.”  <div eID="gen6194" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3004"/><div sID="gen6195" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3004"/> “Buwattingga angkan kaka'nda'nu?” yuk tilaw sigām.  <div eID="gen6195" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3005"/><div sID="gen6196" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3005"/> Anambung iya, yukna, “A'a niōnan si Isa bay angakup pisak pineheran ni mataku. Puwas e' sinō' aku pehē' ni tigbaw Silowam akula'up, ati pehē' aku. Makakula'up pa'in, magtūy aku maka'nda'.”  <div eID="gen6196" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3006"/><div sID="gen6197" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3006"/> “Maingga na a'a inān?” yuk sigām. <div eID="gen6197" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6198" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambungna, “Sitta'a, mbal kata'uwanku.”  <div eID="gen6198" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6187" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3007"/><div sID="gen6199" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a bay Abuta Pinariksa' e' saga Parisi</title> <div sID="gen6200" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3007"/> Sakali binowa l'lla bay abuta ni saga Parisi.

verses.name: John 9:14
verses.text: Na, ya llaw kapangakup pisak e' si Isa maka kapamauli'na mata a'a buta he', llaw Sabtu'.

verses.name: John 9:15
verses.text: Manjari pinariksa' a'a itu e' saga Parisi bang buwattingga iya maka'nda'. Yukna ma sigām, “Bay iya amat'nna' pisak ni mataku. Puwas e' akula'up aku. Pagkula'up itu magtūy aku maka'nda' na.”  <div eID="gen6200" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3008"/><div sID="gen6201" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3008"/> Yuk saga Parisi kasehe', “A'a inān ngga'i ka min Tuhan, sabab talanggalna sara' pasal llaw Sabtu' pagka buwattē' hinangna.” <div eID="gen6201" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6202" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' yuk kasehe', “Bang a'a dusahan, mbal tahinangna buwat saga hinang makainu-inu itu.” Manjari mbal maguyun pikilan sigām.  <div eID="gen6202" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3009"/><div sID="gen6203" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3009"/> Ma katapusanna atilaw sigām pabalik ma a'a buta he', yuk-i, “Ya yuknu in matanu bay kauli'an e' a'a inān. Sai iya, bang ma bistahannu?” <div eID="gen6203" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6204" type="paragraph"/> Yuk a'a bay abuta he', “Bang ma aku, in iya dakayu' nabi.”  <div eID="gen6204" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3010"/><div sID="gen6205" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3010"/> Sagō' mbal am'nnal saga nakura' Yahudi in a'a inān bay buta tagna'. Angkan nilinganan ina'-mma'na e' sigām bo' tinilaw.

verses.name: John 9:19
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “A'a itu, anakbi bahā'? B'nnal bahā', asal buta iya min deyom kandang? Buwattingga kaka'nda'na itu?”  <div eID="gen6205" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3011"/><div sID="gen6206" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3011"/> Yuk saga matto'ana, “Aho', anak kami ko' itu. Maka b'nnal isab, abuta iya asal min deyom kandang.

verses.name: John 9:21
verses.text: Sagō' mbal kata'uwan kami bang buwattingga bay kaka'nda'na atawa bang sai bay makauli' matana. Tilawunbi iya. Asangpot na iya, ata'u du anambung.”

verses.name: John 9:22
verses.text: Buwattē' panambung saga matto'a l'lla he' sabab tināw sigā ma pagnakura'an. Sabab bay na maggara' saga nakura', bang aniya' a'a magsab'nnal ma si Isa in iya Al-Masi ya tapene' e' Tuhan, mbal pinasōd ni deyom langgal.

verses.name: John 9:23
verses.text: Angkan yuk matto'ana, “Tilawunbi iya, asangpot na iya.”  <div eID="gen6206" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3012"/><div sID="gen6207" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3012"/> Jari itu a'a bay abuta he' nilinganan pabalik e' saga nakura' Yahudi. Yuk sigām ni iya, “Pasapahanta ka, saksi'tam Tuhan. Kata'uwan kami, dusahan asal a'a bay amauli' ka'a.”  <div eID="gen6207" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3013"/><div sID="gen6208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3013"/> Anambung a'a he', yukna, “Mbal kata'uwanku bang iya taga-dusa atawa halam. Sagō' bang ma pana'uku, bay aku buta ati maka'nda' na aku.”  <div eID="gen6208" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3014"/><div sID="gen6209" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3014"/> Tinilaw iya pabalik e' sigām, yuk-i, “Ai bay hinangna ni ka'a? Buwattingga e'na amauli' matanu?”  <div eID="gen6209" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3015"/><div sID="gen6210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3015"/> Anambung iya, yukna, “Bay na kam haka'anku sagō' mbal aku kalebi. Angay kam bilahi akale pabīng? Baya'an kam bahā' magpamulid ma iya?”  <div eID="gen6210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3016"/><div sID="gen6211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3016"/> Pinah'llingan iya la'at e' saga nakura' inān, yuk sigām, “Ka'a mulidna. Kami itu mulid si Musa.

verses.name: John 9:29
verses.text: Kata'uwan kami in si Musa bay kapalmanan e' Tuhan. Saguwā' a'a ina'an, mbal minsan kata'uwan kami bang minningga.”  <div eID="gen6211" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3017"/><div sID="gen6212" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3017"/> Anambung a'a bay abuta, yukna, “Ainu-inu aku. Mbal iya kata'uwanbi bang minningga, sagō' makapauli' iya mataku.

verses.name: John 9:31
verses.text: Kata'uwantam in Tuhan mbal akale ma a'a dusahan. Ya kinale e' Tuhan bang a'a magmatāwan iya maka maghinang kabaya'anna.

verses.name: John 9:32
verses.text: Sangay min katagna' dunya, yamboho' kita makakale aniya' makapauli' a'a bay buta min deyom kandang.

verses.name: John 9:33
verses.text: Abila a'a inān ngga'i ka min Tuhan, tantu iya mbal makahinang saga hinang buwattitu.”  <div eID="gen6212" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3018"/><div sID="gen6213" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3018"/> Pinabukagan iya e' sigām, yuk-i, “Dusahan ka min llaw kapaganak ma ka'a sampay ni kaheyanu, ati pandu'annu kami bahā'?” Jari pinaluwas iya e' saga nakura' inān min deyom langgal.  <div eID="gen6213" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6199" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3019"/><div sID="gen6214" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Manusiya' Sali' Hantang Buta</title> <div sID="gen6215" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3019"/> Takale pa'in e' si Isa pasal a'a bay buta inān pinaluwas na min deyom langgal, magtūy pehē' si Isa amiha iya. Tabāk pa'in iya, yuk si Isa, “Magkahagad ka bahā' ma a'a niōnan Anak Manusiya'?”  <div eID="gen6215" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3020"/><div sID="gen6216" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3020"/> Anambung a'a itu, yukna, “Sai iya, Tuwan? Haka'in aku supaya aku magkahagad ma iya.”  <div eID="gen6216" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3021"/><div sID="gen6217" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3021"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Ta'nda'nu na iya, maka itiya' na iya anuli-nulihan ka'a buwattina'an.”  <div eID="gen6217" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3022"/><div sID="gen6218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3022"/> Magtūy pasujud a'a itu ma dahuan si Isa, maka e'na ah'lling, “Tuwan Panghū', magkahagad aku ma ka'a.”  <div eID="gen6218" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3023"/><div sID="gen6219" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3023"/> Yuk si Isa, “Angkan aku pi'itu ni dunya, supaya papagsaddiku saga manusiya'. Jari sasuku a'a bay buta maka'nda' du, maka sasuku bay maka'nda' tabuta du.”  <div eID="gen6219" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3024"/><div sID="gen6220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3024"/> Takale pa'in pah'lling si Isa itu e' saga Parisi kasehe'an bay maina'an, atilaw sigām ma iya. Yuk sigām, “Kami bahā' pah'llingnu sali' hantang buta?”  <div eID="gen6220" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3025"/><div sID="gen6221" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3025"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Abila kam bay buta, mbal du kam katōngan dusa. Pagka yukbi in ka'am maka'nda' du, na, taga-dusa gi' kam sabab mbal beya'bi kabaya'an Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6221" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.9"/> <div eID="gen6214" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3026"/><div sID="gen6222" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Angupiksa' saga Bili-bilina</title> <div sID="gen6223" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3026"/> Manjari magparalilan si Isa, yukna, “B'nnal pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, bang aniya' a'a pasōd ni deyom kuralan bili-bili, ma halam palabay min lawang sagō' pasōd min palabayan saddī, a'a inān panangkaw maka pangalangpas.

verses.name: John 10:2
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a pasōd min lawang, ya na ina'an a'a angupiksa' bili-bili.

verses.name: John 10:3
verses.text: Tantu iya niukaban e' tunggu' lawang. Paglinganna ōn saga bili-bilina pakaniya-pakaniya, tapanhid suwalana e' sigām ati bowana sigām paluwas min deyom kural.

verses.name: John 10:4
verses.text: Makaluwas pa'in, parahū iya ati paturul saga bili-bili min buli'anna sabab tapanhid suwalana.

verses.name: John 10:5
verses.text: Bang a'a saddī, mbal du tinurul e' bili-bili. Alahi sadja sigām sabab mbal tapanhid suwalana.”

verses.name: John 10:6
verses.text: Kissa itu bay pamaralil e' si Isa ma saga a'a inān sagō' halam tahati e' sigām.  <div eID="gen6223" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3027"/><div sID="gen6224" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3027"/> Angkanna ah'lling si Isa ma sigām pabalik, yukna, “B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, aku itu ibarat lawang palabayan saga bili-bili.

verses.name: John 10:8
verses.text: Saga a'a bay pi'itu dahū min aku sali' a'a anangkaw, a'a angalangpas. Saguwā' halam sigām kinale e' saga a'a suku'ku.

verses.name: John 10:9
verses.text: Aku itu ibarat lawang,” yuk si Isa. “Sai-sai pasōd labay min aku, lappasan du iya. Limaya du iya magsōd-luwas ati makabāk iya kalluman.

verses.name: John 10:10
verses.text: Bang a'a angalangpas, halam aniya' gawina pi'itu saddī min anangkaw maka amapatay maka amaka'at. Sagō' ya gawiku pi'itu amuwan kallum ma manusiya', kallum mamarahi hāpna.  <div eID="gen6224" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3028"/><div sID="gen6225" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3028"/> “Aku itu,” yuk si Isa, “ibarat a'a tag-bili-bili ahāp sidda pangupiksa'na ma saga bili-bilina. A'a inān maglilla' amatay ma sabab sigām.

verses.name: John 10:12
verses.text: Sagō' mbal magparuli to'ongan a'a ginadjihan anunggu' sabab ngga'i ka iya tag-dapu. Angkan bang aniya' ta'nda'na ero' talun pasekot, magtūy pasagaranna saga bili-bili ati alahi iya minnē'. Saga bili-bili kasehe' tas'kkat e' ero', kasehe' akaukanat.

verses.name: John 10:13
verses.text: Ya angkan a'a inān alahi sabab ginadjihan sadja iya. Halam aniya' pagka'inoganna ma saga bili-bili.

verses.name: John 10:14
verses.text: Aku itu,” yuk si Isa, “ibarat a'a tag-bili-bili ahāp pangupiksa'na ma saga bili-bilina. Kami maka Mma'ku magkata'u to'ongan. Damikiyanna aku maka saga a'a suku'ku, ata'u aku ma sigām maka ata'u sigām ma aku. Maglilla' isab aku amatay ma sabab sigām.

verses.name: John 10:15
verses.text: Aku itu,” yuk si Isa, “ibarat a'a tag-bili-bili ahāp pangupiksa'na ma saga bili-bilina. Kami maka Mma'ku magkata'u to'ongan. Damikiyanna aku maka saga a'a suku'ku, ata'u aku ma sigām maka ata'u sigām ma aku. Maglilla' isab aku amatay ma sabab sigām.

verses.name: John 10:16
verses.text: Aniya' gi' saga a'a suku'ku saddī minnitu. Ibarat sigām bili-bili ma kuralan saddī. Ya du sigām subay bowaku. Angasip du sigām ma suwalaku ati pagdakayu'ku sigām, manjari dakayu' du angupiksa' sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen6225" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3029"/><div sID="gen6226" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3029"/> “Kinalasahan aku e' Mma'ku Tuhan sabab maglilla' aku amatay bo' supaya bawi'ku kallumku pabīng.

verses.name: John 10:18
verses.text: Halam aniya' taga-kapatut amapatay aku, sabab aku ya magkabaya'an amatay maka mbal. Taga-kapatut aku maglilla' kallum baranku, maka taga-kapatut amakallum baranku pabīng. Panoho'an Mma'ku ko' itu ma aku.”  <div eID="gen6226" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3030"/><div sID="gen6227" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3030"/> Makakale pa'in saga a'a ma pamissala si Isa inān, magtūy sigām abahagi' duwa pabalik.

verses.name: John 10:20
verses.text: Aheka sigām angupama, yuk-i, “A'a itu sinōd saitan! Binelaw! Angay iya kalebi?”  <div eID="gen6227" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3031"/><div sID="gen6228" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3031"/> Sagō' yuk kasehe'an, “Bang a'a kasōran saitan mbal iya makabissala buwat pamissalana itu. Maka bang saitan, mbal tapa'nda'na a'a buta.”  <div eID="gen6228" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6222" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3032"/><div sID="gen6229" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mbal Magkahagad saga Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6230" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3032"/> Manjari timpu paghaggut na, waktu isab Paghinang Pagsussi ma langgal pagkulbanan ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: John 10:23
verses.text: Ina'an si Isa ma deyom langgal lum'ngngan ma saurung ya niōnan Saurung Sulayman.

verses.name: John 10:24
