verses.text: Jari magtimukan saga a'a pehē' ni sakalibutna. Yuk sigām ni iya, “At'ggol gi' ka bahā' amahati kami bang sai ka? Bang ka b'nnal Al-Masi ya tapene' e' Tuhan, subay kami haka'annu pahāp.”  <div eID="gen6230" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3033"/><div sID="gen6231" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3033"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bay na kam haka'anku sagō' halam aku bay pagkahagadbi. Ya amata'uwan ka'am bang sai aku, ya na saga hinang makainu-inu bay hinangku min ōn Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 10:26
verses.text: Sagō' mbal aku pagkahagadbi sabab ka'am ilu ngga'i ka saga bili-biliku, ngga'i ka suku'ku.

verses.name: John 10:27
verses.text: Saga bili-biliku angasip du ma suwalaku. Kata'uwanku sigām maka paturul du sigām ma aku.

verses.name: John 10:28
verses.text: Buwananku sigām kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan. Mbal to'ongan sigām amutawan min Tuhan sumiyan-sumiyan, maka halam aniya' makaragtu' sigām min komkomanku.

verses.name: John 10:29
verses.text: Bay sigām pamasuku'an aku e' Mma'ku, maka akawasa iya min kamemon. Halam aniya' makaragtu' saga a'a suku'ku min komkomanna.

verses.name: John 10:30
verses.text: Aku maka Mma'ku dakayu' du.”  <div eID="gen6231" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3034"/><div sID="gen6232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3034"/> Pagkale saga a'a ma lling si Isa he', amuwa' sigām batu pabīng pamantung sigām ma iya.

verses.name: John 10:32
verses.text: Yukna ni sigām, “Aheka hinang ahāp bay pa'nda'anku ni ka'am, saga hinang bay pamahinang aku e' Mma'ku Tuhan. Hinang ingga ya kab'nsihanbi, ya angkan kam bilahi amantung aku?”  <div eID="gen6232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3035"/><div sID="gen6233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3035"/> Yuk sambung saga a'a inān, “Ngga'i ka ma sabab hinangnu ahāp ya angkan kami magbamba amantung ka'a, sagō' ma sabab llingnu pangkal tudju ni Tuhan. Manusiya' sadja ka, bo' pa'in maglaku-laku ka in ka'a Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3036"/><div sID="gen6234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3036"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Na, tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab Tawrat ya pamissala Tuhan ni saga manusiya'. Yuk-i, ‘Ka'am ilu saga tuhan.’

verses.name: John 10:35
verses.text: Na, kata'uwantam in kamemon tasulat ma deyom Kitab mbal to'ongan apinda salama-lama. Bang Tuhan angōn tuhan ma saga a'a bay pamuwananna lapalna,

verses.name: John 10:36
verses.text: ya lagi'na aku patut niōnan Anak Tuhan. Sabab tapene' aku e' Tuhan bo' ma iya sadja, maka pinapi'itu aku e'na ni dunya. Jari angay yukbi in aku ah'lling pangkal tudju ni Tuhan pagka yukku in aku Anak Tuhan?

verses.name: John 10:37
verses.text: Bang aku saupama mbal angahinang saga hinang kabaya'an Mma'ku, da'a aku pagkahagarunbi.

verses.name: John 10:38
verses.text: Sagō' bang magtaluwa' hinangku maka kabaya'an Tuhan, na, pagkahagarunbi kahinanganku sadja, minsan kam mbal makab'nnal ma pah'llingku. Sabab minnē' kata'uwanbi to'ongan maka tahatibi in Mma'ku maka aku dakayu' du.”

verses.name: John 10:39
verses.text: Magtūy pasulay saga a'a inān pabalik anaggaw si Isa, sagō' makapuwas iya min pang'ntanan sigām.  <div eID="gen6234" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3037"/><div sID="gen6235" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3037"/> Puwas e' pabalik si Isa pehē' ni dambila' sapa' Jordan, ni bay pagpandihan saga a'a e' si Yahiya waktu tagna'. Pat'nna' si Isa maina'an daka pilambahangi.

verses.name: John 10:41
verses.text: Jari aheka a'a pehē' ni iya. Yuk suli-suli sigām, “Si Yahiya halam bay makahinang saga paltanda'an kainu-inuhan a'a, sagō' b'nnal sadja kamemon bay pah'llingna pasal si Isa.”

verses.name: John 10:42
verses.text: Ati aheka a'a mahē' angandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen6235" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.10"/> <div eID="gen6229" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3038"/><div sID="gen6236" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Lasarus</title> <div sID="gen6237" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3038"/> Na, aniya' dakayu' l'lla asaki, ōnna si Lasarus. Ina'an iya maglahat ma kaluma'an Betani maka duwangan danakanna d'nda, si Mariyam maka si Marta.

verses.name: John 11:2
verses.text: In si Mariyam dakayu' d'nda ya amu'usan ns'llan pahamut ni tape' Panghū' Isa bo' sapuhanna maka bu'unna.

verses.name: John 11:3
verses.text: Jari itu, pagga abangat saki si Lasarus, aniya' lapal pinabeya' e' duwangan danakanna ni si Isa, yuk-i, “Tuwan, asaki bagaynu ya kalasahannu.”  <div eID="gen6237" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3039"/><div sID="gen6238" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3039"/> Takale pa'in lapal itu e' si Isa, yukna, “Ya kamaujuran saki si Lasarus inān ngga'i ka du kamatay, sagō' sanglit ni Tuhan, supaya sinanglitan isab Anak Tuhan.”

verses.name: John 11:5
verses.text: Na, alasa asal si Isa ma t'llungan magdanakan inān, disi Marta maka si Mariyam maka si Lasarus.

verses.name: John 11:6
verses.text: Sagō' pagta'una in si Lasarus wa'i asaki, angagad gi' iya duwang'llaw mahē' ma pat'nna'anna.

verses.name: John 11:7
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Sūng kitam pabīng pehē' ni lahat Yahudiya.”  <div eID="gen6238" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3040"/><div sID="gen6239" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3040"/> Yuk saga mulidna ni iya, “Tuwan Guru, baha'u ka arak pinagbantung e' saga Yahudi bo' ka pinapatay. Ati maggara' na ka isab pabīng pehē'?”  <div eID="gen6239" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3041"/><div sID="gen6240" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3041"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Da'a kam asusa. Aniya' sangpū' maka duwanjām kasawahan ma deyom dang'llaw. Bang kita ganta' lum'ngngan ma waktu llaw mbal makarugtul tape'ta sabab asawa asal dunya.

verses.name: John 11:10
verses.text: Sagō' bang kita lum'ngngan waktu sangom makarugtul sadja sabab ma deyom kita lendom.”

verses.name: John 11:11
verses.text: Akatis pa'in lling si Isa itu, yukna ni saga mulidna, “Si Lasarus bagaytam inān wa'i tatuli. Sagō' pehē' aku amati' iya.”  <div eID="gen6240" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3042"/><div sID="gen6241" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3042"/> Yuk saga mulidna ni iya, “Tuwan, pauli' du iya bang hal atuli.”  <div eID="gen6241" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3043"/><div sID="gen6242" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3043"/> Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa in si Lasarus amatay na, sagō' bang ma pangannal saga mulidna dī tuli ya pagpa'inna.

verses.name: John 11:14
verses.text: Angkan pinatampal e' si Isa llingna, yukna, “Amatay na si Lasarus.

verses.name: John 11:15
verses.text: Ahāp aku halam makamahē' ma Betani ma waktu kasaki si Lasarus, sabab tantu du kam angandol ma aku bang ta'nda'bi ka-e'ku ma iya. Sūng kitam pehē'.”  <div eID="gen6242" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3044"/><div sID="gen6243" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3044"/> Manjari si Tomas, ya niranglay K'mbal, ah'lling ni saga pagkahina, yukna, “Sūng. Parongan kitam kamemon minsan kitam paunung ma iya sampay ni kamatay.”  <div eID="gen6243" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6236" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3045"/><div sID="gen6244" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ya Po'onan Kallum</title> <div sID="gen6245" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3045"/> At'kka pa'in disi Isa ni Betani, tata'una mpat llaw na bay kapangubul si Lasarus.

verses.name: John 11:18
verses.text: Betani itu asal asekot ni Awrusalam, saga dabatu lawakna,

verses.name: John 11:19
verses.text: jari aheka saga a'a min lahat Yahudiya magbunyug pehē' ni si Mariyam maka ni si Marta pasal kamatay danakan sigā l'lla.

verses.name: John 11:20
verses.text: Manjari itu, takale pa'in e' si Marta pasal si Isa ilu na, pehē' iya anampang. Si Mariyam tabba ma deyom luma'.

verses.name: John 11:21
verses.text: Magbāk pa'in si Marta maka si Isa, yukna ni si Isa, “Tuwan Panghū', bang ka bay maitu mbal du bay amatay danakanku!

verses.name: John 11:22
verses.text: Sagō' kata'uwanku, minsan ma buwattitu, nirūlan ka e' Tuhan ma ai-ai amu'nu.”  <div eID="gen6245" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3046"/><div sID="gen6246" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3046"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Allum du danakannu pabīng.”  <div eID="gen6246" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3047"/><div sID="gen6247" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3047"/> Yuk si Marta, “Aho', Tuwan, kata'uwanku. Pabangun du iya ni kallum ma llaw kahinapusan.”  <div eID="gen6247" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3048"/><div sID="gen6248" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3048"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Aku ya magpakallum saga a'a magpatayan, maka aku ya po'onan kallum. Sai-sai angandol ma aku allum du minsan iya amatay na.

verses.name: John 11:26
verses.text: Sasuku isab allum bo' angandol ma aku, mbal magkamatay sampay ni kasaumulan.” Manjari atilaw si Isa ni si Marta, yukna, “Magkahagad ka bahā'?”  <div eID="gen6248" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3049"/><div sID="gen6249" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3049"/> “Aho', Panghū'ku,” yuk si Marta, “magkahagad aku in ka'a Al-Masi, Anak Tuhan, ya lagaran kami pi'itu ni dunya.”  <div eID="gen6249" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3050"/><div sID="gen6250" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3050"/> Akatis pa'in lling si Marta itu, pehē' iya angalinganan danakanna si Mariyam bo' yampa singu'-singu'na, yukna, “Itiya' na Tuwan Guru amiha ka'a.”

verses.name: John 11:29
verses.text: Pagkale itu e' si Mariyam, pabuhat iya min paningkō'anna bo' parai'-dai' pehē' ni si Isa.

verses.name: John 11:30
verses.text: Halam gi' makasampay si Isa pehē' ni kaluma'an sagō' ina'an iya masi gi' ma bay pasampangan si Marta ma iya.

verses.name: John 11:31
verses.text: Aniya' saga a'a ma luma' magtingkō'an maka si Mariyam. Jari pag'nda' sigām ma iya pabuhat maka paluwas magdai'-dai', magtūy du sigām paturul. Pangannal sigām in si Mariyam pehē' ni kubul maglemong mahē'.  <div eID="gen6250" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3051"/><div sID="gen6251" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3051"/> Sagō' si Isa ya papehē'anna. Pag'nda'na ma si Isa pasujud iya ni dahuan tape'na, maka yukna, “Panghū'ku, bang ka bay maitu, mbal du bay amatay danakanku.”  <div eID="gen6251" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3052"/><div sID="gen6252" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3052"/> Maka'nda' pa'in si Isa ma si Mariyam maglemong, sampay saga sehe'na Yahudi ameya'-meya' isab maglemongan, magtūy iya angandu'-ngandu' maka ahansul deyom atayna.

verses.name: John 11:34
verses.text: “Maingga,” yukna, “bay pangubulanbi iya?” <div eID="gen6252" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6253" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sigām, “Tuwan, pi'itu ka nda'un.”  <div eID="gen6253" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3053"/><div sID="gen6254" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3053"/> Anangis si Isa.  <div eID="gen6254" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3054"/><div sID="gen6255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3054"/> Yuk suli-suli saga a'a he', “Nda'unbi ba kaheya lasana ma si Lasarus.”  <div eID="gen6255" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3055"/><div sID="gen6256" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3055"/> Sagō' yuk kasehe', “Si Isa itu bay makapaka'nda' saga a'a buta. Angay halam tatabangna si Lasarus bo' mbal amatay?”  <div eID="gen6256" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6244" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3056"/><div sID="gen6257" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapakallum si Isa ma si Lasarus</title> <div sID="gen6258" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3056"/> Na, angandu'-ngandu' si Isa pabīng bo' pehē' ni kubul. In kubul inān bay ma deyom songab batu maka aniya' batu panambol iya.

verses.name: John 11:39
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām ni kubul, yuk si Isa, “La'aninbi batu ilu.” <div eID="gen6258" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6259" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Marta, danakan a'a bay amatay itu. Yukna ni si Isa, “Abau na iya, Tuwan, sabab ka'mpat llawna na.”  <div eID="gen6259" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3057"/><div sID="gen6260" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3057"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Bay na ka haka'anku, maka'nda' ka kawasa Tuhan, bang pa'in ka magkahagad.”

verses.name: John 11:41
verses.text: Sakali nila'anan e' sigām batu panambol kubul. Pahangad si Isa angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan. “O Mma',” yukna, “magsukul aku sabab takalenu pangamu'ku.

verses.name: John 11:42
verses.text: Kata'uwanku in ka'a akale na pa'in ma aku, sagō' paluwasku bissalaku itu ma sabab saga a'a itu supaya sigām am'nnal in ka'a bay amapi'itu aku.”

verses.name: John 11:43
verses.text: Pagubus bissalana itu, angalingan iya pakosog yukna. “Lasarus! Paluwas ka pi'itu.”

verses.name: John 11:44
verses.text: Magtūy paluwas a'a bay amatay. Masi saputna ma tape'-tanganna maka masi turung-mukana. Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “La'aninbi saputna ilu, bo' pasagarinbi iya pal'ngnganan di-na.”  <div eID="gen6260" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6257" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3058"/><div sID="gen6261" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinagisunan si Isa bo' Sinaggaw</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.1-Matt.26.5">Matiyu 26:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.1-Mark.14.2">Markus 14:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.1-Luke.22.2">Lukas 22:1-2</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6262" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3058"/> Aheka saga a'a, bay pina'an ni si Mariyam, maka'nda' hinang si Isa itu ati magkahagad na sigām ma iya.

verses.name: John 11:46
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' sigām kasehe' pehē' ni saga Parisi anumbung pasal bay hinang si Isa.

verses.name: John 11:47
verses.text: Angkanna saga Parisi maka saga imam nakura' bay amapagtipun Tumpukan Maghuhukum<note>Tumpukan Maghuhukum: tumpukan saga a'a pitumpū' maka dda hekana ya amal'ngngan sara' Yahudi. Kaheka'anna Parisi, bo' Sadduki maka guru' sara' agama.</note>. Yuk sigām, “Ai bahā' hinangtam ni a'a itu? Aheka na paltanda'an kainu-inuhan a'a, tahinang e'na.

verses.name: John 11:48
verses.text: Bang iya pasangdantam,” yuk sigām, “tantu magkahagad saga a'a kamemon ma iya. Ati pi'itu saga nakura' Rōm angamula bangsatam sampay langgaltam.”  <div eID="gen6262" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3059"/><div sID="gen6263" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3059"/> Aniya' dakayu' anambung, ōnna si Kayapas. Imam Muwallam iya ma tahun ina'an-i. Yuk si Kayapas itu, “Sali' halam aniya' panghatibi.

verses.name: John 11:50
verses.text: Hatiunbi itu: padpad magmula katibu'ukan bangsatam kamemon, ahāp lagi' bang dakayu' a'a sadja amatay ganti'tam kamemon.”  <div eID="gen6263" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3060"/><div sID="gen6264" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3060"/> Ya pinagba'at itu e' si Kayapas ngga'i ka min baranna. Buwattē' pah'llingna sabab in iya Imam Muwallam ma tahun ina'an-i. Angkan tapagba'at e'na in si Isa subay pinapatay pangangganti' bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: John 11:52
verses.text: Ngga'i ka hal bangsa Isra'il, saguwā' amatay iya pangangganti' saga panganak Tuhan ya apulak-palik ma kalahat-lahatan bo' supaya sigām pinapagdakayu'.

verses.name: John 11:53
verses.text: Jari itu, tinagna'an min llaw ina'an-i, maggara' na saga a'a inān amapatay si Isa.

verses.name: John 11:54
verses.text: Angkan iya mbal na patampal ni kaheka'an a'a mahē' ma lahat Yahudiya. Gom pa'in iya maka saga mulidna ala'an pehē' ni Epra'im, kauman ma bihing lahat paslangan, ati maina'an iya pat'nna' maka saga mulidna.  <div eID="gen6264" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3061"/><div sID="gen6265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3061"/> Manjari asekot na paghinang saga Yahudi ya niōnan Hinang Paglakad. Aheka saga a'a min kalahat-lahatan wa'i patukad ni Awrusalam magpandi sussi bo' supaya sigām manjari palamud ma paghinang.

verses.name: John 11:56
verses.text: Amiha na pa'in sigām ma si Isa kalu iya ina'an ma Awrusalam, jari atipun pa'in sigām ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, magkihaka sigām dangan maka dangan. Yuk sigām, “Ai ma pikilanbi? Pi'itu bahā' si Isa ni paghinangan? Arai' mbal, ā?”

verses.name: John 11:57
verses.text: Buwattē' pagbissala sigām sabab aniya' bay panoho'an saga imam alanga maka saga Parisi, bang aniya' kono' makata'uwan kamaina'anan si Isa, subay pata'una magtūy saga nakura' supaya iya sinaggaw.  <div eID="gen6265" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.11"/> <div eID="gen6261" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3062"/><div sID="gen6266" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Binu'usan Ns'llan Pahamut</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.6-Matt.26.13">Matiyu 26:6-13</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.3-Mark.14.9">Markus 14:3-9</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6267" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3062"/> Nnom llaw la'a bo' Hinang Paglakad, at'kka si Isa ni Betani, kaluma'an si Lasarus ya a'a bay pakallumna min kamatayna.

verses.name: John 12:2
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in si Isa, sinakapan iya kinakan e' saga a'a mahē' pagmahaltabat sigām ma iya. Si Marta anabang magbowa bubuhatan, ati si Lasarus maka a'a kasehe'an ina'an dangkakanan maka si Isa.

verses.name: John 12:3
verses.text: Manjari itu ningā' e' si Mariyam tonga' kilu ns'llan pahamut, ōnna narda. Ns'llan itu halam aniya' lamud-lamudna, ahalga' sidda. Binu'usan e' si Mariyam ns'llan pahamut itu ni tape' si Isa bo' sapuhanna maka bu'unna. Asaplag deyom luma' e' hamut ns'llan e'.  <div eID="gen6267" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3063"/><div sID="gen6268" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3063"/> Manjari anu'al si Judas Iskariyut, dakayu' mulid si Isa. Ya na ko' itu a'a song anukbalan si Isa ni saga bantana.

verses.name: John 12:5
verses.text: “Oy!” yuk si Judas. “Arapun pahamut ilu pinab'llihan ati b'llihanna pamuwan ma saga a'a miskin. Halga'na ilu sali' gadji dantahun.”

verses.name: John 12:6
verses.text: Buwattē' bissala si Judas inān ma sabab pilliyu iya, ngga'i ka ma sabab lasana ma saga miskin. Bay pangandol ma iya sīn kamuliran inān, bo' pa'in anangpas iya angā' sīn minnē'.  <div eID="gen6268" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3064"/><div sID="gen6269" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3064"/> Manjari yuk si Isa, “Pasagarin d'nda itu. Tu'ud pangawal e'na ma llaw kapangubul aku.

verses.name: John 12:8
verses.text: Aniya' na pa'in kamiskinan tabangbi, sagō' aku itu mbal taptap ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen6269" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3065"/><div sID="gen6270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3065"/> Pasalta' aheka a'a makata'u in si Isa ina'an ma Betani, angkan sigām pina'an. Ngga'i ka hal si Isa ya sababanna, tu'ud sigām bilahi ang'nda' si Lasarus, ya bay pinakallum e' si Isa.

verses.name: John 12:10
verses.text: Angkan magisun saga imam alanga amapatay isab si Lasarus.

verses.name: John 12:11
verses.text: Buwattē' pagisun sigām, sabab min si Lasarus angkan aheka saga Yahudi papinda angandol na ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen6270" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6266" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3066"/><div sID="gen6271" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmahaldika' ma si Isa Pagsōdna ni Awrusalam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.21.1-Matt.21.11">Matiyu 21:1-11</reference>,<reference osisRef="Mark.11.1-Mark.11.11">Markus 11:1-11</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.19.28-Luke.19.40">Lukas 19:28-40</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6272" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3066"/> Pagk'llat llaw dakayu', takale e' ba'anan a'a magtimukan ma Hinang Paglakad in si Isa ilu ma labayan tudju ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: John 12:13
verses.text: Jari itu anagpe' sigām saga engas-engas dahunan ati paluwas sigām pehē' anampang si Isa. Angalingan sigām pakosog, yuk sigām, <lg sID="gen6273"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6274"/>“Mahaldika'!<l eID="gen6274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6275"/>Bang pa'in binarakatan ya kawakilan e' Tuhan pi'itu!<l eID="gen6275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6276"/>Bang pa'in binarakatan sultan bangsa Isra'il!”<l eID="gen6276" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6273"/>  <div eID="gen6272" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3067"/><div sID="gen6277" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3067"/> Aniya' dakayu' anak kura' bay tabāk e' si Isa pangura'anna, buwat tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6278"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6279"/>

verses.name: John 12:15
verses.text: “Ka'am saga a'a Awrusalam, da'a kam tināw.<l eID="gen6279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6280"/>Ilu'un sultanbi angura' ma anak kura'.”<l eID="gen6280" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6278"/>  <div eID="gen6277" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3068"/><div sID="gen6281" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3068"/> Ma waktu ina'an-i halam tahati e' saga mulidna bang ai paniya' itu. Sagō' pagpole' si Isa ni sulga', yampa taentom e' sigām in pakaradja'an itu bay asal tasulat ma deyom Kitab. Maka taentom e' sigām bay hinang sigām inān ma iya.  <div eID="gen6281" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3069"/><div sID="gen6282" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3069"/> Pinasaplag na pa'in suli-suli pasal si Isa e' kaheka'an a'a bay makasabu ma iya waktu kapangalinganna ma si Lasarus paluwas min kubul, maka kapamakallumna ma iya.

verses.name: John 12:18
verses.text: Angkan aheka paluwas min da'ira bo' anampang si Isa ma labayan, sabab takale e' sigām pasal hinang si Isa makainu-inu inān.

verses.name: John 12:19
verses.text: Sakali maghimumūngan saga Parisi, yuk-i, “Nda'unbi! Ameya' na ma iya saga a'a kamemon. Halam aniya' dapattam!”  <div eID="gen6282" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6271" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3070"/><div sID="gen6283" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amissala si Isa Pasal Kamatayna</title> <div sID="gen6284" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3070"/> Aniya' saga a'a bangsa Girīk bay magdongan pina'an ni Awrusalam bo' anambahayang ma waktu Paghinang inān.

verses.name: John 12:21
verses.text: Pehē' sigām itu ah'lling ni si Pilip, yuk-i, “Tuwan, bilahi kami mag'nda' maka si Isa.” Si Pilip itu dakayu' mulid si Isa, a'a min kauman Betsaida mahē' ma lahat Jalil.

verses.name: John 12:22
verses.text: Pehē' si Pilip angahaka'an si Andariyas ati pehē' sigā karuwangan angahaka'an si Isa.  <div eID="gen6284" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3071"/><div sID="gen6285" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3071"/> Anambung si Isa yukna, “Asekot na waktuku. Arai' na aku, in Anak Manusiya', pinabangsa to'ongan.

verses.name: John 12:24
verses.text: B'nnal ya panapantunku itu ma ka'am, in dansolag bigi-tinanom<note>‘Jimpaw’ atawa ‘tuwaliya.’</note> taptap na pa'in dansolag sat'ggol mbal tinanom ni tana'. Ma tana' pa'in, pahansul bo' patomo', ati bo' amuwan buwa' paheka.

verses.name: John 12:25
verses.text: Sapantun bigi-tinanom isab kitam manusiya'. Sasuku allogan kallum-baranna ma dunya itu, amutawan du kallum-nyawana min Tuhan. Sagō' sasuku mbal allogan kallum-baranna ma dunya, kakkal du kallum-nyawana sampay ni kasaumulan.”

verses.name: John 12:26
verses.text: Yuk si Isa gi', “Sasuku bilahi maghinang ni aku subay ameya' ma aku. Manjari pi'ingga-pi'ingga papehē'anku, ina'an isab iya ameya' ma aku, maka sasuku maghinang ni aku pinalanga du e' Mma'ku.”  <div eID="gen6285" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3072"/><div sID="gen6286" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3072"/> Masi ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Asusa deyom atayku ma buwattitu. Daka ai pangamu'ku. Parahing bahā' aku ni Mma'ku bo' mbal pat'kkana ni aku kabinasahan itu? Da'a na, sabab ya na itu maksudku pi'itu, subay labayanku kabinasahan itu.”

verses.name: John 12:28
verses.text: Manjari anabbut si Isa ni Tuhan, yukna. “O Mma', paheya'un ōnnu.” <div eID="gen6286" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6287" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy aniya' suwala min sulga' ah'lling, yukna, “Bay na paheyaku ōnku, maka paheyaku du pabalik.”  <div eID="gen6287" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3073"/><div sID="gen6288" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3073"/> Takale suwala itu e' saga a'a magt'nggehan maina'an ati yuk kasehe', “Oy! L'ggon ko' inān.” <div eID="gen6288" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6289" type="paragraph"/> Yuk kasehe', “Mala'ikat ko' inān amissala ni iya.”  <div eID="gen6289" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3074"/><div sID="gen6290" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3074"/> Sagō' yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Suwala inān ngga'i ka ma kahāpanku sagō' ma kahāpanbi.

verses.name: John 12:31
verses.text: Ta'abut na waktu pangahukum saga manusiya' ma dunya. Ta'abut na waktu pamahalam kosog nakura' saitan, ya magagi ma babaw dunya itu.

verses.name: John 12:32
verses.text: Bang aku niangkat na ni hāg, bowaku du saga a'a kamemon ameya' ma aku.”

verses.name: John 12:33
verses.text: Binissala itu e' si Isa pamata'una ma saga a'a maina'an bang buwattingga kamatayna.  <div eID="gen6290" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3075"/><div sID="gen6291" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3075"/> Anambung saga a'a aheka inān ni si Isa, yuk sigām, “Bang ma Kitab in Al-Masi allum du salama-lama. Sagō' yuknu in Anak Manusiya' subay pina'angkat ni hāg pinapatay. Sai bahā' Anak Manusiya' itu?”  <div eID="gen6291" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3076"/><div sID="gen6292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3076"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Itiya' masi ma deyomanbi ya niōnan sawa, sagō' mbal at'ggol maitu. Sat'ggol iya masi gi' ma ka'am, subay palanjalbi l'ngnganbi bo' kam mbal kalendoman. Sabab sasuku lum'ngngan ma kalendoman, mbal kata'uwanna papehē'anna.

verses.name: John 12:36
verses.text: Angkanna,” yuk si Isa, “subay kam angandol ma sawa sat'ggol masi ma ka'am, supaya kam manjari panganak kasawahan.” Aubus pa'in e' si Isa amissala, ala'an iya bo' palimbu min saga a'a inān.  <div eID="gen6292" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6283" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 12:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3077"/><div sID="gen6293" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mbal na pa'in Magkahagad saga Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3077"/> Minsan aheka hinang makainu-inu bay tahinang si Isa ma pang'nda' sigām, masi sigām mbal magkahagad ma iya.

verses.name: John 12:38
verses.text: Jari tatuman ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab e' nabi Isaya, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6295"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6296"/>“O Panghū', sai bay magkahagad ma haka kami?<l eID="gen6296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6297"/>Sai bay kapa'nda'an kawasanu?”<l eID="gen6297" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6295"/>

verses.name: John 12:39
verses.text: Ya na itu po'onna angkan sigām mbal magkahagad, buwat tasulat e' si Isaya ma ayat dakayu', ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6298"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6299"/>

verses.name: John 12:40
verses.text: “Pinabuta sigām e' Tuhan supaya mbal maka'nda'.<l eID="gen6299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6300"/>Nilimbuhan pikilan sigām supaya mbal makahati.<l eID="gen6300" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6301"/>Jari mbal sigām papinda ni aku, yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen6301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6302"/>bo' kauli'anku kasusahan sigām.”<l eID="gen6302" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6298"/>

verses.name: John 12:41
verses.text: Binissala itu e' si Isaya sabab ta'nda'na sahaya si Isa, maka pinagpa'in iya e'na.  <div eID="gen6294" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3078"/><div sID="gen6303" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3078"/> Malaingkan, aheka saga nakura' Yahudi magkahagad ma si Isa. Sagō' mbal sigām anuli-nuli patampal pasal pagkahagad sigām, sabab tināw sigām ma saga Parisi. Tināw sigām pinaluwas tūy min deyom langgal ati mbal na pinasōd pabīng.

verses.name: John 12:43
verses.text: Tu'ud sigām bilahi sinanglitan e' pagkahi manusiya', labi gi' min sanglit min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6303" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3079"/><div sID="gen6304" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3079"/> Manjari atanog e' si Isa amissala, yukna, “Sasuku magkahagad ma aku, ngga'i ka hal aku ya pagkahagadna, sagō' Tuhan isab, ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 12:45
verses.text: Maka sasuku ang'nda' aku, ta'nda'na isab ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 12:46
verses.text: Bay aku pi'itu ni dunya amuwan sawa ma pikilan manusiya', bo' supaya in sasuku magkahagad ma aku mbal paddas ma deyom kalendoman.

verses.name: John 12:47
verses.text: Sasuku akale pandu'ku bo' mbal beya'na, ngga'i ka aku angahukum iya, sabab ngga'i ka pangahukum ma manusiya' ya maksudku pi'itu ni dunya. Pi'itu aku supaya sigām lappasanku min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: John 12:48
verses.text: Ma llaw kahinapusan aniya' du angahukum saga a'a ya anulak aku maka mbal anaima' pamandu'ku. Pamandu'ku ma sigām ya pangahukuman sigām ma llaw katapusan.

verses.name: John 12:49
verses.text: Taluwa' ko' itu sabab ngga'i ka min pagnahu'-nahu'ku ya angkan aku amandu', sagō' min Mma'ku ya bay amapi'itu aku. Bay aku tinugpangan e'na bang ai subay pamandu'ku, maka bang buwattingga e'ku amandu'.

verses.name: John 12:50
verses.text: Maka kata'uwanku in panoho'an Mma'ku itu amuwan kallum kakkal sampay ni kasaumulan. Angkan ai-ai pamissalaku ma manusiya' bay panoho'an aku asal e' Mma'ku.”  <div eID="gen6304" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.12"/> <div eID="gen6293" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3080"/><div sID="gen6305" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Angose'an Tape' saga Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen6306" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3080"/> Sōng pa'in tinagna'an Hinang Paglakad, kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa ta'abut na waktu kala'anna min dunya bo' pabīng ni Mma'na. Bay na kalasahanna asal saga a'a suku'na ma dunya itu, sagō' pa'nda'anna sigām bang buwattingga kaheya lasana.  <div eID="gen6306" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3081"/><div sID="gen6307" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3081"/> Manjari pagabay kohap pa'in, magkakan disi Isa maka saga mulidna. Si Judas anak si Simun Iskariyut aubus na bay pinahōpan pikilan e' nakura' saitan subay anōngan si Isa ni saga bantana.

verses.name: John 13:3
verses.text: Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa in iya baranna kabuwanan kapatut e' Mma'na Tuhan magagi ma kamemon. Kata'uwanna isab in iya bay pi'itu min Tuhan maka pabalik du iya ni Tuhan.

verses.name: John 13:4
verses.text: Jari pabuhat si Isa min pagkakanan ati hurusanna dallapis badju'na bo' yampa a'ampi' maka jimpaw<note>‘Jimpaw’ atawa ‘tuwaliya.’</note>.

verses.name: John 13:5
verses.text: Anumpahan iya bohe' ni deyom undam ati anagna' iya angose'an tape' saga mulidna pakaniya-pakaniya. Puwas e' sinapuhan e'na tape' sigām maka jimpaw ya pa'ampi'na.

verses.name: John 13:6
verses.text: Pagabutna ni si Simun Petros, yuk si Petros ni iya, “Panghū', kose'annu bahā' tape'ku?”  <div eID="gen6307" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3082"/><div sID="gen6308" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3082"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Mbal tahatinu buwattina'an bang ai hinangku itu sagō' tahatinu du ma sinosōng.”  <div eID="gen6308" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3083"/><div sID="gen6309" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3083"/> Yuk si Petros, “Mbal to'ongan pakose'ku tape'ku ma ka'a.” <div eID="gen6309" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6310" type="paragraph"/> “Bang mbal kose'anku tape'nu,” yuk sambung si Isa, “mbal ka mulidku.”  <div eID="gen6310" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3084"/><div sID="gen6311" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3084"/> Yuk si Simun Petros ma iya, “Na Panghū', bang buwattē' du, da'a hal tape'ku, kose'in sampay tanganku maka kōkku.”  <div eID="gen6311" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3085"/><div sID="gen6312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3085"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bang a'a bay amandi alanu' na baranna. Hal tape'na la'a ya subay kose'anna pabīng. Ka'am kamemon, alanu' na pangatayanbi, haliyu sadja min a'a dangan ilu.”

verses.name: John 13:11
verses.text: Buwattē' pah'lling si Isa sabab kata'uwanna asal bang sai song anōngan iya ni saga bantana, angkan yukna in sigām alanu' pangatayan sigām kamemon, haliyu min a'a dangan.  <div eID="gen6312" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3086"/><div sID="gen6313" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3086"/> Aubus pa'in kinose'an e' si Isa tape' saga mulidna, abadju' iya pabīng bo' aningkō' ma baina. Atilaw iya ni saga mulidna, yukna, “Tahatibi bahā' bang ai bay hinangku itu ma ka'am?

verses.name: John 13:13
verses.text: Ōnanbi aku Guru maka Panghū'. Taluwa' ko' inān, sabab gurubi du aku maka panghū'bi.

verses.name: John 13:14
verses.text: Manjari, pagka aku gurubi maka panghū'bi bay angose'an tape'bi, subay aku panunuranbi. Ka'am ilu subay isab magkose'an tape' sehe'bi dangan kam maka dangan.

verses.name: John 13:15
verses.text: Bay hinangku itu pamintānganbi, supaya aku panunuranbi magpareyo' atay.

verses.name: John 13:16
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, in banyaga' mbal alanga min nakura'na, maka sosoho'an mbal alanga min a'a anoho' iya.

verses.name: John 13:17
verses.text: Pagka tahatibi na pamandu'ku itu, tantu aheya kahāpan ma ka'am bang beya'bi du.”  <div eID="gen6313" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3087"/><div sID="gen6314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3087"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Ngga'i ka ka'am kamemon ya pagsambatku itu. Kata'uwanku du bang sai bay tapene'ku ameya' ma aku. Sagō' subay du aniya' kamaujuran ma bay pinagkallam ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Nila'at du aku e' a'a dangkakanan maka aku.’

verses.name: John 13:19
verses.text: Haka'anta kam pasal itu ma halam lagi' pat'kka, jari bang pat'kka, b'nnalbi du bay pah'llingku tagna' ma pasalan baranku, hatina ‘aku na Iya’.

verses.name: John 13:20
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “sasuku anaima' a'a soho'ku, sali' baranku ya tinaima'. Maka sasuku anaima' aku, tataima'na isab ya bay amapi'itu aku.”  <div eID="gen6314" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6305" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3088"/><div sID="gen6315" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Haka si Isa Pasal A'a Sōng Anipu Iya</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.20-Matt.26.25">Matiyu 26:20-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.12-Mark.14.21">Markus 14:12-21</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.7-Luke.22.14">Lukas 22:7-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.21-Luke.22.23">21-23</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6316" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3088"/> Aubus pa'in ah'lling si Isa itu, asasaw pangatayanna ati yukna ni saga mulidna, “B'nnal llingku itu ma ka'am, aniya' dangan min ka'am song anukbalan aku ni saga bantaku.”  <div eID="gen6316" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3089"/><div sID="gen6317" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3089"/> Magpatong-piyatongi saga mulid. Tu'ud halam kinata'uwan e' sigām bang sai pinah'lling e' si Isa.

verses.name: John 13:23
verses.text: Jari aniya' mulid dakayu', ya kalalasahan si Isa, ina'an pasandig ma bihing si Isa.

verses.name: John 13:24
verses.text: Sininyal mulid itu e' si Simun Petros ati yuk si Petros, “Tilawun kono' si Isa bang sai pah'llingna.”  <div eID="gen6317" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3090"/><div sID="gen6318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3090"/> Manjari pali'id mulid inān ni si Isa atilaw, yuk-i, “Panghū', sai bahā' anōngan ka'a ni bantanu?”  <div eID="gen6318" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3091"/><div sID="gen6319" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3091"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya a'a buwananku tinapay aubus bay t'nno'anku ni loho', ya na ko' inān a'a-i.” Sakali niā' tinapay e' si Isa, tin'nno'an e'na ni loho' bo' yampa pamuwanna ma si Judas anak si Simun Iskariyut.

verses.name: John 13:27
verses.text: Pagā' tinapay itu e' si Judas, magtūy pahōp nakura' saitan ni deyom pikilanna. Yuk si Isa ni si Judas, “Dai'-dai'un na ya song hinangnu ilu.”

verses.name: John 13:28
verses.text: Halam aniya' minsan dangan min mulidna kasehe' makahati bang ai bay pah'lling si Isa ma si Judas e'.

verses.name: John 13:29
verses.text: In iya asal amatuntul sīn sigām, angkan pangannal saga mulid kasehe' in si Judas sinō' am'lli sakap paghinang atawa sinō' amuwan tutulungan ma saga miskin.

verses.name: John 13:30
verses.text: Manjari pagsambut pa'in tinapay e' si Judas, magtūy iya paluwas minnē'. Sangom na ma waktu he'-i.  <div eID="gen6319" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6315" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3092"/><div sID="gen6320" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen6321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3092"/> Paglikut si Judas, yuk si Isa, “Buwattina'an pina'nda'an na kamahaldika'an ma aku, Anak Tuhan. Pina'nda'an isab kawasa Tuhan sabab min aku.

verses.name: John 13:32
verses.text: Jari bang kapa'nda'an kawasa Tuhan sabab min aku, song isab pa'nda'anna pangamahaldika'na ma aku. Mbal na at'ggol.

verses.name: John 13:33
verses.text: Na, saga anak-mulidku,” yuk si Isa, “mbal na aku at'ggol maitu ma ka'am. Pihabi du aku, sagō' balikanku bay pangahakaku ma saga nakura' Yahudi: ‘Mbal kam makapehē' ni papehē'anku inān.’

verses.name: John 13:34
verses.text: Na, aniya' panoho'an baha'u pang'bbaku ma ka'am. Subay kam maglasa-liyasahi. Maglasa kam buwat kalasaku ma ka'am.

verses.name: John 13:35
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' maglasa-liyasahi, minnē' kinata'uwan e' saga manusiya' kamemon in ka'am b'nnal mulidku.”  <div eID="gen6321" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6320" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3093"/><div sID="gen6322" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamalilu si Petros</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.31-Matt.26.35">Matiyu 26:31-35</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.27-Mark.14.31">Markus 14:27-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.31-Luke.22.34">Lukas 22:31-34</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6323" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3093"/> Yuk si Simun Petros ni si Isa, “Tuwan Panghū', pi'ingga ka?” <div eID="gen6323" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6324" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Mbal na aku karonganannu ni papehē'anku he', sagō' parongan du ka ma sinosōng.”  <div eID="gen6324" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3094"/><div sID="gen6325" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3094"/> “Tuwan,” yuk si Petros ni iya, “angay aku mbal makarongan ma ka'a buwattina'an? Maglilla' aku pinapatay ma sababnu.”  <div eID="gen6325" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3095"/><div sID="gen6326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3095"/> Sinambungan iya e' si Isa, yukna, “Paglilla'nu bahā' barannu pinapatay ma sababku? B'nnal ya pangahakaku ma ka'a, ma mbal gi' angukku'uk manuk, amalilu du ka min t'llu in aku mbal kata'uwannu.”  <div eID="gen6326" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.13"/> <div eID="gen6322" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3096"/><div sID="gen6327" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinahantap e' si Isa Pangatayan saga Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen6328" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3096"/> Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Da'a pasusahunbi deyom ataybi pasal llingku inān. Angandol sadja kam ma Tuhan maka angandol kam ma aku.

verses.name: John 14:2
verses.text: Aheka pat'nna'an maina'an ma okoman Mma'ku Tuhan. Bang ngga'i ka b'nnal, bay du kam haka'anku. Pehē' du aku anagamahan ka'am pat'nna'an.

verses.name: John 14:3
verses.text: Na, bang aubus e'ku anagamahan kam pat'nna'an, pabalik du aku pi'itu angā' ka'am binowa pehē', supaya kitam magdakayu' pat'nna'an.

verses.name: John 14:4
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi isab labayan tudju ni papehē'anku.”  <div eID="gen6328" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6327" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3097"/><div sID="gen6329" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Lalabayan Tudju ni Mma'na</title> <div sID="gen6330" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3097"/> Yuk si Tomas ni iya, “Tuwan Panghū', mbal kata'uwan kami bang pi'ingga papehē'annu. Daka buwattingga e' kami makatullus pehē'!”  <div eID="gen6330" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3098"/><div sID="gen6331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3098"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Aku ya labayan tudju ni Tuhan. Aku ya po'onan kasab'nnalan. Aku ya po'onan kallum. Halam aniya' makapehē' ni Mma'ku Tuhan bang ngga'i ka aku ya palabayanna.

verses.name: John 14:7
verses.text: Bang aku kata'uwanbi du, kata'uwanbi isab Mma'ku. Puwas min llaw itu kata'uwanbi du iya, maka ta'nda'bi.”  <div eID="gen6331" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3099"/><div sID="gen6332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3099"/> Yuk si Pilip ni si Isa, “Tuwan Panghū', pa'nda'in Mma'nu ma kami, ati ka'amuhan kami.”  <div eID="gen6332" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3100"/><div sID="gen6333" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3100"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “T'ggol kamailuku na ma ka'am, Pilip, mbal gi' kata'uwannu aku bang sai? Sai-sai maka'nda' aku, sali' Mma'ku to'ongan ya ta'nda'na. Jari angay angkan yuknu in Mma'ku subay pina'nda'an ni ka'am?

verses.name: John 14:10
verses.text: Mbal ka bahā' am'nnal, Pilip, in aku maka Mma'ku dakayu' du? Saga pandu' bay pamandu'ku ma ka'am inān, ngga'i ka min paghona'-hona'ku sagō' min Mma'ku, ya pataptap itu ma aku. Angahinang iya hinangna labay min aku.”

verses.name: John 14:11
verses.text: Yuk si Isa lagi', “Subay aku pagkahagadbi pagka yukku in aku maka Mma'ku dakayu' du. Sagō' bang aku ganta' mbal pagkahagadbi ma pamissalaku hal, pagkahagarunbi aku ma sabab saga hinang ya bay tahinangku.

verses.name: John 14:12
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, sai-sai taga-pangandol ma aku, tahinang e'na saga hinang bay hinangku. Maka pasōng lagi' saga hinangna min bay hinangku, sabab marai' na aku pehē' ni Mma'ku Tuhan.

verses.name: John 14:13
verses.text: Ai-ai amu'bi ni Mma'ku ma sabab aku ya panabbutanbi, hinangku du ma ka'am supaya aniya' mahaldika' ma Mma'ku sabab min aku.

verses.name: John 14:14
verses.text: Ai-ai amu'bi ni aku ma sabab ōnku ya panabbutanbi, paniya'ku sadja du ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen6333" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6329" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3101"/><div sID="gen6334" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panganjanji' si Isa pasal Rū Sussi</title> <div sID="gen6335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3101"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Bang aku kalasahanbi du, tantu beya'bi saga panoho'anku.

verses.name: John 14:16
verses.text: Angamu' aku ni Mma'ku ati aniya' paniya'na ma ka'am ganti'ku anabangan ka'am. Pataptap du iya ma ka'am saumul-umul.

verses.name: John 14:17
verses.text: Rū Tuhan ko' itu, ya pinagsambatan Rū kasab'nnalan. Mbal iya tataima' e' saga a'a mbal angisbat, sabab mbal ta'nda' e' sigām maka mbal takilā. Sagō' ka'am ilu, takilābi du Rū Tuhan sabab ilu iya ma ka'am maka pataptap ma deyom ataybi.  <div eID="gen6335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3102"/><div sID="gen6336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3102"/> “Minsan aku ala'an min ka'am, mbal kam siya-siyaku. Pabalik du aku pi'itu ni ka'am.

verses.name: John 14:19
verses.text: Marai' na waktu in aku mbal ta'nda' e' saga a'a ya mbal angisbat Tuhan. Sagō' ta'nda'bi du aku ati allum du kam salama-lama pagka aku ya asal allum.

verses.name: John 14:20
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in waktu ina'an, kata'uwanbi du in aku maka Mma'ku dakayu' du, maka kata'uwanbi isab in ka'am maka aku dakayu' du.

verses.name: John 14:21
verses.text: Sai-sai anaima' saga panoho'anku sampay ameya', ya ilu a'a alasa ma aku. Jari sasuku alasahan aku, kinalasahan iya e' Mma'ku. Ya du aku alasahan iya, maka amakilā aku di-ku ma iya.”  <div eID="gen6336" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3103"/><div sID="gen6337" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3103"/> Sakali tinilaw si Isa e' si Judas, (ya ngga'i ka Judas Iskariyut.) “Panghū',” yukna, “ai sababna angkan hal kami ya pata'unu ma pasalnu, ngga'i ka manusiya' kamemon?”  <div eID="gen6337" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3104"/><div sID="gen6338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3104"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bang a'a alasahan aku, tantu beya'na pamandu'ku. Jari kinalasahan iya e' Mma'ku ati pina'an du kami maka Mma'ku pat'nna' ma iya.

verses.name: John 14:24
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a mbal alasa ma aku, mbal isab beya'na saga pandu'ku. Saga kabtangan ya takalebi min aku, ngga'i ka min hona'-hona'ku sagō' min Mma'ku, ya bay amapi'itu aku.  <div eID="gen6338" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3105"/><div sID="gen6339" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3105"/> “Bay na itu pamissalaku ni ka'am ma waktu kamaituku ma ka'am.

verses.name: John 14:26
verses.text: Sagō' ma sinosōng pinandu'an du kam pasal kamemon e' Rū Sussi, ya pinabeya' e' Mma'ku anabangan ka'am paganti' min aku, maka amaentoman ka'am pasal kamemon bay pamandu'ku.”  <div eID="gen6339" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3106"/><div sID="gen6340" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3106"/> Yuk si Isa lagi', “Ya pang'bbaku ma ka'am kasannangan atay. Kasannangan itu min aku asal, maka halam aniya' sali'na ma deyom dunya. Angkan yukku ma ka'am, da'a pasusahunbi ataybi maka da'a kam tināw.

verses.name: John 14:28
verses.text: Bay na takalebi pah'llingku, ya yuk-i, ‘Ala'an aku min ka'am sagō' pabalik du aku pi'ilu ni ka'am.’ Bang aku kalasahanbi, tantu du kam kinōgan pagka aku pehē' ni Mma'ku, sabab alanga iya min aku.

verses.name: John 14:29
verses.text: Bay na itu pata'uku ma ka'am buwattina'an hinabuku halam lagi' ala'an, supaya aku pagkahagadbi bang ta'abut na waktu ina'an.

verses.name: John 14:30
verses.text: Mbal na aku makat'ggol amissalahan ka'am, sabab marai' na at'kka nakura' saitan ya magagi ma babaw dunya itu. Mbal aku kapagagihan e'na,

verses.name: John 14:31
verses.text: sagō' subay anganad saga manusiya' kamemon in aku alasa asal ma Mma'ku, ya angkan aku amanuyu' angahinang ai-ai panoho'an Mma'ku ma aku. <div eID="gen6340" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6341" type="paragraph"/> “Na, sūng na,” yuk si Isa. “Palanjal kitam minnitu.”  <div eID="gen6341" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.14"/> <div eID="gen6334" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3107"/><div sID="gen6342" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Dalil Dī Po'onan Tinanom</title> <div sID="gen6343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3107"/> Manjari itu magparalilan si Isa. Yukna ni saga mulidna, “Aku itu dalil dī po'onan tinanom, maka Mma'ku dalil a'a angayuput.

verses.name: John 15:2
verses.text: Sinagpe' e'na kamemon kasangahanku ya mbal amuwan buwa', maka nihawanan e'na kamemon kasangahanku taga-buwa' bo' paganap buwa'na.

verses.name: John 15:3
verses.text: Ka'am ilu sali' dalil sanga ati hawananna ka'am maka saga lapal pamandu'ku ka'am.

verses.name: John 15:4
verses.text: Subay kam pat'ttog ma aku ati pat'ttog aku ma ka'am, sabab in sanga mbal abuwa'an di-na, luwal bang dalos maka po'onanna. Damikiyanna ka'am ilu, mbal kam makahinang ahāp luwal bang aku ya paralosanbi kakkal.  <div eID="gen6343" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3108"/><div sID="gen6344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3108"/> “Aku itu dī po'onan tinanom, bo' ka'am ya dalil kasangahanku. Sai-sai kam pat'ttog ma aku, bo' aku isab pat'ttog ma iya, aheka buwa'na ma kaul maka pi'il. Sabab bang a'a ganta' autas min aku, halam aniya' tahinangna ahāp.

verses.name: John 15:6
verses.text: Sai-sai mbal pat'ttog ma aku, sali' iya dalil sanga asagpe', tinimanan maka alanosan di-na. Manjari saga sanga alanos itu tinimuk du bo' nilarukan ni deyom api tinunu'.

verses.name: John 15:7
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam pat'ttog ma aku, maka bang tau'bi pandu'ku ma deyom ataybi, nirūlan du kam e' Tuhan ma ai-ai amu'bi.

verses.name: John 15:8
verses.text: Bang kam amuwan buwa' paheka ma kaul maka pi'il, minahaldika' du Mma'ku, ati minnē' talhakit in ka'am mulidku sab'nnal-b'nnal.  <div eID="gen6344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3109"/><div sID="gen6345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3109"/> “Alasa aku ma ka'am buwat kalasa Mma'ku ma aku. Da'a kam pabutas min lasaku.

verses.name: John 15:10
verses.text: Bang beya'bi saga panoho'anku, mbal du kam abutas min lasaku. Buwat aku, beya'ku asal saga panoho'an Mma'ku ma aku ati mbal aku abutas min lasana.

verses.name: John 15:11
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu pah'llingku ma ka'am, supaya kam makahampit kakōran, halam aniya' kulangna.

verses.name: John 15:12
verses.text: Ya na itu panoho'anku ma ka'am, subay kam maglasa-liyasahi buwat paglasaku ma ka'am.

verses.name: John 15:13
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a lilla' amatay ma sabab lasana ma bagayna, mbal kaliyuhan lasa buwattē'.

verses.name: John 15:14
verses.text: Ka'am ilu, bagayku du kam bang hinangbi saga panoho'anku ma ka'am.

verses.name: John 15:15
verses.text: Mbal na kam ōnanku sosoho'an sabab sosoho'an itu mbal pinata'u bang ai na pa'in nihinang e' nakura'na. Saguwā' ka'am ilu bay na pata'uku pasal kamemon ya takaleku min Mma'ku, angkan kam ōnanku na saga bagayku.

verses.name: John 15:16
verses.text: Ngga'i ka ka'am ya bay amene' aku, sagō' aku ya bay amene' ka'am, maka bay angwakilan ka'am supaya aheka kahāpan tahinangbi, kahāpan mbal apinda, sapantun kayu magbuwa' paheka. Jari ai-ai pangamu'bi ni Tuhan ma sabab ōnku ya panabbutanbi, tantu kam nirūlan e'na.

verses.name: John 15:17
verses.text: Ya itu panoho'anku: maglasa-liyasahi kam.”  <div eID="gen6345" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6342" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3110"/><div sID="gen6346" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kinab'nsihan saga Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6347" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3110"/> Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Bang kam ganta' kinab'nsihan e' saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan, entomunbi aku. Ya du aku kinab'nsihan e' sigām dahū gi' min ka'am.

verses.name: John 15:19
verses.text: Bang bay kam dambeya'an maka saga a'a mbal angisbat e', bay du kam kinalasahan e' sigām pagka dambeya'an maka sigām. Sagō' saddī na kam. Bay kam pene'ku pinasaddī min saga a'a inān, angkan kam kinab'nsihan.

verses.name: John 15:20
verses.text: Entomunbi bay pah'llingku ma ka'am, ya yukku, ‘In banyaga' mbal alanga min nakura'na.’ Na, bang aku nakura'bi nila'at e' saga a'a inān, tantu isab ka'am nila'at du e' sigām. Bang sigām bay ameya' ma pamandu'ku, ameya' du isab sigām ma pamandu'bi.

verses.name: John 15:21
verses.text: Sagō' kinab'nsihan kam e' sigām maka nila'at ma sabab suku'ku kam. Tu'ud sigām halam makakilā ma Tuhan ya bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 15:22
verses.text: Bang bay halam aku pi'itu ni dunya amandu'an sigām, mbal sigām katōngan dusa. Saguwā' ma buwattina'an mbal na sigām makara'awa pasal saga dusa sigām.

verses.name: John 15:23
verses.text: Sai-sai ab'nsihan aku, ab'nsi isab iya Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 15:24
verses.text: Bang bay halam tahinangku ma pang'nda' sigām saga hinang ya mbal tahinang e' a'a saddī, halam du sigām bay katōngan dusa. Sagō' bay na ta'nda' e' sigām kahinanganku inān, malaingkan masi ab'nsihan aku maka Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 15:25
verses.text: Tantu du aku kinab'nsihan e' sigām bo' supaya atuman ya bay tasulat ma Kitab, ya yuk-i, ‘Kinab'nsihan aku e' sigām ma halam aniya' po'on sababna.’ ”  <div eID="gen6347" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3111"/><div sID="gen6348" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3111"/> Ah'lling gi' si Isa, yukna, “Pi'ilu du ni ka'am Pananabang, hatina Rū Tuhan ya luwas min haddarat Tuhan. Angahaka ya kasab'nnalan pasal Tuhan. Papi'ituku iya ni ka'am min Mma'ku. Jari pagmailu na iya anaksi' iya ma sababku.

verses.name: John 15:27
verses.text: In ka'am isab, anaksi' du isab ma sababku, sabab sehe'ku asal kam sangay min katagna'.”  <div eID="gen6348" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.15"/>

verses.name: John 16:1
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni saga mulidna, “Awalanku pangahakaku itu ma ka'am bo' supaya kam mbal ang'bba min pangandolbi ma aku.

verses.name: John 16:2
verses.text: Ka'am ilu song mbal tinugutan pasōd ni deyom langgal e' saga nakura' agama. Maka at'kka du waktu, bang aniya' a'a amapatay ka'am, ya pangannal sigām in hinang sigām maguyun maka kabaya'an Tuhan.

verses.name: John 16:3
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' hinang a'a ma ka'am sabab halam sigām bay makata'u pasalan Mma'ku atawa aku.

verses.name: John 16:4
verses.text: Haka'anta kam pasal itu supaya kam makaentom bang ta'abut waktu pamat'kka saga pakaradja'an itu. Nientom e'bi bay pangahakaku itu ma ka'am. Halam kam bay haka'anku dahū minnitu sabab masi aku bay ma ka'am.”  <div eID="gen6349" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6346" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3112"/><div sID="gen6350" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hinang Rū Sussi</title> <div sID="gen6351" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3112"/> “Sagō' buwattina'an tugila'ku na ni ka'am sabab song na aku pabalik pehē' ni bay amapi'itu aku, bo' pa'in halam aniya' min ka'am atilaw aku bang pi'ingga aku.

verses.name: John 16:6
verses.text: Makalandu' na kasusahanbi pagka kam kahaka'anku na.

verses.name: John 16:7
verses.text: Sagō' b'nnal sadja ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, aheya gi' kahāpan ma ka'am bang aku ala'an min ka'am. Sabab bang aku saupama bay mbal ala'an, mbal du pi'ilu ni ka'am ya Pananabang e'. Sagō' bang aku ala'an, papi'iluku du iya ni ka'am.

verses.name: John 16:8
verses.text: Pagpi'ilu pa'in Pananabang itu, amandu'an iya saga manusiya' ma dunya itu pasal dusa, maka pasal ka'adilan, maka pasal hukuman Tuhan.

verses.name: John 16:9
verses.text: Pinahati sigām e'na pasal dusa sigām pagga mbal magkahagad ma aku.

verses.name: John 16:10
verses.text: Pinahati isab sigām pasal ka'adilan, sabab in aku itu pehē' na ni Mma'ku ati mbal ta'nda'bi.

verses.name: John 16:11
verses.text: Pinahati du isab sigām pasal hukuman Tuhan, sabab tahukum na nakura' saitan, ya magagi ma babaw dunya itu.  <div eID="gen6351" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3113"/><div sID="gen6352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3113"/> “Aheka gi' pangahakaku ma ka'am,” yuk si Isa, “sagō' mbal ta'anggapbi buwattina'an.

verses.name: John 16:13
verses.text: Subay na at'kka pi'ilu in Rū Kasab'nnalan, bo' yampa kam bowana ata'u pasal kasab'nnalan kamemon. Mbal iya amandu' min pagnahu'-nahu'na, sagō' ai-ai takalena min Tuhan, ya na he' pamandu'na ma ka'am. Maka pinata'u kam e'na pasal pakaradja'an ya pat'kka ma sinosōng.

verses.name: John 16:14
verses.text: Pinagmahaldika'an isab aku, sabab kamemon ya pamata'u Rū Tuhan ma ka'am asal min aku.

verses.name: John 16:15
verses.text: Ai-ai palsuku'an Mma'ku, palsuku'anku du isab, angkan yukku ma ka'am, in kamemon pamata'u Rū Tuhan ma ka'am asal bay min aku.”  <div eID="gen6352" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6350" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3114"/><div sID="gen6353" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Karukka'an maka Kalasigan</title> <div sID="gen6354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3114"/> Yuk si Isa, “Mbal at'ggol, mbal na aku ta'nda'bi. Pagpuwas ina'an isab, mbal at'ggol ta'nda'bi du aku pabīng.”  <div eID="gen6354" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3115"/><div sID="gen6355" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3115"/> Magsuli-suli saga mulid si Isa kasehe'an, yuk sigām, “Ai bahā' hatina, ya yukna ‘mbal na at'ggol ati mbal na iya ta'nda'tam, maka puwas ina'an-i mbal at'ggol ati ta'nda'ta iya pabīng?’ Maka bay pah'llingna isab, ya yukna-i, ‘sabab pehē' na iya kono' ni Mma'na?’

verses.name: John 16:18
verses.text: Ai bahā' hatina ‘mbal na at'ggol?’ Hē! Mbal tahati!”  <div eID="gen6355" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3116"/><div sID="gen6356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3116"/> Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa in mulidna inān bilahi atilaw iya pasal bissalana. Angkan yukna ni sigām, “Bay yukku ma ka'am insini', ‘mbal at'ggol ati mbal aku ta'nda'bi, maka mbal du isab at'ggol ati ta'nda'bi du aku pabīng.’ Ya na itu bahā' pagtilaw-tilawanbi dangan maka dangan?

verses.name: John 16:20
verses.text: B'nnal sadja pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, ka'am ilu maglemong du maka magdukka, salta' pa'in kinōgan saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan. Taluwa' du kam kasusahan sagō' papinda du susabi ni kalasigan.

verses.name: John 16:21
verses.text: Ya dalilna buwat d'nda anganak. Asusa iya sasangna song anganak. Sagō' pagma-luwasan pa'in anakna, mbal na taentomna p'ddi' bay kalabayanna. Gom pa'in iya kinōgan sabab aniya' onde'-onde' palahil ni dunya.

verses.name: John 16:22
verses.text: Damikiyanna ma ka'am. Ma buwattina'an asusa kam, sagō' mag'nda' du kitam pabīng. Manjari magkōg-koyag du kam to'ongan ma halam aniya' makala'anan kōg-koyagbi inān.  <div eID="gen6356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3117"/><div sID="gen6357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3117"/> “Bang ta'abut llaw pag'nda'tam pabalik mbal aniya' panilawanbi aku. B'nnal pangahakaku itu ma ka'am, ai-ai amu'bi ni Mma'ku ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutanbi, tantu kam nirūlan e'na.

verses.name: John 16:24
verses.text: Dahū minnitu halam kam bay angamu' ai-ai ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutan. Angamu' na kam, ati nirūlan sadja kam bo' ajukup kakōganbi.”  <div eID="gen6357" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6353" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3118"/><div sID="gen6358" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tara'ug saga A'a Mbal Angisbat Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen6359" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3118"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Dahū, bay aku magparalilan, sagō' aniya' waktu mbal na aku magparalilan ma ka'am. Atampal sadja pamissalaku ma ka'am pasal Mma'ku.

verses.name: John 16:26
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in llaw ina'an-i, angamu' du kam ni Tuhan ma sabab ōnku ya pamanyabutanbi. Ngga'i ka na aku angamu'an ka'am ni Mma'ku,

verses.name: John 16:27
verses.text: sabab Mma'ku alasa asal ma ka'am. Kinalasahan kam e'na ma sabab aku ya kalasahanbi maka ma sabab pam'nnalbi in aku bay pi'itu min Tuhan.

verses.name: John 16:28
verses.text: Aho', bay aku pi'itu min Mma'ku Tuhan bo' pasampay ni dunya itu, ati ma buwattina'an ala'an na aku min dunya bo' pabīng pehē' ni Mma'ku.”  <div eID="gen6359" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3119"/><div sID="gen6360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3119"/> Yuk saga mulidna ni iya, “Buwattina'an ahangpat na pamissalanu, ngga'i ka bissala paralilan.

verses.name: John 16:30
verses.text: Kata'uwan kami na in ka'a makasakupan kamemon. Mbal na kagunahannu akale ma panilaw saga a'a sabab kata'uwannu asal deyom pikilan sigām. Angkanna kami am'nnal to'ongan in ka'a bay pi'itu min Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3120"/><div sID="gen6361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3120"/> Yuk si Isa ma sigām, “Magkahagad na kam bahā' buwattina'an?

verses.name: John 16:32
verses.text: Sōng na waktu, arai' na to'ongan, in ka'am ilu magkaukanat du. Maglahian du kam ni kaluma'anbi pakaniya-pakaniya ati bbahanbi du aku dangan-danganku. Sagō' ya b'nnalna, ngga'i ka aku dangan-danganku sabab pat'ttog du Mma'ku ma aku.

verses.name: John 16:33
verses.text: Haka'anta na kam pasal itu kamemon bo' supaya asannang deyom ataybi ma sabab kapameya'bi ma aku. Maitu ma dunya, bininasa du kam e' saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan, sagō' da'a kam tināw. Tara'ugku na sigām.”  <div eID="gen6361" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.16"/> <div eID="gen6358" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3121"/><div sID="gen6362" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu'-ngamu' si Isa Pasal Baranna</title> <div sID="gen6363" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3121"/> Akatis pa'in itu binissala e' si Isa, pahangad iya tudju ni sulga' anabbut ni Tuhan. “O Mma',” yukna, “ta'abut na waktu. Mahaldika'un aku, Anaknu, supaya aku makamahaldika' ka'a.

verses.name: John 17:2
verses.text: Bay aku kawakilannu magagi ma manusiya' kamemon bo' supaya buwananku kallum kakkal ni sasuku a'a ya pamasuku'nu aku.

verses.name: John 17:3
verses.text: Buwattitu hatulan kallum kakkal itu: sasuku ata'u ma ka'a in ka'a Tuhan tunggal sab'nnal-b'nnal, maka makata'u isab ma si Isa Al-Masi ya papi'itunu ni dunya, aniya' na kallumna kakkal ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: John 17:4
verses.text: Bay na patuwa'ku kabangsanu maitu ma dunya, sabab atalus na e'ku saga hinang bay pamahinangnu aku.

verses.name: John 17:5
verses.text: O Mma', mahaldika'un aku mailu ma pajātannu,<note>‘Pajātan’, hatina ‘haddarat’ atawa ‘matahan’.</note> buwat bay mahaldika'ku ma halam lagi' aniya' dunya pinapanjari.”  <div eID="gen6363" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6362" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3122"/><div sID="gen6364" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angamu'-ngamu' si Isa pasal Saga Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen6365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3122"/> “Bay na ka pata'uku ni saga a'a ya pamasuku'nu aku maitu ma dunya. Suku'nu asal sigām, ati pasuku'nu sigām ma aku. Tabeya' e' sigām lapal palmannu,

verses.name: John 17:7
verses.text: maka kinata'uwan e' sigām in kamemon pamuwannu aku, asal min ka'a.

verses.name: John 17:8
verses.text: Bay na pasampayku ni sigām lapal pamuwannu aku, maka tataima' na e' sigām. Kinata'uwan na e' sigām in aku sab'nnal-b'nnal deyo' bay min ka'a, maka magkahagad na sigām in ka'a bay amapi'itu aku.  <div eID="gen6365" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3123"/><div sID="gen6366" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3123"/> “O Mma', amu'anku junjung saga a'a itu. Ngga'i ka manusiya' kamemon ya amu'anku itu, luwal saga a'a ya pamasuku'nu aku, sabab suku'nu du isab.

verses.name: John 17:10
verses.text: Ma ka'a asal suku'ku kamemon, maka ma aku isab suku'nu kamemon. Talhakit isab kabangsaku ma sabab saga a'a ya suku'ku itu.

verses.name: John 17:11
verses.text: Na, marai' na aku pabalik pi'ilu ni ka'a. Sōng na bbahanku dunya itu, sagō' in sigām suku'ku itiya' masi ma dunya. O Mma'ku Sussi, hampanin sigām sabab min barakat ōnnu, ya ōn bay pamuwannu aku, bo' supaya sigām magdakayu' atay buwat kita.

verses.name: John 17:12
verses.text: T'ggolku masi maitu ma saga a'a ya pamasuku'nu aku, bay sigām hampananku min barakat ōnnu, ōn bay pamuwannu aku. Bay sigām tunggu'anku angkan halam aniya' min sigām bay amutawan min ka'a. Halam aniya' alungay min ka'a, luwal dakayu', ya ganta'anna pabutawan, ati minnē' atuman du pa'in in bay pinagba'at ma deyom Kitab.”  <div eID="gen6366" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3124"/><div sID="gen6367" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3124"/> Angamu'-ngamu' lagi' si Isa, yuk-i, “Na, Mma', marai' na aku pabalik pi'ilu ni ka'a. Angkan ko', t'ggolku masi ma dunya itu pamandu'ku na pa'in llingku itu bo' aheya kakōgan saga mulidku, luwas isab min kakōganku.

verses.name: John 17:14
verses.text: Bay na pasampayku palmannu ni sigām ati kinab'nsihan e' saga a'a ya mbal angisbat ka'a, sabab magsaddī sigām maka a'a he'. Pasali' sigām ni aku, sabab ya du aku halam aniya' lamudku ma saga a'a ya mbal angisbat ka'a ma dunya itu.

verses.name: John 17:15
verses.text: Mbal aku angamu' subay pala'annu saga a'a suku'ku min dunya. Ya amu'ku bang pa'in sigām hampanannu bo' mbal tapagagihan e' nakura' saitan, ya patila'atun.

verses.name: John 17:16
verses.text: Pasali' sigām ni aku, pagka ngga'i ka dunya itu ya lahat sigām luggiya'.

verses.name: John 17:17
verses.text: Pasaddīhun maka sussihun sigām supaya sigām ma ka'a sadja. Ya panussi sigām pandu'nu b'nnal, hatina palmannu.

verses.name: John 17:18
verses.text: Bay sigām soho'ku pehē' ni saga a'a ma dunya, buwat bay panoho'nu aku pi'itu ni deyom dunya.

verses.name: John 17:19
verses.text: Ma sabab sigām, ya angkan aku magpasuku' di-ku ma ka'a, supaya sigām suku'nu to'ongan.  <div eID="gen6367" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3125"/><div sID="gen6368" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3125"/> “Ngga'i ka hal saga mulidku ītu ya amu'anku,” yuk si Isa, “sagō' saga a'a kamemon ya song magkahagad ma aku ma sabab lapal sigām.

verses.name: John 17:21
verses.text: O Mma', angamu' aku junjung ni ka'a, bang pa'in sigām da'atay buwat kita, sabab pataptap na pa'in ka ma aku, maka pataptap isab aku ma ka'a. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in sigām pat'ttog ma kita, bang pa'in isab sigām magdakayu' atay kamemon supaya magkahagad saga a'a ma dunya in ka'a bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 17:22
verses.text: Bay sigām pabangsaku buwat bay pamabangsanu ma aku, supaya sigām magdakayu' atay buwat kita.

verses.name: John 17:23
verses.text: Hatina pataptap aku maina'an ma sigām buwat ka'a pataptap asal ma aku, bo' supaya sigām da'atay to'ongan. Jari minnē' kinata'uwan e' saga a'a ma dunya itu in ka'a bay amapi'itu aku, maka kinata'uwan isab in saga a'a magkahagad ma aku kalasahannu du buwat panglasanu ma aku.  <div eID="gen6368" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3126"/><div sID="gen6369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3126"/> “O Mma'! Bay pamasuku'nu aku saga a'a itu, ati kabaya'anku sigām subay parongan ma aku, bo' sigām maka'nda' sahaya ya pamuwannu aku. Sabab kalasahannu aku asal ma halam gi' aniya' dunya.

verses.name: John 17:25
verses.text: O Mma', a'adil ka. Mbal ka kinata'uwan e' saga a'a porol ma dunya itu, sagō' aku itu makata'uwan ka'a du. Maka saga a'a suku'ku itu, ata'u isab sigām in ka'a bay amapi'itu aku.

verses.name: John 17:26
verses.text: Bay na ka pata'uku ma sigām, maka pata'uku na pa'in bo' supaya sigām pahōpannu lasa tudju ni pagkahi sigām, buwat lasanu ma aku. Pata'uku isab sigām supaya aku pataptap ma deyom atay sigām.”  <div eID="gen6369" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.17"/> <div eID="gen6364" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3127"/><div sID="gen6370" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panaggaw ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.47-Matt.26.56">Matiyu 26:47-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.43-Mark.14.50">Markus 14:43-50</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.47-Luke.22.53">Lukas 22:47-53</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3127"/> Aubus pa'in e' si Isa angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan, ala'an iya maka saga mulidna tudju ni dambila' sapa' Kedron. Aniya' kabbun kayu jaitun maina'an ati pasōd disi Isa pehē'.  <div eID="gen6371" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3128"/><div sID="gen6372" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3128"/> Na, kinata'uwan e' si Judas bang pi'ingga ya papehē'an si Isa sabab araran iya maka saga mulidna bay magtimuk maina'an. Si Judas itu a'a song anōngan si Isa ni saga bantana.

verses.name: John 18:3
verses.text: Jari pina'an si Judas ni kabbun inān angamaliman damba'an sundalu bangsa Rōm maka saga bag'llal bay pinabeya'an iya e' saga imam alanga maka saga Parisi. Magtakos sigām maka aniya' suwariyan maka palita'an binowa e' sigām.

verses.name: John 18:4
verses.text: Kinata'uwan asal e' si Isa kamemon ya song makani-iya, angkan iya pasōng pasampang ni saga a'a inān. Yukna ni sigām, “Sai pihabi?”  <div eID="gen6372" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3129"/><div sID="gen6373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3129"/> Yuk sigām, “Piha kami si Isa a'a Nasaret.” <div eID="gen6373" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6374" type="paragraph"/> “Aku na ko' itu,” yuk si Isa. Si Judas, ya a'a anukbalan si Isa ni saga bantana, ina'an an'ngge maka saga a'a inān.

verses.name: John 18:6
verses.text: Pagpa'in si Isa, “Aku na ko' itu”, magtūy sigām pasuhut pahantak.

verses.name: John 18:7
verses.text: Jari atilaw si Isa pabalik, yukna, “Sai pihabi?” <div eID="gen6374" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6375" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung sigām, “Si Isa, a'a min Nasaret.”  <div eID="gen6375" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3130"/><div sID="gen6376" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3130"/> Jari ah'lling si Isa, yukna, “Bay na kam haka'anku, aku na ko'. Bang aku ya pihabi, na pasagarinbi saga sehe'ku itu amole'.”

verses.name: John 18:9
verses.text: Buwattitu pah'llingna bo' aniya' kamaksuran ma bay pangamu'-ngamu'na ni Mma'na Tuhan, ya yuk-i, “O Mma', halam aniya' pabutawan minsan dakayu' min saga a'a bay pamasuku'nu aku.”  <div eID="gen6376" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3131"/><div sID="gen6377" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3131"/> Magtakos asal si Simun Petros, jari niurusan e'na kalisna bo' lagutna sosoho'an Imam Muwallam inān. Ya tauwa' taingana kowan, autas magtūy. Ōn sosoho'an itu si Malkus.

verses.name: John 18:11
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni si Petros, “Pabalikun pakokosnu ni tagubanna. Akuhanku du kamemon kabinasahan ilu pamakadal ma aku e' Mma'ku.”  <div eID="gen6377" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3132"/><div sID="gen6378" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3132"/> Manjari sinaggaw si Isa e' saga sundalu maka nakura' sigām maka saga bag'llal Yahudi, ati niengkotan.

verses.name: John 18:13
verses.text: Binowa iya e' sigām pehē' ni si Annas dahū. Si Annas itu mato'a si Kayapas, Imam Muwallam ma tahun ina'an.

verses.name: John 18:14
verses.text: Bay angahūg gara' si Kayapas ma saga nakura' Yahudi, ya yukna ahāp lagi' bang dakayu' du a'a amatay pangangganti' saga a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen6378" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6370" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3133"/><div sID="gen6379" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamalilu si Petros Pasal si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.69-Matt.26.70">Matiyu 26:69-70</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.66-Mark.14.68">Markus 14:66-68</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.55-Luke.22.57">55-57</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6380" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3133"/> Na, paturul ma si Isa si Simun Petros maka mulid dakayu'.
