Mulid dakayu' itu magkata'u asal maka Imam Muwallam, angkan iya makabeya' ma si Isa sampay pasōd ni deyom halaman luma' Imam Muwallam he'.

verses.name: John 18:16
verses.text: Sagō' si Petros iya ta'bba ma luwasan lawang. Daipara paluwas pabīng mulid si Isa dakayu' he', bo' ama'id min d'nda anunggu'an lawang bang pa'in bowana si Petros pasōd.

verses.name: John 18:17
verses.text: Tinilaw si Petros e' d'nda ma lawang inān, yuk-i, “Bang aku mbal alaung, dakayu' mulid ka ma a'a itu.” <div eID="gen6380" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6381" type="paragraph"/> Amalilu magtūy si Petros. “Ē, ngga'i ka!” yukna.  <div eID="gen6381" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3134"/><div sID="gen6382" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3134"/> Na, ahaggut sangom inān, angkan saga sosoho'an maka saga bag'llal bay angandokot api, ati ina'an sigām magt'nggehan ma sakalibut api magdangkahan. Pina'an isab si Petros patimbul ni sigām.  <div eID="gen6382" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6379" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3135"/><div sID="gen6383" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Sinumariya e' Imam Muwallam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.59-Matt.26.66">Matiyu 26:59-66</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.55-Mark.14.64">Markus 14:55-64</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.66-Luke.22.71">Lukas 22:66-71</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6384" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3135"/> Manjari si Annas, ya bay Imam Muwallam, amariksa' si Isa ma pasal saga mulidna maka ma pasal pamandu'na.

verses.name: John 18:20
verses.text: Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bay aku amandu'an saga a'a kamemon ma mata mairan. Ai-ai pamandu'ku bay pah'llingku ma pagtimukan saga Yahudi, ma deyom kalanggal-langgalan maka ma langgal pagkulbanan. Halam aniya' bay pamandu'ku ma kalimbungan a'a.

verses.name: John 18:21
verses.text: Angay aku tilawnu? Tilawun saga a'a bay akale ma pamandu'ku. Tilawun sigām bang ai bay pamandu'ku. Kinata'uwan asal e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen6384" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3136"/><div sID="gen6385" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3136"/> Pagbissala pa'in itu e' si Isa, magtūy iya sinampak e' dakayu' jaga bay maina'an, ati yukna ni si Isa, “Halam bahā' aniya' addatnu anambungan Imam Muwallam buwattilu!”  <div eID="gen6385" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3137"/><div sID="gen6386" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3137"/> Sinambungan jaga inān e' si Isa, yukna, “Bang hati' asā' pah'llingku ma Imam Muwallam, haka'in saga a'a kamemon ma pagsara'an itu bang ai kasā'an llingku. Sagō' bang halam aniya' sā'na, angay aku sampaknu?”

verses.name: John 18:24
verses.text: Puwas e', ma masi niengkotan si Isa, tinandanan na iya e' si Annas pehē' ni si Kayapas, ya Imam Muwallam.  <div eID="gen6386" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6383" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3138"/><div sID="gen6387" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amalilu Pabīng si Petros</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.71-Matt.26.75">Matiyu 26:71-75</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.69-Mark.14.72">Markus 14:69-72</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.58-Luke.22.62">Lukas 22:58-62</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6388" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3138"/> Ina'an masi si Simun Petros an'ngge ma parangkahan. Tinilaw iya e' saga sehe'na magt'nggehan, yuk-i, “Ka'a, mulid ka bahā' ma a'a inān?” <div eID="gen6388" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6389" type="paragraph"/> Amalilu magtūy si Petros. “Ngga'i ka,” yukna.  <div eID="gen6389" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3139"/><div sID="gen6390" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3139"/> Ina'an isab dakayu' sosoho'an Imam Muwallam, sugsug ni a'a bay autas taingana e' si Petros. Yuk sosoho'an itu ni si Petros “Ngga'i ka ka'a bahā' bay ta'nda'ku ameya' ma a'a inān hinabuna ma kabbun?”  <div eID="gen6390" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3140"/><div sID="gen6391" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3140"/> Amalilu si Petros pabīng. “Ngga'i ka,” yukna. Magtūy angukku'uk manuk.  <div eID="gen6391" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6387" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3141"/><div sID="gen6392" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Binowa Paharap ma Gubnul Pilatu</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.1-Matt.27.2">Matiyu 27:1-2</reference>, <reference osisRef="Matt.27.11-Matt.27.14">Matiyu 27:11-14</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.1-Mark.15.5">Markus 15:1-5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.1-Luke.23.5">Lukas 23:1-5</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6393" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3141"/> Dai' llaw pa'in, pininda si Isa min luma' si Kayapas tudju ni astana' gubnul bangsa Rōm. Sagō' saga nakura' Yahudi halam bay pasōd ni deyom astana' sabab makabatal kono' bang sigām pasōd ni deyom luma' ngga'i ka luma' Yahudi, ati mbal sigām makajari palamud magjamu ma Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: John 18:29
verses.text: Angkan paluwas gubnul Pilatu ni sigām bo' atilaw, yukna, “Ai panuntutanbi a'a itu?”  <div eID="gen6393" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3142"/><div sID="gen6394" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3142"/> Yuk sambung sigām, “Mbal du bay tukbalan kami a'a itu ni ka'a bang halam aniya' dusana.”  <div eID="gen6394" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3143"/><div sID="gen6395" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3143"/> “Na,” yuk si Pilatu ni sigām, “ka'am na angahukum iya ma buwat kal'ngnganan sara'bi.” <div eID="gen6395" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6396" type="paragraph"/> Anambung saga Yahudi, yuk sigām, “Halam aniya' kapatut kami amat'nna' hukuman ni kamatay minsan ma sai.”

verses.name: John 18:32
verses.text: Buwattē' kahālanna bo' supaya magmaksud bay pah'lling si Isa dahū pasal buwattingga kamatayna.  <div eID="gen6396" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3144"/><div sID="gen6397" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3144"/> Pasōd si Pilatu ni deyom astana' pabīng ati soho'na si Isa binowa patampal ni iya. Yukna ni si Isa, “Ka'a ilu, sultan ka bahā' ma bangsa Yahudi?”  <div eID="gen6397" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3145"/><div sID="gen6398" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3145"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ya patilawnu itu, min paghona'-hona'nu bahā', atawa aniya' a'a saddī bay angahaka'an ka'a ma pasalanku?”  <div eID="gen6398" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3146"/><div sID="gen6399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3146"/> Anambung si Pilatu, yukna, “Oy! Pangannalnu aku itu Yahudi bahā'! Saga bangsanu du maka saga nakura' kaimamanbi ya bay anukbalan ka'a pi'itu ni aku. Angay, ai dusanu?”  <div eID="gen6399" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3147"/><div sID="gen6400" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3147"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Ya pagsultananku ngga'i ka maitu ma dunya. Abila bay maitu ma dunya, bay du angatu saga bebeya'anku bo' aku mbal tasaggaw e' saga nakura' Yahudi. Aho', ngga'i ka maitu pagsultananku.”  <div eID="gen6400" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3148"/><div sID="gen6401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3148"/> Jari tinilaw iya e' si Pilatu, yukna, “Bang buwattilu, sultan ka bahā'?” <div eID="gen6401" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6402" type="paragraph"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Ka'a ya ah'lling in aku sultan. Ya na itu sababanna angkan aku nianakan maka angkan aku pi'itu ni dunya, supaya aku makapamissala ma pasal kasab'nnalan. Sasuku ameya' ma kasab'nnalan akale du ma aku.”  <div eID="gen6402" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3149"/><div sID="gen6403" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3149"/> Yuk si Pilatu, “Ai bahā' in kasab'nnalan?” <div eID="gen6403" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6392" type="section"/> <div sID="gen6404" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Pinat'nna'an Hukuman ni Kamatay</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.15-Matt.27.31">Matiyu 27:15-31</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.6-Mark.15.20">Markus 15:6-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.13-Luke.23.25">Lukas 23:13-25</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6405" type="paragraph"/> Apuwas pa'in ina'an-i, paluwas si Pilatu pehē' ni saga Yahudi ati yukna ma sigām, “Halam aniya' tapihaku sababan pangahukumanku a'a itu.

verses.name: John 18:39
verses.text: Sagō' kahaba' waktu paghinang Hinang Paglakad, ya kabiyaksahanbi subay aniya' dakayu' pilisu paluwasku. Bilahi kam bahā' bang paluwasanku ka'am sultan bangsa Yahudi itu?”  <div eID="gen6405" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3150"/><div sID="gen6406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3150"/> Magpangolang saga a'a inān, yuk-i, “Da'a bang a'a ilu-i. Si Barabbas ya kabaya'an kami.” Na, mundu asal si Barabbas.  <div eID="gen6406" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.18"/>

verses.name: John 19:1
verses.text: Manjari itu magpanoho'an si Pilatu in si Isa subay niraplosan.

verses.name: John 19:2
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' bahan itingan tinabid e' saga sundalu, nihinang sali' luwa korona pamaporong kōk si Isa. Pinajubahan isab iya e' sigām maka juba taluk.

verses.name: John 19:3
verses.text: Patampal sigām ni iya magbalik-balik bo' magtunggīng. Yuk pagtunggīng sigām, “Mahaldika'! Mahaldika'! Sultan Yahudi!” Jari pinagsampak iya e' sigām ma baihu'na.  <div eID="gen6407" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3151"/><div sID="gen6408" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3151"/> Paluwas pabīng si Pilatu amissalahan saga a'a magtimukan inān, yukna, “Nda'unbi. Itiya' si Isa paluwasku ni ka'am bo' supaya kata'uwanbi halam aniya' tabākku sababanna pamat'nna'anku iya hukuman.”

verses.name: John 19:5
verses.text: Jari paluwas isab si Isa. Masi gi' bahan itingan paporong ma kōkna, maka masi gi' jubana taluk. Yuk si Pilatu ni saga a'a, “Nda'unbi. Ya na itu a'a!”  <div eID="gen6408" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3152"/><div sID="gen6409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3152"/> Pag'nda' pa'in saga imam alanga maka saga jaga langgal ma si Isa, magtūy sigām magpangolang, yuk-i, “Papatayun iya! Lansangun iya ni hāg!” <div eID="gen6409" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6410" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Pilatu ni sigām, “Baya'-baya'bi na! Ngā'unbi bo' ka'am na angalansang iya ni hāg. Sagō' bang ma aku, halam aniya' sababanna tabākku pamat'nna'an iya hukuman ni kamatay.”  <div eID="gen6410" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3153"/><div sID="gen6411" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3153"/> Yuk saga Yahudi inān ni iya, “Aniya' sara' kami, yukna, a'a ilu subay pinapatay sabab magpina'in iya in iya kono' Anak Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6411" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3154"/><div sID="gen6412" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3154"/> Makakale pa'in si Pilatu ma lling saga a'a itu, gom pa'in pasōng gawana.

verses.name: John 19:9
verses.text: Binowa e'na si Isa pasōd pabalik ni deyom astana' bo' tilawna, yukna, “Minningga ka?” Sagō' halam anambung si Isa.

verses.name: John 19:10
verses.text: Yuk si Pilatu ni iya, “Angay? Mbal aku sambungannu bahā'? Kalu mbal kata'uwannu aniya' kapatutku amaluhaya ka'a. Maka aniya' kapatutku angalansang ka'a ni hāg bo' ka pinapatay.”  <div eID="gen6412" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3155"/><div sID="gen6413" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3155"/> Anambung si Isa, yukna, “Bang ngga'i ka ya Tuhan amuwanan ka'a kapatut, halam aniya' kapatutnu amapatay aku. Angkanna a'a bay anukbalan aku ni ka'a aheya gi' dusana min dusanu.”  <div eID="gen6413" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3156"/><div sID="gen6414" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3156"/> Puwas e' amiha lawang si Pilatu pamaluhayana ma si Isa. Sagō' magpangolang na pa'in ba'anan Yahudi he', yuk sigām, “Bang ka'a amaluhaya a'a ilu, ngga'i na ka bagay Sultan Mahatinggi. Sai-sai magsultan-sultan di-na magbanta du maka Sultan Mahatinggi.”  <div eID="gen6414" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3157"/><div sID="gen6415" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3157"/> Pagkale pamissala saga a'a inān e' si Pilatu, binowa e'na si Isa paluwas. Ati aningkō' si Pilatu ma pangahukuman, ya ma halaman niōnan Halaman Batu. (Gabbata ōnna bang ma bahasa Hibrani.)

verses.name: John 19:14
verses.text: Llaw pagsakap jamu, ma Hinang Paglakad ko' inān, maka song ugtu llaw na. Jari pagtingkō' si Pilatu, yukna ni saga a'a, “Ilu na Sultanbi!”  <div eID="gen6415" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3158"/><div sID="gen6416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3158"/> Sagō' magpangolang sadja saga a'a inān, yuk sigām, “La'anin iya! La'anin! Lansangun iya ni hāg!” <div eID="gen6416" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6417" type="paragraph"/> Tinilaw sigām e' si Pilatu, yukna, “Papatayku bahā' sultanbi?” <div eID="gen6417" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6418" type="paragraph"/> Anambung saga imam alanga, yuk-i, “Halam aniya' sultan kami, luwal Sultan Mahatinggi ma Rōm!”  <div eID="gen6418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3159"/><div sID="gen6419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3159"/> Ya katapusanna, ni'nde'an si Isa e' si Pilatu pehē' ni kaimaman e', supaya iya pinalansang ni hāg pinapatay. <div eID="gen6419" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6404" type="section"/> <div sID="gen6420" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa nilansang ni hāg</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.32-Matt.27.44">Matiyu 27:32-44</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.21-Mark.15.32">Markus 15:21-32</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.26-Luke.23.43">Lukas 23:26-43</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6421" type="paragraph"/> Manjari binowa na si Isa e' saga sundalu.

verses.name: John 19:17
verses.text: Paluwas iya min da'ira maka e'na ananggung hāg ya song pangalansangan iya. Patudju iya ni lugal niōnan Peya'-peya' Kōk. (Golgota ōnna bang ma bahasa Hibrani.)

verses.name: John 19:18
verses.text: Pagmahē' pa'in, nilansang si Isa ni hāg e' saga sundalu ati pinat'ngge hāg e'. Aniya' isab duwangan l'lla nilansang ni hāg sigā min bihing si Isa karuwambila'.

verses.name: John 19:19
verses.text: Aniya' sulat pamata'u bay sinulat e' gubnul Pilatu, sinō' pinehē' ni diyata' hāg si Isa. Yuk sulat e', “SI ISA A'A NASARET, SULTAN BANGSA YAHUDI.”

verses.name: John 19:20
verses.text: Aheka a'a bay makabassa sulat itu sabab asekot ni Awrusalam lahat pamapatayan si Isa inān, maka sulat itu bay tasulat ma bahasa Hibrani maka ma bahasa Rōm maka ma bahasa Girīk.

verses.name: John 19:21
verses.text: Mbal bilahi saga imam alanga ma bay tasulat e' sultan, angkan yuk sigām pehē' ni si Pilatu, “Da'a sulatun ‘Sultan bangsa Yahudi.’ Sulatun, ‘A'a magpina'in in iya sultan Yahudi.’ ”  <div eID="gen6421" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3160"/><div sID="gen6422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3160"/> Anambung si Pilatu, yukna, “Bay na tasulat sulatku.”  <div eID="gen6422" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3161"/><div sID="gen6423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3161"/> Talansang pa'in si Isa ni hāg e' saga sundalu, ningā' e' sigām s'mmekna ati binahagi' mpat pamahagi' sigām dangan maka dangan. Aniya' gi' dakayu' badju' si Isa dalos hinanganna.

verses.name: John 19:24
verses.text: Magsuli-suli saga sundalu, yuk-i, “Da'a gese'ta badju' itu. Ahāp lagi' pagtokoranta bo' kata'uwanta bang sai kat'nna'anna.” Pagka buwattē' hinang saga sundalu inān aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6424"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6425"/>“Kapagbahagi'an s'mmekku e' saga a'a.<l eID="gen6425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6426"/>Kapagtokoran e' sigām badju'ku bang sai kat'nna'anna.”<l eID="gen6426" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6424"/>  <div eID="gen6423" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3162"/><div sID="gen6427" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3162"/> Na, ina' si Isa, maka danakan ina'na, maka si Mariyam h'nda si Klopas, maka si Mariyam min lahat Magdala, ina'an magt'nggehan ma bihing hāg bay pangalansangan si Isa.

verses.name: John 19:26
verses.text: Ta'nda' e' si Isa ina'na maka dakayu' mulidna ya kalasahanna an'ngge maina'an, ati yukna ni ina'na, “Ina', anaknu na mulid ilu.”

verses.name: John 19:27
verses.text: Yukna isab ni mulidna inān, “Ilu na ina'nu.” Angkanna, puwas min llaw ina'an, ina' si Isa bay binowa e' mulid inān paokom ma iya.  <div eID="gen6427" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6420" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3163"/><div sID="gen6428" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.45-Matt.27.56">Matiyu 27:45-56</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.33-Mark.15.41">Markus 15:33-41</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.44-Luke.23.49">Lukas 23:44-49</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3163"/> Manjari itu kinata'uwan e' si Isa ajukup na kamemon bay pamahinang ma iya. Sakali yukna, “Patay bohe' aku.” Buwattē' pah'llingna bo' aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: John 19:29
verses.text: Aniya' maina'an dakayu' poga-poga isihan binu al'ssom, angkan saga sundalu bay angal'ggoman l'ppus ni deyom binu he'. Pinasagnat e' sigām ni tōng kayu-kayu bo' yampa pina'abut pehē' ni bowa' si Isa.

verses.name: John 19:30
verses.text: Makas'ssop pa'in si Isa ma binu, yukna, “Atalus na hinangku.” Jari patoyok kōkna maka ab'kkat napasna.  <div eID="gen6429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3164"/><div sID="gen6430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3164"/> Na, pagka llaw Juma'at na, angamu' saga nakura' Yahudi pehē' ni si Pilatu, sinō' pinōngan tape' saga a'a t'llungan bay nilansang ni hāg inān, bo' supaya al'kkas amatay, jari tapareyo' min hāg ma halam gi' ta'abut llaw Sabtu'. Mbal bilahi saga nakura' bang patay inān paddas pinasagaran ma hāg sampay ma llaw Sabtu', sabab ya na llaw landu' ahalga' ma bogbog sigām.

verses.name: John 19:32
verses.text: Angkan pehē' saga sundalu amōngan tape' saga a'a duwangan bay nilansang ni hāg sambeya' maka si Isa, ubus tape' dangan bo' dangan.

verses.name: John 19:33
verses.text: Sagō' maka'abut pa'in sigām ni si Isa, ta'nda' e' sigām in iya amatay na asal, angkan halam kala'usan pinōngan tape'na.

verses.name: John 19:34
verses.text: Gom pa'in nihiyak kīdna maka budjak e' dakayu' sundalu inān ati paluwas magtūy laha' maka bohe'.

verses.name: John 19:35
verses.text: A'a bay makanyata' ya tahinang itu ma si Isa, sinulat e'na saga pakaradja'an itu supaya kam magkahagad isab. Kapangandolan panaksi' a'a anulat itu, maka kata'uwanna b'nnal asal bissalana.

verses.name: John 19:36
verses.text: Pat'kka buwattitu supaya aniya' kamaksuran ma bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Halam aniya' to'olangna apōng minsan dakayu'.”

verses.name: John 19:37
verses.text: Maka aniya' gi' ayat Kitab dakayu', ya yuk-i, “Ang'nda' du sigām ma a'a bay tahiyak e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen6430" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6428" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3165"/><div sID="gen6431" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagkubul ma si Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.27.57-Matt.27.61">Matiyu 27:57-61</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.15.42-Mark.15.47">Markus 15:42-47</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.23.50-Luke.23.56">Lukas 23:50-56</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6432" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3165"/> Puwas e' aniya' dakayu' a'a min lahat Arimati pehē' ni si Pilatu. Ōnna si Yusup, mulid si Isa bay maglimbung pasal kapagmulidna sabab tināw nila'at e' saga nakura' Yahudi. Pehē' si Yusup itu ni si Pilatu ama'id angā' mayat si Isa. Pinatugutan iya e' si Pilatu angkan iya pina'an amareyo' mayat si Isa min hāg.

verses.name: John 19:39
verses.text: Sehe'na si Nikudimas, ya bay pehē' ni si Isa waktu sangom. Si Nikudimas itu amowa saga limampū' kilu laksi', mira maka alos<note>‘Mira maka alos:’ ginis pahamut ya ginuna pangapul.</note>, pinaglamugay.

verses.name: John 19:40
verses.text: Manjari niā' mayat si Isa e' saga a'a duwangan itu bo' yampa sinaput e' sigā maka kuku pote' pinabeya'an laksi', buwat addat bangsa Yahudi bang amahilala' mayat.

verses.name: John 19:41
verses.text: Aniya' kabbun ma atag bay pamapatayan si Isa, maka aniya' ma deyom kabbun inān pangubulan baha'u bay kinehean ma deyom batu. Halam gi' aniya' bay takubul maina'an.

verses.name: John 19:42
verses.text: Jari itu, pagka song sangom Sabtu' na, kinubul mayat si Isa maina'an sabab asekot du pangubulan inān ni bay pamapatayan iya.  <div eID="gen6432" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.19"/> <div eID="gen6431" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3166"/><div sID="gen6433" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kubul Halam Maga'a</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.1-Matt.28.8">Matiyu 28:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.16.1-Mark.16.8">Markus 16:1-8</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.1-Luke.24.12">Lukas 24:1-12</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6434" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3166"/> Pagdai' llaw pa'in ma llaw Ahad, ma halam gi' apote' sobangan, pehē' ni kubul si Mariyam, d'nda min lahat Magdala. Ta'nda'na in batu panambol lowang kubul bay na nila'anan.

verses.name: John 20:2
verses.text: Sakali paragan iya pehē' angahaka'an si Simun Petros maka mulid dakayu', ya kinalasahan asal e' si Isa. Yuk si Mariyam ni sigā, “Halam na maina'an Panghū'tam. Aniya' bay angala'anan iya min deyom kubul maka mbal kata'uwan kami bang maingga pamat'nna'an sigām ma iya.”  <div eID="gen6434" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3167"/><div sID="gen6435" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3167"/> Manjari si Petros maka mulid dakayu' magdai'-dai' pehē' ni kubul.

verses.name: John 20:4
verses.text: Paragan sigā karuwangan sagō' al'kkas gi' mulid dakayu' min si Petros, ati makarahū iya at'kka ni kubul.

verses.name: John 20:5
verses.text: Pakuru' iya pasīb ni deyomna ati ta'nda'na saga saput maina'an, sagō' halam iya pasōd.

verses.name: John 20:6
verses.text: Jari at'kka na si Petros min buli'anna ati patūy pasōd ni deyom kubul. Ta'nda'na saput si Isa pat'nna'an di-na maina'an,

verses.name: John 20:7
verses.text: maka ta'nda'na turung-mukana palūn. Saddī kat'nna'anna, mbal magbeya' maka saput e'.

verses.name: John 20:8
verses.text: Ma katapusanna, pasōd na isab mulid dakayu', ya bay makarahū pina'an. Pag'nda'na saput, magtūy iya magkahagad na pasal si Isa.

verses.name: John 20:9
verses.text: (Aniya' asal bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab ma pasalan si Isa, in iya subay allum pabīng min kamatayna, sagō' halam gi' bay tahati lapal Kitab inān e' saga mulid e'.)

verses.name: John 20:10
verses.text: Manjari amole' na sigā karuwangan.  <div eID="gen6435" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6433" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3168"/><div sID="gen6436" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Panyata' Magbaran ni si Mariyam</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.9-Matt.28.10">Matiyu 28:9-10</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.16.9-Mark.16.11">Markus 16:9-11</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6437" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3168"/> Sagō' an'ngge-n'ngge na pa'in si Mariyam mahē' ma atag kubul e', maka e'na anangis. Hinabuna anangis, pakuru' iya pasīb ni deyom kubul.

verses.name: John 20:12
verses.text: Aniya' ta'nda'na duwa mala'ikat magjuba pote' aningkō' maina'an ma bay pamat'nna'an mayat si Isa, dangan min bay kōkna, dangan min bay tape'na.

verses.name: John 20:13
verses.text: Yuk saga mala'ikat itu ni iya, “Arung, angay ka angkan anangis?” <div eID="gen6437" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6438" type="paragraph"/> Anambung si Mariyam, yukna, “Sabab wa'i bay nila'anan e' sigām mayat Panghū'ku, maka mbal kata'uwanku bang pi'ingga ya pamat'nna'an sigām ma iya.”  <div eID="gen6438" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3169"/><div sID="gen6439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3169"/> Masi pa'in ah'lling si Mariyam, palingi' iya ati ta'nda'na si Isa an'ngge maina'an. Sagō' halam takilāna bang iya na si Isa.

verses.name: John 20:15
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Arung, angay ka anangis? Sai pihanu?” <div eID="gen6439" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6440" type="paragraph"/> Kinabā' e' si Mariyam in a'a inān tunggu' kabbun, angkan yukna ni iya, “Tuwan, bang ka'a bay amowa mayatna minnitu, haka'in aku bang maingga pamat'nna'annu iya bo' aku pehē' angā' iya pabīng.”  <div eID="gen6440" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3170"/><div sID="gen6441" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3170"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Mariyam.” <div eID="gen6441" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6442" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy iya paharap ni si Isa ati yukna ni iya ma buwat bahasa Hibrani, “Rabbuni!” Hatina ‘guru’.  <div eID="gen6442" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3171"/><div sID="gen6443" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3171"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Da'a aku balutin sabab halam gi' aku bay makapole' ni Mma'ku. Sagō' pehē' ka ni saga dauranakanku. Haka'in sigām in aku song amole' ni Mma'ku maka Tuhanku, hatina ni Mma' sigām maka Tuhan sigām.”

verses.name: John 20:18
verses.text: Jari si Mariyam, d'nda min Magdala, pehē' na angahaka'an saga mulid pasal kapang'nda'na ma Panghū' Isa maka pasal bay pah'lling si Isa ma iya.  <div eID="gen6443" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6436" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3172"/><div sID="gen6444" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpa'nda' si Isa ni Saga Mulidna</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.28.16-Matt.28.20">Matiyu 28:16-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.16.14-Mark.16.18">Markus 16:14-18</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.36-Luke.24.49">Lukas 24:36-49</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6445" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3172"/> Sangom Ahad pa'in, magtimuk na saga mulid si Isa ma deyom luma'. Saga lawangna bay sinularan pahogot sabab tināw sigām ma saga nakura' Yahudi. Sakali pina'an si Isa an'ngge ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām ati ah'lling ni sigām, yukna, “Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan atay.”

verses.name: John 20:20
verses.text: Manjari pa'nda'anna sigām saga limpa' ma tanganna maka ma kīdna. Akōd to'ongan saga mulidna inān pag'nda' sigām ma Panghū'.  <div eID="gen6445" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3173"/><div sID="gen6446" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3173"/> Ah'lling si Isa pabīng, yukna ma sigām, “Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan atay. Soho'ta kam pehē' ni dunya buwat bay kapanoho' e' Mma'ku ma aku.”

verses.name: John 20:22
verses.text: Puwas e' anganapas si Isa ma sigām maka e'na ah'lling, yukna, “Taima'unbi na Rū Sussi.

verses.name: John 20:23
verses.text: Bang ampunbi dusa a'a, niampun du dusa sigām e' Tuhan. Bang mbal ampunbi, mbal du isab niampun e' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6446" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6444" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3174"/><div sID="gen6447" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Tomas</title> <div sID="gen6448" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3174"/> Na, ma waktu katuwa' si Isa ni saga mulidna inān halam bay maina'an si Tomas. Si Tomas itu dakayu' mulid si Isa min kasangpū' maka duwa, ya niranglay K'mbal.

verses.name: John 20:25
verses.text: Manjari nihaka'an iya e' kasehe'an, yuk-i, “Bay ta'nda' kami in Panghū'.” <div eID="gen6448" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6449" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' yuk si Tomas, “Bang mbal tanyata'ku maka tasadsadku limpa' lansang ma pād tanganna, maka bang mbal tasadsadku bakat ma kīdna, mbal du aku magkahagad.”  <div eID="gen6449" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3175"/><div sID="gen6450" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3175"/> Palabay pa'in pitung'llaw minnē' magtimuk na pabalik saga mulid si Isa ma deyom luma', maka ina'an na isab si Tomas. Kasularan asal saga lawang e', sagō' pina'an sadja si Isa an'ngge ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām ati yukna, “Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kasannangan atay.”

verses.name: John 20:27
verses.text: Jari ah'lling iya ni si Tomas, yukna, “Nda'un tanganku itu. Abutun maka tōng tangannu. Pa'abutun tangannu pi'itu ni kīdku. Da'a na ka magduwa-ruwa. Magkahagad na ka to'ongan.”  <div eID="gen6450" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3176"/><div sID="gen6451" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3176"/> Ah'lling si Tomas, yukna, “Ya Panghū'ku maka Tuhanku!”  <div eID="gen6451" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3177"/><div sID="gen6452" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3177"/> Yuk si Isa ni iya, “Yampa ka magkahagad bahā', pagka ta'nda'nu na aku? Aheya kalasigan saga a'a magkahagad ma aku minsan aku halam ta'nda' e' sigām.”  <div eID="gen6452" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6447" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 20:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3178"/><div sID="gen6453" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Jūd itu Angkan Sinulat</title> <div sID="gen6454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3178"/> Aheka gi' saga hinang makainu-inu bay tahinang e' si Isa ma pang'nda' saga mulidna, saddī min saga hinang ya tasulat ma jūd itu.

verses.name: John 20:31
verses.text: Sagō' angkan sinulat saga kahinangan itu ma deyom jūd itu, bo' supaya pam'nnalanbi si Isa in iya b'nnal Al-Masi, Anak Tuhan, maka supaya kam kaniya'an kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan ma sabab pagkahagadbi ma iya.  <div eID="gen6454" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.20"/> <div eID="gen6453" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3179"/><div sID="gen6455" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpa'nda' si Isa ni Pitu' Mulidna</title> <div sID="gen6456" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3179"/> Puwas daka pilang'llaw minnē' magpa'nda' si Isa pabīng ni saga mulidna mahē' ma bihing danaw Tibiri. Buwattitu ya katuwa'na ni sigām:

verses.name: John 21:2
verses.text: Si Simun Petros bay maina'an magbeya' maka si Tomas ya niranglay K'mbal, maka si Natanael ya min kauman Kana ma lahat Jalil. Ina'an isab magbeya' saga anak si Sibidi, maka duwangan mulid si Isa saddī.

verses.name: John 21:3
verses.text: Na, ah'lling si Simun Petros, yukna. “Kaut gi' aku amokot.” <div eID="gen6456" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6457" type="paragraph"/> “Ameya' kami,” yuk kasehe'an e'. Jari paruwa' sigām ni bayanan bo' pauntas kaut, sagō' halam aniya' ta'ā' sigām sampay ni karai'-llawan.  <div eID="gen6457" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3180"/><div sID="gen6458" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3180"/> Baya-baya pa'in llaw, ina'an si Isa an'ngge ma bihing tampe sagō' halam iya takilā e' saga mulidna.

verses.name: John 21:5
verses.text: Angalingan iya pehē' ni sigām, yukna, “Owa' saga bagay, halam bahā' aniya' ta'ā'bi?” <div eID="gen6458" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6459" type="paragraph"/> “Halam,” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen6459" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3181"/><div sID="gen6460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3181"/> “Na,” yuk si Isa, “hūgunbi pokot min bihingbi kowan ilu ati maka'ā' kam.” Paghūg pa'in, mbal sigām makahella' pokot ma sabab kaheka daing.  <div eID="gen6460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3182"/><div sID="gen6461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3182"/> Manjari ah'lling dakayu' mulid ya kinalasahan e' si Isa. Yukna ni si Petros, “Panghū'ta ko' inān!” Makakale pa'in si Simun Petros itu, magtūy sulugna pabīng badju' bay urusanna, bo' pakuppa ni danaw tudju pehē' ni si Isa.

verses.name: John 21:8
verses.text: Saga mulid kasehe'an paturul min bayanan sigām, maka e' sigām angangguyud pokot ap'nno' e' daing. Asekot asal sigām ni bihing, aniya' saga limampū' d'ppa lawakna.

verses.name: John 21:9
verses.text: Makaruwa'i pa'in sigām ni bihing, aniya' ta'nda' e' sigām api maka saga daing patapa ma bagana, maka aniya' isab saga tinapay.  <div eID="gen6461" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3183"/><div sID="gen6462" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3183"/> Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Bowahunbi pi'itu saga daing min bay ta'ā'bi ilu.”  <div eID="gen6462" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3184"/><div sID="gen6463" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3184"/> Angkan pehē' si Simun Petros paruwa' pabīng ni bayanan sigām bo' guyudna pokot tudju kaleya. Ap'nno' pokot inān e' daing a'aslag, dahatus maka limampū' maka t'llu hekana. Sagō' pokot e' halam agese' minsan sōdna aheka makalandu'.

verses.name: John 21:12
verses.text: Yuk si Isa ni sigām, “Dai' kam amangan.” Halam aniya' ma saga mulidna inān makatawakkal atilaw iya bang sai iya, sabab kinata'uwan e' sigām in iya Panghū' sigām.

verses.name: John 21:13
verses.text: Jari pehē' si Isa angā' tinapay bo' pamuwanna ni sigām, damikiyanna saga daing.

verses.name: John 21:14
verses.text: Kamint'lluna na itu magpa'nda' si Isa ni saga mulidna damuli pa'in min llaw bay pamakallum iya min kamatay.  <div eID="gen6463" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6455" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3185"/><div sID="gen6464" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Petros</title> <div sID="gen6465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3185"/> Aubus pa'in e' sigām amangan, amissala si Isa ni si Simun Petros. “Simun anak si Yahiya,” yukna, “lasanu ni aku, alabi gi' bahā' min saga sehe'nu itu?” <div eID="gen6465" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6466" type="paragraph"/> “Aho' Panghū',” yuk si Petros, “kata'uwannu in aku alasa ma ka'a.” <div eID="gen6466" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6467" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa, “Na, upiksa'un saga bili-biliku.”

verses.name: John 21:16
verses.text: Atilaw si Isa pabīng, yukna, “Simun anak si Yahiya, kalasahannu aku bahā'?” <div eID="gen6467" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6468" type="paragraph"/> “Aho', Panghū',” yukna, “kata'uwannu du in aku alasa du ma ka'a.” <div eID="gen6468" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6469" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa, “Na, ipatun saga bili-biliku.”

verses.name: John 21:17
verses.text: Kamint'lluna na patilaw si Isa ma si Petros. “Simun anak si Yahiya,” yukna, “kalasahannu bahā' aku?” <div eID="gen6469" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6470" type="paragraph"/> Asusa na si Petros sabab pinamint'llu gi' e' si Isa patilawna ma iya, ya yukna, “Alasa ka bahā' ma aku.” Angkan anambung si Petros ma si Isa, yukna, “Panghū', kata'uwannu kamemon. Kata'uwannu in aku alasa du ma ka'a.” <div eID="gen6470" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6471" type="paragraph"/> Yuk si Isa ma iya, “Na, upiksa'un saga bili-biliku.

verses.name: John 21:18
verses.text: B'nnal ya pangahakaku itu ma ka'a,” yuk si Isa, “ma kabata'nu lagi' bay ka amas'mmekan di-nu. Bay ka lum'ngngan pi'ingga-pi'ingga kabaya'annu. Sagō' bang ka ato'a na pah'nnatnu du tangannu ati a'a saddī ya angengkotan ka'a bo' ka binowa ni papehē'an ya ngga'i ka kabaya'annu.”

verses.name: John 21:19
verses.text: Binissala itu e' si Isa pamata'una bang ai bowahan kamatay si Petros ma waktu sinōng, kamatay pangamahaldika'na ma Tuhan. Puwas e' yuk si Isa ma si Petros, “Ameya' sadja ka ma aku.”  <div eID="gen6471" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3186"/><div sID="gen6472" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3186"/> Jari palingi' si Petros ati ta'nda'na paturul ma iya mulid dakayu', ya kinalasahan e' si Isa. Ya na itu mulid bay pali'id ni si Isa ma waktu kapagjamu sigām, maka bay atilaw iya, ya yukna, “Tuwan Panghū', sai bahā' song anōngan ka'a ni saga bantanu?”

verses.name: John 21:21
verses.text: Pag'nda' si Petros ni mulid dakayu' itu, yukna ni si Isa, “Panghū', buwattingga a'a ina'an-i?”  <div eID="gen6472" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3187"/><div sID="gen6473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3187"/> Yuk si Isa ni si Petros, “Bang kabaya'anku a'a inān subay allum sampay ni kabīngku pi'itu, da'a na kasusahun. Ameya' sadja ka ma aku.”

verses.name: John 21:23
verses.text: Jari tinuhuma e' saga bebeya'an si Isa pasal mulidna dakayu' itu mbal magkamatay. Sagō' halam si Isa bay amissala in a'a inān mbal du amatay. Ya sadja yukna, bang saupama kabaya'anna mulidna inān subay allum sampay kabīngna ni dunya, ngga'i ka kasusahan si Petros.  <div eID="gen6473" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3188"/><div sID="gen6474" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3188"/> Ya mulid pinagsuli-suli itu, ya na a'a angahaka pasal saga pakaradja'an itu, maka iya isab bay anulat itu kamemon. Maka kata'uwan kami in hakana asal b'nnal.  <div eID="gen6474" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3189"/><div sID="gen6475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3189"/> Aheka to'ongan saga hinang saddī bay tahinang e' si Isa. Bang saga hinang itu ganta' tasulat kamemon ma saga kitab, kumpasku mbal s'ddong ma deyom dunya saga kitab ya panulatan iya. <signed sID="gen6476"/> Tammat<signed eID="gen6476"/>  <div eID="gen6475" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6464" type="section"/> <div eID="gen5981" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="John.21"/> <div eID="gen5973" osisID="John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3190"/><div sID="gen6485" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapa'angkat si Isa ni Sulga'</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Mark.16.19-Mark.16.20">Markus 16:19-20</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.24.50-Luke.24.53">Lukas 24:50-53-</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen6486" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3190"/> Sulat min si Lukas ni si Teyopilus. <div eID="gen6486" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6487" type="paragraph"/> Tuwan Teyopilus, ma sulat bay sulatanku ka'a dahū, bay pangahakaku saga hinang maka pandu' si Isa kamemon, sangay min tagna' kapaghinangna

verses.name: Acts 1:2
verses.text: sampay ni llaw bay pama'angkat iya tudju ni sulga'. Ma halam gi' iya bay pa'angkat, aniya' saga panoho'an pang'bba e'na ma saga a'a bay kawakilanna, labay min Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Acts 1:3
verses.text: Puwas pa'in kamatay si Isa, ma deyom mpatpū' llaw araran iya magpanyata' magbaran ni saga a'a bay kawakilanna. Min heka iya ama'nda'an di-na bo' mattan to'ongan in iya asal allum. Ta'nda' iya e' sigām ati ma deyom mpatpū' llaw he', amissala iya ni sigām pasal kapagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 1:4
verses.text: Aniya' isab waktu kapagsalu si Isa maka saga mulidna inān, pasalta' magpanoho'an iya ma sigām, yukna, “Da'a gi' kam ala'an min da'ira Awrusalam. Lagarinbi dahū paljanji'an Mma'ku ya pamuwanna ma ka'am, buwat bay pamata'uku ma ka'am.

verses.name: Acts 1:5
verses.text: Si Yahiya he', bohe' ya bay pamandina saga a'a. Sagō' saddī ya pamandi ka'am. Palabay daka pilang'llaw, pinahōpan du kam Rū Sussi.”  <div eID="gen6487" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3191"/><div sID="gen6488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3191"/> Manjari itu, magtimuk pa'in sigām maka si Isa, atilaw sigām ni iya. “Tuwan Panghū',” yuk sigām, “ya na itu bahā' waktu pamabīngnu ni bangsa kami Isra'il ya bay kapatut kami tagna' ang'ntanan pagparinta?”  <div eID="gen6488" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3192"/><div sID="gen6489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3192"/> Yuk sambung si Isa, “Mbal kam makata'u pasal ilu-i, sabab Mma'ku sadja ya taga-kapatut amat'nna' waktu maka masa.

verses.name: Acts 1:8
verses.text: Saguwā',” yuk si Isa, “kabuwanan du kam kawasa ma waktu kahōp Rū Sussi ni ka'am, ati magpasab'nnal kam ma pasalku ma da'ira Awrusalam itu, ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya, ma lahat Samariya, sampay ma mpat pidju alam.”  <div eID="gen6489" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3193"/><div sID="gen6490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3193"/> Aubus pa'in pamissala si Isa, tabowa iya pa'angkat ni sulga', ma sabu sigām magpang'nda'. Sakali kalimbuhan iya e' gabun, halam na ta'nda' e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 1:10
verses.text: Masi na pa'in sigām ang'nda' papatong ni langit hinabu si Isa pa'angkat, jari aniya' duwangan l'lla magpamakay pote' an'ngge ma atag sigām.

verses.name: Acts 1:11
verses.text: Yuk duwangan itu ni sigām, “Ka'am saga a'a Jalil! Angay kam magt'nggehan na pa'in papatong tudju ni langit? Si Isa, ya bay pina'angkat min ka'am tudju ni sulga', pabīng du, bo' kabīngna pi'itu magsali' maka buwat bay ka'angkatna, ya ta'nda'bi itu.”  <div eID="gen6490" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6485" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3194"/><div sID="gen6491" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Mattiyas Pinene' Paganti' min si Judas</title> <div sID="gen6492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3194"/> Sakali amole' na saga a'a kawakilan e' min būd Kayu Jaitun tudju ni Awrusalam, saga dakilometro lawakna.

verses.name: Acts 1:13
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in sigām ni Awrusalam, magtūy sigām pariyata' ni bilik paghanti'an. Ya maina'an disi Petros, si Yahiya, si Yakub, si Andariyas, si Pilip, si Tomas, si Bartolome, si Matiyu, si Yakub anak si Alpa, si Simun ya niranglay Pangangatu, maka si Judas dakayu' ya anak si Yakub.

verses.name: Acts 1:14
verses.text: Araran sigām magtipun angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan. Pabeya' isab ma sigām saga kar'ndahan, sampay si Mariyam ina' si Isa maka saga danakan si Isa l'lla.  <div eID="gen6492" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3195"/><div sID="gen6493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3195"/> Na mbal at'ggol minnē', magtipun saga a'a magpangandol ma si Isa. Aniya' sigām kulang-labi dahatus maka duwampū'. Manjari an'ngge si Petros ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām amissala.

verses.name: Acts 1:16
verses.text: “Saga dauranakanku,” yukna, “wajib subay aniya' kamaksuran ma lapal Rū Sussi, ya bay pinasulat ma si Da'ud ma pasal si Judas. Si Judas Iskariyut, ya na bay anuli'an saga a'a anaggaw si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 1:17
verses.text: Si Judas itu bay dansehe'an maka kitam. Bay iya kawakilan isab e' si Isa maghinang buwat hinangtam.”  <div eID="gen6493" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3196"/><div sID="gen6494" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3196"/> Ya sīn bay panamba si Judas ma hinangna ala'at, ya pamasaggawna si Isa ni saga bantana, bay pam'llina tana'. Tab'llina pa'in tana' he', ahūg iya pareyo' minna'an ati abustak b'ttongna. Paluwas tina'ina kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 1:19
verses.text: Kinata'uwan itu e' a'a kamemon ma Awrusalam, angkan tana' inān niōnan e' sigām Akeldama, ma buwat bahasa Yahudi, hatina ‘Tana' Tamba Laha'.’  <div eID="gen6494" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3197"/><div sID="gen6495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3197"/> “Na,” yuk si Petros, “aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab Jabul, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6496"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6497"/>‘Bang pa'in asiya-siya palahatanna.<l eID="gen6497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6498"/>Subay halam aniya' pat'nna' maina'an pabīng.’<l eID="gen6498" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6496"/> Maka aniya' isab ayat dakayu', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6499"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6500"/>‘Subay aniya' a'a saddī paganti' ma bay hinangna he'.’ ”<l eID="gen6500" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6499"/>  <div eID="gen6495" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3198"/><div sID="gen6501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3198"/> Amissala gi' si Petros, yukna, “Angkanna subay aniya' gin'llal saddī ameya' ma kitam anaksi' in Panghū' Isa allum na pabīng. Ya subay pinene' a'a bay sehe'tam ma waktu kapagbeya' Panghū' Isa maka kitam, min waktu bay kapamandi a'a e' si Yahiya sampay ni llaw ka'angkat si Isa min kitam tudju ni sulga'.”  <div eID="gen6501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3198"/><div sID="gen6501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3198"/> Amissala gi' si Petros, yukna, “Angkanna subay aniya' gin'llal saddī ameya' ma kitam anaksi' in Panghū' Isa allum na pabīng. Ya subay pinene' a'a bay sehe'tam ma waktu kapagbeya' Panghū' Isa maka kitam, min waktu bay kapamandi a'a e' si Yahiya sampay ni llaw ka'angkat si Isa min kitam tudju ni sulga'.”  <div eID="gen6501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3199"/><div sID="gen6502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3199"/> Sakali itu sinabbut e' sigām ōn duwangan l'lla pamene'an. Dakayu' inān si Yusup, ya niōnan si Barsabbas (atawa si Justus), maka dakayu' si Mattiyas.

verses.name: Acts 1:24
verses.text: Angamu'-ngamu' disi Petros ni Tuhan, yuk sigām, “O Tuhan, kata'uwannu bang ai ma deyom pikilan manusiya' kamemon. Pandu'in kami bang sai pene'nu ma duwangan itu

verses.name: Acts 1:25
verses.text: ganti' si Judas, bo' tahinangna hinang ya pamasuku'nu ma saga a'a kawakilan. Sabab hinang itu bay ni'bbahan e' si Judas, pagka wa'i na iya amole' ni lahatna kakkal.”

verses.name: Acts 1:26
verses.text: Puwas ina'an magko'ot-ko'ot na sigām ōn a'a pamene'an. Ya tako'ot inān ōn si Mattiyas, jari pinak'nnop iya ni kasangpū' maka ssa ya bay kawakilan si Isa inān.  <div eID="gen6502" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.1"/> <div eID="gen6491" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3200"/><div sID="gen6503" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapatulun Rū Sussi ma Llaw Pentekosta</title> <div sID="gen6504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3200"/> Ta'abut pa'in llaw paghinang Pentekosta, magtimuk saga a'a magpangandol ma si Isa kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 2:2
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du aniya' bahonos min langit, sali' baliyu alandos patumbuk. Magtūy tasōd kaluha'an luma' ya pagtingkō'an sigām inān.

verses.name: Acts 2:3
verses.text: Ati ta'nda' e' sigām sali' d'lla' api asaplag pat'nna' ma saga a'a inān pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Acts 2:4
verses.text: Manjari kamemon sigām inān kahōpan Rū Sussi ati anagna' sigām magbissala ma ginisan bahasa. Ai-ai pamuwan ma sigām min kawasa Rū Tuhan, ya na he' pamissala e' sigām.  <div eID="gen6504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3201"/><div sID="gen6505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3201"/> Na, aniya' bay pahanti' maina'an ma Awrusalam saga a'a bangsa Yahudi bay min kalahatan, a'a maga'agama.

verses.name: Acts 2:6
verses.text: Pagkale sigām ma hidjul min deyom luma' inān, magtūy aheka sigām patimuk pina'an. Ainu-inu isab sigām sabab takale sigām saga bebeya'an si Isa magbissala ma buwat bahasa sigām pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Acts 2:7
verses.text: Kinobla'an sigām kamemon, maka ainu-inu, angkan yuk sigām, “Daka ai takaletam itu! Ya magpamissala itu hal ba'anan a'a min lahat Jalil!

verses.name: Acts 2:8
verses.text: Angay sigām makabissala bahasatam luggiya', dangan maka dangan?

verses.name: Acts 2:9
verses.text: Kitam itu,” yuk sigām, “min kalahat-lahatan ko'. Aniya' itu min lahat Partiya, min Midiya, min Elam, aniya' min Mesopotami, min lahat Yahudiya itu, min Kappadoke, min Puntus maka min Asiya.

verses.name: Acts 2:10
verses.text: Aniya' isab kitam min Prigiya, min Pampiliya, min lahat Misil maka min kalahatan Libiya ya ma kasekotan lahat Kirini. Aniya' isab kitam min da'ira Rōm.

verses.name: Acts 2:11
verses.text: Aniya' kitam kasehe' bangsa Yahudi, maka aniya' kasehe' ngga'i ka Yahudi ya papinda na ni agama Yahudi. Aniya' isab min pū' Kerete maka min lahat Arab. Sagō' minsan kitam minningga lahat, takaletam saga a'a itu amissala ma bahasatam. Takaletam pasal hinang kawasa ya nihinang e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Acts 2:12
verses.text: Manjari ainu-inu saga a'a magtimukan inān kamemon, maka sali' asasaw. Atilaw na pa'in sigām dangan maka dangan, yuk-i, “Ai bahā' hatina itu?”  <div eID="gen6505" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3202"/><div sID="gen6506" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3202"/> Sagō' aniya' kasehe' angudju'-ngudju' ma saga bebeya'an si Isa inān. Yuk sigām, “Saga a'a itu nilango binu!”  <div eID="gen6506" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6503" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3203"/><div sID="gen6507" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagnasihat si Petros ma Katimukan A'a</title> <div sID="gen6508" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3203"/> Sagō' an'ngge si Petros maka sehe'na kasangpū' maka ssa, ati akosog e'na amissala ma saga a'a magtimukan inān. “Ka'am saga pagkahiku Yahudi,” yukna, “sampay ka'am maglahat ma da'ira Awrusalam itu! Pakale kam bo' kam pahatiku pasal pakaradja'an ya takalebi itu.

verses.name: Acts 2:15
verses.text: Pangannalbi marai' nilango saga a'a magpamissala itu, saguwā' ngga'i ka. Halam aniya' maglangohan bang yampa lisag siyam subu!

verses.name: Acts 2:16
verses.text: Ya ta'nda'bi ma buwattina'an, ya na ko' itu kamaksuran bay pinagkallam e' nabi Jowel ma masa awal e', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6509"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6510"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:17
verses.text: ‘Ya itu hinangku ma saga llaw damuli, yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen6510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6511"/>pahōpku Rū-ku ma manusiya' kamemon.<l eID="gen6511" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6512"/>Saga panubu'bi l'lla-d'nda amaluwas du lapalku,<l eID="gen6512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6513"/>saga l'lla abata' gi' maka'nda' du pakaradja'an halam gi' at'kka,<l eID="gen6513" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6514"/>makauppi isab saga matto'abi.<l eID="gen6514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6515"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:18
verses.text: Aho', yuk Tuhan, minsan saga ataku l'lla-d'nda,<l eID="gen6515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6516"/>pahōpanku du Rū-ku ma masa ina'an-i,<l eID="gen6516" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6517"/>ati sigām ya amaluwas palmanku.<l eID="gen6517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6518"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:19
verses.text: Hinangku isab hinang makainu-inu ma b'ttong langit,<l eID="gen6518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6519"/>maka saga paltanda'an ma babaw dunya.<l eID="gen6519" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6520"/>Pa'nda'ku laha' maka api maka humbu aheya.<l eID="gen6520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6521"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:20
verses.text: Mata llaw magdo'om-do'om du,<l eID="gen6521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6522"/>maka bulan apinda ni keyat, sali' luwa laha',<l eID="gen6522" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6523"/>Bang song at'kka llaw pangahukum e' Panghū'bi,<l eID="gen6523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6524"/>llawna aheya, llaw mahaldika'.<l eID="gen6524" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6525"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:21
verses.text: Jari sai-sai anabbut ma ōn Tuhan mikitabang,<l eID="gen6525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6526"/>lappasan du iya.’ ”<l eID="gen6526" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6509"/>  <div eID="gen6508" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3204"/><div sID="gen6527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3204"/> Yuk gi' si Petros, “Ka'am pagkahiku bangsa Isra'il, kalehunbi bissalaku itu. Si Isa, a'a Nasaret, bay pinatuman ma pang'nda'bi in iya bay sinoho' e' Tuhan. Sabab kabuwanan iya barakat angkan tahinangna saga hinang akawasa kainu-inuhan a'a, sampay saga paltanda'an. Kata'uwanbi asal, sabab maitu ma deyomanbi ya bay pangahinanganna saga hinang e'.

verses.name: Acts 2:23
verses.text: In kamatay si Isa itu kinata'uwan asal e' Tuhan ma halam gi' bay paniya'. Min niyatna maka maksudna angkan si Isa bay tinukbalan ni pang'ntananbi, ati ka'am ya bay amapatay iya pagka pasagaranbi a'a jahulaka' angalansang iya ni hāg.

verses.name: Acts 2:24
verses.text: Saguwā' pinakallum iya pabalik e' Tuhan. Pinaluhaya iya e' Tuhan min katiksa'an kamatay, sabab in iya mbal to'ongan kapagbaya'an e' kamatay.

verses.name: Acts 2:25
verses.text: Aniya' bay tasulat e' si Da'ud ma masa awal e' ma pasal si Isa Al-Masi itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6528"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6529"/>‘Ta'nda'ku Panghū'ku ma atagku sakahaba' waktu.<l eID="gen6529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6530"/>Itiya' iya ma bihingku kowan, mbal aku tajogjog,<l eID="gen6530" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6531"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:26
verses.text: angkan akōd deyom atayku, angkan aku magkalasigan.<l eID="gen6531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6532"/>Minsan amatay baranku aholat sadja aku ma iya,<l eID="gen6532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6533"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:27
verses.text: sabab mbal du aku bbahannu ma lahat saga magpatayan.<l eID="gen6533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6534"/>Aku ya sosoho'annu luggiya',<l eID="gen6534" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6535"/>mbal pasagarannu baranku angahalu' ma deyom paliyangan.<l eID="gen6535" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6536"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:28
verses.text: Katuli'annu aku lān ya amowa ni kallum kakkal.<l eID="gen6536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6537"/>Sinōd aku kōg-koyag ma sabab kamaitunu ma aku.’<l eID="gen6537" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6528"/>  <div eID="gen6527" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3205"/><div sID="gen6538" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3205"/> “Na, saga dauranakanku,” yuk si Petros, “patampalku pamissalaku ni ka'am pasal bay ka'mbo'-mbo'antam si Da'ud e'. Bay iya amatay sampay kinubul, maka kubulna masi takilā sampay ni llaw itu.

verses.name: Acts 2:30
verses.text: Sagō' in iya nabi, angkan kinata'uwan e'na bang ai bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma iya. Bay anapa isab Tuhan ma si Da'ud ma pasal waktu sinōng. Subay aniya' dakayu' panubu'na magsultan.

verses.name: Acts 2:31
verses.text: Na, pagka kinata'uwan e' si Da'ud bang ai pinat'kka e' Tuhan ma waktu sinōng, bay iya angallam pasal kallum Al-Masi pabīng min kamatayna. Yuk pangallamna he', ‘Halam iya bay ni'bbahan ma lahat saga magpatayan. Halam isab bay angahalu' baranna ma deyom paliyangan.’

verses.name: Acts 2:32
verses.text: Si Isa ko' inān,” yuk si Petros, “ya bay pinakallum e' Tuhan pabīng. Ati kami kamemon itu saksi' du, in kallumna pabalik asal b'nnal.

verses.name: Acts 2:33
verses.text: Pinabangsa na iya, pinatingkō' ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan, ati tasambut e'na min Mma'na in Rū Sussi ya bay panganjanji'. Jari pinabeya' Rū itu e' si Isa bo' pahōp ni kami, angkan saga kahinangan ya ta'nda' maka takalebi buwattina'an.

verses.name: Acts 2:34
verses.text: Ngga'i ka si Da'ud ya bay pa'angkat ni sulga', sagō' buwattitu pamissalana, yuk-i <lg sID="gen6539"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6540"/>‘Bay ah'lling Tuhan ni Panghū'ku, yukna,<l eID="gen6540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6541"/>Dai' ka aningkō' ma bihingku kowan,<l eID="gen6541" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6542"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:35
verses.text: sampay bowaku palbantahannu tatau' ma deyo' pād-tape'nu.’<l eID="gen6542" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6539"/>  <div eID="gen6538" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3206"/><div sID="gen6543" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3206"/> “Angkanna,” yuk si Petros, “in ka'am bangsa Isra'il kamemon, subay kata'uwanbi in si Isa itu, ya bay palansangbi ni hāg, gin'llal na e' Tuhan, in iya Panghū' maka Al-Masi, ya pinene' e' Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen6543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3207"/><div sID="gen6544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3207"/> Pagkale saga a'a ma pamissala si Petros itu magtūy alengog sidda pikilan sigām. Yuk sigām ni si Petros maka ni kasehe'an kawakilan e', “Saga dauranakan, ai subay hinang kami?”  <div eID="gen6544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3208"/><div sID="gen6545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3208"/> Yuk sambung si Petros, “Taikutinbi to'ongan dusabi. Ati ka'am dangan maka dangan subay pinandi min ōn si Isa Al-Masi, palsaksi'an in ka'am angandol na ma iya. Manjari niampun du dusabi maka pinaniya'an du kam Rū Sussi, ya pamuwan Tuhan ma ka'am.

verses.name: Acts 2:39
verses.text: Sabab ya ilu janji'na ma ka'am maka saga panubu'bi, sampay isab sigām min katāhan, sai-sai tapene' e' Panghū'tam Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6545" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3209"/><div sID="gen6546" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3209"/> Aheka gi' bissala si Petros ma saga a'a inān. Binanda'an sigām e'na, niebot-ebotan pahāp, yukna, “Anabang kam di-bi bo' kam papuwas min saga a'a ya maghinang kalumu'an ma buwattina'an!”

verses.name: Acts 2:41
verses.text: Manjari aheka am'nnal ma bissala si Petros inān ati pinandi sigām tanda' in sigām suku' si Isa na. Ma llaw inān, aniya' saga t'llungibu heka a'a pinak'nnop ni saga a'a magpangandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen6546" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6507" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3210"/><div sID="gen6547" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagdakayu' Atay saga Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3210"/> Amogbog sigām ma bay pamandu' e' saga a'a kawakilan si Isa, maka magdakayu' sigām maka saga a'a kasehe' ya magpangandol. Magbahagi' sigām tinapay maka magbeya' angarap ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 2:43
verses.text: Aheka hinang makainu-inu maka paltanda'an bay tahinang e' saga a'a kawakilan itu, angkan sinōd tāw saga a'a kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 2:44
verses.text: Magdakayu' na pa'in saga a'a magpangandol kamemon, maka magbahagi'-biyahagi'i.

verses.name: Acts 2:45
verses.text: Pinab'llian ginisan pangalta' sigām ati b'llihanna pamahagi' ni kasehe'an sasuku taga-sukkal.

verses.name: Acts 2:46
verses.text: Llaw-llaw sigām magsabu ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Magsalu sigām ma kaluma'an sigām. Akōd isab magbahagi' kinakan min atay pote'.

verses.name: Acts 2:47
verses.text: Ananglit na pa'in sigām ma Tuhan, ati kasulutan a'a kamemon ma sigām. Sakahaba' llaw aniya' na pa'in a'a pinak'nnop ni sigām e' Panghū', sasuku kalappasan min hukuman dusa.  <div eID="gen6548" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.2"/> <div eID="gen6547" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3211"/><div sID="gen6549" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Aku'il Kauli'an e' si Petros</title> <div sID="gen6550" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3211"/> Manjari dakayu' llaw, pehē' si Petros maka si Yahiya ni langgal pagkulbanan ma waktu sambahayang luhul.

verses.name: Acts 3:2
verses.text: Maina'an ma atag lawang langgal niōnan Lawang Alingkat, aniya' dakayu' a'a mbal makal'ngngan min deyom kandang ina'na gi'. Binowa iya llaw-llaw ni atag bowa' lawang inān supaya iya makapangamu' sarakka ni saga a'a maglabayan minna'an tudju ni deyom langgal.

verses.name: Acts 3:3
verses.text: Pag'nda'na ma si Petros maka ma si Yahiya ina'an song pasōd, magtūy iya angamu' sīn ni sigā.

verses.name: Acts 3:4
verses.text: Pinatongan iya e' sigā, jari yuk si Petros, “Ang'nda' ka ni kami!”

verses.name: Acts 3:5
verses.text: Magtūy ang'nda' a'a inān, aholat kabuwanan ai-ai e' sigā.  <div eID="gen6550" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3212"/><div sID="gen6551" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3212"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Petros ma iya, yukna, “Halam to'ongan aniya' alta'ku sagō' ya pamuwanku ma ka'a bang ai aniya' ma aku. Min kawasa ōn si Isa Al-Masi a'a Nasaret, soho'ta ka pal'ngngan!”

verses.name: Acts 3:7
verses.text: Ati binalutan iya e' si Petros ma tanganna kowan, tinabang bo' makat'ngge. Saru'un-du'un du iya kabuwanan kosog ma tape'na sampay ma buku-bukuna.

verses.name: Acts 3:8
verses.text: Magtūy iya an'ngge bo' yampa lum'ngngan. Puwas e' magbeya' iya maka disi Petros pasōd ni deyom langgal. Pal'ngngan iya maka e'na maglaksu sampay ananglit ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 3:9
verses.text: Ta'nda' iya e' saga a'a magtimuk maina'an, pal'ngngan maka ananglit na pa'in ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 3:10
verses.text: Takilā iya e' sigām in iya bay aningkō' angamu' sarakka ma langgal ma bowa' lawang ya pinagōnan Lawang Alingkat. Magtūy sigām kinobla'an maka ainu-inu ma bay tahinang ma a'a inān.  <div eID="gen6551" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6549" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3213"/><div sID="gen6552" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magnasihat si Petros ma Deyom Langgal</title> <div sID="gen6553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3213"/> Amalut lagi' a'a inān ma si Petros maka si Yahiya maina'an ma saurung langgal ya niōnan Saurung si Sulayman. Angkan ainu-inu saga a'a kamemon ati paragan sigām pina'an ni disi Petros.

verses.name: Acts 3:12
verses.text: Pag'nda' pa'in si Petros ma saga a'a inān, amissala iya, yukna, “Oy, ka'am a'a Isra'il! Angay itu kainu-inuhanbi! Angay kami patonganbi? Pangannalbi bahā' min kawasa kami atawa min kasussi atay kami, ya angkan a'a itu makal'ngngan na?

verses.name: Acts 3:13
verses.text: Tuhan ya pagtuhanan si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub, sampay ka'mbo'-mbo'antam, bay amabangsa sosoho'anna si Isa. Sagō' t'kkahanbi iya ni sara' bo' pinapatay ati sulakbi iya ma matahan gubnul Pilatu, minsan iya anganiyat amaluhaya si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 3:14
verses.text: Asussi si Isa maka a'adil, saguwā' bay taikutanbi. Ya bay amu'bi pinaluwas e' gubnul a'a pamomono'.

verses.name: Acts 3:15
verses.text: Bay iya papataybi, ya po'onan kallum, sagō' pinakallum iya pabīng e' Tuhan. Kami itu saksi' in ina'an b'nnal.

verses.name: Acts 3:16
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Petros, “min kawasa ōn si Isa, angkan a'a bay aku'il itu kabuwanan kosog bo' makal'ngngan na. Ta'nda'bi na iya, maka takilābi asal. Aho', min pangandolna ma ōn si Isa, angkan iya kauli'an ma pang'nda'bi.  <div eID="gen6553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3214"/><div sID="gen6554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3214"/> “Saga dauranakanku,” yuk si Petros, “kata'uwanku in ka'am maka saga nakura'bi bay a'awam, angkan bay hinangbi buwattē' ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 3:18
verses.text: Saguwā' ya na he' katumanan pagkallam Tuhan, ya bay pinata'u e' kanabi-nabihan min awal gi' he'. Pinata'u e' sigām in Al-Masi subay makalabay kabinasahan.

verses.name: Acts 3:19
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Petros, “taikutinbi na dusabi. Papinda kam ni Tuhan bo' pinapasan e'na dusabi, ati bo' kam pinaniya'an kahayangan atay e' Panghū'.

verses.name: Acts 3:20
verses.text: Jari pinapi'itu du si Isa, ya Al-Masi bay tapene' e' Tuhan magbaya' ma ka'am.

verses.name: Acts 3:21
verses.text: Sagō' subay maina'an gi' iya ma sulga' sampay ta'abut waktu pamahāp Tuhan ma kamemon ai-ai, buwat bay janji'na labay min kanabi-nabihan ma masa awal.

verses.name: Acts 3:22
verses.text: Sabab si Musa bay angallam ma bangsa Isra'il, yukna, ‘Ma sinosōng aniya' du dakayu' nabi buwat aku pinaniya'an ka'am e' Panghū'bi Tuhan. A'a bangsabi iya. Wajib iya subay kalebi ma ai-ai pamissalana ma ka'am.

verses.name: Acts 3:23
verses.text: Sai-sai mbal akale ma nabi inān, pinaokat du iya e' Tuhan min bangsa suku'na sampay minula.’  <div eID="gen6554" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3215"/><div sID="gen6555" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3215"/> “Buwattē' na pa'in pangallam saga nabi kamemon, tinagna'an min si Samwel pasal pakaradja'an ya paniya' ma waktu itu.

verses.name: Acts 3:25
verses.text: Manjari ka'am ya makasambut kahāpan min kanabi-nabihan, maka ka'am ya pinasuku'an paljanji'an Tuhan ya bay panganjanji'na ma ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi. Bay anganjanji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, ‘Kamemon saga bangsa ma dunya itu pinaniya'an kahāpan ma sabab panubu'nu.’

verses.name: Acts 3:26
verses.text: Angkan tapene' e' Tuhan sosoho'anna si Isa, ati pinapi'itu iya ni ka'am dahū bo' kam pinaniya'an kahāpan pagka kam binowa e'na ang'bba min kahinanganbi ala'at.”  <div eID="gen6555" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.3"/> <div eID="gen6552" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3216"/><div sID="gen6556" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinatampal disi Petros ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum</title> <div sID="gen6557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3216"/> Masi gi' si Petros maka si Yahiya amissala ma saga a'a, aniya' pina'an ni sigā saga imam maka kapitan jaga langgal pagkulbanan, maka saga Saddusi.<note>Saddusi: umpigan agama Yahudi ya am'nnal halam aniya' allum pabīng ma llaw damuli.</note>

verses.name: Acts 4:2
verses.text: Landu' asasaw pikilan sigām sabab ina'an disi Petros amandu'an saga a'a in si Isa allum pabalik min kamatayna.

verses.name: Acts 4:3
verses.text: Manjari sinaggaw disi Petros. Kinalabusu<note>Kinalabusu: atawa nijīl.</note> sigā sampay ni llaw dakayu' sabab abay-kohap na.

verses.name: Acts 4:4
verses.text: Sagō' aheka a'a bay akale ma bissala disi Petros bo' am'nnal ma si Isa. Ya heka sigām angandol inān saga limangibu bang l'lla sadja ya ni'itung.  <div eID="gen6557" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3217"/><div sID="gen6558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3217"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', magtimuk ma Awrusalam saga kanakura'an bangsa Yahudi, saga pagmatto'ahan, maka saga guru sara' agama.

verses.name: Acts 4:6
verses.text: Ina'an isab maina'an si Annas Imam Muwallam, maka disi Kayapas, si Yahiya, si Iskandar, maka saga kampung si Annas kasehe'.

verses.name: Acts 4:7
verses.text: Manjari duwangan a'a kawakilan e' sinō' pa'alop ni sigām. Tinilaw sigā e' saga nakura' inān, yuk-i, “Kawasa ai bay pangahinangbi saga kahinanganbi di'ilaw e'? Atawa ōn sai bay panabbutanbi?”  <div eID="gen6558" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3218"/><div sID="gen6559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3218"/> Manjari si Petros inān pinahōpan Rū Sussi, ati kasambunganna saga nakura' inān, yukna, “Ka'am saga nakura' bangsa Yahudi, maka ka'am saga pagmatto'ahan ilu,

verses.name: Acts 4:9
verses.text: bang ya panumariyahanbi kami pasal kahāpan bay tahinang ma a'a aku'il itu, maka pasal bang buwattingga bay kapamauli' ma iya,

verses.name: Acts 4:10
verses.text: na, ya itu subay tōp kata'uwanbi. Pata'u kam maka kamemon saga bangsa Isra'il. Ya a'a an'ngge ma dahuanbi itu, angkan iya kauli'an na sabab kawasa si Isa Al-Masi a'a Nasaret! Bay iya palansangbi ni hāg, sagō' pinakallum iya min kamatayna e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 4:11
verses.text: Si Isa itu bay kinallam ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6560"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6561"/>‘Ya batu bay sinulak e'bi saga a'a maghinang luma',<l eID="gen6561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6562"/>ya na ina'an batu tapene' pamapagon luma'.’<l eID="gen6562" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6560"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:12
verses.text: Halam to'ongan aniya' saddī min si Isa ma kaluha'an dunya itu makalappas kitam min mulka'. Luwal ōn si Isa bay pamuwan e' Tuhan panabbutan manusiya', bo' supaya kitam lappasan.”  <div eID="gen6559" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3219"/><div sID="gen6563" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3219"/> Sakali ainu-inu saga kanakura'an inān pag'nda' sigām ma kaesog si Petros maka si Yahiya amissala. Kinata'uwan isab in sigā karuwangan itu a'a areyo' asal, halam bay makalabay pangadji' alanga. Manjari kinilā sigā pahāp e' kanakura'an he', in sigā magbeya' maka si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 4:14
verses.text: Malaingkan halam aniya' panganjawab e' saga nakura', sabab ina'an ma pang'nda' sigām a'a bay kauli'an e', an'ngge ma atag disi Petros.

verses.name: Acts 4:15
verses.text: Angkan sigām magpanoho'an pinaluwas disi Petros minnē' bo' sigām magisun.

verses.name: Acts 4:16
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Ai bahā' subay hinangtam ma saga a'a itu? Mbal kitam makapalilu pasal bay tahinang e' sigā, sabab kinata'uwan e' a'a kamemon ma da'ira Awrusalam itu aniya' hinang landu' akawasa bay tahinang e' sigā duwangan itu.

verses.name: Acts 4:17
verses.text: Sagō',” yuk sigām, “sanggupantam sigā supaya mbal patanyag palkala' itu. Banda'antam subay da'a amissala pabīng min ōn si Isa.”  <div eID="gen6563" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3220"/><div sID="gen6564" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3220"/> Angkan pinalinganan pabalik si Petros maka si Yahiya e' saga nakura' inān. Binanda'an sigā subay da'a to'ongan amissala atawa amandu' min ōn si Isa minsan pandu' ai.

verses.name: Acts 4:19
verses.text: Sagō' anambung si Petros maka si Yahiya yuk-i, “Kumpasunbi kono' bang ingga ya abontol ma pang'nda' Tuhan: ka'am manusiya' ya patut bineya', atawa iya?

verses.name: Acts 4:20
verses.text: Sabab mbal kami makajari pahali angahaka'an saga a'a pasal bay ta'nda' kami maka bay takale kami he'.”  <div eID="gen6564" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3221"/><div sID="gen6565" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3221"/> Gom pa'in pinakosog e' saga nakura' inān ya sanggup sigām ma disi Petros bo' yampa sigā pinaluhaya. Halam aniya' sababan paminasa saga nakura' inān ma disi Petros, sabab ina'an kamemon saga a'a ananglitan Tuhan ma sabab hinang kawasahan bay tahinang e'.

verses.name: Acts 4:22
verses.text: Na, ya a'a bay kauli'an ku'ilna labi mpatpū' tahun umulna.  <div eID="gen6565" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6556" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3222"/><div sID="gen6566" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angamu'-ngamu' Saga A'a Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6567" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3222"/> Na, tapaluwas pa'in disi Petros, magtūy sigā pabīng ni kasehe'an sigā angahaka pasal kamemon bay pah'lling saga kaimaman alanga maka saga pagmatto'ahan.

verses.name: Acts 4:24
verses.text: Takale pa'in ina'an-i e' sigām, magtūy sigām magbeya' angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan. “O Panghū' Sangat Kawasa,” yuk sigām, “ka'a ya bay amapanjari langit maka dunya, tahik maka kabohe'an, sampay binangsa kamemon ma deyomna.

verses.name: Acts 4:25
verses.text: Bay pabissalanu sosoho'annu si Da'ud, pangkat kami, ati angallam iya deyo' bay min Rū Sussi, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6568"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6569"/>‘Angay angkan magpananggup saga kabangsa-bangsahan?<l eID="gen6569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6570"/>Angay sigām magkagara'an ma halam aniya' pūsna?<l eID="gen6570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6571"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:26
verses.text: Magdakayu' saga kasultanan bo' magsakap,<l eID="gen6571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6572"/>Magtipun saga kanakura'an angatu ma Panghū',<l eID="gen6572" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6573"/>maka ma Al-Masi ya tapene'na magbaya'!’<l eID="gen6573" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6568"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:27
verses.text: B'nnal pangallam e',” yuk pangamu'-ngamu' sigām. “sabab bay magtipun ma da'ira itu saga a'a Yahudi maka a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, sultan Herod maka gubnul Puntus Pilatu. Maggara' sigām anguntara ma si Isa, sosoho'annu sussi ya bay g'llalnu Al-Masi.

verses.name: Acts 4:28
verses.text: Jari tahinang e' sigām ya bay niyatnu min awal lagi', luwas min kawasanu maka kahandaknu.

verses.name: Acts 4:29
verses.text: Na, Panghū', kalehun sanggup sigām ma kami. Tabangin kami saga sosoho'annu, bo' kami mbal tināw amissala lapalnu.

verses.name: Acts 4:30
verses.text: Paluwasun kosog kawasanu amauli' saga a'a sakihan. Pahinangun hinang makainu-inu maka paltanda'an min kawasa ōn si Isa, ya sosoho'annu sussi.”  <div eID="gen6567" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3223"/><div sID="gen6574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3223"/> Na, aubus pa'in pangamu'-ngamu' sigām inān, ajogjog luma' ya pagtipunan sigām ati pinahōpan sigām Rū Sussi. Minnē' sigām amissala lapal Tuhan, halam to'ongan aniya' tāw sigām ma a'a.  <div eID="gen6574" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6566" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:32
