verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3224"/><div sID="gen6575" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magbahagi' Sama-sama saga Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6576" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3224"/> Manjari itu magda'atay maka magdakayu' kagara'an kamemon magpangandol ma si Isa inān. Halam aniya' ah'lling in kaniya'na ina'an suku'na sadja, sagō' sama-bahagi' sigām kamemon ma ai-ai sigām.

verses.name: Acts 4:33
verses.text: Saga a'a kawakilan inān magabut-abut anaksi' pasal kallum Panghū' Isa pabīng min kamatayna. Jari akawasa to'ongan panaksi' sigām, ati landu' sigām kinahāpan e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 4:34
verses.text: Halam aniya' ma deyoman sigām kakulang-kabusan. Bang aniya' waktu pamab'lli sigām tana' atawa luma',

verses.name: Acts 4:35
verses.text: ni'nde'an b'llihanna ni saga a'a kawakilan inān. Jari in sīn inān bay pinagbahagi'an ma sasuku taga-kasusahan.  <div eID="gen6576" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3225"/><div sID="gen6577" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3225"/> Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' panubu' si Libi niōnan si Yusup. Bangsa Yahudi asal iya, a'a min pū' Kiprus. Ya pangōn saga a'a kawakilan ma iya, ‘Barnabas’, (hatina a'a amat'ttog iman).

verses.name: Acts 4:37
verses.text: Aniya' bay tana' si Barnabas itu, jari pab'llihanna. Ati b'llihanna ni'nde'an e'na ni saga a'a kawakilan inān.  <div eID="gen6577" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.4"/> <div eID="gen6575" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3226"/><div sID="gen6578" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ananiyas maka si Sappira</title> <div sID="gen6579" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3226"/> Na aniya' inān dakayu' a'a niōnan si Ananiyas, h'ndana si Sappira. Aniya' tana'na bay pab'llihanna,

verses.name: Acts 5:2
verses.text: sagō' in b'llihanna kasehe' bay tatau'na. Niuyunan isab itu e' h'ndana, jari ya sīn bay takapin min b'llihan e' bay ni'nde'an ni saga a'a kawakilan.  <div eID="gen6579" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3227"/><div sID="gen6580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3227"/> Yuk si Petros ma iya, “Ananiyas, angay pasagarannu nakura' saitan pahōp ma deyom pangatayannu, amowa-mowa ka'a amutingan Rū Sussi? Sabab ilu bay tau'nu sīn kasehe'an bay b'llihan tana'nu he'.

verses.name: Acts 5:4
verses.text: Ma halam lagi' bay pab'llihannu, suku'nu asal tana' inān. Maka minsan bay kapab'llihanna, suku'nu du b'llihanna inān paggunabi. Jari angay tapikilnu maghinang buwattilu? Ngga'i ka manusiya' ya pagputingannu ilu, sagō' Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen6580" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3228"/><div sID="gen6581" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3228"/> Pagkale pa'in si Ananiyas ma lling itu, magtūy iya pahantak amatay. Jari sasuku makakale ma pasal kamatayna inān sinōd tāw sidda.

verses.name: Acts 5:6
verses.text: Sakali pasōd pina'an saga kal'llahan abata' gi' anaput mayatna bo' yampa binowa paluwas minnē', kinubul.  <div eID="gen6581" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3229"/><div sID="gen6582" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3229"/> Na, palabay pa'in saga t'llunjām, at'kka pina'an h'nda si Ananiyas, sagō' halam kinata'uwan e'na bang ai bay tum'kka he'.

verses.name: Acts 5:8
verses.text: Yuk si Petros ma iya, “Haka'in aku. Ya na bahā' itu sīn kamemon bay ta'ā'bi maglakibini min b'llihan tana'bi?” <div eID="gen6582" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6583" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk d'nda, “ya na ko' ilu.”  <div eID="gen6583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3230"/><div sID="gen6584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3230"/> Yuk si Petros, “Angay kam maglakibini bay maggara' anulayan Rū Panghū'! Nda'un, ilu na ma bowa' lawang saga a'a bay angubul h'llanu insini'. Maka ya du ka'a binowa du isab e' sigām.”

verses.name: Acts 5:10
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du pahantak d'nda inān ma atag tape' si Petros, amatay. Pagsōd pa'in saga kal'llahan abata' e', ta'nda' iya e' sigām amatay na ati binowa iya kinubul ma bihing h'llana.

verses.name: Acts 5:11
verses.text: Minnē' sidda tināw saga jama'a si Isa kamemon sampay sasuku bay makakale ma pasal ina'an-i.  <div eID="gen6584" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6578" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3231"/><div sID="gen6585" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aheka Saki Kauli'an e' saga A'a Kawakilan</title> <div sID="gen6586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3231"/> Aheka saga paltanda'an maka hinang makainu-inu bay tahinang ma deyoman saga a'a Awrusalam inān e' saga a'a kawakilan. Jari sasuku magpangandol ma si Isa araran magtipunan kamemon ma Saurung si Sulayman.

verses.name: Acts 5:13
verses.text: Halam aniya' a'a saddī makatawakkal palamud ni sigām, minsan aheya pagaddat saga a'a kamemon ma sigām.

verses.name: Acts 5:14
verses.text: Sagō' paganap na pa'in bo' paganap saga a'a l'lla-d'nda angandol ma Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Acts 5:15
verses.text: Ya kaluwasanna, binowa saga a'a sakihan paluwas min luma' ni kalān-lānan bo' pinalege ma kantil atawa ma tepo supaya taluwa' lambung si Petros bang iya ganta' palabay minna'an.

verses.name: Acts 5:16
verses.text: Aheka isab saga a'a bay pina'an min saga kauman ma sakalingkal Awrusalam, amowa sehe' sigām sasuku magsakihan atawa a'a sinōd saitan. Jari kauli'an sigām kamemon.  <div eID="gen6586" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6585" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3232"/><div sID="gen6587" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pininjala' Saga A'a Kawakilan si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3232"/> Pagubus, angimbū Imam Muwallam maka ba'anan pagkahina Saddusi ma saga a'a kawakilan.

verses.name: Acts 5:18
verses.text: Jari pinasaggaw e' sigām saga kawakilan e' bo' kinalabusu.

verses.name: Acts 5:19
verses.text: Sagō' ma sangom inān aniya' mala'ikat min Tuhan bay pina'an angukab tambol kalabusu, amowa saga a'a kawakilan inān paluwas.

verses.name: Acts 5:20
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat ni sigām, “Pehē' kam an'ngge ma halaman langgal pagkulbanan amandu'an saga a'a pasal kallum baha'u itu, bang ai hatulanna.”  <div eID="gen6588" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3233"/><div sID="gen6589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3233"/> Jari pagdai'-llaw dakayu', pehē' na sigām ni halaman langgal buwat bay panoho'an mala'ikat e', ati anagna' sigām amandu'an saga a'a. <div eID="gen6589" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6590" type="paragraph"/> At'kka pa'in pina'an Imam Muwallam maka saga sehe'na, pinatimuk e' sigām Tumpukan Maghuhukum bo' magsakaum kamemon saga pagmatto'ahan bangsa Isra'il. Pagubus, sinō' saga nakura' jaga pehē' ni kalabusu bo' pina'alop saga a'a kawakilan ni Maghuhukum e'.

verses.name: Acts 5:22
verses.text: Sagō' pagt'kka saga jaga itu ni kalabusu, halam maina'an saga a'a kawakilan. Jari pabīng ni Maghuhukum angahaka.

verses.name: Acts 5:23
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Pagt'kka kami ni kalabusu, masi ahogot saga tambol lawangna. Maka ina'an isab saga sundalu jaga masi an'ngge ma luwasan lawang kalabusu e'. Sagō' pagukab kami, halam aniya' tabāk kami ma deyom!”

verses.name: Acts 5:24
verses.text: Na, takale pa'in haka inān e' nakura' jaga langgal sampay e' kaimaman alanga, asasaw pamikil sigām bang ai kat'kkahan saga pakaradja'an itu.  <div eID="gen6590" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3234"/><div sID="gen6591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3234"/> Sakali aniya' a'a at'kka pina'an amowa haka, yukna, “Pakale kam! Ya a'a bay pakalabusubi, ina'an na ma deyom langgal amandu'an saga a'a!”

verses.name: Acts 5:26
verses.text: Magtūy pehē' nakura' jaga maka saga a'ana angā' disi Petros. Sagō' halam sigām makapissoko' disi Petros sabab tināw sigām binantung maka batu e' ba'anan a'a maina'an.  <div eID="gen6591" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3235"/><div sID="gen6592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3235"/> Binowa saga a'a kawakilan itu e' sigām pinatampal ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum, jari sinumariya sigām e' Imam Muwallam.

verses.name: Acts 5:28
verses.text: Yuk-i, “Bay na kam sanggupan kami to'ongan sinō' da'a amandu' pasal a'a ya pameya'anbi ilu. Sagō' nda'unbi na ya kahinanganbi itu! Asaplag deyom Awrusalam ma sabab pamandu'bi. Tu'ud kam magniyat amatanggung dusa ni kami ma pasal kamatay a'a inān!”  <div eID="gen6592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3236"/><div sID="gen6593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3236"/> Anambung si Petros maka kasehe'an bay kawakilan e', yuk sigām, “Panoho'an Tuhan ya subay beya' kami, ngga'i ka panoho'an manusiya'.

verses.name: Acts 5:30
verses.text: Si Isa inān,” yuk sigām, “bay soho'bi nilansang ni hāg bo' pinapatay. Sagō' bay iya pinakallum pabīng e' Tuhan, ya asal pagtuhanan saga pangkattam.

verses.name: Acts 5:31
verses.text: Tapabangsa na iya e' Tuhan, pinat'nna' ma bihingna tampal ni kowan bo' magnakura' sampay Manglalappas ma manusiya', bo' supaya aniya' pagtaubatan maka ka'ampunan dusa ma bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Acts 5:32
verses.text: Kami itu,” yuk disi Petros, “anaksi' in pakaradja'an pamissalaku itu b'nnal sadja. Ya du Rū Sussi, ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma sasuku ameya' ma panoho'anna.”  <div eID="gen6593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3237"/><div sID="gen6594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3237"/> Pagkale pa'in lling itu e' ma Tumpukan, apasu' to'ongan atay sigām ati maggara' sigām amapatay saga a'a kawakilan inān.

verses.name: Acts 5:34
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' maina'an dakayu' Parisi niōnan si Gamaliyal, a'a pagguruhan sara' agama. A'a iya pinagaddatan e' kamemon. Na an'ngge si Gamaliyal itu ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum bo' soho'na pinaluwas dai'-dai' saga a'a sinumariya he'.

verses.name: Acts 5:35
verses.text: Yuk si Gamaliyal, “Ka'am pagkahiku bangsa Isra'il, kamaya'-maya' kam ma ai-ai song hinangbi ma saga a'a ma luwasan itu.

verses.name: Acts 5:36
verses.text: Entomunbi bay palabay he', aniya' bay niōnan si Tiyudas magheya-heya di-na. Aniya' isab saga mpat hatus a'a bay paumpig ma iya. Sagō' ya kamattihanna, pinapatay si Tiyudas ati akaukanat saga tendogna. Ya ina'an katobtobanna.

verses.name: Acts 5:37
verses.text: Puwas min si Tiyudas, aniya' isab pasunu' dakayu' a'a Jalil, ōnna si Judas, ma timpu pagsulat ōn a'a kamemon e' parinta. Aheka isab saga a'a bay tabowana ameya' ma iya, sagō' ya du iya bay pinapatay maka akaukanat isab tendogna kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 5:38
verses.text: Angkan kam banda'anku na ma pasal palkala' itu. Da'a inayunbi saga a'a itu. Pasagarinbi sadja na sigām. Sabab bang hal min pikilan manusiya' ya minaksud maka nihinang e' sigām itu, halam du aniya' kasōnganna.

verses.name: Acts 5:39
verses.text: Sagō' bang min Tuhan, mbal tapaggatbi. Gōm pa'in sagga'bi na kabaya'an Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen6594" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3238"/><div sID="gen6595" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3238"/> Manjari bineya' e' saga a'a inān pamissala si Gamaliyal. Nilinganan e' sigām saga a'a kawakilan inān pinasōd bo' yampa sinō' niraplosan. Binanda'an sigām da'a amandu' pabalik min ōn si Isa, ati pinaluwas sigām.  <div eID="gen6595" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3239"/><div sID="gen6596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3239"/> Sagō' ala'an pa'in saga a'a kawakilan min Tumpukan e', makalandu' akōd sigām sabab tabista sigām e' Tuhan tōp pinalabay min kabinasahan ma sabab pangandol sigām ma ōn si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 5:42
verses.text: Sakahaba' llaw ina'an sigām ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan sampay ma saga kaluma'an, magpandu' na pa'in maka magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa in iya Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen6596" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.5"/> <div eID="gen6587" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3240"/><div sID="gen6597" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pitu' A'a Pinene' Anabang</title> <div sID="gen6598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3240"/> Ma waktu inān magheheka na pa'in saga a'a bebeya'an si Isa. Jari aniya' palkala' ma sigām: saga Yahudi ya amissala bahasa Girīk magsagga' maka saga Yahudi porol ma lahat Yahudiya. Ya makala'at atay saga Yahudi amissala Girīk inān, in kar'ndahan sigām balu takalipat kono' ma waktu kapagbahagi' balanja' kahaba' llaw.

verses.name: Acts 6:2
verses.text: Angkan saga bebeya'an si Isa kamemon sinō' pinatimpuk e' sangpū' maka duwa a'a kawakilan ati ah'lling ni sigām. Yuk-i, “Mbal taluwa' bang kami ang'bbahan hinang kami magnasihat palman Tuhan, ati bo' amahagi' saga balanja'.

verses.name: Acts 6:3
verses.text: Angkanna, saga dauranakan, subay kam amene' pitu' l'lla min deyomanbi ilu, a'a kahōpan e' Rū Sussi, maka taga-pangita'u alalom. Bang tapene'bi na, patanggung kami ni sigām ya hinang amahagi' balanja' itu.

verses.name: Acts 6:4
verses.text: Manjari kami itu,” yuk a'a kawakilan e', “amanuyu' na pa'in angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan maka anganasihat palmanna.”  <div eID="gen6598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3241"/><div sID="gen6599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3241"/> Na, kasulutan a'a inān kamemon ma bay kagara'an e', ati tapene' e' sigām si Esteban, a'a bal-iman maka kahōpan e' Rū Tuhan. Tapene' isab si Pilip, si Prokoros, si Nikanur, si Timun, si Parmenas, maka si Nikulas min Antiyuk. Si Nikulas itu ngga'i ka Yahudi, a'a ya bay apinda ni agama Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 6:6
verses.text: Ya kapitu' a'a itu bay binowa patampal ni saga a'a kawakilan bo' niamu'an tabang min Tuhan. Pinat'ppakan isab sigām tangan, tanda' in sigām pinasuku'an hinang inān.  <div eID="gen6599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3242"/><div sID="gen6600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3242"/> Manjari pasaplag na pa'in palman Tuhan. Pak'nnop to'ongan heka saga a'a ameya' ma si Isa ma deyom Awrusalam, maka aheka isab kaimaman ameya' angandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen6600" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6597" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3243"/><div sID="gen6601" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Esteban Sinaggaw</title> <div sID="gen6602" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3243"/> Si Esteban inān a'a sidda tinabang e' Tuhan, a'a binarakatan, angkan aheka hinang makainu-inu maka paltanda'an bay tahinang e'na ma deyoman saga a'a ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 6:9
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' saga a'a anagga' iya, jama'a min dakayu' langgal niōnan Langgal A'a Aluhaya. Saga a'a inān asal min da'ira Kirini maka min da'ira Iskandari. Jari magbeya' sigām maka saga Yahudi kasehe' min lahat Silisi maka min lahat Asiya isab, ati amowa magjawab ma si Esteban.

verses.name: Acts 6:10
verses.text: Daipara saga a'a inān mbal maka'atu ma bissala si Esteban ma sabab pangita'u ya asal pamuwan ma iya e' Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6602" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3244"/><div sID="gen6603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3244"/> Sakali aniya' a'a saddī tinambahan e' saga anagga' inān. Binidjakan sigām, sinō' angahaka puting pasal si Esteban. Ya yuk puting sigām, “Bay takale kami a'a itu amūng-mūng pangkal ma si Musa maka ma Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6603" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3245"/><div sID="gen6604" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3245"/> Minnē' aniya' sasaw ma kaheka'an a'a inān maka ma saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga guru sara' agama. Angkan sigām pina'an anaggaw si Esteban, ati tinandanan iya ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum.

verses.name: Acts 6:13
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga a'a binidjakan e' sigām magsaksi' puting ma pasal si Esteban. Yuk saksi' he', “A'a itu mbal pahali amissala kala'atan pasal langgaltam sussi itu, maka pasal sara' agamatam.

verses.name: Acts 6:14
verses.text: Bay iya takale kami ah'lling in si Isa, a'a Nasaret e', song angalangkat langgal itu. Maka pinindahan kono' e'na pangaddatan kamemon bay pang'bba kitam e' si Musa.”  <div eID="gen6604" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3246"/><div sID="gen6605" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3246"/> Manjari pinatongan si Esteban e' saga a'a aningkō' ma Paghuhukum e', ati tanda' e' sigām pamaihu'an si Esteban angaluwa pamaihu'an mala'ikat.  <div eID="gen6605" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.6"/> <div eID="gen6601" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3247"/><div sID="gen6606" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala si Esteban ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum</title> <div sID="gen6607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3247"/> Manjari tinilaw si Esteban e' Imam Muwallam, yukna, “B'nnal bahā' ya panuntut e' saga a'a itu?”  <div eID="gen6607" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3248"/><div sID="gen6608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3248"/> Anambung si Esteban, yukna, “Saga matto'a-danakanku, pakale kam. Ya Tuhan Sanglit-sahaya bay patuwa' ni pangkattam si Ibrahim, waktu kapaglahatna ma Mesopotami. Halam gi' iya bay maglahat ma Haran ma waktu ina'an-i.

verses.name: Acts 7:3
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan ni iya, ‘Ala'an ka min lahatnu porol ilu maka min kaheka'annu. Pehē' ka tudju ni lahat dakayu', ya pa'nda'anku ni ka'a ma sinosōng.’  <div eID="gen6608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3249"/><div sID="gen6609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3249"/> “Angkan bay maglain si Ibrahim min lahat Kaldeya tudju ni lahat Haran maglahat maina'an. Amatay pa'in mma'na, pinapi'itu iya e' Tuhan ni lahat ya paglahatantam itu buwattina'an.

verses.name: Acts 7:5
verses.text: Sagō' halam gi' iya bay kabuwanan tana' e' Tuhan palsuku'anna ma lahat itu, minsan la'a hal tana' sarang pagi'ikan tape'na. Sagō' nijanji'an iya e' Tuhan, in iya sampay panubu'na pinasuku'an du lahat itu. Bo' ma waktu bay panganjanji' Tuhan e', bay halam gi' aniya' tubu' si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Acts 7:6
verses.text: Buwattitu bay bissala Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, ‘Maglahat du saga panubu'nu ma lahat bangsa liyu. Tahinang du sigām banyaga' sampay tiniksa' e' bangsa inān ma deyom mpat hatus tahun.

verses.name: Acts 7:7
verses.text: Saguwā' pat'nna'ku hukuman ma bangsa ya song amanyaga' saga panubu'nu. Puwas e', paluwasku du sigām min lahat pamanyaga'an ma sigām ati maghinang du sigām ni aku ma lahat itu.’

verses.name: Acts 7:8
verses.text: Sakali si Ibrahim bay kabuwanan addat pagislam, tanda' palsaksi'an in iya maka panubu'na taga-kapagsulutan maka Tuhan. Angkan anakna si Isa'ak bay ni'islam e' si Ibrahim, ta'abut pa'in walung'llaw ma luwasan. Ya du si Isa'ak, bay isab angislam anakna si Yakub. Maka si Yakub e' bay angislam anakna kasangpū' maka duwa, ya na ka'mbo'an bangsatam Yahudi.  <div eID="gen6609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3250"/><div sID="gen6610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3250"/> “Manjari,” yuk si Esteban, “si Yusup bay ni'ihiran e' saga siyakana, ya saga anak si Yakub kasehe'. Angkan iya pinab'llihan e' sigām, binowa ni lahat Misil binanyaga' mahē'. Daipara ginapi' iya e' Tuhan,

verses.name: Acts 7:10
verses.text: ati pinuwas iya e'na min kasusahan kamemon bay kalabayanna. Binuwanan iya e' Tuhan pangita'u alalom ma waktu kaharapna ni Pira'un ya sultan Misil ati kasulutan sultan inān ma iya. Angkan iya gin'llal gubnul e' sultan, magagi ma lahat Misil kamemon sampay ma saga a'a ma deyom okomanna.  <div eID="gen6610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3251"/><div sID="gen6611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3251"/> “Sakali itu aniya' bay gotom ma kaluha'an lahat Misil e' sampay isab ma lahat Kana'an, ya bay paglahatan disi Yakub. Saga ka'mbo'antam, halam aniya' takakan tapiha e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 7:12
verses.text: Angkanna, pagkale si Yakub aniya' kono' kinakan ma lahat Misil, bay soho'na saga anakna l'lla, ya asal pangkat bangsatam, pehē' ni Misil am'lli takakan. Ya na he' tagna'an kapehē' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 7:13
verses.text: Kaminduwana pa'in kapehē' sigām, bo' yampa magpakilā si Yusup ma saga danakanna he'. Jari minnē' kinata'uwan e' sultan in si Yusup taga-kampung.

verses.name: Acts 7:14
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' lapal bay pinabeya' e' si Yusup ni mma'na si Yakub. Bay soho'na si Yakub magtautai'anak pauntas ni lahat Misil. Pitumpū' maka lima puhu' heka sigām.

verses.name: Acts 7:15
verses.text: Sakali pauntas na sigām ni lahat Misil. Jari amatay si Yakub mahē', damikiyanna saga anakna, ya pangkatantam.

verses.name: Acts 7:16
verses.text: Saga bangkay sigām bay tinūran ni Sekem ma lahat Kana'an, bo' kinubul mahē' ma pagkubulan ya bay bin'lli e' si Ibrahim min tubu' si Hamor ma masa awal e'.  <div eID="gen6611" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3252"/><div sID="gen6612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3252"/> “Manjari itu, song pa'in ta'abut waktu pamaluwas sigām min lahat Misil, buwat bay janji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, paheka na to'ongan bangsatam.

verses.name: Acts 7:18
verses.text: Aniya' na sultan saddī ang'ntanan lahat Misil, sultan halam makata'u ma bay pasalan si Yusup.

verses.name: Acts 7:19
verses.text: Bay niakkalan bangsatam e' sultan e', bay pinissoko' ka'mbo'-mbo'antam, sinō' animanan onde'-onde' sigām bo' supaya amatay.  <div eID="gen6612" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3253"/><div sID="gen6613" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3253"/> “Na, ya na waktu bay kapaganak ma si Musa. Onde'-onde' mustala si Musa, ati ni'ipat ma luma' matto'ana ma deyom t'llumbulan.

verses.name: Acts 7:21
verses.text: Puwas pa'in t'llumbulan e', pinaluwas iya, manda' tapuwa' e' dayang-dayang ya anak sultan, ati tahinang anak e'na.

verses.name: Acts 7:22
verses.text: Bay iya pinandu'an kamemon pangadji' bangsa Misil, ati abantug iya ma pagbissalana maka ma saga kahinanganna.  <div eID="gen6613" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3254"/><div sID="gen6614" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3254"/> “Ta'abut pa'in mpatpū' tahun umul si Musa,” yuk si Esteban, “agara' iya patibaw ni saga pagkahina bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Acts 7:24
verses.text: Makatibaw pa'in, aniya' ta'nda'na dakayu' pagkahina Isra'il nila'ugan e' a'a bangsa Misil. Magtūy nirapitan pagkahina itu e' si Musa ati binalosan a'a Misil inān pinapatay.

verses.name: Acts 7:25
verses.text: Sabab pangannal si Musa in saga pagkahina bangsa Isra'il makahati in iya ginuna du e' Tuhan amapuwas sigām min pagbanyaga'an. Sagō' halam tahati e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 7:26
verses.text: Pagsalung pa'in min llaw bay pamono' he', aniya' ta'nda' e' si Musa duwangan a'a Isra'il magbono'. Arak pinapagkahāp e'na karuwangan. ‘Saga tuwan,’ yukna, ‘magdanakan ko' kam ilu. Angay kam magbono'?’

verses.name: Acts 7:27
verses.text: Sagō' ya a'a bay amono' inān bay anganjudjal si Musa. Yukna, ‘Sai bahā' bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut magnakura' ma kami? Angay ka subay angahukum kami?

verses.name: Acts 7:28
verses.text: Bilahi ka isab amapatay aku, buwat bay pamapataynu ma a'a Misil di'ilaw?’

verses.name: Acts 7:29
verses.text: Takale pa'in itu e' si Musa, magtūy iya alahi min lahat Misil pehē' ni lahat Midiyan bo' maglahat mahē'. Makah'nda iya maina'an, sampay iya niabut duwa anak l'lla.  <div eID="gen6614" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3255"/><div sID="gen6615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3255"/> “Palabay pa'in mpatpū' tahun, aniya' mala'ikat bay magpa'nda' ni iya min t'ngnga' po'on puhung magpasalupa ni api asuleyab, ma atag būd Turusina mahē' ma lahat paslangan.

verses.name: Acts 7:31
verses.text: Ainu-inu si Musa ma bay ta'nda'na inān, angkan iya pasekot ni po'on puhung angaliling. Sagō' asekot pa'in iya, takale e'na suwala Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 7:32
verses.text: Yuk suwala he', ‘Aku ya Tuhan pagtuhanan ka'mbo'-mbo'annu, si Ibrahim, si Isa'ak maka si Yakub.’ Magtūy amidpid baran si Musa sabab min tāwna, angkan iya mbal makatawakkal ang'nda' pehē'.

verses.name: Acts 7:33
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan ni iya, ‘La'anin taumpa'nu, sabab ya tana' pan'nggehannu ilu tana' sussi.’

verses.name: Acts 7:34
verses.text: Yuk Tuhan lagi', ‘Ta'nda'ku asal paminasa ma saga a'aku mahē' ma lahat Misil. Takaleku isab pagdahing sigām, maka itiya' na aku amaluwas sigām. Na dai' na ka. Papehē'ta ka ni lahat Misil.’  <div eID="gen6615" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3256"/><div sID="gen6616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3256"/> “Na,” yuk si Esteban, “si Musa itu, ya na a'a bay sinulak e' saga pagkahina bangsa Isra'il. Pinah'llingan iya e' sigām, yuk-i, ‘Sai bay amuwanan ka'a kapatut magnakura' ma kami! Angay ka subay angahukum kami?’ Bo' si Musa ya bay sinō' e' Tuhan magnakura' sampay angalappas ma saga ka'mbo'-mbo'antam he'. Bay iya tinabangan e' mala'ikat ya bay panyata' ni iya min t'ngnga' po'on puhung he'.

verses.name: Acts 7:36
verses.text: Manjari in ka'mbo'-mbo'antam bangsa Isra'il bay pinagnakura'an e' si Musa paluwas min lahat Misil. Bay iya maghinang saga hinang makainu-inu maka saga paltanda'an kawasahan mahē' ma Misil sampay ma atag S'llang Keyat. Ya du ma lahat paslangan e', ma deyom mpatpū' tahun.  <div eID="gen6616" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3257"/><div sID="gen6617" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3257"/> “Si Musa ko' inān, ya bay amissala ni bangsa Isra'il ma awal lagi', yuk-i, ‘Ma sinosōng aniya' du dakayu' nabi buwat aku pinapi'itu e' Tuhan. A'a bangsabi du iya.’

verses.name: Acts 7:38
verses.text: Waktu kapagtimuk saga a'a Isra'il ma lahat paslangan, bay palamud si Musa ma saga ka'mbo'-mbo'antam, beya' isab mala'ikat ya bay angallam ma iya ma būd Turusina. Si Musa isab ya bay makasambut lapal makabuwan kallum bo' pinalatun ni kitam.  <div eID="gen6617" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3258"/><div sID="gen6618" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3258"/> “Sagō' ka'mbo'-mbo'antam inān,” yuk si Esteban, “mbal to'ongan ameya' ma si Musa. Sinulak iya e' sigām. Ya kabaya'an sigām subay pabīng ni lahat Misil.

verses.name: Acts 7:40
verses.text: Manjari, pagka at'ggol si Musa mahē' ma diyata' būd Turusina, ah'lling saga a'a Isra'il inān ni si Harun, yuk-i, ‘Hinangin kitam saga ta'u-ta'u pagtuhanan, pagmakōkantam. Wa'i daka maingga si Musa ilu, ya bay magnakura'an kitam paluwas min Misil!’

verses.name: Acts 7:41
verses.text: Ya he' waktu bay kapangahinang sigām dakayu' ta'u-ta'u pinasengod ni luwa anak sapi' maka aniya' susumbali'an bay panukbal e' sigām ni ta'u-ta'u he'. Bay sigām maglami-lami isab pangahulmat sigām ma bay hinangan tangan sigām.

verses.name: Acts 7:42
verses.text: Angkan ko' sigām bay tinaikutan e' Tuhan. Pinasagaran sigām amudji saga ba'anan bitu'un ma langit, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab Kanabi-nabihan, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6619"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6620"/>‘O saga a'a Isra'il, yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen6620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6621"/>ngga'i ka aku ya bay harapbi maka susumbali'an<l eID="gen6621" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6622"/>ya pagkulbanbi ma deyom mpatpū' tahun,<l eID="gen6622" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6623"/>waktu kamahē'bi ma lahat paslangan e'.<l eID="gen6623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6624"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:43
verses.text: Ya pagbowa-bowabi na pa'in tampat pat'nna'an ta'u-ta'u tuhanbi si Molok,<l eID="gen6624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6625"/>maka ta'u-ta'u hinangan luwa bitu'un<l eID="gen6625" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6626"/>ya pangarapanbi ni tuhanbi si Repan.<l eID="gen6626" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6627"/>Ya na ina'an saga ta'u-ta'u bay hinangbi panumbahanbi.<l eID="gen6627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6628"/>Angkan kam pala'anku ni liyu lahat Babilon.’<l eID="gen6628" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6619"/>  <div eID="gen6618" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3259"/><div sID="gen6629" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3259"/> “Waktu kamahē' ka'mbo'-mbo'antam ma lahat paslangan,” yuk si Esteban, “ina'an ma sigām luma' tolda ya pagtau'an paljanji'an Tuhan. Luma' inān bay nihinang e' si Musa buwat bay panoho'an Tuhan ma iya. Bineya' e' si Musa suntu'an ya bay pama'nda' ma iya.

verses.name: Acts 7:45
verses.text: Jari in luma' inān bay pang'bba e' disi Musa ma pangkattam pasunu', ati sigām ya bay amowa luma' inān ni lahat itu ma waktu kapagmakōk si Yussa' ma sigām. Waktu inān bay kapangagaw sigām lahat itu min saga kabangsahan ya bay tapala'an e' Tuhan min dahuan sigām. Jari luma' Tuhan inān bay pat'nna' maitu sampay ta'abut waktu kapagsultan si Da'ud.

verses.name: Acts 7:46
verses.text: Si Da'ud e' bay makasulut atay Tuhan, ati ama'id iya min Tuhan bang pa'in iya nirūlan angahinang luma' pat'nna'an Tuhan, ya pagtuhanan pangkattam si Yakub.

verses.name: Acts 7:47
verses.text: Sagō' sultan Sulayman ya bay pinaba'id e' Tuhan angahinang luma' inān.  <div eID="gen6629" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3260"/><div sID="gen6630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3260"/> “Malaingkan in Tuhan Mahatinggi, mbal pat'nna' ma deyom langgal hinangan manusiya'. Bay tasulat e' dakayu' nabi ya pamissala Tuhan itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6631"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6632"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:49
verses.text: ‘Sulga' ya paningkō'anku,<l eID="gen6632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6633"/>maka dunya ya pagi'ikan tape'ku.<l eID="gen6633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6634"/>Luma' ai bahā' hinanganbi aku?<l eID="gen6634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6635"/>Maingga bahā' panakapanbi aku pahalian?<l eID="gen6635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6636"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:50
verses.text: Sabab aku ya bay makahinang ina'an-i kamemon!’ ”<l eID="gen6636" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6631"/>  <div eID="gen6630" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3261"/><div sID="gen6637" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3261"/> Amissala na pa'in si Esteban, yukna, “Ka'am ilu, atuwas sidda kōkbi! Munapik kam! Apalpal pahāp taingabi, mbal akale ma lapal Tuhan! Sali' du kam maka bay ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi sabab ya du isab ka'am anagga' Rū Sussi!

verses.name: Acts 7:52
verses.text: Aniya' bahā' minsan la'a hal dakayu' nabi halam bay tapinjala' e' saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi? Halam. Bay pinapatay e' sigām saga a'a amowa lapal Tuhan ma masa awal e', ya bay magmahalayak pasal kapi'itu sosoho'anna adil. Manjari, makapi'itu pa'in sosoho'anna inān, hal tipubi sampay papataybi.

verses.name: Acts 7:53
verses.text: Ka'am ya bay makasambut sara' Tuhan labay min mala'ikat, malaingkan halam kabogboganbi sara' inān!”  <div eID="gen6637" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6606" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3262"/><div sID="gen6638" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapamantung ma si Esteban</title> <div sID="gen6639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3262"/> Pagkale pa'in saga Maghuhukum inān ma si Esteban, ap'ddi' makalandu' atay sigām ya angkan sigām ang'ttop le'e tudju ni iya.

verses.name: Acts 7:55
verses.text: Sagō' kahōpan si Esteban e' Rū Sussi ati pahangad iya tudju ni sulga'. Ta'nda'na sahaya Tuhan, maka ta'nda'na isab si Isa an'ngge ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan.

verses.name: Acts 7:56
verses.text: “Nda'unbi,” yuk si Esteban, “ta'nda'ku aukab sulga'. Maka ta'nda'ku isab si Isa, ya niōnan Anak Manusiya', an'ngge ma bihing Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6639" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3263"/><div sID="gen6640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3263"/> Pagka buwattē' h'lling si Esteban, angolang pakosog saga a'a ma Tumpukan inān. Tinaplokan tainga sigām, maka pinagheka'an si Esteban

verses.name: Acts 7:58
verses.text: bo' nijudjalan paluwas min da'ira inān. Ma luwasan pa'in, anagna' sigām amantung iya. Saga saksi' inān, hatina saga a'a amantung, bay amatau' badju' sigām ma dakayu' l'lla abata' gi', niōnan si Saul.  <div eID="gen6640" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3264"/><div sID="gen6641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3264"/> Hinabu pa'in si Esteban pinagbantung e' sigām, angamu'-ngamu' iya, yukna, “O Panghū' Isa, taima'un nyawaku.”

verses.name: Acts 7:60
verses.text: Puwas e' angōk-tu'ut iya maka e'na angalingan pakosog, yuk-i, “O Panghū'ku, da'a patōngin dusa saga itu ma pasal pamono' sigām ma aku.” Pagubus pah'lling si Esteban itu, magtūy iya amatay.  <div eID="gen6641" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.7"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3265"/><div sID="gen6643" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangala'ug si Saul ma saga Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6644" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3265"/> Na, wa'i kinubul si Esteban e' saga a'a angisbat Tuhan. Pinagdohonan to'ongan iya e' sigām. Sakali itu, tinagna'an min llaw ina'an, aheya katiksa'an pinat'kka ni saga jama'a si Isa ma Awrusalam. Angkan sigām apulak-palik kamemon tudju ni kaluha'an lahat Yahudi maka ni lahat Samariya. Luwal saga a'a bay kawakilan e' si Isa ya tabba ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3265"/><div sID="gen6643" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangala'ug si Saul ma saga Bebeya'an si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6644" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3265"/> Na, wa'i kinubul si Esteban e' saga a'a angisbat Tuhan. Pinagdohonan to'ongan iya e' sigām. Sakali itu, tinagna'an min llaw ina'an, aheya katiksa'an pinat'kka ni saga jama'a si Isa ma Awrusalam. Angkan sigām apulak-palik kamemon tudju ni kaluha'an lahat Yahudi maka ni lahat Samariya. Luwal saga a'a bay kawakilan e' si Isa ya tabba ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 8:3
verses.text: Sagō' si Saul inān, atuyu' angamula saga jama'a si Isa. Sinōd e'na kaluma'an sigām, ubus luma' dakayu' bo' dakayu'. Sinaggaw isab e'na l'lla-d'nda bo' yampa kinalabusu.  <div eID="gen6644" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6643" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3266"/><div sID="gen6645" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinatanyag Lapal Ahāp ma Lahat Samariya</title> <div sID="gen6646" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3266"/> Sagō' saga bebeya'an si Isa akaukanat inān bay anganasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa pi'ingga-pi'ingga ya papehe'an sigām.

verses.name: Acts 8:5
verses.text: Buwat si Pilip: bay iya pehē' ni dakayu' da'ira ma lahat Samariya anganasihatan saga a'a maina'an ma pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Acts 8:6
verses.text: Pagkale pa'in saga kaheka'an a'a maina'an ma bissala si Pilip, maka pag'nda' sigām ma paltanda'an makainu-inu ya tahinangna, kinale to'ongan lapalna e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 8:7
verses.text: Aheka saga a'a bay paluwasan saitan. Atanog pangolang saga saitan salta' sigām pinaluwas. Aheka isab saga a'a kauli'an, saga aku'il maka saga a'a mbal makaosegan di-sigām,

verses.name: Acts 8:8
verses.text: angkan akōd to'ongan saga a'a ma da'ira inān.  <div eID="gen6646" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6645" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3267"/><div sID="gen6647" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Simun, A'a Maghihikmat</title> <div sID="gen6648" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3267"/> Na, aniya' a'a niōnan si Simun maglahat ma da'ira inān. Ata'u iya maghikmat maka ainu-inu ma kahinanganna saga a'a ma jadjahan Samariya inān. Maglaku-laku si Simun in iya babantugun.

verses.name: Acts 8:10
verses.text: Jari kinale iya e' a'a kamemon maina'an, ai na ka a'a areyo' atawa alanga. Yuk sigām kamemon ma pasal si Simun inān, “A'a itu taga-barakat deyo' bay min Tuhan, angkan niōnan Barakat-Aheya.”

verses.name: Acts 8:11
verses.text: At'ggol na kapanginu-nginu sigām ma paghikmat si Simun angkan sigām akale to'ongan ma iya.

verses.name: Acts 8:12
verses.text: Sagō' am'nnal pa'in saga a'a inān ma lapal ahāp ya pinagnasihat e' si Pilip pasal pagparinta Tuhan maka ma pasal si Isa Al-Masi, magtūy sigām pinandi, d'nda maka l'lla, palsaksi'an in sigām ma si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 8:13
verses.text: Ya du si Simun bay am'nnal isab. Aubus pa'in iya bay pinandi, auli na iya ma si Pilip. Pag'nda'na ma saga paltanda'an maka hinang makainu-inu ya tahinang e' si Pilip, ainu-inu iya to'ongan.  <div eID="gen6648" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3268"/><div sID="gen6649" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3268"/> Manjari itu takale e' saga a'a kawakilan mahē' ma Awrusalam pasal saga a'a Samariya bay makataima' lapal Tuhan, angkan sigām bay magpanoho'an ma si Petros maka si Yahiya pehē' ni lahat Samariya.

verses.name: Acts 8:15
verses.text: Pagt'kka pa'in disi Petros pina'an, niamu'-amu'an e' sigā saga a'a Samariya bo' supaya sigām pinasambutan Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Acts 8:16
verses.text: Sabab in Rū Sussi halam gi' bay pahōp ni sigām minsan dakayu'. Sagō' bay sigām pinandi sadja, palsaksi'an in sigām suku' ma si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 8:17
verses.text: Manjari pinat'nna' e' si Petros maka si Yahiya tangan sigā ma saga a'a Samariya magpangandol inān, ati kaniya'an sigām Rū Sussi.  <div eID="gen6649" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3269"/><div sID="gen6650" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3269"/> Ta'nda' e' si Simun in saga a'a inān pinahōpan Rū Sussi, pagpat'nna' tangan disi Petros ma sigām. Angkan iya bay arak amuwan sīn panambana si Petros maka si Yahiya.

verses.name: Acts 8:19
verses.text: Yukna ni sigā, “Buwaninbi isab aku kawasabi ilu, bo' supaya bang aniya' sai-sai kapat'nna'an tanganku pinahōpan du isab iya Rū Sussi.”  <div eID="gen6650" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3270"/><div sID="gen6651" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3270"/> Sagō' sinambungan iya e' si Petros, yuk-i, “ Ahāp lagi' ka minulka'an maka sīnnu ilu! Pangannalnu in kahāpan Tuhan tab'lli-b'lli maka sīn!

verses.name: Acts 8:21
verses.text: Halam aniya' palsuku'annu atawa lamudnu ma hinang kami itu, sabab mbal abontol ataynu ma pang'nda' Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 8:22
verses.text: Angkan ko', taikutin na kala'atannu ilu. Mikiampun ka ma Tuhan, kalu niampun pikilannu ala'at ilu.

verses.name: Acts 8:23
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanku na, mamarahi pangihidnu. Sali' ka tajallat e' dusanu.”  <div eID="gen6651" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3271"/><div sID="gen6652" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3271"/> Sakali anambung si Simun, yuk-i, “Amu'-amu'inbi aku ni Tuhan supaya mbal pat'kka ni aku ya yukbi ilu.”  <div eID="gen6652" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3272"/><div sID="gen6653" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3272"/> Puwas e', aubus pa'in e' si Petros maka si Yahiya anaksi' pasal si Isa sampay amasaplag lapal Tuhan ma saga a'a inān, pauntas na sigā tudju ni Awrusalam pabīng. Ma labayan lagi' sigā, maghapit-hapit sigā ma ba'anan kauman ma lahat Samariya bo' ninasihat e' sigā lapal ahāp.  <div eID="gen6653" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6647" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3273"/><div sID="gen6654" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Pilip maka Bag'llal Bangsa Eteyopa</title> <div sID="gen6655" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3273"/> Na, aniya' mala'ikat Tuhan amissala ni si Pilip, yuk-i, “Magsakap ka. Pehē' ka ni lān tampal ni timul, ya dalosan Awrusalam maka Gasa.” Lān ina'an-i mbal na agon tapalabayan.

verses.name: Acts 8:27
verses.text: Angkan magsakap si Pilip bo' pauntas pehē'. Manjari itu aniya' a'a bangsa Eteyopa bay ma Awrusalam amudji ni Tuhan. A'a itu alanga kag'llalna, maka kinabili asal. Pangandol ma iya pangalta' si Kandake, ya dayang-dayang magnakura'an lahat Eteyopa.

verses.name: Acts 8:28
verses.text: Na, amole' pa'in bag'llal itu min Awrusalam, aningkō' iya ma kalesana, maka e'na amassa Kitab ma jūd bay tasulat e' nabi Isaya.

verses.name: Acts 8:29
verses.text: Sinoho' si Pilip e' Rū Tuhan, yuk-i, “Pina'an ka pa'abay ma kalesa inān.”  <div eID="gen6655" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3274"/><div sID="gen6656" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3274"/> Jari paragan si Pilip pehē' ati takalena bag'llal itu amassa min jūd nabi Isaya. Atilaw si Pilip ma iya, yukna, “Tahatinu bahā' ya bassanu ilu?”  <div eID="gen6656" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3275"/><div sID="gen6657" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3275"/> Yuk sambung bag'llal inān, “Mbal. Buwattingga kata'uku bang halam aniya' amahati ma aku?” Jari sinoho' e'na si Pilip pariyata' pina'an bo' aningkō' ma bihingna.

verses.name: Acts 8:32
verses.text: Na, ya na itu saga ayat Kitab bay tabassana he', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6658"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6659"/>“A'a itu sali' hantang bili-bili magpabeya' sadja bang binowa sinumbali'.<l eID="gen6659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6660"/>Halam iya bay ah'lling minsan dakabtang.<l eID="gen6660" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6661"/>Sali' anak bili-bili mbal pabanga' bang ginuntingan.<l eID="gen6661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6662"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:33
verses.text: Tahinang iya panunggīngan,<l eID="gen6662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6663"/>maka halam tin'kkahan ni sara' abontol.<l eID="gen6663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6664"/>Halam aniya' makasuli-suli pasal saga tubu'na,<l eID="gen6664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6665"/>sabab atobtob umulna ma deyom dunya itu.”<l eID="gen6665" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6658"/>  <div eID="gen6657" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3276"/><div sID="gen6666" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3276"/> Yuk bag'llal ni si Pilip, “Haka'in aku. Sai binissala e' nabi itu? Baranna ka, atawa a'a saddī?”

verses.name: Acts 8:35
verses.text: Manjari anagna' si Pilip amissala, tinagna'an min saga ayat Kitab bay tabassa e' bag'llal e'. Sinuli-sulihan iya e' si Pilip pasal si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 8:36
verses.text: Manjari itu, ma sabu sigām palanjal ma pal'ngnganan, at'kka sigām ni lahat taga-bohe'. Yuk bag'llal ni si Pilip, “Nda'un, aniya' itu bohe'. Bang halam du aniya' makababag, mikipandi na aku palsaksi'an in aku ma si Isa na.”  <div eID="gen6666" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3277"/><div sID="gen6667" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3277"/> [ Yuk si Pilip, “Bang ka am'nnal min deyom ataynu, makajari sadja.” <div eID="gen6667" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6668" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk bag'llal, “amarassaya aku in si Isa Al-Masi asal Anak Tuhan.” ]

verses.name: Acts 8:38
verses.text: Magtūy magpanoho'an bag'llal pinahogga' kalesa. Jari pareyo' sigā karuwangan ni bohe' bo' yampa iya pinandi e' si Pilip.

verses.name: Acts 8:39
verses.text: Pagluwas sigā min bohe', magtūy tabowa si Pilip ala'an minnē' e' Rū Panghū'. Halam na iya ta'nda' pabīng e' bag'llal inān. Palanjal iya ni patudjuhanna, maka e'na kinōgan to'ongan.

verses.name: Acts 8:40
verses.text: Malaingkan si Pilip itu, wa'i palahil ma lahat Asotus. Nilatag e'na kamemon saga kauman ma jadjahan ina'an maka e'na magnasihat lapal ahāp sampay at'kka ni lahat Kesareya.  <div eID="gen6668" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.8"/> <div eID="gen6654" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3278"/><div sID="gen6669" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Saul Papinda na ni si Isa Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen6670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3278"/> Salta' ma waktu inān masi si Saul ananggup amapatay saga mulid Panghū' Isa. Pehē' iya ni Imam Muwallam

verses.name: Acts 9:2
verses.text: angamu' sulat kataddangan, binowa ni saga kalanggalan mahē' ma da'ira Damaskus. Jari bang aniya' tabākna mahē' saga a'a ameya' ma kal'ngnganan Panghū' Isa Al-Masi, aniya' kapatutna anaggaw sigām l'lla-d'nda sampay amowa sigām pabīng ni Awrusalam bo' kinalabusu.

verses.name: Acts 9:3
verses.text: Manjari itu, ma labayan pa'in si Saul asekot ni Damaskus, patagha' sadja aniya' sawa min deyom sulga' asinag ma katilibutna.

verses.name: Acts 9:4
verses.text: Pahantak iya magtūy ni tana' ati makakale iya suwala amissala, yuk-i, “Saul, O Saul! Angay aku pinjala'nu?”  <div eID="gen6670" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3279"/><div sID="gen6671" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3279"/> Anambung si Saul, yukna, “Sai sa ka'a ilu, Nakura'?” <div eID="gen6671" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6672" type="paragraph"/> Yuk suwala inān, “Aku si Isa, ya pinjala'nu na pa'in.

verses.name: Acts 9:6
verses.text: Sagō' an'ngge na ka,” yukna. “Pehē' ka ni deyom da'ira inān. Nihaka'an du ka maina'an bang ai subay hinangnu.”  <div eID="gen6672" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3280"/><div sID="gen6673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3280"/> Saga a'a bay sehe' si Saul hal an'ngge maina'an, halam makapah'lling. Takale e' sigām suwala inān bo' halam aniya' sai-na ta'nda' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 9:8
verses.text: Pabungkal si Saul min tana' bay kahantakanna bo' amak'llat matana, sagō' mbal iya maka'nda'. Angkan iya niambit e' saga sehe'na tudju ni deyom Damaskus.

verses.name: Acts 9:9
verses.text: T'llumbahangi iya mbal maka'nda', maka halam isab iya bay amangan atawa anginum.  <div eID="gen6673" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3281"/><div sID="gen6674" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3281"/> Aniya' ma Damaskus inān dakayu' mulid si Isa Al-Masi niōnan si Ananiyas. Magpanyata' Panghū' Isa ni iya ah'lling, yukna, “O Ananiyas!” <div eID="gen6674" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6675" type="paragraph"/> “Itiya' aku, Panghū',” yukna.  <div eID="gen6675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3282"/><div sID="gen6676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3282"/> Yuk Panghū' Isa ni iya, “Pasakap ka. Pehē' na ka ni lān niōnan Lān Bontol. Panilawun ma luma' si Judas pasal dakayu' a'a min Tarsus niōnan si Saul. He' na iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan buwattina'an.

verses.name: Acts 9:12
verses.text: Bay iya pata'uku bang ai song makani-iya. Bay ka sali' ta'nda' e'na pasōd ni deyom pa'ataganna inān amat'nna' tangannu ma iya, bo' supaya iya maka'nda' pabīng.”  <div eID="gen6676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3283"/><div sID="gen6677" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3283"/> Sagō' anambung si Ananiyas, yukna, “Allō, Panghū'ku, aheka bay angahaka'an aku pasal si Saul inān. Ala'at makalandu' kahinanganna ma saga a'a suku'nu ma Awrusalam e'.

verses.name: Acts 9:14
verses.text: Maka itiya' na isab iya ma Damaskus itu. Bay iya kabuwanan kapatut e' kaimaman alanga bo' tasaggawna sasuku magpanabbut ma ōnnu.”  <div eID="gen6677" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3284"/><div sID="gen6678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3284"/> Sagō' anambung Panghū' Isa, yukna, “Pehē' na ka, sabab si Saul inān bay tapene'ku maghinang ma aku. Iya ya amatanyag ōnku pehē' ni kabangsa-bangsahan ya ngga'i ka Yahudi, maka ni saga kasultanan, maka ni saga bangsa Isra'il isab.

verses.name: Acts 9:16
verses.text: Baranku ya,” yuk Panghū' Isa, “amandu'an iya pasal sukkal kamemon ya subay sandalanna ma sinosōng pagka aku ya pameya'anna.”  <div eID="gen6678" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3285"/><div sID="gen6679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3285"/> Jari pehē' si Ananiyas ni luma' pahanti'an si Saul bo' pasōd. Pinat'nna' e'na tanganna ma si Saul, ati yukna, “Saul, magdanakan na kita. Itiya' aku sinō' pi'itu e' Panghū' Isa, ya bay magpa'nda' ni ka'a ma labayan ma waktu kapi'itunu. Sinō' aku pi'itu bo' ka maka'nda' pabīng, bo' ka pinahōpan Rū Sussi.”

verses.name: Acts 9:18
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un aniya' sali' sisik daing ahūg min mata si Saul, jari maka'nda' iya pabīng. An'ngge iya bo' yampa pinandi palsaksi'an in iya ma si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 9:19
verses.text: Aubus pa'in iya bay amangan, pabalik na kosogna. <div eID="gen6679" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6669" type="section"/> <div sID="gen6680" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magnasihat si Saul ma Da'ira Damaskus</title> <div sID="gen6681" type="paragraph"/> Na, pahanti' si Saul daka pilambahangi ma saga mulid si Isa ma Damaskus inān.

verses.name: Acts 9:20
verses.text: Anagna' iya magtūy magnasihat ma deyom kalanggalan Yahudi maina'an. “Si Isa itu,” yukna, “tuman anak Tuhan!”

verses.name: Acts 9:21
verses.text: Ainu-inu a'a kamemon sasuku akale ma iya. Yuk sigām, “Ya na ko' itu a'a bay ma Awrusalam ya angamula sasuku anabbut ma ōn si Isa. Maka ya maksudna kono' pi'itu anaggaw sasuku ameya' ma si Isa, bo' yampa sigām bowana pabīng ni Awrusalam, ni saga imam alanga he'.”

verses.name: Acts 9:22
verses.text: Sagō' ya pagnasihat si Saul pak'nnop na pa'in kosogna. Minnē' manyatakan to'ongan pasal si Isa, in iya b'nnal Al-Masi, angkan saga Yahudi maglahat ma Damaskus mbal makajawab ma iya.  <div eID="gen6681" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3286"/><div sID="gen6682" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3286"/> At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in minnē', magisun saga Yahudi amapatay si Saul,

verses.name: Acts 9:24
verses.text: daipara kahaka'an iya pasal pagisun e'. Llaw-sangom, nijagahan e' sigām saga lawang pagluwasan min da'ira inān bo' supaya iya pinapatay.

verses.name: Acts 9:25
verses.text: Sagō' sangom pa'in lahat, binowa si Saul e' saga anak-mulidna pinatingkō' ma deyom ambung aheya bo' yampa tinonton min dakayu' tandawan tudju ni luwasan da'ira inān.  <div eID="gen6682" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6680" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3287"/><div sID="gen6683" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Patibaw si Saul ni Awrusalam</title> <div sID="gen6684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3287"/> Pagt'kka si Saul ni Awrusalam, pasulay iya palamud ma saga kamuliran si Isa mahē'. Sagō' tināw sigām ma iya sabab mbal sigām am'nnal in iya mulid si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 9:27
verses.text: Daipara si Barnabas bay amakilā si Saul ni saga a'a kawakilan. Bay isab sigām pata'una pasal paka'nda' si Saul ma Panghū' Isa, ma labayan tudju ni Damaskus. Bay iya kono' binissalahan isab e' si Isa maina'an. Nihaka isab e' si Barnabas pasal si Saul mbal tināw magnasihat ma pasal si Isa ma deyom da'ira Damaskus e'.

verses.name: Acts 9:28
verses.text: Manjari pat'nna' si Saul ma saga kamuliran si Isa ma Awrusalam. Halam aniya' hawal-hawalna angalatag deyom da'ira magnasihatan saga a'a min kawasa ōn si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 9:29
verses.text: Magbissala isab iya sampay magjawab maka saga Yahudi ya asal amissala bissala Girīk sagō' pasulay sigām amapatay iya.

verses.name: Acts 9:30
verses.text: Pagta'u pa'in ina'an-i e' saga dauranakanna bebeya'an si Isa, magtūy sigām amowa si Saul palūd ni Kesareya bo' yampa pinalaus minnē' tudju ni Tarsus.  <div eID="gen6684" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3288"/><div sID="gen6685" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3288"/> Na, yampa taga-kasannangan saga jama'a si Isa ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya maka ma lahat Jalil, maka mahē' ma lahat Samariya. Tinabang sigām e' Rū Sussi angkan angahogot iman sigām kamemon. Pasōng isab heka sigām, maka e' sigām magmahaltabat to'ongan ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6685" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6683" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3289"/><div sID="gen6686" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Petros ma Lahat Lidda maka Joppa</title> <div sID="gen6687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3289"/> Manjari itu magl'ngngan na si Petros angalatag kalahatan. Aniya' isab waktu, pehē' iya ni da'ira Lidda anibaw saga a'a suku' Tuhan mahē'.

verses.name: Acts 9:33
verses.text: Jari aniya' talanggalna mahē' a'a niōnan si Aneyas. A'a itu amatay ugatna, waluntahun na iya halam bay makabungkal min palegehanna.

verses.name: Acts 9:34
verses.text: Yuk si Petros ni iya, “Aneyas, kauli'an na ka e' si Isa Al-Masi. Pabungkal ka, momosun patulihannu ilu!” Magtūy pabungkal si Aneyas itu.

verses.name: Acts 9:35
verses.text: Ta'nda' iya e' saga a'a kamemon ya maglahat ma Lidda maka ma lahat Saron inān, ati papinda saga a'a inān am'nnal ma Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen6687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3290"/><div sID="gen6688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3290"/> Na, aniya' ma lahat Joppa inān dakayu' d'nda mulid si Isa, niōnan si Tabita. Dorkas ya ōn si Tabita itu bang ma bahasa Girīk, hatina ‘usa’. D'nda inān maghinang sadja kahāpan, maka anabang ma saga a'a miskin.

verses.name: Acts 9:37
verses.text: Jari ma waktu ina'an-i taluwa' saki si Tabita itu ati amatay. Tasussi pa'in mayatna, pinalege iya ma dakayu' bilik ma diyata' angkap.

verses.name: Acts 9:38
verses.text: Lahat Joppa inān mbal du alawak to'ongan min Lidda. Sakali itu, takale pa'in e' saga kamuliran si Isa ma Joppa in si Petros ina'an ma Lidda, magtūy sigām anoho' duwa l'lla pehē' amowa lapal ni si Petros. Yuk lapal e', “Pasa'ut ka pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen6688" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3291"/><div sID="gen6689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3291"/> Pagta'u pa'in si Petros, magtūy iya magsakap ameya' ma duwangan inān. Pagt'kkana ni Joppa binowa iya pariyata' ni bilik. Jari pinagtimukan iya e' saga kabaluhan d'nda magpanangis na pa'in. Pina'nda'an ni iya e' sigām saga badju' indaginis bay tahinang e' si Dorkas waktu bay kallumna gi'.  <div eID="gen6689" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3292"/><div sID="gen6690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3292"/> Na, pinaluwas sigām kamemon e' si Petros min deyom bilik inān bo' yampa iya angōk-tu'ut angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan. Puwas e' pa'alop iya ni mayat d'nda inān. Yukna, “Tabita, pabungkal ka!” Sakali pinak'llat e' si Tabita matana, ati punduk iya pag'nda'na ma si Petros.

verses.name: Acts 9:41
verses.text: Pina'abut e' si Petros tanganna panabang iya bo' makat'ngge. Puwas e' nilinganan e' si Petros saga a'a angandol inān maka saga balu ati sōnganna si Tabita ni sigām, allum na.

verses.name: Acts 9:42
verses.text: Pahayag suli-suli pasal kallum si Tabita itu ni a'a kamemon ma Joppa, angkan aheka angandol ma Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Acts 9:43
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol kat'nna' si Petros ma Joppa inān. Paokom iya ma luma' si Simun, a'a magadjal kuwit hayop.  <div eID="gen6690" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.9"/> <div eID="gen6686" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3293"/><div sID="gen6691" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Petros maka si Kornelos</title> <div sID="gen6692" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3293"/> Na, aniya' a'a ma lahat Kesareya niōnan si Kornelos. Kapitan iya ma dakayu' ba'anan sundalu Rōm, ya niōnan ‘Ba'anan Itali’.

verses.name: Acts 10:2
verses.text: Si Kornelos itu dakayu' a'a magtata'at. Sigām magtai'anak magmatāw asal ma Tuhan. Aheya isab panulungna ma saga Yahudi sasuku kasigpitan, maka atukid iya anambahayang ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 10:3
verses.text: Dakayu' llaw saga lisag t'llu kohap, aniya' magpanyata' ni si Kornelos, ati ta'nda'na to'ongan mala'ikat min Tuhan. Ya pah'lling mala'ikat ma iya, “O Kornelos!”  <div eID="gen6692" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3294"/><div sID="gen6693" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3294"/> Pinatongan mala'ikat inān e' si Kornelos, jari niumagad iya. “Ai gawinu ma aku, tuwan?” yukna. <div eID="gen6693" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6694" type="paragraph"/> Yuk mala'ikat, “Kapandogahan e' Tuhan panabbutnu ilu maka panulungnu ma saga miskin, ati kinannal ka e'na.

verses.name: Acts 10:5
verses.text: Soho'un saga tendognu pehē' ni Joppa angā' dakayu' a'a niōnan Simun, ya niōnan isab Petros.

verses.name: Acts 10:6
verses.text: Ina'an iya paokom ma luma' si Simun, ya maga'adjal kuwit hayop. Ina'an luma'na ma bihing tahik.”  <div eID="gen6694" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3295"/><div sID="gen6695" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3295"/> Makala'an pa'in mala'ikat bay ah'lling e', nilinganan e' si Kornelos duwa ipatanna maka dakayu' sundalu, tendogna lissi, a'a magta'at ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 10:8
verses.text: Kahaka'an sigām kat'llungan itu e' si Kornelos pasal kamemon bay tum'kka inān, bo' yampa sigām patulakna pehē' ni Joppa.  <div eID="gen6695" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3296"/><div sID="gen6696" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3296"/> Pagsalung, saga waktu ugtu na, ma song pa'in at'kka t'llungan itu ni Joppa, pariyata' si Petros ni karatagan atop luma' bo' anambahayang.

verses.name: Acts 10:10
verses.text: Mbal at'ggol, lingantu iya ati bilahi iya amangan. Jari itu, pasalta' pa'in niadjal kinakanna, aniya' pa'nda' ni iya.

verses.name: Acts 10:11
verses.text: Ta'nda'na langit paukab maka aniya' ta'nda'na sali' luwa manta alambu bay niengkotan ma ka'mpat tōngna, ina'an tinontonan pareyo' ni dunya.

verses.name: Acts 10:12
verses.text: Ya pakandung ma deyom manta inān kamemon ginisan hayop, maka saga ai-ai maglelehan, maka saga manuk-manuk.

verses.name: Acts 10:13
verses.text: Jari aniya' suwala takale e' si Petros ah'lling ni iya, yuk-i, “An'ngge ka, Petros. Anumbali' ka pina'an bo' ka amangan!”  <div eID="gen6696" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3297"/><div sID="gen6697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3297"/> Sagō' anambung si Petros, yukna, “Ē, Panghū', mbal aku! T'ggolku allum halam aku bay makakakan haram atawa ai-ai al'mmis.”  <div eID="gen6697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3298"/><div sID="gen6698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3298"/> Takalena suwala inān ah'lling pabīng, yukna, “Da'a ōnin haram bang tahalal e' Tuhan!”

verses.name: Acts 10:16
verses.text: Min t'llu ah'lling buwattē' bo' yampa pina'angkat ai-ai inān pabīng ni sulga'.  <div eID="gen6698" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3299"/><div sID="gen6699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3299"/> Manjari itu, ma sabu si Petros masi angandongdong bang ai hatina ya bay ta'nda'na inān, tatuli' na luma' si Simun e' saga a'a bay sinō' pina'an e' si Kornelos. Ina'an na sigām angagad ma bowa' lawang

verses.name: Acts 10:18
verses.text: angalingan. Atilaw sigām ni a'a luma', yuk sigām, “Owa'! Aniya' bahā' paokom maitu a'a niōnan Simun, ya niōnan isab Petros?”  <div eID="gen6699" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3300"/><div sID="gen6700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3300"/> Sasang si Petros masi angandongdong bang ai hatina bay ta'nda'na inān, na, ah'lling Rū Tuhan ni iya, yukna, “Simun, ilu aniya' t'llungan a'a amiha ka'a.

verses.name: Acts 10:20
verses.text: An'ngge na ka bo' ka pareyo'. Da'a ka hawal-hawal ameya' ma sigām sabab aku ya bay anoho' sigām pi'itu.”  <div eID="gen6700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3301"/><div sID="gen6701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3301"/> Angkan pareyo' si Petros ati yukna ni t'llungan inān, “Aku na ko' ya a'a pihabi ilu. Ai gawibi?”  <div eID="gen6701" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3302"/><div sID="gen6702" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3302"/> Yuk t'llungan inān, “Bay kami sinō' pi'itu e' Kapitan Kornelos. A'a ahāp addatna. Magtata'at iya ma Tuhan maka pinagaddatan e' saga Yahudi kamemon. Bay iya nihaka'an e' mala'ikat sussi, sinō' anambukuhan ka'a. Jari pehē' na ka ni luma'na supaya takalena bang ai pamissalanu ma iya.”

verses.name: Acts 10:23
verses.text: Manjari t'llungan inān bay sinō' pasōd e' si Petros, ati nihulmat e'na ma sangom inān. <div eID="gen6702" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6703" type="paragraph"/> Pagsubu pa'in, magsakap na si Petros bo' ameya' ma saga a'a inān. Aniya' isab saga dauranakanna bebeya'an si Isa min Joppa anehe'an sigām.

verses.name: Acts 10:24
verses.text: Pag'llaw dakayu', at'kka na sigām ni Kesareya. Ina'an asal si Kornelos angalagaran sigām, maka ina'an isab saga kampungna maka saga panonna bay soho'na patipun pina'an.

verses.name: Acts 10:25
verses.text: Sōng pa'in pasōd si Petros, sinampang iya e' si Kornelos. Pasujud iya ma dahuwan si Petros angahulmat iya.

verses.name: Acts 10:26
verses.text: Sagō' sinō' iya an'ngge e' si Petros. “Pabuhat ka,” yukna. “Manusiya' du aku, sali' ka'a.”  <div eID="gen6703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3303"/><div sID="gen6704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3303"/> Magsuli-suli sigā karuwangan sabu sigā pareyom ati aheka a'a ta'nda' e' si Petros magtimuk maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 10:28
verses.text: Yukna ni sigām, “Kata'uwanbi, bang ma agama kami Yahudi, mbal kami makajari maglamud maka bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi. Mbal kami makajari minsan patibaw ni buwat ka'am itu. Sagō' bay aku pinata'u e' Tuhan subay halam aniya' manusiya' bistaku haram atawa al'mmis.

verses.name: Acts 10:29
verses.text: Angkan ko', pagka aku bay tambukuhanbi pi'itu, halam aku magin'mbal. Sagō' tilawta kam, ai panambukuhanbi aku?”  <div eID="gen6704" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3304"/><div sID="gen6705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3304"/> Anambung si Kornelos, yukna, “Aniya' na t'llung'llaw palabay, saga buwattē' waktu, bay aku ma deyom luma' itu anambahayang lisag t'llu kohap. Tagha' aniya' an'ngge paharap ni aku dakayu' a'a angillap pamakayna.

verses.name: Acts 10:31
verses.text: Ah'lling a'a he' ni aku, yukna, ‘Kornelos! Takale na e' Tuhan ya bay amu'nu, maka kinannal isab e'na bay panulungnu ma saga miskin.

verses.name: Acts 10:32
verses.text: Sō'un a'anu ni Joppa angā' pi'itu dakayu' a'a niōnan Simun, ya niōnan isab Petros. Ina'an iya paokom ma si Simun, a'a maga'adjal kuwit hayop. Ina'an luma'na ma bihing tahik.’

verses.name: Acts 10:33
verses.text: Na, ya he' po'onna angkan ka bay tambukuhanku pi'itu magtūy,” yuk si Kornelos. “Magsukul isab aku ni ka'a sabab itiya' na ka maitu. Maka itiya' isab kami kamemon magtimuk ma pang'nda' Tuhan bo' kami akale ma ai-ai bay panoho'an ka'a e' Panghū'.”  <div eID="gen6705" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6691" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3305"/><div sID="gen6706" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala si Petros</title> <div sID="gen6707" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3305"/> Na, tinagna'an e' si Petros pamissalana ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Buwattina'an kamattanan na aku. B'nnal to'ongan, in manusiya' mbal pinagbidda' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 10:35
verses.text: Sasuku magmatāw ma Tuhan sampay angahinang kabontolan, tinaima' du e'na minsan ai bangsa.

verses.name: Acts 10:36
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi lapal ya bay pinasampay e' Tuhan ni bangsa Yahudi, lapal ahāp pasal kapaghāp manusiya' maka Tuhan sabab min bay tahinang e' si Isa Al-Masi, ya pagpanghū'an asal ma kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 10:37
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du pasal pakaradja'an bay pinaniya' ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudiya, ya tinagna'an mahē' ma lahat Jalil pagubus pandi taubat ya bay panganasihat e' si Yahiya.

verses.name: Acts 10:38
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi pasal si Isa, a'a Nasaret, in iya bay pinaniya'an Rū Sussi e' Tuhan, maka binuwanan barakat. Bay iya angalatag kaluma'an maghinang ahāp. Maka sasuku isab bay ma pang'ntanan nakura' saitan kauli'an e'na, sabab ina'an asal Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen6707" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3306"/><div sID="gen6708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3306"/> “Jari kami itu,” yuk si Petros, “amuwan saksi' ma pasal kamemon bay tahinang e' si Isa ma lahat Yahudiya sampay ma Awrusalam. Bay iya pinagantung ma hāg pinapatay.

verses.name: Acts 10:40
verses.text: Malaingkan, ta'abut pa'in t'llumbahangi min kamatayna, bay iya pinakallum pabīng e' Tuhan ati pa'nda'anna iya ni saga a'a.

verses.name: Acts 10:41
verses.text: Ngga'i ka a'a kamemon bay pama'nda'an. Luwal kami, ya tapene' e' Tuhan subay anaksi' ma pasal si Isa, hatina kami ya bay magsalu maka iya ma kallumna pabīng min kamatayna.

verses.name: Acts 10:42
verses.text: Sinō' kami e' si Isa itu magnasihat lapal ahāp ni saga a'a. Sinō' isab kami anaksi' ma pasalna, in iya kabuwanan kapatut e' Tuhan angahukum ma manusiya' kamemon, ma saga allum gi' sampay ma saga magpatayan.

verses.name: Acts 10:43
verses.text: Ya du isab kanabi-nabihan kamemon, bay makasaksi' isab ma pasalna. Ya yuk sigām, sasuku angandol ma si Isa niampun du paldusahan sigām sabab min kawasa ōnna.”  <div eID="gen6708" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3307"/><div sID="gen6709" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3307"/> Salta' pa'in si Petros amissala, pahōp Rū Sussi ma saga a'a inān ya akale ma lapalna.

verses.name: Acts 10:45
verses.text: Ainu-inu saga Yahudi magpangandol ma si Isa, ya bay sehe' si Petros min Joppa. Ya angkan sigām ainu-inu sabab pamuwan e' Tuhan Rū-na Sussi sampay ma saga a'a ngga'i ka bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 10:46
verses.text: Takale e' sigām disi Kornelos amissala saga bahasa saddī maka e' sigām ananglitan Tuhan. Ah'lling si Petros, yukna,

verses.name: Acts 10:47
verses.text: “Saga a'a itu kaniya'an na Rū Sussi sali' du maka kitam. Halam aniya' makasagga' bang sigām itu pinandi.”

verses.name: Acts 10:48
verses.text: Angkan sigām sinō' e' si Petros subay pinandi, paltanda'an in sigām ma si Isa Al-Masi. Jari itu niamu' e' disi Kornelos si Petros sinō' lagi' pahanti' ma sigām pila-pilang'llaw.  <div eID="gen6709" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.10"/> <div eID="gen6706" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3308"/><div sID="gen6710" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Amahati si Petros Pasal Kahinanganna</title> <div sID="gen6711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3308"/> Sakali itu takale e' saga a'a kawakilan maka saga dauranakan bebeya'an si Isa ma sakalibut lahat Yahudiya, pasal saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi bay makataima' lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 11:2
verses.text: Pagtukad pa'in si Petros pabalik ni Awrusalam, magtūy iya sinoway e' saga Yahudi bebeya'an si Isa kasehe', a'a masi amogbog ma addat sigām magislam.

verses.name: Acts 11:3
verses.text: Yuk sigām, “Oy! Ka'a ilu bay pasōd ni deyom luma' saga a'a halam magislam, magsalu maka sigām!”  <div eID="gen6711" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3309"/><div sID="gen6712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3309"/> Angkan sigām pinahati e' si Petros pasal kahālanna inān kamemon, sangay min katagna'na.

verses.name: Acts 11:5
verses.text: Yukna, “Bay pa'in aku anambahayang ma da'ira Joppa inān, aniya' bay pa'nda' ni aku. Ta'nda'ku sali' manta alambu, niengkotan tōngna ka'mpat, tinontonan pareyo' min langit, pinatongod ni atagku.

verses.name: Acts 11:6
verses.text: Ta'nda'ku ma deyomna inān saga hayop, sattuwa talun, maka ai-ai maglelehan ma tana', maka saga manuk-manuk.

verses.name: Acts 11:7
verses.text: Jari aniya' suwala takaleku ah'lling ni aku, yuk-i, ‘An'ngge ka, Petros. Anumbali' ka pina'an bo' ka amangan.’

verses.name: Acts 11:8
verses.text: Sagō' yukku, ‘Ē, Panghū'! Mbal aku! T'ggolku allum halam aniya' kinakan haram atawa l'mmis bay palabay min bowa'ku!’

verses.name: Acts 11:9
verses.text: Sagō' takaleku suwala he' ah'lling pabīng min deyom sulga', yukna, ‘Da'a niōnan haram ai-ai tahalal e' Tuhan.’

verses.name: Acts 11:10
verses.text: Min t'llu pinah'lling buwattē' bo' yampa pina'angkat ai-ai inān kamemon pabīng ni sulga'.  <div eID="gen6712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3310"/><div sID="gen6713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3310"/> “Salta' pa'in inān, aniya' at'kka ni luma' paokomanku t'llungan l'lla bay sinō' pehē' ni aku min lahat Kesareya.

verses.name: Acts 11:12
verses.text: Jari sinō' aku e' Rū Sussi subay mbal hawal-hawal ameya' ma sigām. Bay aku sinehe'an isab e' saga danakantam nnom puhu', a'a min Joppa. Pagt'kka kami ni Kesareya pasōd na kami ni deyom luma' si Kornelos e'.

verses.name: Acts 11:13
verses.text: Nihaka'an kami e' si Kornelos pasal aniya' mala'ikat bay ta'nda'na an'ngge ma deyom luma'na, amissala ma iya. Yuk mala'ikat kono', ‘Sō'un a'anu pehē' ni Joppa angā' dakayu' a'a niōnan Simun, ya niōnan isab Petros.

verses.name: Acts 11:14
verses.text: Binowahan ka e'na lapal, maka lappasan du ka sampay saga sehe'nu karaluma' ilu.’  <div eID="gen6713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3311"/><div sID="gen6714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3311"/> “Makatagna' pa'in aku amissala ni disi Kornelos,” yuk si Petros, “pahōp Rū Sussi ni sigām buwat bay kahōp ni kitam tagna'.

verses.name: Acts 11:16
verses.text: Manjari taentomku ya bay lling Panghū', ya yuk-i, ‘Bohe' ya bay pamandi saga a'a e' si Yahiya, sagō' saddī ya pamandi ka'am. Pinasangon du Rū Sussi ni deyom baranbi.’

verses.name: Acts 11:17
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Petros, “apasti' na, ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, sali' du maka bay pamuwanna ma kitam Yahudi pagka Panghū' Isa Al-Masi ya pam'nnalantam. Jari sai sa aku itu? Mbal tasagga'ku Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3312"/><div sID="gen6715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3312"/> Makakale pa'in saga Yahudi inān ma bissala si Petros e', halam aniya' panganjawab sigām saddī. Sinanglitan Tuhan e' sigām, yuk-i, “Bang buwattē' kahālanna, saga kabangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi kabuwanan du isab kahāpan e' Tuhan bo' supaya sigām ang'bba min dusa sigām sampay pinaniya'an kallum kakkal.”  <div eID="gen6715" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6710" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3313"/><div sID="gen6716" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palhimpunan saga Jama'a si Isa ma Antiyuk</title> <div sID="gen6717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3313"/> Na, ma waktu bay pamapatay ma si Esteban, apulak-palik saga a'a magpangandol ma si Isa pagka sigām nila'ugan. Aniya' sigām kasehe' bay makasampay ni lahat Piniki, ni pū' Kiprus, sampay isab ni da'ira Antiyuk. Ninasihat e' sigām lapal ahāp, bo' Yahudi sadja ya pinakalehan.

verses.name: Acts 11:20
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' sigām kasehe' a'a min Kiprus maka min Kirini bay pehē' ni Antiyuk, ati magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal Panghū' Isa sampay ni saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 11:21
verses.text: Ina'an kawasa Tuhan ma pagnasihat sigām, angkan aheka to'ongan saga a'a Antiyuk bay magkahagad sampay papinda ni Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen6717" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3314"/><div sID="gen6718" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3314"/> Jari itu takale e' saga jama'a si Isa ma Awrusalam pasal ina'an, angkan bay pinapina'an e' sigām si Barnabas ni Antiyuk.

verses.name: Acts 11:23
verses.text: At'kka pa'in si Barnabas pina'an, ta'nda'na ya kaheya tabang Tuhan ma saga a'a inān. Kinōgan iya maka e'na anoho' sigām pat'ttog angandol ma Panghū' min deyom atay sigām.

verses.name: Acts 11:24
verses.text: Si Barnabas itu ahāp addatna, a'a iya kahōpan asal e' Rū Sussi maka akosog pangandolna. Manjari aheka a'a ma Antiyuk bay tabowana angandol ma Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen6718" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3315"/><div sID="gen6719" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3315"/> Puwas e', pehē' na si Barnabas ni da'ira Tarsus amiha si Saul.

verses.name: Acts 11:26
verses.text: Tabākna pa'in, binowa e'na si Saul pabīng ni Antiyuk. Dantahun ya t'ggol si Barnabas maka si Saul pat'nna' ma jama'a si Isa maina'an, ati aheka to'ongan saga a'a bay pinandu'an e' sigā karuwangan. Ma Antiyuk ya bay tagna' pangōn ‘Almasihin’ ma saga bebeya'an si Isa.  <div eID="gen6719" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3316"/><div sID="gen6720" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3316"/> Manjari itu, ma timpu he'-i du, aniya' bay palūd min Awrusalam tudju ni Antiyuk saga a'a magpalatun lapal min Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 11:28
verses.text: Aniya' dangan min sigām niōnan Agabus bay an'ngge angallam ma pasal waktu sinōng, bo' min kawasa Rū Sussi. Yuk si Agabus, “Aniya' gotom song pat'kka ni kalahat-lahatan kamemon.” (Subay na waktu kapagsultan sultan Klaudi bo' yampa pat'kka gotom itu.)

verses.name: Acts 11:29
verses.text: Angkan saga kamuliran ma Antiyuk bay anganiyat amabeya' tulung ni saga dauranakan ma lahat Yahudiya, pila-pila takole' e' sigām dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Acts 11:30
