verses.text: Jari sīn inān bay pinabowa ma si Barnabas maka ma si Saul tudju ni saga pagmatto'ahan ma katipunan jama'a si Isa ma Awrusalam.  <div eID="gen6720" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.11"/> <div eID="gen6716" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3317"/><div sID="gen6721" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kal'ppa si Petros min Kalabusu</title> <div sID="gen6722" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3317"/> Ma waktu ina'an, anagna' sultan Herod anaggaw saga jama'a si Isa kasehe'an bahasa nila'ugan.

verses.name: Acts 12:2
verses.text: Bay paponggolanna kōk si Yakub ya danakan si Yahiya.

verses.name: Acts 12:3
verses.text: Jari makata'u pa'in si Herod in saga Yahudi inān kasulutan ma hinangna, bay isab soho'na sinaggaw si Petros. Ya waktu panaggaw ma si Petros itu pasalta' ma Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna.

verses.name: Acts 12:4
verses.text: Tasaggaw pa'in si Petros, sinoho' iya kinalabusu e' sultan. Mpat ba'an sundalu bay sinō' anganjagahan si Petros, mpat-mpat sigām ma damba'an. Ya gara' si Herod subay pinalabay gi' Hinang Paglakad bo' yampa nihukum si Petros ma mata mairan.  <div eID="gen6722" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3318"/><div sID="gen6723" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3318"/> Angkan tinahan si Petros ma deyom kalabusu, sagō' angamu'-ngamu' saga a'a jama'a si Isa ma sababna.  <div eID="gen6723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3319"/><div sID="gen6724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3319"/> Na, ma sangom song pangahukum sultan Herod ma si Petros, ina'an iya atuli ma llot duwa sundalu. Binaggot iya maka duwa kilikili, maka aniya' isab saga sundalu anganjagahan lawang kalabusu inān.

verses.name: Acts 12:7
verses.text: Patagha' aniya' dakayu' mala'ikat min Panghū' panyata' pehē', maka asawa deyom kalabusu. Ni'ntanan iya ma bahana e' mala'ikat e', kinudjal bo' binati'. “Pal'kkas ka!” yuk mala'ikat itu. “Pabungkal ka!” Magtūy apakpak kilikili min tangan si Petros.

verses.name: Acts 12:8
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat ni iya, “Asintoron ka maka ataumpa'.” Bineya' magtūy e' si Petros. “Sulugun badju'nu bo' ka paturul ma aku,” yuk mala'ikat.

verses.name: Acts 12:9
verses.text: Manjari tinurul mala'ikat inān e' si Petros paluwas min kalabusu. Saguwā' halam kinata'uwan e' si Petros bang b'nnal ya hinang mala'ikat inān atawa mbal. Pangannalna hal bay pabagala ni iya.

verses.name: Acts 12:10
verses.text: Palabay sigā min jaga dakayu' bo' ni jaga pasunu', sampay sigā maka'abut ni tambol basi' ya ma lawang paluwasan ni da'ira. Magtūy aukaban di-na tambol inān, ati paluwas sigā minna'an. Lum'ngngan sigā ma kataha'an dakayu' lān inān, jari saru'un-du'un du ala'an mala'ikat min si Petros.  <div eID="gen6724" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3320"/><div sID="gen6725" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3320"/> Pagla'an mala'ikat, na yampa tasayu e' si Petros ya bay talabayna. Yukna, “Ā, kata'uwanku na, b'nnal to'ongan ko' itu. Mala'ikat e' bay pinabeya' e' Tuhan amal'ppa aku min deyom pang'ntanan si Herod maka min kala'atan kamemon ya kinabaya'an e' saga Yahudi nihinang ma aku.”  <div eID="gen6725" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3321"/><div sID="gen6726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3321"/> Tasayuna pa'in, magtūy iya pehē' ni luma' si Mariyam, ina' si Yahiya Markus. Aheka a'a bay magtimuk maina'an angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 12:13
verses.text: Kinuku' e' si Petros lawang luma' ati aniya' ipatan d'nda niōnan Roda pehē' ang'nda' bang sai.

verses.name: Acts 12:14
verses.text: Tapanhidna lagam si Petros. Jari lumandu'an kakōganna, angkan halam minsan taukabna lawang. Gom pa'in iya parai'-dai' pareyom pabīng bo' angahaka'an kasehe'anna in si Petros ina'an an'ngge ma luwasan.

verses.name: Acts 12:15
verses.text: “Oy! Binelaw ko' ka'a ilu!” yuk sigām ni si Roda. Sagō' binalik-balikan e'na, in si Petros b'nnal ina'an. Jari yuk sigām, “Mala'ikatna ko' he'.”  <div eID="gen6726" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3322"/><div sID="gen6727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3322"/> Sagō' halam pahali anguku' si Petros, angkan niukab e' sigām lawang. Pag'nda' sigām ma si Petros, tak'bbal atay sigām.

verses.name: Acts 12:17
verses.text: Aninyal si Petros, anoho' sigām da'a ahidjul bo' haka'anna sigām bang buwattingga e' Tuhan bay amal'ppa iya min deyom kalabusu. Yuk si Petros, “Haka'inbi kono' si Yakub maka saga danakantam kasehe' pasal ītu.” Puwas e' ala'an iya minnē' tudju ni lahat saddī.  <div eID="gen6727" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3323"/><div sID="gen6728" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3323"/> Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, aheya kahiluhala'an ma saga sundalu bay jaga inān sabab wa'i daka ma'ai si Petros.

verses.name: Acts 12:19
verses.text: Anguldin sultan Herod, sinō' piniha to'ongan si Petros. Sagō' halam iya tabāk. Manjari sinumariya e' si Herod saga jaga he' bo' soho'na sigām pinapatay. Puwas e' palūd sultan Herod min lahat Yahudiya paliyu ni Kesareya, pat'nna' mahē' daka pilang'llaw.  <div eID="gen6728" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6721" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3324"/><div sID="gen6729" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamatay Sultan Herod</title> <div sID="gen6730" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3324"/> Ma masa inān akagit to'ongan atay sultan Herod ma saga a'a ma lahat Tira maka ma lahat Sidun, angkan saga a'a min karuwa da'ira he' bay magbeya' pa'alop ni iya. Dahū binagay e' sigām si Blastus, dakayu' bata'an ya pangandolan sultan, supaya iya amogbogan sigām. Manjari pehē' na sigām ni si Herod pama'ap, sabab min lahat sultan ya pangā'an sigām balanja'.  <div eID="gen6730" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3325"/><div sID="gen6731" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3325"/> Sakali itu, ta'abut pa'in llaw bay tinugila', amakay na si Herod pakayanna pagsultan. Aningkō' iya ma tingkō'an pagsultananna, maka e'na amaluwas bissalana ma katimukan a'a inān.

verses.name: Acts 12:22
verses.text: Angolang pakosog saga a'a inān. “Ngga'i ka manusiya' ya amissala ilu,” yuk sigām, “sagō' dakayu' tuhan!”

verses.name: Acts 12:23
verses.text: Magtūy si Herod taluwa' bala' e' mala'ikat Tuhan sabab halam bay paheyana Tuhan. Manjari itu amatay iya e' ulat bay amangan isina.  <div eID="gen6731" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3326"/><div sID="gen6732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3326"/> Sagō' pasaplag na pa'in lapal Tuhan, maka paheka isab saga a'a magkahagad.

verses.name: Acts 12:25
verses.text: Pagka aubus na e' si Barnabas maka si Saul ya bay gawi sigām pehē' ni Awrusalam, pabīng sigām ni Antiyuk. Binowa e' sigām sehe' si Yahiya Markus.  <div eID="gen6732" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.12"/> <div eID="gen6729" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3327"/><div sID="gen6733" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Barnabas maka si Saul Pinatuntul</title> <div sID="gen6734" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3327"/> Na, ma saga jama'a si Isa ma Antiyuk, aniya' saga a'a magpalatun lapal min Tuhan, maka aniya' isab magpandu' saga lapalna. Sigām itu ya na si Barnabas, si Simiyun ya niranglay Ettom, si Lukiyus min Kirini, si Saul, maka si Mana'en ya bay dasuligan maka gubnul Herod.

verses.name: Acts 13:2
verses.text: Manjari itu, ma sabu pa'in sigām amudji Tuhan maka amuwasa, amissala Rū Sussi, yuk-i, “Pasaddihinbi aku si Barnabas maka si Saul ilu, bo' tahinang ya pamahinangku ma sigām.”

verses.name: Acts 13:3
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e' sigām angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan maka amuwasa, amat'nna' sigām tangan ma duwangan itu bo' yampa pinalanjal.  <div eID="gen6734" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6733" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3328"/><div sID="gen6735" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Pū' Kiprus</title> <div sID="gen6736" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3328"/> Manjari, pagka si Barnabas maka si Saul itu sinō' pal'ngngan e' Rū Sussi, palūd sigā tudju ni Siluki bo' yampa aleha minnē' tudju ni pū' Kiprus.

verses.name: Acts 13:5
verses.text: At'kka pa'in sigā ni pū' inān, ni kauman Salamis, ninasihat e' sigā lapal Tuhan ma deyom saga kalanggalan Yahudi. Si Yahiya Markus ya anehe'an sigā anabang.  <div eID="gen6736" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3329"/><div sID="gen6737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3329"/> Alatag e' sigā kaluha'an pū' inān sampay ta'abut kauman Papos. Jari aniya' talanggal e' sigā maina'an a'a maghikmat, ōnna si Bal-Isa, bangsa Yahudi. Magnahu'-nahu' iya amalatun lapal min Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 13:7
verses.text: Magbagay asal si Bal-Isa maka si Sirgus Paulus, ya gubnul ma pū' inān. Gubnul itu asal alalom pangita'una. Na, pinalinganan si Barnabas maka si Saul e' gubnul sabab bilahi iya akale lapal Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6737" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3330"/><div sID="gen6738" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3330"/> Sagō' sinagga' duwangan itu e' a'a maghikmat inān. (Elimas ōnna dakayu'.) Ya po'on anagga' si Elimas itu, sabab mbal bilahi bang gubnul inān ganta' magkahagad ma lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 13:9
verses.text: Jari kahōpan Rū Sussi si Saul (ya niōnan isab si Paul). Pinandang e'na a'a maghikmat inān.

verses.name: Acts 13:10
verses.text: Yuk si Paul ma iya, “Anak saitan! Pangangakkal! Jahulaka'! Ai-ai makahāp sagga'nu sadja. Mbal ka pahali amabengkok kal'ngnganan b'nnal ya min Panghū'!

verses.name: Acts 13:11
verses.text: “Buwattina'an t'kkahan ka bala' min Tuhan. Abuta du ka, at'ggol-t'ggol ya mbal ka'nda'nu sawa llaw.” <div eID="gen6738" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6739" type="paragraph"/> Saru'un-du'un du angalendom pang'nda' si Elimas, ati pa'agap-agap iya amiha a'a angambit iya.

verses.name: Acts 13:12
verses.text: Pag'nda' ina'an-i e' gubnul, magkahagad na iya sabab ainu-inu iya ma pamandu' si Paul pasal Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen6739" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6735" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3331"/><div sID="gen6740" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">At'kka disi Paul ni Antiyuk ma Lahat Pisidiya</title> <div sID="gen6741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3331"/> Na, aleha disi Paul min Papos tudju ni Perga, dakayu' da'ira ma lahat Pampiliya. At'kka pa'in sigām pina'an, ang'bba si Yahiya Markus min sigā ati amole' pehē' ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 13:14
verses.text: Pauntas si Paul maka si Barnabas min Perga sampay at'kka na ni Antiyuk, ya Antiyuk mahē' ma lahat Pisidiya. Pag'llaw Sabtu', llaw mulliya ma bangsa Yahudi, pasōd sigā ni deyom langgal Yahudi aningkō' maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 13:15
verses.text: Aniya' binassa maina'an min Kitab Tawrat maka min Kitab Kanabi-nabihan. Puwas e' anambuku saga nakura' langgal ma disi Paul, yuk-i, “Saga danakan, bilahi kami bang aniya' bissalabi pamat'ttog iman saga a'a itu.”  <div eID="gen6741" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3332"/><div sID="gen6742" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3332"/> An'ngge si Paul maka e'na aninyal bo' yampa iya amissala ni saga a'a. Yukna, “Ka'am saga pagkahiku bangsa Isra'il, sampay ka'am ya amudji Tuhan min bangsa saddī, kalehunbi aku.

verses.name: Acts 13:17
verses.text: Saga ka'mbo'-mbo'an kami bay tapene' e' Tuhan, ya asal pagtuhanan kami bangsa Isra'il. Pinaheya e'na bangsa Isra'il waktu kamahē' sigām ma lahat Misil. Pinaluwas sigām e'na min lahat inān min kosog kawasana.

verses.name: Acts 13:18
verses.text: Mpatpū' tahun sigām sinabalan e' Tuhan ma lahat paslangan.

verses.name: Acts 13:19
verses.text: Pitu' bangsa bay pinaka'at e' Tuhan ma lahat Kana'an, ati pamasuku' e'na lahat inān ma saga a'a suku'na.

verses.name: Acts 13:20
verses.text: Ya t'ggol saga pakaradja'an inān saga mpat hatus maka limampū' tahun. <div eID="gen6742" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6743" type="paragraph"/> “Puwas e',” yuk si Paul, “pinat'nna'an sigām e' Tuhan saga a'a maghukum. Ta'abut pa'in ni nabi Samwel ya na he' katobtobanna.

verses.name: Acts 13:21
verses.text: Puwas e', angamu' sigām sultan magagian sigām, angkan pinene' e' Tuhan si Saul anak si Kīs, tubu' si Benjamin. Ati si Saul ya pinat'nna' magsultanan sigām ma deyom mpatpū' tahun.

verses.name: Acts 13:22
verses.text: Manjari si Saul e' bay nila'anan e' Tuhan min pagsultananna, ati si Da'ud ya pinaganti' magsultan. Ya na itu bay pangallam Tuhan ma pasal si Da'ud e', yukna, ‘Si Da'ud, anak si Jesse itu, a'a makasulut atayku. Nihinang e'na kamemon kabaya'anku.’  <div eID="gen6743" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3333"/><div sID="gen6744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3333"/> “Na,” yuk si Paul, “min tubu' si Da'ud asal si Isa, ya bay pinat'nna' e' Tuhan angalappas ma bangsa Isra'il, panuhulna janji'na bay ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: Acts 13:24
verses.text: Ma halam gi' bay tinagna'an e' si Isa hinangna, bay magnasihat si Yahiya ma bangsa Isra'il kamemon. Sinō' sigām e' si Yahiya ang'bba min dusa, ati pinandi taubat.

verses.name: Acts 13:25
verses.text: Na, song pa'in aubus e' si Yahiya ai-ai bay pamahinang iya e' Tuhan, amissala iya ma bangsa Isra'il, yukna, ‘Bang ma pamikilbi, sai bahā' aku itu? Ngga'i ka aku ya lagaranbi. Sagō' aniya' a'a dangan pasunu' min aku. Mbal aku tōp minsan angahubaran engkot taumpa'na.’  <div eID="gen6744" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3334"/><div sID="gen6745" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3334"/> “Na, saga danakanku bangsa Isra'il, sasuku kam panubu' si Ibrahim, sampay ka'am min kabangsahan saddī ya angisbat Tuhan, kitam ko' ya pinakalehan lapal itu, manjari lappasan du kitam min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: Acts 13:27
verses.text: Saga a'a Awrusalam maka saga nakura' sigām, halam makakilā ma si Isa. Malaingkan, pagka iya pinat'nna'an e' sigām hukuman ni kamatay, tatuman e' sigām pagkallam kanabi-nabihan ya pinagbassa ma saga langgal Yahudi kahaba' Sabtu'.

verses.name: Acts 13:28
verses.text: Minsan halam aniya' tabāk e' sigām sababan pamapatay iya, bay sigām angamu' ni gubnul Pilatu sinō' iya pinapatay.

verses.name: Acts 13:29
verses.text: Manjari itu, aubus pa'in pinamattan e' saga a'a Awrusalam kamemon bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab pasal si Isa, pinareyo' mayatna min hāg bo' yampa kinubul.

verses.name: Acts 13:30
verses.text: Saguwā' pinakallum iya e' Tuhan min kamatayna.

verses.name: Acts 13:31
verses.text: Jari allum pa'in iya pabīng, araran iya ta'nda' e' saga a'a bay sehe'na magbeya', min lahat Jalil gi' sampay ni Awrusalam. Jari ma buwattina'an saga a'a bay sehe'na he' anaksi' na ma pasalna ni saga bangsa Isra'il.  <div eID="gen6745" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3335"/><div sID="gen6746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3335"/> “Na,” yuk si Paul, “itiya' kami maitu amasampayan ka'am lapal ahāp. Hatina ya bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma ka'mbo'-mbo'antam

verses.name: Acts 13:33
verses.text: tatuman na ma kitam saga panubu' sigām. Sabab tapakallum e'na si Isa. Magmattan to'ongan ya bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab Jabul, ma kalangan karuwana. Yuk Tuhan e', <lg sID="gen6747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6748"/>‘Ka'a ya anakku,<l eID="gen6748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6749"/>llaw itu pamata'uku in aku mma'nu.’<l eID="gen6749" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6747"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:34
verses.text: Ya na itu isab pangallam Tuhan pasal pamakallumna si Isa pabalik min kamatayna, mbal pinahalu' ma deyom gumi. Yukna, <lg sID="gen6750"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6751"/>‘Buwananta ka saga kahāpan tantu,<l eID="gen6751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6752"/>ya kahāpan bay janji'ku ma si Da'ud.’<l eID="gen6752" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6750"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:35
verses.text: Takallam isab ma ayat kitab dakayu', ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6753"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6754"/>‘Mbal pasagarannu angahalu' ma deyom gumi<l eID="gen6754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6755"/>sosoho'annu asussi atayna.’<l eID="gen6755" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6753"/>  <div eID="gen6746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3336"/><div sID="gen6756" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3336"/> “Si Da'ud ma waktu bay kallumna, bay makahinang kamaksuran Tuhan. Puwas e' amatay iya. Takubul iya ma atag bay pangubulan saga kamatto'ahanna ati angahalu' na baranna.

verses.name: Acts 13:37
verses.text: Sagō' ya pinakallum e' Tuhan min kamatayna itu, halam angahalu'.  <div eID="gen6756" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3337"/><div sID="gen6757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3337"/> “Na, saga dauranakanku, subay kata'uwanbi to'ongan, minsan buwattingga e'bi amogbogan sara' si Musa mbal du kam makapuwas min dusa. Sagō' sasuku kam angandol ma si Isa, apuwas na kam min dusabi kamemon. Angkan lapal pasal si Isa itu ninasihatan ka'am na bo' kata'uwanbi aniya' ka'ampunan dusabi.

verses.name: Acts 13:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3337"/><div sID="gen6757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3337"/> “Na, saga dauranakanku, subay kata'uwanbi to'ongan, minsan buwattingga e'bi amogbogan sara' si Musa mbal du kam makapuwas min dusa. Sagō' sasuku kam angandol ma si Isa, apuwas na kam min dusabi kamemon. Angkan lapal pasal si Isa itu ninasihatan ka'am na bo' kata'uwanbi aniya' ka'ampunan dusabi.

verses.name: Acts 13:40
verses.text: Na, kamaya'-maya' kam bo' mbal pat'kka ni ka'am ya bay tasulat e' kanabi-nabihan, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6758"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6759"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:41
verses.text: ‘Ka'am pangungudju' ilu, nda'unbi ba!<l eID="gen6759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6760"/>Painu-inuhanta kam to'ongan bo' kam magmula, yuk Tuhan.<l eID="gen6760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6761"/>Sabab aniya' hinangku ma waktu kallumbi lagi',<l eID="gen6761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6762"/>hinang mbal kahagadbi, minsan kam pinahati.’ ”<l eID="gen6762" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6758"/> Minnē' aubus bissala si Paul.  <div eID="gen6757" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3338"/><div sID="gen6763" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3338"/> Jari itu, makaluwas pa'in si Paul maka si Barnabas min langgal e', sinō' sigām pabīng e' saga a'a inān ma Sabtu' balik amissala pabalik ma pasal ina'an-i.

verses.name: Acts 13:43
verses.text: Makala'an pa'in isab saga a'a bay ma langgal e', aheka saga a'a bay paturul ma si Paul maka si Barnabas, saga bangsa Yahudi maka saga a'a bangsa saddī ameya' na ma agama Yahudi. Binissalahan saga a'a inān e' disi Paul, sinō' sigām pat'ttog ma tatabangan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6763" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3339"/><div sID="gen6764" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3339"/> Pagsabtu' balik pa'in, agon kamemon saga a'a min da'ira Antiyuk inān magtipun pina'an akale ma lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 13:45
verses.text: Saguwā', pag'nda' saga Yahudi kasehe'an ma ba'anan a'a sikatimukan inān, magtūy sigām angihid ma si Paul, angkan nijawab bissalana e' sigām. Pinahina' isab iya.  <div eID="gen6764" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3340"/><div sID="gen6765" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3340"/> Sagō' gom pa'in paesog si Paul maka si Barnabas amissala. Yuk sigā ma saga a'a angihid e', “Ka'am saga Yahudi wajib nilapalan palman Tuhan dahū. Sagō', pagka sulakbi palman itu ati mbal kam amista di-bi in ka'am tōp pinaniya'an kallum taptap ni kasaumulan, ahāp lagi' kami ang'bba min ka'am. Papinda na kami magnasihat ni saga kabangsahan saddī.

verses.name: Acts 13:47
verses.text: Sabab ya itu bay panoho'an Tuhan ma kami, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6766"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6767"/>‘Sali' kam sapantun sawa pat'nna'ku pamasawa saga kabangsahan saddī,<l eID="gen6767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6768"/>supaya maka'abut lapal itu ni mpat pidju alam,<l eID="gen6768" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6769"/>hatina in manusiya' kamemon makajari lappasan.’ ”<l eID="gen6769" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6766"/>  <div eID="gen6765" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3341"/><div sID="gen6770" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3341"/> Takale pa'in bissala itu e' saga a'a bangsa saddī, magtūy sigām kinōgan ati pinaheya e' sigām lapal Tuhan. Manjari magkahagad na ma si Isa sasuku tapene' e' Tuhan pinaniya'an kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen6770" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3342"/><div sID="gen6771" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3342"/> Patanyag na pa'in lapal Tuhan ma kaluha'an lahat inān.

verses.name: Acts 13:50
verses.text: Saguwā' saga pagnakura'an ma da'ira Antiyuk inān maka saga d'nda bangsahan ya magta'at ni Tuhan, bay ni'isihan lling e' saga Yahudi. Sinō' sigām angala'at si Paul maka si Barnabas, angkan sigā duwangan itu bay pinala'an e' saga a'a inān min jadjahan e'-i.

verses.name: Acts 13:51
verses.text: Sakali pinaspasan e' disi Paul bagunbun min tape' sigā, saksi' in sigā papuwas na min saga a'a ma lahat inān. Puwas e' palanjal sigām tudju ni lahat Ikuni.

verses.name: Acts 13:52
verses.text: Sagō' saga kamuliran si Isa ma da'ira e', kinōgan makalandu' maka kahōpan isab e' Rū Sussi.  <div eID="gen6771" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.13"/> <div eID="gen6740" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3343"/><div sID="gen6772" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Da'ira Ikuni</title> <div sID="gen6773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3343"/> Ma lahat Ikuni pa'in, pasōd si Paul maka si Barnabas ni deyom langgal Yahudi buwat kabiyaksahan sigā. Sidda apaslod bissala sigā angkan landu' aheka saga a'a, Yahudi maka ngga'i ka Yahudi, am'nnal ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 14:2
verses.text: Sagō' saga Yahudi ya agagga am'nnal, bay amidjakan saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi maka bay amala'at atay sigām ni sasuku am'nnal ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 14:3
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol ya kahanti' disi Paul ma Ikuni. Halam aniya' tāw sigā amissalahan saga a'a pasal Panghū' Isa. Maka si Isa bay amaniya'an sigā kawasa pangahinang saga hinang makainu-inu maka saga paltanda'an, bo' supaya pinarassaya in lapal sigā pasal kaheya tabang Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 14:4
verses.text: Abahagi' duwa saga a'a ma da'ira he'. Aniya' sigām kasehe' bay amogbogan saga Yahudi, aniya' isab kasehe' amogbogan disi Paul.

verses.name: Acts 14:5
verses.text: Jari magisun saga a'a bangsa saddī maka saga Yahudi, beya' saga pagnakura'an sigām. Ya pagisun sigām angala'ug maka amantung disi Paul.

verses.name: Acts 14:6
verses.text: Tata'u pa'in pagisun itu e' disi Paul, magtūy sigā alahi tudju ni da'ira Listara maka da'ira Derbe, ya ma lahat Likauna sampay ni saga kaluma'an ma sakalibut ina'an-i.

verses.name: Acts 14:7
verses.text: Ati pinasaplag e' sigā maina'an lapal ahāp pasal si Isa.  <div eID="gen6773" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6772" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3344"/><div sID="gen6774" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma da'ira Listara</title> <div sID="gen6775" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3344"/> Sakali itu aniya' aningkō' ma Listara inān a'a aku'il tape'na, halam bay makal'ngngan sangay min kapaganak ma iya.

verses.name: Acts 14:9
verses.text: Akale to'ongan a'a itu ma bissala si Paul. Pinatongan iya pahāp, ati kinata'uwan e' si Paul in a'a itu taga-pangandol ma si Isa in iya kauli'an du e'na.

verses.name: Acts 14:10
verses.text: Manjari pinatanog e' si Paul suwalana, yukna, “An'ngge ka pabontol!” Magtūy pabuwang a'a inān an'ngge maka e'na lum'ngngan.  <div eID="gen6775" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3345"/><div sID="gen6776" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3345"/> Pag'nda' ba'anan a'a inān ma bay tahinang si Paul e', magtūy sigām angolang ma bahasa sigām Likauna, yuk-i, “Itiya' saga tuhan magpasalupa manusiya' pareyo' ni kitam.”

verses.name: Acts 14:12
verses.text: Manjari aniya' ōn tuhan ya pangōn saga a'a inān ma disi Paul. Si Siyus ya pangōn sigām ma si Barnabas, maka si Hermes ya pangōn sigām ma si Paul sabab in iya bibissalahun.

verses.name: Acts 14:13
verses.text: Ya luma' pangarapan ma tuhan Siyus, ina'an ma luwasan lawang da'ira. Manjari aniya' sapi' mandangan ginuyud ni atag lawang inān e' imam maghinang ni tuhan Siyus. Aniya' isab tuhugan sumping tabowana sabab in iya maka kaheka'an a'a inān bilahi anumbali' sapi' pangahulmat sigām ma disi Paul.  <div eID="gen6776" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3346"/><div sID="gen6777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3346"/> Sagō' pagta'u si Barnabas maka si Paul bang ai song nihinang e' saga a'a inān, magtūy gineret s'mmek sigā, tanda' sin susa sigā. Sakali paragan sigā ni t'ngnga' pagtimukan a'a inān maka e' sigā angolang, yuk-i,

verses.name: Acts 14:15
verses.text: “Oy, saga tuwan! Angay buwattilu hinangbi ma kami? Manusiya' du kami buwat ka'am. Ya po'on kami pi'itu sabab lapal ahāp ya pangahaka kami ma ka'am, supaya kam pataikut min pagtuhananbi ilu, ya halam aniya' kapūsanna. Bay kami pi'itu bo' kam papinda ni Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama, ya bay amapanjari langit maka gintana'an maka tahik sampay kakaya'-kaya'anna kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 14:16
verses.text: Ma masa awal in kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon bay pinasagaran e' Tuhan ameya' ma ai-ai kabaya'an sigām.

verses.name: Acts 14:17
verses.text: Sagō' minsan buwattē', aniya' na pa'in saksi' pamamattan manusiya' pasal kapagtuhanna. Pina'nda'an e'na kahāpna, binuwanan kam ulan pamusug tinanombi bo' aniya' buwa'na bang ta'abut musimna. Pinaniya'an kam pagkakan aheka, maka pinalasig ataybi.”

verses.name: Acts 14:18
verses.text: Minsan buwattē' pamahati disi Paul mbal agon pahawid saga a'a. Subay magkulban to'ongan ni sigām.  <div eID="gen6777" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3347"/><div sID="gen6778" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3347"/> Manjari itu aniya' at'kka ni da'ira Listara he' saga Yahudi bay min Antiyuk ma Pisidiya maka aniya' min Ikuni. Jari tabowa-bowa e' sigām saga katimukan a'a inān, ati pinagbantung si Paul. Puwas e' ginuyud iya e' sigām tudju paluwas min kaluma'an inān pagka kinabā' amatay na.

verses.name: Acts 14:20
verses.text: Sagō' kapagtimukan pa'in si Paul e' saga bebeya'an si Isa, magtūy iya an'ngge bo' pabīng ni deyom da'ira. Pagk'llat llaw dakayu', palanjal iya maka si Barnabas tudju ni Derbe.  <div eID="gen6778" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6774" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3348"/><div sID="gen6779" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pabalik disi Paul ni Antiyuk ma Siriya</title> <div sID="gen6780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3348"/> Mahē' pa'in sigā ma Derbe, ninasihat e' sigā lapal ahāp ni saga a'a mahē', ati aheka tabowa ameya' ma si Isa. Puwas e', pabīng sigā ni Antiyuk labay min Listara maka Ikuni.

verses.name: Acts 14:22
verses.text: Pinahogot e' disi Paul iman saga bebeya'an si Isa mahē'. Sinō' sigām pat'ttog angandol ma Tuhan. Yuk pandu' disi Paul, “Subay aheka katiksa'an kalabayanta bo' kita pinasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.”

verses.name: Acts 14:23
verses.text: Aniya' a'a gin'llal e' sigā pagmatto'ahan saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi, maingga-maingga aniya' lahat pagtipunan sigām. Amuwasa disi Paul sampay angamu'-ngamu' bo' pajagahanna saga a'a inān ma Tuhan, ya pangandolan na e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 14:24
verses.text: Tauntas pa'in lahat Pisidiya e' disi Paul, at'kka sigā ni Pampiliya.

verses.name: Acts 14:25
verses.text: Palanjal isab ni da'ira Perga, bo' ninasihat e' sigā lapal Tuhan maina'an. Puwas e' palūd sigām tudju ni Attali.  <div eID="gen6780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3349"/><div sID="gen6781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3349"/> Aleha na sigā minnē' bo' pabīng ni Antiyuk dakayu', ni saga bebeya'an si Isa ya bay amajagahan sigā ma Tuhan bo' makahinang ai-ai pangahandakna.

verses.name: Acts 14:27
verses.text: Makatandan pa'in sigā ni Antiyuk, pinatipun e' sigā saga jama'a si Isa maina'an. Nihaka'an sigām e' disi Paul kamemon bay tahinang sigā, ma sabab tabang min Tuhan. Kabuwanan labayan kono' saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi bo' supaya makapangandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 14:28
verses.text: At'ggol disi Paul paralahat ma saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an ma Antiyuk.  <div eID="gen6781" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.14"/> <div eID="gen6779" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3350"/><div sID="gen6782" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagisunan ma Awrusalam</title> <div sID="gen6783" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3350"/> Manjari itu aniya' saga a'a at'kka ni Antiyuk bay min lahat Yahudiya, ati pinandu'an e' sigām saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an. Yuk pamandu' sigām, “Mbal kam makajari alappas bang kam mbal taislam buwat panoho'an sara' si Musa!”

verses.name: Acts 15:2
verses.text: Nijawab to'ongan saga a'a inān e' si Paul maka si Barnabas, binowa maglugat ma sabab pamandu' sigām buwattē'. Angkan na si Paul maka si Barnabas maka saga bebeya'an kasehe' min Antiyuk inān ginara'an pehē' ni Awrusalam. Sinō' sigām amowa saga a'a kawakilan maka saga pagmatto'ahan maina'an magbissala pasal palkala' inān.  <div eID="gen6783" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3351"/><div sID="gen6784" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3351"/> Na, pinalanjal disi Paul e' saga jama'a ma Antiyuk. Paglintas sigām pa'in labay min lahat Piniki maka min Samariya, nihaka e' sigām maina'an pasal saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi ya papinda na ni Tuhan. Landu' kinōgan saga bebeya'an si Isa, pagkale sigām ma lapal disi Paul itu.

verses.name: Acts 15:4
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām pehē' ni Awrusalam, sinagina sigām e' saga jama'a si Isa mahē', sampay saga a'a kawakilan maka saga pagmatto'ahan. Nihaka'an sigām e' disi Paul pasal kamemon bay tahinang e' sigā deyo' bay min Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 15:5
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' saga Parisi angandol ma si Isa bay an'ngge amissala. Yuk sigām, “Saga a'a angandol ma si Isa min bangsa saddī inān subay ni'islam dahū, maka subay sigām amogbog ma sara' si Musa.”  <div eID="gen6784" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3352"/><div sID="gen6785" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3352"/> Jari magsakaum saga a'a kawakilan maka saga pagmatto'ahan amikil-mikil pasal palkala' inān.

verses.name: Acts 15:7
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in e' sigām magbissala, an'ngge si Petros amissala. Yukna, “Ka'am saga dauranakanku, kata'uwanbi du: ma waktu palabay inān bay aku tapene' e' Tuhan min deyomanbi, sinō' magnasihat lapal ahāp ni saga kabangsahan saddī, ya ngga'i ka Yahudi, bo' supaya sigām makakale sampay magkahagad.

verses.name: Acts 15:8
verses.text: Jari in Tuhan, ya makata'u bang ai ma deyom atay manusiya', bay amuwan Rū Sussi ma kabangsahan saddī buwat bay pamuwanna ma kitam, tanda' palsaksi'an in iya kasulutan na ma sigām.

verses.name: Acts 15:9
verses.text: Sigām maka kitam itu mbal pinapagbidda' e' Tuhan. Sinussi e'na pangatayan sigām labay min pangandol sigām ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 15:10
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Petros, “angay subay pakagitbi atay Tuhan? Angay pahunitanbi saga a'a ya soho'bi amogbogan sara' si Musa? Parahāl minsan kitam maka ka'mbo'-mbo'antam mbal maka'aku amogbog.

verses.name: Acts 15:11
verses.text: Da'a na. Magkahagad kitam ma Panghū' Isa ati lappasan kitam sabab min ase'na maka lasana. Damikiyanna isab saga a'a min kabangsahan saddī inān.”  <div eID="gen6785" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3353"/><div sID="gen6786" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3353"/> Minnē' pahondong magsuli-suli saga a'a magsakaum inān kamemon hinabu sigām akale ma pangahaka si Barnabas maka si Paul. Pinata'u sigām pasal saga paltanda'an maka saga hinang makainu-inu kamemon deyo' bay min Tuhan ya bay tahinang e' sigā ma deyoman saga a'a ya ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 15:13
verses.text: Aubus pa'in sigām angahaka, paganti' si Yakub amissala. “Ka'am saga dauranakanku,” yukna, “kalehunbi na aku.

verses.name: Acts 15:14
verses.text: Bay kami pinahati e' si Simun itu insini' pasal katagna' Tuhan bay ama'nda'an pagka'inagonna ma saga a'a ya ngga'i ka Yahudi. Sabab aniya' saga a'a pene'na min sigām nihinang a'a suku'na.

verses.name: Acts 15:15
verses.text: Atayudtud isab sulat saga kanabi-nabihan, iya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen6787"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6788"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:16
verses.text: ‘Puwas itu, yuk Tuhan, pabīng du aku,<l eID="gen6788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6789"/>ati bawi'ku pagsultan si Da'ud, ya sapantun luma' alarak.<l eID="gen6789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6790"/>Bangunku pabalik, batukku pagdayawna bay alarak e',<l eID="gen6790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6791"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:17
verses.text: supaya aku piniha e' saga manusiya' takapin,<l eID="gen6791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6792"/>beya' isab saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi<l eID="gen6792" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6793"/>ya kaōnan maka ōnku.<l eID="gen6793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6794"/>Pangallam Panghū' ko' itu,<l eID="gen6794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6795"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:18
verses.text: ya makahinang kamemon saga pakaradja'an itu.<l eID="gen6795" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6796"/>Kasakupan ko' itu sangay min awal.<l eID="gen6796" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6787"/>  <div eID="gen6786" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3354"/><div sID="gen6797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3354"/> “Na,” yuk si Yakub, “buwattitu panganggara'ku: subay mbal sasawtam saga a'a min kabangsahan saddī ya papinda na ameya' ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 15:20
verses.text: Sagō' subay sigām pabeya'antam sulat buwattitu: da'a kam amangan haram buwat ai-ai paglamas ni saga ta'u-ta'u, da'a kam maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla, da'a kam amangan isi hayop bay pin'kkol, maka da'a amangan laha'.

verses.name: Acts 15:21
verses.text: Saga sara' panoho'an si Musa pinagbassa na pa'in sakahaba' Sabtu' ma kalanggalantam Yahudi. Lāgi in pandu' si Musa pinagnasihat na pa'in ma kada'irahan sangay min awal lagi'.”  <div eID="gen6797" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6782" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3355"/><div sID="gen6798" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sulat ni saga Almasihin ya Ngga'i ka Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3355"/> Manjari magkagara'an saga a'a kawakilan maka saga pagmatto'ahan maka saga jama'a inān kamemon, amene' saga a'a min deyoman sigām bo' pinapehē' ni Antiyuk, pinasehe' ma si Paul maka si Barnabas. Jari ya pinene' inān si Judas Barsabbas maka si Silas. Duwangan itu asal pinagaddatan e' dauranakan sigā bebeya'an si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 15:23
verses.text: Aniya' isab sulat pinabowa ma sigā, yuk-i: <div eID="gen6799" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6800" type="paragraph"/> “Sulat itu deyo' min kami dauranakanbi, saga a'a kawakilan maka pagmatto'ahan maitu ma Awrusalam. Pinasampay itu ni ka'am saga dauranakan bangsa saddī ya maglahat mailu ma Antiyuk, ma Siriya, sampay saga ma Silisi. <div eID="gen6800" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6801" type="paragraph"/> Aheya pagaddat kami ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen6801" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3356"/><div sID="gen6802" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3356"/> Takale kami aniya' kono' saga l'lla min deyoman kami bay pi'ilu amasusa ka'am sampay anasaw pikilanbi ma sabab pandu' sigām. Sagō' ngga'i ka min panoho'an kami ya angkan sigām amandu' buwattē'.

verses.name: Acts 15:25
verses.text: Angkan kami bay magisun kamemon subay amene' saga a'a maitu bo' sinō' pi'ilu ni ka'am. Jari pasehe' kami sigām ma si Barnabas maka si Paul, bagay kami kinalasahan.

verses.name: Acts 15:26
verses.text: Disi Paul itu bay magmalilla' ma kallum sigām ma sabab Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Acts 15:27
verses.text: Manjari itiya' na si Judas maka si Silas, bay soho' kami pi'ilu pabaran ni ka'am angahaka'an ka'am ai-ai bay tasulat kami itu.

verses.name: Acts 15:28
verses.text: Dauyunan kami maka Rū Sussi, in ka'am ilu subay mbal pinahunitan liyu min saga panoho'an itu, ya wajib bineya':

verses.name: Acts 15:29
verses.text: da'a kam amangan ai-ai bay paglamas ni saga ta'u-ta'u, da'a kam amangan laha', da'a kam amangan isi hayop bay pin'kkol, maka da'a isab kam maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla. Bang halli'anbi he'-i, makahāp to'ongan ma ka'am. Mura-murahan, wassalam.”  <div eID="gen6802" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3357"/><div sID="gen6803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3357"/> Jari itu pinal'ngngan na saga a'a amowa sulat inān tudju ni Antiyuk. Pagt'kka pa'in sigā pina'an, pinatipun e' sigā saga a'a dajama'a maina'an bo' ni'nde'an sulat inān.

verses.name: Acts 15:31
verses.text: Pagbassa pa'in, magtūy sigām kinōgan to'ongan, sabab sulat inān makalasig atay sigām.

verses.name: Acts 15:32
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol isab pamissala si Judas maka si Silas pamahogot maka pamakosog pangandol saga jama'a inān, sabab aniya' kapandayan bay pamuwan Tuhan ma sigā magpalatun palmanna.

verses.name: Acts 15:33
verses.text: Palabay pa'in daka pilang'llaw, pinatuntul sigā e' saga dauranakan, yuk-i “Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam asalamat.” Jari amole' na sigā ni bay anoho' sigā.

verses.name: Acts 15:34
verses.text: (Sagō' si Silas bilahi lagi' pat'nna' maina'an.)

verses.name: Acts 15:35
verses.text: In si Paul maka si Barnabas pahanti' gi' ma Antiyuk, magbeya' maka ba'anan a'a kasehe' magpandu' maka magnasihat lapal Panghū'.  <div eID="gen6803" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6798" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3358"/><div sID="gen6804" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbutas si Paul maka si Barnabas</title> <div sID="gen6805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3358"/> Apuwas pa'in daka pilambahangi, ah'lling si Paul ni si Barnabas, yukna, “Sūng kita patibaw pabīng ni saga dauranakanta bebeya'an si Isa ma kada'irahan kamemon bay pagnasihatanta lapal Tuhan e'. Tibawta bang buwattingga na kahālan sigām.”

verses.name: Acts 15:37
verses.text: Si Barnabas inān bilahi amowa si Yahiya Markus pasehe' ma sigā,

verses.name: Acts 15:38
verses.text: sagō' bang ma bistahan si Paul si Markus itu mbal tōp panehe', sabab bay iya ang'bbahan sigām bay mahē' gi' ma Pampiliya. Halam iya bay makatatas anabangan sigām.

verses.name: Acts 15:39
verses.text: Aheya paglugat si Paul maka si Barnabas angkan sigā magbutas. Malaingkan si Barnabas bay amowa si Markus ati atulak sigā karuwangan tudju ni pū' Kiprus.

verses.name: Acts 15:40
verses.text: Si Paul ya amene' si Silas pasehe' ma iya. Sōng pa'in sigā atulak min Antiyuk, pinajagahan sigā ma Tuhan e' saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an maka niamu'an tatabanganna.

verses.name: Acts 15:41
verses.text: Ala'an pa'in si Paul minnē', palabay iya min lahat Siriya maka min lahat Silisi. Maingga-maingga lahat aniya' saga jama'a si Isa magtipun, pinahogot e'na pangandol sigām.  <div eID="gen6805" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.15"/> <div eID="gen6804" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3359"/><div sID="gen6806" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Timuti Pabunyug ma disi Paul</title> <div sID="gen6807" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3359"/> Manjari palanjal si Paul tudju ni Derbe maka ni Listara. Aniya' ma Listara dakayu' bebeya'an si Isa niōnan si Timuti. Ina'na bangsa Yahudi angandol ma si Isa, ati mma'na bangsa Girīk.

verses.name: Acts 16:2
verses.text: Si Timuti itu binissalahan ahāp e' saga bebeya'an si Isa, ya ma Listara maka ma Ikuni inān.

verses.name: Acts 16:3
verses.text: Bilahi na si Paul amowa si Timuti sehe'na ma pal'ngnganan, angkan iya ni'islam dahū e' si Paul bo' mbal tasoway e' saga Yahudi ma jadjahan ina'an. Sababna kinata'uwan e' saga Yahudi kamemon in mma' si Timuti bangsa Girīk.

verses.name: Acts 16:4
verses.text: Na, pauntas na disi Paul ni saga kalahat-lahatan bo' nihaka'an e' sigām saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an pasal kagara'an bay min saga a'a kawakilan maka saga pagmatto'ahan ma Awrusalam. Sinō' saga bebeya'an inān ameya' ma kagara'an e'.

verses.name: Acts 16:5
verses.text: Jari itu pahogot na pa'in pangandol jama'a si Isa ma saga palhimpunan ma kalahatan inān, maka pasōng isab heka sigām sakahaba' llaw.  <div eID="gen6807" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6806" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3360"/><div sID="gen6808" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aniya' Papanyata' ni si Paul</title> <div sID="gen6809" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3360"/> Na, niuntas e' disi Paul lahat Prigiya maka lahat Galatiya, sabab pinaggat sigām e' Rū Sussi sinō' da'a magnasihat lapal Tuhan maina'an ma kalingkal lahat Asiya.

verses.name: Acts 16:7
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in tobtoban lahat Misiya, pasulay sigām palanjal ni lahat Bitiniya sagō' pinaggat sigām e' Rū si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 16:8
verses.text: Angkan sigām pauntas labay min t'ngnga' lahat Misiya sampay palūd na ni Trowas.

verses.name: Acts 16:9
verses.text: Ma Trowas pa'in bo' sangom na, aniya' pa'nda' ni si Paul. Ta'nda'na a'a min Makidunya mikitabang ma iya. Yuk a'a itu, “Pi'itu ka parambila' ni Makidunya bo' kami tabangun!”

verses.name: Acts 16:10
verses.text: Aubus pa'in si Paul maka'nda' ina'an-i, magtūy kami magsakap atulak ni Makidunya, sabab kata'uwan kami in kami sinoho' e' Tuhan anganasihat lapal ahāp ni saga a'a mahē'.  <div eID="gen6809" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6808" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3361"/><div sID="gen6810" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Lidiya Papinda Ameya' ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen6811" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3361"/> Makauntas pa'in kami min Trowas, patūy kami tudju ni pū' Samoterak. Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, pauntas na isab kami min pū' ina'an tudju ni Neyapoles.

verses.name: Acts 16:12
verses.text: Pagt'kka kami ni Neyapoles patukad kami tudju ni Pilipi, da'ira aheya ma kalingkal Makidunya, paglahatan bangsa Rōm isab. Pahanti' kami maina'an daka pilang'llaw.

verses.name: Acts 16:13
verses.text: Pagsabtu', paluwas kami min da'ira inān tudju ni bihing sapa', sabab ma tokoran kami aniya' pagsambahayangan saga Yahudi maina'an. Jari aningkō' kami amissala ma saga kar'ndahan ya patipun maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 16:14
verses.text: Aniya' inān d'nda niōnan si Lidiya akale ma kami, d'nda min da'ira Tiyatira. Ya usahana maglitu kakana' taluk, kakana' ahalga'. D'nda itu magta'at asal ni Tuhan. Hinabuna akale ma kami, kabuwanan iya pikilan e' Panghū' Isa ati kinahagad e'na bissala si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 16:15
verses.text: Jari pinandi disi Lidiya maka saga sehe'na karaluma', palsaksi'an in sigām ma si Isa na. Puwas e' sinō' kami e' si Lidiya paokom ma deyomanna. Yuk si Lidiya, “Bang aku tabistabi angandol na sab'nnal-b'nnal ma Panghū', pi'itu kam paokom ma luma'ku.” Jari talogos kami e'na.  <div eID="gen6811" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6810" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3362"/><div sID="gen6812" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul maka si Silas Kinalabusu ma Pilipi</title> <div sID="gen6813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3362"/> Manjari itu, ma labayan pa'in kami tudju ni pagsambahayangan e', aniya' talanggal kami dakayu' d'nda banyaga'. Pagkasōran iya saitan angkan iya makapangalimal, ati aheya isab paluntungan saga a'a ya tag-dapuna luwas min pangalimalna.

verses.name: Acts 16:17
verses.text: Paturul na pa'in iya ma kami maka si Paul, maka e'na angolang patanog, yuk-i, “Saga a'a itu sosoho'an Tuhan Mahatinggi! Sigām ya angahaka'an ka'am bang buwattingga kam lappasan!”  <div eID="gen6813" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3363"/><div sID="gen6814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3363"/> Mbal pahali paglinganna buwattē' daka pilang'llaw. Ya kat'kkahanna ap'ddi' pikilan si Paul, angkan iya palingi' ni d'nda inān bo' pah'llinganna saitan ya ma iya, “Min kawasa ōn si Isa Al-Masi,” yuk si Paul, “soho'ta ka paluwas min d'nda ilu!” Saru'un-du'un du magtūy paluwas saitan e', ati d'nda inān mbal na makapangalimal.  <div eID="gen6814" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3364"/><div sID="gen6815" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3364"/> Makata'u pa'in saga tag-dapu d'nda inān in iya mbal na kapangusaha'an, magtūy sinaggaw e' sigām si Paul maka si Silas. Ginuyud sigā karuwangan ni pagtabu'an bo' pinaharap ni saga pagnakura'an da'ira.

verses.name: Acts 16:20
verses.text: Tin'kkahan isab sigā ni saga bag'llal bangsa Rōm ya maghuhukum maina'an. Yuk panuntut saga tag-dapu d'nda inān, “Saga a'a itu hal angahinang kasasawan ma lahattam. Bangsa Yahudi ko' sigā itu.

verses.name: Acts 16:21
verses.text: Pamandu' e' sigā saga addat mbal taluwa' bang ma sara'tam bangsa Rōm. Mbal kami wajib anaima' atawa angahinang saga addat buwattē'.”  <div eID="gen6815" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3365"/><div sID="gen6816" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3365"/> Manjari palamud ba'anan a'a ya bay maina'an ati ameya'-meya' anganjuri disi Paul. Magpanoho'an saga bag'llal inān subay nihurusan s'mmek disi Paul bo' niraplosan.

verses.name: Acts 16:23
verses.text: Makalandu' abisa ya pangandaplos ma sigā bo' yampa sigā ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu. Sinō' isab tunggu' kalabusu pinahogot pangalabusuna ma sigā.

verses.name: Acts 16:24
verses.text: Pagkale uldin itu e' tunggu', magtūy ni'isi e'na disi Paul ni t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' kalabusu bo' pinasungan e'na tape' sigā maka papan aheya.  <div eID="gen6816" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3366"/><div sID="gen6817" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3366"/> Jari itu, saga tonga' bahangi pa'in, angamu'-ngamu' si Paul maka si Silas ni Tuhan, magkalangan isab pamudji sigā ma iya. Akale ma sigā saga pilisu kasehe'an inān.

verses.name: Acts 16:26
verses.text: Taggaha' sadja aniya' linug akosog, ajogjog papagan kalabusu inān. Saru'un-du'un du paukab tambolna kamemon, apakpak isab saga kilikili min tape'-tangan saga pilisu inān.

verses.name: Acts 16:27
verses.text: Tabati' tunggu' kalabusu, ati pag'nda'na aukab saga tambol, pangannalna wa'i makal'ppa saga pilisu. Magtūy nihublut kalisna, arak amapatay di-na.

verses.name: Acts 16:28
verses.text: Sagō' angalingan si Paul pakosog, yukna, “Da'a ka angamula di-nu! Itiya' du kami kamemon.”  <div eID="gen6817" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3367"/><div sID="gen6818" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3367"/> Angalingan tunggu' inān angamu' palita'an bo' pasa'ut pareyom. Pasujud iya amidpid ma atag tape' si Paul maka si Silas.

verses.name: Acts 16:30
verses.text: Sakali niambit sigā e'na paluwas bo' yampa sigā tilawna. “Saga tuwan,” yukna, “ai subay hinangku bo' aku lappasan?”  <div eID="gen6818" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3368"/><div sID="gen6819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3368"/> Yuk disi Paul, “Angandol ka ma Panghū' Isa, ati lappasan du ka sampay saga sehe'nu karaluma'.”

verses.name: Acts 16:32
verses.text: Puwas e' ninasihat lapal Tuhan ni tunggu' kalabusu inān sampay ni a'a kamemon ma deyom luma'na.

verses.name: Acts 16:33
verses.text: Jari alalom pa'in bahangi, binowa sigā paluwas e' tunggu' kalabusu ati kose'anna pali' sigā. Pinandi isab tunggu' inān karamata'an, tanda' in sigām ma si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 16:34
verses.text: Pagubus, binowa disi Paul e' tunggu' inān ni luma'na ati pinakan. Landu' aheya kakōg-koyagan sigām karaluma' sabab Tuhan na ya pagkahagaran sigām.  <div eID="gen6819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3369"/><div sID="gen6820" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3369"/> Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, magpanoho'an saga bag'llal ma saga tendog sigām, sinō' amowa uldin pehē' ni kalabusu. Yuk uldin e', “Pal'ppahun na saga a'a ilu.”

verses.name: Acts 16:36
verses.text: Yuk jaga kalabusu ma si Paul, “Magpanoho'an saga bag'llal in ka'a maka si Silas makajari na pinaluwas. Wajib na kam ala'an, bang pa'in kam asalamat isab,” yukna.  <div eID="gen6820" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3370"/><div sID="gen6821" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3370"/> Sagō' ah'lling si Paul ni saga tendog e', yukna, “Bay kami niraplosan e' sigām di'ilaw ma mata mairan, minsan kami halam bay sinumariya. Bo' pa'in a'a Rōm du kami. Ni'isi isab kami ni deyom kalabusu. Ati bilahi na sigām amaluwas kami ma halam aniya' makata'u. Ā, mbal makajari!” yuk si Paul. “Subay magbaran pi'itu saga bag'llal ilu amaluwas kami.”  <div eID="gen6821" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3371"/><div sID="gen6822" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3371"/> Manjari pehē' na saga tendog inān angahaka'an saga bag'llal pasal h'lling si Paul. Pagkale saga bag'llal aniya' kataddangan disi Paul in sigā bangsa Rōm, tināw sigām

verses.name: Acts 16:39
verses.text: angkan pina'an ni disi Paul pama'ap. Puwas e' binowa disi Paul e' saga bag'llal e' paluwas min kalabusu. Ya pangamu' sigām ma si Paul bang pa'in ala'an min da'ira sigām.

verses.name: Acts 16:40
verses.text: Manjari pina'an si Paul maka si Silas ni luma' si Lidiya. Mag'nda' sigām maka bebeya'an si Isa maina'an, ati amissala disi Paul pamahogot atay sigām. Puwas e' atulak na disi Paul.  <div eID="gen6822" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.16"/> <div eID="gen6812" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3372"/><div sID="gen6823" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Da'ira Tessaloneka</title> <div sID="gen6824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3372"/> Manjari itu tauntas e' disi Paul da'ira Ampipoli maka Apollon, bo' yampa at'kka ni da'ira Tessaloneka. Na, aniya' maina'an dakayu' langgal Yahudi,

verses.name: Acts 17:2
verses.text: ati pina'an si Paul sabab ya na asal kabiyaksahanna. Jari t'llu Sabtu' ya pagbissalana maka saga a'a maina'an pasal pamandu' ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: Acts 17:3
verses.text: Pinahatian sigām e'na, maka pinandu'an sab'nnal-b'nnal min deyom Kitab pasal Al-Masi subay makalabay kabinasahan maka pinapatay, maka subay pinakallum pabīng min kamatayna. Yuk si Paul, “Si Isa ya pagnasihatku itu ma ka'am, in iya Al-Masi, ya asal tapene' e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Acts 17:4
verses.text: Saga Yahudi kasehe' inān bay tabowa magkahagad ati palamud ma si Paul maka si Silas. Aheka isab saga bangsa Girīk ya magtata'at ni Tuhan maka aheka d'nda bangsahan bay palamud.  <div eID="gen6824" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3373"/><div sID="gen6825" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3373"/> Sagō' angihid saga Yahudi kasehe', angkan pinatipun e' sigām saga a'a min katabu'an, a'a bula'ug, sinō' amapaghiluhala' da'ira inān. Nirumpās luma' si Jason pamiha'an sigām ma disi Paul bo' binowa paluwas ni katimukan a'a.

verses.name: Acts 17:6
verses.text: Saguwā', pagka halam tabāk e' sigām disi Paul, ginuyud e' sigām si Jason maka saga bebeya'an si Isa kasehe' tudju ni kabag'llalan. Angolang saga Yahudi inān, yuk-i, “Itiya' pasampay ni da'iratam duwangan a'a ya bay amuwan kasasawan ma kalahat-lahatan.

verses.name: Acts 17:7
verses.text: Maka si Jason itu bay angokoman sigā ma deyom luma'na. Sigām kamemon itu angalanggal sara' Sultan Mahatinggi pagka yuk sigām aniya' sultan saddī, niōnan Isa!”

verses.name: Acts 17:8
verses.text: Pagkale bissala itu e' katimukan a'a inān maka e' saga bag'llal, magtūy sigām ahiluhala'.

verses.name: Acts 17:9
verses.text: Si Jason maka saga sehe'na inān bay sinō' amayad ni bag'llal pamiyansa baran sigām. Puwas e' pinapole' na sigām.  <div eID="gen6825" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6823" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3374"/><div sID="gen6826" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Da'ira Bereya</title> <div sID="gen6827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3374"/> Pagabay-kohap pa'in, pinalanjal si Paul maka si Silas e' saga bebeya'an si Isa inān, sinō' pehē' ni da'ira Bereya. Pagt'kka sigām pina'an, pasōd sigām ni langgal Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 17:11
verses.text: Saga Yahudi maina'an labi alunuk atay sigām min saga Yahudi bay ma Tessaloneka. Kinōgan sigām to'ongan akale ma lapal disi Paul. Pinariksa' e' sigām sulat Kitab llaw-llaw pang'nda'an sigām bang b'nnal ya pamandu' e' si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 17:12
verses.text: Jari aheka saga a'a Bereya magkahagad ma si Isa, sampay saga d'nda bangsahan min bangsa Girīk maka saga l'lla Girīk isab.  <div eID="gen6827" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3375"/><div sID="gen6828" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3375"/> Saguwā', makata'u pa'in saga Yahudi min Tessaloneka in si Paul ina'an na isab ma Bereya anganasihat lapal Tuhan, paturul sigām pina'an. Pinitna-pitnahan e' sigām kaheka'an a'a Bereya inān, binowa magkasasawan.

verses.name: Acts 17:14
verses.text: Magtūy ginara'an si Paul, sinō' palūd kaut. Sagō' si Silas maka si Timuti angalagad gi' maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 17:15
verses.text: Saga a'a ya amowa si Paul palūd inān bay anehe'an iya sampay ni da'ira Aten. Puwas e' amole' sigām ni Bereya maka e' sigām amowa tambuku ni si Silas maka si Timuti. Sinō' pasa'ut ni Aten parakayu' ni si Paul.  <div eID="gen6828" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6826" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3376"/><div sID="gen6829" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Da'ira Aten</title> <div sID="gen6830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3376"/> Manjari itu, ma da'ira Aten pa'in si Paul angalagaran si Silas maka si Timuti, landu' asukkal pikilanna pag'nda'na ma da'ira inān ap'nno' e' ta'u-ta'u ya pagtuhanan saga a'a maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 17:17
verses.text: Angkanna iya pehē' ni langgal Yahudi magsambung himumungan maka saga Yahudi maka saga a'a bangsa saddī ya magta'at ma Tuhan. Ya du ma halaman da'ira inān, sakahaba' llaw magsuli-suli na pa'in iya maka sasuku palabay minna'an.

verses.name: Acts 17:18
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga guru ameya' magjawab. Ya bineya' e' saga guru itu saga pamandu' si Epikuru, atawa pandu' saga a'a niōnan Istuwik. Pagkale saga a'a itu ma pagnasihat si Paul pasal si Isa maka kallumna pabīng min kamatay, yuk kasehe'an, “Daka ai pinah'lling e' a'a magligaw itu!” <div eID="gen6830" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6831" type="paragraph"/> Yuk isab kasehe', “Kilāku, a'a itu amissala pasal saga tuhan saddī, ya pagtutuhanan bangsa liyu.”

verses.name: Acts 17:19
verses.text: Angkanna si Paul binowa e' sigām ni palhimpunan Aten, ya niōnan palhimpunan Areyopagos. Yuk sigām ni si Paul, “Bilahi kami makata'u pasal pandu' baha'u ya pamissalanu ilu.

verses.name: Acts 17:20
verses.text: Saddī-saddī isab pandu'nu ilu, angkan kami bilahi ana'u bang ai hatina.”

verses.name: Acts 17:21
verses.text: Sababna saga a'a porol maka saga a'a liyu ya maglahat ma Aten inān, kabintanan asal magsuli-suli maka akale-kale ma pasal ai-ai t'kka baha'u.  <div eID="gen6831" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3377"/><div sID="gen6832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3377"/> Sakali itu an'ngge si Paul ma dahuan palhimpunan Areyopagos ati yukna, “Tapandogaku in ka'am saga a'a Aten itu, maga'agama to'ongan.

verses.name: Acts 17:23
verses.text: Sabab sasangku maglibutan ma deyom da'irabi itu ang'nda'-ng'nda' ma ba'anan ai-ai ya sumbabi, aniya' ta'nda'ku dakayu' panumbahanbi taga-sulat. Yuk sulat e', ‘Ni tuhan dakayu', ya mbal kinata'uwan.’ Na,” yuk si Paul, “ya tuhan pinudji e'bi minsan mbal kata'uwanbi, ya na Tuhan pamahatiku ka'am buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen6832" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3378"/><div sID="gen6833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3378"/> “Ya na ko' itu Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' bay amapanjari dunya itu maka kakaya'-kaya'anna kamemon. Makapagnakura' asal iya ma sulga' sampay ma dunya. Mbal iya pat'nna' ma deyom luma' pagta'atan bay hinangan manusiya'.

verses.name: Acts 17:25
verses.text: Maka mbal iya mikitabang ma manusiya' sabab halam aniya' kulang ma iya. Dakayu'-kayu' iya asal amuwan kallum maka napas, maka kalluman indaginis ma binangsa manusiya'.

verses.name: Acts 17:26
verses.text: Dangan du a'a,” yuk si Paul, “bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan, ati min dangan e' pinaniya' e' Tuhan saga kabangsa-bangsahan manusiya' kamemon. Pinapaglahat sigām e'na ma kaluha'an dunya itu. Ginanta' asal e'na bangsa dakayu' maka dakayu' bang buwattingga ya t'ggol sigām anatas ma dunya maka bang maingga paglahatan sigām.

verses.name: Acts 17:27
verses.text: Buwattē' hinang Tuhan ma binangsa manusiya' bo' supaya sigām amiha iya, sapantun a'a anadsad ma kalendoman kalu iya tabāk. Sagō' in Tuhan mbal alawak min kitam kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 17:28
verses.text: B'nnal bissala ya yuk-i, ‘Tuhan ya sababanna angkan kitam allum, ya angkan aniya' kuwat-anggawta'tam, ya angkan aniya' kapaga'atam.’ Aniya' isab a'a bay anulat, yukna ‘In kitam itu, anak Tuhan.’  <div eID="gen6833" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3379"/><div sID="gen6834" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3379"/> “Na, pagka saga anak Tuhan na kitam,” yuk si Paul, “da'a subay pikiltam in kajarihan Tuhan pinaluwa ni ta'u-ta'u hinangan bulawan atawa pilak atawa batu, ya nihinang min akkal maka kapandayan manusiya'.

verses.name: Acts 17:30
verses.text: Waktu tagna', halam bay tabista e' Tuhan kahinangan manusiya' ahāp-ala'at pagka a'awam lagi' sigām. Sagō' ma buwattina'an ya panoho'an Tuhan ma a'a kamemon maingga-maingga lahat, subay sigām ang'bba to'ongan min paldusahan sigām.

verses.name: Acts 17:31
verses.text: Sabab aniya' llaw bay tinagama e' Tuhan pangahukumna manusiya' kamemon, maka abontol isab hukumanna. Aniya' isab kawakilan e' Tuhan amal'ngngan hukuman. Pinatampal e' Tuhan ma manusiya' kamemon in a'a itu asal tapene'na, sabab tapakallum iya min kamatay.”  <div eID="gen6834" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3380"/><div sID="gen6835" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3380"/> Pagkale saga a'a inān ma si Paul amissala pasal kallum pabalik min kamatay, magtūy iya tinittowahan e' sigām kasehe'an. Sagō' aniya' a'a kasehe'an ah'lling, yuk-i, “Tuwan, bilahi kami akale ma ka'a pabīng pasal ilu-i.”

verses.name: Acts 17:33
verses.text: Minnē', paluwas si Paul min palhimpunan inān.

verses.name: Acts 17:34
verses.text: Manjari aniya' saga a'a bay pabeya' ma iya bo' angandol ma si Isa. Ōn dakayu' inān si Diyunisi a'a min palhimpunan Areyopagos, maka dakayu' d'nda niōnan si Damaris. Maka aniya' isab a'a kasehe'an bay angandol.  <div eID="gen6835" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.17"/> <div eID="gen6829" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3381"/><div sID="gen6836" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Da'ira Kurintu</title> <div sID="gen6837" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3381"/> Puwas e' atulak si Paul min Aten pauntas ni da'ira Kurintu.

verses.name: Acts 18:2
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in, magbāk iya maka si Akila, dakayu' Yahudi bay nianakan ma lahat Puntus. Si Akila itu baha'u bay at'kka pina'an ni Kurintu bay min lahat Itali, magbeya' maka h'ndana si Prisila. Sigā maglakibini bay ala'an min lahat Itali pagka aniya' panoho'an min sultan Klaudi, in kamemon kono' saga bangsa Yahudi sinō' ala'an min da'ira Rōm.<note>Da'ira Rōm: da'ira aheya ma lahat Itali, ya pat'nna'an sultan mahatinggi.</note> Na, pina'an si Paul anibaw disi Akila.

verses.name: Acts 18:3
verses.text: Jari itu, pagka sali' du usaha sigā maghinang luma' tolda, pat'nna' iya ma sigā ameya' magusaha.

verses.name: Acts 18:4
verses.text: Ati sakahaba' llaw Sabtu' pina'an iya ni langgal Yahudi magsuli-suli maka saga a'a maina'an kalu tabowana saga Yahudi maka saga Girīk magkahagad ma pamandu'na.  <div eID="gen6837" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3382"/><div sID="gen6838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3382"/> Pagt'kka si Silas maka si Timuti min Makidunya, magnasihat sadja si Paul. Halam aniya' hinangna saddī. Anaksi' iya ni saga Yahudi ma pasalan si Isa, in iya Al-Masi ya asal tapene' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 18:6
verses.text: Sagō' tasagga' pa'in si Paul e' saga Yahudi maka pinamūng-mūngan ala'at, magtūy iya angangjabjaban badju'na, tanda' saksi' in iya papuwas na min sigām. Yukna ni sigām, “Kasuppakan du kam bang kam amutawan ni deyom nalka'. Papuwas na aku. Papinda na aku magnasihat pehē' ni saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi.”  <div eID="gen6838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3383"/><div sID="gen6839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3383"/> Sakali ala'an si Paul min saga a'a ma langgal inān bo' yampa pehē' ni luma' si Titus Justus, a'a bangsa saddī ya magta'at asal ni Tuhan. Ina'an luma'na ma bihing langgal.

verses.name: Acts 18:8
verses.text: Na, si Krispus, ya magmakōk ma langgal inān, angandol na ma Panghū' Isa, beya' isab kamemon saga a'a ma okomanna. Aheka isab saga a'a min da'ira Kurintu inān bay akale ma pamandu' si Paul ati angandol ma si Isa maka pinandi tanda' in sigām ma iya na.  <div eID="gen6839" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3384"/><div sID="gen6840" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3384"/> Na, ma llaw dakayu', bo' waktu sangom na, aniya' magpanyata' ni si Paul. Takalena Panghū' Isa amissala ni iya, yukna, “Da'a ka agawa amissala, sagō' anganasihat na pa'in ka,

verses.name: Acts 18:10
verses.text: sabab pagapi' du aku ma ka'a. Halam aniya' makamula ka'a sabab aheka saga a'aku ma deyom da'ira itu.”

verses.name: Acts 18:11
verses.text: Angkan si Paul pat'nna' maina'an dantahun maka nnom bulan. Magpandu' na pa'in iya lapal Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6840" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3385"/><div sID="gen6841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3385"/> Manjari itu, pasalta' pa'in si Galliyu maggubnul ma kalingkal lahat Akaya he', magdakayu' saga Yahudi anaggaw si Paul. Tin'kkahan iya e' sigām ni sara' gubnul.

verses.name: Acts 18:13
verses.text: Ya panuntut sigām, “A'a itu amandu'an saga a'a hatulan pagta'at ni Tuhan ya pangalāngan sara' kami.”  <div eID="gen6841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3386"/><div sID="gen6842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3386"/> Sōng pa'in si Paul anganda'awa, amissala gubnul Galliyu ni saga Yahudi inān, yukna, “Bang hinang ala'at atawa langgal sara' Rōm ya sababan palkala'bi itu, patut kam subay kinale.

verses.name: Acts 18:15
verses.text: Sagō', pagka pagjawabanbi saga kabtangan maka ōn a'a maka sara' agamabi, ka'am ya magsalassayan di-bi. Mbal aku anara' ma palkala' buwattilu!”

verses.name: Acts 18:16
verses.text: Angkan pinala'an sigām e' si Galliyu min pagsara'an inān.

verses.name: Acts 18:17
verses.text: Manjari saga a'a inān kamemon amalutan si Sostenes, ya pagmakōkan ma langgal Yahudi inān. Pinagdaplosan iya ma alopan pagsara'an, sagō' halam pamagay hinang sigām inān e' si Galliyu.  <div eID="gen6842" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6836" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3387"/><div sID="gen6843" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pabīng disi Paul ni Da'ira Antiyuk</title> <div sID="gen6844" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3387"/> At'ggol-t'ggol gi' ya kat'nna' si Paul mahē' ma Kurintu bo' yampa iya ama'id min saga bebeya'an si Isa he'. Aleha iya minnē' tudju ni lahat Siriya, sinehe'an e' si Prisila maka si Akila. Ma halam gi' sigām makatulak, bo' ma Kengkereya lagi', bay magpabagongan kōkna si Paul, panuhul najalna ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 18:19
verses.text: Pagt'kka sigām ni Epesos ni'bbahan e' si Paul disi Akila maina'an. Pasōd iya ni deyom langgal magsuli-suli maka saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 18:20
verses.text: Sinō' gi' iya pat'ggol-t'ggol ma sigām, sagō' mbal iya.

verses.name: Acts 18:21
verses.text: Gom pa'in iya ama'id, yukna, “Bang min kabaya'an Tuhan, pabīng du aku ni ka'am.” Puwas e' aleha iya min Epesos.  <div eID="gen6844" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3388"/><div sID="gen6845" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3388"/> Pagt'kkana ni Kesareya magtūy iya patukad ni Awrusalam magaddatan tipunan jama'a si Isa maina'an. Puwas e' palūd iya pabīng tudju ni Antiyuk.

verses.name: Acts 18:23
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in kamahe'na ma Antiyuk, atulak iya minnē'. Talatagna kalahatan Galatiya maka Prigiya, ati pinahogot pal-imanan saga bebeya'an si Isa kamemon ma saga lahat inān.  <div eID="gen6845" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6843" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3389"/><div sID="gen6846" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Apollos At'kka na Da'ira Epesos</title> <div sID="gen6847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3389"/> Manjari itu aniya' dakayu' Yahudi niōnan si Apollos at'kka ni da'ira Epesos. A'a iya bay nianakan ma da'ira Iskandari. Apanday iya amissala, maka alalom pangadji'na bang ma Kitab.

verses.name: Acts 18:25
verses.text: Bay iya pinandu'an pasal kal'ngnganan Panghū' Isa. Aheya katuyu'na amissala, taluwa' isab pamandu'na. Sagō' ya sadja kata'uwanna ya pagpandi bay pamandu' e' si Yahiya.

verses.name: Acts 18:26
verses.text: Anagna' iya magnasihat ma deyom langgal Yahudi, maka halam aniya' hawal-hawalna. Takale pa'in iya e' si Prisila maka si Akila, binowa iya e' sigā ni luma' ati pinahatian pasal kal'ngnganan Tuhan bo' pasōng ta'una.  <div eID="gen6847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3390"/><div sID="gen6848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3390"/> Manjari agara' si Apollos parambila' ni lahat Akaya. Bilahi isab saga bebeya'an si Isa ma Epesos inān anabangan iya, angkan sigām bay amabeya' sulat ni lahat Akaya he'. Sinō' saga bebeya'an si Isa amatuntul si Apollos pagt'kkana pehē'. Manjari makat'kka pa'in iya, aheya tabangna ma saga a'a Akaya, ya magpangandol ma si Isa ma sabab kahāp Tuhan ma sigām.

verses.name: Acts 18:28
verses.text: Sabab apaslod si Apollos itu angatu ma saga Yahudi waktu kapagjawab sigām ma mairan angkan iya anganda'ug. Ginuna e'na saga ayat Kitab pamamattanna ma sigām pasal si Isa in iya Al-Masi ya asal tapene' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6848" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.18"/> <div eID="gen6846" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3391"/><div sID="gen6849" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul ma Da'ira Epesos</title> <div sID="gen6850" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3391"/> Maina'an pa'in si Apollos ma da'ira Kurintu, palabay si Paul min kareya-reyahan sampay at'kka ni da'ira Epesos. Jari aniya' tabākna maina'an saga mulid si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 19:2
verses.text: Atilaw iya ma sigām, yukna, “Bay bahā' kam pinaniya'an Rū Sussi, waktu kapangandolbi ma si Isa?” <div eID="gen6850" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6851" type="paragraph"/> “Halam,” yuk sambung sigām. “Halam kami makakale saga aniya' Rū Sussi.”  <div eID="gen6851" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3392"/><div sID="gen6852" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3392"/> Yuk si Paul, “Na, pandi ai bahā' bay pamandi ka'am?” <div eID="gen6852" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6853" type="paragraph"/> “Pandi si Yahiya,” yuk sigām.  <div eID="gen6853" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3393"/><div sID="gen6854" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3393"/> Yuk si Paul, “Pandi taubat ya pamandi si Yahiya ma a'a bang ang'bba min dusa sigām. Bay isab soho'na saga bangsa Yahudi am'nnal ma a'a dakayu' ya pasunu' ma iya. Si Isa ya pagsambatna.”

verses.name: Acts 19:5
verses.text: Takale pa'in bissala si Paul itu e' saga a'a Epesos, pinandi na sigām tanda' in sigām ma si Isa na.

verses.name: Acts 19:6
verses.text: Pinat'nna' e' si Paul tanganna ni sigām ati magtūy sigām pahōpan Rū Sussi. Magbissala isab sigām saga bahasa saddī. Amaluwas isab sigām lapal, deyo' bay min Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 19:7
verses.text: Ya heka sigām aniya' saga sangpū' maka duwa l'lla.  <div eID="gen6854" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3394"/><div sID="gen6855" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3394"/> Manjari pasōd si Paul ni deyom langgal Yahudi, ati t'llumbulan ya t'ggolna magpandu' maina'an. Aesog iya amissala ma saga a'a inān pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Binowa sigām magsuli-suli, kalu aniya' tabowa ameya' am'nnal ma lapalna.

verses.name: Acts 19:9
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a kasehe' inān hal magmatuwas, mbal bilahi am'nnal. Ala'at bissala sigām ma alopan kaheka'an a'a inān pasal kal'ngnganan Panghū' Isa. Angkan si Paul ala'an min langgal inān, maka binowa isab saga bebeya'an si Isa. Jari sakahaba' llaw magsambung himumūngan maka sigām ma deyom iskul si Tirannus.

verses.name: Acts 19:10
verses.text: Ya na pa'in he'-i hinangna ma deyom duwantahun, angkan saga a'a kamemon ma sakalingkal lahat Asiya he', bangsa Yahudi maka bangsa saddī, bay makakale lapal Panghū'.  <div eID="gen6855" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3395"/><div sID="gen6856" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3395"/> Aniya' kahinangan sidda makainu-inu tahinang e' si Paul, deyo' min kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 19:12
verses.text: Minsan saga panyu' maka lampik bay pagguna e' si Paul, bang binowa ni a'a sakihan kauli'an saki sigām, maka paluwas isab saga saitan min baran sigām.  <div eID="gen6856" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6849" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3396"/><div sID="gen6857" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Anak si Eskeba</title> <div sID="gen6858" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3396"/> Aniya' isab saga Yahudi magtatawal angalatag kalahatan inān amaluwas saga saitan min deyom baran a'a. Jari itu anabbut sigām ōn Panghū' Isa bahasa amaluwas saitan. Yuk sigām ma saga saitan, “Ma ōn si Isa ya pagnasihatan si Paul, soho'ta kam paluwas min a'a ilu.”

verses.name: Acts 19:14
verses.text: Jari itu aniya' pitu' l'lla magdanakan anawal ma waktu inān. Mma' sigām si Eskeba, dakayu' imam alanga ma saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 19:15
verses.text: Sagō' dakayu' llaw, hinabu sigām magtawal, sinambungan sigām e' saitan, yuk-i, “Si Isa kata'uwanku, maka si Paul kata'uwanku isab. Saguwā' ka'am ilu mbal kata'uwanku bang sai.”

verses.name: Acts 19:16
verses.text: Magtūy nirumpās kapitu' l'lla magdanakan inān e' a'a taga-saitan e'. Aesog iya makalandu' angkan sigām mbal maka'atu ma iya. Alahi sigām kamemon min luma' he', ap'nno' e' pali', maka tinantangan.

verses.name: Acts 19:17
verses.text: Manjari patanyag habal inān ni kamemon saga a'a ma Epesos, ni saga Yahudi maka ni saga bangsa saddī. Sinōd sigām tāw kamemon, ati minnē' pinaheya gom pa'in ōn Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Acts 19:18
verses.text: Aheka saga a'a angandol ma si Isa patampal na magpasab'nnal pasal bay kahinangan sigām ala'at.

verses.name: Acts 19:19
verses.text: Aheka sigām biyaksa bay maghikmat amowa saga lūnan kitab sigām panulatan hikmat maka tawal. Jari tinunu' e' sigām pinamint'dda ma kaheka'an a'a. Pagitung sigām ma halga' saga kitab inān, aniya' limampū' ngibu pilak bang sīn sigām.

verses.name: Acts 19:20
verses.text: Pagka buwattē' pasaplag na pa'in lapal Tuhan maina'an, pasōng isab kawasana angkan aheka am'nnal.  <div eID="gen6858" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3397"/><div sID="gen6859" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3397"/> Apuwas pa'in saga pakaradja'an e'-i, agara' si Paul palabay min lahat Makidunya maka Akaya bo' yampa palanjal ni Awrusalam. Yukna, “Pagka aku aubus na bay ni Awrusalam, subay aku pehē' isab patibaw ni da'ira Rōm.”

verses.name: Acts 19:22
verses.text: Angkanna si Timuti maka si Erastus, ya duwangan sehe' si Paul anabangan iya, bay sohō'na parahū ni Makidunya, bo' in iya inān pat'ggol gi' mahē' ma kalingkal lahat Asiya.  <div eID="gen6859" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6857" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3398"/><div sID="gen6860" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hiluhala' ma Epesos</title> <div sID="gen6861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3398"/> Ma waktu ina'an-i aniya' lengog aheya ma deyom da'ira Epesos ma sabab kal'ngnganan Panghū' Isa. Buwattitu ya kahālanna:

verses.name: Acts 19:24
verses.text: aniya' dakayu' a'a magsasasal pilak, ōnna si Dimitri. Ya hinangna magsasal luma'-luma' pilak pagsusumbahan ni tuhan sigām d'nda, ōnna Artemes. Auntung usaha saga a'a magsasasal ma kompolan si Dimitri.

verses.name: Acts 19:25
verses.text: Jari pinatimuk e'na saga a'a inān maka kasehe'an sasuku magsasal, bo' yukna ni sigām, “Saga bagay, kata'uwanbi du, ya angkan kitam taga-kaniya' sabab min usahatam itu.

verses.name: Acts 19:26
verses.text: Ta'nda'bi na maka takalebi ya tahinang e' a'a niōnan si Paul inān. Yuk pamandu'na, in tuhan nihinang e' manusiya' ngga'i ka tuhan b'nnal. Jari aheka na tabowa am'nnal ma pamandu'na. Ngga'i ka hal maitu ma Epesos, sampay isab ma kaluha'an lahat Asiya.

verses.name: Acts 19:27
