verses.text: Ya kahanggawanku,” yuk si Dimitri “pinalehom marai' usahatam. Lāgi ya langgal isab panumbahan ni si Artemes tuhantam babantugun, marai' mbal na pinaheya ma atay. Buwattina'an si Artemes itu sinumba asal e' saga a'a kamemon ma kaluha'an Asiya sampay isab ma kaluha'an dunya. Ya aniya' pinahalam kabantugna.”  <div eID="gen6861" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3399"/><div sID="gen6862" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3399"/> Makakale pa'in saga a'a magtimukan inān ma bay bissala si Dimitri e', magtūy ap'ddi' makalandu' atay sigām. Anagna' sigām angolang pakosog, yuk-i, “Binabantug si Artemes, tuhan saga a'a Epesos!”

verses.name: Acts 19:29
verses.text: Sakali paheya kalengogan ma kaluha'an da'ira inān. Jari sinaggaw e' saga a'a inān si Gayus maka si Aristarkus, a'a Makidunya karuwangan bay sehe' si Paul ma labayan. Pagsaggaw itu, magtūy magsama-sama kaheka'an saga a'a paragan ni lugal pagtitipunan e', maka e' sigām amowa disi Gayus.

verses.name: Acts 19:30
verses.text: Bilahi si Paul paharap ni saga a'a sikatimukan inān, sagō' nihawiran iya e' saga bebeya'an si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 19:31
verses.text: Minsan saga bag'llal ma lahat Asiya inān, ya bagay si Paul isab, bay amabeya'an iya lapal. Niamay-amayan iya da'a sinō' ama'nda'an di-na pasōd ni luma' pagtitipunan e'.  <div eID="gen6862" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3400"/><div sID="gen6863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3400"/> Pasalta', ahiluhala' na katimukan a'a inān. Saddī pangalingan kasehe', saddī isab pangalingan kasehe', sabab kaheka'anna halam minsan makata'u bang ai po'onna angkan sigām magsakaum inān.

verses.name: Acts 19:33
verses.text: Jari aniya' a'a niōnan si Iskandar bay pinapehē' ni dahuan e' saga Yahudi, sinō' amissala. Kinabā' e' saga a'a kasehe'an iya ya pagsababan hiluhala' inān. Jari pinahantap ba'anan a'a inān e' si Iskandar, sinō' mbal asagaw, ati pa'ahat iya anganda'awa.

verses.name: Acts 19:34
verses.text: Sagō' takilā pa'in iya e' kaheka'an a'a inān in iya bangsa Yahudi, magpangolang sigām sama-sama ma deyom saga duwanjām. Ya na pa'in pangolang sigām: “Binabantug si Artemes, tuhan saga a'a Epesos!”  <div eID="gen6863" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3401"/><div sID="gen6864" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3401"/> Ya katobtobanna, saga a'a inān sinō' pahali e' bag'llal magsusulat. Yukna ni sigām, “Oy! Ka'am saga a'a Epesos! Kinata'uwan asal e' a'a kamemon in kitam saga a'a Epesos tunggu' luma' si Artemes tuhantam babantugun, maka batu mahasussi ya bay pahūg min diyata' langit.

verses.name: Acts 19:36
verses.text: Mbal kapaliluhan pasal ilu-i, angkan kam subay pahantap. Da'a kam magdai'-dai' maghinang ai-ai ma halam tapikilbi pahāp.

verses.name: Acts 19:37
verses.text: Itiya' bowabi pi'itu saga a'a itu, bo' halam sigām bay angalangpasan langgal atawa amūng-mūng ala'at pasal tuhantam d'nda itu.

verses.name: Acts 19:38
verses.text: Abila aniya' panuntutan si Dimitri maka saga tendogna ma sai-sai, aniya' du llaw pagsara', maka aniya' isab bag'llal magsasara'. Patut sigām anuntut mahē'.

verses.name: Acts 19:39
verses.text: Maka bang aniya' palkala'bi saddī, subay pinasalassay ma palhimpunan paghukuman.

verses.name: Acts 19:40
verses.text: Sabab piligdu kitam,” yuk bag'llal inān, “marai' kitam tinuntutan pagka kitam ya po'onan kahiluhala'an itu. Mbal kitam makara'awa sabab halam to'ongan aniya' sababanna.”

verses.name: Acts 19:41
verses.text: Aubus pa'in bissala bag'llal he' magtūy pinapole' e'na saga a'a bay magtimuk inān.  <div eID="gen6864" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.19"/> <div eID="gen6860" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3402"/><div sID="gen6865" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katulak si Paul min Epesos</title> <div sID="gen6866" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3402"/> Na, pahali pa'in hiluhala' inān, anambuku si Paul ma saga bebeya'an si Isa, sinō' patimuk. Amissala iya ma sigām pamat'ttogna pangatayan sigām, bo' yampa iya ama'id palanjal ni lahat Makidunya.

verses.name: Acts 20:2
verses.text: Nil'ngngan e'na kalahat-lahatan maina'an, maka araran iya amissala ma saga a'a supaya pat'ttogna atay sigām. Puwas e' at'kka na iya ni lahat Akaya,

verses.name: Acts 20:3
verses.text: ati t'llumbulan ya kat'nna'na maina'an. Sōng pa'in iya pauntas ni jadjahan Siriya, tabistu pasal saga Yahudi magisun amono' iya. Angkan iya agara' amaklay min deya, bo' pabalik min bay pal'ngngananna labay min kaluha'an lahat Makidunya.

verses.name: Acts 20:4
verses.text: Ya sehe'na inān si Sopater anak si Pirus, a'a min lahat Bereya, maka disi Aristarkus maka si Sigundu, saga a'a min Tessaloneka. Ameya' isab si Gayus min Derbe, maka disi Tikikus maka si Trupimus, a'a min lahat Asiya. Ameya' isab si Timuti.

verses.name: Acts 20:5
verses.text: Bay sigām parahū min kami angalagaran kami maina'an ma Trowas.

verses.name: Acts 20:6
verses.text: Aubus pa'in Hinang Tinapay Halam Pasuligna, atulak kami min Pilipi. Makalabay pa'in limambahangi ta'abut kami saga sehe' kami maina'an ma Trowas. Dapitu' ya kahanti' kami maina'an.  <div eID="gen6866" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6865" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3403"/><div sID="gen6867" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'ira Trowas</title> <div sID="gen6868" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3403"/> Ta'abut pa'in sangom Sabtu',<note>Sangom Sabtu', hatina tagna'an llaw Ahad bang ma bistahan bangsa Yahudi.</note> magtimuk kami bo' magbahagi'an tinapay. Si Paul inān sakap na atulak dai'-llaw, angkan iya anganasihatan saga a'a magtimuk inān sampay ni katonga'an bahangi.

verses.name: Acts 20:8
verses.text: Ya bilik pagtimukan kami inān ma angkap diyata', maka aheka palita'an bay maina'an.

verses.name: Acts 20:9
verses.text: Aniya' maina'an dakayu' l'lla abata' lagi', ōnna si Utikus, aningkō' ma babag tandawan. Manjari itu, pagka pinataha' e' si Paul bissalana, kinaru' sidda si Utikus itu sampay tatuli. Pagtuli itu, ahūg iya pareyo' ni tana' min diyata' t'llu angkap luma' inān. Pagbuhat iya e' saga a'a, asal amatay na.

verses.name: Acts 20:10
verses.text: Sagō' pareyo' si Paul pina'an bo' pak'ppang ni si Utikus maka e'na anganggapus. Yuk si Paul, “Da'a kam asusa. Masi gi' iya allum.”

verses.name: Acts 20:11
verses.text: Puwas e' pabīng si Paul pariyata' amahagi' tinapay bo' yampa sigām magkakan. Amissala gi' iya ma sigām sampay ni karai'-llawan, puwas e' atulak na iya.

verses.name: Acts 20:12
verses.text: Ya subul bay ahūg inān binowa na e' saga sehe'na amole', allum du isab. Jari pahantap atay sigām.  <div eID="gen6868" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3404"/><div sID="gen6869" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3404"/> Na, bay na kami parahū min si Paul ni jambatan bo' ameya' min kappal tudju ni Assos. Ya kapaggara'an kami, mahē' na ma Assos paruwa' si Paul. Min panoho'anna du isab, sabab hal kono' iya amaklay min deya.

verses.name: Acts 20:14
verses.text: Makapagbāk pa'in kami ma Assos, magtūy iya paruwa' kami ni kappal bo' palintas tudju ni lahat Mitilini.

verses.name: Acts 20:15
verses.text: Ak'tta isab kami minnē', ati pak'llat llaw dakayu', tumandan kami ni tongod Kiyus. Pag'llaw dakayu' pahapit kami ni Samos, ati pag'llaw karuwana at'kka kami ni Militus.

verses.name: Acts 20:16
verses.text: Ya gara' si Paul subay da'a pahapit ni Epesos bo' mbal makalihan maina'an ma lahat Asiya. Sabab magdai'-dai' iya palanjal tudju ni Awrusalam bo' tasa'utna paghinang saga Yahudi ya niōnan Pentekosta.  <div eID="gen6869" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6867" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3405"/><div sID="gen6870" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapang'bba si Paul min Pagmatto'ahan ma Epesos</title> <div sID="gen6871" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3405"/> Angkanna, pagt'kka kami ni Militus, amabeya' lapal si Paul ni Epesos, pinasampay ni saga pagmatto'ahan palhimpunan si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 20:18
verses.text: Pagt'kka pa'in sigām ni Militus, amissala si Paul, yukna, “Kata'uwanbi kajarihanku t'ggolku bay ma deyomanbi, sangay min tagna' kat'kkaku ni lahat Asiya.

verses.name: Acts 20:19
verses.text: Bay aku maghinang ma Panghū' Isa ma areyo' pangatayanku. Araran bay am'ttak bohe' mataku. Bay sandalanku katiksa'an ya pinat'kka ni aku sabab min pagisun saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 20:20
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du isab halam bay ka'lloganku ai-ai bang pa'in makahāp ka'am. Gom pa'in bay kam nasihatanku sampay pandu'anku, suma'an ma kaheka'an a'a, suma'an isab ma luma'bi.

verses.name: Acts 20:21
verses.text: Bangsa Yahudi maka bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi, bay banda'anku sali'-sali' subay ang'bba to'ongan min dusa sigām bo' papinda tudju ni Tuhan, maka subay angandol isab ma Panghū'tam si Isa.  <div eID="gen6871" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3406"/><div sID="gen6872" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3406"/> “Na buwattina'an,” yuk si Paul, “itiya' na aku ni Awrusalam ma sabab panoho'an min Rū Sussi. Mbal kata'uwanku bang ai makani-aku mahē'.

verses.name: Acts 20:23
verses.text: Sagō' pinata'u to'ongan aku e' Rū Sussi, ma kamemon saga da'ira ya papehē'anku in aku kinalabusu du maka pininjala'.

verses.name: Acts 20:24
verses.text: Sagō' mbal ka'lloganku kallumku bang pa'in tatalusku ai-ai bay pangangganta' aku. Bang pa'in isab takatisku hinang bay pamahinang aku e' Panghū' Isa, hatina magpasaplag lapal ahāp pasal ase' maka lasa Tuhan.  <div eID="gen6872" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3407"/><div sID="gen6873" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3407"/> “Bay na kam talatagku kamemon. Bay kam nasihatanku pagparinta Tuhan. Maka kata'uwanku na, puwas itu mbal na kitam mag'nda' pabalik.

verses.name: Acts 20:26
verses.text: Angkan kam haka'anku to'ongan ma llaw itu: bang aniya' min ka'am ganta' amutawan ni deyom nalka', min ka'am du, angiyas aku.

verses.name: Acts 20:27
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' bay limbunganku min ka'am. Bay kam pata'uku pasal niyat maka maksud Tuhan kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 20:28
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' kam. Upiksa'unbi isab saga a'a kamemon bay pangandol ma ka'am e' Rū Sussi. Upiksa'unbi saga jama'a ma palhimpunanbi ilu, ya bay pinasuku' ma Tuhan sabab min laha' si Isa bay min kamatayna.

verses.name: Acts 20:29
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanku, bang aku alikut na, aniya' du palamud ni ka'am saga guru putingan, sali' hantang ero' sidda aesog. Mbal sigām ma'ase' ma ka'am.

verses.name: Acts 20:30
verses.text: Minsan min deyomanbi ilu, ma sinosōng aniya' du magputing bo' supaya aniya' saga bebeya'an si Isa tabowa ameya' ma sigām.

verses.name: Acts 20:31
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' kam! Entomunbi bay ka-e'ku ma ka'am. Ma deyom t'lluntahun alandos bay p'ttak bohe' mataku ma sababbi, pagka kam banda'anku dangan maka dangan llaw-sangom.  <div eID="gen6873" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3408"/><div sID="gen6874" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3408"/> “Na buwattina'an, pajagahanta na kam ma Tuhan. Bang pa'in kam mura-murahan pinahōpan lapalna pasal tabangna, sabab minnē' pahogot gom pa'in pangandolbi tudju ni Tuhan. Minnē' kam pinaniya'an kahāpan, ya asal pamusaka' Tuhan ma sasuku ameya' ma iya.

verses.name: Acts 20:33
verses.text: T'ggolku ma ka'am halam aku bay anganapsuhan alta' sai-na, ai na ka pilakna atawa bulawanna atawa saga s'mmekna.

verses.name: Acts 20:34
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du, bay aku magbaran angusaha bo' aniya' kalluman kami maka saga sehe'ku.

verses.name: Acts 20:35
verses.text: Ai-ai bay hinangku he' bay pama'nda'ku ka'am panunuranbi,” yuk si Paul. “Hatina in kitam subay angusaha to'ongan supaya katabangantam saga a'a ya mbal makausaha. Entomunbi bay bissala Panghū' Isa, ya yukna, ‘Bang kita amuwan, labi gi' kakoyaganta min a'a binuwanan.’ ”  <div eID="gen6874" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3409"/><div sID="gen6875" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3409"/> Akatis pa'in e' si Paul amissala, magtūy iya angōk-tu'ut magbeya' maka sigām kamemon angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 20:37
verses.text: Magtangisan sigām kamemon salta' sigām maggapus maka magsiyum, pagka sigām mag'bba na maka iya.

verses.name: Acts 20:38
verses.text: Ya makasusa sigām to'ongan, ya bay yukna in iya mbal na ta'nda' e' sigām pabīng. Manjari sinehe'an iya e' sigām tudju ni kappal.  <div eID="gen6875" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.20"/> <div eID="gen6870" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3410"/><div sID="gen6876" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Patukad si Paul ni Awrusalam</title> <div sID="gen6877" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3410"/> Makapag'bba pa'in kami maka saga a'a Epesos e', ak'tta kami bo' patūy ni Kōs. Pag'llaw dakayu', patandan kami ni Rodos, bo' palanjal minnē' tudju ni Patara.

verses.name: Acts 21:2
verses.text: Ma Patara pa'in, tasabu kami kappal song atulak ni Piniki. Manjari paruwa' kami ati atulak kami minnē'.

verses.name: Acts 21:3
verses.text: Pag'nda' kami pū' Kiprus min katāhan, palabay kami min bihingna tampal kowan bo' makatudju ni kalahatan Siriya. Tumandan kami ni lahat Tira ati pareyo' kami maina'an, sabab aniya' duwa'an kappal nihawas.

verses.name: Acts 21:4
verses.text: Pagka aniya' tabāk kami maina'an saga bebeya'an si Isa, pahanti' kami ma sigām dapitu'. Bay sigām kabuwanan pangita'u e' Rū Tuhan angkan sigām anoho' si Paul da'a subay pehē' ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 21:5
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in llaw katulak kami minnē', sinehe'an kami e' sigām kamemon magtautai'anak paluwas min da'ira he'. Angōk-tu'ut kami kamemon ma bihing tampe angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 21:6
verses.text: Aubus pa'in kami bay mag'bba maka sigām, paruwa' na kami ni kappal, ati in sigām amole' na ni luma' sigām.  <div eID="gen6877" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3411"/><div sID="gen6878" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3411"/> Manjari palanjal kami min lahat Tira bo' paleha tudju ni Tolemas. Pagt'kka kami ni Tolemas, pinagaddatan kami e' saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an ati maina'an kami ma sigām dambahangi.

verses.name: Acts 21:8
verses.text: Pag'llaw dakayu' atulak na isab kami minnē' ati makatandan kami ni Kesareya. Maina'an pa'in, magtūy kami pahanti' ma luma' si Pilip, a'a magnanasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa. Si Pilip itu dakayu' a'a ma deyom pitu' ya bay gin'llal ma Awrusalam ma waktu palabay.

verses.name: Acts 21:9
verses.text: Aniya' mpat anakna budjang amaluwas lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 21:10
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in kami daka pilambahangi, aniya' a'a at'kka pina'an min lahat Yahudiya, ōnna si Agabus. A'a iya amaluwas lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 21:11
verses.text: Jari pasekot iya ni kami angā' sintoron si Paul, bo' yampa angengkotan di-na tape'-tangan. Amissala si Agabus e', yukna, “Ya itu palman min Rū Sussi: ya tag-dapu sintoron itu niengkotan du isab buwattitu e' saga Yahudi ma Awrusalam, ati sinōngan ni pang'ntanan bangsa saddī.”  <div eID="gen6878" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3412"/><div sID="gen6879" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3412"/> Pagkale pa'in kami bissala si Agabus e', magtūy kami maka saga a'a kasehe'an inān anganjunjung ni si Paul, da'a sinō' palanjal ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 21:13
verses.text: Sagō' anambung si Paul, yukna, “Angay kam magtangis ilu? Da'a pahansulunbi atayku. Lilla' du aku, ngga'i ka hal niengkotan, sagō' minsan isab aku pinapatay mahē' ma Awrusalam, bang pa'in ma sabab ōn Panghū' Isa.”

verses.name: Acts 21:14
verses.text: Pagka mbal palogos si Paul, na pahali kami anganjunjung. Yuk kami, “Bang pa'in baya'-baya' Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen6879" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3413"/><div sID="gen6880" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3413"/> At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in kamahē' kami ma Kesareya, magmomos na kami bo' palanjal tudju ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 21:16
verses.text: Aniya' isab saga bebeya'an si Isa min Kesareya bay parongan ma kami. Jari binowa kami e' sigām ni luma' si Manason, paokoman kami. Si Manason itu a'a Kiprus, mulid si Isa asal bay min katagna'.  <div eID="gen6880" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6876" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3414"/><div sID="gen6881" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinibaw si Yakub e' si Paul</title> <div sID="gen6882" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3414"/> Manjari itu, pagt'kka kami ni Awrusalam, sinagina kami pahāp e' saga danakan mahē'.

verses.name: Acts 21:18
verses.text: Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, magbeya' kami maka si Paul anibaw si Yakub. Ina'an isab pahadil saga pagmatto'ahan kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 21:19
verses.text: Aubus pa'in si Paul bay magaddatan sigām, nihaka'an sigām e'na kamemon bay pinahinang ma iya e' Tuhan ma deyom kabangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi.  <div eID="gen6882" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3415"/><div sID="gen6883" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3415"/> Pagkale itu, magtūy sigām ananglitan Tuhan. Yuk sigām ni si Paul, “Bagay Paul, kata'uwannu na. Ma ibu-ibuhan na saga bangsatam Yahudi angandol ma si Isa, a'a amogbog lullun ma sara' si Musa.

verses.name: Acts 21:21
verses.text: Bay na sigām kahaka'an pasal ka'a-i amandu'an kamemon saga Yahudi ya pat'nna' ma kalahatan bangsa saddī, in sigām makajari ang'bbahan sara' si Musa. Yuknu kono' ni sigām mbal na subay magislam saga anak sigām, maka mbal na subay tinurul pangaddatan bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 21:22
verses.text: Na buwattinggatam na bo' ka mbal sinaggaw? Sabab tantu, takale na e' sigām in ka'a at'kka na.

verses.name: Acts 21:23
verses.text: Ahāp bang beya'nu gara' kami itu,” yuk saga matto'a inān. “Aniya' maitu mpat a'a song anuhul bay najal sigām ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 21:24
verses.text: Ameya' gi' ka ma sigām ni langgal pagkulbanan, ati palamud ka maghinang addat Yahudi pagsussi. Subay atasannu gastu pagkulban sigām bo' sigām makabagongan kōk sigām. Jari bang hinangnu buwattē', kinata'uwan du e' a'a kamemon in bay panuhuma ka'a mbal b'nnal, maka barannu amogbog du ma sara' si Musa.

verses.name: Acts 21:25
verses.text: Na, ya pasalan saga a'a min bangsa saddī magpangandol ma si Isa, bay na sigām pabeya'an kami sulat sinō' da'a amangan ai-ai bay paglamas ni saga ta'u-ta'u ya pagtuhanan a'a, da'a amangan laha' atawa hayop bay pin'kkol, maka da'a isab maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla.”  <div eID="gen6883" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3416"/><div sID="gen6884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3416"/> Manjari binowa e' si Paul mpat a'a inān, ati pag'llaw dakayu' magbeya' sigām maghinang saga addat Yahudi pagsussi. Puwas e' pasōd si Paul ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan angahaka'an saga imam e' bang sumiyan atangbus timpu pagsussi sigām, maka bang sumiyan waktu panukbal pagkulban ni Tuhan e' sigām pakaniya-pakaniya.  <div eID="gen6884" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6881" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3417"/><div sID="gen6885" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Sinaggaw ma Langgal Pagkulbanan</title> <div sID="gen6886" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3417"/> Sōng pa'in atangbus pitumbahangi pagsussi sigām, aniya' saga Yahudi bay min Asiya maka'nda' si Paul ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Magtūy pinapaglengog e' sigām kaheka'an a'a inān ati binalutan si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 21:28
verses.text: Angalingan sigām pakosog, yuk-i, “Oy! Ka'am saga a'a Isra'il! Anabang kam ba! Ya na ko' itu a'a angalatag kalahat-lahatan amandu'an a'a kamemon. Sinagga' e'na bangsatam maka sara' si Musa, maka langgal pagkulbanan itu. Lāgi, itiya' na isab bay bowana saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi ni deyom langgal. Alumu' e'na pamudjihantam sussi itu!”

verses.name: Acts 21:29
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' pagpa'in sigām sabab aniya' bay sehe' si Paul ta'nda' e' saga Yahudi inān magbeya' maka iya ma deyom da'ira. Ōnna si Trupimus, a'a Epesos ngga'i ka Yahudi. Jari pangannal sigām in si Trupimus itu binowa e' si Paul ni deyom langgal pagkulbanan, bo' pa'in halam.  <div eID="gen6886" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3418"/><div sID="gen6887" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3418"/> Na, pasaplag kalengogan inān ni kaluha'an Awrusalam. Maglundug saga kabanosan a'a pina'an bo' niagaw e' sigām si Paul, ginuyud paluwas min deyom langgal, ati tinambol magtūy saga lawangna.

verses.name: Acts 21:31
verses.text: Salta' pa'in sigām ano'ongan amapatay si Paul, aniya' habal at'kka pehē' ni nakura' sundalu Rōm. Ahiluhala' kono' deyom Awrusalam inān kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 21:32
verses.text: Magtūy binowa e' nakura' saga tininti maka saga sundalu pasa'ut pehē' ni tongod kahiluhala'an. Pag'nda' saga a'a ma nakura' maka ma kasundaluhan inān, magtūy sigām pahali angandaplosan si Paul.  <div eID="gen6887" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3419"/><div sID="gen6888" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3419"/> Pina'an nakura' sundalu ni si Paul anaggaw iya ati sinō' iya niengkotan maka duwa kilikili. Puwas e' atilaw nakura' ma saga a'a inān, yukna, “Sai a'a itu, maka ai dusana?”

verses.name: Acts 21:34
verses.text: Magbidda' ya pangolang saga a'a inān. Aniya' anambung buwattē', aniya' anambung buwattitu. Aheya kasensongan angkan mbal kahangpatan e' nakura' he' bang ai to'ongan sababanna. Manjari bay soho'na saga sundaluna amowa si Paul ni deyom kuta'.

verses.name: Acts 21:35
verses.text: Ma haron kuta' pa'in, binengket iya e' saga sundalu sabab pasōng to'ongan kalengogan a'a inān, mbal tasapad.

verses.name: Acts 21:36
verses.text: Abut-abut pangamahit saga a'a paturul ni si Paul inān, yuk sigām, “Gom iya pinapatay!”  <div eID="gen6888" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6885" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3420"/><div sID="gen6889" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anganda'awahan di-na si Paul</title> <div sID="gen6890" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3420"/> Sōng pa'in binowa e' sigām si Paul ni deyom kuta', ah'lling iya ni nakura' sundalu, yukna, “Makajari bahā' bang aku ah'lling ni ka'a?” <div eID="gen6890" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6891" type="paragraph"/> Anambung nakura', yukna, “Oy, ata'u ka mag'lling Girīk?

verses.name: Acts 21:38
verses.text: Yukku ka'a ilu a'a Misil ya bay amowa saga a'a anagga' ma parinta Rōm ma waktu palabay he'. Aniya' saga mpat ngibu mundu ma deyo'anna, a'a magtakos kamemon bay munda'anna pehē' ni lahat paslangan. Ka'a bahā'?”  <div eID="gen6891" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3421"/><div sID="gen6892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3421"/> Yuk si Paul, “Ngga'i ka. Aku itu Yahudi. Bay aku nianakan ma da'ira Tarsus, ma lahat Silisi he'. A'a aku min da'ira bangsahan. Na, tuwan, paba'irun aku kono' amissala ni saga a'a itu.”

verses.name: Acts 21:40
verses.text: Jari pinaba'id si Paul e' nakura' sundalu inān ati an'ngge iya ma haronan kuta'. Aninyal iya ma saga a'a, supaya sigām akale ma iya. Pahondong pa'in paghidjul sigām inān, amissala si Paul ma bahasa Hibrani.  <div eID="gen6892" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.21"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:1
verses.text: “Saga matto'a-danakan,” yuk si Paul, “kalehunbi da'awaku.”  <div eID="gen6893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3422"/><div sID="gen6894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3422"/> Pagkale sigām bahasa Hibrani ya pamissalana, pahantap sigām bo' akale pahāp. Jari buwattitu ya pamissalana ma sigām, yukna,

verses.name: Acts 22:3
verses.text: “Aku itu a'a Yahudi. Bay aku nianakan mahē' ma da'ira Tarsus, ma lahat Silisi, sagō' sulig aku maitu ma Awrusalam. Bay aku magguru ma si Gamaliyal, maka bay aku kapandu'an pahāp ma sara' bay pameya'an ka'mbo'-mbo'antam. Bay aku amanuyu' maghinang ni Tuhan, buwat kapanuyu'bi kamemon ilu ma buwattina'an.

verses.name: Acts 22:4
verses.text: Bay pinjala'ku saga a'a ameya' ma kal'ngnganan si Isa bo' supaya sigām pinapatay. Bay sigām saggawku l'lla maka d'nda bo' ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Acts 22:5
verses.text: Makasaksi' Imam Muwallam maka saga palhimpunan matto'a kamemon in bissalaku itu b'nnal sadja. Bay aku pinaniya'an e' sigām sulat pamapatut, sulat ni saga danakanta Yahudi mahē' ma Damaskus. Angkan aku bay pehē' ni Damaskus bo' tasaggawku saga bebeya'an si Isa mahē'. Pinilisu sigām, binowa ni Awrusalam itu bo' bininasa.”  <div eID="gen6894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3423"/><div sID="gen6895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3423"/> “Jari itu,” yuk si Paul, “saga ugtu llaw, asekot pa'in aku ni Damaskus, patagha' sadja aniya' sawa min deyom sulga' anahaya ma sakalibutku.

verses.name: Acts 22:7
verses.text: Pahantak aku ni tana' ati aniya' takaleku suwala ah'lling ni aku, yukna, ‘Saul, O Saul! Angay aku pinjala'nu?’  <div eID="gen6895" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3424"/><div sID="gen6896" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3424"/> “Agsai tilawku. ‘Sai sa ka'a ilu, nakura'?’ yukku. <div eID="gen6896" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6897" type="paragraph"/> “Yuk sambungna, ‘Aku a'a Nasaret, ya pinjala'nu na pa'in.’  <div eID="gen6897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3425"/><div sID="gen6898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3425"/> “Na, saga sehe'ku he',” yuk si Paul, “bay maka'nda' sawa itu sagō' halam tahati e' sigām bang ai pamah'lling ma aku e' suwala inān.

verses.name: Acts 22:10
verses.text: Tilawku isab, ‘Ai subay hinangku, Nakura'?’ <div eID="gen6898" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6899" type="paragraph"/> “Yuk Panghū' inān ni aku, ‘An'ngge ka, bo' ka palanjal pehē' ni Damaskus. Nihaka'an du ka mahē' kamemon ya pamahinang Tuhan ma ka'a.’

verses.name: Acts 22:11
verses.text: Manjari abuta aku e' silaw sawa he', angkan aku bay niambit e' saga sehe'ku pehē' ni Damaskus.  <div eID="gen6899" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3426"/><div sID="gen6900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3426"/> “Mahē' pa'in ma Damaskus aniya' dakayu' a'a niōnan si Ananiyas. A'a iya maga'agama ameya' ma sara'tam, maka pinagaddatan iya e' saga Yahudi kamemon ma da'ira inān.

verses.name: Acts 22:13
verses.text: Bay pehē' si Ananiyas an'ngge ma atagku. Yukna, ‘Saul, magdanakan kita. Maka'nda' na ka pabīng.’ Saru'un-du'un du aku maka'nda',” yuk si Paul, “ati ta'nda'ku si Ananiyas e'.

verses.name: Acts 22:14
verses.text: Yukna, ‘Saul, tapene' ka e' Tuhan ya asal pagtuhanan ka'mbo'-mbo'antam, bo' tata'unu bang ai kabaya'anna. Tapene' ka e'na bo' supaya ta'nda'nu Sosoho'anna Adil, maka bo' takalenu isab suwalana amissala.

verses.name: Acts 22:15
verses.text: Anaksi' du ka pasal si Isa. Angahaka isab ka ma a'a kamemon pasal ai-ai bay ta'nda'nu maka takalenu.

verses.name: Acts 22:16
verses.text: Na, da'a na ka ananggu,’ yuk si Ananiyas ni aku. ‘An'ngge ka bo' ka pinandi, tanda' in ka'a ma si Isa na. Sabbutun ōn Panghū' Isa bo' ka asussi min paldusahannu.’ ”  <div eID="gen6900" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3427"/><div sID="gen6901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3427"/> “Manjari itu,” yuk si Paul, “bay aku pabīng ni Awrusalam itu. Sabuku anambahayang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan aniya' panyata' ni aku.

verses.name: Acts 22:18
verses.text: Ta'nda'ku Panghū' Isa amissala ni aku. Yukna, ‘Parai'-dai' ka ala'an min Awrusalam itu sabab mbal du kinahagad e' saga a'a maitu ya panaksi'nu ma pasal aku.’  <div eID="gen6901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3428"/><div sID="gen6902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3428"/> “ ‘Tuwan Panghū'’, yukku, ‘kinata'uwan asal e' saga a'a itu in aku bay angalatag saga kalanggalan Yahudi bo' tasaggawku maka tabinasaku sasuku angandol ma ka'a.

verses.name: Acts 22:20
verses.text: Ma waktu kapamapatay saga a'a ma si Esteban, ya saksi'nu he', bay aku mahē' angaho'an hinang sigām. Bay aku pamatau'an s'mmek saga a'a bay amapatay iya.’  <div eID="gen6902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3429"/><div sID="gen6903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3429"/> “Sagō' anoho' gi' Panghū' Isa ma aku, yukna, ‘Ala'an na ka minnitu, sabab papehē'ta ka ni katāhan, ni kabangsa-bangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi.’ ”  <div eID="gen6903" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6889" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3430"/><div sID="gen6904" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul dī A'a Rōm</title> <div sID="gen6905" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3430"/> Akale to'ongan saga a'a inān ma si Paul sampay tabissalana ina'an-i, sagō' ta'abut pa'in sinibahat e'na kabangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi, magtūy sigām anagna' angamahit pakosog. Yuk sigām, “Papatayunbi a'a ilu! Mbal iya manjari pinakallum.”  <div eID="gen6905" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3431"/><div sID="gen6906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3431"/> Ina'an sigām maggasud na pa'in, anganjabjaban na pa'in badju' sigām, maka e' sigām anabulakan bagunbun tudju pariyata'.

verses.name: Acts 22:24
verses.text: Manjari magpanoho'an nakura' ma saga sundaluna amowa si Paul ni deyom kuta'. Sinō' iya niraplosan maka sinumariya bo' tata'u bang angay angkan maggasud saga Yahudi he'.

verses.name: Acts 22:25
verses.text: Kaengkotan pa'in si Paul, song pa'in niraplosan, atilaw iya ni tininti ya an'ngge maina'an, yukna, “Patut bahā' daplosanbi a'a Rōm ma halam gi' bay pinalabay min sara'?”  <div eID="gen6906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3432"/><div sID="gen6907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3432"/> Pagkale pa'in itu-i e' tininti, pehē' iya ni nakura' atilaw. Yukna, “Ai maksudnu ma a'a itu? A'a Rōm ko' iya!”  <div eID="gen6907" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3433"/><div sID="gen6908" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3433"/> Angkan pehē' nakura' ni si Paul. Yukna, “Haka'in aku, a'a Rōm ka bahā'?” <div eID="gen6908" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6909" type="paragraph"/> “Aho',” yuk si Paul.  <div eID="gen6909" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3434"/><div sID="gen6910" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3434"/> Yuk nakura', “Aku itu, aheka sīn bay pamayadku bo' aku manjari a'a Rōm.” <div eID="gen6910" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6911" type="paragraph"/> “Sagō' aku,” yuk si Paul, “a'a Rōm asal min kapaganak ma aku.”  <div eID="gen6911" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3435"/><div sID="gen6912" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3435"/> Takale pa'in e'-i, magtūy pasebog saga a'a bay arak amariksa' si Paul. Sampay nakura', tināw isab pagta'una in si Paul a'a Rōm. Sabab iya ya bay magbaran anoho' niengkotan si Paul maka kili-kili.  <div eID="gen6912" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6904" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3436"/><div sID="gen6913" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Pinatandan ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum</title> <div sID="gen6914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3436"/> Jari bilahi mikihaka nakura' sundalu he' bang ai to'ongan panuntut si Paul e' saga Yahudi. Angkanna, pagk'llat llaw dakayu', bay soho'na nila'anan engkot si Paul. Bay soho'na isab magsakaum saga kaimaman alanga maka kamemon saga a'a min Tumpukan Maghuhukum. Ati pinatampal si Paul ni sigām.  <div eID="gen6914" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.22"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:1
verses.text: Manjari amandang si Paul ma Tumpukan Maghuhukum inān. Yukna ma sigām, “Saga dauranakanku, abontol itikadku tudju ni Tuhan pasal bay kahinanganku, min tagna' sampay ni llaw ītu.”

verses.name: Acts 23:2
verses.text: Pagkale si Ananiyas, ya Imam Muwallam, ma bay pina'in e' si Paul e', soho'na saga a'a ma atag si Paul anampak bowa'na.

verses.name: Acts 23:3
verses.text: Yuk si Paul ni si Ananiyas, “Bininasa du ka e' Tuhan. Ahāp luwasannu sagō' ala'at deyom ataynu! Ilu ka aningkō' angahukum aku ma buwat usulan sara', sagō' ka'a ya labi-labina angalanggal sara' sabab soho'nu aku sinampak!”  <div eID="gen6915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3437"/><div sID="gen6916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3437"/> Ah'lling ni si Paul saga a'a ma atagna inān, yuk sigām, “Imam Muwallam ya pahina'nu ilu, ya tapene' e' Tuhan!”  <div eID="gen6916" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3438"/><div sID="gen6917" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3438"/> Anambung si Paul, yukna, “Saga danakanku, halam kata'uwanku in iya Imam Muwallam. Sabab tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, subay da'a pah'llingantam ala'at pagnakura'an bangsatam.”  <div eID="gen6917" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3439"/><div sID="gen6918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3439"/> Manjari itu, pagga kinata'uwan e' si Paul saga a'a ma Tumpukan inān abahagi' duwa, kasehe' sigām Saddusi, kasehe' Parisi, angalingan iya patanog, yukna, “Saga danakan! Aku itu dakayu' Parisi, maka Parisi isab saga matto'aku. Itiya' aku nihukum maitu sabab angaholat aku in a'a magpatayan pinakallum pabalik min kamatay.”

verses.name: Acts 23:7
verses.text: Pagubus, anagna' na magsu'al saga Parisi maka saga Saddusi inān, angkan sigām abahagi' duwa.

verses.name: Acts 23:8
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', in saga Saddusi magpa'in halam aniya' pinakallum pabīng min kamatay, maka halam aniya' mala'ikat atawa umagad. Sagō' saga Parisi magkahagad pasal e'-i kamemon.  <div eID="gen6918" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3440"/><div sID="gen6919" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3440"/> Jari pasōng kasensongan maina'an, maka aniya' saga guru sara' an'ngge, a'a ameya' ma kal'ngnganan saga Parisi. Tino'ongan jawab sigām, yuk-i, “Halam aniya' la'at tabāk kami ma a'a itu! Kalu b'nnal, aniya' umagad atawa mala'ikat bay ah'lling ni iya.”

verses.name: Acts 23:10
verses.text: Manjari karuhunan gom pa'in kasensongan inān, angkan tināw nakura' sundalu kalu pinags'kkat pagdayaw baran si Paul e' saga a'a maina'an. Manjari soho'na saga sundaluna pareyo' pehē' angagaw si Paul bo' binowa ni deyom kuta' pabīng.  <div eID="gen6919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3441"/><div sID="gen6920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3441"/> Sangom inān panyata' Panghū' Isa ni si Paul an'ngge ma bihingna. Yukna, “Paiman ka! Bay aku kasaksi'annu maitu ma Awrusalam. Subay aku kasaksi'annu du isab ma da'ira Rōm.”  <div eID="gen6920" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6913" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3442"/><div sID="gen6921" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magisun saga Yahudi Amapatay si Paul</title> <div sID="gen6922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3442"/> Pagk'llat llaw pa'in, aniya' saga Yahudi magisun. Magsapahan sigām di-sigām subay mbal amangan atawa anginum sat'ggol mbal tapapatay si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 23:13
verses.text: Labi sigām mpatpū' puhu' bay magisun e'.

verses.name: Acts 23:14
verses.text: Manjari pehē' sigām ni saga imam alanga maka pagmatto'ahan, amata'u. Yuk sigām, “Bay na kami magsapa in kami mbal manjari animtim kinakan ai-ai, sat'ggol mbal tapapatay kami si Paul e'.

verses.name: Acts 23:15
verses.text: Angkanna, ka'am maka saga Maghuhukum subay amabeya' lapal ni nakura' sundalu anambukuhan iya amowa si Paul pi'ilu ni ka'am. Subay kam magbau'-bau' in ka'am bilahi amariksa' pahāp-hāp pasal palkala'na he'. Jari kami itu asakap du amapatay iya ma labayan, ma halam gi' makasampay pi'ilu.”  <div eID="gen6922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3443"/><div sID="gen6923" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3443"/> Daipara aniya' kamanakan si Paul l'lla, anak danakanna d'nda, bay makakale pasal pagisun e'. Angkan iya pehē' ni deyom kuta' angahaka'an si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 23:17
verses.text: Jari nilinganan e' si Paul dakayu' tininti, bo' ah'lling ni iya, yukna, “Bowahun subul itu ni nakura'nu, sabab aniya' pangahakana.”

verses.name: Acts 23:18
verses.text: Binowa na iya e' tininti tudju ni nakura'na. <div eID="gen6923" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6924" type="paragraph"/> Yuk tininti, “Bay aku nilinganan e' si Paul, ya pilisu inān, mikipabowa subul itu ni ka'a sabab aniya' kono' pangahakana.”  <div eID="gen6924" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3444"/><div sID="gen6925" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3444"/> Manjari niambit subul inān e' nakura', binowa pasaddī min kasehe'an bo' yampa tilawna. “Ai hakanu ma aku?” yukna.  <div eID="gen6925" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3445"/><div sID="gen6926" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3445"/> Anambung subul he', yukna, “Bay magisun saga nakura' Yahudi. Pagsalung kono', niamu' ka e' sigām amowa si Paul patampal ni Tumpukan Maghuhukum, bahasa iya pinariksa' pabīng.

verses.name: Acts 23:21
verses.text: Sagō' da'a asipun saga nakura' inān, sabab aniya' labi mpatpū' a'a anapukan di-sigām ma bihing lān bo' tinipu si Paul. Bay na sigām magsapahan di-sigām mbal amangan atawa anginum sat'ggol mbal tapapatay sigām si Paul. Asakap na sigām, luwal la'a pangiddanu ya nilagaran.”  <div eID="gen6926" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3446"/><div sID="gen6927" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3446"/> Yuk nakura' ni iya, “Da'a ka ah'lling ni sai-sai in aku bay haka'annu pasal itu-i.” Puwas e' pinaba'id na subul he'.  <div eID="gen6927" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6921" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3447"/><div sID="gen6928" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinandanan si Paul ni Gubnul Pilik</title> <div sID="gen6929" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3447"/> Jari itu nilinganan e' nakura' duwa tinintina. Yukna ni sigām, “Tipununbi duwa hatus sundalu, sō'unbi magsakap pehē' ni Kesareya. Paronganunbi isab pitumpū' sundalu magpangura' maka duwa hatus sundalu magpamowa budjak. Subay sigām atulak lisag siyam sangom ilu.

verses.name: Acts 23:24
verses.text: Sakapunbi isab saga kura' pangura'an si Paul, ati tandaninbi iya pina'an ni gubnul Pilik ma halam aniya' baya-bayana.”  <div eID="gen6929" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3448"/><div sID="gen6930" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3448"/> Jari aniya' sulat pinabeya' e' nakura' ni gubnul. Yuk lapal sulat e',  <div eID="gen6930" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3449"/><div sID="gen6931" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3449"/> “Sulat itu min aku, si Klaudi Lisiyas, pinasampay ni ka'a Pilik, ya gubnul balbangsa.

verses.name: Acts 23:27
verses.text: Tuwan gubnul, a'a itu bay sinaggaw e' saga Yahudi, arak pinapatay. Sagō' pagta'uku pa'in in iya a'a Rōm, magtūy aku pehē' maka saga sundaluku anabang iya.

verses.name: Acts 23:28
verses.text: Ya kabaya'anku subay ana'u bang ai panuntut sigām ma iya, angkan iya bay bowaku patampal ni paghukuman sigām bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 23:29
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in aku, tasayu na in palkala' panuntutan sigām ma iya, palkala' pasal usulan sara' sigām. Halam aniya' bay tahinangna pamapatayan iya atawa pamakalabusuhan iya.

verses.name: Acts 23:30
verses.text: Manjari tapata'u aku aniya' kaisunan saga Yahudi amapatay iya. Angkan iya soho'ku tinandanan magtūy ni ka'a. Maka saga a'a anuntutan iya, bay soho'ku pi'ilu ni ka'a bo' takalenu bang ai panuntut sigām. Ya du ilu. Wassalam.”  <div eID="gen6931" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3450"/><div sID="gen6932" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3450"/> Manjari ningā' na si Paul e' saga sundalu buwat bay panoho'an ma sigām. Ta'abut kauman Antipatri e' sigām sangom inān.

verses.name: Acts 23:32
verses.text: Pagk'llat llaw dakayu', pabīng ni kuta' saga sundalu bay magpamaklay he', ati pinabowa si Paul ma saga sundalu magpangura'.

verses.name: Acts 23:33
verses.text: Makasampay sigām ni da'ira Kesareya, ati ninde'an e' sigām ni gubnul, sulat bay min nakura' sigām. Tinukbalan isab si Paul ni iya.

verses.name: Acts 23:34
verses.text: Binassa sulat e' gubnul bo' yampa tilawna si Paul bang min lahat ingga iya. Tata'u pa'in in si Paul min lahat Silisi,

verses.name: Acts 23:35
verses.text: yuk gubnul ni iya, “Subay na at'kka saga a'a manuntutan ka'a bo' yampa takale palkala'nu.” Manjari magpanoho'an iya in si Paul sinō' nijagahan ma deyom astana' gubnul e'.  <div eID="gen6932" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.23"/> <div eID="gen6928" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3451"/><div sID="gen6933" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Tinuntutan e' saga Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen6934" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3451"/> Makalabay pa'in limambahangi, palūd na si Ananiyas Imam Muwallam ni Kesareya. Aniya' isab saga pagmatto'ahan Yahudi magbeya' maka iya, maka dakayu' abugaw niōnan si Tertullus. Paharap sigām itu ni gubnul supaya anuntutan si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 24:2
verses.text: Kalinganan pa'in si Paul, tinagna'an e' si Tertullus panuntutna. Yukna, “Tuwan balbangsa! Asannang to'ongan lahat kami ma sabab kahāp kapaggubnulnu. Ya bay kahālan kami ala'at tapahāpnu na, sabab ahāp asal pamat'nna'nu.

verses.name: Acts 24:3
verses.text: Ka'amuhan kami ma tabangnu sakahaba' waktu, maingga-maingga lahat, maka aheya pagsukul kami ni ka'a.

verses.name: Acts 24:4
verses.text: Sagō' papu'utku gi' lapal itu bo' ka mbal sinumu,” yukna. “Ya amu'ku junjung ni ka'a, kalehun aku dai'-dai'.  <div eID="gen6934" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3452"/><div sID="gen6935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3452"/> “Tapandoga kami in a'a itu asal panganjabu. Pinahiluhala' e'na bangsa kami Yahudi ma kaluha'an dunya. In iya pagmakōkan ma umpigan Nasaret.<note>Umpigan Nasaret: hatina saga a'a ya ameya' ma si Isa, a'a Nasaret.</note>

verses.name: Acts 24:6
verses.text: Bay iya arak angalumu'an langgal pagkulbanan ma Awrusalam, angkan iya tasaggaw kami. Ya maksud kami in iya subay pinahukum ma buwat usulan sara' kami,

verses.name: Acts 24:7
verses.text: sagō' bay parumpās si Lisiyas nakura' sundalu inān angagaw iya min pang'ntanan kami.

verses.name: Acts 24:8
verses.text: Puwas e' bay soho'na saga a'a anuntut pi'itu patampal ni ka'a. Na, bang ka'a anumariya a'a itu, tata'unu du min iya bang ai sababan angkan kami anuntutan iya.”

verses.name: Acts 24:9
verses.text: Pauyun isab saga Yahudi he' anuntutan si Paul. Yuk sigām in bay binissala e' si Tertullus inān b'nnal sadja.  <div eID="gen6935" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6933" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3453"/><div sID="gen6936" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panganda'awa si Paul ma Alopan si Pilik</title> <div sID="gen6937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3453"/> Manjari sininyalan si Paul e' gubnul, sinō' amissala. Yuk si Paul ni gubnul, “Kinōgan aku anganda'awahan di-ku ma alopannu, tuwan, sabab kata'uwanku at'ggol na pamal'ngngannu sara'nu ma bangsa kami itu.

verses.name: Acts 24:11
verses.text: Aluhay ko' itu pinariksa'. Aniya' na sangpū' maka duwang'llaw buwattina'an, tuwan, bay aku patukad ni Awrusalam anambahayang.

verses.name: Acts 24:12
verses.text: Halam aku bay ta'abut e' saga Yahudi itu maglugat maka sai-na ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Halam aku bay ta'abut amahiluhala' saga a'a, ai na ka ma deyom kalanggalan sigām, ai na ka ma kamaina'anan saddī ma jadjahan da'ira Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 24:13
verses.text: Halam isab aniya' mattanna pamaluwas saga a'a itu palsaksi'an panuntut sigām ma aku.

verses.name: Acts 24:14
verses.text: Sagō', magsab'nnal aku, tuwan, Tuhan kapangkatan kami ya pagta'atanku samantala' aku ameya' ma kal'ngnganan si Isa, ya pinagōnan e' sigām ‘umpigan pagokatan.’ Sagō' kahagadku asal kamemon ya tasulat ma deyom sara' si Musa maka ma deyom Kitab Kanabi-nabihan.

verses.name: Acts 24:15
verses.text: Sali' du aku maka sigām aholat ma Tuhan in manusiya' kamemon, ahāp maka ala'at, pinakallum pabīng.

verses.name: Acts 24:16
verses.text: Angkan aku amanuyu' to'ongan bang pa'in apote' atayku tudju ni Tuhan, sampay ni pagkahiku manusiya'.  <div eID="gen6937" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3454"/><div sID="gen6938" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3454"/> “Manjari itu, pila-pilantahun kalikutanku min Awrusalam, bay aku pabīng pehē' amowa sīn panarakkaku saga a'a bangsaku, sampay maghinang kulban ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Acts 24:18
verses.text: Na, ma sabu pa'in aku maghinang e'-i, bay aku ta'abut e' saga a'a itu ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Baha'u bay talusku hinang pagsussi. Kulang isab a'a bay ma atagku inān maka halam aniya' bay lengog.

verses.name: Acts 24:19
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' saga Yahudi min lahat Asiya bay maina'an. Bang aniya' ganta' panā' saga a'a inān ma aku, arapun sigām maitu anuntutan aku.

verses.name: Acts 24:20
verses.text: Saguwā', pagka sigām halam maitu, pabissalahun na saga Awrusalam itu. Sō'un sigām angahaka bang dusa ai bay panuntutan aku, waktu kapanumariya aku e' Tumpukan Maghuhukum he'.

verses.name: Acts 24:21
verses.text: Sabab halam aku bay katōngan dusa, luwal bahā' ya bay pangalinganku sabuku an'ngge ma dahuan sigām, ya yukku, ‘Ya angkan aku hukumbi ma buwattina'an, ma sabab kahagadku in a'a magpatayan pinakallum du pabīng’.” Minnē' akatis da'awa si Paul.  <div eID="gen6938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3455"/><div sID="gen6939" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3455"/> Manjari pinahondong pagbissala inān e' si Pilik sabab kasakupanna asal pasal kal'ngnganan si Isa Al-Masi. Yuk si Pilik, “Subay na at'kka pi'itu nakura' Lisiyas bo' yampa paluwasku hukumanku.”

verses.name: Acts 24:23
verses.text: Puwas e' bay soho'na dakayu' kapitan inān anganjagahan si Paul ma mbal sakit asigpit kat'nna'anna. Saga bagayna subay pinarūl amowahan iya napakana.  <div eID="gen6939" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3456"/><div sID="gen6940" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3456"/> Apuwas pa'in daka pilambahangi, pina'an si Pilik maka h'ndana si Drusilla, d'nda Yahudi. Pinalinganan e'na pina'an si Paul ati pakale iya ma pamissala si Paul pasal pangandol tudju ni si Isa Al-Masi

verses.name: Acts 24:25
verses.text: Amissala na pa'in si Paul ma pasal a'a subay angahinang kabontolan maka subay amaggat ma napsuna ala'at. Binissala e'na isab hukuman ya pinat'kka e' Tuhan ma saga manusiya' ma llaw sinōng. Pagkale si Pilik ma bissala si Paul itu, magtūy iya tināw ati yukna ma si Paul, “Makajari na ka ala'an. Lingananta pa'in ka pabīng bang aku bilahi.”

verses.name: Acts 24:26
verses.text: Lāgi aholat si Pilik kalu kabuwanan sīn pagmamhu' e' si Paul, angkan si Paul araran pinalinganan e'na bo' magsuli-suli maka iya.  <div eID="gen6940" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3457"/><div sID="gen6941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3457"/> Makalabay pa'in duwantahun, paganti' si Purkiyus Pistus min si Pilik maggubnul. Malaingkan bilahi kinahāpan si Pilik e' saga Yahudi, angkan tahanna lagi' si Paul ma deyom kalabusu.  <div eID="gen6941" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.24"/> <div eID="gen6936" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3458"/><div sID="gen6942" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anganda'awa si Paul ma Alopan Gubnul Pistus</title> <div sID="gen6943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3458"/> Palabay pa'in t'llung'llaw min kat'kka si Pistus ni lahat paggubnulanna inān, patukad iya min Kesareya tudju ni Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 25:2
verses.text: Ma Awrusalam pa'in, pina'an ni iya saga kaimaman alanga maka saga nakura' bangsa Yahudi amowa saga tuntut sigām ma si Paul. Angamu' sigām junjung ni si Pistus

verses.name: Acts 25:3
verses.text: bang pa'in soho'na si Paul pinapinda ni Awrusalam. Bay sigām asal magkaisunan angahapa'an iya ma labayan bo' pinapatay.

verses.name: Acts 25:4
verses.text: Sagō' anambung si Pistus, yukna, “Ina'an si Paul tinahan ma Kesareya ma deyom kalabusu, maka song aku palūd pina'an pabīng.

verses.name: Acts 25:5
verses.text: Paronganunbi ma aku ni Kesareya saga a'abi taga-kapatut. Tuntutinbi iya maina'an bang aniya' bay tahinangna ala'at.”  <div eID="gen6943" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3459"/><div sID="gen6944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3459"/> Saga walu' atawa sangpū' bahangi ya kat'nna' si Pistus ma sigām ma Awrusalam bo' yampa palūd ni Kesareya. Pag'llaw dakayu', aningkō' iya ma bilik paghukuman bo' soho'na si Paul pinasōd pina'an.

verses.name: Acts 25:7
verses.text: Pagsōd pa'in si Paul, pinagtimukan iya e' saga Yahudi ya bay palūd min Awrusalam. Tinuntutan iya e' sigām tuntut abuhat, sagō' halam aniya' kamattanan sigām.

verses.name: Acts 25:8
verses.text: Manjari anganda'awahan di-na si Paul, yukna, “Halam aniya' bay tahinangku langgal sara' ma bangsa kami Yahudi. Halam aniya' bay tahinangku kala'atan tudju ni langgal pagkulbanan, atawa ni Sultan Mahatinggi bangsa Rōm.”  <div eID="gen6944" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3460"/><div sID="gen6945" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3460"/> Sagō' si Pistus, pagka kabaya'anna kinahāpan e' saga Yahudi, atilaw ni si Paul, yukna, “Angaho' ka bahā' bang ka pinatukad pabīng ni Awrusalam, bo' ka hukumku maina'an ma sabab saga tuntut ma ka'a itu?”  <div eID="gen6945" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3461"/><div sID="gen6946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3461"/> Yuk si Paul, “Itiya' aku an'ngge ma paghukuman Sultan Mahatinggi. Wajib aku sinara' maitu. Kasakupannu asal, tuwan gubnul, halam aku bay makabuwan kala'atan ma saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 25:11
verses.text: Bang sab'nnal-b'nnal aku bay makalanggal sara', atawa bang aniya' bay tahinangku patut pamapatayan aku, maglilla' du aku. Sagō' bang ngga'i ka b'nnal ya panuntut e' saga a'a itu ma aku, halam sai-na taga-kapatut ang'nde'an aku ni pang'ntanan sigām. Amu'ku tinukbalan nihukum e' Sultan Mahatinggi!”  <div eID="gen6946" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3462"/><div sID="gen6947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3462"/> Aubus pa'in si Pistus bay makapagisun maka saga bag'llalna, sambunganna si Paul, yukna, “Pagka ka bilahi tinukbalan ni Sultan Mahatinggi, pinapehē' na ka.”  <div eID="gen6947" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6942" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3463"/><div sID="gen6948" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angaru si Pistus ma Sultan Agrippa</title> <div sID="gen6949" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3463"/> At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in minnē', at'kka pina'an ni Kesareya sultan Agrippa maka danakanna d'nda si Bernike. Pina'an sigām anibaw si Pistus, pagaddat sigām ma iya.

verses.name: Acts 25:14
verses.text: Maina'an pa'in sigām daka pilambahangi, pinahatian sultan e' si Pistus pasal palkala' si Paul. Yuk si Pistus, “Aniya' maitu dakayu' pilisu bay tinahan e' si Pilik.

verses.name: Acts 25:15
verses.text: Pagpehē'ku ni Awrusalam, bay aku kabowahan tuntut e' saga kaimaman alanga maka saga pagmatto'ahan Yahudi. Bay aku niamu' e' sigām amat'nna'an iya hukuman.  <div eID="gen6949" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3464"/><div sID="gen6950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3464"/> “Sagō' bay sigām haka'anku, ngga'i ka addat kami bangsa Rōm anōngan sai-sai pinat'nna'an hukuman bang halam gi' bay pinapagtampal dahū maka saga a'a bay anuntutan iya. Aniya' isab waktu kapanganda'awana dahū.

verses.name: Acts 25:17
verses.text: Angkan ko', pagt'kka pi'itu saga a'a anuntut e', halam aku bay amabiyal. Pag'llaw dakayu', bay aku aningkō' magtūy ma bilik paghukuman, ati soho'ku si Paul itu binowa pareyom.

verses.name: Acts 25:18
verses.text: Jari an'ngge saga a'a anuntutan iya. Pangannalku aniya' dusa aheya panuntutan sigām ma si Paul, sagō' halam.

verses.name: Acts 25:19
verses.text: Ya palkala' sigām hal pagjawaban pasal agama sigām, maka pasal dakayu' a'a amatay niōnan Isa. Pinagpa'in a'a inān e' si Paul asal allum.

verses.name: Acts 25:20
verses.text: Na,” yuk si Pistus, “pagka mbal kata'uwanku bang buwattingga subay pamariksa'ku ma saga palkala' buwattē', bay tilawku si Paul bang iya bilahi pinatukad ni Awrusalam bo' nihukum mahē'.

verses.name: Acts 25:21
verses.text: Saguwā' angamu' iya pinatandan palkala'na ni Sultan Mahatinggi ma Rōm bo' sinalassay mahē'. Angkan iya soho'ku tinahan maitu pinajagahan sampay aniya' waktu pamasampay iya ni paghukuman Sultan Mahatinggi.”  <div eID="gen6950" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3465"/><div sID="gen6951" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3465"/> Ah'lling si Agrippa ni si Pistus, “Bilahi aku akale ma a'a itu,” yukna. <div eID="gen6951" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6952" type="paragraph"/> “Takalebi du iya salung,” yuk si Pistus.  <div eID="gen6952" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6948" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3466"/><div sID="gen6953" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Binowa Paharap ma Sultan Agrippa</title> <div sID="gen6954" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3466"/> Pag'llaw dakayu', at'kka pina'an si Agrippa maka si Bernike. Angulinting sigā e' pamulawan maka pamakay angillap, magmahaldika' to'ongan hinabu sigā pasōd ni luma' mairan. Ina'an isab saga nakura' sundalu maka saga a'a bangsahan min lahat ina'an. Magpanoho'an si Pistus, ati binowa si Paul pareyom.

verses.name: Acts 25:24
verses.text: Ma deyom pa'in, yuk si Pistus ni si Agrippa, “Tuwan Sultan, sampay ka'am kamemon makasabuhan kami! Itiya' ta'nda'bi dakayu' a'a ya bay tinuntutan ni aku e' saga Yahudi kamemon, e' saga Yahudi min lahat itu maka saga Yahudi min Awrusalam. Bay sigām angamahit sidda, in a'a itu kono' subay pinapatay saru'un-du'un.

verses.name: Acts 25:25
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' sababan tabākku pamapatayan iya. Jari, pagka iya bilahi tinukbalan ni Sultan Mahatinggi, aniya' niyatku amabeya' iya pehē'.

verses.name: Acts 25:26
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' tantu sababanna panulatanku ni Panghū'ku Sultan,” yuk si Pistus. “Angkan iya bay bowaku pa'alop ni ka'am, ya lagi'na bang ni ka'a, Sultan Agrippa. Ya angkan palkala' itu pinariksa' pabalik, kalu aniya' tabākku sababan bo' sinulat pinabeya' ni Sultan Mahatinggi.

verses.name: Acts 25:27
verses.text: Sabab bang ma aku,” yukna, “mbal taluwa' bang kita anukbalan pilisu ni sara' alanga, bo' mbal tatugila' bang ai panuntut ma iya.”  <div eID="gen6954" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.25"/> <div eID="gen6953" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3467"/><div sID="gen6955" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Amissala ma Matahan Sultan Agrippa</title> <div sID="gen6956" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3467"/> Sakali itu amissala na si Agrippa ni si Paul, yukna, “Paba'idta na ka anganda'awahan di-nu.” Manjari aninyal si Paul maka tanganna bo' yampa anagna' anganda'awa.  <div eID="gen6956" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3468"/><div sID="gen6957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3468"/> “Tuwan sultan Agrippa,” yukna, “kinōgan aku sabab ka'a ya pa'alopanku llaw itu bo' aku makada'awa pasal bay panuntut e' saga Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 26:3
verses.text: Sabab kasakupannu ya addat Yahudi kamemon maka saga pasu'alan sigām. Angkan aku pama'ap ni ka'a, bang pa'in ka mbal sinumu akale ma aku.  <div eID="gen6957" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3469"/><div sID="gen6958" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3469"/> “Kinata'uwan asal e' saga Yahudi kamemon bang buwattingga bay tebongku sangay min kaonde'ku ma deyom kakampunganku, sampay isab mahē' ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: Acts 26:5
verses.text: At'ggol na pakata'u sigām ma aku. Kinata'uwan du e' sigām kapamogbogku ma kal'ngnganan saga Parisi. Halam aniya' makasali' ni saga Parisi bang bogbog du harap ni sara' agama Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 26:6
verses.text: Tu'ud saga Yahudi inān mbal bilahi amuwan saksi' ma pasalku. Na buwattina'an,” yuk si Paul, “itiya' aku nihukum ma sabab pangaholatku in bay janji' Tuhan ni kamatto'ahan kami atuman du.

verses.name: Acts 26:7
verses.text: Ya du isab e'-i niholat e' saga bangsa kami Yahudi kasangpū' maka duwa, salta' pa'in sigām magta'at ni Tuhan llaw-sangom. Tuwan sultan, ya angkan aku tinuntutan e' saga pagkahiku Yahudi, ma sabab pangaholatku itu.

verses.name: Acts 26:8
verses.text: Ka'am saga kasehe' ilu! Angay kam mbal makapam'nnal in Tuhan amakallum a'a min kamatay?  <div eID="gen6958" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3470"/><div sID="gen6959" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3470"/> “Minsan aku, ya pangannalku tagna' subay aku amuspusan kosogku anagga' si Isa, a'a Nasaret.

verses.name: Acts 26:10
verses.text: Ya na he' kahinanganku, waktu tagna' ma Awrusalam. Bay aku kabuwanan kapatut e' saga imam alanga, angkan aheka a'a suku' Tuhan bay isiku ni deyom kalabusu. Ta'abut pa'in sigām pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay, bay aku pauyun angaho'.

verses.name: Acts 26:11
verses.text: Min heka isab sigām bay pabinasaku ma deyom saga kalanggalan kamemon, bo' supaya sigām tapissoko' ang'bba min pameya' sigām ma si Isa. Mamarahi pasu' atayku ma sigām, angkan sigām bay abutku ma saga kalahatan bangsa saddī supaya sigām kala'uganku.  <div eID="gen6959" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3471"/><div sID="gen6960" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3471"/> “Ya na he' bay angutku, ya angkan aku bay pehē' ni Damaskus amowa kapatut maka sulat panoho'an bay pamuwan aku e' saga nakura'.

verses.name: Acts 26:13
verses.text: Na, tuwan Sultan,” yuk si Paul ni si Agrippa, “augtu pa'in llaw, hinabuku ma labayan, aniya' bay ta'nda'ku sawa min deyom sulga', asilaw gi' min llaw. Anahaya sawa he' ma tongodku sampay ma saga a'a bay sehe'ku magl'ngngan e'.

verses.name: Acts 26:14
verses.text: Pahantak kami kamemon ni tana'. Jari aniya' takaleku suwala ah'lling ma bahasa Hibrani, yukna, ‘Saul! O Saul! Angay aku pinjala'nu? Kap'ddi'an du ka pagga aku sagga'nu, sali' sapantun sapi' ya kap'ddi'an bang sipa'na tungkud dapuna.’  <div eID="gen6960" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3472"/><div sID="gen6961" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3472"/> “ ‘Sai sa ka'a ilu, Nakura'?’ yukku. <div eID="gen6961" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6962" type="paragraph"/> “Yukna, ‘Aku si Isa, ya pinjala'nu na pa'in.

verses.name: Acts 26:16
verses.text: Saguwā' an'ngge na ka to'ongan,’ yukna. ‘Ya po'on aku papa'nda' itu ni ka'a bo' ka pene'ku. Kawakilan ka angahaka ma saga a'a pasal in aku bay ta'nda'nu llaw itu, maka ma pasal ai-ai ya pa'nda'anku ni ka'a ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Acts 26:17
verses.text: Papuwasta du ka min pang'ntanan saga pagkahinu Yahudi, maka min pang'ntanan bangsa saddī, ya song pamapehe'anku ka'a,

verses.name: Acts 26:18
verses.text: supaya sigām tabowanu papinda min kalendoman tudju ni kasawahan, min pang'ntanan nakura' saitan tudju ni okoman Tuhan. Manjari ta'ampun du karusahan sigām sabab min pangandol sigām ma aku,’ yuk si Isa, ‘ati pinalamud sigām ni deyoman saga a'a tapene' e' Tuhan.’  <div eID="gen6962" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3473"/><div sID="gen6963" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3473"/> “Angkan ko', tuwan Sultan,” yuk si Paul, “halam bay tasagga'ku ya bay pa'nda' ni aku inān min sulga'.

verses.name: Acts 26:20
verses.text: Jari magnasihat na aku. Bay tagna'anku ma Damaskus, puwas e' ma Awrusalam, bo' ma kaluha'an lahat Yahudi, sampay isab ma saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi. Bay pandu'anku sigām kamemon subay ang'bba to'ongan min dusa sigām bo' papinda ameya' ma Tuhan. Maka subay isab aniya' kahinangan sigām ahāp paltanda'an in sigām ang'bba na min dusa.

verses.name: Acts 26:21
verses.text: Ya na ko' he' sababanna angkan aku bay sinaggaw e' saga Yahudi mahē' ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan. Tino'ongan aku e' sigām, arak pinapatay,

verses.name: Acts 26:22
verses.text: daipara tinabangan na pa'in aku e' Tuhan sampay ni kabuwattituhan. Angkanna aku itiya' an'ngge maitu anaksi' ni saga a'a kamemon areyo'-alanga. Sali' du bissalaku itu maka bay binissala e' saga kanabi-nabihan ma masa awal e', maka e' si Musa, ma pasal pakaradja'an ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Acts 26:23
verses.text: Yuk pangallam sigām in Al-Masi subay makananam kabinasahan maka kamatay. Maka Al-Masi ya pinakallum min kamatay dahū min kamemon, bo' buwananna kasawahan pikilan saga Yahudi maka ngga'i ka Yahudi, supaya sigām kalappasan min hukuman dusa.”  <div eID="gen6963" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3474"/><div sID="gen6964" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3474"/> Sakali itu, salta' pa'in si Paul anganda'awahan di-na buwattē', pinahitan iya e' si Pistus, yukna, “Paul! Binelaw ka! Dumasiyaw pahāp kalanga pangadji'nu, ya na makabelaw ka'a ilu.”  <div eID="gen6964" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3475"/><div sID="gen6965" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3475"/> Anambung si Paul, yukna, “Tuwan Balbangsa, ngga'i ka aku binelaw. B'nnal sadja maka ahantap bissalaku itu.

verses.name: Acts 26:26
verses.text: Kata'uwannu asal, tuwan Sultan, pasal kahālan itu. Angkan aku makatawakkal amissala ni ka'a sabab makatantu aku in kamemon bay pat'kka itu kasakupannu asal. Halam itu bay kalimbungan.

verses.name: Acts 26:27
verses.text: Tuwan sultan Agrippa,” yuk si Paul, “magsab'nnal ka bahā' ma bay kallam saga kanabi-nabihan? Kata'uwanku in ka'a ilu magsab'nnal.”  <div eID="gen6965" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3476"/><div sID="gen6966" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3476"/> Yuk si Agrippa ni si Paul, “Ma pikilannu bahā' tabowanu aku magalmasihin?”  <div eID="gen6966" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3477"/><div sID="gen6967" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3477"/> Yuk si Paul, “Buwattina'an ka atawa ma sinosōng, ya amu'-amu'ku ni Tuhan bang pa'in ka'a, tuwan sultan, sampay saga a'a kamemon ya akale ma aku llaw itu, pasali' ni aku. Ya sadja subay mbal kasali'anbi ya kilikili pangengkot aku itu.”  <div eID="gen6967" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3478"/><div sID="gen6968" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3478"/> Sakali an'ngge sultan maka gubnul maka si Bernike min paningkō'an sigām, sampay saga sehe' sigām magtingkō'an inān.

verses.name: Acts 26:31
verses.text: Pagluwas sigām minnē', magsuli-suli sigām. Yuk sigām, “Halam aniya' sababan pamapatayan atawa pamakalubusuhan a'a inān.”  <div eID="gen6968" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3479"/><div sID="gen6969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3479"/> Yuk si Agrippa ni si Pistus, “Bang iya halam bay makalandu' mikitukbal ni Sultan Mahatinggi, bay iya tapal'ppa.”  <div eID="gen6969" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.26"/> <div eID="gen6955" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3480"/><div sID="gen6970" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Palintas ni Da'ira Rōm</title> <div sID="gen6971" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3480"/> Tagara' pa'in in kami subay pinatulak ni Itali, si Paul maka saga pilisu kasehe' bay pinajagahan ma si Juliyus, dakayu' kapitan ma saga sundalu Rōm. Magnakura' iya ma damba'an sundalu niōnan ‘Ba'anan sundalu Sultan Mahatinggi’.

verses.name: Acts 27:2
verses.text: Paruwa' kami ni dakayu' kappal min lahat Aramittu, marai' na atulak ni saga lahat paghapit-hapitan ma bihing lahat Asiya. Manjari ak'tta na kami min Kesareya he'. Ameya' isab ma kami si Aristarkus a'a Makidunya min da'ira Tessaloneka.  <div eID="gen6971" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3481"/><div sID="gen6972" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3481"/> Pagk'llat pa'in llaw dakayu', pahapit kami ni Sidun. Kinahāpan si Paul e' si Juliyus. Pinaba'id iya anibaw saga bagayna ma lahat Sidun e', bo' iya tatabang e' sigām ma ai-ai kakulanganna.

verses.name: Acts 27:4
verses.text: Makalanjal pa'in kami minnē', anusulan kami min limbu pū' Kiprus sabab anagga' baliyu.

verses.name: Acts 27:5
verses.text: Puwas e' palintas kami ni dambila' s'llang, min dilaut Silisi maka Pampiliya, bo' yampa kami makatandan ni Mira, dakayu' kauman ma lahat Likiya.

verses.name: Acts 27:6
verses.text: Aniya' kappal ta'nda' e' kapitan mahē', kappal min da'ira Iskandari song atulak palanjal ni Itali. Jari pinariyata' kami e'na pina'an bo' atulak na.

verses.name: Acts 27:7
verses.text: Agon kami mbal pasōng ma deyom daka pilambahangi. Kahunitan kami tumandan ni kauman Kinidus. Manjari itu, pagka alandos baliyu, mbal kami makasangsang angkan kami palabay min limbu pū' Kerete, min dilaut tōng Salmone.

verses.name: Acts 27:8
verses.text: Anusul-nusul kami min bihing deya, maka kahunitan kami isab makat'kka ni lo'ok, ya niōnan Parunggu'an Asalamat. Asekot-sekot isab inān ni da'ira Laseya.  <div eID="gen6972" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3482"/><div sID="gen6973" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3482"/> Pagka at'ggol-t'ggol kami maina'an, mbal na kami makalanjal sabab piligdu. Palabay na waktu pagpuwasa ati timpu pamaliyu lagi'. Ginara'an saga a'a inān e' si Paul, yukna,

verses.name: Acts 27:10
verses.text: “Saga tuwan, ma pandogahanku, bang kitam ganta' palanjal minnitu, asiya-siya kitam. Piligdu, magka'at kappal itu maka duwa'anna, maka aniya' isab amatay.”

verses.name: Acts 27:11
verses.text: Sagō' kapitan saga sundalu he', tabowa magkahagad ma bissala nakura' kappal maka tag-dapu. Jari halam sigām bay ameya' ma gara' si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 27:12
verses.text: Ya parunggu'an inān mbal ahāp paglihanan bang salta' timpu pamaliyu, angkan kaheka'an saga a'a inān bilahi ak'tta minnē' tudju ni lahat Pinik, bang pa'in mura-murahan makatandan, ati bo' pinalabay timpu pamaliyu maina'an. Pinik he' dakayu' parunggu'an ahāp ma pū' Kerete, patampal ni hilaga' maka satan.  <div eID="gen6973" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6970" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3483"/><div sID="gen6974" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Baliyu Alandos ma Dilaut</title> <div sID="gen6975" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3483"/> Manjari itu, pagka aniya' baliyu satan mbal sakit akosog, kinabā' e' saga a'a inān ahāp na tinawakkalan bay kagara'an sigām. Angkan nihella' na sau bo' yampa kami anusul min bihing pū' Kerete.

verses.name: Acts 27:14
verses.text: Sagō' mbal gi' at'ggol patumbuk na baliyu min deya, baliyu habagat.

verses.name: Acts 27:15
verses.text: Jari katumbukan kami e' baliyu. Mbal na tasagga' kami baliyu he', angkan kami pabīng munda' ati hal kami magpatūt la'a.

verses.name: Acts 27:16
verses.text: Makalabay pa'in kami min limbu Kauda, pū'-pū' ariki', yampa kami makabaggot buti-buti bay tundanan e', sagō' kahunitan gi' kami.

verses.name: Acts 27:17
verses.text: Taruwa' pa'in buti-buti e' sigām ni diyata' kappal, magtūy binaggot baran kappal maka k'llat bo' mbal pasisa tapi'na. Puwas e', pagka sigām tināw binowa pasanglad ni kat'bbahan asekot pehē' ni Libiya, pinahagmak leha e' sigām. Manjari kappal e' pinasagaran e' sigām tabowa e' baliyu.

verses.name: Acts 27:18
verses.text: Abinasa kami sidda e' goyak angkanna pagk'llat llaw dakayu', anagna' sigām animanan saga duwa'an kasehe'.

verses.name: Acts 27:19
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in kat'llumbahangina, tinimanan e' sigām kapanyapan kappal takapin.

verses.name: Acts 27:20
verses.text: Daka pilambahangi kami halam bay maka'nda' mata llaw atawa bitu'un. Halam isab aniya' kahondongan baliyu. Angkan kami mbal na magniyat lappasan.  <div eID="gen6975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3484"/><div sID="gen6976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3484"/> Sakali itu, pagka at'ggol saga a'a inān halam bay makakakan, an'ngge si Paul ma t'ngnga' sigām amissala. “Saga bagay,” yukna, “arapun bay beya'bi kagara'an da'a subay atulak min pū' Kerete. Bang bay aku beya'bi mbal kitam bay magka'at maka halam aniya' ai-ai alungay.

verses.name: Acts 27:22
verses.text: Sagō' buwattina'an soho'ta kam paiman, sabab halam du aniya' min ka'am amatay. Luwal du kappal itu magka'at.

verses.name: Acts 27:23
verses.text: Sabab dibuhi',” yuk si Paul, “aniya' bay panyata' ni aku dakayu' mala'ikat min Tuhan ya asal pagta'atanku. Aku itu palsuku'anna asal.

verses.name: Acts 27:24
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat ni aku, ‘Paul, da'a ka tināw. Subay ka paharap ni Sultan Mahatinggi. Pinakallum du isab saga sehe'nu ma kappal itu, ma sabab kahāp Tuhan ma ka'a!’

verses.name: Acts 27:25
verses.text: Angkan, saga bagay,” yuk si Paul, “subay kam aiman. Sabab angandol aku ma Tuhan in bay pamissalana ma aku maujud du.

verses.name: Acts 27:26
verses.text: Sagō' tabowa du kitam e' baliyu paragsa' ni dakayu' pū'.”  <div eID="gen6976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3485"/><div sID="gen6977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3485"/> Manjari itu, ta'abut pa'in sangpū' maka mpat bahangi min katagna' badju inān, tapepe na pa'in kami e' baliyu ma olangan s'llang Adriya. Sōng-sōng pa'in tonga' bahangi, tapandoga e' saga a'a kappal inān in kami asekot na ni bihing lahat.

verses.name: Acts 27:28
verses.text: Angkan tin'kkad deyo' inān bo' kinata'uwan bang pila lalomna. Jari t'kkaranna he' aniya' saga duwampū' d'ppa. Mbal at'ggol tin'kkad pabīng, ati sangpū' la'a maka limand'ppa.

verses.name: Acts 27:29
verses.text: Tināw sigām tabowa paragsa' ni kabatuhan, angkan sigām angahūg mpat sau min buli' kappal bo' yampa sigām aminta-minta bang pa'in al'kkas pak'llat llaw.

verses.name: Acts 27:30
verses.text: Saga a'a maghinang ma kappal inān bay pasulay alahi. Magbau'-bau' sigām angahūg saga sau min munda' kappal, sagō' ina'an sigām bay anontonan buti-buti tudju ni tahik.

verses.name: Acts 27:31
verses.text: Sagō' ah'lling si Paul ni kapitan maka ni saga sundalu, yukna, “Bang saga a'a inān mbal pat'ttog ma kappal, magmula du kam!”

verses.name: Acts 27:32
verses.text: Angkan kin'ttob e' saga sundalu lubid bay panonton buti-buti. Hal pinal'bbos ni tahik.  <div eID="gen6977" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3486"/><div sID="gen6978" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3486"/> Apote' pa'in sobangan, nilogos sigām kamemon e' si Paul, sinō' amangan. Yukna, “Kasangpū' na maka mpat bahangi llaw itu ya pagsusabi. Halam kam bay makatimtim ai-ai.

verses.name: Acts 27:34
verses.text: Angkan kam logosku subay amangan, bo' kam makatatas. Sabab minsan hal dalamba bu'unbi mbal du magmula.”

verses.name: Acts 27:35
verses.text: Akatis pa'in e' si Paul ah'lling, angā' iya tinapay ati bo' pinagsukulan e'na ni Tuhan ma alopan sigām kamemon. Puwas e' pinagpōng e'na tinapay bo' iya amangan.

verses.name: Acts 27:36
verses.text: Jari itu pahogot atay sigām ati amangan sigām kamemon.

verses.name: Acts 27:37
verses.text: Aniya' kami duwa hatus maka pitumpū' maka nnom a'a bay ma diyata' kappal e'.

verses.name: Acts 27:38
verses.text: Maka'ssohan pa'in sigām, tinimanan e' sigām ni tahik saga buwas tirigu ya ma deyom mohang, bo' supaya palantung kappal inān.  <div eID="gen6978" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6974" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3487"/><div sID="gen6979" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magka'at Kappal</title> <div sID="gen6980" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3487"/> Pag'llaw pa'in halam takilā e' saga a'a kappal bang pū' ai ya pata'nda' inān, sagō' aniya' ta'nda' e' sigām lo'ok taga-gusung ma bihing. Ya paggara' sigām, bang makajari, pinasanglad kappal pina'an ni gusung.

verses.name: Acts 27:40
verses.text: Angkan kinehet e' sigām engkot saga sau, ni'bbahan ma deyom tahik. Nihubaran isab lubid bay pamaggot saga bansān. Puwas e' pinat'ngge e' sigām leha-leha ma munda' bo' tabowa e' baliyu patandan ni bihing.

verses.name: Acts 27:41
verses.text: Sagō' makaragsa' sigām ni kahanggalan. Amalut munda' kappal, mbal pajudjal, maka buli'na he' abagbag e' goyak.  <div eID="gen6980" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 27:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3488"/><div sID="gen6981" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3488"/> Maggara' saga sundalu inān amapatay saga pilisu kamemon bo' supaya halam aniya' makalangi ni bihing alahi.

verses.name: Acts 27:43
