verses.text: Sagō' nakura' sigām inān mbal bilahi ni'inay si Paul, angkan lāngna saga sundalu, sinō' da'a angalanjalan e'-i. Gom pa'in soho'na saga a'a inān, sasuku ata'u palangi, palaksu dahū ni deyom tahik bo' palangi kaleya.

verses.name: Acts 27:44
verses.text: Saga a'a kasehe'an sinō' paturul, ameya' pagūng ma papan atawa ma kayu bay magka'at ma kappal inān. Manjari tabuwattē' kami kamemon, makatandan ni bihing, halam ainay.  <div eID="gen6981" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Acts.27"/> <div eID="gen6979" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3489"/><div sID="gen6982" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ma Pū' Malta</title> <div sID="gen6983" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3489"/> Makatandan pa'in kami ma halam aniya' baya-baya, aniya' angahaka'an kami in pū' inān niōnan Malta.

verses.name: Acts 28:2
verses.text: Asidda kami kinahāpan e' saga a'a Malta inān. Nirokotan e' sigām api sabab anagna' na angulan maka ahaggut na, ati pina'idda kami kamemon e' sigām.

verses.name: Acts 28:3
verses.text: Si Paul inān bay animuk engas-engas pangayu, dap'kkosan. Ma sabuna pa'in amat'nna' kayu inān ma api, aniya' sowa abisa paluwas sabab min pasu'na. Jari sowa ina'an pakeket ma tangan si Paul.

verses.name: Acts 28:4
verses.text: Pag'nda' saga a'a Malta ma sowa ina'an pagantung ma tangan si Paul, magtūy sigām magupama dangan maka dangan, yuk-i, “Tantu a'a itu bay amapatay, sabab minsan iya bay makapuwas min deyom tahik, tu'ud mbal katangguhan kadalna.”

verses.name: Acts 28:5
verses.text: Sagō' sowa inān hal pinessekan e' si Paul tudju ni deyom api ma halam ainay.

verses.name: Acts 28:6
verses.text: Angagad-ngagad na pa'in saga a'a Malta inān kalu ang'tting tangan si Paul, atawa amatay saru'un-du'un. Sagō' at'ggol-t'ggol pa'in e' sigām angagad, bo' halam aniya' la'at tum'kka ni baran si Paul, apinda pikilan sigām. Yuk sigām, “Dakayu' tuhan ko' a'a itu!”  <div eID="gen6983" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3490"/><div sID="gen6984" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3490"/> Na, aniya' ma kasekotan ina'an saga huma si Publiyus, ya datu' ma pū' inān. Binowa kami ni humana ati sinagina kami e'na pahāp-hāp. Pina'idda kami e'na ma deyom t'llumbahangi.

verses.name: Acts 28:8
verses.text: Ina'an asal mma' si Publiyus palege sabab apasu' iya, maka magsungi'-sungi'. Pasōd si Paul ni deyom bilikna bo' angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ma pasalna. Pinat'nna' isab tangan si Paul ni baran matto'a he', magtūy iya kauli'an.

verses.name: Acts 28:9
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', pina'an na isab ni si Paul sasuku taga-saki ma pū' inān, ati kauli'an du isab sigām.

verses.name: Acts 28:10
verses.text: Aheka bay pamuwan e' saga a'a inān pangahulmat kami, ati song pa'in kami atulak, niruwa' e' sigām ni kappal ai-ai kagunahan kami palutu'.  <div eID="gen6984" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6982" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3491"/><div sID="gen6985" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagtulak ni Rōm</title> <div sID="gen6986" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3491"/> Aniya' kami t'llumbulan ma pū' Malta inān bo' yampa kami ak'tta minnē'. Ya pameya'an kami kappal min Iskandari bay palihan ma pū' inān t'ggol bay timpu pamaliyu.

verses.name: Acts 28:12
verses.text: At'kka kami ni da'ira Sirakus, ati t'llumbahangi ya kahanti' kami maina'an

verses.name: Acts 28:13
verses.text: bo' yampa kami palaus minnē' tudju ni lahat Rigiyum. Pag'llaw dakayu', baliyu satan na ati duwambahangi bo' kami at'kka ni kauman Putiuli.

verses.name: Acts 28:14
verses.text: Aniya' tabāk kami saga bebeya'an si Isa maina'an. Sinō' kami paokom ma sigām saga dapitu'. Puwas e' palaus kami amaklay ni da'ira Rōm.

verses.name: Acts 28:15
verses.text: Takale pa'in e' saga bebeya'an si Isa ma Rōm in kami at'kka na, magtūy sigām bay pa'abut ni tiyanggi Appiyus maka ni kauman T'llu-Kadday anampang kami. Pag'nda' si Paul ma sigām, magsukul iya ni Tuhan ati pahogot atayna pabīng.

verses.name: Acts 28:16
verses.text: Makat'kka pa'in kami ni da'ira Rōm, pinaba'id si Paul magluma'an di-na. Aniya' dakayu' sundalu anganjagahan iya.  <div eID="gen6986" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6985" type="section"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3492"/><div sID="gen6987" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Magnasihat ma Da'ira Rōm</title> <div sID="gen6988" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3492"/> Palabay pa'in t'llumbahangi, nilinganan e' si Paul saga kanakura'an Yahudi ya maglahat maina'an, sinō' patimuk. Atimuk pa'in, yuk si Paul ni sigām, “Saga dauranakanku, halam aniya' dusaku ma pagkahiku Yahudi, maka halam aniya' palsagga'anku ma pangaddatan ka'mbo'antam. Sagō' minsan buwattē', bay aku sinaggaw sampay pinakalabusu e' saga Yahudi ma Awrusalam, bo' sinōngan e' sigām ni pang'ntanan bangsa Rōm.

verses.name: Acts 28:18
verses.text: Bay aku sinumariya e' saga bag'llal Rōm. Jari bilahi na sigām amal'ppa aku sabab halam aniya' tapiha e' sigām sababan pamapatayan aku.

verses.name: Acts 28:19
verses.text: Sagō' mbal to'ongan amarūl saga Yahudi he' bang aku ganta' pinal'ppa, angkan halam aniya' tahimangkanku saddī min mikitukbal ni Sultan Mahatinggi ma Rōm itu. Saguwā', minsan buwattē', halam aniya' panuntutku ma saga pagkahiku Yahudi.

verses.name: Acts 28:20
verses.text: Angkan kam bay amu'ku pi'itu bo' kitam mag'nda' maka magbissala, supaya kata'uwanbi bang ai ya maksudku. Itiya' aku niengkotan maka kilikili ma sabab pameya'ku ma a'a dakayu'-kayu' ya holattam bangsa Isra'il.”  <div eID="gen6988" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3493"/><div sID="gen6989" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3493"/> Yuk saga a'a magtimukan inān ni si Paul, “Halam kami bay makasambut sulat min lahat Yahudiya ma pasalannu. Halam isab aniya' saga danakantam Yahudi bay pi'itu minnē' amowa haka atawa tuhuma ala'at bang ma sababannu.

verses.name: Acts 28:22
verses.text: Sagō' bilahi kami akale bang ai kapam'nnalannu. Sabab kata'uwan kami, ya pandu' pameya'annu ilu binissalahan na pa'in ala'at e' saga a'a ma sabarang lahat.”  <div eID="gen6989" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3494"/><div sID="gen6990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3494"/> Manjari itu, maggara' sigām maka si Paul bang sumiyan pamissalana ma sigām. Ta'abut pa'in llawna, aheka sigām bay pina'an ni luma' pahanti'an si Paul e'. Min subu-subu sampay ni kasangoman pinahatian sigām e' si Paul maka ninasihatan pasal kapagparinta Tuhan. Tinō'an sigām bang ai bay tasulat ma deyom Sara' si Musa maka ma Kitab Kanabi-nabihan, bo' sigām kamattanan sampay tabowa magkahagad ma si Isa.

verses.name: Acts 28:24
verses.text: Aniya' min sigām tabowa magkahagad ma bissalana, maka aniya' halam.

verses.name: Acts 28:25
verses.text: Minnē' aniya' pagsu'al sigām. Ma song pa'in sigām amole', aniya' gi' bissala si Paul ma sigām, yukna, “Atumlang na bay pangallam Rū Sussi, ya bay pinalatun e' nabi Isaya ni saga ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi.

verses.name: Acts 28:26
verses.text: Sabab ya itu bay yukna, <lg sID="gen6991"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6992"/>‘Pehē' na ka ni bangsa itu bo' sigām haka'in:<l eID="gen6992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6993"/>Asal kam pakale, sagō' mbal tahatibi.<l eID="gen6993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6994"/>Asal kam papatong, sagō' mbal tapanhidbi.<l eID="gen6994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6995"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:27
verses.text: Sabab saga a'a itu hal magmatuwas.<l eID="gen6995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6996"/>Tainga sigām bay tinaplokan, mata sigām bay tinambunan.<l eID="gen6996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6997"/>Bang bay ngga'i ka buwattē', bay du ta'nda' e' mata sigām,<l eID="gen6997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6998"/>bay takale e' tainga sigām.<l eID="gen6998" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6999"/>Bay du isab tahati e' tawhid sigām,<l eID="gen6999" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7000"/>ati pabalik sigām magta'at ma aku,’ yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen7000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7001"/>‘bo' yampa sigām bawi'ku.’ ”<l eID="gen7001" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6991"/>  <div eID="gen6990" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3495"/><div sID="gen7002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3495"/> Tinambol e' si Paul bissalana, yukna, “Angkan subay kata'uwanbi, in lapal Tuhan pasal kalappasna ma manusiya' pinasampay na ni saga kabangsahan ya ngga'i ka Yahudi. Sigām inān angikut du.” [

verses.name: Acts 28:29
verses.text: Akatis pa'in e' si Paul amissala, magtūy ala'an saga Yahudi maka e' sigām magjawab sidda.]  <div eID="gen7002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Acts 28:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3496"/><div sID="gen7003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3496"/> Ma deyom duwantahun, ina'an si Paul pat'nna' ma luma' bay padjakna. Sinagina e'na sasuku bay pina'an ni iya,

verses.name: Acts 28:31
verses.text: ninasihatan na pa'in pasal pagparinta Tuhan, maka pasal Panghū' Isa Al-Masi. Atampal e'na amandu' maka halam aniya' makalāng iya. <signed sID="gen7004"/> Tammat<signed eID="gen7004"/>  <div eID="gen7003" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6987" type="section"/> <div eID="gen6484" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Acts.28"/> <div eID="gen6477" osisID="Acts" type="book"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu deyo' min aku, si Paul, pinasampay ni ka'am ma da'ira Rōm. Aku itu dakayu' sosoho'an si Isa Al-Masi. Tapene' aku e' Tuhan, kawakilan e'na magnasihat lapalna ahāp.

verses.name: Romans 1:2
verses.text: Lapal ahāp itu bay panganjanji' e' Tuhan ma masa awal. Bay pinalatun e'na ma saga nabi, ati sinulat e' sigām ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: Romans 1:3
verses.text: Si Isa anak Tuhan ya pinagbissala ma lapal ahāp itu. Bang takdil ni kapaga'ana, tubu' iya min sultan Da'ud.

verses.name: Romans 1:4
verses.text: Bang takdil ni kajarihanna maka palnyawahanna, asussi iya luwas bay min Rū Sussi, maka manyatakan isab in iya b'nnal Anak Tuhan ma sabab kosog kawasa Tuhan ya bay pamakallum iya min kamatay. Si Isa Almasi Panghū'tam ko' itu.

verses.name: Romans 1:5
verses.text: Iya ya palsababan angkan aku kabuwanan kapatut e' Tuhan ati kawakilan magnasihat bo' supaya aniya' saga a'a min bangsa kamemon tabowa e'ku magsab'nnal maka ameya' ma si Isa.

verses.name: Romans 1:6
verses.text: Ya du ka'am maglahat ma da'ira Rōm ilu, tapene' du isab kam e' Tuhan bo' pasuku' ma si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7012" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3497"/><div sID="gen7013" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3497"/> Amabeya' aku sulat itu ni ka'am kamemon mailu ma Rōm, a'a kinalasahan e' Tuhan maka pinene' e'na bo' kam manjari a'ana. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7013" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3498"/><div sID="gen7014" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magsukul si Paul ni Tuhan ma Sabab saga A'a Rōm</title> <div sID="gen7015" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3498"/> Tagna'anku na bissalaku ma ka'am: magsukul aku ni Tuhan labay min si Isa Al-Masi, maka magsukul aku ma pasalanbi kamemon sabab abantug na pangandolbi sampay ma kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Romans 1:9
verses.text: Saksi'ku Tuhan ya paghinanganku min deyom atay pagka aku magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal Anakna. Taentomku kam sakahaba'

verses.name: Romans 1:10
verses.text: waktu kapangarapku ni Tuhan. Amu'ku isab ni iya bang pa'in aku kinahandakan e'na supaya makaluhaya pi'ilu patibaw ni ka'am ma waktu itu.

verses.name: Romans 1:11
verses.text: Landu' to'ongan aku bilahi mag'nda' maka ka'am sabab aniya' kahāpan min Rū Tuhan bowahanku ka'am, supaya angahogot imanbi tudju ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 1:12
verses.text: Saguwā' bang aku makamailu ma ka'am, magkalasigan kitam sali'-sali', ka'am ma sabab pangandolku, aku isab ma sabab pangandolbi.  <div eID="gen7015" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3499"/><div sID="gen7016" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3499"/> Saga dauranakanku, kabaya'anku subay kam mbal a'awam ma pasalanku. Min heka na aku bay agara' anibaw ka'am, saguwā' aniya' na pa'in makabimbang, ya po'on aku halam bay makalanjal. Ya maksudku pi'ilu, subay aniya' paluntungan min pagnasihatku, hatina aniya' a'a tabowaku magsab'nnal ma si Isa, buwat bay kapamowaku ma bangsa kasehe' ya ngga'i ka isab Yahudi.

verses.name: Romans 1:14
verses.text: Sabab aniya' hinang bay pama'atas ma aku, ya po'on aku subay magnasihat lapal ahāp ma a'a kamemon minsan ai bangsa, bangsa Girīk ka atawa bangsa saddī, a'a taga-pangadji' ka atawa halam aniya' pangadji'na.

verses.name: Romans 1:15
verses.text: Angkan aku atuyu' to'ongan magnasihat lapal ahāp itu sampay ma ka'am ya maglahat mailu ma da'ira Rōm.  <div eID="gen7016" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3500"/><div sID="gen7017" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3500"/> Mbal aku aiya' magnasihat lapal ahāp itu sabab aniya' barakatna min Tuhan pamapuwas a'a kamemon min hukuman dusa, bangsa Yahudi dahū bo' yampa bangsa kasehe', ya sasuku magsab'nnal ma lapal itu.

verses.name: Romans 1:17
verses.text: Lapal ahāp itu amahatian kitam bang buwattingga pamabontol Tuhan ma kitam manusiya'. Subay kitam angandol sadja, min tagna'anna sampay ni katapusanna, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Sai-sai angandol ma Tuhan, bo' tabista e'na abontol, allum du iya.”  <div eID="gen7017" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7014" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3501"/><div sID="gen7018" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bangsa Manusiya' Taga-dusa Kamemon</title> <div sID="gen7019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3501"/> In mulka' Tuhan pinabukis na min deyom sulga', pinat'kkahan saga manusiya' ma sabab ya nihinang e' sigām ma halam aniya' pagmatāw ma Tuhan. Katambunan e' sigām in pangita'u b'nnal.

verses.name: Romans 1:19
verses.text: Patut sigām minulka'an sabab manyatakan asal kajarihan Tuhan, sabab baran Tuhan ya bay amata'uwan sigām. Tu'ud sigām mbal bilahi am'nnal.

verses.name: Romans 1:20
verses.text: Sangay min waktu bay pamapanjari dunya itu e' Tuhan atampal asal palantarana, minsan iya mbal ta'nda' e' manusiya'. Atampal in iya taga-kawasa taptap ni kasaumulan. Atampal isab in iya Tuhan, takilā asal min kamemon ai-ai bay papanjarina. Manjari halam aniya' a'a makara'awa in iya a'awam pasal Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7019" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3502"/><div sID="gen7020" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3502"/> Makata'u asal sigām ma pasal Tuhan, in iya patut pagtuhanan, saguwā' mbal sigām bilahi angamahaltabat iya atawa angōn Tuhan ma iya. Mbal sigām minsan magsarang-sukul. Ya pinikil na pa'in e' sigām pikilan halam aniya' kagunahanna, ati alendom akkal sigām kabowa karupangan ya tahinang sigām.

verses.name: Romans 1:22
verses.text: Maglaku-laku sigām in sigām taga-pangita'u sagō' magkarupangan sadja.

verses.name: Romans 1:23
verses.text: Arapun sigām amudji Tuhan ya taptap allum, saguwā' ya pinudji e' sigām saga ta'u-ta'u pinaka luwa manusiya' ya magkamatay. Pinudji isab e' sigām ta'u-ta'u luwa hayop, luwa manuk-manuk, luwa ai-ai maglelehan ma kuwit tana'.  <div eID="gen7020" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3503"/><div sID="gen7021" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3503"/> Angkanna manusiya' itu pinasagaran e' Tuhan magdūl-baya' ma kasabulan ai-ai kinanapsuhan e' sigām. Magkahinangan na pa'in sigām kalumu'an dapagkahian.

verses.name: Romans 1:25
verses.text: Sinulak e' sigām bissala b'nnal pasal Tuhan ati pinene' e' sigām bissala puting. Ya sinumba e' sigām saga ai-ai bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan, sagō' Tuhan ya mbal sinanglitan minsan iya ya Magpapanjari angkan patut subay pinudji sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen7021" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3504"/><div sID="gen7022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3504"/> Pagka buwattē' kahinangan manusiya', pinasagaran sigām e' Tuhan magpangandūlan napsu sigām makatamparasa. Ang'bba kar'ndahan min addat sigām kar'ndahan bo' magkabaya' maka pagkahi d'nda maghinang ala'at.

verses.name: Romans 1:27
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab kal'llahan, mbal bilahi ma d'nda sagō' magkabaya' maka pagkahi sigām l'lla. Magbeya' sigām maghinang kasabulan, angkan sigām pinat'kkahan la'at pinapagtongod maka kala'atan ya bay tahinang sigām.  <div eID="gen7022" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3505"/><div sID="gen7023" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3505"/> Na, pagka bangsa manusiya' itu mbal bilahi angisbat pangita'u b'nnal pasal Tuhan, pinasagaran sigām e'na magpikil karupangan, ati nihinang e' sigām ya mbal manjari nihinang.

verses.name: Romans 1:29
verses.text: Ap'nno' panahu'an sigām e' kala'atan maka dusa kaginisan, hawa napsu maka kajahilan. Makalandu' heka kala'atan ma deyom pangatayan sigām, buwat saga angalindi, amono' pagkahi sigām manusiya', angalugat, angulli', anganjahulaka', amalatun bissala ala'at,

verses.name: Romans 1:30
verses.text: angalimut isab sigām ma kasehe'an sigām. Ab'nsi saga a'a buwattē' ma Tuhan. Ajingki sigām ma pagkahi sigām, alanga to'ongan atay sigām maka magabbu-abbu na pa'in. Ya sadja pinikil e' sigām bang buwattingga kasōng hinang sigām ala'at-i. Agagga sigām ma pami'at matto'a

verses.name: Romans 1:31
verses.text: maka ala'at pamikil sigām. Mbal sigām kapangandolan, mbal alasa atawa ma'ase' ma pagkahi sigām, mbal tabowa magkahāp.

verses.name: Romans 1:32
verses.text: Makata'u saga manusiya' itu abontol asal pangahandak Tuhan ma pasal a'a maghinang saga dusa itu, in sigām subay pinapatay. Sagō' minsan buwattē', luhūy sigām maghinang kala'atan maka kinōgan gom pa'in bang aniya' a'a kasehe' makasali' ni sigām.  <div eID="gen7023" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.1"/> <div eID="gen7018" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3506"/><div sID="gen7024" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hukuman Tuhan ma Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen7025" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3506"/> Angkanna kam mbal makara'awa, sasuku kam anoway pagkahibi ma sabab ala'at hinangna. Yukbi in sigām patut pinat'nna'an hukuman, sagō' amat'nna'an kam di-bi hukuman sabab ya du ka'am maghinang kala'atan. Hatina, bang kam anoway kasehe'anbi, sali' ka'am baranbi ya sinoway.

verses.name: Romans 2:2
verses.text: Kata'uwanta asal, abontol hukuman Tuhan ya pamat'nna'na ma sasuku maghinang ginisan la'at bay sambatku he'.

verses.name: Romans 2:3
verses.text: Kumpasbi bahā' in ka'am makapuwas min hukuman Tuhan, bo' pa'in masi maghinang kala'atan ya panowaybi sehe'bi?

verses.name: Romans 2:4
verses.text: Ma'ase' Tuhan ma ka'am, angkan kam halam pinat'nna'an hukuman saru'un-du'un, sagō' halam tapaheyabi ma atay in kahāpanna, maka ka'ase'na, maka kalunuk pangatayanna. Ya sadja kabaya'anna in ka'am subay pataikut sampay ang'bba min dusabi.

verses.name: Romans 2:5
verses.text: Sagō' atuwas kam, mbal bilahi apinda min dusabi. Angkanna paruhun kabinasahan ma ka'am bang ta'abut llaw pamatuwa' e' Tuhan astolna maka hukumanna abontol.

verses.name: Romans 2:6
verses.text: Sabab in manusiya' kamemon tinungbasan du e' Tuhan pakaniya-pakaniya, pinapagtongod maka ai-ai bay hinang sigām ma dunya.

verses.name: Romans 2:7
verses.text: Aniya' manusiya' kasehe' atukid maghinang ahāp sabab sanglit maka hulmat min Tuhan ya niangut e'na, maka kallum kakkal. Ya pamuwan Tuhan ma a'a buwattē' kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Romans 2:8
verses.text: Aniya' isab a'a kabintanan magpalanga di-na min kasehe'anna. Sinulak e' sigām kasab'nnalan ati ameya' ma kala'atan. Tantu pinat'kkahan mulka' Tuhan saga a'a buwattē'.

verses.name: Romans 2:9
verses.text: Sasuku biyaksa maghinang ala'at taluwa' du katiksa'an maka kabinasahan, bangsa Yahudi bo' yampa bangsa kasehe'.

verses.name: Romans 2:10
verses.text: Saguwā' sasuku maghinang ahāp sinanglitan du e' Tuhan, binuwanan kahulmatan maka kasannangan atay, bangsa Yahudi bo' yampa isab bangsa kasehe',

verses.name: Romans 2:11
verses.text: sabab Tuhan mbal amapagbidda' ma manusiya'. Sali'-sali' sigām ma pang'nda'na minsan ai bangsa.  <div eID="gen7025" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3507"/><div sID="gen7026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3507"/> Saga bangsa kasehe', ya halam bay kapat'nna'an sara' si Musa, amutawan du min Tuhan minsan halam aniya' sara' pangalanggalan sigām. Maka bangsa Yahudi isab, taluwa' sigām hukuman ma buwat panoho'an sara' si Musa.

verses.name: Romans 2:13
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka min kakaleta ma sara' si Musa ya angkan kita abontol ma pang'nda' Tuhan, saguwā' min kapameya'ta ma panoho'anna.

verses.name: Romans 2:14
verses.text: Halam aniya' sara' si Musa ma saga a'a ya ngga'i ka Yahudi, sagō' bang sigām angahinang kahāpan luwas min deyom atay sigām, hatina tabeya' e' sigām sara' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 2:15
verses.text: Aniya' tanda' saksi' in panoho'an sara' pat'nna' asal ma deyom itikad sigām, jari minnē' aniya' pangita'u sigām pasal hinang ya patut nihinang maka mbal.

verses.name: Romans 2:16
verses.text: Manjari bang ta'abut llaw damuli, ya llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya' labay min si Isa Al-Masi, tinanding e'na ai-ai bay katapukan ma deyom pamikil, ati minnē' sigām nihukum. Buwattē' isab ma lapal ahāp ya pagnasihatku.  <div eID="gen7026" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7024" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3508"/><div sID="gen7027" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bangsa Yahudi maka Pamogbog Sara'</title> <div sID="gen7028" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3508"/> Na ka'am saga Yahudi, ya pasangdol ma sara'-panoho'an min si Musa bo' supaya kam tinaima' e' Tuhan. Tuhan isab ya pagmalangkahianbi ni a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Romans 2:18
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi bang ai pangahandak Tuhan ma ka'am, maka bang ai ya wajib hinangbi ma sabab sara' si Musa ya pangadji'anbi.

verses.name: Romans 2:19
verses.text: Pangannalbi in ka'am tōp magmalim ma a'a buta, ya halam pangadji'na. Yukbi in ka'am sali' sawa pamasawa akkal a'a kasehe', ya ma deyom kalendoman.

verses.name: Romans 2:20
verses.text: Pangannalbi isab in ka'am jukup ma akkal maka ma pangita'u sabab ilu sara' ma ka'am, angkan yukbi in ka'am ata'u amaguru ma a'a mbal ata'u, amituwa isab ma saga a'a a'awam.

verses.name: Romans 2:21
verses.text: Ata'u kam amandu' ma a'a kasehe'an, angay kam mbal amandu'an di-bi? Banda'anbi a'a kasehe' subay mbal anangkaw, bo' ka'am ya anangkaw du!

verses.name: Romans 2:22
verses.text: Pamandu'bi subay mbal angaliyu-lakad ma ngga'i ka paghola'na, bo' ka'am ya labi magd'nda. Asammal kono' ma pang'nda'bi bang a'a anumba ta'u-ta'u, bo' pa'in ka'am ya angagaw ai-ai ahalga' min luma' pagsusumbahan ta'u-ta'u inān!

verses.name: Romans 2:23
verses.text: Magabbu-abbu kam in ka'am kabuwanan sara' Tuhan, sagō' ka'am ya amuwan kamaruhan ma Tuhan pagka halam beya'bi panoho'anna.

verses.name: Romans 2:24
verses.text: Buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Ka'am saga Yahudi ya sababna angkan Tuhan pinah'llingan pangkal e' bangsa kasehe'an.”  <div eID="gen7028" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3509"/><div sID="gen7029" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3509"/> In kitam Yahudi sinō' ni'islam tanda' saksi' in kitam a'a suku' Tuhan. Saguwā' bang kam maglalanggal sara', sali' halam aniya' pūs ma pagislambi. Ahāp lagi' kam halam bay ni'islam.

verses.name: Romans 2:26
verses.text: Bang takdil ni a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, a'a halam bay ni'islam, abila sigām ameya' ma panoho'an sara', binista sigām e' Tuhan suku'na sali' du maka a'a bay ni'islam.

verses.name: Romans 2:27
verses.text: Manjari ka'am saga Yahudi katōngan dusa e' bangsa kasehe' inān, minsan kam kaniya'an Kitab Tawrat. Katōngan kam dusa sabab ka'am ya angalanggal sara' minsan bay ni'islam, sagō' sigām ya angisbat sara' minsan halam bay ni'islam.  <div eID="gen7029" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3510"/><div sID="gen7030" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3510"/> Ya dī Yahudi ngga'i ka a'a ya amogbogan addat maka usulan Yahudi, ya taga-bainat pagislam isab ma baranna.

verses.name: Romans 2:29
verses.text: Ya taluwa' niōnan Yahudi to'ongan bang a'a taga-bainat ma deyom pangatayanna. Hinang Rū Tuhan ko' itu, ngga'i ka min pamogbogna ma sara'. A'a inān mbal sinanglitan e' pagkahina manusiya' bang buwattē' kapagyahudina, sagō' sinanglitan iya e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7030" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.2"/> <div eID="gen7027" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3511"/><div sID="gen7031" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tuhan ya Kapangandolan</title> <div sID="gen7032" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3511"/> Kalu aniya' atilaw, yuk-i, “Na bang buwattē', halam bahā' aniya' kasōngan kami bangsa Yahudi? Maka addat kami pagislam halam aniya' kapūsanna?”

verses.name: Romans 3:2
verses.text: Buwattitu panambungku ma a'a inān: tantu aheya kasōngan bangsa Yahudi. Muna-muna, pangandol ma sigām ya dī palman Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7032" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3512"/><div sID="gen7033" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3512"/> Kalu aniya' anilaw, yuk-i, “Painay Yahudi kasehe'an ya mbal angandol ma Tuhan? Taluwa' bahā' bang yukta in Tuhan mbal kapangandolan ma sabab manusiya' mbal angandol?”

verses.name: Romans 3:4
verses.text: Tantu mbal. Minsan magputing kamemon manusiya', mbal magputing Tuhan. Buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7034"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7035"/>“Mattan in ka'adilannu min ai-ai pamissalanu.<l eID="gen7035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7036"/>Anganda'ug sadja ka bang ma paghuhukuman.”<l eID="gen7036" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7034"/>  <div eID="gen7033" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3513"/><div sID="gen7037" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3513"/> Aniya' gi' anganjawab, yuk-i, “Tantu atampal to'ongan ka'adilan Tuhan sabab katā pagbidda'anna maka manusiya' ya ngga'i ka a'adil. Jari ai pamikilta bang buwattē'? Asā' bahā' hinang Tuhan bang pagmulka'anna dusatam?”

verses.name: Romans 3:6
verses.text: Tantu mbal. Abontol pangamulka' Tuhan, patut iya amat'nna' hukuman ma binangsa manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7037" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3514"/><div sID="gen7038" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3514"/> Aniya' gi' isab anganjawab, yuk-i, “Bang aku saupama magputing, bo' minnē' kasakupan du in Tuhan b'nnal to'ongan angkan subay minahaldika', angay aku subay pinat'nna'an hukuman dusa?

verses.name: Romans 3:8
verses.text: Gom gi' kita magdusa, sabab minnē' aniya' pangamahaldika' ma Tuhan.” Asā' panganjawab e', sagō' aniya' saga a'a bay anuna'an aku in aku kono' bay amitnahan a'a subay angandusa paheka bo' supaya paheya kamahaldika'an Tuhan. Putingan asal panuna' he'. Saga a'a inān tōp pinataluwa'an hukuman Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7038" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7031" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3515"/><div sID="gen7039" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dusahan Manusiya' Kamemon</title> <div sID="gen7040" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3515"/> Na, ahāp bahā' kahālanta bangsa Yahudi itu min bangsa kasehe'? Ngga'i ka. Bay na kam pata'uku in bangsa kamemon, Yahudi maka ngga'i ka, kapagbaya'an sali'-sali' e' paldusahan sigām,

verses.name: Romans 3:10
verses.text: buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7042"/>“Halam aniya' manusiya' abontol ma pang'nda' Tuhan.<l eID="gen7042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7043"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:11
verses.text: Halam aniya' pangita'u sigām pasal Tuhan,<l eID="gen7043" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7044"/>halam aniya' atuyu' angisbat iya.<l eID="gen7044" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7045"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:12
verses.text: Magsiha'an a'a kamemon min kabontolan,<l eID="gen7045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7046"/>halam aniya' kagunahan sigām.<l eID="gen7046" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7047"/>Halam aniya' minsan dangan maghinang ahāp.<l eID="gen7047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7048"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:13
verses.text: Bowa' sigām sali' dalil kubul halam katambunan,<l eID="gen7048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7049"/>hal paluwasan bissala pangakkal.<l eID="gen7049" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7050"/>Sapantun sigām sowa sabab makamula bowa' sigām.<l eID="gen7050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7051"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:14
verses.text: Anukna' na pa'in sigām, sabab landu' ab'nsi.<l eID="gen7051" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7052"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:15
verses.text: Tagihan sigām anganjuri, kabintanan sigām amapatay.<l eID="gen7052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7053"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:16
verses.text: Kabiyaksahan sigām amaka'at, amasukkal.<l eID="gen7053" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7054"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:17
verses.text: Mbal sigām ata'u angahāp atawa amapagsulut.<l eID="gen7054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7055"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:18
verses.text: Halam aniya' pagmatāw sigām tudju ni Tuhan.”<l eID="gen7055" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7041"/>  <div eID="gen7040" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3516"/><div sID="gen7056" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3516"/> Kata'uwanta asal, ai-ai panoho'an ma deyom sara' inān bay pinat'nna'an saga a'a ya ma deyo'an sara', supaya halam aniya' makapanganda'awa bang katōngan dusa. Manjari tabowa manusiya' kamemon pinat'nna'an hukuman e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 3:20
verses.text: Sabab halam to'ongan aniya' manusiya' binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pameya'na ma panoho'an sara'. Saguwā' sara' Tuhan ya po'onanna angkan tata'utam in kitam dusahan.  <div eID="gen7056" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7039" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3517"/><div sID="gen7057" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapangampun Tuhan ma Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen7058" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3517"/> Saguwā' ma buwattina'an pinata'u kita bang buwattingga kapangampun Tuhan ma dusa manusiya', bo' supaya sigām tabista e'na abontol minsan ngga'i ka min pamogbog sara'. Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab Tawrat maka Kitab Jabul pasal maksud Tuhan itu,

verses.name: Romans 3:22
verses.text: hatina sai-sai angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, minsan ai bangsa, niampun dusana ati abontol iya ma bistahan Tuhan. Halam aniya' kapagbidda'an manusiya',

verses.name: Romans 3:23
verses.text: sabab makarusa sigām sali'-sali' ati halam aniya' maka'abut ni ka'adilan Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 3:24
verses.text: Malaingkan pina'nda'an e' Tuhan lasana maka ase'na ni manusiya' minsan halam aniya' tongodna. Ati tahinang sigām abontol ma bistahanna, sali' halam bay makarusa, ma sabab kapangal'kkat sigām min hukuman dusa e' si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Romans 3:25
verses.text: Bay pinalahil si Isa e' Tuhan bo' supaya amabu'us laha'na pangampun dusa manusiya', sasuku angandol ma iya. Buwattē' hinang Tuhan pama'nda'na kabontolanna, sabab halam bay inayna karusahan manusiya' ma waktu palabay, hal bay sabalanna.

verses.name: Romans 3:26
verses.text: Ta'nda' isab kabontol Tuhan ma buwattina'an, sabab aniya' na taluwa' hukuman ma sabab dusa manusiya'. Minnē' magmattan in Tuhan abontol to'ongan, maka sasuku angandol ma si Isa abontol isab ma pang'nda' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7058" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3518"/><div sID="gen7059" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3518"/> Jari bang buwattē' kahinangan Tuhan ma kitam, mbal na kita makapagabbu pasal ai-ai bay hinangta. Kalu-kalu bang bay kita binista abontol ma sabab kapamogbogta ma sara', sagō' ngga'i ka. Subay min pangandolta sadja ya angkan kita binista abontol e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 3:28
verses.text: Atampal du, ya po'on manusiya' tabista abontol e' Tuhan, min pangandolna sadja, ngga'i ka min pamogbogna ma sara'.

verses.name: Romans 3:29
verses.text: Arai' pangannalbi in Tuhan itu pagtuhanan e' bangsa Yahudi sadja, sagō' ngga'i ka. Pagtuhanan iya sampay e' bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi,

verses.name: Romans 3:30
verses.text: sabab dakayu' du Tuhan. Bangsa Yahudi maka bangsa kasehe', sali'-sali' du sigām binista abontol e' Tuhan, sasuku sigām angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: Romans 3:31
verses.text: Kalu yukbi in sara' Tuhan inān subay tinimanan pagka aniya' na pangandolta ma si Isa. Sagō' mbal isāb, sabab bang si Isa ya pangandolanta, gom pa'in isbatta sara' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7059" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.3"/> <div eID="gen7057" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3519"/><div sID="gen7060" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Ibrahim Panunurantam</title> <div sID="gen7061" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3519"/> Manjari ai na pamūngta pasal bay kalabayan si Ibrahim, ya pag'mma'an pangkattam Yahudi?

verses.name: Romans 4:2
verses.text: Saupama si Ibrahim, bang iya bay binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab ahāp kahinanganna, aniya' pamantugna ma baranna. Saguwā' halam aniya' pamantuganna ma pang'nda' Tuhan, sabab ngga'i ka min kahinanganna ya angkan iya binista abontol.

verses.name: Romans 4:3
verses.text: Entomunbi bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Bay am'nnal si Ibrahim ma Tuhan, ati binista iya abontol sabab min kapam'nnalna.”

verses.name: Romans 4:4
verses.text: Saupama bang aniya' a'a maghinang ni a'a dakayu' bo' ginadjihan, mbal yukta in gadji inān hal paglasa ma iya. Tu'ud gadjina, tongod hulas-sangsā'na. Bang halam aniya' hinangna, halam du aniya' tongodna.

verses.name: Romans 4:5
verses.text: Buwattitu isab hatulanna: bang a'a mbal angandol ma hinangna, sagō' angandol ma Tuhan ya amuwan ka'adilan ma manusiya' baldusa, in a'a inān binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pangandolna.

verses.name: Romans 4:6
verses.text: Buwattē' du isab bissala si Da'ud, waktu kapamissalana pasal kalasig a'a bang binista abontol e' Tuhan ma halam aniya' hinang ahāp pasangdolanna. Yukna he', <lg sID="gen7062"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7063"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:7
verses.text: “Aheya kahāpan ma sasuku niampun kala'atanna,<l eID="gen7063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7064"/>maka sasuku pinapasan paldusahanna.<l eID="gen7064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7065"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:8
verses.text: Aheya kahāpan ma iya bang mbal ni'itung dusana e' Tuhan.”<l eID="gen7065" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7062"/>  <div eID="gen7061" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3520"/><div sID="gen7066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3520"/> Kalu pangannalbi in kahāpan ya binissala e' si Da'ud itu pamasuku' ma saga Yahudi sadja, pagka bangsa magislam. Ngga'i ka, sabab pamasuku' isab sampay ma bangsa kasehe', ya mbal magislam. Bay na sambatku si Ibrahim dahū inān, in iya bay binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pam'nnalna.

verses.name: Romans 4:10
verses.text: Na, sumiyan bay kapamista Tuhan itu? Dahū min kapagislam ma si Ibrahim, atawa damuli? Kata'uwanta, si Ibrahim bay tabista abontol e' Tuhan dahū lagi' min bay kapagislam ma iya.

verses.name: Romans 4:11
verses.text: Bay iya am'nnal ma janji' Tuhan dahū bo' yampa ni'islam tanda' palsaksi'an in iya bay tabista abontol e' Tuhan ma halam gi' bay ni'islam. Manjari itu si Ibrahim sali' hantang pag'mma'an a'a kamemon ya magpam'nnal ma Tuhan, sasuku tabista abontol e' Tuhan minsan halam bay makalabay pagislam.

verses.name: Romans 4:12
verses.text: Pag'mma'an isab si Ibrahim ma sasuku bay magislam, ngga'i ka ma saukat na ni'islam, saguwā' ma sabab panunud sigām ma si Ibrahim, ya bay angandol ma Tuhan ma halam gi' bay ni'islam.  <div eID="gen7066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3521"/><div sID="gen7067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3521"/> Na aniya' bay janji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim ma masa awal e', in iya maka saga panubu'na subay pinusaka'an kaluha'an dunya itu. Ya po'on si Ibrahim nijanji'an buwattē', ngga'i ka min pamogbogna ma sara' sagō' min pangandolna ma Tuhan, angkan iya binista abontol.

verses.name: Romans 4:14
verses.text: Bang hal a'a amogbogan sara' ya panganjanji'an pusaka', halam du aniya' pūs pangandolta ma Tuhan. Maka janji' Tuhan inān halam aniya' kamaujuranna bang sara' ya subay binogbogan.

verses.name: Romans 4:15
verses.text: Sabab hatina, in sara' itu amuwan palsababan ma mulka' Tuhan. Bang bay halam aniya' sara' halam aniya' bay makalanggal iya.  <div eID="gen7067" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3522"/><div sID="gen7068" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3522"/> Angkan yukta in panganjanji' Tuhan subay ajatu labay min pangandol manusiya'. Ati minnē' atayudtud, in janji'na ngga'i ka hal tungbas, saguwā' pamusaka'na ma saga panubu' si Ibrahim kamemon. Ngga'i ka sadja ma bangsa Yahudi, ya amogbogan sara' itu, saguwā' ma a'a kamemon sasuku angandol ma Tuhan buwat bay pangandol si Ibrahim. Jari pag'mma'antam si Ibrahim,

verses.name: Romans 4:17
verses.text: buwat tasulat ma Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Hinangta ka pag'mma'an saga kabangsa-bangsahan kamemon.” Jari pag'mma'antam si Ibrahim bang ma bistahan Tuhan, sabab am'nnal iya ma Tuhan, in iya makapakallum a'a magpatayan maka amaniya' ai-ai bay halam aniya', min pangallamna sadja.  <div eID="gen7068" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3523"/><div sID="gen7069" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3523"/> Bin'nnal e' si Ibrahim janji' Tuhan, ati angagad iya ma halam aniya' niholat. Angkan iya wajib pag'mma'an e' kamemon bangsa, buwat bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma iya. Buwattitu ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Ya heka tubu'nu buwat du heka bitu'un.”

verses.name: Romans 4:19
verses.text: Ya umul si Ibrahim waktu bay kapanganjanji' Tuhan ma iya marai' na dahatus tahun, saguwā' halam apinda pangandolna minsan tapikilna baranna inān agon-agon amatay na. Sampay h'ndana si Sara, mbal na maka'anak,

verses.name: Romans 4:20
verses.text: sagō' halam iya bay pahondong angandol ma Tuhan. Halam aniya' pagduwa-duwana pasal bay janji' Tuhan e', sagō' pasōng gom pa'in pangandolna maka e'na magmahaldika'an Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 4:21
verses.text: Tatantuna asal in Tuhan makaga'os du angahinang ai-ai bay panganjanji'na.

verses.name: Romans 4:22
verses.text: Angkan si Ibrahim bay binista abontol e' Tuhan, ma sabab pangandolna.

verses.name: Romans 4:23
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka hal si Ibrahim bay pinagsulat inān, ya yuk-i, “binista iya abontol e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Romans 4:24
verses.text: Sampay kitam, sabab tahinang kitam abontol ma bistahan Tuhan, sasuku kitam am'nnal ma iya, ya bay amakallum Panghū'tam si Isa min kamatay.

verses.name: Romans 4:25
verses.text: Bay tinukbalan si Isa pinapatay ma sabab dusatam, maka pinakallum iya pabīng e' Tuhan supaya kitam binista abontol.  <div eID="gen7069" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.4"/> <div eID="gen7060" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3524"/><div sID="gen7070" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maghāp na Kitam maka Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7071" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3524"/> Manjari itu, pagka niampun na kitam sampay nihinang abontol ma bistahan Tuhan ma sabab pangandoltam, magkahāp na kitam maka iya, min bay tahinang e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Romans 5:2
verses.text: Pinananaman kitam kaheya tabang Tuhan ma sabab pangandoltam ma si Isa, ati pataptapantam tabang itu buwattina'an. Magkōg-koyag kitam sabab aniya' holatantam in kitam pinahampitan kasahaya'an Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 5:3
verses.text: Ngga'i ka isab hal pakaradja'an sinōng ya amuwan kakōgan, sampay pakaradja'an ma buwattina'an minsan kitam ma deyom katiksa'an, sabab kata'uwantam isab, bang kalabayantam katiksa'an pasōng lagi' kasandaltam.

verses.name: Romans 5:4
verses.text: Bang kitam anandal, ka'amuhan du Tuhan ma kaul-pi'iltam. Maka bang iya ka'amuhan, tantu aniya' holatantam ahāp.

verses.name: Romans 5:5
verses.text: Halam aniya' pagsusunantam bang buwattē' kaholatantam, sabab itiya' 5 asal Tuhan pinat'nna' ma deyom pangatayantam, labay min Rū Sussi ya pamuwan e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7071" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3525"/><div sID="gen7072" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3525"/> Sabab hatina, ma waktu bay panugila' e' Tuhan, waktu halam aniya' ga'ostam, bay amatay Al-Masi ganti' saga a'a baldusa.

verses.name: Romans 5:7
verses.text: Alahang aniya' manusiya' lilla' amatay ganti' sehe'na minsan painay ka'adilna. Kalu-kalu bang a'a ahāp to'ongan kasuddahanna, ya aniya' makatawakkal amatay ma pasalna.

verses.name: Romans 5:8
verses.text: Saguwā' pina'nda'an kitam e' Tuhan bang buwattingga heya lasana ma kitam, sabab amatay Al-Masi ganti'tam, ma waktu lagi' kitam masi ma deyom karusahan.  <div eID="gen7072" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3526"/><div sID="gen7073" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3526"/> Na, pagka kitam abontol ma bistahan Tuhan ma sabab kamatay si Isa, manantuhi kitam lappasan e'na min mulka'na.

verses.name: Romans 5:10
verses.text: Maghāp na kitam maka Tuhan sabab min kamatay Anakna, waktu lagi' kitam masi amantahan Tuhan. Na, bang kitam nihāp e' Tuhan ma sabab kamatay Anakna, palabi gi' kalappastam ma sabab kallumna pabalik.

verses.name: Romans 5:11
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Aniya' gi' isab kakōgantam aheya ma sabab bay tahinang e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam, angkan kitam maghāp na maka Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7073" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7070" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3527"/><div sID="gen7074" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbidda'an si Mbo' Adam maka Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7075" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3527"/> Na, aniya' dangan manusiya' bay makarusa, ya po'on aniya' dusa ma dunya itu. Bay iya makahinang dusa, ati minnē' aniya' kamatay ma dunya. Ya kamattihanna aniya' kamatay ma manusiya' kamemon, sabab magdusa kitam kamemon.

verses.name: Romans 5:13
verses.text: Ma halam gi' aniya' sara' bay pamuwan ma si Musa e' Tuhan, aniya' asal dusa ma dunya itu. Sagō' sat'ggol halam aniya' sara' pinal'ngngan, in dusa sigām mbal kaōnan langgal sara'.

verses.name: Romans 5:14
verses.text: Malaingkan in binangsa manusiya' kamemon min si Adam sampay ni si Musa bay kapagbaya'an he' kamatay. Beya' isab saga a'a ya mbal magsali' dusa sigām maka bay dusa si Adam waktu kapanagga'na panoho'an Tuhan. <div eID="gen7075" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7076" type="paragraph"/> Si Adam itu sali' suntu'an pangā'antam panghati pasal a'a dangan ya pi'itu ni dunya ma llaw damuli.

verses.name: Romans 5:15
verses.text: Sagō' atā pagbidda'an dusa si Adam maka kahāpan ya pamuwan kitam e' Tuhan. Magpatayan bangsa manusiya' ma sabab dusa a'a dakayu' inān, sagō' ballabi-labihan kahāpan Tuhan ya pangahilasna ma manusiya' labay min kasi-lasa si Isa Al-Masi, ya a'a dakayu' itu.

verses.name: Romans 5:16
verses.text: Lāgi, magbidda' ya pamuwan e' Tuhan maka kamattihan dusa si Adam. Dakayu' du dusa bay tahinang e'na ati minnē' kitam kamemon katōngan dusa. Saguwā' saddī kahāpan ya pangahilas Tuhan ma manusiya' supaya sigām tabistana abontol, minsan landu' aheka paldusahan bay tahinang sigām.

verses.name: Romans 5:17
verses.text: Hatina, in manusiya' kamemon kapagbaya'an na pa'in e' kamatay ma sabab dusa a'a dangan, malaingkan in kamatay itu mbal maka'atu ma kabontolan atay ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma sasuku anaima' ase'na maka lasana. Ya kamaujuranna, sasuku makataima' kasi-lasa itu tahinang sali' sultan makapagbaya' ma dusa, sabab min a'a dakayu', ya si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7076" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3528"/><div sID="gen7077" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3528"/> Ya hatulanna, dakayu' du dusa tahinang e' dangan a'a, jari hukuman Tuhan ya kamattihanna ma saga a'a kamemon. Damikiyanna, dakayu' du hinang abontol tahinang e' a'a dangan, jari kabontolan maka kallum kakkal ma a'a kamemon ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Romans 5:19
verses.text: Dakayu' du a'a bay anagga' panoho'an Tuhan, ati aheka tabowa angandusa ma sabab iya ya panunuran. Damikiyanna isab ma damuli itu, dakayu' du a'a bay ameya' ma panoho'an Tuhan, ya si Isa Al-Masi, ati aheka tahinang abontol ma bistahan Tuhan labay min si Isa he'.  <div eID="gen7077" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3529"/><div sID="gen7078" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3529"/> Na, pagka dusahan asal saga manusiya', aniya' sara' bay pinat'nna' e' Tuhan bo' supaya kak'nnopan kalanggal sara' sigām. Saguwā' minsan buwattingga kosog dusa manusiya', palabi lagi' lasa maka ase' Tuhan ma sigām.

verses.name: Romans 5:21
verses.text: Jari in binangsa manusiya' kamemon bay kapagbaya'an asal e' dusa sigām, ati kamatay ya kamattihanna. Saguwā' kapagbaya'an na kitam e' lasa maka ase' Tuhan, ati kallum kakkal ya kamattihantam, sasuku kitam tabista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab bay kahinangan si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7078" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.5"/> <div eID="gen7074" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3530"/><div sID="gen7079" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Al-Masi Panunurantam</title> <div sID="gen7080" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3530"/> Na, buwattingga? Pasangdantam bahā' kabaya'antam magdusa, bo' supaya pasōng lagi' ase' maka lasa Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 6:2
verses.text: Tantu mbal! Sabab kitam itu sali' hantang a'a amatay, ya mbal na makapagdusa, angkan kitam subay ang'bba min dusa.

verses.name: Romans 6:3
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanbi, bay kitam pinandi tanda' saksi' in kitam lamud na ma si Isa Al-Masi, ati minnē' aniya' lamudtam ma kamatayna.

verses.name: Romans 6:4
verses.text: Hatina to'ongan, sali' kitam hantang paunung na ma Al-Masi kinubul maka iya, pagka buwattē' kapamandi ma kitam. Sali' kitam da-kamatay maka iya, bo' supaya kita kabuwanan kallum baha'u buwat bay pamakallum iya min kawasa Mma'na Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7080" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3531"/><div sID="gen7081" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3531"/> Sabab hatina, bang kitam parongan amatay maka si Isa, tantu kitam magdongan maka iya pinakallum pabalik.

verses.name: Romans 6:6
verses.text: Kata'uwantam isab, in kajarihantam tagna' wa'i pinapatay ma hāg magbeya' maka Al-Masi, bo' supaya pahalam kala'atantam. Jari mbal na kitam tabowa binanyaga' pabīng e' saga dusatam,

verses.name: Romans 6:7
verses.text: sabab sai-sai amatay apuwas na min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: Romans 6:8
verses.text: Bang kitam bay parongan ma Al-Masi ma kamatayna, am'nnal du kitam in kitam parongan ma iya ma kallumna.

verses.name: Romans 6:9
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanta Al-Masi, in iya bay pinakallum pabīng min kamatay, angkan mbal na magkamatay pabalik. Puwas na iya min kamatay sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Romans 6:10
verses.text: Min t'dda du iya bay amatay bo' supaya kapuwasanna paldusahan manusiya' kamemon. Saguwā' in kallumna buwattina'an ma okoman Tuhan na.  <div eID="gen7081" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3532"/><div sID="gen7082" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3532"/> Ya du ka'am, subay bistahunbi baranbi sali' hantang a'a amatay, ang'bba na min katagihanna magdusa. Allum na kam bang harap ni Tuhan, ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi.

verses.name: Romans 6:12
verses.text: Angkan kam subay mbal kapagagihan e' dusa indaginis, bo' mbal beya'bi napsubi.

verses.name: Romans 6:13
verses.text: Paggatunbi baya' ginhawa-baranbi bo' kam mbal tabowa angahinang kala'atan. Pamalilla'unbi baranbi ni Tuhan, sabab a'a kam bay pinakallum e'na pabīng min kamatay. In ginhawa-baranbi ilu subay pamasuku'bi ni iya paglagina ma kahinangan abontol.

verses.name: Romans 6:14
verses.text: Da'a kam magpasagad pinagagihan e' dusabi, sabab puwas na kam min kal'ngnganan sara'. Ma gomgoman Tuhan na kam, kaniya'an ka'ase'na maka kalasana.  <div eID="gen7082" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7079" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3533"/><div sID="gen7083" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpa'ata Kitam ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7084" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3533"/> Na, ai lagi'? Angandusa bahā' kitam ma sabab apinda min kal'ngnganan sara' ni ase' maka lasa Tuhan? Tantu mbal.

verses.name: Romans 6:16
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du, bang kam saupama magpatiata ni a'a dakayu', pinagbaya'an kam e'na sabab atana kam. Ati bang dusa ya pa'atahanbi, kamatay ya kamattihanna. Bang kabaya'an Tuhan ya pa'atahanbi, na, kabontolan atay ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Romans 6:17
verses.text: Angkan aheya pagsukulan ni Tuhan! Tagna', bay kam tabanyaga' e' dusa, sagō' makakale pa'in kam ma pamandu' ya pangandolanbi na, magtūy beya'bi magatay-pote'.

verses.name: Romans 6:18
verses.text: Jari pinaluhaya na kam min dusa bay pamanyaga'an ka'am tagna', ati banyaga' Tuhan na kam maghinang kabontolan.  <div eID="gen7084" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3534"/><div sID="gen7085" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3534"/> Amaralil aku pasal banyaga' maka nakura' bo' supaya tahatibi, sabab kulang lagi' akkalbi. Ma waktu tagna' inān bay kam magparūl binanyaga' e' dusabi, ya po'on kam maghinang kasabulan maka kala'atan duhun manduhun. Saguwā' buwattina'an Tuhan ya pagbanyaga'anbi, angkan kam maghinang ai-ai abontol ya makasussi pangatayanbi.

verses.name: Romans 6:20
verses.text: Sat'ggol kam sapantun banyaga' abowa-bowa e' ba'anan dusabi, mbal kam pasoho' maghinang kabontolan.

verses.name: Romans 6:21
verses.text: Makaiya'-iya' ya bay kahinanganbi tagna', bang isab tapikilbi ma buwattina'an. Ai bay paluntunganna? Tantu halam, sabab kamatay ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Romans 6:22
verses.text: Sagō' ma buwattina'an tapuwas na kam e' Tuhan min dusa, ati banyaga'na na kam. Ya paluntunganbi atay asussi tudju ni iya, maka kallum kakkal ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Romans 6:23
verses.text: Tagna', bay kitam tabanyaga' e' dusa ati kamatay ya tungbasna, saguwā' kallum kakkal ya pangahilas Tuhan ma kitam bang si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam ya pameya'antam.  <div eID="gen7085" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.6"/> <div eID="gen7083" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3535"/><div sID="gen7086" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Apuwas na Kitam min Sara'</title> <div sID="gen7087" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3535"/> Saga danakanku magpangandol ma si Isa, tantu kam makahati ma song pah'llingku itu sabab biyaksa du kam ma bowahan sara'. Kapagbaya'an kita e' sara'-manara' t'ggolta allum, sagō' puwas kita min sara' bang amatay na.

verses.name: Romans 7:2
verses.text: Saupama d'nda taga-h'lla, wajib iya magpūn maka h'llana t'ggolna allum. Saguwā' bang h'llana amatay na, apuwas na iya min hatulan sara' pasal a'a maglakibini.

verses.name: Romans 7:3
verses.text: Bang d'nda inān ganta' parakayu' ni l'lla saddī hinabu masi allum paghola'na tagna', makalanggal iya sara' sabab angaliyu-lakad. Saguwā' bang amatay h'llana ati magpūn iya maka l'lla saddī, mbal kaōnan pangaliyu-lakad sabab apuwas na iya min bowahan sara' he'.  <div eID="gen7087" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3536"/><div sID="gen7088" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3536"/> Buwattē' isab ma ka'am, saga dauranakanku. Apuwas na kam min sara' tasulat si Musa. Sali' kam hantang a'a magpatayan sabab dambeya'an na kam maka Al-Masi ma kamatayna. Bay iya pinakallum pabīng, manjari suku'na na kam bo' supaya kam maghinang ahāp ma Tuhan sadja.

verses.name: Romans 7:5
verses.text: Ma waktu tagna', in ginhawa-baranta itu bay kapagbaya'an e' kajarihanta tagna'. Karuhunan gom pa'in napsuta pagka subay anagga' ma sara', jari kamatay ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Romans 7:6
verses.text: Sagō' buwattina'an alimaya na kita min kal'ngnganan sara' sabab hantang kita bay amatay, ati ang'bba na min dusa ya bay magbaya'an kita ma waktu tagna'. Ma buwattitu saddī na pameya'ta ma Tuhan. Ngga'i ka kal'ngnganan sara' ya beya'ta saguwā' kal'ngnganan baha'u, ya min Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7088" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7086" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3537"/><div sID="gen7089" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' maka Dusa</title> <div sID="gen7090" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3537"/> Manjari ai pamikilta pasal sara' itu? Dusahan bahā'? Tantu mbal. Atampal du, ya angkan kata'uwanku dusa maka kamattihanna, ma sabab aniya' sara' amata'u aku. Bay aku a'awam pasal napsu itu, manda' aniya' panoho'an sara' amata'u aku, ya yuk-i, “Wajib kam da'a anganapsuhan alta' pagkahibi.”

verses.name: Romans 7:8
verses.text: Sagō' makata'u pa'in aku min sara' in napsu itu dusahan asal, luhūy pasōng saga dusa ma deyom ginhawa-baranku maka pak'nnop napsuku indaginis. Hatina, sat'ggol bay halam aniya' sara' mbal kinata'uwan in kitam dusahan.

verses.name: Romans 7:9
verses.text: Ahāp asal palasahanku ma waktu tagna' pagka halam aniya' tata'uku pasal sara', ati pangannalku in aku a'a ahāp. Sagō' pagta'uku pa'in pasal sara' Tuhan itu, magtūy kata'uwanku aheya kasalla'anku, maka patut aku pinat'nna'an hukuman ni kamatay.

verses.name: Romans 7:10
verses.text: Jari minnē' aheya kasusahanku. Sara' itu bay panganiyat Tuhan ma binangsa manusiya' supaya sigām binowa ni kallum, saguwā' ma kasulayanku, in sara' itu hal amowa aku ni kamatay sabab dusahan aku.

verses.name: Romans 7:11
verses.text: Sali' aku nirupang e' dusaku sabab pangannalku in panoho'an sara' ta'anggapku du, sagō' mbal. Jari pinat'nna'an aku hukuman ni kamatay sabab min sara' itu.  <div eID="gen7090" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3538"/><div sID="gen7091" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3538"/> Ahāp asal sara' si Musa sabab min Tuhan du. Abontol maka ahāp panoho'anna kamemon.

verses.name: Romans 7:13
verses.text: Jari taluwa' bahā' bang yukta in sara' ahāp ya amowa aku ni kamatay? Tantu mbal. In sara' ahāp itu hal pamabukisan dusaku bo' takilāku to'ongan. Dusaku ya amowa aku ni kamatay. Talhakit to'ongan in dusa itu mamarahi ala'at, ma sabab sara'.  <div eID="gen7091" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7089" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3539"/><div sID="gen7092" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aniya' Pagsagga'an ma Ginhawa-baranta</title> <div sID="gen7093" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3539"/> Kata'uwantam in sara' itu deyo' bay min Rū Tuhan. Saguwā' aku itu manusiya' sadja, tabanyaga' na pa'in e' dusaku.

verses.name: Romans 7:15
verses.text: Mbal to'ongan tahatiku kaul-pi'ilku itu, sabab bang aku bilahi angahinang ahāp, sali' aniya' ma ginhawaku makabimbang. Ya balikna, bang aniya' mbal kabaya'anku nihinang, ya he' tahinangku.

verses.name: Romans 7:16
verses.text: Jari bang aku ganta' ab'nsi ma hinang ala'at ya asal hinangku, angaho' du aku in sara' Tuhan ahāp du.

verses.name: Romans 7:17
verses.text: Ngga'i ka itikadku to'ongan ya angahinang kala'atan ya kab'nsihanku he', tu'ud aku abowa-bowa e' dusa ya pat'nna' ma deyom kajarihanku.

verses.name: Romans 7:18
verses.text: Kata'uwanku du, halam aniya' ahāp ma deyom baranku, hatina ma kajarihanku itu, sabab minsan kabaya'anku angahinang ahāp, mbal ta'anggapku.

verses.name: Romans 7:19
verses.text: Mbal tahinangku kahāpan ya angutku, sagō' ya na pa'in hinangku kala'atan mbal kabaya'anku.

verses.name: Romans 7:20
verses.text: Jari bang aku ganta' angahinang ai-ai ya mbal makasulut atayku, hatina ngga'i ka dī baranku ya angahinang inān, tu'ud aku tabowa-bowa e' dusa ya ma deyom kajarihanku itu.  <div eID="gen7093" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3540"/><div sID="gen7094" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3540"/> Buwattitu ya kal'ngngananna bang aku ganta' bilahi maghinang ahāp, maumu aku tabowa-bowa maghinang ala'at.

verses.name: Romans 7:22
verses.text: Ma itikadku sadja landu' aku kasulutan ma sara' Tuhan,

verses.name: Romans 7:23
verses.text: saguwā' pag'nda'ku pa'in ni deyom ginhawa-baranku, saddī isab kal'ngngananna. Sabab aniya' na pa'in la'at ma deyom kajarihanku magsagga' maka sara' Tuhan ya makasulutan aku. Minnē' aku binanyaga', pinagagihan na pa'in e' dusa ya amowa na pa'in ma deyom ginhawa-baranku.

verses.name: Romans 7:24
verses.text: Allā! Mbal manjari susaku! Sai bahā' anabang aku supaya aku makapuwas min kajarihan ala'at itu, sabab itiya' aku binowa ni kamatay?

verses.name: Romans 7:25
verses.text: Magsukul ni Tuhan, itiya' anabang si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam! <div eID="gen7094" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7095" type="paragraph"/> Na ya du ilu kasusahanku: makaisbat aku sara' Tuhan ma deyom pikilanku, sagō' abowa-bowa aku magdusa pagga kapagbaya'an kajarihanku e' dusa.  <div eID="gen7095" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.7"/> <div eID="gen7092" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3541"/><div sID="gen7096" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabaya'an Rū Sussi ya Panunurantam</title> <div sID="gen7097" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3541"/> Malaingkan buwattina'an, pagka kitam sōd si Isa Al-Masi na, mbal na kapat'nna'an hukuman Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:2
verses.text: Apuwas na kitam min kal'ngnganan dusa maka min kamatay ya kamattihanna, sabab ameya' na kitam ma kal'ngnganan Rū Tuhan. Tabowa kitam ni kallum pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'antam.

verses.name: Romans 8:3
verses.text: Halam aniya' ga'osan sara' pamapuwas kitam min pagbaya'an dusa, sabab manusiya' sadja kitam mbal makabogbogan sara'. Sagō' Tuhan ya makaga'os. Pinapi'itu e'na Anakna lissi pamapuwas ba'anan dusatam. Daisi iya maka kitam, ati iya ya katōngan dusa ganti' min kitam.

verses.name: Romans 8:4
verses.text: Buwattē' hinang Tuhan supaya tatuman kamemon ya tasulat ma panoho'an-sara' sabu pa'in kitam ang'bba min napsutam bo' ameya' ma kabaya'an Rū Sussi.  <div eID="gen7097" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3542"/><div sID="gen7098" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3542"/> Sai-sai angandūl ma napsu baranna kapagbaya'an du e' napsu. Sai-sai ameya' ma kabaya'an Rū Sussi, kapagbaya'an du e' Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Romans 8:6
verses.text: Bang a'a abowa-bowa pikilanna e' napsu baranna, kamatay ya kamattihanna, sagō' bang kapagbaya'an pikilanna e' Rū Sussi, kallum kakkal ya kamattihanna maka kasannangan deyom atay.

verses.name: Romans 8:7
verses.text: Manjari bang a'a abowa-bowa e' napsuna, sagga'na Tuhan pagga mbal magmaluluy ma panoho'anna. Maka minsan iya bilahi ameya', mbal to'ongan ta'anggapna.

verses.name: Romans 8:8
verses.text: Bang a'a abowa-bowa e' napsuna, mbal tasulutna Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7098" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3543"/><div sID="gen7099" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3543"/> Malaingkan ka'am ilu mbal na abowa-bowa e' napsubi buwat bay kajarihanbi tagna', saguwā' Rū Tuhan ya pameya'anbi na ma ai-ai kabaya'anna, pagka ilu na iya pat'nna' ma deyom ataybi. Sai-sai halam kaniya'an Rū Tuhan e' Al-Masi, ngga'i ka iya suku' Al-Masi.

verses.name: Romans 8:10
verses.text: Magkamatay baranbi sabab dusa, sagō' minsan na, kabuwanan du kam kallum taptap min Rū Sussi bang ilu Al-Masi ma deyom ataybi, sabab tabista kam abontol e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:11
verses.text: Bang pat'nna' ma ka'am Rū Tuhan, tantu kam pinakallum e' Tuhan buwat bay pamakallumna Al-Masi min kamatayna.  <div eID="gen7099" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3544"/><div sID="gen7100" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3544"/> Angkan yukku ma ka'am, saga dauranakanku, aniya' subay pagmatayantam saddī min kajarihan maka kanapsuhantam tagna'.

verses.name: Romans 8:13
verses.text: Sabab bang kitam ganta' abowa-bowa na pa'in, e' kajarihantam dusahan, kamatay ya kamattihanna. Saguwā' bang paglagitam tabang min Rū Tuhan bo' bbahantam hinangtam ala'at, taptap du kallumtam.

verses.name: Romans 8:14
verses.text: Panganak Tuhan sasuku minaliman e' Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:15
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka umagad makatāw-tāw ya tasambuttam, sagō' Rū Sussi ya angahinang kitam panganak Tuhan. Kawasa min iya isab, ya angkan kitam makatawakkal angōn ‘Mma'’ ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:16
verses.text: Aniya' saksi' ma deyom palnyawahantam bay min Rū Sussi, angkan kitam makatantu in kitam tantu anak Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:17
verses.text: Na, pagka kitam panganak Tuhan sab'nnal-b'nnal, pinahampitan kitam pusaka' ma llaw damuli. Magdakayu' kitam maka Al-Masi pinasambutan pusaka' itu, sabab bang kitam palamud ma kabinasahanna ma buwattina'an, palamud isab kitam ma kasahaya'anna bang ta'abut waktuna.  <div eID="gen7100" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7096" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3545"/><div sID="gen7101" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasahaya'an ma Sinosōng</title> <div sID="gen7102" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3545"/> Bang ma aku, mbal angatu kasigpitan ya kalabayantam buwattina'an ma kasahaya'an ya pinabukisan kitam ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Romans 8:19
verses.text: Angagad ai-ai pinapanjari kamemon ma waktu kapamabukis e' Tuhan saga panganakna.

verses.name: Romans 8:20
verses.text: Sabab kamemon bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan kalungayan pūsna, ngga'i ka min kabaya'an ai-ai pinapanjari itu, saguwā' min kahandak Tuhan. Sabab aniya' niholat,

verses.name: Romans 8:21
verses.text: hatina ma sinosōng in bay pinapanjari kamemon pinalimaya du min kasigpitan ya kalabayanna ma buwattina'an, pagka magka'ndang du maka magkamatay du kamemon. Saguwā' ma sinosōng magdakayu' du bay pinapanjari kamemon itu maka panganak Tuhan, bang sigām pinabangsa sampay pinalimaya na min kasigpitan kamatay.  <div eID="gen7102" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3546"/><div sID="gen7103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3546"/> Kata'uwanta, in kamemon pinapanjari itu magsalinggā asal sampay ni kabuwattina'an, buwat hantang d'nda kap'ddi'an bang song anganak.

verses.name: Romans 8:23
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka hal ina'an-i, sampay kitam ya kabuwanan Rū Sussi e' Tuhan pangawalna, magsalinggā du isab sat'ggoltam angalagaran waktu pamabaha'u barantam. Bang ta'abut waktu ina'an pinatampal in kitam panganak Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 8:24
verses.text: Ya na he' holatantam pagka lappasan na kitam min hukuman dusa. Halam gi' mattan, angkan niōnan ‘holat’. Mbal kaōnan holat bang magmattan na.

verses.name: Romans 8:25
verses.text: Saguwā' aniya' holatantam tantu minsan mbal gi' magmattan, ya angkan kitam mbal sinumu angagad.  <div eID="gen7103" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3547"/><div sID="gen7104" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3547"/> Pagapi' du Rū Sussi anabangan kitam bang mbal makakole'. Maumu kitam mbal ata'u bang buwattingga subay pangamu'-ngamu'tam ni Tuhan, sagō' Rū Sussi ya anibahat ma sababtam, bo' arapun mbal tapagsuli-suli sibahatna.

verses.name: Romans 8:27
verses.text: Tatanding deyom pamikiltam e' Tuhan maka kasakupanna isab bang ai kinannal e' Rū Sussi, sabab palamud Rū Sussi itu angamu'an kitam suku' Tuhan kahāpan, ma buwat kahandak Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7104" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3548"/><div sID="gen7105" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3548"/> Ya ko' itu kata'uwantam: nihinangan kitam kahāpan e' Tuhan ma deyom pakaradja'an indaginis ahāp-ala'at, pagka kitam alasa ma iya. Jari minsan buwattingga pakaradja'an ya kalabayantam, ahāp sadja kaluwasanna.

verses.name: Romans 8:29
verses.text: Bay kitam tapene' e' Tuhan min awal lagi', ginanta' kitam subay anunud ma Anakna supaya iya pagsiyakahan ma dauranakanna manusiya' kamemon.

verses.name: Romans 8:30
verses.text: Sasuku bay ginanta' e' Tuhan anunud ma Anakna, pinene' isab e'na, maka sasuku ya pinene' binista e'na abontol. Sasuku isab abontol ma bistahanna binahagi'an du min deyom sahayana.  <div eID="gen7105" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7101" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3549"/><div sID="gen7106" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Lasa Tuhan Mbal Kaliyuhan</title> <div sID="gen7107" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3549"/> Na, bang pikiltam bay pah'llingku-i, sali' halam aniya' sugpatna. Sabab bang Tuhan ya amogbogan kitam, mbal kitam takole' e' sai-na.

verses.name: Romans 8:32
verses.text: Halam bay ka'lloganna Anakna lissi, sagō' sinōngan e'na pinapatay ma pasalantam kamemon. Bang buwattē' kalasa Tuhan anukbalan Anakna, tantu kitam binuwanan e'na ai-ai makahāp, luwas min kahilasanna.

verses.name: Romans 8:33
verses.text: Halam aniya' makatuna'an kitam ya pinene' e' Tuhan, sabab Tuhan ya amabontol itikadtam.

verses.name: Romans 8:34
verses.text: Angkanna halam aniya' amat'nna'an kitam kasā'an pinehē' ni deyom nalka'. Bay amatay si Isa Al-Masi ma sabab dusatam, ati pinakallum pabīng e' Tuhan. Pinabangsa na iya ma buwattitu, pinatingkō' ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan, ati ina'an na iya magpatillot ma manusiya' maka Tuhan, angamu'an kitam tabang.

verses.name: Romans 8:35
verses.text: Manjari sai bahā' amapagbutas kitam maka lasa Al-Masi? Tantu halam aniya'. Minsan ai kalabayantam, ai na kasusahan, ai na ka katiksa'an, ai na ka pagpuhinga' a'a, kasigpitan ka atawa kamiskinan, minsan ma deyom kapiligduhan, minsan kita pinapatay, tantu mbal apinda lasa Al-Masi ma kitam.

verses.name: Romans 8:36
verses.text: Saga kabinasahan inān tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7108"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7109"/>“Kasiya-siyahan kami sakahaba' llaw,<l eID="gen7109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7110"/>hal angagad pinapatay ma sabab ka'a ya pameya'an.<l eID="gen7110" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7111"/>Sali' kami hantang hayop bili-bili ma pamista saga a'a,<l eID="gen7111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7112"/>hal binowa sinumbali'.”<l eID="gen7112" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7108"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:37
verses.text: Saguwā' mbal tapamagaytam saga pakaradja'an itu. Anganda'ug du kitam to'ongan ma sabab Al-Masi, ya alasa asal ma kitam.

verses.name: Romans 8:38
verses.text: Makatantu du aku, halam aniya' makaga'os amapagbutas kitam maka lasa Al-Masi, minsan ma kallumta maka ma kamatayta. Minsan bangsa mala'ikat atawa bangsa mananasat, minsan ai kalabayantam ma masa itu maka ma masa sinōng, tantu kitam kinalasahan na pa'in.

verses.name: Romans 8:39
verses.text: Minsan ma diyata' maka minsan ma deyo', halam aniya' min bay pinapanjari kamemon makaga'os amapagbutas kitam maka lasa Tuhan, ya bay pina'nda'an ni kitam e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7107" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.8"/> <div eID="gen7106" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3550"/><div sID="gen7113" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Tapene' e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7114" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3550"/> B'nnal ya pah'llingku itu ma ka'am: mbal aku magputing sabab suku' Al-Masi aku. Anubali aku sab'nnal-b'nnal min atay pote', sabab kapagbaya'an aku e' Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Romans 9:2
verses.text: Makalandu' heya dukkaku. Kasangdanan sukkalku ma pasal pagkahiku bangsa Yahudi. Bang bay makajari, lilla' aku taluwa' mulka' Tuhan sampay pinaokat min Al-Masi, bang pa'in sigām angandol ma iya.

verses.name: Romans 9:3
verses.text: Makalandu' heya dukkaku. Kasangdanan sukkalku ma pasal pagkahiku bangsa Yahudi. Bang bay makajari, lilla' aku taluwa' mulka' Tuhan sampay pinaokat min Al-Masi, bang pa'in sigām angandol ma iya.

verses.name: Romans 9:4
verses.text: Panubu' si Isra'il asal sigām, bangsa suku' Tuhan. Bay sigām nihinang panganakna, maka pina'nda'an sahayana ma deyoman sigām. Aniya' kapagsulutan sigām maka Tuhan, maka kabuwanan sigām sara'na. Ma sigām ya hatulan pagta'at b'nnal maka panganjanji' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 9:5
verses.text: Tubu' asal sigām min saga pangkat Yahudi babantugun. Minnē' du isab Al-Masi bang harap ni pangkat manusiya'. Tuhan ya magbaya' ma kamemon, patut sinanglitan salama-lama. Amin.  <div eID="gen7114" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3551"/><div sID="gen7115" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3551"/> Mbal isab yukku in janji' Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il halam aniya' pūsna. Sagō' ya yukku, aniya' tubu' si Isra'il kasehe' mbal manjari niōnan bangsa suku' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 9:7
verses.text: Aniya' isab tubu' si Ibrahim mbal kaōnan panganak Tuhan. Ya tubu' si Ibrahim sab'nnal-b'nnal subay binista ma buwat bay pangallam Tuhan ma iya, ya yuk-i, “Ya panubu'nu to'ongan subay min anaknu dangan ilu, min si Isa'ak.”

verses.name: Romans 9:8
verses.text: Bang pina'amu, aniya' panubu' si Ibrahim mbal kaōnan panganak Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 9:9
verses.text: Buwattitu bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Bang ta'abut waktuna, pabalik du aku pi'ilu ati maka'anak l'lla h'ndanu si Sara.”  <div eID="gen7115" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3552"/><div sID="gen7116" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3552"/> Ngga'i ka hal si Ibrahim ya pagsambatku. Pikilunbi isab duwangan anak si Ripka. Da'mma' sigām, si Isa'ak ya pag'mma'an bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Romans 9:11
verses.text: Jari ma halam gi' palahil onde' inān, amissala Tuhan ni si Ripka, yukna, “Ya k'mbal siyaka ilu pinagagihan du e' siyali.” Minnē' kinata'uwan in kapamene' Tuhan min baya'na asal, ngga'i ka min kahinangan manusiya' ahāp-ala'at. Sabab k'mbal inān halam gi' bay makahinang ai-ai ahāp ka atawa ala'at, sabab masi ma deyom kandang. Manjari bang Tuhan ya amene', subay min palniyatanna.

verses.name: Romans 9:12
verses.text: Jari ma halam gi' palahil onde' inān, amissala Tuhan ni si Ripka, yukna, “Ya k'mbal siyaka ilu pinagagihan du e' siyali.” Minnē' kinata'uwan in kapamene' Tuhan min baya'na asal, ngga'i ka min kahinangan manusiya' ahāp-ala'at. Sabab k'mbal inān halam gi' bay makahinang ai-ai ahāp ka atawa ala'at, sabab masi ma deyom kandang. Manjari bang Tuhan ya amene', subay min palniyatanna.

verses.name: Romans 9:13
verses.text: Buwat du bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab pasal k'mbal itu, ya yuk-i, “Si Yakub kalasahanku, si Esaw ya kab'nsihanku.”  <div eID="gen7116" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3553"/><div sID="gen7117" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3553"/> Jari ai na pamikilta pasal kissa ina'an? Sowayta bahā' Tuhan in pamene'na mbal abontol? Tantu mbal,

verses.name: Romans 9:15
verses.text: sabab Tuhan ya magkahandak, buwat yukna ma si Musa, <lg sID="gen7118"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7119"/>“Ma'ase' aku ma sai-sai kabaya'anku,<l eID="gen7119" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7120"/>alasa aku ma sai-sai kabaya'anku.”<l eID="gen7120" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7118"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:16
verses.text: Na minnē' tahatita, ngga'i ka min kabaya'anta manusiya' atawa min hulas-sangsā'ta maghinang ahāp ya angkan kita kina'ase'an e' Tuhan, sagō' min baya'na du.

verses.name: Romans 9:17
verses.text: Aniya' isab bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab pasal pamissala Tuhan ni sultan ma lahat Misil ma masa awal e'. Yuk-i, “Aniya' kagunahanku ma ka'a, ya angkan ka g'llalku magsultan. Bay paluwasku kawasaku panganda'ug ka'a, bo' supaya abantug ōnku ma kaluha'an dunya.”

verses.name: Romans 9:18
verses.text: Jari itu manyatakan du, ma'ase' Tuhan ma sasuku kabaya'anna. Maka sasuku kabaya'anna subay atuwas kōkna, patuwasna du.  <div eID="gen7117" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7113" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3554"/><div sID="gen7121" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paminasa Tuhan maka Ka'ase'na</title> <div sID="gen7122" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3554"/> Kalu aniya' dakayu' min ka'am anganjawab, yuk-i, “Bang buwattē', bang hati' min kabaya'an Tuhan ya angkan a'a anuwas, angay iya subay sinoway e' Tuhan? Sabab halam aniya' makasagga' kabaya'an Tuhan.”

verses.name: Romans 9:20
verses.text: Atawakkal pahāp ka anganjawab buwattilu! Manusiya' du ka, ati samlangnu Tuhan! Bang saupama kibut, aniya' bahā' anamlang a'a bay angahinang iya, yukna, “Angay aku hinangnu buwattitu?”

verses.name: Romans 9:21
verses.text: Kata'uwanta, ya a'a angahinang kibut itu taga-kapatut du ma tana' inān angahinang ai-ai kabaya'anna. Daginis du tana', sagō' dabahagi'na nihinang kibut pangisihan llaw-llaw, maka dabahagi'na isab nihinang pagguna ahalga'.  <div eID="gen7122" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3555"/><div sID="gen7123" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3555"/> Buwattē' du isab ma Tuhan, taga-kapatut iya maghinang ai-ai kabaya'anna. Bilahi iya amatuwa' ka'astolna ma manusiya' baldusa bo' ta'nda' kaheya kawasana, daipara ni'imanan e'na saga a'a ka'astolanna minsan sigām patut pinataluwa'an mulka'.

verses.name: Romans 9:23
verses.text: Angkan saga manusiya' itu ni'imanan e' Tuhan sabab kabaya'anna subay tata'u e' a'a kamemon pasal kahāpna ma saga a'a ka'ase'anna, ya sakapna supaya pinabangsa ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Romans 9:24
verses.text: Kitam ko' inān, a'a pinene' e' Tuhan min bangsa Yahudi, sampay isab min saga bangsa kamemon.

verses.name: Romans 9:25
verses.text: Buwattitu pamissala Tuhan bay tasulat e' nabi Hoseya, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7124"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7125"/>“Saga a'a ngga'i ka bay a'aku tagna',<l eID="gen7125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7126"/>ōnanku a'a suku'ku buwattina'an.<l eID="gen7126" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7127"/>Ya bangsa halam bay kalasahanku,<l eID="gen7127" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7128"/>ōnanku na bangsa kalasahanku.”<l eID="gen7128" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7124"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:26
verses.text: Maka itu gi': <lg sID="gen7129"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7130"/>“Mahē' ma lahat bay pamah'llinganku sigām<l eID="gen7130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7131"/>in sigām ngga'i ka suku'ku,<l eID="gen7131" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7132"/>mahē' du isab sigām ōnanku panganak Tuhan,<l eID="gen7132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7133"/>ya Tuhan kakkal salama-lama.”<l eID="gen7133" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7129"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:27
