verses.text: Buwattitu isab ya tasulat e' nabi Isaya ma pasal bangsa Isra'il, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7134"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7135"/>“In bangsa Isra'il itu, minsan heka sigām<l eID="gen7135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7136"/>sali' solagan gusung ma bihing tampe,<l eID="gen7136" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7137"/>akulang sigām makapuwas min mulka' Tuhan.<l eID="gen7137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7138"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:28
verses.text: Sabab pinuspusan e' Tuhan hukumanna ni dunya,<l eID="gen7138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7139"/>mbal katangguhan.”<l eID="gen7139" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7134"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:29
verses.text: Buwat bay pangallam si Isaya isab ma masa awal, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7140"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7141"/>“Bang kitam halam bay kinapinan tubu'<l eID="gen7141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7142"/>e' Tuhan Sangat Kawasa,<l eID="gen7142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7143"/>bay du kitam alaglag kamemon,<l eID="gen7143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7144"/>buwat a'a min kauman Sodom maka kauman Gomora.”<l eID="gen7144" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7140"/>  <div eID="gen7123" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7121" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3556"/><div sID="gen7145" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Al-Masi Sinulak e' Bangsa Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen7146" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3556"/> Manjari ai yukta pasal bay sambatanku baha'u si'? Ya itu: saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, ya halam bay angangut ma kabontolan atay, angandol na ma Al-Masi jari abontol na sigām ma pang'nda' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 9:31
verses.text: Saguwā' saga bangsa Isra'il, ya bay amanuyu'an sara' si Musa pangā'an sigām kabontolan atay, halam tabista abontol e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 9:32
verses.text: Angay bahā'? Sabab hinang baran sigām ya pasangdolan sigām, ngga'i ka pangandol ni Tuhan. Sapantun sigām a'a makarugtul ni ‘batu parugtulan’,

verses.name: Romans 9:33
verses.text: buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7147"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7148"/>“Aniya' batu bay pat'nna'ku ma da'ira Siyun,<l eID="gen7148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7149"/>batu parugtulan a'a, batu pamah'bba'an.<l eID="gen7149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7150"/>Saguwā' sasuku angandol ma iya,<l eID="gen7150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7151"/>halam to'ongan aniya' kapagsusunanna.”<l eID="gen7151" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7147"/>  <div eID="gen7146" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.9"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:1
verses.text: Saga dauranakanku bebeya'an si Isa, ya pagmatayanku to'ongan pagkahiku bangsa Yahudi, bang pa'in sigām lappasan bo' makasōd ni deyom sulga'. Ya ko' ina'an pangamu'-ngamu'ku ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 10:2
verses.text: Makasaksi' aku ma pasal katuyu' sigām ma Tuhan, sagō' halam tahati e' sigām bang ai kataluwa'anna.

verses.name: Romans 10:3
verses.text: Halam tahati sigām bang buwattingga e' Tuhan angampun dusa, maka e'na amuwan kabontolan ma manusiya'. Angusul sigām ma agama sigām, ati mbal anambut kabontolan ya pamat'nna' Tuhan ma sigām.

verses.name: Romans 10:4
verses.text: Ya sara' bay tasulat e' si Musa taga-katumanan na pagka makapi'itu na Al-Masi, manjari sai-sai angandol ma iya niōnan abontol e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7152" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7145" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3557"/><div sID="gen7153" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Kamemon Makajari Lappasan</title> <div sID="gen7154" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3557"/> Aniya' isab tasulat e' si Musa pasalan a'a amogbogan sara' supaya binista abontol e' Tuhan. Yuk sulat e', “Sai-sai angahinang panoho'an sara' itu, aniya' kallumna kakkal.”

verses.name: Romans 10:6
verses.text: Aniya' sulat dakayu' pasal kabontolan atay ya pinaniya'an sasuku angandol, yuk-i, “Da'a kam atilaw-tilaw ma deyom ataybi bang sai patukad pariyata' ni sulga'.” (Hatina sai amareyo' Al-Masi minnē'.)

verses.name: Romans 10:7
verses.text: “Da'a isab kam atilaw bang sai pareyo' ni deyom ahirat.” (Hatina sai amowa Al-Masi pariyata' min lahat kamatayan.)

verses.name: Romans 10:8
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi ayat Kitab dakayu', ya yuk-i, “Ilu na lapal Tuhan ma ka'am. Ilu ma deyom bowa'bi. Ilu isab ma deyom ataybi.” Hatina ilu na ma ka'am lapal bay nasihat kami pasal pangandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7154" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3558"/><div sID="gen7155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3558"/> Bang kam magpasab'nnal in si Isa Panghū'bi maka magkahagad to'ongan min deyom ataybi in iya bay pinakallum min kamatay e' Tuhan, tantu kam lappasan bo' pasōd ni deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Romans 10:10
verses.text: Sabab min pagkahagadtam ma si Isa ya angkan kitam binista abontol e' Tuhan, ati bang kitam angahaka sab'nnal ni a'a kasehe'an pasal pagkahagadtam, minnē' kitam lappasan.

verses.name: Romans 10:11
verses.text: Yuk sulat Kitab isab, “Sai-sai magkahagad ma iya halam aniya' pagsusunanna sapupud-daya.”

verses.name: Romans 10:12
verses.text: Talapay manusiya' kamemon pinagbissala ma ayat Kitab itu, sabab mbal magbidda' Yahudi maka ngga'i ka Yahudi. Dakayu' du Tuhan ya pameya'an e' sigām kamemon, maka aheya kahāpan pamuwanna ma sasuku parahing ni iya.

verses.name: Romans 10:13
verses.text: Buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Sai-sai parahing ni Panghū', tantu lappasan.”  <div eID="gen7155" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3559"/><div sID="gen7156" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3559"/> Buwattingga e' sigām parahing ni Panghū' bang halam gi' makapam'nnal ma iya? Maka buwattingga e' sigām am'nnal bang halam gi' bay makakale lapal ahāp? Buwattingga isab e' sigām akale lapal ahāp bang halam aniya' magnasihatan sigām?

verses.name: Romans 10:15
verses.text: Maka buwattingga isab e' a'a magnasihat bang halam aniya' bay anoho' iya magnasihat? Sagō' aniya' bay sinoho', buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Kahāp du pa'in bang aniya' amowahan kita lapal ahāp!”

verses.name: Romans 10:16
verses.text: Saguwā' ngga'i ka a'a kamemon bay akale lapal ahāp itu, buwat na bay pamūng si Isaya inān, ya yuk-i, “O Tuhan, kulang du a'a magkahagad ma panglapal kami.”

verses.name: Romans 10:17
verses.text: Manjari lapal pasal Al-Masi subay pinagnasihat dahū bo' yampa takale e' a'a, ati minnē' aniya' pagkahagad sigām.  <div eID="gen7156" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3560"/><div sID="gen7157" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3560"/> Amikilan aku pasal bangsa Isra'il. Kalu baha' halam takale sigām lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi? Sagō' tantu takale sabab atanyag lapal itu, buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yukna, <lg sID="gen7158"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7159"/>“Patanyag pamandu' sigām ni kamemon bangsa,<l eID="gen7159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7160"/>pasampay bissala sigām ni mpat pidju alam.”<l eID="gen7160" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7158"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:19
verses.text: Amikilan lagi' aku, kalu halam tahati e' bangsa Isra'il pasal lapal itu. Sagō' tahati du. Si Musa ya makarahū anambung, yukna, <lg sID="gen7161"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7162"/>“Pagalakta kam ni bangsa kasehe',<l eID="gen7162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7163"/>ya yukbi halam aniya' gunana.<l eID="gen7163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7164"/>Pap'ddi'ku ataybi tudju ni bangsa dakayu',<l eID="gen7164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7165"/>ya pangannalbi mbal makata'uwan aku.”<l eID="gen7165" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7161"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:20
verses.text: Atampal du pangallam Tuhan ya tasulat e' si Isaya, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7166"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7167"/>“Tabāk aku e' saga a'a bay halam amiha aku.<l eID="gen7167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7168"/>Panyata' aku ni saga a'a halam bay atilaw ma pasalanku.”<l eID="gen7168" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7166"/>

verses.name: Romans 10:21
verses.text: Saguwā' buwattitu ya pamissala Tuhan ma pasal bangsa Isra'il, yukna, <lg sID="gen7169"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7170"/>“Kahaba' llaw bilahi aku anaima' saga a'a anagga' aku,<l eID="gen7170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7171"/>ya anagga' na pa'in ma kabaya'anku.”<l eID="gen7171" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7169"/>  <div eID="gen7157" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.10"/> <div eID="gen7153" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3561"/><div sID="gen7172" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ka'ase' Tuhan ma Bangsa Isra'il<note>Bangsa Isra'il: sali' du maka bangsa Yahudi. Kaōnan sigām bangsa Isra'il ma sabab pangkat sigām si Isra'il, kaōnan sigām Yahudi ma sabab pangkat sigām si Yahudi.</note></title> <div sID="gen7173" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3561"/> Manjari angannal-ngannal lagi' aku: “Tinimanan bahā' e' Tuhan bangsa dakayu'-kayu' ya palsuku'anna?” Tantu mbal. Bangsaku ko' inān sabab bangsa Isra'il aku, tubu' si Ibrahim, min panubu' si Benjamin.

verses.name: Romans 11:2
verses.text: Halam katimanan e' Tuhan bangsa ya bay tapene'na sangay min awal tagna'. Kata'uwanbi ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, waktu kapanutul si Elija ni Tuhan pasal bangsa Isra'il. Yuk si Elija e',

verses.name: Romans 11:3
verses.text: “O Tuhan, pinapatay e' sigām saga nabi sosoho'annu. Nilubu e' sigām pagkukulbanan kami ni ka'a. Hal aku la'a takapin min ba'anan nabi, ati piniha aku e' sigām bo' pinapatay.”

verses.name: Romans 11:4
verses.text: Entomunbi bay panambung Tuhan ma panutul si Elija e', yuk-i, “Aniya' gi' pitu' ngibu a'a bay kapinanku, a'a halam bay makasumba ni ta'u-ta'u Ba'al.”

verses.name: Romans 11:5
verses.text: Damikiyanna ma buwattina'an, aniya' gi' takapin bangsa Isra'il halam pataikut min Tuhan, a'a isab tapene'na min lasana maka min ka'ase'na ma sigām.

verses.name: Romans 11:6
verses.text: Bang kasi-lasa Tuhan ya sababanna angkan iya amene' a'a, tantu ngga'i ka kahinangan manusiya' ya makasabab. Sagō' bang Tuhan bay amene' a'a ma saukat na ahāp hinangna, sali' halam aniya' pūs ma ase' maka lasa Tuhan e'.  <div eID="gen7173" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3562"/><div sID="gen7174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3562"/> Jari ai lagi'? Halam tabāk e' bangsa Isra'il ya pagmatayan sigām. Luwal a'a pinene' e' Tuhan ya makabāk. Bay pinatuwas kōk saga a'a kasehe'an,

verses.name: Romans 11:8
verses.text: buwat tasulat ma kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7175"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7176"/>“Pinabongog e' Tuhan pamikil sigām, ya po'on mbal makahati.<l eID="gen7176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7177"/>Aniya' mata sigām sagō' mbal maka'nda',<l eID="gen7177" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7178"/>Aniya' tainga sigām sagō' mbal makakale.”<l eID="gen7178" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7175"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:9
verses.text: Aniya' isab bay pamissala si Da'ud, yukna, <lg sID="gen7179"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7180"/>“Bang pa'in sigām nijallat e' paglami sigām,<l eID="gen7180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7181"/>Bang pa'in sigām palukbu' sampay ah'bba',<l eID="gen7181" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7182"/>panungbas kala'atan sigām.<l eID="gen7182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7183"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:10
verses.text: Bang pa'in palendom pang'nda' sigām bo' mbal maka'nda',<l eID="gen7183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7184"/>bang pa'in parukkug bukut sigām sampay ni kasaumulan.”<l eID="gen7184" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7179"/>  <div eID="gen7174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3563"/><div sID="gen7185" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3563"/> Amikilan lagi' aku pasal bangsa Isra'il itu. Ya kah'bba' sigām inān, anatas bahā' sampay ni kasaumulan? Tantu mbal. Sabab buwattitu ya pinagmohotan e' Tuhan: saga bangsa ngga'i ka Isra'il pas'lle' na lappasan min hukuman dusa ma sabab karusahan bangsa Isra'il. Minnē' isab in bangsa Isra'il tabowa angihid pagka tinaikutan.

verses.name: Romans 11:12
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi, bang kaniya'an kahāpan saga a'a ngga'i ka Isra'il ma sabab karusahan bangsa Isra'il, maka ma sabab kapanaikut Tuhan ma sigām, luhūy paheya kahāpan ma palbangsa-bangsahan kamemon bang jukup na saga a'a Isra'il magpangahagad.  <div eID="gen7185" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7172" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3564"/><div sID="gen7186" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Ngga'i ka Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen7187" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3564"/> Aniya' pamissalaku ma ka'am ya ngga'i ka Yahudi. Kawakilan aku e' Tuhan magnasihat ma buwat ka'am. Paheyaku isāb pagnasihatku itu ma atay,

verses.name: Romans 11:14
verses.text: bang pa'in pinaihid pagkahiku Yahudi bo' supaya aniya' sigām lappasan min mulka'.

verses.name: Romans 11:15
verses.text: Sabab bang maghāp na Tuhan maka saga palbangsa-bangsahan ma sabab kataikut Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il, ai kaluwasanna bang sigām tinaima' e' Tuhan pabīng? Lumandu'an ahāp. Sali' sigām a'a pinakallum pabīng min kamatay.

verses.name: Romans 11:16
verses.text: Buwat tinapay bang ma pangaddat Yahudi. Niakup dangkuri' min addunan bay panukbal ni Tuhan, paltanda'an in tinapay inān kamemon palsuku'an Tuhan du. Atawa po'on kayu, panukbal gamutna ni Tuhan, jari palsuku'anna katibu'ukan kayu inān sampay ni sangana.  <div eID="gen7187" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7186" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3565"/><div sID="gen7188" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kayu Jaitun Ni'ipat maka Kayu Jaitun Talun<note>Bangsa Isra'il sapantun po'on kayu jaitun ni'ipat bo' ahāp buwa'na, maka saga bangsa kasehe' sapantun po'on kayu hal atomo'an di-na ma talun.</note></title> <div sID="gen7189" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3565"/> Na, magparalilan aku: bang aniya' sanga sinagpe' min po'on kayu ni'ipat, bo' aniya' sanga kayu talun pinabatuk ni bay panagpe'an sanga tagna', jari kabahagi'an kajatuhan min kayu ni'ipat saga magdalos na maka gamutna.

verses.name: Romans 11:18
verses.text: Sagō' da'a pagabbu-abbuhinbi, sabab ka'am ilu hal sanga, maka ngga'i ka sanga ya amuwan kallum ma gamut. Gamut ya amuwan kallum ma sanga.  <div eID="gen7189" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3566"/><div sID="gen7190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3566"/> Kalu yukbi, “B'nnal ko' ilu, saguwā' sinagpe' sigām e' Tuhan supaya kami kapabatukan.”

verses.name: Romans 11:20
verses.text: Aho', b'nnal. Sagō' ya po'on sigām bangsa Isra'il sinagpe' sabab agagga am'nnal ma Tuhan, ati ka'am ya pinabatuk ni po'on kayu ma sabab kapam'nnalbi. Sagō' da'a pagmalangkahianbi ina'an-i. Gom pa'in kam magmatāw, ya aniya' kam sinagpe' buwat bay sigām.

verses.name: Romans 11:21
verses.text: Sabab hatina, bang mbal allog Tuhan ma saga sanga porol, ya du ka'am mbal ka'lloganna.  <div eID="gen7190" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3567"/><div sID="gen7191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3567"/> Kira-kirahunbi ka'ase' Tuhan maka kab'ngngisna. Kab'ngngisanna saga a'a ya pataikut min iya, saguwā' ka'ase'anna kam bang pa'in pataptap ma kahāpna, mbal magla'an-la'an. Bang kam ganta' pataikut min pangandolbi, ya du ka'am sinagpe' du buwat ibarat sanga kayu.

verses.name: Romans 11:23
verses.text: Ya balikna, pinabatuk bangsa Isra'il ni bay bai sigām, bang sigām ganta' pahali anulak Al-Masi. Sabab halam aniya' ahunit ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 11:24
verses.text: Ya hantang hatulanna, bang ka'am bay niā' min kayu jaitun talun bo' pinabatuk ni kayu ni'ipat, labi aluhay bang bangsa Isra'il pinabīng ni kayu bay panagpe'an sigām tagna', sabab ya na po'onan sigām.  <div eID="gen7191" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7188" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3568"/><div sID="gen7192" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lappasan Bangsa Isra'il Kamemon ma Sinōng</title> <div sID="gen7193" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3568"/> Saga dauranakanku, aniya' bay pamata'u aku e' Tuhan ma pasal bangsa Isra'il itu. Bilahi aku amahatian ka'am supaya kam mbal amikil di-bi in ka'am ahāp min sigām. Buwattitu: in bangsa Isra'il itu bay agagga am'nnal ma si Isa Al-Masi, saguwā' mbal anatas kagagga sigām. Bang ajukup na kaheka'an a'a min bangsa saddī ameya' ma Tuhan, ameya' isab bangsa Isra'il.

verses.name: Romans 11:26
verses.text: Manjari lappasan isab bangsa Isra'il kamemon, buwat bay sinulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7194"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7195"/>“Pi'itu min lahat Siyun ya Manglalappas.<l eID="gen7195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7196"/>Pahalamna saga la'at bay tahinang e' panubu' si Yakub.<l eID="gen7196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7197"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:27
verses.text: Makapi'ilu pa'in aku, la'ananku dusa sigām kamemon,<l eID="gen7197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7198"/>buwat bay asal tajanji'ku ma sigām.”<l eID="gen7198" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7194"/>  <div eID="gen7193" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3569"/><div sID="gen7199" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3569"/> In bangsa Isra'il itu bay banta Tuhan sabab tasulak e' sigām lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi, sagō' in kahāpan bay ma sigām tagna' papelleng na ni bangsa saddī. Saguwā' mbal du taptap kapanagga' sigām, sabab nientom e' Tuhan bay kapamene'na ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām, angkan sigām kinalasahan na pa'in.

verses.name: Romans 11:29
verses.text: Sabab Tuhan, bang aniya' a'a bay pinene' e'na sampay lidjiki'anna, mbal to'ongan apinda niyatna.

verses.name: Romans 11:30
verses.text: Ka'am ngga'i ka Yahudi ilu, bay kam anulang kabaya'an Tuhan ma waktu palabay inān, manda' kina'ase'an kam e'na buwattina'an ma sabab kapanulang bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Romans 11:31
verses.text: Ya du isab bangsa Yahudi, tasulang e' sigām kabaya'an Tuhan buwattina'an, sagō' kina'ase'an sigām e' Tuhan buwat ka'ase'na ma ka'am.

verses.name: Romans 11:32
verses.text: Min kahandak Tuhan angkan in kamemon bangsa manusiya' tahinang sali' sapantun pilisu mbal makalimaya min kapanulang sigām, bo' supaya in sigām kamemon pinat'kkahan ase'na.  <div eID="gen7199" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7192" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3570"/><div sID="gen7200" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pananglit ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7201" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3570"/> Mbal tapula'-pula' kahāp Tuhan, ka'ase'na, pangita'una maka panahu'anna. Halam aniya' min kitam makahati ma kagara'anna maka ma kahinanganna.

verses.name: Romans 11:34
verses.text: Buwat yukna ma deyom Kitab, <lg sID="gen7202"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7203"/>“Sai makata'u panahuan Tuhan?<l eID="gen7203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7204"/>Sai makapituwahan iya?<l eID="gen7204" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7205"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:35
verses.text: Sai bay makabuwanan Tuhan ai-ai,<l eID="gen7205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7206"/>atawa bay makapautang ma iya?”<l eID="gen7206" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7202"/>

verses.name: Romans 11:36
verses.text: Min Tuhan asal ai-ai kamemon. Iya ya bay amaniya' kamemon maka iya isab sababanna angkan paniya' ba'anan ai-ai kamemon. Sanglitanta iya ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen7201" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.11"/> <div eID="gen7200" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3571"/><div sID="gen7207" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hinang Makasulut Atay Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7208" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3571"/> Saga dauranakanku, landu' kitam kina'ase'an e' Tuhan, angkan buwattitu junjungku ma ka'am: pamasuku'unbi baranbi ni Tuhan, panukbalunbi ni iya t'ggolbi allum. Ai-ai hinangbi subay ma iya sadja, maka subay makasulut atayna. Bang buwattē' ajatu du pa'in pagta'atbi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 12:2
verses.text: Da'a panunurinbi kajarihan ya maumu panunuran ma ahil jaman itu, sagō' parūlunbi Tuhan amabaha'u deyom panahu'anbi bo' supaya pinindahan e'na addat-tabi'atbi kamemon. Bang buwattē' kasakupanbi du bang ai kahandak Tuhan, kahāpna maka kasampulna'anna, ati kata'uwanbi bang ai makasulut iya.  <div eID="gen7208" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3572"/><div sID="gen7209" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3572"/> Bay aku kinahāpan e' Tuhan, binuwanan kapatut magnasihat, angkan yukku ma ka'am kamemon, da'a kam maglaku-laku in ka'am alanga min bay pamat'nna' ka'am. Subay kam amikilan di-bi pahāp-hāp. Bistahunbi to'ongan bang ai bay pamatulun Tuhan ma ka'am kaniya-kaniya, sabab min pangandolbi.

verses.name: Romans 12:4
verses.text: Dalilunbi baran manusiya'. Baranta itu dakayu' du, bo' magginis pagdayawna. Magbidda' isab hinang pagdayaw dakayu' maka dakayu'.

verses.name: Romans 12:5
verses.text: Buwattē' isab ma kitam magpangandol ma si Isa. Minsan kitam aheka, sapantun kitam dakayu' baran atibu'uk pagka suku' kitam Al-Masi. Magsugpat kitam dangan maka dangan minsan magbidda' kahinangantam, buwat pagdayaw baran.

verses.name: Romans 12:6
verses.text: Kabuwanan kitam kapandayan ginisan ma sabab lasa Tuhan, saddī ma dangan maka ma dangan. Maka kapandayan itu subay ginuna pahāp-hāp, pinapagtongod maka pangandoltam. Bang a'a kabuwanan kapandayan magpaluwas bissala deyo' min Tuhan, subay paluwasna to'ongan.

verses.name: Romans 12:7
verses.text: Bang a'a kabuwanan kapandayan anabangan pagkahina, subay tabanganna to'ongan. Bang kapandayan magpandu', subay amandu' to'ongan.

verses.name: Romans 12:8
verses.text: Bang kapandayan amalasig atay kasehe', subay amalasig to'ongan. Bang a'a anulung ma sukkal kasehe', subay hilas panulungna. Bang a'a binuwanan kapatut magnakura', subay atukid e'na magpal'ngngan ai-ai. Bang a'a binuwanan kapandayan angayura a'a kasigpitan, subay iya magkalasigan angayura.  <div eID="gen7209" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3573"/><div sID="gen7210" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3573"/> Ya lasabi ma sehe'bi subay min deyom atay. Kab'nsihinbi ai-ai ala'at, balutinbi ai-ai ahāp.

verses.name: Romans 12:10
verses.text: Subay kam maglasa-liyasahi to'ongan sabab magdanakan kam ma deyoman si Isa Al-Masi. Magaddat-iyaddati kam min deyom atay.

verses.name: Romans 12:11
verses.text: Subay kam mbal lisu'an sabab Panghū' Isa ya paghinanganbi. Subay kam atukid sadja ma ai-ai pamahinang ka'am.

verses.name: Romans 12:12
verses.text: Subay kam magkakōgan ma pangaholatbi ma Tuhan. Bang kam taluwa' sukkal sandalinbi sadja, maka da'a kam pahali angamu'-ngamu' ni iya.

verses.name: Romans 12:13
verses.text: Buwaninbi pagkahibi suku' Tuhan bang kasigpitan, pa'iddahunbi isab sasuku pahapit ni luma'bi.  <div eID="gen7210" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3574"/><div sID="gen7211" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3574"/> Bang aniya' angala'at ka'am, amu'inbi sigām kahāpan ni Tuhan. Da'a balosinbi sukna'.

verses.name: Romans 12:15
verses.text: Ameya' kam magkōg-koyag bang aniya' sehe'bi magkōg-koyag, ameya' kam magtangis bang aniya' sehe'bi ganta' magtangisan.

verses.name: Romans 12:16
verses.text: Magsulut-siyuluti kam dapagkahian. Da'a palangahunbi bowahanbi, maka da'a kam aiya' magbagay maka a'a areyo'. Da'a kam maglaku-laku in pangita'ubi alalom.  <div eID="gen7211" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3575"/><div sID="gen7212" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3575"/> Bang aniya' angala'at ka'am, da'a pellenginbi la'at. Ai-ai binista abontol e' saga a'a kamemon, ya na he' subay tukirinbi.

verses.name: Romans 12:18
verses.text: Amanuyu' kam magsulut maka a'a kamemon. Bang aniya' pagsagga'an subay ngga'i ka ka'am ya amowa sagga'.

verses.name: Romans 12:19
verses.text: Saga bagay, da'a to'ongan kam amalos bang kam nila'at. Sagarinbi sigām binalos e' mulka' Tuhan. Entomunbi bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Aku na amalos, aku na anungbas, yuk Panghū'.”

verses.name: Romans 12:20
verses.text: Ahāp bang beya'bi panoho'an itu, ya bay tasulat isab ma Kitab, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7214"/>“Bang aniya' bantabi lingantu, pakanunbi.<l eID="gen7214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7215"/>Bang iya patay bohe', painumunbi,<l eID="gen7215" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7216"/>sabab bang buwattē' lasabi ma iya, kalu iya sinōd susun.”<l eID="gen7216" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7213"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:21
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' nila'at, da'a balosinbi. Hāpunbi a'a angala'at inān bo' tara'ug la'atna sabab min kahāpbi.  <div eID="gen7212" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.12"/> <div eID="gen7207" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3576"/><div sID="gen7217" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Subay Beya'ta Ang'ntan Pagparinta</title> <div sID="gen7218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3576"/> In kitam manusiya' kamemon subay ameya' ma saga a'a magparinta ma paglahattam sabab halam aniya' kabuwanan kapatut magparinta bang ngga'i ka min kahandak Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 13:2
verses.text: Sasuku anagga' ma a'a magparinta, sali' Tuhan maka panoho'anna ya sagga'na, angkan iya taluwa' hukuman.

verses.name: Romans 13:3
verses.text: Bang a'a maghinang ahāp mbal du tināw ma parinta. Luwal a'a maghinang kala'atan ya tināw. Bang kam mbal bilahi tināw ma a'a magparinta, subay ahāp sadja hinangbi. Sinanglitan kam e'na

verses.name: Romans 13:4
verses.text: sabab sosoho'an Tuhan iya, a'a pinat'nna' maghinang kahāpan ma pasalanbi. Saguwā' bang kam ganta' maghinang kala'atan, patut kam tināw, sabab nakura' inān taga-kapatut aminasa ka'am. Sosoho'an Tuhan iya, wajib aminasa sasuku maghinang ala'at.

verses.name: Romans 13:5
verses.text: Angkan kam subay magmaluluy ma saga a'a ang'ntan pagparinta, kaissana ma sabab kam tināw bininasa, karuwana ma sabab kata'uwanbi ma deyom itikadbi bang ai subay hinangbi.  <div eID="gen7218" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3577"/><div sID="gen7219" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3577"/> Ya he' sababanna angkan kam subay amayad sukay parinta, sabab sosoho'an Tuhan saga a'a ya maghinang ma deyo'an parinta inān.

verses.name: Romans 13:7
verses.text: Subay kam amayaran sigām sukay pila-pila ya katongoranna, ai na ka tongod ni usahabi, ai na ka tongod ni baranbi. Pagaddatinbi sigām kamemon bang aniya' kawasa sigām patut pinagaddatan. Pagmahaltabatinbi bang patut pinagmahaltabatan.  <div eID="gen7219" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7217" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3578"/><div sID="gen7220" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Subay Kita Maglasa-liyasahi</title> <div sID="gen7221" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3578"/> Bang aniya' utangbi, bayarinbi bang ta'abut waktuna. Aniya' isab utang mbal kabayaran, ya na lasa ma pagkahibi. Bang kam alasa ma pagkahibi tatuman e'bi panoho'an-sara' bay tasulat e' si Musa,

verses.name: Romans 13:9
verses.text: ya yuk-i, “Wajib kam da'a angaliyu-lakad min paghola'bi. Wajib kam da'a amapatay, da'a anangkaw, da'a anganapsuhan alta' kasehe'anbi.” Ya panoho'an panambatku itu maka panoho'an kasehe', tapagdakayu' maka panoho'an dakayu'-dakayu', ya yuk-i, “Kalasahinbi pagkahibi buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi.”

verses.name: Romans 13:10
verses.text: Hatulanna, sasuku alasa ma pagkahina mbal to'ongan bilahi angala'at iya. Angkan bang kitam alasahan pagkahita manusiya', tatuman e'tam sara' Tuhan maka panoho'anna kamemon.  <div eID="gen7221" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3579"/><div sID="gen7222" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3579"/> Patut subay hinangbi panoho'an itu sabab song na waktu pabīng si Isa. Asekot na min katagna' pam'nnalta ma si Isa. In kitam sali' hantang a'a bay magtulihan, sagō' abati' na.

verses.name: Romans 13:12
verses.text: Sōng palabay kalendoman, ya masa pangandusa. Apote' na sobangan, angkan subay bbahanta kahinangan ala'at, ya nihinang ma deyom kalendoman. Subay kita sakap anagga' kala'atan, buwat ibarat sundalu magsakap.

verses.name: Romans 13:13
verses.text: Kaul-pi'ilta subay ahāp, ya tōp ma a'a pat'nna' ma deyom kasawahan. Angkan da'a subay dumasiyaw paglami-lamita, da'a kita maglango-lango, da'a magba'is, da'a magkasabulan. Da'a kita magbono', da'a isab maglindi-lindi.

verses.name: Romans 13:14
verses.text: Sapantun badju' paghaggut, ahāp lagi' bang Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi ya pangalampikbi. Da'a kannalunbi napsu baranbi bang buwattingga e'bi amarūl.  <div eID="gen7222" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.13"/> <div eID="gen7220" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3580"/><div sID="gen7223" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangandol Akosog maka Pangandol Alamma</title> <div sID="gen7224" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3580"/> Aniya' pamituwaku ma ka'am ma pasalan a'a alamma pangandolna ma si Isa. Bagayunbi iya, da'a iya bowahunbi magjawab ma saukat na aniya' kapam'nnalanna saddī.

verses.name: Romans 14:2
verses.text: Buwat saupama ma pagkakan, aniya' a'a dakayu' makahalal pagkakan ai-ai sabab ahogot pangandolna ma si Isa Al-Masi. Aniya' isab a'a dangan, hal sayul ya palaukna pagka mbal gi' ahogot pangandolna.

verses.name: Romans 14:3
verses.text: Na, ya a'a makahalal kinakan indaginis subay mbal angudju' ma a'a dangan ya mbal makahalal. Damikiyanna a'a amangan sayul sadja, subay mbal anoway a'a dangan ma saukat tahalalna kinakan ai-ai. Sabab tinaima' du a'a inān e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 14:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' kapatutbi anoway a'a dakayu' bang ngga'i ka ka'am ya pagnakura'an. Nakura'na sadja ya tag-kapatut amah'llingan iya ahāp-ala'at. Saguwā' tantu iya mbal tabowa ni kala'atan sabab tinabang iya e' Panghū' Isa angkan makasandal.  <div eID="gen7224" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3581"/><div sID="gen7225" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3581"/> Bang takdil ni llaw, aniya' a'a angisbat llaw mulliya sabab aheya bang ma bistahanna. Saddī isab bistahan a'a dangan, bang ma iya sali' du llaw kamemon. Jari ai-ai pamistabi pasal llaw, da'a pagduwa-duwahinbi.

verses.name: Romans 14:6
verses.text: Sai-sai angamulliya llaw, Tuhan ya aheya ma atayna pagmahaldika'anna. Sai-sai angahalal kinakan ai-ai, Tuhan ya mahaldika'na sabab Tuhan ya pagsukulanna bang amangan. Damikiyanna isab, sai-sai amene' pagkakanna, Tuhan du isab mahaldika'na sampay pagsukulanna.

verses.name: Romans 14:7
verses.text: Ngga'i ka baranta sadja ya pagka'inagonanta t'ggolta allum.

verses.name: Romans 14:8
verses.text: Subay isbatta Panghū' Isa ma kallumta maka ma kamatayta sabab suku'na kita.  <div eID="gen7225" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3582"/><div sID="gen7226" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3582"/> Ya na itu sababanna angkan Al-Masi bay amatay sampay allum pabīng min kamatayna, supaya iya pagpanghū'an saga a'a suku'na, ai na ka allum, ai na ka bay magpatayan.

verses.name: Romans 14:10
verses.text: Angkanna kam subay mbal anoway atawa angudju' danakanbi. Makapagbalharap du kitam kamemon maka Tuhan ma llaw damuli bo' nihukum e'na.

verses.name: Romans 14:11
verses.text: Buwat tasulat ma Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7228"/>“B'nnal sadja bissalaku,” yuk Tuhan.<l eID="gen7228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7229"/>“Pasujud du ni aku saga manusiya' kamemon.<l eID="gen7229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7230"/>Magpanyabut sigām kamemon in aku asal Tuhan.”<l eID="gen7230" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7227"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:12
verses.text: Manjari in kitam kamemon subay magpamattan ni Tuhan ma sinosōng pasal ai-ai bay hinangtam ma dunya.  <div eID="gen7226" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7223" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3583"/><div sID="gen7231" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'a Parusahunbi Sehe'bi</title> <div sID="gen7232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3583"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan kita subay pahali magsoway dangan maka dangan. Ahāp lagi' kita da'a magniyat angahinang ai-ai bang hinang inān amowa magdusa ma dakayu' danakanta.

verses.name: Romans 14:14
verses.text: Aku itu, pagka parakayu' na ma Panghū' Isa, kata'uwanku to'ongan halam aniya' pagkakan haram min ka'asalna. Sagō' ma sehe'ta dakayu', bang aniya' pagkakan haram ma pamistana mbal to'ongan tas'llongna.

verses.name: Romans 14:15
verses.text: Na, bang danakannu ganta' asusa ma sabab ka'a ya ta'nda'na amangan kinakan ya haram ma pamistana, sali' halam aniya' lasabi ma iya. Subay ka mbal pasangdan amangan e'-i bang amowa danakannu ni kala'atan, sabab bay amatay Al-Masi ma sababanna inān.

verses.name: Romans 14:16
verses.text: Bang ma ka'a ahāp pagkakannu, saguwā' mbal ahāp bang binissalahan ala'at e' kasehe'an.

verses.name: Romans 14:17
verses.text: Pagka kita ma deyoman pagparinta Tuhan, mbal subay pahalga'ta ma atay pagkakanta atawa paginumta. Ya subay paheyata kahinanganta abontol, maka kasannangan atay, maka kalasigan pamuwan e' Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Romans 14:18
verses.text: Jari bang buwattē' paghinangta tudju ni Al-Masi kasulutan du Tuhan ma kita, maka pinagaddatan kita e' pagkahita manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3584"/><div sID="gen7233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3584"/> Angkan na, subay kita angamohot maghinang ai-ai makapagsulut pagkahita, maka magpahogot pangandolta dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Romans 14:20
verses.text: Da'a paka'atunbi hinang Tuhan ma saukat na magbidda' pangaddatbi pasal pagkakan. Tahalal asal pagkakan kamemon, saguwā' asā' kam bang kam amangan ai-ai, bo' kam ta'nda' e' dakayu' pagkahibi, ati minnē' iya ang'bba min pangandolna.

verses.name: Romans 14:21
verses.text: Ahāp lagi' kita pahondong amangan susumbali'an, atawa anginum binu, atawa angahinang ai-ai bang ina'an-i manjari panababan pamowa danakanta angandusa atawa ang'bba min pangandolna.  <div eID="gen7233" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3585"/><div sID="gen7234" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3585"/> Manjari ai-ai pamistabi pasal itu-i subay hal ka'am maka Tuhan ya makata'u. Aheya kalasiganbi bang kam anganiyat angahinang ai-ai ma halam aniya' dusa tananam ma itikadbi.

verses.name: Romans 14:23
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a magduwa-ruwa pasal pagkakan bo' amangan na pa'in, katōngan iya dusa sabab mbal magtaluwa' maka pangandolna. Taga-dusa kita bang aniya' hinangta mbal magtaluwa' maka pangandolta.  <div eID="gen7234" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.14"/> <div eID="gen7231" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3586"/><div sID="gen7235" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panabang ma Danakantam</title> <div sID="gen7236" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3586"/> Sasuku kitam akosog pangandoltam ma Tuhan subay anabang ma a'a kasehe'an ya mbal angandol to'ongan. Subay tanggungtam kalammahan sigām. Ngga'i ka baranta ya subay sinulut,

verses.name: Romans 15:2
verses.text: sagō' danakantam bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi, pamahāp kahālanna bo' supaya pasōng pahogot pangandolna.

verses.name: Romans 15:3
verses.text: Panunurantam Al-Masi sabab halam iya bay angandūlan di-na. Atumlang ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Ka'a, Tuhan, pinamūng-mūngan ala'at, bo' aku ya t'kkahan himumungan sigām.”

verses.name: Romans 15:4
verses.text: Ai-ai ma deyom Kitab bay pinasulat e' Tuhan ma awal jaman pangā'antam kapamintāngan, bo' supaya ahogot imantam maka kasandal ma katiksa'an. Minnē' kitam angaholat lappasan.  <div eID="gen7236" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3587"/><div sID="gen7237" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3587"/> Tuhan ya amasandal maka amahogot imantam. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam tinabang e'na bo' kam magdakayu' pikilan hinabubi anunud ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Romans 15:6
verses.text: Jari maguyun kam amudji ma Tuhan, ya Mma' sin Panghū' Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7237" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3588"/><div sID="gen7238" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3588"/> Taima'unbi kasehe'anbi angandol ma Al-Masi, buwat kapanaima' ka'am e' Al-Masi. Tapudji Tuhan bang buwattē' panaima'bi.

verses.name: Romans 15:8
verses.text: Haka'anta kam pasal Al-Masi, bay iya pi'itu ni dunya anabang bangsa Yahudi bo' sigām makatantu in Tuhan kapangandolan du, ati bo' atuman bay janji'na ma pangkat kami.

verses.name: Romans 15:9
verses.text: Ya minaksud e'na saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi bo' supaya sigām amudji Tuhan ma sabab ka'ase'na. Buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7239"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7240"/>“Magsukul aku ni ka'a, Tuhan, ma deyoman saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi.<l eID="gen7240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7241"/>Magkalang aku kalangan pamudji ōnnu.”<l eID="gen7241" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7239"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:10
verses.text: Aniya' gi' ayat Kitab dakayu', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7242"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7243"/>“Ka'am kabangsa-bangsahan ya ngga'i ka Yahudi,<l eID="gen7243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7244"/>dai' kam magkōg-koyag sama-sama<l eID="gen7244" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7245"/>maka bangsa ya tapene' e' Tuhan.”<l eID="gen7245" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7242"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:11
verses.text: Maka ayat itu gi': <lg sID="gen7246"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7247"/>“Sanglitinbi Tuhan, ka'am kamemon ya ngga'i ka Yahudi.<l eID="gen7247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7248"/>Pudjihunbi iya, ka'am sabarang bangsa.”<l eID="gen7248" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7246"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:12
verses.text: Aniya' isab bay sinulat e' si Isaya pasal Al-Masi, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7250"/>“Aniya' tubu' si Jesse palahil ni dunya ma sinōng.<l eID="gen7250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7251"/>Magbaya' du iya ma bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi,<l eID="gen7251" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7252"/>ati iya ya pangasahan sigām.”<l eID="gen7252" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7249"/>  <div eID="gen7238" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3589"/><div sID="gen7253" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3589"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kaniya'an kakōgan maka kasannangan deyom atay min Tuhan, ya po'onan holatanbi, pagka kam angandol na pa'in ma iya. Ati manglabi-labihan kaholatanbi ma sabab kawasa min Rū Sussi.  <div eID="gen7253" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7235" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3590"/><div sID="gen7254" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Po'on si Paul Atawakkal Anulat</title> <div sID="gen7255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3590"/> Saga dauranakanku, halam aniya' hawal-hawalku ma sababanbi. Tatantuku in ka'am ahāp kasuddahanbi, aheya isab pangita'ubi, patut kam magpandu'-pandu'an di-bi.

verses.name: Romans 15:15
verses.text: Saguwā' aniya' gi' pamaentomku ka'am, ya po'on aku atawakkal amabeya' sulat itu. Halam aniya' pagduwa-duwaku anulatan ka'am sabab taga-wakil aku min Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 15:16
verses.text: Maghinang aku ma si Isa Al-Masi ma pasalan saga bangsa saddī min Yahudi. Ibarat aku imam magnasihat lapal ahāp min Tuhan, bo' supaya angandol saga bangsa kasehe'an. Ungsuranku sigām ni Tuhan dalil tutukbalan. Kasulutan iya ma sigām, sabab tasussi na pangatayan sigām e' Rū Sussi.  <div eID="gen7255" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3591"/><div sID="gen7256" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3591"/> Na, mbal aku aiya' magpata'u pasal paghinangku ma Tuhan, sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pagkōganku.

verses.name: Romans 15:18
verses.text: Halam aniya' pagbissalahanku haliyu min bay pamahinang aku e' Al-Masi. Maka Al-Masi ya sababna angkan tabowa saga bangsa saddī ameya' ma Tuhan. Takale e' sigām pagnasihatku, ta'nda' e' sigām saga hinang bay hinanganku

verses.name: Romans 15:19
verses.text: min kawasa Rū Sussi, hatina saga paltanda'an maka hinang kainu-inuhan a'a. Bay pasaplagku to'ongan lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi, tinagna'an min Awrusalam sampay ta'abut lahat Ilirikum.

verses.name: Romans 15:20
verses.text: Sangay min tagna' kapagnasihatku, ya pagmatayanku subay pinasaplag lapal ahāp itu ma lahat halam bay kapakalehan pasal Al-Masi, sabab mbal aku bilahi anugpat ni bay tahinang e' a'a bay dumahū min aku.

verses.name: Romans 15:21
verses.text: Kabaya'anku subay atuman sulat Kitab itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7257"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7258"/>“Saga a'a halam bay pinata'u ma pasalanna,<l eID="gen7258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7259"/>makata'u du ma sinosōng,<l eID="gen7259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7260"/>maka a'a halam bay makakale, makahati na.”<l eID="gen7260" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7257"/>  <div eID="gen7256" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7254" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3592"/><div sID="gen7261" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Agara' si Paul Palanjal ni Da'ira Rōm</title> <div sID="gen7262" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3592"/> Ya ko' ina'an sababna angkan aku bay makat'ggol pi'ilu ni ka'am, sabab hinangku angalatag kalahatan ītu subay apuwas dahū.

verses.name: Romans 15:23
verses.text: Sagō' atammat na hinangku ma jadjahan ītu. Bilahi na aku sidda patibaw ni ka'am,

verses.name: Romans 15:24
verses.text: manjari agara' na aku amusay ni lahat Kastila', sagō' bilahi aku pahapit ni ka'am dahū bo' supaya kitam makapag'nda'. Bilahi isab aku patuntulbi, bang aku song pauntas ni papehē'anku he'. Subay na ahāp katibawku ma ka'am bo' yampa aku ala'an.

verses.name: Romans 15:25
verses.text: Saguwā' aniya' gi' gawiku dahū. Itiya' aku ni Awrusalam ang'nde'an tutulungan ni saga a'a suku' si Isa mahē'.

verses.name: Romans 15:26
verses.text: Sabab bay animuk sīn saga jama'a si Isa ya maglahat ma sakalibut lahat Makidunya maka Akaya itu, panulung saga miskin ma kajama'ahan suku' Tuhan ma Awrusalam.

verses.name: Romans 15:27
verses.text: Hilas isab min deyom atay sigām, maka patut isab sabab Yahudi ya po'onna angkan sigām ngga'i ka Yahudi bay pinakalehan lapal min Tuhan. Tauwa' bang bangsa Yahudi ya pinahampitan ai-ai bay pangalidjiki' saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: Romans 15:28
verses.text: Manjari bang atangbus gawiku ang'nde'an kamemon bay pinabowa ma aku, pauntas aku tudju ni lahat Kastila' ati pahapit du ni ka'am.

verses.name: Romans 15:29
verses.text: Kata'uwanku isab, bang aku ganta' makat'kka ni ka'am, tantu kam bowahanku kahāpan aheya min Al-Masi, kahāpan halam kulangna.  <div eID="gen7262" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3593"/><div sID="gen7263" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3593"/> Saga dauranakanku, kata'uwanku aheya pangisbatbi ma si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam maka aniya' lasabi luwas min Rū Tuhan, angkan aku angamu' junjung itu. Gapi'unbi aku, amu'inbi aku tabang ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Romans 15:31
verses.text: Amu'-amu'inbi isab aku bo' aku mbal ainay e' saga a'a ma lahat Yahudi ya mbal magkahagad ma si Isa. Amu'inbi isab aku kahāpan pasal tutulungan ya bowaku pina'an, bang pa'in tinaima' sangkahāpan e' saga a'a suku' Tuhan he'.

verses.name: Romans 15:32
verses.text: Jari bang kabaya'an Tuhan, pasampay du aku ni ka'am maka kalasiganku aheya, ati ahāp palasahanku bang kita makapag'nda'.

verses.name: Romans 15:33
verses.text: Na, mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam ginapi' kamemon e' Tuhan, ya po'onan kasannangan. Amin.  <div eID="gen7263" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rom.15"/> <div eID="gen7261" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3594"/><div sID="gen7264" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangentom si Paul ma saga Bagayna</title> <div sID="gen7265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3594"/> Bilahi aku amakilā ni ka'am dakayu' danakantam d'nda itu. Ōnna si Pebe, a'a anabang ma katipunan jama'a si Isa ma lahat Kengkereya.

verses.name: Romans 16:2
verses.text: Aniya' gawina pi'ilu ni Rōm. Subay ahāp e'bi ama'idda iya bang makat'kka pi'ilu, pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya Panghū'bi sali'-sali', maka suku' Tuhan du kam. Subay iya patuntulbi ma ai-ai kalagihanna, sabab aheka a'a bay tatabang e'na, sampay isab aku.  <div eID="gen7265" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3595"/><div sID="gen7266" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3595"/> Amabeya' aku minsan la'a hal lapal kasi-lasaku ni disi Akila maka si Prisila ilu, a'a maglakibini bay sehe'ku maghinang ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Romans 16:4
verses.text: Bay sigā arak amatay ma sababanku waktu aku bay ma deyom kapiligduhan, angkanna aheya pagsukulanku ma sigā. Ngga'i ka hal aku ya magsukul, sampay saga jama'a si Isa kamemon ya ngga'i ka Yahudi, sasuku magpalhimpunan ma kalahat-lahatan ilu.

verses.name: Romans 16:5
verses.text: Pabeya'ku isab lapalku ma saga jama'a si Isa ya magtipun ma luma' sigā. <div eID="gen7266" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7267" type="paragraph"/> Damikiyanna si Epeneto bagayku kalalasahan, pabeya'anku minsan hal lapalku. Dahū asal iya min a'a kamemon ya magpangandol ma Al-Masi ma kaluha'an lahat Asiya.

verses.name: Romans 16:6
verses.text: Maka si Mariyam, ya akosog hinangna ma pasalanbi.

verses.name: Romans 16:7
verses.text: Si Androniku maka si Juniyas, pagkahiku Yahudi bay sehe'ku ma deyom kalabusu. Abantug sigā bang takdil ni saga a'a kawakilan si Isa, dahū sigā min aku bay angandol ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7267" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3596"/><div sID="gen7268" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3596"/> Pabeya'ku isab lapalku ni disi Ampliyatu, bagayku kinalasahan ma deyoman Panghū' Isa,

verses.name: Romans 16:9
verses.text: maka si Urbanu, sehe'tam maghinang ma Al-Masi, maka si Istakis bagayku kinalasahan isab.

verses.name: Romans 16:10
verses.text: Si Apelles isab, apa bay na iya kasulayan in pameya'na ma Al-Masi ahogot du. Sigām ma okoman si Aristobol,

verses.name: Romans 16:11
verses.text: maka si Herodiyun pagkahiku Yahudi, maka sigām angandol ma Panghū' Isa min okoman si Narkissu.  <div eID="gen7268" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3597"/><div sID="gen7269" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3597"/> Damikiyanna disi Tripena maka si Triposa, d'nda maghinang ma Panghū' Isa, maka bagayku si Persis, d'nda kinalasahan, ya abasag paghinangna ni Panghū'tam. Amabeya' isab aku minsan la'a hal lapalku ni sigām.

verses.name: Romans 16:13
verses.text: Si Rupus isab, a'a tapene' e' Panghū'ta, maka ina' si Rupus e'. Sapantun iya ina' angayura aku.

verses.name: Romans 16:14
verses.text: Disi Asingkrit, si Plegon, si Hermes, si Patrobas, si Hermas maka saga sehe' sigām angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: Romans 16:15
verses.text: Disi Pilologo maka si Juliya isab, si Nereyo maka danakanna d'nda, si Olimpas isab maka a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon ya dansehe'an maka sigām. Pabeya'ku lapalku ni sigām ilu kamemon.  <div eID="gen7269" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3598"/><div sID="gen7270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3598"/> Bang kam magsabu, subay kam magsiyum ta'nda' paglasabi. Kamemon saga jama'a Al-Masi ya magtipun-tipun maitu amabowa tambuku ni ka'am, in ka'am nientom kono' e' sigām.  <div eID="gen7270" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7264" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3599"/><div sID="gen7271" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen7272" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3599"/> Saga dauranakanku, aniya' junjungku ni ka'am. Halli'inbi saga a'a anagga' pandu' bay pamandu' ka'am pasal si Isa Al-Masi. Saga a'a ilu bilahi amapagsagga' ka'am bo' kam aboklang duwa, maka bilahi isab amowa ka'am pasiha' min pangandolbi ni si Isa. Tangkisinbi saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Romans 16:18
verses.text: Sabab bang a'a maghinang buwattē' ngga'i ka Panghū'tam Al-Masi ya paghinangan sigām, saguwā' baran sigām ya nirūlan. Binidjakan e' sigām saga a'a kulang panahu'anna, nilanahan bo' supaya tabowa niakkalan.

verses.name: Romans 16:19
verses.text: In ka'am ilu abantug na ma sabab kahogot pameya'bi ma Al-Masi, angkan aku kinōgan ma sababbi. Kabaya'anku ma ka'am subay alalom pamikilbi pasal ai-ai makahāp, ma halam aniya' la'at makani-pikilanbi.

verses.name: Romans 16:20
verses.text: Manjari Tuhan, ya po'onan kasannangan ataytam, pasa'ut du amaka'at nakura' saitan ni deyo' pād-tape'tam. <div eID="gen7272" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7273" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Panghū'tam si Isa.  <div eID="gen7273" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3600"/><div sID="gen7274" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3600"/> Si Timuti, ya sehe'ku maghinang ma Tuhan itu, amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapalna ni ka'am. Damikiyanna isab disi Lukiyus itu maka si Jason, maka kampungku si Sosepater.  <div eID="gen7274" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3601"/><div sID="gen7275" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3601"/> (Palamud si Tertiyu, ya bay kawakilan anulat sulat itu, yuk-i, “Amabeya' aku lapalku ni ka'am pagka kitam Almasihin sali'-sali'.”)  <div eID="gen7275" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3602"/><div sID="gen7276" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3602"/> Si Gayus, ya tag-luma' paokomanku itu, amabeya' isab minsan la'a hal lapalna ni ka'am. Ya du si Erastus, a'a ang'ntan alta' parinta ma da'ira itu, maka danakantam si Kuwartu.

verses.name: Romans 16:24
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan e' si Isa Al-Masi, ya Panghū'tam. Amin.  <div eID="gen7276" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7271" type="section"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3603"/><div sID="gen7277" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamudji si Paul ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3603"/> Pudjitam Tuhan. Taga-kawasa iya amahogot pangandolbi, pagga beya'bi lapal ahāp ya bay pagnasihatku pasal si Isa Al-Masi. In lapal ahāp itu halam bay kinata'uwan e' manusiya' sangay min masa awal e', saguwā' buwattina'an pinamahalayak na ni a'a kamemon ma sabab panoho'an Tuhan, ya taptap allum. Bay pinasulat e'na lapalna ma kanabi-nabihan, pamata'u ma bangsa a'a kamemon ma deyom dunya bo' supaya sigām magkahagad sampay ameya' ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7278" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3603"/><div sID="gen7277" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamudji si Paul ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3603"/> Pudjitam Tuhan. Taga-kawasa iya amahogot pangandolbi, pagga beya'bi lapal ahāp ya bay pagnasihatku pasal si Isa Al-Masi. In lapal ahāp itu halam bay kinata'uwan e' manusiya' sangay min masa awal e', saguwā' buwattina'an pinamahalayak na ni a'a kamemon ma sabab panoho'an Tuhan, ya taptap allum. Bay pinasulat e'na lapalna ma kanabi-nabihan, pamata'u ma bangsa a'a kamemon ma deyom dunya bo' supaya sigām magkahagad sampay ameya' ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7278" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Romans 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3604"/><div sID="gen7279" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3604"/> Pudjitam Tuhan, ya tunggal tubus ma pangita'u. Pudjitam iya sampay ni kasaumulan, pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya pamanyabutantam. Amin. <signed sID="gen7280"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7280"/>  <div eID="gen7279" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7277" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7011" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Rom.16"/> <div eID="gen7005" osisID="Rom" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, maka min si Sostenes dakayu' danakantam. Tapene' aku sabab min kahandak Tuhan, kawakilan aku e' si Isa Al-Masi magnasihat lapalna.  <div eID="gen7288" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3605"/><div sID="gen7289" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3605"/> Ka'am saga jama'a suku' Tuhan magtipun ma da'ira Kurintu ya pamasampayan kami sulat itu. Bay kam tapene' asal e' Tuhan bo' kam tahinang a'ana sussi, palsuku'anna ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi. Pinasampay isab sulat itu ni saga a'a kamemon ma sabarang lahat, sasuku amudji Panghū' Isa Al-Masi, ya Panghū' sigām maka Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7289" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3606"/><div sID="gen7290" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3606"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay min Mma'tam Tuhan maka min si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7290" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3607"/><div sID="gen7291" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magsukul si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7292" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3607"/> Magsukul aku ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu ma pasalanbi, ma sabab ase'na maka lasana, ya pamuwanna ma ka'am bay min si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:5
verses.text: Mamarahi heka kahāpanbi indaginis ma sabab Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi, luba'-lagi'na ma bissalabi maka ma pangita'ubi kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: Ahogot na pandu' pasal Al-Masi ma deyom pangatayanbi,

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: angkan tubus na kam ma kapandayan indaginis, hinabubi angalagaran waktu pamatuwa' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: Pinahogot e'na imanbi sampay ni llaw kahinapusan bo' supaya halam aniya' tamak ataybi bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum manusiya' e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:9
verses.text: Kapangandolan asal Tuhan, ya bay amene' ka'am bo' supaya kam makapagda'atay maka Anakna si Isa Al-Masi ya Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7292" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7291" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3608"/><div sID="gen7293" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Abahagi' saga Jama'a si Isa ma Kurintu</title> <div sID="gen7294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3608"/> Saga dauranakanku, kabuwanan aku kapatut e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam, angkan aku angamu' junjung itu ni ka'am kamemon: magsulut-siyuluti kam. Da'a kam magkaniya-kaniya. Subay kam dauyunan to'ongan ma maksudbi maka ma niyatbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:11
verses.text: Angkan tasambatku palkala' itu, saga dauranakanku, sabab aniya' min luma' si Kaluya bay angahaka'an aku aniya' palsagga'an ma ka'am dansehe'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:12
verses.text: Hatina mbal maguyun pamikilbi, sabab aniya' ilu magpina'in: “Aku itu ameya' ma si Paul.” Aniya' isab ah'lling: “Aku itu ameya' ma si Apollos.” Aniya' ah'lling: “Aku itu ameya' ma si Petros.” Maka aniya' gi' isab magpina'in, yuk-i,“Aku itu ameya' ma Al-Masi.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', bā'nu Al-Masi bay pinagsalik-salik! Sai bahā' bay amatay ma hāg ma sababbi? Aku bahā'? Bay bahā' kam pinandi tanda' in ka'am suku'ku?  <div eID="gen7294" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3609"/><div sID="gen7295" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3609"/> Magsukul to'ongan aku ni Tuhan sabab halam aniya' sai-sai bay pandiku, haliyu min si Krispus maka si Gayus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: Angkan halam aniya' makapah'lling in iya bay pinandi bo' beya' ma aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: Ā, yamboho' taentomku si Estepanos magtai'anak inān. Bay sigām tapandiku, sagō' halam aniya' taentomku saddī min sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: Sabab halam aku bay sinoho' e' Al-Masi magpandi. Sinō' sadja aku magpasaplag lapalna ahāp. Maka subay mbal paggunaku bissala alalom luwas bay min pangita'uku. Halam aniya' kawasa ma pagnasihatku liyu min kamatay Al-Masi ma hāg.  <div eID="gen7295" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7293" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3610"/><div sID="gen7296" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Al-Masi ya Pang'nda'an Kawasa maka Pangita'u Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3610"/> Ya lapal pasal kamatay Al-Masi ma hāg, niōnan lapal karupangan e' saga a'a ya anudju nalka'. Sagō' bang ma kitam ya anudju sulga', in lapal itu pamatuwa'an kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: Aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yukna, <lg sID="gen7298"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7299"/>“Paka'atku pangita'u saga a'a alalom pangita'una.<l eID="gen7299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7300"/>La'ananku akkal sigām, sasuku alanga pangadji'na.”<l eID="gen7300" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7298"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: Manjari ai kamattihan saga a'a alalom pangita'una, maka saga a'a alanga pangadji'na? Ai isab kamattihan saga a'a apanday magjawab ma dunya pinjaman itu? Ai dapat sigām? Sabab pinahati kitam e' Tuhan in akkal manusiya' itu halam aniya' kapūsanna.  <div eID="gen7297" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3611"/><div sID="gen7301" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3611"/> Alalom to'ongan asal panahu'an Tuhan angkan halam aniya' makata'uwan iya bang luwas sadja min ta'u manusiya'. Ya kagara'an Tuhan in manusiya' subay lappasan min mulka' bang pa'in pagsab'nnalanna lapal ya pagnasihat kami itu, minsan niōnan lapal karupangan e' saga a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: Saga bangsa Yahudi bilahi to'ongan ang'nda' saga hinang kawasahan bo' supaya sigām am'nnal, maka saga bangsa Girīk bilahi pinakalehan pangita'u alalom.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: Sagō' ya pagnasihat kami Al-Masi nilansang ni hāg pinapatay pamapuwas dusa manusiya'. Ala'at atay saga bangsa Yahudi ma lapal itu, maka binista karupangan e' saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a bay tapene' e' Tuhan tahinang suku'na, bangsa Yahudi maka bangsa saddī, magkahagad ma Al-Masi in iya kawasa maka pangita'u Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:25
verses.text: Sabab kagara'an Tuhan itu, minsan binista sali' karupangan e' saga a'a, alalom gi' pangita'una min pangita'u manusiya' kamemon. Maka minsan yuk saga a'a in Tuhan mbal makaga'os pagka si Isa Al-Masi bay pasagaranna amatay, aga'os du to'ongan iya labi min ga'osan manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7301" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3612"/><div sID="gen7302" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3612"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, entomunbi bay kahālanbi tagna' ma halam gi' kam tapene' e' Tuhan. Kulang pangadji'bi, kulang ga'osbi, maka kulang isab kabangsabi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:27
verses.text: Sagō' minsan na, tu'ud pinagtu'uran e' Tuhan subay pene'na sasuku binista e' manusiya' halam taga-pangita'u, bo' supaya magkaiya'an saga a'a taga-pangita'u. Pinene' e'na saga a'a ya binista e' manusiya' halam aniya' ga'osanna, bo' supaya magkaiya'an saga a'a ga'osan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:28
verses.text: Pinene' e' Tuhan saga a'a pinaggunyak-gunyak e' kasehe'an, saga a'a binista halam taga-pūs, supaya kinata'uwan ai-ai ahalga' ma bistahan manusiya', halam aniya' halga'na ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:29
verses.text: Manjari halam aniya' makapagmalangkahi bang paharap ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:30
verses.text: Ka'am ilu tabowa e' Tuhan parakayu' ni Al-Masi, maka Al-Masi ya tahinang po'onan pangita'u e' Tuhan. Min Al-Masi isab ya angkan kitam taitung abontol e' Tuhan, tahinang a'ana sussi. Jari apuwas na kitam min pang'ntanan dusa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:31
verses.text: Angkan taluwa' ya bay binissala ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Sai-sai bilahi magmalangkahi, subay pagmalangkahianna ya bay tahinang e' Panghū'.”  <div eID="gen7302" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.1"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: Tagna' kapi'iluku ni ka'am, saga dauranakan, waktu bay kapamandu'ku ma ka'am pasal lapal min Tuhan, halam bay gunaku saga bissala ahunit nihati atawa pangadji' alanga.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: Sat'ggol bay kamailuku ma ka'am, ya niyatku subay halam aniya' saddī min si Isa Al-Masi pagnasihatku ma ka'am, ya lagi'na kamatayna ma hāg.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: Angkanna, pagt'kkaku pa'in pi'ilu, bay sali' angalongkoy baranku, magk'bba-k'bba atayku, kalu mbal taluwa' pagnasihatku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: Sasangku anganasihat lapalku ma ka'am, halam bay beya'anku addat saga a'a apaul amissala, ya ataha' akkalna. Sagō' tinapilan llingku e' kawasa min Rū Sussi, ya angkan kam bay tabowa magkahagad.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: Ngga'i ka pangita'u manusiya' ya pasangdolan pangandolbi, sagō' kawasa Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7303" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7296" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3613"/><div sID="gen7304" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangita'u min Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7305" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3613"/> Malaingkan bang a'a asangpot pangandol sigām, alalom isab pamandu'ku ma sigām. Sagō' ngga'i ka pangita'u min babaw dunya itu ya pamandu'ku, ngga'i ka isab ta'u min saga a'a ya makapagbaya' ma dunya itu. Sabab tantu patobtob du kapagbaya' sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: Ya pamandu'ku itu pangita'u Tuhan, hatina kagara'anna ya bay nilimbungan min manusiya' kamemon. Ma halam gi' aniya' dunya bay pinapanjari ginanta' asal e'na bang buwattingga kitam pinaniya'an sahayana ma sinosōng.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:8
verses.text: Halam tahati pangita'u Tuhan itu e' saga a'a makapagbaya' maitu ma dunya. Bang bay tahati e' sigām, halam sigām bay magpanoho'an pinalansang ni hāg si Isa, ya Panghū' Balbangsahan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:9
verses.text: Sagō' a'awam sigām buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7306"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7307"/>“Halam gi' ta'nda' mata, halam gi' takale tainga,<l eID="gen7307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7308"/>halam gi' minsan tapikil e' manusiya',<l eID="gen7308" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7309"/>bang ai tinagama e' Tuhan ma sasuku alasahan iya.”<l eID="gen7309" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7306"/>  <div eID="gen7305" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3614"/><div sID="gen7310" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3614"/> Sagō' kitam ya bay pinata'u e' Tuhan, deyo' bay min Rū-na. <div eID="gen7310" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7311" type="paragraph"/> Sabab Rū Tuhan ya ata'u angaliling kamemon sampay ni niyat maka maksud ya ma deyom palkuli-kulihan Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:11
verses.text: Minsan kitam manusiya', luwal nyawata ya makata'u bang ai to'ongan ma deyom itikadta. Damikiyanna ma Tuhan, Rū-na ya makata'u bang ai ma deyom itikadna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:12
verses.text: Ya pamikil bay pinaniya'an kitam ngga'i ka hal pamikil manusiya' min dunya itu. Sagō' pinaniya'an kitam Rū Tuhan ya pinabeya' e' Tuhan supaya kitam makata'uwan kamemon pamuwan e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7311" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3615"/><div sID="gen7312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3615"/> Manjari bang kami magnasihat, ngga'i ka min pangadji' manusiya' ya pangā'an kami bissala, sagō' min bay pamandu' kami e' Rū Tuhan. Ati pandu' b'nnal min iya ya pamahati kami ni sasuku kaniya'an Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:14
verses.text: Bang a'a halam bay kaniya'an Rū itu, mbal tataima'na ya pamuwan e' Rū Tuhan. Mbal to'ongan tahatina, halam sali' aniya' kapūsanna bang ma bistahanna. A'a inān subay pinaniya'an Rū Tuhan dahū bo' yampa tahatina.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:15
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' kaniya'an Rū Tuhan, tasilangna kamemon bang ai katongoranna ahāp-ala'at, sagō' in iya baranna mbal tasalla' e' a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:16
verses.text: Sagō' kata'uwantam na, sabab sali' du pamikiltam maka pamikil Al-Masi, buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7313"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7314"/>“Halam aniya' makata'u bang ai ma deyom pikilan Panghū',<l eID="gen7314" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7315"/>halam aniya' makapituwahan iya!”<l eID="gen7315" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7313"/>  <div eID="gen7312" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.2"/> <div eID="gen7304" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3616"/><div sID="gen7316" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Sosoho'an Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7317" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3616"/> Saga dauranakanku, waktu kamailuku ma ka'am, mbal aku makabissala ni ka'am buwat a'a kaniya'an Rū Tuhan sabab mbal gi' ahogot pangandolbi ma Al-Masi. Masi kam abowa-bowa e' napsu baranbi, sali' hantang anak duru'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:2
verses.text: Ya pamandu' ma ka'am sapantun gatas ya pamainum onde' ariki', sabab mbal gi' makakakan pagkakan atuwas. Sampay isab ni kabuwattina'anan, mbal gi' kam makahati pandu' ahunit,

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:3
verses.text: sabab masi kam ameya'-meya' ma addat-tabi'at ya kabiyaksahan kaheka'an manusiya' ma dunya itu. Aniya' ma deyomanbi ilu saga a'a magihid maka maglugat. Minnē' kinata'uwan in ka'am masi ameya' ma kajarihan dunya itu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:4
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a ah'lling in iya ma si Paul, bo' ah'lling a'a dangan in iya ameya' ma si Apollos, halam du aniya' pagbidda'anbi maka a'a kasehe'an ma dunya itu, sabab masi kam maglugat.  <div eID="gen7317" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3617"/><div sID="gen7318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3617"/> Pikilunbi, sai bahā' si Apollos, maka sai aku itu? Sosoho'an Tuhan du kami sali'-sali', tapaglagi e'na supaya kam tabowa am'nnal ma si Isa Al-Masi. Ya sadja hinang kami ai-ai bay pamahinang kami pakaniya-pakaniya e' Panghū'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:6
verses.text: Sali' kami dalil a'a maghuma. Aku itu sali' dalil magtatanom binhi', maka si Apollos sali' a'a magbusug tinanom e'. Sagō' Tuhan ya amasulig kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:7
verses.text: Angkan ko', ya magtatanom maka magbubusug mbal patut paheyata. Tuhan sadja ya patut pinaheya, sabab iya ya amasulig saga tinanom.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:8
verses.text: In a'a magtanom maka a'a magbusug halam aniya' pagbidda'anna. Sali'-sali' du sigā tinungbasan e' Tuhan ma sinosōng, pinapagtongod maka bay hinang sigā dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:9
verses.text: Kami maka si Apollos dakahinangan du maghinang ni Tuhan, ati ka'am ilu sali' dalil huma Tuhan paghinangan kami. <div eID="gen7318" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7319" type="paragraph"/> Maka ka'am isab sapantun luma' nihinang e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:10
verses.text: Aku itu a'a kabuwanan kapandayan e' Tuhan amat'nna' papaganna, bo' aniya' a'a dakayu' angahinang baran luma' ma diyata' papagan bay hinangku he'. Malaingkan sai-sai maghinang luma' subay kamaya'-maya' bo' ahāp lullun kahinanganna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:11
verses.text: Bang niralil, si Isa Al-Masi ya dī papagan luma', ya asal pinat'nna' e' Tuhan. Halam aniya' pasangdolantam saddī min si Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:12
verses.text: Magginis pagdayaw ya pinagguna e' a'a maghinang luma'. Aniya' pagdayaw apagon, landu' ahalga' buwat saga bulawan, pilak atawa palmata intan. Aniya' isab pagdayaw aguya', buwat saga kayu maka parang maka sairap.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:13
verses.text: Ma sinosōng, bang ta'abut llaw pamabukis e' Al-Masi kahinangan a'a kamemon, ta'nda' du bang pagdayaw ai bay ginuna e' a'a maghinang dangan maka dangan, ahāp ka atawa ala'at. Ta'nda' isab kahinangan kamemon ma llaw he'-i, pagka pinalabay min api bo' ta'nda' bang buwattingga kapūsanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: Bang mbal atunu' ya bay nihinang e' a'a ma diyata' papagan inān, tinungbasan iya ni kahāpan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:15
verses.text: Sagō' bang atunu' ya bay nihinang e'na, alugi' iya. Bo' arapun in iya baranna lappasan du, sali' hantang a'a bay makal'ppa min deyom tunu'.  <div eID="gen7319" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3618"/><div sID="gen7320" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3618"/> Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi? In ka'am angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi pat'nna'an Tuhan na, maka ilu Rū Tuhan pat'nna' ma deyom pangatayanbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:17
verses.text: Angkan bang aniya' a'a amaka'at pat'nna'an Tuhan ilu, tantu du a'a inān magka'at e' Tuhan. Sabab mahasussi asal pat'nna'an Tuhan, maka ka'am ya pat'nna'anna.  <div eID="gen7320" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3619"/><div sID="gen7321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3619"/> Na, in pasal pangita'u itu, da'a kam angakkalan di-bi. Bang aniya' a'a ma deyomanbi amikilan di-na in pangita'una alalom, buwat pinikil e' saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan, ahāp lagi' bang a'a inān angakuhan karupangna bo' supaya pinaniya'an kata'u min Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:19
verses.text: Sabab ya niōnan pangita'u e' kaheka'an manusiya', halam aniya' gunana bang ma bistahan Tuhan, buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Tajallat e' Tuhan saga a'a bal-akkal, kapellengan sigām e' akkal sigām.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:20
verses.text: Maka ayat itu lagi', “Kasakupan asal e' Panghū' ai-ai pamikilan e' a'a alalom pangita'una, halam aniya' kapūsanna.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:21
verses.text: Angkan kam subay mbal magmalangkahi ma kahinangan manusiya'. Palsuku'anbi ai-ai ahāp kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:22
verses.text: Kami maka si Apollos maka si Petros, tahinang sosoho'anbi bo' kam kaniya'an kahāpan. Sampay dunya itu maka ai-ai paniya' ma buwattina'an atawa ma sinosōng, minsan isab kallum maka kamatay, ma ka'am isab bo' supaya kam kaniya'an kahāpan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:23
verses.text: Sagō' entomunbi, in ka'am ilu suku' Al-Masi, maka Al-Masi ya suku' Tuhan asal.  <div eID="gen7321" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.3"/> <div eID="gen7316" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3620"/><div sID="gen7322" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Kawakilan e' Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7323" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3620"/> In kami maka si Apollos subay itungbi sosoho'an Al-Masi. Bay pangandol ma kami e' Tuhan saga pandu' b'nnal ya halam bay pinata'u ma bangsa manusiya' dahū.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' pamahinang a'a e' nakura'na, patut bang a'a inān kapangandolan ma ai-ai bay pamahinang iya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: Mbal pamagayku bang ka'am atawa sara' manusiya' analla' aku. Mbal na aku analla' atawa angandapit di-ku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' kasā'an tananamku ma deyom pangatayanku, sagō' minsan buwattē', kalu aniya' kasā'an tu'ud halam bay tananamku. Panghū' Isa ya taga-kapatut analla' aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: Angkan kam subay da'a magdai'-dai' amat'nna' kasā'an ma kasehe'anbi ma halam gi' waktu pangahukum. Subay na pabīng Panghū' Isa bo' yampa aniya' hukuman. Pinatampal du e'na ai-ai bay tatau' ma deyom kalendoman. Pinaluwas e'na saga maksud maka niyat bay tinapukan e' manusiya' ma deyom panahu'an. Manjari sinanglitan saga manusiya' e' Tuhan, pinapagtongod maka bay kahinangan sigām.  <div eID="gen7323" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3621"/><div sID="gen7324" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3621"/> Saga dauranakanku, bay sambatku si Apollos maka aku baranku supaya aniya' kapamintānganbi, ati bo' ta'anadbi bang ai hatina bissala itu, ya yuk-i, “Da'a kam palabi min bay pamat'nna' e' Tuhan ma ka'am.” Mbal ahāp bang bantugbi a'a dakayu', bo' pareyo'bi isab a'a dakayu'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: Angay yukbi in ka'am alanga min kasehe'anbi? Tuhan ya bay amuwanan ka'am ai-ai kaniya'bi. Angay kam magbantug in ka'am taga-kaniya', bo' pa'in hal pamuwan ma ka'am?  <div eID="gen7324" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3622"/><div sID="gen7325" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3622"/> Ajukup kam bahā' ma pikilanbi? Dayahan bahā' kam? Tahinang kam sultan bahā', bo' pa'in kami itu halam? Ahāp du isab ma aku bang kam sab'nnal-b'nnal tahinang sultan bo' supaya kitam makapagnakura' sama-sama.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' bay pah'llingku ma ka'am, sabab bang ma bistahanku in kami saga a'a kawakilan pinareyo' to'ongan e' Tuhan, min deyo'an a'a kamemon. Sali' kami a'a sapantun nihukum subay pinapatay ma mairan. Tahinang kami pang'nda'-nda'an e' bangsa mala'ikat maka bangsa manusiya'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: In kami saga kawakilan itu kinabā' dupang ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'an kami, bo' ka'am ilu, ahāp kono' kōkbi pagka sōd kam ma si Isa. Angay bahā'? Kami itu binista alamma, bo' ka'am ilu abasag. Kami itu pinagudju', bo' ka'am ya pinagmahaltabatan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: Sampay ni kabuwattituhan magsandal kami ma lingantu maka ma patay bohe'. Ya pas'mmek kami basak s'mmek. Araran isab kami pinagla'ugan, maka halam aniya' pat'ttogan kami.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: Magsangsā' kami maghinang bo' aniya' napaka kami. Bang kami sinukna'an e' a'a, gom pa'in sigām amu'an kami lidjiki' ni Tuhan. Bang kami pininjala', hal imanan kami.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: Bang kami nihina' e' sai-sai, bissala sangkahāpan ya panambung kami ma sigām. Sampay ni kabuwattina'anan binista kami e' sigām sali' halam aniya' kagunahan ma babaw dunya itu, sali' s'ggit ma deyo' tape' sigām.  <div eID="gen7325" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3623"/><div sID="gen7326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3623"/> Sulat itu ngga'i ka pamaiya'-iya' sagō' pamandu'ku, sabab ka'am ilu sali' saga anakku ya kalasahanku to'ongan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:15
verses.text: Sabab minsan ibu-ibuhan a'a magpandu'an ka'am ma pasal Al-Masi, dakayu' du pag'mma'anbi. Luwal aku ya pag'mma'anbi sangay min waktu kasōdbi ma Al-Masi, sabab aku ya bay makatagna' amowahan ka'am lapal ahāp.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: Angkan ko', pagka aku mma'bi, ya na itu junjungku ni ka'am: panunurinbi addat-tabi'atku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:17
