verses.text: Ya ilu po'onna angkan pabeya'ku si Timuti itu ni ka'am, supaya kam ata'u anunud. Kalasahanku iya sali' anakku lissi, sabab aku ya bay amowa iya angandol ma Panghū' Isa. Kapangandolan du si Timuti, maka iya ya amaentoman ka'am bang buwattingga ya kal'ngngananku pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anku. Ya na ko' inān pamandu'ku ma saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi, sasuku magpalhimpunan ma sabarang lahat bay papehē'anku.  <div eID="gen7326" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3624"/><div sID="gen7327" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3624"/> Na, aniya' ma deyomanbi ilu saga a'a alanga atay sigām, sabab pangannal sigām in aku mbal du pi'ilu anibaw ka'am.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:19
verses.text: Sagō' pasa'ut du aku pi'ilu bang min kabaya'an Tuhan, ati nda'ku bang kawasa ai ya ma saga a'a ilu, kawasa b'nnal ka atawa hal min bowa' sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:20
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka pagsuli-suli a'a ya makapo'onan pagparinta Tuhan, sagō' kawasa Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:21
verses.text: Na, ai kabaya'anbi? Bilahi kam subay pah'llinganku bo' kam bininasa? Bang hati mbal, bang kam bilahi pinananaman lasaku, maka bang kam bilahi pinakalehan kahanunut bissalaku, pindahinbi hinangbi.  <div eID="gen7327" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.4"/> <div eID="gen7322" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3625"/><div sID="gen7328" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Angaliyu Lakad min Paghola'na</title> <div sID="gen7329" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3625"/> Takaleku suli-suli, aniya' kono' ma deyomanbi ilu a'a maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla. Minsan saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan, mbal makaharus maghinang buwattē'. Kahaka'an aku aniya' ma ka'am l'lla maghulid maka ina'na tape'!

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: Bo' ilu kam magmalangkahian di-bi. Arapun kam magkarukka'an ma sabab aniya' a'a ma pagtipunanbi magkasumbang. A'a inān subay pinaluwas min ka'am saga jama'a si Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:3
verses.text: Minsan aku halam mailu magbaran, mailu du aku ma deyom pamikil sabab mbal kam alungay min pangannalku. Taga-kapatut aku min Panghū' Isa amat'nna'an hukuman ma a'a maghinang kala'atan ilu, buwat e'ku mailu ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' magtipun min ōn Panghū' Isa, bistahunbi aku sali' mailu ma t'ngnga'bi, maka ilu isāb ma ka'am kapatut min Panghū'tam Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: Tukbalinbi a'a magdusa ilu ni pang'ntanan nakura' saitan bo' bininasa baranna, ati kalappasan nyawana bang ta'abut llaw kapangahukum Panghū'tam ma bangsa manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7329" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3626"/><div sID="gen7330" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3626"/> Mbal taluwa' bang kam maglanga-langa di-bi. Kata'uwanbi bissala, ya yuk-i, “Dangkuri' du pasulig ati pabuskag katibu'ukan addunan.” In pasulig itu pamaralil a'a angandusa. Minsan iya dakayu' du, palemed la'atna ni kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:7
verses.text: La'aninbi pasulig ndang bo' supaya kam sapantun addunan baha'u ya halam aniya' pasuligna. Kata'uwanku in ka'am asussi asal ma sabab Al-Masi bay amatay, sapantun bili-bili sinumbali' ma waktu kapaghinang Hinang Paglakad.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:8
verses.text: Angkan kitam subay maghinang ni Tuhan ma halam aniya' kala'atantam atawa kalumu'an. Subay tuyu'antam addat-tabi'at ahāp to'ongan, min atay sussi maka min kasab'nnalan.  <div eID="gen7330" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3627"/><div sID="gen7331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3627"/> Na, ma lapal sulat bay pabeya'anku ka'am tagna', bay kam soho'ku paokat min a'a magd'nda atawa magl'lla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: Ngga'i ka saga a'a ya mbal am'nnal ma si Isa ya sibahatku, buwat saga a'a maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla, magnapsu karalaman, magpanangkaw, magsumba ni ta'u-ta'u. Subay kam halam na maitu ma dunya bo' paokat katūyan min kamemon saga a'a dusahan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: Sagō' ya yukku he', da'a kam palamud ma a'a ya amūng-mūng in iya pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa, bo' pa'in masi magd'nda, atawa anganapsuhan alta' sehe'na, atawa anumba ni ta'u-ta'u, atawa angalimut, atawa maglalango atawa panangkaw. Da'a kam minsan pasalu ma saga a'a buwattē'.  <div eID="gen7331" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3628"/><div sID="gen7332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3628"/> Halam aniya' kapatutku analassay palkala' ma saga a'a ma luwasan palhimpunan jama'a Al-Masi. Tuhan sadja ya angahukum sigām. Sagō' kitam saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi wajib amat'nna' hukuman saga sehe'tam dapalhimpunan. Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Pala'anunbi a'a ala'at min deyomanbi.”  <div eID="gen7332" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.5"/> <div eID="gen7328" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3628"/><div sID="gen7332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3628"/> Halam aniya' kapatutku analassay palkala' ma saga a'a ma luwasan palhimpunan jama'a Al-Masi. Tuhan sadja ya angahukum sigām. Sagō' kitam saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi wajib amat'nna' hukuman saga sehe'tam dapalhimpunan. Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Pala'anunbi a'a ala'at min deyomanbi.”  <div eID="gen7332" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.5"/> <div eID="gen7328" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3629"/><div sID="gen7333" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Palkala' ma Deyoman saga Jama'a Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7334" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3629"/> Na, bang aniya' palsagga'anbi maka pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa, angay t'kkahanbi ni sara' luwasan, ni ngga'i ka bebeya'an si Isa? Arapun pasara'bi ma saga a'a suku' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: Arai' mbal kata'uwanbi in kitam saga suku' Tuhan angahukum bangsa manusiya' kamemon ma llaw damuli. Jari bang kitam angahukum saga a'a ma sinosōng ma palkala' aheya, luba'-lagi'na na kam makapangahukum saga palkala' ariki'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: Marai' mbal kata'uwanbi, in kitam angahukum isab bangsa mala'ikat ma waktu sinōng. Jari bang tahukumtam saga mala'ikat, luba'-lagi'na na saga palkala' ya kalabayanbi ma dunya itu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: Angkan bang aniya' palkala'bi, subay pasara'bi ma saga a'a areyo' kapaga'a sigām ma deyomanbi saga jama'a Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: Buwattitu pah'llingku supaya kam aiya'. Angay bahā', halam aniya' a'a ma deyomanbi minsan dakayu' taga-pangita'u angahukum ka'am bebeya'an Al-Masi bang aniya' palsagga'anbi?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:6
verses.text: Sagō' biyaksa kam an'kkahan palkala'bi ni sara' luwasan, ati mikisara' kam ma sigām ya mbal angandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen7334" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3630"/><div sID="gen7335" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3630"/> Sali' halam aniya' dapatbi sabab aniya' na pa'in palkala'bi ma deyomanbi. Bang kam saupama nila'at atawa kinulli'an e' pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa, ahāp lagi' imananbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: Sagō' ilu kam angulli' maka angala'at bo' pa'in danakanbi ya nila'at.  <div eID="gen7335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3631"/><div sID="gen7336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3631"/> Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi? Bang a'a ala'at kajarihanna mbal pinahampitan pusaka' ma pamarintahan Tuhan. Pahalli' kam bo' mbal niakkalan. Sasuku maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla, atawa pasumba ni ta'u-ta'u, atawa angaliyu-lakad min paghola'na, sasuku isab l'lla atawa d'nda maghinang kahina'an maka pagkahina l'lla-d'nda, tantu halam aniya' palsuku'an sigām ma okoman pagparinta Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: Damikiyanna saga a'a anangkaw, a'a anganapsuhan alta' sehe'na, a'a paglalango, a'a pangalimut, maka a'a pangalangpas.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: Ma waktu tagna' aniya' min ka'am bay buwattē', sagō' buwattina'an sinussi na kam min dusabi. Pinasuku' na kam ma Tuhan sadja maka taitung kam abontol ma sabab Panghū' Isa Al-Masi maka Rū Tuhantam.  <div eID="gen7336" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7333" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3632"/><div sID="gen7337" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hinang Kalumu'an D'nda maka L'lla</title> <div sID="gen7338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3632"/> Aniya' ah'lling yukna, “Makajari aku angahinang ai-ai kabaya'anku bang pa'in ngga'i ka langgal sara'.” B'nnal ko' inān, sagō' aniya' baya'bi mbal makahāp. Aniya' isab amina'in, yukna, “Makajari aku magdūl-baya' ma baranku.” B'nnal isab, sagō' mbal aku bilahi binanyaga' e' napsuku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: Yuk dakayu' isab, “Pagkakan itu bay pinaniya' bo' ni'isi ni b'ttong, maka b'ttongta itu bay pinaniya' pangisihan pagkakan.” B'nnal ko' inān, sagō' in pagkakan maka b'ttong pinatobtob sali'-sali' e' Tuhan. In ginhawa-barantam itu mbal patut pinagguna maghinang kahina'an d'nda maka l'lla. Ya angkan aniya' ginhawa-barantam sabab si Isa ya pagpanghū'antam, maka Panghū' Isa ya tag-kapatut ma ginhawa-barantam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: Bay iya pinakallum e' Tuhan pabīng min kamatayna, maka ya du kitam pinakallum ma sinosōng sabab min kosogna.  <div eID="gen7338" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3633"/><div sID="gen7339" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3633"/> Kata'uwanbi na in kitam angandol ma Al-Masi, saga barantam itu sali' dalil pagdayaw pamaranan Al-Masi. Angkanna, bang a'a binista sali' pagdayaw baran Al-Masi, mbal patut bang iya pahulid ni d'nda ala'at hinangna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du, sai-sai pahulid ni d'nda ala'at, magdakayu' iya maka baran d'nda he', buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “L'lla maka d'nda bay duwa baran tahinang dabaran na.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: Sagō' bang kitam parakayu' ni Panghū' Isa, magdakayu' atay kitam maka iya.  <div eID="gen7339" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3634"/><div sID="gen7340" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3634"/> Amay-amay. Da'a kam maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla. Dusa saddī minnē' mbal makainay baranta, sagō' bang kita pabihing ni ngga'i ka paghola'ta, makabuwan kita dusa ni baranta.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:19
verses.text: Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi? In ginhawa-baranbi sali' sapantun luma' pat'nna'an Rū Sussi ya pamuwan ka'am e' Tuhan bo' pat'nna' ma deyom baranbi. Tuhan ya tag-dapu baranbi, ngga'i ka ka'am.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:20
verses.text: Bay kam nil'kkat e'na bo' kam makapuwas min karusahanbi, maka ahalga' pangal'kkatna. Angkan subay gunabi ginhawa-baranbi pamaheyabi ōn Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7340" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.6"/> <div eID="gen7337" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3635"/><div sID="gen7341" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagh'nda maka Pagh'lla</title> <div sID="gen7342" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3635"/> Na, in pasal bay tilawbi aku ma lapal sulatbi, buwattitu panambungku. Bang ma aku, ahāp bang l'lla mbal magh'nda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: Sagō' aheka tabowa-bowa maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla, angkan kam d'nda maka l'lla subay pinahola'an kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: In a'a maglakibini subay magdūl-baya' d'nda maka l'lla, subay sigā mbal magkahukaw.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: Sabab in d'nda mbal makapagbaya' ma baranna, subay h'llana. Damikiyanna du in l'lla isab mbal makapagbaya' ma baranna, subay isab h'ndana.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: Ka'am maglakibini, da'a kahukawinbi batin. Makajari bang asal bay pagsulutanbi subay da'a magbihing daka pilambahangi bo' supaya aniya' waktu pangarapbi ni Tuhan. Sagō' da'a tangguhinbi pagbihing pabalik, bo' supaya kam mbal tabowa e' sasat saitan bang ganta' mbal kasandalan napsu baranbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: Patut isab kam magh'nda atawa magh'lla, sagō' ngga'i ka panoho'anku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: Ya kabaya'anku in ka'am subay buwat aku mbal magh'nda. Sagō' magsaddī ya pangangganta' Tuhan ma dangan maka ma dangan, mbal magsali'-sali' kamemon.  <div eID="gen7342" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3636"/><div sID="gen7343" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3636"/> Na, ka'am saga subul maka budjang, maka ka'am saga balu, ya na itu pah'llingku ma ka'am: ahāp bang kam mbal pinahola'an, buwat aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: Sagō' bang mbal tapaggatbi napsubi, magh'nda kam atawa magh'lla. Ahāp lagi' kam pinahola'an min atiksa' anandalan napsu baranbi.  <div eID="gen7343" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3637"/><div sID="gen7344" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3637"/> Ka'am maglaulakibini, ya na itu panoho'anku ma ka'am, panoho'an deyo' bay min Panghū' Isa Al-Masi, ngga'i ka min baranku. Yukna in d'nda mbal manjari patiman min h'llana.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' d'nda ganta' pabutas min h'llana, subay iya mbal maghola' pabalik, luwal bang pabīng ni bay h'llana tagna'. Ya du l'lla subay da'a animanan h'ndana.  <div eID="gen7344" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3638"/><div sID="gen7345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3638"/> Ya itu pah'llingku ma ka'am kasehe'an, lling min baranku sadja, ngga'i ka min Panghū' Isa. Saupamaku a'a maglakibini: bang l'lla iya bebeya'an si Isa, bo' h'ndana ngga'i ka, subay mbal tinimanan e'na h'ndana sat'ggol bilahi magdakayu' maka iya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang d'nda ya bebeya'an si Isa, bo' h'llana ngga'i ka. Subay mbal tinimanan e'na h'llana sat'ggol h'llana bilahi magdakayu' maka iya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: Bang ka angandol ma si Isa, bo' paghola'nu mbal, tahalal iya e' Tuhan ma sabab pangandolnu. Tahalal isab e' Tuhan saga anakbi, jari mbal kaōnan onde'-onde' halam tuhanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: Malaingkan bang aniya' bebeya'an si Isa taga-h'nda atawa h'lla mbal angandol ma si Isa, bo' bilahi tu'ud patiman min iya, makajari sadja. Halam aniya' dusabi, aluhaya kam magtiman bang buwattē'. Ya kabaya'an Tuhan subay kam pasulut sadja.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: Mbal isab kata'uwanbi bang ai kasōnganna, kalu tabowa paghola'bi angandol ma si Isa ma sabab kahāp kaul-pi'ilbi, ati lappasan na.  <div eID="gen7345" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7341" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3639"/><div sID="gen7346" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Akuhinbi Bay Pamat'nna' Ka'am e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7347" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3639"/> Ya itu pamituwaku ma saga jama'a si Isa kamemon ma lahat dakayu' maka dakayu': ai-ai pamat'nna' Panghū' ma ka'am pakaniya-pakaniya, akuhinbi. Ai-ai bay katanamanbi tagna' kam pinene' e' Tuhan, da'a kam angangut papinda ni saddī.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:18
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a asal magislam dahū gi' min kapangaho'na ma Tuhan, mbal subay la'ananna bainatna pagislam. Damikiyanna isab bang a'a halam bay taislam, bo' angaho' na ma pangabbit Tuhan, da'a ya subay magpa'islam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:19
verses.text: Sabab mbal aheya ma atay Tuhan magislam kitam atawa mbal. Ya sadja aheya ma atayna bang beya'tam saga panoho'anna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:20
verses.text: Da'a kam apinda min bay kahālanbi tagna' kapangaho'bi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:21
verses.text: Bang ka bay banyaga' waktu kapamene' Tuhan ma ka'a, imaninbi. Sagō' bang aniya' waktu kaluwasnu min pagbanyaga'an, na, paluwas ka.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:22
verses.text: Sabab bang banyaga' maka'aho' ameya' ma Panghū' Isa, alimaya iya ma bistahan Panghū'. Damikiyanna bang a'a ngga'i ka banyaga' maka'aho' ameya' ma Al-Masi, tabista iya banyaga' Panghū'na.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:23
verses.text: Ahalga' ya bay pangal'kkat ka'am min pang'ntanan dusa, angkan kam subay da'a pabanyaga' ni sai-sai, subay Tuhan sadja ya pabanyaga'anbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:24
verses.text: Saga dauranakanku, subay kam pat'ttog ma bay katanamanbi tagna' kam pinene' e' Tuhan. Pataptapunbi ataybi ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7347" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7346" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3640"/><div sID="gen7348" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Budjang, Subul maka saga Balu</title> <div sID="gen7349" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3640"/> Na, in bay tilawbi pasal a'a halam taga-paghola', halam aniya' panoho'anku deyo' bay min Panghū' Isa, sagō' paluwasku bang ai ma pamikilanku. Sagō' kapangandol aku ma sabab ka'ase' Panghū' ma aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:26
verses.text: Bang ma aku, ahāp lagi' mbal apinda min kabuwattilubi, sabab aheka kasusahan tum'kka ma patahunan ītu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:27
verses.text: Sasuku kam taga-h'nda, da'a timaninbi. Sasuku kam halam taga-h'nda, da'a kam atuyu' magh'nda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:28
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam ganta' magh'nda ngga'i ka dusa. Saga budjang isab bang magh'lla, mbal magdusa. Ya po'on kam gara'anku da'a magh'nda atawa magh'lla, sabab kabaya'anku ma ka'am subay mbal pinananaman kasusahan ya maumu kalabayan e' a'a maglaulakibini.  <div eID="gen7349" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3641"/><div sID="gen7350" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3641"/> Saga dauranakan, mbal kitam at'ggol maitu ma dunya. Puwas minnitu a'a taga-anak-h'nda subay mbal sakit abimbang ma sigām bo' supaya alimaya maghinang ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:30
verses.text: Bang a'a magdukka, subay ni'bbahan karukka'anna. Bang a'a magkalasigan, subay pasengod ni a'a halam aniya' kalasiganna. Bang a'a am'lli ai-ai subay mbal parulina bay b'llina he', sali' ngga'i ka dapuna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:31
verses.text: Maka bang a'a angangguna kapanyapan dunya itu, subay mbal paheyana ma atay, sabab in dunya itu maka kajarihanna palabay sadja.  <div eID="gen7350" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3642"/><div sID="gen7351" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3642"/> Kabaya'anku subay halam aniya' makabimbang ka'am. Bang l'lla halam taga-paghola', ya sadja tapikilna hinangna ma Panghū' Isa bang buwattingga e'na makasulut atay Panghū'na.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:33
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a taga-h'nda, abimbang iya e' kalluman anak-h'ndana. Ya tapikilna na pa'in bang buwattingga e'na makasulut atay h'ndana he'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:34
verses.text: Sali' abahagi' duwa pamikilna. Damikiyanna isab bang d'nda halam taga-h'lla, ya sadja tapikilna hinangna ma Panghū' Isa sabab kabaya'anna subay pinama-Tuhan ginhawa-baranna sampay pangatayanna. Sagō' bang d'nda taga-h'lla na, ya na pa'in tapikilna saga kahinanganna ma anak-h'llana, sabab kabaya'anna subay makasulut atay h'llana.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:35
verses.text: Amissala aku buwattitu sabab aheya baya'ku anabangan ka'am, ngga'i ka ma sabab aniya' baya'ku amahunitan ka'am. Ya kabaya'anku to'ongan subay tahinangbi ai-ai ya apatut nihinang, bo' supaya ahantap palantarabi bo' supaya magmalilla' maghinang ma Panghū' Isa ma halam aniya' duwa-ruwabi.  <div eID="gen7351" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3643"/><div sID="gen7352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3643"/> Na, in pasal pagtunang. Bang aniya' at'ggol kapagtunang sigā, bo' ala'un-la'un na d'nda, ati makapikil l'lla in hinangna ma tunangna he' kulang asaltun, bang kabaya'anna magpūn, patut sigā magkawin. Ngga'i ka dusa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:37
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a magniyat subay mbal magpūn maka tunangna, ati mbal abowa-bowa e' napsu baranna sabab tahatul e'na, taluwa' isab hinangna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:38
verses.text: Ya hatulanna, ahāp du bang a'a bilahi magkawin maka budjang ya tunangna, sagō' labi gi' ahāp bang iya mbal pakawin  <div eID="gen7352" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3644"/><div sID="gen7353" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3644"/> Na, balikanta lagi' pasal pagtiman. Bang d'nda taga-h'lla, mbal iya makaluhaya pakawin ni l'lla saddī sat'ggol allum bay h'llana tagna'. Sagō' bang amatay na h'llana, puwas na iya, aluhaya iya magh'lla pabīng ni l'lla kabaya'anna, bang pa'in pagkahina angandol ma Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:40
verses.text: Bang aku anganggara', labi ahāp palasahan d'nda inān bang iya mbal pinahola'an pabīng. Bang aku mbal asā' anguyun isab Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7353" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.7"/> <div eID="gen7348" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3645"/><div sID="gen7354" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kinakan Paglamas ni Ta'u-ta'u</title> <div sID="gen7355" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3645"/> Na in pasal susumbali'an bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u: taga-pangita'u asal kitam kamemon, sagō' aniya' pangita'u hal pagmalangkahian. Bang kam alasa ma pagkahibi tapahogot pangandol sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:2
verses.text: Bang a'a amikilan di-na in iya taga-kata'u, kulang asal ta'una.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:3
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a alasa ma Tuhan, takilā iya e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7355" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3646"/><div sID="gen7356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3646"/> Manjari itu, ya pasal kapamangan susumbali'an bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u: kata'uwanta asal in niōnan ta'u-ta'u itu ngga'i ka tuhan to'ongan. Maka kata'uwanta isab in Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' du.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:5
verses.text: (B'nnal, aheka pagtuhanan maka pagpanghū'an, ai na ka ma sulga' atawa ma dunya.) Sagō' minsan aniya' pinagbahasa ‘tuhan’,

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:6
verses.text: tunggal du Tuhan pagtuhanantam, ya na Mma'tam ma sulga'. In iya po'onan kamemon ai-ai, maka iya isab pagtuyu'antam t'ggoltam allum. Tunggal isab Panghū'tam, ya na si Isa Al-Masi. Bay pinapanjari e'na kamemon deyo' bay min Tuhan, maka allum na pa'in kitam labay min iya.  <div eID="gen7356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3647"/><div sID="gen7357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3647"/> Saguwā' aniya' saga sehe'ta bebeya'an si Isa halam gi' makata'u to'ongan ma pasal ta'u-ta'u halam aniya' kawasana, sabab masi amikit ni pikilan sigām bay kabiyaksahan sigām tagna', waktu kasumba sigām ni ta'u-ta'u. Angkan bang sigām amangan ai-ai bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u, pangannal sigām in sigām palamud anumba ta'u-ta'u inān. Manjari asasaw itikad sigām minsan halam taga-dusa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:8
verses.text: Sagō' ngga'i ka kinakanta ya amowa kita pasekot ni Tuhan. Mbal kinulangan kahāpta ma sabab aniya' mbal kakanta. Mbal isab kin'nnopan kahāpta ma sabab aniya' kakanta.  <div eID="gen7357" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3648"/><div sID="gen7358" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3648"/> Sagō' minsan kam wajib angahalal ma pagkakan indaginis, subay kannalbi pahāp pagkahibi, ya mbal gi' ahogot pangandolna ma si Isa, bo' supaya iya mbal tabowa magdusa ma sabab pagkakanbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:10
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' pagkahibi mbal katiyu'-tiyu'an itikadna maka'nda' kam amangan lalamasan ma deyom luma' panumbahan ta'u-ta'u. Asal kata'uwanbi in ta'u-ta'u mbal makainay, sagō' a'awam pagkahibi inān ati tabowa iya amangan susumbali'an bay pangalamas ni ta'u-ta'u.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:11
verses.text: Manjari pagkahibi inān, a'a bay pinuwas min dusana ma sabab kamatay Al-Masi, tabowa ni kala'atan ma sabab pangita'ubi, pagka alamma pangandolna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:12
verses.text: Jari makarusa kam ma danakanbi ya alamma pangandolna he', maka amakay dusa kam ni Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:13
verses.text: Angkan aku magniyat, bang pagkakan ya sababanna angkan magdusa dakayu' danakanku bebeya'an si Isa, mbal na aku amangan susumbali'an sat'ggolku allum, bo' supaya iya mbal tabowa magdusa.  <div eID="gen7358" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.8"/> <div eID="gen7354" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3649"/><div sID="gen7359" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapatut A'a Kawakilan</title> <div sID="gen7360" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3649"/> Limaya aku magbaya'an di-ku. Bay aku kawakilan e' Panghū' Isa, sinō' magnasihat lapalna. Bay iya ta'nda' mataku. Maka ka'am ya kamaujuran hinangku ma Panghū', pagka kam angandol na ma iya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:2
verses.text: Minsan aku mbal kinahagad e' saga kasehe'an in aku bay kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi, tantu du kahagadbi sabab ka'am baranbi ya tanda' saksi' in aku kawakilan e'na. Sabab aku ya po'onan angkan kam ameya' ma iya.  <div eID="gen7360" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3650"/><div sID="gen7361" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3650"/> Bang aku pinariksa' e' sai-sai ma pasal kahinanganku, buwattitu ya panambungku:

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:4
verses.text: halam bahā' aniya' kapatutku binalanja'an e' saga a'a pandu'anku?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:5
verses.text: Halam bahā' aniya' kapatutku magh'nda ma d'nda angandol ma si Isa, supaya aniya' sehe'ku ma l'ngngananku? Taga-h'nda saga danakan si Panghū' Isa l'lla maka saga a'a kawakilan kasehe'an buwat si Petros.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:6
verses.text: Atawa hal kami baha' maka si Barnabas ya subay magusaha supaya aniya' napaka kami?  <div eID="gen7361" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3651"/><div sID="gen7362" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3651"/> Bang saupama sundalu, aniya' bahā' mbal binalanja'an e' parinta? Atawa a'a maghuma, aniya' bahā' mbal amangan min buwa' kayu ya tanomna? Atawa a'a magipat sapi' atawa kambing, aniya' bahā' mbal patut angā' gatas min saga hayop ya ipatna he'?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:8
verses.text: Ngga'i ka isab hal kahālan manusiya' ya pangā'anta ta'u pasal kapatut ma saga a'a maghinang, anguyun isab Kitab Tawrat.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:9
verses.text: Tasulat asal ma panoho'an-sara' si Musa, yuk-i, “Da'a sampongunbi sapi' sabuna anganggi'ikan pai”. Pangannalbi bahā' sapi' sadja ya pinagka'inagonan e' Tuhan ma ayat Kitab e'?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:10
verses.text: Tu'ud manusiya' ya pinagka'inagonan e'na angkan pinasulat sara' inān. Paralilanta a'a magararu maka a'a magani. Ya angkan sigām maghinang ma deyom huma sabab aniya' holat sigām kabuwanan palsuku'an min buwa'na. Kami itu sali' dalil a'a maghuma inān.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:11
verses.text: Bay kami anganasihatan ka'am lapal Tuhan, sali' dalil binhi' ma deyom pikilanbi. Angkan kam subay mbal takuddat bang kami binuwanan bahagi' min kaniya'bi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:12
verses.text: Bang gurubi kasehe' taga-kapatut binalanja'an e'bi, luba'-lagi'na kami itu. <div eID="gen7362" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7363" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' halam kami bay mikibalanja' ma ka'am minsan aniya' kapatut kami. Gom pa'in kami anandalan kasigpitan bo' supaya halam aniya' maka'agpangan lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi asal, minsan saga a'a maghinang ma deyom langgal pagkulbanan, langgal ya pangā'an sigām kinakan. Maka saga imam ya anukbalan susumbali'an pagkulban, binahagi'an du sigām isi hayop pagkulban.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab saga a'a magnasihat lapal ahāp, aniya' panoho'an Panghū' Isa subay sigām binalanja'an e' sasuku magkahagad ma lapal inān.  <div eID="gen7363" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3652"/><div sID="gen7364" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3652"/> Sagō' halam bay gunaku kapatutku. Maka ngga'i ka balanja' ya mohotku angkan anulat ni ka'am. Padpad aku mikibalanja' ma ka'am, bilahi gi' aku amatay, sabab ya pagbantugku in aku halam bay angamu' binalanja'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:16
verses.text: Mbal aku makajari magbantug pasal pagnasihatku lapal ahāp, sabab hinangku asal bay panoho'an aku e' si Isa Al-Masi. Aheya kasusahanku bang mbal pagnasihatku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:17
verses.text: Bang aku bay makapene'an di-ku maghinang buwattitu, patut du aku ginadjihan. Sagō' ngga'i ka min baya'ku hal, tu'ud hinang bay pangandol e' Tuhan ma aku angkan wajib hinangku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:18
verses.text: Manjari ai panambahan aku? Katambahan aku bang pa'in tapagnasihatku lapal ahāp ma halam aniya' bayadna, minsan aniya' kapatutku binalanja'an.  <div eID="gen7364" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3653"/><div sID="gen7365" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3653"/> Luhaya aku magbaya'an di-ku, ngga'i ka aku banyaga'. Sagō' minsan buwattē', magpabanyaga' aku di-ku maghinang ni a'a kamemon supaya aheka tabowaku angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:20
verses.text: Angkanna, bang aku palamud ma saga bangsa Yahudi, beya'ku addat sigām Yahudi bo' supaya sigām tabowaku angandol ma si Isa. Minsan aku apuwas min sara' si Musa ya niusul na pa'in e' bangsa Yahudi, beya'ku sadja sat'ggolku ma deyoman sigām, bo' sigām tabowa angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:21
verses.text: Bo' arapun bang aku magbeya' maka saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, mbal beya'ku sara' agama Yahudi. Beya'ku addat saga bangsa liyu bo' supaya sigām isab tabowaku angandol ma si Isa. Sagō' minsan mbal beya'ku sara' agama Yahudi, masi du aku ameya' ma sara' Tuhan sabab beya'ku du panoho'an Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:22
verses.text: Bang aku ganta' magbeya' maka saga a'a ya halam gi' ahogot pangandol sigām tudju ni si Isa, amasali' aku di-ku ni sigām bo' supaya tabowaku angandol to'ongan. Manjari minsan ai bangsa, pasali' aku ni sigām supaya aniya' min sigām lappasan min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:23
verses.text: Angkan buwattē' hinangku, supaya pasaplag lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi ni saga a'a kamemon, bo' aku isab palamud ni kahāpan ya tumabeya' ma lapal ahāp.  <div eID="gen7365" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3654"/><div sID="gen7366" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3654"/> Biyaksa kam ma hatulan paglomba, aheka a'a pasōd maglomba sagō' dangan du anganda'ug bo' anambut kahāpan ya panungbas ma a'a anganda'ug. Paralilan ko' itu ma ka'am ya bebeya'an Al-Masi, angkan kam soho'ku maglomba to'ongan bo' kam makasambut kahāpan ma sinosōng.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:25
verses.text: Tali'-tali'unbi isab ya addat saga a'a bilahi maglomba. Magmahil sigām maka amaggat napsu sigām supaya makara'ug sampay minahaldika' maka korona dahun kayu, ya al'kkas alanos. Sagō' kitam bebeya'an si Isa angangut pinaniya'an kamahaldika'an ya anatas ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:26
verses.text: Angkan sengoranku a'a maglomba, ya mbal paragan m'ssa'-bidda' sabab aniya' tudjuna tantu. Sengoranku isab a'a magsuntuk, ya mbal anuntuk pehē'-pi'itu sabab aniya' tigi'na.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:27
verses.text: Paggatku napsuku sabab mbal aku bilahi sinulak e' Tuhan minsan bay makapagnasihat lapalna ma a'a kasehe'an.  <div eID="gen7366" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.9"/> <div eID="gen7359" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3655"/><div sID="gen7367" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Banda'an Pasal saga Ta'u-ta'u</title> <div sID="gen7368" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3655"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, ta'uhunbi pasal bay kalabayan saga pangkattam Yahudi waktu kapameya' sigām ma si Musa ma masa awal e'. Bay kalandungan gabun sigām kamemon, maka bay amaklay kamemon labay min tahik.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:2
verses.text: Ya dalilna, tapandi sigām ma deyom gabun maka ma deyom tahik, tanda' in sigām beya' ma si Musa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:3
verses.text: Kamemon sigām bay magkakanan kinakan ya pamuwan e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:4
verses.text: Kamemon sigām bay maginuman bohe' ya pamuwan e' Tuhan, sabab magbeya' sigām anginum bohe' paluwas min batu lakit ya bay sehe' sigām, ya dalilna Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:5
verses.text: Sagō' halam kasulutan atay Tuhan ma kaheka'an sigām e', angkan aheka alaglag ma lahat paslangan.  <div eID="gen7368" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3656"/><div sID="gen7369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3656"/> Na, subay kitam amintāng min pakaradja'an ya bay tum'kka ni kamatto'ahantam inān, supaya kitam mbal an'ppu sigām anganapsuhan la'at,

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:7
verses.text: atawa anumba ni ta'u-ta'u buwat sigām kasehe' ma masa he'. Tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab pasal bay kahinangan sigām, yuk-i, “Saga a'a inān bay magtingkō'an magjamu pagduwa'ahan ta'u-ta'u ya pagtuhanan sigām. Puwas e', magt'nggehan sigām magpangigal maka maghinang kasabulan.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:8
verses.text: Wajib kitam da'a maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla, buwat bay tahinang e' kasehe'an sigām. Angkan aniya' sigām labi duwampū' maka t'llungibu puhu' alaglag ma deyom dang'llaw du.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:9
verses.text: Da'a na kitam angandusa pangandusta'tam kahandak Panghū'. Aniya' isab min ka'mbo'-mbo'antam bay makahinang buwattē' ma masa awal, ati aheka sigām bay amatay e' sowa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:10
verses.text: Da'a isab pagmusmurinbi Tuhan ma sabab ai-ai pamat'nna'na ma ka'am, buwat bay kapagmusmud sigām kasehe' ma masa awal e', angkan sigām bay pinapatay e' mala'ikat pagmumulka'.  <div eID="gen7369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3657"/><div sID="gen7370" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3657"/> Na, tum'kka saga pakaradja'an inān ni sigām bo' aniya' pamintāngan saga a'a ma patahunan katapusan itu. Tasulat isab ma Kitab supaya kitam mbal angahinang buwattē'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:12
verses.text: Angkan ko', bang aniya' a'a ma deyomanbi ilu amikilan di-na in imanna ahogot, a'a inān subay kamaya'-maya' to'ongan bo' mbal tabowa maghinang dusa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:13
verses.text: Kamemon sasat-manasat ya kalabayanbi mbal magbidda' maka sasat ya maumu kalabayan e' bangsa manusiya'. Maka kapangandolan Tuhan, angkan kam mbal pasagaranna sinasat labi min kosogbi. Sabab bang kam pinat'kkahan sasat sumiyan-sumiyan, tantu kam binuwanan e'na kosog ma waktu kasasat bo' kam makasandal, ati minnē' aniya' kapuwasanbi.  <div eID="gen7370" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3658"/><div sID="gen7371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3658"/> Angkan ko', saga bagay kalasahanku, da'a kam palamud anumba ni ta'u-ta'u.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:15
verses.text: Ahāp asal kōkbi, angkan yukku ma ka'am, dongdonginbi bissalaku itu bang b'nnal atawa mbal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:16
verses.text: Bang kitam magtipun angentom kamatay Panghū' Isa, anginum kitam min deyom sawan ya pagsukulantam ni Tuhan. Tanda' saksi' ko' inān in kitam magdakayu' maka Al-Masi ma sabab laha'na. Damikiyanna isab tinapay ya pagbahagi'antam, tanda' ko' inān in kitam taga-lamud ma baran Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:17
verses.text: Sabab dakayu' du tinapay ya pagbahagi'antam kamemon, angkan kitam sali' dalil ginhawa-baran dakayu' du, minsan aheka.  <div eID="gen7371" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3659"/><div sID="gen7372" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3659"/> Kira-kirahunbi addat bangsa Isra'il e': sasuku sigām amangan min bay panukbal ni Tuhan aniya' lamud sigām ma pagta'at ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:19
verses.text: Na, mbal yukku aniya' pūs ma ai-ai pangalamas ni ta'u-ta'u, atawa aniya' kallum ma ta'u-ta'u ya pangalamasan e'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:20
verses.text: Tantu mbal, sagō' in susumbali'an pangalamas ta'u-ta'u, tinukbalan asal ni saga saitan, ngga'i ka ni Tuhan. Maka kabaya'anku subay halam aniya' lamudbi ma binangsa saitan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:21
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' magtipun amangan maka anginum pangentomanbi Panghū' Isa, mbal kam makajari palamud amangan maka anginum min bay pangalamas saga saitan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:22
verses.text: Luwal bahā' bang kita bilahi anunggud Panghū'. Palabi bahā' ga'osanta min ga'osanna?  <div eID="gen7372" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3660"/><div sID="gen7373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3660"/> Aniya' saga a'a ah'lling, yuk sigām, “Makajari kita angahinang ai-ai kabaya'anta.” B'nnal ko' inān, sagō' aniya' mbal makahāp. Makajari kita angahinang ai-ai, sagō' aniya' hinang mbal makasōng pangandolta ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:24
verses.text: Mbal ahāp bang baranta sadja ya kinannal, sagō' subay pagka'inagonanta pagkahita.  <div eID="gen7373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3661"/><div sID="gen7374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3661"/> Makajari kam amangan sumbali'an ai-ai pinagdagangan ma tabu' minsan halam tilawbi bang bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u. Halam aniya' dusabi amangan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:26
verses.text: sabab tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Tuhan ya tag-dapu dunya itu maka kakaya'-kaya'anna.”  <div eID="gen7374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3662"/><div sID="gen7375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3662"/> Bang saupama aniya' a'a mbal magkahagad ma si Isa amowa kam amangan ma luma'na, bo' kam bilahi pehē', makajari kam amangan ai-ai pangalabot ka'am minsan mbal tilawbi bang bay paglamas atawa halam. Halam aniya' dusabi bang kam amangan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:28
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' ganta' angahaka'an ka'am in kinakan inān bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u, na, da'a kakanunbi. Kaissana, ma sabab sehe'bi ya bay angahaka'an ka'am, karuwana, ma sabab kasasaw pikilanna bang kam ta'nda' e'na amangan lalamasan. Ngga'i ka itikadbi ya asasaw, sagō' itikadna. Kalu aniya' atilaw bang angay iya pinaggat amangan ai-ai kabaya'anku ma saukat aniya' a'a dangan asasaw pikilanna?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:29
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' ganta' angahaka'an ka'am in kinakan inān bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u, na, da'a kakanunbi. Kaissana, ma sabab sehe'bi ya bay angahaka'an ka'am, karuwana, ma sabab kasasaw pikilanna bang kam ta'nda' e'na amangan lalamasan. Ngga'i ka itikadbi ya asasaw, sagō' itikadna. Kalu aniya' atilaw bang angay iya pinaggat amangan ai-ai kabaya'anku ma saukat aniya' a'a dangan asasaw pikilanna?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:30
verses.text: Angay iya sinoway ma ai-ai pagkakanna, bang bay pagsukulanna ni Tuhan?  <div eID="gen7375" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3663"/><div sID="gen7376" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3663"/> Buwattitu panambungku: ai-ai kakanbi atawa inumbi, ai-ai hinang, subay nihinang pagmahaldika'bi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:32
verses.text: Da'a pasasawunbi pikilan pagkahibi minsan sai-na, bangsa Yahudi ka atawa bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi, atawa pagkahibi jama'a Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:33
verses.text: Beya'inbi aku itu sabab tuyu'anku anulut saga a'a kamemon ma ai-ai hinangku. Ngga'i ka kahāpan baranku ya kannalku, sagō' kahāpan saga a'a kasehe'an, bang pa'in sigām lappasan bo' makasōd ni sulga'.  <div eID="gen7376" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.10"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:1
verses.text: Manjari sengorinbi aku buwat e'ku anengoran Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7377" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7367" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3664"/><div sID="gen7378" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagturung Bu'un Bang Angarap ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7379" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3664"/> Sanglitanta kam ma sabab pangentombi ma aku sakahaba' waktu, maka ma sabab pameya'bi ma pamandu' ya bay pang'bbaku ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen7379" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3665"/><div sID="gen7380" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3665"/> Na aniya' gi' pamandu'ku. Ta'uhunbi itu: si Isa Al-Masi ya pagmakōkan kal'llahan, ati l'lla ya pagmakōkan kah'nda'an sigām, maka Tuhan ya pagmakōkan Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:4
verses.text: Bang kam magtipun dajama'ahan magsambahayang, bo' aniya' l'lla angamu'-ngamu' atawa amaluwas lapal min Tuhan, bang iya ganta' aturung, pahina'na Al-Masi ya pagmakōkanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:5
verses.text: Sagō' bang d'nda ya angamu'-ngamu' atawa amaluwas lapal min Tuhan ma deyom katipunanbi ma halam magtinurung, pahina'na h'llana ya pagmakōkanna. Mbal magbidda' d'nda inān maka d'nda bay binagongan kōkna, bang takdil isab ni kaiya'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:6
verses.text: Bang d'nda mbal tu'ud anurungan kōkna ma deyom katipunanbi, subay iya magpagunting apu'ut. Sagō', pagka makaiya'-iya' bang d'nda binagongan atawa pinapu'ut bu'unna, subay iya magtinurung.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:7
verses.text: Mbal patut bang l'lla magtinurung sabab l'lla ya pinapanjari pamandogahan kajarihan maka kamahaldika'an Tuhan. Sagō' d'nda ya pamandogahan kamahaldika'an l'lla

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:8
verses.text: sabab l'lla ya bay pinapanjari dahū e' Tuhan. Ngga'i ka l'lla ya pinapanjari min baran d'nda, sagō' d'nda ya pinapanjari min baran l'lla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:9
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka l'lla ya pinapanjari pamalimbang ma d'nda, sagō' d'nda ya pinapanjari pamalimbang l'lla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:10
verses.text: Angkan subay magtinurung d'nda, tanda' saksi' ma saga mala'ikat in iya kapagbaya'an e' h'llana.  <div eID="gen7380" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3666"/><div sID="gen7381" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3666"/> Malaingkan in kitam ma deyom okoman Panghū' Isa subay magtabang-tiyabangi d'nda maka l'lla. Mbal manjari bang hal l'lla atawa hal d'nda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:12
verses.text: Bay pinapanjari d'nda luwas min baran l'lla, saguwā' d'nda ya anganakan l'lla. Maka min Tuhan asal ai-ai kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:13
verses.text: Na, angandongdong kam di-bi: patut bahā' bang d'nda anabbut ni Tuhan ma deyom katipunanbi ma mbal magtinurung?

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:14
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi, sangay min katagna' makaiya'-iya' asal bang l'lla ataha' bu'unna,

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: sagō' bang d'nda ataha' bu'unna, ya he' makamanis iya. Kaniya'an iya bu'un ataha' paturung kōkna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: Na, bang aniya' mailu bilahi anganjawab pasal ina'an-i, ya itu panambungku ma iya: halam aniya' kal'ngnganan saddī ma kami maka ma saga jama'a Tuhan maingga-maingga lahat.  <div eID="gen7381" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7378" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3667"/><div sID="gen7382" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangentoman ma Kamatay Panghū' Isa</title> <title subType="x-preverse" type="parallel">(<reference osisRef="Matt.26.26-Matt.26.27">Matiyu 26:26-27</reference>, <reference osisRef="Mark.14.22-Mark.14.25">Mark 14:22-25</reference>, <reference osisRef="Luke.22.14-Luke.22.20">Lukas 22:14-20</reference>)</title> <div sID="gen7383" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3667"/> Aniya' gi' panoho'anku ma ka'am, sagō' mbal kam sanglitanku. Sababna, bang kam magtipun angarap ni Tuhan, ngga'i ka kahāpan ya kaluwasanna sagō' kala'atan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: Muna-muna itu: makakale aku hunub-hunub in ka'am kono' mbal magdauyunan bang magtipun. B'nnalna hunub-hunub inān, bang ma aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: Patut isab bang aniya' pagbidda'an ma ka'am, supaya atampal bang sai min ka'am ya makasulut atay Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: Ma waktu kapagtipunbi amangan pangentoman kamatay Panghū' Isa, sali' ngga'i ka Panghū' Isa ya taentombi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: Sabab aniya' kam pasa'ut amangan kinakan bay bowabi ati mbal kapinanbi sehe'bi. Jari aniya' kam lingantu, maka aniya' maglangohan sabab makalandu' he'na anginum.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: Angay bahā'! Halam aniya' luma'bi pamangananbi dahū? Atawa kabaya'anbi tu'ud subay amariki'-diki' saga pagkahibi jama'a Tuhan, maka amahina' saga sehe'bi kamiskinan? Daka ai pamissalaku ma ka'am ma pasal hinangbi buwattilu! Bilahi kam bahā' sanglitanku? Tantu mbal.  <div eID="gen7383" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3668"/><div sID="gen7384" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3668"/> Bay pamandu'ku ma ka'am ya bay pang'bba aku e' Panghū'. Ma sangom kapanukbal Panghū' Isa ni saga bantana, bay iya angā' tinapay.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: Aubus pa'in pagsukulanna ni Tuhan, pinagpōng e'na. Yukna ni saga mulidna, “Baranku ko' itu, ya pamalilla'ku ni kamatay ma sababbi. Amangan kam tinapay itu pangentomanbi aku.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab inuman. Aubus pa'in e' sigām amangan, ningā' sawan e' si Isa. Yukna, “Inuman itu paltanda'an ma kapagsulutan baha'u ya panganjanji' Tuhan ma ka'am, tatuman e' laha'ku. Isbatunbi, pangentomanbi aku sakahaba' kam anginum.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: Hatulanna, sakahaba' kam amangan tinapay itu sampay anginum min sawan itu, tapasaplag e'bi kamatay si Isa sampay ta'abut waktu kabalikna pi'itu.  <div eID="gen7384" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3669"/><div sID="gen7385" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3669"/> Angkan ko', sai-sai amangan tinapay maka anginum min sawan Panghū' itu ma halam abontol pangatayanna, a'a inān katōngan dusa sabab halam pagaddatanna baran Panghū' Isa sampay laha'na.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: Subay kam angaliling di-bi dahū bo' yampa kam amangan tinapay maka anginum min sawan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai amangan atawa anginum ma halam tasilangna baran Panghū' Isa bang ai hatina, amat'kkahan iya di-na hukuman Tuhan pagka buwattē' pamanganna maka panginumna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:30
verses.text: Ya he' po'onna angkan aheka ma deyomanbi ilu magkalammahan, maka aniya' isab amatay.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: Bang kita ganta' angaliling di-ta dahū, mbal kita taluwa' hukuman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: Bang kita nihukum maka bininasa e' Panghū' Isa, hatina bini'at kitam bo' supaya mbal pinat'kkahan hukuman nalka' sambeya' maka saga a'a ya mbal angisbat Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7385" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3670"/><div sID="gen7386" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3670"/> Manjari itu, saga dauranakanku, bang kam magtipun amangan pangentoman kamatay Panghū' Isa, lagad-lagarinbi saga kasehe'anbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:34
verses.text: Bang aniya' kam lingantu, subay iya amangan dahū ma luma'na, bo' kam mbal t'kkahan hukuman Tuhan ma waktu kapagtipunbi. Na, in pasal saga palkala' kasehe', subay na aku mailu bo' yampa salassayku.  <div eID="gen7386" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.11"/> <div eID="gen7382" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3671"/><div sID="gen7387" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Kapandayan Pamuwan e' Rū Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7388" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3671"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, bilahi aku amahatian ka'am pasal kapandayan pamuwan e' Rū Tuhan supaya kam mbal a'awam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: Taentombi bay kahalanbi tagna', waktubi halam gi' beya' ma si Isa, tabowa-bowa sadja kam e' saga hibilis bo' maghinang ni saga pagtuhanan ya mbal makabissala.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am, bang a'a kapagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan mbal iya makapah'lling pangkal ma si Isa. Halam aniya' makapasab'nnal in si Isa pagpanghū'anna bang ngga'i ka min Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7388" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3672"/><div sID="gen7389" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3672"/> Na, ginisan asal kapandayan ya min Rū Tuhan, bo' pa'in dakayu' du Rū ya amuwan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: Magginis isab saga hinang pananabang, sagō' tunggal du Panghū' Isa ya paghinangan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: Magginis bowahan hinangta dangan maka dangan, sagō' dakayu' du Tuhan ya amuwan ta'u bo' supaya tahinangta ai-ai bay pamahinang kitam kamemon.  <div eID="gen7389" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3673"/><div sID="gen7390" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3673"/> Kitam saga bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi kamemon, pinagtopod-toporan paltanda'an in Rū Tuhan pat'nna' asal ma deyom ataytam, bo' supaya kitam kaniya'an kahāpan sama-sama.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: Aniya' a'a kabuwanan kapandayan e' Rū Sussi amahati pandu' alalom, aniya' isab kabuwanan kapandayan amaluwas pangita'u.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: Tunggal du Rū Tuhan ya amuwan saga kapandayan itu, halam aniya' saddī. Aniya' kabuwanan pangandol akosog to'ongan, maka aniya' kabuwanan kapandayan amauli' saga saki.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: Aniya' a'a kabuwanan barakat bo' tahinangna saga hinang barakatan, aniya' isab kabuwanan kapandayan e' Rū Tuhan amaluwas lapal Tuhan, maka aniya' a'a kasehe' kabuwanan pangita'u anilang kapandayan a'a bang b'nnal min Rū Tuhan. Aniya' a'a kabuwanan kapandayan makabissala saga bissala saddī ya mbal tahatina, maka aniya' isab kabuwanan pangita'u magpahati bang ai binissala inān.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: Sagō' tunggal du Rū Tuhan ya magkabaya'an amuwan saga kapandayan itu, maka pinagsaddī-saddī isab pamuwanna ma manusiya' dangan maka dangan.  <div eID="gen7390" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7387" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3674"/><div sID="gen7391" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamaralilan Pasal Baran A'a</title> <div sID="gen7392" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3674"/> Kitam saga bebeya'an Al-Masi sali' dalil dakayu' ginhawa-baran du, bo' aheka pagdayawna indaginis. Sagō' minsan aheka pagdayawna, dakayu' du baran atibu'uk.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: Sabab kitam itu, bangsa Yahudi maka ngga'i ka Yahudi, banyaga' maka ngga'i ka banyaga', bay pinandi e' Rū Tuhan dakayu'-kayu', pinapagdakayu' sali' dalil baran atibu'uk. Pinahōpan kitam Rū Tuhan sali'-sali'.  <div eID="gen7392" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3675"/><div sID="gen7393" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3675"/> Na, bang niralil ginhawa baran itu, ngga'i ka daginis kamemon pagdayawna. Magginis asal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: Bang saupama ah'lling tape' pasal kahālanna, yukna, “Aku itu ngga'i ka suku' ma baran itu, sabab ngga'i ka aku tangan.” Sagō' suku' baran asal, minsan asā' pangannalna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: Ya du isab bang tainga ya ah'lling, yukna, “Ngga'i ka aku suku' baran itu sabab ngga'i ka aku mata,” tantu iya suku' ma baran.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: Bang bay mata lungbus katibu'ukan baran a'a, buwattingga pakakalena? Bang bay tainga lungbus, buwattingga pangahamutna?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: Sagō' ya b'nnalna, pinapanjari e' Tuhan ginisan pagdayaw baranta kamemon, nihatul e'na ma buwat kabaya'anna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: Mbal kaōnan baran bang mata lungbus atawa tainga lungbus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: Bang pina'amu, aheka ginisan pagdayaw bo' pa'in baran dakayu' du.  <div eID="gen7393" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3676"/><div sID="gen7394" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3676"/> Mbal manjari bang mata ah'lling ni tangan, yukna, “Halam aniya' kagunahanku ma ka'a.” Damikiyanna bang kōk ah'lling ni tape', yukna, “Halam du aniya' kagunahanku ma ka'am.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:22
verses.text: Sabab ya b'nnalna, saga pagdayaw ya pangannalta aguya', aheya asal kagunahanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:23
verses.text: Saga pagdayaw baranta ya yukta ariki' kagunahanna, ya na he' subay ayaranta pahāp. Saga pagdayaw ya mbal ahāp ninda', subay pas'mmekanta pahāp.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:24
verses.text: Maka saga pagdayawta ahāp luwana, minsan mbal pinahāp. Bay pinapagsugpat pagdayaw baran itu e' Tuhan ati pinalabi e'na kahāpan ma saga pagdayaw ya mbal pinagaddatan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:25
verses.text: supaya halam aniya' palsagga'an ma deyom ginhawa-baranta itu. Gom pa'in magtabang-tiyabangi saga pagdayawna kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:26
verses.text: Bang kap'ddi'an pagdayaw baranta dakayu', magtūy pananam ni saga pagdayaw kamemon. Damikiyanna isab bang aniya' pagdayawta dakayu' sinanglitan, kinōgan baranta kamemon.  <div eID="gen7394" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3677"/><div sID="gen7395" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3677"/> Ya na itu hatian bay pamaralilku he': ka'am saga jama'a Al-Masi sali' dalil ginhawa-baranna, maka ka'am dangan maka dangan sali' pagdayawna indaginis.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:28
verses.text: Jari Tuhan ya amat'nna' kamemon pagdayaw ma deyoman kajama'ahan si Isa Al-Masi. Kaissa, aniya' saga a'a kawakilan e'na magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi, karuwana, aniya' a'a kabuwanan kapandayan amaluwas lapal Tuhan ni manusiya', kat'lluna, aniya' saga a'a kabuwanan kapandayan magpandu'. Puwas e' aniya' kabuwanan kapandayan angahinang saga hinang kawasahan, bo' pasunu' a'a kabuwanan barakat pamauli'na saga saki, maka aniya' kabuwanan kapandayan anabang ma saga sehe'na. Aniya' kabuwanan kapandayan amal'ngngan hinang a'a kasehe'an, maka aniya' isab kabuwanan kapandayan amissala ma bahasa mbal tahati sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:29
verses.text: Mbal kawakilan saga bebeya'an Al-Masi kamemon, mbal sinō' magnasihat kamemon. Mbal kabuwanan kapandayan saga a'a kamemon maghinang hinang kawasahan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:30
verses.text: atawa magpauli' saki, atawa magbissala ma bahasa mbal tahati sigām, atawa amahati bang ai binissala inān.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:31
verses.text: Tuyu'inbi kapandayan ya kagunahan to'ongan. <div eID="gen7395" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7396" type="paragraph"/> Saguwā' aniya' gi' palabi to'ongan min kapandayan itu kamemon, hatina lasata ma kasehe'anta.  <div eID="gen7396" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.12"/> <div eID="gen7391" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3678"/><div sID="gen7397" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Lasa</title> <div sID="gen7398" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3678"/> Bang aku saupama taga-kapandayan amissala bahasa manusiya' kamemon sampay bahasa mala'ikat, halam du aniya' pūsna bang aku mbal alasa. Kapandayanku he' sali' lling agung hal angulenseng, atawa mital hal tinitik pehē'-pi'itu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: Minsan aku taga-kapandayan amaluwas lapal deyo' bay min Tuhan, maka minsan tahatiku ai-ai bay tatau' e' Tuhan, minsan isab aku bal-iman bo' makapahigin būd min baina, bang halam aniya' lasaku ma pagkahiku halam du aniya' kapūsanku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: Minsan pamuwanku alta'ku kamemon ma miskin, maka minsan paglilla'ku baranku tinunu' ma sabab si Isa, bang halam aniya' lasaku ma pagkahiku halam du aniya' pahala'ku.  <div eID="gen7398" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3679"/><div sID="gen7399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3679"/> Bang kita ganta' alasa ma pagkahita, tantu sigām imananta. Ma'ase' sadja kita. Mbal kitam angihid, mbal alanga pagatayta, mbal kita magmalangkahi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: Bang kita alasa ma kasehe'anta a'addat du kita ma sigām. Mbal kita angannal ma baranta sadja, mbal kita ab'nsi, mbal isab anau' kala'atan ma deyom atayta.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: Bang kita alasa mbal kita ka'amuhan ma a'a maghinang ala'at, sagō' ka'amuhan kita ma kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: Bang kita alasa mbal kita sinumu angahampanan sehe'ta. Taptap du kita angandol, maka aholat, maka angimanan ai-ai.  <div eID="gen7399" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3680"/><div sID="gen7400" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3680"/> Lasa itu anatas ni kasaumulan, sagō' palabay sadja saga kapandayan, minsan kapandayan amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, atawa kapandayan amissala saga bahasa mbal tahati. Ya du isab bang kita kabuwanan pangita'u alalom, palabay du isab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: Sabab minsan buwattingga pangita'uta, minsan buwattingga kapandayanta amaluwas lapal min Tuhan, taga-kulang du.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: Sagō' bang tatuman na saga maksud Tuhan, palabay du saga kapandayan taga-kulang inān.  <div eID="gen7400" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3681"/><div sID="gen7401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3681"/> Aku itu, ma waktu kaonde'-onde'ku, palkuli-kulihan onde' asal llingku maka pamikilku maka akkalku. Sagō' buwattina'an, pagka aku asangpot na, ka'bbahanku kapagonde'-onde'ku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: Ya ta'uta buwattina'an sali' dalil a'a ang'nda' ni deyom samin gabul. Sagō' ma llaw sinōng inān magalop du kita maka iya. Kulang lagi' ta'uku pasal Tuhan buwattina'an, sagō' ajukup du kata'uku ma iya ma sinosōng, dasali' maka kata'u Tuhan ma aku.  <div eID="gen7401" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3682"/><div sID="gen7402" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3682"/> Manjari t'llu du anatas ni kasaumulan: pangandolta maka pangaholatanta maka lasata. Sagō' ma deyom t'llu itu lasa ya katobtoban ahāp.  <div eID="gen7402" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.13"/> <div eID="gen7397" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3683"/><div sID="gen7403" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Kapandayan Pamuwan e' Rū Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7404" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3683"/> Pagmatayinbi lasa, tuyu'inbi isab saga kapandayan min Rū Tuhan, luba'-lagi'na kapandayan magpaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:2
verses.text: Bang a'a kabuwanan kapandayan amissala saga bahasa mbal tahati e' kaheka'an, Tuhan du ya pamissalahanna, ngga'i ka pagkahina manusiya', sabab halam aniya' manusiya' makahati iya. Pinabissala iya e' Rū Tuhan sagō' kalimbungan hatina pagga halam aniya' makahatian iya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:3
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, pamissalahanna saga pagkahina manusiya', angkan sigām kaniya'an tatabangan maka kakosogan iman, maka kahantap pangatayan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:4
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' amissala ma saga bahasa mbal tahati, luwal baranna ya tatabangna, sagō' bang a'a amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan tatabangna saga jama'a si Isa dapalhimpunan.  <div eID="gen7404" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3684"/><div sID="gen7405" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3684"/> Ka'amuhan aku bang ka'am kamemon ilu makabissala ma saga bahasa mbal tahati e' kaheka'an, sagō' labi gi' ahāp bang kam kabuwanan kapandayan pamaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan. Sabab bang a'a ata'u amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, aheya lagi' kagunahanna min a'a amissala bahasa saddī. Taga-kagunahan isab saga bahasa mbal tahati bang pa'in aniya' amahati supaya tatabang saga jama'a kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:6
verses.text: Saga dauranakanku, bang aku ganta' pi'ilu ni ka'am, bo' aku amissalahan ka'am ma bahasa saddī ya mbal tahatibi, ai kagunahanna? Halam aniya'. Ya sadja makahāp ka'am bang kam bowahanku lapal bay pamata'u aku e' Tuhan, atawa pangita'u, atawa pituwa bay min Tuhan, atawa bang kam pandu'anku.  <div eID="gen7405" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3685"/><div sID="gen7406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3685"/> Dalilunbi soleng atawa biyula bang pinah'lling. Mbal kahangpatan batbatanna bang mbal ahapal llingna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:8
verses.text: Ya du isab bang a'a amah'lling tiyup-tiyup pamasakap saga sundalu, bang mbal ahapal llingna halam aniya' sundalu magsakap.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:9
verses.text: Damikiyanna ma ka'am, bang mbal ahangpat bissalabi mbal tata'u bang ai hatulanna. Ai-ai pamissalabi tabowa paleyang e' baliyu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:10
verses.text: Magginis bahasa ma kaluha'an dunya itu, ati taga-ma'ana kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:11
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' a'a ganta' ah'lling ni aku bo' mbal tahatiku bahasana, in aku maka a'a inān sali' bangsa magsaddī mbal maghati.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:12
verses.text: Na pagka kam atuyu' binuwanan kapandayan e' Rū Tuhan, angutunbi kapandayan aheya kagunahanna, pamahogot pangandol saga jama'a dapalhimpunan kamemon.  <div eID="gen7406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3686"/><div sID="gen7407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3686"/> Angkan ko', bang a'a makapamissala ma saga bahasa saddī ya mbal tahati e' kaheka'an, subay iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan bo' pinaniya'an kapandayan magpahati ai-ai bay bissalana.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:14
verses.text: Sabab bang aku angamu' duwa'a ma bahasa mbal tahatiku, angamu' aku min deyom atayku sagō' mbal talamud akkal-pikilanku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:15
verses.text: Jari, ai subay hinangku? Angamu' duwa'a aku min deyom pangatayanku, maka min akkal-pikilanku. Angalang aku pamudji Tuhan, min deyom pangatayanku maka min akkal-pikilanku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:16
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' magsukul ni Tuhan min deyom pangatayanbi sadja, bo' mbal kahangpatan e' saga jama'a kasehe'an ma pagtipunanbi, buwattingga e' sigām makapangaho' ma pagsukulbi ilu?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:17
verses.text: Minsan ahāp bowahan pagsukulbi mbal makahāp pangandol kasehe'anbi sabab mbal tahati.  <div eID="gen7407" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3687"/><div sID="gen7408" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3687"/> Magsukul aku ni Tuhan, in aku kabuwanan kapandayan amissala saga bahasa mbal tahati e' a'a kasehe'an, labi aheka min ka'am kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:19
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku ma palhimpunan saga jama'a si Isa bilahi gi' aku amah'lling saga lima kabtang sadja, bang pa'in tahati e' kasehe'an. Da'a laksa'an kabtang ma bahasa mbal tahati.  <div eID="gen7408" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3688"/><div sID="gen7409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3688"/> Saga dauranakanku, pasangpotunbi pikilanbi. Pasali' kam ni onde'-onde' bang takdil ni kala'atan, sagō' da'a sengorinbi onde'-onde' ma akkal-pikilanbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:21
verses.text: Tasulat ma deyom Kitab ya bay pamissala Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il, yuk-i. <lg sID="gen7410"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7411"/>“Ka'am saga a'aku itu, yuk Tuhan,<l eID="gen7411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7412"/>aniya' soho'ku bangsa liyu amissala ni ka'am,<l eID="gen7412" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7413"/>a'a amissala saga bahasa saddī.<l eID="gen7413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7414"/>Minsan sigām amalatun lapalku ni ka'am,<l eID="gen7414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7415"/>mbal aku kalebi.”<l eID="gen7415" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7410"/>  <div eID="gen7409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3689"/><div sID="gen7416" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3689"/> Jari kata'uwanta na pasal kapandayan amissala bahasa saddī. Paltanda'an ko' itu ma saga a'a ya mbal magkahagad, ngga'i ka ma a'a ya magkahagad na. Ya kapandayan amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, paltanda'an ko' inān ma saga a'a magkahagad, ngga'i ka ma a'a ya mbal gi' magkahagad.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:23
verses.text: Angkanna, bang kam magtipun, bo' aniya' pasōd a'a mbal ata'u atawa mbal am'nnal, bo' takale kam magbissala lullun ma saga bahasa mbal tahati, tantu sigām ah'lling in ka'am binelaw.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:24
verses.text: Malaingkan bang aniya' pasōd ni palhimpunanbi hinabu kam amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, tantu iya kamattanan e'bi kamemon ma sabab dusana maka katōngan dusa isab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:25
verses.text: Paluwas saga pikilanna bay limbunganna ati tabowa iya pasujud amanyabut ni Tuhan. Magpasab'nnal iya, yukna, “Magsab'nnal aku, ilu Tuhan ma deyomanbi.”  <div eID="gen7416" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7403" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3690"/><div sID="gen7417" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Paghinang ni Tuhan Subay Auntul</title> <div sID="gen7418" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3690"/> Na ai lagi', saga dauranakanku? Buwattitu pamituwaku: bang kam magtipun dapalhimpunan, ahāp bang kam taga-kalangan pamudji ma Tuhan, atawa pamandu' ma kasehe'an, atawa lapal bay pamata'u e' Tuhan, atawa bissala ma bahasa saddī. Ahāp isab bang aniya' a'a taga-kapandayan magpahati bissala inān. Ai-ai hinangbi subay patut pamahogot pangandolbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:27
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a bilahi amissala ma bahasa mbal tahati e' kaheka'an, sarang bang duwangan atawa t'llungan mags'lle'-s'lle' amissala. Subay aniya' magpahati isab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:28
verses.text: Bang halam aniya', in a'a taga-kapandayan ma bahasa inān subay mbal ah'lling ma palhimpunan, luwal ni baranna maka ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7418" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3691"/><div sID="gen7419" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3691"/> Damikiyanna bang aniya' amaluwas lapal deyo' bay min Tuhan, sarang isab bang duwangan atawa t'llungan ya mags'lle'-s'lle'. Subay nirongdongan isab lapal sigām e' a'a kasehe'an ma palhimpunan inān bang b'nnal bay min Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:30
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' a'a pinaniya'an lapal min Tuhan sabuna akale-kale, subay pahondong a'a ya amissala tagna'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:31
verses.text: Bang buwattē' makapags'lle'-s'lle' kam kamemon amaluwas lapal min Tuhan, bo' supaya kapandu'an kamemon sampay pinahantap atay sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:32
verses.text: Saga a'a taga-barakat amaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan, subay ata'u amaggat baya' sigām amissala,

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:33
verses.text: sabab kabaya'an Tuhan subay auntul maka ahantap kapagtipunbi. Mbal iya bilahi ma kasasawan. <div eID="gen7419" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7420" type="paragraph"/> Bang bineya' kabiyaksahan saga palhimpunan Al-Masi kamemon,

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:34
verses.text: saga d'nda subay pahantap sabu sigām ma palhimpunan. Mbal sigām pinalamud magsambung himumūngan sabab bang ma dakayu' sara' Yahudi, “kar'ndahan subay magmaluluy sadja.”

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:35
verses.text: Bang aniya' panilaw sigām subay h'lla sigām ya patilawan pagt'kka ni luma', sabab makaiya'-iya' bang d'nda anuli-nuli ma deyom palhimpunanbi.  <div eID="gen7420" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3692"/><div sID="gen7421" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3692"/> Pangannalbi bahā' in ka'am po'onan lapal Tuhan? Hal ka'am ya pinakalehan lapalna?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:37
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a mailu amikilan di-na in iya taga-barakat amaluwas lapal min Tuhan, atawa aniya' saddī bay pamatulun iya e' Rū Tuhan, subay akuhanna sulat itu bay min panoho'an Panghū'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:38
verses.text: Sagō' bang a'a ilu mbal akale ma bay yukku he', da'a iya ikutunbi.  <div eID="gen7421" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3693"/><div sID="gen7422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3693"/> Angkan ko', saga dauranakan, subay tuyu'inbi kapandayan magpaluwas lapal bay min Tuhan. Da'a isab lāngunbi pamissala ma saga bahasa ya mbal tahati e' kaheka'an.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:40
verses.text: Ai-ai hinangbi ma waktu kapagtipunbi subay ahatul maka auntul.  <div eID="gen7422" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.14"/> <div eID="gen7417" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3694"/><div sID="gen7423" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kallum Al-Masi Pabalik</title> <div sID="gen7424" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3694"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, bilahi aku amaentoman ka'am pabīng pasal lapal ahāp bay pagnasihatku ma ka'am. Bay na tataima'bi lapal inān pasangdolan imanbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:2
verses.text: Sabab lapal itu ya sababanna angkan kam lappasan min hukuman dusa, bang pa'in kam pat'ttog ma pandu' bay pamata'uku ka'am. Bang kam ganta' mbal pat'ttog, kaliman bay kapam'nnalbi.  <div eID="gen7424" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3695"/><div sID="gen7425" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3695"/> Bay pasampayku ni ka'am lapal pandu' bay pamata'u aku, pandu' labi ahalga' min kamemon bay pagnasihatku ni ka'am. Hatina Al-Masi bay amatay pamapuwas dusatam, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:4
verses.text: Amatay pa'in, bay iya kinubul, maka ta'abut pa'in kat'llumbahangina ma deyom kubul, pinakallum iya pabīng buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:5
verses.text: Allum pa'in iya, patuwa' iya ni si Petros, bo' patuwa' isab iya ni saga a'a kasangpū' maka duwa bay kawakilanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:6
verses.text: Puwas e' patuwa' iya ni saga a'a bay pamulid ma iya, aniya' sigām labi lima hatus bay magtimuk. Kaheka'an sigām masi allum sampay ni kabuwattina'anan sagō' aniya' kasehe'an wa'i na amatay.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:7
verses.text: Puwas e' isab patuwa' iya ni si Yakub, bo' patuwa' pabalik ni saga a'a bay kawakilanna kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:8
verses.text: Katapusanna, patuwa' iya ni aku, bo' pa'in aku itu sapantun onde'-onde' nianakan ma ngga'i ka gi' bulananna.  <div eID="gen7425" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3696"/><div sID="gen7426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3696"/> Aku itu areyo' min a'a kawakilan kamemon. Arapun aku da'a niōnan wakil si Isa, ma sabab kapaminjala'ku ma saga bebeya'anna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:10
verses.text: Sagō' aheya lasa maka ase' Tuhan ma aku, ya angkan buwattitu na kahālanku. Aniya' isab kamaujuran lasana maka ase'na ma aku, sabab ai-ai pamahinangna aku subay sangsā'anku to'ongan labi gi' min saga pagkahiku ya kawakilan si Isa. Sagō' ngga'i ka min kosogku ya angkan aku makahinang buwattē', sagō' min tabang Tuhan ma aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:11
verses.text: Malaingkan dakayu' du lapal ya pinasaplag e' kami kamemon, ai na ka aku atawa saga a'a kawakilan kasehe'an. Ya ko' ina'an lapal ya pagkahagadbi na.  <div eID="gen7426" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7423" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3697"/><div sID="gen7427" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kitam Pinakallum Pabīng</title> <div sID="gen7428" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3697"/> Na, pagka Al-Masi ya pagnasihat kami, in iya bay pinakallum e' Tuhan min kamatayna, angay ka'am kasehe' ilu ah'lling in a'a magpatayan mbal pinakallum pabīng?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:13
verses.text: Bang b'nnal ya yukbi, hatina Al-Masi halam du bay pinakallum min kamatayna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:14
verses.text: Maka bang b'nnal ya yukbi in Al-Masi halam bay pinakallum pabīng, halam aniya' kapūsan bay pagnasihat kami ma ka'am, maka pagkahagadbi halam aniya' kagunahanna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:15
verses.text: Ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Bang b'nnal ya yukbi in saga a'a magpatayan mbal pinakallum pabalik e' Tuhan, hatina in Al-Masi halam bay pinakallum pabalik. Maka putingan isab kami itu pasal Tuhan, pagka yuk kami in iya bay makapakallum Al-Masi, bo' pa'in halam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:16
verses.text: Ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Bang b'nnal ya yukbi in saga a'a magpatayan mbal pinakallum pabalik e' Tuhan, hatina in Al-Masi halam bay pinakallum pabalik. Maka putingan isab kami itu pasal Tuhan, pagka yuk kami in iya bay makapakallum Al-Masi, bo' pa'in halam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:17
verses.text: Maka bang Al-Masi halam bay pinakallum pabīng, hatina pangandolbi ma iya halam du aniya' kapūsanna, maka dusabi masi angakkot ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:18
verses.text: Saga bebeya'an si Isa isab ya magpatayan inān, wa'i amutawan min Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:19
verses.text: Maka halam aniya' kahāpan lagaranta ma liyu ahirat bang b'nnal halam aniya' kaholatantam min Al-Masi puwas min dunya ītu. Jari kapagandu'-andu'an kitam labi min a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen7428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:20
