verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3698"/><div sID="gen7429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3698"/> Sagō' ya b'nnalna, tantu Al-Masi tapakallum min kamatayna. Pinakallum iya dahū min kamemon, pamatuman in a'a magpatayan pasunu' pinakallum.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:21
verses.text: Magkamatay binangsa manusiya' kamemon sabab dusa ya bay tahinang e' dangan a'a, damikiyanna isab tapakallum manusiya' kamemon ma sabab tahinang e' a'a dangan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:22
verses.text: Magkamatay manusiya' kamemon sabab dambeya'an maka si Adam, sagō' pinakallum kitam kamemon pagka dambeya'an maka Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:23
verses.text: Pinakallum kitam dangan maka dangan ma untulanna. Dahū Al-Masi, bo' kitam palsuku'anna ma waktu kapi'ituna pabalik.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:24
verses.text: Puwas e', ta'abut ganta'an dunya ati tara'ug e' Al-Masi kamemon bay palbantahan Tuhan, ai na ka saga nakura', ai na ka saga kawasa, ai na ka saga gaga'osan. Manjari ni'nde'an e' Al-Masi kapagparintana ni Mma'na Tuhan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:25
verses.text: Sabab maksud Tuhan asal in Al-Masi subay ang'ntan pagparinta sampay ta'abut waktu kara'ugna saga palbantahanna kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:26
verses.text: Bang aubus nira'ug saga palbantahan kamemon, tara'ug na banta katapusan, ya na kamatay ma manusiya'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:27
verses.text: Sabab tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Pinat'nna' e' Tuhan ai-ai kamemon ma deyo' pād-tape'na.” Tantu mbal beya' Tuhan ma ‘ai-ai kamemon’ ya pinagsambat itu. Atampal ko' itu sabab Tuhan ya amat'nna' ai-ai kamemon ma pagbaya'an Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:28
verses.text: Bang itu atammat na, pareyo' isab Anak ni iya, ya bay amat'nna' ai-ai kamemon ma deyo'anna. Jari Tuhan ya makapagtuhan ma kamemon.  <div eID="gen7429" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3699"/><div sID="gen7430" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3699"/> Na, bang saupama b'nnal ya yuk kasehe'an, in a'a magpatayan mbal pinakallum pabalik, buwattingga saga a'a ya pinandi ganti' saga pagkahi sigām bay amatay? Angay sigām ameya' ma addat buwattē', bang hati mbal pinakallum saga pagkahi sigām?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:30
verses.text: Maka kami itu, angay kami magmalilla' palabay min ka'aniban sararan-daran, bang kami mbal pinakallum du ma llaw damuli?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:31
verses.text: Haka'anta kam, saga dauranakan, in aku itu sa'agon-agon amatay kahaba' llaw. Malaingkan ka'am ya kakōganku ma sabab kapameya'bi ma si Isa Al-Masi ya Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7430" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3700"/><div sID="gen7431" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3700"/> Bang hal palkuli-kulihan dunya itu ya holatanku, angay aku angatu ma saga bantaku ma Epesos itu, ya sapantun halimaw angal'kkob? Bang aku b'nnal mbal pinakallum pabalik ma llaw damuli, ahāp lagi' aku maghāp palasahan ma dunya itu, buwat yuk bissala he', <lg sID="gen7432"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7433"/>“Magkakan kita maka maginum,<l eID="gen7433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7434"/>sabab amatay du kita ma salung-simuddai.”<l eID="gen7434" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7432"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:33
verses.text: Da'a pasā'unbi pamikilbi. Bang kita dansehe'an maka a'a ala'at addatna, tantu kita tabowa maghinang kala'atan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:34
verses.text: Jari pahantapun pamikilbi! Pahali kam magdusa, sabab aniya' min ka'am ilu masi gi' a'awam pasal Tuhan, angkan kam subay aiya'.  <div eID="gen7431" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7427" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3701"/><div sID="gen7435" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Baran Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen7436" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3701"/> Kalu aniya' atilaw, yukna, “Buwattingga pamakallum a'a amatay? Buwattingga baranna bang iya allum pabīng?”

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:36
verses.text: Sali' halam aniya' akkalbi atilaw buwattē'. Pandogahinbi binhi' tinanom. Bang tanombi ni tana', subay angahansul dahū bo' yampa pauplut ugbusna.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:37
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' ananom binhi' pai atawa binhi' saddī, ngga'i ka katibu'ukan tinanom ya tanombi ni tana', luwal binhi'na.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:38
verses.text: Manjari binhi' inān pinajukupan e' Tuhan ma buwat kahandakna. Saga binhi' indaginis, magsaddī-saddī pangluwahanna kaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:39
verses.text: Sampay ai-ai binangsa taga-napas ma dunya itu, maggintil isab isina kaniya-kaniya. Saddī isi manusiya', saddī isi hayop, saddī isab isi kamanuk-manukan maka isi daing.  <div eID="gen7436" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3702"/><div sID="gen7437" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3702"/> Aniya' baran magindaginis ma sulga', aniya' baran magindaginis ma dunya itu. Saddī manis kabaranan ma sulga', saddī isab manis kabaranan ma dunya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:41
verses.text: Ahāp sawa mata llaw, ahāp sawa bulan, maka ahāp isab sawa bitu'un, sagō' magsaddī-saddī ya kahāp sawa sigām. Minsan saga bitu'un, magsaddī-saddī du isab kahāp luwana.  <div eID="gen7437" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3703"/><div sID="gen7438" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3703"/> Na, buwattē' ya dalil manusiya' magpatayan bang pinakallum pabīng min kamatay. Ya baran kinubul ma deyom tana' angahansul du, saguwā' bang pinakallum na mbal magkamatay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:43
verses.text: Pagkubul ma baranta, ala'at ninda' maka halam aniya' kosogna. Sagō' bang pinakallum na pabīng, aheya manisna maka akosog to'ongan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:44
verses.text: Ya baran manusiya' kinubul itu papanjarihan asal bay min dunya itu, sagō' bang talbangun na min kamatay, baran baha'u na, papanjarihan sulga' na! Bang aniya' baran papanjarihan min dunya itu, aniya' du isab baran papanjarihan ma sulga',

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:45
verses.text: buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Si Adam tagna' bay kabuwanan kallum e' Tuhan.” Sagō' aniya' gi' Adam damuli, hatina Al-Masi ya po'onan kallum pamakallum ma manusiya'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:46
verses.text: Subay dahū baranta papanjarihan min dunya, bo' yampa baran papanjarihan ma sulga'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:47
verses.text: Si Adam tagna' inān bay kinompol min tana', sagō' si Adam damuli itu min sulga' asal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:48
verses.text: Saga a'a suku' ma dunya itu dasali' asal maka si Adam ya bay kinompol min tana'. Sagō' a'a suku' ma sulga' pasali' ni a'a dakayu' ya min sulga', hatina si Isa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:49
verses.text: Ya luwa baranta ma buwattitu an'ppu baran si Adam ya bay kinompol min tana', sagō' bang kita mahē' ma sulga' an'ppu kita baran si Isa, a'a min sulga'.  <div eID="gen7438" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3704"/><div sID="gen7439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3704"/> Haka'anta kam, saga dauranakanku, in baranta ma dunya itu mbal du kaniya'an palsuku'an ma pagparinta Tuhan. Baranta magkahalu' itu mbal kaniya'an kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:51
verses.text: Pakale kam bo' kam pata'uku pasal bay nilimbungan e' Tuhan waktu tagna', sagō' pinabukis na ma buwattina'an. Kitam bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi mbal magkamatay kamemon, sagō' pinindahan du barantam kamemon

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:52
verses.text: ma deyom dasasa'at, ma dapillawan mata. Saru'un-du'un sadja du bang pinah'lling na tiyup-tiyup pamatapus alam. Saru'un-du'un pinakallum du saga pagkahitam bay magpatayan, ati mbal na magkamatay sampay ni kasaumulan. Maka kitam ya masi allum ma waktu kapi'ituna, kapindahan du barantam kamemon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:53
verses.text: Subay pinindahan barantam magkahalu' itu ni baran taptap allum. Subay pinindahan baran magkahalu' itu ni baran mbal magkamatay.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:54
verses.text: Na, bang kapindahan na baranta magkahalu' ni baran taptap allum, maka bang baranta magkamatay itu pinindahan ni baran mbal magkamatay sampay ni kasaumulan, manjari tatuman na ya bay kinallam ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7440"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7441"/>“Halam na aniya' kamatay ma manusiya',<l eID="gen7441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7442"/>sabab tara'ug na e' Tuhan.<l eID="gen7442" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7443"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:55
verses.text: Mbal na kitam magmula e' kamatay,<l eID="gen7443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7444"/>mbal kitam tināw pinananaman bisana.”<l eID="gen7444" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7440"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:56
verses.text: Ya angkan manusiya' tināw amatay sabab aniya' dusa sigām song pinat'nna'an kabinasahan. Ya po'on dusa sigām subay bininasa, sabab sara' Tuhan ya bay talanggal e' sigām.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:57
verses.text: Saguwā' aheya pagsukulantam ni Tuhan, ya amuwanan kitam da'ugan. Mbal na kitam tināw amatay sabab kapuwasan na dusatam e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7439" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3705"/><div sID="gen7445" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3705"/> Angkanna, saga dauranakan kinalasahan, patotogunbi pangandolbi ma si Isa, da'a kam apinda min pameya'bi ma iya. Puspusinbi hinang Panghū' sabab kata'uwanbi asal, ai-ai hinangbi ma iya ajatu sadja du.  <div eID="gen7445" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.15"/> <div eID="gen7435" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3706"/><div sID="gen7446" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panulung ma saga A'a Suku' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7447" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3706"/> Na, in pasal sīn sinakap e'bi panulung saga pagkahibi suku' Tuhan ma lahat Yahudiya: beya'unbi bay panganggara'ku ma saga palhimpunan jama'a si Isa mahē' ma lahat Galatiya.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:2
verses.text: Ka'am ilu dangan maka dangan, subay kam amasaddī na sīn ma sakahaba' Ahad. Tongorinbi sīn bay tausahabi ma deyom dapitu' palabay inān. Bang aheka, aheka isab ya pamuwanbi, bang kulang, na ariki' du isab pamuwanbi. Pagdakayu'unbi sīn bay pagsaddī-saddībi kamemon, supaya bang aku at'kka pi'ilu, aniya' na asal sīnbi sakap panulung.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:3
verses.text: Jari makapi'ilu pa'in aku, sō'ku saga a'a tapene'bi amowa sīn inān ni Awrusalam. Pabowahanku sigām sulat pamakilā ma sigām ni saga a'a Awrusalam e'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:4
verses.text: Bang ma kira-kiraku subay du isab aku pehē' ni Awrusalam, na, magbeya' du aku maka sigām.  <div eID="gen7447" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7446" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3707"/><div sID="gen7448" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kagara'an si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7449" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3707"/> Agara' aku pi'ilu ni ka'am ni lahat Kurintu, sagō' palabay aku min lahat Makidunya dahū sabab aniya' gawiku pehē'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:6
verses.text: At'ggol-t'ggol arai' kamailuku ma ka'am, kalu pinalabay lagi' timpu pamaliyu bo' yampa aku palanjal minnilu, ati ka'am du iya amatuntul aku pi'ingga-pi'ingga ya palanjalanku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:7
verses.text: Mbal aku bilahi pat'nna' mailu ma ka'am bang dai'-dai' sadja. Kabaya'anku subay at'ggol-t'ggol kamailuku ma ka'am, bang kabaya'an Tuhan isab.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:8
verses.text: Sagō' maitu gi' aku ma Epesos sampay puwas hinang Pentekosta.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:9
verses.text: Sabab aheya hinang pamahinang aku maitu, hinang aheya kalagihanna, bo' pa'in aheka saga a'a anagga' aku.  <div eID="gen7449" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3708"/><div sID="gen7450" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3708"/> Bang si Timuti at'kka pi'ilu ni ka'am, paiddahunbi iya pahāp sabab hinang Tuhan ya nihinang e'na, buwat du aku.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:11
verses.text: Da'a iya siya-siyahunbi. Bang iya palanjal na minnilu subay iya patuntulbi supaya ahāp kal'ngngananna ati bo' iya makabīng ni aku, sabab lagaranku iya maka saga danakantam kasehe'an.  <div eID="gen7450" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3709"/><div sID="gen7451" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3709"/> Na, in pasal danakantam si Apollos, min heka na iya bay pogosku anehe'an saga danakantam kasehe' itu anibaw ka'am. Sagō' halam kono' aniya' galakna pi'ilu buwattina'an. Bang aniya' waktuna ahāp ma sinosōng pi'ilu du iya.  <div eID="gen7451" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7448" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3710"/><div sID="gen7452" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen7453" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3710"/> Pajaga kam. Patotogunbi pangandolbi ni si Isa. Da'a kam agawa. Paluwasunbi kosogbi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:14
verses.text: Ma ai-ai hinangbi, subay lasabi ni pagkahibi ya pamanuyu'anbi.  <div eID="gen7453" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3711"/><div sID="gen7454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3711"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, makata'u du kam pasal si Estepanas magtai'anak ilu. Dahū sigām bay am'nnal ma si Isa min kamemon ma lahat Akaya ilu, maka atogol sigām anabangan saga pagkahi sigām suku' Tuhan. Amu'ku junjung ni ka'am,

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:16
verses.text: beya'unbi ai-ai pamat'nna' ka'am e' saga a'a buwat si Estepanas inān maka saga sehe' sigām maghinang pakosog ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7454" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3712"/><div sID="gen7455" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3712"/> Akōd aku pagka at'kka na pi'itu disi Estepanas maka si Portunatus maka si Akaikus. Minsan kam mbal makapi'itu kamemon, aniya' na panandalanku entomku sabab min saga a'a t'llungan itu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:18
verses.text: Taga-kasannangan atayku min sigām, buwat kasannangan ataybi isab min sigām. Patut du subay pagaddatanbi saga a'a buwat sigām itu.  <div eID="gen7455" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3713"/><div sID="gen7456" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3713"/> Na, saga pagkahibi jama'a si Isa magtipun ma kalahat-lahatan Asiya itu, amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal sigām. Ya du si Akila maka h'ndana si Prisila, maka saga jama'a ya biyaksa magtipun ma luma' sigām, amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal sigām pagka Almasihin kam sali'-sali'.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:20
verses.text: Kamemon isab saga dauranakantam maitu, amabeya' isab pagaddat sigām ma ka'am. Maka ka'am isab mailu, bang kam magsabu subay kam magsiyum tanda' paglasabi.  <div eID="gen7456" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3714"/><div sID="gen7457" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3714"/> Aku na pas'lle' anulat maka sulatan tanganku, bo' kam pabeya'anku minsan la'a hal lapalku.  <div eID="gen7457" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3715"/><div sID="gen7458" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3715"/> Bang aniya' mailu mbal alasa ma Panghū' Isa, subay iya pinat'kkahan mulka' Tuhan. <div eID="gen7458" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7459" type="paragraph"/> Sagō' “marana tā”, hatina, “O Panghū' kami, pi'itu na ka!”  <div eID="gen7459" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3716"/><div sID="gen7460" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3716"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan min si Isa Al-Masi, Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7460" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3717"/><div sID="gen7461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3717"/> Alasa aku ma ka'am kamemon ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pagdakayu'antam. Amin. <div eID="gen7461" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7462" type="paragraph"/> <signed sID="gen7463"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7463"/>  <div eID="gen7462" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7452" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7287" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1Cor.16"/> <div eID="gen7281" osisID="1Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, maka si Timuti dakayu' danakantam. Kahandak min Tuhan asal, ya angkan aku kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi magnasihat lapalna. Ka'am saga jama'a Tuhan magtipun ma da'ira Kurintu ya pamasampayan kami sulat itu, sampay saga a'a suku' Tuhan ma kaluha'an lahat Akaya.  <div eID="gen7472" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3718"/><div sID="gen7473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3718"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka e' si Isa Al-Masi, Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7473" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3719"/><div sID="gen7474" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magsukul si Paul ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3719"/> Pudjitam Tuhan, ya Mma' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam. Landu' ma'ase' Mma'tam, maka po'onan tatabangan kamemon.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:4
verses.text: Pinat'ttogan kami atay e'na ma deyom kasusahan indaginis supaya kami isab makapat'ttog atay a'a kasehe'an bang sigām isab t'kkahan kasusahan. Makatabang kami ma sigām ma sabab panabang Tuhan bay kalabayan kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:5
verses.text: Talapay kami angananam saga kabinasahan ya bay kalabayan Al-Masi, maka talapay kami angananam kaheya tabang Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: Bang kami makananam kasusahan sumiyan-sumiyan, ka'am ya pinat'ttogan atay maka pinaniya'an kasalamatan. Bang kami ganta' tinabang, ya du ka'am tinabang. Pinakosog pangandolbi bo' kaimananbi saga kabinasahan buwat kaimanan kami itu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: Manjari bang ka'am makananam kabinasahan buwat kami, taptap kami angaholat ma pasalanbi sabab kata'uwan kami in ka'am tinabang du e' Tuhan buwat panabangna ma kami.  <div eID="gen7475" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3720"/><div sID="gen7476" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3720"/> Saga dauranakanku, bilahi kami amata'uwan ka'am pasal kasigpitan bay kalabayan kami mahē' ma lahat Asiya. Bay kami t'kkahan kasigpitan ala'at makalandu', angkan kami halam na magniyat allum.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:9
verses.text: Pangannal kami ta'abut na ganta'an, sagō' pinananaman kasukkalan buwattē' bo' supaya kami mbal pasangdol ma baran kami. Tuhan sadja ya pasangdolan kami, in iya amakallum saga a'a magpatayan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:10
verses.text: Jari pinuwasan kami min kapiligduhan ya arāk makamula kami, maka tantu kami pinuwasan e'na isab ma sinosōng. Aho', Tuhan sadja ya pangandolan kami, in kami puwasanna du bang aniya' kapiligduhan sumiyan-sumiyan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:11
verses.text: Maka ka'am ya anabang isab pagka kam angamu'an kami kahāpan ni Tuhan. Ya kaluwasanna, aheka saga a'a magsarang-sukul ni Tuhan ma sabab ba'anan pangamu'-ngamu' ya karūlan e' Tuhan ma pasalan kami.  <div eID="gen7476" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7474" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3721"/><div sID="gen7477" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Apinda Gara' si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7478" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3721"/> Na, aniya' pagbantugan kami. Kata'uwan kami min deyom itikad, ahāp sadja bowahan kami tudju ni a'a kamemon luba'-lagi'na na ni ka'am. Min Tuhan asal, angkan halam aniya' buli'an lling kami tudju ni ka'am. Ngga'i ka min akkal-pamikil ya kabiyaksahan manusiya' sagō' min kaheya tabang Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: Ai-ai tasulat kami ma ka'am tabassabi du maka tahatibi. Ma buwattina'an aniya' gi' halam tata'ubi ma pasal niyat maka maksud kami, sagō' aholat kami in ka'am makata'u to'ongan ma sinosōng, bo' supaya kam makapagbantug isab ma pasal kami, bang ta'abut llaw kabalik Panghū' Isa. Ya du kami amantug ma pasalbi ma llaw du ina'an.  <div eID="gen7478" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:14
verses.text: Ai-ai tasulat kami ma ka'am tabassabi du maka tahatibi. Ma buwattina'an aniya' gi' halam tata'ubi ma pasal niyat maka maksud kami, sagō' aholat kami in ka'am makata'u to'ongan ma sinosōng, bo' supaya kam makapagbantug isab ma pasal kami, bang ta'abut llaw kabalik Panghū' Isa. Ya du kami amantug ma pasalbi ma llaw du ina'an.  <div eID="gen7478" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3722"/><div sID="gen7479" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3722"/> Angkan ko', pagka halam aniya' hawal-hawalku ma pasal ina'an, bay aku agara' patibaw ni ka'am min duwa, supaya kam makasambut kahāpan nilipat duwa. Agara' aku pahapit ni ka'am ma labayanku tudju pehē' ni lahat Makidunya, maka ma labayanku tudju amole'. Jari makapatuntul kam aku ma pal'ngngananku pehē' ni lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3722"/><div sID="gen7479" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3722"/> Angkan ko', pagka halam aniya' hawal-hawalku ma pasal ina'an, bay aku agara' patibaw ni ka'am min duwa, supaya kam makasambut kahāpan nilipat duwa. Agara' aku pahapit ni ka'am ma labayanku tudju pehē' ni lahat Makidunya, maka ma labayanku tudju amole'. Jari makapatuntul kam aku ma pal'ngngananku pehē' ni lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: Kabā'bi bahā' in aku itu magduwa-baihu', pagka buwattē' gara'ku bo' pa'in halam bay kalanjalan? Atawa pangannalbi bahā' in maksudku hal pangandūl napsuku, angkan aku angaho' maka magin'mbal ma halam pūsna?  <div eID="gen7479" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3723"/><div sID="gen7480" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3723"/> Sagō' b'nnal sadja Tuhan, angkan b'nnal isab bissalaku ma ka'am. Mbal paglamuranku pangaho'ku maka pagin'mbalku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: Hatiunbi si Isa Al-Masi, Anak Tuhan, ya bay pinagnasihat ma ka'am e' kami maka si Silas maka si Timuti. Halam aniya' pagkalu-kaluna. Si Isa Al-Masi ya po'onna angkan niaho'an e' Tuhan saga janji'na,

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: sabab Al-Masi ya panumanan janji' Tuhan kamemon. Min Al-Masi asal ya angkan kami makapah'lling “amin”, bo' supaya pinaheya kasanglitan Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: Baran Tuhan ya amahogot ataytam kamemon, angkan kitam makatantu in kitam magdakayu' pahāp maka Al-Masi. Tapene' kitam e' Tuhan bo' tahinang suku'na.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: Pinat'nna'an kitam gindan in kitam ma iya na, maka kabuwanan kitam Rū-na pat'nna' ma deyom ataytam. Sabab Rū Sussi ya pamatuman in kitam pinasambutan kamemon ya panagama kitam e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7480" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3724"/><div sID="gen7481" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3724"/> Sabbutku Tuhan, in iya makasaksi' bang ai ma deyom atayku. B'nnal sadja ya yukku itu: ya po'on aku halam bay pahapit ni Kurintu sabab mbal aku bilahi amabukagan ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: Mbal kami bilahi magmandahan ka'am bang ai subay kahagadbi, sabab kata'uwan kami in pangandolbi ahogot asal. Ya sadja kabaya'an kami subay anabangan ka'am supaya pasōng kakōganbi bang harap ni Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7481" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.1"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: Bay aku anganiyat mbal anibaw ka'am pabalik, bang hal pamasusa ataybi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: Sabab bang aku ganta' amasusa ka'am, sai amakōg aku? Luwal ka'am, ya bay pasusaku!

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: Kata'uwanku du, bang aku kinōgan, ya du ka'am tabowa kinōgan. Mbal aku bilahi pi'ilu bang aku tabowa asusa ma sabab aniya' kahinanganbi mbal taluwa'. Arapun ka'am ilu amuwanan aku kakōgan. Ya na ko' he' sababna angkan aku bay amabeya' sulat tagna' inān ni ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: Landu' aheya bay kasusahanku ma waktu kapanulatku ka'am, sampay am'ttak bohe' mataku. Sagō' ya maksudku ma masa ina'an ngga'i ka amasukkal ka'am. Ya kabaya'anku subay tananambi lasaku ma ka'am kamemon.  <div eID="gen7482" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7477" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3725"/><div sID="gen7483" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ka'ampunan A'a Bay Makarusa</title> <div sID="gen7484" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3725"/> Na, in pasal a'a bay makarusa ilu, ngga'i ka hal aku ya bay pinasusa e'na sagō' ka'am kamemon, sabab palabi lagi' kasusahanbi min kasusahanku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: Sarang na hukuman ya bay pamat'nna' iya e' kaheka'anbi ilu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: Ampununbi na iya, pataptapunbi atayna bo' mbal lumandu'an sukkalna, ya aniya' papinda min imanna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:8
verses.text: Angkan aku angamu' junjung ni ka'am, hāpunbi iya pabalik bo' kata'uwanna in ka'am masi alasa ma iya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:9
verses.text: Ya na ko' itu mohotku ya angkan kam bay pabeya'anku sulat e', panulayanku ka'am bang kam ahutu ameya' ma panoho'anku sakahaba' waktu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:10
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a mailu taga-dusa bo' ampunbi dusana, ya du aku angampun iya. Bang aniya' isab a'a subay ampunku, ampunku iya ma pang'nda' Al-Masi supaya kam makabāk kahāpan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:11
verses.text: Sabab bang kita mbal magampun, tantu kita ka'akkalan e' nakura' saitan, maka kata'uwanta asal bang ai mohotna.  <div eID="gen7484" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7483" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3726"/><div sID="gen7485" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasusahan si Paul ma Da'ira Trowas</title> <div sID="gen7486" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3726"/> Manjari itu, makat'kka pa'in aku ni da'ira Trowas magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi, aniya' tahinang e' Panghū' maina'an angkan aku pinaluhaya magnasihat.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:13
verses.text: Sagō' minsan buwattē', aheya kasusahanku sabab halam tabākku maina'an danakantam si Titus. Angkan aku bay ang'bba magtūy min saga a'a Trowas bo' palanjal tudju ni Makidunya.  <div eID="gen7486" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7485" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3727"/><div sID="gen7487" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga A'a Magpatanyag Pahati Pasal Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3727"/> Sagō' aheya pagsukulan kami ni Tuhan! Sababna Al-Masi ya parakayu'an kami, maka tahinang kami paltanda'an e' Tuhan sakahaba' waktu, ta'nda' Al-Masi anganda'ug sadja. Maka kami itu sali' hantang pilisuna paturul min buli'anna. Ginuna kami e' Tuhan bo' pasaplag kata'u pasal Al-Masi ni kalahat-lahatan kamemon, sali' dalil hamut kamanyan an'bbud ni kamemon.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:15
verses.text: Sabab kami itu dalil kamanyan ahāp hamutna tinugtugan e' Al-Masi tudju ni Tuhan. Maka lapal ahāp itu sali' dalil hamutna pinahamut ma a'a kamemon, ai na ka a'a lappasan min hukuman atawa a'a mbal lappasan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:16
verses.text: Bang mbal lappasan, in pagnasihat kami sali' dalil bau makapatay. Sagō' bang ma saga a'a lappasan, sali' hamut ahāp, hamut makabuwan kallum. Hinang ahunit ya pagnasihat itu, mbal agon ta'anggap e' manusiya'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:17
verses.text: Saddī kam min a'a kasehe'an, ya anganasihat lapal Tuhan pagpilak, jari in lapal Tuhan tahinang sali' dagangan. Sagō' kami itu, pagka Tuhan bay anoho' kami magnasihat, amissala magatay pote' ma pang'nda' Tuhan. Patut asal subay buwattē' pagka sosoho'an kami Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7488" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.2"/> <div eID="gen7487" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3728"/><div sID="gen7489" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapagsulutan Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen7490" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3728"/> Na, kalu tapikilbi in kami magbantug-bantug di-kami supaya kami taima'bi. Sagō' ngga'i ka. Mbal sengoran kami saga a'a kasehe'an, mbal kami magkagunahan sulat pamakilā kami ni ka'am. Mbal isab angamu' sulat pamakilā min ka'am bang ganta' pehē' ni lahat saddī.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:2
verses.text: Ka'am baranbi ya hantang sulat sinulat maitu ma deyom atay kami. Angkan talhakit in kami itu taga-kapatut, ma sabab kahāp kaul-pi'ilbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:3
verses.text: Atampal du, Al-Masi ya bay anulat sulat itu, ati pangandolna na ma kami bo' pinatuntul pahāp. Ya panulat sulat itu ngga'i ka dawat, sagō' Rū min Tuhan kakkal salama-lama. Maka ya panulatan sulat itu ngga'i ka papan batu buwat bay panulatan sara' e' si Musa, sagō' deyom atay manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7490" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3729"/><div sID="gen7491" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3729"/> Ya angkan kami makatawakkal amissala buwattitu sabab angandol kami ma Tuhan, min Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:5
verses.text: Mbal isab kami magbau'-bau' in kami itu taga-kapandayan angkan kami tōp makahinang saga hinang itu. Sagō' aniya' barakat bay pamuwan kami e' Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:6
verses.text: Iya ya bay amuwanan kami kapandayan bo' supaya kami amal'ngngan kapagsulutan baha'u. Ngga'i ka sara' sinulat ma deyom Kitab ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma buwattina'an, sagō' Rū-na ma deyom atay. Ya sara' bay tasulat ma batu ma masa awal e' hal amowa ni kamatay, sagō' Rū Tuhan itu amowa ni kallum taptap.  <div eID="gen7491" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7489" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3730"/><div sID="gen7492" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasahaya'an Paljanji'an Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen7493" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3730"/> Bay niukilan ma papan batu in sara' bay pamowahan janji' Tuhan waktu tagna', beya' isab maka sahaya Tuhan landu' asawa. Taluwa' sahaya isab baihu' si Musa, angkan mbal tapandang e' a'a Isra'il minsan anginut-nginut pabaluba. Na, bang sara' amowa ni kamatay ya pinabeya'an sahaya buwattē',

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:8
verses.text: luba'-lagi'na na janji' ya pinal'ngngan e' Rū Tuhan buwattitu, akalap gi' sahaya-barakatna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:9
verses.text: Bang abarakat sara' awal, ya pamat'kkahan manusiya' hukuman ni kamatay, labi-labi gi' abarakat ya kapagsulutan baha'u itu, sabab minnitu kitam binista abontol e' Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:10
verses.text: Ya b'nnalna, pagka kapagsulutan baha'u itu atā bidda' barakatna, kalimbuhan na bay kal'ngnganan sara' tagna', minsan painay barakatna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:11
verses.text: Hatina in kapagsulutan baha'u itu alanga gi' barakatna min sara' tagna' ya palabay he', sabab anatas kapagsulutan baha'u itu ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen7493" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3731"/><div sID="gen7494" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3731"/> Angkan kami aesog magnasihat, sabab aniya' holatan kami mbal pabaluba.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:13
verses.text: Saddī kami min si Musa, ya bay anambunan baihu'na bo' mbal ta'nda' e' bangsa Isra'il, sabab in sahaya Tuhan bay ma baihu'na he' pabaluba du sampay alanyap.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: Kakulangan panghati saga bangsa Isra'il ma masa he'-i. Maka sampay isab ma waktu itu, sakahaba' waktu bang sigām binassahan Kitab si Musa, aniya' sali' dalil tambun ma pikilan sigām bo' mbal makahati. Subay sigām parakayu' ni Al-Masi bo' yampa nila'anan tambun inān min pikilan sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:15
verses.text: Sampay isab ma waktu itu, mbal makahati bangsa Isra'il bang aniya' binassa min deyom Kitab si Musa, sabab masi gi' aniya' patambun ma pikilan sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: Sagō' kala'anan du tambun e', buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Kala'anan tambun min baihu'na ma waktu kabīngna ameya' ma Panghū'.”

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:17
verses.text: Na, ya Panghū' sibahatku itu ya na Rū Tuhan, maka sai-sai kaniya'an Rū itu aluhaya na.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: Manjari kitam kamemon ya halam aniya' tambun ma baihu'tam, sali' kitam dalil samin pama'nda'an sahaya maka barakat Panghū'tam. Pinindahan kitam e'na painut-inut, pak'nnop na pa'in kasahayatam sampay kitam makasali' na ni iya. Ya Panghū' amindahan kitam itu, ya na Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7494" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.3"/> <div eID="gen7492" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3732"/><div sID="gen7495" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dalil L'ppo' Ahalga' Isina</title> <div sID="gen7496" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3732"/> Min ka'ase' Tuhan, ya po'on kami pinasuku'an hinang itu magnasihat pasal kapagsulutan baha'u. Angkanna kami mbal alamma maghinang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: Bay na bbahan kami ai-ai bay hinang kami ma kalimbungan, maka saga kahina'an. Mbal kami angakkal, mbal kami amandu' saddī min pandu' b'nnal. Gom pa'in pinapasti' to'ongan pagnasihat kami ma pandu' b'nnal, supaya kinahāpan hinang kami e' a'a kamemon ma halam aniya' sababan panowayan sigām ma kami. Maka ina'an asal Tuhan ang'nda' ma kahinangan kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a mbal makahati ma lapal ahāp ya nasihat kami, saga a'a inān anudju nalka'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: Tu'ud sigām mbal magkahagad ma lapal ahāp sabab akkal sigām wa'i nilokoban e' nakura' saitan ya pagtuhanan saga a'a ma alam dakayu' itu. Nilokoban sigām e' nakura' saitan inān bo' mbal makahati ma lapal ahāp pasal kamahaldika' Al-Masi, ya magsali' kajarihanna maka kajarihan Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka baran kami ya pagnasihat kami ni ka'am sagō' si Isa Al-Masi, in iya asal Panghū'. Sosoho'anbi asal kami, sinō' anabangan ka'am ma sabab si Isa ya kalasahan kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: Bay angallam Tuhan ma awal tagna', yukna, “Paniya'un sawa min deyom kalendoman.” Jari pinasawa isab e' Tuhan deyom pikilantam supaya makata'u ma sahayana maka kawasana, ya pina'nda'an kitam e' Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7496" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3733"/><div sID="gen7497" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3733"/> Sagō' halam aniya' kosog kami bang ma baran kami, minsan bay pangandol e' Tuhan amowa lapalna ahalga'. Sali' kami dalil l'ppo' aguya'. Angkan buwattē' supaya atampal ni a'a kamemon Tuhan ya po'onan kawasa, ngga'i ka kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: Maumu kami kat'kkahan kasusahan sagō' mbal kami tabowa-bowa katūyan. Suma'an asasaw pikilan kami sagō' mbal alungay iman kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: Araran kami pinalabay min kapinjala'an sagō' mbal kami asiya-siya e' Tuhan. Maka minsan kami binono', mbal du magmula to'ongan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: Pi'ingga-pi'ingga pal'ngnganan kami sakahaba' waktu, tananam e' kami kamatay buwat bay kamatay si Isa. Malaingkan tinabangan kami e' si Isa bo' supaya aniya' palsaksi'an ma ginhawa-baran kami in si Isa allum du.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: Minsan kami masi allum, mbal kami magniyat allum pat'ggol apa aheka ka'aniban kalabayan kami ma sabab si Isa. Buwattē' na pa'in bo' supaya ta'nda' kallum si Isa ma deyom baran kami magkamatay itu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: Bang pina'amu, in kami itu angananam kabinasahan sampay ni kamatay ma sabab pagnasihat kami, sagō' ya kamattihanna kallum kakkal makani-ka'am.  <div eID="gen7497" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3734"/><div sID="gen7498" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3734"/> Aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Angandol aku ma Tuhan, ya angkan aku bay amissala.” Damikiyanna kami itu, pagka buwattē' pangandol kami ma Tuhan, amissala isab ma saga a'a,

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: sabab tantu kami pasambeya' ma si Isa pinakallum min kamatay e' Tuhan, buwat bay pamakallumna isab ma Panghū' Isa. Jari pinapagdongan kami maka ka'am bo' pinatampal ni haddarat Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:15
verses.text: Ma sababbi du, angkan kami anandalan saga kabinasahan itu kamemon, supaya paheka na pa'in saga a'a kaniya'an tatabangan min Tuhan, jari manglabi-labihan saga a'a magsukul ni Tuhan supaya iya minahaldika' to'ongan.  <div eID="gen7498" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3735"/><div sID="gen7499" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3735"/> Angkanna kami mbal to'ongan ang'bbahan katuyu' kami magnasihat. Minsan kami angalamma, minsan isab apinda baran kami, pakosog gom pa'in iman kami llaw ni llaw.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: Pinjaman sadja saga kasusahan ya tananam kami itu, mbal bista kami sabab ya kamattihanna pahala' mbal tapula'-pula', anatas ni kasaumulan, magbidda' to'ongan maka bay kasusahan e'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: Mbal anatas ai-ai ta'nda' mata ma dunya itu angkan mbal angut kami. Ya pagmatayan kami saga kahāpan ya mbal gi' ta'nda', kahāpan anatas ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen7499" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.4"/> <div eID="gen7495" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3736"/><div sID="gen7500" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Luma' Kakkal ma Sulga'</title> <div sID="gen7501" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3736"/> Mbal kita pahondong maghinang ni Tuhan sabab kata'uwanta, minsan alubu panggung ya pahanti'anta itu (hatina baranta pinjaman), aniya' luma' kakkal tinagamahan kita e' Tuhan ma deyom sulga'. Nihinangan kita e'na baran baha'u anatas ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: Buwattina'an, angandahing kita ma sabab baya'ta itu mbal agon kasandalan sat'ggol kita mbal gi' pinabatuk ni deyom baran papanjarihan sulga'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:3
verses.text: Bilahi kita ma baran buwattē' bo' mbal sali' anantang palnyawahanta bang amole' ni sulga'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: Sat'ggol kita pahanti' ma baran pinjaman itu, angandahing sadja kita maka landu' isab kabuhatan. Halam aniya' kabaya'anta pasa'ut amutawan min baranta itu, sagō' bilahi kita pinabatukan baran baha'u ya min sulga'. Manjari pinindahan baranta pinjaman ni baran allum ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: Tuhan ya amasakap kita bo' supaya kapindahan baranta, ati pamuwanna Rū-na Sussi pat'nna' ma deyom atayta, pamatantu in kita makasambut ai-ai kamemon bay panagama kita e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7501" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3737"/><div sID="gen7502" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3737"/> Angkan at'ttog na pa'in imanta. Kata'uwanta asal, sat'ggol kita allum masi ma baran pinjaman itu, halam gi' kita maina'an ma atag Panghū'ta.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:7
verses.text: Niulinan kita e' pangandolta minsan mbal gi' ta'nda'ta bang ai tum'kka ma sinosōng.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:8
verses.text: Ahogot imanta, mbal kita tināw. Ya angutta to'ongan subay pabutawan min baranta pinjaman itu bo' makapole' ni Panghū'ta.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: Sagō' ai na ka maitu ma dunya, ai na ka maina'an ma sulga', ya na pa'in angutku to'ongan labi min kamemon, bang pa'in sulutku iya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: Sabab in kitam kamemon wajib patampal ni paghuhukuman Al-Masi bo' pinasambutan ai-ai tōp panungbas kitam pakaniya-pakaniya. Pinapagtongod maka bay kahinangantam ahāp-ala'at maitu ma dunya.  <div eID="gen7502" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7500" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3738"/><div sID="gen7503" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maghāp na Tuhan maka Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen7504" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3738"/> Na, magmatāw kami ma Panghū' angkan kami angegot-ngegot amowa saga a'a angandol ma Al-Masi. Atampal kajarihan kami ma pang'nda' Tuhan, maka kabaya'anku subay atampal isab ma pang'nda'bi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: Pangannalbi baha' in kami bilahi angā' kabantugan ma baran kami? Ngga'i ka isab. Angkan buwattitu pamissala kami, bo' kam mbal aiya' ma pasalan kami, bo' aniya' isab panambungbi ma saga a'a ya magabbu-abbu ma kahāp pangluwahan sigām. Mbal pamagay e' sigām deyom pangatayan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: Bang kami kalungayan pangannal, Tuhan ya pagmohotan. Ya balikna, bang ahantap akkal kami, ka'am iya kabuwanan kahāpan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:14
verses.text: Kapagbaya'an kami e' lasa Al-Masi sabab kab'nnalan kami, dakayu' du a'a bay amatay ganti' saga a'a kamemon angkan a'a kamemon taga-palsuku'an ma kamatayna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:15
verses.text: Al-Masi ya bay amatay ganti' saga a'a kamemon, jari sasuku kitam allum ma sabab kamatayna subay amuspus angahinang kabaya'anna, ngga'i ka kabaya'an barantam. Amatay iya ma sababtam ati tapakallum na pabalik.  <div eID="gen7504" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3739"/><div sID="gen7505" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3739"/> Manjari saddī na pamikil kami bang takbil ni pagkahi kami manusiya'. Mbal bista kami kapagā'ana, aniya' kaniya'na atawa halam. Minsan Al-Masi ma waktu palabay he', tabista iya sali' halam aniya' kasuddahanna, sagō' apinda na pamikil kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:17
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' parakayu' na ni Al-Masi, papanjarihan baha'u na iya. In bay kajarihanna tagna' patobtob na, jari a'a baha'u na.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:18
verses.text: Min Tuhan asal kahāpan itu kamemon. Bay kitam banta Tuhan sagō' nihāp na kitam e'na ma sabab tahinang e' Al-Masi. Bagay Tuhan na kitam, ati sinō' kami amata'uwan kasehe'an bang buwattingga kapaghāp sigām maka Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:19
verses.text: Hatina in a'a kamemon makajari na maghāp maka Tuhan ma sabab kamatay Al-Masi, ati mbal taitung e' Tuhan saga paldusahan sigām. Jari pangandol e' Tuhan ma kami in lapal pasal kapaghāp Tuhan maka manusiya'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:20
verses.text: Kawakilan kami e' Al-Masi, sinō' amissala lapalna, sali' hantang baran Tuhan ya amissalahan ka'am labay min kami. Ganti' kami Al-Masi angamu'an kam junjung: maghāp kam maka Tuhan!

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:21
verses.text: Halam to'ongan aniya' dusa Al-Masi, saguwā' pinatanggungan iya paldusahantam, supaya kitam kaniya'an kabontol Tuhan ma sabab kasōdta ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7505" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.5"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: Na, pagka kami dauyunan maka Tuhan maghinang hinangna, ya itu pangamu' kami ni ka'am: da'a haman-hamanunbi ase' maka lasa Tuhan ya tasambutbi ilu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: Sabab aniya' bissalana tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7508"/>“Bay ka kaleku ma waktu kagalakanku,<l eID="gen7508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7509"/>bay ka tabangku ma llaw pangalappasku ka'a.”<l eID="gen7509" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7507"/> Angkan yukku ma ka'am, ya na ko' llaw bay pangangganta' e' Tuhan pama'nda' lasana, llaw pangalappas ka'am min hukuman dusa.  <div eID="gen7506" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7503" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3740"/><div sID="gen7510" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasigpitan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7511" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3740"/> Pahalli' kami bo' supaya halam aniya' minsan sai pinat'nna'an bimbang ma ai-ai tahinang kami. Ya kabaya'an kami subay mbal tasoway hinang kami magpasaplag lapal ahāp.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: Gom du bang magmanyatakan ma ai-ai tahinang kami in kami b'nnal sosoho'an Tuhan, ma sabab katuyu' kami angimanan ai-ai tum'kka, ai na ka kabinasahan, atawa kasigpitan atawa kasusahan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: Magmalulus sadja kami minsan pinagdaplosan, pinakalabusu, pinagjabu. Araran kami maghulas-sangsā', animpus llaw-sangom ma halam pagtuli atawa pagkakan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:6
verses.text: Manyatakan isab kasaltun maka panghati kami, kapangiman maka ka'ase' kami ma pagkahi manusiya'. Atampal in kami kaniya'an Rū Tuhan maka alasa magatay pote'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: Pandu' kasab'nnalan ya pangalapal kami ma sabab barakat bay min Tuhan. Ya pamanyap kami kaul-pi'il abontol, ya sapantun kapanyapan sundalu pangatuna maka panampanna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: Sosoho'an Tuhan kami, suma'an pinagaddatan e' a'a kasehe', suma'an pinaggunyak-gunyak, suma'an kami sinanglitan, suma'an isab pinagtunggīngan. Pinahiputing kami, minsan b'nnal sadja ya pah'lling kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: Halam kami taga-ōn, bo' pa'in kinata'uwan e' a'a kamemon. Sa'agon-agon kami amatay, bo' pa'in masi allum. Pinagdaplosan kami, sagō' halam gi' pinapatay.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: Pinasukkal, sagō' kinōgan sakahaba' waktu. Kamiskinan kami, sagō' aheka a'a kasehe' taga-karaya ma sabab kami. Halam aniya' palsuku'an kami ma dunya itu, malaingkan suku' ma kami kahāpan kamemon.  <div eID="gen7511" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3741"/><div sID="gen7512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3741"/> Atampal na pamissala kami ma ka'am saga a'a Kurintu, halam aniya' nilimbungan. Tantu aheya lasa kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: Bang aniya' la'at-la'at ma deyom ataybi, ngga'i ka min kami. Halam kami pahondong alasa.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: Bissalahanta kam buwat pamissalaku ma anakku lahasiya': kalasahinbi kami, buwat kami alasahan ka'am!  <div eID="gen7512" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7510" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3742"/><div sID="gen7513" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Paglamud maka A'a Mbal Angisbat Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3742"/> Da'a kam magdakayu' maka saga a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan. Sabab mbal manjari pinapaglamud ahāp maka ala'at, sapantun sawa mbal tapaglamud maka kalendoman.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: Mbal makapaguyun Al-Masi maka nakura' saitan, jari mbal makapagda'atay saga bebeya'an Al-Masi maka saga a'a ya mbal magkahagad.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: In langgal pagtata'atan ni Tuhan mbal manjari panumbahan saga ta'u-ta'u. In kitam bebeya'an Al-Masi isab sali' dalil langgal pagtata'atan luma' Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama, buwat bay pangallam Tuhan, ya yuk-i, “Palahat aku ma sigām bo' pat'nna' ma deyoman sigām. Jari aku ya pagtuhanan sigām, maka sigām a'a suku'ku.” Buwattitu isāb sugpatna, <lg sID="gen7515"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7516"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: “Ala'an kam min saga a'a mbal magkahagad ma aku,<l eID="gen7516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7517"/>paokat kam min sigām.<l eID="gen7517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7518"/>Da'a kam palamud maghinang ai-ai makatamak atay,<l eID="gen7518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7519"/>ati taima'ta du kam.<l eID="gen7519" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7520"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: Pag'mma'anbi aku,<l eID="gen7520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7521"/>maka ka'am ya panganakku l'lla-d'nda.<l eID="gen7521" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7522"/>Pangallam Panghū' Sangat Kawasa ko' itu.”<l eID="gen7522" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen7515"/>  <div eID="gen7514" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.6"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: Na, saga bagay kalasahanku, pagka kitam ya pinagtu'uran saga janji' Tuhan itu, gom bbahantam ai-ai makalumu' baran maka pikilan supaya kitam asussi lullun ma sabab pagmatāwtam ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7523" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7513" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3743"/><div sID="gen7524" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kakoyagan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7525" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3743"/> Kalasahinbi kami. Halam aniya' dusa kami minsan ma sai-na, halam aniya' bay tabowa kami maghinang ala'at, maka halam aniya' bay kulli'an kami supaya ta'ā' kaniya'na.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: Mbal pah'llingku buwattitu bo' kam pabukaganku. Bay na sa yukku ma ka'am tagna', landu' kam aheya ma atay kami, angkan kami maglilla' magunung maka ka'am kallum-kamatay.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: Aheya pangandolku ma ka'am, maka aheya isab pagbantugku ma pasalanbi. Minsan kami ma deyom katiksa'an, ahogot na pa'in pangatayanku maka kumarukan isab kakoyaganku.  <div eID="gen7525" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3744"/><div sID="gen7526" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3744"/> Waktu pa'in kat'kka kami ni lahat Makidunya, halam aniya' halian kami sabab aniya' na pa'in pagsasawan maka paglugat. Magabut-abut isab kasusahan deyom atay.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: Manda' kami pinahantapan atay e' Tuhan, ya ata'u anabang sasuku taluwa' kasukkalan. Pinat'kka si Titus,

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: lāgi aniya' lapal tabowana pasal pamatuntulbi ma iya. Yukna isab in ka'am bilahi mag'nda' maka aku. Aheya kono' pagsusunbi pasal bay tahinang ma deyomanbi ilu, maka aheya pagka'inagonbi ma aku. Gom pa'in pasōng kakōganku.  <div eID="gen7526" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3745"/><div sID="gen7527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3745"/> Sabab minsan kam bay pinat'kkahan sukkal waktu kapanambutbi sulatku, halam aniya' susunku. B'nnal aniya' susun pagta'uku pasal kasukkalbi, minsan sukkal mbal anatas.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: Sagō' kinōgan aku buwattina'an, ngga'i ka ma sabab pamasukkalku ka'am, sagō' ma sabab kapang'bbabi dusa inān. Sukkalbi inān bay ginuna e' Tuhan bo' kam tabowa magsusun. Angkan yukku in sulatku inān bay pamowahan ka'am ni kahāpan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: Ahāp isāb bang kita pinat'kkahan sukkal e' Tuhan, sabab kallum taptap ya kamattihanna. Sagō' aniya' ginis sukkal kalabayan manusiya' ngga'i ka sukkal min Tuhan, ati kamatay ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: Nda'unbi kahāpan ya pamuwan ka'am e' Tuhan luwas min sukkalbi inān. Ahutu na kam. Ya katuyu'anbi subay halam aniya' sababan panā'an ka'am. Ab'nsi kam ma hinang ala'at! Ilu kam pahalli' bo' mbal tabowa-bowa magdusa! Landu' kam angentom ma aku! Bilahi kam anulut aku, maka asa'ut na kam amat'nna' kasā'an ma a'a bay makarusa. Manyatakan halam aniya' lamudbi ma dusa a'a inān.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: Jari itu, minsan kam bay pabeya'anku sulat, ngga'i ka a'a makarusa atawa a'a nirusahan ya mohotku. Luwal ka'am, bang pa'in tahimangkanbi aheya asal lasabi ma kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: Angkan ahantap na atay kami. <div eID="gen7527" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7528" type="paragraph"/> Maka ngga'i ka isab hal e'-i. Tabowa kami kinōgan isab, pag'nda' kami kakōgan si Titus. Ka'am kono' bay makabuwanan iya kahayangan atay, angkan iya kinōgan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: Bay kam sanglitanku waktu kapagsuli-suli kami maka si Titus, dahū lagi' min kapi'iluna ni ka'am. Kinōgan aku sabab halam aku bay karapatanbi. Pag'nda' pa'in si Titus ma ka'am, kinata'uwan magtūy e'na in bay pananglitku ka'am b'nnal sadja. Buwat kamemon bay pah'llingku ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: Angkan pasōng lasana ma ka'am pagka taentom e'na ya bay kalunuk ataybi ameya' ma panoho'anna. Nientom isab bay panaima'bi ma iya. Nihanggaw kam, kalu iya mbal kasulutan ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: Angkan aheya na kakōganku sabab kata'uwanku na in ka'am kapangandolan to'ongan.  <div eID="gen7528" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.7"/> <div eID="gen7524" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3746"/><div sID="gen7529" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagmura</title> <div sID="gen7530" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3746"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, bilahi kami angahaka'an ka'am pasal kaheya tabang Tuhan ma saga palhimpunan jama'a si Isa Al-Masi ma kalahat-lahatan Makidunya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:2
verses.text: Minsan sigām ma deyom kasusahan, mbal kaliyuhan kakōgan sigām. Minsan sigām landu' kamiskinan, magmura sigām amuwan tutulungan ma saga pagkahi sigām kakulangan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:3
verses.text: Aku ya saksi', bay sigām amuwan pila-pila ya taga'os sigām, maka palabi lagi' minnē'. Min kahilasan sigām du,

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:4
verses.text: sabab niamu'an kami junjung e' sigām bang pa'in sigām pinalamud anulung saga pagkahi sigām suku' Tuhan, ya pat'nna' ma lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:5
verses.text: Pamuwan e' sigām palabi gi' to'ongan min bay taholat kami, sabab ngga'i ka hal pilak ya pamuwan e' sigām. Bay pinaglilla' e' sigām baran sigām, dahū ni Panghū', puwas e' ni kami. Sabab ya na ko' he' kahandak Tuhan ma sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:6
verses.text: Ahāp hinang sigām, maka ahāp isab bang atalus panimukbi sīn panulungbi. Angkan kami bay anoho' si Titus pi'ilu anabangan ka'am pabalik sabab iya ya bay makatagna' animuk mailu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:7
verses.text: Mbal kam taramuli bang takdil ni kahāpan indaginis. Akosog pangandolbi, apanday kam amissala lapal Tuhan, maka alalom pangita'ubi. Atuyu' kam anabangan saga sehe'bi, maka aheya lasabi ma kami. Angkan kam pogosku supaya kam mbal taramuli bang takdil ni panulung ma pagkahibi.  <div eID="gen7530" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3747"/><div sID="gen7531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3747"/> Ngga'i ka ko' itu panoho'an. Bilahi sadja aku ata'u bang aniya' lasabi sab'nnal-b'nnal ma kasehe'anbi, angkan bay sibahatku lasa saga a'a Makidunya he', bang kalu panunuranbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:9
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi ya kaheya lasa maka ase' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Minsan iya dayahan asal ma sulga', bay iya magpamiskin di-na ma sababbi, bo' supaya kam taga-karaya b'nnal min kahilasanna.  <div eID="gen7531" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3748"/><div sID="gen7532" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3748"/> Na, bang ma gara'ku, ahāp talusbi ya bay tagna'anbi tahun palabay inān. Bay ka'am galakan dahū lagi' min palhimpunan jama'a kasehe', maka ka'am ya bay makarahū amuwan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:11
verses.text: Jari lanjalinbi na panimukbi bo' atalus. Bay kam kinōgan anagna', subay kam kinōgan analus, pila-pila ya taga'osbi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:12
verses.text: Sabab bang kam lilla' amuwan bo' pamuwanbi pila-pila ya taga'osbi minsan mbal aheka, tantu tinaima' e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7532" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3749"/><div sID="gen7533" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3749"/> Ngga'i ka mohotku amasigpit ka'am bo' supaya magkasannangan saga a'a kasehe'. Ya mohotku in ka'am subay taga-kaniya' sali'-sali'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:14
verses.text: Saguwā' ma buwattina'an ka'am ya taga-labi, angkan patut du bang kam amuwan tutulungan ma pagkahibi kulang-kabus. Jari bang ganta' aniya' waktu kakulang-kabusbi, bo' sigām kasehe' ya taga-labi, na ka'am ya tinabang isab e' sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:15
verses.text: Buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “A'a bay makatimuk pagkakan aheka halam aniya' labina. Maka a'a bay makatimuk ariki', halam aniya' kulangna.”  <div eID="gen7533" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7529" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3750"/><div sID="gen7534" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Disi Titus maka saga Sehe'na</title> <div sID="gen7535" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3750"/> Aheya pagsukulan kami ni Tuhan ma sabab pikilan ya pamahōpna ma si Titus, angkan iya atuyu' anabangan ka'am, buwat katuyu' kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:17
verses.text: Magmalulus iya maghinang ai-ai bay pangamu' kami, maka ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Min kaheya baya'na angkan iya agara'an di-na pi'ilu anabangan ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:18
verses.text: Pabeya' kami isab ma iya danakantam dakayu', ya pinagaddatan to'ongan e' jama'a Al-Masi ma ba'anan palhimpunan itu, ma sabab hinangna amasaplag lapal ahāp.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:19
verses.text: Lāgi, tapene' iya e' saga a'a ma saga palhimpunan itu, sinō' anehe'an kami bang kami palanjal ni lahat Yahudiya ang'nde'an tutulungan itu. Angkan buwattitu kagara'an kami, sabab bilahi kami amaheya ōn Panghū' Isa. Ahāp isab bang ta'nda' kahutu kami anabang.  <div eID="gen7535" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3751"/><div sID="gen7536" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3751"/> Kinamaya'-maya'an asal e' kami heka sīn tutulungan itu bo' halam aniya' sababan panā'an kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:21
verses.text: Sabab ya katuyu'an kami subay abontol sadja kahinangan kami, ngga'i ka hal ma pang'nda' Panghū', sampay isab ma pang'nda' manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7536" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3752"/><div sID="gen7537" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3752"/> Aniya' gi' isab danakantam dakayu' pinasehe' ma disi Titus, a'a bay kasulayan kami min heka, in iya ahutu anabang. Pasōng isab baya'na buwattina'an ma sabab kaheya pangandolna ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:23
verses.text: Na in pasal si Titus, sehe'ku iya maghinang ma pasalanbi. Maka saga danakantam kasehe', kawakilan asal sigām e' palhimpunan jama'a Al-Masi maka sinanglitan Al-Masi ma sabab kahinangan sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:24
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu pangamu'ku' ni ka'am: pa'nda'inbi lasabi ma saga a'a itu supaya talhakit ni saga palhimpunan jama'a si Isa in pagsanglit kami ma pasalbi b'nnal taga-pūs.  <div eID="gen7537" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.8"/> <div eID="gen7534" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3753"/><div sID="gen7538" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tulung ma saga Pagkahi Almasihin</title> <div sID="gen7539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3753"/> Na, in pasal tutulungan ya pabeya'bi ni pagkahitam suku' Tuhan ma lahat Yahudiya, minsan kam mbal sulatanku

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:2
verses.text: sabab asal kata'uwanku, aheya baya'bi anabang. Ya na ko' he' pagbantugku ni saga a'a Makidunya itu. Yukku ma sigām, “Sangay min tahun palabay in dauranakantam mahē' ma lahat Akaya, sakap asal animuk sīn tutulungan.” Jari, makakale pa'in sigām ma bay llingku, magtūy palamud anabang kaheka'an sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:3
verses.text: Jari soho'ku pi'ilu saga danakan itu bo' kam sakap animuk tutulungan buwat bay pagbantug ma pasalanbi, ati mbal aku taluwa' pinahiputing.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:4
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a min Makidunya itu anehe'an aku, bo' kam ta'abut halam gi' asakap, aiya' kami. Luba'-lagi'na isab ka'am, sabab ka'am ya pagbantugan kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:5
verses.text: Angkan aku agara' amapi'ilu saga danakan itu parahū min aku angahatul tutulungan ya bay janji'bi. Jari asakap na sabab pagmurabi, ngga'i ka ma sabab kam pinogos.  <div eID="gen7539" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7538" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3754"/><div sID="gen7540" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagtanom Paheka</title> <div sID="gen7541" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3754"/> Entomunbi to'ongan paralilan itu pasal a'a ananom. Bang salat ya tanomna, salat isab anihanna. Bang aheka tanomna, aheka isab anihanna.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:7
verses.text: Angkan kam dangan maka dangan subay angangganta' bang pila ya pamuwanna. Minsan pila pamuwanna, subay hilas min deyom atay ma halam aniya' bay amogos iya. Sabab alasa Tuhan ma a'a bang hilas pagmurana.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:8
verses.text: Ata'u du Tuhan amuwanan ka'am ai-ai manglabi-labihan supaya halam aniya' kakulanganbi sakahaba' waktu, ati bo' aniya' labina isab panabangbi sasuku taga-kulang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:9
verses.text: Buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7542"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7543"/>“Aheka pamuwanna ma saga a'a miskin.<l eID="gen7543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7544"/>Mbal apinda kahāp addatna ni kasaumulan.”<l eID="gen7544" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7542"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:10
verses.text: Tuhan ya amuwan binhi' ma a'a magtanom, maka amuwan pagkakan bo' aniya' kinakan manusiya'. Buwattē' isab ma ka'am, buwat ibarat a'a maghuma. Tuhan ya amuwanan ka'am binhi' pila-pila kagunahanbi, maka Tuhan ya amaheka buwa'na, hatina kahinangan abontol ya tahinangbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:11
verses.text: Binuwanan kam e' Tuhan kaniya' ballabi-labihan bo' supaya kam makapagmura minsan sumiyan waktu. Manjari pagt'kka kami pi'ilu, aheka saga a'a magsukul to'ongan ni Tuhan ma sabab tutulungan ya tahampit sigām min ka'am.  <div eID="gen7541" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3755"/><div sID="gen7545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3755"/> Pagka buwattē' hinangbi, tatabang saga a'a suku' Tuhan ya kasukkalan, sagō' aniya' gi' sugpatna. Minnē' isab aniya' pagsukulan lumandu'an aheya tinukbalan ni Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: Manjari hinangbi ahāp inān tanda' saksi' in ka'am b'nnal angandol ma Tuhan, maka aheka a'a tabowa ananglitan Tuhan ma sabab pangisbatbi ma lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi, ya lapal pagsab'nnalanbi. Amuwan sigām sanglit ni Tuhan isab ma sabab pagmurabi amahagi'an sigām sampay saga a'a kamemon.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: Hinabu pa'in sigām angamu' duwa'a ni Tuhan ma pasalbi, paheya lasa sigām ma ka'am ma sabab tatabangan Tuhan ya mbal tapula'-pula'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: Magsukul kitam ni Tuhan ma sabab kahāpna mbal tasipat.  <div eID="gen7545" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.9"/> <div eID="gen7540" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3756"/><div sID="gen7546" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anganda'awa si Paul Pasal Kahinanganna</title> <div sID="gen7547" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3756"/> Aniya' ilu amah'llingan aku, yuk-i, “At'mmun si Paul inān bang maitu ma atag kami, sagō' aesog amabukag labay min deyom sulat bang makalikut.” Sagō' panunuranku Al-Masi ma kareyo' atayna maka ma kahanunut bissalana, jari angamu' aku junjung ni ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:2
verses.text: Pahāpunbi kaul-pi'ilbi supaya halam aniya' pamabukaganku ka'am bang aku mailu ma ka'am. Sabab atawakkal aku amabukag saga a'a ya angalimut kami, in kami kono' hal ameya' ma kahinangan dunya itu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:3
verses.text: Manusiya' kami pat'nna' ma dunya itu, sagō' ngga'i ka kapandayan manusiya' ya ginuna e' kami pamaggat kala'atan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:4
verses.text: Ngga'i ka patakos manusiya' ya pangatu kami sagō' patakos taga-kawasa deyo' bay min Tuhan, angkan kami makapaka'at kuta' (hatina ai-ai makasagga'.)

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:5
verses.text: Tara'ug e' kami pasu'alan maka pagabbu saga a'a ya anulak pandu' kasab'nnalan pasal Tuhan. Jari tabowa paghona'-hona' manusiya' magmalulus ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:6
verses.text: Na, sakap na kami amat'nna' kabinasahan ma sasuku mbal angikut panoho'anna, bang hati' aniya' ma deyomanbi mbal gi' angikut.  <div eID="gen7547" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3757"/><div sID="gen7548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3757"/> Hal pangluwahan a'a ya tandingbi, ngga'i ka deyom atay. Aniya' baha' mailu magabbu-abbu in iya palsuku'an Al-Masi? Subay iya amikil pahāp sabab ya du kami palsuku'an Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:8
verses.text: Mbal aku aiya' minsan lumandu'an kapagbantugku pasal kapatut bay pamuwan kami e' Panghū'. Ngga'i ka kapatut pamaka'at pangandolbi, sagō' kapatut pamahogot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:9
verses.text: Mbal aku bilahi amakitāw ka'am labay min kasulatanku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:10
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanku aniya' ilu angupama, yukna, “Atumlang bissala si Paul bang anulat, apaslod panganjawabna. Sagō' bang iya maitu magbaran sali' halam aniya' kosogna, maka mbal iya ata'u amissala.”

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:11
verses.text: Subay pahati saga a'a angupama buwattilu: ai-ai pamissala kami ma deyom sulat ma kalikut kami, hinang kami du bang mailu ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen7548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3758"/><div sID="gen7549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3758"/> Mbal kami makatawakkal amasali' di-kami ni saga a'a magheya-heya di-sigām inān. Dupang saga a'a inān! Pangannal sigām in sigām ata'u anilang ahāp maka ala'at, bo' pa'in hal baran sigām ya pamandogahan. Angkan ai-ai nihinang e' sigām ahāp-ala'at, ahāp lullun kono'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:13
verses.text: Saguwā' mbal kami magbantug ma baran kami haliyu min hinang bay pamasuku' kami e' Tuhan. Damikiyanna isab kahinangan kami ma deyomanbi, bay pamasuku' isab e' Tuhan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:14
verses.text: Mbal paliyu pagbantug kami, sabab kami ya bay makarahū amowahan ka'am lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:15
verses.text: Mbal kami magbantug-bantug ma pasal hinang saga a'a kasehe'. Ya kabaya'an kami subay pasōng hogot pangandolbi supaya tapasōng isab hinang kami mailu ma deyomanbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:16
verses.text: Jari bang ahogot na pangandolbi, makajari na kami palanjal ni saga kalahat-lahatan ma liyuhanbi. Sabab hatina mbal kami bilahi angā' kabantugan min kahinangan saga a'a kasehe', ya pamasuku' asal ma sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:17
verses.text: Tasulat asal ma Kitab, “Sai-sai bilahi magbantug, Panghū' ya subay pagbantuganna.”

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:18
verses.text: Sabab mbal kita tinaima' ma saukat na kita ananglitan di-ta, luwal bang kita binuwanan sanglit e' Panghū'.  <div eID="gen7549" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.10"/> <div eID="gen7546" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3759"/><div sID="gen7550" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul maka saga A'a Magwakil-wakil di-Sigām</title> <div sID="gen7551" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3759"/> Da'a pa'in aku kasumuhinbi, minsan sali' ula-ula bissalaku itu. Dūlinbi aku dai'-dai',

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:2
verses.text: sabab a'llogan aku ka'am buwat ka'llog Tuhan. Ka'am ilu sali' dalil budjang halam aniya' lumu'na, maka aku itu dalil matto'a amatunangan ka'am ni l'lla dakayu'-kayu', ya na Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:3
verses.text: Asusa aku ya aniya' kam binidjakan pataikut min Al-Masi ati ang'bba min bay lasabi tuman ma iya. Kalu kam ka'akkalan buwat si Sitti Hawa ma awal jaman e'. Bay iya ka'akkalan e' sowa ma sabab min kapanday sowa inān magputing.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:4
verses.text: Sabab bang aniya' pi'ilu anganasihatan ka'am, kinōgan sadja kam. Mbal lāngbi minsan saddī pamandu' saga a'a inān pasal si Isa min bay pamandu' kami, minsan isab ngga'i ka Rū Sussi ya pinasambutan ka'am.  <div eID="gen7551" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3760"/><div sID="gen7552" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3760"/> Bang ma bistahanku, mbal aku kalakbawan e' saga gurubi ilu, ya pinagsambat “kawakilan Al-Masi umbul dakayu'”.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:6
verses.text: Akulang arai' kapandayanku bang takdil ni bissala, sagō' ajukup pangita'uku bang takdil ni kasab'nnalan. Pinapasti' ko' itu ma ka'am kamemon sakahaba' waktu.  <div eID="gen7552" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3761"/><div sID="gen7553" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3761"/> Taga-dusa aku bahā' amareyo' baranku supaya ka'am ya pinalanga, pagka kam ninasihatan lapal ahāp ma halam pangamu'an tamba?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:8
verses.text: Bang pinaralil, bay langpasanku saga jama'a ma palhimpunan kasehe' supaya ka'am ya katabangan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:9
verses.text: Halam aku bay mikibalanja' ma ka'am t'ggolku bay mailu. Bay aku binowahan ai-ai kulang-kabusku e' saga danakantam min Makidunya. Halam kam bay kabuhatan amalanja'an aku, maka buwattē' na pa'in ma sinosōng!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:10
verses.text: Mbal kapaliluhan pagbantugku itu e' sai-sai minsan ma kaluha'an lahat Akaya, sabab halam aku bay angamu' ai-ai ni ka'am. B'nnal sadja pah'llingku itu sabab itiya' kasab'nnalan Al-Masi ma pangatayanku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:11
verses.text: Angay aku subay anganggastuhan di-ku? Pangannalbi bahā' in aku mbal alasa ma ka'am, ya po'on aku mbal mikitabang ma ka'am? Tuhan ya makata'u in aku alasa du.  <div eID="gen7553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3762"/><div sID="gen7554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3762"/> Togolanku na pa'in hinangku itu. Mbal aku mikitamba ma sai-sai bo' mbal makapagabbu saga a'a ya bilahi pasali' ni kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:13
verses.text: Halam sigām bay kawakilan e' Al-Masi, hal magbau'-bau' in sigām bay kawakilanna. Pangangakkal isab ma ai-ai tahinang sigām.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:14
verses.text: Sagō' mbal sakit makainu-inu, sabab minsan nakura' saitan ata'u isab magpasalupa ni luwa mala'ikat asahaya.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: Angkan kitam subay mbal anginu-nginu bang saga a'a sosoho'an nakura' saitan maghāp-hāp di-sigām, magbau'-bau' in sigām maghinang abontol. Sagō' magtongod kadal saga a'a he' maka bay kahinangan sigām ala'at.  <div eID="gen7554" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7550" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3763"/><div sID="gen7555" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Angahaka si Paul Pasal Bay Kalabayanna</title> <div sID="gen7556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3763"/> Balikanku gi' bay yukku: da'a aku bistahunbi ula-ula ma sabab bissalaku. Sagō' bang aku subay bistabi sali' ula-ula, na tugutinbi aku magbantug-bantug, minsan la'a hal bantug ma kariki'an.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: Ngga'i ka min panoho'an Panghū' angkan aku magbantug sagō' min baranku. Hatina min ula-ulaku angkan aku magbantug-bantug di-ku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: Malaingkan, pagka aheka a'a magbantug-bantug pasal kahinangan sigām, ameya'-meya' isab aku magbantug-bantug di-ku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: Alalom kono' pamikilbi angkan kam mbal sinumu akale minsan ma bissala saga ula-ula itu!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: Ya b'nnalna, sabalanbi saga a'a minsan sigām magmandahan ka'am, minsan isab angulli' atawa angakkal ma ka'am. Minsan a'a amareyo' ka'am atawa anampak ka'am, ahāp sadja ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: Aiya' aku angahaka'an ka'am, kulang esog kami angkan kami mbal makasengod ni hinang sigām! <div eID="gen7556" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7557" type="paragraph"/> Min ula-ulaku angkan aku atawakkal magbantug ma buwat pagbantug a'a kasehe'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: Bangsa Hibrani bahā' sigām? Ya du aku. Bangsa Isra'il bahā'? Ya du aku. Panubu' si Ibrahim bahā'? Ya du aku, panubu' si Ibrahim isab.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: Sosoho'an Al-Masi bahā'? Sosoho'an Al-Masi isab aku, sagō' akalap lagi' min sigām. (Ula-ula pahāp pamissalaku buwattitu.) Minsan painay kalu'ugan sigām, palabi gi' kalu'uganku. Minsan sigām bay pinakalabusu, aheka lagi' kapangalabusu ma aku. Min pila aku bay nilappet? Labi gi' min sigām. Min heka aku agon-agon amatay.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: Min lima aku bay niraplosan e' saga Yahudi, t'llumpū' maka siyam pangandaplos min t'dda.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: Min t'llu aku bay niraplosan e' bangsa Rōm, maka min t'dda aku bay pinagbantung. Min t'llu aku bay alogdang ma dilaut, maka aniya' isab waktu hal pagūng ma s'llang, dang'llaw dambahangi t'ggolna.  <div eID="gen7557" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3764"/><div sID="gen7558" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3764"/> Maglatun-latun na pa'in aku min lahat dakayu' ni dakayu', maka aheka ka'aniban bay kalabayanku. Bay aku nirunukan, bay minunduhan. Bay aku nirogpa'an, suma'an e' saga pagkahiku Yahudi, suma'an e' bangsa saddī. Ai na ka ka'aniban ma deyom kaluma'an, ai na ka ka'aniban ma deya-dilaut, bay na kalabayanku kamemon. Kalabayanku isab kala'atan min saga a'a magbau'-bau' in sigām pagkahiku bebeya'an si Isa.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: Bay aku makapagsangsā', bay aku abinasa. Araran aku halam bay atuli sangom. Bay aku pinunung maka patay bohe'. Maumu aku kulang-kabus ma kapamangan maka ma kapan'mmek, angkan kasandalanku haggut.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: Ahunit ko' inān, sagō' aniya' gi' kasusahanku paliyu minnē'. Makananam aku kasukkalan kahaba' llaw ma sabab saga palhimpunan jama'a Al-Masi ma kalahat-lahatan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' alamma imanna tudju ni si Isa, tananamku kalammahanna. Bang aniya' tabowa-bowa angahinang dusa, tabowa isab aku magkarukka'an.  <div eID="gen7558" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:30
