verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3765"/><div sID="gen7559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3765"/> Mbal aku bilahi magbantug, sagō' bang aku subay magbantug, gom pagbantuganku ai-ai bay kalabayanku supaya manyatakan in aku halam aniya' kosogku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: B'nnal sadja ya bay pah'llingku inān, kinata'uwan asal e' Tuhan, ya Mma' Panghū' Isa. Wajib iya sinanglitan sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: Waktu kamahē'ku ma da'ira Damaskus, saga lawang paluwasan min da'ira bay pinajagahan ma sundalu e' gubnul ya ma deyo'an sultan Aretas. Sinoho' sigām anaggaw aku, manda' aku tinontonan pareyo' ma deyom ambung labay min tandawan ma ād da'ira. Jari makal'ppa aku.  <div eID="gen7559" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.11"/> <div eID="gen7555" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: Waktu kamahē'ku ma da'ira Damaskus, saga lawang paluwasan min da'ira bay pinajagahan ma sundalu e' gubnul ya ma deyo'an sultan Aretas. Sinoho' sigām anaggaw aku, manda' aku tinontonan pareyo' ma deyom ambung labay min tandawan ma ād da'ira. Jari makal'ppa aku.  <div eID="gen7559" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.11"/> <div eID="gen7555" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3766"/><div sID="gen7560" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Bay Magpasalupa ni si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7561" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3766"/> Magbantug gi' aku. Minsan halam aniya' pūsna, magsuli-suli aku pasal ai-ai bay magpasalupa ni aku min Panghū' Isa, sampay bay pamata'una ma aku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: Aniya' kata'uwanku dakayu' l'lla bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi bay tabowa pa'angkat ni sulga'. Aniya' na sangpū' maka mpat tahun palabay. Mbal kata'uwanku bang iya bay pa'angkat magbaran, atawa hal pinasalupahan. Tuhan sadja makata'u.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: Saguwā' kata'uwanku in l'lla itu bay tabowa pa'angkat ni lahat paliyama. Balikanku, mbal kata'uwanku bang baranna to'ongan atawa hal umagadna bay pinapehē', atawa bang iya bay pinasalupahan. Luwal Tuhan ya makata'u.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: Mahē' pa'in, pinakalehan iya kabtangan mbal wajib binissala e' manusiya'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: Patut du aku magbantug ma sabab a'a itu sagō' mbal aku magbantug-bantug ma baranku, luwal ma pasal kalammahanku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: Bang aku ganta' bilahi magbantug, ngga'i ka ula-ula sabab b'nnal sadja kamemon pah'llingku. Sagō' pahondong na aku magbantug-bantug, sabab mbal aku bilahi sinanglitan labi min kasab'nnalanna. Kabaya'anku sinanglitan ma pasal kahinanganku maka pamissalaku.  <div eID="gen7561" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3767"/><div sID="gen7562" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3767"/> Bay aku pinat'kkahan p'ddi', ya pinagbahasa ‘tugsuk ma isiku’, sali' hantang sosoho'an saitan pinabeya' anasat aku bo' supaya aku mbal makapagabbu ma bay pina'nda'an aku ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: Min t'llu aku bay angamu' junjung ni Panghū' pasal saki itu, bang pa'in nila'anan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: Sagō' anambung iya, yukna, “Sarang ma ka'a bang ka tabangku na pa'in. Minnē' asampulna' kawasaku, pagka ka'a mbal makakole'an di-nu.” Angkanna aku kinōgan magbantug ma pasal kalammahanku, sabab bang aku alamma, tananamku to'ongan kawasa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: Ya ina'an sababanna angkan aku kasulutan ma ai-ai at'kka ni aku, alamma ka baranku atawa pinagudju'-udju' aku, magtiksa' aku atawa pininjala', atawa pinalabayan min kasusahan indaginis. Sandalanku ina'an kamemon ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anku, sabab akosog aku ma waktu kalammaku.  <div eID="gen7562" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7560" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3768"/><div sID="gen7563" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Susa si Paul ma Pasal saga A'a Kurintu</title> <div sID="gen7564" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3768"/> Sali' aku dupang magpaheya-heya di-ku buwattitu. Sagō' min ka'am du, sabab bang aku bay paheyabi mbal aku bay amaheya di-ku. Minsan halam aniya' pūsku, mbal aku kalakbawan e' saga a'a ya magnahu'-nahu' in sigām muna-muna kawakilan e' Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: Bay na tahinang ma deyomanbi saga kahinangan ya pamandogahan a'a kawakilan Al-Masi. Bay na ta'nda'bi saga paltanda'an, saga hinang kawasahan maka hinang makainu-inu ya tahinangku hinabuku angimanan kasigpitan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: Ya sadja dusaku ma ka'am, halam aku bay mikibalanja' ma ka'am. Saddī minnē', sali' du bowahanku ma ka'am maka bowahanku ma saga palhimpunan jama'a si Isa kasehe'. Bang ya du he' kasā'anku, ampununbi pa'in aku.  <div eID="gen7564" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3769"/><div sID="gen7565" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3769"/> Agara' aku pi'ilu anibaw ka'am, kamint'lluku na. Mbal kam pabuhatanku sabab ngga'i ka alta'bi ya anguttku, luwal lasabi. Patut isab, sabab ngga'i ka matto'a ya niayuput e' anak, sagō' anak ya niayuput e' matto'a sigām. Maka ka'am ya sali' hantang panganakku.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: Kinōgan aku amuwanan ka'am kaniya'ku kamemon. Aho', paglilla'ku sampay baranku bang pa'in kam tatabangku. Bang pasōng lasaku ma ka'am, pakō' bahā' lasabi ma aku?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: Tantu kam am'nnal in ka'am halam bay pabuhatanku. Sagō' aniya' mailu ah'lling, in aku ataha' akkalku angulli'an sīnbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: Buwattingga pangulli'ku ka'am? Bay bahā' kam niakkalan e' saga a'a soho'ku pi'ilu?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: Bay amu'ku si Titus anibaw ka'am waktu palabay inān, maka aniya' isab danakantam dakayu' sinō' anehe'an iya. Bay kam kinulli'an bahā' e' disi Titus? Tantu mbal. Jari sali' du kami ma maksud maka ma palantara.  <div eID="gen7565" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3770"/><div sID="gen7566" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3770"/> Kalu isab pangannalbi in kami hal anganda'awahan di-kami, ya angkan kami amissala buwattē'. Sagō' amissala kami ma pang'nda' Tuhan, maka pamissala e' kami ai-ai ya patut pamissala saga a'a palsuku'an Al-Masi. Ai-ai nihinang e' kami, saga bagay, nihinangan ka'am supaya akosog pangandolbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: Agawa aku pi'iluku, ya aniya' ta'abutku pasaddī kaul-pi'ilna min kabaya'anku. Maka aku isab, kalu saddī kaul-pi'ilku min kabaya'anbi. Kagawahanku isab ya aniya' ta'abutku magsagga', magihid, al'kkas angastol. Kalu aniya' magokat-okat, maglimut-limutan, angalituhan suli-suli, magmalangkahi, maka magkasasawan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: Lāgi, ya kagawahanku pagbalikku, kalu aku pinareyo'-deyo' e' Tuhanku ma kamailuhanbi, ati taluwa' aku kasusahan ma sabab saga a'a bay makarusa ma waktu tagna', bo' pa'in halam gi' makapang'bba min kalumu'an bay tahinang sigām, buwat saga pagba'is maka paglango.  <div eID="gen7566" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.12"/> <div eID="gen7563" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3771"/><div sID="gen7567" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen7568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3771"/> Na, kamint'lluku na pi'ilu anibaw ka'am. Bang aniya' a'a mailu anuntutan sehe'na bay maghinang ala'at, subay beya'bi kal'ngnganan sara' ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab. Yuk-i, “Subay aniya' duwangan atawa t'llungan amuwan saksi' pasal panuntut bo' aniya' kab'nnalanna.”

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: Bay kam banda'anku ma l'ngnganku kaminduwa pi'ilu, sagō' balikanku buwattina'an ma kalikutku. Sasuku kam bay makarusa ma waktu tagna' sampay ka'am kasehe', mbal ka'ase'anku bang aku makapi'ilu pabīng.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: Bang kam hatulku, tantu du kam angahalap ma aku in aku taga-kapatut deyo' bay min Al-Masi. Mbal alamma Al-Masi bang takdil ni ka'am, tananambi du kawasana.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: Sabab minsan halam aniya' kawasa Al-Masi ma waktu kapangalansang iya ni hāg, allum na iya pabalik e' kawasa Tuhan. Damikiyanna kami saga kawakilan Al-Masi, sali' kami alamma isab pagka kami sōd ma iya. Saguwā' allum kami sambeya' maka iya ma sabab kawasa Tuhan, ya angkan akawasa pangahatul kami ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen7568" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3772"/><div sID="gen7569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3772"/> Ananding kam di-bi, anumariya kam di-bi, bo' kata'uwanbi bang b'nnal ajatu pangandolbi ma Al-Masi. Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi? Ilu si Isa Al-Masi pat'nna' ma deyom ataybi. Bang hati' halam, halam aniya' kajatuhan pangandolbi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in tata'ubi in pameya' kami ma Al-Masi ajatu to'ongan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: Angamu'-ngamu' kami ni Tuhan bang pa'in halam aniya' sā' ma ai-ai hinangbi. Ngga'i ka hinang kami ya angut kami subay binantug, ya sadja angut kami bang pa'in ta'nda' kajatu pangandolbi. Minsan pangannal e' saga a'a in hinang kami kulang ajatu, mbal pamagay kami.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: Mbal kami maka'atu ma kasab'nnalan, gom pa'in kami angisbat.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: Kinōgan kami minsan tabista alamma, bang pa'in akosog pameya'bi ma si Isa. Ya pangamu' kami ni Tuhan, bang pa'in kam asampulna' ma kaul maka pi'il.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: Ya ilu po'onna angkan aku anulatan ka'am pasal ai-ai itu hinabu aku makalikut, supaya kam angawal amahāp addatbi. Jari mbal aku anangguna kapatut ya pamuwan Panghū' Isa ma aku hal pamabukag. Gom pa'in gunaku pamakosog pangandolbi maka pangahatul kaul-pi'ilbi.  <div eID="gen7569" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7567" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3773"/><div sID="gen7570" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagaddat Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3773"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, tammat na. Ang'bba na aku min ka'am. Pagmatayinbi kasampulna'an ma kaul-pi'ilbi, ikutunbi panganjunjungku ma ka'am, magda'atay kam, maka tuyu'inbi kasannangan ma deyomanbi. Jari mailu Tuhan ma ka'am, ya po'onan lasa maka kasannangan.  <div eID="gen7571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3774"/><div sID="gen7572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3774"/> Bang kam maglanggal sumiyan-sumiyan subay kam magsiyum tanda' paglasabi.  <div eID="gen7572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3775"/><div sID="gen7573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3775"/> Saga pagkahibi suku' Tuhan maitu amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal sigām.  <div eID="gen7573" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3776"/><div sID="gen7574" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3776"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan min Panghū' Isa Al-Masi, maka lasa min Tuhan, maka kapagdakayu' atay min Rū Sussi. <div eID="gen7574" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7575" type="paragraph"/> <signed sID="gen7576"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7576"/>  <div eID="gen7575" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7570" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7471" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="2Cor.13"/> <div eID="gen7464" osisID="2Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, pinasampay ni ka'am maglahat ma Galatiya. Kawakilan aku magnasihat sagō' ngga'i ka pangwakil min manusiya'. Ngga'i ka isāb manusiya' bay angangg'llal aku. Tu'ud aku kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi, sampay e' Mma'tam Tuhan ya bay amakallum ma si Isa min kamatayna.

verses.name: Galatians 1:2
verses.text: Kami maka dauranakantam maitu, maguyun amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal kami ni ka'am saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi ma ba'anan palhimpunan ma lahat Galatiya.  <div eID="gen7584" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3777"/><div sID="gen7585" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3777"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan deyom atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan sampay e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Galatians 1:4
verses.text: Bay maglilla' amatay si Isa pamapuwas dusatam supaya kitam limaya min kala'atan ya taptap nihinang ma ahil jaman itu. Ya na kabaya'an Mma'tam Tuhan subay hinangna.

verses.name: Galatians 1:5
verses.text: Patut iya pinudji saumul-umul. Amin.  <div eID="gen7585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3778"/><div sID="gen7586" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dakayu' du Lapal Ahāp</title> <div sID="gen7587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3778"/> Landu' aku ainu-inu ma ka'am. Asa'ut pahāp kam pataikut min Tuhan ya bay amene' ka'am ma sabab ase' maka lasa Al-Masi! Apinda kam magtūy ni lapal saddī!

verses.name: Galatians 1:7
verses.text: Saguwā' halam aniya' kaōnan lapal ahāp bang saddī min lapal pasal si Isa. Atampal asal, aniya' a'a bilahi anasaw pikilanbi maka amindahan lapal pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Galatians 1:8
verses.text: Minsan kami, minsan isāb mala'ikat min deyom sulga', bang aniya' amandu' lapal saddī min bay panganasihat kami ma ka'am, a'a inān subay taluwa' mulka' saumul-umul.

verses.name: Galatians 1:9
verses.text: Balikanku bay pamissala kami dahū: bang aniya' amandu' lapal saddī min lapal ahāp ya bay taima'bi, a'a inān subay minulka'an.  <div eID="gen7587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3779"/><div sID="gen7588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3779"/> Kira-kirahunbi bang ai mohotku: sanglit min manusiya' atawa sanglit min Tuhan? Kabaya'anku bahā' anulut manusiya'? Bang aku bay bilahi anulut manusiya', mbal aku niōnan sosoho'an Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7588" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7586" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3780"/><div sID="gen7589" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Kawakilan e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7590" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3780"/> Saga danakanku, aniya' pamahatiku ka'am. Ya lapal pagnasihatku itu ngga'i ka min pikilan manusiya' ya paluwasanna.

verses.name: Galatians 1:12
verses.text: Halam bay tasambutku min manusiya', maka ngga'i ka manusiya' bay pagguruhanku. Tasambutku asal min si Isa Al-Masi, bay pamabukis ni aku.  <div eID="gen7590" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3781"/><div sID="gen7591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3781"/> Kata'uwanbi pasal kajarihanku tagna', waktu kapamogbogku ma agama Yahudi, bay apaslod paminjala'ku ma saga jama'a si Isa, ya pinagsambatan palhimpunan Tuhan. Kabaya'anku subay halam aniya' min sigām takapin allum.

verses.name: Galatians 1:14
verses.text: Bidda' du aku min saga topad-sibu'ku Yahudi bang takdil ni pangisbat ma agama kami. Atuyu' lagi' aku min sigām amogbog ma usulan bay min kamatto'ahan kami.  <div eID="gen7591" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3782"/><div sID="gen7592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3782"/> Sagō' tapene' aku e' Tuhan ma sabab ase'na maka lasana tudju ni aku. Pinene' asal aku ma halam gi' bay nianakan.

verses.name: Galatians 1:16
verses.text: Ya kahandak Tuhan ma aku subay kasakupanku pasal Anakna, bo' supaya aku makapagnasihat lapal ahāp ma pasalanna ni kabangsahan ngga'i ka Yahudi. Jari halam bay pangaruhanku sai-sai.

verses.name: Galatians 1:17
verses.text: Halam aku minsan patukad ni Awrusalam anibaw sigām ya bay kawakilan e' si Isa dahū min aku. Bay aku patūy kaleya ni lahat Arab, ati pagubus, pabīng aku ni da'ira Damaskus.  <div eID="gen7592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3783"/><div sID="gen7593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3783"/> Palabay pa'in t'lluntahun, patukad aku ni Awrusalam bo' magkata'u maka si Petros, ati pahanti' aku ma iya duwa pitu' t'ggolna.

verses.name: Galatians 1:19
verses.text: Saddī min si Petros, halam aniya' ta'nda'ku maina'an a'a kawakilan e' si Isa, luwal si Yakub ya siyali Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Galatians 1:20
verses.text: Saksi'ku Tuhan, b'nnal sadja ya panulatku itu. Ngga'i ka puting.

verses.name: Galatians 1:21
verses.text: Puwas ina'an, bay aku pehē' ni saga kaluma'an ma lahat Siriya sampay ma lahat Silisi.

verses.name: Galatians 1:22
verses.text: Ma waktu ina'an, mbal aku takilā e' saga jama'a Al-Masi ya ma ba'anan palhimpunan Al-Masi ma lahat Yahudiya.

verses.name: Galatians 1:23
verses.text: Ya sadja takale sigām habal pasal kapindaku min bay kajarihanku tagna'. Yuk habal e', “Pinasaplag lapal ahāp e' a'a bay angala'at kajama'ahan si Isa, nirapitan e'na bowahan pangandol ya bay sagga'na tagna'.”

verses.name: Galatians 1:24
verses.text: Jari pinudji Tuhan e' saga a'a ya makakale habal pasalan aku.  <div eID="gen7593" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gal.1"/> <div eID="gen7589" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3784"/><div sID="gen7594" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tinaima' si Paul e' saga A'a Kawakilan</title> <div sID="gen7595" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3784"/> Palabay pa'in sangpū' maka mpat tahun minnē', bay aku pabalik ni Awrusalam. Si Barnabas ya sehe'ku, maka bay bowaku isab si Titus.

verses.name: Galatians 2:2
verses.text: Angkan aku pehē' sabab aniya' pamabukis ni aku e' Tuhan subay beya'ku. Bay haka'anku saga a'a ma palhimpunan inān pasal lapal ya pagnasihatku ma a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi. Ngga'i ka kamemon ya binissalahan, hal saga a'a ya pangannalku pagnakura'an sabab nihanggaw aku. Kalu mbal tinaima' hinangku, ati halam aniya' pūs ma hulas-sangsā'ku. Sagō' kasulutan sigām,

verses.name: Galatians 2:3
verses.text: ati halam bay amogos si Titus subay ni'islam minsan iya bangsa Girīk.

verses.name: Galatians 2:4
verses.text: Aniya' palkala' asal pasal si Titus itu, sabab aniya' a'a bay palamud ma kami magbau'-bau' in sigām bebeya'an Al-Masi. Sagō' ya maksud sigām subay anipihan kaluhaya'an ya pinaniya'an kami e' si Isa Al-Masi pagka apuwas na min hatulan sara'. Tu'ud sigām bilahi amanyaga' kami pabīng.

verses.name: Galatians 2:5
verses.text: Malaingkan halam kami bay angaho' ma sigām minsan dansasa'at sabab ya pagmatayan kami subay pataptap ma ka'am in kasab'nnalan pasal si Isa.  <div eID="gen7595" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3785"/><div sID="gen7596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3785"/> Halam aniya' bay pinasugpat ni pamandu'ku e' saga pagnakura'an inān, ya pangannalku taga-kapatut. Mbal aheya ma atayku bang a'a taga-kapatut atawa halam, sabab sali'-sali' du a'a kamemon ma pang'nda' Tuhan.

verses.name: Galatians 2:7
verses.text: Halam aniya' pagsoway-soway sigām. Gom pa'in aku niakuhan e' sigām in aku b'nnal bay pangandolan e' Tuhan magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi ma saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi. Buwat isab si Petros, bay pangandolan e' Tuhan magnasihat ma bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Galatians 2:8
verses.text: Sabab min kawasa Tuhan ya angkan aku makapagnasihat ma bangsa kasehe'. Damikiyanna isab si Petros, min kawasa Tuhan isab angkan iya makapagnasihat ma bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Galatians 2:9
verses.text: Jari takilā aku e' disi Yakub, si Petros maka si Yahiya, ya taga-ōn ma palhimpunan sigām, in aku taga-barakat min Tuhan. Ati magsalam sigām maka aku maka si Barnabas, tanda' in kami dambeya'an maka sigām. Magtūy arakayu' gara' kami in kami subay magnasihat pehē' ni bangsa kasehe', ati sigām ya magnasihat na pa'in ma deyoman bangsa Yahudi.

verses.name: Galatians 2:10
verses.text: Ya sadja niamu' e' sigām bang pa'in kami angannal ma saga bebeya'an si Isa ya kulang-kabus ma deyoman sigām e'. Buwattē' isab katuyu'anku.  <div eID="gen7596" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7594" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3786"/><div sID="gen7597" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinulang si Petros e' si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3786"/> Na ma waktu dakayu', maina'an pa'in kami ma da'ira Antiyuk, bay pahanti' isab si Petros maina'an. Jari bay tampalku iya sabab aniya' hinangna inān mbal magtaluwa'.

verses.name: Galatians 2:12
verses.text: Tagna', bay iya makapagsalu maka saga jama'a Al-Masi ya ngga'i ka Yahudi. Saguwā' pagt'kka pa'in saga Yahudi bay pinapehē' e' si Yakub, paokat iya min bay paumpiganna inān, pagka tināw iya pinabukagan e' saga a'a t'kka baha'u. Yahudi asal sigām, ya amogbog na pa'in ma addat pagislam.

verses.name: Galatians 2:13
verses.text: Ya du tināw saga Yahudi kasehe', angkan sigām anunuran si Petros ati mbal na magsalu maka saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi. Minsan si Barnabas, abowa-bowa isab maghinang buwattē'.

verses.name: Galatians 2:14
verses.text: Pag'nda'ku hinang sigām mbal magtaluwa' maka pandu' b'nnal ya katōpan lapal ahāp, magtūy pah'llinganku si Petros ma matahan sigām kamemon. “Ka'a ilu,” yukku, “Yahudi ka, sagō' ameya' na ma addat bangsa saddī itu. Angay logosnu saga bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi subay amogbog addat Yahudi?  <div eID="gen7598" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3787"/><div sID="gen7599" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3787"/> “Ya b'nnalna, bangsa Yahudi kitam sabab tubu' min bangsa Yahudi, saddī min a'a kasehe', ya pinagbahasa ‘bangsa baldusa’.

verses.name: Galatians 2:16
verses.text: Saguwā' kata'uwan kami halam aniya' a'a niōnan abontol ma saukat na sara' agama ya bogbogna. Ya sadja binista abontol e' Tuhan bang a'a angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi. Kami bangsa Yahudi, angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, ati binista kami abontol e' Tuhan. Ngga'i ka ma sabab sara' agama ya ni'isbat, sabab halam aniya' binista abontol e' Tuhan minsan painay pamogbogna ma sara'.  <div eID="gen7599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3788"/><div sID="gen7600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3788"/> “Na, bang manyatakan in kami masi dusahan, hinabu kami pasōd ma Al-Masi bo' binista abontol, ai bahā' pah'llingta? Al-Masi bahā' ya sababan angkan kami magdusa? Tantu mbal!

verses.name: Galatians 2:18
verses.text: Bang aku saupama pabalik amogbogan sara' bay taikutanku, mattan in aku dusahan,

verses.name: Galatians 2:19
verses.text: sabab sapantun aku a'a amatay bang takdil ni sara' si Musa, supaya aku allum bang takdil ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Galatians 2:20
verses.text: Bang pina'amu, ang'bba na aku min bay kahālanku tagna', buwat ibarat a'a bay paunung ma Al-Masi pinapatay ma hāg. In kallumku buwattina'an ngga'i ka min baran-baranku, saguwā' min Al-Masi, ya pat'nna' ma deyom pangatayanku. T'ggolku allum ma dunya itu, angandol aku ma Anak Tuhan. Alasa iya ma aku sabab maglilla' iya amatay ma sababku.

verses.name: Galatians 2:21
verses.text: Mbal taikutanku lasa Tuhan maka ase'na. Bang bay kita makajari binista abontol ma sabab pamogbog sara' agama, kaliman kamatay Al-Masi ma sababtam!”  <div eID="gen7600" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gal.2"/> <div eID="gen7597" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3789"/><div sID="gen7601" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamogbog Sara' Atawa Pangandol ma si Isa</title> <div sID="gen7602" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3789"/> Ka'am saga a'a Galatiya, asā' pahāp akkalbi! Sai bay angakkalan ka'am? Bay kam kamattanan ma pasal kamatay si Isa Al-Masi ma hāg bo' niampun dusabi.

verses.name: Galatians 3:2
verses.text: Aniya' panilawku ma ka'am: bay kam anaima' Rū Tuhan ma sabab pamogbog ma sara' agama? Atawa ma sabab pangandolbi ma lapal ya takalebi?

verses.name: Galatians 3:3
verses.text: Dupang pahāp kam! Tagna' kam angandol, Rū Tuhan ya pasangdolanbi. Sagō' buwattina'an hulas-sangsā'bi ya pasangdolan.

verses.name: Galatians 3:4
verses.text: Pangannalbi bahā' halam aniya' kagunahan ma bay kalabayanbi sangay min tagna' kapangandolbi ma si Isa? Tantu aheya kagunahanna.

verses.name: Galatians 3:5
verses.text: Tuhan ya bay amuwanan ka'am Rū-na Sussi, maka bay amahinang saga hinang barakatan ma deyomanbi. Angay bahā'? Ma sabab pamogbogbi ma sara' atawa ma sabab pangikutbi maka pagkahagadbi ma lapal ahāp?  <div eID="gen7602" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3790"/><div sID="gen7603" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3790"/> Pikilunbi si Ibrahim ma masa awal e': “Bay am'nnal si Ibrahim ma pangallam Tuhan, ati tabista iya abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pam'nnalna.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:7
verses.text: Pahati kam, sasuku angandol ma Tuhan kaōnan panubu' si Ibrahim.

verses.name: Galatians 3:8
verses.text: Pinagkallam ma deyom Kitab pasal a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, in sigām isab binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pangandol sigām. Bay pata'una isab si Ibrahim pasal lapal ahāp ma halam gi' ta'abut waktuna. Yuk Tuhan ma si Ibrahim, “Binuwanan kahāpan ma sababnu saga manusiya' kamemon ma kaluha'an dunya.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:9
verses.text: Pinagsab'nnal e' si Ibrahim janji' Tuhan inān, ati kabuwanan iya kahāpan. Ya du sasuku magsab'nnal ma Tuhan, kabuwanan kahāpan isab buwat si Ibrahim, ya a'a pangangandol.  <div eID="gen7603" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3791"/><div sID="gen7604" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3791"/> Saguwā' sasuku amogbog sara' agama bo' supaya binista abontol e' Tuhan, taluwa' sigām mulka' Tuhan. Sabab tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Taluwa' mulka' sasuku mbal maka'ambat angahinang saga panoho'an kamemon ya tasulat ma Kitab Tawrat.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:11
verses.text: Na, pasti' to'ongan ko' itu. Halam aniya' binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab panoho'an-sara' ya bogboganna, sabab aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Taga-kallum kakkal sasuku binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pangandolna.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:12
verses.text: Wajib bogboganta sara' minsan mbal pangandolanta, buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Sasuku bilahi allum subay amogbog sara' maka panoho'anna kamemon, ma halam aniya' nilakaran minsan dakayu'.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:13
verses.text: Sagō' mbal ta'ambat binogbog panoho'an sara' kamemon, jari mulka' Tuhan ya kadalta. Malaingkan tal'kkat kitam e' Al-Masi min mulka', sabab iya ya bay makananam mulka' ganti'tam. Buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Bang a'a pinasagnat ma hāg pinapatay, a'a inān taluwa' mulka' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Galatians 3:14
verses.text: Tal'kkat kitam e' si Isa supaya saga kahāpan ya bay pamuwan ma si Ibrahim pasampay isab ni saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, labay min si Isa Al-Masi. Jari makataima' kitam Rū ya panganjanji' e' Tuhan ma sabab pangandoltam ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7604" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7601" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3792"/><div sID="gen7605" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sara' maka Janji' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7606" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3792"/> Saga danakanku, buwananta kam paralilan. Bang aniya' duwangan magsulut bo' bay na makapagsapa, tantu mbal kapindahan kapagsulutan sigā.

verses.name: Galatians 3:16
verses.text: Buwattē' isab bowahan janji' Tuhan. Bay iya anganjanji' ma si Ibrahim maka ma panubu'na, bo' ngga'i ka panubu' si Ibrahim kamemon ya kapanganjanji'an. Ya niōnan panubu'na itu dakayu' du, hatina Al-Masi.

verses.name: Galatians 3:17
verses.text: Buwattitu isab: aniya' kapagsulutan Tuhan bay pat'nna'na ma waktu kapanganjanji'na ma si Ibrahim. Jari palabay pa'in mpat hatus maka t'llumpū' tahun, aniya' sara' bay pat'nna'na. Malaingkan in kapagsulutan tagna' inān mbal kapindahan ma saukat na aniya' sara', maka janji' Tuhan inān mbal kapindahan.

verses.name: Galatians 3:18
verses.text: Bang saupama si Ibrahim bay pinahampitan pusaka' ma sabab kal'ngnganan sara', sali' halam aniya' kagunahan ma bay janji' Tuhan. Sagō' ya b'nnalna, kabuwanan iya pusaka' ma sabab kasi-lasa Tuhan ma iya, luwas min janji'na.  <div eID="gen7606" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3793"/><div sID="gen7607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3793"/> Na, bang buwattē' kahālanna, ai kagunahan sara'? Aniya' sara' bay pinasugpat e' Tuhan ni janji'na supaya tasayu e' manusiya' saga dusa sigām. Buwattē' na pa'in sampay ni waktu palahil pi'itu dakayu' tubu' si Ibrahim ya panganjanji'an e'. Bay pinat'nna' sara' inān labay min saga mala'ikat, maka si Musa ya magpati'llot amasampay sara' ni manusiya'.

verses.name: Galatians 3:20
verses.text: Sagō' halam aniya' magpati'llot kinagunahan ma waktu kapanganjanji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim. Luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu'.  <div eID="gen7607" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7605" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3794"/><div sID="gen7608" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Maksud Sara' Agama</title> <div sID="gen7609" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3794"/> Kalu tapikilbi aniya' palsagga'an ma sara' tasulat si Musa maka janji' Tuhan inān, sagō' halam, dakagara'an du. Bang bay aniya' sara' taga-kawasa amuwan kallum kakkal ma manusiya', makajari kitam niōnan abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab pamogbogta ma sara'. Saguwā' halam aniya' sara' buwattē',

verses.name: Galatians 3:22
verses.text: maka dusahan kitam manusiya' kamemon, sali' pinagagihan e' dusa, buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab. Malaingkan kabuwanan kitam kahāpan ya bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma sasuku angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7609" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3795"/><div sID="gen7610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3795"/> Sat'ggol halam pinalahil bowahan pangandol itu, in kitam manusiya' ibarat pilisu katambolan e' sara'. Subay pinabukis pasal pangandol ma si Isa bo' yampa kitam pinaluwas.

verses.name: Galatians 3:24
verses.text: Bini'at kitam e' sara' si Musa sat'ggol halam gi' pi'itu Al-Masi, supaya kitam binista abontol e' Tuhan bang iya palahil na ni dunya.

verses.name: Galatians 3:25
verses.text: Jari ta'abut na masa kapangandoltam ma si Isa, ati mbal na kitam pinagagihan e' sara'.  <div eID="gen7610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3796"/><div sID="gen7611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3796"/> Ka'am ilu, anak Tuhan du kam kamemon ma sabab pangandolbi ma si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi.

verses.name: Galatians 3:27
verses.text: Bay na kam pinandi tanda' saksi' in ka'am sōd na ma Al-Masi, ati kajarihan Al-Masi ya kajarihanbi na.

verses.name: Galatians 3:28
verses.text: Manjari halam aniya' pagbidda'an Yahudi maka ngga'i ka Yahudi. Halam aniya' pagbidda'an ata maka ngga'i ka ata. Halam aniya' pagbidda'an l'lla maka d'nda, sabab magdakayu' na kam kamemon pagka sōd na kam ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Galatians 3:29
verses.text: Pagga kam suku' ma Al-Masi, binista kam sali' panubu' si Ibrahim, ati kaniya'an kam kahāpan bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim e'.  <div eID="gen7611" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gal.3"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:1
verses.text: Palanjalku gi' pamandu'ku. Bang saupama aniya' onde'-onde' amatay mma'na, pamusaka' ma iya pangalta' mma'na he'. Sagō' sat'ggol halam gi' asangpot umulna mbal iya pinahampitan pamusaka'. Sapantun iya ata lagi'.

verses.name: Galatians 4:2
verses.text: Pinagbaya'an iya sampay pangalta'na e' saga a'a angulip iya. Subay ta'abut waktu bay panugila' e' mma'na bo' yampa aniya' kapatutna magbaya' ma alta' inān.

verses.name: Galatians 4:3
verses.text: Buwattē' isab kahālanta ma waktu tagna', hinabu kita onde'-onde' lagi', pinagbaya'an kita e' kaga'osan ya mbal ta'nda' mata.

verses.name: Galatians 4:4
verses.text: Saguwā' ta'abut pa'in waktu bay panugila' e' Tuhan, sinoho' e'na Anakna pi'itu ni dunya. Nianakan iya e' manusiya' supaya kitam makataima' kapatutan ya pamusaka' panganak. Bangsa Yahudi iya, nianakan ma deyo'an sara' agama, supaya tapaluwas e'na sasuku binanyaga' e' sara'.  <div eID="gen7612" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:5
verses.text: Saguwā' ta'abut pa'in waktu bay panugila' e' Tuhan, sinoho' e'na Anakna pi'itu ni dunya. Nianakan iya e' manusiya' supaya kitam makataima' kapatutan ya pamusaka' panganak. Bangsa Yahudi iya, nianakan ma deyo'an sara' agama, supaya tapaluwas e'na sasuku binanyaga' e' sara'.  <div eID="gen7612" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3797"/><div sID="gen7613" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3797"/> Pagga kam panganak Tuhan na, pinahōpan kam Rū si Isa ya anak Tuhan. Angkan kitam makajari na angōn Mma' ma Tuhan, ma sabab Rū-na ya pat'nna' ma deyom pangatayantam.

verses.name: Galatians 4:7
verses.text: Angkan kam mbal na kaōnan banyaga', sagō' panganak Tuhan na. Ati ma ka'am pusaka' kamemon ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma saga anakna, pagka anak Tuhan na kam.  <div eID="gen7613" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7608" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3798"/><div sID="gen7614" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasusa si Paul Pasal A'a Galatiya</title> <div sID="gen7615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3798"/> Ma waktu tagna', ma halam gi' kam ata'u ma Tuhan, sapantun kam banyaga' pinagbaya'an e' kaga'osan ya mbal ta'nda'.

verses.name: Galatians 4:9
verses.text: Sagō' magkata'u na kam maka Tuhan, kinilā kam e'na, jari angay kam pabalik pinagbaya'an e' kaga'osan ya halam aniya' kawasa atawa pūsna? Kabaya'anbi bahā' binanyaga' pabīng?

verses.name: Galatians 4:10
verses.text: Sabab ilu kam angisbat llaw mulliya maka bulan, musim maka tahun!

verses.name: Galatians 4:11
verses.text: Asusa aku ma pasalbi, kalu kaliman bay sangsā'ku ma deyomanbi.  <div eID="gen7615" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3799"/><div sID="gen7616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3799"/> Saga dauranakanku, aniya' panganjunjungku ni ka'am. Sengorinbi aku, sabab ya du aku bay anengoran ka'am. Halam aniya' la'at tahinangbi ma aku.

verses.name: Galatians 4:13
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi asal bay kahālanku waktu kahanti'ku ma ka'am tagna'. Bay aku t'kkahan saki, angkan aku bay pahanti' ma ka'am anganasihatan ka'am lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Galatians 4:14
verses.text: Halam aku bay palehombi, halam aku bay sulakbi, minsan kam kabuhatan ma sabab sakiku. Gom pa'in saginabi aku buwat e'bi anagina mala'ikat min Tuhan. Bay aku taima'bi buwat e'bi anaima' si Isa Al-Masi bang ganta' patibaw ni ka'am.

verses.name: Galatians 4:15
verses.text: Ai bay tumaluwa' ni kakōganbi tagna'? Saksi'anta kam, bang sadja makajari, bay kam lilla' angalugit matabi pangangganti' mataku.

verses.name: Galatians 4:16
verses.text: Bantahanbi na aku bahā', pagka aku amissala kasab'nnalan ma ka'am?  <div eID="gen7616" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3800"/><div sID="gen7617" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3800"/> Aheya pangannal saga a'a inān ma ka'am, sagō' aniya' maksud sigām mbal ahāp. Ya kabaya'an sigām subay kam niokat min aku bo' amanuyu' ma sigām sadja.

verses.name: Galatians 4:18
verses.text: Ahāp isab bang kam magpanuyu' bang pa'in ahāp maksudna. Ahāp bang aku mailu ma ka'am, sagō' labi-labi ahāp bang aku alikut.

verses.name: Galatians 4:19
verses.text: Ka'am saga anak-mpuku, kahunitan pikilanku pabīng ma pasalbi, buwat ibarat d'nda kahunitan bang anganak. Asigpit pikilanku ma pasalbi sat'ggol halam gi' ajatu kajarihan Al-Masi ma deyom pangatayanbi.

verses.name: Galatians 4:20
verses.text: Aheya kabaya'anku bang pa'in aku makamailu ma ka'am buwattina'an, bo' ahanunut pamissalaku ma ka'am. Sabab alengog pikilanku ma pasalanbi.  <div eID="gen7617" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7614" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3801"/><div sID="gen7618" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamaralilan pasal si Hagar maka si Sara</title> <div sID="gen7619" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3801"/> Aniya' tilawku ma ka'am: sasuku kam bilahi amogbog panoho'an-sara', kata'uwanbi bahā' ya tasulat ma deyom Tawrat?

verses.name: Galatians 4:22
verses.text: Tasulat pasal si Ibrahim, aniya' anakna l'lla duwa hekana. Dangan inān min atana si Hagar, dangan min si Sara, ya h'ndana po'on.

verses.name: Galatians 4:23
verses.text: Ya anakna min ata inān bay nianak buwat panganak kasehe' ma dunya itu. Sagō' bidda' anakna min h'ndana po'on, ya d'nda alimaya he', sabab anak panumanan bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen7619" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3802"/><div sID="gen7620" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3802"/> Na buwattitu hatulanna: in duwangan d'nda itu sali' dalil duwa pagsulutan Tuhan maka manusiya'. Jari in pagsulutan dakayu' bay min būd Turusina. Bang niralil, ya na si Hagar ya anganakan ata.

verses.name: Galatians 4:25
verses.text: Si Hagar itu sali' dalil būd Turusina mahē' ma lahat Arab. Taparalil isab iya ni da'ira Awrusalam ma patahunan ītu, sabab tabanyaga' isab saga a'ana.

verses.name: Galatians 4:26
verses.text: Sagō' in da'ira Awrusalam porol, ya ma deyom sulga', limaya asal. In iya pag-ina'an ma sasuku kitam angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: Galatians 4:27
verses.text: Aniya' ayat Kitab pasal Awrusalam, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7621"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7622"/>“Magkōg-koyag ka, arung,<l eID="gen7622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7623"/>minsan ka halam bay makalabay paganak!<l eID="gen7623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7624"/>Angolang ka patanog ma sabab kakōgannu,<l eID="gen7624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7625"/>minsan ka halam bay makananam p'ddi' panganak!<l eID="gen7625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7626"/>Sabab aheka lagi' anak ma h'nda ka'bbahan<l eID="gen7626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7627"/>min anak h'nda taga-paghola'.”<l eID="gen7627" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7621"/>  <div eID="gen7620" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3803"/><div sID="gen7628" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3803"/> Na, saga dauranakan, ka'am ilu sali' dalil anak panumanan janji' Tuhan, buwat si Isa'ak.

verses.name: Galatians 4:29
verses.text: Bistahunbi bay masa si Ibrahim e'. Ya anakna min si Hagar bay nianakan ma buwat paganak kasehe'. Aheya pa'in iya, bay iya angala'at danakanna, ya nianakan labay min barakat Rū Tuhan. Damikiyanna isab kitam ma buwattina'an, aniya' na pa'in pangala'at kitam.

verses.name: Galatians 4:30
verses.text: Kira-kirahunbi ya bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, “Pala'anunbi d'nda ata maka anakna, sabab mbal manjari binahagi'an pusaka' ya pang'bba anak min h'nda po'on, ya alimaya.”

verses.name: Galatians 4:31
verses.text: Manjari itu, saga dauranakanku, ngga'i ka kitam panganak d'nda ata. Panganak kitam d'nda alimaya, ya ngga'i ka ata.  <div eID="gen7628" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gal.4"/> <div eID="gen7618" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3804"/><div sID="gen7629" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaluhaya'an ma Sabab Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7630" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3804"/> Kitam itu, aluhaya na min bay pagbanyaga'an tagna', sabab pinuwasan kitam e' Al-Masi. Angkanna kam subay mbal pasagad binanyaga' pabalik. Subay kam patotog sadja ma kaluhaya'anbi.  <div eID="gen7630" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3805"/><div sID="gen7631" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3805"/> Ikutunbi bissala itu sabab baranku ya ah'lling: bang kam ganta' angaho' pinagislam bo' supaya kam binista abontol e' Tuhan, tahinangbi Al-Masi sali' halam aniya' gunana ma ka'am.

verses.name: Galatians 5:3
verses.text: Banda'anta kam to'ongan. Sasuku pinagislam ma buwat panoho'an-sara' tasulat si Musa, subay angisbat panoho'an-sara' inān kamemon.

verses.name: Galatians 5:4
verses.text: Sasuku kam magupama in ka'am binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab sara' ya bogboganbi, sali' kam ang'bba min Al-Masi. Alawak na kam min ase' maka lasa Tuhan.

verses.name: Galatians 5:5
verses.text: Saguwā' aholat kitam pinaniya'an kabontolan atay labay min Rū Sussi, ya po'on kitam angandol.

verses.name: Galatians 5:6
verses.text: Sabab bang kitam sōd na ma si Isa Al-Masi sali'-sali' du kitam kamemon ma pang'nda' Tuhan, ni'islam kitam maka halam. Ya sadja ahalga' ma Tuhan bang aniya' pangandoltam maka bang lasa ni pagkahi ya kat'kkahanna.  <div eID="gen7631" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3806"/><div sID="gen7632" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3806"/> Ahāp bay pameya'bi ma pandu' b'nnal pasal si Isa, ibarat a'a maglomba. Saguwā' sai bahā' bay amidjakan ka'am bo' kam pahondong ameya'?

verses.name: Galatians 5:8
verses.text: Ngga'i ka Tuhan, sabab iya ya bay amene' ka'am ameya' ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: Galatians 5:9
verses.text: Buwat lling kamatto'ahan, “Minsan dangkuri' du pasulig abuskag katibu'ukan addunan.”

verses.name: Galatians 5:10
verses.text: Sagō' makatantu aku labay min Panghū' Isa in kitam dauyunan du. Tantu isab tinambahan kabinasahan ya a'a anasaw pikilanbi, pinapagtongod e' Tuhan maka bay dusana, minsan sai-na.  <div eID="gen7632" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3807"/><div sID="gen7633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3807"/> Saga dauranakan, mbal aku bay pininjala' e' saga Yahudi bang bay masi pamandu'ku in addat pagislam subay binogbog. Sabab bang buwattē' pamandu'ku, halam aniya' sababan pagla'atan sigām atay ma pasal kamatay si Isa ma hāg.

verses.name: Galatians 5:12
verses.text: Ya kabaya'anku ma saga a'a ya anasaw pikilanbi ilu, gom lagi' sigām kapellengan laring tudju ni harapan sigām.  <div eID="gen7633" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3808"/><div sID="gen7634" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3808"/> Manjari ka'am, saga dauranakan, bay tapene' e' Tuhan bo' aluhaya min usulan sara'. Sagō' pahalli' kam, da'a dūlinbi napsu baranbi ma saukat na kam aluhaya na. Ahāp lagi' bang kam atukid magtabang-tiyabangi ma sabab lasabi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Galatians 5:14
verses.text: Ya na itu kamaujuran panoho'an-sara', tumabeya' kamemonna ma panoho'an dakayu' itu, ya yuk-i, “Kalasahinbi pagkahibi manusiya' buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi.”

verses.name: Galatians 5:15
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam magjingki-jingki maka magkosog-kosogan, buwat hantang ero' magl'kkob, subay kam ahalli' to'ongan sabab tantu kam makani-kala'atan.  <div eID="gen7634" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7629" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3809"/><div sID="gen7635" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Rū Tuhan atawa Napsu Manusiya'</title> <div sID="gen7636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3809"/> Aniya' pamissalaku ma ka'am: beya'unbi Rū Sussi magbaya' ma baranbi ati tantu mbal karūlan napsubi.

verses.name: Galatians 5:17
verses.text: Magbesod kabaya'an napsuta maka kabaya'an Rū Sussi. Mbal maguyun duwa ginis baya' itu, ya po'on kitam mbal makarapat angahinang ai-ai ya anguttam.

verses.name: Galatians 5:18
verses.text: Sagō' bang kitam pinagnakura'an e' Rū Sussi, puwas du kitam min pagbaya'an sara'.  <div eID="gen7636" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3810"/><div sID="gen7637" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3810"/> Atampal du saga kahinangan ya luwas min kajarihanta tagna': hinang kalumu'an d'nda maka l'lla, hinang kasabulan, pagba'is,

verses.name: Galatians 5:20
verses.text: paghulmat ma saga ta'u-ta'u, paghinang pantak, pagbanta maka pagbono', paglindi-lindi, pangastol, paglanga-langa min pagkahi, pagsu'al, pakaniya-kaniya tumpukan,

verses.name: Galatians 5:21
verses.text: pangandali'it ma pagkahi, paglami-lami makalandu', maka paglango. Aniya' gi' hinang sigām buwattē'. Balikanku bay pamituwaku ma ka'am waktu dahū, sai-sai maghinang saga hinang ala'at itu mbal to'ongan pinasōd ni deyom pagparintahan Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7637" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3811"/><div sID="gen7638" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3811"/> Saguwā' buwattitu ya kahinangan a'a pinagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan: patilasahun iya, taptap kalasiganna, asannang pamikilna, patilu'uyun iya ma pagkahina, patitabangun maka ahatul bowahanna. Kapangandolan iya,

verses.name: Galatians 5:23
verses.text: areyo' pagatayna, ata'u isab angahawid napsuna. Halam aniya' sara' makapagin'mbal ma hinang buwattē'.

verses.name: Galatians 5:24
verses.text: Manjari sai-sai magpasuku' ma si Isa Al-Masi pinahalam e' sigām kajarihan sigām tagna'. Sapantun sigām bay paunung ma Al-Masi amatay ma hāg. Hatina napsu maka baya' sigām kamemon pinahalam sabab mbal na karūlan.

verses.name: Galatians 5:25
verses.text: Kabuwanan kita kallum baha'u min Rū Tuhan, angkan kita subay ameya' pinagbaya'an e'na.

verses.name: Galatians 5:26
verses.text: Da'a kita magabbu-abbu, atawa anukas ma pagkahitam, atawa angalindi.  <div eID="gen7638" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Gal.5"/> <div eID="gen7635" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3812"/><div sID="gen7639" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magtabang-tiyabangi Kam</title> <div sID="gen7640" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3812"/> Saga dauranakanku, bang aniya' sehe'bi ilu ta'abut angahinang dusa, ka'am ya pinagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan subay amandu' ma iya bo' supaya ang'bba min dusana he'. Sagō' subay ahanunus pamandu'bi ma iya. Subay kam pahatul-hatul isab ma baranbi bo' mbal tabowa-bowa maghinang dusa.

verses.name: Galatians 6:2
verses.text: Magtabang-tiyabangi kam dangan maka dangan bang aniya' kabuhatan. Bang buwattē', bineya' e'bi panoho'an Al-Masi.

verses.name: Galatians 6:3
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a alanga atayna, pangannalna in iya ahāp min kasehe', a'a inān hal angakkalan di-na.

verses.name: Galatians 6:4
verses.text: Subay kam ananding di-bi kaniya-kaniya, bo' tata'ubi bang buwattingga kaul-pi'ilbi. Bang hati ahāp, makajari kam magkōg-koyagan di-bi. Da'a kam magbantug-bantug ma sabab aniya' hinangbi labi ahāp min hinang a'a dangan.

verses.name: Galatians 6:5
verses.text: Subay kitam ananggung ai-ai bay pangangganta' kitam dangan maka dangan.  <div eID="gen7640" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3813"/><div sID="gen7641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3813"/> Sasuku kam makapagguru pasal palman Tuhan subay anabang ma a'a pagguruhanbi. Pahampitinbi iya min ai-ai ahāp ya ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen7641" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3814"/><div sID="gen7642" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3814"/> Da'a kam asā' ma pamikilbi, mbal tarupang Tuhan. Buwat a'a magtanom, niani du e'na bang ai bay tanomna. Buwattē' du isab ma hinangan manusiya'.

verses.name: Galatians 6:8
verses.text: Bang a'a angandūlan napsuna karuhunan du la'atna ati tinungbasan iya kamatay saumul-umul. Bang a'a ameya' pinagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan, minnē' iya tinungbasan kallum kakkal ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Galatians 6:9
verses.text: Da'a kita sinumu maghinang ahāp. Sabab bang mbal bbahanta hinang ahāp, tantu kita katungbasan pahala' ma waktu sinosōng.

verses.name: Galatians 6:10
verses.text: Angkanna isab, subay kita maghinang kahāpan ma a'a kamemon sakahaba' waktu, ya lagi'na ma dauranakantam ya angandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen7642" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7639" type="section"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3815"/><div sID="gen7643" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7644" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3815"/> Nda'unbi katapusan sulat itu, sulatan tanganku ya aheya batang sulatna.

verses.name: Galatians 6:12
verses.text: Aniya' ilu ma ka'am saga a'a hal maglaku-laku pangā'an sigām bantug. Saga a'a ilu angalogos ka'am subay ni'islam. Tu'ud sigām tināw nila'at ma sabab pagsab'nnal sigām ma kamatay Al-Masi ma hāg.  <div eID="gen7644" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3816"/><div sID="gen7645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3816"/> Minsan saga a'a magislam ma buwat sara' si Musa, mbal ta'ambat binogbogan e' sigām panoho'an sara' he'. Pinogos kam e' sigām subay magislam, bo' supaya sigām makapagbantug in ka'am tapogos e' sigām.

verses.name: Galatians 6:14
verses.text: Saguwā', halam aniya' pagbantuganku saddī min kamatay Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Apuwas na aku min dusaku ma sabab kamatayna ma hāg inān, ati halam na aniya' baya'ku ma napsu dunya itu. Halam isab aniya' lamudku ma legot dunya.

verses.name: Galatians 6:15
verses.text: Mbal aheya ma atayku bang a'a pinagislam atawa halam. Ya sadja aheya ma atayku bang pinabaha'u kajarihanta e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Galatians 6:16
verses.text: Sasuku angaho' ma pamituwaku itu, mura-murahan bang pa'in sigām pinaniya'an kasannangan maka ka'ase'. Talapay isab saga a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon, ya pinagsambatan ‘Isra'il sin Tuhan’.  <div eID="gen7645" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3817"/><div sID="gen7646" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3817"/> Aubus na. Subay halam aniya' anasaw aku pabīng puwas itu, sabab aniya' limpa' bakat ma baranku, bainat in aku sosoho'an si Isa.  <div eID="gen7646" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3818"/><div sID="gen7647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3818"/> Saga dauranakanku, mura-murahan bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Amin. <signed sID="gen7648"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7648"/>  <div eID="gen7647" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7643" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7583" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Gal.6"/> <div eID="gen7577" osisID="Gal" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, a'a kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi min kahandak Tuhan. Pinabeya' sulat itu ni ka'am palsuku'an Tuhan ya maglahat ma Epesos, ya ahogot kapagdakayu'bi maka si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7655" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3819"/><div sID="gen7656" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3819"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan deyom atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7656" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3820"/><div sID="gen7657" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kahāpan min Haddarat Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7658" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3820"/> Pudjitam Tuhan, ya Mma' Panghū' Isa Al-Masi. Nilidjiki'an kitam e'na ma sabab kasōdtam ma Al-Masi, angkan kitam pinaniya'an kahāpan indaginis bay min haddarat Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:4
verses.text: Sabab pinene' kitam e' Tuhan ma halam gi' bay pinapanjari dunya itu, bo' pasōd ma Al-Masi ati bo' asussi pangatayantam ma halam aniya' tamaktam ma pang'nda' Tuhan. Lasana ya sababan

verses.name: Ephesians 1:5
verses.text: angkan iya bay agara' min awal lagi' in kitam subay tahinangna anak, sabab min kahinangan si Isa Al-Masi. Min kōgna maka baya' angkan buwattē' kagara'anna.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:6
verses.text: Patut iya sinanglitan ma sabab ase'na maka lasana ya mbal tapula'-pula', ya pangahilasna ma kitam labay min Anakna kinalasahan.  <div eID="gen7658" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3821"/><div sID="gen7659" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3821"/> Nil'kkat kitam min hukuman ma sabab Al-Masi, labay min laha' sin kamatayna, hatina niampun dusatam e' Tuhan. Mamarahi aheya ase'na maka lasana,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:8
verses.text: ya pagmurana ma kitam! Nihinang e' Tuhan ma buwat maksudna, min pangita'una kamemon maka min panahu'anna. Pamata'una na ni kitam bang ai kamaksuranna, ya bay halam kinata'uwan e' manusiya' dahū, hatina Al-Masi ya kinahandakan e' Tuhan anuman maksudna.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:9
verses.text: ya pagmurana ma kitam! Nihinang e' Tuhan ma buwat maksudna, min pangita'una kamemon maka min panahu'anna. Pamata'una na ni kitam bang ai kamaksuranna, ya bay halam kinata'uwan e' manusiya' dahū, hatina Al-Masi ya kinahandakan e' Tuhan anuman maksudna.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:10
verses.text: Ya itu maksud Tuhan, ya pinaniya' ma sinosōng bang maujud na kamemon: in ai-ai pinapanjari kamemon, ai na ka ma deyom sulga', ai na ka ma dunya itu, subay pinapagdakayu' ma deyo'an Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7659" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3822"/><div sID="gen7660" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3822"/> Tahinang kamemon ya minaksud maka kinahandak e' Tuhan, ati kami ya pinene' nihinang palsuku'anna, pagka sōd ma Al-Masi. Maksudna ko' itu, min awal tagna' lagi',

verses.name: Ephesians 1:12
verses.text: in kami itu, ya bay dumahū angaholatan Al-Masi, subay amuwan sababan pananglit Tuhan ma sabab kamahaldika'na.  <div eID="gen7660" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3823"/><div sID="gen7661" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3823"/> Buwattē' du isab ma ka'am. Bay kam angandol ma Al-Masi, waktu kakalebi lapal b'nnal, ya lapal ahāp pasal kalappas ka'am min hukuman. Maka pamuwan e' Tuhan Rū-na Sussi ma ka'am, buwat bay panganjanji'na bo' aniya' tanda' palsaksi'an in ka'am suku'na na.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:14
verses.text: Rū Sussi itu pamatantu in kitam anambut ai-ai bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma saga a'ana, ati minnē' kitam makatantu in a'a palsuku'an Tuhan pinalimaya to'ongan du ma sinosōng. Jari sinanglitan Tuhan ma sabab kamahaldika'na.  <div eID="gen7661" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7657" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3824"/><div sID="gen7662" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu' si Paul ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7663" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3824"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan aku mbal pahali magsukul ni Tuhan ma pasalanbi sangay min waktu kakaleku habal pasal pangandolbi ma Panghū' Isa maka ma pasal lasabi ma a'a palsuku'an Tuhan kamemon. Kinannal na pa'in kam sakahaba' waktu kapangamu'ku duwa'a,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3824"/><div sID="gen7662" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu' si Paul ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7663" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3824"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan aku mbal pahali magsukul ni Tuhan ma pasalanbi sangay min waktu kakaleku habal pasal pangandolbi ma Panghū' Isa maka ma pasal lasabi ma a'a palsuku'an Tuhan kamemon. Kinannal na pa'in kam sakahaba' waktu kapangamu'ku duwa'a,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:17
verses.text: ati abut-abut aku angamu' junjung ni Tuhan ya pagtuhanan Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi maka pag'mma'antam mahaldika'. Ya pangamu'ku bang pa'in iya amahōp Rū-na ni ka'am bo' kam binuwanan panahu'an alalom maka panghati pasal kahandak Tuhan, ati bo' pasōng pangita'ubi ma iya.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:18
verses.text: Amu'ku isab bang pa'in pinasawa akkalbi bo' kasakupanbi to'ongan bang ai pangaholatanbi angkan kam pinene' e' Tuhan. Kabaya'anku isab subay kasakupanbi bang ai pamusaka' e' Tuhan ma ka'am saga a'a palsuku'anna, hatina saga lidjiki' mamarahi ahāp.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:19
verses.text: Bang pa'in isab kata'uwanbi kawasana landu' apaslod, kawasa mbal tapula'-pula', ya makahāp kitam sasuku angandol ma iya. Dasali' kawasa Tuhan itu maka kosog barakatna

verses.name: Ephesians 1:20
verses.text: ya bay pamakallumna Al-Masi pabīng min kamatayna. Puwas e', pinatingkō' iya ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan, mahē' ma sulga'.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:21
verses.text: Pinabangsa na iya, alanga to'ongan min binangsa mala'ikat maka min ai-ai kamemon taga-kawasa, min bangsa pananasat maka min pagnakura'an indaginis ya ma diyata' ayan. Alanga kag'llal Al-Masi min kag'llal kamemon, ma dunya itu sampay ma ahirat.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:22
verses.text: Pinat'nna' e' Tuhan ai-ai kamemon ma deyo' pād-tape' si Isa bo' pinagbaya'an e'na. Jari gin'llal iya pagmakōkan ma palhimpunan saga jama'ana kamemon.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:23
verses.text: ya dalil pagdayaw pamasugpat baranna, ya amuwan kajatuhan ma ai-ai kamemon.  <div eID="gen7663" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Eph.1"/> <div eID="gen7662" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3825"/><div sID="gen7664" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapinda min Kamatay ni Kallum</title> <div sID="gen7665" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3825"/> Na, ma waktu palabay in ka'am ilu bay sali' a'a patay ma pang'nda' Tuhan ma sabab salla' maka dusa ya tahinangbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:2
verses.text: Bay kam ameya'an addat-tabi'at ala'at ya pameya'an saga a'a baldusa ma dunya itu. Pameya'anbi isab nakura' saitan, ya pagnakura'an saga bangsa mananasat min diyata' ayan, ya pameya'an isab e' saga manusiya' agagga ma panoho'an Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:3
verses.text: Maglamugay asal kitam maka saga a'a inān magdūlan napsutam, maghinang ai-ai makahāp palasahan barantam, abowa-bowa e' hona'-hona'tam asabul. Bay kitam dasali' maka manusiya' kasehe' angkan kitam pagmulka'an e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7665" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3826"/><div sID="gen7666" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3826"/> Daipara aheya ka'ase' Tuhan. Apaslod lasana

verses.name: Ephesians 2:5
verses.text: angkan kitam pinakallum e'na sambeya' maka Al-Masi, minsan kita bay sali' sapantun patay ma sabab bay kahinangantam ala'at. Min ka'ase' Tuhan maka min lasana ya angkan kam lappasan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:6
verses.text: Pinakallum kitam sambeya' maka Al-Masi, ati pinapagdakayu' kitam maka iya bo' magbaya' maka iya minna'an min lahat sulga'.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:7
verses.text: Buwattē' hinang Tuhan bo' supaya ta'nda'an di-na salama-lama in ase'na maka lasana mahal-mahal du pa'in, mbal to'ongan tasipat. Ta'nda' asal ma kahinangan si Isa Al-Masi bang buwattingga kahāp Tuhan tudju ni kitam.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:8
verses.text: Sabab min ase' maka lasa Tuhan ya angkan kam lappasan, ma sabab pangandolbi ma Al-Masi. Ngga'i ka min kahinanganbi, tu'ud pamuwan Tuhan ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen7666" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3827"/><div sID="gen7667" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3827"/> Mbal kam makapagmalangkahi ma baranbi, sabab ngga'i ka min hulas-sangsā'bi ya angkan kam lappasan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:10
verses.text: Hinangan Tuhan du kita, tapabaha'u e'na ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pasōranta, bo' supaya ta'ambatta saga hinang ahāp ya pangangganta'an kita e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7667" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7664" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3828"/><div sID="gen7668" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapagdakayu' saga Bebeya'an Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7669" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3828"/> Jari entomunbi bay kahālanbi dahū. Saddī bangsa kam, ya pinagsambatan e' saga Yahudi “a'a halam bay makalabay pagislam”. Ya pangōn saga Yahudi di-sigam: “Bangsa magi'islam”, sabab aniya' bainat hinangan manusiya' ma kuwit baran sigām.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:12
verses.text: Entomunbi, bay kam alawak asal min Al-Masi ma waktu tagna' inān. A'a liyu kam halam aniya' lamud ma bangsa Isra'il, ya bangsa palsuku'an Tuhan. Halam isab aniya' lamudbi ma kapagsulutan ya bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma saga a'a suku'na. Bay halam aniya' holatanbi ma dunya itu, lāgi halam aniya' Tuhan pana'atanbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:13
verses.text: Daipara ma buwattina'an, in ka'am bay alawak sidda min Tuhan pinasekot na sabab min kamatay Al-Masi ati sōd na kam ma iya.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:14
verses.text: Sabab baran Al-Masi bay amowahan kitam kasannangan, ati dabangsa na kitam, bangsa Yahudi maka ngga'i ka. Pinahalam e' si Isa agpang ya bay makabahagi'-duwa bangsatam, hatina pinahalam e'na bay pagbantahan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:15
verses.text: Tinangbus na e' Al-Masi in sara' agama maka panoho'anna bay pamogbogan bangsa Yahudi. Ya maksudna, in bay duwa bangsa subay dabangsa na, bangsa baha'u, pagka sōd sali'-sali' ma iya. Jari maghāp na kitam, magsulut-siyuluti.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:16
verses.text: Lāgi pinapaghāp maka Tuhan sigām karuwa bangsa, labay min kamatay si Isa ma hāg. Pinahalam e'na pagbantahan Yahudi maka bangsa saddī.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:17
verses.text: Bay pi'itu Al-Masi anganasihatan kitam kamemon, ka'am ya bay alawak min Tuhan maka ka'am ya asekot. Ya panganasihatna ni kitam, makajari na kitam maghāp maka Tuhan

verses.name: Ephesians 2:18
verses.text: sabab in kitam kamemon makapagbalharap na maka Tuhan labay min Al-Masi pagka tinabangan sali'-sali' e' Rū-na dakayu'-kayu'.  <div eID="gen7669" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3829"/><div sID="gen7670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3829"/> Hatina in ka'am ngga'i ka Yahudi mbal na kaōnan a'a liyu atawa a'a saddī, sabab dabangsa na kam maka saga a'a bay palsuku'an Tuhan tagna'. Dampalanakan kam ma okoman Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:20
verses.text: Jari in kitam kamemon sali' dalil luma'. Bay nihinang papaganna e' saga a'a kawakilan si Isa maka e' saga kanabihan, bo' si Isa Al-Masi ya sali' dalil batu pamahogot kamemonna.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:21
verses.text: Al-Masi ya pamabatukan pagdayaw maka panyapna kamemon, bo' pasōng heyana sampay tahinang langgal pangarapan ni Panghū'.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:22
verses.text: Ka'am isab, pagka sōd na kam ma Al-Masi, sali' dalil pagdayaw luma'. Pinapagdakayu' kam, pinapagbatuk bo' kam manjari luma' pat'nna'an Tuhan, sabab min Rū-na ya pat'nna' ma deyom pangatayanbi.  <div eID="gen7670" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Eph.2"/> <div eID="gen7668" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3830"/><div sID="gen7671" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Magnasihat ma saga A'a Ngga'i ka Yahudi</title> <div sID="gen7672" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3830"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan aku angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ma pasalbi. Aku si Paul, pilisu Al-Masi ma sabab ka'am ya bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:2
verses.text: Tantu takalebi pasal hinang bay pama'atas ma aku e' Tuhan sabab min ase'na maka lasana, hinang pamowa ka'am ni kahāpan.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:3
verses.text: Bay aku pinabukisan e' Tuhan maksudna ya halam bay kinata'uwan e' manusiya'. Bay na kam sulatanku pasal itu, sagō' kapu'utanna hal.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:4
verses.text: Jari bassahunbi sulat itu bo' tahatibi bang ai bay pinabukis ni aku pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:5
verses.text: Halam itu bay pinata'u ni manusiya' ma masa awal, sagō' pinabukis na e' Rū Sussi ni saga a'a kawakilan maka ni kanabi-nabihan asussi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:6
verses.text: Ya na itu bay pamabukis e': dambeya'an na saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi maka bangsa Isra'il ma sabab lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi ya tapagsab'nnalbi na. Sapantun sigām pagdayaw baran dakayu'-kayu', maka sali'-sali' sigām pinaniya'an janji' pagka sōd si Isa Al-Masi na.  <div eID="gen7672" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3831"/><div sID="gen7673" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3831"/> Bay aku kabuwanan hinang e' Tuhan subay magnasihat lapal ahāp, ati katulunan aku kapandayan min kawasana.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:8
verses.text: Areyo' aku min saga a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon, sagō' nihāp aku e'na. Sinō' aku angalapal ni saga a'a bangsa ngga'i ka Yahudi pasal anughala' mbal tapula'-pula' ya pamaniya' sigām min Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:9
verses.text: Sinō' aku amahati manusiya' kamemon ma pasalan maksud Tuhan bang buwattingga kal'ngngananna. Halam bay pinabukis maksud itu ni sai-na sangay min awal tagna'. Tu'ud bay kinuli-kulihan asal e' Tuhan, ya magpapanjari ma kamemon.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:10
verses.text: Jari ya na itu maksud Tuhan: subay pinahati saga bangsa mala'ikat maka bangsa ga'osan ma diyata' ayan pasal kalalom pangita'u Tuhan ma indalupa ginis, ya pinaluwas e'na labay min palhimpunan saga jama'a Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:11
verses.text: Ya na ko' itu maksud Tuhan bay niniyat e'na dahū lagi' min awal tagna', ya tatuman e'na labay min si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:12
verses.text: Alimaya na kitam pasōd sampay ni haddarat Tuhan, mbal na tināw sabab Al-Masi ya parakayu'antam maka pangandolantam.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:13
verses.text: Angkan amu'ku ni ka'am, da'a bbahinbi pangimanbi ma sabab aniya' katiksa'an kalabayanku itu. Ma kahāpbi du angkan subay pagkoyaganbi.  <div eID="gen7673" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7671" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3832"/><div sID="gen7674" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu'-ngamu' ma Pasal saga A'a Epesos</title> <div sID="gen7675" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3832"/> Angkanna aku pasujud ma alopan Mma'tam Tuhan,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:15
verses.text: ya po'onan ma pag'mma'an kamemon, ai na ka ma sulga', ai na ka ma dunya.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:16
verses.text: Angamu' aku duwa'a ni Tuhan bang pa'in kam paniya'anna kawasa luwas min barakatna mbal tapula'-pula', labay min Rū-na Sussi ya pat'nna' ma iman-nyawabi.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:17
verses.text: Ya angutku bang pa'in pataptap Al-Masi ma deyom pangatayanbi ma sabab pangandolbi ma iya. Angamu' aku junjung isab bang pa'in ahogot lasabi sapantun kayu alalom gamutna, atawa luma' ahāp papaganna.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:18
verses.text: Bang pa'in kam maka a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon pinaniya'an barakat bo' kasakupanbi lasa Al-Masi, luhana, langana, taha'na, maka lalomna.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:19
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kata'uwanbi lasa itu, ya mbal tat'kkad e' pangita'u manusiya', bo' supaya kam tinulunan manglabi-labihan min katubus Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3833"/><div sID="gen7676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3833"/> Na, mahaldika' ni Tuhan, ya taga-kawasa maghinang kahāpan ma pangatayanbi paliyu to'ongan min ai-ai amu'tam maka min ai-ai tahimangkantam.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:21
verses.text: Wajib iya pinagmahaldika'an ma deyomantam saga jama'ana maka ma deyoman si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'antam, waktu ni waktu sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin!  <div eID="gen7676" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Eph.3"/> <div eID="gen7674" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3834"/><div sID="gen7677" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagda'atay saga Bebeya'an Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7678" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3834"/> Na, pagka aku pilisu ma sabab pameya'ku ma Panghū'tam, aniya' amu'ku ni ka'am: angutunbi palantara ya tōp ma sasuku pinene' e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:2
verses.text: Subay areyo' pangatayanbi, subay ahanunut bissalabi maka subay kam angimanan pagkahibi. Magka'inagon kam dangan-parangan, tanda' lasabi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:3
verses.text: Amanuyu' kam magsulut-siyuluti bo' taptap kapagdakayu'bi atay, ya pamuwan ka'am e' Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:4
verses.text: Kitam magpangandol sali' dalil pagdayaw baran Al-Masi, bo' baranna dakayu' du. Dakayu' du Rū Tuhan maka dakayu' du isab pangaholatantam, waktu kapamene' Tuhan ma kitam.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:5
verses.text: Dakayu' du Panghū', dakayu' du pangandolantam, maka dakayu' du pagpandi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:6
verses.text: Dakayu' du Tuhan ya pag'mma'an ma binangsa manusiya' kamemon. Magnakura' iya ma kamemon, ta'abut kamemon e' kawasana maka itiya' na iya ma deyom ataytam kamemon.  <div eID="gen7678" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3835"/><div sID="gen7679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3835"/> Binuwanan kitam kapandayan pakaniya-pakaniya, ai-ai ya pangangganta' e' Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:8
verses.text: Buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7680"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7681"/>“Waktu ka'angkatna ni sulga'<l eID="gen7681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7682"/>aheka pilisu bay tabowana.<l eID="gen7682" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7683"/>Ati pamuwanna kahāpan ma manusiya'.”<l eID="gen7683" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7680"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:9
verses.text: Na, buwattitu hatian ya yukna he', “pariyata' ni sulga'”. Hatina in iya bay pareyo' ni dunya itu dahū, ni deyo'na katapusan, bo' yampa pariyata'.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:10
verses.text: Jari ya a'a bay pareyo', iya isab bay pa'angkat pabalik ni liyu saga langit, bo' supaya aliput e'na kamemon.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:11
verses.text: In iya isāb bay amuwan saga a'a kawakilan magnasihat, maka a'a taga-kapandayan amaluwas bissala Tuhan, maka a'a magpasaplag lapal ahāp, maka a'a ata'u amandu' maka angupiksa' saga jama'a.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:12
verses.text: Ya po'on aniya' kapandayan buwattē' ma kajama'ahan Al-Masi, bo' supaya asakap saga a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon maghinang ai-ai, maka supaya pahogot gom pa'in saga pagdayaw ya pagsambatta baran Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:13
verses.text: Jari maka'abut du kitam kamemon pinapagdakayu' atay ma pangandoltam maka ma pangita'utam pasal Anak Tuhan. Jari ajatu kitam ma kaul maka pi'il buwat kajatu Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7679" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3836"/><div sID="gen7684" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3836"/> Mbal na kitam sali' onde'-onde' halam aniya' panahu'anna, mbal na ‘tabowa pap'llay e' baliyu atawa goyak,’ hatina pandu' indalupa ginis ya pinahinang e' saga guru pangangakkal, panganjallat ma sasuku mbal gi' asangpot.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:15
verses.text: Padpad kitam kaddasan ma kaonde'-onde'tam, gom gi' kitam amanuyu' magbissala kasab'nnalan luwas min lasatam dangan-parangan, ati pasangpot kitam ma kaul maka pi'il bo' pasali' ni Al-Masi. In iya pagmakōkantam maka kitam sapantun pagdayaw baranna,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:16
verses.text: ati magbatuk-biyatuki ba'anan pagdayaw itu, magsugpat pahāp min ugat ya karalosanna. Jari bang ajatu na kahinangan pagdayaw kamemon, pasulig du katibu'ukantam. Buwattē' isab ma kitam baran Al-Masi, maglasa-liyasahi kitam bo' ajatu kahinangantam dangan maka dangan, ati tantu aniya' kasōngantam.  <div eID="gen7684" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7677" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3837"/><div sID="gen7685" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaul-pi'il ya Tōp ma A'a Sōd ma Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7686" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3837"/> Magbanda' aku ma ka'am sabab aniya' kapatutku min Panghū'tam. Pahali kam ameya' ma kasuddahan saga a'a ya mbal magta'at ni Tuhan, ya kulang pūs ma pamikil sigām.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:18
verses.text: Kalaungan akkal sigām maka halam aniya' lamud sigām ma kallum ya pamuwan e' Tuhan. Tu'ud sigām magmatuwas di-sigām angkan mbal ata'uwan iya.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:19
verses.text: Mbal sigām ata'u aiya', gom pa'in sigām angandūlan di-sigām maghinang kasabulan makamaru. Paddas sigām maghinang kalumu'an duhun manduhun.  <div eID="gen7686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3838"/><div sID="gen7687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3838"/> Sagō' ngga'i ka buwattē' ya pakata'ubi pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:21
verses.text: Tantu kam bay makakale ma pasalna, bay kam pinandu'an kasab'nnalanna labay min lapal ahāp pasal si Isa.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:22
verses.text: Angkanna kam subay ang'bba min bay kabiyaksahanbi tagna'. Bbahinbi kajarihanbi tagna', waktu kam tabowa-bowa e' saga napsu baran pangangakkal.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:23
verses.text: Subay kam pinabaha'u to'ongan ma itikadbi maka panahu'anbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:24
verses.text: Sulugunbi kajarihanbi baha'u (sapantun badju') ya pinaniya'an ka'am e' Tuhan bo' kam makasali' ni iya ma kabontolan maka kasussihan atay.  <div eID="gen7687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3839"/><div sID="gen7688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3839"/> Angkan ko' kitam subay pataikut min pagputing. Ai-ai pah'llingta ma pagkahita subay b'nnal sadja, sabab dambeya'an kitam, sapantun pagdayaw baran Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:26
verses.text: “Bang kam ganta' angastol, pahalli' kam bo' mbal tabowa angahinang ala'at.” Da'a buku-bukuhinbi pangastolbi sampay ni kakohapan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:27
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' halam aniya' lawang pasōran nakura' saitan anasat ka'am.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:28
verses.text: Bang a'a bay panangkaw subay ang'bba min pagtangkawna. Subay iya amiha pagusaha alaba, jari bang manglabi-labihan na aniya' du pa'in panulungna ma saga a'a miskin.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:29
verses.text: Da'a kam amaluwas bissala asabul. Ai-ai pamissalabi subay panabang sadja ma kasehe'anbi, pamahāp panghati sigām ma ai-ai kagunahan. Bang buwattē', aniya' kasōngan ma sasuku makakale.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:30
verses.text: Da'a pabakatunbi atay Rū Sussi min Tuhan, ya pinatulunan ka'am bo' aniya' palsaksi'an in ka'am pinalimaya du ma llaw damuli.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:31
verses.text: Timaninbi koto'-koto' deyom ataybi kamemon, maka astolbi. Da'a pakawasunbi ataybi, da'a kam angamahit atawa angalimut, da'a isab kam anganjingki ma sai-sai.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:32
verses.text: Saguwā' hāpunbi sehe'bi, ka'ase'inbi. Magampun-iyampuni kam, buwat bay pangampun ka'am e' Tuhan sabab min Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7688" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Eph.4"/> <div eID="gen7685" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:1
