verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3840"/><div sID="gen7689" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Kahinangan Abontol</title> <div sID="gen7690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3840"/> Panganak Tuhan na kam landu' kinalasahan, angkan kam subay ameya'-meya'an kajarihanna.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:2
verses.text: Subay kam alasa na pa'in, buwat kalasa Al-Masi ma ka'am. Bay paglilla'na baranna ni kamatay ma sababbi, tinukbal ni Tuhan sali' dalil pagkulban, sali' lalabotan ahāp hamutna pamasulut atay Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3841"/><div sID="gen7691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3841"/> Ka'am ilu, pagka kam palsuku'an Tuhan, subay mbal na maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla atawa maghinang kahina'an, atawa dumasiyaw magnapsu ai-ai. Mbal tapagsuli-suli saga kahinangan buwattē'.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:4
verses.text: Mbal apatut isab bang kam maglaka'-laka' atawa magsuli-suli karupangan atawa maglata kasabulan. Ya patut hinangbi magsukul ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:5
verses.text: Pata'u kam to'ongan, sasuku maghinang kasabulan, atawa magkahina'an d'nda maka l'lla, atawa bahaya pilak, napsuna ya pagtuhanan a'a inān. Tantu halam aniya' lamudna ma deyom pagparintahan Al-Masi maka Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:6
verses.text: Painsap kam bo' mbal ka'akkalan e' bissala halam pūsna. Haka'anta ka, dusa buwattē' ya sababan angkan pinataluwa'an mulka' e' Tuhan saga a'a agagga ma iya.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:7
verses.text: Angkan kam banda'anku, da'a kam palamud ma saga a'a buwattē'.  <div eID="gen7691" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3842"/><div sID="gen7692" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3842"/> Tagna', bay kam sapantun ma deyom kalendoman, sagō' ma karanta'an na kam sabab Panghū' Isa ya pasōranbi. Subay ahantap maka asaltun kajarihanbi pagka kam a'a ma deyom karanta'an na.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:9
verses.text: Sasuku ma deyom karanta'an, kahāpan maka ka'adilan maka kasab'nnalan ya kamattihanna.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:10
verses.text: Panuyu'inbi ai-ai makasulut atay Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:11
verses.text: Da'a kam palamud ma hinang halam pūsna, ya nihinang na pa'in ma kalendoman. Padpad kam palamud, gom pa'in patanyagunbi la'atna.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:12
verses.text: Makaiya'-iya' ya nihinang e' saga a'a ma deyom limbung, subay mbal minsan pinagsuli-suli.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:13
verses.text: Sagō' ta'nda'an di-na ai­-ai kamemon bang taluwa' kasawahan,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:14
verses.text: sabab asawa asal. Angkan takallam ma ayat Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7693"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7694"/>“Ka'a atuli ilu, abati' na ka.<l eID="gen7694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7695"/>Pabangun ka min kamataynu,<l eID="gen7695" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7696"/>ati taluwa' ka kasawahan Al-Masi.”<l eID="gen7696" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7693"/>  <div eID="gen7692" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3843"/><div sID="gen7697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3843"/> Jari pahatul-hatul kam bo' ahāp bowahanbi ma kaul maka pi'il. Palalomunbi akkalbi, da'a beya'-beya'unbi akkal karupangan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:16
verses.text: Tukirinbi hinang ahāp sakahaba' waktu, sabab aheka kala'atan nihinang ma patahunan ītu.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:17
verses.text: Da'a kam magkarupangan, sagō' patukid kam anganad bang ai kahandak Panghū'tam pamahinangna ka'am.  <div eID="gen7697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3844"/><div sID="gen7698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3844"/> Da'a kam maglango binu sabab makamula ko' inān. Ahāp lagi' kam kahōpan e' Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:19
verses.text: Bang kam maglanggal maka pagkahibi jama'a Al-Masi, paggunahunbi bissala min Kitab, maka kalangan ginisan pamudjibi Tuhan. Magkalangan kam pamudjibi Tuhan, pamaheyabi iya, luwas min bowa'bi maka min deyom ataybi.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:20
verses.text: Subay kam magsukul ni Mma'tam Tuhan sakahaba' waktu ma pasal ai-ai kamemon, sabab Panghū' Isa Al-Masi ya pamanyabutanbi.  <div eID="gen7698" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7689" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3845"/><div sID="gen7699" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal A'a Maglakibini</title> <div sID="gen7700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3845"/> Subay kam magmalulus dangan maka dangan, pagka Al-Masi ya pagta'atanbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:22
verses.text: Ka'am kar'ndahan, subay asulut ma kabaya'an h'llabi, buwat kasulutbi ma Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:23
verses.text: H'llabi ya pagmakōkanbi, buwat Al-Masi ya pagmakōkan ma kitam saga a'ana. Manglalappas asal iya.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:24
verses.text: Magmalulus ma iya saga jama'ana kamemon, damikiyanna ka'am kar'ndahan subay magmalulus ma h'llabi ma ai-ai kabaya'an sigām.  <div eID="gen7700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3846"/><div sID="gen7701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3846"/> Ka'am kal'llahan, kalasahinbi h'ndabi, buwat ka-e' Al-Masi alasahan kitam saga a'ana. Bay paglilla'na baranna pinapatay ma sabab kitam,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:26
verses.text: supaya kitam pinasuku' ma Tuhan sadja. Sinussi kitam e' Al-Masi min lapalna maka min bohe',

verses.name: Ephesians 5:27
verses.text: bo' supaya halam aniya' dusa panā'an kitam, maka halam aniya' tamaktam, atawa limpa' atawa salla'. Jari aninag kitam kajama'ahanna ati tinaima' e'na sapantun pangantin d'nda.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:28
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am kal'llahan, subay alasahan h'ndabi buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi. Bang kam alasa ma h'ndabi, sali' kam alasahan ginhawa-baranbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:29
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' ab'nsihan baranna, gom pa'in pakanna maka pahilala'na pahāp, buwat kapahilala' Al-Masi ma kitam saga jama'ana,

verses.name: Ephesians 5:30
verses.text: sabab sapantun kitam pagdayaw baranna.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:31
verses.text: Tasulat ko' itu ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Ya na itu sababanna angkan a'a ang'bba min ina'-mma'na, bo' papūn ni h'ndana. Jari dabaran na sigām karuwangan.”

verses.name: Ephesians 5:32
verses.text: Alalom bissala inān, mbal agon tahati. Bang ma bistahanku, Al-Masi maka kajama'ahanna ya sinambat inān.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:33
verses.text: Malaingkan ka'am kal'llahan subay alasahan kah'nda'anbi buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi, maka ka'am kar'ndahan subay magaddatan kah'lla'anbi.  <div eID="gen7701" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Eph.5"/> <div eID="gen7699" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3847"/><div sID="gen7702" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Magtautai'anak</title> <div sID="gen7703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3847"/> Ka'am saga onde'-onde', beya'unbi pami'at ina'-mma'bi, sabab patut ko' itu ma sasuku angandol ma Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:2
verses.text: Ikutunbi panoho'an bay tasulat ma Kitab, ya muna-muna panoho'an sinugpatan janji' e' Tuhan. Yuk-i, “Wajib kam magaddatan mma'bi maka ina'bi.”

verses.name: Ephesians 6:3
verses.text: Maka buwattitu sugpatna, “bo' supaya kam makani-kahāpan, sampay ataha' umulbi maitu ma dunya.”  <div eID="gen7703" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3848"/><div sID="gen7704" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3848"/> Ka'am saga matto'a, subay ahanunut bowahanbi ma saga anakbi bo' mbal mandā'-dā'. Ya pami'atbi maka pamandu'bi ma sigām subay makasulut atay Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7704" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7702" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3849"/><div sID="gen7705" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ata maka Tag-Ata</title> <div sID="gen7706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3849"/> Ka'am saga ata, beya'unbi panoho'an nakura'bi maitu ma dunya. Ya hinangbi ma sigām subay hilas min atay pote', buwat Al-Masi ya paghinanganbi. Subay kam magmatāw maka magaddat ma sigām.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:6
verses.text: Subay ahāp hinangbi, ngga'i ka hal ma waktu kapangaliling sigām ma ka'am, supaya kam nihulmat e' sigām. Hinangunbi panoho'an sigām hilas min deyom ataybi ma sabab Al-Masi ya pa'atahanbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:7
verses.text: Hinangunbi pahāp ai-ai pamahinang ka'am sabab ngga'i ka hal manusiya' ya paghinanganbi, sampay isab Panghū'tam.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:8
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanbi asal, sai-sai ahāp hinangna, ata maka ngga'i ka, tinungbasan iya ahāp e' Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen7706" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3850"/><div sID="gen7707" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3850"/> Ka'am saga nakura', subay ahatul addatbi ma saga panendogbi. Da'a sanggupinbi, sabab dakayu' du nakura' ya magnakura'an ka'am sali'-sali', nakura' ka atawa ata. Ya na si Isa ya pagnakura'anbi ma deyom sulga', ya mbal amapagbidda' manusiya' bang angahukum.  <div eID="gen7707" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7705" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3851"/><div sID="gen7708" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panyap Pangatu ma Nakura' Saitan</title> <div sID="gen7709" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3851"/> Buwattitu ya pamituwaku katapusan: pahogotunbi na pangandolbi sabab Panghū' Isa ya parakayu'anbi. Paggunahunbi kosogna akawasa.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:11
verses.text: Sapantun kam sundalu binowa magbono', angkan kam subay magpanyap maka panyap kamemon ya pamuwan e' Tuhan pangatubi, bo' kam maka'atu ma nakura' saitan.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:12
verses.text: Ngga'i ka pagkahi manusiya' ya sehe'ta magbono', sagō' binangsa mananasat ya makapagbaya' ma tonga'an ayan, maka bangsa mbal ta'nda' mata, ai-ai taga-ga'os atawa ntan, sampay ba'anan kawasa ma deyom kalendoman.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:13
verses.text: Angkan kam soho'ku: sakapunbi na panyap kamemon ya pamuwan ka'am e' Tuhan. Jari bang pat'kka llaw kapanasat ka'am e' saitan, aniya' na pangatubi ati mbal kam tara'ug. Bang ta'ambatbi kamemon ya pamahinang ka'am e' Tuhan, tantu kam mbal angaku-da'ug.  <div eID="gen7709" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3852"/><div sID="gen7710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3852"/> Manjari patanam kam buwat ibarat sundalu. Pakambotunbi kasab'nnalan pangahampan hawakanbi. Gunahunbi hinang abontol panampan daggahabi.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:15
verses.text: Subay kam asakap magpatanyag lapal pasal kapaghāp Tuhan maka manusiya'. Ya he' sali' sapantun pataumpa'bi.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:16
verses.text: Bowahunbi pangandolbi sakahaba' waktu bo' tasagangbi pana' arokot, hatina ai-ai panasat ka'am e' saitan ya patila'atun.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:17
verses.text: Kannalunbi pangita'ubi in ka'am tantu lappasan. Ya he' sali' saruk basi' pangagpang kōkbi. Pangatuhunbi palman Tuhan, sapantun kalis pamuwan ka'am e' Rū Tuhan pakokosbi.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:18
verses.text: Subay kam taptap anabbut ni Tuhan labay min Rū-na. Amu'-amu'unbi ni iya ai-ai kasusahanbi sakahaba' waktu, min kawasa maka kata'u ya pamuwan Tuhan ma ka'am. Da'a kam sinumu pajaga, angabut-ngabut kam angamu'an tabang saga pagkahibi suku' Tuhan kamemon.  <div eID="gen7710" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3853"/><div sID="gen7711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3853"/> Amu'inbi isab aku tabang ni Tuhan bang pa'in aku buwananna bissala ma waktu kapagnasihatku, bo' aku makatawakkal amahati saga a'a pasal lapal ahāp, ya pinabukis na e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:20
verses.text: Bay aku kawakilan magnasihat lapal itu, angkan aku itiya' na ma deyom kalabusu. Angamu'-ngamu' kam ni Tuhan, bang pa'in aku aesog magpasaplag palman buwat bay pama'atas aku e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7711" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7708" type="section"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3854"/><div sID="gen7712" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3854"/> Papi'iluku ni ka'am si Tikikus, danakantam kinalasahan, a'a kapangandolan isab ma kahinanganna tudju ni Panghū'tam. Pi'ilu du iya amowahan ka'am habal pasal ai-ai kamemon ya makani-kami itu. Kahaka'an isab kam bang ai na pa'in kahālanku maka hinangku, maka bang ai kahālan kami itu kamemon. Pinahogot e'na pangatayanbi.  <div eID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3854"/><div sID="gen7712" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3854"/> Papi'iluku ni ka'am si Tikikus, danakantam kinalasahan, a'a kapangandolan isab ma kahinanganna tudju ni Panghū'tam. Pi'ilu du iya amowahan ka'am habal pasal ai-ai kamemon ya makani-kami itu. Kahaka'an isab kam bang ai na pa'in kahālanku maka hinangku, maka bang ai kahālan kami itu kamemon. Pinahogot e'na pangatayanbi.  <div eID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3855"/><div sID="gen7714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3855"/> Buwattitu pangamu'-ngamu'ku ma pasal saga dauranakan mailu: bang pa'in sigām pinaniya'an kasannangan atay maka lasa maka pangandol ahogot, deyo' min Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:24
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kaniya'an tatabangan kamemon saga a'a ya taptap lasa sigām ma Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. <signed sID="gen7715"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7715"/>  <div eID="gen7714" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7712" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7654" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Eph.6"/> <div eID="gen7649" osisID="Eph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min si Paul maka si Timuti, duwangan sosoho'an si Isa Al-Masi. Pabeya' kami pi'ilu ni ka'am saga a'a sōd si Isa Al-Masi kamemon ya maglahat mailu ma Pilipi, beya' isab pagmatto'ahanbi maka saga a'abi magpanabang.  <div eID="gen7723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3856"/><div sID="gen7724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3856"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan sampay e' Panghū' Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7724" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3857"/><div sID="gen7725" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu'-ngamu' maka Pagsukul si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3857"/> Aheya pagsukulanku ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu bang kam taentomku.

verses.name: Philippians 1:4
verses.text: Sakahaba' waktu kapanambahayangku, akōd aku angamu'an ka'am kahāpan kamemon,

verses.name: Philippians 1:5
verses.text: sabab taentomku bay tabangbi ma aku magnasihat lapal ahāp, sangay min waktu tagna' sampay ni kabuwattituhan.

verses.name: Philippians 1:6
verses.text: Makatantu aku pasal hinang ahāp ya tinagna'an e' Tuhan ma deyom pangatayanbi, sabab tantu tukiranna sampay ta'abut llaw kapi'itu pabalik si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7726" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3858"/><div sID="gen7727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3858"/> Patut aku magka'inagonan ka'am kamemon, sabab itiya' kam taptap ma pangatayanku. Bay kam palamud kamemon ma hinang ya pamasuku' aku e' Tuhan. Bay aku gapi'bi, minsan ma kapagsambungku himumungan maka saga a'a ya anulang pagnasihatku, minsan maitu ma deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Philippians 1:8
verses.text: Saksi'ku Tuhan, b'nnal sadja pah'llingku ya yukku aheya pangentomku ma ka'am. Alasa aku ma ka'am buwat lasa Al-Masi ma aku.  <div eID="gen7727" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3859"/><div sID="gen7728" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3859"/> Angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in aku ni Tuhan ma pasalbi, bang pa'in magkak'nnop na pa'in paglasabi dangan maka dangan, sampay pangita'ubi harap ni Tuhan. Bang pa'in pasōng isab akkalbi bo' ahāp e'bi amikilan ai-ai,

verses.name: Philippians 1:10
verses.text: ati bo' kam makatali' bang ai ya hinangbi ahāp katapusan. Bang tatali'bi pahāp, tantu alanu' ataybi, maka halam aniya' dusa panā'an ka'am bang at'kka llaw kabalik Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 1:11
verses.text: Pin'nno'an du kam kahāpan indaginis labay min si Isa Al-Masi ma addat-tabi'atbi, ati pinudji Tuhan maka sinanglitan ma sababbi.  <div eID="gen7728" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7725" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3860"/><div sID="gen7729" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangalabusu ma si Paul Ahāp Kaluwasanna</title> <div sID="gen7730" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3860"/> Saga dauranakanku, kabaya'anku subay kata'uwanbi in pakaradja'an kalabayanku itu ahāp sadja kamattihanna, sabab minnē' pasaplag gom pa'in lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 1:13
verses.text: Kinata'uwan na e' saga jaga ma deyom astana' itu maka saga a'a kamemon ma jadjahan ītu, in aku kinalabusu ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anku.

verses.name: Philippians 1:14
verses.text: Jari pahogot lagi' pangandol kaheka'an saga danakantam suku' Panghū' Isa ma sabab kili-kili ya pangengkot aku itu, ati pasōng katawakkal sigām amasaplag lapal Tuhan. Mbal na sigām tināw.  <div eID="gen7730" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3861"/><div sID="gen7731" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3861"/> Ya b'nnalna aniya' saga a'a kasehe' magnasihat pasal Al-Masi ma sabab pangihid maka pangalindi sigām. Sagō' aniya' kasehe'an magnasihat min atay pote'

verses.name: Philippians 1:16
verses.text: ma sabab lasa sigām ma aku. Kinata'uwan asal e' sigām in aku bay pinamaitu min kahandak Tuhan bo' t'nggehanku lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Philippians 1:17
verses.text: Magnasihat pasal Al-Masi saga a'a angalindi inān, sagō' magduwa baihu' sigām sabab ya maksud sigām to'ongan subay karuhunan susaku hinabuku ma deyom kalabusu.  <div eID="gen7731" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3862"/><div sID="gen7732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3862"/> Saguwā' minsan buwattē', mbal pamagayku. Gom pa'in aku kinōgan bang pa'in pinagnasihat Al-Masi, ai na ka min atay pote', ai na ka min panganjingki. Maka taptap du kakōganku,

verses.name: Philippians 1:19
verses.text: sabab kata'uwanku in aku pinaluwas du min deyom kalabusu, labay min pangamu'-ngamu'bi ni Tuhan. Tinabang isab aku e' Rū si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 1:20
verses.text: Ya angutku to'ongan, maka holatanku, bang pa'in aku mbal karapatan ma hinang bay pamasuku' aku e' Tuhan. Bilahi aku anawakkal sakahaba' waktu, ya lagi'na ma waktu itu, bo' supaya aniya' sanglit ma Al-Masi min ai-ai hinangku, ma kallumku ka atawa ma kamatayku.

verses.name: Philippians 1:21
verses.text: Sabab ahalga' ma atayku Al-Masi sat'ggolku allum. Maka bang aku ganta' amatay na, labi ahāp to'ongan.

verses.name: Philippians 1:22
verses.text: Bang pina'amu, sat'ggol halam ta'abut ganta'anku, paheka gom pa'in kahinanganku ajatu. Sagō' dalam duwa gi' aku. Mbal kata'uwanku bang ingga ya subay pene'ku, ni kamatay atawa ni kallum.

verses.name: Philippians 1:23
verses.text: Magduwa-ruwa deyom pikilanku. Bilahi aku amutawan minnitu bo' pa'atag ma Al-Masi, sabab labi hāpna bang kita ma atagna na.

verses.name: Philippians 1:24
verses.text: Sagō' muna-muna ahalga' ma ka'am bang pinataha' lagi' umulku.

verses.name: Philippians 1:25
verses.text: Manantuhi aku bang ingga ya makahāp ka'am, angkan aku mbal gi' amutawan min ka'am. Maitu lagi' aku ma ka'am bo' supaya pasōng pangandolbi maka kakōganbi.

verses.name: Philippians 1:26
verses.text: Jari bang aku makamailu ma ka'am pabīng, aku ya sababan angkan manglabi-labihan kakōg-koyagbi.  <div eID="gen7732" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3863"/><div sID="gen7733" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3863"/> Na, minsan ai paniya', pahantapunbi palantarabi bo' makatōp ma saga a'a ya angisbat lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi. Jari minsan aku mailu ma ka'am, atawa hal pinahabalan sadja ma pasal kahālanbi, kata'uwanku du in ka'am dauyunan sadja. Kata'uwanku isab in ka'am magdakayu' amogbogan lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Philippians 1:28
verses.text: Da'a kam tināw ma saga a'a ya amantahan ka'am, minsan kam ni'inay. Sabab bang ta'nda' e' sigām in ka'am mbal tapakitāw, nahas ko' inān pamata'u sigām in sigām magka'at du, maka ka'am ya lappasan ma sabab katabang Tuhan ma ka'am.

verses.name: Philippians 1:29
verses.text: Ahāp ya pangangganta' Tuhan ma ka'am ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anbi, ngga'i ka hal pamarassayabi ma iya, lāgi makananam kam kabinsana'an isab ma pasalanna.

verses.name: Philippians 1:30
verses.text: Sabab ilu kam binowa magsu'al maka saga a'a ya magpanagga' lapal ahāp, buwat bay ta'nda'bi ma aku waktu kapagsu'alku maka a'a kasehe'. Maka takalebi isab buwattina'an in aku masi binowa magsu'al.  <div eID="gen7733" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Phil.1"/> <div eID="gen7729" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3864"/><div sID="gen7734" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Addat Al-Masi ya Panunurantam</title> <div sID="gen7735" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3864"/> Na, kata'uwanku ahogot imanbi ma sabab pagbeya'bi maka Al-Masi. Kauli'an kasusahanbi ma sabab lasana maka aniya' kapagdakayu'bi atay sabab min Rū Sussi. Aheya isab kasi-lasabi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:2
verses.text: Manjari, pagga buwattē' kahālanbi, pajatuhun lagi' kakōganku. Magdakayu' kam ma pamikilbi, papagsali'-sali'unbi lasabi, magda'atay kam to'ongan. Bang aku beya'bi buwattē', jukup du pa'in kakōganku.

verses.name: Philippians 2:3
verses.text: Ai-ai hinangbi subay da'a min pangihidbi atawa min kabaya'anbi magmalangkahi. Subay areyo' sadja pangatayanbi. Bistahunbi pagkahibi ilu alanga gi' min ka'am.

verses.name: Philippians 2:4
verses.text: Da'a pikilunbi kahāpan ni baranbi sadja, saguwā' magka'inagon kam dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:5
verses.text: Ya pangatayanbi subay pasali' ni buwat pangatayan si Isa Al-Masi. <lg sID="gen7736"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7737"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:6
verses.text: Tuhan asal iya min ka'asalna,<l eID="gen7737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7738"/>sagō' halam tapikilna in kapagdakayu'na maka Tuhan subay gomgomanna.<l eID="gen7738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7739"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:7
verses.text: Gom pa'in bbahanna kaniya'na kamemon,<l eID="gen7739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7740"/>ati maglilla' iya magpa'ata.<l eID="gen7740" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7741"/>Bay iya magpabaran manusiya' pi'itu ni dunya,<l eID="gen7741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7742"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:8
verses.text: pasengod iya ni kajarihan manusiya'.<l eID="gen7742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7743"/>Bay iya magpareyo' di-na,<l eID="gen7743" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7744"/>ati beya'na kabaya'an Tuhan sampay ni kamatay,<l eID="gen7744" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7745"/>minsan pinapatay ma hāg.<l eID="gen7745" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7746"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:9
verses.text: Angkan iya pinalanga e' Tuhan ni langa katapusan.<l eID="gen7746" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7747"/>Kabuwanan iya ōn alanga min ōn kamemon,<l eID="gen7747" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7748"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:10
verses.text: bo' magsujuran ni iya binangsa ai-ai kamemon,<l eID="gen7748" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7749"/>ai na ka ma sulga', ai na ka ma dunya,<l eID="gen7749" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7750"/>ai na ka isab ma deyom ahirat.<l eID="gen7750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7751"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:11
verses.text: Magpasab'nnal sigām kamemon<l eID="gen7751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7752"/>in si Isa Al-Masi Panghū' to'ongan,<l eID="gen7752" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7753"/>maka Mma'tam Tuhan ya pinagmahaldika'an.<l eID="gen7753" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7736"/>  <div eID="gen7735" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7734" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3865"/><div sID="gen7754" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sawa Pamasawa Dunya</title> <div sID="gen7755" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3865"/> Manjari itu, saga bagay kalasahanku, beya'unbi na pa'in pamituwaku buwat bay sakahaba'. Bay asal beya'bi ma kamailuku lagi', sagō' luba'-lagi'na na bang aku alikut. Isbatunbi Tuhan, pagmatāwinbi, hinabubi amanuyu' bo' tatuman kalappasbi.

verses.name: Philippians 2:13
verses.text: Sabab Tuhan ya angahinang na pa'in ma deyom pangatayanbi bo' aniya' baya'bi maka kosogbi angahinang ai-ai pangahandakna.  <div eID="gen7755" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3866"/><div sID="gen7756" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3866"/> Hinangunbi ai-ai panoho'an ka'am ma halam aniya' karugalan atawa panganjawabbi,

verses.name: Philippians 2:15
verses.text: supaya halam aniya' la'at atawa salla' panā'an ka'am. Jari anak Tuhan na kam halam taga-tamak minsan kam palamud ma saga a'a ya abengkok pikilan sigām maka ala'at kasuddahan sigām. Sapantun kam bitu'un asahaya amuwan sawa ma b'ttong langit,

verses.name: Philippians 2:16
verses.text: salta' ka'am amasampay lapal min Tuhan ni saga a'a ma dunya itu, lapal makabuwanan sigām kallum taptap. Bang hinangbi ina'an, pamantuganku ka'am bang ta'abut llaw kabalik Al-Masi, sabab ka'am ya sali' bainat in hinangku maka sangsā'ku taga-kamattihan du.  <div eID="gen7756" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3867"/><div sID="gen7757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3867"/> Na, ya pangandolbi ma Al-Masi sali' dalil pagkulban tinukbalan ni Tuhan. Maka bang aku saupama pinapatay, laha'ku sali' dalil lalabotan pamajukup ni pagkulbanbi. Jari mbal aku magang-ang amutawanan nyawaku, gom pa'in aku magbeya' maka ka'am magkōg-koyagan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:18
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am ilu, subay kam kinōgan na pa'in sampay ameya' ma kakōganku.  <div eID="gen7757" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7754" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3868"/><div sID="gen7758" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Timuti maka si Epaprode</title> <div sID="gen7759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3868"/> Agara' aku amabeya' si Timuti pasa'ut pi'ilu, bang kabaya'an Panghū' Isa isab. Jari bang iya pabīng pi'itu amowahan aku habal pasal kahālanbi, aheya kalasiganku.

verses.name: Philippians 2:20
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' angatu ma si Timuti itu bang takdil ni pagka'inagon ma ka'am.

verses.name: Philippians 2:21
verses.text: Kaheka'an saga a'a itu hal angannal ma baran sigām sadja, mbal angannal pasal pakaradja'an si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 2:22
verses.text: Sagō' kata'uwanbi si Timuti maka kahatulna. Bay iya anabangan aku magnasihat lapal ahāp, buwat panabang a'a ma mma'na.

verses.name: Philippians 2:23
verses.text: Angkan aku magniyat amapi'ilu si Timuti, sago' subay kata'uwanku dahū bang ai tum'kka ni aku.

verses.name: Philippians 2:24
verses.text: Pasangdol isab aku ma Panghū' Isa, bang pa'in aku makasaunu' ni ka'am.  <div eID="gen7759" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3869"/><div sID="gen7760" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3869"/> Bang ma kumpasanku ahāp subay pabalikku ni ka'am danakanku si Epaprode, ya bay soho'bi pi'itu anabangan aku. Sehe'ku iya maghinang ni Tuhan, gapi'ku angosogan lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Philippians 2:26
verses.text: Angentom iya ma ka'am kamemon, maka asusa isab iya pagka takalebi habal pasal sakina.

verses.name: Philippians 2:27
verses.text: B'nnal bay abangat sakina, arak iya amatay, manda' iya kina'ase'an e' Tuhan. Ya du aku kina'ase'an, sabab bang iya ganta' bay amatay, magduruhun karukka'anku.

verses.name: Philippians 2:28
verses.text: Angkanna aheya baya'ku amabalik iya ni ka'am, bo' kam kinōgan pag'nda'bi ma iya, ati pahantap bay kasusahanku.

verses.name: Philippians 2:29
verses.text: Sampangunbi iya pahāp luwas min pagkōg-koyagbi, sabab Panghū' Isa ya pameya'anbi sali'-sali'. Pagaddatinbi saga a'a ya pasali' ni si Epaprode itu,

verses.name: Philippians 2:30
verses.text: sabab arak to'ongan iya amatay ma sabab hinangna tudju ni Al-Masi. Bay panūkna kallumna, bang pa'in iya paganti' min ka'am amatuntul aku.  <div eID="gen7760" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Phil.2"/> <div eID="gen7758" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3870"/><div sID="gen7761" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ya Pasangdolan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7762" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3870"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, ya itu katapusanna: magkōg-koyag kam ma sabab Panghū'bi si Isa. Mbal makainay ma aku bang aku anulatan ka'am pabalik pasal itu, bang pa'in kam asalamat.  <div eID="gen7762" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3871"/><div sID="gen7763" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3871"/> Halli'inbi saga a'a maghinang kala'atan ilu, ya sapantun ero' landu' ab'ngngis. Tagihan sigām anganggali'an kuwit a'a, bainat in sigām suku' Tuhan.

verses.name: Philippians 3:3
verses.text: Sagō' haka'anta kam, kitam ya taga-bainat b'nnal. Amudji kitam ni Tuhan sabab min Rū-na Sussi, maka magkōg-koyag isab kitam ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi. Halam aniya' pasangdolantam ma hinangan baran.

verses.name: Philippians 3:4
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku subay taga-pasangdolan ma hinangan baran, aniya' du kahinangan ma aku. <div eID="gen7763" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7764" type="paragraph"/> Bang pangannal saga a'a kasehe' aniya' kapatutan sigām pasangdol ma pamogbog sigām ma agama, luba'-lagi'na na aku.

verses.name: Philippians 3:5
verses.text: Sabab ta'abut pa'in walung'llaw min bay kapaganak ma aku, ni'islam aku ma buwat addat kami Yahudi. Bangsa Isra'il aku, panubu' si Benjamin asal kamatto'ahanku. Porol aku bangsa Hibrani. Bang takdil ni pamogbog ma sara' agama Yahudi, umpigan Parisi aku ya atukid amogbog ma sara' agama.

verses.name: Philippians 3:6
verses.text: Landu' aku atukid ma agama Yahudi, ya po'on bay pinjala'ku saga jama'a Al-Masi. Bang aniya' a'a tabista a'adil ma sabab kapamogbogna ma panoho'an-sara' si Musa, luba'-lagi'na na aku itu, sabab halam aniya' salla'ku.  <div eID="gen7764" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3872"/><div sID="gen7765" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3872"/> Malaingkan ai-ai bay pangannalku amowa aku ni kahāpan mbal na pamagayku bang pa'in aku taga-lamud ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 3:8
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka hal e'-i. Ai-ai bay ahalga' ma aku dahū itungku na sali' halam aniya' pūsna, bang pa'in kata'uwanku Panghū'ku si Isa Al-Masi. Sabab ahalga' gi' iya min kamemon. Taikutanku na kamemon bay bistaku pangalta' ma waktu tagna', ati itungku na sali' s'ggit, bang pa'in ta'angutku Al-Masi,

verses.name: Philippians 3:9
verses.text: sampay makaparakayu' na ni iya. Mbal paheyaku ma atay in kabontolan luwas min pamogbogku ma sara' bay tasulat si Musa. Binista aku abontol e' Tuhan sabab min pangandolku ma Al-Masi. Ya na ko' ilu kabontolan pamuwanna ma sasuku angandol.

verses.name: Philippians 3:10
verses.text: Ya sadja pagmatayanku bang pa'in kasakupanku Al-Masi, bo' tananamku isab barakat Tuhan ya bay pamakallum Al-Masi min kamatayna. Bilahi aku pasali' ni iya anandalan kabinasahan buwat bay panandalna, sampay ni kamatay.

verses.name: Philippians 3:11
verses.text: Sabab bang buwattē' kapameya'ku ma Al-Masi makaholat aku pinakallum pabīng min kamatay.  <div eID="gen7765" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7761" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3873"/><div sID="gen7766" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ya Pagmatayantam Sakahaba' Waktu</title> <div sID="gen7767" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3873"/> Halam gi' ta'abut kamemon ya pagmatayanku, maka mbal gi' aku sampulna' ma kaul maka pi'il. Sagō' amanuyu' na pa'in aku bo' ta'angutku kamemon ya minaksud e' si Isa Al-Masi angkan iya bay amene' aku.

verses.name: Philippians 3:13
verses.text: Haka'anta kam saga dauranakan, mbal aku amikil di-ku in aku maka'angut na. Sagō' buwattitu na pa'in hinangku: bbahanku na ai-ai bay talabayku inān, ati angutku na ai-ai ya pinama-aku ma sinosōng.

verses.name: Philippians 3:14
verses.text: Amanuyu' aku sampay ta'abutku kahāpan ya pangabbitan aku e' Tuhan labay min si Isa Al-Masi, hatina kallum kakkal ma deyom sulga'.  <div eID="gen7767" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3874"/><div sID="gen7768" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3874"/> Kitam kamemon, sasuku kitam asangpot na ma pangandol maka ma akkal, subay sali'-sali' panganguttam. Bang hati aniya' amikilan saddī pasal ai maka ai, pinasawa du e' Tuhan pamikilna.

verses.name: Philippians 3:16
verses.text: Sagō' minsan painay, subay tukiranta ai-ai bay ta'abutta min katagna' pangandolta sampay ni kabuwattituhan.  <div eID="gen7768" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3875"/><div sID="gen7769" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3875"/> Saga danakanku, subay kam dauyunan anunuran aku. Pandogahinbi isab saga a'a kasehe'an, ya ameya' ma suntu'an bay pang'bba kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: Philippians 3:18
verses.text: Araran itu bay pah'llingku ni ka'am ma waktu palabay, maka balikanku hinabu aku anangis: aheka a'a anulakan pandu' pasal kamatay Al-Masi ma hāg.

verses.name: Philippians 3:19
verses.text: Nalka' ya kamattihan sigām, sabab tabanyaga' sigām e' napsu, maka pagbantugan sigām saga hinang makaiya'-iya'. Luwal legot dunya ya kinannal e' sigām.

verses.name: Philippians 3:20
verses.text: Saguwā' mbal buwattē' ma kitam. Sulga' ya lahattam luggiya', maka aniya' Manglalappas lagarantam pabalik pi'itu minnē', hatina Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Philippians 3:21
verses.text: Makapi'itu pa'in iya, pinindahan e'na ginhawa barantam ya magkalamma maka magkamatay itu. Pinindahan ni buwat baranna asahaya, min kawasana ya pangangga'osna ma ai-ai kamemon.  <div eID="gen7769" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Phil.3"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:1
verses.text: Saga dauranakanku kinalasahan, landu' aku angentom ma ka'am. Ka'am ya po'onan kalasiganku maka kamaujuran hinangku. Angkan buwattitu pah'llingku ma ka'am: patotogunbi pameya'bi ma Panghū'tam!  <div eID="gen7770" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7766" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3876"/><div sID="gen7771" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamituwa Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7772" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3876"/> Aniya' amu'ku ni duwangan d'nda ilu, si Yudi maka si Sintiki, bang pa'in sigā magsulut sabab magdanakan asal sigā ma deyoman Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Philippians 4:3
verses.text: Ka'a isab, bagayku kapangandolan, aniya' panganjunjungku ni ka'a pagka kita dansehe'an maghinang panoho'an Tuhan. Tabangun pa'in duwangan d'nda ilu sabab sehe'ku asal amuspus amasaplag lapal ahāp, beya' isab si Klemen maka a'a kamemon bay anehe'an aku maghinang. Tasulat na e' Tuhan ōn sigām ma būk ya panunulatan ōn a'a taga-kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen7772" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3877"/><div sID="gen7773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3877"/> Magkōg-koyag kam sakahaba' waktu ma sabab Panghū' Isa ya parakayu'anbi. Balikanku lagi': magkōg-koyag kam!  <div eID="gen7773" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3878"/><div sID="gen7774" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3878"/> Subay ahantap bowahanbi ni a'a kamemon. Asekot na waktu kapi'itu Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Philippians 4:6
verses.text: Da'a kasusahinbi ai-ai, saguwā' amu'unbi ai-ai kagunahanbi ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu pangaharapbi iya. Pagsukulinbi iya ma waktu kapangamu'-ngamu'bi.

verses.name: Philippians 4:7
verses.text: Jari pinaniya'an kam kasannangan Tuhan, kasannangan mbal ta'ambat pinikil e' manusiya', ati asalamat du pa'in ataybi maka pamikilbi sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi.  <div eID="gen7774" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3879"/><div sID="gen7775" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3879"/> Na, ya katapusanna, saga dauranakanku, pahōpunbi ni deyom pamikilbi ai-ai landu' ahāp maka patut binantug. Pikilunbi ai-ai abontol, asaltun, ahāp kinale, maka ai-ai makasulut atay.

verses.name: Philippians 4:9
verses.text: Beya'unbi ai-ai bay ta'anadbi atawa ta'ā'bi min aku, ai na ka min bissalaku, ai na ka min palantaraku. Ati pat'ttog ma ka'am in Tuhan ya amuwanan kitam kasannangan atay.  <div eID="gen7775" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7771" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3880"/><div sID="gen7776" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsukulan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3880"/> Aheya pagsarang-sukulanku ni Panghū'tam ma sabab pagka'inagonbi ma aku pinabalik na. Bay kam alasa asal ma aku, sagō' halam aniya' dapatbi amabeya'an aku tatabangan.

verses.name: Philippians 4:11
verses.text: Mbal yukku in aku kasigpitan, sabab ahantap pangatayanku minsan buwattingga kahālanku.

verses.name: Philippians 4:12
verses.text: Bay na kalabayanku kasigpitan maka kaniya' ballabi-labihan, sagō' biyaksa aku amahantap pangatayan minsan ai paniya', ai na ka lingantu, ai na ka asso, ai na ka taga-kaniya' manglabi-labihan, ai na kakulang-kabusan.

verses.name: Philippians 4:13
verses.text: Kasandalanku ai-ai kamemon ya tum'kka ni aku, sabab min kosog Al-Masi ya pamakosogna aku.  <div eID="gen7777" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3881"/><div sID="gen7778" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3881"/> Saguwā' ahāp addatbi anabangan aku ma deyom kasusahanku itu.

verses.name: Philippians 4:15
verses.text: Ka'am saga a'a Pilipi ata'u isab ma bay kahālanku, waktu katulakku min lahat Makidunya ilu. Halam aniya' jama'a Al-Masi saddī min ka'am bay amatuntul aku. Luwal ka'am ya sehe'ku magtabang-tiyabangi, bo' pa'in baha'u kata'ubi ma pasal lapal ahāp.

verses.name: Philippians 4:16
verses.text: Minsan ma waktu kamaina'anku ma Tessaloneka, bay kam angabut-ngabut amabeya'an aku tatabangan hinabuku ma deyom asigpit.

verses.name: Philippians 4:17
verses.text: Sagō' ngga'i ka kaniya'bi ya angutku. Ya sadja kabaya'anku bang pa'in aniya' paluntunganbi aheya bang ta'abut waktu panungbas ka'am e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Philippians 4:18
verses.text: Bo' kata'uwanbi, tasambutku na kamemon bay pabeya'anbi aku, magsukul. Gom pa'in palabi lagi', jari halam aniya' kulangku, sabab itiya' na isab paglasa ya bay pabowabi ma si Epaprode. Sapantun lalabotan ahamut ko' itu, tinukbalan ni Tuhan. Kasulutan isab iya.

verses.name: Philippians 4:19
verses.text: Jari Tuhanku ya amuwanan ka'am ai-ai kulangbi min alta'na ya mbal tapula'-pula', luwas isab min si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7778" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3882"/><div sID="gen7779" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3882"/> Sanglitantam Tuhantam, ya Mma'tam, sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen7779" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3883"/><div sID="gen7780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3883"/> Pasampayunbi pa'in minsan la'a hal lapal kasi-lasaku ni kamemon saga a'a Tuhan, ya pasuku' ma si Isa Al-Masi. Ya du saga dauranakantam ma aku itu, amasampay isab lapal kasi-lasa sigām.

verses.name: Philippians 4:22
verses.text: Ya du isab kamemon saga a'a suku' Tuhan ma lahat itu, luba'-lagi'na sigām ya paokom ma deyom astana' Sultan Mahatinggi itu, amabeya' isab ni ka'am minsan la'a hal lapal kasi-lasa sigām.  <div eID="gen7780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3884"/><div sID="gen7781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3884"/> Mura-murahan bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Amin. <div eID="gen7781" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7782" type="paragraph"/> <signed sID="gen7783"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7783"/>  <div eID="gen7782" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7776" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7722" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Phil.4"/> <div eID="gen7716" osisID="Phil" type="book"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu deyo' min aku, si Paul, maka min danakantam si Timuti. Kawakilan aku e' si Isa Al-Masi min kahandak Tuhan.

verses.name: Colossians 1:2
verses.text: Pasampayku sulat itu ni ka'am saga dauranakan ma Kolossa, a'a asussi taga-pangandol ma Al-Masi. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7791" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3885"/><div sID="gen7792" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsukulan si Paul ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7793" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3885"/> Sakahaba' waktu kapangamu'-ngamu' kami ma pasalanbi, aheya pagsukulan kami ni Tuhan ya Mma' Panghū' Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 1:4
verses.text: Sabab makakale kami habal pasal pangandolbi ma si Isa Al-Masi maka pasal lasabi ma a'a saga suku' Tuhan kamemon.

verses.name: Colossians 1:5
verses.text: Angandol kam maka alasa sabab aniya' kaholatan tinau'an ka'am ma deyom sulga'. Bay na kam pinakalehan lapal kasab'nnalan pasal si Isa, ati minnē' kata'uwanbi aniya' niholat.

verses.name: Colossians 1:6
verses.text: Pasaplag na pa'in lapal ahāp itu ni kaluha'an dunya. Aheya du pa'in paluntungan lapal itu ma deyom kaul-pi'il manusiya', buwat ma kaul-pi'ilbi isab sangay min llaw tagna' kakalebi pasal kasi-lasa Tuhan. Tahatibi isab bang ai hatulanna

verses.name: Colossians 1:7
verses.text: pagka kam pinandu'an e' si Epapras, sehe' kami kinalasahan ya magbeya' maka kami maghinang panoho'an Tuhan. Atukid e'na maghinang ma deyo'an si Isa Al-Masi, ganti' kami.

verses.name: Colossians 1:8
verses.text: Bay iya amowahan kami haka pasal lasabi ma sabab Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7793" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3886"/><div sID="gen7794" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3886"/> Angkan na kami halam pahali angamu'an ka'am kahāpan ni Tuhan sangay min waktu kapanambut kami lapal pasal kahālanbi. Angamu'-ngamu' kami tabang ni Tuhan bang pa'in kam binuwanan panghati maka pangita'u e' Rū-na, bo' supaya kasakupanbi to'ongan bang ai pangahandak Tuhan ma buwat ka'am.

verses.name: Colossians 1:10
verses.text: Manjari ahatul kam ma kaul-pi'ilbi buwat kabaya'an Panghū' Isa, ati ai-ai hinangbi makasulut iya maka ajatu kahinanganbi waktu ni waktu, maka pasōng pangita'ubi pasal Tuhan.

verses.name: Colossians 1:11
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam binuwanan kosog e' Tuhan deyo' min kawasana barakatan, manjari kaimananbi ai-ai minsan buwattingga.

verses.name: Colossians 1:12
verses.text: Subay kam magkōg-koyag magsukul ni Mma'tam Tuhan, ya bay amapatut ka'am bo' tataima'bi palsuku'an ma deyom lahat asahaya.

verses.name: Colossians 1:13
verses.text: Pinuwasan kitam e'na min deyom kalendoman ya pagbaya'an nakura' saitan, ati pininda kitam ni pagbaya'an Anakna kinalasahan.

verses.name: Colossians 1:14
verses.text: Nil'kkat na kitam min pagbanyaga'an nakura' saitan maka ta'ampun dusatam.  <div eID="gen7794" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7792" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3887"/><div sID="gen7795" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">In Al-Masi Mbal Kaliyuhan</title> <div sID="gen7796" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3887"/> Dasali' Al-Masi maka Tuhan. Mbal ta'nda'tam Tuhan sagō' kasakupanta kajarihanna pag'nda'tam Al-Masi. Anak tunggal-kawasa iya, dahū asal min kamemon pinapanjari.

verses.name: Colossians 1:16
verses.text: Ai-ai kamemon ma deyom sulga' maka ai-ai ma dunya, ya ta'nda' e' manusiya' maka ya mbal ta'nda', bangsa hibilis maka ai-ai taga-ga'osan ma diyata' ayan, in itu kamemon bay pinapapanjari e' Al-Masi, deyo' bay min Tuhan. Maka Al-Masi ya taga-kapatut ma kamemon.

verses.name: Colossians 1:17
verses.text: Asal na iya ma halam gi' aniya' pinapanjari, maka iya ya angumbangan pinapanjari kamemon bo' supaya mbal apulag.

verses.name: Colossians 1:18
verses.text: Pagmakōkan iya ma saga jama'ana, maka sigām ya buwat ibarat baranna. In iya asal po'onan kallum ma sigām, maka dahū iya min kamemon pinakallum min kamatay, supaya iya tunggal bangsahan min kamemon.

verses.name: Colossians 1:19
verses.text: Min kabaya'an Tuhan isab angkan Al-Masi dasali' maka iya ma kajarihanna kamemon.

verses.name: Colossians 1:20
verses.text: Ya minaksud asal e' Tuhan in ummat pinapanjari kamemon subay maghāp maka iya labay min Anakna. Manjari ai na ka bangsa ma babaw dunya atawa ma diyata' langit, makapagkahāp maka Tuhan ma sabab laha' Anakna bay pabu'us waktu kamatayna ma hāg.  <div eID="gen7796" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3888"/><div sID="gen7797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3888"/> Waktu tagna', bay kam alawak min Tuhan. Bantana asal kam ma deyom pikilanbi ma sabab kala'atan ya hinangbi.

verses.name: Colossians 1:22
verses.text: Saguwā' buwattitu maghāp na kam maka Tuhan sabab min kamatay Al-Masi. Ya maksud Tuhan subay kam magharap maka iya ma asussi pangatayanbi, ma halam aniya' tamak-tamakbi atawa dusa panā'an ka'am.

verses.name: Colossians 1:23
verses.text: Tantu ko' inān, bang pa'in kam patotog angandol ma Al-Masi. Da'a bbahinbi lapal ahāp bay takalebi sabab ya na po'onna angkan aniya' holatbi. Ya na ko' itu lapal ahāp ya pinasaplagan a'a kamemon ma kaluha'an dunya itu. Aku si Paul taga-kag'llal min Tuhan magnasihat lapal itu.  <div eID="gen7797" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7795" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3889"/><div sID="gen7798" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kahinangan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3889"/> Kinōgan aku bininasa bang pa'in ma sababanbi, sabab bang aku anandalan kabinasahan, paganap binasaku ni kabinasahan bay kasandalan Al-Masi, ya sasuku halam ajukup. Bay iya anandalan kabinasahan ma sababan saga jama'ana, ya ibarat baranna.

verses.name: Colossians 1:25
verses.text: Aku itu tahinang sosoho'an na e' Tuhan bo' aku anabang ma sasuku magpangandol ma si Isa. Kawakilan aku e'na anabang ka'am, sinō' aku magnasihat lapalna kamemon.

verses.name: Colossians 1:26
verses.text: Lapalna itu bay nilimbungan e' Tuhan min manusiya' kamemon min masa awal lagi', sagō' pamata'u na buwattina'an ni saga a'a suku'na.

verses.name: Colossians 1:27
verses.text: Sigām suku'na ya pinata'u, bo' manyatakan saga a'a ma sabarang bangsa bang ai maksud Tuhan ma manusiya'. Mamarahi ahāp ya bay limbunganna he', ahalga' to'ongan, sagō' pinabukis na. Hatina Al-Masi pat'nna' du ma deyom ataytam, angkan aniya' holattam in kitam pinasuku'an sahaya ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Colossians 1:28
verses.text: Angkanna halam aniya' panganasihat kami saddī min Al-Masi. Ginuna e' kami ai-ai tata'u kami pasal Al-Masi, pami'at maka pamandu' kami ma a'a kamemon bo' supaya sigām dangan maka dangan abontol du ma kaul maka pi'il, pagka ameya' na ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 1:29
verses.text: Ya na itu pagsangsā'anku na pa'in. Puspusku kosogku, ya bay pamakosog aku e' Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7799" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Col.1"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:1
verses.text: Bilahi aku amata'u ka'am pasal pagka'inagonku ma ka'am maka saga a'a min da'ira Laodikiya inān, sampay isab sasuku mbal gi' magkilā maka aku.

verses.name: Colossians 2:2
verses.text: Ya angutku subay ahogot pangandolbi maka subay arakayu' ataybi maglasa-liyasahi. Subay asawa panghatibi pasal Al-Masi sabab minnē' ahogot to'ongan pangandolbi ati kasakupanbi lapal bay nilimbungan e' Tuhan ma waktu palabay, ya pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 2:3
verses.text: In iya pagtatau'an pangalta' kamemon, hatina kapandayan maka kata'u Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7800" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3890"/><div sID="gen7801" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3890"/> Na, buwattē' pamahatiku ka'am supaya kam mbal takole' nirupang e' ba'anan pasu'alan halam aniya' pūsna, minsan buwattingga kalu'uyna.

verses.name: Colossians 2:5
verses.text: Manjari itu, minsan aku alikut min ka'am, aheya du kam ma deyom pikilanku. Sidda aku kinōgan ma sabab ahatul pagtipunbi maka atotog pangandolbi ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7801" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7798" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3891"/><div sID="gen7802" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Al-Masi ya Pagmakōkan</title> <div sID="gen7803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3891"/> Jari itu, pagka tataima'bi na si Isa Al-Masi pagpanghū'anbi, subay kam pasangdan na pa'in ma iya.

verses.name: Colossians 2:7
verses.text: Ya pamalutbi ma iya subay buwat gamut kayu lalomna. Pat'ttog kam ma iya supaya pahogot gom pa'in pangandolbi buwat bay pamandu' ka'am. Subay lipat-manglipat pagsukulanbi ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7803" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3892"/><div sID="gen7804" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3892"/> Kamaya'-maya' kam bo' kam mbal ka'akkalan e' manusiya' minsan sai-na bang bilahi amanyaga' ka'am supaya kam tabowa ameya' ma sigām. Pangangakkal asal pangita'u saga a'a inān. Halam aniya' kagunahanna sabab hal pali-pali bay pang'bba min kamatto'ahan, maka ilmu' bay min bangsa hibilis ya magbaya' ma diyata' ayan. Ngga'i ka pangita'u min Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7804" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3893"/><div sID="gen7805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3893"/> Sabab ina'an ma Al-Masi kajarihan Tuhan, jukup ma addatna maka ma panahu'anna, bo' pa'in magpabaran manusiya' buwat kitam.

verses.name: Colossians 2:10
verses.text: Ya du ka'am kabuwanan kasampulna'an pagka Al-Masi ya pasōranbi. Alanga asal iya min kamemon, makapagagi ma ai-ai taga-ga'os, bangsa mala'ikat ka maka bangsa saitan.

verses.name: Colossians 2:11
verses.text: Aniya' bainat pangilāhan ka'am ya sōd ma Al-Masi, saguwā' ngga'i ka bainat ma kuwit baranbi ya nihinang e' manusiya' magi'islam. Ya pangilāhan ka'am bainat bay nihinang e' Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 2:12
verses.text: Sababna sapantun kam a'a bay kinubul sambeya' maka iya, waktu kapamandi ma ka'am tanda' palsaksi'an in ka'am suku'na na. Pinakallum isab kam pabīng, pagka pasangdolanbi kawasa Tuhan ya bay amakallum si Isa pabīng min kamatayna.  <div eID="gen7805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3894"/><div sID="gen7806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3894"/> Tagna'bi inān sali' kam hantang a'a magpatayan ma pang'nda' Tuhan sabab masi magdusa. Bay ala'at kajarihanbi maka halam aniya' lamudbi ma bangsa suku' Tuhan. Daipara apinda na kahālanbi buwattina'an, pinakallum na kam e' Tuhan sambeya' maka Al-Masi. Niampun e'na dusata kamemon,

verses.name: Colossians 2:14
verses.text: maka pinapasan e'na sulat panuntut ya pamat'nna'an kitam. Pinuwasan kita min hukuman sara' ma sabab kamatay Al-Masi ma hāg. Jari halam na aniya' sababan pamat'nna'an kita hukuman.

verses.name: Colossians 2:15
verses.text: Tara'ug isab e' Al-Masi bangsa mananasat maka ai-ai taga-kaga'os ma diyata' ayan. Kala'anan e'na ga'osan sigām ati pinahina' sigām ma mairan. Tara'ug e'na kamemon ma sabab kamatayna ma hāg.  <div eID="gen7806" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3895"/><div sID="gen7807" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3895"/> Angkanna kam subay mbal tasoway e' sai-sai ma pasal kinakanbi maka inumanbi, atawa pasal jamu duwa'a atawa hinang bulan atawa hinang ma llaw mulliya.

verses.name: Colossians 2:17
verses.text: Binogbog e' sigām usulan inān bo' pa'in hal gindan pamaentom sigām aniya' gi' nilagaran ma waktu sinōng, ya na Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 2:18
verses.text: Jagahinbi kahāpan ya panungbas ka'am e' Tuhan bo' kam mbal kinulli'an e' saga a'a ya maglaku-laku pasal kareyo' pangatayan sigām. Anumba sigām ma saga mala'ikat, magmalangkahi na pa'in sigām pasal aniya' kono' bay panyata' ni sigām min Tuhan. Abbuhan saga a'a buwattē' ati abowa-bowa e' legot dunya, maka hona'-hona' halam aniya' pūsna.

verses.name: Colossians 2:19
verses.text: Tu'ud sigām pabutas min Al-Masi ya po'onan kallum sigām. Buwat sapantun baran, Al-Masi ya kōkna, maka kitam ya pagdayawna. Jari magdalos pagdayaw itu maka kōk pagka aniya' ugat paralosanna. Angkan kitam itu, ya dalil pagdayaw Al-Masi, pasōngna pa'in kosogtam ma sabab Tuhan ya magkabaya'an.  <div eID="gen7807" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7802" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3896"/><div sID="gen7808" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapaunung ma Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen7809" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3896"/> Sapantun kam a'a bay paunung ma Al-Masi ma kamatayna, sabab amatay na kam ni bay palihalanbi tagna', ati apuwas na kam min komkoman binangsa saitan ya magbaya' ma diyata' ayan. Jari angay kam subay pasangdan na pa'in ma kal'ngnganan a'a kasehe' ma dunya itu?

verses.name: Colossians 2:21
verses.text: Angay beya'bi pali-pali sigām, ya yuk-i, “Da'a ntanin ilu!” atawa “Da'a kakanun ina'an!” atawa “Da'a umasun ina'an!”

verses.name: Colossians 2:22
verses.text: Saguwā' pinjaman sadja ya pinagpali-pali e' saga a'a inān, sabab ubus pa'in ginuna, magtūy pahalam. Maka pali-pali inān hal pinahinang e' manusiya'.

verses.name: Colossians 2:23
verses.text: Nihagda kita e' sigām subay magsumba ni mala'ikat. Sinō' magpareyo'-deyo' di-ta, maka magtiksa'-tiksa' di-ta. Aniya' kono' paluntungan ma pangahagda sigām, sagō' halam aniya' dapatna pamapaggat napsu baran.  <div eID="gen7809" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Col.2"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:1
verses.text: Manjari itu, pagka Al-Masi allum na pabīng, ya du ka'am parakayu' ma iya binuwanan kallum kakkal. Na pagka buwattē', tuyu'inbi ai-ai ma deyom sulga' ma kamaina'anan Al-Masi. Ina'an asal iya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan, ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan.

verses.name: Colossians 3:2
verses.text: Pagmatayinbi ai-ai suku' ma sulga', da'a na ai-ai ma babaw dunya itu.

verses.name: Colossians 3:3
verses.text: Sabab ka'am ya angandol ma Al-Masi, ibarat a'a amatay na, halam na aniya' baya'na ma alam itu. Ina'an asal po'onan kallumbi ma haddarat Tuhan, tinau' pahogot e' Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 3:4
verses.text: Sababna Al-Masi ya po'onan kallumbi, angkanna ma sinosōng, bang iya pa'nda' pi'itu, magdongan du kam maka iya bo' aliput isab e' sahayana.  <div eID="gen7810" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7808" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3897"/><div sID="gen7811" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaul-pi'il Tagna' maka Kaul-Pi'il Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen7812" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3897"/> Angkan yukku ma ka'am, taikutinbi napsubi ala'at. Da'a kam magd'nda atawa magl'lla. Da'a kam magkasabulan, da'a kam magba'is-ba'is. Da'a kam abahaya ma pilak sabab bang alta' ya paheyabi ma atay, ya na he' sali' pagtuhananbi.

verses.name: Colossians 3:6
verses.text: Ab'nsi Tuhan ma hinang buwattē', ya po'on iya amat'kka mulka' ni saga a'a agagga ma panoho'anna.

verses.name: Colossians 3:7
verses.text: Buwattē' kabiyaksahanbi tagna', waktu lagi' kam ameya' ma ai-ai kanapsuhanbi.  <div eID="gen7812" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3898"/><div sID="gen7813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3898"/> Sagō' ma buwattitu subay bbahanbi bay kasuddahanbi ala'at inān, buwat saga magastol, magb'nsi ma pagkahi, maka magb'ngngis. Da'a kam angalimut sehe'bi, da'a isab maglaka'-laka',

verses.name: Colossians 3:9
verses.text: da'a kam magputing ma sehe'bi. Bay na bbahanbi kajarihanbi maka kahinanganbi tagna'.

verses.name: Colossians 3:10
verses.text: Kaniya'an na kam kajarihan baha'u ya pinindahan na pa'in e' Tuhan Magpapanjari, supaya kam makasali' ni buwat kajarihanna. Ya mohotna in ka'am subay pasōng pangita'ubi ma iya.

verses.name: Colossians 3:11
verses.text: Manjari dasali' saga a'a kamemon sasuku bay pinabaha'u na e' Tuhan. Halam aniya' pagbidda'an sigām, bangsa Yahudi ka maka bangsa kasehe', a'a magislam ka maka a'a halam bay magislam, ata ka maka ngga'i ka, sampay saga a'a bangsa liyu. Pat'nna' Al-Masi ma deyom ataytam sali'-sali', maka Al-Masi sadja ya katumanan ma ai-ai kamemon.  <div eID="gen7813" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3899"/><div sID="gen7814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3899"/> Bay kam tapene' e' Tuhan nihinang a'ana. A'a sussi kam kinalasahan e'na angkan kam wajib ma'ase' ma pagkahibi samantala' ahāp addatbi ni kasehe'an, areyo' isab maka alunuk pangatayanbi. Tatasinbi pagkahibi minsan kam ni'inay.

verses.name: Colossians 3:13
verses.text: Bang aniya' pagla'atanbi maka pagkahibi, sagarinbi na. Bang aniya' kap'ddi'anbi atay, subay kam magampun-iyampuni. Ya pangampunbi ma pagkahibi manusiya' subay buwat kapangampun ka'am e' Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: Colossians 3:14
verses.text: Maka aniya' gi' sugpatna aheya: subay kam alasa ma pagkahibi sabab bang kam maglasa-liyasahi ahogot du kapagdakayu'bi atay.  <div eID="gen7814" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3900"/><div sID="gen7815" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3900"/> Magmalulus kam ma Al-Masi bo' kam minaliman e' kasannanganna, sabab sinō' kam e' Tuhan subay magsulut-siyuluti, sabab kitam magpangandol ma Al-Masi sapantun dabaran du. Pagsukulinbi isab Tuhan.

verses.name: Colossians 3:16
verses.text: Gomgominbi pamandu' Al-Masi bo' pasobsob to'ongan ni deyom ataybi. Bang kam ganta' magpandu' dangan maka dangan, paglagihunbi pangita'u kamemon bay pamuwan ka'am. Magkalang kam saga kalangan pamudji Tuhan sampay kalangan makani-ka'am min Rū Tuhan. Magkalang kam pagka aheya pagsukulanbi ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Colossians 3:17
verses.text: Entomunbi Panghū' Isa ma ai-ai hinangbi maka pamūngbi, in iya pameya'anbi. Maka pagsukulinbi na pa'in Tuhan ya Mma'tam labay min ōn si Isa.  <div eID="gen7815" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7811" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3901"/><div sID="gen7816" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pandu' ma saga A'a Daokoman</title> <div sID="gen7817" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3901"/> Ka'am kar'ndahan subay ameya' ma kabaya'an h'llabi. Patut isab, pagka si Isa ya Panghū'bi.  <div eID="gen7817" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3902"/><div sID="gen7818" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3902"/> Ka'am kal'llahan, kalasahinbi h'ndabi, da'a kab'ngngisinbi.  <div eID="gen7818" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3903"/><div sID="gen7819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3903"/> Ka'am saga kamanahutan, angikut kam ma pami'at matto'abi sabab kasulutan Panghū'tam ma hinangbi buwattē'.  <div eID="gen7819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3904"/><div sID="gen7820" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3904"/> Ka'am kamatto'ahan, da'a pala'atunbi atay anakbi bo' mbal mandā'-dā'.  <div eID="gen7820" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3905"/><div sID="gen7821" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3905"/> Ka'am saga tendog, subay beya'bi kamemon panoho'an nakura'bi. Da'a hal ma salta' sigām ang'nda' bo' supaya kam sinanglitan. Subay sali' du ma kamaina'an maka ma kalikut sigām. Hinangunbi panoho'an sigām min deyom ataybi, ma sabab Panghū' ya pagaddatanbi.

verses.name: Colossians 3:23
verses.text: Subay kam atukid ma ai-ai hinangbi sabab minsan manusiya' ya paghinanganbi, Panghū' Isa ya luggiya' nakura'bi.

verses.name: Colossians 3:24
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du, Panghū'tam ya anungbasan ka'am ma sinosōng. Pinasambutan kam pusaka' ya tinau'an saga a'a suku'na ma sabab Al-Masi ya paghinanganbi.

verses.name: Colossians 3:25
verses.text: Sasuku mbal taluwa' hinangna, tinungbasan du pinapagtongod maka hinangna ala'at, sabab mbal amapagbidda' Tuhan ma manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7821" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Col.3"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:1
verses.text: Ka'am saga nakura', subay ahāp pangahatulbi ma saga sosoho'anbi. Ya panambabi ma sigām subay pinapagtongod maka hinang sigām, sabab kata'uwanbi asal aniya' pagnakura'anbi mahē' ma sulga'.  <div eID="gen7822" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7816" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3906"/><div sID="gen7823" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamituwa Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3906"/> Patukid kam angarap ni Tuhan, pahāpun akkal-pamikilbi, maka pagsukulinbi Tuhan.

verses.name: Colossians 4:3
verses.text: Amu'-amu'inbi isab kami tabang bang pa'in kami mura-murahan pinaluhaya e' Tuhan bo' supaya kami makapagnasihat lapal pasal Al-Masi, ya lapal halam bay kinata'uwan ma masa awal e'. Ya he' po'onna angkan aku kinarenahan ma deyom kalabusu itu, tu'ud aku magnasihat pasal Al-Masi.

verses.name: Colossians 4:4
verses.text: Amay-amay, amu'inbi aku tabang min Tuhan supaya asawa e'ku magnasihat pasal si Isa sabab ya na he' bay pamahinangna ma aku.  <div eID="gen7824" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3907"/><div sID="gen7825" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3907"/> Pahāpunbi addatbi tudju ni saga a'a ya mbal am'nnal ma si Isa. Bang aniya' waktu sumiyan-sumiyan, haka'inbi to'ongan sigām ma pasalna.

verses.name: Colossians 4:6
verses.text: Ai-ai pamissalabi subay ahanunut sadja, bo' supaya kasulutan sasuku akale. Subay kam ata'u isāb anambungan sasuku anilaw ka'am.  <div eID="gen7825" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7823" type="section"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3908"/><div sID="gen7826" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Pama'iran</title> <div sID="gen7827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3908"/> Aniya' lapal ma pasal kahālanku binowahan ka'am e' si Tikikus. Danakantam iya, a'a landu' kinalasahan. Dansehe'an iya maka kami maghinang ma Panghū' Isa, a'a kapangandolan isab.

verses.name: Colossians 4:8
verses.text: Makabāk kam kalasigan bang iya angahati ka'am pasal kahālan kami itu, ya po'on iya sō'ku pi'ilu.

verses.name: Colossians 4:9
verses.text: Bay pasehe'ku ma iya si Onesimus, a'a dalahat maka ka'am. Danakantam iya kinalasahan maka kapangandolan. Kahaka'an kam e'na pasal saga pakaradja'an maitu kamemon.  <div eID="gen7827" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3909"/><div sID="gen7828" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3909"/> Si Aristarkus, sehe'ku ma deyom kalabusu itu, amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapalna ma ka'am. Ya du si Markus itu, kaki si Barnabas. Bay na kam haka'anku pasal si Markus. Bang iya ganta' pahapit ni lahatbi ilu subay iya patuntulunbi pahāp-hāp.

verses.name: Colossians 4:11
verses.text: Itiya' isab si Yussa' ya niranglay Justus, amabeya' isab lapalna ma ka'am. Luwal t'llungan itu ya bangsa Yahudi anehe'an aku magnasihat pasal pagparinta Tuhan. Aheya to'ongan panabang sigām ma aku.  <div eID="gen7828" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3910"/><div sID="gen7829" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3910"/> Si Epapras amabeya' isab minsan la'a hal lapalna. Sosoho'an iya ma si Isa Al-Masi, a'a min lahatbi du isab. Angamu'-ngamu' iya pakosog ma sababbi sakahaba' waktu, bang pa'in ahogot pameya'bi ma kabaya'an Tuhan bo' supaya kam asampulna' ma kaul-pi'ilbi, ma halam aniya' hawal-hawal ma deyom ataybi.

verses.name: Colossians 4:13
verses.text: Makasaksi' du aku ma pasal si Epapras itu. Bay iya magsangsā' ma sababbi sampay ma saga a'a ma da'ira Laodikiya maka ma da'ira Hirapulis.

verses.name: Colossians 4:14
verses.text: Maka itiya' isab si Lukas ya doktol kalasahantam, maka si Demas. Ya du sigām duwangan itu amabeya' isab lapal sigām.  <div eID="gen7829" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3911"/><div sID="gen7830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3911"/> Amabeya' aku lapal pagaddatku ma saga danakantam ma Laodikiya, maka ma si Nimpa. Lapayun isab kajama'ahan Al-Masi ya magtipun ma luma'na.  <div eID="gen7830" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3912"/><div sID="gen7831" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3912"/> Bang aubus na e'bi amassa sulat itu palanjalunbi lagi' ni saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi ya magtipun ma da'ira Laodikiya inān bo' tabassa e' sigām. Amu'unbi isab sulat bay pabeya'anku sigām, ati bassahunbi isab he'-i.  <div eID="gen7831" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3913"/><div sID="gen7832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3913"/> Haka'inbi si Arkippus ilu: “Amay-amay. Talusun hinang bay pamahinang ka'a e' Panghū' Isa sabab iya ya paghinangannu.”  <div eID="gen7832" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3914"/><div sID="gen7833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3914"/> Sugpatanku isab da'ayat maka sulatan tanganku du. Nientom du kam e'ku, e' si Paul. Da'a aku takalipatunbi pagka itiya' aku ma deyom kalabusu kinarenahan. <div eID="gen7833" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7834" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Tuhan. <signed sID="gen7835"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7835"/>  <div eID="gen7834" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7826" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7790" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Col.4"/> <div eID="gen7784" osisID="Col" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, maka min sehe'ku si Silas maka si Timuti, pinasampay pi'ilu ni palhimpunan Tessaloneka, ya suku' Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. <div eID="gen7843" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7844" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan.  <div eID="gen7844" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3915"/><div sID="gen7845" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsukulan ma Sabab saga A'a Tessaloneka</title> <div sID="gen7846" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3915"/> Magsukul kami ni Tuhan ma sababbi sakahaba' waktu kapangamu'-ngamu' kami ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: Nientom kam ma alopan Mma'tam Tuhan, nientom kahāpan ya hinangbi luwas min pangandolbi, nientom pagsangsā'bi ma sabab lasabi ma iya, maka kahogot imanbi isab ma sabab Panghū' Isa Al-Masi ya pangasahanbi.  <div eID="gen7846" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3916"/><div sID="gen7847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3916"/> Saga dauranakan, ka'am kinalasahan e' Tuhan, kata'uwan kami in ka'am bay tapene' e'na.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka pangupama manusiya' ya panganasihat kami ma ka'am, sagō' lapal abarakat bay min Rū Tuhan, angkan ahogot pagsab'nnalbi. Kata'uwanbi bay bowahan kami waktu kat'nna' kami ma ka'am bo' ahāp kahālanbi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: Bay sunuranbi kajarihan kami maka kajarihan Panghū'tam. Minsan kalabayanbi katiksa'an abisa, tinaima' e'bi lapal itu, lāgi kinōgan kam sabab min Rū Sussi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: Angkan buwattina'an, ka'am ya panunuran e' kamemon saga a'a magpangandol ma lahat Makidunya maka ma lahat Akaya.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: Pasaplag isāb lapal pasal Panghū' Isa sabab min ka'am, pasampay ni kaluha'an lahat Makidunya maka Akaya. Ngga'i ka hal jadjahan ina'an, pasaplag habal pasal pangandolbi ni Tuhan ni sabarang lahat. Minsan kami mbal na ah'lling,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: sabab amissala na pa'in saga a'a inān pasal kapanaima'bi ma kami. Tabissala pasal kapang'bbabi min ta'u-ta'u ya bay pagtuhananbi tagna' bo' kam papinda angisbat Tuhan b'nnal, ya kakkal salama-lama.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: Angagad kono' kam ma waktu kapi'itu min sulga' Anakna, ya bay pakallumna min kamatayna. Si Isa ko' inān, ya angalappas kitam min mulka' song pinat'kka ni saga manusiya'.  <div eID="gen7847" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Thess.1"/> <div eID="gen7845" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3917"/><div sID="gen7848" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kahinangan si Paul ma Da'ira Tessaloneka</title> <div sID="gen7849" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3917"/> Saga dauranakanku, kata'uwanbi aheya kapūsan l'ngngan kami pi'ilu ni ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi asal, bay kami makalabay kabinasahan ma da'ira Pilipi maka landu' nihina', sago' magsukul ni Tuhan, bay kami makatawakkal angahaka'an ka'am lapalna ahāp minsan aheka anagga'.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Ya pamandu' kami ma ka'am halam aniya' sā'na, halam aniya' mohotna ala'at, halam aniya' niyat kami angakkalan kami.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: Tabista kami e' Tuhan makajari pinangandolan lapal ahāp itu. Mbal kami angangut anulut manusiya' sagō' Tuhan, ya makaliling deyom pikilantam.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi haliluwal kami, halam kami bay angalanahan a'a minsan sai bo' tabowa am'nnal, halam kami magbau'-bau' in kami asaltun bo' pa'in sinōd bahaya pilak. Tuhan ya saksi' kami.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: Halam isab kami bay amiha mahaltabat min manusiya', ai na ka min ka'am atawa min a'a saddī. <div eID="gen7849" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7850" type="paragraph"/> Minsan kami taga-kapatut pagka kawakilan Al-Masi, halam kami bay angahagda atawa amabuhat ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: Gom pa'in ahanunut pah'lling kami ma ka'am, buwat d'nda angupiksa' saga anakna.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: Aheya lasa kami ma ka'am, ya po'on kami lilla' angahaka'an ka'am pasal lapal ahāp min Tuhan. Lāgi pamalilla' baran kami sampay ni kamatay, ma sabab kaheya lasa kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: Tantu taentombi, saga dauranakan, bay paglu'ug kami waktu kamailu kami ma ka'am. Bay kami maghulas-sangsā' llaw-sangom bo' aniya' kalluman kami, supaya halam sai-sai kabuhatan sat'ggol kami anganasihatan ka'am lapal Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7850" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3918"/><div sID="gen7851" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3918"/> Kasaksi'anbi, maka kasaksi'an isab e' Tuhan, bang buwattingga bay tebong kami ma deyomanbi saga a'a magpangandol. Abontol sadja kami, halam aniya' kasā'an.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi isab bay addat kami ma ka'am pakaniya-pakaniya, sali' addat matto'a ma saga anakna lahasiya'.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: Bay pahogot kami imanbi, bay palasig kami pangatayanbi, bay kam sinō' amahāp kaul-pi'ilbi bo' tōp ma Tuhan, ya amowa ka'am palamud ma pagparintahanna maka ma kasahaya'anna.  <div eID="gen7851" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3919"/><div sID="gen7852" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3919"/> Magsukul na pa'in kami ni Tuhan sabab mbal takalipat kami bay kapanaima'bi lapal palman. Takalebi min kami bo' pa'in ngga'i ka lapal manusiya' ya taima'bi sagō' palman sab'nnal-b'nnal min Tuhan, palman amowa na pa'in ma deyom pangatayan sasuku magkahagad.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: Dauranakanku, panunuranbi na pakaradja'an ya kalabayan e' saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi ya ma palhimpunan lahat Yahudiya. Sabab ya du ka'am bay nila'at e' pagkahibi dabangsa, buwat bay pangala'at sigām e' pagkahi sigām Yahudi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: Bay pinapatay e' sigām Panghū' Isa, maka pinapatay isab kanabi-nabihan ma awal lagi'. Mbal sigām makasulut atay Tuhan maka sinagga' e' sigām saga a'a kamemon.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: Sinagga' kami e' sigām bo' mbal tapagnasihat lapal ahāp ma saga a'a bangsa liyu, ya ngga'i ka Yahudi sabab mbal bilahi bang bangsa liyu lappasan min dusa. Mbal sigām pahali angalandu'an dusa sigām, ya angkan pinataluwa'an mulka' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7852" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7848" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3920"/><div sID="gen7853" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabaya'an si Paul Anibaw saga A'a Tessaloneka</title> <div sID="gen7854" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3920"/> Saga dauranakanku, pagka kami bay magokat maka ka'am minsan mbal at'ggol, landu' kami angentom ati atuyu' to'ongan kami amowa mag'nda' maka ka'am pabīng. Minsan kami alawak min ka'am buwattina'an, itiya' kam ma deyom pikilan kami.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:18
verses.text: Bilahi kami patibaw ni ka'am, paligay aku itu, si Paul. Min pila aku bay magsakap pi'ilu, sagō' pinat'nna'an aku bimbang e' nakura' saitan, ya angkan halam makalanjal.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:19
