verses.text: Na, ka'am ya pagsababan pagkōg-koyagan kami maka kaholatan kami. Maka ka'am ya pamantugan kami ma matahan Panghū'tam si Isa bang ta'abut waktu pagbīngna pi'itu.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:20
verses.text: Aho' b'nnal, ka'am ya pamantugan maka pagkōg-koyagan kami.  <div eID="gen7854" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Thess.2"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: Na, pagka mbal kasandalan pangentom kami ma ka'am, anganiyat kami amatibaw si Timuti pi'ilu, bo' kami duwangan ta'bba ma da'ira Aten itu. Si Timuti itu, danakan kami asal maka sehe' kami maghinang kahinangan Tuhan. Magbeya' kami magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi. Pinatibaw iya pi'ilu bo' amahogot imanbi maka amakosog pangandolbi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: Na, pagka mbal kasandalan pangentom kami ma ka'am, anganiyat kami amatibaw si Timuti pi'ilu, bo' kami duwangan ta'bba ma da'ira Aten itu. Si Timuti itu, danakan kami asal maka sehe' kami maghinang kahinangan Tuhan. Magbeya' kami magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal Al-Masi. Pinatibaw iya pi'ilu bo' amahogot imanbi maka amakosog pangandolbi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: Ya kabaya'an kami subay halam aniya' tabowa maghenggol-henggol imanna ma sabab kabinasahan ya kalabayanbi ilu. Kata'uwanbi asal, pinakadal kitam kabinasahan pagka suku' Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: Bay sa kam nihaka'an waktu kamailu kami, in kitam suku' Al-Masi tantu t'kkahan kabinasahan. Jari kasakupanbi na, paniya' na bay pangahaka kami.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: Angkanna, pagka mbal na kasandalanku susaku ma kahālanbi, bay soho'ku si Timuti pi'ilu angahati ka'am bang masi ahogot pagimanbi ma si Isa Al-Masi. Ya kahanggawanku, kalu kam bay tasasat e' nakura' saitan, sabab bang kam tabowa e' sasat saitan, kaliman bay hinang kami mailu.  <div eID="gen7855" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3921"/><div sID="gen7856" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3921"/> Daipara itiya' na si Timuti baha'u bay at'kka min ka'am, maka ahāp to'ongan habal ya tabowana pasalbi. Yukna ahogot masi pagimanbi ma Tuhan maka masi na pa'in paglasabi dangan maka dangan. Yukna isab ahāp ataybi tudju ni kami itu, maka aheya baya'bi ang'nda' kami, buwat kaheya baya' kami mag'nda' maka ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: Angkanna, saga dauranakan, minsan kami ma deyom kasigpitan maka kabinasahan, ahogot du atay kami sabab makata'u na kami in ka'am halam apinda min pangandolbi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: Ahāp na palnyawahan kami pagka kata'uwan kami in pameya'bi ma Panghū' Isa atotog du.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: Magsukul na kami ni Tuhan ma sababbi, sabab ka'am ya po'onna angkan aheya kakōgan kami ma matahanna.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: Llaw-sangom atukid kami angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan, bang pa'in kami mag'nda' maka ka'am, bo' kam katabangan kami bang aniya' mbal gi' jukup ma pagimanbi.  <div eID="gen7856" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3922"/><div sID="gen7857" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3922"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kami tinabang e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka e' Panghū'tam si Isa bo' kami makatūy pi'ilu ni ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: Mura-murahan isab, bang pa'in kam tinabang e' Panghū'tam bo' lumabihan lasabi ma saga sehe'bi dambeya'an ilu sampay ma manusiya' kamemon, buwat isab lasa kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: Bang pa'in pinatotog ataybi e' Panghū' supaya kam asussi maka saltun ma matahan Mma'tam Tuhan ma waktu kabalik pi'itu Panghū' Isa, beya' maka ba'anan a'a suku'na.  <div eID="gen7857" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Thess.3"/> <div eID="gen7853" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3923"/><div sID="gen7858" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaul-pi'il ya Makasulut Atay Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7859" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3923"/> Na, saga dauranakan, buwattitu hatulanna. Bay kam pandu'an kami bang kaul-pi'il ingga ya makasulutan Tuhan. Buwattē' asal kaul-pi'ilbi, Sagō' buwattina'an, pagka aniya' kapatut kami min Panghū' Isa, amu'ta kam maka soho'ta kam amuspus to'ongan ma kaul-pi'il ahāp.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:2
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du, in pamandu' kami ma ka'am asal min kapatut Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:3
verses.text: Ya kabaya'an Tuhan subay asussi deyom ataybi. Da'a kam maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:4
verses.text: Ka'am kal'llahan, subay ahantap e'bi amowa h'ndabi ma halam aniya' sabulna, maka subay ahatul addatbi ma sigām.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:5
verses.text: Da'a parūlunbi napsu baranbi magba'is-ba'is, buwat saga a'a mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:6
verses.text: Na, bang takdil ni napsu baran itu, da'a to'ongan kam angahinang la'at ma pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa. Da'a isab kam angulli' ai-aina sabab bininasa e' Panghū' sasuku magdusa buwattē'. Bay kam pata'u kami pasal palkala' itu ma waktu tagna' gi', bay na kam asal banda'an kami.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:7
verses.text: Pinene' kitam e' Tuhan supaya anuyu'an palantara asaltun, da'a paghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:8
verses.text: Jari sasuku anaikutan pandu' itu, Tuhan ya taikutanna, ngga'i ka manusiya'. Lāgi Tuhan ya amuwanan ka'am Rū-na Sussi.  <div eID="gen7859" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3924"/><div sID="gen7860" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3924"/> Na, minsan kam mbal sinulatan pasal paglasabi maka pagkahibi angandol ma Al-Masi, sabab kapandu'an kam e' Tuhan, subay maglasa-liyasahi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:10
verses.text: Maka alasa du kam asal ma saga danakanbi kamemon magpangandol ma si Isa, ina'an ma kaluha'an lahat Makidunya ilu. Sagō' amu'ta kam, saga dauranakan, pasōngunbi gi' lasabi ma sigām.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:11
verses.text: Tuyu'inbi ai-ai amowa ni kasannangan. Tukirinbi hinangbi luggiya', da'a kam anasaw ma hinang pagkahibi. Magusaha'an kam di-bi bo' aniya' kallumanbi, buwat bay panoho'an kami ma ka'am dahū.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:12
verses.text: Manjari bang beya'bi panoho'an itu, pinagaddatan kam e' saga a'a minsan sigām mbal angandol ma si Isa, ati mbal kam asukkal ma kalluman.  <div eID="gen7860" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7858" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3925"/><div sID="gen7861" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kapabalik Panghū' Isa</title> <div sID="gen7862" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3925"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, bilahi kami amahati ka'am pasal saga a'a angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi bang sigām ganta' amatay na. Subay kam mbal magdukka buwat saga a'a kasehe'an, ya halam aniya' pangasa-ngasahan sigām allum pabalik.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:14
verses.text: Am'nnal kitam in si Isa bay amatay ati allum pabīng, angkan kitam am'nnal bang amatay saga a'a ya angandol ma si Isa, pinakallum du sigām pabīng e' Tuhan ati paronganna sigām ma si Isa ma waktu pagbīngna.  <div eID="gen7862" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3926"/><div sID="gen7863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3926"/> Pamandu' kami itu bay min Panghū' Isa, ya yukna in kitam masi allum ma waktu kabīngna pi'itu, mbal du parahū min saga a'a magpatayan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:16
verses.text: Sabab dahū aniya' lling pagtawag akosog, maka suwala nakura' mala'ikat, maka lling tiyup-tiyup min Tuhan. Magtūy saru'un-du'un ya t'kka Panghū' min sulga'. Puwas e' pinabangun dahū saga a'a bay magpatayan, a'a asal bay angandol ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:17
verses.text: Puwas e' kitam ya masi allum ma dunya itu, binowa du magdongan maka sigām pa'angkat ni diyata' gabun bo' anampang Panghū'tam ma tonga'an ayan. Manjari parakayu' kitam ma Panghū' sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:18
verses.text: Angkan pangahaka'unbi saga bissala itu dangan ni dangan, bo' supaya ahogot pangatayanbi.  <div eID="gen7863" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Thess.4"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:1
verses.text: Na, saga dauranakan, in pasal masa sinōng maka pakaradja'anna, minsan kami mbal na anulatan ka'am.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:2
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanbi du, ya llaw kapi'itu Panghū' magtagha' sadja sali' hantang a'a anangkaw ma sangom, mbal kinata'uwan bang sumiyan ya kat'kkana.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:3
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a magupama in sigām asannang na, maka halam aniya' kapiligduhan, magtūy sigām t'kkahan bala' sabu pa'in sigām ah'lling. Mbal sigām makalahi sabab tagha' sadja t'kka bala' he', sapantun d'nda song anganak bang patagha' p'ddi'na.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:4
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu, saga dauranakanku, ngga'i ka ma deyom kalendoman, angkan kam subay mbal kinobla'an bang patagha' ya t'kka llaw ina'an-i, buwat kakobla' a'a bang aniya' sugarul anōd luma'na.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:5
verses.text: Sabab ka'am ilu sali' a'a porol ma kasawahan, ngga'i ka ma kalendoman.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:6
verses.text: Angkanna kitam subay mbal makasali' ni saga a'a kasehe'an, ya magtulihan sadja. Subay kita pajaga, maka subay ahāp pamikiltam.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:7
verses.text: Sarang na waktu sangom pagtuli a'a, maka sangom isab ya waktu paglalango saga a'a magi'inum.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:8
verses.text: Sagō' kitam, pagka ma deyom kasawahan na, subay ahāp pamikiltam, ngga'i ka buwat pamikil a'a maglalango. Kitam magpangandol ma si Isa sali' dalil sundalu magtinampan. Ya panampan daggahata, ya na pangandolta ni Tuhan maka lasata. Ya panurung kōkta, ya na kaholatanta ma Tuhan in kitam kalappasan du.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:9
verses.text: Halam kitam bay pinene' e' Tuhan supaya kitam pinananam mulka'na, sagō' supaya kitam lappasan ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya Panghū'tam.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:10
verses.text: Bay iya amatay ganti'tam bo' supaya kitam pat'nna' ma iya, ai na ka amatay, ai na ka allum lagi' ma waktu kapi'ituna.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:11
verses.text: Angkan kam subay amahogot atay sehe'bi dangan maka dangan. Subay kam magtabang-tiyabangi buwat asal kabiyaksahanbi.  <div eID="gen7864" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7861" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3927"/><div sID="gen7865" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7866" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3927"/> Na, saga dauranakan, aniya' gi' pangamu' kami ma ka'am. Pagaddatinbi saga a'a pagnakura'anbi ma deyoman Panghū' Isa. Atukid sigām maghinang ma deyomanbi, amandu'an ka'am pasal addat-tabi'at maka hinang ya makasulut iya.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:13
verses.text: Pagmahaltabatinbi maka kalasahinbi saga pagnakura'an ilu ma sabab hinang sigām ma ka'am. Magsulut isab kam dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:14
verses.text: Ya na itu isab pangamu' kami ma ka'am, saga dauranakan, amay-amayinbi saga a'a lisu'an, sō'unbi sigām maghinang. Pahogotunbi atay sasuku al'kkas sinōd tāw. Tabanginbi isab saga a'a aluhay tabowa e' sasat. Imaninbi a'a kamemon.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:15
verses.text: Pajaga kam supaya halam aniya' ma ka'am amalosan la'at bang ganta' aniya' angala'at ka'am. Sagō' ya tuyu'anbi sakahaba' waktu subay maghinang ahāp ma pagkahibi angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, sampay ma saga a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen7866" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3928"/><div sID="gen7867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3928"/> Subay kam magkakōran sakahaba' llaw.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:17
verses.text: Subay kam angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:18
verses.text: Ai-ai pat'kka ni ka'am, subay kam magsukul sadja sabab ya na kabaya'an Tuhan subay hinangbi pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi.  <div eID="gen7867" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3929"/><div sID="gen7868" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3929"/> Da'a sagga'unbi ai-ai nihinang e' Rū Sussi ma deyomanbi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:20
verses.text: Da'a palehomunbi saga bissala ya pinabissala e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:21
verses.text: Sagō' pariksa'unbi ai-ai takalebi. Bang ahāp, bogboginbi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:22
verses.text: Halli'inbi la'at indaginis.  <div eID="gen7868" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3930"/><div sID="gen7869" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3930"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in pinasussi kajarihanbi kamemon e' Tuhan, ya amuwan kasannangan atay. Mura-murahan isab, bang pa'in jagahanna nyawabi maka pikilanbi maka baranbi bo' halam aniya' tamakbi ma waktu pagbīng pi'itu Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:24
verses.text: Tantu itu nihinang e' Tuhan ya bay amene' ka'am, sabab kapangandolan iya to'ongan.  <div eID="gen7869" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3931"/><div sID="gen7870" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3931"/> Saga dauranakanku, amu'inbi isab kami tabang ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7870" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3932"/><div sID="gen7871" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3932"/> Siyumunbi saga danakantam mailu kamemon, tanda' pagaddat kami ma sigām.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:27
verses.text: Aniya' kapatutku min Panghū', ya angkan kam soho'ku amassa sulat itu ni pagkahibi kamemon ya angandol ma si Isa.  <div eID="gen7871" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3933"/><div sID="gen7872" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3933"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan min Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. <signed sID="gen7873"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7873"/>  <div eID="gen7872" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7865" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7842" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1Thess.5"/> <div eID="gen7836" osisID="1Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, maka min sehe'ku si Silas maka si Timuti, pinasampay pi'ilu ni palhimpunan Tessaloneka, ya ka'am suku' Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7880" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3934"/><div sID="gen7881" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3934"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'ta Tuhan maka e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7881" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3935"/><div sID="gen7882" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagsukulan maka Pangamu'-ngamu'</title> <div sID="gen7883" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3935"/> Saga dauranakanku angandol ma Al-Masi, wajib kami magsukul na pa'in ni Tuhan ma sababbi sakahaba' waktu. Ya angkan kami patut magsukul sabab aheya na kasōngan pagimanbi ni si Isa Al-Masi, maka pasōng gom pa'in paglasabi dangan maka dangan.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: Ya na itu sababanna angkan kami amantug ma pasalbi ni saga kajama'ahan Tuhan. Sabab minsan kam ma deyom katiksa'an maka kabinasahan, asandal kam maka anatas pangandolbi ma iya.  <div eID="gen7883" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3936"/><div sID="gen7884" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3936"/> Saga pakaradja'an itu kamemon amuwan bainat in hukuman Tuhan abontol, sabab kasandalanbi katiksa'an ma sabab suku' Tuhan kam, ati minnē' kinata'uwan in ka'am tōp pinasōd ni deyom pagparintahanna.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: Abontol asal hukuman Tuhan, tiniksa' du e'na saga a'a bay aniksa' ka'am.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: Ka'am sasuku magkasusahan buwattina'an, binuwanan du kasalamatan ma sinosōng, beya' isab kami. Nihinang itu e' Tuhan bang panyata' Panghū' Isa pi'itu min deyom sulga' magbeya' maka saga mala'ikatna akawasa.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: Asahaya kapi'ituna sali' sapantun api asuleyab. Amat'nna' iya hukuman ma sasuku mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan, maka ma sasuku isab mbal ameya' ma lapal ahāp pasal Panghū' Isa.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: Ya pangahukum Tuhan ma saga a'a inān mulka' halam aniya' katobtobanna. Binutawanan sigām min Panghū'tam maka min kawasana asahaya,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: ma llaw pagbīng si Isa Al-Masi pi'itu. Ya na ina'an waktu pangamahaldika' iya e' a'a suku'na, waktu pamaheya ma iya e' saga a'a magpangandol kamemon. Talapay isab ka'am ilu ma waktu sinōng inān, sabab tapagkahagadbi saksi' kami pasal si Isa.  <div eID="gen7884" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3937"/><div sID="gen7885" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3937"/> Angkanna kami angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in ni Tuhan ma sababbi. Ya pangamu' kami, bang pa'in kam tubus ma kaul maka pi'il pagka kam bay tapene' e' Tuhan. Ya pangamu' kami isab, bang pa'in kam tinabangan min kawasana bo' tatalusbi kamemon niyatbi ma sabab si Isa ya pangandolanbi.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:12
verses.text: Angkan kami angamu'-ngamu' buwattitu supaya pinaheya ōn si Isa Panghū'tam ma sababbi. Maka pinaheya du isab kam e'na, ma sabab tatabangan min Tuhantam sampay min Panghū' Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7885" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Thess.1"/> <div eID="gen7882" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3938"/><div sID="gen7886" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Banta Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7887" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3938"/> Na, in pasal kapi'itu Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi, maka pasal pagtimuktam maina'an maka iya, ya na itu pangamu' kami ma ka'am saga dauranakanku.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: Da'a kam magtūy asasaw atawa asusa bang aniya' a'a magbau'-bau' in llaw pagbīng Panghū' Isa ni dunya ta'abut na. Da'a beya'unbi minsan kami ya tinugpang bay amabeya' lapal atawa sulat atawa bissala bay patulun min Tuhan.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Da'a kam ameya' nilingu e' sai-sai minsan buwattingga pamissala sigām. Sabab ya llaw Panghū' inān mbal gi' magtūy at'kka, sabab in kaheka'an manusiya' ma dunya itu subay anagga' dahū ma Tuhan. Maka aniya' dakayu' a'a mamarahi la'atna subay patuwa' dahū bo' yampa at'kka llaw ina'an-i. Nalka' ya pamakadal ma a'a inān.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: Kinuntarahan e'na ai-ai kamemon ya pagtuhanan e' manusiya', maka kamemon ya sinumba e' sigām. Magpalanga iya di-na min kamemon, ati pasōd iya aningkō' ma langgal pangarapan Tuhan magnahu'-nahu' in iya Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7887" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3939"/><div sID="gen7888" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3939"/> Halam bahā' taentombi? Bay na itu pangahakaku ma ka'am waktu lagi' bay kamailuku.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du bang ai ya angagpang a'a mamarahi ala'at e', ya angkan mbal magtūy paniya' bay yukku-i. Subay ta'abut waktu bay pangangganta' iya bo' yampa iya palahil.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: Ma buwattina'an magkahinangan asal a'a mamarahi la'atna inān, sagō' ma deyom sipuk. Mbal gi' tino'ongan hinangna sat'ggol masi maitu ya manghahawid.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: Subay nila'anan manghahawid inān bo' yampa palahil a'a mamarahi la'atna itu. Sagō' atubag du iya e' Panghū' Isa ma waktu kabalikna pi'itu. Amatay iya e' napas Panghū', magmula iya katūyan ma sabab sahaya Panghū'.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: Jari paglahil a'a itu, aniya' kawasana min nakura' saitan ya angkan iya makahinang kaginisan hinang kawasahan maka saga paltanda'an maka saga hinang makainu-inu, sagō' ngga'i ka b'nnal.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: Ginuna e'na kala'atan indaginis pamarupangna saga a'a anudju nalka'. Ya angkan sigām anudju nalka' sabab mbal sigām bilahi ma pandu' kasab'nnalan. Halam tataima' e' sigām bo' supaya sigām lappasan min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: Pagka buwattē', pinat'kkahan sigām e' Tuhan akkal-pikilan abengkok, ya po'on sigām magkahagad ma kaputingan.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: Angkan pinat'kkahan hukuman sasuku mbal magkahagad ma pandu' kasab'nnalan saguwā' kinōgan gom pa'in maghinang kala'atan.  <div eID="gen7888" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7886" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3940"/><div sID="gen7889" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamatotog Pangandoltam</title> <div sID="gen7890" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3940"/> Sagō' wajib kami magsukul ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu ma sabab ka'am, saga dauranakan kinalasahan e' Panghū'tam. Sabab bay kam tapene' asal e' Tuhan min awal tagna' lagi', supaya kam lappasan ma sabab hinang Rū Tuhan amasussi deyom ataybi, maka ma sabab pagkahagadbi ma pandu' kasab'nnalan pasal si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: Ya na ko' he' po'onna angkan kam tapene' e' Tuhan, pagka takalebi lapal ahāp ya bay pagnasihat kami ma ka'am. Tapene' kam e'na supaya kam pinahampitan sanglit maka sahaya Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: Angkanna, saga dauranakanku, patotogunbi pangandolbi. Bogboginbi to'ongan saga pandu' bay takalebi min bowa' kami, sampay saga pandu' ma deyom sulat bay pabeya'an kami ni ka'am.  <div eID="gen7890" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3941"/><div sID="gen7891" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3941"/> Kinalasahan kitam e' Mma'tam Tuhan, maka tinabang kitam e'na, angkan pamuwanna na ma kitam katotogan atay anatas ni kasaumulan. Pamuwanna isab pangasa mbal magkapinda. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: amahogot ataybi maka amakosog ka'am supaya ahāp sadja hinangbi maka bissalabi.  <div eID="gen7891" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Thess.2"/> <div eID="gen7889" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3942"/><div sID="gen7892" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Paul Mikisambahayang</title> <div sID="gen7893" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3942"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, ya itu llingku katapusan. Amu'-amu'inbi kami tabang ni Tuhan, bang pa'in al'kkas palatag lapal pasal Panghū'tam, bang pa'in nihulmat isab lapal itu e' saga a'a makakale, buwat bay kapangahulmatbi.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: Angamu'-ngamu' kam isab bang pa'in kami pinuwas e' Tuhan min a'a jahulaka', sabab ngga'i ka a'a kamemon ya magkahagad ma lapal ahāp.  <div eID="gen7893" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3943"/><div sID="gen7894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3943"/> Daipara kapangandolan to'ongan Panghū'tam. Pinahogot e'na imanbi, nihampanan isab kam bo' mbal ni'inay e' nakura' saitan.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: Angandol kami ma ka'am ma sabab Panghū'tam, ati kata'uwan kami in ka'am tantu ameya' ma bay panoho'an kami, maka hinangbi na pa'in.  <div eID="gen7894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3944"/><div sID="gen7895" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3944"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam niulinan e' Panghū' bo' pasōng ta'ubi pasal lasa Tuhan ma ka'am, maka pasal kasandal Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7895" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7892" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3945"/><div sID="gen7896" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' Pasal Kalisu'</title> <div sID="gen7897" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3945"/> Manjari, saga dauranakanku, pagka aniya' kapatut kami min Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi, soho'ta kam paokat min pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa kasehe', ya lisu'an magusaha, maka mbal ameya' ma bay pamandu' kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanbi asal in kami subay panunuranbi. Halam kami bay lisu'an maghinang waktu gi' kamailu kami ma ka'am.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: Halam kami bay mikibalanja', sagō' bayaran kami ai-ai bay pagnapaka kami. Gom pa'in kami maghulas-sangsā' llaw maka sangom bo' supaya aniya' kalluman kami. Jari mbal kam kabuhatan amalanja'.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: Patut asal bang kami mikibalanja' ni ka'am, sagō' amalanja'an kami di-kami bo' aniya' kapamintānganbi.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: Sabab minsan ma waktu kamailu kami, aniya' bay pamandu' kami ma ka'am, yuk-i, “Bang a'a mbal bilahi maghinang, subay iya mbal pakanbi.”  <div eID="gen7897" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3946"/><div sID="gen7898" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3946"/> Ya angkan itu binissala, sabab makakale kami aniya' ilu ma ka'am saga a'a lisu'an magusaha maka kabiyaksahan sigām palamud ma palkala' ngga'i ka suku' sigām.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: Ya panoho'an kami maka pamituwa kami ma sigām min kapatut Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi, subay sigām pahantap magusaha.  <div eID="gen7898" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3947"/><div sID="gen7899" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3947"/> Sagō' ka'am, saga dauranakanku, da'a kam sinumu maghinang ahāp.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:14
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' mailu agagga ameya' ma panoho'an kami ya ma deyom sulat itu, gindaninbi a'a inān ati da'a kam magbeya' maka iya bo' supaya iya aiya'.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:15
verses.text: Da'a pa'in iya itungunbi sali' bantabi, sagō' banda'anbi iya sali' dakayu' danakanbi.  <div eID="gen7899" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7896" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3948"/><div sID="gen7900" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen7901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3948"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an kasannangan e' Panghū'tam, ya po'onan kasannangan, sakahaba' waktu minsan ai makani-ka'am. Mura-murahan isab, bang pa'in iya pagapi' ma ka'am kamemon.  <div eID="gen7901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3949"/><div sID="gen7902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3949"/> Na, aku baranku ya anulat katapusan sulat itu, tanda' in aku si Paul ya amabeya'. Buwattitu asal kabiyaksahanku ma sulatku kamemon.  <div eID="gen7902" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3950"/><div sID="gen7903" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3950"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan aheya e' Panghū' Isa Al-Masi. <signed sID="gen7904"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7904"/>  <div eID="gen7903" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7900" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7879" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="2Thess.3"/> <div eID="gen7874" osisID="2Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, a'a kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi ma sabab panoho'an Tuhantam Manglalappas, maka ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pangaholatantam.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:2
verses.text: Pasampayku sulat itu ni ka'a, Timuti, ya ōnanku anakku lahasiya' ma sabab pangandolnu ma si Isa. <div eID="gen7912" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7913" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Bang pa'in ka kina'ase'an sampay binuwanan kasannangan deyom atay.  <div eID="gen7913" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3951"/><div sID="gen7914" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Saga Guru Magpandu' Kaputingan</title> <div sID="gen7915" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3951"/> Na, Timuti, balikanku lagi' bay panoho'anku ma ka'a, songku pa'in atulak ni lahat Makidunya. Kabaya'anku subay ka pat'ddas mailu ma Epesos bo' supaya talāngnu saga a'a mailu, ya amandu' saga pandu' ngga'i ka b'nnal.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:4
verses.text: Soho'un sigām pahali magsuli-suli pasal kissa hinangan manusiya' maka saga salsila panugsugan ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām, sabab hal paglugatan. Mbal amowa ni maksud Tuhan, ya pamata'una ma saga a'a angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:5
verses.text: Ya mohotku angkan buwattitu pamituwaku, subay ajatu lasabi luwas min atay pote', maka min pikilan alanu' maka min iman sab'nnal-b'nnal.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:6
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' a'a bay pasiha' min pandu'ku. Ya taturul e' sigām saga suli-suli halam aniya' pūsna.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:7
verses.text: Bilahi sigām niōnan guru pagguruhan sara' Tuhan, sagō' mbal tahati e' sigām bang ai pamandu' sigām maka ai pangalogos sigām ma saga a'a.  <div eID="gen7915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3952"/><div sID="gen7916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3952"/> Kata'uwanta in sara' bay tasulat e' si Musa ahāp asal, bang pa'in apatut e'ta angangguna iya.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:9
verses.text: Kata'uwantam isab ngga'i ka a'a adil ya pinat'nna'an sara' itu, sagō' a'a magpangalanggal sara' maka a'a agagga pinandu'an, a'a mbal angisbat Tuhan, maka a'a baldusa. Ya pinat'nna'an sara' isab saga a'a asabul maka a'a halam aniya' kannal sigām tudju ni Tuhan, beya' isab saga a'a amono' matto'a sigām atawa pagkahi sigām manusiya'.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:10
verses.text: Pinat'nna'an isab sara' saga a'a angaliyu-lakad, maka a'a maghinang kasabulan, maka a'a anaggaw pagkahi sigām pagpilak, a'a magputing, a'a anaksi' ya ngga'i ka b'nnal. Taluwa' sara' isab ba'anan kahinangan ai-ai ya mbal magtaluwa' maka pandu' b'nnal.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:11
verses.text: Pandu' b'nnal itu magtaluwa' maka lapal ahāp ya pangandol ma aku e' Tuhan asahaya, ya wajib pinagmahaldika'an.  <div eID="gen7916" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7914" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3953"/><div sID="gen7917" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Ase' maka Lasa Tuhan ya Pagsukulan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen7918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3953"/> Magsukul aku ni si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam, ya amuwanan aku kosog bo' supaya aku makahinang hinangku. Magsukul aku ni iya sabab tabistana aku patut pangandolan, ati kawakilan aku e'na maghinang ma iya.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:13
verses.text: Kawakilan aku e'na minsan iya bay pah'llinganku pangkal ma tahun palabay, minsan bay tala'atku saga a'ana maka abisa bay pangala'ugku ma sigām. Daipara kina'ase'an aku e'na sabab ma waktu he' halam gi' aniya' bay pangandolku ma iya, angkan aku a'awam in bay kahinanganku inān ala'at.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:14
verses.text: Pinalabi e' Panghū'tam lasana maka ase'na ma aku, maka tinabang aku e'na bo' pasōng pangandolku. Tinabang isab aku angalasa pagkahiku. Suku'tam asal kahāpan ina'an-i bang kitam parakayu' ni si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7918" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3954"/><div sID="gen7919" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3954"/> B'nnal kabtangan itu, subay tinaima' to'ongan, ya yuk-i, “In si Isa Al-Masi bay pi'itu ni dunya bo' supaya puwasanna saga a'a dusahan min hukuman dusa.” Bang takdil ni a'a dusahan, halam aniya' paliyu min aku.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:16
verses.text: Sagō' minsan buwattē' paldusahanku, bay aku kina'ase'an to'ongan e' Tuhan ati niampun aku e'na. Pina'nda'an e' si Isa katuyu'na ma saga a'a dusahan, angkan aku bay imananna to'ongan minsan aku dusahan labi min kamemon. Manjari aku itu sali' suntu'an ma saga a'a magkahagad ma iya ma llaw sinōng sampay binuwanan kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:17
verses.text: Magmahaldika' kitam ma Tuhan dakayu'-kayu', ya Sultan ni kasaumulan. Mbal iya magkamatay, mbal iya ta'nda' e' manusiya'. Wajib iya pinudji salama-lama. Amin.  <div eID="gen7919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3955"/><div sID="gen7920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3955"/> Timuti, anakta ka. Pangandolku na ma ka'a panoho'an itu, ya magtaluwa' asal maka palman Tuhan, ya bay binowahan ka'a e' saga a'a magbobowa palman. Isbatun to'ongan kabtangan palman itu bo' ahāp e'nu angatu ma ai-ai ala'at.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:19
verses.text: Pahogotun pangandolnu ma si Isa Al-Masi. Paisbat ka bo' halam aniya' dusa tahinangnu ya makasasaw pikilannu. Sabab aniya' saga a'a mbal ameya' ma pikilan alanu', ya angkan magka'at pangandol sigām ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:20
verses.text: Buwattē' si Himinus maka si Iskandar maka kasehe'an lagi'. Bay na sigām tukbalanku ni pang'ntanan nakura' saitan supaya sigām amintāng ati bo' pahali amah'lling pangkal ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7920" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.1"/> <div eID="gen7917" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3956"/><div sID="gen7921" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangarap ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3956"/> Ya itu saga pamituwaku: in kitam bebeya'an si Isa subay anabbut Tuhan, subay angamu' tabang ni iya maka magsarang-sukul. Subay kitam angamu'-ngamu' ma pasal a'a kamemon,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:2
verses.text: ma pasal saga sultan maka a'a kamemon taga-kapatut magparinta bo' supaya asannang maka ahantap paglahattam, samantala' kitam magmatāw ma Tuhan min addat-tabi'at asaltun.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Landu' ahāp bang buwattē' bowahantam, makasulut atay Tuhan ya Manglalappas.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:4
verses.text: Ya kabaya'an Tuhan itu, in manusiya' kamemon subay lappasan min hukuman dusa maka subay ata'uwan pandu' kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:5
verses.text: Sabab dakayu' du Tuhan, maka dakayu' du isab magpa'llot ma Tuhan maka manusiya' amapagkahāp sigām, ya na si Isa Al-Masi pagkahita manusiya'.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:6
verses.text: Bay paglilla'na kallumna pangal'kkat bangsa manusiya' min paldusahan sigām. Manjari, pagka amatay si Isa ma waktu bay asal pangangganta' e' Tuhan, minnē' tatuman bang ai ya kabaya'an Tuhan ma manusiya'.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Ya na itu sababna angkan aku kawakilan e' Tuhan, sinō' amandu' ma saga a'a ngga'i ka bangsa Yahudi, supaya sigām nasihatanku pasal pangandol ma si Isa Al-Masi maka pasal pandu' kasab'nnalan. B'nnal sadja ya pah'llingku itu, mbal aku magputing!  <div eID="gen7922" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3957"/><div sID="gen7923" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3957"/> Maingga-maingga aniya' saga jama'a si Isa magtipun, ya kabaya'anku in kal'llahan subay angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan magatay pote', hinabu sigām anangga ma halam aniya' ka'astol atawa paglugat sigām ni sai-sai.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:9
verses.text: Kabaya'anku isab subay ahantap bowahan saga d'nda bang takdil ni pan'mmek. Ya kalingkat sigām subay aganta'. Bu'un sigām subay nihatul sagō' da'a sakit pina'alti. Subay sigām da'a magbulawan atawa magmussa' atawa mags'mmek ahalga'.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Ya makalingkat sigām saga kahinangan ahāp. Tōp asal itu ma saga d'nda ya magpina'in in sigām magtata'at ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7923" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3958"/><div sID="gen7924" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3958"/> Saga d'nda isab subay akale sadja bang ninasihatan, maka subay angaku pinandu'an.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:12
verses.text: Mbal tugutanku saga d'nda magnasihat atawa magmanda ma l'lla. In d'nda subay hal akale bang ma palhimpunanbi.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:13
verses.text: Sabab si Mbo' Adam bay pinapanjari dahū e' Tuhan bo' yampa si Sitti Hawa.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:14
verses.text: Maka ngga'i ka si Adam ya bay ka'akkalan e' nakura' saitan. D'nda ya bay ka'akkalan, maka d'nda ya bay angalanggal sara' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:15
verses.text: Malaingkan lappasan du saga d'nda ma paganak bang pa'in tinuyu'an e' sigām pangandol ma Tuhan, maka lasa sigām ma a'a, maka kasussi pangatayan sigām. Addat-tabi'at sigām isab subay ahantap na pa'in.  <div eID="gen7924" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.2"/> <div eID="gen7921" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3959"/><div sID="gen7925" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmakōkan ma Palhimpunan saga Jama'a si Isa</title> <div sID="gen7926" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3959"/> B'nnal kabtangan itu, ya yuk-i, “Bang a'a angangut pinat'nna' magmakōk ma saga jama'a si Isa, ahāp pangangutna.”

verses.name: I Timothy 3:2
verses.text: Subay halam aniya' la'at atawa sā' panā'an a'a magmakōk. Subay dakayu' du h'ndana, subay iya ahantap ma ai-ai hinangna, subay ahāp pikilanna maka ahāp addatna. Bang aniya' pehē' ni luma'na subay pa'iddana to'ongan. Subay iya apanday isab amandu' ma saga sehe'na.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:3
verses.text: Subay iya ngga'i ka a'a maglalango. Subay iya mbal ab'ngngis sagō' subay ahāp bowahanna ni kamemon. Subay iya mbal pangalulugat, subay mbal napsuhan ma pilak.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:4
verses.text: Subay ahāp e'na angahatul anak-h'ndana, maka in iya baranna subay pinagaddatan e' panganakna. Panoho'anna isab subay bineya' e' sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:5
verses.text: Sabab bistahunbi, bang a'a pinat'nna' nakura' bo' mbal ata'u angahatul ma anak-h'ndana, buwattingga e'na angahatul katimukan saga a'a suku' Tuhan?

verses.name: I Timothy 3:6
verses.text: Bang a'a sōd baha'u ni si Isa Al-Masi mbal iya makajari pinat'nna' nakura' sabab mbal gi' ahogot pangandolna, gana-gana palanga atayna ati pinat'kkahan iya hukuman, buwat bay hukuman ma nakura' saitan.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:7
verses.text: Sagō' ya a'a pinat'nna' pagmakōkan subay pinagaddatan asal e' saga a'a ngga'i ka jama'a si Isa. Sababna, bang iya ganta' tasā' e' sigām, gana-gana iya tabowa e' sasat nakura' saitan.  <div eID="gen7926" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7925" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3960"/><div sID="gen7927" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magtatabang ma Palhimpunan saga Jama'a si Isa</title> <div sID="gen7928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3960"/> Na, in pasal a'a pinat'nna' magtatabang ma katimukanbi saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi, subay asaltun addat-tabi'at sigām, maka subay sigām mbal magduwa-d'lla'. Subay sigām mbal maglalango maka subay mbal napsuhan ma sīn.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:9
verses.text: Subay sigām patotog magatay pote' ma pandu' kasab'nnalan ya bay pamata'u e' Tuhan pasal si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:10
verses.text: Subay sigām sinulayan dahū, jari bang kapandogahan na in addat sigām ahāp, makajari na sigām pinat'nna' magtatabang ma saga nakura'.  <div eID="gen7928" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3961"/><div sID="gen7929" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3961"/> Damikiyanna h'nda sigām, subay ahāp isab addat-tabi'at sigām maka subay mbal biyaksa angalituhan suli-suli. Subay isab mbal angandūl ma napsu sigām, maka subay kapangandolan ma ai-ai indaginis.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Saga a'a pinat'nna' magtatabang itu subay dakayu' du h'ndana maka subay ahāp e'na angahatul anak-h'ndana maka sasuku ma okomanna.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:13
verses.text: Jari bang ahāp e' saga a'a magtatabang itu maghinang kahinangan sigām, pinaheya du ōn sigām, ati makatawakkal sigām amissala ma pasal pangandol ni si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7929" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7927" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3962"/><div sID="gen7930" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Bay Pamata'u e' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7931" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3962"/> Na, Timuti, buwattitu panulatku ma ka'a sabab angasa aku pasa'ut pi'ilu.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:15
verses.text: Sagō' bang aku tinaggahan, kata'uwannu du min sulat itu bang buwattingga bowahan saga a'a ma deyom okoman Tuhan, hatina ma palhimpunanbi saga a'a suku' Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama. In palhimpunan ilu ibarat papagan maka hāg ya pasangdolan pandu' kasab'nnalan itu.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:16
verses.text: Halam aniya' kalu-kaluna, alalom sidda pandu' agamatam, pandu' pasal si Isa Al-Masi ya bay halam kinata'uwan, sagō' pinata'u na e' Tuhan. <lg sID="gen7932"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7933"/>Bay iya palahil pi'itu magpabaran manusiya',<l eID="gen7933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7934"/>sinaksi'an iya e' Rū Sussi in iya a'adil.<l eID="gen7934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7935"/>Ta'nda' iya e' ba'anan mala'ikat.<l eID="gen7935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7936"/>Pinagnasihat iya ni palbangsahan kamemon,<l eID="gen7936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7937"/>pinagkahagad iya e' saga a'a ma kaluha'an dunya.<l eID="gen7937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7938"/>Tabowa iya pa'angkat ni kasahaya'an sulga'.<l eID="gen7938" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7932"/>  <div eID="gen7931" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.3"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:1
verses.text: Pasti' asal pamissala Rū Tuhan ma pasal waktu sinōng. Yukna aheka a'a ang'bba min pamogbog sigām ma pandu' kasab'nnalan bo' angisbat ma saitan putingan, maka ameya' isab ma pandu' bay minnē'.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:2
verses.text: Saga pandu' itu pinalatun e' saga a'a pangangakkal, ya mbal ata'u magsusun sabab abengkok itikad sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:3
verses.text: Bang ma pandu' saga a'a itu, dusahan kono' sasuku magh'nda atawa magh'lla, maka aniya' kono' pagkakan mbal manjari kinakan. Asā' to'ongan pandu' buwattē' sabab in pagkakan itu bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan, angkan patut nihalal maka pinagsukulan e' sasuku magkahagad maka makata'u pandu' b'nnal.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:4
verses.text: Ahāp asal kamemon bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan, angkan subay taima'ta sadja bang pa'in amu'anta pagsukulan ni iya.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:5
verses.text: Halal kinakanta kamemon ma sabab lapal Tuhan maka ma sabab pagsukulta isab.  <div eID="gen7939" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7930" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3963"/><div sID="gen7940" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sosoho'an si Isa Al-Masi Ahāp</title> <div sID="gen7941" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3963"/> Na, Timuti, bang pamandu'nu saga pituwaku itu ni saga dauranakanta angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, ahāp hinangnu. Akosog isab imannu ma sabab lapal agamatam ya pamalutannu, maka ma sabab pandu' kasab'nnalan ya pameya'annu.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:7
verses.text: Sagō' da'a ka angikut ma saga kissa-kissa nsa'-bidda', ya halam aniya' kapūsanna. Patanamun akkal-pikilannu bo' taptap ahāp pameya'nu ma kabaya'an Tuhan.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Bang baranta ya pakosogta, aniya' du kagunahanna minsan mbal aheya. Sagō' bang pakosogta pangandolta tudju ni Tuhan supaya tabeya'ta kabaya'anna, aheya to'ongan kagunahanna. Sabab minnē' kita tabowa ni kahāpan, ngga'i ka hal ma dunya ītu, sampay isab ma dunya dakayu'.  <div eID="gen7941" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3964"/><div sID="gen7942" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3964"/> B'nnal kabtangan itu, wajib ni'isbat kamemon.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:10
verses.text: Ya angkan kitam magsangsā' na pa'in maka magtuyu' na pa'in magnasihat, sabab pangasahantam Tuhan kakkal salama-lama. In iya isab angalappas ma manusiya' kamemon min hukuman dusa, labi-luba'na saga a'a magkahagad ma iya.  <div eID="gen7942" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3965"/><div sID="gen7943" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3965"/> Manjari, Timuti, pandu'in pahāp maka soho'un bineya' saga panoho'an itu.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:12
verses.text: Da'a ka aiya' amandu' minsan aniya' amareyo'-deyo' ka'a ma sabab abata' lagi' ka. Sagō' subay ahāp bowahannu kamemon bo' ka manjari panunuran e' saga a'a angandol mailu ma si Isa Al-Masi. Subay ahāp kaul-pi'ilnu, subay alasa ma pagkahinu, subay akosog pangandolnu ma Tuhan, maka subay halam aniya' la'at ma deyom pikilannu.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:13
verses.text: Sat'ggolku mbal gi' makapi'ilu, patuyu' ka amassa min Kitab sakahaba' waktu kapagtipunbi saga jama'a si Isa. Patuyu' ka anganasihat maka amandu'an sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Da'a haman-hamanun kapandayannu, ya bay min Rū Sussi. Kapandayan itu bay pamuwan ka'a ma waktu palabay, pagka aniya' lapal min Tuhan bay binissala ma pasalnu, maka ka'a bay pinat'nna'an tangan e' saga pagmatto'ahan.  <div eID="gen7943" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3966"/><div sID="gen7944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3966"/> Hinangun kamemon ya pamahinang ka'a ma deyom sulat itu. Patukid ka to'ongan, bo' supaya ta'nda' e' a'a kamemon ahāp kasōngannu.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:16
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' ka ma barannu sampay ma pamandu'nu. Hinangun na pa'in ai-ai panoho'anku itu ma ka'a. Sabab bang itu pagtuyu'annu, ngga'i ka hal ka'a ya lappasan min hukuman dusa, sagō' sasuku akale ma lapalnu.  <div eID="gen7944" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.4"/> <div eID="gen7940" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3967"/><div sID="gen7945" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmatto'ahan, Balu D'nda, maka Ata</title> <div sID="gen7946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3967"/> Da'a ka amah'llingan l'lla aumul gi' min ka'a. Bang saupama aniya' pamandu'nu ma iya, palunukun bissalanu buwat e'nu amissala ni mma'nu lissi. Saga l'lla abata' lagi', bistahun sali' danakannu.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:2
verses.text: Saga d'nda aumul min ka'a, pagaddatin buwat ka-e'nu ma ina'nu lissi. Saga d'nda abata' lagi', pagaddatin sigām buwat danakannu isab, ma halam aniya' pikilannu saddī tudju ni sigām.  <div eID="gen7946" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3968"/><div sID="gen7947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3968"/> Na, in pasal saga d'nda abalu angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, ya halam taga-kampung amatuntul sigām, pagaddatin sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:4
verses.text: Sagō' bang balu d'nda aniya' anakna atawa mpuna, anak-mpuna he' subay magka'inagonan kamatto'ahan sigām. Bainat ko' inān in sigām magta'at sab'nnal-b'nnal ni Tuhan, ati katungbasan e' sigām bay kamale'an matto'a sigām atawa mbo' sigām angipat sigām tagna'. Jari bang buwattē' hinang sigām, kasulutan Tuhan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:5
verses.text: Saguwā' bang balu d'nda karangan-danganan, halam to'ongan aniya' angupiksa' iya, Tuhan sadja ya kaholatanna. Angamu'-ngamu' na pa'in iya ni Tuhan, mikitabang isab ma iya llaw-sangom.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:6
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' balu d'nda hal angandūlan napsu baranna, sapantun iya a'a amatay minsan masi gi' allum baranna.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:7
verses.text: Pasampayun pamandu'ku itu ni saga bebeya'an si Isa mailu, supaya halam aniya' pagsababan panā'an a'a ma sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:8
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' a'a mailu mbal bilahi amahilala' lahasiya'na, ya lagi'na bang mbal amahilala' a'a ma okomanna, a'a inān ang'bba na min pandu' ya pagkahagarantam, maka akalap gi' dusana min a'a mbal angandol ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7947" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3969"/><div sID="gen7948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3969"/> Na, bang takdil ni pagsusulatan balu d'nda, ya patut nilapay bang d'nda ta'abut nnompū' tahun umulna, maka balu halam bay magh'lla ni saddī.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:10
verses.text: Ya patut nilapay, bang balu abantug ma sabab hinangna ahāp, buwat pami'atna ma panganakna, pamahilala'na ma saga a'a makani-luma'na, maka areyo' pangatayanna angayuput saga pagkahina suku' Tuhan. Subay d'nda anabang saga a'a taluwa' kasusahan, maka atuyu' isab angahinang kahāpan indaginis. Ya na ina'an ginis balu ya taluwa' sinulat.  <div eID="gen7948" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3970"/><div sID="gen7949" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3970"/> Sagō' bang balu d'nda abata' gi', da'a sigām lapayun ma deyom pagsulatan ilu, sabab aluhay apinda pikilan sigām. Bang sigām t'kkahan baya' magh'lla, ang'bba du sigām min paghinang sigām ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:12
verses.text: Jari makarusa sigām pagka mbal na taisbat bay janji' sigām ni Tuhan tagna' kabalu sigām.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:13
verses.text: Gana-gana sigām angalisu' maghinang, ati pabiyaksa sigām angalatag kaluma'an. Maka ngga'i ka isab hal e'-i, sabab tagihan sigām maglituhan suli-suli ma pasal a'a kasehe'an. Palamud sigām ma palkala' ngga'i ka suku' sigām, maka pinagsuli-suli na pa'in e' sigām ya mbal wajib binissala.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:14
verses.text: Bang ma aku, ahāp lagi' bang saga balu masi gi' abata' magh'lla pabīng maka maganak maka angahatul deyom luma' sigām. Manjari halam aniya' la'at tabissala e' saga bantatam ma pasalan kitam magpangandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:15
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu pamandu'ku, sabab aniya' saga balu pataikut na min Tuhan bo' ameya' ma nakura' saitan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:16
verses.text: Sagō' bang d'nda bebeya'an si Isa taga-lahasiya' balu d'nda, ya d'nda inān subay angupiksa' iya. Mbal manjari pinaupiksa' e'na ma saga Almasihin kasehe'. Sarang ma sigām amahilala' saga d'nda balu ya halam to'ongan aniya' magka'inagonan sigām.  <div eID="gen7949" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3971"/><div sID="gen7950" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3971"/> Na, in pasal saga matto'a ya ahāp pamatuntul sigām ma ka'am jama'a si Isa Al-Masi ilu, patut tungbas sigām nilipat duwa. Labi-labi gi' isab bang matto'a amuspusan kosogna magnasihat maka magpandu'.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:18
verses.text: Sabab tasulat asal ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Da'a sampongunbi bowa' sapi' pasalta' anganggisa' pai.” Maka aniya' isab ayat Kitab dakayu', ya yuk-i, “Bang a'a sinō' maghinang, patut iya tinambahan.”

verses.name: I Timothy 5:19
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' anuntutan dakayu' matto'abi, da'a magtūy asipunbi tuntut e'. Subay aniya' duwangan atawa t'llungan ya makasaksi' ma dusana.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:20
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' makarusa, bi'atunbi a'a inān ma pang'nda' saga bebeya'an si Isa kamemon, bo' supaya amintāng a'a kasehe'an maka tināw isab anunuran a'a bay makarusa he'.  <div eID="gen7950" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3972"/><div sID="gen7951" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3972"/> Timuti, saksi'ku Tuhan maka si Isa Al-Masi maka saga mala'ikat asussi, soho'ta ka to'ongan angisbat ai-ai ya panoho'anku ka'a ma deyom sulat itu. Da'a ka amapagbidda' ma a'a minsan sai. Ai-ai hinangnu da'a ka angandapitan dangan ma saukat kalasahannu.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:22
verses.text: Da'a ka magdai'-dai' amene' a'a nihinang pagmakōkan ma palhimpunanbi. Tandingun dahū bo' kinata'uwan addat-tabi'atna. Da'a ka palamud ma dusa a'a kasehe'an. Pahalli' ka ma barannu bo' asaltun kaul-pi'ilnu.  <div eID="gen7951" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3973"/><div sID="gen7952" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3973"/> Da'a hal bohe' ya inumnu, sagō' anginum ka isab dangkuri' binu-anggul panambal b'ttongnu, sabab maumu ka magsaki-saki.  <div eID="gen7952" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3974"/><div sID="gen7953" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3974"/> Aniya' saga a'a ta'nda'an di-na paldusahan sigām, maka kata'uwanta in sigām taga-dusa angkan sigām tantu nihukum ma sinosōng. Aniya' isab saga a'a kasehe'an mbal magtūy ta'nda' dusa sigām. Subay waktu sinōng bo' yampa kinata'uwan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:25
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab aniya' saga hinang atampal magtūy kahāpna, maka aniya' isab saga hinang mbal magtūy kinata'uwan. Sagō' minsan buwattē', mbal katapukan, kinata'uwan du ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen7953" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.5"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:1
verses.text: Sasuku banyaga' magpangandol ma si Isa subay magaddat to'ongan ma saga a'a ya tag-dapu sigām, bo' supaya halam aniya' makapah'lling la'at ma Tuhan, atawa makasoway pandu' ya pameya'antam.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:2
verses.text: Bang banyaga' pinagdapuhan e' pagkahi bebeya'an si Isa, subay mbal kinulangan pagaddatna ma saukat magdanakan sigām ma deyoman Al-Masi. Ahāp lagi' bang banyaga' inān amahāp hinangna, ma sabab a'a paghinanganna he' pagkahina bebeya'an si Isa, a'a isab asal kalasahanna. Ya itu subay pamandu'nu ma kasehe'annu ilu: soho'un sigām ameya' to'ongan.  <div eID="gen7954" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7945" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3975"/><div sID="gen7955" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Karaya B'nnal</title> <div sID="gen7956" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3975"/> Bang aniya' mailu magpandu', bo' saddī pamandu'na min pandu' kasab'nnalan bay min Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi, maka bang saddī isab min pandu' ya amowa kitam maghinang kabaya'an Tuhan,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:4
verses.text: na, hal magmalangkahi a'a inān maka halam aniya' kata'uwanna. Ya sadja kabaya'anna subay magpayod maka magsu'al pasal saga kabtangan. Ya kamaujuranna aniya' maglindi-lindihan, aniya' magpanganjawab, aniya' maghimumungan ala'at, aniya' magtuna' nsa'-bidda'.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:5
verses.text: Jari magsagga' na pa'in saga a'a itu. Asagut deyom pikilan sigām, maka mbal na tasilang e' sigām pandu' kasab'nnalan. Ma pangannal sigām, bang sigām magagama magdaya du sigām.  <div eID="gen7956" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3976"/><div sID="gen7957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3976"/> B'nnal isab, aheya untungta bang kita magsukul sadja ma ai-ai pangangganta' kita.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:7
verses.text: Kita itu ma waktu kalahilta, aniya' bahā' bay bowata ni deyom dunya itu? Halam aniya'. Damikiyanna bang kita amatay, halam aniya' tabowata pehē'.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:8
verses.text: Angkanna kita subay mbal anawad. Bang pa'in aniya' napakata maka pan'mmekta, sarang na ko' he'.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:9
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a bilahi magkarayahan, aluhay tabowa sinasat magdusa. Tajallat sigām e' ba'anan napsu ma karupangan indaginis ya amaka'at sigām, ati ya kamattihanna magmula du sigām ma dunya ītu sampay ma dunya dakayu'.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:10
verses.text: Sabab napsuta ma alta' ya po'onan la'at kaginisan kamemon ya nihinang e' manusiya'. Aniya' isab saga a'a napsuhan ma alta', ati minnē' sigām ang'bbahan pangandol sigām ma si Isa Al-Masi. Ya kamaujuranna ahansul pangatayan sigām e' ba'anan kasusahan ya pat'kka ni sigām.  <div eID="gen7957" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7955" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3977"/><div sID="gen7958" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamituwa ma si Timuti Sadja</title> <div sID="gen7959" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3977"/> Saguwā' ka'a, Timuti, a'a tapene' e' Tuhan, patala ka min kala'atan inān kamemon. Tukirin kaul-pi'il abontol maka pangisbat ni Tuhan, maka pangandol ma Al-Masi, maka lasa ma pagkahinu. Pahantapun bowahannu minsan ma sai, maka imanin ai-ai tum'kka ni ka'a.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:12
verses.text: Puspusin kosognu ameya' ma Al-Masi, maka angutun kallum kakkal ya anatas ni kasaumulan, sabab ya na ilu po'onanna ya angkan ka'a-i niabbit e' Tuhan. Entomun bay kapagsab'nnalnu ma alopan saga saksi' aheka, hatina in ka'a angandol to'ongan ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:13
verses.text: Aniya' itu pamituwaku ma ka'a ma pang'nda' Tuhan, ya amuwan napas ma binangsa kamemon, maka ma pang'nda' si Isa Al-Masi, ya bay atawakkal magpasab'nnal ma alopan gubnul Puntus Pilatu pasal pangandol ma Tuhan. Buwattitu pamituwaku:

verses.name: I Timothy 6:14
verses.text: hinangun kamemon ya pamahinang ka'a e' Tuhan, ma halam aniya' sā'na atawa la'atna panā'an iya. Hinangun to'ongan sampay ta'abut waktu kabalik Panghū' Isa Al-Masi pi'itu ni dunya.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:15
verses.text: Bang ta'abut na waktuna, pinapi'itu du iya pabalik e' Tuhan, ya jukup asal barakatna, maka tunggal isab magbaya' ma kamemon. Sultan asal iya ma kasultan-sultanan kamemon, Panghū' isab ma kapanghū'-panghū'an kamemon.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:16
verses.text: Hal iya mbal magkamatay. Pa'ataganna asal deyom sahaya ya mbal tasekot e' manusiya'. Halam aniya' bay maka'nda' iya ma waktu palabay, maka halam du aniya' maka'nda' iya ma sinōng. Wajib iya mahaldika'tam, maka ma iya asal barakat sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen7959" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3978"/><div sID="gen7960" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3978"/> Na, in pasal saga a'a mailu taga-karaya, soho'un sigām da'a magmalangkahi ma sabab karaya sigām ma deyom dunya itu. Subay sigām mbal angandol ma pangalta' sigām sabab mbal du kakkal. Subay Tuhan ya pasangdolan sigām, sabab magmura e'na amuwan ai-ai makalasig pangatayantam.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:18
verses.text: Pandu'in isab saga a'a ilu subay maghinang kahāpan ma pagkahi sigām. Ya karaya sigām subay kahinangan ahāp. Subay sigām hilas amuwan ma sasuku taluwa' kasusahan.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:19
verses.text: Bang itu nihinang e' sigām, sali' aniya' alta' tatau' e' sigām ma deyom sulga' panantuhan sigām ma waktu sinōng. Jari makasambut du sigām kallum b'nnal, hatina kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen7960" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3979"/><div sID="gen7961" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3979"/> Na, Timuti, amay-amay, tau'un pahogot saga pandu' bay pangandol ma ka'a. Tangkisin bissala ya mbal makasulut atay Tuhan, maka saga pagpayod halam aniya' gunana. Niōnan ko' itu pangita'u e' a'a kasehe'an, sagō' ngga'i ka.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:21
verses.text: Sabab aniya' saga a'a magpina'in in sigām bay kaniya'an pangita'u ina'an-i, sagō' minnē' sigām tabowa pasiha' min pandu' b'nnal ya pam'nnalantam. <div eID="gen7961" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7962" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Tuhan. <signed sID="gen7963"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen7963"/>  <div eID="gen7962" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7958" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7911" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1Tim.6"/> <div eID="gen7905" osisID="1Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul. Kawakilan aku e' si Isa Al-Masi sabab min kabaya'an Tuhan, sinō' magnasihat ni saga a'a pasal kallum kakkal ya bay paljanji'an Tuhan ma sasuku parakayu' ma si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen7970" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3980"/><div sID="gen7971" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3980"/> Pasampayku sulat itu ni ka'a, Timuti. Sali' ka anakku kinalasahan. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan deyom atay e' Mma'ta Tuhan maka Panghū'ta si Isa Al-Masi. Bang pa'in ka kina'ase'an isab.  <div eID="gen7971" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3981"/><div sID="gen7972" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamalasig si Paul ma Pangatayan si Timuti</title> <div sID="gen7973" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3981"/> Magsukul aku ni Tuhan, ya paghinanganku. Maghinang na pa'in aku ma iya ma abontol itikadku, buwat bay paghinang kamatto'ahanku ma masa awal e'. Magsukul aku ni Tuhan ma sababnu, Timuti, pagka taentomta ka ma waktu kapangarapku ni Tuhan llaw maka sangom.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:4
verses.text: Bang taentomku bay panangisnu ma waktu katulakku, landu' aku bilahi mag'nda' maka ka'a pabalik supaya aku kinōgan to'ongan.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:5
verses.text: Taentomku isab kapangandolnu sab'nnal-b'nnal ma si Isa Al-Masi, buwat bay pangandol mbo'nu d'nda si Loyda maka bay pangandol ina'nu si Yunis. Tatantuku isab in ka'a taga-pangandol buwattē'.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:6
verses.text: Ya itu po'onna angkan ka paentomanku pasal kapandayan bay pamuwan ka'a e' Tuhan, waktu kapat'nna'ku tanganku ma ka'a. Pajatuhun kapandayannu ilu

verses.name: II Timothy 1:7
verses.text: sabab ngga'i ka tāw ya pamahōp Tuhan ma pangatayantam, sagō' kawasa, maka lasa ma pagkahi, maka pamaggat napsu.  <div eID="gen7973" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3982"/><div sID="gen7974" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3982"/> Da'a ka aiya' magsab'nnal ni a'a pasal Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Da'a ka isab aiya' ma pasalku, pagka aku ma deyom kalabusu itu ma sabab pameya'ku ma Al-Masi. Sagō' maglilla' sadja ka ameya'an aku anandalan kasigpitan ma sabab lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi. Pinakosog du ka e' Tuhan bo' kasandalannu.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:9
verses.text: Lappasan na kitam e'na min hukuman dusa, tapene' kitam bo' kitam tahinang a'a suku'na. Ngga'i ka ko' itu tungbas ma sabab aniya' bay hinangtam ahāp, sagō' ma sabab aniya' lasana maka ase'na tudju ni kitam. Ya asal mohotna ma halam gi' tapapanjari dunya, in kitam manusiya' asal kalasahanna maka ka'ase'anna sabab min kahinangan si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:10
verses.text: A'awam kitam tagna' sagō' pinabukis na ma buwattina'an, sabab makapi'itu na ni dunya si Isa Al-Masi, ya Manglalappas. Taga'os e'na kosog kamatay ati kaniya'an kitam kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan luwas min lapal ahāp.  <div eID="gen7974" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3983"/><div sID="gen7975" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3983"/> Kawakilan aku e' Tuhan, sinō' magnasihat maka magpandu' lapal ahāp.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:12
verses.text: Ya na itu sababna angkan aku katiksa'an ma deyom kalabusu itu, sagō' mbal aku aiya' sabab kata'uwanku du bang sai ya pangandolanku. Maka tatantuku isab in iya makakole' anganjagahan kamemon bay pangandolna ma aku, sampay ta'abut llaw pabalikna ni dunya.  <div eID="gen7975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3984"/><div sID="gen7976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3984"/> Isbatun to'ongan saga pandu' b'nnal bay pamandu'ku ma ka'a. Panunurin pahāp. Pahogotun pangandolnu ma si Isa Al-Masi maka kalasahin isab pagkahinu, pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'antam sali'-sali'.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:14
verses.text: Tau'un pandu' ahāp ya bay pangandol Tuhan ma ka'a, pagka ka tinabang e' Rū Sussi, ya pat'nna' ma deyom ataytam.  <div eID="gen7976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3985"/><div sID="gen7977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3985"/> Kata'uwannu, Timuti, bay aku siniya-siya e' saga bebeya'an si Isa ma lahat Asiya itu, sampay e' si Pigilus maka si Hermogen.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:16
verses.text: Saguwā' mura-murahan bang pa'in disi Onesepor magtai'anak kina'ase'an e' Tuhan, sabab araran iya bay amalasig pangatayanku. Halam iya bay aiya' anibaw aku minsan aku ma deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:17
verses.text: Sagō' pagt'kkana pi'itu ni da'ira Rōm, magtūy pinuspusan e'na kosogna amiha aku sampay aku tabākna na.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:18
verses.text: Mura-murahan, bang pa'in iya kina'ase'an e' Tuhan ma llaw kabalik si Isa Al-Masi pi'itu angahukum manusiya'. Kata'uwannu du bang buwattingga bay katabang si Onesepor itu ma aku, waktu kamahē'ku gi' ma da'ira Epesos e'.  <div eID="gen7977" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Tim.1"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:1
verses.text: Manjari ka'a Otō', pakosogun pangandolnu sabab min tatabangan ya pamuwan kitam bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:2
verses.text: Saga pamandu'ku bay takalenu min aku ma alopan saga saksi' aheka, subay patanggungnu ma saga a'a kapangandolan, a'a ata'u isab amandu'an saga sehe' sigām.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Maglilla' ka ameya'an aku anandalan kasigpitan, supaya ka makasali' ni sundalu ahāp ma deyoman si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:4
verses.text: Sabab bang a'a magsundalu, mbal iya palamud ma kahinangan saga a'a ngga'i ka sundalu sabab kabaya'anna subay kasulutan nakura'na.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:5
verses.text: Atawa bang a'a bilahi maglomba ma pagdaganan, mbal iya makara'ug bang mbal beya'na aturan paglomba he'.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:6
verses.text: Bang a'a isab magsangsā' maghuma, subay iya parahū angā' bahagi'na min buwa' huma he'.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Tali'un to'ongan saga pamaralilku itu, sabab tinabang du ka e' Tuhan bo' tahatinu to'ongan.  <div eID="gen7978" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3986"/><div sID="gen7979" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3986"/> Entomun si Isa Al-Masi, tubu' iya si Da'ud maka bay iya pinakallum pabīng min kamatay. Ya na itu lapal ahāp pagnasihatku.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:9
verses.text: Angananam aku kabinasahan ma sabab pagnasihatku lapal ahāp itu, maka itiya' aku tinahan ma deyom kalabusu buwat a'a bay makalanggal sara'. Sagō' minsan tinahan baranku itu, mbal tatahan lapal Tuhan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Manjari maglilla' aku angananam kabinasahan ma sabab saga a'a tapene' e' Tuhan, bo' supaya sigām parakayu' ni si Isa Al-Masi ati pinaniya'an kasalamatan ma deyom sahaya Tuhan salama-lama.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:11
verses.text: B'nnal sadja saga kabtangan itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen7980"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7981"/>“Bang kita bay ameya' ma si Isa ma kamatayna,<l eID="gen7981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7982"/>ameya' du isab ma iya ma kallumna.<l eID="gen7982" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7983"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:12
verses.text: Bang kita anandal na pa'in ma deyom kabinasahan,<l eID="gen7983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7984"/>ameya' du kita ma si Isa ang'ntanan pagparinta ma sinosōng.<l eID="gen7984" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7985"/>Bang kita amalilu in si Isa ngga'i ka pameya'anta,<l eID="gen7985" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7986"/>pinaliluhan du kita isab e'na.<l eID="gen7986" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7987"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:13
verses.text: Bang kita mbal at'ttog angandol ma iya,<l eID="gen7987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7988"/>masi du iya kapangandolan sabab mbal to'ongan apinda addatna.”<l eID="gen7988" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7980"/>  <div eID="gen7979" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7972" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3987"/><div sID="gen7989" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sosoho'an ya Makasulut Atay Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen7990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3987"/> Paentomin saga bebeya'an si Isa mailu pasal pamituwaku itu. Amay-amayin to'ongan sigām ma pang'nda' Tuhan, sō'un sigām da'a magsu'al pasal saga kabtangan. Saga pagsu'al itu mbal du makahāp, sagō' amaka'at gom pa'in pangandol saga a'a sasuku makakale iya.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:15
verses.text: Puspusun kosognu amahāp ai-ai hinangnu bo' ka makasulut atay Tuhan. Subay abontol e'nu magnasihat pasal lapal kasab'nnalan, supaya ka mbal aiya' ma sabab hinangnu.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:16
verses.text: Halli'in saga pagbissala karupangan ya mbal makasulut atay Tuhan. Bang a'a palamud ma saga pagbissala buwattē', ya kamattihanna tabowa sigām magdusa ati palawak gom pa'in min Tuhan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:17
verses.text: Ya pandu' saga a'a magbissala karupangan e' ibarat dugsul, palatag na pa'in ma deyom baran sampay alapat kamemonna. Buwattē' isab saga pamandu' disi Himinus maka si Pilitus.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:18
verses.text: Ka'bbahan e' sigā pandu' b'nnal. Yuk sigā in pamakallum saga a'a magpatayan palabay na, angkan halam na aniya' pinakallum ma sinosōng. Jari minnē' aniya' saga a'a mbal na angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:19
verses.text: Sagō' ya pandu' min Tuhan itu apagon asal, sali' dalil papagan luma' mbal tajogjog. Aniya' sulat ma papagan itu, yuk-i, “Kinata'uwan e' Tuhan bang sai a'ana.” Aniya' gi' isab sulatna dakayu', yuk-i, “Sasuku ah'lling in iya suku' Tuhan, subay bbahanna saga kahinangan ala'at.”  <div eID="gen7990" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3988"/><div sID="gen7991" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3988"/> Buwattitu pamaralilku ma ka'a, Timuti. Ma deyom luma' aheya ya pat'nna'an a'a dayahan, magginisan kapanyapanna. Aniya' saga pangisihan hinangan bulawan, aniya' isab hinangan pilak. Subay palkala' aheya bo' yampa ginuna saga pangisihan ahalga' itu. Aniya' isab saga pangisihan hinangan kayu atawa tana', makajari ginuna llaw-llaw.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:21
verses.text: Manjari saga bebeya'an si Isa sali' dalil kapanyapan indaginis. Sasuku anussihan di-na min la'at kamemon, tapagguna ma pakaradja'an aheya. Ya angkan iya tapagguna e' Panghū'na, sabab tasussi deyom atayna maka sakap iya maghinang ai-ai ahāp.  <div eID="gen7991" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3989"/><div sID="gen7992" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3989"/> Halli'in saga napsu baran ya kabiyaksahan saga onde' baha'u. Ya tuyu'annu subay atay abontol, maka pagiman, maka paglasa, maka kasannangan. Magda'atay ka maka saga a'a angarap ma Panghū'ta si Isa Al-Masi min deyom atay sussi.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:23
verses.text: Da'a ka palamud ma saga pagjawab karupangan, ya halam aniya' kapūsanna. Kata'uwannu in pagjawab buwattitu tahinang sadja pagbono'.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:24
verses.text: Pagka sosoho'an Tuhan ka, da'a ka maglugat maka sai-sai. Subay ka angahāp maka anabalan a'a kamemon, maka subay ahāp e'nu magpandu'.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:25
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' makasagga' pandu'nu, subay ahanunus panambungnu. Kalu sigām binuwanan pikilan e' Tuhan bo' makabāk pagsusunan, ati tabowa sigām pata'u ma pandu' kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:26
verses.text: Jari angahāp pikilan sigām pabīng, ati papuwas sigām min pang'ntanan nakura' saitan, ya bay anganjallat pikilan sigām bo' ameya' maghinang kabaya'anna.  <div eID="gen7992" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Tim.2"/> <div eID="gen7989" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3990"/><div sID="gen7993" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Masa Kahinapusan</title> <div sID="gen7994" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3990"/> Entomun to'ongan itu, Timuti. Bang sōng na ta'abut masa kahinapusan dunya itu, aheka katiksa'an paniya'.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:2
verses.text: Ya niangut e' saga a'a ma masa ina'an kahāpan di-sigām sadja, mbal takannal e' sigām a'a kasehe'an. Napsuhan du sigām ma pilak, abbuhan sigām, maka alanga atay sigām. Amissala sigām kala'atan ma pagkahi sigām maka mbal ameya' ma pami'at matto'a sigām. Mbal sigām ata'u magsukul, maka landu' sigām asabul.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:3
verses.text: Mbal sigām ma'ase' ma sehe' sigām, mbal isab bilahi magkahāp bang aniya' bay pagsagga'an. Angalimut na pa'in sigām ma a'a kasehe'an, maka nirūlan ai-ai kinanapsuhan baran sigām. Ab'ngngis sigām makalandu', maka ab'nsi ma ai-ai ahāp.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:4
verses.text: Mbal sigām kapangandolan sabab paninipu. Lumandu'an esog sigām, maka mbal manjari pagmalangkahi sigām. Bilahi sadja sigām maghāp palasahan ati halam aniya' baya' sigām angisbat Tuhan.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:5
verses.text: B'nnal sigām magagama sagō' halam aniya' pūsna sabab mbal sigām bilahi pinindahan pangatayan. Oto' halli'in saga a'a buwattē'.  <div eID="gen7994" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3991"/><div sID="gen7995" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3991"/> Aniya' isab saga l'lla ma waktu ina'an-i pasōd ni deyom luma' a'a bo' amidjakan saga kar'ndahan magkarupangan. Asasaw pikilan saga d'nda inān sabab min dusa sigām, ati abowa-bowa sigām e' napsu magindaginis.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:7
verses.text: Akale sadja sigām ma sai-sai amandu', sagō' mbal to'ongan makahati ma pandu' b'nnal.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:8
verses.text: Saga l'lla ya amidjak inān anagga' asal ma pandu' b'nnal. Asagut deyom pikilan sigām, maka pangandol sigām ngga'i ka b'nnal. Ya panunuran sigām kahinangan disi Jannis maka si Jambes, ya bay anagga' si Musa ma masa awal e'.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:9
verses.text: Saguwā' in pamandu' saga a'a amidjak inān halam du aniya' kasōnganna. Mbal at'ggol, kinata'uwan du karupangan sigām e' a'a kamemon, buwat bay karupangan disi Jannis maka si Jambes e'.  <div eID="gen7995" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7993" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3992"/><div sID="gen7996" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Patogol ma Pandu' B'nnal</title> <div sID="gen7997" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3992"/> Samantala' ka'a, Timuti, kata'uwannu du bang ai pamandu'ku maka bang buwattingga kaul-pi'ilku maka bang ai mohotku. Kata'uwannu isab in aku angandol asal ma si Isa. Imananku maka kalasahanku isab saga pagkahiku, maka sandalanku saga kasukkalan.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:11
verses.text: Kata'uwannu du saga kapinjala'an maka kasigpitan bay pat'kka ni aku mahē' ma da'ira Antiyuk maka mahē' ma Ikuni maka ma Listara. Aho', kata'uwannu saga kapinjala'an kamemon bay kasandalanku. Daipara kapuwasan aku e' Panghū'tam min kasukkalanku inān kamemon.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:12
verses.text: B'nnal asal, sasuku bilahi ameya' ma kabaya'an Tuhan ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya parakayu'anna, tantu sigām kat'kkahan kapinjala'an.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:13
verses.text: Sagō' saga a'a patila'atun maka saga a'a pangakkal, paruhun na pa'in kahinangan sigām ala'at. Angalingu sigām ma sehe' sigām, maka talingu du isab baran sigām.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:14
