verses.text: Sagō' ka'a, Timuti, patogol ka ameya' ma pandu' b'nnal bay pamandu' ka'a, ya pandu' asal pagkahagarannu to'ongan. Kata'uwannu du bang sai bay amandu'an ka'a.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:15
verses.text: Maka kata'uwannu isab kahālannu sangay min kariki'-diki'nu sampay ni kaheyanu, bay ka pina'anad asal ma ai-ai tasulat ma deyom Kitab. Ya na ina'an po'onanna angkan ka makapikil anaima' kallum kakkal, ya pamuwan e' Tuhan ma sasuku angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:16
verses.text: Kamemon tasulat ma deyom Kitab inān bay pinasulat e' Tuhan, ati aheya kagunahanna pamandu' maka pangalāng saga hinang mbal taluwa', maka pamabontol kasā'an. Aheya isab kagunahanna pamituwa pasal addat-tabi'at ahāp,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:17
verses.text: supaya ajukup saga a'a sosoho'an Tuhan ma pangita'u maka ma kapandayan. Jari sakap na sigām maghinang saga hinang ahāp kamemon.  <div eID="gen7997" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Tim.3"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:1
verses.text: Na, Timuti, aniya' gi' panoho'anku to'ongan ma ka'a. Saksi'ku Tuhan maka si Isa Al-Masi, ya angahukum manusiya' ma sinosōng, saga a'a masi allum sampay saga a'a magpatayan. Song iya pabalik pi'itu ni dunya amat'nna' pagparintana, angkan buwattitu pangamay-ngamayku ma ka'a.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:2
verses.text: Pagnasihatun lapal Tuhan, anakap ka di-nu minsan ai waktu, kinale ka llingnu atawa mbal. Bang aniya' makahinang kasā'an, bi'atun. Bang aniya' makarusa, lāngun. Bang aniya' alamma pangandolna ma Tuhan, pakosogun. Patampalun pamandu'nu, maka imanin saga a'a pandu'annu minsan sigām ahunit pinandu'an.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:3
verses.text: Angkan buwattitu panoho'anku ma ka'a, sabab aniya' waktu ma sinosōng mbal anaima' saga a'a ma pandu' b'nnal. Ya tinurul e' sigām ai-ai kabaya'an sigām, ati aheka guru pinatimuk e' sigām, sasuku amowahan sigām lling ahāp kinale.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:4
verses.text: Pataikut sigām min pandu' b'nnal ati akale gom pa'in ma kissa bay hinangan manusiya'.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:5
verses.text: Saguwā' ka'a, Timuti, subay atotog pikilannu minsan ai kalabayannu. Sandalin kasigpitan ai-ai, maka tuyu'in hinangnu magnasihat lapal ahāp pasal si Isa Al-Masi. Hinangun to'ongan ai-ai kamemon bay pamahinang ka'a e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen7998" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3993"/><div sID="gen7999" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3993"/> Song na ta'abut ganta'an panukbal kallumku, sapantun inuman panukbal ni Tuhan. Asekot na waktu pamole'ku ni ahirat.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:7
verses.text: Bay na puspusanku kosogku sali' dalil a'a maglomba ma pagdaganan, ati makasampay na aku ni gindananna. Halam bay bbahanku pangandolku ma Tuhan.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Manjari aniya' asal tinagama e' Tuhan ma deyom sulga' panungbasna ma sasuku bay abontol atayna ma deyom dunya. Pinasambutan du aku tungbas inān e' Panghū' Isa Al-Masi, ya maghuhukum abontol, bang ta'abut llaw aheya inān. Ngga'i ka isab hal aku ya tinungbasan. Tinungbasan du isab saga a'a kamemon sasuku aholat angalagaran kapi'itu si Isa.  <div eID="gen7999" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7996" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3994"/><div sID="gen8000" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal bay Kalabayan si Paul</title> <div sID="gen8001" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3994"/> Patuyu' ka pasa'ut pi'itu,

verses.name: II Timothy 4:10
verses.text: sabab bay na aku ni'bbahan e' si Demas pagka ahalga' ma iya saga legot dunya itu, ati wa'i na iya ala'an tudju ni lahat Tessaloneka. Si Kresken wa'i na ni Galatiya, maka si Titus wa'i ni Dalmatiya.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Luwal la'a si Lukas ya sehe'ku maitu. Ngā'un si Markus ati bowahun pi'itu sabab makatabang iya ma aku ma hinangku itu.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:12
verses.text: Ina'an si Tikikus bay soho'ku ni Epesos.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:13
verses.text: Bang ka pi'itu, bowahun s'mmekku ya bay ta'bba ma luma' si Karpus mahē' ma lahat Trowas. Bowahun isab saga būkku, ya lagi'na saga katas panulatanku.  <div eID="gen8001" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3995"/><div sID="gen8002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3995"/> Si Iskandar, ya a'a magsasal e', bay sidda angala'at aku. Sagō' pī'un na, Tuhan ya ata'u anungbasan iya ma sabab hinangna.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Ka'a isab, pahalli' ka ma iya sabab akosog panagga'na ma lapal pagnasihatta.  <div eID="gen8002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3996"/><div sID="gen8003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3996"/> Tagna' aku sinumariya mahē' ma sara', halam aniya' bay angandapitan aku. Bay aku siniya-siya e' sehe'ku kamemon. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in mbal binista e' Tuhan paghinang sigām buwattē'.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:17
verses.text: Sagō' minsan aku bay ni'bbahan e' sigām, pagapi' asal Panghū' Isa ma aku. Kabuwanan aku kosog e'na supaya aku makapagnasihat ma saga a'a ngga'i ka Yahudi, bo' sigām makakale pahāp ma lapalna. Jari kapuwasan aku e'na min kamulahan, sapantun a'a niliyusan min bowa' halimaw.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:18
verses.text: Tantu isab aku lappasan e' Tuhan min kala'atan kamemon ya pat'kka ni aku ma sinosōng, ati binowa aku e'na ni lahat pagparintahanna ma deyom sulga', ma halam aniya' baya-bayana. Patut iya pinudji sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen8003" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8000" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3997"/><div sID="gen8004" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen8005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3997"/> Itiya' aku amasampay minsan la'a hal lapalku ni si Prisila maka si Akila maka disi Onesepor magtai'anak.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:20
verses.text: Si Erastus, he' na angagad ma Kurintu, maka si Trupimus bay bbahanku ma da'ira Militus pagka asaki.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:21
verses.text: Amay-amay, Timuti, pasa'ut ka pi'itu bo' ka mbal ta'abut e' musim pamaliyu. <div eID="gen8005" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8006" type="paragraph"/> Itiya' isab disi Ubulus, si Pudin, si Linus maka si Klauda magpasampay isab minsan la'a hal lapal sigām ni ka'am. Damikiyanna isab saga dauranakantam bebeya'an si Isa kasehe'an.  <div eID="gen8006" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3998"/><div sID="gen8007" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3998"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in patotog Panghū'tam ma deyom ataynu. Bang pa'in ka'am kamemon kaniya'an tatabangan min Tuhan. <signed sID="gen8008"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8008"/>  <div eID="gen8007" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8004" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7969" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="2Tim.4"/> <div eID="gen7964" osisID="2Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, sosoho'an Tuhan. Kawakilan isab aku e' si Isa Al-Masi, sinō' pehē' anabangan saga a'a bay tapene' e' Tuhan bo' pasōng pangandol sigām ma iya, bo' pasōng isab pangita'u sigām pasal pandu' b'nnal, ya amowa sigām ameya' ma kabaya'an Tuhan.

verses.name: Titus 1:2
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', sabab aniya' kallum kakkal holatantam. Kallum kakkal inān bay panganjanji' asal e' Tuhan dahū gi' min waktu pamapanjari dunya, maka Tuhan itu mbal ata'u magputing.

verses.name: Titus 1:3
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in waktu bay pangangganta' inān, pinaluwas e'na lapalna labay min pagnasihatku. In pagnasihat itu bay pangandol ma aku e' Tuhantam Manglalappas.  <div eID="gen8016" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3999"/><div sID="gen8017" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3999"/> Pasampayku sulat itu ni ka'a, Titus. Sali' na ka anakku lahasiya' pagka kita angandol sali'-sali' ma si Isa Al-Masi. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka e' si Isa Al-Masi, ya maglalappas ma kitam.  <div eID="gen8017" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4000"/><div sID="gen8018" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Hinang si Titus ma Pū' Kerete</title> <div sID="gen8019" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4000"/> Bay ka bbahanku mailu ma pū' Kerete bo' tahatulnu ai-ai halam bay aubus, tapat'nna'nu isab saga a'a nihinang pagmatto'ahan ma saga jama'a si Isa ya magtimuk ma kalahat-lahatan ilu kamemon. Entomun bay panoho'anku ma ka'a:

verses.name: Titus 1:6
verses.text: bang a'a pinat'nna' pagmatto'ahan subay halam aniya' dusana panā'an iya maka subay dakayu' du h'ndana. Saga panganakna isab subay angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi, maka subay mbal bula'ug atawa atuwas pinandu'an.

verses.name: Titus 1:7
verses.text: Sababna bang a'a pinat'nna' pagmakōkan ma saga jama'a si Isa, hinang Tuhan ya pangandol ma iya, angkan subay halam aniya' dusa panā'an iya. Subay iya mbal abbuhan atawa al'kkas apasu' atayna. Subay iya ngga'i ka a'a patilango, maka subay mbal ab'ngngis atawa napsuhan ma pilak.

verses.name: Titus 1:8
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a pehē' ni luma'na subay pa'iddana to'ongan, maka subay iya ka'amuhan isab ma ai-ai makahāp. Subay iya ahantap ma ai-ai hinangna, maka subay iya abontol. Subay iya ameya' ma Tuhan min deyom atayna, maka subay ata'u ahalli'an napsuna.

verses.name: Titus 1:9
verses.text: Subay ahogot pamalutna ma lapal kapangandolan itu, buwat bay pamandu' ma iya. Manjari ata'u iya amahogot atay saga a'a kasehe'an, pagka pamandu'na pandu' kasab'nnalan ma sigām. Maka ata'u iya anambungan saga a'a anagga' iya bo' pabontolna kasā'an sigām.  <div eID="gen8019" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4001"/><div sID="gen8020" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4001"/> Angkan subay buwattē', sabab aheka a'a atuwas kōk sigām maka agagga pinandu'an, labi-luba'na saga sehe'bi bay papinda min agama Yahudi. Binissala e' saga a'a inān ya halam aniya' pūsna, maka nilingu e' sigām a'a kasehe'an.

verses.name: Titus 1:11
verses.text: Lāngun saga a'a magbissala buwattē' sabab aheka a'a magtautai'anak tabowa asasaw e' pamandu' sigām, pandu' mbal wajib pinamūng, maka pandu' pagpilak sadja.

verses.name: Titus 1:12
verses.text: Aniya' dakayu' pagkahi sigām bangsa Kerete, a'a bibissalahun, bay makapaluwas bissala, yuk-i, “Saga bangsa Kerete itu hal magputing, ab'ngngis sigām buwat sattuwa talun, napsuhan sigām maka lisu'an maghinang.”

verses.name: Titus 1:13
verses.text: Taluwa' bissala inān, angkan subay lāngnu saga a'a magpandu' inān bo' supaya ahāp pagkahagad sigām ma pandu' b'nnal.

verses.name: Titus 1:14
verses.text: Soho'un sigām da'a angisbat ma saga kissa-kissa bangsa Yahudi ya ngga'i ka b'nnal, da'a isab ameya' ma panoho'an bay nihinang e' saga a'a pataikut min kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: Titus 1:15
verses.text: Bang a'a asussi pangatayanna, asussi ai-ai kamemon makani-pikilanna. Sagō' bang a'a mbal asussi pangatayanna maka mbal am'nnal ma si Isa Al-Masi, halam aniya' asussi ma iya sabab katamakan deyom pamikilna, maka mbal tapagbidda'na hāp maka la'at.

verses.name: Titus 1:16
verses.text: Saga a'a inān magbau'-bau' in sigām ata'u ma Tuhan, sagō' hinang sigām maka bissala sigām mbal magtaluwa'. Makab'nsi-b'nsi addat sigām, mbal sigām ameya' pandu', maka mbal makapaghinang ahāp.  <div eID="gen8020" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Titus.1"/> <div eID="gen8018" type="section"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4002"/><div sID="gen8021" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pandu' B'nnal</title> <div sID="gen8022" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4002"/> Samantala' ka'a, Titus, pamituwanu subay magtaluwa' maka pandu' b'nnal.

verses.name: Titus 2:2
verses.text: Pituwahin saga matto'a l'lla in sigām subay ahalli' ma napsu baran sigām, subay ahāp addat sigām, maka subay ahantap ma ai-ai nihinang e' sigām. Subay ahogot to'ongan pangandol sigām ma si Isa, subay alasa ma pagkahi sigām, maka subay asandal minsan ai tum'kka ni sigām.

verses.name: Titus 2:3
verses.text: Buwattē' isab pamituwanu ma saga matto'a d'nda. Ya addat-tabi'at sigām subay makatōp ma d'nda ya atuyu' ameya' ma kabaya'an Tuhan. Subay sigām da'a angalimut ma sehe' sigām maka subay mbal tagihan anginum ai-ai makalango. Ya pamandu' e' sigām subay pandu' ahāp.

verses.name: Titus 2:4
verses.text: Manjari tabi'at e' matto'a d'nda itu saga kar'ndahan abata' gi' bo' sigām alasa ma anak-h'lla sigām,

verses.name: Titus 2:5
verses.text: sampay ahantap ma ai-ai hinang sigām. Subay asussi pangatayan sigām maka subay atuyu' maghinang ma deyom luma'. Subay isab angaku kagara'an e' h'lla sigām. Bang buwattē' addat sigām, manjari halam aniya' makapah'llingan la'at pasal lapal Tuhan itu.  <div eID="gen8022" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4003"/><div sID="gen8023" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4003"/> Damikiyanna isab saga l'lla abata' gi', soho'un sigām pahantap ma ai-ai tahinang sigām.

verses.name: Titus 2:7
verses.text: Ka'a Titus, subay ahāp to'ongan kaul-pi'ilnu bo' ka manjari panunuran e' saga sehe'nu. Bang ka amandu' subay abontol sadja pamandu'nu, maka bowahannu subay magtaluwa' maka lapal Tuhan ya pamandu'nu.

verses.name: Titus 2:8
verses.text: Ma ai-ai pamandu'nu paggunahun saga bissala ahāp ya mbal tasoway, supaya aiya' saga kuntaratam pagka mbal makabāk sababan pamah'lling sigām la'at ma kitam.  <div eID="gen8023" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4004"/><div sID="gen8024" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4004"/> Pandu'in saga ata in sigām subay ameya' kapagbaya'an nakura' sigām, maka subay patuyu' anulut atayna. Mbal sigām manjari anganjawab ma panoho'an nakura' sigām.

verses.name: Titus 2:10
verses.text: Subay sigām mbal anangkawan nakura' sigām, sagō' subay mattan in sigām ahatul maka kapangandolan sakahaba' waktu. Jari ka'amuhan saga a'a ma pamandu'tam pasal Tuhan, ya angalappas ma kitam min hukuman dusa.  <div eID="gen8024" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4005"/><div sID="gen8025" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4005"/> Sabab pinatuwa' na e' Tuhan lasana maka ase'na bo' kalappasan saga manusiya' kamemon min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: Titus 2:12
verses.text: Kapandu'an kitam e' lasa maka ase' Tuhan subay ang'bba min ai-ai ya mbal amowa kitam tudju ni iya. Subay bbahanta isab napsuta ma legot dunya itu. Jari subay kitam ahantap ma ai-ai hinangtam. Subay kitam abontol sadja, maka subay ameya'an kabaya'an Tuhan sat'ggoltam ma dunya itu,

verses.name: Titus 2:13
verses.text: samantala' kitam angalagaran llaw ya asal holatantam. Ya na ina'an llaw patuwa' sahaya Tuhantam Sangat Kawasa, si Isa Al-Masi ya maglalappas ma kitam.

verses.name: Titus 2:14
verses.text: Bay iya maglilla' amatay ma sababtam, supaya kitam tal'kkat e'na maka kapuwasan min kala'atan kamemon. Kabaya'anna subay asussi ataytam, bo' kitam manjari a'a suku'na na, ya atuyu' maghinang kahāpan.  <div eID="gen8025" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4006"/><div sID="gen8026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4006"/> Ya itu pamandu'nu ni saga a'a. Amay-amayin sigām maka bi'atun sasuku sigām asā', sabab aniya' kapatutnu anagda sigām. Subay halam aniya' amareyo' ka'a.  <div eID="gen8026" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Titus.2"/> <div eID="gen8021" type="section"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4007"/><div sID="gen8027" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sakap Maghinang Ahāp</title> <div sID="gen8028" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4007"/> Paentomin saga bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi mailu, in sigām subay angaku ma kapatut saga pagnakura'an maka saga a'a ang'ntan pagparinta, ati subay ameya' ma panoho'an sigām. Subay sigām sakap maghinang ai-ai ahāp.

verses.name: Titus 3:2
verses.text: Soho'un sigām da'a angalimut ma sai-sai, sagō' subay sigām pasulut maka pabagay sadja ma a'a kasehe'an. Subay ahanunut pah'lling sigām ni a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen8028" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4008"/><div sID="gen8029" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4008"/> Sabab in kitam bay du isab a'awam ma waktu palabay, bay agagga sinoho', maka bay talingu. Tabowa-bowa na pa'in kitam e' napsu ahāp-ala'at, ai-ai ya makahāp palasahan. Bay ala'at isab kasuddahantam maka angandali'it na pa'in kitam ma saga sehe'tam. Ab'nsi kitam ma pagkahita, maka kinab'nsihan isab kitam e' sigām.

verses.name: Titus 3:4
verses.text: Sagō' Tuhan, ya angalappas kitam, bay makapatuwa' kahāpna maka lasana ma bangsa manusiya',

verses.name: Titus 3:5
verses.text: ati puwasanna kitam min hukuman dusa. Ngga'i ka ma sabab aniya' kahāpan bay hinangtam, sagō' ma sabab ase'na ma kitam. Nianakan kitam pabīng e' Rū Sussi maka kabuwanan kallum baha'u pagka sussina ataytam.

verses.name: Titus 3:6
verses.text: Manglabi-labihan na kahāpan ma kitam pagka kitam pinasangonan Rū Sussi e' Tuhan ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya angalappas kitam.

verses.name: Titus 3:7
verses.text: Sabab min lasa maka ase' Tuhan ya angkan kitam pinapagkahāp na maka Tuhan, bo' kitam kaniya'an kallum kakkal ya asal holatantam.

verses.name: Titus 3:8
verses.text: B'nnal sadja ya pah'llingku itu. Kabaya'anku subay ka amandu' pahāp-hāp pasal saga pandu'ku ya ma deyom sulat itu. Soho'un saga a'a ilu angikut to'ongan bo' supaya sasuku sigām magkahagad ma Tuhan magmatuyu' na pa'in maghinang ahāp. Ahāp asal hinang sigām buwattē', maka aniya' kagunahanna ma a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen8029" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4009"/><div sID="gen8030" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4009"/> Saguwā' halli'in saga a'a magjawab ma halam aniya' kagunahanna, maka pagsuli-suli pasal saga ōn ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām pangkat-mamangkat. Da'a ka isab palamud bang aniya' maglugat atawa magsu'al pasal sara' bay pang'bba e' si Musa ma masa awal e'. Saga pagsuli-suli buwattē' mbal makahāp, halam aniya' pūsna.

verses.name: Titus 3:10
verses.text: Bang aniya' sehe'bi makatagna'an paglugat ma saga bebeya'an si Isa, sanggupin iya mint'dda, bo' sanggupin iya pabīng min t'dda la'a. Bang iya mbal ang'bba min hinangna he', da'a ka palamud ma iya.

verses.name: Titus 3:11
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwannu in a'a buwattē', abengkok asal pikilanna maka dusahan. Atampal sā'na sabab min hinangna.  <div eID="gen8030" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8027" type="section"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4010"/><div sID="gen8031" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen8032" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4010"/> Na, Titus, bang at'kka pi'ilu si Artemas atawa si Tikikus, sai-sai ya soho'ku, patuyu' ka pehē' ni da'ira Nikupulis bo' kitam magbāk mahē'. Sabab agara' aku pat'nna' mahē' sat'ggol timpu pamaliyu.

verses.name: Titus 3:13
verses.text: Patuntulun si Apollos maka si Senas ya abugaw he' bang sigā pauntas ni pal'ngnganan sigā. Buwanin sigā ai-ai kagunahan sigā.

verses.name: Titus 3:14
verses.text: Pandu'in saga sehe'tam bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi ilu, in sigām subay patukid maghinang ahāp bo' aniya' panabang sigām ma a'a kasehe'an bang kasigpitan. Bang buwattē' aniya' du pa'in kagunahan saga kahinangan sigām.  <div eID="gen8032" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4011"/><div sID="gen8033" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4011"/> Saga sehe'ku kamemon maitu amasampay minsan la'a hal lapal sigām ni ka'a. Ya du aku amasampay kasi-lasaku ni sasuku alasahan kami, pagka kitam dambeya'an angandol ma Al-Masi. <div eID="gen8033" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8034" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Tuhan. <signed sID="gen8035"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8035"/>  <div eID="gen8034" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8031" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8015" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Titus.3"/> <div eID="gen8009" osisID="Titus" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Paul, maka min si Timuti danakantam ma deyoman si Isa. Itiya' aku ma deyom kalabusu ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pameya'anku. <div eID="gen8043" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8044" type="paragraph"/> Pinasampay sulat itu ni ka'a, Pilimun. Bagay kami ka, maka sehe' kami maghinang ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Philemon 1:2
verses.text: Pinasampay isab ni si Appiya danakantam d'nda, maka ni si Arkippus ya sehe' kami maghinang ma si Isa ibarat sundalu, maka ni kajama'ahan si Isa ya magtipun ma luma'nu.  <div eID="gen8044" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4012"/><div sID="gen8045" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4012"/> Mura-murahan bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan deyom atay e' Mma'tam Tuhan maka Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen8045" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4013"/><div sID="gen8046" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magsukul si Paul ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8047" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4013"/> Magsukul aku ni Tuhan sakahaba' waktu kapangamu'-ngamu'ku ma pasalnu,

verses.name: Philemon 1:5
verses.text: sabab takaleku pasal pangandolnu ma Panghū' Isa maka kaheya lasanu ma saga a'a suku' Tuhan kamemon.

verses.name: Philemon 1:6
verses.text: Angamu'-ngamu' aku ni Tuhan bang pa'in ka atuyu' angahaka'an saga a'a pasal pangandolnu ma Panghū' Isa, bo' supaya palalom panghatinu pasal kamemon kahāpan ya pinaniya'an kitam ma sabab Al-Masi ya parakayu'antam.

verses.name: Philemon 1:7
verses.text: Bagay, akōd to'ongan aku sabab min lasanu, maka alasig isab deyom atayku ma sabab kapamalasignu pangatayan saga a'a suku' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8047" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8046" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4014"/><div sID="gen8048" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu' si Paul ma Pasal si Onesimus</title> <div sID="gen8049" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4014"/> Manjari itu, minsan aniya' kapatutku deyo' min Al-Masi anoho' ka'a pasal ai-ai subay hinangnu, mbal du aku magpanoho'an.

verses.name: Philemon 1:9
verses.text: Sagō' amu'anta sadja ka junjung, luwas min paglasata. Jari aku, si Paul, a'a to'a na, ya ma deyom kalabusu itu ma sabab kapameya'ku ma Al-Masi, hal anganjunjung la'a.

verses.name: Philemon 1:10
verses.text: Angamu' aku junjung ni ka'a pasal si Onesimus, ya sali' anakku lahasiya' itu. Tahinang aku pag'mma'anna sabab tabowa iya magkahagad ma si Isa hinabuku ma deyom kalabusu itu.

verses.name: Philemon 1:11
verses.text: Tagna' he', halam bay aniya' gunana ma ka'a, sagō' ma buwattina'an aheya na gunana ma ka'am sampay isab ma aku.  <div eID="gen8049" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4015"/><div sID="gen8050" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4015"/> Jari itiya' papole'ku ni ka'a si Onesimus, a'a kalasahanku to'ongan.

verses.name: Philemon 1:13
verses.text: Bilahi aku bang iya bay paddas maitu ma aku bo' aniya' paganti' min ka'a anabangan aku sat'ggolku ma deyom kalabusu itu ma sabab lapal ahāp ya pagnasihatku.

verses.name: Philemon 1:14
verses.text: Sagō' mbal ka pogosku subay anabangan aku. Ya kabaya'anku bang aku tabangannu, subay min baya'nu to'ongan. Jari mbal aku angahinang ai-ai bang ka mbal pasulut.  <div eID="gen8050" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4016"/><div sID="gen8051" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4016"/> Ya angkan arai' si Onesimus bay pinaokat min ka'a dai'-dai', supaya iya pakakkal ma ka'a t'ggolna allum.

verses.name: Philemon 1:16
verses.text: Tagna' he' banyaga'nu sadja iya, sagō' ma buwattina'an ahāp lagi' iya min banyaga', sabab danakantam na iya kinalasahan. Ahalga' to'ongan iya ma aku, sagō' labi iya ahalga' ma ka'a sabab banyaga'nu iya maka danakannu isab ma sabab Panghū' Isa ya parakayu'anbi.  <div eID="gen8051" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4017"/><div sID="gen8052" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4017"/> Manjari, Pilimun, bang aku tabistanu sali' sehe'nu magusaha, taima'un si Onesimus itu buwat panaima'nu ma aku.

verses.name: Philemon 1:18
verses.text: Bang aniya' dusana ma ka'a, atawa bang aniya' utangna, aku ya pa'atasun.

verses.name: Philemon 1:19
verses.text: Nda'un paljanji'anku itu, ma sulatan tanganku: “Aku si Paul amayad.” Ngga'i ka isab pagtungbuy, sagō' aheya utangnu ma aku, sabab aku ya po'onna angkan ka taga-kallum kakkal na ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Philemon 1:20
verses.text: Aho', bagay, dūlin lagi' aku maka palasigun atayku ma sabab pangandolta ma Al-Masi ya Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen8052" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4018"/><div sID="gen8053" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4018"/> Sulatku sulat itu sabab tatantuku in ka'a akale du. Kata'uwanku in tabangnu ma aku palabi lagi' min pangamu'ku itu.

verses.name: Philemon 1:22
verses.text: Aniya' gi' isab amu'ku: sakapin aku bilik mailu, sabab aholat aku in pangamu'bi ni Tuhan nirūlan du e'na, ati ni'nde'an du aku ni ka'am.  <div eID="gen8053" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8048" type="section"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4019"/><div sID="gen8054" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen8055" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4019"/> Itiya' si Epapras, sehe'ku maitu ma deyom kalabusu ma sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pameya'anna, amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapalna ma ka'a.

verses.name: Philemon 1:24
verses.text: Damikiyanna disi Markus, si Aristarkus, si Demas maka si Lukas, saga sehe'ku maitu maghinang ma Tuhan, amabeya' isab lapal sigām ma ka'a.  <div eID="gen8055" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4020"/><div sID="gen8056" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4020"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam. <div eID="gen8056" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8057" type="paragraph"/> <signed sID="gen8058"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8058"/>  <div eID="gen8057" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8054" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8042" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Phlm.1"/> <div eID="gen8036" osisID="Phlm" type="book"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4021"/><div sID="gen8065" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Anak Tuhan Labi Alanga min saga Mala'ikat</title> <div sID="gen8066" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4021"/> Ma awal jaman lagi' araran e' Tuhan amasampay palmanna ni ka'mbo'-mbo'antam labay min kanabi-nabihan, maka aheka ginisan lān bay pamasampayna.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:2
verses.text: Saguwā' ma ahil jaman itu, Anakna ya amasampay palmanna ni kitam. Bay pinapanjari e' Anak saga alam min kahandak Tuhan, maka gin'llal iya pinusaka'an kamemon ai-ai ma sakalingkal alam.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:3
verses.text: Takilāta sahaya Tuhan labay min Anakna, ta'nda'ta isab ma kajarihan Anak bang buwattingga kajarihan Tuhan. Tinayak na pa'in alam itu e' Anak sabab min kallamna kawasahan. Aubus pa'in e'na angahinang lawang pamasussi manusiya' min dusa sigām, aningkō' iya ma bihing Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, tampal ni kowan.  <div eID="gen8066" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4022"/><div sID="gen8067" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4022"/> Jari pinabangsa Anak itu labi min saga mala'ikat. Maka alanga isab ōn ya pamusaka' Tuhan ma iya, labi alanga min ōn saga mala'ikat.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:5
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' mala'ikat bay binissalahan e' Tuhan buwat bay pamissalana ma Anakna, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8068"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8069"/>“Ka'a ya Anakku, maka aku ya mma'nu min llaw itu.”<l eID="gen8069" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8068"/> Damikiyanna isab, halam aniya' mala'ikat bay pinalmanan e' Tuhan buwat ma ayat ītu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8070"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8071"/>“Mma'na du aku,<l eID="gen8071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8072"/>maka anakku du iya.”<l eID="gen8072" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8070"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:6
verses.text: Aniya' isab bay pangallam e' Tuhan ma waktu song pinabeya' Anakna tunggal-kawasahan pi'itu ni deyom dunya, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8073"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8074"/>“Subay iya pinudji e' kamemon saga mala'ikat Tuhan.”<l eID="gen8074" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8073"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:7
verses.text: Buwattitu isab pamissalana ma pasal bangsa mala'ikat: <lg sID="gen8075"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8076"/>“Tahinangna bangsa mala'ikat sali' baliyu,<l eID="gen8076" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8077"/>tahinang sosoho'anna sali' dallet api.”<l eID="gen8077" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8075"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:8
verses.text: Malaingkan buwattitu pangallam Tuhan pasal Anakna: <lg sID="gen8078"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8079"/>“O Tuhan, anatas pagparintanu ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen8079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8080"/>Abontol sadja kapagsultannu.<l eID="gen8080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8081"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:9
verses.text: Kasulutan ka ma ai-ai abontol,<l eID="gen8081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8082"/>kab'nsihannu ai-ai ala'at.<l eID="gen8082" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8083"/>Angkan ka pinene' pinalanga e' Tuhannu,<l eID="gen8083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8084"/>angkan ka binuwanan kakōgan maka kabantugan<l eID="gen8084" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8085"/>labi gi' min bay pamuwanna ma kasehe'annu.”<l eID="gen8085" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8078"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:10
verses.text: Aniya' gi' pamissala dakayu', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8086"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8087"/>“O Panghū', bay papanjarinu dunya itu ma awal tagna'.<l eID="gen8087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8088"/>Tangannu ya bay angahinang kalangit-langitan.<l eID="gen8088" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8089"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:11
verses.text: Palanyap du babaw dunya itu maka diyata' ayan,<l eID="gen8089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8090"/>Magka'ndang kamemonna buwat sapantun s'mmek.<l eID="gen8090" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8091"/>sago' ka'a ilu kakkal sadja.<l eID="gen8091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8092"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:12
verses.text: Momosnu dunya maka langit buwat s'mmek nilūnan,<l eID="gen8092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8093"/>ati pindahannu ni saddī, buwat badju'.<l eID="gen8093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8094"/>Malaingkan ka'a ilu mbal magkapinda,<l eID="gen8094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8095"/>kakkal ka saumul-umul.”<l eID="gen8095" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8086"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:13
verses.text: Halam aniya' mala'ikat bay binissalahan e' Tuhan buwat pamissalana ma Anakna, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8096"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8097"/>“Dai' ka aningkō' ma bihingku kowan,<l eID="gen8097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8098"/>sampay pat'nna'ku palbantahannu kamemon,<l eID="gen8098" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8099"/>ma deyo' pād-tape'nu.”<l eID="gen8099" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8096"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:14
verses.text: Na pagka buwattē', ai bahā' saga mala'ikat? Ginis umagad sigām pinabeya' e' Tuhan anabang ma manusiya' ya makataima' kalappasan min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8067" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.1"/> <div eID="gen8065" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4023"/><div sID="gen8100" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kalappas Aheya</title> <div sID="gen8101" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4023"/> Pagka buwattē' kawasa Anak Tuhan, subay isbatta pandu' b'nnal bay takaleta ma pasalna, supaya kita mbal tabowa palaran.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:2
verses.text: Sabab bang mbal katangkisan sara' ya bay pinalatun e' mala'ikat ni ka'mbo'-mbo'antam, maka bang sasuku makahinang kasā'an atawa dusa bay pinat'nna'an kabinasahan pinapagtongod maka dusana,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:3
verses.text: na, buwattingga kita apuwas min mulka' bang palehomta kalappas landu' aheya itu? Panghū' Isa baranna bay magnasihat pasal kalappas itu, ati tinuman kasab'nnalanna e' saga a'a bay makakale iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:4
verses.text: Tinapilan isab saksi' sigām e' Tuhan, pagka sigām buwananna barakat maghinang paltanda'an maka hinang kainu-inuhan a'a. Katulunan sigām ginis kapandayan min Rū Sussi, min kahandak Tuhan isab.  <div eID="gen8101" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8100" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4024"/><div sID="gen8102" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ya Manglalappas</title> <div sID="gen8103" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4024"/> Na ngga'i ka bangsa mala'ikat ya gin'llal e' Tuhan makapagbaya' ma dunya sinosōng ya pagsambatta itu.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:6
verses.text: Manusiya' ya pinapagbaya', buwat tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8104"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8105"/>“Ai kapūsan manusiya' angkan pagka'inagonannu?<l eID="gen8105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8106"/>Ai anak manusiya' angkan parulinu?<l eID="gen8106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8107"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:7
verses.text: Pat'nna'nu iya areyo' dangkuri' min bangsa mala'ikat.<l eID="gen8107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8108"/>Buwanannu iya kasanglitan maka kabantugan,<l eID="gen8108" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8109"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:8
verses.text: sampay kapatut magbaya' ma kamemon ai-ai.”<l eID="gen8109" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8104"/> <div eID="gen8103" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8110" type="paragraph"/> Bang ma bissala Kitab itu, aniya' kapatut pamuwan e' Tuhan ma Anak Manusiya' bo' kapagbaya'an e'na ai-ai kamemon. Halam aniya' mbal tumabeya' pinagbaya'an. Malaingkan mbal gi' ta'nda'ta manusiya' magbaya' ma kamemon.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:9
verses.text: Ta'nda'ta si Isa, ya bay pinareyo' dai'-dai' min saga mala'ikat, minahaldika'an na maka sinanglitan ma sabab kamatayna ganti' manusiya' kamemon, sabab min ase' maka lasa Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8110" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4025"/><div sID="gen8111" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4025"/> Tuhan ya po'onan ma kamemon maka kamattihan ma kamemon, angkan patut bang iya amasampulna' si Isa labay min saga kabinasahan bay kalabayanna. Aheka a'a tahinang panganak Tuhan bay binowa e' si Isa ni kasahaya'anna, sabab iya ya pagmakōkan maka Manglalappas sigām.  <div eID="gen8111" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4026"/><div sID="gen8112" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4026"/> Sinussi e'na pangatayan manusiya', jari da'mma' iya maka saga a'a ya sinussi. Angkan iya mbal aiya' angaku in sigām danakanna.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:12
verses.text: Buwattitu ya bay pah'llingna ni Tuhan, yuk-i: <lg sID="gen8113"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8114"/>“Bissalahanku saga danakanku ma pasal kahinangannu.<l eID="gen8114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8115"/>Sanglitanta ka ma palhimpunan sigām.”<l eID="gen8115" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8113"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:13
verses.text: Yukna isab, <lg sID="gen8116"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8117"/>“Pasangdol aku ma Tuhan.”<l eID="gen8117" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8116"/> Maka aniya' isab ayat dakayu', ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8118"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8119"/>“Itiya' aku maka dauranakan ya bay pamaipat aku e' Tuhan.”<l eID="gen8119" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8118"/>  <div eID="gen8112" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4027"/><div sID="gen8120" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4027"/> In niōnan dauranakan itu dalaha' maka daisi sabab manusiya' sigām sali'-sali', angkan si Isa bay tahinang manusiya' bo' supaya makananam kamatay. Jari itu, pagka kalabayanna kamatay, tara'ug e'na nakura' saitan ya bay taga-ga'osan ma kamatay manusiya'.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:15
verses.text: Pagka buwattē' kapanganda'ug si Isa min nakura' saitan, tapalimaya e'na sasuku bay tabanyaga' e' tāw sigām ma kamatay, sangay lagi' min kaonde' sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:16
verses.text: Atampal ko' itu, ngga'i ka mala'ikat ya tinabang e' si Isa, sagō' saga panubu' si Ibrahim.”

verses.name: Hebrews 2:17
verses.text: Ya itu sababanna angkan si Isa subay magsali' to'ongan maka dauranakanna manusiya' bo' supaya tananamna ai-ai kalabayan sigām. Manjari ma'ase' iya maka kapangandolan, jari patut iya nihinang Imam Muwallam magpati'llot ma sigām maka Tuhan bo' supaya aniya' ka'ampunan dusa sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:18
verses.text: Ma buwattina'an makatabang na si Isa ma sasuku sinasat sabab bay kalabayanna sasat maka kabinasahan.  <div eID="gen8120" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.2"/> <div eID="gen8102" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4028"/><div sID="gen8121" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Alanga min si Musa</title> <div sID="gen8122" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4028"/> Saga dauranakanku magpangandol ma si Isa, ka'am bay niabbit<note>‘Niabbit,’ hatina ‘pinabā'’ atawa ‘pinata'u.’</note> e' Tuhan nihinang a'ana, soho'ta na kam angannal ma pasal si Isa. Bay iya pinapi'itu e' Tuhan nihinang Imam Muwallam ma agama ya pagsab'nnalantam.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:2
verses.text: Atukid asal iya ma hinangna tudju ni Tuhan, ya bay amene' iya magimam, buwat bay katukid si Musa maghinang ai-ai ma luma' okoman Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:3
verses.text: Patut asal bang si Isa sinanglitan labi min si Musa. Buwat ibarat luma', patut bang a'a maghinang luma' ya sinanglitan labi min luma' bay hinangna.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:4
verses.text: Minsan maingga luma', aniya' bay makahinang iya, saguwā' Tuhan ya makahinang kamemon ai-ai.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:5
verses.text: Sosoho'an Tuhan asal si Musa, atukid maghinang ai-ai ma deyom luma' Tuhan. Binissala e'na pasal palman Tuhan ya pinaluwas ma waktu sinōng.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:6
verses.text: Saguwā' pangandolan Al-Masi pagka Anak tag-luma' iya, angkan tukiranna hinangna magbaya' ma luma' Tuhan. Sapantun kitam luma' Tuhan kapagbaya'anna, bang pa'in ahogot imantam maka kaholatantam.  <div eID="gen8122" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8121" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4029"/><div sID="gen8123" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aniya' Pahalian ma saga A'a Suku' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8124" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4029"/> Ya itu lapal min Rū Sussi, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8125"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8126"/>“Ma llaw itu, bang takalebi suwala Tuhan,<l eID="gen8126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8127"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:8
verses.text: da'a patuwasunbi kōkbi buwat bay ka'mbo'-mbo'anbi,<l eID="gen8127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8128"/>waktu bay kapanulang sigām ma kabaya'anku,<l eID="gen8128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8129"/>waktu isab kapanukas sigām ma aku ma lahat paslangan.<l eID="gen8129" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8130"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:9
verses.text: Sinulayan na pa'in aku e' sigām, yuk Tuhan, tinukas na pa'in,<l eID="gen8130" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8131"/>minsan sigām bay maka'nda' saga kahinanganku<l eID="gen8131" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8132"/>ma deyom mpatpū' tahun e'.<l eID="gen8132" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8133"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:10
verses.text: Angkan ap'ddi' atayku ma saga a'a inān.<l eID="gen8133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8134"/>‘Saga a'a itu,’ yukku, ‘mbal at'ttog pameya' sigām ma aku.<l eID="gen8134" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8135"/>Halam ni'ikut e' sigām addat-tabi'at ya kabaya'anku.’<l eID="gen8135" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8136"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:11
verses.text: Bay aku angastol ati pagsapahanku sigām, yukku,<l eID="gen8136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8137"/>‘Saga a'a itu mbal to'ongan pasōd ni lahat pahalian bay tagamaku.’ ”<l eID="gen8137" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8125"/>  <div eID="gen8124" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4030"/><div sID="gen8138" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4030"/> Na, saga dauranakan, halli'inbi pikilanbi bo' supaya halam aniya' min ka'am maghinang kala'atan, saga ang'bbahan pangandolna, ati tabowa pataikut min Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:13
verses.text: Sat'ggol masi waktu niōnan “llaw itu”, subay kam magtabang-tiyabangi dapagkahian sakahaba' waktu bo' pahogot imanbi, supaya kam mbal ka'akkalan e' kala'atan ati tabowa magmatuwas ma Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:14
verses.text: Tantu kita dambeya'an maka Al-Masi bang pa'in isbatta pangandolta min tagna' sampay ni katapusan.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:15
verses.text: Buwat lapal sulat Kitab, ya yuk-i: <lg sID="gen8139"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8140"/>“Ma llaw itu, bang takalebi suwala Tuhan,<l eID="gen8140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8141"/>da'a patuwasunbi kōkbi buwat bay ka'mbo'-mbo'an e',<l eID="gen8141" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8142"/>ma waktu bay kapanulang sigām ma kabaya'an Tuhan.”<l eID="gen8142" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8139"/>  <div eID="gen8138" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4031"/><div sID="gen8143" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4031"/> Na, sai pinagbissala itu, ya bay makakale suwala Tuhan saguwā' anulang ma kabaya'anna? Ya na sigām kamemon bay pinagmunda'an e' si Musa paluwas min lahat Misil.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:17
verses.text: Sai isab bay kina'astolan e' Tuhan ma deyom mpatpū' tahun e'? Ya na saga a'a bay makarusa, angkan sigām bay nilaglagan ma lahat paslangan e'.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:18
verses.text: Maka sai isab taluwa' sapahan Tuhan, ya yukna, “Saga a'a itu mbal to'ongan pasōd ni pahalian bay tagamahanku sigām.” Ya taluwa' sapa Tuhan inān, ya na saga bay anulang kabaya'anna.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:19
verses.text: Manjari kata'uwanta, halam bay makasōd saga a'a inān ni lahat pahalian sabab mbal magkahagad ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8143" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.3"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:1
verses.text: Na, pagka masi taga-pūs bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma kitam, hatina in kitam makajari pasōd ni pahalian bay tagamana, angkan kita subay ahalli' supaya halam aniya' min kitam mbal maka'abut pinasōd ni pahalian e'.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:2
verses.text: Bay kitam makakale lapal ahāp min Tuhan, buwat bay pinakale ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an e'. Bay sigām makakale lapal sagō' halam aniya' kahāpan ta'ā' sigām minnē' sabab halam bay am'nnal.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:3
verses.text: Sagō' makasōd kitam ni pahalian bay tinagama e' Tuhan, pagka am'nnal ma lapalna. Saguwā' sasuku mbal am'nnal, mbal isab pasōd buwat bay pamissala e' Tuhan, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8145"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8146"/>“Astolan aku, ya po'on aku makasubali, yukku,<l eID="gen8146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8147"/>Saga a'a itu, mbal to'ongan makasōd<l eID="gen8147" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8148"/>ni deyom lahat pamahalianku sigām.”<l eID="gen8148" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8145"/> Buwattē' bay janji' Tuhan. Aniya' asal pahalian sabab ajukup hinang Tuhan sangay min waktu bay kapamapanjarina dunya.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:4
verses.text: Sabab aniya' tasulat ma deyom Kitab ma pasal llaw kapitu'na, ya yuk-i, “Ta'abut pa'in llaw kapitu'na, magtūy pahali Tuhan min hinangna kamemon sabab ajukup na.”

verses.name: Hebrews 4:5
verses.text: Ni'isaban isab e' Tuhan pah'llingna,, yukna, “Mbal to'ongan makasōd saga a'a itu ni lahat bay tagamaku pahalian sigām.”  <div eID="gen8144" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4032"/><div sID="gen8149" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4032"/> Jari halam bay makasōd ni deyom pahalian saga a'a bay makakale tagna', sabab agagga sigām. Malaingkan aniya' a'a pinasōd,

verses.name: Hebrews 4:7
verses.text: sabab aniya' gi' llaw dakayu' pangangganta' e' Tuhan ma manusiya', ya pinagbahasa “Llaw Ītu”. Palabay pa'in daka pilantahun min waktu ka'mbo'-mbo'an e', ni'isaban e' Tuhan palmanna, pinabissala ma si Da'ud, ati tasulat bissalana ma ayat Kitab bay pagbassata tagna'. Yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8150"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8151"/>“Ma llaw itu, bang takalebi palman Tuhan,<l eID="gen8151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8152"/>da'a patuwasunbi kōkbi.”<l eID="gen8152" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8150"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:8
verses.text: Bang si Yussa' bay makabuwanan pahalian tantu ma bangsa Isra'il ma masa awal inān, waktu tagna', mbal bay amissala Tuhan pasal llaw saddī.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:9
verses.text: Sagō' aniya' bissalana, maka aniya' pahalian ma a'a suku' Tuhan,

verses.name: Hebrews 4:10
verses.text: sabab sasuku makasōd ni deyom pahalian bay tinagamahan iya e' Tuhan, pahali iya min hinangna buwat kahali Tuhan min bay hinangna.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:11
verses.text: Angkan kitam subay amuspus pasōd ni pahalian Tuhan, bo' supaya halam aniya' min kitam tinaikutan ma sabab kapameya'na ma kajarihan saga a'a patigaggahun inān.  <div eID="gen8149" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4033"/><div sID="gen8153" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4033"/> Pahōp asal palman Tuhan, maka apaslod. Atalom gi' labi min katalom kalis, ati pa'abut to'ongan ni deyom paltubu-tubuhanta maka ni palnyawahanta sampay ni sumsumta. Manjari ai-ai pinikil maka niniyat e' manusiya', tasilang sadja ma sabab palman Tuhan e'.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:13
verses.text: Halam aniya' katapukan min pang'nda' Tuhan ma ai-ai pinapanjari kamemon. Atampal sadja ma pang'nda'na, ati paharap du kitam ni iya ma sinosōng, magpasab'nnal ma pasal kamemon bay hinangta.  <div eID="gen8153" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8123" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4034"/><div sID="gen8154" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Imam Muwallam Bangsahan</title> <div sID="gen8155" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4034"/> Na, aniya' ma kitam Imam Muwallam landu' bangsahan, wa'i na makasampay ni haddarat Tuhan. Ya na si Isa Anak Tuhan. Angkan subay ahogot pamogbogtam ma agama ya pagsab'nnalantam itu.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:15
verses.text: Sabab si Isa, ya Imamta Muwallam, landu' ma'ase' ma kitam. Kata'uwanna asal kalammahantam sabab bay na kalabayanna sasat indaginis buwat makani-kitam. Ya sadja pagbidda'anna, in iya halam bay makarusa.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:16
verses.text: Na, pagka aniya' ma kitam Imam Muwallam buwattē', subay mbal ag'mma sumangattam pasekot ni haddarat Tuhan angamu' tabang min iya, ya po'onan tabang. Tantu kitam kina'ase'an maka tinabang ma waktu asigpit.  <div eID="gen8155" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.4"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:1
verses.text: Na, in pasal Imam Muwallam bangsa Yahudi: bang aniya' pinene' magimam muwallam, pinene' iya min pagkahina manusiya'. Kawakilan iya maghinang ni Tuhan paganti' min pagkahina. Tinukbalan e'na lalabotan ni Tuhan, kinulban e'na saga hayop supaya aniya' pangampunan dusa saga a'a.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:2
verses.text: Biyaksa iya t'kkahan lamma angkan ahanunut e'na amissalahan saga a'a halam kapandu'an, a'a bay paokat min lān tudju ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:3
verses.text: Ngga'i ka isab hal dusa a'a kasehe'an ya pinagkulbanan, sampay dusa baranna isab, sabab manusiya' iya magkalamma.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' angangg'llal di-na Imam Muwallam bang hal min baranna, saguwā' Tuhan sadja ya amene', buwat bay pamene'na ma si Harun waktu palabay.  <div eID="gen8156" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4035"/><div sID="gen8157" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4035"/> Damikiyanna Al-Masi, halam iya bay maglaku-laku di-na in iya subay imam muwallam, saguwā' Tuhan bay angangg'llal. Buwattitu pamissala Tuhan ma iya: <lg sID="gen8158"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8159"/>“Ka'a ya Anakku, maka aku ya mma'nu min llaw itu.”<l eID="gen8159" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8158"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:6
verses.text: Aniya' isab bay pamissalana ma ayat saddī, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8160"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8161"/>“Ka'a ya tahinang imam salama-lama tahun.<l eID="gen8161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8162"/>Sali' du pagimamnu maka bay pagimam si Malkisadik waktu tagna'.”<l eID="gen8162" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8160"/>  <div eID="gen8157" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4036"/><div sID="gen8163" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4036"/> Hinabu pa'in si Isa ma dunya itu, bay iya angamu' duwa'a maka anganjunjung ni Tuhan, ya taga-kapatut amuwasan iya min kamatay. Akosog panangisna sabuna angamu'-ngamu', ati kinale iya e' Tuhan ma sabab kapagmalulusna ma kahandakna.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:8
verses.text: Makananam si Isa katiksa'an minsan iya Anak Tuhan, manjari atukid pameya'na ma panoho'an Tuhan pagka kapamintānganna tiksa' inān.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:9
verses.text: Ta'abut pa'in iya atubus ma kamemon, tahinang iya tunggal manglalappas ma sasuku ameya' ma iya, bo' supaya sigām pinaniya'an kallum kakkal.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:10
verses.text: Lāgi pinat'nna' iya Imam Muwallam e' Tuhan, buwat bay kapagimam si Malkisadik ma masa awal e'.  <div eID="gen8163" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8154" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4037"/><div sID="gen8164" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Imanta Subay Ginomgoman Pahāp</title> <div sID="gen8165" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4037"/> Na, aheka lagi' arak pamata'u kami ma ka'am ma pasal ina'an-i, saguwā' kahunitan aku amahati ka'am sabab agagga kam pinandu'an.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:12
verses.text: At'ggol na kapameya'bi ma si Isa, sagō' mbal gi' kam makapandu' ma pagkahibi ilu. Subay aniya' a'a saddī amandu'an ka'am pabalik pasal lapal Tuhan. Sali' kam hantang onde'-onde' ya mbal makakakan atuwas, subay hal gatas.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:13
verses.text: Bang a'a mbal makakakan saddī min gatas, masi iya onde'-onde' ya mbal gi' makapanilang ahāp maka ala'at.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:14
verses.text: Subay kam asangpot bo' yampa makakakan pagkakan atuwas. Hatulanna, bang a'a asangpot pangandolna, biyaksa iya ami'at baranna bo' tasilangna ahāp maka ala'at.  <div eID="gen8165" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.5"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:1
verses.text: Angkanna, bang kitam bilahi asangpot ma kaul maka pi'il, subay kitam ang'bba min pamandu' panagna'an pasal Al-Masi, bo' palanjal ni pangadji' alalom-lalom. Da'a balikantam undang-undangan pasal pagtaikut min hinang halam taga-pūs maka pangandol ma Tuhan,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:2
verses.text: pasal pagpandi maka pagt'ppak tangan, maka pandu' pasal pagpakallum a'a magpatayan maka hukuman kakkal. Bay na pangadji'antam ina'an.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:3
verses.text: Jari pasangpot du pangita'utam, bang karūlan isab e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8166" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4038"/><div sID="gen8167" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4038"/> Saupama a'a bay pinasawahan panahu'anna: bay makananam anughala' min sulga' maka bay makahampit kawasa min Rū Sussi. Bang a'a inān anaikutan pangandolna ma si Isa, tantu iya mbal makabāk kataubatan pabīng.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:5
verses.text: Bay na kalabayanna kahāpan min palman Tuhan maka tananamna isāb barakat min pagparintahan sinōng.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:6
verses.text: Sagō' bang iya animanan pangandolna, tantu iya mbal makabāk pagsusunan atawa pagtaubatan pabalik. Sabab hatulanna, nilansang e'na Anak Tuhan ni hāg pabalik, nihinang iya panunggīngan a'a ma mata mairan pabīng.  <div eID="gen8167" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4039"/><div sID="gen8168" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4039"/> Na, kitam manusiya' sapantun tana' paghuma'an. Bang araran kaulanan, pasulig maina'an saga tinanom ya pagguna e' a'a tag-huma.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:8
verses.text: Saguwā' bang tana' hal patomo'an sagmot maka kayu-kayu itingan, halam aniya' kagunahanna. Taka-taka sinukna'an ati tinunu' ma katobtobanna.  <div eID="gen8168" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4040"/><div sID="gen8169" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4040"/> Saguwā' minsan buwattē' pagbanda'ku ma ka'am, saga bagay kalasahanku, makatantu kami in ka'am mbal magkabuwattē'. Tantu kam kaniya'an kahāpan ya pinasambeya' maka kalappasan kalabayanbi ilu.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:10
verses.text: Abontol asal Tuhan. Mbal takalipatna bay hinangbi ahāp sampay lasabi ma iya. Ta'nda' lasabi min panabangbi ma pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa, min tagna' sampay ni kabuwattina'anan.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:11
verses.text: Ya sadja kabaya'an kami bang pa'in ataptap katuyu'bi dangan maka dangan sampay ta'abutbi kamaujuranna, bo' tatuman ai-ai holatbi min Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:12
verses.text: Mbal kami bilahi bang kam maglisu'-lisu'. Ahāp lagi' kam anengoran saga a'a anandalan haggut-pasu' ma sabab pangandol sigām, ya angkan sigām makasambut panganjanji' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8169" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8164" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4041"/><div sID="gen8170" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tuman du Janji' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8171" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4041"/> Ma waktu kamatto'ahan, aniya' janji' Tuhan ma si Ibrahim. Bay sapahanna isab janji'na, ōnna dakayu'-kayu' ya pagsapahanna sabab halam aniya' alanga min ōnna.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:14
verses.text: Angallam iya ma si Ibrahim, yukna, “Ya itu janji'ku ma ka'a: barakatanta ka to'ongan maka pahekaku saga panubu'nu.”

verses.name: Hebrews 6:15
verses.text: Halam sinumu si Ibrahim angalagaran Tuhan, angkan tasambutna kamemon bay panganjanji' ma iya.  <div eID="gen8171" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4042"/><div sID="gen8172" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4042"/> Ya addat manusiya' bang anapa, subay aniya' pagsapahan liyu min sigām, jari asulut palkala' a'a duwangan bang makapagsapa na.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:17
verses.text: Ya kabaya'an Tuhan subay atampal to'ongan bang ai maksudna maka bang buwattingga tatasna, angkan pinapagtapil janji'na maka sapana.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:18
verses.text: Minnē' kitam makatantu in janji' Tuhan mbal magkapinda sabab mbal kapindahan in duwa magtapil itu, mbal isab kapaliluhan e' Tuhan. Angkan pat'ttog gom pa'in imanta, sasuku kitam makabāk kasalamatan ma iya, ati amalut kitam ma kaholatan ya pamuwanna ma kitam.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:19
verses.text: Jari ahogot kaholatantam, sali' sapantun sau mbal talaran minsan buwattingga kalandos s'llog. Angkan ahogot, sabab ina'an paengkot ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan ni Tuhan, ma haddaratna to'ongan.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:20
verses.text: Bay na pareyom pina'an si Isa, dahū min kitam, sali' dalil imam magpatillot ma pasaltam. Tahinang na iya Imam Muwallam magimam salama-lama, buwat bay kapagimam si Malkisadik ma masa awal e'.  <div eID="gen8172" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.6"/> <div eID="gen8170" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4043"/><div sID="gen8173" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Imam Malkisadik</title> <div sID="gen8174" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4043"/> Na in pasal sultan Malkisadik: si Malkisadik itu bay sultan ma lahat Salem ma masa awal e', maka imam isab iya ma Tuhan Mahatinggi. Jari dakayu' llaw, hinabu si Ibrahim amole' min panganda'ugna ma saga sultan kuntarana, sinampang iya e' Malkisadik maka sinibahatan e'na kahāpan.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:2
verses.text: Kabuwanan bahagi' si Malkisadik e' si Ibrahim, dambahagi' min sangpū' ma pangalta' bay ta'agawna ma pagbono'an. Bang nihati ōn Malkisadik itu, ‘Sultan Ka'adilan’ atawa ‘Sultan Kasannangan.’

verses.name: Hebrews 7:3
verses.text: Halam aniya' salsila pasal si Malkisadik bang minningga pangkatanna. Mbal isab kata'uwanta bang buwattingga kapaganak ma iya maka bang sumiyan kamatayna. Dasali' iya maka Anak Tuhan, sabab anatas kapagimamna ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8174" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4044"/><div sID="gen8175" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4044"/> Kira-kirahunbi kabangsa si Malkisadik itu, sabab kabuwanan iya bahagi' sangpū' min pangalta' bay tataban e' si Ibrahim, pangkattam landu' abantug.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:5
verses.text: Aniya' panoho'an sara' pinat'nna'an saga panubu' si Libi pasal kapagimam sigām. Sinō' sigām animuk alta' min pagkahi sigām tubu' si Ibrahim, bahagi' sangpū' min kaniya' sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:6
verses.text: Ngga'i ka panubu' si Libi si Malkisadik itu, sagō' makasambut iya bahagi' min si Ibrahim. Jari si Ibrahim, a'a bay kapanganjanji'an e' Tuhan, bay niamu'an kahāpan e' si Malkisadik.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:7
verses.text: Atampal ko' itu, ya a'a angamu' kahāpan akawasa lagi' min a'a ya niamu'an kahāpan.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:8
verses.text: A'a magkamatay asal saga kaimaman Yahudi ya animuk bahagi' alta' min pagkahi sigām. Saguwā' si Malkisadik itu, ya bay makasambut bahagi' min si Ibrahim, tasulat ma deyom Kitab in iya taptap allum.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:9
verses.text: Taga-kapatut saga imam panubu' si Libi animuk alta' sagō' tumabeya' si Libi ma mbo'na si Ibrahim ma kapanukbal bahagi' alta' ni si Malkisadik.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:10
verses.text: Halam gi' bay nianakan si Libi ma waktu kapanukbal si Ibrahim e', sagō' ina'an iya patanam ma deyom kuddarat mbo'na.  <div eID="gen8175" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8173" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4045"/><div sID="gen8176" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa maka si Malkisadik</title> <div sID="gen8177" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4045"/> Na, ma waktu tagna' inān aniya' sara' pamat'nna' e' Tuhan ma bangsa Isra'il, maka aniya' kaimaman panubu' si Libi bay gin'llal magsuluhan. Manjari bang panubu' si Libi itu bay taga-kawasa amasampulna' kajarihan saga pagkahi sigām, angay subay aniya' bowahan imam saddī buwat kapagimam si Malkisadik? Angay mbal bineya' kapagimam si Harun ya panubu' si Libi?

verses.name: Hebrews 7:12
verses.text: Bang ginanti'an bowahan pagimam tagna', subay ginanti'an isab sara' ya pameya'anna.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:13
verses.text: Atampal ko' itu, ngga'i ka panubu' si Libi ya pagbissalahantam itu, sagō' si Isa ya Panghū'tam. Saddī tubu'anna sabab panubu' si Yuda iya, maka halam aniya' panubu' si Yuda maghinang ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan ni Tuhan. Halam minsan sinambat e' si Musa panubu' si Yuda bang takdil ni imam.  <div eID="gen8177" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:14
verses.text: Atampal ko' itu, ngga'i ka panubu' si Libi ya pagbissalahantam itu, sagō' si Isa ya Panghū'tam. Saddī tubu'anna sabab panubu' si Yuda iya, maka halam aniya' panubu' si Yuda maghinang ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan ni Tuhan. Halam minsan sinambat e' si Musa panubu' si Yuda bang takdil ni imam.  <div eID="gen8177" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4046"/><div sID="gen8178" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4046"/> Atampal to'ongan, aniya' na imam saddī palahil, ma buwat kapagimam si Malkisadik.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:16
verses.text: Ngga'i ka sara' atawa usulan manusiya' ya makabuwanan si Isa kapatut magimam, sagō' nihinang iya imam ma sabab kawasana, pagka halam aniya' kahinapusan kallumna.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:17
verses.text: Buwat bay binissala ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8179"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8180"/>“Ka'a ya tahinang imam ma salama-lama tahun,<l eID="gen8180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8181"/>buwat bay kapagimam si Malkisadik.”<l eID="gen8181" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8179"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:18
verses.text: Pinapasan na bay sara' tagna' pagka halam aniya' kosogna, halam aniya' kapūsanna.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:19
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' bay tasussi pangatayanna ma sabab sara' si Musa ya bogboganna. Maka aniya' na niholat saddī, labi ahāp min sara' inān. Minnē' kitam taga-kapatut pasekot ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8178" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4047"/><div sID="gen8182" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4047"/> Aniya' gi' sapa Tuhan pinabeya' ma pagimam si Isa. Halam aniya' sapa ma saga imam tagna',

verses.name: Hebrews 7:21
verses.text: saguwā' si Isa tahinang imam labay min panapa Tuhan, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8183"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8184"/>“Angallam Panghū' ma pasalan ka'a, yukna,<l eID="gen8184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8185"/>‘Ka'a ya tahinang imam sampay ni kasaumulan.’<l eID="gen8185" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8186"/>Mbal to'ongan apinda sapa pangallamna itu.”<l eID="gen8186" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8183"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:22
verses.text: Na pagka buwattē', labi ahāp kapagsulutan baha'u itu, ya niumbangan e' si Isa.  <div eID="gen8182" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4048"/><div sID="gen8187" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4048"/> Aniya' gi' pagbidda'an saga imam tagna' maka si Isa. Magkamatay asal saga imam tagna' inān, angkan subay aheka bo' aniya' na pa'in paganti'.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:24
verses.text: Saguwā' halam aniya' ganti' si Isa sabab allum iya salama-lama.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:25
verses.text: Angkan iya makaga'os angalappas to'ongan ma sasuku angandol ma iya, bo' supaya makapagsekot maka Tuhan. Makalappas iya min buwattina'an sampay ni kasaumulan sabab allum iya salama-lama anganjunjung ni Tuhan ma pasalan sigām.  <div eID="gen8187" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4049"/><div sID="gen8188" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4049"/> Manjari Imamtam Muwallam si Isa, ya ata'u anabangan kitam. Asussi pangatayanna, halam aniya' tamakna. Pinabidda' iya min manusiya' dusahan ati pinalanga iya ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:27
verses.text: Bidda' isab iya min saga Imam Muwallam kasehe'an inān. Taga-kapatut sigām anukbalan susumbali'an llaw-llaw pamapuwas dusa. Dusa baran sigām ya pinuwas dahū, bo' yampa dusa kasehe'an. Sumaguwā' mbal magkagunahan buwattē' si Isa. Pinamint'dda panukbalna pagkulban ni Tuhan pamapuwas dusa manusiya' kamemon, pagka paglilla'na baranna ni kamatay.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:28
verses.text: Bang ma sara' si Musa, manusiya' salla'an ya pinat'nna' magimam-nakura'. Saguwā' labi ajatu pangwakil Tuhan ma Anakna sabab min janji'na ahogot, damuli lagi' min waktu kapamuwan sara'. Jari Anakna, ya halam aniya' salla'-salla'na, tahinang Imam Muwallam sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8188" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.7"/> <div eID="gen8176" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4050"/><div sID="gen8189" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa ya Imam Muwallam</title> <div sID="gen8190" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4050"/> Na, ya na itu to'ongan maksud pagbissalahantam: aniya' ma kitam Imam Muwallam buwat bay bissalaku he'. Ina'an iya ma haddarat Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, aningkō' ma bihingna tampal ni kowan.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:2
verses.text: Ina'an iya magimam ma pangarapan mahasussi, hatina ma langgal to'ongan ya bay nihinang e' Panghū', ngga'i ka e' manusiya'.  <div eID="gen8190" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4051"/><div sID="gen8191" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4051"/> Ya angkan aniya' imam muwallam pinat'nna', sabab anukbalan sigām lalabotan saga manusiya' ni Tuhan, sampay susumbali'an ya pagkulban sigām. Damikiyanna Imamtam Muwallam, subay aniya' panukbalna ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:4
verses.text: Bang iya bay ma dunya lagi', mbal iya makapagimam sabab aniya' asal imam maitu pinat'nna' anukbalan lalabotan saga a'a ni Tuhan ma buwat usulan sara' Yahudi.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:5
verses.text: Sagō' ya nihinang e' imam ma dunya itu ngga'i ka kab'nnalanna. Sali' lambung sadja atawa patta' ma hinang to'ongan, ya nihinang ma deyom sulga'. Buwattē' isab bay kahinangan si Musa ma masa awal e', ma songna maghinang langgal tolda. Bay iya binanda'an e' Tuhan, yuk-i, “Amay-amay, beya'in suntu'an langgal bay pa'nda'anku ni ka'a ma diyata' būd.”

verses.name: Hebrews 8:6
verses.text: Sagō' kapagimam ya pamahinang ma si Isa, aheya to'ongan lagi' min kapagimam saga a'a ma dunya. Labi ahāp isab kapagsulutan baha'u ya paghāpan manusiya' maka Tuhan ma sabab si Isa, maka labi ahāp paljanji'an ya amuwan kajatuhan.  <div eID="gen8191" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4052"/><div sID="gen8192" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4052"/> Bang bay halam aniya' salla' ma kapagsulutan tagna', mbal bay ginanti'an ni saddī,

verses.name: Hebrews 8:8
verses.text: sagō' tasoway e' Tuhan saga a'a suku'na, angkan yukna, <lg sID="gen8193"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8194"/>“Aniya' waktu paniya' ma sinosōng<l eID="gen8194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8195"/>waktu pangahinangku pagsulutan baha'u maka bangsa Isra'il,<l eID="gen8195" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8196"/>beya' isab bangsa Yuda.<l eID="gen8196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8197"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:9
verses.text: Saddī isab min kapagsulutan tagna',<l eID="gen8197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8198"/>ya bay hinangku ma ka'mbo'-mbo'an sigām,<l eID="gen8198" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8199"/>waktu kapamowaku sigām paluwas min lahat Misil.<l eID="gen8199" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8200"/>Halam kabogbogan e' sigām kapagsulutanku maka sigām,<l eID="gen8200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8201"/>ya angkan sigām pasagaranku, yuk Panghū'.<l eID="gen8201" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8202"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:10
verses.text: Buwattitu ya kapagsulutan song hinangku ma bangsa Isra'il:<l eID="gen8202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8203"/>Ma waktu sinōng inān, yuk Panghū',<l eID="gen8203" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8204"/>pahōpku panoho'anku ni deyom pamikil sigām.<l eID="gen8204" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8205"/>Sulatku isab sara'ku ma deyom atay sigām.<l eID="gen8205" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8206"/>Ati aku ya pagtuhanan sigām,<l eID="gen8206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8207"/>maka sigām ya tahinang bangsa suku'ku.<l eID="gen8207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8208"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:11
verses.text: Mbal na sigām subay amandu'an sehe' sigām ma pasalanku,<l eID="gen8208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8209"/>mbal sigām amogos pagkahi sigām subay ata'u ma Panghū'.<l eID="gen8209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8210"/>Sabab kinata'uwan du aku e' a'a kamemon,<l eID="gen8210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8211"/>min a'a areyo' sampay ni a'a bangsahan.<l eID="gen8211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8212"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:12
verses.text: Ati ampunku paldusahan sigām kamemon.<l eID="gen8212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8213"/>Mbal na entomku bay hinang sigām ala'at.”<l eID="gen8213" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8193"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:13
verses.text: Na, pagka binissala e' Tuhan kapagsulutan baha'u itu, hatina amaluba na in kapagsulutan tagna'. Sabab minsan ai-ai, bang ang'ndang na atawa amaluba na, al'kkas na magka'at.  <div eID="gen8192" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.8"/> <div eID="gen8189" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4053"/><div sID="gen8214" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Untulan ma Langgal Pagkulbanan Tagna'</title> <div sID="gen8215" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4053"/> Na, aniya' sara' pasal pagta'at ni Tuhan bay pabeya' ma kapagsulutan tagna', maka aniya' isab luma' pangarapan bay hinangan manusiya'. Buwattitu hinanganna:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:2
verses.text: aniya' luma' tolda bay nihinang duwa bilikna. Ya bilik pasōran dahū niōnan Bilik Sussi. Aniya' panyapna papagan palita'an maka lamisahan pagtutukbalan, maka tinapay pangalabot ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:3
verses.text: Aniya' isab bilik niōnan Bilik Mahasussi ma deyom to'ongan, ma liyu kultina pangagpang.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:4
verses.text: Ya panyapna lamisahan bulawan panugtugan kamanyan, maka ba'ul sinarul deyom-luwasanna maka bulawan, ya pinagōnan Ba'ul Pagsulutan. Aniya' ma deyom ba'ul inān garul bulawan isihan kinakan niōnan “manna”. Ina'an isab tungkud si Harun ya bay tinomo'an dahun, maka duwa papan batu bay niukilan pagsulutan Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:5
verses.text: Aniya' duwa mala'ikat pikpikan ma diyata'an ba'ul, tanda' pangilahan in ina'an-i haddarat Tuhan. Pab'llat pikpik sigām angalimbuhan sa'ob ba'ul, ya pinigsikan laha' pangampunan dusa. Saguwā' mbal tapagbissalatam ba'anan kapanyapanna ma waktu itu.  <div eID="gen8215" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4054"/><div sID="gen8216" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4054"/> Na, buwattitu ya kal'ngngananna ma deyom Luma' Pangarapan inān: magsōd saga imam llaw-llaw ni deyom bilik tampal ni luwasan bo' angahinang ai-ai ya kapatutan sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:7
verses.text: Saguwā' luwal imam muwallam ya makajari pasōd ni bilik ma deyom to'ongan inān, mint'dda dantahun. Maka minsan iya, subay aniya' laha' pagkulban tabowana pareyom, tinukbalan ni Tuhan pamapuwas dusana sampay dusa saga a'a kasehe'an ya halam tasayu e' sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:8
verses.text: Jari asawa pamandu' min Rū Sussi itu, hatina halam aniya' pasōran ni Bilik Mahasussi To'ongan sat'ggol masi Luma' Pangarapan tagna' inān.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:9
verses.text: Kapamintāngan ko' itu ma kitam buwattina'an, hatina in lalabotan maka kukulbanan ya tinukbal ni Tuhan ma waktu palabay inān, halam aniya' dapatna amabontol itikad saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:10
verses.text: Angkan buwattē', sabab in untulan bay bogbogan sigām pasal pagkakan maka paginum maka ginisan pagail, hal pamasussi baran sigām sampay ta'abut waktu pamabaha'u ai-ai e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8216" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8214" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4055"/><div sID="gen8217" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Laha' Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8218" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4055"/> Saguwā' makalahil pa'in Al-Masi magimam muwallam angumbangan saga pakaradja'an ahāp ya paniya' ma buwattina'an, bay iya pasōd ni langgal labi asampulna' min langgal hinangan manusiya'. In langgal itu ngga'i ka suku' ma alam pinapanjari.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:12
verses.text: Min t'dda du Al-Masi bay pasōd ni Bilik Mahasussi. Ngga'i ka laha' kambing maka laha' sapi' ya tabowana, saguwā' dī laha'na, bo' supaya kitam pinuwas min hukuman dusa sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:13
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a abatal ma masa awal, subay iya pinigsikan maka laha' kambing atawa laha' sapi', maka abu min anak sapi' tinunu' pinalamud ni bohe'. Manjari ala'an batalna ati patut iya anambahayang.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:14
verses.text: Saguwā' labi akawasa laha' Al-Masi min laha' hayop. Tinabang iya e' Rū kakkal ma waktu kapaglilla'na baranna pagkulban ni Tuhan, halam isab aniya' tamak-tamakna. Manjari laha'na itu makapabontol itikadtam min kahinangan ya amowa ni kamatay. Minnē' limaya na kitam maghinang ni Tuhan ya kakkal salama-lama.  <div eID="gen8218" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4056"/><div sID="gen8219" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4056"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan Al-Masi wajib magpatillot angahatul kapagsulutan baha'u ya paghāpan manusiya' maka Tuhan, bo' supaya sasuku tapene' e'na makasambut pusaka' kakkal. Angkan sigām makajari anambut, sabab Al-Masi bay amatay pamapuwas sigām min paldusahan ya bay tahinang sigām ma deyo'an kapagsulutan tagna'.  <div eID="gen8219" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4057"/><div sID="gen8220" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4057"/> Bang takdil ni kataddangan pamusaka', buwattitu kal'ngngananna: in pusaka' mbal magtūy ni'nde'an ni a'a pinusaka'an. Subay amatay dahū in a'a amusaka', maka subay aniya' bainat pasal kamatayna bo' yampa ni'nde'an pusaka' inān.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:17
verses.text: Sabab in kataddangan pusaka' itu mbal gi' taga-pūs sat'ggol masi allum a'a tag-alta'. Subay iya amatay bo' yampa taga-pūs.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:18
verses.text: Angkanna, minsan ma kapagsulutan tagna', subay aniya' laha' pagkulban pabu'us dahū bo' yampa aniya' kajatuhanna.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:19
verses.text: Buwattitu isab kal'ngngananna: aubus pa'in e' si Musa bay amata'u saga a'a Isra'il pasal kamemon sara' ya panoho'an Tuhan ma sigām, bay iya angā' laha' hayop pinaglamud maka bohe', bo' pigsikanna Kitab panulatan sara', beya' isab saga a'a inān kamemon. Ya tagunana pamigsik laha', engas-engas min kayu-kayu hissup pin'kkos maka bulbul bili-bili nianjibi keyat.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:20
verses.text: Ya lling si Musa hinabuna amigsik: “Ya itu laha' amuwan kajatuhan ma pagsulutan itu, ya bay pinat'nna'an ka'am e' Tuhan bo' kam ameya' ma panoho'anna.”

verses.name: Hebrews 9:21
verses.text: Damikiyanna luma' pangarapan sigām ni Tuhan, maka panyap kamemon ya pinakay ma paghinang sigām, pinigsikan isab maka laha'.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:22
verses.text: Hatina, sinussi maka laha' agon-agon kamemon ai-ai ya pinakay ma sara' agama inān. Subay aniya' laha' pinabu'us bo' ka'ampunan paldusahan manusiya'.  <div eID="gen8220" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4058"/><div sID="gen8221" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4058"/> Jari in luma' pangarapan tagna' maka kapanyapanna subay sinussi maka laha' hayop. Sagō' ngga'i ka he' kab'nnalanna. Hal ibarat patta' ma dī Luma' Pangarapan ya ma deyom sulga'. Bo' malaingkan landu' ahalga' ai-ai ma deyom sulga', angkan subay aniya' laha' labi ahalga' panussi iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:24
verses.text: Jari sinōd e' Al-Masi in Bilik Mahasussi, sagō' ngga'i ka bilik sussi hinangan manusiya' ma buwat suntu'an bay min sulga'. Pasōd Al-Masi ni deyom sulga' to'ongan bo' makapagharap maka Tuhan ma haddaratna, ati maina'an iya anganjunjung ma pasalantam.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:25
verses.text: Bay pasōd saga imam muwallam Yahudi ni deyom Bilik Mahasussi tahun ni tahun amowa laha' hayop pagkulban ni Tuhan. Saguwā' Al-Masi halam bay pasōd bo' maglilla' baranna magbalik-balik.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:26
verses.text: Bang iya bay pasōd min heka, min heka du isab tananamna kabinasahan sangay min waktu kapamapanjari dunya. Saguwā' mint'dda sadja kalahilna ni dunya itu, ma song akiyamat dunya, bo' supaya paglilla'na baranna ni kamatay pamala'an dusa manusiya'.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:27
verses.text: Ya pangangganta' bangsa manusiya' subay amatay min t'dda sadja bo' yampa nihukum e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:28
verses.text: Damikiyanna Al-Masi, min t'dda du isab iya bay amatay pagkulban bo' supaya tatanggungna dusa manusiya'. Palahil iya pabīng ma sinosōng, kaminduwana na, sagō' ngga'i ka pamuwas dusa. Ya angkan iya palahil pabīng bo' kalappasanna to'ongan sasuku angalagaran iya.  <div eID="gen8221" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.9"/>
