verses.name: Hebrews 10:1
verses.text: Ya sara' bay pamuwan e' Tuhan ma bangsa Yahudi he' hal hantang suntu'an pang'nda'anta kahāpan ya song pinaniya'. Ngga'i ka kab'nnalanna. Aniya' susumbali'an bay pinagkulban ni Tuhan tahun ni tahun, halam aniya' kaubusanna. Sagō' mbal makarapat saga pagkulban inān pangalanu' pangatayan a'a magsasambahayang.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:2
verses.text: Bang sigām bay sinussi sab'nnal-b'nnal min dusa sigām, halam aniya' dusa tananam sigām, ati mbal sigām magkagunahan magkulban pabalik. Malaingkan masi du dusa sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:3
verses.text: Maka susumbali'an ya pagkulban na pa'in ma pasalan sigām tahun ni tahun hal pamaentom in sigām masi taga-dusa.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:4
verses.text: Mattan du, laha' sapi' maka laha' kambing mbal makapuwasan dusa manusiya'.  <div eID="gen8222" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4059"/><div sID="gen8223" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4059"/> Na, pagka halam aniya' ka'ampunan dusa min paghinang tagna' he', buwattitu pagkallam Al-Masi hinabuna palahil ni dunya itu. Yukna, <lg sID="gen8224"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8225"/>“Ngga'i ka pagkulban maka lalabotan ya kabaya'annu,<l eID="gen8225" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8226"/>saguwā' sakapannu aku baran manusiya'.<l eID="gen8226" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8227"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:6
verses.text: Mbal ka kasulutan ma katibu'ukan hayop tinunu' pagkulban,<l eID="gen8227" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8228"/>atawa ginisan lalabotan ya tinukbal pama'ampun dusa.<l eID="gen8228" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8229"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:7
verses.text: Buwattitu isab pamissalaku: Itiya' aku, O Tuhan,<l eID="gen8229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8230"/>lilla' angahinang ai-ai pangahandaknu aku,<l eID="gen8230" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8231"/>buwat tasulat ma pasalku ma deyom Kitab.”<l eID="gen8231" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8224"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:8
verses.text: Duwa ginis bay pamissalana he', kaissana, “Halam aniya' kabaya'annu, ai na ka ma susumbali'an maka lalabotan, atawa ma hayop tinunu' ma katibu'ukan atawa ma pagkulban pagtaubatan dusa.” (Buwattē' pah'llingna minsan panoho'an sara' asal saga pagkulban maka tutukbalan.)

verses.name: Hebrews 10:9
verses.text: Karuwana, ya yukna, “Itiya' aku, O Tuhan, sakap angahinang ai-ai pangahandaknu aku.” Hatina, nibbahan e' Tuhan bay bowahan tagna' bo' pinaganti' bowahan baha'u.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:10
verses.text: Na, pagka ajukup e' si Isa Al-Masi bay pangahandak Tuhan ma iya, asussi kitam min dusatam ma sabab baran si Isa bay pagkulban pinam'nt'dda.  <div eID="gen8223" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4060"/><div sID="gen8232" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4060"/> Magt'nggehan na pa'in ma deyom langgal saga imam Yahudi inān kamemon bo' maghinang ai-ai pamahinang sigām. Tinukbalan e' sigām magbalik-balik saga pagkulban halam dapatna pamala'an dusa.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:12
verses.text: Saguwā' in imam damuli itu, hatina Al-Masi, bay magmalilla' baranna min t'dda sadja, nihinang pagkulban pamapuwas dusa manusiya', ati mbal binalikan sampay ni kasaumulan. Jari itu, aubus pa'in hinangna he', aningkō' iya ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:13
verses.text: ati ina'an na iya angagad buwattina'an sampay ta'abut waktu kapanganda'ug Tuhan min palbantahanna kamemon, bo' yampa pinat'nna' saga palbantahan e' ma deyo' pād-tape' Al-Masi.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:14
verses.text: Al-Masi itu, pinamint'dda pagmalilla'na baranna ni Tuhan, ati minnē' pinabontol to'ongan itikad manusiya', sasuku sinussi e'na.  <div eID="gen8232" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4061"/><div sID="gen8233" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4061"/> Aniya' isab saksi' min Rū Sussi, ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8234"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8235"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:16
verses.text: “Ya na itu kapagsulutan pat'nna'ku ma manusiya'<l eID="gen8235" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8236"/>bang ta'abut llawna, yuk Panghū'.<l eID="gen8236" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8237"/>Pahōpku panoho'anku ni deyom atay sigām.<l eID="gen8237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8238"/>Sulatku isab ma deyom panahu'an sigām.”<l eID="gen8238" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8234"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:17
verses.text: Sinugpat isab ayat dakayu' itu, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8239"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8240"/>“Mbal na entomku paldusahan sigām,<l eID="gen8240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8241"/>sampay kala'atan bay tahinang e' sigām.”<l eID="gen8241" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8239"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:18
verses.text: Na, pagka ta'ampun dusatam kamemon e' Tuhan, mbal na kitam magkagunahan angahinang pagkulban pabīng.  <div eID="gen8233" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8217" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4062"/><div sID="gen8242" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasekot Kitam ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8243" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4062"/> Manjari itu, saga danakanku, makatawakkal na kitam pasōd ni deyom Bilik Mahasussi ma sabab laha' si Isa.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:20
verses.text: Sabab bay pagmalilla' e' si Isa baranna pinapatay, ati minnē' kitam niukaban pasōran baha'u, pasōran kakkal. Hatina makasōd na kitam ni Bilik Mahasussi labay min kultina ya sapantun baran si Isa.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:21
verses.text: Aniya' na Imamtam bangsahan tag-kapatut ma okoman Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:22
verses.text: Angkan kitam subay pasekot ni Tuhan magatay pote', ma ahogot pangandolta ma iya. Subay halam aniya' hawal-hawalta ma pasal dusa bay hinangta ma waktu palabay, sabab tapabontol na itikadta. Tapandi isab baranta paltanda'an in kitam asussi na.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:23
verses.text: Subay kita amalut pahogot ma kaholatan ya pagkahagaranta, sabab kapangandolan asal Tuhan ya bay anganjanji' ma kitam.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:24
verses.text: Subay kannalta isab pagkahita bang buwattingga e'ta anabangan sigām bo' maglasa-liyasahi maka maghinang kahāpan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:25
verses.text: Da'a kitam ang'bba min addattam magtipun-tipun, buwat kapang'bba e' saga jama'a si Isa kasehe'. Gom na pa'in kita magtipun amat'ttog iman pagkahita dangan maka dangan, ya lagi'na ma buwattina'an pagka kata'uwanta asekot na Llaw Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen8243" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4063"/><div sID="gen8244" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4063"/> Na, bang kita angahinang kala'atan bo' pagtu'uranta minsan bay tataima' pandu' kasab'nnalan, tantu halam aniya' pagkulban pamala'an dusata.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:27
verses.text: Ya sadja lagaranta hukuman Tuhan makatāw-tāw, maka api asiglat ya panunu'na ma saga a'a anagga' iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:28
verses.text: Bang aniya' a'a bay makalanggal sara' si Musa ma masa awal e', bo' aniya' saksi' min duwangan atawa t'llungan maguyun, pinapatay iya, mbal kina'ase'an.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:29
verses.text: Jari labi abisa hukuman pinat'kkahan a'a ya angahalipulu Anak Tuhan. Mbal isab magaddat ma laha' bay pamajatu pagsulutan baha'u, ya panussi pangatayanna min dusa. Tahina' isab e'na Rū Sussi, ya ama'nda'an kitam ka'ase' Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:30
verses.text: Kata'uwanta bang sai bay amaluwas bissala, ya yuk-i, “Aku ya amalos. Aku ya anungbas.” Yukna isab, “Angahukum Panghū' ma bangsa suku'na.”

verses.name: Hebrews 10:31
verses.text: Landu' makatāw-tāw bang kita taluwa' hukuman Tuhan, ya kakkal salama-lama.  <div eID="gen8244" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4064"/><div sID="gen8245" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4064"/> Entomunbi bay palihalanbi ma waktu tagna' gi'. Baha'u kam bay makananam kasawahan min Tuhan sampay am'nnal ma si Isa, maka aheka katiksa'an bay kalabayanbi, sagō' halam bay apinda imanbi.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:33
verses.text: Suma'an pinaggunyak-gunyak baranbi maka pininjala' ma mata mairan, suma'an ka'am angandapitan pagkahibi waktu sigām pininjala'.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:34
verses.text: Bay ka'ase'anbi saga a'a pilisu ati tanggungbi kabinasahan sigām. Minsan kalangpasan ai-aibi kamemon, gom pa'in kam kinōgan sabab kata'uwanbi aniya' gi' ma ka'am alta' labi ahalga', anatas ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8245" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4065"/><div sID="gen8246" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4065"/> Angkan kam sinoho' da'a ang'bbahan pangandolbi ma Tuhan, sabab aheya tungbasna bang binogbogan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:36
verses.text: Paiman kam supaya tahinangbi ai-ai pangahandak ka'am e' Tuhan, bo' kam makahampit bay paljanji'anna ma ka'am.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:37
verses.text: Sabab asekot na waktu, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8247"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8248"/>“Mbal at'ggol bo' at'kka ya bay nilagaran. Marai' na t'kkana.<l eID="gen8248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8249"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:38
verses.text: Allum du saga a'aku abontol ma sabab pangandol sigām,<l eID="gen8249" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8250"/>sagō' bang a'a pataikut min aku, mbal aku kasulutan ma iya.”<l eID="gen8250" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8247"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:39
verses.text: Saguwā' halam aniya' lamudtam ma saga a'a ya pataikut min Tuhan bo' yampa binutawanan e'na. Angandol kitam ma Tuhan ati lappasan kitam min hukuman.  <div eID="gen8246" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.10"/> <div eID="gen8242" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4066"/><div sID="gen8251" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangandol</title> <div sID="gen8252" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4066"/> Na in pasal pangandol itu, hatina aniya' paltantuhanta in ai-ai holatta buwattina'an paniya' du ma sinosōng. Min pangandolta, ya angkan kita am'nnal ma pasal ai-ai ya mbal gi' ta'nda'ta.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:2
verses.text: Bay kasulutan Tuhan ma saga a'a ma waktu ka'mbo'-mbo'an ma sabab pangandol sigām ma iya.  <div eID="gen8252" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4067"/><div sID="gen8253" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4067"/> Bang kita angandol, makata'u kita in alam itu kamemon bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan min palmanna sadja. Manjari kakaya'-kaya'anna itu ya ta'nda' mata, bay tahinang min ai-ai ya mbal ta'nda'.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:4
verses.text: Entomunbi saga a'a bay ma masa awal e', buwat si Habil. Bay iya angandol ma Tuhan, ya po'on iya bay makatukbalan pagkulban tudju ni iya, labi ahāp min bay pangalamas siyakana si Kabil. Bay angandol si Habil, ati binista iya abontol e' Tuhan sabab ka'amuhan Tuhan ma panukbalna. Masi aniya' kapamintāngantam min pangandol si Habil minsan at'ggol na kamatayna.  <div eID="gen8253" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4068"/><div sID="gen8254" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4068"/> Si Idris isab ma masa awal e', halam iya bay makalabay kamatay sabab akosog pangandolna ni Tuhan. Halam tabāk bangkayna sabab bay iya pina'angkat e' Tuhan hinabuna allum. Angkan buwattē', sabab a'a iya makasulut atay Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:6
verses.text: Halam aniya' manusiya' makasulut atay Tuhan bang mbal angandol ma iya. Sabab sai-sai bilahi angarap ni Tuhan subay magkahagad aniya' Tuhan. Subay isab kahagadna aniya' panungbas Tuhan ma sasuku atuyu' amiha iya.  <div eID="gen8254" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4069"/><div sID="gen8255" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4069"/> Si Nū isab, aniya' pangandolna angkan iya bay angasip ma pagbanda' Tuhan pasal bala' song pinat'kka ni dunya. Kinahagad e'na ma halam gi' ta'nda'na. Bineya' e'na panoho'an Tuhan, ati nihinang e'na adjung aheya supaya sigām magtai'anak lappasan min latap. Ati minnē', min bowahan hinang si Nū he', talhakit in a'a kasehe'an bay ma dunya patut pinatōngan dusa. Bo' si Nū ya binista abontol ma sabab pangandolna.  <div eID="gen8255" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4070"/><div sID="gen8256" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4070"/> Si Ibrahim isab, bay iya angandol ma Tuhan angkan beya'na panoho'an Tuhan ati ala'an min dī lahatna tudju ni lahat saddī, ni bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma iya. Bay iya palintas minsan halam kata'uwanna bang pi'ingga patudjuhanna.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:9
verses.text: Ma sabab pangandolna isab, angkan si Ibrahim bay pat'nna' ma lahat bay panganjanji' Tuhan ma iya, minsan iya sali' a'a liyu maina'an. Maglihan-lihan iya, ati luma' tolda ya luma' palihananna. Buwattē' du isab anakna si Isa'ak maka mpuna si Yakub, ya tumabeya' ma si Ibrahim panganjanji'an lahat inān e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:10
verses.text: Aiman si Ibrahim sabab aniya' lagaranna lahat saddī, hatina da'ira ahogot pangosolanna, ya ginanta' maka nihinang e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8256" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4071"/><div sID="gen8257" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4071"/> Damikiyanna si Sara h'nda si Ibrahim, angandol isab ma Tuhan ati kabuwanan iya kosog makapangiram minsan iya aumul na, minsan palabay na bay waktu pangiramna. Tu'ud pangandolanna Tuhan in janji'na maujud du.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:12
verses.text: Si Ibrahim itu, minsan iya sali' a'a pinagamatay na, humeka to'ongan tubu'na. Ya heka panubu'na buwat heka bitu'un ma b'ttong langit, buwat solagan gusung ma bihing tahik, mbal takole' ni'itung.  <div eID="gen8257" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4072"/><div sID="gen8258" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4072"/> Manjari kamemon saga a'a kaōnan inān bay magpangandol ma Tuhan sampay ni kamatay. Ya bay paljanji'an Tuhan ma sigām, halam bay tasambut ma dunya lagi', saguwā' tapantaw e' sigām min katāhan, maka e' sigām kinōgan. Bay sigām angahaka patampal in sigām sali' a'a liyu, hal maglihan ma dunya itu.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:14
verses.text: Na, pagka sigām ah'lling in sigām a'a liyu, manyatakan du aniya' lahat saddī minohot, hatina lahat sigām luggiya'.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:15
verses.text: Halam isab nientom lahat bay pala'anan sigām tagna', sabab bang aniya' bay baya' sigām pabīng ni lahat e', halam aniya' bay makasagga'.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:16
verses.text: Sagō' ngga'i ka lahat tagna' ya nientom e' sigām, sagō' lahat labi ahāp, lahat sulga'. Angkan Tuhan mbal aiya' niōnan Tuhan e' sigām, sabab aniya' da'ira bay tinagama e'na ma sigām.  <div eID="gen8258" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4073"/><div sID="gen8259" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4073"/> Si Ibrahim isab, waktu bay kapanulay Tuhan ma iya, ahogot pangandolna. Angkan iya bay mbal allog amapatay anakna si Isa'ak pagkulban, minsan ya anak bay panganjanji' e' Tuhan. Yuk janji' Tuhan e', “Paheka du panubu'nu luwas min si Isa'ak.” Sagō' angandol si Ibrahim, angkan iya magmalilla' amapatay anakna he', pagkulban ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4073"/><div sID="gen8259" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4073"/> Si Ibrahim isab, waktu bay kapanulay Tuhan ma iya, ahogot pangandolna. Angkan iya bay mbal allog amapatay anakna si Isa'ak pagkulban, minsan ya anak bay panganjanji' e' Tuhan. Yuk janji' Tuhan e', “Paheka du panubu'nu luwas min si Isa'ak.” Sagō' angandol si Ibrahim, angkan iya magmalilla' amapatay anakna he', pagkulban ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:19
verses.text: Sabab bang ma bistahan si Ibrahim, tapakallum du anakna e' Tuhan. Jari tasambut e' si Ibrahim anakna sali' luwas min kamatay.  <div eID="gen8259" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4074"/><div sID="gen8260" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4074"/> Si Isa'ak isab bay angandol ma Tuhan, angkan nijanji'an e'na anakna duwangan, si Yakub maka si Esaw, in sigā pinat'kkahan du lidjiki' e' Tuhan ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen8260" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4075"/><div sID="gen8261" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4075"/> Si Yakub isab, song pa'in iya magkamamatay, bay angandol ma Tuhan ati niamu'an e'na barakat mpuna, anak si Yusup duwangan. Binalutan e'na tungkud pasangdolanna hinabuna amudji Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8261" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4076"/><div sID="gen8262" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4076"/> Si Yusup isab, song pa'in iya magkamamatay, bay angandol ma Tuhan. Angkan iya bay makapah'lling pasal kala'an bangsa Isra'il min lahat Misil. Pang'bba e'na ma sigām panoho'an pasal bangkayna.  <div eID="gen8262" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4077"/><div sID="gen8263" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4077"/> Ina'-mma' si Musa isab bay angandol ma Tuhan waktu kapanguldin sultan Misil subay pinapatay kamemon anak Yahudi l'lla sasuku nianakan baha'u. Angkan sigā bay anapukan si Musa ma deyom t'llumbulan puwas min kapaganak ma iya. Ta'nda' pa'in e' sigā in si Musa mahal-mahal lingkatna, halam sigā tināw ma uldin sultan e'.  <div eID="gen8263" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4078"/><div sID="gen8264" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4078"/> Si Musa isab bay angandol ma Tuhan, sabab ta'abut pa'in kasangpotna mbal na iya angaku niōnan anak dayang-dayang, ya anak Sultan bay amasulig iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:25
verses.text: Pād-pād iya ameya' ma hinang ala'at ma luma' sultan, ya makahāp palasahan dai'-dai' sadja, bilahi lagi' iya parakayu' ma pagkahina bangsa Isra'il, a'a suku' Tuhan. Lilla' iya magbeya' maka sigām bininasa.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:26
verses.text: Bang ma iya, minsan iya pinakaiya' ma sabab Al-Masi, ahalga' lagi' min kamemon alta' ma lahat Misil, sabab ya angutna tungbas min Tuhan ma llaw damuli.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:27
verses.text: Bay ala'an si Musa min lahat Misil ma sabab kosog pangandolna ma Tuhan, halam iya tināw ma pangastol sultan e'. Akosog to'ongan niyatna, sabab ta'nda'na Tuhan ya mbal ta'nda' manusiya'.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:28
verses.text: Ma sabab pangandolna isab, angkan iya bay magpanoho'an ma bangsa Isra'il. Sinō' sigām amigsikan laha' bili-bili ni lusuk-lusuk lawang sigām, bo' mbal talapay pinapatay anak sigām l'lla kasiyakahan bang palabay mala'ikat pangmumulka'. Ya he' tagna'an Hinang Paglakad.  <div eID="gen8264" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4079"/><div sID="gen8265" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4079"/> Bangsa Isra'il isab, waktu kauntas sigām ni dambila' s'llang ya niōnan S'llang Keyat. Minsan du bay s'llang, tahinang gintana'an magtūy ma sabab pangandol sigām, jari pauntasan sigām parambila'. Saguwā' pasulay pa'in saga a'a Misil pauntas, alembo sigām sabab pabīng magtūy tahik.  <div eID="gen8265" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4080"/><div sID="gen8266" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4080"/> Waktu kapehē' bangsa Isra'il ni da'ira Ariha, pinaglibut-libutan da'ira inān e' sigām ma deyom dapitu'. Ta'abut pa'in kapitu'na, magtūy alubu ādna batu sabab min kosog pangandol sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:31
verses.text: Bay angandol ni Tuhan si Rahab ya d'nda pagtatambahan ma da'ira Ariha. Pinatuntul e'na saga a'a magmata-mata ati halam iya bay talapay pinapatay maka saga a'a ya agagga ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8266" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4081"/><div sID="gen8267" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4081"/> Na, mbal na sugpatanku sabab mbal aku makasa'ut angahaka'an ka'am ma pasal disi Gidiyun, si Barak, si Samson, si Jepta, si Da'ud, si Samwel, sampay ni kanabi-nabihan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:33
verses.text: Saga a'a itu bay angangga'os pagsultanan ma sabab pangandol sigām. Aniya' kasehe' abontol pagsara' sigām ma sabab pangandol, maka aniya' bay makasambut panganjanji' Tuhan ma sabab pangandol sigām. Aniya' isab bay amak'ttop bowa' halimaw.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:34
verses.text: Aniya' sigām kasehe' bay am'ddahan api aheya, aniya' isab bay makaliyus min patay bono'. Aniya' isab sigām taluwa' kalammahan saguwā' angosog gom pa'in pamaranan sigām. Landu' sigām aesog ma pagbono', sampay tara'ug e' sigām ba'anan sundalu min lahat saddī.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:35
verses.text: Aniya' saga d'nda bay kamatayan sagō' allum pabalik saga lahasiya' sigām magpatayan he'. Aniya' isab a'a kasehe' mbal angaho' pinal'ppa minsan sigām pinap'ddi'an to'ongan sampay kamatay. Tu'ud sigām aholat pinakallum pabalik bo' binuwanan kallum labi ahāp.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:36
verses.text: Aniya' isab kasehe' bay pinaggunyak-gunyak sampay niraplosan, aniya' isab kasehe' bay kinarenahan bo' yampa tinambolan ma deyom kalabusu.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:37
verses.text: Aniya' isab sigām bay pinagbantung, aniya' bay pinagkatkat duwa, maka aniya' isab bay binono' maka kalis. Aniya' sigām kasehe' hal kuwit bili-bili atawa kambing ya pas'mmek sigām, miskin to'ongan. Nila'ugan na pa'in sigām, nijahulaka'.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:38
verses.text: Dunya itu mbal tōp paglahatan saga a'a inān, subay lahat labi ahāp. Sat'ggol sigām ma dunya itu, hal sigām maglihan na pa'in suma'an ma lahat paslangan, suma'an ma kabūd-būran. Bay sigām pat'nna' ma deyom sengab batu<note>‘Sengab batu,’ atawa ‘songab batu.’</note> atawa ma lowang ma deyom tana'.  <div eID="gen8267" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4082"/><div sID="gen8268" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4082"/> Babantugun saga a'a itu kamemon ma sabab kosog pangandol sigām ma Tuhan. Saguwā' halam sigām bay makasambut panganjanji' Tuhan t'ggol sigām allum,

verses.name: Hebrews 11:40
verses.text: sabab aniya' labi ahāp pangangganta' kitam e' Tuhan. Hatina in kitam maka saga a'a bay masa awal inān subay magbeya' anambut paljanji'an maka kasampulna'anna.  <div eID="gen8268" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.11"/> <div eID="gen8251" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4083"/><div sID="gen8269" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mma'tam Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8270" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4083"/> Na, pagka kita sali' dalil a'a maglomba pinagtimukan e' ba'anan saksi', subay bbahanta ai-ai makasembol, sampay saga dusa ya katagihanta sidda. Subay kita atuyu' magdagan sampay ta'abutta gindan ya pat'kkahanta.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:2
verses.text: Subay patonganta si Isa saumul-umul, sabab iya ya pasangdolanta min katagna' sampay ni katapusan. Bay sinandalan e'na katiksa'an ma waktu kapangalansang iya ni hāg pinapatay. Halam bay paheyana ma atay kaiya'anna amatay ma hāg, sabab niangut e'na kakōgan ya tinagamahan iya. Ina'an na iya ma sulga' aningkō' ma haddarat Tuhan, tampal ni kowan.  <div eID="gen8270" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4084"/><div sID="gen8271" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4084"/> Kannalunbi to'ongan bay kasandal si Isa waktuna pinagsagga' e' saga a'a baldusa. Bang he'-i takannalbi mbal du palamma pangandolbi. Mbal du kam sinumu ameya' ma iya,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:4
verses.text: sabab kata'uwanbi asal, halam lagi' aniya' min ka'am bay amatay min kapanagga'bi ma kala'atan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:5
verses.text: Marai' takalipatbi ya bay binissala e' Panghū' ni buwat ka'am anakna bo' supaya ahogot ataybi. Yukna inān, <lg sID="gen8272"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8273"/>“Ka'am saga anak, da'a kam amabiyal ma pami'atku ma ka'am.<l eID="gen8273" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8274"/>Da'a kam mandā'-dā' bang kam buwananku kal'ggahan.<l eID="gen8274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8275"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:6
verses.text: Sabab bi'atku du sasuku kalasahanku.<l eID="gen8275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8276"/>Palabayku isab min kabinasahan sasuku ōnanku anak.”<l eID="gen8276" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8272"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:7
verses.text: Angkanna, bang kam ganta' pinat'kkahan kabinasahan, subay kam magmalilla' sadja sabab pami'at mma'bi ko' itu. Ya kabinasahan tananambi ilu tanda' palsaksi'an in ka'am binista anak e' Tuhan. Aniya' bahā' onde'-onde' mbal bini'at e' mma'na?

verses.name: Hebrews 12:8
verses.text: Bang kam mbal tumabeya' bini'at e' Tuhan buwat kapami'atna ma anakna kamemon, mbal kam manjari niōnan anakna lahasiya'. Sali' kam ngga'i ka anak to'ongan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:9
verses.text: Minsan mma'ta maitu ma dunya, bay ami'at kita ati masi sigām pagaddatanta. Ya lagi'na isab Mma'ta Tuhan, ya ang'ntan palnyawahan manusiya'. Subay kita magmaluluy ma iya bo' supaya kita allum to'ongan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:10
verses.text: Pinagbi'at kita e' matto'ata sat'ggol kita onde'-onde', bo' pami'at sigām hal min akkal manusiya'. Saguwā' saddī pami'at Tuhan sabab tantu pamahāpna kaul-pi'ilta bo' supaya kita makasali' ni buwat kasussina.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:11
verses.text: Bang kita bini'at e' Tuhan mbal kita magtūy kinōgan sabab masi alengog pikilanta. Saguwā' bang palabay na waktu bay pami'at e', amintāng du kita bo' aniya' kasannanganta luwas min kabontolan hinangta.  <div eID="gen8271" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8269" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4085"/><div sID="gen8277" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandu' maka Pagbanda'</title> <div sID="gen8278" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4085"/> Angkan yukku ma ka'am: pakosog kam, maka pat'ttogunbi pangandolbi.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:13
verses.text: Pabontolunbi lān pal'ngngananbi. Jari bang aniya' pagkahibi ilu magduwa-ruwa, mbal iya alungay min lān. Gom pa'in kauli'an kalamma pangandolna.  <div eID="gen8278" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4086"/><div sID="gen8279" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4086"/> Subay kam amuspus magsulut maka a'a kamemon. Tuyu'inbi isab kaul-pi'il asussi, sabab halam aniya' makata'u Tuhan bang mbal asussi.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:15
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' kam, kalu aniya' min ka'am ang'bba min ase' maka lasa Tuhan. Painsap kam isab bang aniya' a'a ma deyomanbi ala'at kasuddahanna, sabab a'a buwattē' sapantun gamut kayu makalassun, taka-taka pasaha' ati paledled la'atna ni kaheka'an.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:16
verses.text: Kamaya'-maya' kam isab bo' supaya halam aniya' min ka'am magd'nda atawa magl'lla. Da'a isab pasagarinbi bang aniya' mailu an'ppu si Esaw, a'a masa awal sali' halam aniya' tuhanna. Si Esaw itu bay anak kasiyakahan, ati pamusaka' ma iya paljanji'an Tuhan. Saguwā' bay panambi' e'na palsuku'anna ni dapinggan kinakan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:17
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi asal kissana. At'ggol-t'ggol pa'in minnē', anganjunjung iya ma mma'na bang pa'in iya niamu'an lidjiki' min Tuhan. Sagō' pinagin'mbal iya sabab in bay hinang mma'na inān mbal to'ongan kapindahan, minsan buwattingga pagtangisna.  <div eID="gen8279" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4087"/><div sID="gen8280" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4087"/> Ka'am ilu, asekot na kam ni Tuhan, sagō' ya kasekotbi ngga'i ka buwat bay ma bangsa Isra'il masa awal e', sabab ta'nda' e' sigām bang ai ya pasekotan sigām, hatina būd Turusina. Ta'nda' e' sigām kosog apina, maka lendom makatangkob lahat, maka hunus alandos.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:19
verses.text: Takale isab sigām sali' tiyup-tiyup atanog, maka lling suwala makatāw-tāw. Pagkale sigām ma suwala he', magtūy sigām anganjunjung to'ongan bang pa'in sigām mbal pinakalehan pabalik, minsan hal dakabtang.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:20
verses.text: Tināw sigām makalandu' ma sabab panoho'an, ya yuk-i, “Bang aniya' makaragpak ni būd itu, minsan hayop, subay pinagbantung pinapatay.”

verses.name: Hebrews 12:21
verses.text: Makatāw-tāw sidda ya ta'nda' sigām inān. Sampay isab si Musa, sabab buwattitu bay llingna: “Amidpid aku,” yukna. “Tināw aku sidda.”  <div eID="gen8280" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4088"/><div sID="gen8281" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4088"/> Saguwā' ka'am ilu, saddī na kasekotbi ni Tuhan. Ilu na kam makasampay ni būd Siyun, ni da'ira paglahatan Tuhan kakkal salama-lama. Makasampay na kam ni da'ira Awrusalam ma deyom sulga', sampay ni saga mala'ikatna magibu-ibuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:23
verses.text: Ina'an kam ma palhimpunan magkalasigan, ma palhimpunan saga a'a niōnan anak Tuhan siyaka, ya tasulat ōn sigām ma deyom sulga'. Makaharap isab kam ni Tuhan, ya angahukum ma manusiya' kamemon. Ina'an isab kam ma saga umagad a'a adil bay magpatayan, ya asampulna' na.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:24
verses.text: Makasampay na isab kam ni si Isa, ya magpatillot ma manusiya' maka Tuhan bo' angahatul kapagsulutan baha'u. Ta'abutbi isab laha' si Isa, ya pinagsambat laha' pamigsik. Laha' labi ahāp ko' inān min laha' si Habil ya bay pinabu'us ma masa awal e', sabab laha' pamalosan.  <div eID="gen8281" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4089"/><div sID="gen8282" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4089"/> Angkanna kita subay mbal amabiyal bang Tuhan ya amissala ni kita. Subay kita amintāng min saga a'a bay amabiyal ma pagbanda' si Musa, waktu kapamowana palman Tuhan ma masa awal e'. Bang sigām halam bay makapuwas min kabinasahan minsan hal manusiya' ya bay pinabiyal e' sigām, luba'-lagi'na kita mbal makapuwas bang taikutanta Tuhan ya magbanda'an kitam min deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:26
verses.text: Ma waktu kapamalman Tuhan ma si Musa, bay ajogjog deyom dunya e' suwalana. Sagō' buwattina'an aniya' panganjanji'na dakayu', ya yuk-i, “Pajogjogku dunya pabīng, min t'dda lagi', sagō' ngga'i ka hal dunya ya pinajogjog, sampay isab saga lapis langit.”

verses.name: Hebrews 12:27
verses.text: Bang nihati kabtangan itu, ya yuk-i, “min t'dda lagi'”, in ai-ai pinapanjari nijogjog du bo' palanyap, malaingkan pataptap sadja ya mbal takole' nijogjog.  <div eID="gen8282" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4090"/><div sID="gen8283" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4090"/> Angkanna kitam subay magsukul to'ongan ni Tuhan, sabab makasambut kitam lahat mbal takole' nijogjog. Subay kita amudji Tuhan ma buwat kabaya'anna. Subay kitam magmamay maka magmatāw ma iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:29
verses.text: Sabab bang angahukum Tuhantam, sali' api makasuleyaban kamemon.  <div eID="gen8283" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Heb.12"/> <div eID="gen8277" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4091"/><div sID="gen8284" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Hinang Makasulut Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8285" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4091"/> Da'a bbahinbi kabiyaksahanbi maglasa-liyasahi sabab magdanakan kam ma deyoman Al-Masi.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:2
verses.text: Paentom kam. Bang aniya' pi'ilu ni luma'bi a'a mbal takilābi, subay iya patuntulbi. Sabab aniya' ma waktu palabay bay amatuntul a'a liyu, kinabā' manusiya' sagō' mala'ikat min sulga'.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:3
verses.text: Kannalunbi na pa'in kahālan pagkahibi ma deyom kalabusu ilu, sali' hantang baranbi ya ma deyom kalabusu. Kannalunbi isab saga pininjala', sali' hantang ka'am isab pininjala'.  <div eID="gen8285" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4092"/><div sID="gen8286" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4092"/> Ka'am kamemon, pahalga'unbi paglakibinibi. Kamaya'-maya' kam, sabab sasuku maghinang kala'atan d'nda maka l'lla atawa angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'na, tantu pinataluwa'an hukuman Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:5
verses.text: Subay kam ahalli' isab ma napsubi bo' kam mbal ameya' ma bahaya pilak. Da'a kam atawad min bay pangangganta' ka'am, sabab aniya' du Tuhan amaruli, buwat yukna, <lg sID="gen8287"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8288"/>“Mbal kam bbahanku, mbal kam pasagaranku saumul-umul.”<l eID="gen8288" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8287"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:6
verses.text: Angkan kita subay atawakkal amissala buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8289"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8290"/>“Panghū' du ya anabangan aku,<l eID="gen8290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8291"/>ati halam aniya' kagawahanku.<l eID="gen8291" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8292"/>Mbal du aku tināw ni'inay e' a'a.”<l eID="gen8292" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8289"/>  <div eID="gen8286" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4093"/><div sID="gen8293" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4093"/> Entomunbi saga a'a pagmakōkanbi, ya bay anganasihatan ka'am lapal Tuhan. Entomunbi bay kamattihan sigām pagka ahāp bowahan sigām t'ggol sigām allum. Sengorinbi isab bay pangandol sigām.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:8
verses.text: Mbal magkapinda si Isa Al-Masi, sali' du iya min katagna' sampay ni kabuwattina'anan, sampay isab ni katapusan.  <div eID="gen8293" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4094"/><div sID="gen8294" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4094"/> Da'a kam abowa-bowa e' pandu' magsaddī-saddī, supaya kam mbal pabidda' min pandu' b'nnal. Ahāp bang lasa maka ase' Tuhan ya ginuna pamakosog palnyawahanta, da'a na panoho'an pasal kapamangan. Halam aniya' paluntungan saga a'a pinagbaya'an e' panoho'an buwattē'.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:10
verses.text: Aniya' kulban tinukbalan ma pasaltam, sagō' mbal makalamud saga a'a ya maghinang ma langgal pagkulbanan Yahudi.  <div eID="gen8294" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4095"/><div sID="gen8295" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4095"/> Ma agama Yahudi, bang ta'abut waktu pagkulban ni Tuhan supaya pinuwasan dusa saga a'a, Imam Muwallam ya wajib amowa laha' hayop ni deyom Bilik Mahasussi bo' tinukbal ni Tuhan. Saguwā' baran hayop itu binowa paluwas min kaluma'an inān, bo' yampa tinunu'.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:12
verses.text: Damikiyanna si Isa, bay iya amatay isab ma luwasan da'ira supaya tasussina saga a'ana maka laha'na luggiya'.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:13
verses.text: Jari paluwas kita min agama Yahudi tudju ni si Isa, ati ameya' kita pinaggunyak-gunyak buwat bay paggunyak-gunyak saga a'a ma iya.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:14
verses.text: Sabab halam aniya' palahatanta kakkal ma dunya itu. Tu'ud kita angalagaran lahat dakayu' ya paniya' ma sinosōng.  <div eID="gen8295" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4096"/><div sID="gen8296" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4096"/> Angkan na, subay kitam magabut-abut anukbal pudji ni Tuhan labay min si Isa, hatina bissala pamudji paluwas min bowa'ta, pagka si Isa pamanyabutantam.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:16
verses.text: Da'a kam alipas angahinang kahāpan ni sehe'bi. Bahagi'inbi sigām kaniya'bi bang sigām taluwa' kasigpitan, sabab hinangbi buwattē' sali' dalil lalabotan makasulut atay Tuhan.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:17
verses.text: Beya'unbi pamandu' saga a'a pagmakōkanbi maka paluluy sadja kam ma panoho'an sigām. Anganjaga na pa'in sigām ma ka'am bo' mbal ainay pal-imananbi, sabab aniya' waktu pabaihu' sigām ni Tuhan angahaka pasal ai-ai bay tahinang sigām. Beya'unbi isab panoho'an sigām supaya aniya' kakōgan sigām, sabab halam aniya' kasōngan ma ka'am bang sigām kabuhatan ma sabab panulangbi.  <div eID="gen8296" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4097"/><div sID="gen8297" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4097"/> Da'a kam pahali angamu'an kami tabang ni Tuhan. Makatantu kami in itikad kami abontol sadja tudju ni Tuhan, maka halam aniya' angut kami saddī min hinang ahāp maka kasuddahan ahāp.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:19
verses.text: Aniya' isab panganjunjungku ni ka'am: angamu'-ngamu' kam kono' ni Tuhan bang pa'in aku makasa'ut pabīng ni ka'am.  <div eID="gen8297" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8284" type="section"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4098"/><div sID="gen8298" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lling Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen8299" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4098"/> Pangamu'antam Tuhan po'onan kasannangan, ya bay amangun Panghū'tam si Isa min kamatayna supaya iya allum pabīng. Si Isa ya dakayu' babantugun angupiksa' kitam ma sabab laha' kamatayna bay pamajatu kapagsulutan kakkal ni kasaumulan. Angipat na iya ma kitam suku'na, ya pinagbahasa sali' bili-bilina. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinanyapan e' Tuhan ai-ai kagunahanbi supaya ahāp e'bi angahinang kahandakna. Mura-murahan isab, bang pa'in Tuhan angahinang ai-ai kabaya'anna ma deyom pangatayanbi ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anbi. Manjari sanglitantam Al-Masi salama-lama. Amin.  <div eID="gen8299" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4098"/><div sID="gen8298" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lling Katapusan</title> <div sID="gen8299" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4098"/> Pangamu'antam Tuhan po'onan kasannangan, ya bay amangun Panghū'tam si Isa min kamatayna supaya iya allum pabīng. Si Isa ya dakayu' babantugun angupiksa' kitam ma sabab laha' kamatayna bay pamajatu kapagsulutan kakkal ni kasaumulan. Angipat na iya ma kitam suku'na, ya pinagbahasa sali' bili-bilina. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinanyapan e' Tuhan ai-ai kagunahanbi supaya ahāp e'bi angahinang kahandakna. Mura-murahan isab, bang pa'in Tuhan angahinang ai-ai kabaya'anna ma deyom pangatayanbi ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anbi. Manjari sanglitantam Al-Masi salama-lama. Amin.  <div eID="gen8299" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4099"/><div sID="gen8300" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4099"/> Saga dauranakanku, aniya' gi' panganjunjungku ni ka'am: ikutunbi lapal sulat ya pabeya'ku itu. Da'a kam sinumu amassa, sabab mbal sakit ataha'.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:23
verses.text: Subay kata'uwanbi in danakantam si Timuti tapaluwas na min kalabusu. Bang iya makasa'ut pi'itu, bowaku iya ameya' ma aku anibaw ka'am.  <div eID="gen8300" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4100"/><div sID="gen8301" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4100"/> Haka'inbi saga pagnakura'anbi sampay a'a suku' Tuhan ilu kamemon in kami itu amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal kami ma sigām. Saga danakantam min lahat Itali itu amabeya' isab lapal sigām.  <div eID="gen8301" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4101"/><div sID="gen8302" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4101"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan. <signed sID="gen8303"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8303"/>  <div eID="gen8302" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8298" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8064" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Heb.13"/> <div eID="gen8059" osisID="Heb" type="book"/>

verses.name: James 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku si Yakub, a'a sosoho'an Tuhan maka si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam. Magaddat aku ma ka'am saga pagkahiku Yahudi, a'a suku' Tuhan apulak-palik ma kaluha'an dunya.  <div eID="gen8310" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4102"/><div sID="gen8311" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kasukkalan maka Pagiman</title> <div sID="gen8312" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4102"/> Saga dauranakanku, bang kam taluwa' kasukkalan indaginis, subay kam kinōgan.

verses.name: James 1:3
verses.text: Sabab kata'uwanbi, bang pangandolbi pinalabayan kasukkalan bo' kaimananbi, gom pa'in pasōng tatasbi anandalan ai-ai.

verses.name: James 1:4
verses.text: Puspusinbi kosogbi anandalan kasukkalan bo' supaya kam asangpot ma kaul maka pi'il, ma halam aniya' kulangbi.

verses.name: James 1:5
verses.text: Sagō' bang aniya' ma ka'am akulang pangita'una, subay iya angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ati tantu iya kabuwanan pangita'u, sabab magmura asal Tuhan ma a'a kamemon. Mbal iya an'ndal bang pangamu'an.

verses.name: James 1:6
verses.text: Saguwā' bang kam ganta' angamu' ai-ai ni Tuhan, subay kam am'nnal ma iya ma halam aniya' pagduwa-duwabi. Sasuku magāng-āng pangandolbi ni Tuhan, ibarat kam sahal goyak tabowa pehē'-pi'itu e' baliyu.

verses.name: James 1:7
verses.text: Da'a kam aholat pinasambutan ai-ai e' Panghū',

verses.name: James 1:8
verses.text: sabab bang a'a magduwa-ruwa pikilanna mbal ahantap pamikilna.  <div eID="gen8312" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8311" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4103"/><div sID="gen8313" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Miskin maka Dayahan</title> <div sID="gen8314" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4103"/> Bang saupama aniya' pagkahitam sōd si Isa kamiskinan, subay iya kinōgan sabab pinalanga du iya e' Tuhan.

verses.name: James 1:10
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang aniya' a'a sōd si Isa taga-karaya, subay iya kinōgan bang pinareyo' e' Tuhan, sabab minsan a'a dayahan pahalam du isab ibarat sumping kasagmotan.

verses.name: James 1:11
verses.text: Makasilak pa'in llaw, magtūy alanos kasagmotan e' pasu' llaw he'. Apakpak sumpingna ati pahalam bay manisna. Buwattē' du isab bang a'a dayahan. Kosog-kosogan pa'in iya angusaha, amatay du iya ati ka'bbahan du pagusahana.  <div eID="gen8314" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8313" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4104"/><div sID="gen8315" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Sasat</title> <div sID="gen8316" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4104"/> Aheya du kahāpan a'a bang mbal alungay pangandolna minsan iya anandalan kasukkalan. Sababna bang mbal apinda pangandolna minsan ma deyom kasukkalan, pinaniya'an du iya kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan. Ya na itu tungbas panganjanji' Tuhan ma sasuku alasa ma iya.  <div eID="gen8316" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4105"/><div sID="gen8317" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4105"/> Bang kam ganta' sinasat maghinang la'at, da'a bīnginbi Tuhan. Da'a yukbi Tuhan ya anasat ka'am inān, sabab in Tuhan mbal tasasat maka mbal isab iya anasat.

verses.name: James 1:14
verses.text: Sagō' napsu manusiya' ya amowa-mowa iya maghinang kala'atan. Napsuna sali' dalil umpan angati iya maghinang dusa.

verses.name: James 1:15
verses.text: Ma tagna'anna, aniya' kinanapsuhan e' a'a, ma deyom pikilanna sadja. Mbal at'ggol magbuwa' du napsu inān, jari dusa ya buwa'na. Bang karuhunan dusa inān, nalka' ya kamattihanna.  <div eID="gen8317" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4106"/><div sID="gen8318" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4106"/> Angkanna, saga danakan kalasahanku, da'a palinguhunbi pikilanbi.

verses.name: James 1:17
verses.text: Saga lidjiki' kamemon maka ai-ai halam aniya' salla'na ya pamuwan kitam, patulun asal min sulga', min Tuhan magpapanjari saga sawa ya anahaya ma b'ttong langit. Magkapinda sawa inān sagō' mbal magkapinda Tuhan maka mbal amuwan landung.

verses.name: James 1:18
verses.text: Min kabaya'anna angkan kitam nihinang anakna pagka kahagadtam lapal palmanna. Ya kabaya'anna in kitam saga anakna subay pinabangsa labi gi' min bangsa ai-ai bay papanjarina.  <div eID="gen8318" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8315" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4107"/><div sID="gen8319" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pagkale maka Paghinang</title> <div sID="gen8320" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4107"/> Amay-amay, saga dauranakan kalasahanku, subay kitam pakale pahāp maka subay mbal magdai'-dai' amissala. Subay kitam mbal al'kkas angastol,

verses.name: James 1:20
verses.text: sabab bang a'a angastol mbal tahinangna saga hinang ahāp ya kinabaya'an e' Tuhan.

verses.name: James 1:21
verses.text: Angkan subay la'ananbi kamemon ya makalumu' ataybi, maka subay bbahanbi saga hinang ala'at ya mamarahi hekana ilu. Pareyo'unbi ataybi tudju ni Tuhan, maka taima'unbi lapal palmanna, ya sali' dalil binhi' tinanom e'na ma deyom pangatayanbi. Sabab palman Tuhan ya sababanna angkan kam lappasan min hukuman dusa.  <div eID="gen8320" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4108"/><div sID="gen8321" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4108"/> Da'a kam hal akale ma palman Tuhan. Ikutunbi panoho'anna. Bang kalebi bo' mbal hinangbi, angakkalan kam di-bi.

verses.name: James 1:23
verses.text: Bang a'a ganta' hal akale ma palman Tuhan, bo' mbal ameya' ma panoho'anna, in a'a inān ibarat a'a ananding pangluwahanna ma samin.

verses.name: James 1:24
verses.text: Aubus pa'in e'na ananding, ala'an iya min atag ina'an ati takalipatna magtūy bang buwattingga pangluwahanna.

verses.name: James 1:25
verses.text: Samin itu ibarat sara' Tuhan ya halam aniya' salla'na, sara' makapaluhaya ma manusiya'. Maka a'a ang'nda' ma samin itu ibarat a'a angadji' na pa'in ma sara' inān. Mbal takalipatna sagō' bineya' e'na bay ta'adji'na, jari tantu iya kabuwanan kahāpan e' Tuhan minsan ai hinangna.  <div eID="gen8321" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4109"/><div sID="gen8322" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4109"/> Bang aniya' a'a amikilan di-na in iya bal-agama, bo' mbal tapaggatna d'lla'na amissala ala'at, a'a inān angakkalan di-na. Halam aniya' kapūsan pagagamana.

verses.name: James 1:27
verses.text: Bang ma Mma'tam Tuhan, ya na itu pagagama halam aniya' lamudna ala'at: kaissana, subay tabangta saga anak-ilu' maka saga balu d'nda bang sigām ma deyom kasigpitan. Karuwana, subay kita angahalli'an di-ta bo' kita mbal tabowa anunuran saga addat ala'at maitu ma dunya.  <div eID="gen8322" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jas.1"/> <div eID="gen8319" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4110"/><div sID="gen8323" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinō' Kita Da'a Amapagbidda' A'a</title> <div sID="gen8324" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4110"/> Saga dauranakanku, pagka kam ameya' ma si Isa Al-Masi, ya Panghū'tam bangsahan, subay mbal papagbidda'bi a'a minsan sai-na.

verses.name: James 2:2
verses.text: Saupama aniya' duwangan a'a pasōd ni deyom pagtimukanbi, dakayu' inān dayahan magsingsing bulawan maka mags'mmek ahalga', bo' dakayu' inān miskin, ndang asal s'mmekna.

verses.name: James 2:3
verses.text: Saupama palabi pagaddatbi ma a'a ahalga' s'mmekna, ati yukbi ma iya, “Tuwan, aningkō' ka kono' ma tingkō'an ahāp itu.” Sagō' yukbi ni a'a miskin e', “An'ngge sadja ka mailu,” atawa “Aningkō' ka maitu ma lantay, ma atag tape'ku”.

verses.name: James 2:4
verses.text: Na, bang buwattē' hinangbi, asā' kam pagka papagbidda'bi saga pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa. Ala'at deyom pikilanbi, pagka yukbi alanga dakayu', bo' areyo' dakayu'.  <div eID="gen8324" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4111"/><div sID="gen8325" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4111"/> Pakale kam, saga dauranakanku kinalasahan. Tapene' asal e' Tuhan saga a'a ya binista miskin ma dunya itu, bo' aniya' karaya sigām b'nnal, hatina pangandol sigām ma iya. Pinene' isab sigām bo' binuwanan palsuku'an ma deyom pagparintahanna, buwat asal panganjanji'na ma sasuku alasahan iya.

verses.name: James 2:6
verses.text: Sagō' ilu pagtunggīnganbi saga a'a miskin! Sai bahā' anigpitan ka'am, maka sai anukbalan ka'am ni pagsara'an? A'a dayahan ko' he'.

verses.name: James 2:7
verses.text: Sai bahā' amissalahan la'at ma pasal ōn bangsahan ya pangōn tag-suku' ma ka'am? A'a dayahan!  <div eID="gen8325" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4112"/><div sID="gen8326" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4112"/> Ahāp hinangbi bang beya'bi to'ongan sara' Tuhan, sara' umbul dakayu'. Tasulat asal sara' itu ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “Kalasahinbi pagkahibi buwat e'bi alasahan baranbi.”

verses.name: James 2:9
verses.text: Sagō' bang papagbidda'bi a'a ma sabab luwana, makarusa kam, maka taluwa' kam hukuman sabab langgal sara' kam.

verses.name: James 2:10
verses.text: Sara' Tuhan itu, minsan bogboganbi kaheka'anna bo' pa'in lakaranbi hal dakayu', talanggalbi du kamemonna.

verses.name: James 2:11
verses.text: Sabab yuk Tuhan ma deyom sara'na, “Da'a ka angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'nu,” maka yukna isab, “Da'a ka amapatay”. Manjari minsan kam mbal angaliyu-lakad, bo' amapatay kam, masi du talanggalbi sara' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8326" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4113"/><div sID="gen8327" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4113"/> Subay kitam ahantap ma kaul maka pi'il sabab sinara' kitam ma sara' ya makabuwan kalimayahan.

verses.name: James 2:13
verses.text: Sabab bang Tuhan ya angahukum ma manusiya', bo' aniya' a'a halam bay ma'ase' ma pagkahina, mbal du isab kina'ase'an e' Tuhan. Saguwā' bang a'a ma'ase' ma pagkahina, mbal iya tināw sinara' sabab ma'ase' du Tuhan ma iya.  <div eID="gen8327" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8323" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4114"/><div sID="gen8328" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangandol maka Paghinang</title> <div sID="gen8329" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4114"/> Saga dauranakanku, bang aniya' a'a ganta' ah'lling in iya angandol ma Tuhan, bo' mbal taluwa' saga hinangna, pangandolna inān halam aniya' pūsna, maka halam aniya' dapat makalappas iya min hukuman dusa.

verses.name: James 2:15
verses.text: Saupama aniya' pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa kulang-kabus ma pan'mmek maka ma pagkakan,

verses.name: James 2:16
verses.text: ai kapūsanna bang hal yukbi ni sigām, “Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ahāp kahālanbi. Mags'mmek kam akapal bo' kam mbal nihaggut! Amangan kam pahāp!” Bang kam hal amissala sadja bo' mbal amuwan ai-ai panabangbi kulang-kabus sigām, na, tantu halam aniya' pūsna.

verses.name: James 2:17
verses.text: Damikiyanna bang takdil ni pangandol. Bang yukbi in ka'am angandol ma Tuhan, bo' halam aniya' hinangbi ahāp tumabeya', mbal b'nnal pangandolbi.  <div eID="gen8329" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4115"/><div sID="gen8330" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4115"/> Kalu aniya' anganjawab, yuk-i, “Aniya' angandol ma Tuhan, aniya' maghinang kahāpan.” Na, bang buwattē' panganjawabna, buwattitu panambungku, “Pa'nda'in aku pangandolnu ma halam aniya' hinang tumabeya' tanda' saksi', ati pa'nda'anta ka pangandolku luwas min kahinanganku ahāp.”

verses.name: James 2:19
verses.text: Am'nnal ka bahā' in Tuhan dakayu' du? Na, ahāp isab. Sagō' minsan saga saitan, am'nnal isab sigām in Tuhan dakayu' du, ati amidpid sigām sabab min tāw sigām.  <div eID="gen8330" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4116"/><div sID="gen8331" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4116"/> Dupang pahāp ka! Bilahi ka bahā' kab'nnalan pasal pangandolta halam aniya' pūsna bang mbal pinabeya'an kahinangan ahāp?

verses.name: James 2:21
verses.text: Pikilun si Ibrahim ya ka'mbo'-mbo'antam. Angkan iya bay binista abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab tahinang e'na panoho'an Tuhan. Bay tukbalanna ni Tuhan anakna si Isa'ak, pinat'nna' e'na ma diyata' batu pagkulban.

verses.name: James 2:22
verses.text: Mbal bahā' tahatinu? Ya pangandol si Ibrahim inān bay magbeya' maka hinangna. Min hinangna angkan jukup pangandolna ma Tuhan.

verses.name: James 2:23
verses.text: Jari tahatita na in bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab pasal si Ibrahim, ya yuk-i, “Si Ibrahim bay am'nnal ma Tuhan, ati binista iya abontol e' Tuhan sabab min kapam'nnalna.” Angkan iya bay kaōnan bagay Tuhan.

verses.name: James 2:24
verses.text: Na, minnē' kata'uwannu in kitam itu binista abontol e' Tuhan bang aniya' isab hinangta ahāp. Mbal jukup bang kita hal angandol. In pangandolta subay magbeya' maka hinangta.  <div eID="gen8331" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4117"/><div sID="gen8332" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4117"/> Buwattē' isab si Rahab, d'nda pagtatambahan ma masa awal e'. Sagō' binista iya abontol e' Tuhan ma sabab hinangna ahāp. Bay patuntulna saga mata-mata bangsa Isra'il bay pina'an anganyata' lahatna. Pinandu'an sigā e'na lān saddī pamole'an sigā.

verses.name: James 2:26
verses.text: Manjari in pangandolta ma Tuhan sapantun baran, amatay bang halam aniya' napasna. Damikiyanna pangandolta ma Tuhan, amatay isāb bang halam aniya' kahinangan ahāp tumabeya'.  <div eID="gen8332" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jas.2"/> <div eID="gen8328" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4118"/><div sID="gen8333" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal D'lla'</title> <div sID="gen8334" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4118"/> Saga dauranakanku, subay mbal aheka min ka'am angangut nihinang guru. Sabab kata'uwanbi in kami saga guru, bang asā' pamandu' kami, labi abuhat in hukuman ya pinat'nna'an kami e' Tuhan min saga a'a ngga'i ka guru.

verses.name: James 3:2
verses.text: In kitam manusiya', araran magkasā'. Bang aniya' a'a mbal to'ongan asā' ma bissalana, tubus na a'a inān ma kaul maka pi'il, maka kapagagihanna kabaya'an baranna.

verses.name: James 3:3
verses.text: Ya dalilna kakkang kura'. Sangonanta kakkang itu ni bowa' kura' bo' ameya' ma panoho'anta, ati kapagbaya'anta pi'ingga-pi'ingga.

verses.name: James 3:4
verses.text: Dalilna isab bansān ma kappal leha'an. Minsan aheya baran kappal, maka minsan akosog baliyu, maka minsan ariki' isab bansān, in kappal inān tabowa patudju pi'ingga-pi'ingga ya kinabaya'an e' a'a amansān.

verses.name: James 3:5
verses.text: Buwattē' isab hatulan d'lla'ta itu. Minsan b'nnal ariki', tantu aheya hinangna. <div eID="gen8334" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8335" type="paragraph"/> Pikilunbi api. Minsan hal keyat ariki', tantu makaralletan gulangan aluha.

verses.name: James 3:6
verses.text: Na, api itu pangandalilan d'lla'ta, sabab d'lla'ta ya makatagna'an ginisan kala'atan. Dakayu' du d'lla' ma baranta, sagō' bang itu palagtik na, tabowa katibu'ukan baranta ni kala'atan. T'ggolta allum, in d'lla'ta itu amuwanan kita kasusahan. Ya dalilna api luwas bay min nalka'.

verses.name: James 3:7
verses.text: Binangsa kaginisan, sattuwa talun maka manuk-manuk, daing isab maka sowa, takole' pinagbaya'an e' manusiya'.

verses.name: James 3:8
verses.text: Saguwā' d'lla' itu, halam aniya' makapagbaya'an iya. Halam aniya' hondongan la'atna, ap'nno' asal e' lassun makapatay.  <div eID="gen8335" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4119"/><div sID="gen8336" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4119"/> D'lla'ta ya ginuna pamudjita Panghū'ta Tuhan, ya Mma'tam. Maka d'lla'ta isab ya ginuna panukna'ta pagkahita manusiya', ya bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan ma buwat kajarihanna.

verses.name: James 3:10
verses.text: Hatina dakayu' du bowa' ya paluwasan bissala pamudji maka bissala panukna'. Saga dauranakanku, subay kita da'a buwattē'.

verses.name: James 3:11
verses.text: Aniya' bahā' bohe' ahāp maka bohe' at'bbag magbeya' paluwas min dakayu' tuburan?

verses.name: James 3:12
verses.text: Tantu halam. Saga dauranakanku, aniya' bahā' kayu igira amuwan buwa' jaitun? Aniya' bahā' bahan anggul amuwan buwa' igira? Tantu halam. Damikiyanna, mbal ka makasauk bohe' ahāp min pagbohe'an at'bbag.  <div eID="gen8336" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8333" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4120"/><div sID="gen8337" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pangita'u min Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8338" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4120"/> Bang aniya' mailu ma ka'am a'a alalom pangita'una maka ahāp panghatina, subay manyatakan ma kahāp tebong a'a ilu in iya taga-pangita'u. Subay areyo' pangatayanna maka subay alalom pikilanna bo' maghinang ahāp.

verses.name: James 3:14
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu, bang ala'at deyom hona'-hona'bi bo' kam angandali'it ma sehe'bi, maka bang hal kahāpan baranbi ya kannalbi, da'a kam magbantug-bantug di-bi in ka'am taga-kata'u. Da'a paliluhinbi dusabi.

verses.name: James 3:15
verses.text: Min dunya sadja saga hona'-hona' buwattē', min pikilan manusiya' maka min saitan. Ngga'i ka buwattē' bang pangita'u min Tuhan.

verses.name: James 3:16
verses.text: Sabab maingga-maingga lahat, bang aniya' saga a'ana angandali'it maka hal angannal ma kahāpan baran sigām, tantu aniya' maina'an kasasawan maka ginisan la'at kamemon.  <div eID="gen8338" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4121"/><div sID="gen8339" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4121"/> Sagō' bang a'a taga-pangita'u min Tuhan buwattitu kahālanna: kaissana, halam aniya' tamak atayna. Karuwana, aluhay iya binowa magsulut bang aniya' pagsagga'an. Ahāp bowahanna ni a'a kamemon, maka ahanunus iya. Ma'ase' iya, maka biyaksa iya maghinang ahāp ma pagkahina. Magtaluwa' hinangna maka lling bowa'na, maka mbal iya amapagbidda' a'a minsan sai.

verses.name: James 3:18
verses.text: Sasuku a'a amapagkahāp sehe'na, sali' dalil a'a magtanom. Kabontolan atay ya ta'ā'na min tinanomna, pagka patisulutun iya maka mbal pangalulugat.  <div eID="gen8339" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jas.3"/> <div eID="gen8337" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4122"/><div sID="gen8340" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magmaluluy Sadja Kam ma Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8341" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4122"/> Ai po'onna angkan kam araran magsagga' maka maglugat? Min napsubi ko' ilu, ya magkosog-kosogan na pa'in ma deyom ataybi.

verses.name: James 4:2
verses.text: Aniya' kabaya'anbi sagō' mbal ta'ā'bi, angkan kam bilahi amapatay. Aniya' kanapsuhanbi sagō' mbal kam karūlan, angkan kam magsagga' maka magbono'. Mbal kam pinaniya'an ai-ai ya kabaya'anbi, sabab mbal kam angamu' ni Tuhan.

verses.name: James 4:3
verses.text: Maka minsan isab amu'bi, mbal kam binuwanan sabab ala'at kōkbi. Tu'ud kam bilahi magparūl napsubi, angkan kam angamu'.

verses.name: James 4:4
verses.text: Ka'am ilu sali' sapantun a'a angaliyu-lakad ni ngga'i ka paghola'na. Halam bahā' kata'uwanbi? Sasuku amanuyu' ma kala'atan ai-ai ma dunya itu, kab'nsihanna Tuhan. Maka sasuku ka'amuhan ma addat-tabi'at ya sinunuran ma dunya itu, bantahanna Tuhan.

verses.name: James 4:5
verses.text: Marai' pangannalbi mbal b'nnal ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, “In ginhawa bay pinat'nna' e' Tuhan ma deyom baranta akosog asal magnapsu.”

verses.name: James 4:6
verses.text: Sagō' akosog lagi' tabang Tuhan ma kita min saga napsu ya amowa-mowa baranta, buwat bay tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8342"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8343"/>“Sinagga' e' Tuhan saga a'a alanga atayna,<l eID="gen8343" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8344"/>sagō' tinabangan e'na saga a'a areyo' atayna.”<l eID="gen8344" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8342"/>  <div eID="gen8341" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4123"/><div sID="gen8345" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4123"/> Angkan kam subay magmaluluy sadja ma kabaya'an Tuhan. Paggatunbi nakura' saitan ati alahi du iya min ka'am.

verses.name: James 4:8
verses.text: Pasekot kam ni Tuhan ati sinekot kam isab e'na. Ka'am saga dusahan ilu, bbahinbi saga hinangbi ala'at. Ka'am isab, ya mbal magtaluwa' hinangbi maka llingbi, sussihunbi deyom ataybi.

verses.name: James 4:9
verses.text: Kasukkalinbi saga kala'atan ya tahinangbi. Magkarukka'an kam maka magtangis. Ya pagtittowabi maka kakōganbi subay pininda ni kasusahan.

verses.name: James 4:10
verses.text: Pareyo'unbi ataybi tudju ni Panghū' ati pinalanga du kam e'na.  <div eID="gen8345" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4124"/><div sID="gen8346" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4124"/> Saga dauranakanku, da'a kam angalimut kasehe'anbi. Sabab sasuku angalimut atawa anoway danakanna bebeya'an si Isa, sali' sara' Tuhan maka kahandakna ya sowayna. Jari bang kam ganta' anoway kahandak Tuhan, tantu mbal beya'bi sabab yukbi aniya' sā'na.

verses.name: James 4:12
verses.text: Dakayu'-kayu' Tuhan ya amat'nna' sara' maka angahukum. Tunggal du iya ya angalappas maka tunggal iya amowa ni kamulahan. Angkan halam aniya' kapatutbi anoway pagkahibi manusiya'.  <div eID="gen8346" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8340" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4125"/><div sID="gen8347" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' Pasal Pagabbu</title> <div sID="gen8348" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4125"/> Pakale kam sasuku kam magpangupama pasal llaw sinōng. Yukbi, “Salung atawa simuddai pehē' du kami ni da'ira ina'an-i ati pahanti' kami dantahun maina'an maglitu supaya aheka sīn paluntungan kami.”

verses.name: James 4:14
verses.text: Malaingkan mbal kata'uwanbi bang ai pat'kka ni ka'am salung! Kallumbi ma dunya itu sali' dalil husbu. Dai'-dai' du ta'nda', magtūy palanyap.

verses.name: James 4:15
verses.text: Angkan subay buwattitu pah'llingbi, “Bang min kabaya'an Panghū', allum gi' kami ati makahinang itu-ini.”

verses.name: James 4:16
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am ilu, alanga ataybi maka abbuhan kam. Bo' arapun in pagabbu buwattilu ala'at kamemon.

verses.name: James 4:17
verses.text: Manjari sai-sai ata'uwan hinang ahāp bo' mbal hinangna, taga-dusa du iya.  <div eID="gen8348" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Jas.4"/> <div eID="gen8347" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4126"/><div sID="gen8349" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagbanda' ma saga A'a Dayahan</title> <div sID="gen8350" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4126"/> Na, ka'am saga a'a dayahan, pakale na kam ma aku. Subay kam magpanangis, subay kam maglemong, ma sabab kasukkalan ya song pat'kka ni ka'am.

verses.name: James 5:2
verses.text: Magka'at na alta'bi, maka s'mmekbi ahāp aubus bay kinakan e' ulat.

verses.name: James 5:3
verses.text: Saga bulawanbi maka pilakbi anawasa' na ma deyom tau'an. Jari in sawasa' inān tanda' saksi' in ka'am bay anipun alta' paheka ma llaw kahinapusan dunya itu. Taka-taka in alta'bi inān sapantun api amangan isibi.

verses.name: James 5:4
verses.text: Dayahan kam, sagō' halam kagadjihanbi saga a'a maghinang ma kahuma'anbi. Kalehunbi pangandahing saga a'a bay soho'bi animuk buwa' min tana'bi. Wa'i pasampay pangandahing sigām ni Tuhan Sangat Kawasa.

verses.name: James 5:5
verses.text: Ka'am saga dayahan, kabiyaksahan kam maghāp palasahan maka angandūlan napsubi. Ibarat kam sapi' hal amahambug di-na, bo' mbal kata'uwanna song waktu panumbali' iya.

verses.name: James 5:6
verses.text: Bay hukumbi maka papataybi saga a'a halam taga-dusa, minsan sigām halam bay anagga' ka'am.  <div eID="gen8350" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8349" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4127"/><div sID="gen8351" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangiman ma Deyom Kabinasahan</title> <div sID="gen8352" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4127"/> Angkanna, saga dauranakanku, tatasinbi ai-ai makani-ka'am sat'ggol mbal pabīng Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Pikilunbi a'a maghuma, atatas iya angagaran waktu pagbuwa' tana'na, sabab ahalga' asal buwa'na ma iya. Mbal iya sinumu angagaran kat'kka ulan, ulan pagararu maka ulan pamatahak pai.

verses.name: James 5:8
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab ka'am, subay kam mbal sinumu angagad. Pahogotunbi ataybi sabab asekot na waktu papi'itu Panghū'tam.

verses.name: James 5:9
verses.text: Saga dauranakanku, da'a pagmusmurinbi sehe'bi bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi, bo' kam mbal taluwa' hukuman Tuhan. Ilu na ya maghuhukum, asekot na to'ongan.  <div eID="gen8352" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4128"/><div sID="gen8353" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4128"/> Saga dauranakanku, pikilunbi saga nabi, ya bay amowa lapal deyo' min Panghū' ma masa awal e'. Panunurinbi sigām, pagka sigām bay atuyu' angiman ma deyom kabinasahan.

verses.name: James 5:11
verses.text: Bang ma bistahanta, taga-kahāpan asal saga a'a makatatas buwattē'. Takalebi pasal kasandal si Ayyub waktuna ma deyom kasusahan. Kata'uwanbi isab kamaujuranna, ahāp bay panungbas Panghū' ma iya. Sabab landu' patiase'un maka patilasahun Panghū'tam.  <div eID="gen8353" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4129"/><div sID="gen8354" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4129"/> Saga dauranakanku, ahalga' pamituwaku itu min kamemon: bang aniya' bissalabi da'a kam magsapa. Da'a sibahatunbi sulga' atawa dunya atawa ai-ai saddī pagsapahanbi. Magaho' sadja kam bang subay aho'. Mag'mbal isab bang subay mbal. Da'a palabihunbi minnē', bo' kam mbal taluwa' hukuman Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8354" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8351" type="section"/>

verses.name: James 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4130"/><div sID="gen8355" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pangamu'-ngamu' maka Pangandol</title> <div sID="gen8356" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4130"/> Abila aniya' a'a mailu ma ka'am t'kkahan kasusahan, subay iya angamu' tabang ni Tuhan. Abila isab aniya' ma ka'am kinōgan, subay iya angalang saga kalangan pamudjina Tuhan.

verses.name: James 5:14
verses.text: Abila aniya' ma ka'am taga-saki, subay tambukuhanna saga pagmatto'ahan ma palhimpunan si Isa Al-Masi mailu. Ati saga matto'a inān subay angamu'-ngamu' ni Tuhan ma kamaina'anan a'a sakihan, maka subay sigām anapu iya maka ns'llan ma salta' sigām anabbut ōn Panghū'tam.

verses.name: James 5:15
verses.text: Manjari itu, bang sigām angamu'-ngamu', bo' ahogot asal pangandol sigām ma Tuhan, a'a inān kauli'an du. Niuli'an du iya e' Panghū', maka bang aniya' dusana, niampun du.

verses.name: James 5:16
verses.text: Angkan yukku ma ka'am, magpasab'nnal kam pasal saga dusabi ni pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa Al-Masi. Amu'inbi isab tabang ni Tuhan ma sabab pagkahibi dangan maka dangan, bo' supaya kam kauli'an. Bang a'a abontol angamu' ni Tuhan min deyom atayna, abarakat to'ongan pangamu'na.  <div eID="gen8356" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4131"/><div sID="gen8357" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4131"/> Si Nabi Elija e', manusiya' du buwat kitam. Bay iya anabbut Tuhan min deyom atayna ma masa awal e', angamu' subay mbal angulan. Jari halam to'ongan aniya' ulan am'ttak ni lahat inān ma deyom t'lluntahun maka tonga'.

verses.name: James 5:18
verses.text: Puwas e' bay iya angamu'-ngamu' pabalik subay aniya' ulan. Angulan magtūy, jari magbuwa' saga tinanom.  <div eID="gen8357" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: James 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4132"/><div sID="gen8358" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4132"/> Na, saga dauranakanku, abila aniya' min ka'am pasiha' min pandu' b'nnal, bo' aniya' a'a dangan amowa iya ameya' ma pandu' b'nnal pabalik, ahāp ko' he'.

verses.name: James 5:20
verses.text: Tau'unbi itu ma deyom pikilanbi: sai-sai makabowa a'a dusahan ang'bba min kasā'anna, lappasan e'na a'a dusahan inān bo' mbal pinehē' ni deyom nalka', ati ta'ampun du paldusahanna aheka. <signed sID="gen8359"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8359"/>  <div eID="gen8358" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8355" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8309" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Jas.5"/> <div eID="gen8304" osisID="Jas" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Petros, a'a kawakilan e' si Isa Al-Masi magnasihat lapalna. Pasampayku sulat itu pi'ilu ni ka'am saga a'a bay tapene'na, ya maglihan-lihan ma dunya itu. Ilu kam apulak-palik ma kalahat-lahatan buwattina'an, ma sakalibut lahat Puntus, Galatiya, Kappadoke, Asiya, maka ma lahat Bitiniya.

verses.name: I Peter 1:2
verses.text: Bay kam tapene' e' Mma'tam Tuhan min maksudna, jari suku'na na kam ma sabab hinang Rū Tuhan ya ma deyom ataybi. Tapene' kam supaya kam ameya' ma si Isa Al-Masi, bo' pinuwasan dusabi ma sabab laha'na. <div eID="gen8366" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8367" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka kasannangan atay ma halam aniya' kulangna.  <div eID="gen8367" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4133"/><div sID="gen8368" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaholatantam Kallum Kakkal</title> <div sID="gen8369" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4133"/> Mahaldika' ni Tuhan, ya mma' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Aheya to'ongan ka'ase'na ma kitam, ya angkan kitam binuwanan kallum baha'u buwat sapantun a'a nianakan pabīng. Makaholat isab kitam pinakallum min kamatay, sabab ya du si Isa Al-Masi bay pinakallum isab min kamatayna.

verses.name: I Peter 1:4
verses.text: Jari angagad na kitam pinaniya'an pusaka' ya tinau' e' Tuhan ma saga a'a suku'na. Tinau' e'na ma deyom sulga', ati maina'an mbal magka'at, mbal magkahalu', mbal magkapinda.

verses.name: I Peter 1:5
verses.text: Nihampanan kam pahāp sabab min kawasa Tuhan, pagka kam angandol ma iya. Tantu kam nihampanan sampay ta'abutbi kasalamatan ya pinabukis ma llaw kahinapusan.  <div eID="gen8369" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4134"/><div sID="gen8370" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4134"/> Angkan kam kinōgan minsan ma deyom susa ma dunya pinjaman itu, ma sabab katiksa'an indaginis ya kalabayanbi.

verses.name: I Peter 1:7
verses.text: Pinaniya'an kam katiksa'an ilu bo' sinulayan pangandolbi bang b'nnal atawa ngga'i ka. Minsan bulawan, subay pinalabay min api bo' nila'anan l'mmi'na. Sagō' ahalga' lagi' pangandolbi min bulawan, sabab mbal anatas bulawan ni kasaumulan. Bang kam angandol sab'nnal-b'nnal, sinanglitan du kam maka minahaldika'an bang ta'abut llaw pamatuwa' si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Peter 1:8
verses.text: Alasa kam ma iya minsan halam ta'nda'bi. Maka minsan iya mbal ta'nda'bi ma buwattitu, angandol kam asal ma iya. Jari aheya sidda kakōganbi, mbal tasibahat,

verses.name: I Peter 1:9
verses.text: sabab kaniya'an kam kasalamatan kakkal, ya kamaksuran pangandolbi.  <div eID="gen8370" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4135"/><div sID="gen8371" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4135"/> Bay amikilan pahāp saga kanabihan ma masa awal e', bay angahangpat to'ongan pasal kasalamatan itu. Bay pinagbissala e' sigām kahāpan ya pinama-ka'am ma ahil jaman itu.

verses.name: I Peter 1:11
verses.text: Pinatulunan sigām Rū Al-Masi, angkan sigām bay angabtang pasal kabinasahan ya subay kalabayanna, maka ma pasal sanglit-sahaya ma iya puwas kabinasahan e'. Jari sidda bilahi saga nabi inān makata'u bang sumiyan kat'kkana maka bang buwattingga kal'ngngananna.

verses.name: I Peter 1:12
verses.text: Pinata'u sigām e' Tuhan in pakaradja'an bay pagbissala sigām inān ngga'i ka ma baran sigām, sagō' ma saga a'a ma tahun sinōng, hatina ma ka'am. Manjari ka'am na ya pinakale na e' saga a'a bay magnasihat lapal ahāp min kawasa Rū Tuhan ya pinatulunan sigām min sulga'. Minsan saga mala'ikat, bilahi to'ongan makahati ma pasal saga pakaradja'an itu.  <div eID="gen8371" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8368" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4136"/><div sID="gen8372" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sinō' Kita Amanuyu' ma Ka'adilan</title> <div sID="gen8373" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4136"/> Angkan kam soho'ku subay pahatul-hatul ma deyom pamikilbi. Pahalli' kam, maka holatunbi kahāpan ya pamuwan ka'am bang ta'abut na llaw pamatuwa' si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Peter 1:14
verses.text: Beya'unbi panoho'an Tuhan, sengorinbi onde'-onde' ahatul. Da'a parūlunbi kanapsuhan ya bay kabiyaksahanbi waktu tagna', ma halam gi' aniya' kata'ubi.

verses.name: I Peter 1:15
verses.text: Subay kam a'adil ma ai-ai hinangbi sabab a'adil asal Tuhan, ya bay anoho' ka'am ameya' ma iya.

verses.name: I Peter 1:16
verses.text: Sabab tasulat ma deyom Kitab bay bissala Tuhan, ya yuk-i, “Wajib kam sussi ma kaulbi maka pi'ilbi, sabab aku itu mahasussi asal.”  <div eID="gen8373" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4137"/><div sID="gen8374" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4137"/> Angahukum Tuhan ma manusiya' kamemon, tinongoran kahinangan sigām pakaniya-pakaniya ma halam aniya' papagbidda'na. Angkanna, pagga pangōnbi ‘Mma'’ ma Tuhan bang aniya' pangamu'-ngamu'bi, subay kam magmatāw ma iya t'ggolbi pat'nna' ma dunya itu.

verses.name: I Peter 1:18
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi du bang ai bay pamuwan e' Tuhan pangal'kkat ka'am min bay kajarihanbi halam taga-pūs inān, ya kajarihan bay pang'bba ka'am e' kamatto'ahanbi. Ngga'i ka alta' magkaka'at buwat bulawan atawa pilak ya bay pangal'kkat ka'am,

verses.name: I Peter 1:19
verses.text: sagō' laha' Al-Masi ahalga', ya bay pabu'us ma kamatayna. Ibarat iya bili-bili halam aniya' tamakna atawa salla'na, pagkulban pamapuwas dusatam.

verses.name: I Peter 1:20
verses.text: Ya na itu asal pangahandak Tuhan ma iya ma halam gi' aniya' dunya, jari makapi'itu na iya ma masa damuli itu, ma sababbi du.

verses.name: I Peter 1:21
verses.text: Min hinang si Isa Al-Masi angkan kam angandol na ma Tuhan, ya bay amakallum si Isa min kamatayna sampay amabangsa iya ma deyom kasahaya'an. Jari ahogot na pangandolbi maka pangasabi ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8374" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4138"/><div sID="gen8375" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4138"/> Na buwattina'an, pagka kam angisbat na ma pandu' kasab'nnalan, tabowa na kam ang'bba min kasabulan kamemon bo' aniya' kasi-lasabi b'nnal ma pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa. Angkan kam soho'ku: maglasa-liyasahi kam min deyom ataybi.

verses.name: I Peter 1:23
verses.text: Sabab ka'am ilu sali' sapantun onde' baha'u bay nianakan. In kapaganak ma ka'am itu ngga'i ka min manusiya' ya magkamatay, sagō' min palman Tuhan. A'a baha'u na kam sabab min kapagsab'nnalbi ma palman Panghū', ya makakallum ma manusiya' maka mbal magkapinda.

verses.name: I Peter 1:24
