verses.text: Yuk ayat Kitab, <lg sID="gen8376"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8377"/>“Pinjaman sadja saga manusiya' kamemon, sapantun parang.<l eID="gen8377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8378"/>Kamemon kabantugan sigām sapantun sumping-sumping.<l eID="gen8378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8379"/>Angalanos du parang, magkapakpak du isab kasumpingan,<l eID="gen8379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8380"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:25
verses.text: saguwā' anatas palman Panghū' salama-lama.”<l eID="gen8380" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8376"/> In palman Panghū' itu, ya na lapal ahāp bay panganasihat ka'am.  <div eID="gen8375" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Pet.1"/> <div eID="gen8372" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4139"/><div sID="gen8381" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Al-Masi Dalil Batu Landu' Ahalga'</title> <div sID="gen8382" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4139"/> Angkan kam subay ang'bbahan kamemon kahinanganbi ajahil. Da'a kam magputing. Da'a kam magbau'-bau' in ka'am ahāp bo' pa'in masi ala'at deyom ataybi. Da'a kam angalindi, maka da'a kam angalimut sehe'bi.

verses.name: I Peter 2:2
verses.text: Pasali' kam ni onde'-onde' baha'u nianakan, ya aruru' na pa'in. Ya du ka'am subay angabut-ngabut angadji' palman Tuhan. Sali' dalil gatas ahāp ko' inān, ya makapasangpot pangandolbi sampay ta'abutbi kasalamatanna,

verses.name: I Peter 2:3
verses.text: pagka tananambi na bang buwattingga kahāp Panghū' ma ka'am.  <div eID="gen8382" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4140"/><div sID="gen8383" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4140"/> Pasekot na kam ni si Isa, ya dalil batu allum ni kasaumulan. Pasekot kam bo' kam pinagguna e' Tuhan pangahinanganna luma' pat'nna'an Rū-na. Pinaralil isab kam ni batu allum, maka si Isa iya batu aheya pamahogotan luma' Tuhan. Bay tasulak si Isa Al-Masi e' saga a'a, sagō' pinene' iya e' Tuhan sabab landu' ahalga' ma atayna. Jari maina'an du kam ma luma' Tuhan maghinang ni iya min itikad abontol, buwat dalil imam. Maina'an kam anukbal ni iya saga kapudjihanbi maka kahinanganbi ahāp. Jari ka'amuhan iya ma panukbalbi sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pamanyabutanbi.

verses.name: I Peter 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4140"/><div sID="gen8383" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4140"/> Pasekot na kam ni si Isa, ya dalil batu allum ni kasaumulan. Pasekot kam bo' kam pinagguna e' Tuhan pangahinanganna luma' pat'nna'an Rū-na. Pinaralil isab kam ni batu allum, maka si Isa iya batu aheya pamahogotan luma' Tuhan. Bay tasulak si Isa Al-Masi e' saga a'a, sagō' pinene' iya e' Tuhan sabab landu' ahalga' ma atayna. Jari maina'an du kam ma luma' Tuhan maghinang ni iya min itikad abontol, buwat dalil imam. Maina'an kam anukbal ni iya saga kapudjihanbi maka kahinanganbi ahāp. Jari ka'amuhan iya ma panukbalbi sabab si Isa Al-Masi ya pamanyabutanbi.

verses.name: I Peter 2:6
verses.text: Buwattitu ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab: <lg sID="gen8384"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8385"/>“Aniya' batu landu' ahalga' tapene'ku,<l eID="gen8385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8386"/>pat'nna'ku nihinang papagan luma' ma da'ira Siyun.<l eID="gen8386" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8387"/>Jari sasuku angandol ma iya<l eID="gen8387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8388"/>halam du aniya' kapagsusunanna.”<l eID="gen8388" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8384"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:7
verses.text: Tantu ahalga' batu itu ma ka'am ya magpangandol ma si Isa. Saguwā' aniya' mbal bilahi magkahagad, ya sinambat ma ayat Kitab dakayu', ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8389"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8390"/>“Ya batu bay tasulak e' saga a'a maghinang luma',<l eID="gen8390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8391"/>kinabā' halam aniya' gunana,<l eID="gen8391" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8392"/>ya na ina'an batu aheya to'ongan kalagihanna.”<l eID="gen8392" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8389"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:8
verses.text: Maka aniya' gi' ayat dakayu', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8394"/>“Ya ina'an batu parugtulan tape' a'a,<l eID="gen8394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8395"/>batu pamah'bba'an.”<l eID="gen8395" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8393"/> B'nnal ko' he'. Mbal sigām magkahagad ma palman Tuhan pasal si Isa, ya po'on sigām sali' dalil a'a makarugtul ni batu. Ya na tu'ud pangahandak Tuhan ma sigām.  <div eID="gen8383" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4141"/><div sID="gen8396" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4141"/> Malaingkan tapene' kam e' Tuhan bo' kam tahinang kaimaman magsusultan, bangsa sussi, a'a palsuku'an Tuhan. Nilinganan kam e'na paluwas min kalendoman, bo' papinda ni kasawahanna makainu-inu. Tapene' kam bo' supaya patanyagbi pasal kahinangan Tuhan ahāp makalandu'.

verses.name: I Peter 2:10
verses.text: Ma waktu bay dahū inān ngga'i ka kam suku' Tuhan, sagō' a'a Tuhan na kam ma buwattitu. Bay kam a'awam ma pasal ka'ase' Tuhan ma waktu palabay, saguwā' tananambi na ka'ase'na.  <div eID="gen8396" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4142"/><div sID="gen8397" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4142"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, sali' kitam a'a liyu ma dunya itu sabab aniya' lahattam saddī. Angkan buwattitu panganjunjungku ma ka'am: da'a to'ongan dūlinbi napsu baranbi ala'at, sabab napsuta itu magsagga' asal maka kapameya'ta ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 2:12
verses.text: Ya kal'ngngananbi subay ahantap sadja minsan kam ma deyoman saga a'a mbal ata'uwan Tuhan. Minsan sigām bilahi anuna'an ka'am maghinang ala'at, ta'nda' e' sigām saga hinangbi ahāp, ya po'on sigām ananglitan Tuhan ma llaw kapi'ituna.  <div eID="gen8397" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8381" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4143"/><div sID="gen8398" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmalulus ma Pagnakura'an</title> <div sID="gen8399" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4143"/> Subay kam magpabeya' sadja ma saga a'a kamemon sasuku taga-kag'llal, ma sabab Panghū' Isa ya pameya'anbi. Kaissana, beya'unbi panoho'an min sultan mahatinggi, ya alanga min kamemon ma lahat itu.

verses.name: I Peter 2:14
verses.text: Pasunu', beya'unbi panoho'an min saga gubnul, ya kabuwanan kapatut aminasa sasuku maghinang ala'at, maka ananglit ma sasuku maghinang ahāp.

verses.name: I Peter 2:15
verses.text: Sabab ya na itu kabaya'an Tuhan ma ka'am, hinangunbi kahāpan. Jari pag'nda' saga a'a kulang panghati inān ma kahinanganbi, magtūy patambol bowa' sigām. Pahondong sigām amūng-mūng karupangan.

verses.name: I Peter 2:16
verses.text: Limaya na kam, maka ahāp isab. Saguwā' da'a kam anumagal in ka'am makajari maghinang ala'at ma sabab limaya na. Ata Tuhan na kam, angkan kam limaya maghinang panoho'anna sadja.

verses.name: I Peter 2:17
verses.text: Pagaddatinbi manusiya' kamemon. Kalasahinbi pagkahibi magpangandol ma si Isa, pagmatāwinbi Tuhan, pagaddatinbi sultan mahatinggi.  <div eID="gen8399" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8398" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4144"/><div sID="gen8400" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Si Isa Al-Masi ya Panunuran</title> <div sID="gen8401" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4144"/> Ka'am saga sosoho'an maghinang ma a'a, angalilla' sadja kam ma a'a ya paghinanganbi. Ngga'i ka hal a'a ahāp kasuddahanna, a'a alasa ma ka'am ya subay pagaddatanbi. Subay pagaddatinbi sigām minsan isab ab'ngngis.

verses.name: I Peter 2:19
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' bininasa ma halam aniya' sā'bi paminasahan ka'am, bo' pa'in sandalanbi ma sabab Tuhan ya paheyabi ma atay, kasulutan Tuhan ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Peter 2:20
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam angimanan katiksa'an ya pinapagtongod maka hinangbi ala'at, mbal kam patut sinanglitan. Sagō' bang kam anandal kabinasahan minsan bay makahinang ahāp, kasulutan du Tuhan ma ka'am.

verses.name: I Peter 2:21
verses.text: Ya na he' asal kabaya'an Tuhan ma ka'am, in ka'am subay asandal ma deyom kabinasahan. Al-Masi ya panunuranbi sabab bay na iya anandalan kabinasahan ma sababanbi. Pasali' kam ni iya. <lg sID="gen8402"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8403"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:22
verses.text: Halam to'ongan iya bay makarusa,<l eID="gen8403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8404"/>halam iya bay makapah'lling puting minsan min t'dda.<l eID="gen8404" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8402"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:23
verses.text: Ma waktu bay kapamūng-mūng ala'at ma iya, halam iya bay anambung ala'at. Waktu kapaminasa ma iya, halam iya bay ananggupan sai-sai. Gom pa'in pangandolna baranna ni Tuhan ya abontol hukumanna.

verses.name: I Peter 2:24
verses.text: Bay tinanggung e' si Isa karusahantam pagka amatay ma hāg pangalansangan ma iya, supaya kitam ang'bba min dusatam bo' amanuyu' kahinangan abontol. Kauli'an kitam ma sabab saga bakat bay tananamna.

verses.name: I Peter 2:25
verses.text: Bay kam sali' sapantun bili-bili alungay min paglabayan, sagō' ma buwattina'an pabibud na kam bo' pabeya' ma Al-Masi, ya angupiksa' ka'am sampay anganjagahan nyawabi.  <div eID="gen8401" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Pet.2"/> <div eID="gen8400" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4145"/><div sID="gen8405" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamandu' ma A'a Maglakibini</title> <div sID="gen8406" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4145"/> Ka'am saga kar'ndahan, subay sulutbi kabaya'an h'llabi. Manjari bang aniya' sigām mbal gi' magsab'nnal ma lapal Tuhan, bo' pag'nda' sigām kaul-pi'ilbi ahāp du, minnē' aniya' pagsab'nnalan sigām. Minsan sigām mbal bissalahanbi, tabowa sigām asulut

verses.name: I Peter 3:2
verses.text: pag'nda' sigām ma kabontol itikadbi sampay ma pana'atbi ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:3
verses.text: Mbal kam tahinang alingkat ma sabab pangari-ngaribi ma pangluwahanbi, buwat saga pama'alti bu'unbi, maka pamulawanbi maka pan'mmekbi ahalga'.

verses.name: I Peter 3:4
verses.text: Ya wajib tuyu'anbi bo' kam ahāp d'nda, subay addat ahāp. Bang kam ahongpot, bang areyo' pangatayanbi, anatas du kamanisbi sampay ni kato'abi. Maka landu' ahalga' kamanisbi buwattē' ma pang'nda' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:5
verses.text: Buwattē' isab kahinangan saga d'nda suku' Tuhan ma masa awal. Bay sigām pasangdol ma iya, angkan sigām ahāp d'nda. Bay sinulut e' sigām kabaya'an h'lla sigām

verses.name: I Peter 3:6
verses.text: buwat si Sara, h'nda si Ibrahim. Sinulut e'na kabaya'an h'llana, niōnan e'na nakura'na. Na, ka'am saga d'nda ma buwattitu, bang ahāp hinangbi, maka bang kam mbal aluhay pinakitāw, sali' kam dī tubu' si Sara.  <div eID="gen8406" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4146"/><div sID="gen8407" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4146"/> Ka'am kal'llahan, subay ahāp akkalbi magpūn maka paghola'bi. Pagaddatinbi sigām pahāp pagka alunuk baran sigām min baranbi, sabab sali'-sali' du kam pinahampitan kallum taptap ma deyom sulga'. Bang buwattē' hinangbi halam aniya' makalimbit pangamu'-ngamu'bi ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8407" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8405" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4147"/><div sID="gen8408" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabinasahan ma Sabab Hinang Ahāp</title> <div sID="gen8409" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4147"/> Ya na itu bissalaku katapusan ma ka'am, subay kam dauyunan kamemon, magkannal-kiyannali. Sunurinbi addat magdanakan maglasa-liyasahi, ka'ase'inbi pagkahibi ma areyo' pangatayanbi.

verses.name: I Peter 3:9
verses.text: Bang kam ganta' nila'at, da'a balosinbi la'at. Bang kam sinukna'an, da'a pellenginbi sukna'. Ya pamalosbi ma sigām subay kahāpan sabab ya na kabaya'an Tuhan ma ka'am, supaya kam pinusaka'an kahāpan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:10
verses.text: Sabab tasulat ma deyom Kitab, ya yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8410"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8411"/>“Sai-sai bilahi ahāp palasahanna,<l eID="gen8411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8412"/>supaya tananamna waktu kasannangan,<l eID="gen8412" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8413"/>subay pahondong maghimumungan ala'at,<l eID="gen8413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8414"/>subay mbal magbissala kaputingan.<l eID="gen8414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8415"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:11
verses.text: Subay iya pataikut min hinang ala'at,<l eID="gen8415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8416"/>bo' maghinang ahāp.<l eID="gen8416" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8417"/>Subay iya atuyu' magsulut maka kasehe'anna,<l eID="gen8417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8418"/>maka subay pagmatayanna kasannangan.<l eID="gen8418" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8419"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:12
verses.text: Sabab anganjaga du Panghū' ma saga a'a abontol,<l eID="gen8419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8420"/>kinale e'na pamanyabut sigām.<l eID="gen8420" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8421"/>Sagō' sinagga' e'na saga a'a jahallis.”<l eID="gen8421" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8410"/>  <div eID="gen8409" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4148"/><div sID="gen8422" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4148"/> Halam aniya' angala'at ka'am bang kam atuyu' maghinang ahāp.

verses.name: I Peter 3:14
verses.text: Maka minsan kam saupama pinuhinga' ma sabab hinangbi ahāp, aheya du kakōganbi. Da'a kam atāw ma pananggup manusiya', da'a isab kam magkahanggawan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:15
verses.text: Sagō' paheya'unbi Al-Masi ma deyom pangatayanbi, in iya tantu Panghū'bi. Subay kam asakap sakahaba' waktu supaya kam makasambungan sai-sai atilaw ka'am bang angay kam makatantu pinaniya'an kahāpan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:16
verses.text: Sagō' subay ahanunut maka a'addat panambungbi. Subay abontol isab itikadbi bo' magkaiya'an saga a'a ya anoway kahinanganbi ahāp ma sabab pameya'bi ma Al-Masi.

verses.name: I Peter 3:17
verses.text: Bang Tuhan ya magkahandak, ahāp kam taluwa' kabinasahan ma sabab ahāp hinangbi, bang pa'in da'a hinang ala'at.  <div eID="gen8422" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4149"/><div sID="gen8423" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4149"/> Sabab bay amatay Al-Masi pinamint'dda ma sabab kamemon paldusahan manusiya'. Ngga'i ka ma sabab dusa baranna, sabab halam aniya' dusana minsan dakayu'. Tu'ud iya amatay supaya kam binowa maghāp maka Tuhan. Bay iya pinapatay sagō' pinakallum e' Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:19
verses.text: Min Rū Tuhan isab angkan iya bay pehē' magmahalayak ni saga umagad ya bay tinambolan e' Tuhan ma deyom ahirat.

verses.name: I Peter 3:20
verses.text: Ya na ina'an umagad saga a'a bay mbal ameya' ma kabaya'an Tuhan waktu kapangahinang adjung e' si Nū. Bay angagad Tuhan ma samantala' si Nū angahinang adjung inān, ya aniya' ameya' ma iya. Saguwā' pagtumbuk latap, walu' du a'a bay pasakat ni adjung bo' lappasan min latap.

verses.name: I Peter 3:21
verses.text: Ya kalappas sigām min latap inān sali' paralilan kalappastam labay min bohe' pagpandi ma waktu itu. Bang nihati pagpandi itu, ngga'i ka hinang pamala'an lumut baranta saguwā' paltanda'an in kitam bay anganjanji' ni Tuhan min itikad abontol. Manjari lappasan kitam sabab min kallum si Isa pabalik min kamatayna.

verses.name: I Peter 3:22
verses.text: Wa'i na iya pehē' ni sulga' aningkō' ma bihing Tuhan tampal ni kowan. Mahē' na iya magbaya' ma bangsa mala'ikat kamemon, maka ma ai-ai taga-kapatut atawa taga-ga'osan ma deyom sulga'.  <div eID="gen8423" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Pet.3"/> <div eID="gen8408" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4150"/><div sID="gen8424" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kaul-Pi'il ya Makasulut Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8425" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4150"/> Na, pagka Al-Masi bay makalabayan kabinasahan ma ginhawa-baranna, ya du ka'am subay anengoran iya bo' kam sakap anandal kabinasahan. Sabab sai-sai angananam kabinasahan buwattē', ang'bba na min katagihanna magdusa.

verses.name: I Peter 4:2
verses.text: Jari puwas itu, sat'ggolbi maitu ma dunya, subay kam pinagagihan e' kabaya'an Tuhan. Da'a na kam pinagagihan e' napsu maka baya' manusiya',

verses.name: I Peter 4:3
verses.text: ya pinene' e' saga a'a ya mbal ata'uwan Tuhan. At'ggol bay kapaghinangbi kasabulan makatamparasa, magba'is maka maglangohan. Sakahaba' waktu pagtipunbi maglami-lami, landu' aheka bay inumbi. Bay kam pasumba isab ni ta'u-ta'u ya sammal ma pang'nda' Tuhan. Sagō' sarang na.

verses.name: I Peter 4:4
verses.text: Ma buwattina'an ainu-inu saga a'a bay sehe'bi waktu tagna' bang angay kam mbal na palamugay ni sigām angandūlan napsubi. Angkanna kam binissalahan la'at e' sigām.

verses.name: I Peter 4:5
verses.text: Saguwā' aniya' du waktu paharap saga a'a inān ni Tuhan angahaka pasal bay kahinangan sigām. Asakap asal Tuhan angahukum binangsa manusiya', saga a'a masi allum sampay a'a bay magpatayan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:6
verses.text: Ya itu sababanna angkan lapal ahāp itu bay pinagnasihat sampay ni umagad saga a'a magpatayan, bo' supaya sigām pinaniya'an kallum ma haddarat Tuhan, minsan sigām bay pinalabayan hukuman ya pangangganta'an manusiya' pagma-dunya lagi'.  <div eID="gen8425" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4151"/><div sID="gen8426" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4151"/> Sōng na kiyamat dunya itu, angkan subay ahāp sadja kōkbi. Subay ahantap e'bi amikil bo' ahāp pangamu'-ngamu'bi ni Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:8
verses.text: Maka ya na itu subay pahalga'bi min kamemon: maglasa-liyasahi kam to'ongan, sabab bang kam maglasa sab'nnal-b'nnal tantu kam magampun-iyampuni minsan painay heka kasā'anbi.

verses.name: I Peter 4:9
verses.text: Bang aniya' saga pagkahibi bebeya'an si Isa ganta' pahapit ni luma'bi, da'a kam magmusmud. Pa'iddahunbi sadja sigām min atay pote'.

verses.name: I Peter 4:10
verses.text: Aniya' ma ka'am kapandayan bay pamuwan e' Tuhan pakaniya-kaniya. Jari paggunahunbi kapandayanbi ilu panabangbi ni kasehe'an, sabab patut du bang ahāp e'bi angangguna kata'u atawa kapandayan bay pangandol ma ka'am e' Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:11
verses.text: Sai-sai apanday magnasihat, subay lapal min Tuhan ya pagnasihatna. Sai-sai ata'u anabang ma sehe'na, subay iya anabang to'ongan min kosog bay pangahandak iya e' Tuhan. Sabab minnē' pinaheya ōn Tuhan ma ai-ai hinangbi, pagka si Isa Al-Masi ya pamanyabutanbi. Patut iya pinasuku'an kasahaya'an maka barakat sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen8426" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8424" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4152"/><div sID="gen8427" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kabinasahan ma Sabab Kapameya'ta ma Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8428" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4152"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, da'a kam kinobla'an ma sabab kabinasahan aheya ya tum'kka panulayan ka'am, sabab maumu aniya' buwattē'.

verses.name: I Peter 4:13
verses.text: Sagō' palasigunbi ataybi, sabab tananambi na kabinasahan buwat bay kalabayan Al-Masi, jari aheya du kakōganbi bang pina'nda'an na sanglit sahayana ni kamemon.

verses.name: I Peter 4:14
verses.text: Subay kam kinōgan bang kam pinamūng-mūngan ala'at ma sabab Al-Masi ya pameya'anbi, sabab ilu pat'nna' ma ka'am Rū barakatan, ya na Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:15
verses.text: Bang kam taluwa' kabinasahan, subay halam aniya' sababanna, buwat saga bay amapatay a'a, bay anangkaw, bay magpilliyu, atawa minsan bay palamud ma palkala' a'a ngga'i ka lamudbi.

verses.name: I Peter 4:16
verses.text: Sagō' bang kam pinananaman kabinasahan ma sabab Almasihin kam, da'a kam aiya'. Magsukul sadja kam ni Tuhan ma sabab ōn Al-Masi ya pangōn ka'am.  <div eID="gen8428" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4153"/><div sID="gen8429" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4153"/> Song na waktu panagna' hukuman Tuhan, sagō' kitam ma deyomanna ya nihukum dahū. Bang buwattē' kahālanna, bang kitam suku'na pinat'nna'an hukuman, ai kamaujuran saga a'a mbal magkahagad ma lapal ahāp ya min Tuhan?

verses.name: I Peter 4:18
verses.text: Buwat yukna ma deyom Kitab, <lg sID="gen8430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8431"/>“Bang a'a adil mbal agon lappasan,<l eID="gen8431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8432"/>luba'-lagi'na na a'a baldusa, ya mbal angisbat Tuhan!”<l eID="gen8432" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8430"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:19
verses.text: Angkanna, sai-sai kam angalabayan kabinasahan sabab iya na kahandak Tuhan ma ka'am, pasangdan kam maghinang ahāp. Pangandolunbi isab baranbi ni bay amapanjari ka'am, sabab tantu iya kapangandolan.  <div eID="gen8429" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1Pet.4"/> <div eID="gen8427" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4154"/><div sID="gen8433" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagmatto'ahan maka Onde' Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen8434" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4154"/> Aniya' isab pamituwaku ma saga pagmatto'ahan ya ma deyomanbi, sabab pagmatto'ahan isab aku. Mataku itu bay maka'nda' kabinasahan Al-Masi, maka aniya' du isab lamudku ma sinosōng bang iya pinabangsa na ma pang'nda' saga manusiya' kamemon. Ya na itu amu'ku ni ka'am:

verses.name: I Peter 5:2
verses.text: Upiksa'unbi pahāp saga a'a bay pangandol ma ka'am e' Tuhan, ya sali' dalil bili-bili pinaipat ma ka'am. Ayarinbi sigām min kōg maka baya', sabab ya na itu kabaya'an Tuhan. Da'a kam subay nihagda. Ya pangupiksa'bi ma sigām subay ngga'i ka pagpilak, subay min kahilasanbi sadja.

verses.name: I Peter 5:3
verses.text: Da'a pagmandahinbi saga a'a bay pama'atas ka'am, gom pa'in kam panunuran sigām.

verses.name: I Peter 5:4
verses.text: Jari bang pi'itu pabalik si Isa Al-Masi, ya dalil nakura' magupiksa' bili-bili, landu' ahāp panungbasna ma ka'am. Ya tungbas inān mbal magkapinda kahāpna, sabab makahampit kam ma sahayana.  <div eID="gen8434" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4155"/><div sID="gen8435" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4155"/> Na, ka'am isab saga l'lla abata' lagi', beya'unbi pamituwa pagmatto'ahanbi ilu. Subay areyo' pangatayanbi sabubi magtabang-tiyabangi, sabab yuk lling Kitab, <lg sID="gen8436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8437"/>“Angatu Tuhan ma a'a alanga atayna,<l eID="gen8437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8438"/>sagō' tabangna sasuku areyo' atayna.”<l eID="gen8438" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8436"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:6
verses.text: Angkan kam subay magpatireyo' ni Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, bo' kam pinalanga e'na bang ta'abut llaw bay pangangganta'na.

verses.name: I Peter 5:7
verses.text: Tukbalunbi kasusahanbi kamemon ni Tuhan, sabab magka'inagon du iya.  <div eID="gen8435" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4156"/><div sID="gen8439" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4156"/> Pahāpunbi pamikilbi, pajaga kam to'ongan. Sabab ilu bantabi nakura' saitan amiha ka'am. Sali' iya sapantun halimaw maglunsul na pa'in, kalu aniya' tapihana nil'kkob e'na.

verses.name: I Peter 5:9
verses.text: Atuhunbi nakura' saitan ma ahogot pangandolbi ma si Isa, sabab kata'uwanbi ngga'i ka hal ka'am ya t'kkahan kabinasahan, sampay isab saga pagkahibi Almasihin ma kaluha'an dunya.  <div eID="gen8439" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4157"/><div sID="gen8440" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4157"/> Sagō' aubus pa'in e'bi anandalan kabinasahan ma dai'-dai', binawi' du kam e' Tuhan sampay halam aniya' salla'bi. Pinatotog e'na imanbi, binuwanan du kam kosog bo' mbal apinda min pangandolbi ma iya. In iya Tuhan po'onan tatabangan. Pinagabbit kam e'na supaya kam pinabangsa ma deyom kasahaya'anna ya mbal magkapinda, pagka Al-Masi ya parakayu'anbi.

verses.name: I Peter 5:11
verses.text: Sanglitantam Tuhan, ya sangat kawasa sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin.  <div eID="gen8440" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8433" type="section"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4158"/><div sID="gen8441" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen8442" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4158"/> Si Silas bay anabangan aku anulat sulat apu'ut itu. Bang ma bistahanku in iya dakayu' danakantam tantu kapangandolan. Bilahi aku amahogot ataybi, ya po'on aku amabeya' sulat itu. Sugpatanku isab saksi'ku, in itu tatabangan sab'nnal-b'nnal deyo' bay min Tuhan. Da'a bbahinbi.  <div eID="gen8442" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4159"/><div sID="gen8443" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4159"/> Amabeya' minsan la'a hal lapal sigām saga pagkahibi bebeya'an Al-Masi ya magsakaum maitu ma lahat Babilon, a'a tapene' e' Tuhan buwat ka'am. Ya du si Markus itu, ya itungku sali' anakku.

verses.name: I Peter 5:14
verses.text: Magsiyum kam tanda' sin paglasabi dangan maka dangan. <div eID="gen8443" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8444" type="paragraph"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an kasannangan deyom atay, sasuku kam suku' Al-Masi. <signed sID="gen8445"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8445"/>  <div eID="gen8444" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8441" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8365" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1Pet.5"/> <div eID="gen8360" osisID="1Pet" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu deyo' min aku, si Simun Petros, dakayu' sosoho'an si Isa Al-Masi ya kawakilan e'na magnasihat. <div eID="gen8452" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8453" type="paragraph"/> Pabeya'ku sulat itu ni ka'am kamemon angandol ma si Isa Al-Masi. In iya Tuhantam maka iya ya makalappas kitam. Min kabontolanna, ya angkan kitam kaniya'an pangandol itu. Manjari pangandolbi ilu maka pangandol kami itu mbal du magbidda', ahalga' sali'-sali'.  <div eID="gen8453" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4160"/><div sID="gen8454" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4160"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in manglabi-labihan tatabangan maka kasannangan deyom atay ma ka'am, min pangita'ubi ma pasal Tuhan maka ma pasal Panghū'tam si Isa.  <div eID="gen8454" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4161"/><div sID="gen8455" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Pana'abbit maka Pamene' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8456" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4161"/> Min barakatna du, angkan kita kaniya'an ai-ai pamajatu kallumta maka pamahogot pangisbatta ma Tuhan, labay min Al-Masi ya bay amowa ka'am pinasuku'an kahāpna maka kabangsana.

verses.name: II Peter 1:4
verses.text: Jari pamuwan na ma kitam saga janji' Tuhan, ya mamarahi ahāp maka ahalga'. Minnē' kitam makasengod ni kajarihan Tuhan, ati makapuwas kitam min kanapsuhan alumu' ya ma deyom dunya itu.  <div eID="gen8456" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4162"/><div sID="gen8457" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4162"/> Ya itu sababanna angkan kam subay amanuyu' bo' supaya pinasugpat addat-tabi'at ahāp ni pangandolbi, ati addat-tabi'atbi pinasugpatan pangita'u.

verses.name: II Peter 1:6
verses.text: Pangita'ubi subay pinasugpatan pamaggat napsu, ati pamaggatbi napsu subay pinasugpatan iman. Pangimanbi subay pinasugpatan pagta'at ni Tuhan,

verses.name: II Peter 1:7
verses.text: ati pagta'atbi subay pinasugpatan lasa ma saga danakanbi bebeya'an si Isa, maka lasabi subay pinasugpatan lasa ni a'a kamemon.

verses.name: II Peter 1:8
verses.text: Bang jukup itu kamemon ma ka'am sampay manglabi-labihan na, tantu ahāp kamattihanna ma ai-ai hinangbi, maka pasōng ta'ubi pasal si Isa Al-Masi, Panghū'tam.

verses.name: II Peter 1:9
verses.text: Saguwā' sai-sai halam kaniya'an bay pamūngku he', ibarat iya a'a kasamunan matana, mbal agon maka'nda'. Takalipatna na in iya bay sinussi min karusahanna tagna'.  <div eID="gen8457" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4163"/><div sID="gen8458" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4163"/> Angkan yukku ma ka'am, saga dauranakan, subay kam atuyu' to'ongan bo' atuman kapamene' Tuhan ma ka'am. Bang itu hinangbi na pa'in, mbal to'ongan kam ang'bba min pangandolbi tudju ni iya.

verses.name: II Peter 1:11
verses.text: Minnē' kam binuwanan kapatut bo' kam sinagina pasōd ni deyoman pagparinta si Isa Al-Masi, ya Panghū'tam Manglalappas. Taptap kapagbaya'na sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8458" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4164"/><div sID="gen8459" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4164"/> Ya du ina'an sababanna angkan aku mbal pahali amaentoman ka'am, minsan kata'uwanbi na maka minsan ahogot na pameya'bi ma pandu' b'nnal ya ta'ā'bi.

verses.name: II Peter 1:13
verses.text: Sababna, bang ma aku, patut kam paentomanku na pa'in sat'ggolku allum.

verses.name: II Peter 1:14
verses.text: Kata'uwanku, mbal aku at'ggol maitu, sabab pinata'u aku e' si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam in aku song amole' lahat.

verses.name: II Peter 1:15
verses.text: Angkan tukiranku pamandu'ku ma ka'am bo' supaya aniya' pangentomanbi ma ai-ai bay pamūngku bang aku amatay na.  <div eID="gen8459" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8455" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4165"/><div sID="gen8460" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasahaya maka Barakat Panghū' Isa Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8461" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4165"/> Ngga'i ka kissa luwas min akkal manusiya' ya pameya'an kami, waktu kapangahaka kami ma ka'am pasal kabalik si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam ni dunya, maka pasal kawasana. Mata kami ya bay maka'nda' sahayana maka kaheya'anna.

verses.name: II Peter 1:17
verses.text: Mahē' asal kami waktu bay kapanambutna kamahaldika'an maka sahaya min Tuhan ya Mma'na. Aniya' suwala bay pinakale ma iya luwas min haddarat Tuhan, yuk-i, “Anakku ko' itu kalasahanku. Landu' aku kasulutan ma iya.”

verses.name: II Peter 1:18
verses.text: Baran kami bay makakale suwala he' amissala min deyom sulga', waktu kapagdongan kami maka Al-Masi ni pussuk būd ya bay kamahē'an Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8461" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4166"/><div sID="gen8462" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4166"/> Manjari itu, pagka ina'an bay tanyata' kami, makatantu kami in bay pagkallam saga nabi pasal Al-Masi kapam'nnalan sadja du. Subay asipbi pahāp ya bay pinagkallam e' sigām, sabab sapantun palita'an ko' inān asinag na pa'in ma deyom kalendoman, sampay ni karai'-llawan, sampay ni waktu kasobang bitu'un maga.

verses.name: II Peter 1:20
verses.text: Muna-muna, asipunbi pandu' ītu labi min kamemon: halam aniya' manusiya' makapahati pasal pagkallam kanabi-nabihan ya tasulat ma deyom Kitab, bang hal min baranna.

verses.name: II Peter 1:21
verses.text: Sabab ya pinagkallam e' kanabi-nabihan itu ngga'i ka luwas min kahandak manusiya'. Tu'ud sigām kapagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan angkan makapaluwas lapal deyo' min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8462" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Pet.1"/> <div eID="gen8460" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Peter 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4167"/><div sID="gen8463" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Guru Mbal B'nnal</title> <div sID="gen8464" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4167"/> Ma waktu palabay inān aniya' saga a'a magnabi-nabi di-sigām bay patuwa' ni bangsa kami. Damikiyanna isab ma ka'am, aniya' du patuwa' ma deyomanbi a'a maglaku-laku in sigām guru, bo' pa'in mbal b'nnal pagguru sigām. Binowahan kam e' sigām pandu' amaka'at pangandolbi ma si Isa. Pinaliluhan e' sigām Panghū'tam si Isa, ya bay angal'kkat sigām min naja'. Sakadjap sadja mulka' ma saga a'a buwattē'.

verses.name: II Peter 2:2
verses.text: Sagō' aheka a'a ameya'-meya'an sigām maghinang kasabulan makatamparasa. Ya he' po'onna angkan binissalahan la'at bowahan kasab'nnalan ya pameya'antam.

verses.name: II Peter 2:3
verses.text: Saga guru mbal b'nnal itu napsuhan sidda, angkan kam pinakalehan saga kissa bay pahinang-hinang sigām, bo' kam kapanguntungan e' sigām. Sagō' in hukuman ma saga a'a inān sakap asal sangay min awal. Mbal atuli mulka' ya tinagamahan sigām.  <div eID="gen8464" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4168"/><div sID="gen8465" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4168"/> Minsan saga mala'ikat dusahan, halam sigām bay kina'ase'an e' Tuhan. Gom pa'in nilarukan e'na ni nalka' ati kinabbat sigām maina'an ma deyom lendom bitu-bituhan, bo' angalagaran llaw hukuman.

verses.name: II Peter 2:5
verses.text: Damikiyanna isab saga a'a bay mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan ma masa awal e', halam sigām bay kina'ase'an e' Tuhan, gom pa'in sigām pinatumbukan latap ma sakalingkal dunya. Luwal disi Nū bay hampananna, iya maka sehe'na pitu' puhu'. Ma halam gi' latap inān, bay ninasihatan e' si Nū ba'anan a'a inān pasal pangatayan sigām subay pinabontol.

verses.name: II Peter 2:6
verses.text: Bay tinunu' isab e' Tuhan da'ira Sodom maka Gomora, pangahukumna ma karusahan saga a'a maina'an. Minnē' aniya' kapamintāngan saga a'a kasehe'an bang ai kamattihan sasuku mbal angisbat Tuhan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:7
verses.text: Hal si Lōt ya bay pinuwas e' Tuhan min saga da'ira inān. Bay ahantap addat-tabi'atna angkan asasaw pikilanna e' saga a'a pangalanggal sara' maina'an, sabab hal magba'isan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:8
verses.text: Bay iya pat'nna' ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga' sigām ang'nda' ma palantara sigām, akale ma himumungan sigām kahaba' llaw, ya po'on abakat atayna e' kala'atan sigām.

verses.name: II Peter 2:9
verses.text: Kamattanan kitam min si Nū maka si Lōt in Panghū' ata'u angalappas min deyom katiksa'an sasuku ameya' ma kabaya'anna. Ata'u isab iya anambolan saga a'a dusahan ma deyom kabinasahan sampay ta'abut llaw hukuman.

verses.name: II Peter 2:10
verses.text: Luba'-lagi'na na bang a'a magdūl-baya'an napsu sigām landu' asammal, maka mbal magaddat ma sai-sai taga-pagbaya'. <div eID="gen8465" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8466" type="paragraph"/> Atawakkal makalandu' saga guru ngga'i ka b'nnal itu, maka mamarahi sidda pagmalangkahi sigām. Mbal sigām magaddat ma saga bangsa sulga', gom pa'in magtunggīng.

verses.name: II Peter 2:11
verses.text: Labi aga'os maka akawasa saga mala'ikat min guru putingan itu, sagō' minsan mala'ikat, mbal du amah'llingan la'at ma pagkahi sigām bangsa sulga' bang ta'abut waktu kapangaharap sigām ni Panghū'.

verses.name: II Peter 2:12
verses.text: Sagō' saga guru itu amah'lling pangkal ma mbal tahati e' sigām. Nihinang e' sigām ai-ai makani-pikilan sigām, buwat hantang sattuwa talun ya halam taga akkal, hal sinaggaw bo' pinapatay. Buwattē' isab kadal saga a'a buwattē', magmula du.  <div eID="gen8466" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4169"/><div sID="gen8467" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4169"/> Katungbasan sigām kala'atan ma sabab kala'atan ya bay tahinang sigām. Ya makahāp palasahan sigām bang magdūlan napsu sigām sampay ma mata mairan. Ya na pa'in pagkōg-koyagan sigām bang angakkalan ka'am ma waktu kapagsalubi maka sigām. Tinamakan kam e' sigām, binuwanan kamaruhan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:14
verses.text: Tagihan sigām ang'nda'-ng'nda' ma saga d'nda ya pagba'isan sigām, mbal to'ongan sinumu magdusa. Binidjakan e' sigām ni kala'atan saga a'a mbal ahogot pangandolna. Kabiyaksahan sigām maghawa napsu ma indaginis. Pagmulka'an Tuhan saga a'a inān!

verses.name: II Peter 2:15
verses.text: Bay na sigām pasaddī min pal'ngnganan abontol, alopas na min paglabayan. Ya panunuran sigām nabi bay ma masa awal, ōnna si Bala'am anak si Beyor. Si Bala'am he' bay bilahi tinambahan sīn ma sabab kahinanganna ala'at,

verses.name: II Peter 2:16
verses.text: sagō' pinabukagan iya e' kura' ma sabab dusana. Kura' he' bay magsuwala buwat suwala manusiya', angkan halam kalandu'an e' si Bala'am karupanganna.  <div eID="gen8467" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4170"/><div sID="gen8468" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4170"/> Halam aniya' pūs pagguru saga a'a itu. Sali' sigām sapantun tuburan bohe' at'ggang, atawa gabun tabowa paleyang e' baliyu. Aniya' lahat tinagamahan sigām e' Tuhan ma lendom bitu-bituhan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:18
verses.text: Bowa'an sidda sigām, pangangabbu, sagō' halam aniya' pūs bissala sigām. Niumpanan e' sigām saga a'a baha'u bay ang'bba min kasā'an ya kabiyaksahan pagkahi sigām. Pinabilahi sigām angandūlan baya' napsu sigām makatamparasa.

verses.name: II Peter 2:19
verses.text: Bang ma janji' saga guru itu, limaya sasuku ameya'-meya'an hinang buwattē'. Sagō' ya b'nnalna, sali' sigām banyaga' kapagagihan e' napsu angkan sigām subay maghinang kasabulan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:20
verses.text: Saupama a'a bay makapuwas min kalumu'an dunya pagka si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam ya pangandolanna, bang iya tajallat pabīng maghinang kalumu'an bay bbahanna, luhūy ala'at kahālanna damuli min bay dahū.

verses.name: II Peter 2:21
verses.text: Bang sigām bay ata'u ma kal'ngnganan ya amowa ni atay abontol, bo' bay pataikut min panoho'an deyo' min Tuhan, ahāp lagi' sigām halam bay makata'uwan panoho'an e'.

verses.name: II Peter 2:22
verses.text: Taluwa' sigām lling bay min kamatto'ahan, ya yuk-i, “Ero' bay angutta', pabīng amangan utta'na,” maka itu gi', “Bawi bay pinandi, pabīng magtūy paloblob ni kapisakan.”  <div eID="gen8468" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="2Pet.2"/> <div eID="gen8463" type="section"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4171"/><div sID="gen8469" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Llaw Kapabalik Panghū' Isa</title> <div sID="gen8470" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4171"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, kaminduwaku na anulat ni ka'am. Ya maksudku ma sulat dahū sampay ma sulat ītu, subay amaentoman ka'am pasal bay ta'anadbi tagna', bo' supaya abontol e'bi amikil ma halam aniya' simbugna ala'at.

verses.name: II Peter 3:2
verses.text: Entomunbi bay pinagkallam e' kanabi-nabihan ma masa awal, sampay panoho'an deyo' min si Isa Panghū'tam Manglalappas. Bay kam pinandu'an pasal panoho'an inān e' saga a'a kawakilan si Isa.  <div eID="gen8470" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4172"/><div sID="gen8471" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4172"/> Ya na itu subay hatiunbi dahū min kamemon: ma kahinapusan masa itu aniya' patuwa' ni deyomanbi saga a'a tagihan ameya' ma napsu sigām. Niudju' kam e' sigām, yuk-i,

verses.name: II Peter 3:4
verses.text: “Angay halam tatuman ya bay janji' si Isa pasal kapi'ituna pabīng? Amatay na saga kamatto'ahan kami, sagō' masi na pa'in pa'atol dunya itu maka kakaya'-kaya'anna. Halam aniya' apinda ma dunya itu sangay min waktu bay pamapanjari!”

verses.name: II Peter 3:5
verses.text: Tu'ud panu'uran e' saga a'a angudju' itu, angkan sigām mbal angentom ma bay hinang Tuhan ma awal tagna'. Angallam iya mint'dda, magtūy paniya' langit maka dunya. Pinatuwa' gintana'an min deyom bohe', bo' bohe' du bay pangahinang iya.

verses.name: II Peter 3:6
verses.text: Min bohe' du isab angkan nilatapan dunya bay waktu awal e', pinaka'at e' Tuhan.

verses.name: II Peter 3:7
verses.text: Min pagkallam Tuhan isab, ya angkan umbanganna langit maka dunya ma buwattitu, bo' supaya tinunu' bang ta'abut llaw pangahukumna ma saga manusiya' ya mbal bilahi magta'at ni iya. Ya na ko' ina'an llaw kapamutawan sigām min Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8471" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4173"/><div sID="gen8472" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4173"/> Saga bagay, da'a takalipatunbi ītu: dang'llaw maka dangibu tahun sali' du t'ggolna bang ma bistahan Panghū'.

verses.name: II Peter 3:9
verses.text: Bang ma pangannal kasehe'an at'ggol e' Panghū' anuman bay panganjanji'na. Sagō' ngga'i ka. Tu'ud iya pasangdan angimanan ka'am sabab mbal iya bilahi bang aniya' minsan la'a hal dakayu' manusiya' amutawan min iya. Ya kabaya'anna in manusiya' kamemon subay apinda pikilanna sampay ang'bba min dusana.  <div eID="gen8472" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4174"/><div sID="gen8473" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4174"/> Saguwā' patagha' sadja ya Llaw Panghū'tam, buwat kat'kka a'a panangkaw. Palanyap du langit ma llaw du ina'an, maka akosog sidda lagublubna. Ahansul e' api kamemon bay paniya' ma diyata' ayan. Pahalam isab dunya itu sampay kakaya'-kaya'anna kamemon.  <div eID="gen8473" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4175"/><div sID="gen8474" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4175"/> Na, pagka kata'uwanbi in ai-ai kamemon itu pinahalam du ma sinosōng, kira-kirahunbi to'ongan pasal kajarihanbi bang buwattingga bowahanna. Subay kam amuspus bo' asussi pangatayanbi maka halam aniya' salla'bi,

verses.name: II Peter 3:12
verses.text: ma salta' kam angalagaran llaw kapi'ituna inān. Subay kam patukid isab maghinang ai-ai pamahinang ka'am, bo' tasa'ut kapi'ituna. Ya na ina'an llaw pangahansul saga lapis langit ma deyom api, llaw isab panunaw ai-ai kamemon bay ma diyata' ayan, sabab min pasu'na.

verses.name: II Peter 3:13
verses.text: Saguwā' kitam itu, angalagaran gi' panganjanji' Tuhan, hatina langit baha'u maka dunya baha'u ya paglahatan ka'adilan.  <div eID="gen8474" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4176"/><div sID="gen8475" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4176"/> Angkanna, saga bagay, sat'ggol kam angalagaran llaw ina'an-i, patukid kam bo' supaya halam aniya' tamak atawa la'at tabāk ma pangatayanbi, hinabubi isab magda'atay maka Tuhan.

verses.name: II Peter 3:15
verses.text: Da'a bistahunbi in Panghū' alallay pagka tangguhanna hukuman. Tu'ud iya angimanan bangsa manusiya' sabab kabaya'anna subay aniya' waktu kapang'bba sigām min dusa ati bo' lappasan min mulka' sinōng. Buwattē' du isab bay panulat ni ka'am e' si Paul, dakayu' danakantam kinalasahan. Tulun min Tuhan asal pangita'una anulatan ka'am buwattē'.

verses.name: II Peter 3:16
verses.text: Atayudtud du isab sulat si Paul kamemon bang harap ni pakaradja'an sinōng inān. Sagō' aniya' lapal sulatna ahunit nihati, ya pinabengkok e' saga a'a akulang ma panghatina maka ma pangandol, buwat kapamabengkok sigām ma ayat Kitab kasehe'. Tantu sigām minulka'an.  <div eID="gen8475" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4177"/><div sID="gen8476" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4177"/> Saga bagay, bay na kam kabanda'anku pasal pakaradja'an itu. Angkan kam soho'ku pajaga bo' kam mbal tabowa apinda min kahogot pangandolbi. Da'a beya'-beya'unbi kasā'an saga a'a asabul ilu,

verses.name: II Peter 3:18
verses.text: sagō' pasōngunbi pangandolbi ma tatabangan si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam Manglalappas. Pasōngunbi isab ta'ubi ma pasalanna. Patut iya pinasuku'an kamahaldika'an, min waktu itu sampay ni kasaumulan! Amin. <signed sID="gen8477"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8477"/>  <div eID="gen8476" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8469" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8451" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="2Pet.3"/> <div eID="gen8446" osisID="2Pet" type="book"/>

verses.name: I John 1:1
verses.text: Sulatanta kam pasal si Isa Al-Masi, ya palman pamo'onan kallum. Min awal tagna' asal palman itu. Bay iya takale kami, bay iya ta'nda' maka mata kami. Tatanding iya maka ka'ntanan e' kami.

verses.name: I John 1:2
verses.text: Bay na palahil ya niōnan Po'onan Kallum. Bay iya ta'nda' kami, jari kami itu saksi'na angkan kami angahaka'an ka'am ma pasalna, ya amuwan kallum kakkal. Bay iya ma Mma'na Tuhan asal min ka'asalna, bo' bay pa'nda' ni kami.

verses.name: I John 1:3
verses.text: Jari in bay ta'nda' maka takale kami, ya na he' pamata'u kami ni ka'am bo' supaya kam pauyun ma kami magda'atay maka Mma'tam Tuhan sampay anakna si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: I John 1:4
verses.text: Sulatanta kam sulat itu bo' supaya ajukup kakoyagantam.  <div eID="gen8486" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4178"/><div sID="gen8487" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tuhan Ya Po'onan Karanta'an</title> <div sID="gen8488" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4178"/> Ya na itu lapal bay takale kami min si Isa Al-Masi, lapal pangahaka kami ma ka'am: in Tuhan asal po'onan kasawahan. Halam aniya' kalendoman ma kajarihanna minsan dangkuri'.

verses.name: I John 1:6
verses.text: Angkan ko', bang kita ganta' magpa'in in kita da'atay maka Tuhan bo' masi kita ma deyom kalendoman dusa, putingan kita pagka mbal ameya' ma kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I John 1:7
verses.text: Kakkal Tuhan ma deyom karanta'an, jari bang kita pasengod ni iya pataptap ma karanta'an, da'atay kita. Maka sinussi kita min dusata kamemon sabab min laha' si Isa Anak Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8488" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4179"/><div sID="gen8489" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4179"/> Abila yukta halam aniya' dusata, angakkalan kita di-ta maka halam aniya' kasab'nnalan ma deyom kajarihanta.

verses.name: I John 1:9
verses.text: Sagō' bang kita magpasab'nnal ni Tuhan pasal paldusahanta, tantu kita niampun. Sinussi isab kita min kala'atanta kamemon sabab tinuman e' Tuhan janji'na, maka abontol kahinanganna.

verses.name: I John 1:10
verses.text: Bang yukta in kita halam bay makarusa, sali' pahiputingta Tuhan, ati halam pasobsob lapal palmanna ni deyom atayta.  <div eID="gen8489" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1John.1"/> <div eID="gen8487" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4180"/><div sID="gen8490" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Aniya' Amogbogan Kita ma Haddarat Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8491" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4180"/> Saga anak-mpuku, sulatanta kam sulat itu supaya kam mbal magdusa. Malaingkan bang aniya' ganta' makarusa, aniya' du amogbogan kita ma alopan Tuhan, ya na si Isa Al-Masi, ya A'adil.

verses.name: I John 2:2
verses.text: Baran Al-Masi bay tahinang pagkulban pangampunan dusatam. Maka ngga'i ka dusatam hal, sampay dusa manusiya' kamemon ma dunya itu.  <div eID="gen8491" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4181"/><div sID="gen8492" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4181"/> Bang beya'ta panoho'an Tuhan, minnē' kita makatantu in kita ata'uwan iya.

verses.name: I John 2:4
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' magpa'in in iya ata'uwan Tuhan bo' mbal beya'na panoho'anna, a'a inān putingan maka halam aniya' kasab'nnalan ma deyom kajarihanna.

verses.name: I John 2:5
verses.text: Saguwā' sasuku ameya' ma lapal palman Tuhan, tantu ajatu lasa Tuhan ma kajarihan a'a inān. Bang kita makarakayu' sab'nnal-b'nnal ma Tuhan, buwattitu pangilahanna:

verses.name: I John 2:6
verses.text: sasuku ah'lling in iya pataptap ameya' ma Tuhan, panunuranna kaul-pi'il si Isa waktu kamaituna lagi' ma dunya.  <div eID="gen8492" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8490" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4182"/><div sID="gen8493" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panoho'an Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen8494" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4182"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, ngga'i ka panoho'an baha'u ya panulatku itu ma ka'am. Panoho'an tagna' gi' ko' itu, ya bay ma ka'am sangay min katagna' kapagkahagadbi ma Al-Masi, hatina lapal pagnasihat ya bay takalebi.

verses.name: I John 2:8
verses.text: Saguwā' minsan bay at'ggol ma ka'am, patut niōnan panoho'an baha'u sabab manyatakan kab'nnalna ma kajarihan Al-Masi maka ma kajarihanbi. Anginut na palabay kalendoman, anahaya na in sawa b'nnal.  <div eID="gen8494" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4183"/><div sID="gen8495" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4183"/> Sasuku magpina'in in iya ma deyom karanta'an, bo' kab'nsihanna na pa'in pagkahina bebeya'an si Isa, masi iya ma deyom kalendoman sampay ni kabuwattituhan.

verses.name: I John 2:10
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku alasa ma pagkahina, karanta'an iya pataptapanna, maka halam aniya' makabowa iya angahinang dusa.

verses.name: I John 2:11
verses.text: Sagō' masi gi' ma deyom kalendoman sasuku ab'nsi ma pagkahina. Mbal kata'uwanna bang pi'ingga ya patudjuhanna sabab abuta iya e' kalendoman. <lg sID="gen8496"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8497"/>

verses.name: I John 2:12
verses.text: Sulatanta kam, saga anak-mpuku,<l eID="gen8497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8498"/>sabab ta'ampun na dusabi min ōn Al-Masi.<l eID="gen8498" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8499"/>

verses.name: I John 2:13
verses.text: Sulatanta kam isab, saga kamatto'ahan,<l eID="gen8499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8500"/>sabab kata'uwanbi Al-Masi, ya min katagna' awal.<l eID="gen8500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8501"/>Sulatanta kam isab, saga kasubulan,<l eID="gen8501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8502"/>sabab tara'ugbi nakura' saitan, ya patila'atun.<l eID="gen8502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8503"/>Sulatanta kam isab, saga anak-mpuku,<l eID="gen8503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8504"/>sabab kata'uwanbi na Mma'bi Tuhan.<l eID="gen8504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8505"/>

verses.name: I John 2:14
verses.text: Sulatanta kam isab, saga kamatto'ahan,<l eID="gen8505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8506"/>sabab kata'uwanbi Al-Masi,<l eID="gen8506" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8507"/>ya bay asal min katagna' awal.<l eID="gen8507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8508"/>Sulatanta kam isab, saga kasubulan,<l eID="gen8508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8509"/>sabab akosog kam maka pat'ttog palman Tuhan<l eID="gen8509" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8510"/>ma deyom pangatayanbi.<l eID="gen8510" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8511"/>Tara'ugbi isab nakura' saitan, ya patila'atun.<l eID="gen8511" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8496"/>  <div eID="gen8495" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4184"/><div sID="gen8512" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4184"/> Da'a panuyu'inbi dunya pinjaman itu maka kahinanganna, sabab mbal alasa ma Mma'tam Tuhan sasuku amanuyu'an kahinangan dunya itu.

verses.name: I John 2:16
verses.text: Sabab ngga'i ka min Tuhan saga kahinangan dunya itu: buwat saga napsutam ala'at, maka ai-ai kinarandaman mata, maka ai-ai pagmalangkahian manusiya'. Luwas ko' itu min alam dakayu'.

verses.name: I John 2:17
verses.text: Palabay du alam itu maka kanapsuhanna, sagō' sasuku maghinang kabaya'an Tuhan allum sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8512" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8493" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4185"/><div sID="gen8513" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Banta Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8514" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4185"/> Saga anak-mpuku, song na patobtob dunya itu. Bay na kam kahaka'anku, aniya' banta Al-Masi palahil pi'itu. Aheka na isab pi'itu buwattina'an amantahan iya, angkan kata'uwanta asekot na katapusan dunya itu.

verses.name: I John 2:19
verses.text: Bay palamud saga banta inān ma kitam tagna', sagō' wa'i na sigām pasaddī sabab ngga'i ka dambeya'an to'ongan maka kitam. Bang bay sigām b'nnal dambeya'an maka kitam, bay du sigām pataptap ma kitam. Sagō' pasaddī na sigām bo' mattan in sigām ngga'i ka min pameya'antam.  <div eID="gen8514" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4186"/><div sID="gen8515" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4186"/> Aniya' bay pamatulun ni ka'am e' Mahasussi, angkan ka'am kamemon taga-pangita'u.

verses.name: I John 2:21
verses.text: Ya po'on aku anulat itu ni ka'am, ngga'i ka ma sabab kam a'awam pasal pandu' b'nnal, sagō' ma sabab kasakupanbi na. Kata'uwanbi isab, halam aniya' puting paluwas min kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I John 2:22
verses.text: Na, sai bahā' putingan? Ya amina'in in si Isa ngga'i ka Al-Masi tapene' e' Tuhan. Banta Al-Masi in a'a putingan he', sinulak e'na Tuhan maka Anakna.

verses.name: I John 2:23
verses.text: Sabab sai-sai anulak si Isa Anak Tuhan, tasulakna isab Tuhan. Maka sai-sai angaku si Isa in iya Anak Tuhan, ina'an isab Tuhan Mma' ma a'a inān.  <div eID="gen8515" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4187"/><div sID="gen8516" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4187"/> Angkan kam amay-amayanku: pasobsobunbi lapal bay takalebi tagna' ni deyom panahu'anbi. Bang tau'bi pahogot, kakkal du kapagdakayu'bi maka Anak Tuhan maka Mma'na.

verses.name: I John 2:25
verses.text: Panganjanji' Al-Masi ko' itu ma kitam, hatina kallum taptap ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8516" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4188"/><div sID="gen8517" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4188"/> Angkan buwattē' panulatku ma ka'am bo' tata'ubi pasal saga a'a ya bilahi amowa ka'am pasaddī min kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I John 2:27
verses.text: Sagō' pat'ttog ma ka'am ya bay pamatulun e' Al-Masi, mbal kam magkagunahan pandu' min sai-sai. Sabab kapandu'an na kam e' Rū Sussi ya pamatulun ma ka'am, maka b'nnal sadja pamandu'na, ngga'i ka puting. Jari beya'unbi pamandu'na bo' supaya kam taptap ma Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen8517" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8513" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4189"/><div sID="gen8518" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Panganak Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8519" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4189"/> Na, saga anak-mpuku, pataptap kam ma Al-Masi bo' kam mbal tināw ma waktu kabalikna, ati mbal magkaiya'an pa'alop ma iya bang ta'abut llaw kapi'ituna pabīng.  <div eID="gen8519" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4190"/><div sID="gen8520" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4190"/> Pagka kata'uwanbi in Al-Masi asal adil, kata'uwanbi sasuku maghinang ka'adilan tahinang anak Tuhan isab.  <div eID="gen8520" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1John.2"/> <div eID="gen8518" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4191"/><div sID="gen8521" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Panganak Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8522" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4191"/> Mbal tapula'-pula' lasa Mma'tam ma kitam. Min kaheya lasana angkan kitam niōnan anak Tuhan na. B'nnal isab, anak Tuhan na kitam. Mbal ata'uwan Tuhan kaheka'an a'a ma dunya itu, angkan kitam mbal takilā e' sigām.

verses.name: I John 3:2
verses.text: Saga bagay kalasahanku, anak Tuhan kitam buwattina'an, bo' halam gi' pinabukis bang buwattingga kasōngantam. Daipara kata'uwantam, bang pabīng na Al-Masi, makasali' kitam ni iya sabab maka'nda' kitam pangluwahanna.

verses.name: I John 3:3
verses.text: Jari sai-sai aniya' holatanna buwattē', sinussi e'na pangatayanna bo' pasali'na ni kasussi Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen8522" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4192"/><div sID="gen8523" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4192"/> Makalanggal sara' Tuhan sasuku makahinang dusa, sabab in niōnan dusa itu sali' du maka langgal sara'.

verses.name: I John 3:5
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi bang ai mohotna angay palahil Al-Masi ni dunya. Bay iya pi'itu amuwasan paldusahan manusiya', sagō' halam to'ongan aniya' dusa ma iya.

verses.name: I John 3:6
verses.text: Jari mbal kasangdanan magdusa sasuku taptap ma Al-Masi. Malaingkan sasuku angandusa na pa'in, halam bay takilāna Al-Masi, halam isab kata'uwanna.  <div eID="gen8523" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4193"/><div sID="gen8524" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4193"/> Saga anak-mpuku, pahalli' kam bo' kam mbal ka'akkalan e' sai-na. Sasuku maghinang kabontolan a'adil asal, sali' Al-Masi.

verses.name: I John 3:8
verses.text: Sasuku angandusa na pa'in, suku' iya ma nakura' saitan, sabab saitan e' bay magdusa asal sangay min awal tagna'. Angkan Anak Tuhan bay palahil pi'itu ni dunya, bo' paka'atna kahinangan nakura' saitan e'.

verses.name: I John 3:9
verses.text: Mbal maghinang dusa sasuku tahinang anak e' Tuhan, sabab ina'an kajarihan Tuhan ma deyom pangatayanna. Mbal iya makasangdan magdusa sabab Tuhan ya pag'mma'anna.

verses.name: I John 3:10
verses.text: Aniya' pagbidda'an saga anak Tuhan maka anak nakura' saitan angkan tasilangtam. Sasuku mbal angahinang kabontolan maka mbal alasa ma pagkahina, mbal kaōnan anak Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8524" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8521" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4194"/><div sID="gen8525" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Paglasa-liyasahi</title> <div sID="gen8526" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4194"/> Ya itu lapal nasihat bay takalebi, tagna' kapameya'bi ma Al-Masi: in kitam subay maglasa-liyasahi.

verses.name: I John 3:12
verses.text: Da'a subay panunurantam si Kabil, ya bay amapatay siyalina l'lla. Suku' saitan Patila'atun iya, sabab ala'at asal bay kahinanganna, bo' arapun abontol bay kahinangan siyalina he'.

verses.name: I John 3:13
verses.text: Da'a kam ainu-inu, saga danakan, bang kam kinab'nsihan e' saga a'a ma dunya itu.

verses.name: I John 3:14
verses.text: Kata'uwanbi kahālantam tagna', sapantun kitam a'a magpatayan, sagō' papinda na kitam min kamatay tudju ni kallum. Angkan kata'uwantam, sabab alasa na kitam ma pagkahita bebeya'an Al-Masi. Paddas ma deyom kamatay sasuku mbal alasa.

verses.name: I John 3:15
verses.text: Sasuku ab'nsi ma pagkahina, a'a inān sali' pamomono'. Maka kata'uwanbi asal, bang a'a amono' pagkahina manusiya' halam iya bay kaniya'an kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen8526" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4195"/><div sID="gen8527" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4195"/> Min Al-Masi ya kata'uwantam dī lasa bang buwattingga, sabab bay pinaglilla' e'na kallumna ganti'tam. Maka ya du kitam, subay kitam magmalilla' amatay ma sabab saga pagkahitam jama'a Al-Masi.

verses.name: I John 3:17
verses.text: Bang saupama aniya' a'a taga-kaniya' maka'nda' pagkahina ma deyom kasigpitan bo' mbal ka'ase'anna, painay e'na alasahan Tuhan?

verses.name: I John 3:18
verses.text: Saga anak-mpuku, da'a kitam alasa hal min kuwit bowa'ta. Subay min atay-pote' maka min itikad abontol maka min kahinangan b'nnal.  <div eID="gen8527" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4196"/><div sID="gen8528" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4196"/> Jari bang kita alasa ma pagkahita min deyom atay, minnē' kita manantuhi in kita beya' du ma kasab'nnalan, ati ahantap pangatayantam ma alopan Tuhan.

verses.name: I John 3:20
verses.text: Minsan aniya' amadlak ni ataytam pasal bay dusata tagna', mbal kita sakit asusa sabab alalom gi' pangita'u Tuhan min ai-ai tananam e' itikadta. Kasakupan e' Tuhan ai-ai kamemon.

verses.name: I John 3:21
verses.text: Angkanna, saga bagay kinalasahan, bang halam aniya' salla' atawa dusa tananamta ma deyom pangatayanta, mbal kita tināw ma matahan Tuhan.

verses.name: I John 3:22
verses.text: Makasambut kita min iya ai-ai amu'ta sabab beya'ta saga panoho'anna. Hinangta isab ai-ai makasulut atayna.

verses.name: I John 3:23
verses.text: Ya na itu panoho'anna: subay kita magkahagad ma ōn Anakna si Isa Al-Masi, maka subay maglasa-liyasahi isab buwat bay panoho'an kita.

verses.name: I John 3:24
verses.text: Pataptap du ma Tuhan sasuku maghinang panoho'anna, maka pataptap isab Tuhan ma iya. Angkan kata'uwanta in Tuhan pataptap na ma kita, ma sabab Rū ya bay pat'nna'na ma deyom pangatayanta.  <div eID="gen8528" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1John.3"/> <div eID="gen8525" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4197"/><div sID="gen8529" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tatabun Pahāp saga A'a Magnabi-nabi</title> <div sID="gen8530" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4197"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, bang aniya' a'a amūng in iya bay katulunan e' Rū Tuhan, da'a iya kahagarunbi magdai'-dai'. Subay tatabunbi dahū bang b'nnal min Tuhan ya pasangon ma iya. Sabab aheka na saga a'a bay paluwas ni kaluha'an dunya maglaku-laku in sigām nabi, bo' ngga'i ka.

verses.name: I John 4:2
verses.text: Buwattitu ya pangilāhanbi saga a'a bang b'nnal bay patulunan Rū Tuhan: sasuku angaku in si Isa Al-Masi bay pi'itu magbaran manusiya', min Tuhan iya.

verses.name: I John 4:3
verses.text: Sagō' sasuku mbal angaku buwattē', ngga'i ka Rū Tuhan ya pasangon ma iya. Min banta Al-Masi ko' inān, ya yukku ma ka'am song palahil pi'itu. Itiya' na iya ma buwattina'an.  <div eID="gen8530" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4198"/><div sID="gen8531" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4198"/> Sagō' ka'am ilu, saga anak-mpu, suku' Tuhan na. Tara'ugbi saga nabi ya ngga'i ka b'nnal ma sabab Rū Tuhan ma deyom pangatayanbi ilu. Akawasa gi' Rū Tuhan ya bay pasangon ma ka'am min sai-sai ma dunya itu.

verses.name: I John 4:5
verses.text: Suku' ma dunya itu saga nabi putingan inān, angkan niasip pandu' sigām e' saga a'a ma dunya.

verses.name: I John 4:6
verses.text: Saguwā' suku' Tuhan asal kitam, ati sai-sai ata'uwan Tuhan angikut kitam du. Mbal angikut saga a'a ya ngga'i ka suku' Tuhan. Minnē' kapandogahanta pamandu' a'a, bang min Rū kasab'nnalan ka atawa min saddī.  <div eID="gen8531" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8529" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4199"/><div sID="gen8532" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Tuhan Po'onan Lasa</title> <div sID="gen8533" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4199"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, subay kitam maglasa-liyasahi sabab min Tuhan asal lasa kamemon. Anak Tuhan sasuku alasa, maka kata'uwanna Tuhan.

verses.name: I John 4:8
verses.text: Sasuku mbal alasa, mbal kata'uwanna Tuhan sabab Tuhan ya po'onan lasa kamemon.

verses.name: I John 4:9
verses.text: Buwattitu ya kamattanan lasa Tuhan ni kitam: bay soho'na Anakna tunggal pi'itu ni dunya supaya kitam pinaniya'an kallum kakkal.

verses.name: I John 4:10
verses.text: Ya itu dī lasa: lasa Tuhan ma kitam, ngga'i ka lasatam ma Tuhan. Min lasana angkan soho'na Anakna pi'itu ni dunya pinapatay hantang pagkulban bo' supaya aniya' pangampunan dusatam.  <div eID="gen8533" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4200"/><div sID="gen8534" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4200"/> Saga bagay kalasahanku, pagka buwattē' lasa Tuhan ma kitam, wajib kitam subay maglasa-liyasahi.

verses.name: I John 4:12
verses.text: Halam aniya' a'a bay maka'nda' luwa Tuhan, malaingkan bang kitam maglasa-liyasahi, pataptap du Tuhan ma kitam ati pinasampulna' lasana ma deyom kajarihantam.  <div eID="gen8534" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4201"/><div sID="gen8535" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4201"/> Ya na itu pamandogahantam angkan kata'uwantam in kitam pataptap na ma Tuhan, maka iya ya pataptap isab ma kitam: itiya' Rū-na bay pamuwan e'na bo' pat'nna' ma deyom pangatayantam.

verses.name: I John 4:14
verses.text: Bay ya ta'nda' kami, maka kami isab saksi' in si Isa bay sinō' pi'itu e' Mma'na Tuhan bo' kalappasanna manusiya' kamemon.

verses.name: I John 4:15
verses.text: Sasuku magpasab'nnal in si Isa Anak Tuhan, pataptap du Tuhan ma a'a inān, maka iya isab pataptap ma Tuhan.

verses.name: I John 4:16
verses.text: Pasangdolantam lasa Tuhan ya kata'uwantam asal. <div eID="gen8535" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8536" type="paragraph"/> Tuhan ya po'onan lasa, jari sasuku pasangdan alasa ma Tuhan maka ma pagkahina, pataptap iya ma Tuhan, maka Tuhan isab pataptap ma iya.

verses.name: I John 4:17
verses.text: Pinasampulna' lasatam supaya kita mbal agawa bang ta'abut llaw pangahukum Tuhan ma manusiya'. Mbal kita tināw sabab sali' du kahālantam ma dunya itu maka kahālan Al-Masi.

verses.name: I John 4:18
verses.text: Bang b'nnal to'ongan lasata, mbal du kalamuran tāw, sabab bang tinubus na lasata pahalam tāwta. Sasuku masi makananam tāw halam gi' asampulna' lasana, sabab tināw iya bininasa e' Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8536" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4202"/><div sID="gen8537" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4202"/> Angkan kitam alasa ma Tuhan sabab dahū iya bay alasahan kitam.

verses.name: I John 4:20
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' amūng in iya alasa ma Tuhan bo' masi kab'nsihanna pagkahina, putingan a'a inān. Sabab bang mbal kalasahanna pagkahina ya ta'nda'na, daka buwattingga e'na alasahan Tuhan ya halam ta'nda'na.

verses.name: I John 4:21
verses.text: Ya na itu panoho'an Al-Masi ma kitam: sasuku alasa ma Tuhan subay alasa isab ma pagkahina.  <div eID="gen8537" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="1John.4"/> <div eID="gen8532" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4203"/><div sID="gen8538" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Da'ugantam min Kala'atan Dunya</title> <div sID="gen8539" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4203"/> Sasuku magkahagad in si Isa asal Al-Masi ya tapene' e' Tuhan, a'a inān anak Tuhan. Bang kita alasa ma a'a, kalasahanta isab anakna.

verses.name: I John 5:2
verses.text: Minnē' kata'uwantam, bang kita alasa ma Tuhan maka bang beya'ta isab panoho'anna, tantu kita alasa ma panganakna.

verses.name: I John 5:3
verses.text: Hatina bang kita sab'nnal alasa ma Tuhan, subay beya'ta panoho'anna. Maka panoho'anna mbal sakit abuhat.

verses.name: I John 5:4
verses.text: Sabab sasuku kita bay tahinang anak e' Tuhan, tara'ugta na sasat dunya itu. Min pangandolta ma Al-Masi ya angkan kita makapanganda'ug.

verses.name: I John 5:5
verses.text: Jari sai lagi' ya makara'ug min kala'atan dunya itu? Luwal sasuku ya amarassaya ma si Isa, ya Anak Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8539" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8538" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4204"/><div sID="gen8540" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saksi' Pasal si Isa Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8541" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4204"/> Si Isa Al-Masi bay pi'itu ni dunya labay min bohe' maka laha'. Ngga'i ka hal bohe', sagō' laha' isab bay kamatayanna. Rū Tuhan ya anaksi' sabab in iya po'onan kasab'nnalan.

verses.name: I John 5:7
verses.text: Manjari maguyun t'llu saksi' itu:

verses.name: I John 5:8
verses.text: Rū Tuhan, maka bohe', maka laha'.

verses.name: I John 5:9
verses.text: Magkahagad kita bang saksi' min manusiya', sagō' akosog lagi' saksi' min Tuhan sabab saksi' Tuhan ko', ya bay pangallamna pasal Anakna.

verses.name: I John 5:10
verses.text: Manjari sasuku amarassaya ma Anak Tuhan, aniya' isab saksi' ma deyom itikadna. Sagō' sasuku mbal amarassaya ma Tuhan, amahiputing iya ma Tuhan pagka halam kahagadna panaksi' ya bay pamuwan e' Tuhan pasal anakna.

verses.name: I John 5:11
verses.text: Ya na itu lapal saksi' min Tuhan: Tuhan ya bay amuwanan kitam kallum kakkal ni kasaumulan, maka kallum kakkal itu bay min Anakna.

verses.name: I John 5:12
verses.text: Sasuku parakayu' to'ongan ni Anak Tuhan, ma iya asal kallum itu. Sasuku isab halam makarakayu', halam aniya' kallumna kakkal.  <div eID="gen8541" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8540" type="section"/>

verses.name: I John 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4205"/><div sID="gen8542" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Kallum Kakkal</title> <div sID="gen8543" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4205"/> Sulatanta kam bo' kata'uwanbi in ka'am taga-kallum kakkal salama-lama, sasuku kam amarassaya ma Anak Tuhan.

verses.name: I John 5:14
verses.text: Halam aniya' hawal-hawaltam paharap ni Tuhan, sabab tantu kinale ai-ai panabbuttam bang pa'in min kahandakna.

verses.name: I John 5:15
verses.text: Kata'uwantam isab, tantu kitam pinaniya'an ai-ai bay panabbuttam.  <div eID="gen8543" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4206"/><div sID="gen8544" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4206"/> Bang aniya' maka'nda' danakanna magdusa bo' ngga'i ka dusa pagmulka'an Tuhan, subay iya angamu' tabang ni Tuhan. Jari kabuwanan kallum danakanna he' bang pa'in ngga'i ka dusa pagmulka'an. B'nnal aniya' dusa pagmulka'an Tuhan, mbal yukku in ka'am subay angamu'-ngamu' pasal dusa buwattē'.

verses.name: I John 5:17
verses.text: Dusa asal kahinangan ala'at kamemon, sagō' aniya' dusa mbal pagmulka'an Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8544" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4207"/><div sID="gen8545" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4207"/> Kata'uwanta, sasuku bay tahinang panganak Tuhan mbal pinasangdan dusana sabab nihampanan iya e' Anak Tuhan, ati mbal ya ta'abut e' saitan Patila'atun.

verses.name: I John 5:19
verses.text: Kata'uwanta in kitam suku' Tuhan na, sagō' in a'a kaheka'an ma dunya itu masi kapagbaya'an e' saitan Patila'atun.

verses.name: I John 5:20
verses.text: Kata'uwanta, in Anak Tuhan bay pi'itu ni dunya sampay amuwanan kita panghati bo' supaya kata'uwanta Tuhan b'nnal. Maka parakayu' na kita ni Tuhan b'nnal itu maka ni Anakna si Isa Al-Masi. Ya na itu Tuhan b'nnal, iya ya po'onan kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen8545" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: I John 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4208"/><div sID="gen8546" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4208"/> Saga anak-mpuku, pahalli' kam bo' kam mbal kapagtuhanan e' saddī min Tuhan. <signed sID="gen8547"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8547"/>  <div eID="gen8546" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8542" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8485" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="1John.5"/> <div eID="gen8478" osisID="1John" type="book"/>

verses.name: II John 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, dakayu' pagmatto'ahan, pinabeya' ni dakayu' d'nda tapene' e' Tuhan sampay ni saga panganakna. Alasahan aku ka'am sab'nnal-b'nnal. Lāgi ngga'i ka hal aku, sampay a'a kamemon ya ata'uwan kasab'nnalan, alasa du isab ma ka'am.

verses.name: II John 1:2
verses.text: Alasa kami ma sabab kasab'nnalan ma deyom pangatayantam, ya pataptap ma kitam sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8553" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II John 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4209"/><div sID="gen8554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4209"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kitam pinaniya'an tatabangan maka ase' maka kasannangan atay, deyo' min Mma'tam Tuhan maka min si Isa Al-Masi Anakna. Bang pa'in pinama-kitam luwas min kasab'nnalanna maka min lasana.  <div eID="gen8554" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II John 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4210"/><div sID="gen8555" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kasab'nnalan maka Lasa</title> <div sID="gen8556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4210"/> Landu' aku kinōgan pagka aku kahaka'an aniya' panganaknu kasehe'an ameya' ma kasab'nnalan, buwat bay panoho'an kitam e' Mma'tam Tuhan.

verses.name: II John 1:5
verses.text: Jari aniya' amu'ku ni ka'a, arung: beya'un panoho'an ya sulatku itu. Ngga'i ka panoho'an baha'u, sagō' panoho'an bay ma kitam sangay min katagna' gi', ya yuk-i: maglasa-liyasahi kam.

verses.name: II John 1:6
verses.text: Ya lasa pah'llingku itu, iya na palantaratam ameya' na pa'in ma panoho'an Tuhan. Buwat bay takalebi sangay min katagna', in kitam sinō' taptap maglasa-liyasahi.  <div eID="gen8556" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II John 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4211"/><div sID="gen8557" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4211"/> Aheka a'a pangakkal ma dunya, a'a mbal angaku in si Isa Al-Masi bay pi'itu ni dunya magbaran manusiya'. Pandogahinbi a'a buwattē' sabab Pangangakkal maka Banta ko' inān, ya kuntara Al-Masi.

verses.name: II John 1:8
verses.text: Halli'inbi sigām bo' mbal kaliman bay pagsangsā'antam ati bo' tasambutbi kamemon ya panungbas ka'am.

verses.name: II John 1:9
verses.text: Sai-sai mbal pataptap ma pandu' bay min Al-Masi, bo' paliyu gom pa'in minnē', halam ma iya Tuhan. Ya balikna, sai-sai pataptap na pa'in, ina'an ma iya Tuhan Mma' maka Anakna.

verses.name: II John 1:10
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' pi'ilu ni ka'am, bo' mbal maguyun pandu'na maka pandu' Al-Masi, da'a pareyomunbi ni luma'bi. Da'a minsan saginahunbi,

verses.name: II John 1:11
verses.text: sabab sai-sai anagina a'a buwattē' taga-lamud na ma kahinanganna ala'at.  <div eID="gen8557" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8555" type="section"/>

verses.name: II John 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4212"/><div sID="gen8558" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Panangbusan</title> <div sID="gen8559" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4212"/> Aheka gi' pangahakaku ni ka'am sagō' mbal aku bilahi amataha' sulat itu. Aholat aku kalu makatibaw pi'ilu magsuli-suli pabaihu' maka ka'am, ati bo' ajukup kakoyagantam.  <div eID="gen8559" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: II John 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4213"/><div sID="gen8560" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4213"/> Saga anak danakanbi d'nda ya tapene' e' Tuhan, amabeya' ni ka'am minsan la'a hal lapal sigām. <signed sID="gen8561"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8561"/>  <div eID="gen8560" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8558" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8552" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="2John.1"/> <div eID="gen8548" osisID="2John" type="book"/>

verses.name: III John 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, dakayu' pagmatto'ahanbi, pinasampay ni si Gayus, bagay kalasahanku sab'nnal-b'nnal.

verses.name: III John 1:2
verses.text: Bagay, ya amu'ku ni Tuhan bang pa'in ahāp labayannu kamemon, bang pa'in ahāp anggauta'nu, pinasali' ni kahāp ataynu tudju ni Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8567" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4214"/><div sID="gen8568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4214"/> Landu' aku kinōgan pagka aniya' saga danakanta bay at'kka pi'itu angahaka'an aku ma pasalannu. In ka'a kono' ahogot to'ongan pamalutnu ma pandu' b'nnal. At'ttog asal pameya'nu ma kal'ngnganan b'nnal.

verses.name: III John 1:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' makalasig atayku liyu min habal pasal saga panganakku ameya' na pa'in ma kal'ngnganan b'nnal.  <div eID="gen8568" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4215"/><div sID="gen8569" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4215"/> Bagay, atuyu' asal ka ma hinangnu amatuntul saga danakanta bebeya'an Al-Masi, minsan a'a mbal takilānu.

verses.name: III John 1:6
verses.text: Sinuli-suli lasanu e' sigām ni saga jama'a Al-Masi ma palhimpunan itu. Ahāp asal hinangnu amatuntul saga inān song sigām pauntas ni pal'ngnganan sigām. Makasulut Tuhan ko' ilu.

verses.name: III John 1:7
