verses.text: Saga a'a itu bay angalanjalan l'ngngan sigām ma sabab ōn si Isa ya panabbutan sigām, maka halam aniya' tabang tasambut sigām min a'a ya mbal magkahagad ma si Isa.

verses.name: III John 1:8
verses.text: Patut kita angayuput saga a'a buwattē', bo' aniya' lamudta ma hinang sigām magnasihat pandu' b'nnal.  <div eID="gen8569" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4216"/><div sID="gen8570" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4216"/> Bay na aku amabeya' sulat ni saga jama'a si Isa Al-Masi mailu, sagō' si Diyutripi, ya bilahi magmakōk ma palhimpunan sigām, mbal to'ongan angasip.

verses.name: III John 1:10
verses.text: Angkan bang aku pi'ilu bangkilku du bay hinangna maka bay pangalimutna m'ssa' bidda' ma pasalan kami. Maka mbal gi' iya ka'amuhan ma hinangna buwattē', angkan paruhunna gom pa'in. Mbal taima'na saga dauranakanta ya pahapit pi'ilu magnasihat, maka nilāng e'na sasuku bilahi anaima', pinaokat isab min palhimpunanbi!  <div eID="gen8570" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4217"/><div sID="gen8571" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4217"/> Bagayku kalasahanku, da'a sengorin addat-tabi'at ala'at. Sengorin addat-tabi'at ahāp. Sasuku maghinang kahāpan suku' Tuhan iya, sagō' sasuku maghinang kala'atan halam aniya' kata'una ma Tuhan.

verses.name: III John 1:12
verses.text: Si Dimitri ilu sinaksi'an sangkahāpan e' a'a kamemon, maka saksi' sigām maguyun du maka kasab'nnalan. Kami isab saksi'na, maka kata'uwannu in saksi' kami b'nnal sadja.  <div eID="gen8571" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4218"/><div sID="gen8572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4218"/> Aheka gi' pangahakaku ka'a sagō' mbal aku bilahi amataha' sulat itu.

verses.name: III John 1:14
verses.text: Aholat aku makasa'ut pi'ilu mag'nda' maka ka'a bo' kita makapagtampal bissala.  <div eID="gen8572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: III John 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4219"/><div sID="gen8573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4219"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka kaniya'an kasannangan deyom atay. Amabeya' kamemon saga bagay kami maitu minsan la'a hal lapal sigām. Haka'in saga bagay kami mailu dangan maka dangan, in sigām masi nientom. <signed sID="gen8574"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8574"/>  <div eID="gen8573" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8566" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="3John.1"/> <div eID="gen8562" osisID="3John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:1
verses.text: Sulat itu min aku, si Judas, dakayu' sosoho'an si Isa Al-Masi, maka danakan si Yakub. Pasampayku sulat itu ni ka'am saga a'a tapene' maka kinalasahan e' Tuhan, ya niokoman e' si Isa Al-Masi.  <div eID="gen8582" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4220"/><div sID="gen8583" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4220"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an ase' maka lasa ballabi-labihan, sampay kasannangan deyom atay.  <div eID="gen8583" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4221"/><div sID="gen8584" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kamaujuran saga A'a Mbal Angisbat Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8585" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4221"/> Sagay bagayku kinalasahan, landu' aku bilahi anulatan ka'am pasal kalappasan ya pagkahagarantam sali'-sali', sagō' saddī ya panulatku ma ka'am buwattina'an. Ya pangamay-ngamayku ma ka'am: t'nggehinbi pandu' b'nnal ya bay pangandol pinam'nt'dda e' Tuhan ma saga a'a suku'na.

verses.name: Jude 1:4
verses.text: Aniya' saga a'a mbal magmatāw ma Tuhan makalamud ni ka'am ma halam kata'uwanbi, angkan kam amay-amayanku pahāp. Pinabengkok e' sigām pamandu' pasal ase' maka lasa Tuhantam, bo' aniya' panganda'awahan sigām maghinang kalumu'an. Tapaliluhan e' sigām si Isa Al-Masi, ya tunggal Panghū'tam Sangat Kawasa. Tasulat asal ma masa awal lagi' pasal hukuman ya pangangganta' ma saga a'a buwattē'.  <div eID="gen8585" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4222"/><div sID="gen8586" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4222"/> Minsan kasakupanbi bay kahālan bangsa Isra'il ma masa awal, bilahi gi' aku amaentoman ka'am pasal waktu kabanyaga' sigām ma lahat Misil. Bay sigām niliyus e' Panghū' min lahat Misil sagō' puwas e' bay papatayna sasuku mbal magkahagad ma iya.

verses.name: Jude 1:6
verses.text: Entomunbi isāb pasal saga mala'ikat kasehe', ya bay angaliyu-lakad min kapatutan bay pangangganta' Tuhan ma sigām bo' ang'bba min pat'nna'an sigām luggiya'. Wa'i sigām tinambolan e' Tuhan ma deyom kalendoman bitu-bituhan, binaggot maka kili-kili kakkal ni kasaumulan, sampay ta'abut Llaw Aheya pangahukum Tuhan ma sigām.

verses.name: Jude 1:7
verses.text: Entomunbi isāb saga a'a bay ma da'ira Sodom maka Gomora sampay ma saga kaluma'an ma sakalibutna. Tagihan sigām maghinang kalumu'an maka kasabulan makatamparasa, ati pinat'kkahan sigām api mbal magkap'dda bo' aniya' pamintāngan ma a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen8586" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4223"/><div sID="gen8587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4223"/> Buwattē' isāb saga a'a ma deyomanbi ilu. Anguppi na pa'in sigām ati katamakan anggauta'-baran sigām. Sinulak e' sigām kapagbaya' Tuhan, nilimut bangsa mala'ikat ya landu' asahaya.

verses.name: Jude 1:9
verses.text: Minsan si Mika'il, ya pagnakura'an saga mala'ikat, mbal makatawakkal angalimut ma nakura' saitan, waktu kapaglugat sigā. Ya sadja pah'lling si Mika'il, “Panghū' Tuhan ya amabukagan ka'a.”

verses.name: Jude 1:10
verses.text: Malaingkan maghimumūngan na pa'in saga a'a ya sambatku ma sulat itu. Akasla pah'lling sigām pasal ai-ai ya mbal tahati e' sigām. Sali' sigām hayop angandūlan ai-ai kanapsuhan sigām, angkan sigām kamulahan.  <div eID="gen8587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4224"/><div sID="gen8588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4224"/> Maka'ase'-ase' sidda saga a'a inān sabab sinengoran e' sigām kajarihan si Kabil. Bineya'-beya' e' sigām kasā'an si Bala'am, sabab ya du sigām tabowa e' bahaya pilak. Anagga' sigām ma Tuhan, buwat bay kapanagga' disi Kora ma masa awal e', ati alaglag isab sigām.  <div eID="gen8588" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4225"/><div sID="gen8589" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4225"/> Saga a'a ilu sali' dalil tamak ma pagjamubi, ya hinangbi tanda' sin paglasabi. Mbal sigām ata'u aiya' sabab halam aniya' pangannal sigām saddī, luwal baran sigām. Sapantun sigām gabun mbal amuwan ulan, gabun tabowa paleyang e' baliyu. Sapantun isab sigām po'on kayu mbal amuwan buwa' minsan musimna na, angkan binubut sampay gamutna. Jari minduwa kamatay saga a'a inān.

verses.name: Jude 1:13
verses.text: Sapantun sigām goyak ma timpu badju. In kaiya'an sigām sali' bula'-bula' goyak bang am'ssa'. Ibarat sigām bitu'un maglensa, mbal tapamandogahan. Kalendoman bitu-bituhan ya katobtoban sigām sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8589" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4226"/><div sID="gen8590" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4226"/> Bay angallam nabi Idris, ya panubu' si Adam min nnom pangkat, ma pasal a'a buwattilu, yuk-i, “Pata'u kam. Pi'itu du Panghū'tam maka mala'ikatna sussi magibu-ibuhan,

verses.name: Jude 1:15
verses.text: bo' tahukum e'na manusiya' kamemon. Pinatōngan e'na dusa saga a'a agagga ma iya, ma sabab kala'atan ya tahinang sigām luwas min kajarihan sigām ala'at, maka ma sabab lling pangkal kamemon bay pamissala e' sigām ni Tuhan.”

verses.name: Jude 1:16
verses.text: Magdurugal maka magsosoway saga a'a inān. Tagihan sigām angandūlan napsu sigām ala'at, maka magbantug-bantug di-sigām. Nilanahan e' sigām a'a kasehe'an bo' supaya karūlan ai-ai kabaya'an sigām.  <div eID="gen8590" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8584" type="section"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4227"/><div sID="gen8591" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Pangamay-ngamay</title> <div sID="gen8592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4227"/> Sagō' saddī ma ka'am, saga bagayku. Entomunbi bay pangallam e' saga a'a kawakilan e' Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Jude 1:18
verses.text: Yuk sigām ma ka'am, “Bang song na kahinapusan masa itu, paniya' saga a'a angudju'-ngudju' ka'am, a'a hal angandūlan napsu sigām minsan pangalāngan e' Tuhan.”

verses.name: Jude 1:19
verses.text: Bilahi saga a'a inān angahinang okatan ma saga jama'a Al-Masi. Pinagbaya'an sigām e' napsu baran sigām maka halam ma sigām Rū Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4228"/><div sID="gen8593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4228"/> Saguwā' ka'am, saga bagay, subay magpakosog di-bi bo' ahogot pagkahagadbi ma pandu' sussi ya pangandolanbi. Subay kam angamu' duwa'a isab min kawasa Rū Sussi.

verses.name: Jude 1:21
verses.text: Pahogot kam ma lasa Tuhan samantala' kam angalagaran si Isa Al-Masi Panghū'tam, ya amuwanan ka'am kallum taptap ni kasaumulan ma sabab ka'ase'na.  <div eID="gen8593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4229"/><div sID="gen8594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4229"/> Ma'ase' kam ma saga sehe'bi ya magāng-āng angandol ma si Isa.

verses.name: Jude 1:23
verses.text: Liyusunbi saga a'a ya song magnikala'atan, ibarat a'a song ahūg ni api. Ka'ase'inbi pahāp saga a'a kasehe'an, sagō' tangkisinbi kala'atan sigām bo' kam mbal kalaminan. Kab'nsihinbi napsu sigām, ya sali' hantang l'mmis makatupak badju'.  <div eID="gen8594" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8591" type="section"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4230"/><div sID="gen8595" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pamudji ni Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4230"/> Magpudji kitam ni Tuhan. Luwal iya taga-kawasa angahampanan kitam bo' mbal tabowa maghinang dusa pabīng. Pinatampal kitam e'na ni haddaratna asahaya ma halam aniya' tamak atay. Aheya isab pagkōg-koyagtam.

verses.name: Jude 1:25
verses.text: Luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' ya amuwasan kitam min hukuman dusa, angkan iya subay pudjitam labay min Panghū'tam si Isa Al-Masi. Sabab ma iya kasanglitan, kabantugan, ga'osan maka kawasahan, min awal tagna' sampay ni kabuwattituhan, sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin. <signed sID="gen8597"/> Wassalam<signed eID="gen8597"/>  <div eID="gen8596" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8595" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8581" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Jude.1"/> <div eID="gen8575" osisID="Jude" type="book"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:1
verses.text: Jūd pasal pakaradja'an song paniya', ya pamata'u e' Tuhan ma si Isa Al-Masi sinō' pamabukis ma iya ni saga sosoho'anna. Pinabukis e' si Isa labay min mala'ikatna ya papehē'na ni sosoho'anna si Yahiya. Jari si Yahiya ya anaksi' ma deyom jūd itu pasal kamemon ta'nda'na.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:2
verses.text: Kasaksi'an e' si Yahiya kamemon bay ta'nda'na maka takalena, hatina pangallam Tuhan maka kasab'nnalan bay pamata'u e' si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:3
verses.text: Tantu isab pinaniya'an kahāpan sasuku amassa sulat itu pasal pakaradja'an sinosōng, damikiyanna sasuku akale maka angikut ma ai-ai tasulat maitu. Sabab asekot na waktu pamat'kka pakaradja'an itu kamemon.  <div eID="gen8605" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4231"/><div sID="gen8606" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagaddat maka Pagpudji</title> <div sID="gen8607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4231"/> Sulat itu deyo' min aku, si Yahiya, pinasampay ni pitu' palhimpunan jama'a si Isa ma kalingkal lahat Asiya. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tabang maka kasannangan atay min Tuhan, ya mbal magkapinda min awal sampay ni kabuwattituhan sampay isab ni kasaumulan, maka min Rū pitu' hekana ya ma dahuan tingkō'an Tuhan, maka min si Isa Al-Masi, ya kapangandolan ma saksi'na. Dahū asal iya pinakallum pabīng min kamatay. Magagi isab iya ma sasuku magnakura' ma kaluha'an dunya. <div eID="gen8607" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8608" type="paragraph"/> Pudji ni iya, ya alasa ma kitam. Tapapuwas kitam e'na min paldusahan ma sabab laha'na ya pinabu'us ma kamatayna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4231"/><div sID="gen8606" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pagaddat maka Pagpudji</title> <div sID="gen8607" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4231"/> Sulat itu deyo' min aku, si Yahiya, pinasampay ni pitu' palhimpunan jama'a si Isa ma kalingkal lahat Asiya. Mura-murahan, bang pa'in kam pinaniya'an tabang maka kasannangan atay min Tuhan, ya mbal magkapinda min awal sampay ni kabuwattituhan sampay isab ni kasaumulan, maka min Rū pitu' hekana ya ma dahuan tingkō'an Tuhan, maka min si Isa Al-Masi, ya kapangandolan ma saksi'na. Dahū asal iya pinakallum pabīng min kamatay. Magagi isab iya ma sasuku magnakura' ma kaluha'an dunya. <div eID="gen8607" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8608" type="paragraph"/> Pudji ni iya, ya alasa ma kitam. Tapapuwas kitam e'na min paldusahan ma sabab laha'na ya pinabu'us ma kamatayna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:6
verses.text: Tahinangna kitam bangsa sultan, tumpukan kaimaman maghinang ni Tuhan, ya Mma'na. Angkan subay sanglitantam Al-Masi itu, in iya sangat kawasa sampay ni kasaumulan. Amin. <lg sID="gen8609"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8610"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:7
verses.text: Pajaga kam. Ilu si Isa Al-Masi song pi'itu, ameya' min gabun.<l eID="gen8610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8611"/>Ta'nda' du iya e' manusiya' kamemon<l eID="gen8611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8612"/>sampay e' saga a'a bay angahiyak iya.<l eID="gen8612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8613"/>Kamemon bangsa ma dunya itu magkarukka'an du ma sababna.<l eID="gen8613" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8614"/>Aho', bang du pa'in. Amin.<l eID="gen8614" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8609"/>  <div eID="gen8608" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4232"/><div sID="gen8615" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4232"/> “Aku ya Alip maka Ya',” yuk Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, “Aku in Panghū' ya mbal magkapinda sangay min awal sampay ni kabuwattituhan, sampay ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen8615" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8606" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4233"/><div sID="gen8616" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magpanyata' Al-Masi</title> <div sID="gen8617" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4233"/> Aku itu si Yahiya dakayu' danakanbi. Dansehe'an kitam ma deyoman si Isa, angkan aku taga-lamud ma ka'am angimanan kasigpitan maka kabinasahan, ya pinaniya'an sai-sai pasuku' ni pagparinta si Isa. Bay aku pinalawak pehē' ni pū' Patmos ma sabab panganasihatku palman Tuhan, maka ma sabab lapal kasab'nnalan bay pamata'u e' si Isa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:10
verses.text: Manjari aniya' dakayu' llaw, llaw Panghū' Isa, bay aku kapagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan. Makakale aku suwala akosog ma bukutanku, ahapal sali' lling tiyup-tiyup.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:11
verses.text: Yuk suwala inān, “Sulatun ai-ai ta'nda'nu ati pabeya'un ni saga jama'a ya magtipun ma pitu' da'ira itu: ni Epesos, Ismirna, Pergamo, Tiyatira, Sardis, Piladilpi, maka ni Laodikiya.”  <div eID="gen8617" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4234"/><div sID="gen8618" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4234"/> Sakali palingi' aku ang'nda' bang sai ya amissala ni aku. Paglingi'ku pa'in, maka'nda' aku pitu' papagan bulawan pamat'nna'an palita'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:13
verses.text: Maina'an, ma t'ngnga' saga papagan palita'an inān, aniya' dangan an'ngge, angaluwa manusiya'. Ya pakayanna pa'abut ni tape'na, maka aniya' kambot bulawan palebod ma daggahana.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:14
verses.text: Bu'unna apote' to'ongan buwat pote' tawas, maka parallet matana, pinaka na api.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:15
verses.text: Tape'na inān magsinglab sali' tumbaga bay sinubuhan ni api bo' yampa nilanu'an. Ya suwalana inān sali' lagublub bohe' anasahan min diyata'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:16
verses.text: Aniya' pitu' bitu'un balutanna ma tanganna kowan, maka aniya' takos paluwas min bowa'na, atalom solabna karuwambila'. Baihu'na aninag sali' silak llaw bang augtu na.  <div eID="gen8618" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4235"/><div sID="gen8619" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4235"/> Pag'nda'ku ni iya, magtūy aku pahantak ma atag tape'na, bā'nu aku amatay. Daipara pinat'nna' e'na tanganna kowan ni aku, maka e'na ah'lling. Yukna, “Da'a ka atāw! Aku ya Tagna'an maka Kahinapusan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:18
verses.text: Aku dakayu'-kayu' ya asal allum. Bay na aku amatay, sagō' nda'un itu, allum na aku pabīng sampay ni kasaumulan. Aku ya taga-kawasa magagi ma kamatay sampay ma lahat saga a'a magpatayan.  <div eID="gen8619" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4236"/><div sID="gen8620" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4236"/> “Na, sulatun,” yukna, “kamemon bay ta'nda'nu maina'an sī', maka ya ta'nda'nu ma buwattina'an, maka ya paniya' isab ma waktu sinōng.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:20
verses.text: Pamahatiku na pasal pitu' bitu'un bay ta'nda'nu ma tanganku kowan maka pasal pitu' papagan palita'an bulawan. Ya na itu hatina: in pitu' bitu'un itu, ya na pitu' mala'ikat ang'ntanan pitu' palhimpunan jama'aku. In pitu' papagan palita'an, ya na pitu' palhimpunan.”  <div eID="gen8620" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.1"/> <div eID="gen8616" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4237"/><div sID="gen8621" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Epesos</title> <div sID="gen8622" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4237"/> Yukna gi', “Sulatun lapal itu bo' pabeya'un ni mala'ikat dakayu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Epesos. <div eID="gen8622" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8623" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya amowa pitu' bitu'un ma tanganku kowan, maka magl'ngngan pehē'-pi'itu ma deyoman pitu' papagan palita'an bulawan itu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:2
verses.text: Kata'uwanku hinangbi. Kata'uwanku isab kapanuyu'bi maghulas-sangsā', maka ma kosogbi anandalan kasigpitan ai-ai. Kata'uwanku isab mbal kaimananbi saga a'a maghinang kala'atan. Bay na tapariksa'bi to'ongan saga a'a magnahu'-nahu' in sigām bay kawakilan e'ku, ati minnē' kata'uwanbi saga a'a inān magputing.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:3
verses.text: Kata'uwanku isab in ka'am aiman asal. Bay sandalanbi kasigpitan ai-ai ma pasalku, maka halam bay bbahanbi imanbi.  <div eID="gen8623" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4238"/><div sID="gen8624" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4238"/> Sagō' aniya' panowayku ma ka'am, sabab lasabi ma aku ngga'i ka buwat bay ka'ina tagna'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:5
verses.text: Entomunbi bay kaheya lasabi tagna', apinda na to'ongan. Taikutinbi na dusabi, jari hinangunbi kahāpan buwat bay hinangbi tagna'. Bang mbal taikutanbi dusabi magbaran du aku pi'ilu ni ka'am angala'anan palita'anbi min pat'nna'anna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:6
verses.text: Sagō' kasulutan isab aku ma ka'am sabab ka'mbalanbi hinang saga a'a magpameya' ma umpigan Nikulai, ya ka'mbalanku isab.  <div eID="gen8624" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4239"/><div sID="gen8625" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4239"/> Na, ka'am kamemon ya taga-tainga, asipunbi to'ongan pamissala Rū Tuhan ni saga palhimpunan jama'aku. Sai-sai mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, buwananku iya kapatut amangan buwa' min kayu ya makabuwan kallum salama-lama, ya patomo' mahē' ma lahat Tuhan.”  <div eID="gen8625" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8621" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4240"/><div sID="gen8626" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Ismirna</title> <div sID="gen8627" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4240"/> “Sulatun isab lapal itu ni mala'ikat pasunu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Ismirna. <div eID="gen8627" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8628" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya Tagna'an maka Kahinapusan. Bay aku amatay, bo' allum na pabīng.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:9
verses.text: Kata'uwanku kabinasahan ya kalabayanbi ilu, maka ya kahālan kamiskinbi, saguwā' ya b'nnalna taga-karaya kam aheya. Kata'uwanku isab bang ai pangalimut ka'am e' a'a magnahu'-nahu' in sigām Yahudi a'a suku' Tuhan, bo' pa'in ngga'i ka. Saga a'a inān dansehe'an asal maka saga a'a bebeya'an nakura' saitan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:10
verses.text: Da'a katāwinbi saga kabinasahan ya song pat'kka ni ka'am. Pakale kam! Sōng kam sinulayan e' nakura' saitan bo' kam apinda min pagimanbi. Aniya' kam ni'isi ni deyom kalabusu, ati sangpū' ng'llaw ya t'ggol kapangananambi kabinasahan. Sagō' pat'ttog kam angandol ma aku minsan kamatay ya sōngbi, sabab tungbasanta du kam kallum saumul-umul.  <div eID="gen8628" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4241"/><div sID="gen8629" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4241"/> Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi to'ongan pamissala Rū Tuhan itu, ya pinasampay ni palhimpunan jama'aku. Sai-sai mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat mbal du makananam kap'ddi'an ma deyom nalka', ya pinagbahasa kamatay kaminduwana.”  <div eID="gen8629" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8626" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4242"/><div sID="gen8630" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Pergamo</title> <div sID="gen8631" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4242"/> “Sulatun isab lapal itu ni mala'ikat pasunu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Pergamo. <div eID="gen8631" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8632" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya amowa takos atalom solabna karuwambila'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:13
verses.text: Kata'uwanku bang ma'ai paglahatanbi. Ina'an kam ma lahat binabantug sabab pagsusumbahan ni nakura' saitan. Saguwā' minsan buwattē', ahogot pameya'bi ma aku. Halam bay butawananbi pagimanbi ni aku minsan waktu bay pamapatay ma si Antipas e'. Kapangandolan iya magnasihat ma pasalku, angkanna iya bay binono' ma lahat nakura' saitan ilu.  <div eID="gen8632" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4243"/><div sID="gen8633" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4243"/> Sagō' aniya' panowayku ma ka'am. Muna-muna, aniya' min ka'am ilu ameya'-meya' ma pandu' si Bala'am, ya bay ma masa awal e'. Si Bala'am e' bay amandu'an si Balak amowa bangsa Isra'il magdusa ni Tuhan, ati takakan e' sigām pagkakan haram ya bay paglamas ni ta'u-ta'u. Bay isab sigām magkarupangan d'nda-l'lla.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:15
verses.text: Karuwana, aniya' isab min ka'am ameya'-meya' ma pandu' umpigan Nikulai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:16
verses.text: Angkan kam subay pataikut min dusabi. Bang kam ganta' mbal, pasa'ut aku pi'ilu ati atuhanku saga a'a ilu. Pangatuku pakokos ya paluwas min bowa'ku.  <div eID="gen8633" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4244"/><div sID="gen8634" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4244"/> Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi to'ongan pamissala Rū Tuhan itu, ya pinasampay ni palhimpunan jama'aku. Sai-sai mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, buwananku sigām kinakan mbal ta'nda' e' kasehe'an, kinakan min deyom sulga' ya niōnan manna. Toporanku isab sigām batu pote' bay kasulatan ōn sigām baha'u. Halam aniya' makata'uwan ōn inān saddī min a'a asal makataima' iya.”  <div eID="gen8634" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8630" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4245"/><div sID="gen8635" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Tiyatira</title> <div sID="gen8636" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4245"/> “Sulatun na isab lapal itu ni mala'ikat pasunu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Tiyatira. <div eID="gen8636" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8637" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, Anak Tuhan. Mataku itu parallet sali' suleyab api, tape'ku itu magsinglab sali' tumbaga bay sinubuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:19
verses.text: Kata'uwanku kahinanganbi. Kata'uwanku in lasabi aheya, maka pangandolbi ma aku ahogot, maka akosog isab panabangbi ma pagkahibi, maka panandalbi ma kasigpitan ai-ai. Ahāp lagi' kahinanganbi buwattina'an min bay dahū.  <div eID="gen8637" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4246"/><div sID="gen8638" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4246"/> Saguwā' aniya' panowayku ma ka'am. Ilu pasagaranbi si Jesebel, ya d'nda magnahu'-nahu' in iya magpalatun palman min Tuhan. Tabowa saga sosoho'anku magdusa sabab min pamandu'na. Tabowana sigām maghinang kasabulan d'nda maka l'lla, sampay amangan kinakan haram ya bay pangalamas ni ta'u-ta'u.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:21
verses.text: Bay na patangguku d'nda inān, kalu iya apinda min paldusahanna. Sagō' mbal iya bilahi ang'bba min pagba'is-ba'isna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:22
verses.text: Pahantakku iya ma pabahakanna sabab saki, ati makananam iya kabinasahan. Ya du saga sehe'na maghinang ala'at, bowaku isab angananam kabinasahan aheya bang mbal pinagsusunan sampay tinaikutan saga kala'atan bay tahinang sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:23
verses.text: Papatayku isab saga a'a ameya' ma pandu' d'nda inān, bo' supaya kinata'uwan e' saga jama'aku kamemon ma palhimpunan sigām, in aku itu dakayu'-kayu' makasakupan akkal-pamikil maka itikad manusiya'. Tungbasanku kam isab kaniya-kaniya, pinapagtongod maka bay kahinanganbi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:24
verses.text: Sagō' ka'am kasehe'an ma Tiyatira ilu, halam bay ameya' ma pandu' si Jesebel e'. Halam isab bay anadbi pandu' magilmu' ya pinagōnan pandu' alalom min nakura' saitan. Haka'anta kam, mbal kam pahunitanku angkan itu sadja panoho'anku ka'am:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:25
verses.text: gomgominbi ai-ai bay pamasuku' ka'am, sampay ta'abut waktu kabalikku pi'ilu.  <div eID="gen8638" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4247"/><div sID="gen8639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4247"/> Sai-sai mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, maka atuyu' isab maghinang kabaya'anku sampay ni llaw kamatayna, buwananku du kawasa buwat bay pamuwan aku e' Mma'ku. Buwananku sigām kawasa magnakura' ma kabangsa-bangsahan. Ya bowahan pagnakura' sigām sali' hantang tungkud basi' mbal ka'atuhan, ati palbantahan sigām sali' bila' poga akaukanat sadja.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4247"/><div sID="gen8639" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4247"/> Sai-sai mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, maka atuyu' isab maghinang kabaya'anku sampay ni llaw kamatayna, buwananku du kawasa buwat bay pamuwan aku e' Mma'ku. Buwananku sigām kawasa magnakura' ma kabangsa-bangsahan. Ya bowahan pagnakura' sigām sali' hantang tungkud basi' mbal ka'atuhan, ati palbantahan sigām sali' bila' poga akaukanat sadja.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:28
verses.text: Buwananku isab sigām bitu'un maga.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:29
verses.text: Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi to'ongan pamissala Rū Tuhan ya pinasampay ni saga jama'aku ilu.”  <div eID="gen8639" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.2"/> <div eID="gen8635" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4248"/><div sID="gen8640" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Sardis</title> <div sID="gen8641" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4248"/> Amissala gi' ya a'a ta'nda'ku inān, yukna, “Sulatun lapal itu ni mala'ikat pasunu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Sardis. <div eID="gen8641" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8642" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya amowa Rū Tuhan maka bitu'un pitu' hekana. Kata'uwanku bang ai kahinanganbi. Kata'uwanku isab kabantugbi maghinang kabaya'anku, sagō' ngga'i ka ko' ilu b'nnal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:2
verses.text: Angkan kam subay pahalli'. Pahogotunbi pangandolbi ya masi takapin ilu, bo' mbal atighan kamemon. Ya kahinanganbi ilu, bang ma lilinganku isab, mbal gi' ajatu ma pang'nda' Tuhanku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:3
verses.text: Angkan pikilunbi saga pandu' bay takalebi tagna'. Beya'unbi na, pataikut kam min dusabi. Sagō' bang kam mbal pahalli', patangkaw du aku pi'ilu ma waktu mbal kata'uwanbi.  <div eID="gen8642" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4249"/><div sID="gen8643" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4249"/> Sagō' aniya' gi' min ka'am ma Sardis ilu halam kalaminan kala'atan. Bay asal halli'anbi ataybi, buwat hantang s'mmek nihalli'an bo' mbal katamakan. Papagdonganta kam maka aku ma apote' lullun pakayanbi, sabab tōp kam ameya' ma aku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:5
verses.text: Sasuku mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, pinas'mmekan du sigām pote' buwat yukku e', maka mbal papasanku ōn sigām min Kitab pagsusulatan ōn a'a ya kabuwanan kallum kakkal. Patanyagku ni Mma'ku maka ni saga mala'ikatna in a'a inān suku'ku na.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:6
verses.text: Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi to'ongan pamissala Rū Tuhan, ya pinasampay ni palhimpunan jama'aku.”  <div eID="gen8643" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8640" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4250"/><div sID="gen8644" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Piladilpi</title> <div sID="gen8645" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4250"/> “Sulatun lapal itu ni mala'ikat pasunu', ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Piladilpi. <div eID="gen8645" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8646" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya Mahasussi, ya Ab'nnal To'ongan. Aku ya ang'ntan kunsi' sultan Da'ud. Bang aku ya angukab halam aniya' makatambol. Damikiyanna bang aku ya anambol halam aniya' makaukab.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:8
verses.text: Kata'uwanku bang ai ya kahinanganbi. Kata'uwanku isab akulang ga'osbi, sagō' taisbatbi pandu'ku maka ahogot pameya'bi ma aku. Aniya' lawang bay ukabanku ka'am pasōranbi, lawang mbal tatambol minsan e' sai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:9
verses.text: Pakale kam! Saga a'a magbau'-bau' ilu in sigām bangsa Yahudi suku' Tuhan kono', hal magputing. Suku' saitan sigām. Ma waktu sinōng, bowaku du sigām pasujud ni tape'bi, jari kinata'uwan e' sigām kamemon in ka'am kalasahanku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:10
verses.text: Bay kam soho'ku angimanan ai-ai, ati katukiranbi panoho'anku he'. Angkan kam hampananku pahāp bo' halam aniya' baya-bayabi ma deyom kabinasahan ya pat'kka ni kaluha'an dunya ma sinosōng, kabinasahan panulayan a'a kamemon.  <div eID="gen8646" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4251"/><div sID="gen8647" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4251"/> Arai' na aku pi'ilu pabalik ni dunya. Gomgominbi pahāp ai-ai bay pamasuku' ka'am bo' supaya halam aniya' maka'agaw tungbas ya pamahala' ka'am.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:12
verses.text: Sasuku mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, paheyaku du ma haddarat Tuhan. Pataptap iya maina'an, mbal to'ongan ala'an minnē' salama-lama. Sulatku ōn Tuhanku ma baranna, maka ōn da'ira Tuhan ya niōnan Awrusalam Baha'u. Ya na ko' itu da'ira song pinareyo' min sulga', min Tuhanku. Sulatku isab ōnku baha'u ma baran saga a'aku inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:13
verses.text: Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi pamissala Rū Tuhan, ya pinasampay ni palhimpunan jama'aku.”  <div eID="gen8647" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8644" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4252"/><div sID="gen8648" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Lapal ni Palhimpunan Almasihin ma Laodikiya</title> <div sID="gen8649" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4252"/> “Sulatun lapal itu ni mala'ikat damuli, ya ang'ntanan palhimpunan jama'aku ma da'ira Laodikiya. <div eID="gen8649" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8650" type="paragraph"/> Buwattitu ya panulatnu: lapal itu deyo' min aku, ya niōnan Amin, ya tantu kapangandolan. B'nnal asal panaksi'ku. Aku ya po'onan ma kamemon bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:15
verses.text: Kata'uwanku isab kahinanganbi, in ka'am ma llot ameya' ma aku maka mbal, sali' hantang bohe' mbal papasu', mbal paringin. Ya kabaya'anku subay kam ano'ongan. Bang kam ameya' ma aku, ameya' kam to'ongan. Bang hati' mbal, da'a na.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:16
verses.text: Sagō' magduwa-ruwa lagi' pikilanbi ma pasalku, buwat bohe' bang ma llot apasu' maka aringin. Angkan kam ludja'anku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:17
verses.text: Yukbi in ka'am dayahan, ahāp kallumanbi. Yukbi halam aniya' sukkalbi. Sagō' ya b'nnalna, sali' kam hantang buta sabab halam tasayubi bang ai to'ongan kahālanbi. Asiya-siya kam, makahansul kam deyom atay, sabab miskin kam, hatina akulang pagimanbi. Sali' kam a'a halam aniya' kapan'mmekna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:18
verses.text: Angkan kam hūganku gara' buwattitu: b'llihunbi min aku bulawan halam aniya' simbugna bo' kam manjari dayahan. B'llihunbi min aku pakayan pote' pamakaybi bo' katambunan tamparasabi. B'llihunbi isab tambal min aku panambal matabi bo' kam maka'nda'.  <div eID="gen8650" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4253"/><div sID="gen8651" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4253"/> Sasuku kalasahanku, bi'atku na pa'in sampay sowayku supaya amintāng. Angkanna, panuyu'inbi kahāpan, pataikut kam min dusabi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:20
verses.text: Pakale kam! Itiya' aku angalagaran ka'am, sali' a'a an'ngge ma lawang luma'bi anguku' pikiukab. Bang aniya' angasip ma suwalaku sampay angukaban aku, pasōd du aku bo' kami magsalu.  <div eID="gen8651" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4254"/><div sID="gen8652" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4254"/> Sasuku anganda'ug maka mbal tabowa e' sasat-manasat, buwananku du kapatut magsamatingkō' maka aku ma tingkō'anku bangsahan. Pasali' du iya ni aku pagka tara'ugku palbantahanku ati aningkō' aku ma bihing Mma'ku, ma paningkō'anna bangsahan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:22
verses.text: Na, sai-sai kam taga-tainga, asipunbi pamissala Rū Tuhan, ya pinasampay ni saga palhimpunan jama'aku.”  <div eID="gen8652" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.3"/> <div eID="gen8648" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4255"/><div sID="gen8653" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pakaradja'an ma Deyom Sulga'</title> <div sID="gen8654" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4255"/> Puwas e' aniya' saddī pa'nda' ni aku. Aniya' ta'nda'ku lawang aukab ma deyom sulga'. Takaleku isab suwala ya bay amissala ni aku dahū, ya sali' lling tiyup-tiyup. Yukna, “Pariyata' ka pi'itu, pa'nda'anta ka saga pakaradja'an ya song pat'kka.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:2
verses.text: Saru'un-du'un du aku kapagbaya'an e' Rū Tuhan ati ta'nda'ku paningkō'an bangsahan ma deyom sulga', maka aniya' Dangan aningkō' ma diyata'na.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:3
verses.text: Angillap asal pamaihu'anna, buwat palmata gaddung maka palmata keyat. Paningkō'an inān alengkol e' biradali<note>Biradali: atawa salindugu'.</note> walna' gaddung.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:4
verses.text: Alibut isab e' duwampū' maka mpat paningkō'an saddī, paningkō'an e' duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan magpamakay pote', maka magpinorong korona bulawan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:5
verses.text: Ya paningkō'an ma t'ngnga' inān asal paluwasan lāt maka l'tte' maka l'ggon maglagublub, maka aniya' pitu' suwariyan parallet ma alopanna. Bang nihati, in pitu' suwariyan inān ya na Rū Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:6
verses.text: Aniya' isab ma dahuan paningkō'an inān pinaka s'llang aningaw-tingaw, sali' luwa samin. <div eID="gen8654" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8655" type="paragraph"/> Ta'nda'ku isab ma sakalibut paningkō'an, ma mpat duguna, aniya' mpat binatang<note>Binatang: atawa sattuwa palsuku'an Tuhan.</note>. Alapat baran sigām e' mata, min dahuan maka min bukutan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:7
verses.text: Ya pangluwahan dakayu' binatang inān buwat luwa halimaw. Karuwana buwat luwa sapi', kat'lluna buwat pamaihu'an manusiya', maka ka'mpatna inān buwat luwa belle' bang paleyang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:8
verses.text: In mpat binatang inān taga-kepet, nnom hekana pakaniya-pakaniya, maka alapat sigām e' mata deyom-luwasan. Halam aniya' halian sigām magkalang llaw-sangom, yuk-i, <div eID="gen8655" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8656" type="paragraph"/> “Sussi, sussi, sussi asal Tuhan, <div eID="gen8656" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8657" type="paragraph"/> ya Panghū' Sangat Kawasa. <div eID="gen8657" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8658" type="paragraph"/> In iya Tuhan mbal magkapinda sangay min awal tagna' <div eID="gen8658" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8659" type="paragraph"/> sampay ni kabuwattituhan, sampay isab ni kasaumulan.”  <div eID="gen8659" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4256"/><div sID="gen8660" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4256"/> Magkalang na pa'in mpat binatang inān, pagsanglit maka pagmahaldika' maka pagsukul sigām ni Tuhan kakkal salama-lama ya aningkō' ma tingkō'anna bangsahan. Sakahaba' waktu magkalang mpat binatang itu,

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:10
verses.text: magsujuran saga pagmatto'ahan karuwampū' maka mpat. Paharap sigām ni Dangan ya aningkō' ma tingkō'an e', ati amudji sigām ma iya, ya kakkal allum salama-lama. Pinat'nna' e' sigām saga korona bay paporong sigām ma dahuan paningkō'an bangsahan, bo' yampa sigām amaluwas bissala. Yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8661"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8662"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:11
verses.text: “O Tuhan, Panghū' kami, ka'a ya dakayu'-kayu'<l eID="gen8662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8663"/>patut sinanglitan sampay minahaldika'.<l eID="gen8663" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8664"/>Patut isab ka kaniya'an kawasa,<l eID="gen8664" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8665"/>sabab ka'a ya bay amapanjari kamemon.<l eID="gen8665" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8666"/>Asal min kahandaknu angkan pinaniya' ai-ai kamemon,<l eID="gen8666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8667"/>angkan kabuwanan kallum.”<l eID="gen8667" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8661"/>  <div eID="gen8660" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.4"/> <div eID="gen8653" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4257"/><div sID="gen8668" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Gulungan Katas maka Bili-bili</title> <div sID="gen8669" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4257"/> Manjari aniya' isab ta'nda'ku gulungan katas, ina'an binalutan ma tanganna kowan e' Dangan ya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan. Katas inān bay sinulatan min karuwambila'na maka bay pinikitan maka pitu' gindan bo' mbal pab'llat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:2
verses.text: Sakali aniya' ta'nda'ku mala'ikat akawasa. Atanog e'na amissala, yuk-i, “Sai bahā' taga-kapatut amitas saga gindan ma gulungan katas itu sampay am'llat iya?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:3
verses.text: Sagō' minsan ma diyata' langit atawa ma babaw dunya atawa ma deyom ahirat, halam aniya' bay tabāk makarapat am'llat gulungan katas inān, ang'nda' ni deyomna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:4
verses.text: Na, pagka halam aniya' minsan dakayu' patut am'llat katas inān atawa ang'nda' ma deyomna, magtūy aku anangis magkarukka'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:5
verses.text: Manjari binissalahan aku e' dakayu' matto'a min duwampū' maka mpat inān, yuk-i, “Da'a ka anangis. Nda'un ba. Tara'ug na nakura' saitan e' dangan a'a ya pinagsambat Halimaw min panubu' si Yuda. Babantugun iya, maka tubu' sultan Da'ud. Angkanna iya makarapat amitas pitu' gindan ma gulungan katas inān, sampay am'llat iya.”  <div eID="gen8669" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4258"/><div sID="gen8670" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4258"/> Puwas e' aniya' ta'nda'ku maina'an sali' Bili-bili an'ngge ma atag paningkō'an bangsahan ma t'ngnga'-t'ngnga'na. Pinaglibutan iya e' mpat binatang maka duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan. Aniya' ta'nda'ku ma baran Bili-bili saga bainat in iya bay pinapatay. Aniya' pitu' tandukna maka pitu' isab matana. Bang pina'amu, in pitu' matana inān, ya na Rū Tuhan pinabeya' e' Tuhan ni kaluha'an dunya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:7
verses.text: Sakali itu pa'abut Bili-bili itu ni Dangan ya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan, angā' gulungan katas min tanganna kowan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:8
verses.text: Pagā'na katas, magtūy in mpat binatang, maka duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan inān magsujuran ma dahuanna amudji iya. Saga pagmatto'ahan inān bay amowa biyula kaniya-kaniya maka tugtugan bulawan ap'nno' e' kamanyan, bo' hamut kamanyan inān buwat ibarat pagduwa'a min a'a suku' Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:9
verses.text: Sakali magkalangan sigām kalangan baha'u, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8671"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8672"/>“Ka'a ya taga-kapatut angā' gulungan katas<l eID="gen8672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8673"/>sampay amitas gindanna,<l eID="gen8673" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8674"/>sabab ka'a ya bay pinapatay,<l eID="gen8674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8675"/>maka laha'nu bay pabu'us ma kamataynu.<l eID="gen8675" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8676"/>Ya na ko' ilu bay pangal'kkat saga manusiya' min karusahan sigām<l eID="gen8676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8677"/>bo' supaya sigām manjari suku' Tuhan.<l eID="gen8677" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8678"/>Saga a'a itu asal min bangsa kamemon, min bahasa kamemon,<l eID="gen8678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8679"/>min panubu' kamemon, sampay min lahat kamemon.<l eID="gen8679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8680"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:10
verses.text: Tahinangnu sigām tubu'an sultan,<l eID="gen8680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8681"/>tumpukan imam maghinang ni Tuhantam.<l eID="gen8681" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8682"/>Ati sigām ya magbaya' ma babaw dunya itu ma sinosōng.”<l eID="gen8682" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8671"/>  <div eID="gen8670" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4259"/><div sID="gen8683" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4259"/> Puwas e' ang'nda' aku pina'an pabalik, ati aniya' takaleku suwala min mala'ikat magibu-ibuhan. Sikat'nggehan sigām ma sakalibut paningkō'an bangsahan maka mpat binatang maka duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:12
verses.text: Atanog e' ba'anan mala'ikat itu magkalang, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8684"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8685"/>“Patut minahaldika' Bili-bili ya bay pinapatay.<l eID="gen8685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8686"/>Akawasa iya maka dayahan to'ongan.<l eID="gen8686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8687"/>Aheya asal pangita'una maka kosogna.<l eID="gen8687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8688"/>Mahaldika'ta iya, sanglitanta iya, pudjita iya.”<l eID="gen8688" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8684"/>  <div eID="gen8683" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4260"/><div sID="gen8689" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4260"/> Puwas e' takaleku magkalangan kamemon bay pinapanjari e' Tuhan, ma diyata' langit, ma babaw dunya, ma ahirat, sampay ma deyom tahik. Aho', magdakayu' saga binangsa kamemon ma sakalingkal alam, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8690"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8691"/>“Pudjitam iya ya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan.<l eID="gen8691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8692"/>Pudjitam Bili-bili inān.<l eID="gen8692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8693"/>Subay iya mahaldika'tam,<l eID="gen8693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8694"/>subay sanglitantam salama-lama,<l eID="gen8694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8695"/>sabab in iya asal sangat kawasa.”<l eID="gen8695" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8690"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:14
verses.text: Sakali anambag mpat binatang inān, yuk-i, “Amin”. Ati pasujud karuwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan inān amudji Tuhan maka Bili-bili.  <div eID="gen8689" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.5"/> <div eID="gen8668" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4261"/><div sID="gen8696" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Gindan Pinikit ni Gulungan Katas</title> <div sID="gen8697" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4261"/> Na, sabu pa'in aku ang'nda' pina'an, ta'nda'ku Bili-bili amitas gindan kaissana min gulungan katas inān. Maka takaleku dakayu' binatang min atag paningkō'an inān magsuwala. Sali' l'ggon ya tanog suwalana, yuk-i, “Lanjalin na!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:2
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' ta'nda'ku kura' pote'. Ya angura' inān amowa ba'ugan pana', maka binuwanan iya korona paporong kōkna. Jari angura' iya paluwas minna'an angangga'osan saga bantana kamemon. Mbal iya angaku da'ug.  <div eID="gen8697" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4262"/><div sID="gen8698" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4262"/> Sakali pinitas e' Bili-bili inān ya gindan karuwana, ati takaleku binatang karuwana magsuwala, yuk-i, “Lanjalin na!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:4
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' kura' dakayu' paluwas, kura' alutu' keyatna. Ya angura' inān binuwanan patakos ataha', maka binuwanan iya kapatut angala'anan kasannangan min kaluha'an dunya, sampay amat'nna' kalengogan ma bangsa manusiya' amapagbono' sigām.  <div eID="gen8698" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4263"/><div sID="gen8699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4263"/> Puwas e' pinitas isab e' Bili-bili ya gindan kat'lluna, ati takaleku binatang kat'lluna magsuwala, yuk-i, “Lanjalin na!” Pag'nda'ku, aniya' kura' ettom pangura'an e' a'a amenten timbangan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:6
verses.text: Jari aniya' takaleku sali' suwala paluwas min t'ngnga' mpat binatang inān. Yuk suwala he', “Ya pam'lli dapansing buwas tirigu atawa t'llu pansing dawa subay gadji a'a dang'llaw. Sagō' in ns'llan maka binu da'a subay pinaka'at.”  <div eID="gen8699" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4264"/><div sID="gen8700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4264"/> Puwas e' pinitas isab e' Bili-bili ya gindan ka'mpatna, ati takaleku binatang ka'mpatna magsuwala, yuk-i, “Lanjalin na!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:8
verses.text: Pag'nda'ku aniya' kura' angamudas, sali' halam laha'na. Ya angura' inān niōnan Kamatay, maka paturul min buli'anna niōnan Ahirat. Manjari in duwangan itu binuwanan kapatut amapatay dabahagi' min bahagi' mpat ma manusiya' kamemon ma dunya. Bono', gotom, bonglay, sampay sattuwa talun, ya pinat'kka e' duwangan itu pamapatay saga a'a.  <div eID="gen8700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4265"/><div sID="gen8701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4265"/> Puwas e', pagpitas pa'in e' Bili-bili ya gindan kalimana min gulungan katas e', ta'nda'ku maina'an, ma deyo' tongod pagkulbanan, saga umagad a'a. A'a inān bay pinapatay ma sabab pagnasihat sigām ma palman Tuhan, maka ma sabab katuyu' sigām anaksi' ma pasal si Isa Al-Masi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:10
verses.text: Sakali angalingan saga umagad itu. Atanog pangalingan sigām, yuk-i, “O Tuhan Panghū' kami, ka'a ya tunggal Sangat Kawasa. Mahasussi ka maka ab'nnal to'ongan! Buwattingga gi' t'ggolna bo' yampa hukumnu saga a'a ma dunya he'? Sumiyan sigām pagmulka'annu ma sabab pamapatay sigām ma kami itu?”

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:11
verses.text: Jari binuwanan sigām juba pote' pakaniya-pakaniya, ati sinō' sigām pahali-hali gi' dai'-dai'. Subay kono' jukup ya heka dauranakan sigām sosoho'an Tuhan pinapatay bo' yampa minulka'an saga a'a bay amapatay he'.  <div eID="gen8701" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4266"/><div sID="gen8702" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4266"/> Na, aubus pa'in ina'an-i, ta'nda'ku Bili-bili amitas gindan ka'nnomna min gulungan katas. Magtūy aniya' linug aheya makajogjog deyom dunya. Angalendom isab mata llaw sali' hantang karut ettom, maka luwa bulan inān akeyat pinaka luwa laha'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:13
verses.text: Sampay bitu'un ma b'ttong langit, sikapakpakan sali' hantang buwa' kayu amalaganas hūgna bang taluwa' badju.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:14
verses.text: Nilanyapan isab langit sali' hantang katas nilūnan, maka kamemon kabūd-būran maka kapū'-pū'an apinda min baina.  <div eID="gen8702" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4267"/><div sID="gen8703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4267"/> Manjari saga a'a ma dunya, saga kasultanan maka saga parinta, saga kanakura'an sundalu, saga a'a dayahan maka a'a ga'osan sampay isab a'a kamemon, ata maka ngga'i ka ata, magtapukan di-sigām sama-sama, ai na ka ma deyom songab batu, ai na ka ma deyo' kabatuhan ma kabūd-būran.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:16
verses.text: Aminta-minta sigām ni kabūd-būran maka ni kabatuhan, yuk-i, “Tambunin kami, bo' supaya kami mbal ta'nda' e' Dangan ya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan, bo' mbal isab taluwa' mulka' min niōnan Bili-bili.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:17
verses.text: Sabab ta'abut na waktu pamat'kka mulka' e' sigā ma manusiya'. Halam aniya' makasandalan mulka' inān, minsan sai.”  <div eID="gen8703" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.6"/> <div eID="gen8696" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4268"/><div sID="gen8704" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dahatus maka Mpatpū' maka Mpat Ngibu A'a Isra'il</title> <div sID="gen8705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4268"/> Puwas inān maka'nda' aku mpat mala'ikat an'ngge ma mpat pidju alam magpanagang. Ina'an sinagang e' sigām mpat baliyu aheya bo' supaya mbal patumbuk ni gintana'an atawa ni dilaut, atawa ni kakayu-kayuhan minsan la'a hal ni dampo'on.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:2
verses.text: Maka aniya' ta'nda'ku dakayu' mala'ikat paluwas min sobangan amowa pagsasāp Tuhan, ya kakkal salama-lama. Ginasuran e' mala'ikat dakayu' saga mala'ikat ka'mpat inān, ya bay kabuwanan kawasa e' Tuhan magpaka'at dunya deya-dilaut.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:3
verses.text: Yuk mala'ikat dakayu' itu, “Da'a gi' mulahunbi gintana'an maka dilaut ilu sampay kakayu-kayuhanna, sat'ggol halam gi' kasāpan e' kami saga sosoho'an Tuhantam ma tuktuk sigām.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:4
verses.text: Manjari nihaka'an aku bang pila puhu' ya subay sināpan ma tuktuk. Dahatus kono' maka mpatpū' maka mpat ngibu min kabangsahan tubu' Isra'il.  <div eID="gen8705" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><div sID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/> Min panubu' si Yuda aniya' sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan. Ya du min panubu' si Ruben, si Gād, si Aser, si Naptali, si Manasse, si Simiyun, si Libi, si Issakar, si Sibulun, si Yusup, maka si Benjamin. Sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan min panubu' sigām kaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8704" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><div sID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/> Min panubu' si Yuda aniya' sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan. Ya du min panubu' si Ruben, si Gād, si Aser, si Naptali, si Manasse, si Simiyun, si Libi, si Issakar, si Sibulun, si Yusup, maka si Benjamin. Sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan min panubu' sigām kaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8704" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><div sID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/> Min panubu' si Yuda aniya' sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan. Ya du min panubu' si Ruben, si Gād, si Aser, si Naptali, si Manasse, si Simiyun, si Libi, si Issakar, si Sibulun, si Yusup, maka si Benjamin. Sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan min panubu' sigām kaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8704" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><div sID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/> Min panubu' si Yuda aniya' sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan. Ya du min panubu' si Ruben, si Gād, si Aser, si Naptali, si Manasse, si Simiyun, si Libi, si Issakar, si Sibulun, si Yusup, maka si Benjamin. Sangpū' maka duwangibu bay kasāpan min panubu' sigām kaniya-kaniya.  <div eID="gen8706" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8704" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4270"/><div sID="gen8707" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Katimukan A'a Mamarahi Hekana</title> <div sID="gen8708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4270"/> Puwas e' ang'nda' aku, ati ta'nda'ku katimukan a'a mamarahi hekana, mbal taitung! Aniya' sigām min lahat kamemon maka min bangsa kamemon, min panubu' kamemon maka min bahasa kamemon. Ina'an sigām sikat'nggehan ma alopan paningkō'an bangsahan maka ma alopan Bili-bili. Magnijuba sigām pote', magpamowa isab sali' lokay kaniya-kaniya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:10
verses.text: Atanog e' sigām magsuwala sama-sama, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8709"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8710"/>“Sanglitanta Tuhan Manglalappas,<l eID="gen8710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8711"/>ya aningkō' ma paningkō'anna bangsahan.<l eID="gen8711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8712"/>Pudjita isab Bili-bili.”<l eID="gen8712" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8709"/>  <div eID="gen8708" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4271"/><div sID="gen8713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4271"/> Ina'an mpat binatang maka saga pagmatto'ahan an'ngge ma atag paningkō'an, maka ina'an isab saga mala'ikat kamemon an'ngge min sakalibut sigām. Sakali magsujuran ba'anan mala'ikat inān paharap ni paningkō'an ati pinudji Tuhan e' sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:12
verses.text: Yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8714"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8715"/>“Amin. Sanglitanta Tuhan, mahaldika'ta na iya.<l eID="gen8715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8716"/>Paheyata ōnna, pagsukulanta iya,<l eID="gen8716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8717"/>sabab ma iya asal pangita'u alalom<l eID="gen8717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8718"/>maka barakat maka sangat kawasa<l eID="gen8718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8719"/>sampay ni kasaumulan!<l eID="gen8719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8720"/>Amin!”<l eID="gen8720" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8714"/>  <div eID="gen8713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4272"/><div sID="gen8721" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4272"/> Sakali itu, tinilaw aku e' dakayu' min pagmatto'ahan inān, yukna, “Kata'uwannu bahā' bang sai saga a'a magnijuba pote' itu? Kata'uwannu bang minningga sigām?”  <div eID="gen8721" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4273"/><div sID="gen8722" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4273"/> Anambung aku, “Tuwan, mbal. Ka'a ya makata'u.” <div eID="gen8722" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8723" type="paragraph"/> Yukna ma aku, “Sigām inān bay makalabay kabinasahan aheya. Bay karakdakan e' sigām juba sigām ma laha' Bili-bili, hatina kala'anan tamak dusa sigām. <lg sID="gen8724"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8725"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:15
verses.text: Ya he' sababanna angkan sigām an'ngge ma alopan tingkō'an Tuhan.<l eID="gen8725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8726"/>Maghinang sigām ma iya llaw-sangom ma tongod pangarapan ni iya.<l eID="gen8726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8727"/>Nihampanan sigām e' Tuhan, ya aningkō' ma tingkō'anna bangsahan.<l eID="gen8727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8728"/>Asalamat sigām ma haddaratna.<l eID="gen8728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8729"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:16
verses.text: Mbal na sigām lingantu atawa patay bohe' pabalik<l eID="gen8729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8730"/>sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen8730" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8731"/>Mbal sigām kinapiyalu atawa apanggang,<l eID="gen8731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8732"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:17
verses.text: sabab Bili-bili, ya pa'atag ma haddarat Tuhan, angupiksa' sigām.<l eID="gen8732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8733"/>Iya ya magmakōk, amowa sigām ni tuburan bohe' makakallum.<l eID="gen8733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8734"/>Ati sinapuhan e' Tuhan bohe' mata sigām kamemon.”<l eID="gen8734" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8724"/>  <div eID="gen8723" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.7"/> <div eID="gen8707" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4274"/><div sID="gen8735" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Gindan Kapitu'na</title> <div sID="gen8736" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4274"/> Manjari itu, apuwas pa'in e' Bili-bili amitas gindan kapitu'na min gulungan katas inān, magtūy halam aniya' minsan bah'ssek ma deyom sulga' ma deyom saga tonga' jām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:2
verses.text: Puwas e' ta'nda'ku pitu' mala'ikat an'ngge ma haddarat Tuhan, ati tinoporan sigām tiyup-tiyup pakaniya-pakaniya.  <div eID="gen8736" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4275"/><div sID="gen8737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4275"/> Sakali aniya' mala'ikat dakayu' pina'an an'ngge ma atag pagkukulbanan, maka e'na amowa tugtugan bulawan. Aheka kamanyan bay pamuwan ma iya pamasimbugna ni saga duwa'a ya pangamu'-ngamu' e' kamemon saga a'a suku' Tuhan. Ati tinukbal e' mala'ikat maina'an ma lamisahan bulawan ya ma dahuan tingkō'an Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:4
verses.text: Jari in humbu kamanyan maka pangamu'-ngamu' saga a'a suku' Tuhan, wa'i pat'bbud pariyata' min tangan mala'ikat e'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:5
verses.text: Sakali, niā' tugtugan e' mala'ikat itu. Pin'nno'an e'na maka baga api min diyata' lamisahan inān bo' yampa nilarukan ni dunya. Paglaruk itu, magtūy aniya' l'ggon maglagublub, maka l'tte', maka lāt aninglab. Aniya' isab linug anganjogjog deyom dunya.  <div eID="gen8737" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8735" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4276"/><div sID="gen8738" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinah'lling Tiyup-tiyup</title> <div sID="gen8739" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4276"/> Manjari in pitu' mala'ikat, ya amowa pitu' tiyup-tiyup inān, sakap na song amah'lling.  <div eID="gen8739" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4277"/><div sID="gen8740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4277"/> Ya mala'ikat dakayu' inān amah'lling na tiyup-tiyupna. Magtūy aniya' tigtigan aes maka api bay pinatumbuk ni dunya maglamud maka laha'. Minnē' atunu' dunya, dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu. Talapay saga kakayu-kayuhan dabahagi' isab min bahagi' t'llu, maka atunu' isab kaparang-parangan kamemon ma dunya.  <div eID="gen8740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4278"/><div sID="gen8741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4278"/> Puwas e' ya mala'ikat karuwana inān amah'lling na isab tiyup-tiyupna. Sakali aniya' api akompol buwat heya būd wa'i pinatumbuk ni deyom tahik. Paglaruk pa'in itu, magtūy dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu ma katahikan inān tahinang laha'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:9
verses.text: Amatay magtūy dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu ya ai-ai bay allum ma deyom tahik. Magka'at isab dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu ya sasuku tabayan ma kuwit tahik inān.  <div eID="gen8741" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4279"/><div sID="gen8742" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4279"/> Puwas e' ya mala'ikat kat'lluna amah'lling na isab tiyup-tiyupna. Sakali aniya' bitu'un aheya amaga'-maga' sali' suwariyan, wa'i pinatumbuk min b'ttong langit tudju ni kasapa'-sapa'an maka ni tuburan bohe', dabahagi' isab min bahagi' t'llu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:11
verses.text: Bitu'un inān niōnan “Pa'it” sabab ya bohe' bay katumbukanna apa'it du. Aheka a'a bay amatay paginum sigām bohe' inān, sabab min pa'itna.  <div eID="gen8742" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4280"/><div sID="gen8743" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4280"/> Puwas e' ya mala'ikat ka'mpatna amah'lling na isab tiyup-tiyupna. Magtūy taluwa' lendom dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu ma llaw, ma bulan, sampay saga bitu'un. Angkan ma deyom dang'llaw, alendom mpat jām t'ggolna. Damikiyanna ma waktu sangom, mpat jām isab mbal amuwan sawa min diyata' langit.  <div eID="gen8743" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4281"/><div sID="gen8744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4281"/> Na puwas ina'an-i, sabuku ang'nda', aniya' belle' takaleku magsuwala, ina'an paleyang ma to'ongan ayan. Atanog suwalana, yukna, “Arōy! Arōy! Asiya-siya na sasuku maglahat ma dunya, sabab landu' abisa saga bala' ya pinat'kka ni sigām bang ta'abut waktu pamah'lling tiyup-tiyup e' t'llu mala'ikat damuli!”  <div eID="gen8744" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.8"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:1
verses.text: Manjari ya mala'ikat kalimana bay amah'lling tiyup-tiyupna, ati aniya' ta'nda'ku sali' bitu'un bay ahūg ni dunya min diyata' langit. Bitu'un itu bay kabuwanan kunsi' pangukab tambol lowang tegob-tegoban.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:2
verses.text: Pagukabna pa'in lowang inān, magtūy aniya' humbu an'bbud min deyomna, sali' humbu min tunu' aheya. Jari kalendoman llaw maka langit e' humbu inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:3
verses.text: Aniya' ba'anan ampan pat'ppak ni dunya luwas bay min deyom humbu, kabuwanan kapatut angeket, buwat jalalangking.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:4
verses.text: Sinō' sigām da'a amaka'at kaparang-parangan atawa kakayu-kayuhan atawa ai-ai patomo' ma babaw dunya. Luwal saga a'a halam bay kasāpan tuktuk sigām maka sāp Tuhan ya makajari minula e' saga ampan inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:5
verses.text: Malaingkan mbal sigām pinarūl amapatay. In manusiya' inān subay pinap'ddi'an sadja ma deyom limambulan. Ya nanam p'ddi' kalabayan saga a'a inān sali' maka p'ddi' keket jalalangking.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:6
verses.text: Na, ma deyom limambulan parahing na pa'in saga a'a kineket itu bang pa'in sigām amatay, sagō' mbal tinugutan amatay. Bilahi to'ongan sigām amatay sagō' mbal nirūlan.  <div eID="gen8745" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4282"/><div sID="gen8746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4282"/> Ya pangluwahan saga ampan inān sali' hantang kura' pinanyapan song pangura'an ni pagbono'an. Aniya' sali' korona bulawan paporong ma kōk sigām, maka pamaihu'an sigām sali' manusiya'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:8
verses.text: Bu'un sigām ataha' sali' bu'un d'nda, maka empon sigām sali' taling sattuwa halimaw.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:9
verses.text: Daggaha sigām tinamingan maka sisik sali' luwa basi'. Ang'llub isab pikpik sigām bang pajabjab, sali' tagandak ba'anan kura' angangguyud saga kalesa bang parugpak ni pagbono'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:10
verses.text: Togel sigām sali' togel jalalangking, taga-tugsuk ma tōngna. Ya ina'an paminasa sigām ma manusiya' ma deyom limambulan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:11
verses.text: Aniya' isab sultan magagi ma sigām, ya na dakayu' saitan tag-ntanan lowang tegob-tegoban inān. Ōn tag-ntanan inān, bang ma bahasa Hibrani, si Abaddon. Bang ma bahasa Girīk, si Apolyon, hatina Pamamaka'at.  <div eID="gen8746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4283"/><div sID="gen8747" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4283"/> Na, minnē' patobtob na bala' ya dahū pinat'kka, sagō' masi gi' duwa bala' damuli.  <div eID="gen8747" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4284"/><div sID="gen8748" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4284"/> Manjari mala'ikat kannomna bay amah'lling tiyup-tiyupna ati makakale aku suwala paluwas min mpat dugu lamisahan bulawan ya pagtugtugan kamanyan, ya maina'an ma alopan Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:14
verses.text: Buwattitu ya lapal suwala inān, yukna, “Hubarin na mpat saitan ya bay niengkotan ma bihing sapa' Alpurati he'.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:15
verses.text: Saga saitan inān bay pinasakap asal sagō' halam sigām bay nihubaran. Subay na ta'abut waktuna to'ongan, llawna maka bulanna maka tahunna, bo' yampa sigām pinaluwas amapatay ba'anan manusiya', dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu ma sigām kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:16
verses.text: Kahaka'an aku bang pila sundalu ma deyo'an mpat saitan e', a'a magpangura' lullun. Duwampū' ngibu laksa' kono' ya heka sigām.  <div eID="gen8748" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4285"/><div sID="gen8749" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4285"/> Buwattitu ya pangluwahan saga kura' bay ta'nda'ku, maka saga sundalu magpangura' inān. Ya daggaha sigām bay tinampanan maka taming magwalna' keyat api maka bilu alutu' maka sali' biyaning mailang. Ya kōk kura' inān angaluwa halimaw, ya bowa' sigām paluwasan api maka humbu maka mailang arokot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:18
verses.text: Jari amatay in binangsa manusiya', dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu. Ya makapatay inān t'llu ginis bala' bay paluwas min bowa' saga kura', hatina api maka humbu maka mailang arokot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:19
verses.text: Aniya' duwa bala' pamapatay saga kura' inān ma manusiya'. Kaissana, ya bala' paluwas min bowa' sigām. Karuwana, ya bala' ma togel sigām, sabab togel sigām inān sali' sowa taga-kōk pangamula ma manusiya'.  <div eID="gen8749" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4286"/><div sID="gen8750" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4286"/> Malaingkan saga manusiya' takapin, ya halam bay amatay e' bala' inān, mbal to'ongan pataikut min ta'u-ta'u pagtutuhanan sigām. Mbal sigām pahali anumba ni saga saitan sampay ni ta'u-ta'u mbal maka'nda', mbal makakale, maka mbal makal'ngngan, ya bay hinangan bulawan, pilak, tumbaga, batu maka kayu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:21
verses.text: Mbal sigām papinda min kahinangan ala'at. Masi-masi sigām magpamono' sampay amantak ni pagkahi sigām. Mbal sigām pahali maghinang kasabulan d'nda maka l'lla, sampay magtangkaw.  <div eID="gen8750" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.9"/> <div eID="gen8738" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4287"/><div sID="gen8751" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Mala'ikat maka Gulungan Katas Ariki'</title> <div sID="gen8752" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4287"/> Manjari aniya' na isab dakayu' mala'ikat akosog ta'nda'ku pareyo' min sulga' tudju ni dunya, paputus ma gabun. Aniya' biradali<note>‘Biradali’ atawa ‘salindugu'’. ‘Rainbow’ bang ma bahasa Ingglis.</note> palengkong min diyata' kōkna, ati baihu'na magsinag sali' mata llaw. Ya b'ttisna inān sali' hāg arokot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:2
verses.text: Aniya' ntananna gulungan katas ariki' pab'llat. Tape'na kowan bay pinat'ppak ni diyata' tahik, ati tape'na gibang pinat'ppak ni gintana'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:3
verses.text: Sakali angalingan pakosog mala'ikat itu, sali' pamanggohong<note>‘Pamanggohong:’ ya lling halimaw atawa baruwang landu' akosog.</note> pakosog min bowa' halimaw. Paglinganna itu, na, sinambag iya e' pitu' l'ggon angalagublub.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:4
verses.text: Paglagublub itu, arak sulatku bay lapal l'ggon e', sagō' aniya' takaleku suwala min deyom sulga' anagang aku, yuk-i, “Da'a sulatun ya pagkallam e' pitu' l'ggon ilu. Kuli-kulihun sadja.”  <div eID="gen8752" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4288"/><div sID="gen8753" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4288"/> Manjari in mala'ikat ya bay ta'nda'ku an'ngge ma tahik maka ma gintana'an, bay anayang tanganna kowan tudju ni langit

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:6
verses.text: maka e'na anibahat. Ya panibahatanna ōn Tuhan kakkal, ya bay amapanjari langit maka kakaya'-kaya'anna sampay dunya itu deya-dilaut maka kakaya'-kaya'anna isab. Yuk sibahatna, “Pinalanjal na, mbal na patanggu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:7
verses.text: Sagō' ta'abut pa'in saga llaw song pinah'lling tiyup-tiyup e' mala'ikat kapitu'na, atuman kagara'an Tuhan ya bay ma deyom sipuk. Tahinang buwat bay pamata'una ma saga sosoho'anna, hatina ma kanabi-nabihan.”  <div eID="gen8753" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4289"/><div sID="gen8754" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4289"/> Puwas e' amissala ni aku pabīng ya suwala bay takaleku ah'lling min deyom sulga', yuk-i, “Pehē' ka, ngā'un katas pab'llat min tangan mala'ikat ya an'ngge ma tahik sampay ma gintana'an inān.”  <div eID="gen8754" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4290"/><div sID="gen8755" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4290"/> Na, pehē' aku ni mala'ikat angamu' gulungan katas ariki'. Yukna ni aku, “Ā, ngā'un na, kakanun. Tananamnu du ko' ilu, amamis sali' gula' buwani ma deyom bowa'nu, sagō' al'ssom ma deyom b'ttongnu.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: Ngā'ku gulungan katas ariki' min tangan mala'ikat inān bo' yampa kakanku. Pagkakanku magtūy amamis sali' gula' buwani, sagō' pagt'llonku, al'ssom ma deyom b'ttongku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: Manjari aniya' amissala ni aku, yukna, “Subay paluwasnu lapal Tuhan pabīng pasal ya song pinat'kka ni kabangsa-bangsahan, ni kapanubu'an, ni bahasa kaginisan, sampay ni ba'anan kasultanan sigām.”  <div eID="gen8755" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.10"/> <div eID="gen8751" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4291"/><div sID="gen8756" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwangan Saksi'</title> <div sID="gen8757" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4291"/> Manjari itu kabuwanan aku batang kayu pagsukuran, ati sinoho' aku anukud. Yuk panoho'an e', “Pehē' ka, sukurun langgal Tuhan sampay pagkukulbanan. Itungun bang pila jama'a ya angarap ni Tuhan maina'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: Sagō' da'a lapayun halaman ma katilibut langgal inān. Da'a sukurun he'-i sabab pamasuku' ma saga a'a ngga'i ka suku' Tuhan. Nilumu' da'ira sussi e' sigām ma deyom mpatpū' maka duwambulan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: Sō'ku duwangan saksi'ku pina'an,” yukna. “Magpamakay sigā s'mmek karut, ati pinasaplag e' sigā lapal Tuhan ma deyom dangibu maka duwa hatus maka nnompū' llaw.”  <div eID="gen8757" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4292"/><div sID="gen8758" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4292"/> Na, in duwa saksi' itu<note>Tasulat pasal saksi' itu ma Jūd Nabi Jakariya 4:1-14.</note>, ya na duwa kayu jaitun maka duwa palita'an an'ngge ma dahuan Panghū' ya tag-suku'an dunya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: Bang aniya' ganta' pasulay angala'ugan saga saksi' itu, aniya' api pasulapput min bowa' sigā amaka'at saga banta sigā. Angkan tantu amatay sai-sai anawakkal anganjahulaka'an duwangan itu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: Aniya' isab kapatut sigā anambolan langit bo' supaya mbal angulan sat'ggol sigā masi magpasaplag lapal Tuhan. Taga-kapatut isab sigā magbaya' ma tuburan bohe', pinapinda ni laha'. Maka aniya' isab kapatut sigā amat'kka bala' kaginisan ni dunya, sumiyan-sumiyan ya kabaya'an sigā.  <div eID="gen8758" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4293"/><div sID="gen8759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4293"/> Na, bang aubus na e' duwangan saksi' itu magpasaplag lapal Tuhan, nirugpakan du sigā e' dakayu' sattuwa makatāw-tāw, ya paluwas min deyom lowang tegob-tegoban. Tara'ug e'na duwangan itu, pinapatay.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: Jari patay sigā pinasagaran pahantal ma paglabayan ma deyom da'ira binabantug inān, da'ira bay pangalansangan Panghū' sigā ni hāg. Ya pangōn da'ira inān Sodom maka Misil, bo' ngga'i ka he' dī ōnna. Tu'ud ōn pamaralil sadja.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
