verses.text: Ma deyom t'llung'llaw maka tonga' in patay duwangan saksi' itu niaro'-aro'an na pa'in e' ba'anan a'a min panubu' kamemon, min bangsa kamemon, min bahasa kamemon, maka min lahat kamemon. Saguwā' mbal to'ongan amakubul saga a'a angaro'-ngaro' inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: Na, kinōgan du sidda saga a'a ma sakalingkal dunya ma sabab kamatay duwangan itu. Magkalamihan sigām sampay maghulmat-hiyulmati dangan maka dangan, sabab in duwa nabi itu bay amaniya' kabinasahan ni saga a'a pat'nna' ma dunya.  <div eID="gen8759" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4294"/><div sID="gen8760" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4294"/> Saguwā', palabay pa'in t'llung'llaw maka tonga' min bay kamatay duwangan itu, magtūy pinabatuk nyawa sigā pabīng e' Tuhan, binuwanan kallum pabalik. Magtūy sigā pabungkal, ati sasuku maka'nda' ma sigā landu' to'ongan tināw.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' takale e' duwangan nabi itu suwala atanog amissala ni sigā min deyom sulga', yuk-i, “Pariyata' kam pi'itu.” Magtūy sigā pariyata' ni sulga' min deyom gabun ma sabu banta sigā ang'nda'-ng'nda'.  <div eID="gen8760" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4295"/><div sID="gen8761" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4295"/> Salta' kapariyata' sigā, saru'un-du'un aniya' linug akosog makalandu'. Alubu dabahagi' min bahagi' sangpū' ma da'ira inān. Aniya' pitu' ngibu a'a amatay e' linug. Sakali saga a'a ya takapin allum inān sinōd tāw sidda, angkan sigām bay amuwan sanglit ma Tuhan ya ma deyom sulga'.  <div eID="gen8761" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4296"/><div sID="gen8762" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4296"/> Na, palabay na bala' karuwana sagō' arai' na bala' kat'lluna.  <div eID="gen8762" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8756" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4297"/><div sID="gen8763" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pinah'lling Tiyup-tiyup Kapitu'</title> <div sID="gen8764" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4297"/> Na, ya mala'ikat katapusan amah'lling na tiyup-tiyupna. Magtūy aniya' saga suwala atanog takale min deyom sulga', yuk-i, “In dunya itu kapagparintahan na e' Panghū'tam Tuhan maka Al-Masi ya tapene'na. Taptap kapagparintana sampay ni kasaumulan!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: Manjari in duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan, ya magtingkō'an asal ma alopan Tuhan, pasujud magpamudji iya,

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8765"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8766"/>“O Tuhan Panghū' kami Sangat Kawasa,<l eID="gen8766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8767"/>kakkal ka asal min awal sampay ni kabuwattituhan.<l eID="gen8767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8768"/>Aheya pagsukulan kami sabab ginuna e'nu kawasanu<l eID="gen8768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8769"/>bo' ka anagna' magparinta ma dunya.<l eID="gen8769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8770"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: Bay akagit atay saga palbangsahan patigaggahun,<l eID="gen8770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8771"/>ati ta'abut na waktu kapangamulka'nu sigām,<l eID="gen8771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8772"/>waktu pangahukumnu ma saga a'a magpatayan,<l eID="gen8772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8773"/>waktu kapanungbasnu ma saga kanabi-nabihan ya sosoho'annu,<l eID="gen8773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8774"/>sampay a'a suku'nu kamemon maka sasuku magaddat ma ōnnu,<l eID="gen8774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8775"/>ai na ka alanga, ai na ka areyo',<l eID="gen8775" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8776"/>waktu isab kapamaka'atnu saga a'a bay amaka'at dunya itu.”<l eID="gen8776" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8765"/>  <div eID="gen8764" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4298"/><div sID="gen8777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4298"/> Sakali niukab na langgal Tuhan ma sulga' ati ta'nda'ku maina'an ba'ul pangisihan kapagsulutan Tuhan maka saga a'a suku'na. Aniya' inān singlab lāt, maka l'ggon maglagublub, maka linug, maka aniya' tigtigan aes parugpak min diyata'.  <div eID="gen8777" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.11"/> <div eID="gen8763" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4299"/><div sID="gen8778" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">D'nda maka Naga</title> <div sID="gen8779" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4299"/> Manjari itu aniya' ta'nda'ku paltanda'an landu' makainu-inu palahil ma b'ttong langit. Aniya' inān dakayu' d'nda an'ngge ma bulan, ya pas'mmekna sali' sinag llaw. Ya paporong ma kōkna sangpū' maka duwa bitu'un.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: D'nda itu arai' na anganak. T'kkahan iya p'ddi' angkan iya angolang.  <div eID="gen8779" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4300"/><div sID="gen8780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4300"/> Puwas e' aniya' paltanda'an makainu-inu saddī palahil ma b'ttong langit. Ta'nda'ku dakayu' naga keyat landu' aheya, pitu' kōkna, sangpū' tandukna. Kōkna kapitu' inān taga-korona.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: Sakali itu, in togel naga itu bay angalappet saga bitu'un, dabahagi' min bahagi' t'llu, bo' nihantakan e'na min b'ttong langit pareyo' ni dunya. An'ngge iya ma dahuan d'nda ya song anganak e', supaya l'kkobna onde'-onde' bang makaluwas na.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: Manjari d'nda inān anganak l'lla sagō' halam ta'abut e' naga sabab niragtu' minnē' bo' tinandanan ni Tuhan ma paningkō'anna bangsahan. Ya pangangganta' asal ma onde' inān in iya subay magbaya' ma palbangsa-bangsahan kamemon ma sinosōng, maka akosog kapagbaya'na, sali' hantang tungkud basi' mbal tasagga'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: Na, taragtu' pa'in onde' he', magtūy alahi d'nda inān ni lahat halam a'ana, lahat bay tinagamahan iya e' Tuhan. Maina'an iya niussap ma deyom dangibu maka duwa hatus maka nnompū' llaw.  <div eID="gen8780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4301"/><div sID="gen8781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4301"/> Sakali aniya' pagbono' ma deyom sulga'. Disi Mika'il maka saga mala'ikat ma deyo'anna bay magbono' maka naga. Angatu isab naga inān maka saga panendogna,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: sagō' mbal makaga'os angkan pinala'an min bay tongod sigām ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: Ya naga aheya bay nilarukan paluwas min sulga'. Ya na he' sowa bay awal, ya niōnan hibilis atawa nakura' saitan. Angakkal asal iya ma manusiya' kamemon. Nihantakan iya pareyo' ni dunya, sampay panendogna kamemon.  <div eID="gen8781" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4302"/><div sID="gen8782" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4302"/> Puwas e', aniya' takaleku suwala akosog ah'lling min deyom sulga', yukna, <lg sID="gen8783"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8784"/>“Ta'abut na waktu kapangalappas Tuhan ma manusiya'.<l eID="gen8784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8785"/>Pina'nda'an na e' Tuhan ya kosog kapagparintana.<l eID="gen8785" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8786"/>Pina'nda'an na isab kapatut Al-Masi ya tapene'na.<l eID="gen8786" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8787"/>Sabab nakura' saitan bay anuntutan danakantam llaw-sangom<l eID="gen8787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8788"/>ma alopan Tuhan, ina'an na bay nilarukan paluwas min sulga'.<l eID="gen8788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8789"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: Tara'ug na iya e' dauranakantam sabab min laha' si Isa, ya niōnan Bili-bili,<l eID="gen8789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8790"/>maka min pandu' b'nnal ya pamatanyag sigām.<l eID="gen8790" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8791"/>Lāgi pinaglilla' e' sigām ginhawa-baran sigām sampay ni kamatay.<l eID="gen8791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8792"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: Ka'am maglahat ma deyom sulga' ilu, magkōg-koyag kam.<l eID="gen8792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8793"/>Maka'ase'-ase' ka'am maglahat ma dunya, ma gintana'an maka ma tahik,<l eID="gen8793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8794"/>sabab ilu nakura' saitan paruwa'i ni ka'am.<l eID="gen8794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8795"/>Kumarukan to'ongan pasu' atayna,<l eID="gen8795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8796"/>sabab kata'uwanna in ganta'anna song na ta'abut.”<l eID="gen8796" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8783"/>  <div eID="gen8782" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4303"/><div sID="gen8797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4303"/> Sakali itu, tata'u pa'in e' naga in iya bay nihantakan ni dunya, magtūy turulna d'nda ya bay anganakan l'lla inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: Sagō' d'nda itu bay kabuwanan duwa pikpik belle' aheya bo' makaleyang tudju ni lahat halam a'ana, ya bay tinagamahan iya. Ati maina'an iya niussap ma deyom t'lluntahun maka tonga' bo' supaya mbal ta'abut e' sowa, hatina e' naga inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: Jari aniya' bohe' alandos bay sinulapputan e' naga inān min deyom bowa'na bo' supaya nirunukan d'nda inān sampay talaran.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: Daipara tinabang iya e' tana'. Wa'i palowang tana' ati in bohe' bay min bowa' naga inān hal pahūs ni deyom lowang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: Na, minnē' mbal takole'-kole' pasu' atay naga inān tudju ni d'nda, angkan iya angangut anguntarahan saga anak-mpu d'nda inān kasehe'an, sasuku ameya' ma panoho'an Tuhan sampay amogbogan pandu' b'nnal bay min si Isa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:18
verses.text: Manjari pehē' naga inān an'ngge ma bihing tampe.  <div eID="gen8797" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.12"/> <div eID="gen8778" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4304"/><div sID="gen8798" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Duwa Sattuwa</title> <div sID="gen8799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4304"/> Manjari itu, aniya' ta'nda'ku sali' sattuwa paluwas min tahik. Sattuwa itu pitu' kōkna maka sangpū' tandukna, bo' tandukna he' bay sinangonan korona pakaniya-pakaniya. Kōkna kapitu' inān bay sinulatan ōn sidda ala'at, ōn pangkal ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: Ya sattuwa ta'nda'ku itu sali' luwa halimaw b'ttikan, tape'na sali' tape' sattuwa baruwang, maka bowa'na sali' bowa' halimaw. Sattuwa itu bay kawakilan e' naga, kabuwanan barakatna luggiya' maka kapagsultanna maka kapatutna akosog.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: Dakayu' kōk sattuwa itu bay nilagut ma katubaganna, sagō' kauli'an bay bakatna arak makapatay he', angkan takuddat saga a'a kamemon ma dunya. Jari ameya' sigām ma sattuwa itu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: Pasumba kamemon saga a'a ma naga inān sabab in iya bay amuwan kapatutna ma sattuwa. Sinumba isab sattuwa e' sigām maka e' sigām ah'lling, yuk-i, “Sattuwa itu halam aniya' sali'na! Halam aniya' maka'atuhan iya!”  <div eID="gen8799" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4305"/><div sID="gen8800" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4305"/> Manjari in sattuwa itu pinarūl magbaya' ma dunya ma deyom mpatpū' maka duwambulan. Pinasagaran isab iya magmalangkahi sampay amah'lling pangkal ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: Pinabanga' e'na bowa'na anukna'an Tuhan maka ōnna maka pajātanna, maka sasuku maglahat ma deyom sulga'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: Pinasagaran isab sattuwa itu amono' saga a'a suku' Tuhan sampay sigām tara'ug e'na. Binuwanan iya kapatut magbaya' ma panubu' kamemon, ma pihak kamemon, ma bahasa kamemon, sampay ma bangsa kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: Ma sinosōng in sattuwa itu pinudji e' a'a kamemon maglahat ma deyom dunya, sasuku halam tasulat ōnna ma kitab ya palsuku'an Bili-bili. Sangay min waktu kapamapanjari dunya, tasulat asal ma kitab inān ōn saga a'a ya taga-kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen8800" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4306"/><div sID="gen8801" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4306"/> Na, sasuku kam taga-tainga, asipunbi itu-i: <lg sID="gen8802"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8803"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: Bang a'a pinakadalan sinaggaw, tantu du iya sinaggaw.<l eID="gen8803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8804"/>Bang kadalna patay lagut, tantu du iya amatay e' lagut.<l eID="gen8804" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8802"/> Angkan ka'am saga a'a suku' Tuhan, subay kam pasandal maka subay pahogotbi imanbi.  <div eID="gen8801" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4307"/><div sID="gen8805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4307"/> Manjari aniya' na isab ta'nda'ku sattuwa dakayu', luwas bay min deyom tana'. Aniya' duwa tandukna ariki' pinaka luwa tanduk bili-bili, sagō' suwalana inān sali' lling naga.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: Sattuwa damuli itu bay kawakilan e' sattuwa tagna', ya bay kauli'an bakatna makatubag e', angkan pinagguna e' sattuwa damuli in kapatut aheya ya bay min sattuwa tagna'. Pinissoko' a'a kamemon ma dunya e' sattuwa damuli itu, sinō' pasumba ma sattuwa dahū inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: Tahinang isab e' sattuwa damuli itu hinang makainu-inuhan a'a. Bay soho'na api pareyo' min diyata' langit tudju ni dunya ma pang'nda'an a'a kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: Ka'akkalan e'na saga a'a kamemon ma deyom dunya. Tabowa-bowa sigām sabab hinang makainu-inu ya tahinangna deyo' bay min sattuwa dahū ya paganti'anna. Jari in sattuwa damuli itu bay magpanoho'an ma a'a kamemon, sinō' sigām angahinang ta'u-ta'u pangahulmat sattuwa ya bay nilagut maka kalis e', sagō' masi allum.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: Kabuwanan isab kawasa sattuwa damuli itu amuwan napas ma ta'u-ta'u, ya nihinang sali' pangluwahan sattuwa dahū. Manjari allum ta'u-ta'u itu, angkan makapamūng na, anoho' subay pinapatay sasuku mbal anumba iya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: Bay pinissoko' e'na a'a kamemon subay sināpan ma tangan sigām kowan maka ma tuktuk sigām. Pinagsali'-sali' kamemon, alanga maka areyo', miskin maka dayahan, ata maka ngga'i ka.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: Sai-sai halam taga-sāp mbal makajari am'lli atawa amab'lli. Sāp inān, ya na ōn sattuwa atawa umbul ganti' ōnna.  <div eID="gen8805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4308"/><div sID="gen8806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4308"/> Ahunit umbul itu nihati. Sagō' sai-sai ataha' nahu'na makatali' du bang ai hatina umbul sattuwa itu, sabab ōn a'a ko' he'. Umbulna itu nnom hatus maka nnompū' maka nnom.  <div eID="gen8806" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.13"/> <div eID="gen8798" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4309"/><div sID="gen8807" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bili-bili maka saga A'a Suku'na</title> <div sID="gen8808" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4309"/> Puwas e' ang'nda' aku pabalik ati ta'nda'ku ya pinagsambat Bili-bili, ina'an an'ngge ma būd Siyun. Ameya' isab ma iya ba'anan a'a, dahatus maka mpatpū' maka mpat ngibu hekana, ya bay sinulatan tuktuk sigām maka ōn Bili-bili sampay ōn Mma'na Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: Takaleku isab lling min deyom sulga' landu' atanog, sali' lagublub bohe' anasahan min diyata', sali' kosog l'ggon. Bo' alu'uy lling bay takaleku inān, sali' tunis min a'a magbibiyula.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: Na, ya a'a dahatus maka mpatpū' maka mpat ngibu, ina'an maina'an magpan'ngge pa'alop ma tingkō'an Tuhan maka ma mpat binatang maka ma saga pagmatto'ahan. Magkalangan sigām kalangan baha'u, kalangan mbal ta'anad e' saddī min sigām karahatus maka mpatpū' maka mpat ngibu, ya bay nil'kkat min pang'ntanan nakura' saitan waktu lagi' sigām bay ma dunya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: Halam aniya' tamak ma saga a'a itu, sali' sapantun subul asussi to'ongan pangatayanna, a'a halam gi' bay makalabay d'nda. Paumpig sadja sigām ma niōnan Bili-bili pi'ingga-pi'ingga pal'ngngananna. Bay sigām nil'kkat e' Tuhan min pang'ntanan nakura' saitan waktu sigām lagi' ma dunya, ati sigām ya makarahū pinasuku' ma Tuhan maka ma Bili-bili.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: Halam aniya' kaputingan atawa tamak sigām.  <div eID="gen8808" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8807" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4310"/><div sID="gen8809" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">T'llu Mala'ikat</title> <div sID="gen8810" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4310"/> Puwas e' maka'nda' aku mala'ikat dakayu' paleyang ma diyata' ayan, maka e'na amowa lapal ahāp ya mbal magkapinda ni kasaumulan. Pinasaplag e'na ni a'a kamemon ma dunya, ni lahat kamemon, ni bangsa kamemon, ni bahasa kamemon, maka ni pihak kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: Sakali magsuwala mala'ikat e'. Atanog suwalana, yuk-i, “Katāwinbi Tuhan, mahaldika'unbi, sabab ta'abut na waktu pangahukumna ma manusiya' kamemon. Pudjihunbi na iya, ya bay amapanjari langit maka dunya, s'llang maka tuburan bohe' kamemon.”  <div eID="gen8810" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4311"/><div sID="gen8811" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4311"/> Na, aniya' paturul mala'ikat saddī magsuwala isab. Yukna, “Magka'at na, magka'at to'ongan na da'ira Babilon, ya da'ira binabantug inān. Sapantun iya d'nda ala'at bay amowa-mowa bangsa kamemon maginum binuna makalango, hatina tabowa maghinang kaba'isan.”  <div eID="gen8811" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4312"/><div sID="gen8812" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4312"/> Puwas e' paturul isab mala'ikat saddī, kat'lluna na. Atanog isab e'na magsuwala, yukna, “Sasuku amudji sattuwa maka ta'u-ta'una, maka sasuku bay makataima' sāp sattuwa ma tuktukna atawa ma tanganna,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: pinananaman mulka' Tuhan. In mulka' itu sali' hantang binu halam aniya' lamudna, ya tinumpahan ni deyom Sawan Mulka' Tuhan. Aho', sasuku amudji sattuwa inān pinap'ddi'an to'ongan ma deyom api maka mailang asuleyab, ma pang'nda' saga mala'ikat sussi maka Bili-bili.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: Aniya' humbu pat'bbud na pa'in min api paminasahan inān, sampay ni kasaumulan. Llaw-sangom halam aniya' halian pagsandal saga a'a ya bay anumba ni sattuwa maka ta'u-ta'una, atawa sai-sai bay kasāpan maka ōn sattuwa.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: Angkan ko' ka'am suku' Tuhan ilu, ya ameya' ma panoho'an Tuhan sampay amogbogan si Isa, pahogotunbi imanbi.  <div eID="gen8812" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4313"/><div sID="gen8813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4313"/> Sakali makakale aku suwala min deyom sulga', yukna, “Sulatun na: puwas min llaw itu aheya du kakōganna sasuku amatay ma deyoman Panghū' Isa.” <div eID="gen8813" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8814" type="paragraph"/> Magtūy anambag Rū Tuhan, yukna, “Aho', tantu du sigām magkōg-koyag. Pahali sigām min bay pagsangsā'an sigām, sabab paddas na ma sigām ya kamaujuran ma bay kahinangan sigām ahāp.”  <div eID="gen8814" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8809" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4314"/><div sID="gen8815" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dalil Kapagani ma Dunya</title> <div sID="gen8816" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4314"/> Manjari ang'nda' aku pabalik ati aniya' ta'nda'ku gabun pote', maka aniya' aningkō' maina'an sali' angaluwa manusiya'. Aniya' korona bulawan pamaporong kōkna, maka aniya' sanggot atalom ma tanganna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: Sakali aniya' gi' mala'ikat saddī bay paluwas min deyom langgal inān, ati angalingan pakosog ni iya ya aningkō' ma diyata' gabun e'. Yuk-i, “Gunahun na sanggotnu ilu. Magani na ka, sabab ta'abut na musim kapagani ma dunya. In dunya inān sali' dalil huma ajatu na buwa'na.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: Manjari ya mala'ikat bay aningkō' ma diyata' gabun inān wa'i angalabaran sanggotna ni dunya bo' pinagani e'na kamemon.  <div eID="gen8816" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4315"/><div sID="gen8817" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4315"/> Sakali aniya' isab ta'nda'ku mala'ikat saddī luwas bay min langgal ma deyom sulga', amowa isab sanggot atalom.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: Maka aniya' gi' isab mala'ikat saddī, mala'ikat tunggu' api, paluwas min tongod lamisahan pagtugtugan kamanyan ni Tuhan. Angalingan pakosog mala'ikat itu ni mala'ikat ya amowa sanggot atalom e', yukna, “Gunahun na sanggotnu ilu pananggot buwa' anggul ma dunya sabab atahak na. Sanggotun na saga tundunanna min bahanna.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: Magtūy ya mala'ikat taga-sanggot e' bay angalabaran sanggotna ni dunya. Tinipun e'na buwa' anggul inān bo' yampa larukanna ni deyom pagp'gga'an aheya, ya pangisihan mulka' Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: Jari pin'gga' ba'anan anggul inān ma pagp'gga'an ma luwasan da'ira. Pagp'gga' pa'in, laha' ya paluwas angandunuk ni katāhan saga t'llu hatus kilometro. Ati lalomna dand'ppa maka tonga'.  <div eID="gen8817" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.14"/> <div eID="gen8815" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4316"/><div sID="gen8818" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pitu' Mala'ikat Amowa Bala' Kahinapusan</title> <div sID="gen8819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4316"/> Manjari itu aniya' na isab ta'nda'ku paltanda'an dakayu' ma diyata' langit, landu' makainu-inu maka makahailan. Ya ta'nda'ku inān pitu' mala'ikat amowa pitu' ginis bala'. Ya na he'-i kahinapusan bala' pamatobtob mulka' Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: Sakali aniya' ta'nda'ku maina'an sali' kahantang s'llang, landu' asawa sali' sawa samin, maka kalamuran api angillaw-ngillaw. Ta'nda'ku isab saga a'a bay makapanganda'ug min sattuwa talun maka min ta'u-ta'u ya hinangan pangluwahanna. Halam sigām bay angaku umbul ya panganggindan ōn sattuwa he'. Jari ina'an saga a'a bay anganda'ug magpan'ngge ma bihing s'llang, ya sali' sawa samin. Amowa sigām biyula bay pamuwan sigām e' Tuhan pakaniya-pakaniya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: Magkalangan sigām kalangan bay min si Musa ya sosoho'an Tuhan, maka kalangan min Bili-bili. Buwattitu ya lapal kalangan sigām: <lg sID="gen8820"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8821"/>“O Panghū', Tuhan Sangat Kawasa,<l eID="gen8821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8822"/>kawasahan kahinangannu kamemon, makainu-inu sidda.<l eID="gen8822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8823"/>Ka'a ya sultan ma palbangsa-bangsahan.<l eID="gen8823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8824"/>Abontol maka b'nnal kaniyatannu kamemon.<l eID="gen8824" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8825"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: O Panghū', sai bahā' mbal magmatāwan ka'a?<l eID="gen8825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8826"/>Aniya' bahā' mbal magmahaldika'an ka'a?<l eID="gen8826" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8827"/>Ka'a sadja ya tunggal mahasussi,<l eID="gen8827" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8828"/>magsakaum kamemon palbangsahan amudji ka'a,<l eID="gen8828" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8829"/>sabab ta'nda' e' a'a kamemon in kahinangannu asal adil.”<l eID="gen8829" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8820"/>  <div eID="gen8819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4317"/><div sID="gen8830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4317"/> Puwas e' ta'nda'ku aukab langgal ma deyom sulga', maka ta'nda'ku isab Bilik Mahasussi maina'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: Ta'nda'ku isab pitu' mala'ikat paluwas min deyom langgal inān, ya mala'ikat amowa pitu' ginis bala'. Al'ssin pakayan sigām, makasilaw pote'na. Pinakambotan bulawan isab daggaha sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: Makaluwas pa'in, na, tinoporan sigām pinggan bulawan e' dakayu' binatang min mpat inān. Ya pitu' pinggan inān ap'nno' e' mulka' Tuhan ya kakkal ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: Manjari langgal inān ap'nno' e' humbu min haddarat Tuhan, paltanda'an sahayana maka kawasana, ati halam aniya' makasōd ni deyom langgal inān sat'ggol halam gi' aubus saga bala' pitu' hekana ya binowa e' pitu' mala'ikat e'.  <div eID="gen8830" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.15"/> <div eID="gen8818" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4318"/><div sID="gen8831" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Saga Pinggan Isihan Mulka' Tuhan</title> <div sID="gen8832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4318"/> Manjari itu, aniya' takaleku suwala atanog ah'lling min deyom langgal tudju ni pitu' mala'ikat ya amowa pinggan inān. Yuk suwala itu, “Pehē' na kam. Bu'usinbi na ni dunya isi pitu' pinggan, ya ap'nno' e' mulka' Tuhan ilu.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: Sakali, pehē' dakayu' mala'ikat amu'usan bala' min pingganna tudju ni kareya-reyahan. Pagbu'us pa'in, magtūy paluwasan saga dugsul abau maka ap'ddi' saga a'a inān, ya bay makataima' sāp sattuwa maka anumba ta'u-ta'u bay hinangan pangluwahanna.  <div eID="gen8832" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4319"/><div sID="gen8833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4319"/> Puwas e' ya mala'ikat karuwana amu'usan bala' min pingganna tudju ni dilaut. Pagbu'us pa'in, magtūy tahik inān tahinang sagu, ati ai-ai bay allum ma deyom tahik amatay kamemon.  <div eID="gen8833" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4320"/><div sID="gen8834" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4320"/> Manjari mala'ikat kat'lluna amu'usan na isab bala' min pingganna tudju ni kasapa'-sapa'an maka ni saga tuburan bohe'. Pagbu'us pa'in, saga bohe' inān tahinang laha'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: Sakali takaleku bissala mala'ikat, ya tag-ntanan ma kabohe'-bohe'an. Yukna, <lg sID="gen8835"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8836"/>“O Tuhan Mahasussi, ya mbal magkapinda min awal tagna'<l eID="gen8836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8837"/>sampay ni kabuwattina'anan, abontol sadja hukumannu.<l eID="gen8837" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8838"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: Sabab in saga a'a suku'nu maka saga nabi<l eID="gen8838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8839"/>ya bay magpalatun palmannu, wa'i bay pinapatay.<l eID="gen8839" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8840"/>Bay pinabu'us laha' sigām e' saga a'a ma deyom dunya,<l eID="gen8840" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8841"/>angkan patut sigām pinainum laha'.<l eID="gen8841" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8842"/>Magtongod du pa'in hinang sigām maka tungbasna.”<l eID="gen8842" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8835"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' takaleku suwala min atag lamisahan pagkulbanan. Yuk suwala he', <lg sID="gen8843"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8844"/>“O Panghū', Tuhan Sangat Kawasa,<l eID="gen8844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8845"/>abontol sadja hukumannu, mbal tasoway.”<l eID="gen8845" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8843"/>  <div eID="gen8834" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4321"/><div sID="gen8846" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4321"/> Puwas pa'in e'-i, ya mala'ikat ka'mpatna amu'usan bala' min pingganna tudju ni mata llaw, manjari pinakalap silak llaw min bay dahū pamahanglus saga manusiya'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: Na, pagka ahanglus saga a'a e' llaw sabab kumarukan pasu'na, magtūy sigām magpanukna' ma ōn Tuhan ya magkabaya'an ma bala'. Mbal sigām pataikut min dusa sigām atawa amuwan sanglit ma Tuhan.  <div eID="gen8846" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4322"/><div sID="gen8847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4322"/> Manjari binu'usan pingganna e' mala'ikat kalimana, pinat'kka bala'na ni paningkō'an sattuwa talun, ni po'onan pamarintahanna. Magtūy taluwa' lendom katilibut lahat ya pamarintahan sattuwa he'. Pinagk'ttop e' saga a'a d'lla' sigām ma sabab kabisa p'ddi'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: Magpanukna' isab sigām ma Tuhan ya tag-sulga', ma sabab p'ddi' maka dugsul sigām. Sagō' mbal na pa'in sigām pataikut min kahinangan ala'at.  <div eID="gen8847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4323"/><div sID="gen8848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4323"/> Sakali binu'usan pinggan e' mala'ikat kannomna, pinat'kka bala'na ni sapa' aheya ya niōnan Alpurati. Pagbu'us pa'in, magtūy atigang bohe' sapa' inān, tahinang lān palabayan saga sultan luwas min sobangan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: Puwas e' aniya' saga saitan ta'nda'ku magbagala pinaka luwa ambak, t'llu hekana. Ina'an paluwas min bowa' naga, min bowa' sattuwa, maka min bowa' nabi ya bay magpamissala puting.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: Ya magbagala inān saga hibilis ata'u maghinang saga hinang makainu-inu. Manjari saga hibilis itu wa'i pehē' ni saga kasultanan ma kaluha'an dunya, amowa sigām magsakaum bo' supaya magbono' bang ta'abut llaw bay ginanta' e' Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, ya llawna makatāw-tāw.  <div eID="gen8848" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4324"/><div sID="gen8849" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4324"/> Sakali angabtang Al-Masi, yukna, “Pakale kam. Patangkaw aku pi'ilu ma waktu halam tapikilbi. Kinōgan to'ongan sasuku ta'abutku ajaga na pa'in maka asakap isab pan'mmekna. Mbal iya ta'abut ma sasangna anantang, ati halam aniya' kaiya'anna minsan iya paluwas ni kaheka'an a'a.”  <div eID="gen8849" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4325"/><div sID="gen8850" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4325"/> Na, tatipun e' t'llu hibilis inān saga sultan ma kaluha'an dunya, ni lahat ya niōnan Armageddon ma bahasa Hibrani.  <div eID="gen8850" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4326"/><div sID="gen8851" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4326"/> Manjari itu binu'usan na isab pingganna e' mala'ikat kapitu'na, pinat'kka ni tonga'an ayan. Pagbu'us pa'in, magtūy aniya' suwala akosog ah'lling min paningkō'an ma deyom langgal. Yuk suwala inān, “Na! Atangbus na!”

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: Magtūy aniya' lāt maka l'tte' maka l'ggon maglagublub, maka aniya' linug akosog makalandu'. Sangay min kaniya' manusiya' halam aniya' linug paliyu minnē' kosogna. Ya na he' kapuspusanna!

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: Magtūy magb'kka' tana' ma da'ira abantug, aboklang t'llu. Magka'at saga kada'irahan ma sabarang lahat. Manjari nientom Babilon Babantugun e' Tuhan, ati pinainum iya mulka' landu' abisa, luwas min sawanna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: Alanyap kapū'-pū'an kamemon. Sampay kabūd-būran, ala'an lullun min bay pat'nna'anna, mbal na ta'nda'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: Saga manusiya' inān bay katumbukan tigtigan aes min diyata' langit. Ya buhat dansolag aes itu aniya' saga limampū' kilu. Angkan saga a'a inān bay anukna'an Tuhan ma sabab kabisa bala' inān.  <div eID="gen8851" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.16"/> <div eID="gen8831" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4327"/><div sID="gen8852" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">D'nda Babantugun maka Sattuwa</title> <div sID="gen8853" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4327"/> Manjari itu aniya' pasekot ni aku dangan min saga pitu' mala'ikat ya magbowa pinggan inān. Yukna ni aku, “Dai' ka. Pa'nda'anta ka bang buwattingga hukuman ya pinat'kka ni da'ira aheya, ya ma atag kasowang-sowangan. Ya dalilna d'nda ala'at to'ongan hinangna, d'nda asal babantugun.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: Saga kanakura'an tag-lahat min sakalingkal dunya bay makapagbeya' maka d'nda babantugun itu maghinang kahina'an. Jari saga a'a kamemon tabowa-bowa isab ginila e' hinangna, sali' sapantun a'a nilango binu, mbal aiya' maghinang kasabulan.”  <div eID="gen8853" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4328"/><div sID="gen8854" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4328"/> Sakali kapagbaya'an aku e' Rū Tuhan ati binowa aku e' mala'ikat tudju ni lahat paslangan. Maina'an pa'in, aniya' ta'nda'ku dakayu' d'nda angura' ma sattuwa talun, walna' keyat. Sattuwa inān pitu' kōkna maka sangpū' tandukna. Alapat baranna e' ōn makapangkal ni Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: D'nda inān magbinadju' taluk maka keyat, ap'nno' e' pamulawan, palmata ahalga' maka saga mussa' tipay. Aniya' bowana ma tanganna sawan bulawan ap'nno' e' kalumu'an maka kasabulan, luwas bay min usahana.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: Aniya' isab ōn tasulat ma tuktukna, ōn alalom hatina. Ya na itu sulatanna: <div eID="gen8854" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8855" type="paragraph"/> BABILON DA'IRA BABANTUGUN <div eID="gen8855" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8856" type="paragraph"/> PO'ONAN KAPUTAHAN <div eID="gen8856" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8857" type="paragraph"/> PO'ONAN KALUMU'AN MAKA KASAMMALAN.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: Maka ta'nda'ku isab in d'nda inān nilango e' laha' bay tainumna, laha' min saga a'a suku' Tuhan, ya bay pinapatay ma sabab si Isa ya pamalutan sigām. <div eID="gen8857" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8858" type="paragraph"/> Pag'nda'ku d'nda inān, landu' tak'bbal atayku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: Na, tinilaw aku e' mala'ikat, yukna, “Ai kainu-inuhannu? Pahatita na ka ma pasalan d'nda inān maka bang ai hatina sattuwa pangura'anna inān, ya pitu' kōkna maka sangpū' tandukna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: Ya sattuwa talun ta'nda'nu inān, bay allum tagna', bo' bay amatay, maka marai' na paluwas min lowang tegob-tegoban bo' yampa pinapehē' ni katobtobanna, pinaka'at. Aheya kainu-inuhan saga a'a maglahat ma deyom dunya, sasuku halam bay tasulat ōn sigām ma deyom kitab panulatan ōn a'a taga-kallum kakkal, ya bay asal tasulat ma halam gi' bay pinapanjari dunya. Landu' sigām ainu-inu, pag'nda' sigām ma sattuwa talun e'. Bay allum, ati amatay, bo' palahil du pabalik.”  <div eID="gen8858" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4329"/><div sID="gen8859" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4329"/> Yuk mala'ikat gi', “Ya pamahatiku buwattina'an tahati du e' a'a alalom panahu'anna maka pangita'una. Ya pitu' kōk ma sattuwa talun inān, hatina pitu' būd paningkō'an e' d'nda ala'at e'. Maka hatina isab pitu' sultan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: Lima sultan inān palabay na kapagsultan sigām. Dakayu' inān masi magsultan ma buwattina'an, maka ya kapitu'na halam gi' magsultan. Bang ganta' magsultan na kapitu'na inān, dai'-dai' du kapagsultanna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: Ya sattuwa talun, bay allum bo' amatay, ya na ina'an sultan kawalu'na. Dambeya'an asal iya maka pitu' sultan e', ati pinapehē' iya ni katobtobanna, pinaka'at.  <div eID="gen8859" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4330"/><div sID="gen8860" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4330"/> In sangpū' tanduk ta'nda'nu inān, ya na sangpū' sultan saddī, halam gi' makapagsultan. Sigām kasangpū' kabuwanan kawasa magsultan magsambeya' maka sattuwa talun, saguwā' dai'-dai' du ya kapagsultan sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: Dakagara'an kasangpū' inān, ati pamuwan e' sigām ga'osan maka kapatut sigām ma sattuwa he'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: Manjari pa'atubang sigām magbono' maka Bili-bili. Sagō' tara'ug sigām e' Bili-bili maka saga a'a kapangandolanna, a'a bay tapene'na ameya' ma iya. Mbal iya angaku da'ug sabab in iya Panghū' sin kapanghū'an kamemon, maka Sultan sin kasultanan kamemon.”  <div eID="gen8860" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4331"/><div sID="gen8861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4331"/> Ah'lling gi' mala'ikat ni aku, yukna, “Bang pahatiku pasal kasowang-sowangan ya paningkō'an d'nda bay ta'nda'nu inān, ya na ginisan panubu', palbangsahan, pangkatan maka pihak, sampay ginisan bahasa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: Sangpū' tanduk isab ya ta'nda'nu inān, hatina sangpū' sultan. Ma sinosōng, sigām maka sattuwa talun e' ab'nsi du ma d'nda ala'at inān. Niā'an iya e' sigām pangalta'na kamemon, tinantangan ai-ai kamemon bay ma baranna. Pinagkakan e' sigām isina bo' yampa iya tinunu'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: Buwattē' hinang sigām sabab pinapikil sigām e' Tuhan angahinang kabaya'anna. Min kahandakna, ya angkan atayudtud kagara'an sangpū' sultan inān anukbalan kapatut sigām ni sattuwa talun, sampay ta'abut atuman kamemon bay pangallam Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: Ya d'nda bay ta'nda'nu,” yuk mala'ikat, “ya na da'ira babantugun ya magkuma'agi ma kasultanan ma deyom dunya.”  <div eID="gen8861" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.17"/> <div eID="gen8852" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4332"/><div sID="gen8862" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Magka'at Da'ira Babilon</title> <div sID="gen8863" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4332"/> Pagubus pa'in inān, aniya' isab ta'nda'ku mala'ikat saddī pareyo' min sulga'. Aheya kawasana, maka sahayana inān makabuwan kasawahan ma katilibut dunya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: Magsuwala iya pakosog, yukna, <lg sID="gen8864"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8865"/>“Katūyan na! Magka'at na Babilon, da'ira babantugun!<l eID="gen8865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8866"/>Tahinang na paglahatan saga hibilis,<l eID="gen8866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8867"/>pagsakauman saga saitan,<l eID="gen8867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8868"/>pagt'ppakan saga manuk-manuk haram, ya makasammal.<l eID="gen8868" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8869"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: Babilon itu sapantun d'nda ala'at,<l eID="gen8869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8870"/>amidjakan bangsa a'a kamemon maginum binuna makalango,<l eID="gen8870" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8871"/>tabowa-bowa sigām maghinang kahina'an maka iya.<l eID="gen8871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8872"/>Saga pagsultanan isab, ya tag-lahat ma deyom dunya,<l eID="gen8872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8873"/>bay magkahina'an maka iya.<l eID="gen8873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8874"/>Maka saga a'a maglilitu ma sabarang lahat,<l eID="gen8874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8875"/>bay magkarayahan ma sabab napsu karalaman d'nda itu.”<l eID="gen8875" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8864"/>  <div eID="gen8863" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4333"/><div sID="gen8876" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4333"/> Sakali aniya' takaleku suwala saddī ah'lling min sulga', yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8877"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8878"/>“Paluwas kam minnilu, ka'am suku'ku.<l eID="gen8878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8879"/>Ala'an kam min d'nda ilu.<l eID="gen8879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8880"/>Da'a kam palamud ma iya maghinang kala'atan,<l eID="gen8880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8881"/>bo' kam mbal talapay ma kabinasahan ya pinat'nna'an iya.<l eID="gen8881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8882"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: Kalna' paldusahanna magtimbun-tambak na, pabūd ni diyata' langit.<l eID="gen8882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8883"/>Halam takalipat e' Tuhan kahinanganna ala'at.<l eID="gen8883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8884"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: Hinangunbi ma iya buwat bay hinangna ma kasehe'an.<l eID="gen8884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8885"/>Ya panungbas ma iya subay nilipat duwa ma ai-ai bay hinangna.<l eID="gen8885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8886"/>Pagka tabowana saga a'a anginam kasabulanna,<l eID="gen8886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8887"/>subay isab iya pinananaman mulka' Tuhan nilipat duwa kosogna.<l eID="gen8887" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8888"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: Pat'kkahunbi ma iya kabinasahan maka karukka'an.<l eID="gen8888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8889"/>Papagtongorunbi maka bay pagmalangkahina<l eID="gen8889" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8890"/>maka pagdūl-baya'na ma kanapsuhanna indaginis.<l eID="gen8890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8891"/>Hal iya magabbu ma deyom pikilanna, yuk-i,<l eID="gen8891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8892"/>‘Aku itu sultan makapagbaya', mbal du aku magkabalu.<l eID="gen8892" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8893"/>Mbal du aku makananam kasusahan.’<l eID="gen8893" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8894"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: Sabab min pagabbuna angkan d'nda itu<l eID="gen8894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8895"/>katumbukan bala' indalupa ginis ma deyom dang'llaw.<l eID="gen8895" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8896"/>Taluwa' iya bonglay, kaudjulan maka gotom.<l eID="gen8896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8897"/>Tinunu' isab iya ma deyom api,<l eID="gen8897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8898"/>sabab akawasa asal Panghū'tam Tuhan,<l eID="gen8898" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8899"/>ya amat'nna'an iya hukuman.”<l eID="gen8899" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8877"/>  <div eID="gen8876" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4334"/><div sID="gen8900" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4334"/> Manjari saga nakura' tag-lahat ma deyom dunya, ya bay magbeya' maka d'nda inān maghinang kasabulan maka magdūl-baya'an kanapsuhan sigām, magtangis du maka magdukka, pag'nda' sigām humbu ya paluwas min tunu' da'ira he'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: Ina'an sigām an'ngge ang'nda'-ng'nda' min katāhan sabab atāw talapay ma kabinasahanna. Ya pagdohon sigām, “Allā, mbal manjari! Kaliman da'ira Babilon, kabantugna maka kakosogna. Dasasa'at du, kabinasahan magtūy ya pakadalanna.”  <div eID="gen8900" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4335"/><div sID="gen8901" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4335"/> Ya du saga a'a maglilitu ma deyom dunya, magtangis isab maka magdohon pasal halam na aniya' magpam'lli dagangan sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: Halam aniya' am'lli ni sigām saga bulawan, pilak, palmata maka mussa'. Halam na aniya' am'lli kakana' sigām ahalga', buwat kakana' taluk, keyat, maka sutla'. Halam na aniya' am'lli ginisan kayu ya alahang ta'nda' e' a'a, maka ai-ai hinangan garing maka kayu ahalga', maka ai-ai hinangan tumbaga, basi' maka batu marbol.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: Halam isab aniya' am'lli saga pamapā ya dagangan sigām, saga kamanyan, laksi', maka ns'llan pahamut. Halam na aniya' am'lli saga binu, ns'llan jaitun,<note>Jaitun itu ginis kayu ahāp pangā'an ns'llan pagb'lla, ns'llan pang'ns'llan palita'an.</note> tirigu maka buwasna. Halam na aniya' am'lli ni sigām saga sapi', bili-bili, kura' maka saga pameya'an ya ginuyud e' kura', sampay isab saga a'a ya niragangan e' sigām nihinang ata.  <div eID="gen8901" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4336"/><div sID="gen8902" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4336"/> Yuk saga a'a maglilitu itu ni da'ira Babilon, “Na, pahalam na min ka'a kamemon bay kanapsuhannu. Alungay na min ka'a pangalta'nu kamemon maka kapanyapannu ahalga'. Mbal na tabaliknu saumul-umul.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: Saga a'a magdaragang, ya bay magkarayahan min pagdagang sigām ma deyom da'ira inān, ang'nda'-ng'nda' ma tunu'na min katahan sabab atāw sigām talapay ma kabinasahanna. Magtangis sigām maka magdohon,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8903"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8904"/>“Allā, mbal manjari da'ira babantugun e'.<l eID="gen8904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8905"/>Sapantun d'nda magpamakay kakana' ahalga',<l eID="gen8905" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8906"/>walna' taluk maka keyat, alapat isab e' pamulawan,<l eID="gen8906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8907"/>palmata ahalga' maka mussa'.<l eID="gen8907" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8908"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: Dasasa'at du, magtūy alungay pangalta'na kamemon.”<l eID="gen8908" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8903"/> <div eID="gen8902" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8909" type="paragraph"/> Damikiyanna isab saga nakura' ma kappal maka saga pasahero, maka saga a'a maghinang isab ma kappal sampay sasuku magusaha ma dilaut, ang'nda'-ng'nda' isab ma da'ira inān min katāhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: Pag'nda' sigām ma humbu min tunu'na he', magtūy sigām angolang, yuk-i, “Halam aniya' da'ira saddī makaliyu bantugna min da'ira Babilon inān.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: Magtūy sigām amusugan bagunbun ni diyata' kōk sigām, tanda' saksi' in sigām magkarukka'an na. Magtangis sigām maka magdohon, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8910"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8911"/>“Allā, mbal manjari da'ira babantugun e'! Kaugun to'ongan.<l eID="gen8911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8912"/>Ya na da'ira pangā'an karaya e' sasuku magkakappal<l eID="gen8912" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8913"/>sabab aheka alta' bay mahē'.<l eID="gen8913" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8914"/>Sagō' dasasa'at du, magtūy alungay ai-aina kamemon!”<l eID="gen8914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8915"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: Ka'am ma deyom sulga', magkōg-koyag kam<l eID="gen8915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8916"/>pagka magka'at na da'ira he'.<l eID="gen8916" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8917"/>Ka'am saga a'a suku' Tuhan, maka ka'am saga a'a kawakilan,<l eID="gen8917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8918"/>maka ka'am isāb kanabi-nabihan,<l eID="gen8918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8919"/>magkōg-koyag kam sabab katungbasan in da'ira Babilon,<l eID="gen8919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8920"/>taluwa' hukuman Tuhan ma sabab bay hinangna ma ka'am.<l eID="gen8920" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8910"/>  <div eID="gen8909" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4337"/><div sID="gen8921" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4337"/> Na puwas e', aniya' mala'ikat akosog amuhat batu aheya to'ongan, sali' heya batu gilingan bay awal, ati nihantakan e'na ni tahik. Yukna, <lg sID="gen8922"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8923"/>“Buwattina'an ya kaheya paglubu ma Babilon, da'ira babantugun,<l eID="gen8923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8924"/>mbal na ta'nda' pabīng sampay ni kasaumulan.<l eID="gen8924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8925"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: Ka'a, da'ira Babilon, mbal na takale ma deyomannu<l eID="gen8925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8926"/>saga a'a magbiyula maka a'a magkalangan,<l eID="gen8926" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8927"/>a'a magsoleng maka a'a magtiyup-tiyup.<l eID="gen8927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8928"/>Mbal na ta'nda' mailu a'a maghinang ai-ai kapandayan sigām.<l eID="gen8928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8929"/>Mbal na takale llub paggilingan.<l eID="gen8929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8930"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: Minsan sū' palita'an mbal na ta'nda' mailu.<l eID="gen8930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8931"/>Sampay paglami-lami pagkawin, mbal na takale.<l eID="gen8931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8932"/>Saga a'abi magdaragang bay tamakaga'os ma kaluha'an dunya.<l eID="gen8932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8933"/>Ka'akkalan saga palbangsahan kamemon ma sabab pantaknu maka hikmatnu.<l eID="gen8933" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8934"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: Katōngan dusa da'ira Babilon itu ma sabab kapamono'na<l eID="gen8934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8935"/>ma saga kanabi-nabihan maka saga a'a suku' Tuhan.<l eID="gen8935" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8936"/>Ina'an ma Babilon ba'anan bangkay sigām,<l eID="gen8936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8937"/>sampay saga a'a kamemon ya patay bono' ma deyom dunya.”<l eID="gen8937" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8922"/>  <div eID="gen8921" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.18"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: Na aubus pa'in e'-i, aniya' takaleku sali' suwala min manusiya' kumarukan hekana sikapūn-pūnan maina'an ma sulga'. Yuk sigām, <lg sID="gen8939"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8940"/>“Pudjitam Tuhan! Ma iya asal sahaya maka kawasa.<l eID="gen8940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8941"/>Tunggal du iya makalappasan kitam min dusa.<l eID="gen8941" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8942"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: Abontol maka b'nnal hukumanna kamemon.<l eID="gen8942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8943"/>Pat'nna'na hukuman ma d'nda babantugun, d'nda ala'at hinangna<l eID="gen8943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8944"/>ya bay amowa-mowa a'a kamemon anunud ma iya maghinang kalumu'an.<l eID="gen8944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8945"/>Bininasa iya e' Tuhan ma sabab a'a suku' Tuhan ya papatayna.”<l eID="gen8945" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8939"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: Sakali in ba'anan a'a inān magsuwala pabīng, suwala atanog, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8946"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8947"/>“Sanglitantam Tuhan! Atunu' da'ira babantugun.<l eID="gen8947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8948"/>Pat'bbud na pa'in humbuna sampay ni kasaumulan.”<l eID="gen8948" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8946"/>  <div eID="gen8938" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4338"/><div sID="gen8949" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4338"/> Manjari in duwampū' maka mpat pagmatto'ahan maka mpat binatang e' magsujuran na, maka e' sigām amudji Tuhan ya aningkō' ma paningkō'an bangsahan. Yuk sigām, <lg sID="gen8950"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8951"/>“Amin! Sanglitantam Tuhan!”<l eID="gen8951" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8950"/>  <div eID="gen8949" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4339"/><div sID="gen8952" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4339"/> Sakali aniya' takaleku suwala paluwas min tongod paningkō'an Tuhan, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8953"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8954"/>“Sanglitinbi Tuhan, ka'am kamemon sosoho'anna,<l eID="gen8954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8955"/>sasuku kam magmatāw ma iya,<l eID="gen8955" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8956"/>ai na ka alanga, ai na ka areyo'.”<l eID="gen8956" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen8953"/>  <div eID="gen8952" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4340"/><div sID="gen8957" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4340"/> Puwas e' aniya' takaleku sali' suwala min manusiya' kumarukan hekana. Akosog to'ongan llingna, sali' lagublub bohe' anasahan min diyata' maka sali' l'ggon landu' akosog. Takaleku ya bissala sigām, yuk-i, <lg sID="gen8958"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8959"/>“Sanglitanta na Tuhan! Sanglitanta na Panghū'tam Tuhan<l eID="gen8959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8960"/>Sangat Kawasa, sabab pat'nna'na na pagparintana!<l eID="gen8960" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8961"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: Subay kitam magkōg-koyag, magkalasigan to'ongan.<l eID="gen8961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8962"/>Sanglitantam Tuhan<l eID="gen8962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8963"/>sabab ta'abut na waktu pagkawin Bili-bili maka saga a'a suku'na,<l eID="gen8963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8964"/>sapantun pangantin d'nda ya angari-ngarihan di-na.<l eID="gen8964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8965"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: Kabuwanan iya s'mmek angillap, s'mmek apote' to'ongan.”<l eID="gen8965" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen8958"/> (In s'mmek pote' itu, bang nihati, ya na ka'adilan bay tahinang e' saga a'a suku' Tuhan.)  <div eID="gen8957" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4341"/><div sID="gen8966" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4341"/> Sakali ah'lling ni aku dakayu' mala'ikat e', yukna, “Sulatun itu: aheya kahāpan sasuku sinō' paluruk ni pagkawinan Bili-bili.” Sinugpatan lagi' bissala mala'ikat inān, yukna, “Kallam Tuhan ko' itu, kallam b'nnal.”  <div eID="gen8966" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4342"/><div sID="gen8967" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4342"/> Magtūy aku pasujud ma atag tape' mala'ikat inān amudji iya, sagō' yukna, “Da'a ka pasujud ni aku. Aku itu dakayu' sosoho'an Tuhan buwat du ka'a maka saga dauranakannu ya amogbogan lapal b'nnal bay pamata'u e' si Isa. Tuhan sadja pudjihun. Lapal si Isa itu, ya na lapal bay pamatulun e' Tuhan ni saga nabi.”  <div eID="gen8967" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8862" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4343"/><div sID="gen8968" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">A'a Angura'an Kura' Pote'</title> <div sID="gen8969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4343"/> Manjari itu ta'nda'ku aukab sulga', maka aniya' kura' pote'. Ya angura' ma kura' inān pinagōnan si Kapangandolan maka Kasab'nnalan. Abontol pangahukumna maka pamono'na ma palbantahanna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: Matana inān sali' api parallet, maka aheka korona paporong ma kōkna. Aniya' ōn sinulat ma puhu'na sagō' halam aniya' makata'u bang ai hatina, luwal baranna ya makata'u.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: Ya juba pas'mmekna inān ap'nno' e' laha', maka ya ōn pangōn iya, “Palman Tuhan”.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: Tinurul iya e' ba'anan sundalu min sulga'. Magpangura' sigām ma saga kura' pote' maka magnijuba pote' isab, juba halam aniya' tamakna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: Ya niōnan Palman Tuhan itu, aniya' takos atalom paluwas min bowa'na, panganda'ugna ma palbangsa-bangsahan. Magbaya' iya ma sigām kamemon, maka akosog kapagbaya'na, sali' hantang tungkud basi' mbal tasagga'. Sasuku angatu ma iya sali' sapantun buwa' anggul ya gini'ikan ma pagp'gga'an Tuhan Sangat Kawasa, jari mulka' mbal tasipat bisana ya paluwas minnē'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: Aniya' ōn sinulat ma jubana maka ma pa'ana, buwattitu: <div eID="gen8969" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8970" type="paragraph"/> SULTAN SIN KASULTANAN, <div eID="gen8970" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8971" type="paragraph"/> PANGHŪ' SIN KAPANGHŪ'AN.  <div eID="gen8971" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4344"/><div sID="gen8972" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4344"/> Manjari ta'nda'ku na isab dakayu' mala'ikat ma diyata' langit, an'ngge ma sinag llaw. Angalingan iya pakosog ni kamanuk-manukan kamemon ya magleyangan ma tonga'an ayan inān. Yuk-i, “Pi'itu kam magsakaum ni pagjamuhan Tuhan, pagjamuhanna aheya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: Pi'itu kam amangan isi patay saga kasultanan, saga jiniral maka saga kasundaluhan, sambil isi kura' maka isi a'a ya bay magpangura'. Amangan kam isi patay indaginis kamemon, ata maka ngga'i ka ata, a'a alanga maka a'a areyo'.”  <div eID="gen8972" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4345"/><div sID="gen8973" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4345"/> Puwas e' ta'nda'ku sattuwa talun inān magtipun maka kasultanan min kaluha'an dunya sampay kasundaluhan sigām. Ina'an sigām magdakayu' amono' ma dangan ya angura' ma kura' pote' inān, beya' isab saga sundaluna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: Manjari sinaggaw sattuwa talun maka nabi putingan ya kawakilan e' sattuwa talun, angkan iya bay makahinang saga hinang kainu-inuhan a'a. Hinangna inān bay pangakkalna saga a'a, sasuku kasāpan maka umbul sattuwa, maka sasuku bay anumba ni ta'u-ta'u ya nihinang pangluwahan sattuwa dakayu'. Na, in sattuwa talun maka nabi putingan inān, bay nilarukan maka kallum-llum sigām ni deyom api mailang ya magdanaw-danaw suleyabna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: Ati saga kasundaluhan sigām bay pinapatay maka takos ya paluwas min bowa' a'a ya angura' inān. Pinagkakan isi patay sigām e' kamanuk-manukan, sampay mag'ssohan na.  <div eID="gen8973" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.19"/> <div eID="gen8968" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4346"/><div sID="gen8974" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Dangibu Tahun</title> <div sID="gen8975" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4346"/> Manjari aniya' na isab ta'nda'ku mala'ikat pareyo' min sulga', amowa kunsi' tambol lowang tegob-tegoban, maka kilikili a'aslag.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: Sinaggaw e'na naga, ya Sowa Masa Awal, hatina nakura' saitan atawa hibilis. Tasaggaw pa'in, niengkotan iya maka kilikili ati ginanta'an dangibu tahun.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: Puwas e', nilarukan iya e' mala'ikat ni deyom lowang tegob-tegoban, bo' kinandaruhan pahogot sampay pinikitan gindan bo' mbal taukab. Tinambolan nakura' saitan inān bo' supaya mbal na pa'in makapangakkal ma palbangsa-bangsahan, sat'ggol mbal gi' pa'abut ni dangibu tahun e'. Bang ta'abut na dangibu tahun, pinal'ppa du iya, sagō' dai'-dai' du.  <div eID="gen8975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4347"/><div sID="gen8976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4347"/> Manjari itu aniya' ta'nda'ku saga paningkō'an babangsahun maka saga a'a magtingkō'an maina'an. Kabuwanan sigām kapatut amal'ngngan hukuman. Ta'nda'ku ba'anan saga umagad min a'a bay pinapatay ma sabab pagnasihat sigām pandu' b'nnal ya bay pamata'u e' si Isa, maka ma sabab palman Tuhan. Saga a'a itu halam bay makasumba ni sattuwa talun atawa ni ta'u-ta'u hinangan pangluwahanna. Halam isab bay makataima' umbul sattuwa panāp tuktuk sigām atawa tangan sigām. Allum na sigām pabalik min kamatay ati ameya' sigām ma Al-Masi magsultan ma deyom dangibu tahun.  <div eID="gen8976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4348"/><div sID="gen8977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4348"/> Ya ina'an tagna'an pagpakallum pabalik ma saga a'a bay magpatayan. (A'a magpatayan kasehe' mbal gi' pinakallum pabīng. Subay na apuwas dangibu tahun e'.)

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: Aheya kalasigan maka kahāpan sasuku makasambeya' pinakallum min kamatay ma pagpakallum dahū itu. Mbal sigām talapay ma kabinasahan paddas, ya pinagbahasa kamatay kaminduwana. Pina'ntanan sigām hinang kaimaman angarap ni Tuhan maka ni Al-Masi. Ati ameya' sigām ma Al-Masi ang'ntan pagparinta ma deyom dangibu tahun.  <div eID="gen8977" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8974" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4349"/><div sID="gen8978" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Pasal Nakura' Saitan Tara'ug na</title> <div sID="gen8979" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4349"/> Na, bang atobtob na dangibu tahun inān, pinal'ppa du nakura' saitan min deyom lowang bay pangalabusuhan iya.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: Pagluwasna minnē', angakkal na isab iya ma kabangsa-bangsahan ma mpat pidjū alam, ya bangsa pinagōnan Gōg maka Magog. Pinapagsakaum saga a'a inān kamemon e' nakura' saitan, pinasakap magbono'. Ya heka sigām inān sali' sapantun heka solagan gusung ma bihing tampe.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: Manjari maglanjalan ba'anan a'a inān bo' angulatapan kaluha'an dunya, sampay alikus e' sigām paghanti'an a'a suku' Tuhan maka da'ira kalasahanna. Sagō' aniya' api pareyo' min langit anunu' sigām kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: Puwas e' in nakura' saitan, ya bay angakkalan saga a'a palbangsa-bangsahan inān, wa'i nilarukan ni deyom api mailang ya magdanaw-danaw suleyabna. Ya na he' api bay pangalarukan sattuwa talun maka nabi putingan. Na, ina'an sigām pinap'ddi'an llaw-sangom sampay ni kasaumulan.  <div eID="gen8979" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8978" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4350"/><div sID="gen8980" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Hukuman Kahinapusan</title> <div sID="gen8981" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4350"/> Manjari itu aniya' ta'nda'ku paningkō'an apote' maka aheya, maka ta'nda'ku isab ya magtingkō' maina'an. Dunya maka langit wa'i na ala'an min haddaratna, mbal na ta'nda' pabīng.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: Sakali ta'nda'ku a'a magpatayan kamemon aheya-ariki', ina'an magpan'ngge ma dahuan paningkō'an inān. Jari niukab kakitaban, maka aniya' gi' kitab dakayu' niukab, ya kitab pagsusulatan ōn saga a'a, sasuku kabuwanan kallum kakkal. Saga a'a magpatayan inān nihukum min bay kahinangan sigām ahāp-ala'at, ya tasulat asal ma deyom saga kitab inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: Sai-sai bay magpatayan ma deyom tahik bay paluwas paharap ni Tuhan. Damikiyan isab sigām bay ma deyom gumi maka nalka' paluwas isab sigām kamemon bo' paharap ni Tuhan. Ati nihukum sigām kamemon kaniya-kaniya min bay kahinangan sigām ahāp-ala'at.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: Puwas e', sasuku halam bay tasulat ōnna ma deyom kitab pagsusulatan ōn saga a'a taga-kallum kakkal, nilarukan ni deyom kasaplagan api ya magdanaw-danaw suleyabna. Manjari in kamatay maka nalka' bay tinimanan ni deyom api mailang ya magdanaw-danaw, ya pinagōnan kamatay karuwana.  <div eID="gen8981" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.20"/> <div eID="gen8980" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: Puwas e', sasuku halam bay tasulat ōnna ma deyom kitab pagsusulatan ōn saga a'a taga-kallum kakkal, nilarukan ni deyom kasaplagan api ya magdanaw-danaw suleyabna. Manjari in kamatay maka nalka' bay tinimanan ni deyom api mailang ya magdanaw-danaw, ya pinagōnan kamatay karuwana.  <div eID="gen8981" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.20"/> <div eID="gen8980" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4351"/><div sID="gen8982" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Langit Baha'u maka Dunya Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen8983" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4351"/> Manjari itu aniya' ta'nda'ku langit maka dunya hinangan baha'u, halam aniya' tahikna. Langit tagna' maka dunya tagna' bay na nilanyapan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: Ta'nda'ku isab da'ira Sussi, Awrusalam Baha'u, deyo' bay min sulga' min haddarat Tuhan. Ya da'ira inān bay niari-arihan sali' sapantun pangantin d'nda bang song binatalan ni pangantin l'lla.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: Sakali aniya' takaleku suwala akosog luwas min paningkō'an Tuhan, yuk-i, “Buwattina'an magdalahat na Tuhan maka manusiya'. Pat'nna' iya ma sigām, jari in sigām palsuku'anna na. Magbaran na Tuhan pataptap ma manusiya' ati iya ya pagtuhanan sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: Sinapuhan e'na kamemon bohe' mata sigām. Halam na aniya' magkamatay, halam na aniya' magdohon atawa magtangis, maka halam na aniya' p'ddi' tananam e' sigām. Sabab kamemon kahālan ma dunya tagna' pahalam na.”  <div eID="gen8983" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4352"/><div sID="gen8984" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4352"/> Sakali angabtang Dangan ya aningkō' ma tingkō'an bangsahan, yukna, “Na, pabaha'uku na ai-ai kamemon.” Yukna lagi', “Sulatun itu, sabab b'nnal sadja kabtangan itu maka kapangandolan.”  <div eID="gen8984" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4353"/><div sID="gen8985" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4353"/> Angallam isab iya ni aku, yukna, “Aubus na kahinanganku kamemon. Aku in Alip maka Ya', Tagna'an maka Kahinapusan. Sai-sai patay bohe' painumku min tuburan bohe' ya amuwan kallum kakkal. Painumku iya minsan halam aniya' tongodna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: Pasuku'anku kahāpan itu ma sasuku mbal taga'os e' sasat-manasat. Aku ya pagtuhananna, maka iya ya anakku.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: Saguwā' sasuku patāw maka sasuku mbal kapangandolan, nilarukan ni deyom api. Damikiyanna isab sasuku maghinang kasammalan, saga amono' ma pagkahina manusiya', maghinang kalumu'an d'nda maka l'lla, saga magpantak, saga a'a anumba ni saddī min Tuhan, sampay kamemon saga a'a magputing, ya palsuku'an sigām kamemon pinehē' ni deyom api mailang, ya magdanaw-danaw suleyabna. Ya na he' pinagōnan Kamatay Karuwana.”  <div eID="gen8985" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8982" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4354"/><div sID="gen8986" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Awrusalam Baha'u</title> <div sID="gen8987" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4354"/> Sakali itu aniya' pasekot ni aku dakayu' mala'ikat min mala'ikat pitu' inān, ya amowa pitu' pinggan bulawan ap'nno' e' pitu' ginis bala'. Yukna ni aku, “Pi'itu ka. Pa'nda'anta ka pangantin d'nda, ya pinah'nda e' Bili-bili.”

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: Manjari kapagbaya'an aku e' Rū Tuhan ati binowa aku e' mala'ikat e' tudju ni diyata' būd alanga to'ongan. Pina'nda'an aku Awrusalam, Da'ira Sussi, hinabuna pareyo' min sulga', min haddarat Tuhan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: Da'ira inān angillap e' sahaya Tuhan. Ya illapna sali' illap palmata intan gaddung, atilag sali' sawa samin.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: Da'ira inān bay nilikusan maka ād batu aluha maka alangkaw. Sangpū' maka duwa lawangna, tinunggu'an pakaniya-pakaniya e' mala'ikat sangpū' maka duwa. Ya lawang inān bay sinulatan maka ōn bangsa Isra'il kasangpū' maka duwa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: Ād inān aniya' t'llu lawangna tampal ni sobangan, t'llu ni satan, t'llu ni uttala', maka t'llu isab tampal ni s'ddopan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: Ya papagan ād pangalikus da'ira inān sangpū' maka duwa batu aheya, sinulatan pakaniya-pakaniya maka ōn a'a kasangpū' maka duwa ya bay kawakilan e' Bili-bili.  <div eID="gen8987" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4355"/><div sID="gen8988" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4355"/> Na, ya mala'ikat bay amissalahan aku inān, aniya' bowana sukuran bulawan panukudna ma da'ira sampay ma lawangna maka ādna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: Magpasagi' da'ira inān, sali' du taha'na maka luhana. Pagsukud itu duwangibu maka mpat hatus kilometro taha'na, maka langana maka luhana.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: Sinukud isab e'na kapal ād inān ati sukuranna mpatpū' d'ppa bang ma sukurantam.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: Palmata intan gaddung ya pangahinang ād inān ati baran da'ira inān bay nihinang maka dī bulawan, sagō' atilag sali' sawa samin.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: Saga batu pamapagan ād pangalikus da'ira inān bay niari-arihan maka palmata ginis-ginisan. Ya pangari-ngari batu dakayu' inān palmata intan gaddung, ya karuwana palmata bilu alutu', kat'lluna palmata jali'-jali', ka'mpatna palmata gaddung alutu',

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: kalimana palmata sakulati magjali'-jali', kannomna palmata keyat alutu', kapitu'na palmata biyaning, kawalu'na palmata ogos gaddung, kasiyamna palmata kuning, kasangpū'na palmata gaddung ugbus-ugbus saging, kasangpū' ka ssana palmata bilu magb'ttik-b'ttik, ati ya kasangpū' karuwana palmata taluk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: Ya pangahinang sangpū' maka duwa lawang da'ira inān sangpū' maka duwa isab mussa' tipay. Dakayu' du mussa' atibu'uk ya pangahinang dakayu' lawang. Maka saga lān ma deyom da'ira inān dī bulawan, atilag sali' sawa samin.  <div eID="gen8988" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4356"/><div sID="gen8989" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4356"/> Halam aniya' langgal ta'nda'ku ma deyom da'ira inān pangarapan Tuhan sabab ina'an asal Tuhan ya Panghū' Sangat Kawasa, maka ina'an isab Bili-bili. Angkan mbal kagunahan langgal maina'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: Mbal isab magkagunahan sawa llaw atawa sawa bulan ma da'ira inān sabab ina'an asal sahaya Tuhan amuwan kasawahan, maka ina'an Bili-bili pamalita'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: Pasaplag sawana inān pamasawa pal'ngnganan palbangsa-bangsahan. Maka saga kasultanan min kaluha'an dunya amowa du pangalta' sigām ni deyom da'ira inān.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: Saga lawangna mbal tinambol, aukab sadja kahaba' llaw sabab halam na aniya' sangom maina'an.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: Ai-ai makabuwan kabantugan ma palbangsa-bangsahan maka ai-ai pangalta' sigām, binowa du pina'an ni deyom da'ira,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: sagō' halam aniya' lumu' pinasōd pina'an atawa a'a maghinang kamaruhan atawa a'a magputing. Ya sadja makasōd ni deyom da'ira inān bang a'a bay tasulat ōn sigām ma kitab suku' Bili-bili, ya kitab panunulatan ōn a'a bay kabuwanan kallum kakkal.  <div eID="gen8989" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.21"/> <div eID="gen8986" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4357"/><div sID="gen8990" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Sapa' Po'onan Kallum</title> <div sID="gen8991" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4357"/> Sakali itu pina'nda'an aku sapa' e' mala'ikat, sapa' makabuwan kallum kakkal. Asawa sidda bohe'na, anasahan min paningkō'an Tuhan maka Bili-bili,

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: labay min t'ngnga' lān ya ma deyom da'ira he'. Ma karuwambila' sapa' inān aniya' kayu, ya kayu makabuwan kallum. Kayu inān magbuwa' min sangpū' maka duwa ma deyom dantahun, min t'dda ma deyom dambulan. Bo' dahunna inān tapanguli' saki ma kabangsa-bangsahan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: Halam aniya' mulka' tabāk ma deyom da'ira inān. <div eID="gen8991" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8992" type="paragraph"/> Ya tingkō'an Tuhan maka Bili-bili ina'an ma deyom da'ira ati pinudji du iya e' saga sosoho'anna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: Ta'nda' e' sigām pamaihu'anna maka sinulatan ōnna tuktuk sigām.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: Halam aniya' sangomna mahē' maka mbal sigām magkagunahan palita'an atawa mata llaw sabab Panghū' Tuhan ya amaranta' sigām. Maka sigām ya ang'ntan pagparinta sampay ni kasaumulan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: Manjari amissala mala'ikat inān ni aku, yukna, “Ya lapal kabtangan bay tasulatnu ilu b'nnal sadja, kapangandolan asal. Sabab in Panghū'tam Tuhan, ya amasangon Rū-na ma kanabi-nabihan, bay amapi'itu mala'ikatna amata'uwan saga sosoho'anna pasal pakaradja'an marai' na pinat'kka.”  <div eID="gen8992" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8990" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4358"/><div sID="gen8993" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Kapi'itu si Isa Pabalik</title> <div sID="gen8994" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4358"/> “Pakale kam,” yuk si Isa, “asekot na kapi'iluku. Aheya du kakōgan sasuku magkahagad ma kabtangan bay takallam ma deyom sulat ilu.”  <div eID="gen8994" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4359"/><div sID="gen8995" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4359"/> Na, aku itu si Yahiya. Bay takaleku maka ta'nda'ku saga pakaradja'an tasulat itu kamemon. Akatis pa'in e'ku akale maka ang'nda', magtūy aku bay pasujud ma alopan mala'ikat, ya bay ama'nda'an aku ai-ai he'. Arak aku amudji iya,

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: sagō' yuk mala'ikat e' ni aku, “Da'a ka amudji aku sabab pagkahinu aku sosoho'an Tuhan. Pagkahiku isab saga kanabi-nabihan ya dauranakannu, maka sasuku magkahagad ma lapal sulat itu. Luwal Tuhan dakayu'-kayu' ya pudjita.”  <div eID="gen8995" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4360"/><div sID="gen8996" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4360"/> Yukna isab ni aku, “Da'a limbungin lapal bay pamalman ma deyom sulat itu sabab asekot na waktu pamat'kka pakaradja'anna kamemon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: Sai-sai angahinang kala'atan maka kasabulan, paruhun gom pa'in kala'atanna maka kasabulanna ma sinosōng. Damikiyanna isab sai-sai bay angahinang ahāp subay pasangdan na maghinang ahāp. Maka sai-sai isab asussi pangatayanna subay pasangdan magmasussi.”  <div eID="gen8996" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4361"/><div sID="gen8997" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4361"/> “Pakale kam,” yuk si Isa. “Asekot na kapi'iluku. Bowaku du tungbas panungbasku a'a kamemon kaniya-kaniya, ai-ai katongoran hinangna.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: Aku in Alip maka Ya', in Awal maka Ahil, in Tagna'an maka Kahinapusan.  <div eID="gen8997" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4362"/><div sID="gen8998" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4362"/> “Aheya kakōganna sasuku anussi pamakayna min tamak kamemon, hatina anussi pangatayanna, sabab kabuwanan sigām kapatut amangan buwa' min kayu makabuwan kallum e', maka kapatut isab palabay min saga lawang pasōran ni deyom da'ira he'.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: Sagō' ina'an ma luwasan da'ira saga maghihinang kalumu'an na pa'in, saga magpapantak, saga a'a maghinang kasabulan d'nda maka l'lla, saga a'a magpapatay pagkahina manusiya', saga a'a magpanumba ni saddī min Tuhan maka saga a'a magpangakkal maka magputing.  <div eID="gen8998" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4363"/><div sID="gen8999" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4363"/> “Aku itu si Isa. Bay soho'ku mala'ikatku pi'ilu ni ka'am saga palhimpunan jama'aku bo' kam pinata'u e'na pasal saga pakaradja'an itu. Aku itu tubu' sultan Da'ud. Aku itu niōnan Maga, bitu'un asahaya.”  <div eID="gen8999" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4364"/><div sID="gen9000" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4364"/> Sakali ah'lling Rū Tuhan maka saga a'a ya pinagbahasa pangantin d'nda. Yuk sigām, “Pi'itu ka.” Sasuku makakale bissala itu subay ameya'-meya' ah'lling, “Pi'itu ka.” Pi'itu kam, sasuku kam patay bohe'. Anginum kam bohe' makabuwan kallum itu. Pangahilas ko' itu ni sai-sai bilahi, minsan halam aniya' tongodna.  <div eID="gen9000" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8993" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4365"/><div sID="gen9001" type="section"/> <title subType="x-preverse">Bissala Katangbusan</title> <div sID="gen9002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4365"/> Aku itu si Yahiya. Banda'anta kam, sasuku kam makakale lapal bay takallam ma deyom sulat itu: bang aniya' ganta' amak'nnop ai-ai halam bay takallam ma deyom sulat itu, pinak'nnopan du iya e' Tuhan saga bala' bay tasabbut ma deyomna itu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: Damikiyanna, sai-sai angulangan kabtangan min deyom sulat itu, kinulangan isab e' Tuhan palsuku'anna ya tasabbut ma deyom sulat itu. Mbal iya kaniya'an buwa' min kayu ya makabuwan kallum. Mbal iya pinasōd ni deyom Da'ira Sussi.  <div eID="gen9002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4366"/><div sID="gen9003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4366"/> Na, ya na itu pamissala e' dangan ya anaksi' ma saga pakaradja'an bay pinabukis ma sulat itu, yukna, “Tantu. Asekot na kapi'iluku.” <div eID="gen9003" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen9004" type="paragraph"/> Na, bang pa'in ka pi'itu, Panghū' Isa.  <div eID="gen9004" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4367"/><div sID="gen9005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4367"/> Mura-murahan, bang pa'in ka'am kamemon pinaniya'an tatabangan e' Panghū' Isa. Amin.  <div eID="gen9005" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen9001" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8604" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Rev.22"/> <div eID="gen8598" osisID="Rev" type="book"/>
